name: RandomSetTheory.mem_compactConvexSubsets
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_compactConvexSubsets {C : Set E} {K : CompactConvexSet E} :
    K ∈ compactConvexSubsets C ↔ (K : Set E) ⊆ C
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: RandomSetTheory.isCompact_compactConvexSubsets_of_isCompact
statement:
theorem isCompact_compactConvexSubsets_of_isCompact
    {C : Set E} (hC : IsCompact C) :
    IsCompact (compactConvexSubsets C)
proof:
:= by
  let val : CompactConvexSet E → NonemptyCompacts E := fun K => K.1
  have hval : Isometry val := by
    exact isometry_subtype_coe
  have himage :
      val '' compactConvexSubsets C =
        {K : NonemptyCompacts E |
          (K : Set E) ⊆ C ∧ Convex ℝ (K : Set E)} := by
    ext K
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨L, hLC, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨hLC, L.convex⟩
    · rintro ⟨hKC, hKconv⟩
      exact ⟨⟨K, hKconv⟩, hKC, rfl⟩
  rw [hval.isEmbedding.isCompact_iff, himage]
  exact isCompact_nonemptyCompactConvex_subsets_of_isCompact hC

name: RandomSetTheory.isCompact_compactConvexSubsets_closedBall
statement:
theorem isCompact_compactConvexSubsets_closedBall (R : ℝ) :
    IsCompact (compactConvexSubsets (Metric.closedBall (0 : E) R))
proof:
:=
  isCompact_compactConvexSubsets_of_isCompact
    (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E) R)

name: RandomSetTheory.isCompact_compactConvexSet_of_norm_le
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [compactConvexSubsets, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.subset_def,
    Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using
    isCompact_compactConvexSubsets_closedBall (E := E) R

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_tendsto_subseq_compactConvexSet_of_subsets
statement:
theorem exists_tendsto_subseq_compactConvexSet_of_subsets
    {C : Set E} (hC : IsCompact C) (K : ℕ → CompactConvexSet E)
    (hsubset : ∀ n, (K n : Set E) ⊆ C) :
    ∃ L : CompactConvexSet E, (L : Set E) ⊆ C ∧
      ∃ phi : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono phi ∧
        Tendsto (fun n => K (phi n)) atTop (nhds L)
proof:
:= by
  have hA : IsCompact (compactConvexSubsets C) :=
    isCompact_compactConvexSubsets_of_isCompact hC
  have hK : ∀ n, K n ∈ compactConvexSubsets C := hsubset
  obtain ⟨L, hL, phi, hphi, hlim⟩ := hA.isSeqCompact hK
  exact ⟨L, hL, phi, hphi, hlim⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_tendsto_subseq_uniformlyBounded_compactConvexSet
statement:
theorem exists_tendsto_subseq_uniformlyBounded_compactConvexSet
    (K : ℕ → CompactConvexSet E) (R : ℝ)
    (hbound : ∀ n, ∀ x ∈ (K n : Set E), ‖x‖ ≤ R) :
    ∃ L : CompactConvexSet E,
      (∀ x ∈ (L : Set E), ‖x‖ ≤ R) ∧
      ∃ phi : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono phi ∧
        Tendsto (fun n => K (phi n)) atTop (nhds L)
proof:
:= by
  have hsubset : ∀ n, (K n : Set E) ⊆
      Metric.closedBall (0 : E) R := by
    intro n x hx
    simpa only [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using
      hbound n x hx
  obtain ⟨L, hL, phi, hphi, hlim⟩ :=
    exists_tendsto_subseq_compactConvexSet_of_subsets
      (E := E) (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E) R) K hsubset
  refine ⟨L, ?_, phi, hphi, hlim⟩
  intro x hx
  simpa only [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hL hx

name: RandomSetTheory.bundleNonemptyCompacts_mem_blaschkeFamily
statement:
theorem bundleNonemptyCompacts_mem_blaschkeFamily
    {S : Ω → Set E} (hScompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hSne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty) (hSconvex : ∀ ω, Convex ℝ (S ω))
    {C : Set E} (hsubset : ∀ ω, S ω ⊆ C) (ω : Ω) :
    bundleNonemptyCompacts S hScompact hSne ω ∈
      {K : NonemptyCompacts E |
        (K : Set E) ⊆ C ∧ Convex ℝ (K : Set E)}
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨hsubset ω, hSconvex ω⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.bundleCompactConvexSet_mem_compactConvexSubsets
statement:
theorem bundleCompactConvexSet_mem_compactConvexSubsets
    {S : Ω → Set E} (hScompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hSne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty) (hSconvex : ∀ ω, Convex ℝ (S ω))
    {C : Set E} (hsubset : ∀ ω, S ω ⊆ C) (ω : Ω) :
    bundleCompactConvexSet S hScompact hSne hSconvex ω ∈
      compactConvexSubsets C
proof:
:= by
  exact hsubset ω

name: RandomSetTheory.map_bundleNonemptyCompacts_compl_blaschkeFamily_eq_zero
statement:
theorem map_bundleNonemptyCompacts_compl_blaschkeFamily_eq_zero
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    [MeasurableSpace (NonemptyCompacts E)]
    [BorelSpace (NonemptyCompacts E)]
    (μ : Measure Ω) {S : Ω → Set E}
    (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hScompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω)) (hSne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    (hSconvex : ∀ ω, Convex ℝ (S ω))
    {C : Set E} (hC : IsCompact C) (hsubset : ∀ ω, S ω ⊆ C) :
    Measure.map (bundleNonemptyCompacts S hScompact hSne) μ
        ({K : NonemptyCompacts E |
          (K : Set E) ⊆ C ∧ Convex ℝ (K : Set E)}ᶜ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let f := bundleNonemptyCompacts S hScompact hSne
  let A : Set (NonemptyCompacts E) :=
    {K | (K : Set E) ⊆ C ∧ Convex ℝ (K : Set E)}
  have hf : Measurable f :=
    measurable_bundleNonemptyCompacts hS hScompact hSne
  have hA : IsCompact A := by
    simpa only [A] using
      isCompact_nonemptyCompactConvex_subsets_of_isCompact (E := E) hC
  have hpre : f ⁻¹' Aᶜ = ∅ := by
    apply Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
    intro ω hω
    exact hω (bundleNonemptyCompacts_mem_blaschkeFamily
      hScompact hSne hSconvex hsubset ω)
  rw [Measure.map_apply hf hA.isClosed.measurableSet.compl, hpre,
    measure_empty]

name: RandomSetTheory.map_bundleCompactConvexSet_compl_compactConvexSubsets_eq_zero
statement:
theorem map_bundleCompactConvexSet_compl_compactConvexSubsets_eq_zero
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    [MeasurableSpace (NonemptyCompacts E)]
    [BorelSpace (NonemptyCompacts E)]
    [MeasurableSpace (CompactConvexSet E)]
    [BorelSpace (CompactConvexSet E)]
    (μ : Measure Ω) {S : Ω → Set E}
    (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hScompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω)) (hSne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    (hSconvex : ∀ ω, Convex ℝ (S ω))
    {C : Set E} (hC : IsCompact C) (hsubset : ∀ ω, S ω ⊆ C) :
    Measure.map
        (bundleCompactConvexSet S hScompact hSne hSconvex) μ
        (compactConvexSubsets C)ᶜ = 0
proof:
:= by
  let f := bundleCompactConvexSet S hScompact hSne hSconvex
  have hf : Measurable f :=
    measurable_bundleCompactConvexSet
      hS hScompact hSne hSconvex
  have hA : IsCompact (compactConvexSubsets C) :=
    isCompact_compactConvexSubsets_of_isCompact hC
  have hpre : f ⁻¹' (compactConvexSubsets C)ᶜ = ∅ := by
    apply Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
    intro ω hω
    exact hω (bundleCompactConvexSet_mem_compactConvexSubsets
      hScompact hSne hSconvex hsubset ω)
  rw [Measure.map_apply hf hA.isClosed.measurableSet.compl, hpre,
    measure_empty]

name: RandomSetTheory.map_bundleCompactConvexSet_compl_normBounded_eq_zero
statement:
theorem map_bundleCompactConvexSet_compl_normBounded_eq_zero
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    [MeasurableSpace (NonemptyCompacts E)]
    [BorelSpace (NonemptyCompacts E)]
    [MeasurableSpace (CompactConvexSet E)]
    [BorelSpace (CompactConvexSet E)]
    (μ : Measure Ω) {S : Ω → Set E}
    (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hScompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω)) (hSne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    (hSconvex : ∀ ω, Convex ℝ (S ω)) (R : ℝ)
    (hbound : ∀ ω, ∀ x ∈ S ω, ‖x‖ ≤ R) :
    Measure.map
        (bundleCompactConvexSet S hScompact hSne hSconvex) μ
        {K : CompactConvexSet E |
          ∀ x ∈ (K : Set E), ‖x‖ ≤ R}ᶜ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hsubset : ∀ ω, S ω ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) R := by
    intro ω x hx
    simpa only [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using
      hbound ω x hx
  simpa only [compactConvexSubsets, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.subset_def,
    Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using
    map_bundleCompactConvexSet_compl_compactConvexSubsets_eq_zero
      μ hS hScompact hSne hSconvex
      (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E) R) hsubset

name: RandomSetTheory.isTightMeasureSet_singleton_map_bundleNonemptyCompacts
statement:
theorem isTightMeasureSet_singleton_map_bundleNonemptyCompacts
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    [MeasurableSpace (NonemptyCompacts E)]
    [BorelSpace (NonemptyCompacts E)]
    (μ : Measure Ω) {S : Ω → Set E}
    (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hScompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω)) (hSne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    (hSconvex : ∀ ω, Convex ℝ (S ω))
    {C : Set E} (hC : IsCompact C) (hsubset : ∀ ω, S ω ⊆ C) :
    IsTightMeasureSet
      {Measure.map (bundleNonemptyCompacts S hScompact hSne) μ}
proof:
:= by
  rw [isTightMeasureSet_iff_exists_isCompact_measure_compl_le]
  intro ε hε
  let A : Set (NonemptyCompacts E) :=
    {K | (K : Set E) ⊆ C ∧ Convex ℝ (K : Set E)}
  have hA : IsCompact A := by
    simpa only [A] using
      isCompact_nonemptyCompactConvex_subsets_of_isCompact (E := E) hC
  refine ⟨A, hA, ?_⟩
  intro ν hν
  have hνeq : ν = Measure.map
      (bundleNonemptyCompacts S hScompact hSne) μ := by
    simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hν
  rw [hνeq]
  calc
    (Measure.map (bundleNonemptyCompacts S hScompact hSne) μ) Aᶜ = 0 := by
      simpa only [A] using
        map_bundleNonemptyCompacts_compl_blaschkeFamily_eq_zero
          μ hS hScompact hSne hSconvex hC hsubset
    _ ≤ ε := bot_le

name: RandomSetTheory.isTightMeasureSet_singleton_map_bundleCompactConvexSet
statement:
theorem isTightMeasureSet_singleton_map_bundleCompactConvexSet
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    [MeasurableSpace (NonemptyCompacts E)]
    [BorelSpace (NonemptyCompacts E)]
    [MeasurableSpace (CompactConvexSet E)]
    [BorelSpace (CompactConvexSet E)]
    (μ : Measure Ω) {S : Ω → Set E}
    (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hScompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω)) (hSne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    (hSconvex : ∀ ω, Convex ℝ (S ω))
    {C : Set E} (hC : IsCompact C) (hsubset : ∀ ω, S ω ⊆ C) :
    IsTightMeasureSet
      {Measure.map
        (bundleCompactConvexSet S hScompact hSne hSconvex) μ}
proof:
:= by
  rw [isTightMeasureSet_iff_exists_isCompact_measure_compl_le]
  intro ε hε
  refine ⟨compactConvexSubsets C,
    isCompact_compactConvexSubsets_of_isCompact hC, ?_⟩
  intro ν hν
  have hνeq : ν = Measure.map
      (bundleCompactConvexSet S hScompact hSne hSconvex) μ := by
    simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hν
  rw [hνeq]
  exact
    (map_bundleCompactConvexSet_compl_compactConvexSubsets_eq_zero
      μ hS hScompact hSne hSconvex hC hsubset).le.trans bot_le

name: ProbabilityTheory.conditionalValueAtRisk_finiteProcessSupremum_sub_integral_le_rioStrongMoment
statement:
theorem conditionalValueAtRisk_finiteProcessSupremum_sub_integral_le_rioStrongMoment
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    [SigmaFiniteFiltration mu filtration]
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty) (X : T → Omega → ℝ)
    (A : Omega → ℝ) (hA : Integrable A mu)
    (hX : ∀ u ∈ s, Measurable (X u))
    (hdom : ∀ omega u, u ∈ s → |X u omega| ≤ |A omega|)
    (second : ℕ → ℝ) (moment : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (n q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    {V Q y alpha : ℝ} (hV : 0 < V) (hQ : 0 < Q) (hy : 0 < y)
    (hterminal : mu[finiteProcessSupremum s hs X | filtration n]
      =ᵐ[mu] finiteProcessSupremum s hs X)
    (hDsq : ∀ i < n + 1, Integrable (fun omega ↦
      doobCenteredDifference filtration mu
        (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X) i omega ^ 2) mu)
    (hpow : ∀ i < n + 1, ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      Integrable (fun omega ↦
        (max (doobCenteredDifference filtration mu
          (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X) i omega) 0) ^ k) mu)
    (hsecond0 : (∫ omega,
      doobCenteredDifference filtration mu
        (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X) 0 omega ^ 2 ∂mu) ≤ second 0)
    (hsecondSucc : ∀ i < n,
      mu[fun omega ↦ doobCenteredDifference filtration mu
          (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X) (i + 1) omega ^ 2 |
        filtration i] ≤ᵐ[mu] fun _ ↦ second (i + 1))
    (hmoment0 : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      (∫ omega, (max (doobCenteredDifference filtration mu
        (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X) 0 omega) 0) ^ k ∂mu) ≤
        moment 0 k)
    (hmomentSucc : ∀ i < n, ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      mu[fun omega ↦ (max (doobCenteredDifference filtration mu
          (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X) (i + 1) omega) 0) ^ k |
        filtration i] ≤ᵐ[mu] fun _ ↦ moment (i + 1) k)
    (hsecond : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), second i) ≤ V)
    (hmiddle : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Ico 3 q,
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), moment i k) ≤
        interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient q V Q k)
    (hmomentQ : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), moment i q) ≤ Q)
    (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha < 1)
    (hscale : Q * Real.exp (-Real.log alpha) ≤ y ^ q) :
    conditionalValueAtRisk alpha
        (fun omega ↦ finiteProcessSupremum s hs X omega -
          ∫ z, finiteProcessSupremum s hs X z ∂mu) mu ≤
      Real.sqrt (2 * V * (-Real.log alpha)) +
        (1 + 1 / (q : ℝ)) * y +
          Real.exp 1 * strongMomentQScale q Q * (-Real.log alpha) / 3 +
        alpha⁻¹ * (Q / ((q : ℝ) * y ^ (q - 1)))
proof:
:= by
  let F : Omega → ℝ := finiteProcessSupremum s hs X
  let D : ℕ → Omega → ℝ :=
    doobCenteredDifference filtration mu F
  have hFint : Integrable F mu :=
    integrable_finiteProcessSupremum s hs X A hA hX hdom
  have hDint : ∀ i < n + 1, Integrable (D i) mu := by
    intro i _hi
    cases i with
    | zero =>
        change Integrable
          (fun omega ↦ mu[F | filtration 0] omega - ∫ z, F z ∂mu) mu
        exact integrable_condExp.sub (integrable_const _)
    | succ i =>
        change Integrable
          (fun omega ↦ mu[F | filtration (i + 1)] omega -
            mu[F | filtration i] omega) mu
        exact integrable_condExp.sub integrable_condExp
  have hDAdapted : StronglyAdapted filtration D :=
    stronglyAdapted_doobCenteredDifference filtration mu F
  have hDsq' : ∀ i < n + 1,
      Integrable (fun omega ↦ D i omega ^ 2) mu := by
    intro i hi
    simpa only [D, F] using hDsq i hi
  have hpow' : ∀ i < n + 1, ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      Integrable (fun omega ↦ (max (D i omega) 0) ^ k) mu := by
    intro i hi k hk
    simpa only [D, F] using hpow i hi k hk
  have hcenter0 : ∫ omega, D 0 omega ∂mu = 0 :=
    integral_doobCenteredDifference_zero filtration F
  have hcenterSucc : ∀ i < n + 1 - 1,
      mu[D (i + 1) | filtration i] =ᵐ[mu] 0 := by
    intro i _hi
    exact condExp_doobCenteredDifference_succ_ae_eq_zero filtration F i
  have hsecond0' : (∫ omega, D 0 omega ^ 2 ∂mu) ≤ second 0 := by
    simpa only [D, F] using hsecond0
  have hsecondSucc' : ∀ i < n + 1 - 1,
      mu[fun omega ↦ D (i + 1) omega ^ 2 | filtration i] ≤ᵐ[mu]
        fun _ ↦ second (i + 1) := by
    intro i hi
    simpa only [D, F] using hsecondSucc i (by omega)
  have hmoment0' : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      (∫ omega, (max (D 0 omega) 0) ^ k ∂mu) ≤ moment 0 k := by
    intro k hk
    simpa only [D, F] using hmoment0 k hk
  have hmomentSucc' : ∀ i < n + 1 - 1, ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      mu[fun omega ↦ (max (D (i + 1) omega) 0) ^ k |
        filtration i] ≤ᵐ[mu] fun _ ↦ moment (i + 1) k := by
    intro i hi k hk
    simpa only [D, F] using hmomentSucc i (by omega) k hk
  have hsum := conditionalValueAtRisk_sum_le_rioStrongMoment_explicit
    filtration D hDAdapted second moment (n + 1) q (by omega) hq
      hV hQ hy hDint hDsq' hpow' hcenter0 hcenterSucc hsecond0'
      hsecondSucc' hmoment0' hmomentSucc' hsecond hmiddle hmomentQ
      halpha0 halpha1 hscale
  have hsumEq : (fun omega ↦ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), D i omega)
      =ᵐ[mu] fun omega ↦ F omega - ∫ z, F z ∂mu := by
    filter_upwards [hterminal] with omega hterminalOmega
    rw [sum_doobCenteredDifference filtration mu F n omega]
    exact sub_left_inj.mpr hterminalOmega
  have hcenteredInt : Integrable
      (fun omega ↦ F omega - ∫ z, F z ∂mu) mu :=
    hFint.sub (integrable_const _)
  have hsumInt : Integrable
      (fun omega ↦ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), D i omega) mu :=
    hcenteredInt.congr hsumEq.symm
  have hcvarEq := conditionalValueAtRisk_congr_ae
    hsumInt hcenteredInt halpha0 halpha1.le hsumEq
  rw [← hcvarEq]
  simpa only [F] using hsum

name: RandomSetTheory.upperVietorisEvent_univ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem upperVietorisEvent_univ [TopologicalSpace X] :
    upperVietorisEvent (X := X) Set.univ = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  ext K
  simp [upperVietorisEvent]

name: RandomSetTheory.upperVietorisEvent_inter
statement:
theorem upperVietorisEvent_inter [TopologicalSpace X] (U V : Set X) :
    upperVietorisEvent (X := X) (U ∩ V) =
      upperVietorisEvent U ∩ upperVietorisEvent V
proof:
:= by
  ext K
  simp only [upperVietorisEvent, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff]
  exact Set.subset_inter_iff

name: RandomSetTheory.hyperspaceHitEvent_mono
statement:
theorem hyperspaceHitEvent_mono [TopologicalSpace X] :
    Monotone (hyperspaceHitEvent (X := X))
proof:
:= by
  intro A B hAB K
  rintro ⟨x, hxK, hxA⟩
  exact ⟨x, hxK, hAB hxA⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.hyperspaceHitEvent_iUnion
statement:
theorem hyperspaceHitEvent_iUnion [TopologicalSpace X]
    {ι : Sort*} (A : ι → Set X) :
    hyperspaceHitEvent (⋃ i, A i) =
      ⋃ i, hyperspaceHitEvent (A i)
proof:
:= by
  ext K
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hxK, hxA⟩
    rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hxA with ⟨i, hxi⟩
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, x, hxK, hxi⟩
  · intro hK
    rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hK with ⟨i, x, hxK, hxi⟩
    exact ⟨x, hxK, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, hxi⟩⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.hyperspaceHitEvent_eq_compl_upper_compl
statement:
theorem hyperspaceHitEvent_eq_compl_upper_compl [TopologicalSpace X]
    (A : Set X) :
    hyperspaceHitEvent A = (upperVietorisEvent (X := X) Aᶜ)ᶜ
proof:
:= by
  ext K
  change ((K : Set X) ∩ A).Nonempty ↔ ¬(K : Set X) ⊆ Aᶜ
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hxK, hxA⟩ hKA
    exact (hKA hxK) hxA
  · intro hnot
    by_contra hnone
    apply hnot
    intro x hxK hxA
    exact hnone ⟨x, hxK, hxA⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.upperVietorisEvent_eq_compl_hit_compl
statement:
theorem upperVietorisEvent_eq_compl_hit_compl [TopologicalSpace X]
    (U : Set X) :
    upperVietorisEvent (X := X) U = (hyperspaceHitEvent Uᶜ)ᶜ
proof:
:= by
  rw [hyperspaceHitEvent_eq_compl_upper_compl]
  simp

name: RandomSetTheory.iUnion_metricInnerApprox_eq
statement:
private theorem iUnion_metricInnerApprox_eq [MetricSpace X]
    {U : Set X} (hU : IsOpen U) :
    ⋃ n : ℕ, metricInnerApprox U n = U
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx with ⟨n, hxn⟩
    by_contra hxU
    exact hxn (Metric.self_subset_thickening
      (by positivity : 0 < 1 / (n + 1 : ℝ)) Uᶜ hxU)
  · intro hxU
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := (Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU) x hxU
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_one_div_lt hε
    refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨n, ?_⟩
    intro hxthick
    rcases Metric.mem_thickening_iff.mp hxthick with ⟨z, hzUc, hxz⟩
    have hzball : z ∈ Metric.ball x ε := by
      simpa only [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm] using lt_trans hxz hn
    exact hzUc (hball hzball)

name: RandomSetTheory.measurableSet_upperVietorisEvent_generate
statement:
private theorem measurableSet_upperVietorisEvent_generate
    [TopologicalSpace X] {U : Set X} (hU : IsOpen U) :
    @MeasurableSet (NonemptyCompacts X)
      (MeasurableSpace.generateFrom (upperVietorisOpenGenerator (X := X)))
      (upperVietorisEvent U)
proof:
:=
  MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_generateFrom ⟨U, hU, rfl⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.measurableSet_hyperspaceHitEvent_open_generate
statement:
private theorem measurableSet_hyperspaceHitEvent_open_generate
    [MetricSpace X] {U : Set X} (hU : IsOpen U) :
    @MeasurableSet (NonemptyCompacts X)
      (MeasurableSpace.generateFrom (upperVietorisOpenGenerator (X := X)))
      (hyperspaceHitEvent U)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← iUnion_metricInnerApprox_eq hU, hyperspaceHitEvent_iUnion]
  apply MeasurableSet.iUnion
  intro n
  rw [hyperspaceHitEvent_eq_compl_upper_compl]
  apply MeasurableSet.compl
  apply measurableSet_upperVietorisEvent_generate
  simpa only [metricInnerApprox, compl_compl] using
    (Metric.isOpen_thickening :
      IsOpen (Metric.thickening (1 / (n + 1 : ℝ)) Uᶜ))

name: RandomSetTheory.isPiSystem_upperVietorisOpenGenerator
statement:
theorem isPiSystem_upperVietorisOpenGenerator [TopologicalSpace X] :
    IsPiSystem (upperVietorisOpenGenerator (X := X))
proof:
:= by
  intro A hA B hB _hne
  rcases hA with ⟨U, hU, rfl⟩
  rcases hB with ⟨V, hV, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨U ∩ V, hU.inter hV, ?_⟩
  exact upperVietorisEvent_inter U V

name: RandomSetTheory.borel_nonemptyCompacts_eq_generateFrom_upperVietoris
statement:
theorem borel_nonemptyCompacts_eq_generateFrom_upperVietoris
    [MetricSpace X] [SecondCountableTopology X] :
    borel (NonemptyCompacts X) =
      MeasurableSpace.generateFrom (upperVietorisOpenGenerator (X := X))
proof:
:= by
  let C : Set (Set (NonemptyCompacts X)) :=
    (fun u => {K : NonemptyCompacts X |
      (K : Set X) ⊆ ⋃₀ u ∧
        ∀ U ∈ u, ((K : Set X) ∩ U).Nonempty}) ''
      {u : Set (Set X) | u.Finite ∧ u.Nonempty ∧ ∀ U ∈ u, IsOpen U}
  have hCbasis : IsTopologicalBasis C := by
    simpa only [C] using
      (TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts.isTopologicalBasis (α := X))
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [hCbasis.borel_eq_generateFrom]
    apply MeasurableSpace.generateFrom_le
    intro W hW
    rcases hW with ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
    have hUnionOpen : IsOpen (⋃₀ u) :=
      isOpen_sUnion fun U hU => hu.2.2 U hU
    have hUpper : @MeasurableSet (NonemptyCompacts X)
        (MeasurableSpace.generateFrom
          (upperVietorisOpenGenerator (X := X)))
        (upperVietorisEvent (⋃₀ u)) :=
      measurableSet_upperVietorisEvent_generate hUnionOpen
    letI := hu.1.to_subtype
    have hLower : @MeasurableSet (NonemptyCompacts X)
        (MeasurableSpace.generateFrom
          (upperVietorisOpenGenerator (X := X)))
        (⋂ U : u, hyperspaceHitEvent (U : Set X)) :=
      MeasurableSet.iInter fun U =>
        measurableSet_hyperspaceHitEvent_open_generate
          (hu.2.2 U U.property)
    have hEq :
        {K : NonemptyCompacts X |
          (K : Set X) ⊆ ⋃₀ u ∧
            ∀ U ∈ u, ((K : Set X) ∩ U).Nonempty} =
          upperVietorisEvent (⋃₀ u) ∩
            ⋂ U : u, hyperspaceHitEvent (U : Set X) := by
      ext K
      simp only [upperVietorisEvent, hyperspaceHitEvent, Set.mem_setOf_eq,
        Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_iInter]
      exact and_congr_right fun _ => by
        constructor
        · intro h U
          exact h U U.property
        · intro h U hU
          exact h ⟨U, hU⟩
    change @MeasurableSet (NonemptyCompacts X)
      (MeasurableSpace.generateFrom
        (upperVietorisOpenGenerator (X := X)))
      {K : NonemptyCompacts X |
        (K : Set X) ⊆ ⋃₀ u ∧
          ∀ U ∈ u, ((K : Set X) ∩ U).Nonempty}
    rw [hEq]
    exact hUpper.inter hLower
  · apply MeasurableSpace.generateFrom_le
    intro W hW
    rcases hW with ⟨U, hU, rfl⟩
    exact MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_generateFrom
      (TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts.isOpen_subsets_of_isOpen hU)

name: RandomSetTheory.measure_nonemptyCompacts_eq_of_hit_closed_eq
statement:
theorem measure_nonemptyCompacts_eq_of_hit_closed_eq
    [MetricSpace X] [SecondCountableTopology X]
    [MeasurableSpace (NonemptyCompacts X)]
    [BorelSpace (NonemptyCompacts X)]
    {μ ν : Measure (NonemptyCompacts X)}
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (h_univ : μ Set.univ = ν Set.univ)
    (h_hit : ∀ F : Set X, IsClosed F →
      μ (hyperspaceHitEvent F) = ν (hyperspaceHitEvent F)) :
    μ = ν
proof:
:= by
  apply MeasureTheory.ext_of_generate_finite
    (upperVietorisOpenGenerator (X := X))
    (BorelSpace.measurable_eq.trans
      borel_nonemptyCompacts_eq_generateFrom_upperVietoris)
    isPiSystem_upperVietorisOpenGenerator
  · intro A hA
    rcases hA with ⟨U, hU, rfl⟩
    have hFmeas : MeasurableSet (hyperspaceHitEvent (X := X) Uᶜ) :=
      (TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts.isClosed_inter_nonempty_of_isClosed
        hU.isClosed_compl).measurableSet
    rw [upperVietorisEvent_eq_compl_hit_compl,
      measure_compl hFmeas (by finiteness),
      measure_compl hFmeas (by finiteness), h_univ,
      h_hit Uᶜ hU.isClosed_compl]
  · exact h_univ

name: RandomSetTheory.measure_nonemptyCompacts_eq_of_hit_open_eq
statement:
theorem measure_nonemptyCompacts_eq_of_hit_open_eq
    [MetricSpace X] [SecondCountableTopology X]
    [MeasurableSpace (NonemptyCompacts X)]
    [BorelSpace (NonemptyCompacts X)]
    {μ ν : Measure (NonemptyCompacts X)}
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (h_univ : μ Set.univ = ν Set.univ)
    (h_hit : ∀ U : Set X, IsOpen U →
      μ (hyperspaceHitEvent U) = ν (hyperspaceHitEvent U)) :
    μ = ν
proof:
:= by
  apply measure_nonemptyCompacts_eq_of_hit_closed_eq h_univ
  intro F hF
  let A : ℕ → Set (NonemptyCompacts X) := fun n =>
    hyperspaceHitEvent
      (Metric.thickening (1 / (n + 1 : ℝ)) F)
  have hAeq : hyperspaceHitEvent (X := X) F = ⋂ n, A n := by
    simpa only [A, hyperspaceHitEvent, hitEvent] using
      (hitEvent_closed_eq_iInter_thickening_of_compact_values
        (S := fun K : NonemptyCompacts X => (K : Set X))
        (fun K => K.isCompact) hF)
  have hAmeas : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (A n) := fun n =>
    (TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts.isOpen_inter_nonempty_of_isOpen
      Metric.isOpen_thickening).measurableSet
  have hAanti : Antitone A := by
    intro m n hmn
    exact hyperspaceHitEvent_mono
      (Metric.thickening_mono (Nat.one_div_le_one_div hmn) F)
  rw [hAeq,
    hAanti.measure_iInter (fun n => (hAmeas n).nullMeasurableSet)
      ⟨0, by finiteness⟩,
    hAanti.measure_iInter (fun n => (hAmeas n).nullMeasurableSet)
      ⟨0, by finiteness⟩]
  exact iInf_congr fun n =>
    h_hit _ Metric.isOpen_thickening

name: RandomSetTheory.measure_nonemptyCompacts_eq_of_hit_compact_eq
statement:
theorem measure_nonemptyCompacts_eq_of_hit_compact_eq
    [MetricSpace X] [SecondCountableTopology X] [CompactSpace X]
    [MeasurableSpace (NonemptyCompacts X)]
    [BorelSpace (NonemptyCompacts X)]
    {μ ν : Measure (NonemptyCompacts X)}
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (h_univ : μ Set.univ = ν Set.univ)
    (h_hit : ∀ K : Set X, IsCompact K →
      μ (hyperspaceHitEvent K) = ν (hyperspaceHitEvent K)) :
    μ = ν
proof:
:=
  measure_nonemptyCompacts_eq_of_hit_closed_eq h_univ fun F hF =>
    h_hit F hF.isCompact

name: RandomSetTheory.map_bundleNonemptyCompacts_eq_of_capacity_open_eq
statement:
theorem map_bundleNonemptyCompacts_eq_of_capacity_open_eq
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Ω']
    [MetricSpace X] [SecondCountableTopology X]
    [MeasurableSpace (NonemptyCompacts X)]
    [BorelSpace (NonemptyCompacts X)]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {ν : Measure Ω'}
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    {S : Ω → Set X} {T : Ω' → Set X}
    (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hT : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable T)
    (hScompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hTcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (T ω))
    (hSne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    (hTne : ∀ ω, (T ω).Nonempty)
    (h_univ : μ Set.univ = ν Set.univ)
    (h_capacity : ∀ U : Set X, IsOpen U →
      capacityFunctional μ S U = capacityFunctional ν T U) :
    Measure.map (bundleNonemptyCompacts S hScompact hSne) μ =
      Measure.map (bundleNonemptyCompacts T hTcompact hTne) ν
proof:
:= by
  have hSmeas : Measurable (bundleNonemptyCompacts S hScompact hSne) :=
    measurable_bundleNonemptyCompacts hS hScompact hSne
  have hTmeas : Measurable (bundleNonemptyCompacts T hTcompact hTne) :=
    measurable_bundleNonemptyCompacts hT hTcompact hTne
  apply measure_nonemptyCompacts_eq_of_hit_open_eq
  · rw [Measure.map_apply hSmeas MeasurableSet.univ,
      Measure.map_apply hTmeas MeasurableSet.univ]
    simpa only [Set.preimage_univ] using h_univ
  · intro U hU
    have hHitMeas : MeasurableSet (hyperspaceHitEvent (X := X) U) :=
      (TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts.isOpen_inter_nonempty_of_isOpen hU).measurableSet
    rw [Measure.map_apply hSmeas hHitMeas,
      Measure.map_apply hTmeas hHitMeas]
    simpa only [hyperspaceHitEvent, coe_bundleNonemptyCompacts,
      capacityFunctional, hitEvent, Set.preimage_setOf_eq] using
      h_capacity U hU

name: RandomSetTheory.map_bundleNonemptyCompacts_eq_of_capacity_closed_eq
statement:
theorem map_bundleNonemptyCompacts_eq_of_capacity_closed_eq
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Ω']
    [MetricSpace X] [SecondCountableTopology X]
    [MeasurableSpace (NonemptyCompacts X)]
    [BorelSpace (NonemptyCompacts X)]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {ν : Measure Ω'}
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    {S : Ω → Set X} {T : Ω' → Set X}
    (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hT : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable T)
    (hScompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hTcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (T ω))
    (hSne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    (hTne : ∀ ω, (T ω).Nonempty)
    (h_univ : μ Set.univ = ν Set.univ)
    (h_capacity : ∀ F : Set X, IsClosed F →
      capacityFunctional μ S F = capacityFunctional ν T F) :
    Measure.map (bundleNonemptyCompacts S hScompact hSne) μ =
      Measure.map (bundleNonemptyCompacts T hTcompact hTne) ν
proof:
:= by
  have hSmeas : Measurable (bundleNonemptyCompacts S hScompact hSne) :=
    measurable_bundleNonemptyCompacts hS hScompact hSne
  have hTmeas : Measurable (bundleNonemptyCompacts T hTcompact hTne) :=
    measurable_bundleNonemptyCompacts hT hTcompact hTne
  apply measure_nonemptyCompacts_eq_of_hit_closed_eq
  · rw [Measure.map_apply hSmeas MeasurableSet.univ,
      Measure.map_apply hTmeas MeasurableSet.univ]
    simpa only [Set.preimage_univ] using h_univ
  · intro F hF
    have hHitMeas : MeasurableSet (hyperspaceHitEvent (X := X) F) :=
      (TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts.isClosed_inter_nonempty_of_isClosed hF).measurableSet
    rw [Measure.map_apply hSmeas hHitMeas,
      Measure.map_apply hTmeas hHitMeas]
    simpa only [hyperspaceHitEvent, coe_bundleNonemptyCompacts,
      capacityFunctional, hitEvent, Set.preimage_setOf_eq] using
      h_capacity F hF

name: ProbabilityTheory.exactStrongMomentTailExponent_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem exactStrongMomentTailExponent_zero
    {q : ℕ} (hq : q ≠ 0) (Q y : ℝ) :
    exactStrongMomentTailExponent q Q y 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [exactStrongMomentTailExponent, hq]

name: ProbabilityTheory.exactStrongMomentTailExponent_nonneg
statement:
theorem exactStrongMomentTailExponent_nonneg
    (q : ℕ) {Q y t : ℝ} (hQ : 0 ≤ Q) (hy : 0 < y)
    (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    0 ≤ exactStrongMomentTailExponent q Q y t
proof:
:= by
  unfold exactStrongMomentTailExponent
  exact mul_nonneg (div_nonneg hQ (pow_nonneg hy.le q))
    (expSeriesTail_nonneg (mul_nonneg ht hy.le) q)

name: ProbabilityTheory.chernoffTransform_exactStrongMomentTailExponent_le
statement:
theorem chernoffTransform_exactStrongMomentTailExponent_le
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 1 ≤ q) {Q y x : ℝ}
    (hQ : 0 ≤ Q) (hy : 0 < y) (hx : 0 < x)
    (hscale : Q * Real.exp x ≤ y ^ q) :
    chernoffTransform (exactStrongMomentTailExponent q Q y) x ≤
      (1 + 1 / (q : ℝ)) * y
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 : (q : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hq)
  have hyq : 0 < y ^ q := pow_pos hy q
  have hcoef : 0 ≤ Q / y ^ q := div_nonneg hQ hyq.le
  have hcoefExp : (Q / y ^ q) * Real.exp x ≤ 1 := by
    calc
      (Q / y ^ q) * Real.exp x =
          (Q * Real.exp x) / y ^ q := by ring
      _ ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hyq).2 hscale
  have htail := expSeriesTail_le_div_mul_exp q hq x hx.le
  have hscaledTail :
      (Q / y ^ q) * expSeriesTail q x ≤ x / (q : ℝ) := by
    calc
      (Q / y ^ q) * expSeriesTail q x ≤
          (Q / y ^ q) * ((x / (q : ℝ)) * Real.exp x) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htail hcoef
      _ = (x / (q : ℝ)) *
          ((Q / y ^ q) * Real.exp x) := by ring
      _ ≤ (x / (q : ℝ)) * 1 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcoefExp (div_nonneg hx.le (by positivity))
      _ = x / (q : ℝ) := by ring
  have hnonneg : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t →
      0 ≤ exactStrongMomentTailExponent q Q y t := by
    intro t ht
    exact exactStrongMomentTailExponent_nonneg q hQ hy ht.le
  have hb : BddBelow
      (Set.range (chernoffObjective
        (exactStrongMomentTailExponent q Q y) x)) :=
    bddBelow_range_chernoffObjective hx.le hnonneg
  have heval := chernoffTransform_le_objective
    (psi := exactStrongMomentTailExponent q Q y) (x := x)
    (t := x / y) (div_pos hx hy) hb
  have harg : (x / y) * y = x := by field_simp
  unfold exactStrongMomentTailExponent at heval
  rw [harg] at heval
  calc
    chernoffTransform (exactStrongMomentTailExponent q Q y) x ≤
        ((Q / y ^ q) * expSeriesTail q x + x) / (x / y) := heval
    _ ≤ (x / (q : ℝ) + x) / (x / y) := by
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
        (add_le_add hscaledTail le_rfl) (div_pos hx hy).le
    _ = (1 + 1 / (q : ℝ)) * y := by
      field_simp [hx.ne', hy.ne', hq0]
      ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.sum_signedCoordinateKernel_inl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sum_signedCoordinateKernel_inl
    (W : Fin n → Z → T → ℝ) (x : Fin n → Z) (t : T) :

name: ProbabilityTheory.finiteCoordinateSumSupremum_signedCoordinateKernel
statement:
theorem finiteCoordinateSumSupremum_signedCoordinateKernel
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (W : Fin n → Z → T → ℝ) (x : Fin n → Z) :
    finiteCoordinateSumSupremum (signedFinset s)
        (signedFinset_nonempty hs) (signedCoordinateKernel W) x =
      finiteCoordinateSumAbsSupremum s hs W x
proof:
:= by
  unfold finiteCoordinateSumSupremum finiteCoordinateSumAbsSupremum
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Finset.sup'_le (signedFinset_nonempty hs)
    intro u hu
    rcases u with t | t
    · have ht : t ∈ s := by simpa [signedFinset] using hu
      rw [sum_signedCoordinateKernel_inl]
      exact (le_abs_self (∑ j : Fin n, W j (x j) t)).trans
        (Finset.le_sup' (fun v ↦ |∑ j : Fin n, W j (x j) v|) ht)
    · have ht : t ∈ s := by simpa [signedFinset] using hu
      rw [sum_signedCoordinateKernel_inr]
      exact (neg_le_abs (∑ j : Fin n, W j (x j) t)).trans
        (Finset.le_sup' (fun v ↦ |∑ j : Fin n, W j (x j) v|) ht)
  · apply Finset.sup'_le hs
    intro t ht
    by_cases hnonneg : 0 ≤ ∑ j : Fin n, W j (x j) t
    · rw [abs_of_nonneg hnonneg]
      exact Finset.le_sup'
        (fun u ↦ ∑ j : Fin n, signedCoordinateKernel W j (x j) u)
        (by simpa [signedFinset] using ht : Sum.inl t ∈ signedFinset s)
    · rw [abs_of_neg (lt_of_not_ge hnonneg)]
      simpa only [sum_signedCoordinateKernel_inr] using
        (Finset.le_sup'
          (fun u ↦ ∑ j : Fin n, signedCoordinateKernel W j (x j) u)
          (by simpa [signedFinset] using ht : Sum.inr t ∈ signedFinset s))

name: ProbabilityTheory.measurable_signedCoordinateKernel
statement:
theorem measurable_signedCoordinateKernel
    (W : Fin n → Z → T → ℝ)
    {j : Fin n} {u : T ⊕ T}
    (hW : ∀ t, Measurable (fun z ↦ W j z t)) :
    Measurable (fun z ↦ signedCoordinateKernel W j z u)
proof:
:= by
  cases u with
  | inl t => exact hW t
  | inr t =>
      change Measurable (fun z ↦ -W j z t)
      exact (hW t).neg

statement:
theorem continuous_signedProcess
    (F : Omega → T → ℝ) (omega : Omega)

proof:
:= by
  exact hF.sumElim hF.neg

name: RandomSetTheory.iSup_signedProcess_eq_iSup_abs
statement:
theorem iSup_signedProcess_eq_iSup_abs
    [Nonempty T] (F : Omega → T → ℝ) (omega : Omega) (B : ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ t, |F omega t| ≤ B) :
    (⨆ u : T ⊕ T, signedProcess F omega u) = ⨆ t : T, |F omega t|
proof:
:= by
  have hBnonneg : 0 ≤ B :=
    (abs_nonneg (F omega (Classical.choice inferInstance))).trans (hB _)
  have hsignedBdd : BddAbove (Set.range (signedProcess F omega)) := by
    refine ⟨B, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨u, rfl⟩
    cases u with
    | inl t => exact (le_abs_self _).trans (hB t)
    | inr t => exact (neg_le_abs _).trans (hB t)
  have habsBdd : BddAbove (Set.range fun t ↦ |F omega t|) := by
    exact ⟨B, by rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩; exact hB t⟩
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply ciSup_le
    intro u
    cases u with
    | inl t =>
        exact (le_abs_self _).trans (le_ciSup habsBdd t)
    | inr t =>
        exact (neg_le_abs _).trans (le_ciSup habsBdd t)
  · apply ciSup_le
    intro t
    rw [abs_eq_max_neg]
    exact max_le
      (le_ciSup hsignedBdd (Sum.inl t))
      (le_ciSup hsignedBdd (Sum.inr t))

name: RandomSetTheory.conditionalValueAtRisk_centered_iSup_abs_le_of_signedDensePrefixes
statement:
theorem conditionalValueAtRisk_centered_iSup_abs_le_of_signedDensePrefixes
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (F : Omega → T → ℝ) (B : Omega → ℝ)
    (hcontinuous : ∀ omega, Continuous (F omega))
    (hmeas : ∀ t, Measurable (fun omega ↦ F omega t))
    (hB : Integrable B mu)
    (hdom : ∀ omega t, |F omega t| ≤ |B omega|)
    {alpha C : ℝ} (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha ≤ 1)
    (hfinite : ∀ n,
      ProbabilityTheory.conditionalValueAtRisk alpha
        (fun omega ↦
          densePrefixSupremum (signedProcess F omega) n -
            ∫ z, densePrefixSupremum (signedProcess F z) n ∂mu) mu ≤ C) :
    ProbabilityTheory.conditionalValueAtRisk alpha
        (fun omega ↦
          (⨆ t, |F omega t|) - ∫ z, (⨆ t, |F z t|) ∂mu) mu ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  let SF : Omega → T ⊕ T → ℝ := signedProcess F
  have hSFcontinuous : ∀ omega, Continuous (SF omega) := by
    intro omega
    exact continuous_signedProcess F omega (hcontinuous omega)
  have hSFmeasAll : ∀ u : T ⊕ T, Measurable (fun omega ↦ SF omega u) := by
    intro u
    cases u with
    | inl t => exact hmeas t
    | inr t =>
        change Measurable (fun omega ↦ -F omega t)
        exact (hmeas t).neg
  have hSFmeas : ∀ k,
      Measurable (fun omega ↦ SF omega (denseSeq (T ⊕ T) k)) := by
    intro k
    exact hSFmeasAll _
  have hSFdom : ∀ omega u, |SF omega u| ≤ |B omega| := by
    intro omega u
    cases u with
    | inl t => exact hdom omega t
    | inr t => simpa only [SF, signedProcess_inr, abs_neg] using hdom omega t
  have hsource := conditionalValueAtRisk_centered_iSup_le_of_densePrefixes
    SF B hSFcontinuous hSFmeas hB hSFdom halpha0 halpha1 (by
      intro n
      simpa only [SF] using hfinite n)
  have hsup : ∀ omega, (⨆ u, SF omega u) = ⨆ t, |F omega t| := by
    intro omega
    exact iSup_signedProcess_eq_iSup_abs F omega |B omega| (hdom omega)
  simpa only [hsup] using hsource

name: RandomSetTheory.dist_le_setRadiusAt
statement:
theorem dist_le_setRadiusAt
    {E : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace E] {K : Set E} {x x₀ : E}
    (hcompact : IsCompact K) (hx : x ∈ K) :
    dist x x₀ ≤ setRadiusAt K x₀
proof:
:= by
  apply le_csSup
  · exact (hcompact.image (continuous_id.dist continuous_const)).bddAbove
  · exact ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.setRadiusAt_nonneg
statement:
theorem setRadiusAt_nonneg
    {E : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace E] {K : Set E} {x₀ : E}
    (hcompact : IsCompact K) (hne : K.Nonempty) :
    0 ≤ setRadiusAt K x₀
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hne
  exact dist_nonneg.trans (dist_le_setRadiusAt hcompact hx)

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_mem_setRadiusAt_eq_dist
statement:
theorem exists_mem_setRadiusAt_eq_dist
    {E : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace E] {K : Set E} {x₀ : E}
    (hcompact : IsCompact K) (hne : K.Nonempty) :
    ∃ x ∈ K, setRadiusAt K x₀ = dist x x₀
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, heq, _⟩ := hcompact.exists_sSup_image_eq_and_ge hne
    (continuous_id.dist continuous_const).continuousOn
  exact ⟨x, hx, heq⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.setRadiusAt_eq_hausdorffDist_singleton
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · obtain ⟨x, hx, hradius⟩ :=
      exists_mem_setRadiusAt_eq_dist hcompact hne
    have hfin : hausdorffEDist K {x₀} ≠ ⊤ :=
      hausdorffEDist_ne_top_of_nonempty_of_bounded hne
        (singleton_nonempty x₀) hcompact.isBounded
        Bornology.isBounded_singleton
    calc
      setRadiusAt K x₀ = dist x x₀ := hradius
      _ = infDist x {x₀} := infDist_singleton.symm
      _ ≤ hausdorffDist K {x₀} :=
        infDist_le_hausdorffDist_of_mem hx hfin
  · apply hausdorffDist_le_of_mem_dist
      (setRadiusAt_nonneg hcompact hne)
    · intro x hx
      exact ⟨x₀, mem_singleton x₀,
        dist_le_setRadiusAt hcompact hx⟩
    · intro x hx
      rw [mem_singleton_iff.mp hx]
      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hne
      exact ⟨y, hy, by
        simpa only [dist_comm] using
          (dist_le_setRadiusAt (x₀ := x₀) hcompact hy)⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.measurable_setRadiusAt
statement:
theorem measurable_setRadiusAt
    {Omega E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    [MetricSpace E] [CompleteSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] [Nonempty E]
    {S : Omega → Set E} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ omega, IsCompact (S omega))
    (hne : ∀ omega, (S omega).Nonempty)
    {c : Omega → E} (hc : Measurable c) :
    Measurable (fun omega => setRadiusAt (S omega) (c omega))
proof:
:= by
  have hsingleton : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable
      (fun omega => ({c omega} : Set E)) :=
    RandomSet.isEffrosMeasurable_singleton hc
  have hhausdorff : Measurable
      (fun omega => hausdorffDist (S omega) ({c omega} : Set E)) :=
    measurable_hausdorffDist_correspondence hS hsingleton
      (fun omega => (hcompact omega).isClosed)
      (fun _ => isClosed_singleton)
      hne (fun omega => singleton_nonempty (c omega))
  have heq : (fun omega => setRadiusAt (S omega) (c omega)) =
      fun omega => hausdorffDist (S omega) ({c omega} : Set E) := by
    funext omega
    exact setRadiusAt_eq_hausdorffDist_singleton
      (hcompact omega) (hne omega)
  rw [heq]
  exact hhausdorff

name: RandomSetTheory.measurable_setRadiusAt_const
statement:
theorem measurable_setRadiusAt_const
    {Omega E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    [MetricSpace E] [CompleteSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] [Nonempty E]
    {S : Omega → Set E} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ omega, IsCompact (S omega))
    (hne : ∀ omega, (S omega).Nonempty) (x₀ : E) :
    Measurable (fun omega => setRadiusAt (S omega) x₀)
proof:
:= by
  exact measurable_setRadiusAt hS hcompact hne measurable_const

name: RandomSetTheory.diam_le_two_mul_setRadiusAt
statement:
theorem diam_le_two_mul_setRadiusAt
    {E : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace E] {K : Set E} {x₀ : E}
    (hcompact : IsCompact K) (hne : K.Nonempty) :
    Metric.diam K ≤ 2 * setRadiusAt K x₀
proof:
:= by
  apply Metric.diam_le_of_forall_dist_le
    (mul_nonneg zero_le_two (setRadiusAt_nonneg hcompact hne))
  intro x hx y hy
  calc
    dist x y ≤ dist x x₀ + dist y x₀ := dist_triangle_right x y x₀
    _ ≤ setRadiusAt K x₀ + setRadiusAt K x₀ :=
      add_le_add (dist_le_setRadiusAt hcompact hx)
        (dist_le_setRadiusAt hcompact hy)
    _ = 2 * setRadiusAt K x₀ := by ring

name: RandomSetTheory.setRadiusAt_le_diam_of_mem
statement:
theorem setRadiusAt_le_diam_of_mem
    {E : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace E] {K : Set E} {x₀ : E}
    (hcompact : IsCompact K) (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ K) :
    setRadiusAt K x₀ ≤ Metric.diam K
proof:
:= by
  apply csSup_le
  · exact ⟨dist x₀ x₀, ⟨x₀, hx₀, rfl⟩⟩
  · intro r hr
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hr
    exact Metric.dist_le_diam_of_mem hcompact.isBounded hx hx₀

name: RandomSetTheory.ediam_eq_iSup_edist_castaingRepresentation
statement:
theorem ediam_eq_iSup_edist_castaingRepresentation
    {Omega E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    [MetricSpace E] [CompleteSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] [Nonempty E]
    {S : Omega → Set E} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hclosed : ∀ omega, IsClosed (S omega))
    (hne : ∀ omega, (S omega).Nonempty) (omega : Omega) :
    Metric.ediam (S omega) =
      ⨆ i : ℕ, ⨆ j : ℕ,
        edist (castaingRepresentation hS hclosed hne i omega)
          (castaingRepresentation hS hclosed hne j omega)
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℕ → Omega → E := castaingRepresentation hS hclosed hne
  calc
    Metric.ediam (S omega) =
        Metric.ediam (closure (Set.range fun n => f n omega)) := by
      rw [closure_range_castaingRepresentation hS hclosed hne omega]
    _ = Metric.ediam (Set.range fun n => f n omega) :=
      Metric.ediam_closure _
    _ = ⨆ i : ℕ, ⨆ j : ℕ, edist (f i omega) (f j omega) := by
      simp only [Metric.ediam, iSup_range]
    _ = ⨆ i : ℕ, ⨆ j : ℕ,
        edist (castaingRepresentation hS hclosed hne i omega)
          (castaingRepresentation hS hclosed hne j omega) := rfl

name: RandomSetTheory.measurable_ediam_correspondence
statement:
theorem measurable_ediam_correspondence
    {Omega E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    [MetricSpace E] [CompleteSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] [Nonempty E]
    {S : Omega → Set E} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hclosed : ∀ omega, IsClosed (S omega))
    (hne : ∀ omega, (S omega).Nonempty) :
    Measurable (fun omega => Metric.ediam (S omega))
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℕ → Omega → E := castaingRepresentation hS hclosed hne
  have hf : ∀ n, Measurable (f n) :=
    castaingRepresentation_measurable hS hclosed hne
  have heq : (fun omega => Metric.ediam (S omega)) =
      fun omega => ⨆ i : ℕ, ⨆ j : ℕ, edist (f i omega) (f j omega) := by
    funext omega
    exact ediam_eq_iSup_edist_castaingRepresentation
      hS hclosed hne omega
  rw [heq]
  exact Measurable.iSup fun i => Measurable.iSup fun j =>
    (hf i).edist (hf j)

name: RandomSetTheory.measurable_diam_correspondence
statement:
theorem measurable_diam_correspondence
    {Omega E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    [MetricSpace E] [CompleteSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] [Nonempty E]
    {S : Omega → Set E} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hclosed : ∀ omega, IsClosed (S omega))
    (hne : ∀ omega, (S omega).Nonempty) :
    Measurable (fun omega => Metric.diam (S omega))
proof:
:= by
  exact (measurable_ediam_correspondence hS hclosed hne).ennreal_toReal

name: RandomSetTheory.measurable_diam_compact_correspondence
statement:
theorem measurable_diam_compact_correspondence
    {Omega E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    [MetricSpace E] [CompleteSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] [Nonempty E]
    {S : Omega → Set E} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ omega, IsCompact (S omega))
    (hne : ∀ omega, (S omega).Nonempty) :
    Measurable (fun omega => Metric.diam (S omega))
proof:
:=
  measurable_diam_correspondence hS (fun omega => (hcompact omega).isClosed) hne

name: RandomSetTheory.setNormEnvelope_eq_sSup_norm
statement:
theorem setNormEnvelope_eq_sSup_norm
    {E : Type*} [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] (K : Set E) :
    setNormEnvelope K = sSup ((fun x => ‖x‖) '' K)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [setNormEnvelope, setRadiusAt, dist_zero_right]

name: RandomSetTheory.norm_le_setNormEnvelope
statement:
theorem norm_le_setNormEnvelope
    {E : Type*} [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] {K : Set E} {x : E}
    (hcompact : IsCompact K) (hx : x ∈ K) :
    ‖x‖ ≤ setNormEnvelope K
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [setNormEnvelope, dist_zero_right] using
    (dist_le_setRadiusAt hcompact hx : dist x 0 ≤ setRadiusAt K 0)

name: RandomSetTheory.measurable_setNormEnvelope
statement:
theorem measurable_setNormEnvelope
    {Omega E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] [Nonempty E]

name: RandomSetTheory.diam_le_two_mul_setNormEnvelope
statement:
theorem diam_le_two_mul_setNormEnvelope
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] {K : Set E}
