name: RandomSetTheory.shapleyTagSum_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem shapleyTagSum_apply {I : Type*} [Fintype I]
    (z : E × (I → ℝ)) : shapleyTagSum z = ∑ i, z.2 i
proof: := rfl

name: RandomSetTheory.card_le_finrank_add_card_of_affineIndependent_tagged
statement:
theorem card_le_finrank_add_card_of_affineIndependent_tagged
    {I : Type*} [Fintype I]
    (T : Finset (E × (I → ℝ)))
    (hT : ∀ z ∈ T, ∑ i, z.2 i = 1)
    (hind : AffineIndependent ℝ ((↑) : T → E × (I → ℝ))) :
    T.card ≤ finrank ℝ E + Fintype.card I
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hTne := T.eq_empty_or_nonempty
  · simp
  have hspan : vectorSpan ℝ (T : Set (E × (I → ℝ))) ≤
      LinearMap.ker (shapleyTagSum (E := E) (I := I)) := by
    rw [vectorSpan_def, Submodule.span_le]
    intro v hv
    rcases hv with ⟨z, hz, w, hw, rfl⟩
    change shapleyTagSum (E := E) (I := I) (z - w) = 0
    rw [map_sub, shapleyTagSum_apply, shapleyTagSum_apply,
      hT z hz, hT w hw, sub_self]
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hTne
  have hzsum : shapleyTagSum (E := E) (I := I) z ≠ 0 := by
    rw [shapleyTagSum_apply, hT z hz]
    norm_num
  have hker : LinearMap.ker (shapleyTagSum (E := E) (I := I)) < ⊤ := by
    rw [lt_top_iff_ne_top]
    intro htop
    apply hzsum
    change z ∈ LinearMap.ker (shapleyTagSum (E := E) (I := I))
    rw [htop]
    trivial
  have hspanTop : vectorSpan ℝ (T : Set (E × (I → ℝ))) < ⊤ :=
    hspan.trans_lt hker
  have hfinrank : finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ (T : Set (E × (I → ℝ)))) <
      finrank ℝ (E × (I → ℝ)) := by
    simpa using Submodule.finrank_lt_finrank_of_lt hspanTop
  calc
    T.card = Fintype.card T := by simp
    _ ≤ finrank ℝ
        (vectorSpan ℝ (Set.range ((↑) : T → E × (I → ℝ)))) + 1 :=
      hind.card_le_finrank_succ
    _ = finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ (T : Set (E × (I → ℝ)))) + 1 := by
      have hrange : Set.range ((↑) : T → E × (I → ℝ)) =
          (T : Set (E × (I → ℝ))) := by
        ext x
        simp
      rw [hrange]
    _ ≤ finrank ℝ (E × (I → ℝ)) := Nat.add_one_le_iff.mpr hfinrank
    _ = finrank ℝ E + Fintype.card I := by simp

name: RandomSetTheory.shapleyUnitTag_self
statement: @[simp] theorem shapleyUnitTag_self (i : I) : shapleyUnitTag i i = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [shapleyUnitTag]

name: RandomSetTheory.sum_shapleyUnitTag
statement: theorem sum_shapleyUnitTag (i : I) : ∑ j, shapleyUnitTag i j = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [shapleyUnitTag]

name: RandomSetTheory.shapleyTagMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem shapleyTagMap_apply (i : I) (x : E) :
    shapleyTagMap i x = (x, shapleyUnitTag i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [shapleyTagMap]

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_shapleyTaggedRep
statement:
theorem exists_shapleyTaggedRep (S : I → Set E)
    {z : E × (I → ℝ)} (hz : z ∈ shapleyTaggedSet S) :
    ∃ q : Σ i, S i,
      shapleyTagMap (E := E) q.1 (q.2 : E) = z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [shapleyTaggedSet, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_image] at hz
  obtain ⟨i, a, ha, hza⟩ := hz
  exact ⟨⟨i, ⟨a, ha⟩⟩, hza⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.shapleyTaggedRep_spec
statement:
theorem shapleyTaggedRep_spec (S : I → Set E)
    (z : E × (I → ℝ)) (hz : z ∈ shapleyTaggedSet S) :
    shapleyTagMap (E := E) (shapleyTaggedRep S z hz).1
      ((shapleyTaggedRep S z hz).2 : E) = z
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec (exists_shapleyTaggedRep S hz)

name: RandomSetTheory.shapleyTagSum_eq_one_of_mem_taggedSet
proof:
:= by
  simp only [shapleyTaggedSet, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_image] at hz
  obtain ⟨i, x, hx, rfl⟩ := hz
  simp [sum_shapleyUnitTag]

name: RandomSetTheory.shapleyTagMap_mem_convexHull_taggedSet
statement:
theorem shapleyTagMap_mem_convexHull_taggedSet
    (S : I → Set E) (i : I) {x : E}
    (hx : x ∈ convexHull ℝ (S i)) :
    shapleyTagMap i x ∈ convexHull ℝ (shapleyTaggedSet S)
proof:
:= by
  have himage : shapleyTagMap (E := E) i '' convexHull ℝ (S i) =
      convexHull ℝ (shapleyTagMap i '' S i) :=
    (shapleyTagMap (E := E) i).image_convexHull (S i)
  have hsmall : shapleyTagMap (E := E) i x ∈
      convexHull ℝ (shapleyTagMap i '' S i) := by
    rw [← himage]
    exact ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  apply convexHull_mono _ hsmall
  exact Set.subset_iUnion (fun j => shapleyTagMap (E := E) j '' S j) i

name: RandomSetTheory.normalized_tagged_sum_mem
statement:
theorem normalized_tagged_sum_mem (S : I → Set E) [Nonempty I]
    (x : I → E) (hx : ∀ i, x i ∈ convexHull ℝ (S i)) :
    (∑ i, ((Fintype.card I : ℝ)⁻¹) • shapleyTagMap i (x i)) ∈
      convexHull ℝ (shapleyTaggedSet S)
proof:
:= by
  apply (convex_convexHull ℝ (shapleyTaggedSet S)).sum_mem
  · intro i hi
    positivity
  · simp [Fintype.card_ne_zero]
  · intro i hi
    exact shapleyTagMap_mem_convexHull_taggedSet S i (hx i)

name: RandomSetTheory.normalized_tagged_sum_eq
statement:
theorem normalized_tagged_sum_eq [Nonempty I] (x : I → E) :
    (∑ i, ((Fintype.card I : ℝ)⁻¹) • shapleyTagMap i (x i)) =
      (((Fintype.card I : ℝ)⁻¹) • ∑ i, x i,
        fun _ => (Fintype.card I : ℝ)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  apply Prod.ext
  · simp only [Prod.fst_sum, Prod.smul_fst, shapleyTagMap_apply, Prod.fst]
    rw [Finset.smul_sum]
  · funext j
    simp only [Prod.snd_sum, Prod.smul_snd, shapleyTagMap_apply,
      Prod.snd, Pi.smul_apply]
    simp [shapleyUnitTag]

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_small_affineIndependent_tagged_support
statement:
theorem exists_small_affineIndependent_tagged_support (S : I → Set E)
    {y : E × (I → ℝ)} (hy : y ∈ convexHull ℝ (shapleyTaggedSet S)) :
    ∃ T : Finset (E × (I → ℝ)),
      (T : Set (E × (I → ℝ))) ⊆ shapleyTaggedSet S ∧
      AffineIndependent ℝ ((↑) : T → E × (I → ℝ)) ∧
      y ∈ convexHull ℝ (T : Set (E × (I → ℝ))) ∧
      T.card ≤ finrank ℝ E + Fintype.card I
proof:
:= by
  rw [convexHull_eq_union] at hy
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, exists_prop] at hy
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hind, hymem⟩ := hy
  refine ⟨T, hT, hind, hymem, ?_⟩
  apply card_le_finrank_add_card_of_affineIndependent_tagged T _ hind
  intro z hz
  exact shapleyTagSum_eq_one_of_mem_taggedSet (hT hz)

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_small_tagged_convex_representation
statement:
theorem exists_small_tagged_convex_representation (S : I → Set E)
    {y : E × (I → ℝ)} (hy : y ∈ convexHull ℝ (shapleyTaggedSet S)) :
    ∃ (T : Finset (E × (I → ℝ))) (w : E × (I → ℝ) → ℝ),
      (T : Set (E × (I → ℝ))) ⊆ shapleyTaggedSet S ∧
      AffineIndependent ℝ ((↑) : T → E × (I → ℝ)) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ T, 0 ≤ w z) ∧
      ∑ z ∈ T, w z = 1 ∧
      ∑ z ∈ T, w z • z = y ∧
      T.card ≤ finrank ℝ E + Fintype.card I
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hind, hymem, hcard⟩ :=
    exists_small_affineIndependent_tagged_support S hy
  rw [Finset.mem_convexHull'] at hymem
  obtain ⟨w, hw_nonneg, hw_sum, hw_center⟩ := hymem
  exact ⟨T, w, hT, hind, hw_nonneg, hw_sum, hw_center, hcard⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_small_representation_of_componentwise_convexHull
statement:
theorem exists_small_representation_of_componentwise_convexHull
    (S : I → Set E) [Nonempty I] (x : I → E)
    (hx : ∀ i, x i ∈ convexHull ℝ (S i)) :
    ∃ (T : Finset (E × (I → ℝ))) (w : E × (I → ℝ) → ℝ),
      (T : Set (E × (I → ℝ))) ⊆ shapleyTaggedSet S ∧
      AffineIndependent ℝ ((↑) : T → E × (I → ℝ)) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ T, 0 ≤ w z) ∧
      ∑ z ∈ T, w z = 1 ∧
      ∑ z ∈ T, w z • z =
        (((Fintype.card I : ℝ)⁻¹) • ∑ i, x i,
          fun _ => (Fintype.card I : ℝ)⁻¹) ∧
      T.card ≤ finrank ℝ E + Fintype.card I
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T, w, hT, hind, hw0, hw1, hcenter, hcard⟩ :=
    exists_small_tagged_convex_representation S
      (normalized_tagged_sum_mem S x hx)
  refine ⟨T, w, hT, hind, hw0, hw1, ?_, hcard⟩
  rw [hcenter, normalized_tagged_sum_eq]

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_partitioned_shapleyFolkman_components
statement:
theorem exists_partitioned_shapleyFolkman_components
    (S : I → Set E) [Nonempty I] (x : I → E)
    (hx : ∀ i, x i ∈ convexHull ℝ (S i)) :
    ∃ (T : Finset (E × (I → ℝ)))
      (label : T → I) (atom : T → E) (weight : T → ℝ)
      (fiber : I → Finset T) (z : I → E),
      (∀ q : T, atom q ∈ S (label q)) ∧
      (∀ q : T, (q : E × (I → ℝ)) =
        shapleyTagMap (label q) (atom q)) ∧
      (∀ q : T, 0 ≤ weight q) ∧
      (∀ i, fiber i = Finset.univ.filter fun q => label q = i) ∧
      (∀ i, ∑ q ∈ fiber i, weight q = 1) ∧
      (∀ i, z i = ∑ q ∈ fiber i, weight q • atom q) ∧
      (∀ i, z i ∈ convexHull ℝ (S i)) ∧
      ∑ i, z i = ∑ i, x i ∧
      ∑ i, (fiber i).card = T.card ∧
      T.card ≤ finrank ℝ E + Fintype.card I
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨T, w, hT, hind, hw0, hw1, hcenter, hcard⟩ :=
    exists_small_representation_of_componentwise_convexHull S x hx
  let rep : T → Σ i, S i := fun q =>
    shapleyTaggedRep S (q : E × (I → ℝ)) (hT q.property)
  let label : T → I := fun q => (rep q).1
  let atom : T → E := fun q => ((rep q).2 : E)
  let weight : T → ℝ := fun q => (Fintype.card I : ℝ) * w q
  let fiber : I → Finset T := fun i =>
    Finset.univ.filter fun q => label q = i
  let z : I → E := fun i => ∑ q ∈ fiber i, weight q • atom q
  have hrep (q : T) :
      shapleyTagMap (E := E) (label q) (atom q) =
        (q : E × (I → ℝ)) := by
    simpa only [rep, label, atom] using
      shapleyTaggedRep_spec S (q : E × (I → ℝ)) (hT q.property)
  have hatom (q : T) : atom q ∈ S (label q) :=
    (rep q).2.property
  have hcenter' :
      (∑ q : T, w q • (q : E × (I → ℝ))) =
        (((Fintype.card I : ℝ)⁻¹) • ∑ i, x i,
          fun _ => (Fintype.card I : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
    simpa only [← T.sum_attach, Finset.attach_eq_univ] using hcenter
  have htag (q : T) :
      (q : E × (I → ℝ)).2 = shapleyUnitTag (label q) := by
    rw [← hrep q, shapleyTagMap_apply]
  have hcoord (i : I) :
      ∑ q : T, w q * shapleyUnitTag (label q) i =
        (Fintype.card I : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
    have hc := congrArg (fun y : E × (I → ℝ) => y.2 i) hcenter'
    simp only [Prod.snd_sum, Prod.smul_snd, Pi.smul_apply] at hc
    simp_rw [htag] at hc
    simpa using hc
  have hgroup (i : I) :
      ∑ q ∈ fiber i, w q = (Fintype.card I : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
    change ∑ q ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun q => label q = i), w q = _
    rw [Finset.sum_filter]
    simpa [shapleyUnitTag, eq_comm] using hcoord i
  have hweight_sum (i : I) : ∑ q ∈ fiber i, weight q = 1 := by
    rw [show (∑ q ∈ fiber i, weight q) =
        (Fintype.card I : ℝ) * ∑ q ∈ fiber i, w q by
      simp only [weight, Finset.mul_sum]]
    rw [hgroup]
    simp [Fintype.card_ne_zero]
  have hweight_nonneg (q : T) : 0 ≤ weight q :=
    mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (hw0 q q.property)
  have hzmem (i : I) : z i ∈ convexHull ℝ (S i) := by
    dsimp only [z]
    apply (convex_convexHull ℝ (S i)).sum_mem
    · intro q hq
      exact hweight_nonneg q
    · exact hweight_sum i
    · intro q hq
      apply subset_convexHull ℝ
      have hlabel : label q = i := by
        change q ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun q => label q = i) at hq
        exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hq).2
      simpa only [hlabel] using hatom q
  have hfirst :
      ∑ q : T, w q • atom q =
        (Fintype.card I : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ i, x i := by
    have hc := congrArg Prod.fst hcenter'
    simp only [Prod.fst_sum, Prod.smul_fst] at hc
    have hfst (q : T) : (q : E × (I → ℝ)).1 = atom q := by
      rw [← hrep q, shapleyTagMap_apply]
    simp_rw [hfst] at hc
    exact hc
  have hweighted_atoms :
      ∑ q : T, weight q • atom q = ∑ i, x i := by
    calc
      ∑ q : T, weight q • atom q =
          (Fintype.card I : ℝ) • ∑ q : T, w q • atom q := by
        rw [Finset.smul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro q hq
        simp only [weight, mul_smul]
      _ = (Fintype.card I : ℝ) •
          ((Fintype.card I : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ i, x i) := by rw [hfirst]
      _ = ∑ i, x i := by
        rw [smul_smul]
        simp [Fintype.card_ne_zero]
  have hsum_z : ∑ i, z i = ∑ i, x i := by
    calc
      ∑ i, z i = ∑ i, ∑ q ∈ fiber i, weight q • atom q := by rfl
      _ = ∑ q : T, weight q • atom q := by
        simpa only [fiber] using
          (Finset.sum_fiberwise (Finset.univ : Finset T) label
            (fun q => weight q • atom q))
      _ = ∑ i, x i := hweighted_atoms
  have hcard_fibers : ∑ i, (fiber i).card = T.card := by
    calc
      ∑ i, (fiber i).card = Fintype.card T := by
        simpa [fiber] using
          (Finset.sum_card_fiberwise_eq_card_filter
            (Finset.univ : Finset T) (Finset.univ : Finset I) label)
      _ = T.card := by simp
  refine ⟨T, label, atom, weight, fiber, z, hatom, ?_, hweight_nonneg,
    fun i => rfl, hweight_sum, fun i => rfl, hzmem, hsum_z,
    hcard_fibers, hcard⟩
  intro q
  exact (hrep q).symm

name: RandomSetTheory.shapleyFolkman_caratheodory_precursor
statement:
theorem shapleyFolkman_caratheodory_precursor
    (I : Finset ι) (S : ι → Set E) {x : E}
    (hx : x ∈ ∑ i ∈ I, convexHull ℝ (S i)) :
    ∃ (z : I → E) (T : I → Finset E),
      (∀ i, (T i : Set E) ⊆ S i) ∧
      (∀ i, AffineIndependent ℝ ((↑) : T i → E)) ∧
      (∀ i, z i ∈ convexHull ℝ (T i : Set E)) ∧
      (∑ i, z i) = x ∧
      (∀ i, #(T i) ≤ finrank ℝ E + 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Set.mem_finsetSum] at hx
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hsum⟩ := hx
  have hchoice (i : I) :
      ∃ T : Finset E, (T : Set E) ⊆ S i ∧
        AffineIndependent ℝ ((↑) : T → E) ∧
        g i ∈ convexHull ℝ (T : Set E) := by
    have hgi := hg (i := i) i.property
    rw [convexHull_eq_union] at hgi
    simpa only [Set.mem_iUnion, exists_prop] using hgi
  choose T hTsub hTind hTmem using hchoice
  refine ⟨fun i ↦ g i, T, hTsub, hTind, hTmem, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hatt : (∑ i : I, g i) = ∑ i ∈ I, g i := by
      simpa only [Finset.attach_eq_univ] using I.sum_attach (fun i ↦ g i)
    exact hatt.trans hsum
  · intro i
    simpa only [Fintype.card_coe] using
      (hTind i).card_le_finrank_succ.trans
        (Nat.add_le_add_right (Submodule.finrank_le _) 1)

name: RandomSetTheory.mem_set_of_mem_convexHull_card_eq_one
statement:
theorem mem_set_of_mem_convexHull_card_eq_one
    {S : Set E} {T : Finset E} {z : E}
    (hsub : (T : Set E) ⊆ S) (hcard : #T = 1)
    (hz : z ∈ convexHull ℝ (T : Set E)) : z ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp hcard
  have : z = y := by simpa using hz
  subst z
  exact hsub (by simp)

name: RandomSetTheory.card_exceptional_supports_le
statement:
theorem card_exceptional_supports_le
    {I α : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (T : I → Finset α) (hne : ∀ i, (T i).Nonempty) {d : ℕ}
    (htotal : (∑ i, #(T i)) ≤ Fintype.card I + d) :
    #(Finset.univ.filter fun i ↦ 1 < #(T i)) ≤ d
proof:
:= by
  let J : Finset I := Finset.univ.filter fun i ↦ 1 < #(T i)
  have hJ : #J ≤ ∑ i ∈ J, (#(T i) - 1) := by
    calc
      #J = ∑ _i ∈ J, 1 := by simp
      _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ J, (#(T i) - 1) := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi ↦ by
        have := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
        omega
  have hsub : (∑ i ∈ J, (#(T i) - 1)) ≤ ∑ i, (#(T i) - 1) := by
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
  have hsplit : (∑ i, (#(T i) - 1)) + Fintype.card I = ∑ i, #(T i) := by
    rw [Fintype.card_eq_sum_ones, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    exact Nat.sub_add_cancel (hne i).card_pos
  change #J ≤ d
  omega

name: RandomSetTheory.shapleyFolkman
statement:
theorem shapleyFolkman
    {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [Nonempty I]
    (S : I → Set E) (x : I → E)
    (hx : ∀ i, x i ∈ convexHull ℝ (S i)) :
    ∃ (J : Finset I) (z : I → E),
      #J ≤ finrank ℝ E ∧
      (∀ i ∉ J, z i ∈ S i) ∧
      (∀ i ∈ J, z i ∈ convexHull ℝ (S i)) ∧
      ∑ i, z i = ∑ i, x i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨T, label, atom, weight, fiber, z,
      hatom, htag, hweight0, hfiber, hweight1, hz,
      hzmem, hsum, hcard_fiber, hcard⟩ :=
    exists_partitioned_shapleyFolkman_components S x hx
  have hfiber_ne (i : I) : (fiber i).Nonempty := by
    rw [Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty]
    intro hempty
    have hone := hweight1 i
    rw [hempty] at hone
    norm_num at hone
  have htotal :
      (∑ i, #(fiber i)) ≤ Fintype.card I + finrank ℝ E := by
    rw [hcard_fiber]
    simpa [Nat.add_comm] using hcard
  let J : Finset I := Finset.univ.filter fun i => 1 < #(fiber i)
  have hJ : #J ≤ finrank ℝ E := by
    exact card_exceptional_supports_le fiber hfiber_ne htotal
  refine ⟨J, z, hJ, ?_, ?_, hsum⟩
  · intro i hi
    have hnot : ¬1 < #(fiber i) := by
      simpa [J] using hi
    have hcard_one : #(fiber i) = 1 := by
      have hpos := (hfiber_ne i).card_pos
      omega
    obtain ⟨q, hfiber_q⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp hcard_one
    have hlabel : label q = i := by
      have hq : q ∈ fiber i := by simp [hfiber_q]
      rw [hfiber i] at hq
      exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hq).2
    have hweight_q : weight q = 1 := by
      simpa [hfiber_q] using hweight1 i
    have hzq : z i = atom q := by
      calc
        z i = ∑ r ∈ fiber i, weight r • atom r := hz i
        _ = weight q • atom q := by simp [hfiber_q]
        _ = atom q := by rw [hweight_q, one_smul]
    rw [hzq]
    simpa only [hlabel] using hatom q
  · intro i hi
    exact hzmem i

name: RandomSetTheory.shapleyFolkman_sum_dist_le
statement:
theorem shapleyFolkman_sum_dist_le
    (S : I → Set F) (x : I → F)
    (hx : ∀ i, x i ∈ convexHull ℝ (S i))
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (happrox : ∀ i (v : F), v ∈ convexHull ℝ (S i) →
      ∃ y ∈ S i, dist v y ≤ R) :
    ∃ y : I → F,
      (∀ i, y i ∈ S i) ∧
      dist (∑ i, x i) (∑ i, y i) ≤ (finrank ℝ F : ℝ) * R
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨J, z, hJ, hzS, hzconv, hsum⟩ := shapleyFolkman S x hx
  have hchoice (i : I) :
      ∃ y ∈ S i, dist (z i) y ≤ if i ∈ J then R else 0 := by
    by_cases hi : i ∈ J
    · obtain ⟨y, hy, hdist⟩ := happrox i (z i) (hzconv i hi)
      exact ⟨y, hy, by simpa [hi] using hdist⟩
    · exact ⟨z i, hzS i hi, by simp [hi]⟩
  choose y hyS hydist using hchoice
  refine ⟨y, hyS, ?_⟩
  rw [← hsum, dist_eq_norm, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  calc
    ‖∑ i, (z i - y i)‖ ≤ ∑ i, ‖z i - y i‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ = ∑ i, dist (z i) (y i) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      rw [dist_eq_norm]
    _ ≤ ∑ i, if i ∈ J then R else 0 :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => hydist i
    _ = (J.card : ℝ) * R := by simp
    _ ≤ (finrank ℝ F : ℝ) * R := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast hJ) hR

name: RandomSetTheory.convexHull_exists_mem_dist_le_of_diameter
statement:
theorem convexHull_exists_mem_dist_le_of_diameter
    {S : Set F} (hne : S.Nonempty) {R : ℝ}
    (hdiam : ∀ a ∈ S, ∀ b ∈ S, dist a b ≤ R)
    {x : F} (hx : x ∈ convexHull ℝ S) :
    ∃ y ∈ S, dist x y ≤ R
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hne
  refine ⟨y, hy, ?_⟩
  have hsub : S ⊆ closedBall y R := by
    intro a ha
    rw [mem_closedBall]
    exact hdiam a ha y hy
  exact convexHull_min hsub (convex_closedBall y R) hx

name: RandomSetTheory.shapleyFolkman_sum_dist_le_of_diameter
statement:
theorem shapleyFolkman_sum_dist_le_of_diameter
    (S : I → Set F) (x : I → F)
    (hx : ∀ i, x i ∈ convexHull ℝ (S i))
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hne : ∀ i, (S i).Nonempty)
    (hdiam : ∀ i a, a ∈ S i → ∀ b, b ∈ S i → dist a b ≤ R) :
    ∃ y : I → F,
      (∀ i, y i ∈ S i) ∧
      dist (∑ i, x i) (∑ i, y i) ≤ (finrank ℝ F : ℝ) * R
proof:
:= by
  apply shapleyFolkman_sum_dist_le S x hx hR
  intro i v hv
  exact convexHull_exists_mem_dist_le_of_diameter (hne i) (hdiam i) hv

name: RandomSetTheory.convexHull_univ_sum_exists_dist_le
statement:
theorem convexHull_univ_sum_exists_dist_le
    (S : I → Set F) {v : F}
    (hv : v ∈ convexHull ℝ (∑ i, S i))
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hne : ∀ i, (S i).Nonempty)
    (hdiam : ∀ i a, a ∈ S i → ∀ b, b ∈ S i → dist a b ≤ R) :
    ∃ w ∈ ∑ i, S i, dist v w ≤ (finrank ℝ F : ℝ) * R
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [convexHull_sum] at hv
  rw [Set.mem_finsetSum] at hv
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hsum⟩ := hv
  have hx' : ∀ i, x i ∈ convexHull ℝ (S i) :=
    fun i => hx (i := i) (by simp)
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hdist⟩ :=
    shapleyFolkman_sum_dist_le_of_diameter S x hx' hR hne hdiam
  refine ⟨∑ i, y i, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Set.mem_finsetSum]
    exact ⟨y, fun {_i} _hi => hy _i, rfl⟩
  · rw [← hsum]
    simpa using hdist

name: RandomSetTheory.convexHull_average_sum_exists_dist_le
statement:
theorem convexHull_average_sum_exists_dist_le
    (S : I → Set F) {v : F}
    (hv : v ∈ convexHull ℝ
      (((Fintype.card I : ℝ)⁻¹) • ∑ i, S i))
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hne : ∀ i, (S i).Nonempty)
    (hdiam : ∀ i a, a ∈ S i → ∀ b, b ∈ S i → dist a b ≤ R) :
    ∃ w ∈ ((Fintype.card I : ℝ)⁻¹) • ∑ i, S i,
      dist v w ≤ (Fintype.card I : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        ((finrank ℝ F : ℝ) * R)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [convexHull_smul] at hv
  obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := hv
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hdist⟩ :=
    convexHull_univ_sum_exists_dist_le S hu hR hne hdiam
  refine ⟨(Fintype.card I : ℝ)⁻¹ • w, ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [dist_smul₀, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _))]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdist
    (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _))

name: RandomSetTheory.closedConvexHull_exists_dist_le_of_convexHull
statement:
theorem closedConvexHull_exists_dist_le_of_convexHull
    {K : Set F} (hK : IsCompact K) (hKne : K.Nonempty)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (happrox : ∀ x ∈ convexHull ℝ K, ∃ y ∈ K, dist x y ≤ r)
    {x : F} (hx : x ∈ closedConvexHull ℝ K) :
    ∃ y ∈ K, dist x y ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  have hconv : convexHull ℝ K ⊆ cthickening r K := by
    intro v hv
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hvy⟩ := happrox v hv
    exact mem_cthickening_of_dist_le v y r K hy hvy
  have hclosed : closedConvexHull ℝ K ⊆ cthickening r K := by
    rw [closedConvexHull_eq_closure_convexHull]
    exact closure_minimal hconv isClosed_cthickening
  have hxthick := hclosed hx
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := hK.exists_infDist_eq_dist hKne x
  refine ⟨y, hy, ?_⟩
  rw [← hxy]
  calc
    infDist x K = (infEDist x K).toReal := rfl
    _ ≤ (ENNReal.ofReal r).toReal :=
      ENNReal.toReal_mono ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top hxthick
    _ = r := ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hr

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_self_closedConvexHull_le_of_convexHull_approx
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_self_closedConvexHull_le_of_convexHull_approx
    {K : Set F} (hK : IsCompact K) (hKne : K.Nonempty)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (happrox : ∀ x ∈ convexHull ℝ K, ∃ y ∈ K, dist x y ≤ r) :
    hausdorffDist K (closedConvexHull ℝ K) ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  apply hausdorffDist_le_of_mem_dist hr
  · intro x hx
    exact ⟨x, subset_closedConvexHull hx, by simpa using hr⟩
  · intro x hx
    exact closedConvexHull_exists_dist_le_of_convexHull
      hK hKne hr happrox hx

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_average_sum_closedConvexHull_le
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_average_sum_closedConvexHull_le
    (S : I → Set F)
    (hK : IsCompact (((Fintype.card I : ℝ)⁻¹) • ∑ i, S i))
    (hKne : (((Fintype.card I : ℝ)⁻¹) • ∑ i, S i).Nonempty)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hne : ∀ i, (S i).Nonempty)
    (hdiam : ∀ i a, a ∈ S i → ∀ b, b ∈ S i → dist a b ≤ R) :
    hausdorffDist
        (((Fintype.card I : ℝ)⁻¹) • ∑ i, S i)
        (closedConvexHull ℝ
          (((Fintype.card I : ℝ)⁻¹) • ∑ i, S i)) ≤
      (Fintype.card I : ℝ)⁻¹ * ((finrank ℝ F : ℝ) * R)
proof:
:= by
  apply hausdorffDist_self_closedConvexHull_le_of_convexHull_approx
    hK hKne
  · exact mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
      (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hR)
  · intro x hx
    exact convexHull_average_sum_exists_dist_le S hx hR hne hdiam

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_minimal_compact_rounding
statement:
theorem exists_minimal_compact_rounding
    (S : I → Set H) (z : I → H)
    (hcompact : ∀ i, IsCompact (S i))
    (hne : ∀ i, (S i).Nonempty) :
    ∃ a : I → H,
      (∀ i, a i ∈ S i) ∧
      ∀ b : I → H, (∀ i, b i ∈ S i) →
        ‖∑ i, (a i - z i)‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖∑ i, (b i - z i)‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let P : Set (I → H) := {a | ∀ i, a i ∈ S i}
  have hPcompact : IsCompact P := isCompact_pi_infinite hcompact
  have hPne : P.Nonempty := by
    choose a ha using hne
    exact ⟨a, ha⟩
  have hcont : Continuous (fun a : I → H => ‖∑ i, (a i - z i)‖ ^ 2) := by
    fun_prop
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hmin⟩ :=
    hPcompact.exists_isMinOn hPne hcont.continuousOn
  exact ⟨a, ha, fun b hb => hmin hb⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.minimal_rounding_coordinate
statement:
theorem minimal_rounding_coordinate
    (S : I → Set H) (z a : I → H)
    (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ S i)
    (hmin : ∀ b : I → H, (∀ i, b i ∈ S i) →
      ‖∑ i, (a i - z i)‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖∑ i, (b i - z i)‖ ^ 2)
    (i : I) {b : H} (hb : b ∈ S i) :
    ‖∑ j, (a j - z j)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ‖(∑ j, (a j - z j)) + (b - a i)‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let a' := Function.update a i b
  have ha' : ∀ j, a' j ∈ S j := by
    intro j
    by_cases hji : j = i
    · subst j
      simpa [a'] using hb
    · simpa [a', Function.update_of_ne hji] using ha j
  have hm := hmin a' ha'
  have hsum :
      ∑ j, (a' j - z j) = (∑ j, (a j - z j)) + (b - a i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    change (∑ j, Function.update a i b j) - ∑ j, z j = _
    rw [Finset.sum_update_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ i)]
    have hsplit_a :
        ∑ x ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset I) \ {i}, a x =
          (∑ x, a x) - a i := by
      have hs :
          (∑ x ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset I) \ {i}, a x) +
            ∑ x ∈ ({i} : Finset I), a x = ∑ x, a x :=
        Finset.sum_sdiff (by simp : ({i} : Finset I) ⊆ Finset.univ)
      simp only [Finset.sum_singleton] at hs
      exact eq_sub_of_add_eq hs
    rw [hsplit_a]
    abel
  rw [hsum] at hm
  exact hm

name: RandomSetTheory.inner_lower_bound_of_sq_norm_minimal
proof:
:= by
  rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, ← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] at h
  rw [real_inner_add_add_self] at h
  rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq w] at h
  nlinarith

name: RandomSetTheory.inner_lower_bound_on_convexHull_of_minimal
statement:
theorem inner_lower_bound_on_convexHull_of_minimal
    (S : I → Set H) (a : I → H) (v : H) (i : I) (D : ℝ)
    (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hminimal : ∀ b ∈ S i, ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖v + (b - a i)‖ ^ 2)
    (hdiam : ∀ b ∈ S i, ‖b - a i‖ ≤ D)
    {z : H} (hz : z ∈ convexHull ℝ (S i)) :
    -(D ^ 2) / 2 ≤ @inner ℝ H _ v (z - a i)
proof:
:= by
  let L : Set H :=
    {y | -(D ^ 2) / 2 + @inner ℝ H _ v (a i) ≤ @inner ℝ H _ v y}
  have hsub : S i ⊆ L := by
    intro b hb
    have hinner := inner_lower_bound_of_sq_norm_minimal
      (hminimal b hb)
    have hnorm_nonneg : 0 ≤ ‖b - a i‖ := norm_nonneg _
    have hsq : ‖b - a i‖ ^ 2 ≤ D ^ 2 :=
      (sq_le_sq₀ hnorm_nonneg hD).2 (hdiam b hb)
    change -(D ^ 2) / 2 + @inner ℝ H _ v (a i) ≤
      @inner ℝ H _ v b
    rw [inner_sub_right] at hinner
    nlinarith
  have hconvex : Convex ℝ L := by
    exact convex_halfSpace_ge (innerₗ H v).isLinear
      (-(D ^ 2) / 2 + @inner ℝ H _ v (a i))
  have hzL : z ∈ L := convexHull_min hsub hconvex hz
  change -(D ^ 2) / 2 + @inner ℝ H _ v (a i) ≤
    @inner ℝ H _ v z at hzL
  rw [inner_sub_right]
  linarith

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_compact_rounding_sq_le
statement:
theorem exists_compact_rounding_sq_le
    (S : I → Set H) (z : I → H) (D : ℝ)
    (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hcompact : ∀ i, IsCompact (S i))
    (hne : ∀ i, (S i).Nonempty)
    (hz : ∀ i, z i ∈ convexHull ℝ (S i))
    (hdiam : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ S i, ∀ y ∈ S i, ‖x - y‖ ≤ D) :
    ∃ a : I → H,
      (∀ i, a i ∈ S i) ∧
      ‖∑ i, (a i - z i)‖ ^ 2 ≤ (Fintype.card I : ℝ) * D ^ 2 / 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hmin⟩ :=
    exists_minimal_compact_rounding S z hcompact hne
  let v : H := ∑ i, (a i - z i)
  have hcoord (i : I) :
      -(D ^ 2) / 2 ≤ @inner ℝ H _ v (z i - a i) := by
    apply inner_lower_bound_on_convexHull_of_minimal S a v i D hD
    · intro b hb
      dsimp only [v]
      exact minimal_rounding_coordinate S z a ha hmin i hb
    · intro b hb
      exact hdiam i b hb (a i) (ha i)
    · exact hz i
  have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum
    (s := (Finset.univ : Finset I)) (fun i _ => hcoord i)
  have hinner_sum :
      (∑ i, @inner ℝ H _ v (z i - a i)) = -(‖v‖ ^ 2) := by
    rw [← inner_sum]
    have hneg : (∑ i, (z i - a i)) = -v := by
      dsimp only [v]
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      abel
    rw [hneg, inner_neg_right, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
  rw [hinner_sum] at hsum
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul] at hsum
  refine ⟨a, ha, ?_⟩
  change ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ _
  nlinarith

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_compact_rounding_norm_le_sqrt_card_mul
statement:
theorem exists_compact_rounding_norm_le_sqrt_card_mul
    (S : I → Set H) (z : I → H) (D : ℝ)
    (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hcompact : ∀ i, IsCompact (S i))
    (hne : ∀ i, (S i).Nonempty)
    (hz : ∀ i, z i ∈ convexHull ℝ (S i))
    (hdiam : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ S i, ∀ y ∈ S i, ‖x - y‖ ≤ D) :
    ∃ a : I → H,
      (∀ i, a i ∈ S i) ∧
      ‖∑ i, (a i - z i)‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (Fintype.card I) * D
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hsq⟩ :=
    exists_compact_rounding_sq_le S z D hD hcompact hne hz hdiam
  refine ⟨a, ha, ?_⟩
  have hcard_nonneg : 0 ≤ (Fintype.card I : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hsq' :
      ‖∑ i, (a i - z i)‖ ^ 2 ≤ (Fintype.card I : ℝ) * D ^ 2 := by
    calc
      ‖∑ i, (a i - z i)‖ ^ 2 ≤
          (Fintype.card I : ℝ) * D ^ 2 / 2 := hsq
      _ ≤ (Fintype.card I : ℝ) * D ^ 2 := by
        have hnonneg : 0 ≤ (Fintype.card I : ℝ) * D ^ 2 := by
          positivity
        linarith
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _)
    (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hD)).mp
  calc
    ‖∑ i, (a i - z i)‖ ^ 2 ≤
        (Fintype.card I : ℝ) * D ^ 2 := hsq'
    _ = (Real.sqrt (Fintype.card I) * D) ^ 2 := by
      rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hcard_nonneg]

name: RandomSetTheory.shapleyFolkmanStarr
statement:
theorem shapleyFolkmanStarr
    [Nonempty I] [FiniteDimensional ℝ H]
    (S : I → Set H) (x : I → H) (D : ℝ)
    (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hcompact : ∀ i, IsCompact (S i))
    (hne : ∀ i, (S i).Nonempty)
    (hx : ∀ i, x i ∈ convexHull ℝ (S i))
    (hdiam : ∀ i, ∀ a ∈ S i, ∀ b ∈ S i, ‖a - b‖ ≤ D) :
    ∃ a : I → H,
      (∀ i, a i ∈ S i) ∧
      ‖(∑ i, a i) - ∑ i, x i‖ ≤
        Real.sqrt (finrank ℝ H) * D
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨J, z, hJ, hz_out, hz_in, hsum_z⟩ :=
    shapleyFolkman S x hx
  let SJ : J → Set H := fun q => S q
  let zJ : J → H := fun q => z q
  have hzJ (q : J) : zJ q ∈ convexHull ℝ (SJ q) :=
    hz_in q q.property
  obtain ⟨aJ, haJ, hroundJ⟩ :=
    exists_compact_rounding_norm_le_sqrt_card_mul SJ zJ D hD
      (fun q => hcompact q) (fun q => hne q) hzJ
      (fun q => hdiam q)
  let a : I → H := fun i =>
    if hi : i ∈ J then aJ ⟨i, hi⟩ else z i
  have ha (i : I) : a i ∈ S i := by
    by_cases hi : i ∈ J
    · simpa [a, hi, SJ] using haJ ⟨i, hi⟩
    · simpa [a, hi] using hz_out i hi
  have herror :
      (∑ i, a i) - ∑ i, x i =
        ∑ q : J, (aJ q - zJ q) := by
    rw [← hsum_z, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    have hglobal :
        ∑ i, (a i - z i) = ∑ q : J, (aJ q - zJ q) := by
      calc
        ∑ i, (a i - z i) = ∑ i ∈ J, (a i - z i) := by
          symm
          apply Finset.sum_subset (by simp)
          intro i hi_univ hiJ
          simp [a, hiJ]
        _ = ∑ q : J, (a q - z q) := by
          simpa only [Finset.attach_eq_univ] using
            (J.sum_attach (fun i => a i - z i)).symm
        _ = ∑ q : J, (aJ q - zJ q) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro q hq
          simp [a, q.property, zJ]
    exact hglobal
  refine ⟨a, ha, ?_⟩
  rw [herror]
  have hcard_cast :
      (Fintype.card J : ℝ) ≤ (finrank ℝ H : ℝ) := by
    simp only [Fintype.card_coe]
    exact_mod_cast hJ
  calc
    ‖∑ q : J, (aJ q - zJ q)‖ ≤
        Real.sqrt (Fintype.card J) * D := hroundJ
    _ ≤ Real.sqrt (finrank ℝ H) * D := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hcard_cast) hD

name: RandomSetTheory.shapleyFolkmanStarr_continuousLinearMap
statement:
theorem shapleyFolkmanStarr_continuousLinearMap
    {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
    [Nonempty I] [FiniteDimensional ℝ H]
    (f : H →L[ℝ] F)
    (S : I → Set H) (x : I → H) (D : ℝ)
    (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hcompact : ∀ i, IsCompact (S i))
    (hne : ∀ i, (S i).Nonempty)
    (hx : ∀ i, x i ∈ convexHull ℝ (S i))
    (hdiam : ∀ i, ∀ a ∈ S i, ∀ b ∈ S i, ‖a - b‖ ≤ D) :
    ∃ a : I → H,
      (∀ i, a i ∈ S i) ∧
      ‖(∑ i, f (a i)) - ∑ i, f (x i)‖ ≤
        ‖f‖ * (Real.sqrt (finrank ℝ H) * D)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, herr⟩ :=
    shapleyFolkmanStarr S x D hD hcompact hne hx hdiam
  refine ⟨a, ha, ?_⟩
  calc
    ‖(∑ i, f (a i)) - ∑ i, f (x i)‖ =
        ‖f ((∑ i, a i) - ∑ i, x i)‖ := by
      rw [map_sub, map_sum, map_sum]
    _ ≤ ‖f‖ * ‖(∑ i, a i) - ∑ i, x i‖ := f.le_opNorm _
    _ ≤ ‖f‖ * (Real.sqrt (finrank ℝ H) * D) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left herr (norm_nonneg f)

name: RandomSetTheory.isCompact_finset_minkowski_sum
statement:
theorem isCompact_finset_minkowski_sum
    (s : Finset I) (S : I → Set H)
    (hS : ∀ i ∈ s, IsCompact (S i)) : IsCompact (∑ i ∈ s, S i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simpa using (isCompact_singleton : IsCompact ({0} : Set H))
  | @insert a s ha ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_insert ha]
      exact (hS a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)).add <|
        ih fun i hi => hS i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)

name: RandomSetTheory.nonempty_finset_minkowski_sum
statement:
theorem nonempty_finset_minkowski_sum
    (s : Finset I) (S : I → Set H)
    (hS : ∀ i ∈ s, (S i).Nonempty) : (∑ i ∈ s, S i).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simpa using (Set.singleton_nonempty (0 : H))
  | @insert a s ha ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_insert ha]
      exact (hS a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)).add <|
        ih fun i hi => hS i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_mem_sum_dist_le_of_mem_convexHull_sum
statement:
theorem exists_mem_sum_dist_le_of_mem_convexHull_sum
    [Nonempty I] [FiniteDimensional ℝ H]
    (S : I → Set H) (D : ℝ)
    (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hcompact : ∀ i, IsCompact (S i))
    (hne : ∀ i, (S i).Nonempty)
    (hdiam : ∀ i, ∀ a ∈ S i, ∀ b ∈ S i, ‖a - b‖ ≤ D)
    {y : H} (hy : y ∈ convexHull ℝ (∑ i, S i)) :
    ∃ s ∈ ∑ i, S i,
      dist s y ≤ Real.sqrt (finrank ℝ H) * D
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [convexHull_sum] at hy
  rw [Set.mem_fintype_sum] at hy
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hsumx⟩ := hy
  obtain ⟨a, ha, herr⟩ :=
    shapleyFolkmanStarr S x D hD hcompact hne hx hdiam
  refine ⟨∑ i, a i, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Set.mem_fintype_sum]
    exact ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
  · rw [← hsumx, dist_eq_norm]
    exact herr

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_sum_convexHull_sum_le
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_sum_convexHull_sum_le
    [Nonempty I] [FiniteDimensional ℝ H]
    (S : I → Set H) (D : ℝ)
    (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hcompact : ∀ i, IsCompact (S i))
    (hne : ∀ i, (S i).Nonempty)
    (hdiam : ∀ i, ∀ a ∈ S i, ∀ b ∈ S i, ‖a - b‖ ≤ D) :
    hausdorffDist (∑ i, S i) (convexHull ℝ (∑ i, S i)) ≤
      Real.sqrt (finrank ℝ H) * D
proof:
:= by
  apply hausdorffDist_le_of_mem_dist
    (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hD)
  · intro x hx
    exact ⟨x, (subset_convexHull ℝ (∑ i, S i)) hx,
      dist_self x ▸ mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hD⟩
  · intro y hy
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hsy⟩ := exists_mem_sum_dist_le_of_mem_convexHull_sum
      S D hD hcompact hne hdiam hy
    exact ⟨s, hs, by rwa [dist_comm]⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_average_sum_closedConvexHull_le_starr
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_average_sum_closedConvexHull_le_starr
    [Nonempty I] [FiniteDimensional ℝ H]
    (S : I → Set H) (D : ℝ)
    (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hcompact : ∀ i, IsCompact (S i))
    (hne : ∀ i, (S i).Nonempty)
    (hdiam : ∀ i, ∀ a ∈ S i, ∀ b ∈ S i, ‖a - b‖ ≤ D) :
    hausdorffDist
        (((Fintype.card I : ℝ)⁻¹) • ∑ i, S i)
        (closedConvexHull ℝ
          (((Fintype.card I : ℝ)⁻¹) • ∑ i, S i)) ≤
      (Fintype.card I : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        (Real.sqrt (finrank ℝ H) * D)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let c : ℝ := (Fintype.card I : ℝ)⁻¹
  let K : Set H := c • ∑ i, S i
  have hc : 0 ≤ c := inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  have hsum_compact : IsCompact (∑ i, S i) :=
    isCompact_finset_minkowski_sum Finset.univ S
      (fun i _ => hcompact i)
  have hsum_ne : (∑ i, S i).Nonempty :=
    nonempty_finset_minkowski_sum Finset.univ S
      (fun i _ => hne i)
  have hKcompact : IsCompact K := hsum_compact.smul c
  have hKne : K.Nonempty := hsum_ne.smul_set (a := c)
  apply hausdorffDist_self_closedConvexHull_le_of_convexHull_approx
    hKcompact hKne
  · exact mul_nonneg hc (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hD)
  · intro x hx
    change x ∈ convexHull ℝ (c • ∑ i, S i) at hx
    rw [convexHull_smul] at hx
    obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hwu⟩ :=
      exists_mem_sum_dist_le_of_mem_convexHull_sum
        S D hD hcompact hne hdiam hu
    refine ⟨c • w, ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [dist_smul₀, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hc]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by rwa [dist_comm] at hwu) hc

name: RandomSetTheory.shapleyFolkman_of_sparse_component_support
statement:
theorem shapleyFolkman_of_sparse_component_support
    (I : Finset ι) (S : ι → Set E) {x : E} {d : ℕ}
    (z : I → E) (T : I → Finset E)
    (hsub : ∀ i, (T i : Set E) ⊆ S i)
    (hmem : ∀ i, z i ∈ convexHull ℝ (T i : Set E))
    (hsum : (∑ i, z i) = x)
    (hne : ∀ i, (T i).Nonempty)
    (htotal : (∑ i, #(T i)) ≤ Fintype.card I + d) :
    ∃ J : Finset I,
      #J ≤ d ∧
      (∀ i ∉ J, z i ∈ S i) ∧
      (∀ i ∈ J, z i ∈ convexHull ℝ (S i)) ∧
      (∑ i, z i) = x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let J : Finset I := Finset.univ.filter fun i ↦ 1 < #(T i)
  refine ⟨J, card_exceptional_supports_le T hne htotal, ?_, ?_, hsum⟩
  · intro i hi
    have hnot : ¬1 < #(T i) := by
      simpa [J] using hi
    have hcard : #(T i) = 1 := by
      have hpos := (hne i).card_pos
      omega
    exact mem_set_of_mem_convexHull_card_eq_one (hsub i) hcard (hmem i)
  · intro i _hi
    exact convexHull_mono (hsub i) (hmem i)

name: RandomSetTheory.effrosMeasurable_iUnion
statement:
theorem effrosMeasurable_iUnion
    {Ω X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [TopologicalSpace X]
    {S : ℕ → Ω → Set X} (hS : ∀ n, RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable (S n)) :
    RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable (fun ω => ⋃ n, S n ω)
proof:
:= by
  intro U hU
  have hEq :
      {ω | ((⋃ n, S n ω) ∩ U).Nonempty} =
        ⋃ n, {ω | (S n ω ∩ U).Nonempty} := by
    ext ω
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, hx, hxU⟩
      rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx with ⟨n, hxn⟩
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨n, x, hxn, hxU⟩
    · intro hω
      rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hω with ⟨n, x, hxn, hxU⟩
      exact ⟨x, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨n, hxn⟩, hxU⟩
  rw [hEq]
  exact MeasurableSet.iUnion fun n => hS n U hU

name: RandomSetTheory.effrosMeasurable_closure
statement:
theorem effrosMeasurable_closure
    {Ω X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [TopologicalSpace X]
    {S : Ω → Set X} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S) :
    RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable (fun ω => closure (S ω))
proof:
:= by
  intro U hU
  have hEq :
      {ω | (closure (S ω) ∩ U).Nonempty} =
        {ω | (S ω ∩ U).Nonempty} := by
    ext ω
    exact closure_inter_open_nonempty_iff hU
  rw [hEq]
  exact hS U hU

name: RandomSetTheory.continuous_convexJoinMap
statement:
theorem continuous_convexJoinMap
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] :
    Continuous (convexJoinMap : (E × E) × ℝ → E)
proof:
:= by
  unfold convexJoinMap
  simp only [AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module]
  fun_prop

name: RandomSetTheory.convexJoin_eq_image
statement:
theorem convexJoin_eq_image
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (A B : Set E) :
    convexJoin ℝ A B =
      convexJoinMap '' ((A ×ˢ B) ×ˢ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  constructor
  · rw [mem_convexJoin]
    rintro ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hz⟩
    rw [segment_eq_image_lineMap] at hz
    rcases hz with ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨((x, y), t), ⟨⟨hx, hy⟩, ht⟩, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨⟨x, y⟩, t⟩, ⟨⟨hx, hy⟩, ht⟩, rfl⟩
    rw [mem_convexJoin]
    exact ⟨x, hx, y, hy, lineMap_mem_segment ℝ x y ht⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.isCompact_convexJoin
statement:
theorem isCompact_convexJoin
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {A B : Set E} (hA : IsCompact A) (hB : IsCompact B) :
    IsCompact (convexJoin ℝ A B)
proof:
:= by
  rw [convexJoin_eq_image]
  exact ((hA.prod hB).prod isCompact_Icc).image continuous_convexJoinMap

name: RandomSetTheory.nonempty_convexJoin
statement:
theorem nonempty_convexJoin
    {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    {A B : Set E} (hA : A.Nonempty) (hB : B.Nonempty) :
    (convexJoin ℝ A B).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  rcases hA with ⟨x, hx⟩
  rcases hB with ⟨y, hy⟩
  exact ⟨x, segment_subset_convexJoin hx hy (left_mem_segment ℝ x y)⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.effrosMeasurable_convexJoin_of_closed
statement:
theorem effrosMeasurable_convexJoin_of_closed
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    {S T : Ω → Set E}
    (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hT : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable T)
    (hSclosed : ∀ ω, IsClosed (S ω))
    (hTclosed : ∀ ω, IsClosed (T ω))
    (hSne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    (hTne : ∀ ω, (T ω).Nonempty) :
    RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable (fun ω => convexJoin ℝ (S ω) (T ω))
proof:
:= by
  let P : Ω → Set ((E × E) × ℝ) := fun ω =>
    ((S ω ×ˢ T ω) ×ˢ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
  have hST : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable (fun ω => S ω ×ˢ T ω) :=
    hS.prod hT hSclosed hTclosed hSne hTne
  have hP : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable P :=
    hST.prod (RandomSet.isEffrosMeasurable_const (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1))
      (fun ω => (hSclosed ω).prod (hTclosed ω))
      (fun _ => isClosed_Icc)
      (fun ω => (hSne ω).prod (hTne ω))
      (fun _ => nonempty_Icc.2 zero_le_one)
  have himage := hP.image continuous_convexJoinMap
  apply himage.congr
  intro ω
  exact (convexJoin_eq_image (S ω) (T ω)).symm

name: RandomSetTheory.effrosMeasurable_convexJoin
statement:
theorem effrosMeasurable_convexJoin
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    {S T : Ω → Set E}
    (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hT : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable T)
    (hScompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hTcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (T ω))
    (hSne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    (hTne : ∀ ω, (T ω).Nonempty) :
    RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable (fun ω => convexJoin ℝ (S ω) (T ω))
proof:
:=
  effrosMeasurable_convexJoin_of_closed hS hT
    (fun ω => (hScompact ω).isClosed)
    (fun ω => (hTcompact ω).isClosed) hSne hTne

name: RandomSetTheory.convexJoinIterate_mono_nat
statement:
theorem convexJoinIterate_mono_nat
    {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    {S : Set E} (hS : S.Nonempty) {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n) :
    convexJoinIterate S m ⊆ convexJoinIterate S n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      have : m = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hmn
      subst m
      exact Subset.rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      by_cases hmn' : m ≤ n
      · exact (ih hmn').trans
          (subset_convexJoin_left (convexJoinIterate_nonempty hS n))
      · have hm : m = n + 1 := by omega
        subst m
        exact Subset.rfl

  | zero => exact hSC
  | succ n ih => exact convexJoin_subset ih ih hC

name: RandomSetTheory.iUnion_convexJoinIterate_eq_convexHull
statement:
theorem iUnion_convexJoinIterate_eq_convexHull
    {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    {S : Set E} (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    (⋃ n, convexJoinIterate S n) = convexHull ℝ S
proof:
:= by
  apply Subset.antisymm
  · exact iUnion_subset (convexJoinIterate_subset_convex
      (subset_convexHull ℝ S) (convex_convexHull ℝ S))
  · apply convexHull_min
    · intro x hx
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨0, by simpa using hx⟩
    · rw [convex_iff_segment_subset]
      intro x hx y hy z hz
      rcases mem_iUnion.mp hx with ⟨m, hxm⟩
      rcases mem_iUnion.mp hy with ⟨n, hyn⟩
      let k := max m n
      have hxk : x ∈ convexJoinIterate S k :=
        convexJoinIterate_mono_nat hS (Nat.le_max_left m n) hxm
      have hyk : y ∈ convexJoinIterate S k :=
        convexJoinIterate_mono_nat hS (Nat.le_max_right m n) hyn
      exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨k + 1, segment_subset_convexJoin hxk hyk hz⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.closure_iUnion_convexJoinIterate_eq_closedConvexHull

statement:
theorem convex_iUnion_closedConvexJoinIterate
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {S : Set E} (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    Convex ℝ (⋃ n, closedConvexJoinIterate S n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [convex_iff_segment_subset]
  intro x hx y hy z hz
  rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx with ⟨m, hxm⟩
  rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hy with ⟨n, hyn⟩
  let k := max m n
  have hxk : x ∈ closedConvexJoinIterate S k :=
    closedConvexJoinIterate_mono_nat hS (Nat.le_max_left m n) hxm
  have hyk : y ∈ closedConvexJoinIterate S k :=
    closedConvexJoinIterate_mono_nat hS (Nat.le_max_right m n) hyn
  exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨k + 1,
    subset_closure (segment_subset_convexJoin hxk hyk hz)⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.closure_iUnion_closedConvexJoinIterate_eq_closedConvexHull
statement:
theorem closure_iUnion_closedConvexJoinIterate_eq_closedConvexHull
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {S : Set E} (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    closure (⋃ n, closedConvexJoinIterate S n) =
      closedConvexHull ℝ S
proof:
:= by
  apply Subset.antisymm
  · apply closure_minimal
    · exact iUnion_subset (closedConvexJoinIterate_subset_closedConvex
        (subset_closedConvexHull (𝕜 := ℝ)) convex_closedConvexHull
        isClosed_closedConvexHull)
    · exact isClosed_closedConvexHull
  · apply closedConvexHull_min
    · intro x hx
      exact subset_closure (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨0, by simpa using hx⟩)
    · exact (convex_iUnion_closedConvexJoinIterate hS).closure
    · exact isClosed_closure

name: RandomSetTheory.effrosMeasurable_convexJoinIterate
statement:
theorem effrosMeasurable_convexJoinIterate
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    {S : Ω → Set E}
    (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hScompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hSne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty) :
    ∀ n, RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable
      (fun ω => convexJoinIterate (S ω) n)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using hS
  | succ n ih =>
      exact effrosMeasurable_convexJoin ih ih
        (fun ω => convexJoinIterate_compact (hScompact ω) n)
        (fun ω => convexJoinIterate_compact (hScompact ω) n)
        (fun ω => convexJoinIterate_nonempty (hSne ω) n)
        (fun ω => convexJoinIterate_nonempty (hSne ω) n)

name: RandomSetTheory.effrosMeasurable_closedConvexJoinIterate
statement:
theorem effrosMeasurable_closedConvexJoinIterate
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    {S : Ω → Set E}
    (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hSclosed : ∀ ω, IsClosed (S ω))
    (hSne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty) :
    ∀ n, RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable
      (fun ω => closedConvexJoinIterate (S ω) n)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using hS
  | succ n ih =>
      have hJoin := effrosMeasurable_convexJoin_of_closed ih ih
        (fun ω => closedConvexJoinIterate_isClosed (hSclosed ω) n)
        (fun ω => closedConvexJoinIterate_isClosed (hSclosed ω) n)
        (fun ω => closedConvexJoinIterate_nonempty (hSne ω) n)
        (fun ω => closedConvexJoinIterate_nonempty (hSne ω) n)
      simpa using effrosMeasurable_closure hJoin

name: RandomSetTheory.effrosMeasurable_closedConvexHull_of_compact
statement:
theorem effrosMeasurable_closedConvexHull_of_compact
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]

  have hUnion : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable
      (fun ω => ⋃ n, convexJoinIterate (S ω) n) :=
    effrosMeasurable_iUnion

  have hClosure := effrosMeasurable_closure hUnion

  exact closure_iUnion_convexJoinIterate_eq_closedConvexHull (hSne ω)
