name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_unitBall_finite_centeredTruncated_largeDeviation_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_unitBall_finite_centeredTruncated_largeDeviation_le
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (H : Z → E → ℝ) (R : Z → ℝ) {M K x : ℝ}
    (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hK : 0 < K) (hx : 0 ≤ x)
    (c : ℝ≥0) (hc : 0 < c)
    (X : iota → Omega → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X mu)
    (hHmeas : ∀ t, Measurable (fun z ↦ H z t))
    (hHcont : ∀ z, Continuous (H z)) (hRmeas : Measurable R)
    (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (hLip : ∀ z s t, |H z s - H z t| ≤ R z * dist s t)
    (I : Finset iota) (hI : I.Nonempty)
    (hRL2 : ∀ i ∈ I, MemLp (fun omega ↦ R (X i omega)) 2 mu)
    (hRsecond : ∀ i ∈ I, ∫ omega, R (X i omega) ^ 2 ∂mu ≤ K ^ 2) :
    let G : Omega → EuclideanUnitBall E → ℝ := fun omega t ↦
      centeredAnchoredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess (mu := mu) H R M (c : ℝ)
        X I 0 omega (t : E)
    mu.real {omega | ∃ t : EuclideanUnitBall E,
      mixedEuclideanProcessBound
          (finiteTruncatedGaussianScale I c K)
          (finiteTruncatedLinearScale c M) (finrank ℝ E) x <
        |G omega t|} ≤ Real.exp (-x)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let sigma2 : ℝ := finiteTruncatedGaussianScale I c K
  let sigma1 : ℝ := finiteTruncatedLinearScale c M
  let G : Omega → EuclideanUnitBall E → ℝ := fun omega t ↦
    centeredAnchoredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess (mu := mu) H R M (c : ℝ)
      X I 0 omega (t : E)
  apply measureReal_unitBall_mixedProcess_largeDeviation_le
    G (finiteTruncatedGaussianScale_nonneg I c hK.le)
      (finiteTruncatedLinearScale_nonneg c hM) hx
  · intro omega
    exact (continuous_centeredAnchoredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess
      H R hM X hX hHmeas hHcont hRmeas hR hLip I 0 omega).comp
        continuous_subtype_val
  · intro omega
    exact centeredAnchoredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess_anchor
      H R M (c : ℝ) X I 0 omega
  · intro s t y hy
    by_cases hst : s = t
    · subst t
      simp only [dist_self, mul_zero, zero_mul, add_zero, sub_self, abs_zero,
        lt_self_iff_false, Set.setOf_false, measureReal_empty]
      positivity
    · have hdist : 0 < dist s t := dist_pos.mpr hst
      let v : ℝ≥0 := c ^ 2 *
        ∑ _i ∈ I, nnrealOfNonneg (2 * (K * dist s t) ^ 2) (by positivity)
      let b : ℝ≥0 := c *
        nnrealOfNonneg (2 * (M * dist s t)) (by positivity)
      have hmgf : HasBernsteinMGF
          (fun omega ↦ (c : ℝ) * ∑ i ∈ I,
            (truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X i (s : E) (t : E) omega -
              ∫ xi, truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X i
                (s : E) (t : E) xi ∂mu)) v b mu := by
        simpa only [v, b, Subtype.dist_eq] using
          (hasBernsteinMGF_centeredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess_increment
            (μ := mu) H R c hM hK.le X hX hIndep hHmeas hRmeas hR hLip I
              hRL2 hRsecond (s : E) (t : E))
      have hvpos : 0 < (v : ℝ) := by
        dsimp only [v]
        push_cast
        simp only [coe_nnrealOfNonneg, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
        have hcard : 0 < (I.card : ℝ) := by
          exact_mod_cast Finset.card_pos.mpr hI
        positivity
      have htail := hmgf.measureReal_abs_gt_mixedThreshold_le hy hvpos
      have hv : (v : ℝ) = (sigma2 * dist s t) ^ 2 := by
        dsimp only [v, sigma2, finiteTruncatedGaussianScale]
        push_cast
        simp only [coe_nnrealOfNonneg, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
        have hsqrtcard :
            (Real.sqrt (2 * (I.card : ℝ))) ^ 2 = 2 * (I.card : ℝ) := by
          rw [Real.sq_sqrt]
          positivity
        calc
          (c : ℝ) ^ 2 * ((I.card : ℝ) *
              (2 * (K * dist s t) ^ 2)) =
              (2 * (I.card : ℝ)) * (c : ℝ) ^ 2 * K ^ 2 *
                dist s t ^ 2 := by ring
          _ = (Real.sqrt (2 * (I.card : ℝ))) ^ 2 * (c : ℝ) ^ 2 *
                K ^ 2 * dist s t ^ 2 := by rw [hsqrtcard]
          _ = (Real.sqrt (2 * (I.card : ℝ)) * (c : ℝ) * K *
                dist s t) ^ 2 := by ring
      have hb : (b : ℝ) = sigma1 * dist s t := by
        dsimp only [b, sigma1, finiteTruncatedLinearScale]
        push_cast
        simp only [coe_nnrealOfNonneg]
        ring
      have hsigmaDist : 0 ≤ sigma2 * dist s t := by
        dsimp only [sigma2]
        exact mul_nonneg (finiteTruncatedGaussianScale_nonneg I c hK.le)
          dist_nonneg
      have hsqrt :
          Real.sqrt (2 * (v : ℝ) * y) =
            sigma2 * dist s t * Real.sqrt (2 * y) := by
        have hleft : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * (v : ℝ) * y) :=
          Real.sqrt_nonneg _
        have hright :
            0 ≤ sigma2 * dist s t * Real.sqrt (2 * y) :=
          mul_nonneg hsigmaDist (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
        have hleftsq :
            (Real.sqrt (2 * (v : ℝ) * y)) ^ 2 =
              2 * (v : ℝ) * y := by
          rw [Real.sq_sqrt]
          positivity
        have hrightsq :
            (sigma2 * dist s t * Real.sqrt (2 * y)) ^ 2 =
              2 * (v : ℝ) * y := by
          rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt]
          · rw [hv]
            ring
          · positivity
        nlinarith
      have hthreshold :
          bernsteinMixedThreshold (v : ℝ) (b : ℝ) y =
            sigma2 * dist s t * Real.sqrt (2 * y) +
              2 * sigma1 * dist s t * y := by
        unfold bernsteinMixedThreshold
        rw [hsqrt, hb]
        ring
      have hsub : ∀ omega, G omega s - G omega t =
          (c : ℝ) * ∑ i ∈ I,
            (truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X i (s : E) (t : E) omega -
              ∫ xi, truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X i
                (s : E) (t : E) xi ∂mu) := by
        intro omega
        exact centeredAnchoredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess_sub
          H R hM X hX hHmeas hRmeas hR hLip I 0 omega (s : E) (t : E)
      simpa only [G, hsub, hthreshold, Subtype.dist_eq, sigma2, sigma1]
        using htail

name: RandomSetTheory.variance_directionalSupportDeviation_eq_supportFunction
statement:
theorem variance_directionalSupportDeviation_eq_supportFunction
    {Omega E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (S : ℕ → Omega → Set E) (L : Set E) (u : E)
    (hmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable
      (fun omega => supportFunction (S 0 omega) u) mu) :
    Var[directionalSupportDeviation S L u 0; mu] =
      Var[fun omega => supportFunction (S 0 omega) u; mu]
proof:
:= by
  change Var[fun omega =>
    supportFunction (S 0 omega) u - supportFunction L u; mu] = _
  exact variance_sub_const hmeas (supportFunction L u)

name: RandomSetTheory.covariance_directionalSupportDeviation_eq_supportFunction
statement:
theorem covariance_directionalSupportDeviation_eq_supportFunction
    {Omega E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (S : ℕ → Omega → Set E) (L : Set E) (u v : E)
    (hu : Integrable (fun omega => supportFunction (S 0 omega) u) mu)
    (hv : Integrable (fun omega => supportFunction (S 0 omega) v) mu) :
    cov[directionalSupportDeviation S L u 0,
        directionalSupportDeviation S L v 0; mu] =
      cov[fun omega => supportFunction (S 0 omega) u,
        fun omega => supportFunction (S 0 omega) v; mu]
proof:
:= by
  change cov[fun omega =>
      supportFunction (S 0 omega) u - supportFunction L u,
    fun omega => supportFunction (S 0 omega) v - supportFunction L v; mu] = _
  rw [covariance_sub_const_left hu, covariance_sub_const_right hv]

name: RandomSetTheory.tendstoInDistribution_directionalSupportDeviation_sum
statement:
theorem tendstoInDistribution_directionalSupportDeviation_sum
    {Omega Omega' E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega] [MeasurableSpace Omega']
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    {mu : Measure Omega} {mu' : Measure Omega'}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu']
    (S : ℕ → Omega → Set E) (L : Set E) (u : E) (Y : Omega' → ℝ)
    (hY : HasLaw Y
      (gaussianReal 0
        Var[directionalSupportDeviation S L u 0; mu].toNNReal) mu')
    (hL2 : MemLp (directionalSupportDeviation S L u 0) 2 mu)
    (hindep : iIndepFun (directionalSupportDeviation S L u) mu)
    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib
      (directionalSupportDeviation S L u i)
      (directionalSupportDeviation S L u 0) mu mu)
    (hcenter : mu[directionalSupportDeviation S L u 0] = 0) :
    TendstoInDistribution
      (fun (n : ℕ) omega => (√n)⁻¹ *
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, directionalSupportDeviation S L u i omega)
      atTop Y (fun _ => mu) mu'
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [hcenter, Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero, sub_zero] using
    (tendstoInDistribution_inv_sqrt_mul_sum_sub hY hL2 hindep hident)

name: RandomSetTheory.tendstoInDistribution_directionalSupportDeviation_sum_succ
statement:
theorem tendstoInDistribution_directionalSupportDeviation_sum_succ
    {Omega Omega' E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega] [MeasurableSpace Omega']
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    {mu : Measure Omega} {mu' : Measure Omega'}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu']
    (S : ℕ → Omega → Set E) (L : Set E) (u : E) (Y : Omega' → ℝ)
    (hY : HasLaw Y
      (gaussianReal 0
        Var[directionalSupportDeviation S L u 0; mu].toNNReal) mu')
    (hL2 : MemLp (directionalSupportDeviation S L u 0) 2 mu)
    (hindep : iIndepFun (directionalSupportDeviation S L u) mu)
    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib
      (directionalSupportDeviation S L u i)
      (directionalSupportDeviation S L u 0) mu mu)
    (hcenter : mu[directionalSupportDeviation S L u 0] = 0) :
    TendstoInDistribution
      (fun (n : ℕ) omega => (√((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))⁻¹ *
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          directionalSupportDeviation S L u i omega)
      atTop Y (fun _ => mu) mu'
proof:
:= by
  let h := tendstoInDistribution_directionalSupportDeviation_sum
    S L u Y hY hL2 hindep hident hcenter
  exact
    { forall_aemeasurable := fun n => h.forall_aemeasurable (n + 1)
      aemeasurable_limit := h.aemeasurable_limit
      tendsto := h.tendsto.comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1) }

name: RandomSetTheory.tendstoInDistribution_sqrt_mul_supportFunction_minkowskiAverage_sub
statement:
theorem tendstoInDistribution_sqrt_mul_supportFunction_minkowskiAverage_sub
    {Omega Omega' E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega] [MeasurableSpace Omega']
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    {mu : Measure Omega} {mu' : Measure Omega'}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu']
    (S : ℕ → Omega → Set E) (L : Set E) (u : E) (Y : Omega' → ℝ)
    (hScompact : ∀ i omega, IsCompact (S i omega))
    (hSne : ∀ i omega, (S i omega).Nonempty)
    (hY : HasLaw Y
      (gaussianReal 0
        Var[directionalSupportDeviation S L u 0; mu].toNNReal) mu')
    (hL2 : MemLp (directionalSupportDeviation S L u 0) 2 mu)
    (hindep : iIndepFun (directionalSupportDeviation S L u) mu)
    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib
      (directionalSupportDeviation S L u i)
      (directionalSupportDeviation S L u 0) mu mu)
    (hcenter : mu[directionalSupportDeviation S L u 0] = 0) :
    TendstoInDistribution
      (fun (n : ℕ) omega => √((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        (supportFunction
            (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range (n + 1)) (fun i => S i omega)) u -
          supportFunction L u))
      atTop Y (fun _ => mu) mu'
proof:
:= by
  have hclt :=
    tendstoInDistribution_directionalSupportDeviation_sum_succ
      S L u Y hY hL2 hindep hident hcenter
  apply hclt.congr
  · intro n
    filter_upwards [] with omega
    rw [supportFunction_minkowskiAverage_sub_eq_average_deviation
      S L (Finset.range (n + 1)) (by simp)
      (fun i _hi omega' => hScompact i omega')
      (fun i _hi omega' => hSne i omega')]
    have hn : (0 : ℝ) < (n + 1 : ℕ) := by positivity
    have hsqrt : √(n + 1 : ℕ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hn)
    field_simp
    rw [Finset.card_range, Real.sq_sqrt hn.le]
    ring
  · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => rfl)

name: RandomSetTheory.tendstoInDistribution_iid_supportFunction_minkowskiAverage
statement:
theorem tendstoInDistribution_iid_supportFunction_minkowskiAverage
    {Omega Omega' Z E : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace Omega] [MeasurableSpace Omega'] [MeasurableSpace Z]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    {mu : Measure Omega} {mu' : Measure Omega'}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu']
    (X : ℕ → Omega → Z)
    (hindep : iIndepFun X mu)
    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (F : Z → Set E) (hF : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable F)
    (hFcompact : ∀ z, IsCompact (F z))
    (hFne : ∀ z, (F z).Nonempty)
    (L : Set E) (u : E) (Y : Omega' → ℝ)
    (hY : HasLaw Y
      (gaussianReal 0
        Var[directionalSupportDeviation
          (fun i omega => F (X i omega)) L u 0; mu].toNNReal) mu')
    (hL2 : MemLp
      (directionalSupportDeviation
        (fun i omega => F (X i omega)) L u 0) 2 mu)
    (hLsupport : supportFunction L u =
      ∫ omega, supportFunction (F (X 0 omega)) u ∂mu) :
    TendstoInDistribution
      (fun (n : ℕ) omega => √((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        (supportFunction
            (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range (n + 1))
              (fun i => F (X i omega))) u -
          supportFunction L u))
      atTop Y (fun _ => mu) mu'
proof:
:= by
  let S : ℕ → Omega → Set E := fun i omega => F (X i omega)
  have hsupp : Measurable (fun z => supportFunction (F z) u) :=
    measurable_supportFunction hF hFcompact hFne u
  have hdev : Measurable
      (fun z => supportFunction (F z) u - supportFunction L u) :=
    hsupp.sub_const (supportFunction L u)
  have hindepDev : iIndepFun (directionalSupportDeviation S L u) mu := by
    have h := hindep.comp
      (fun _ z => supportFunction (F z) u - supportFunction L u)
      (fun _ => hdev)
    change iIndepFun
      (fun i omega => supportFunction (F (X i omega)) u - supportFunction L u) mu
    simpa only [Function.comp_def] using h
  have hidentDev : ∀ i, IdentDistrib
      (directionalSupportDeviation S L u i)
      (directionalSupportDeviation S L u 0) mu mu := by
    intro i
    change IdentDistrib
      (fun omega => supportFunction (F (X i omega)) u - supportFunction L u)
      (fun omega => supportFunction (F (X 0 omega)) u - supportFunction L u)
      mu mu
    simpa only [Function.comp_def] using (hident i).comp hdev
  have hdevInt : Integrable (directionalSupportDeviation S L u 0) mu :=
    hL2.integrable (by norm_num)
  have hsuppInt : Integrable
      (fun omega => supportFunction (F (X 0 omega)) u) mu := by
    have h := hdevInt.add (integrable_const (supportFunction L u))
    apply h.congr
    filter_upwards [] with omega
    change (supportFunction (F (X 0 omega)) u - supportFunction L u) +
      supportFunction L u = supportFunction (F (X 0 omega)) u
    ring
  have hcenter : mu[directionalSupportDeviation S L u 0] = 0 := by
    change ∫ omega,
      (supportFunction (F (X 0 omega)) u - supportFunction L u) ∂mu = 0
    rw [integral_sub hsuppInt (integrable_const (supportFunction L u)),
      ← hLsupport]
    simp
  exact tendstoInDistribution_sqrt_mul_supportFunction_minkowskiAverage_sub
    S L u Y
    (fun i omega => hFcompact (X i omega))
    (fun i omega => hFne (X i omega))
    hY hL2 hindepDev hidentDev hcenter

name: ProbabilityTheory.upperTruncation_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem upperTruncation_apply (X : Omega → ℝ) (y : ℝ)
    (omega : Omega) :
    upperTruncation X y omega = min (X omega) y
proof: := rfl

name: ProbabilityTheory.upperTruncation_le
statement:
theorem upperTruncation_le (X : Omega → ℝ) (y : ℝ) (omega : Omega) :
    upperTruncation X y omega ≤ y
proof:
:=
  min_le_right _ _

name: ProbabilityTheory.upperTruncation_le_self
statement:
theorem upperTruncation_le_self (X : Omega → ℝ) (y : ℝ) (omega : Omega) :
    upperTruncation X y omega ≤ X omega
proof:
:=
  min_le_left _ _

name: ProbabilityTheory.measurable_upperTruncation
proof:
:= by
  exact hX.min measurable_const

name: ProbabilityTheory.aemeasurable_upperTruncation
proof:
:= by
  exact hX.min aemeasurable_const

name: ProbabilityTheory.max_mul_eq_mul_max
statement:
theorem max_mul_eq_mul_max (t x : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    max (t * x) 0 = t * max x 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_max_of_nonneg x 0 ht]
  simp

name: ProbabilityTheory.max_upperTruncation_zero_le
statement:
theorem max_upperTruncation_zero_le
    (X : Omega → ℝ) {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 ≤ y) (omega : Omega) :
    max (upperTruncation X y omega) 0 ≤ y
proof:
:= by
  exact max_le (upperTruncation_le X y omega) hy

name: ProbabilityTheory.integrable_upperTruncation
statement:
theorem integrable_upperTruncation [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    {X : Omega → ℝ} (hX : Integrable X mu) (y : ℝ) :
    Integrable (upperTruncation X y) mu
proof:
:= by
  change Integrable (X ⊓ fun _ => y) mu
  exact hX.inf (integrable_const y)

name: ProbabilityTheory.max_upperTruncation_zero_le_max_self
statement:
theorem max_upperTruncation_zero_le_max_self
    (X : Omega → ℝ) (y : ℝ) (omega : Omega) :
    max (upperTruncation X y omega) 0 ≤ max (X omega) 0
proof:
:= by
  exact max_le_max (upperTruncation_le_self X y omega) le_rfl

name: ProbabilityTheory.pow_max_upperTruncation_zero_le_pow_max_self
statement:
theorem pow_max_upperTruncation_zero_le_pow_max_self
    (X : Omega → ℝ) (y : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (omega : Omega) :
    (max (upperTruncation X y omega) 0) ^ k ≤
      (max (X omega) 0) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (le_max_right _ _)
    (max_upperTruncation_zero_le_max_self X y omega) k

name: ProbabilityTheory.sq_upperTruncation_le_sq_self
statement:
theorem sq_upperTruncation_le_sq_self
    (X : Omega → ℝ) {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 ≤ y) (omega : Omega) :
    upperTruncation X y omega ^ 2 ≤ X omega ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hxy : X omega ≤ y
  · rw [upperTruncation_apply, min_eq_left hxy]
  · have hyx : y ≤ X omega := (le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge hxy))
    rw [upperTruncation_apply, min_eq_right hyx]
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ hy hyx 2

name: ProbabilityTheory.integrable_sq_upperTruncation
statement:
theorem integrable_sq_upperTruncation
    {X : Omega → ℝ} (hX : AEMeasurable X mu)
    (hXsq : Integrable (fun omega => X omega ^ 2) mu)
    {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    Integrable (fun omega => upperTruncation X y omega ^ 2) mu
proof:
:= by
  apply Integrable.mono_nonneg hXsq
    ((aemeasurable_upperTruncation hX y).pow_const 2).aestronglyMeasurable
  · exact ae_of_all mu fun omega => sq_nonneg _
  · exact ae_of_all mu fun omega => sq_upperTruncation_le_sq_self X hy omega

name: ProbabilityTheory.integrable_pow_max_upperTruncation_zero
statement:
theorem integrable_pow_max_upperTruncation_zero
    {X : Omega → ℝ} (hX : AEMeasurable X mu) (y : ℝ) (k : ℕ)
    (hpow : Integrable (fun omega => (max (X omega) 0) ^ k) mu) :
    Integrable
      (fun omega => (max (upperTruncation X y omega) 0) ^ k) mu
proof:
:= by
  have hmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable
      (fun omega => (max (upperTruncation X y omega) 0) ^ k) mu :=
    (((aemeasurable_upperTruncation hX y).max aemeasurable_const).pow_const k)
      |>.aestronglyMeasurable
  apply Integrable.mono_nonneg hpow hmeas
  · exact ae_of_all mu fun omega => pow_nonneg (le_max_right _ _) k
  · exact ae_of_all mu fun omega =>
      pow_max_upperTruncation_zero_le_pow_max_self X y k omega

name: ProbabilityTheory.sum_strongMomentTaylorExponent
statement:
theorem sum_strongMomentTaylorExponent
    {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (q : ℕ) (t y : ℝ)
    (second : ι → ℝ) (moment : ι → ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, strongMomentTaylorExponent q t y (second i) (moment i)) =
      strongMomentTaylorExponent q t y
        (∑ i ∈ s, second i) (fun k => ∑ i ∈ s, moment i k)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfirst :
      (∑ i ∈ s, (1 / 2 : ℝ) * t ^ 2 * second i) =
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * t ^ 2 * ∑ i ∈ s, second i := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  have hmiddle :
      (∑ i ∈ s, ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 3 q,
        t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ) * moment i k) =
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 3 q,
          t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ) * ∑ i ∈ s, moment i k := by
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro k hk
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  have htail :
      (∑ i ∈ s,
        t ^ q / (q.factorial : ℝ) * Real.exp (t * y) * moment i q) =
        t ^ q / (q.factorial : ℝ) * Real.exp (t * y) *
          ∑ i ∈ s, moment i q := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  unfold strongMomentTaylorExponent
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rw [hfirst, hmiddle, htail]

name: ProbabilityTheory.integral_exp_mul_le_exp_strongMomentTaylorExponent
statement:
theorem integral_exp_mul_le_exp_strongMomentTaylorExponent
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : Omega → ℝ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    {t y : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hy : 0 ≤ y)
    (hX : Integrable X mu)
    (hXsq : Integrable (fun omega => X omega ^ 2) mu)
    (hpow : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      Integrable (fun omega => (max (X omega) 0) ^ k) mu)
    (hupper : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, X omega ≤ y)
    (hcenter : (∫ omega, X omega ∂mu) ≤ 0) :
    (∫ omega, Real.exp (t * X omega) ∂mu) ≤
      Real.exp (strongMomentTaylorExponent q t y
        (∫ omega, X omega ^ 2 ∂mu)
        (fun k => ∫ omega, (max (X omega) 0) ^ k ∂mu))
proof:
:= by
  let M : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => ∫ omega, (max (X omega) 0) ^ k ∂mu
  let V : ℝ := ∫ omega, X omega ^ 2 ∂mu
  let E : ℝ := strongMomentTaylorExponent q t y V M
  have hExp : Integrable (fun omega => Real.exp (t * X omega)) mu := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound
      ((hX.aemeasurable.const_mul t).exp.aestronglyMeasurable)
      (Real.exp (t * y))
    filter_upwards [hupper] with omega homega
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
    exact Real.exp_monotone (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left homega ht)
  have hMomentNonneg : ∀ k, 0 ≤ M k := by
    intro k
    exact integral_nonneg fun omega => pow_nonneg (le_max_right _ _) k
  have hVNonneg : 0 ≤ V := integral_nonneg fun omega => sq_nonneg _
  have hENonneg : 0 ≤ E := by
    unfold E strongMomentTaylorExponent
    have hsum : 0 ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 3 q,
        t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ) * M k := by
      positivity
    positivity
  have hfiniteInt : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Ico 3 q,
      Integrable (fun omega =>
        (t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) * (max (X omega) 0) ^ k) mu := by
    intro k hk
    exact (hpow k (Finset.mem_Icc.mpr
      ⟨(mem_Ico.mp hk).1.trans' (by norm_num),
        (mem_Ico.mp hk).2.le⟩)).const_mul _
  have htailInt : Integrable (fun omega =>
      (t ^ q / (q.factorial : ℝ) * Real.exp (t * y)) *
        (max (X omega) 0) ^ q) mu :=
    (hpow q (Finset.mem_Icc.mpr
      ⟨hq.trans' (by norm_num), le_rfl⟩)).const_mul _
  have hmajorantInt : Integrable (fun omega =>
      1 + t * X omega + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (t * X omega) ^ 2 +
        (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 3 q,
          (t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) * (max (X omega) 0) ^ k) +
        (t ^ q / (q.factorial : ℝ) * Real.exp (t * y)) *
          (max (X omega) 0) ^ q) mu := by
    have hlin : Integrable (fun omega => t * X omega) mu := hX.const_mul t
    have hquad : Integrable
        (fun omega => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (t * X omega) ^ 2) mu := by
      have hs : Integrable (fun omega => (t * X omega) ^ 2) mu := by
        convert hXsq.const_mul (t ^ 2) using 1
        ext omega
        ring
      exact hs.const_mul _
    have hsumInt : Integrable (fun omega =>
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 3 q,
          (t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) * (max (X omega) 0) ^ k) mu := by
      exact integrable_finsetSum _ hfiniteInt
    have hshape :
        (fun omega =>
          1 + t * X omega + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (t * X omega) ^ 2 +
            (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 3 q,
              (t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) * (max (X omega) 0) ^ k) +
            (t ^ q / (q.factorial : ℝ) * Real.exp (t * y)) *
              (max (X omega) 0) ^ q) =
          ((((fun _ : Omega => (1 : ℝ)) + (fun omega => t * X omega)) +
              (fun omega => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (t * X omega) ^ 2)) +
            (fun omega => ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 3 q,
              (t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) * (max (X omega) 0) ^ k)) +
            (fun omega =>
              (t ^ q / (q.factorial : ℝ) * Real.exp (t * y)) *
                (max (X omega) 0) ^ q) := by
      funext omega
      simp only [Pi.add_apply]
    rw [hshape]
    exact (((((integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).add hlin).add hquad).add
      hsumInt).add htailInt)
  have hpoint : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      Real.exp (t * X omega) ≤
        1 + t * X omega + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (t * X omega) ^ 2 +
          (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 3 q,
            (t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) * (max (X omega) 0) ^ k) +
          (t ^ q / (q.factorial : ℝ) * Real.exp (t * y)) *
            (max (X omega) 0) ^ q := by
    filter_upwards [hupper] with omega homega
    have hTaylor := exp_le_oneSidedExpTaylorBound q hq (t * X omega)
    have hmax : max (t * X omega) 0 = t * max (X omega) 0 :=
      max_mul_eq_mul_max t (X omega) ht
    have hmaxUpper : max (X omega) 0 ≤ y := max_le homega hy
    have hexpUpper : Real.exp (t * max (X omega) 0) ≤ Real.exp (t * y) :=
      Real.exp_monotone (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmaxUpper ht)
    unfold oneSidedExpTaylorBound at hTaylor
    rw [hmax] at hTaylor
    have hsumEq :
        (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 3 q,
          (t * max (X omega) 0) ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) =
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 3 q,
          (t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) * (max (X omega) 0) ^ k := by
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro k _hk
      rw [mul_pow]
      ring
    have htailEq :
        (t * max (X omega) 0) ^ q / (q.factorial : ℝ) *
            Real.exp (t * max (X omega) 0) =
          (t ^ q / (q.factorial : ℝ) *
              Real.exp (t * max (X omega) 0)) *
            (max (X omega) 0) ^ q := by
      rw [mul_pow]
      ring
    rw [hsumEq, htailEq] at hTaylor
    have hcoefNonneg : 0 ≤
        t ^ q / (q.factorial : ℝ) * (max (X omega) 0) ^ q := by
      positivity
    have htailBound :
        (t ^ q / (q.factorial : ℝ) *
            Real.exp (t * max (X omega) 0)) *
              (max (X omega) 0) ^ q ≤
          (t ^ q / (q.factorial : ℝ) * Real.exp (t * y)) *
              (max (X omega) 0) ^ q := by
      calc
        (t ^ q / (q.factorial : ℝ) *
            Real.exp (t * max (X omega) 0)) *
              (max (X omega) 0) ^ q =
            (t ^ q / (q.factorial : ℝ) *
              (max (X omega) 0) ^ q) *
                Real.exp (t * max (X omega) 0) := by ring
        _ ≤ (t ^ q / (q.factorial : ℝ) *
              (max (X omega) 0) ^ q) * Real.exp (t * y) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexpUpper hcoefNonneg
        _ = (t ^ q / (q.factorial : ℝ) * Real.exp (t * y)) *
              (max (X omega) 0) ^ q := by ring
    have hprefixEq :
        1 + t * X omega + (t * X omega) ^ 2 / 2 +
            (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 3 q,
              (t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) * (max (X omega) 0) ^ k) =
          1 + t * X omega + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (t * X omega) ^ 2 +
            (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 3 q,
              (t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) * (max (X omega) 0) ^ k) := by
      ring
    exact hTaylor.trans (add_le_add hprefixEq.le htailBound)
  have hint := integral_mono_ae hExp hmajorantInt hpoint
  have hlin : Integrable (fun omega => t * X omega) mu := hX.const_mul t
  have hquad : Integrable
      (fun omega => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (t * X omega) ^ 2) mu := by
    have hs : Integrable (fun omega => (t * X omega) ^ 2) mu := by
      convert hXsq.const_mul (t ^ 2) using 1
      ext omega
      ring
    exact hs.const_mul _
  have hsumInt : Integrable (fun omega =>
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 3 q,
        (t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) * (max (X omega) 0) ^ k) mu :=
    by
      exact integrable_finsetSum _ hfiniteInt
  have hlinIntegral :
      (∫ omega, t * X omega ∂mu) = t * ∫ omega, X omega ∂mu := by
    rw [integral_const_mul]
  have hquadIntegral :
      (∫ omega, (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (t * X omega) ^ 2 ∂mu) =
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * t ^ 2 * V := by
    rw [integral_const_mul]
    have hscaled :
        (∫ omega, (t * X omega) ^ 2 ∂mu) = t ^ 2 * V := by
      change (∫ omega, (t * X omega) ^ 2 ∂mu) =
        t ^ 2 * ∫ omega, X omega ^ 2 ∂mu
      have hfun : (fun omega => (t * X omega) ^ 2) =
          fun omega => t ^ 2 * X omega ^ 2 := by
        funext omega
        ring
      rw [hfun, integral_const_mul]
    rw [hscaled]
    ring
  have hsumIntegral :
      (∫ omega, (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 3 q,
        (t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) * (max (X omega) 0) ^ k) ∂mu) =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 3 q,
        t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ) * M k := by
    calc
      (∫ omega, (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 3 q,
          (t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) * (max (X omega) 0) ^ k) ∂mu) =
          ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 3 q,
            ∫ omega, (t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) *
              (max (X omega) 0) ^ k ∂mu :=
        integral_finsetSum (Finset.Ico 3 q) hfiniteInt
      _ = ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 3 q,
          t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ) * M k := by
        apply sum_congr rfl
        intro k hk
        rw [integral_const_mul]
  have htailIntegral :
      (∫ omega,
        (t ^ q / (q.factorial : ℝ) * Real.exp (t * y)) *
          (max (X omega) 0) ^ q ∂mu) =
        t ^ q / (q.factorial : ℝ) * Real.exp (t * y) * M q := by
    rw [integral_const_mul]
  have hmajorantIntegral :
      (∫ omega,
        1 + t * X omega + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (t * X omega) ^ 2 +
          (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 3 q,
            (t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) * (max (X omega) 0) ^ k) +
          (t ^ q / (q.factorial : ℝ) * Real.exp (t * y)) *
            (max (X omega) 0) ^ q ∂mu) =
        1 + t * (∫ omega, X omega ∂mu) + E := by
    have hconst : Integrable (fun _ : Omega => (1 : ℝ)) mu := integrable_const _
    have hconstLin := hconst.add hlin
    have hconstLinQuad := hconstLin.add hquad
    have hprefix := hconstLinQuad.add hsumInt
    have hshape :
        (fun omega =>
          1 + t * X omega + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (t * X omega) ^ 2 +
            (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 3 q,
              (t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) * (max (X omega) 0) ^ k) +
            (t ^ q / (q.factorial : ℝ) * Real.exp (t * y)) *
              (max (X omega) 0) ^ q) =
          ((((fun _ : Omega => (1 : ℝ)) + (fun omega => t * X omega)) +
              (fun omega => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (t * X omega) ^ 2)) +
            (fun omega => ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 3 q,
              (t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) * (max (X omega) 0) ^ k)) +
            (fun omega =>
              (t ^ q / (q.factorial : ℝ) * Real.exp (t * y)) *
                (max (X omega) 0) ^ q) := by
      funext omega
      simp only [Pi.add_apply]
    rw [hshape]
    rw [integral_add' hprefix htailInt,
      integral_add' hconstLinQuad hsumInt,
      integral_add' hconstLin hquad,
      integral_add' hconst hlin,
      integral_const, hlinIntegral, hquadIntegral,
      hsumIntegral, htailIntegral]
    simp only [probReal_univ, one_smul]
    unfold E strongMomentTaylorExponent
    ring
  rw [hmajorantIntegral] at hint
  calc
    (∫ omega, Real.exp (t * X omega) ∂mu) ≤
        1 + t * (∫ omega, X omega ∂mu) + E := hint
    _ ≤ 1 + E := by
      have htcenter : t * (∫ omega, X omega ∂mu) ≤ 0 :=
        mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos ht hcenter
      linarith
    _ ≤ Real.exp E := by
      simpa [add_comm] using Real.add_one_le_exp E

name: RandomSetTheory.IsIntegrableSelection.map_continuousLinearMap
statement:
theorem IsIntegrableSelection.map_continuousLinearMap
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S : Ω → Set E} {g : Ω → E}
    (L : E →L[ℝ] F) (hg : IsIntegrableSelection μ S g) :
    IsIntegrableSelection μ (fun ω => L '' S ω) (fun ω => L (g ω))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨L.integrable_comp hg.1, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hg.2] with ω hω
  exact ⟨g ω, hω, rfl⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.isIntegrableSelection_map_continuousLinearEquiv_iff
statement:
theorem isIntegrableSelection_map_continuousLinearEquiv_iff
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S : Ω → Set E} (e : E ≃L[ℝ] F) (g : Ω → E) :
    IsIntegrableSelection μ (fun ω => e '' S ω) (fun ω => e (g ω)) ↔
      IsIntegrableSelection μ S g
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hg
    refine ⟨e.integrable_comp_iff.mp hg.1, ?_⟩
    filter_upwards [hg.2] with ω hω
    rcases hω with ⟨z, hz, heq⟩
    have hzg : z = g ω := e.injective heq
    simpa [hzg] using hz
  · intro hg
    exact hg.map_continuousLinearMap e.toContinuousLinearMap

name: RandomSetTheory.map_mem_aumannExpectation_image
statement:
theorem map_mem_aumannExpectation_image
    [CompleteSpace E] [CompleteSpace F]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S : Ω → Set E} (L : E →L[ℝ] F)
    {x : E} (hx : x ∈ aumannExpectation μ S) :
    L x ∈ aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => L '' S ω)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hx with ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨fun ω => L (g ω), hg.map_continuousLinearMap L, ?_⟩
  exact L.integral_comp_comm hg.1

name: RandomSetTheory.image_aumannExpectation_subset_aumannExpectation_image
statement:
theorem image_aumannExpectation_subset_aumannExpectation_image
    [CompleteSpace E] [CompleteSpace F]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S : Ω → Set E} (L : E →L[ℝ] F) :
    L '' aumannExpectation μ S ⊆
      aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => L '' S ω)
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  exact map_mem_aumannExpectation_image L hx

name: RandomSetTheory.image_aumannExpectation_continuousLinearEquiv
statement:
theorem image_aumannExpectation_continuousLinearEquiv
    [CompleteSpace E] [CompleteSpace F]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S : Ω → Set E} (e : E ≃L[ℝ] F) :
    e '' aumannExpectation μ S =
      aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => e '' S ω)
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · exact image_aumannExpectation_subset_aumannExpectation_image
      e.toContinuousLinearMap
  · intro y hy
    have hy' : e.symm y ∈
        aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => e.symm '' (e '' S ω)) :=
      map_mem_aumannExpectation_image e.symm.toContinuousLinearMap hy
    have hyS : e.symm y ∈ aumannExpectation μ S := by
      simpa only [e.symm_image_image] using hy'
    exact ⟨e.symm y, hyS, e.apply_symm_apply y⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.image_closure_aumannExpectation_subset
statement:
theorem image_closure_aumannExpectation_subset
    [CompleteSpace E] [CompleteSpace F]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S : Ω → Set E} (L : E →L[ℝ] F) :
    L '' closure (aumannExpectation μ S) ⊆
      closure (aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => L '' S ω))
proof:
:= by
  exact (image_closure_subset_closure_image L.continuous).trans
    (closure_mono (image_aumannExpectation_subset_aumannExpectation_image L))

name: RandomSetTheory.image_closedConvexHull_continuousLinearEquiv
statement:
theorem image_closedConvexHull_continuousLinearEquiv
    (e : E ≃L[ℝ] F) (s : Set E) :
    e '' closedConvexHull ℝ s = closedConvexHull ℝ (e '' s)
proof:
:= by
  have hconv : e '' convexHull ℝ s = convexHull ℝ (e '' s) := by
    simpa only [ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_coe,
      ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe] using
      e.toContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap.image_convexHull s
  rw [closedConvexHull_eq_closure_convexHull, e.image_closure,
    closedConvexHull_eq_closure_convexHull]
  exact congrArg closure hconv

name: RandomSetTheory.image_closedConvexHull_aumannExpectation_subset
statement:
theorem image_closedConvexHull_aumannExpectation_subset
    [CompleteSpace E] [CompleteSpace F]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S : Ω → Set E} (L : E →L[ℝ] F) :
    L '' closedConvexHull ℝ (aumannExpectation μ S) ⊆
      closedConvexHull ℝ
        (aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => L '' S ω))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    L '' closedConvexHull ℝ (aumannExpectation μ S) =
        L '' closure (convexHull ℝ (aumannExpectation μ S)) := by
      rw [closedConvexHull_eq_closure_convexHull]
    _ ⊆ closure (L '' convexHull ℝ (aumannExpectation μ S)) :=
      image_closure_subset_closure_image L.continuous
    _ = closure (convexHull ℝ (L '' aumannExpectation μ S)) := by
      have hconv : L '' convexHull ℝ (aumannExpectation μ S) =
          convexHull ℝ (L '' aumannExpectation μ S) := by
        simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe] using
          L.toLinearMap.image_convexHull (aumannExpectation μ S)
      exact congrArg closure hconv
    _ ⊆ closure
        (convexHull ℝ
          (aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => L '' S ω))) :=
      closure_mono (convexHull_mono
        (image_aumannExpectation_subset_aumannExpectation_image L))
    _ = closedConvexHull ℝ
        (aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => L '' S ω)) := by
      rw [closedConvexHull_eq_closure_convexHull]

name: RandomSetTheory.image_closedConvexHull_aumannExpectation_continuousLinearEquiv
statement:
theorem image_closedConvexHull_aumannExpectation_continuousLinearEquiv
    [CompleteSpace E] [CompleteSpace F]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S : Ω → Set E} (e : E ≃L[ℝ] F) :
    e '' closedConvexHull ℝ (aumannExpectation μ S) =
      closedConvexHull ℝ
        (aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => e '' S ω))
proof:
:= by
  rw [image_closedConvexHull_continuousLinearEquiv,
    image_aumannExpectation_continuousLinearEquiv]

name: RandomSetTheory.image_closure_aumannExpectation_continuousLinearEquiv
statement:
theorem image_closure_aumannExpectation_continuousLinearEquiv
    [CompleteSpace E] [CompleteSpace F]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S : Ω → Set E} (e : E ≃L[ℝ] F) :
    e '' closure (aumannExpectation μ S) =
      closure (aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => e '' S ω))
proof:
:= by
  rw [e.image_closure, image_aumannExpectation_continuousLinearEquiv]

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_caratheodoryImageAt_le
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_caratheodoryImageAt_le
    {Ω Θ X E : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace Θ]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (S : Ω → Set X) (φ : (Ω × Θ) × X → E)
    (L : Ω → ℝ) (hL : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ L ω)
    (hφLip : ∀ ω θ η x, x ∈ S ω →
      ‖φ ((ω, θ), x) - φ ((ω, η), x)‖ ≤ L ω * dist θ η)
    (ω : Ω) (θ η : Θ) :
    hausdorffDist (caratheodoryImageAt S φ θ ω)
        (caratheodoryImageAt S φ η ω) ≤ L ω * dist θ η
proof:
:= by
  apply hausdorffDist_le_of_mem_dist (mul_nonneg (hL ω) dist_nonneg)
  · rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨φ ((ω, η), x), ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hφLip ω θ η x hx
  · rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨φ ((ω, θ), x), ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    simpa [dist_eq_norm, dist_comm] using hφLip ω η θ x hx

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_closedConvexHull_caratheodoryImageAt_le
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_closedConvexHull_caratheodoryImageAt_le
    {Ω Θ X E : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace Θ]
    [TopologicalSpace X]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (S : Ω → Set X) (φ : (Ω × Θ) × X → E)
    (hScompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hSne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    (hφcont : ∀ p : Ω × Θ, Continuous fun x => φ (p, x))
    (L : Ω → ℝ) (hL : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ L ω)
    (hφLip : ∀ ω θ η x, x ∈ S ω →
      ‖φ ((ω, θ), x) - φ ((ω, η), x)‖ ≤ L ω * dist θ η)
    (ω : Ω) (θ η : Θ) :
    hausdorffDist
        (closedConvexHull ℝ (caratheodoryImageAt S φ θ ω))
        (closedConvexHull ℝ (caratheodoryImageAt S φ η ω)) ≤
      L ω * dist θ η
proof:
:= by
  have hθcompact : IsCompact (caratheodoryImageAt S φ θ ω) :=
    (hScompact ω).image (hφcont (ω, θ))
  have hηcompact : IsCompact (caratheodoryImageAt S φ η ω) :=
    (hScompact ω).image (hφcont (ω, η))
  have hθne : (caratheodoryImageAt S φ θ ω).Nonempty :=
    (hSne ω).image _
  have hηne : (caratheodoryImageAt S φ η ω).Nonempty :=
    (hSne ω).image _
  exact (hausdorffDist_closedConvexHull_le hθcompact hηcompact hθne hηne).trans
    (hausdorffDist_caratheodoryImageAt_le S φ L hL hφLip ω θ η)

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_convexifiedAumannExpectationParam_le
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_convexifiedAumannExpectationParam_le
    {Ω Θ X E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [PseudoMetricSpace Θ] [MeasurableSpace Θ]
    [MetricSpace X] [CompleteSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    [SecondCountableTopology X] [Nonempty X]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [Nonempty E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (S : Ω → Set X) (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hScompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hSne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    (φ : (Ω × Θ) × X → E) (hφmeas : Measurable φ)
    (hφcont : ∀ p : Ω × Θ, Continuous fun x => φ (p, x))
    (L : Ω → ℝ) (hLint : Integrable L μ) (hL : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ L ω)
    (hφLip : ∀ ω θ η x, x ∈ S ω →
      ‖φ ((ω, θ), x) - φ ((ω, η), x)‖ ≤ L ω * dist θ η)
    (g : Ω → ℝ) (hg : Integrable g μ)
    (hdom : ∀ ω θ x, x ∈ S ω → ‖φ ((ω, θ), x)‖ ≤ g ω)
    (θ η : Θ) :
    hausdorffDist
        (convexifiedAumannExpectationParam μ S φ θ)
        (convexifiedAumannExpectationParam μ S φ η) ≤
      (∫ ω, L ω ∂μ) * dist θ η
proof:
:= by
  let I : Θ → Ω → Set E := fun ξ ω => caratheodoryImageAt S φ ξ ω
  let C : Θ → Ω → Set E := fun ξ ω => closedConvexHull ℝ (I ξ ω)
  have hφfixed_meas : ∀ ξ : Θ,
      Measurable (fun p : Ω × X => φ ((p.1, ξ), p.2)) := by
    intro ξ
    exact hφmeas.comp
      ((measurable_fst.prodMk measurable_const).prodMk measurable_snd)
  have hIEffros : ∀ ξ, RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable (I ξ) := by
    intro ξ
    exact effrosMeasurable_caratheodoryImage hS
      (fun ω => (hScompact ω).isClosed) hSne
      (hφfixed_meas ξ) (fun ω => hφcont (ω, ξ))
  have hIcompact : ∀ ξ ω, IsCompact (I ξ ω) := by
    intro ξ ω
    exact (hScompact ω).image (hφcont (ω, ξ))
  have hIne : ∀ ξ ω, (I ξ ω).Nonempty := by
    intro ξ ω
    exact (hSne ω).image _
  have hCEffros : ∀ ξ, RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable (C ξ) := by
    intro ξ
    exact effrosMeasurable_closedConvexHull_of_compact
      (hIEffros ξ) (hIcompact ξ) (hIne ξ)
  have hCcompact : ∀ ξ ω, IsCompact (C ξ ω) := by
    intro ξ ω
    exact closedConvexHull_compact (hIcompact ξ ω)
  have hCne : ∀ ξ ω, (C ξ ω).Nonempty := by
    intro ξ ω
    exact (hIne ξ ω).mono subset_closedConvexHull
  have hCconv : ∀ ξ ω, Convex ℝ (C ξ ω) :=
    fun _ _ => convex_closedConvexHull
  have hCdom : ∀ ξ ω, ∀ y ∈ C ξ ω, ‖y‖ ≤ g ω := by
    intro ξ ω
    apply norm_le_on_closedConvexHull_of_norm_le
    intro y hy
    rcases hy with ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact hdom ω ξ x hx
  have hpoint : ∀ ω,
      hausdorffDist (C θ ω) (C η ω) ≤ L ω * dist θ η := by
    intro ω
    exact hausdorffDist_closedConvexHull_caratheodoryImageAt_le
      S φ hScompact hSne hφcont L hL hφLip ω θ η
  have hdistMeas : Measurable (fun ω => hausdorffDist (C θ ω) (C η ω)) :=
    measurable_hausdorffDist_correspondence
      (hCEffros θ) (hCEffros η)
      (fun ω => (hCcompact θ ω).isClosed)
      (fun ω => (hCcompact η ω).isClosed)
      (hCne θ) (hCne η)
  have hLipInt : Integrable (fun ω => L ω * dist θ η) μ :=
    hLint.mul_const _
  have hdistInt : Integrable (fun ω => hausdorffDist (C θ ω) (C η ω)) μ := by
    apply hLipInt.mono' hdistMeas.aestronglyMeasurable
    filter_upwards [] with ω
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg hausdorffDist_nonneg,
      abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hL ω) dist_nonneg)] using hpoint ω
  have hmain :
      hausdorffDist (closure (aumannExpectation μ (C θ)))
          (closure (aumannExpectation μ (C η))) ≤
        (∫ ω, L ω ∂μ) * dist θ η := by
    calc
      hausdorffDist (closure (aumannExpectation μ (C θ)))
          (closure (aumannExpectation μ (C η))) ≤
          ∫ ω, hausdorffDist (C θ ω) (C η ω) ∂μ :=
        hausdorffDist_closure_aumannExpectation_le_integral
          (hCEffros θ) (hCEffros η) (hCcompact θ) (hCcompact η)
          (hCne θ) (hCne η) (hCconv θ) (hCconv η)
          hg hg (hCdom θ) (hCdom η) hdistInt
      _ ≤ ∫ ω, L ω * dist θ η ∂μ :=
        integral_mono hdistInt hLipInt hpoint
      _ = (∫ ω, L ω ∂μ) * dist θ η := integral_mul_const _ _
  simpa [convexifiedAumannExpectationParam, C, I] using hmain

name: RandomSetTheory.compact_nonempty_convexifiedAumannExpectationParam
statement:
theorem compact_nonempty_convexifiedAumannExpectationParam
    {Ω Θ X E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Θ]
    [MetricSpace X] [CompleteSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    [SecondCountableTopology X] [Nonempty X]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [Nonempty E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (S : Ω → Set X) (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hScompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hSne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    (φ : (Ω × Θ) × X → E) (hφmeas : Measurable φ)
    (hφcont : ∀ p : Ω × Θ, Continuous fun x => φ (p, x))
    (g : Ω → ℝ) (hg : Integrable g μ)
    (hdom : ∀ ω θ x, x ∈ S ω → ‖φ ((ω, θ), x)‖ ≤ g ω)
    (θ : Θ) :
    IsCompact (convexifiedAumannExpectationParam μ S φ θ) ∧
      (convexifiedAumannExpectationParam μ S φ θ).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  let I : Ω → Set E := fun ω => caratheodoryImageAt S φ θ ω
  let C : Ω → Set E := fun ω => closedConvexHull ℝ (I ω)
  have hφfixed : Measurable (fun p : Ω × X => φ ((p.1, θ), p.2)) :=
    hφmeas.comp
      ((measurable_fst.prodMk measurable_const).prodMk measurable_snd)
  have hIEffros : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable I :=
    effrosMeasurable_caratheodoryImage hS
      (fun ω => (hScompact ω).isClosed) hSne hφfixed
      (fun ω => hφcont (ω, θ))
  have hIcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (I ω) := fun ω =>
    (hScompact ω).image (hφcont (ω, θ))
  have hIne : ∀ ω, (I ω).Nonempty := fun ω => (hSne ω).image _
  have hCEffros : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable C :=
    effrosMeasurable_closedConvexHull_of_compact hIEffros hIcompact hIne
  have hCcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (C ω) := fun ω =>
    closedConvexHull_compact (hIcompact ω)
  have hCne : ∀ ω, (C ω).Nonempty := fun ω =>
    (hIne ω).mono subset_closedConvexHull
  have hCdom : ∀ ω, ∀ y ∈ C ω, ‖y‖ ≤ g ω := by
    intro ω
    apply norm_le_on_closedConvexHull_of_norm_le
    intro y hy
    rcases hy with ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact hdom ω θ x hx
  have hcompactA : IsCompact (closure (aumannExpectation μ C)) :=
    closure_aumannExpectation_compact_of_integrable_envelope hg
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hCdom)
  have hsel : HasIntegrableSupportSelection μ C 0 :=
    hasIntegrableSupportSelection_of_effros_of_envelope
      hCEffros hCcompact hCne hg hCdom 0
  rcases hsel with ⟨f, hf, _⟩
  have hneA : (closure (aumannExpectation μ C)).Nonempty :=
    (aumannExpectation_nonempty_of_selection hf).closure
  simpa [convexifiedAumannExpectationParam, C, I] using
    And.intro hcompactA hneA

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffContinuous_convexifiedAumannExpectationParam
statement:
theorem hausdorffContinuous_convexifiedAumannExpectationParam
    {Ω Θ X E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [PseudoMetricSpace Θ] [MeasurableSpace Θ]
    [MetricSpace X] [CompleteSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    [SecondCountableTopology X] [Nonempty X]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [Nonempty E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (S : Ω → Set X) (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hScompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hSne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    (φ : (Ω × Θ) × X → E) (hφmeas : Measurable φ)
    (hφcont : ∀ p : Ω × Θ, Continuous fun x => φ (p, x))
    (L : Ω → ℝ) (hLint : Integrable L μ) (hL : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ L ω)
    (hφLip : ∀ ω θ η x, x ∈ S ω →
      ‖φ ((ω, θ), x) - φ ((ω, η), x)‖ ≤ L ω * dist θ η)
    (g : Ω → ℝ) (hg : Integrable g μ)
    (hdom : ∀ ω θ x, x ∈ S ω → ‖φ ((ω, θ), x)‖ ≤ g ω) :
    HausdorffContinuous (convexifiedAumannExpectationParam μ S φ)
proof:
:= by
  intro θ
  apply squeeze_zero
    (fun _ => hausdorffDist_nonneg)
    (fun η => hausdorffDist_convexifiedAumannExpectationParam_le
      S hS hScompact hSne φ hφmeas hφcont L hLint hL hφLip g hg hdom η θ)
  have hdist : Tendsto (fun η : Θ => dist η θ) (𝓝 θ) (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa using (continuousAt_id.dist (continuousAt_const :
      ContinuousAt (fun _ : Θ => θ) θ))
  simpa [mul_comm] using hdist.const_mul (∫ ω, L ω ∂μ)

name: RandomSetTheory.isClosed_zeroSet_convexifiedAumannExpectationParam
statement:
theorem isClosed_zeroSet_convexifiedAumannExpectationParam
    {Ω Θ X E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [PseudoMetricSpace Θ] [MeasurableSpace Θ]
    [MetricSpace X] [CompleteSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    [SecondCountableTopology X] [Nonempty X]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [Nonempty E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (S : Ω → Set X) (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hScompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hSne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    (φ : (Ω × Θ) × X → E) (hφmeas : Measurable φ)
    (hφcont : ∀ p : Ω × Θ, Continuous fun x => φ (p, x))
    (L : Ω → ℝ) (hLint : Integrable L μ) (hL : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ L ω)
    (hφLip : ∀ ω θ η x, x ∈ S ω →
      ‖φ ((ω, θ), x) - φ ((ω, η), x)‖ ≤ L ω * dist θ η)
    (g : Ω → ℝ) (hg : Integrable g μ)
    (hdom : ∀ ω θ x, x ∈ S ω → ‖φ ((ω, θ), x)‖ ≤ g ω) :
    IsClosed (setValuedZeroSet
      (convexifiedAumannExpectationParam μ S φ))
proof:
:= by
  have hhaus := hausdorffContinuous_convexifiedAumannExpectationParam
    S hS hScompact hSne φ hφmeas hφcont L hLint hL hφLip g hg hdom
  have hreg : ∀ θ,
      IsCompact (convexifiedAumannExpectationParam μ S φ θ) ∧
        (convexifiedAumannExpectationParam μ S φ θ).Nonempty := fun θ =>
    compact_nonempty_convexifiedAumannExpectationParam
      S hS hScompact hSne φ hφmeas hφcont g hg hdom θ
  exact hhaus.isClosed_setValuedZeroSet_of_compact
    (fun θ => (hreg θ).1) (fun θ => (hreg θ).2)

statement:
theorem isCompact_zeroSet_convexifiedAumannExpectationParam
    {Ω Θ X E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]

    (φ : (Ω × Θ) × X → E) (hφmeas : Measurable φ)

    (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S) (K : Set X) :
    RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable (correspondenceOn A S K)
proof:
:= by
  intro U hU
  have hEq :
      {ω | (correspondenceOn A S K ω ∩ U).Nonempty} =
        (A ∩ {ω | (S ω ∩ U).Nonempty}) ∪

    ext ω

  rw [hEq]
  exact (hA.inter (hS U hU)).union
    (hA.compl.inter (RandomSet.isEffrosMeasurable_const K U hU))

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_measurable_bergeMaximizer_ae
statement:
theorem exists_measurable_bergeMaximizer_ae
    {Ω X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [MetricSpace X] [CompleteSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    [SecondCountableTopology X]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {A : Set Ω} (hAmeas : MeasurableSet A)
    (hA : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ω ∈ A)
    {S : Ω → Set X} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ ω ∈ A, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hne : ∀ ω ∈ A, (S ω).Nonempty)
    (x₀ : X) {f : Ω × X → ℝ} (hfmeas : Measurable f)
    (hfcont : ∀ ω, Continuous fun x => f (ω, x)) :
    ∃ s : Ω → X, Measurable s ∧
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, s ω ∈ S ω ∧
        f (ω, s ω) = bergeMaxValue S f ω
proof:
:= by
  letI : Nonempty X := ⟨x₀⟩
  let T : Ω → Set X := correspondenceOn A S {x₀}
  have hT : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable T :=
    effrosMeasurable_correspondenceOn hAmeas hS {x₀}
  have hTcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (T ω) := fun ω =>
    correspondenceOn_isCompact hcompact (isCompact_singleton) ω
  have hTne : ∀ ω, (T ω).Nonempty := fun ω =>
    correspondenceOn_nonempty hne (Set.singleton_nonempty x₀) ω
  obtain ⟨s, hsmeas, hs⟩ :=
    exists_measurable_bergeMaximizer hT hTcompact hTne hfmeas hfcont
  refine ⟨s, hsmeas, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hA] with ω hω
  have hTω : T ω = S ω := by simp [T, hω]
  refine ⟨hTω ▸ (hs ω).1, ?_⟩
  exact (hs ω).2.trans (by simp only [bergeMaxValue, hTω])

    (x₀ : X) {y : Ω → X} (hy : Measurable y) :
    ∃ p : Ω → X, Measurable p ∧
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, p ω ∈ S ω ∧
        dist (y ω) (p ω) = Metric.infDist (y ω) (S ω)
proof:
