name: RandomSetTheory.continuous_cdf_of_nullSingletonClass
statement:
theorem continuous_cdf_of_nullSingletonClass (mu : Measure ℝ)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [NullSingletonClass mu] :
    Continuous (ProbabilityTheory.cdf mu)
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  intro x
  rw [(ProbabilityTheory.monotone_cdf mu).continuousAt_iff_leftLim_eq_rightLim,
    (ProbabilityTheory.cdf mu).rightLim_eq]
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact (ProbabilityTheory.monotone_cdf mu).leftLim_le le_rfl
  · have hzero : ENNReal.ofReal
        (ProbabilityTheory.cdf mu x - Function.leftLim (ProbabilityTheory.cdf mu) x) = 0 := by
      rw [← (ProbabilityTheory.cdf mu).measure_singleton x,
        ProbabilityTheory.measure_cdf mu, measure_singleton]
    have hnonpos : ProbabilityTheory.cdf mu x -
        Function.leftLim (ProbabilityTheory.cdf mu) x ≤ 0 :=
      ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero.mp hzero
    linarith

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_Iic_measure_eq_of_between
statement:
theorem exists_Iic_measure_eq_of_between (mu : Measure ℝ)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [NullSingletonClass mu]
    {a : ℝ} (ha0 : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) :
    ∃ x : ℝ, mu (Iic x) = ENNReal.ofReal a
proof:
:= by
  have hlow : ∀ᶠ x in atBot, ProbabilityTheory.cdf mu x < a :=
    (ProbabilityTheory.tendsto_cdf_atBot mu).eventually_lt_const ha0
  have hupp : ∀ᶠ x in atTop, a < ProbabilityTheory.cdf mu x :=
    (ProbabilityTheory.tendsto_cdf_atTop mu).eventually_const_lt ha1
  obtain ⟨xlow, hxlow⟩ := hlow.exists
  obtain ⟨xupp, hxupp⟩ := hupp.exists
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := mem_range_of_exists_le_of_exists_ge
    (continuous_cdf_of_nullSingletonClass mu)
    ⟨xlow, hxlow.le⟩ ⟨xupp, hxupp.le⟩
  refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
  rw [← hx, ProbabilityTheory.ofReal_cdf]

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_measurable_measureReal_eq_mul_univ
statement:
theorem exists_measurable_measureReal_eq_mul_univ (nu : Measure ℝ)
    [IsFiniteMeasure nu] [NullSingletonClass nu]
    {a : ℝ} (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1) :
    ∃ A : Set ℝ, MeasurableSet A ∧ nu.real A = a * nu.real univ
proof:
:= by
  rcases ha0.eq_or_lt with rfl | ha0
  · exact ⟨∅, MeasurableSet.empty, by simp⟩
  rcases ha1.eq_or_lt with rfl | ha1
  · exact ⟨univ, MeasurableSet.univ, by simp⟩
  by_cases hnu : nu = 0
  · subst nu
    exact ⟨∅, MeasurableSet.empty, by simp⟩
  let nuf : FiniteMeasure ℝ := ⟨nu, inferInstance⟩
  have hnuf : nuf ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hnu
    have hc := congrArg FiniteMeasure.toMeasure h
    simpa [nuf] using hc
  let P : ProbabilityMeasure ℝ := nuf.normalize
  letI : NullSingletonClass (P : Measure ℝ) :=
    ⟨fun x ↦ by
      rw [show (P : Measure ℝ) = nuf.mass⁻¹ • (nuf : Measure ℝ) by
        exact nuf.toMeasure_normalize_eq_of_nonzero hnuf]
      rw [Measure.smul_apply]
      have hx0 : (nuf : Measure ℝ) {x} = 0 := by
        change nu {x} = 0
        exact measure_singleton x
      rw [hx0]
      simp⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_Iic_measure_eq_of_between
    (P : Measure ℝ) ha0 ha1
  refine ⟨Iic x, measurableSet_Iic, ?_⟩
  have hxreal : (P : Measure ℝ).real (Iic x) = a := by
    rw [measureReal_def, hx, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal ha0.le]
  have hxP : (P (Iic x) : ℝ) = a := by simpa using hxreal
  change (nuf (Iic x) : ℝ) = a * (nuf univ : ℝ)
  calc
    (nuf (Iic x) : ℝ) = (nuf.mass : ℝ) * (P (Iic x) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast nuf.self_eq_mass_mul_normalize (Iic x)
    _ = (nuf.mass : ℝ) * a := by rw [hxP]
    _ = a * (nuf univ : ℝ) := by
      simp only [FiniteMeasure.mass]
      ring

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_measurable_subset_measureReal_eq_mul
statement:
theorem exists_measurable_subset_measureReal_eq_mul (nu : Measure ℝ)
    [IsFiniteMeasure nu] [NullSingletonClass nu]
    {s : Set ℝ} (hs : MeasurableSet s)
    {a : ℝ} (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1) :
    ∃ A : Set ℝ, A ⊆ s ∧ MeasurableSet A ∧
      nu.real A = a * nu.real s
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsFiniteMeasure (nu.restrict s) :=
    isFiniteMeasure_restrict.mpr (measure_ne_top nu s)
  obtain ⟨A, hA, hmeasure⟩ :=
    exists_measurable_measureReal_eq_mul_univ (nu.restrict s) ha0 ha1
  rw [measureReal_restrict_apply hA, measureReal_restrict_apply_univ] at hmeasure
  refine ⟨A ∩ s, inter_subset_right, hA.inter hs, ?_⟩
  simpa using hmeasure

name: RandomSetTheory.isAtomlessMeasure_of_nullSingletonClass_real
statement:
theorem isAtomlessMeasure_of_nullSingletonClass_real (nu : Measure ℝ)
    [IsFiniteMeasure nu] [NullSingletonClass nu] :
    IsAtomlessMeasure nu
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs hspos
  obtain ⟨A, hAs, hA, hmeasure⟩ :=
    exists_measurable_subset_measureReal_eq_mul nu hs
      (a := (1 / 2 : ℝ)) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  refine ⟨A, hAs, hA, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply (ENNReal.toReal_lt_toReal (by simp) (measure_ne_top nu A)).mp
    change 0 < nu.real A
    rw [hmeasure]
    have hsreal : 0 < nu.real s :=
      ENNReal.toReal_pos hspos.ne' (measure_ne_top nu s)
    positivity
  · apply (ENNReal.toReal_lt_toReal (measure_ne_top nu A)
      (measure_ne_top nu s)).mp
    change nu.real A < nu.real s
    rw [hmeasure]
    have hsreal : 0 < nu.real s :=
      ENNReal.toReal_pos hspos.ne' (measure_ne_top nu s)
    linarith

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_setIntegral_eq_mul_real_of_measurable
statement:
theorem exists_setIntegral_eq_mul_real_of_measurable
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [NullSingletonClass mu]
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f mu) (hfm : Measurable f)
    {a : ℝ} (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1) :
    ∃ A : Set ℝ, MeasurableSet A ∧
      (∫ x in A, f x ∂mu) = a * ∫ x, f x ∂mu
proof:
:= by
  let P : Set ℝ := {x | 0 ≤ f x}
  let N : Set ℝ := {x | f x < 0}
  have hP : MeasurableSet P := hfm measurableSet_Ici
  have hN : MeasurableSet N := hfm measurableSet_Iio
  let mup : Measure ℝ := mu.withDensity (fun x ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (f x))
  let mun : Measure ℝ := mu.withDensity (fun x ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (-f x))
  letI : IsFiniteMeasure mup :=
    isFiniteMeasure_withDensity hf.lintegral_lt_top.ne
  letI : IsFiniteMeasure mun :=
    isFiniteMeasure_withDensity hf.neg.lintegral_lt_top.ne
  obtain ⟨Ap, hApP, hAp, hApmeasure⟩ :=
    exists_measurable_subset_measureReal_eq_mul mup hP ha0 ha1
  obtain ⟨An, hAnN, hAn, hAnmeasure⟩ :=
    exists_measurable_subset_measureReal_eq_mul mun hN ha0 ha1
  have hmup_compl : mup Pᶜ = 0 := by
    change mu.withDensity (fun x ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (f x)) Pᶜ = 0
    rw [withDensity_apply _ hP.compl]
    apply setLIntegral_eq_zero hP.compl
    intro x hx
    simp only [Pi.zero_apply]
    apply ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero.mpr
    exact le_of_not_ge hx
  have hmun_compl : mun Nᶜ = 0 := by
    change mu.withDensity (fun x ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (-f x)) Nᶜ = 0
    rw [withDensity_apply _ hN.compl]
    apply setLIntegral_eq_zero hN.compl
    intro x hx
    simp only [Pi.zero_apply]
    apply ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero.mpr
    exact neg_nonpos.mpr (le_of_not_gt hx)
  have hmup_full : mup.real P = mup.real univ := by
    rw [measureReal_def, measureReal_def,
      measure_of_measure_compl_eq_zero hmup_compl]
  have hmun_full : mun.real N = mun.real univ := by
    rw [measureReal_def, measureReal_def,
      measure_of_measure_compl_eq_zero hmun_compl]
  have hAp_nonneg : 0 ≤ᵐ[mu.restrict Ap] f := by
    change ∀ᵐ x ∂mu.restrict Ap, 0 ≤ f x
    rw [ae_restrict_iff' hAp]
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun x hx ↦ by simpa [P] using hApP hx
  have hAn_nonneg : 0 ≤ᵐ[mu.restrict An] fun x ↦ -f x := by
    change ∀ᵐ x ∂mu.restrict An, 0 ≤ -f x
    rw [ae_restrict_iff' hAn]
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun x hx ↦ by
      have hxN : f x < 0 := by simpa [N] using hAnN hx
      exact neg_nonneg.mpr hxN.le
  have hApint : (∫ x in Ap, f x ∂mu) = mup.real Ap := by
    rw [integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae hAp_nonneg
      hf.aestronglyMeasurable.restrict]
    simp only [measureReal_def, mup, withDensity_apply _ hAp]
  have hAnnegint : (∫ x in An, -f x ∂mu) = mun.real An := by
    rw [integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae hAn_nonneg
      hf.neg.aestronglyMeasurable.restrict]
    simp only [measureReal_def, mun, withDensity_apply _ hAn]
  have hAnint : (∫ x in An, f x ∂mu) = -mun.real An := by
    rw [← hAnnegint, ← integral_neg]
    simp
  have htotal : (∫ x, f x ∂mu) = mup.real univ - mun.real univ := by
    rw [integral_eq_lintegral_pos_part_sub_lintegral_neg_part hf]
    simp only [measureReal_def, mup, mun, withDensity_apply _ MeasurableSet.univ,
      Measure.restrict_univ]
  have hdisj : Disjoint Ap An := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro x hxp hxn
    have hp : 0 ≤ f x := by simpa [P] using hApP hxp
    have hn : f x < 0 := by simpa [N] using hAnN hxn
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hp) hn
  refine ⟨Ap ∪ An, hAp.union hAn, ?_⟩
  rw [setIntegral_union hdisj hAn hf.integrableOn hf.integrableOn,
    hApint, hAnint, hApmeasure, hAnmeasure, hmup_full, hmun_full, htotal]
  ring

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_setIntegral_eq_mul_real
statement:
theorem exists_setIntegral_eq_mul_real
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [NullSingletonClass mu]
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f mu)
    {a : ℝ} (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1) :
    ∃ A : Set ℝ, MeasurableSet A ∧
      (∫ x in A, f x ∂mu) = a * ∫ x, f x ∂mu
proof:
:= by
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := hf.aestronglyMeasurable.mk f
  have hfg : f =ᵐ[mu] g := hf.aestronglyMeasurable.ae_eq_mk
  have hg : Integrable g mu := hf.congr hfg
  obtain ⟨A, hA, hEq⟩ := exists_setIntegral_eq_mul_real_of_measurable
    mu hg hf.aestronglyMeasurable.measurable_mk ha0 ha1
  refine ⟨A, hA, ?_⟩
  calc
    (∫ x in A, f x ∂mu) = ∫ x in A, g x ∂mu :=
      integral_congr_ae (ae_restrict_of_ae hfg)
    _ = a * ∫ x, g x ∂mu := hEq
    _ = a * ∫ x, f x ∂mu := by rw [integral_congr_ae hfg.symm]

name: RandomSetTheory.hasLyapunovConvexity_of_proportional_splitting
statement:
theorem hasLyapunovConvexity_of_proportional_splitting
    {Omega E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (mu : Measure Omega)
    (hsplit : ∀ (f : Omega → E), Integrable f mu →
      ∀ {a : ℝ}, 0 ≤ a → a ≤ 1 →
        ∃ A : Set Omega, MeasurableSet A ∧
          (∫ x in A, f x ∂mu) = a • ∫ x, f x ∂mu) :
    HasLyapunovConvexity mu E
proof:
:= by
  intro f hf
  intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
  rcases hx with ⟨A, hA, rfl⟩
  rcases hy with ⟨B, hB, rfl⟩
  let p : Omega → E := A.indicator f
  let q : Omega → E := B.indicator f
  have hp : Integrable p mu := hf.integrableOn.integrable_indicator hA
  have hq : Integrable q mu := hf.integrableOn.integrable_indicator hB
  have hpq : Integrable (fun w ↦ p w - q w) mu := hp.sub hq
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hsplitD⟩ := hsplit (fun w ↦ p w - q w) hpq ha (by linarith)
  let C : Set Omega := (D ∩ A) ∪ (Dᶜ ∩ B)
  have hC : MeasurableSet C := (hD.inter hA).union (hD.compl.inter hB)
  have hind : C.indicator f = fun w ↦ q w + D.indicator (fun z ↦ p z - q z) w := by
    funext w
    by_cases hwD : w ∈ D <;> by_cases hwA : w ∈ A <;> by_cases hwB : w ∈ B <;>
      simp [C, p, q, hwD, hwA, hwB]
  refine ⟨C, hC, ?_⟩
  rw [← integral_indicator hC, hind,
    integral_add hq (hpq.integrableOn.integrable_indicator hD),
    integral_indicator hD, hsplitD, integral_sub hp hq,
    integral_indicator hA, integral_indicator hB]
  have hb' : b = 1 - a := by linarith
  rw [hb']
  module

name: RandomSetTheory.hasLyapunovConvexity_real_of_nullSingletonClass
statement:
theorem hasLyapunovConvexity_real_of_nullSingletonClass
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [NullSingletonClass mu] :
    HasLyapunovConvexity mu ℝ
proof:
:= by
  apply hasLyapunovConvexity_of_proportional_splitting mu
  intro f hf a ha0 ha1
  obtain ⟨A, hA, hEq⟩ := exists_setIntegral_eq_mul_real mu hf ha0 ha1
  exact ⟨A, hA, by simpa [smul_eq_mul] using hEq⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.SimpleFunc.exists_setIntegral_eq_smul_of_nullSingletonClass
statement:
theorem exists_setIntegral_eq_smul_of_nullSingletonClass
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure mu] [NullSingletonClass mu]
    (f : SimpleFunc ℝ E) {a : ℝ} (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1) :
    ∃ A : Set ℝ, MeasurableSet A ∧
      (∫ x in A, f x ∂mu) = a • ∫ x, f x ∂mu
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfiber : ∀ y : E, MeasurableSet (f ⁻¹' {y}) := fun y ↦
    f.measurableSet_fiber y
  have hexists : ∀ y : E, ∃ A : Set ℝ,
      A ⊆ f ⁻¹' {y} ∧ MeasurableSet A ∧
        mu.real A = a * mu.real (f ⁻¹' {y}) := fun y ↦
    exists_measurable_subset_measureReal_eq_mul mu (hfiber y) ha0 ha1
  choose As hAs hAsmeas hAsmeasure using hexists
  let A : Set ℝ := ⋃ y ∈ f.range, As y
  have hA : MeasurableSet A := by
    exact Finset.measurableSet_biUnion f.range fun y _ ↦ hAsmeas y
  have hinter : ∀ y ∈ f.range, f ⁻¹' {y} ∩ A = As y := by
    intro y hy
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · intro x hx
      rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx.2 with ⟨z, hxz⟩
      rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hxz with ⟨hz, hxAs⟩
      have hfxz : f x = z := hAs z hxAs
      have hfxy : f x = y := hx.1
      have hzy : z = y := hfxz.symm.trans hfxy
      simpa [hzy] using hxAs
    · intro x hx
      refine ⟨hAs y hx, ?_⟩
      exact Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem y (Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem hy hx)
  refine ⟨A, hA, ?_⟩
  rw [f.integral_eq_sum f.integrable_of_isFiniteMeasure.integrableOn,
    f.integral_eq_sum f.integrable_of_isFiniteMeasure]
  simp_rw [measureReal_restrict_apply (hfiber _)]
  have hsum :
      ∑ y ∈ f.range, mu.real (f ⁻¹' {y} ∩ A) • y =
        ∑ y ∈ f.range, (a * mu.real (f ⁻¹' {y})) • y := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro y hy
    rw [hinter y hy, hAsmeasure y]
  rw [hsum, Finset.smul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro y hy
  rw [smul_smul]

name: RandomSetTheory.measurableSetIntegralRange_map_measurableEquiv
statement:
theorem measurableSetIntegralRange_map_measurableEquiv
    {Omega Omega' E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega] [MeasurableSpace Omega']
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (mu : Measure Omega) (e : Omega ≃ᵐ Omega') (f : Omega → E) :
    measurableSetIntegralRange (Measure.map e mu)
        (fun y ↦ f (e.symm y)) =
      measurableSetIntegralRange mu f
proof:
:= by
  have hIntegral : ∀ (B : Set Omega'), MeasurableSet B →
      (∫ y in B, f (e.symm y) ∂(Measure.map e mu)) =
        ∫ x in e ⁻¹' B, f x ∂mu := by
    intro B hB
    rw [e.restrict_map, integral_map_equiv]
    simp
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨B, hB, hz⟩
    refine ⟨e ⁻¹' B, e.measurable hB, ?_⟩
    rw [← hIntegral B hB]
    exact hz
  · rintro ⟨A, hA, hz⟩
    refine ⟨e '' A, (e.measurableSet_image).2 hA, ?_⟩
    rw [hIntegral (e '' A) ((e.measurableSet_image).2 hA)]
    simpa using hz

name: RandomSetTheory.hasLyapunovConvexity_map_measurableEquiv_iff
statement:
theorem hasLyapunovConvexity_map_measurableEquiv_iff
    {Omega Omega' E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega] [MeasurableSpace Omega']
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (mu : Measure Omega) (e : Omega ≃ᵐ Omega') :
    HasLyapunovConvexity (Measure.map e mu) E ↔
      HasLyapunovConvexity mu E
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h f hf
    let g : Omega' → E := fun y ↦ f (e.symm y)
    have hg : Integrable g (Measure.map e mu) := by
      rw [integrable_map_equiv e]
      refine hf.congr (Eventually.of_forall fun x ↦ ?_)
      simp only [g, Function.comp_apply]
      rw [e.symm_apply_apply]
    have hconv := h g hg
    rw [measurableSetIntegralRange_map_measurableEquiv mu e f] at hconv
    exact hconv
  · intro h f hf
    let g : Omega → E := fun x ↦ f (e x)
    have hg : Integrable g mu := by
      exact (integrable_map_equiv e f).mp hf
    have hconv := h g hg
    have hrange := measurableSetIntegralRange_map_measurableEquiv mu e g
    have hgeq : (fun y ↦ g (e.symm y)) = f := by
      funext y
      simp [g]
    rw [hgeq] at hrange
    rw [hrange]
    exact hconv

name: RandomSetTheory.hasLyapunovConvexity_real_of_measurableEquiv
statement:
theorem hasLyapunovConvexity_real_of_measurableEquiv
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    (mu : Measure Omega) (e : Omega ≃ᵐ ℝ)
    [NullSingletonClass (Measure.map e mu)] :
    HasLyapunovConvexity mu ℝ
proof:
:= by
  exact (hasLyapunovConvexity_map_measurableEquiv_iff mu e).mp
    (hasLyapunovConvexity_real_of_nullSingletonClass (Measure.map e mu))

name: RandomSetTheory.hasLyapunovConvexity_real_of_atomless_measurableEquiv
statement:
theorem hasLyapunovConvexity_real_of_atomless_measurableEquiv
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    (mu : Measure Omega) (hmu : IsAtomlessMeasure mu)
    (e : Omega ≃ᵐ ℝ) :
    HasLyapunovConvexity mu ℝ
proof:
:= by
  letI : MeasurableSingletonClass Omega :=
    ⟨fun x ↦ by
      have heq : ({x} : Set Omega) = e ⁻¹' {e x} := by
        ext y
        simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_preimage]
        exact ⟨fun h ↦ by simpa [h], fun h ↦ e.injective h⟩
      rw [heq]
      exact e.measurable (measurableSet_singleton (e x))⟩
  letI : NullSingletonClass mu := hmu.toNullSingletonClass
  letI : NullSingletonClass (Measure.map e mu) :=
    ⟨fun y ↦ by
      rw [Measure.map_apply_of_aemeasurable e.measurable.aemeasurable
        (measurableSet_singleton y)]
      have heq : e ⁻¹' ({y} : Set ℝ) = {e.symm y} := by
        ext x
        simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
        exact ⟨fun h ↦ e.injective (h.trans (e.apply_symm_apply y).symm),
          fun h ↦ by simpa [h]⟩
      rw [heq, measure_singleton]⟩
  exact hasLyapunovConvexity_real_of_measurableEquiv mu e

name: RandomSetTheory.isCompact_nonemptyCompactConvex_subsets_of_isCompact
statement:
theorem isCompact_nonemptyCompactConvex_subsets_of_isCompact
    {C : Set E} (hC : IsCompact C) :
    IsCompact {K : NonemptyCompacts E |
      (K : Set E) ⊆ C ∧ Convex ℝ (K : Set E)}
proof:
:= by
  have hsubsets : IsCompact {K : NonemptyCompacts E | (K : Set E) ⊆ C} :=
    NonemptyCompacts.isCompact_subsets_of_isCompact hC
  have hconvex : IsClosed {K : NonemptyCompacts E |
      Convex ℝ (K : Set E)} :=
    isClosed_compactConvexSet
  simpa only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.setOf_and] using
    hsubsets.inter_right hconvex

name: RandomSetTheory.isCompact_nonemptyCompactConvex_subsets_closedBall
statement:
theorem isCompact_nonemptyCompactConvex_subsets_closedBall (R : ℝ) :
    IsCompact {K : NonemptyCompacts E |
      (K : Set E) ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) R ∧
        Convex ℝ (K : Set E)}
proof:
:=
  isCompact_nonemptyCompactConvex_subsets_of_isCompact
    (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E) R)

name: RandomSetTheory.isCompact_nonemptyCompactConvex_of_norm_le
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Set.subset_def, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using
    isCompact_nonemptyCompactConvex_subsets_closedBall (E := E) R

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_hausdorff_tendsto_subseq_of_compactConvex_subsets
statement:
theorem exists_hausdorff_tendsto_subseq_of_compactConvex_subsets
    {C : Set E} (hC : IsCompact C) (K : ℕ → NonemptyCompacts E)
    (hsubset : ∀ n, (K n : Set E) ⊆ C)
    (hconvex : ∀ n, Convex ℝ (K n : Set E)) :
    ∃ L : NonemptyCompacts E,
      (L : Set E) ⊆ C ∧ Convex ℝ (L : Set E) ∧
      ∃ phi : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono phi ∧
        Tendsto
          (fun n ↦ hausdorffDist (K (phi n) : Set E) (L : Set E))
          atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  let A : Set (NonemptyCompacts E) := {L |
    (L : Set E) ⊆ C ∧ Convex ℝ (L : Set E)}
  have hA : IsCompact A := by
    simpa only [A] using
      isCompact_nonemptyCompactConvex_subsets_of_isCompact (E := E) hC
  have hK : ∀ n, K n ∈ A := fun n ↦ ⟨hsubset n, hconvex n⟩
  obtain ⟨L, hL, phi, hphi, hlim⟩ := hA.isSeqCompact hK
  refine ⟨L, hL.1, hL.2, phi, hphi, ?_⟩
  have hdist := (tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero).1 hlim
  simpa only [Function.comp_apply, NonemptyCompacts.dist_eq] using hdist

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_hausdorff_tendsto_subseq_of_uniformlyBounded_compactConvex
statement:
theorem exists_hausdorff_tendsto_subseq_of_uniformlyBounded_compactConvex
    (K : ℕ → NonemptyCompacts E) (R : ℝ)
    (hbound : ∀ n, ∀ x ∈ (K n : Set E), ‖x‖ ≤ R)
    (hconvex : ∀ n, Convex ℝ (K n : Set E)) :
    ∃ L : NonemptyCompacts E,
      (∀ x ∈ (L : Set E), ‖x‖ ≤ R) ∧ Convex ℝ (L : Set E) ∧
      ∃ phi : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono phi ∧
        Tendsto
          (fun n ↦ hausdorffDist (K (phi n) : Set E) (L : Set E))
          atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hsubset : ∀ n, (K n : Set E) ⊆
      Metric.closedBall (0 : E) R := by
    intro n x hx
    simpa only [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hbound n x hx
  obtain ⟨L, hLsub, hLconv, phi, hphi, hlim⟩ :=
    exists_hausdorff_tendsto_subseq_of_compactConvex_subsets
      (E := E) (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E) R) K hsubset hconvex
  refine ⟨L, ?_, hLconv, phi, hphi, hlim⟩
  intro x hx
  have := hLsub hx
  simpa only [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using this

name: ProbabilityTheory.fukNagaevConstant_eq_six_add_max
statement:
theorem fukNagaevConstant_eq_six_add_max (q : ℕ) :
    fukNagaevConstant q = 6 + max 4 (q : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold fukNagaevConstant fukNagaevMu
  rw [mul_add]
  norm_num
  rw [mul_max_of_nonneg _ _ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3)]
  congr 1 <;> ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.one_le_fukNagaevConstant
statement:
theorem one_le_fukNagaevConstant (q : ℕ) :
    1 ≤ fukNagaevConstant q
proof:
:= by
  unfold fukNagaevConstant fukNagaevMu
  have hmax : 0 ≤ max (4 / 3 : ℝ) ((q : ℝ) / 3) := by
    exact (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 4 / 3) |>.trans (le_max_left _ _)
  nlinarith

name: ProbabilityTheory.fukNagaevConstant_nonneg
statement:
theorem fukNagaevConstant_nonneg (q : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ fukNagaevConstant q
proof:
:=
  (zero_le_one.trans (one_le_fukNagaevConstant q))

name: ProbabilityTheory.natCast_le_fukNagaevConstant
statement:
theorem natCast_le_fukNagaevConstant (q : ℕ) :
    (q : ℝ) ≤ fukNagaevConstant q
proof:
:= by
  rw [fukNagaevConstant_eq_six_add_max]
  exact (le_max_right 4 (q : ℝ)).trans (by linarith)

name: ProbabilityTheory.not_exists_forall_fukNagaevConstant_le
statement:
theorem not_exists_forall_fukNagaevConstant_le :
    ¬ ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ q : ℕ, fukNagaevConstant q ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨C, hC⟩
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := exists_nat_gt C
  have hqC := (natCast_le_fukNagaevConstant q).trans (hC q)
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hqC) hq

name: ProbabilityTheory.mixedEuclideanProcessBound_nonneg
statement:
theorem mixedEuclideanProcessBound_nonneg
    {sigma2 sigma1 x : ℝ} (hsigma2 : 0 ≤ sigma2)
    (hsigma1 : 0 ≤ sigma1) (d : ℕ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    0 ≤ mixedEuclideanProcessBound sigma2 sigma1 d x
proof:
:= by
  unfold mixedEuclideanProcessBound
  positivity

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_unitBall_mixedProcess_largeDeviation_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_unitBall_mixedProcess_largeDeviation_le
    {Omega E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (Z : Omega → EuclideanUnitBall E → ℝ)
    {sigma2 sigma1 x : ℝ}
    (hsigma2 : 0 ≤ sigma2) (hsigma1 : 0 ≤ sigma1) (hx : 0 ≤ x)
    (hcontinuous : ∀ omega, Continuous (Z omega))
    (hzero : ∀ omega, Z omega ⟨0, by simp⟩ = 0)
    (hmixed : ∀ (s t : EuclideanUnitBall E) (y : ℝ), 0 ≤ y →
      mu.real {omega |
        sigma2 * dist s t * Real.sqrt (2 * y) +
            2 * sigma1 * dist s t * y <
          |Z omega s - Z omega t|} ≤
        2 * Real.exp (-y)) :
    mu.real {omega | ∃ t : EuclideanUnitBall E,
        mixedEuclideanProcessBound sigma2 sigma1 (finrank ℝ E) x <
          |Z omega t|} ≤
      Real.exp (-x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, proj, hNzero, hNcard, hprojMem, _hprojNear, hedge,
      hprojDist⟩ := RandomSetTheory.exists_unitBall_dyadic_chainingData (E := E)
  let edges : ℕ → Finset (EuclideanUnitBall E × EuclideanUnitBall E) :=
    RandomSetTheory.unitBallLocalDyadicEdges N
  have hbase : ∀ t, proj 0 t ∈ N 0 := hprojMem 0
  have hbaseZero : ∀ omega, ∀ u ∈ N 0, Z omega u = 0 := by
    intro omega u hu
    have huval : (u : E) = 0 := hNzero u hu
    have hu0 : u = (⟨0, by simp⟩ : EuclideanUnitBall E) := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact huval
    rw [hu0]
    exact hzero omega
  have hedgeDist : ∀ k, ∀ e ∈ edges k,
      dist e.1 e.2 ≤ 3 * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k) := by
    intro k e he
    simpa only [edges, RandomSetTheory.dyadicResolution] using
      RandomSetTheory.dist_le_three_mul_dyadicResolution_of_mem_localEdges N he
  have hedgeCard : ∀ k, ((edges k).card : ℝ) ≤
      Real.exp (4 * (finrank ℝ E : ℝ) * (k + 2 : ℝ)) := by
    intro k
    exact RandomSetTheory.card_unitBallLocalDyadicEdges_real_le_exp N
      (finrank ℝ E) hNcard k
  have hproj : ∀ t, Tendsto (fun k ↦ proj k t) atTop (nhds t) := by
    intro t
    rw [tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero]
    simpa only [dist_comm] using hprojDist t
  simpa only [mixedEuclideanProcessBound] using
    (measureReal_mixedEuclideanContinuousProcess_largeDeviation_le
      Z (N 0) edges proj (finrank ℝ E) hsigma2 hsigma1 hx hcontinuous
      hbase (by simpa only [edges] using hedge) hproj hbaseZero hedgeDist
      hedgeCard hmixed)

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_unitBall_mixedPolynomialProcess_largeDeviation_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_unitBall_mixedPolynomialProcess_largeDeviation_le
    (Z G : Omega → EuclideanUnitBall E → ℝ) (A : Omega → ℝ)
    {q : ℕ} {sigma2 sigma1 rho x y : ℝ}
    (hsigma2 : 0 ≤ sigma2) (hsigma1 : 0 ≤ sigma1)
    (hrho : 0 ≤ rho) (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 < y)
    (hGcontinuous : ∀ omega, Continuous (G omega))
    (hGzero : ∀ omega, G omega ⟨0, by simp⟩ = 0)
    (hGmixed : ∀ (s t : EuclideanUnitBall E) (z : ℝ), 0 ≤ z →
      mu.real {omega |
        sigma2 * dist s t * Real.sqrt (2 * z) +
            2 * sigma1 * dist s t * z <
          |G omega s - G omega t|} ≤
        2 * Real.exp (-z))
    (hAq : Integrable (fun omega ↦ |A omega| ^ q) mu)
    (hdom : ∀ omega t, |Z omega t - G omega t| ≤ rho * |A omega|) :
    mu.real {omega | ∃ t : EuclideanUnitBall E,
        mixedEuclideanProcessBound sigma2 sigma1 (finrank ℝ E) x +
            fukNagaevConstant q * rho * y < |Z omega t|} ≤
      Real.exp (-x) + absoluteMoment A q mu / y ^ q
proof:
:= by
  let lightBad : Set Omega := {omega | ∃ t : EuclideanUnitBall E,
    mixedEuclideanProcessBound sigma2 sigma1 (finrank ℝ E) x <
      |G omega t|}
  let heavyBad : Set Omega := {omega | y ≤ |A omega|}
  have hsubset :
      {omega | ∃ t : EuclideanUnitBall E,
          mixedEuclideanProcessBound sigma2 sigma1 (finrank ℝ E) x +
              fukNagaevConstant q * rho * y < |Z omega t|} ⊆
        lightBad ∪ heavyBad := by
    intro omega homega
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := homega
    by_cases hlight : omega ∈ lightBad
    · exact Or.inl hlight
    by_cases hheavy : omega ∈ heavyBad
    · exact Or.inr hheavy
    exfalso
    have hG : |G omega t| ≤
        mixedEuclideanProcessBound sigma2 sigma1 (finrank ℝ E) x := by
      by_contra hnot
      apply hlight
      exact ⟨t, lt_of_not_ge hnot⟩
    have hA : |A omega| < y := by
      exact lt_of_not_ge hheavy
    have hrhoA : rho * |A omega| ≤ rho * y :=
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hA.le hrho)
    have hC : rho * y ≤ fukNagaevConstant q * rho * y := by
      have hry : 0 ≤ rho * y := mul_nonneg hrho hy.le
      nlinarith [one_le_fukNagaevConstant q]
    have htriangle : |Z omega t| ≤
        |G omega t| + |Z omega t - G omega t| := by
      calc
        |Z omega t| = |G omega t + (Z omega t - G omega t)| := by ring_nf
        _ ≤ |G omega t| + |Z omega t - G omega t| := abs_add_le _ _
    have hupper : |Z omega t| ≤
        mixedEuclideanProcessBound sigma2 sigma1 (finrank ℝ E) x +
          fukNagaevConstant q * rho * y := by
      calc
        |Z omega t| ≤ |G omega t| + |Z omega t - G omega t| := htriangle
        _ ≤ mixedEuclideanProcessBound sigma2 sigma1 (finrank ℝ E) x +
            rho * |A omega| := add_le_add hG (hdom omega t)
        _ ≤ mixedEuclideanProcessBound sigma2 sigma1 (finrank ℝ E) x +
            rho * y := add_le_add le_rfl hrhoA
        _ ≤ mixedEuclideanProcessBound sigma2 sigma1 (finrank ℝ E) x +
            fukNagaevConstant q * rho * y := add_le_add le_rfl hC
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hupper) ht
  have hlight : mu.real lightBad ≤ Real.exp (-x) := by
    simpa only [lightBad] using
      measureReal_unitBall_mixedProcess_largeDeviation_le G hsigma2 hsigma1 hx
        hGcontinuous hGzero hGmixed
  have hheavy : mu.real heavyBad ≤ absoluteMoment A q mu / y ^ q := by
    simpa only [heavyBad] using
      measureReal_abs_ge_le_absoluteMoment_div A q hAq hy
  calc
    mu.real {omega | ∃ t : EuclideanUnitBall E,
        mixedEuclideanProcessBound sigma2 sigma1 (finrank ℝ E) x +
            fukNagaevConstant q * rho * y < |Z omega t|} ≤
        mu.real (lightBad ∪ heavyBad) := measureReal_mono hsubset
    _ ≤ mu.real lightBad + mu.real heavyBad := measureReal_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-x) + absoluteMoment A q mu / y ^ q :=
      add_le_add hlight hheavy

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_unitBall_mixedPolynomialProcess_confidence_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_unitBall_mixedPolynomialProcess_confidence_le
    (Z G : Omega → EuclideanUnitBall E → ℝ) (A : Omega → ℝ)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    {sigma2 sigma1 rho x Kq delta : ℝ}
    (hsigma2 : 0 ≤ sigma2) (hsigma1 : 0 ≤ sigma1)
    (hrho : 0 ≤ rho) (hx : 0 ≤ x)
    (hKq : 0 < Kq) (hdelta : 0 < delta)
    (hGcontinuous : ∀ omega, Continuous (G omega))
    (hGzero : ∀ omega, G omega ⟨0, by simp⟩ = 0)
    (hGmixed : ∀ (s t : EuclideanUnitBall E) (z : ℝ), 0 ≤ z →
      mu.real {omega |
        sigma2 * dist s t * Real.sqrt (2 * z) +
            2 * sigma1 * dist s t * z <
          |G omega s - G omega t|} ≤
        2 * Real.exp (-z))
    (hAq : Integrable (fun omega ↦ |A omega| ^ q) mu)
    (hAmoment : absoluteMoment A q mu ≤ Kq ^ q)
    (hdom : ∀ omega t, |Z omega t - G omega t| ≤ rho * |A omega|) :
    mu.real {omega | ∃ t : EuclideanUnitBall E,
        mixedEuclideanProcessBound sigma2 sigma1 (finrank ℝ E) x +
            fukNagaevConstant q * rho *
              (Kq * (1 / delta) ^ (1 / (q : ℝ))) <
          |Z omega t|} ≤
      Real.exp (-x) + delta
proof:
:= by
  let r : ℝ := 1 / delta
  let y : ℝ := Kq * r ^ (1 / (q : ℝ))
  have hqreal : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hr : 0 < r := one_div_pos.mpr hdelta
  have hy : 0 < y := mul_pos hKq (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hr _)
  have hrootPow : (r ^ (1 / (q : ℝ))) ^ q = r := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hr.le]
    rw [one_div, inv_mul_cancel₀ hqreal.ne', Real.rpow_one]
  have hyPow : y ^ q = Kq ^ q * r := by
    simp only [y, mul_pow, hrootPow]
  have hpoly : absoluteMoment A q mu / y ^ q ≤ delta := by
    calc
      absoluteMoment A q mu / y ^ q ≤ Kq ^ q / y ^ q := by
        exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hAmoment (pow_nonneg hy.le q)
      _ = delta := by
        rw [hyPow]
        have hKpow : Kq ^ q ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero q hKq.ne'
        dsimp only [r]
        field_simp
  have hbase := measureReal_unitBall_mixedPolynomialProcess_largeDeviation_le
    Z G A hsigma2 hsigma1 hrho hx hy hGcontinuous hGzero hGmixed hAq hdom
  simpa only [y, r] using hbase.trans (add_le_add le_rfl hpoly)

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_unitBall_mixedPolynomialEmpiricalProcess_confidence_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_unitBall_mixedPolynomialEmpiricalProcess_confidence_le
    (Z G : Omega → EuclideanUnitBall E → ℝ) (A : Omega → ℝ)
    {n q : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hq : 0 < q)
    {sigma2 sigma1 x Kq delta : ℝ}
    (hsigma2 : 0 ≤ sigma2) (hsigma1 : 0 ≤ sigma1) (hx : 0 ≤ x)
    (hKq : 0 < Kq) (hdelta : 0 < delta)
    (hGcontinuous : ∀ omega, Continuous (G omega))
    (hGzero : ∀ omega, G omega ⟨0, by simp⟩ = 0)
    (hGmixed : ∀ (s t : EuclideanUnitBall E) (z : ℝ), 0 ≤ z →
      mu.real {omega |
        sigma2 * dist s t * Real.sqrt (2 * z) +
            2 * sigma1 * dist s t * z <
          |G omega s - G omega t|} ≤
        2 * Real.exp (-z))
    (hAq : Integrable (fun omega ↦ |A omega| ^ q) mu)
    (hAmoment : absoluteMoment A q mu ≤ Kq ^ q)
    (hdom : ∀ omega t,
      |Z omega t - G omega t| ≤
        (n : ℝ) ^ (-1 + 1 / (q : ℝ)) * |A omega|) :
    mu.real {omega | ∃ t : EuclideanUnitBall E,
        mixedEuclideanProcessBound sigma2 sigma1 (finrank ℝ E) x +
            fukNagaevConstant q * Kq *
              (1 / delta) ^ (1 / (q : ℝ)) *
              (n : ℝ) ^ (-1 + 1 / (q : ℝ)) <
          |Z omega t|} ≤
      Real.exp (-x) + delta
proof:
:= by
  have hnreal : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hrho : 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ (-1 + 1 / (q : ℝ)) :=
    (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hnreal _).le
  have h := measureReal_unitBall_mixedPolynomialProcess_confidence_le
    Z G A hq hsigma2 hsigma1 hrho hx hKq hdelta hGcontinuous hGzero
      hGmixed hAq hAmoment hdom
  simpa only [mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using h

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_unitBall_subgaussianPolynomialEmpiricalProcess_confidence_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_unitBall_subgaussianPolynomialEmpiricalProcess_confidence_le
    (Z G : Omega → EuclideanUnitBall E → ℝ) (A : Omega → ℝ)
    {n q : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hq : 0 < q)
    {K2 Kq x delta : ℝ} (hK2 : 0 ≤ K2) (hx : 0 ≤ x)
    (hKq : 0 < Kq) (hdelta : 0 < delta)
    (hGcontinuous : ∀ omega, Continuous (G omega))
    (hGzero : ∀ omega, G omega ⟨0, by simp⟩ = 0)
    (hGsubgaussian : ∀ (s t : EuclideanUnitBall E) (z : ℝ), 0 ≤ z →
      mu.real {omega |
        (K2 / Real.sqrt n) * dist s t * Real.sqrt (2 * z) <
          |G omega s - G omega t|} ≤
        2 * Real.exp (-z))
    (hAq : Integrable (fun omega ↦ |A omega| ^ q) mu)
    (hAmoment : absoluteMoment A q mu ≤ Kq ^ q)
    (hdom : ∀ omega t,
      |Z omega t - G omega t| ≤
        (n : ℝ) ^ (-1 + 1 / (q : ℝ)) * |A omega|) :
    mu.real {omega | ∃ t : EuclideanUnitBall E,
        6 * (K2 / Real.sqrt n) * Real.sqrt (2 * x) +
            72 * (K2 / Real.sqrt n) *
              Real.sqrt (finrank ℝ E + 1 : ℝ) +
            fukNagaevConstant q * Kq *
              (1 / delta) ^ (1 / (q : ℝ)) *
              (n : ℝ) ^ (-1 + 1 / (q : ℝ)) <
          |Z omega t|} ≤
      Real.exp (-x) + delta
proof:
:= by
  have hsqrt : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hsigma : 0 ≤ K2 / Real.sqrt n := div_nonneg hK2 hsqrt
  have h := measureReal_unitBall_mixedPolynomialEmpiricalProcess_confidence_le
    Z G A hn hq hsigma (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 0 by norm_num) hx hKq hdelta
      hGcontinuous hGzero (by
        intro s t z hz
        simpa using hGsubgaussian s t z hz) hAq hAmoment hdom
  simpa only [mixedEuclideanProcessBound, mul_zero, zero_mul, add_zero] using h

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasBernsteinMGF.const_mul
statement:
theorem HasBernsteinMGF.const_mul {X : Ω → ℝ} {v b : ℝ≥0}
    (hX : HasBernsteinMGF X v b μ) (a : ℝ) :
    HasBernsteinMGF (fun ω ↦ a * X ω)
      ⟨a ^ 2 * (v : ℝ), mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg a) v.coe_nonneg⟩
      ⟨|a| * (b : ℝ), mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg a) b.coe_nonneg⟩ μ
proof:
:= by
  refine
    { aemeasurable := hX.aemeasurable.const_mul a
      integrable_exp_mul := ?_
      mgf_le := ?_ }
  · intro t ht
    change |a| * (b : ℝ) * |t| < 1 at ht
    have hdomain : (b : ℝ) * |a * t| < 1 := by
      rw [abs_mul]
      nlinarith [abs_nonneg a, abs_nonneg t, b.coe_nonneg]
    simpa only [mul_assoc, mul_left_comm] using
      hX.integrable_exp_mul (a * t) hdomain
  · intro t ht
    change |a| * (b : ℝ) * |t| < 1 at ht
    have hdomain : (b : ℝ) * |a * t| < 1 := by
      rw [abs_mul]
      nlinarith [abs_nonneg a, abs_nonneg t, b.coe_nonneg]
    change mgf (fun ω ↦ a * X ω) μ t ≤
      Real.exp ((a ^ 2 * (v : ℝ)) * t ^ 2 /
        (2 * (1 - (|a| * (b : ℝ)) * |t|)))
    rw [mgf_const_mul]
    convert hX.mgf_le (a * t) hdomain using 1
    · simp only [abs_mul]
      ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasBernsteinMGF.nnreal_mul
proof:
:= by
  refine
    { aemeasurable := hX.aemeasurable.const_mul (a : ℝ)
      integrable_exp_mul := ?_
      mgf_le := ?_ }
  · intro t ht
    have hdomain : (b : ℝ) * |(a : ℝ) * t| < 1 := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg a.coe_nonneg]
      push_cast at ht ⊢
      nlinarith [a.coe_nonneg, abs_nonneg t, b.coe_nonneg]
    simpa only [mul_assoc, mul_left_comm] using
      hX.integrable_exp_mul ((a : ℝ) * t) hdomain
  · intro t ht
    have hdomain : (b : ℝ) * |(a : ℝ) * t| < 1 := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg a.coe_nonneg]
      push_cast at ht ⊢
      nlinarith [a.coe_nonneg, abs_nonneg t, b.coe_nonneg]
    rw [mgf_const_mul]
    convert hX.mgf_le ((a : ℝ) * t) hdomain using 1
    push_cast
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg a.coe_nonneg]
    ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.exp_le_one_add_add_three_quarters_sq
statement:
theorem exp_le_one_add_add_three_quarters_sq {x : ℝ} (hx : |x| ≤ 1) :
    Real.exp x ≤ 1 + x + (3 / 4 : ℝ) * x ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := (abs_le.mp (Real.exp_bound hx (n := 2) (by norm_num))).2
  norm_num [Finset.sum_range_succ, Nat.factorial] at h ⊢
  nlinarith

name: ProbabilityTheory.hasBernsteinMGF_of_memLp_two_of_ae_abs_le_of_integral_eq_zero
statement:
theorem hasBernsteinMGF_of_memLp_two_of_ae_abs_le_of_integral_eq_zero
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 2 μ) {v b : ℝ}
    (hv : 0 ≤ v) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hbound : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, |X ω| ≤ b)
    (hcenter : ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ = 0)
    (hsecond : ∫ ω, X ω ^ 2 ∂μ ≤ v) :
    HasBernsteinMGF X
      ⟨2 * v, mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hv⟩ ⟨b, hb⟩ μ
proof:
:= by
  have hXint : Integrable X μ := hX.integrable (by norm_num)
  have hXsq : Integrable (fun ω ↦ X ω ^ 2) μ :=
    (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq hX.aestronglyMeasurable).1 hX
  refine
    { aemeasurable := hX.aemeasurable
      integrable_exp_mul := ?_
      mgf_le := ?_ }
  · intro t ht
    apply Integrable.of_bound
      ((hX.aemeasurable.const_mul t).exp.aestronglyMeasurable)
      (Real.exp (|t| * b))
    filter_upwards [hbound] with ω hω
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    calc
      t * X ω ≤ |t * X ω| := le_abs_self _
      _ = |t| * |X ω| := abs_mul _ _
      _ ≤ |t| * b := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hω (abs_nonneg _)
  · intro t ht
    have hdomain : 0 < 1 - b * |t| := sub_pos.mpr ht
    have hpoint : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ,
        Real.exp (t * X ω) ≤
          1 + t * X ω + (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (t * X ω) ^ 2 := by
      filter_upwards [hbound] with ω hω
      apply exp_le_one_add_add_three_quarters_sq
      calc
        |t * X ω| = |t| * |X ω| := abs_mul _ _
        _ ≤ |t| * b := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hω (abs_nonneg _)
        _ = b * |t| := mul_comm _ _
        _ ≤ 1 := ht.le
    have hexp : Integrable (fun ω ↦ Real.exp (t * X ω)) μ := by
      apply Integrable.of_bound
        ((hX.aemeasurable.const_mul t).exp.aestronglyMeasurable)
        (Real.exp (|t| * b))
      filter_upwards [hbound] with ω hω
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      calc
        t * X ω ≤ |t * X ω| := le_abs_self _
        _ = |t| * |X ω| := abs_mul _ _
        _ ≤ |t| * b := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hω (abs_nonneg _)
    have hlin : Integrable (fun ω ↦ t * X ω) μ := hXint.const_mul t
    have hsqscaled : Integrable (fun ω ↦ (t * X ω) ^ 2) μ := by
      convert hXsq.const_mul (t ^ 2) using 1
      ext ω
      ring
    have hsqterm : Integrable
        (fun ω ↦ (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (t * X ω) ^ 2) μ :=
      hsqscaled.const_mul (3 / 4 : ℝ)
    have hfirst : Integrable (fun ω ↦ 1 + t * X ω) μ :=
      (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).add hlin
    have hquad : Integrable
        (fun ω ↦ 1 + t * X ω + (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (t * X ω) ^ 2) μ :=
      hfirst.add hsqterm
    have hsqIntegral :
        (∫ ω, (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (t * X ω) ^ 2 ∂μ) =
          (3 / 4 : ℝ) * t ^ 2 * (∫ ω, X ω ^ 2 ∂μ) := by
      calc
        (∫ ω, (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (t * X ω) ^ 2 ∂μ) =
            (3 / 4 : ℝ) * ∫ ω, (t * X ω) ^ 2 ∂μ :=
          integral_const_mul _ _
        _ = (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (t ^ 2 * ∫ ω, X ω ^ 2 ∂μ) := by
          congr 1
          convert integral_const_mul (t ^ 2) (fun ω ↦ X ω ^ 2) using 1
          ring
        _ = (3 / 4 : ℝ) * t ^ 2 * (∫ ω, X ω ^ 2 ∂μ) := by ring
    have hmgf : mgf X μ t ≤ 1 + (3 / 4 : ℝ) * t ^ 2 * v := by
      calc
        mgf X μ t ≤ ∫ ω,
            (1 + t * X ω + (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (t * X ω) ^ 2) ∂μ :=
          integral_mono_ae hexp hquad hpoint
        _ = 1 + (3 / 4 : ℝ) * t ^ 2 *
            (∫ ω, X ω ^ 2 ∂μ) := by
          rw [integral_add hfirst hsqterm,
            integral_add (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)) hlin,
            integral_const_mul, hcenter, hsqIntegral]
          simp
        _ ≤ 1 + (3 / 4 : ℝ) * t ^ 2 * v := by gcongr
    calc
      mgf X μ t ≤ 1 + (3 / 4 : ℝ) * t ^ 2 * v := hmgf
      _ ≤ Real.exp ((3 / 4 : ℝ) * t ^ 2 * v) := by
        simpa [add_comm] using
          Real.add_one_le_exp ((3 / 4 : ℝ) * t ^ 2 * v)
      _ ≤ Real.exp
          (((⟨2 * v, mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hv⟩ : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) * t ^ 2 /
            (2 * (1 - ((⟨b, hb⟩ : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) * |t|))) := by
        apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
        change (3 / 4 : ℝ) * t ^ 2 * v ≤
          (2 * v) * t ^ 2 / (2 * (1 - b * |t|))
        rw [le_div_iff₀ (mul_pos (by norm_num) hdomain)]
        have hz : 0 ≤ b * |t| := mul_nonneg hb (abs_nonneg t)
        have hA : 0 ≤ (3 / 4 : ℝ) * t ^ 2 * v := by positivity
        calc
          (3 / 4 : ℝ) * t ^ 2 * v * (2 * (1 - b * |t|)) ≤
              (3 / 4 : ℝ) * t ^ 2 * v * 2 := by
            gcongr
            linarith
          _ ≤ 2 * v * t ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg t]

name: ProbabilityTheory.hasBernsteinMGF_centered_of_memLp_two_of_ae_abs_le
statement:
theorem hasBernsteinMGF_centered_of_memLp_two_of_ae_abs_le
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 2 μ) {v b : ℝ}
    (hv : 0 ≤ v) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hbound : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, |X ω| ≤ b)
    (hsecond : ∫ ω, X ω ^ 2 ∂μ ≤ v) :
    HasBernsteinMGF (fun ω ↦ X ω - ∫ z, X z ∂μ)
      ⟨2 * v, mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hv⟩
      ⟨2 * b, mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hb⟩ μ
proof:
:= by
  let m : ℝ := ∫ z, X z ∂μ
  let Xc : Ω → ℝ := fun ω ↦ X ω - m
  have hXint : Integrable X μ := hX.integrable (by norm_num)
  have hXc : MemLp Xc 2 μ := by
    exact hX.sub (memLp_const m)
  have hm : |m| ≤ b := by
    have h := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
      (μ := μ) (f := X) (C := b) (by
        filter_upwards [hbound] with ω hω
        simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hω)
    simpa only [m, Real.norm_eq_abs, probReal_univ, mul_one] using h
  have hXcbound : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, |Xc ω| ≤ 2 * b := by
    filter_upwards [hbound] with ω hω
    calc
      |Xc ω| = |X ω - m| := rfl
      _ ≤ |X ω| + |m| := abs_sub _ _
      _ ≤ b + b := add_le_add hω hm
      _ = 2 * b := by ring
  have hXccenter : ∫ ω, Xc ω ∂μ = 0 := by
    change (∫ ω, X ω - m ∂μ) = 0
    rw [integral_sub hXint (integrable_const m)]
    simp [m]
  have hXcsecond : ∫ ω, Xc ω ^ 2 ∂μ ≤ v := by
    change (∫ ω, (X ω - ∫ z, X z ∂μ) ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤ v
    rw [← variance_eq_integral hX.aemeasurable]
    exact (variance_le_expectation_sq hX.aestronglyMeasurable).trans hsecond
  exact hasBernsteinMGF_of_memLp_two_of_ae_abs_le_of_integral_eq_zero
    Xc hXc hv (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hb) hXcbound hXccenter hXcsecond

statement:

:=
  Iff.rfl

name: RandomSetTheory.finiteRegimeCorrespondence_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finiteRegimeCorrespondence_apply (p : Ω → ι) (K : ι → Set E)
    (ω : Ω) : finiteRegimeCorrespondence p K ω = K (p ω)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: RandomSetTheory.sum_regimeCell_indicator
statement:
theorem sum_regimeCell_indicator [Fintype ι]
    (p : Ω → ι) (g : ι → Ω → E) (ω : Ω) :
    ∑ i, (regimeCell p i).indicator (g i) ω = g (p ω) ω
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (p ω)]
  · exact Set.indicator_of_mem (M := E)
      (s := regimeCell p (p ω)) (a := ω) rfl (g (p ω))
  · intro i _ hi
    exact Set.indicator_of_notMem
      (fun hmem : ω ∈ regimeCell p i => hi hmem.symm) (g i)
  · simp

name: RandomSetTheory.effrosMeasurable_finiteRegimeCorrespondence
statement:
theorem effrosMeasurable_finiteRegimeCorrespondence
    [Fintype ι] [TopologicalSpace E]
    {p : Ω → ι} {K : ι → Set E}
    (hcell : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (regimeCell p i)) :
    RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable (finiteRegimeCorrespondence p K)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro U _hU
  have heq :
      {ω | (finiteRegimeCorrespondence p K ω ∩ U).Nonempty} =
        ⋃ i : ι, if (K i ∩ U).Nonempty then regimeCell p i else ∅ := by
    ext ω
    simp only [finiteRegimeCorrespondence_apply, mem_setOf_eq, mem_iUnion]
    constructor
    · intro hω
      refine ⟨p ω, ?_⟩
      rw [if_pos hω]
      exact rfl
    · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
      by_cases hKi : (K i ∩ U).Nonempty
      · rw [if_pos hKi] at hi
        rw [mem_regimeCell] at hi
        rwa [hi]
      · rw [if_neg hKi] at hi
        have : False := by simpa using hi
        exact this.elim
  rw [heq]
  exact MeasurableSet.iUnion fun i => by
    by_cases hi : (K i ∩ U).Nonempty
    · simpa [hi] using hcell i
    · simp only [hi, if_false, MeasurableSet.empty]

name: RandomSetTheory.setIntegral_mem_measureReal_smul
statement:
theorem setIntegral_mem_measureReal_smul
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {A : Set Ω}
    {K : Set E} (hKconv : Convex ℝ K) (hKclosed : IsClosed K)
    (hKne : K.Nonempty) {f : Ω → E}
    (hf : Integrable f μ)
    (hfK : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ.restrict A, f ω ∈ K) :
    (∫ ω in A, f ω ∂μ) ∈ μ.real A • K
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hA0 : μ A = 0
  · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hKne
    have hzeroMem : (0 : ℝ) • k ∈ (0 : ℝ) • K :=
      Set.smul_mem_smul_set hk
    have hintZero : (∫ ω in A, f ω ∂μ) = 0 := by
      rw [Measure.restrict_eq_zero.mpr hA0, integral_zero_measure]
    simpa [hintZero, measureReal_def, hA0] using hzeroMem
  · have havg : (⨍ ω in A, f ω ∂μ) ∈ K :=
      hKconv.set_average_mem hKclosed hA0 (measure_ne_top μ A) hfK hf.integrableOn
    have hscaled : μ.real A • (⨍ ω in A, f ω ∂μ) ∈ μ.real A • K :=
      Set.smul_mem_smul_set havg
    have hscaleEq :
        μ.real A • (⨍ ω in A, f ω ∂μ) = ∫ ω in A, f ω ∂μ := by
      simpa only [measureReal_restrict_apply_univ] using
        (measure_smul_average (μ.restrict A) f)
    rwa [hscaleEq] at hscaled

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_finiteRegimeCorrespondence
statement:
theorem aumannExpectation_finiteRegimeCorrespondence
    [Fintype ι]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {p : Ω → ι} {K : ι → Set E}
    (hcell : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (regimeCell p i))
    (hKconv : ∀ i, Convex ℝ (K i))
    (hKclosed : ∀ i, IsClosed (K i))
    (hKne : ∀ i, (K i).Nonempty) :
    aumannExpectation μ (finiteRegimeCorrespondence p K) =
      ∑ i, μ.real (regimeCell p i) • K i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
    have hfKi : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ.restrict (regimeCell p i), f ω ∈ K i := by
      intro i
      rw [ae_restrict_iff' (hcell i)]
      filter_upwards [hf.2] with ω hsel hωi
      rw [finiteRegimeCorrespondence_apply] at hsel
      rw [mem_regimeCell] at hωi
      rwa [hωi] at hsel
    have hpiece : ∀ i, (∫ ω in regimeCell p i, f ω ∂μ) ∈
        μ.real (regimeCell p i) • K i := by
      intro i
      exact setIntegral_mem_measureReal_smul (hKconv i)
        (hKclosed i) (hKne i) hf.1 (hfKi i)
    have hdecomp :
        (∫ ω, f ω ∂μ) = ∑ i, ∫ ω in regimeCell p i, f ω ∂μ := by
      calc
        (∫ ω, f ω ∂μ) =
            ∫ ω, ∑ i, (regimeCell p i).indicator f ω ∂μ := by
              apply integral_congr_ae
              filter_upwards [] with ω
              simpa using
                (sum_regimeCell_indicator p (fun _ => f) ω).symm
        _ = ∑ i, ∫ ω, (regimeCell p i).indicator f ω ∂μ :=
          integral_finsetSum Finset.univ fun i _ => hf.1.indicator (hcell i)
        _ = ∑ i, ∫ ω in regimeCell p i, f ω ∂μ := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          exact integral_indicator (hcell i)
    rw [hdecomp]
    exact Set.finsetSum_mem_finsetSum Finset.univ
      (fun i => μ.real (regimeCell p i) • K i)
      (fun i => ∫ ω in regimeCell p i, f ω ∂μ)
      (fun i _ => hpiece i)
  · rw [Set.mem_fintype_sum]
    rintro ⟨y, hy, hySum⟩
    have hex : ∀ i, ∃ k ∈ K i, μ.real (regimeCell p i) • k = y i := by
      intro i
      exact Set.mem_smul_set.mp (hy i)
    choose k hkK hky using hex
    let f : Ω → E := fun ω =>
      ∑ i, (regimeCell p i).indicator (fun _ => k i) ω
    have hfInt : Integrable f μ := by
      dsimp only [f]
      exact integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ fun i _ =>
        (integrable_const (k i)).indicator (hcell i)
    have hfSel : ∀ ω, f ω ∈ finiteRegimeCorrespondence p K ω := by
      intro ω
      have hfEq : f ω = k (p ω) := by
        exact sum_regimeCell_indicator p (fun i _ => k i) ω
      rw [finiteRegimeCorrespondence_apply, hfEq]
      exact hkK (p ω)
    refine ⟨f, ⟨hfInt, Filter.Eventually.of_forall hfSel⟩, ?_⟩
    calc
      (∫ ω, f ω ∂μ) =
          ∑ i, ∫ ω, (regimeCell p i).indicator (fun _ => k i) ω ∂μ := by
            dsimp only [f]
            exact integral_finsetSum Finset.univ fun i _ =>
              (integrable_const (k i)).indicator (hcell i)
      _ = ∑ i, μ.real (regimeCell p i) • k i := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        exact integral_indicator_const (k i) (hcell i)
      _ = ∑ i, y i := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        exact hky i
      _ = x := hySum

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_isCompact_of_finiteRegime
statement:
theorem aumannExpectation_isCompact_of_finiteRegime
    [Fintype ι]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {p : Ω → ι} {K : ι → Set E}

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasCondOneSidedMGF.ae_condExp_le
statement:
theorem ae_condExp_le
    {X : Omega → ℝ} {psi : ℝ → ℝ} {hm : m ≤ mOmega}
    (hX : HasCondOneSidedMGF m hm X psi mu)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      mu[fun z ↦ exp (t * X z) | m] omega ≤ exp (psi t)
proof:
:=
  hX.cond_mgf_le t ht

name: ProbabilityTheory.integrable_exp_mul_add_of_ae_le
statement:
theorem integrable_exp_mul_add_of_ae_le
    [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    {X Y : Omega → ℝ} (hX : AEMeasurable X mu) (hY : AEMeasurable Y mu)
    {BX BY t : ℝ} (hBX : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, X omega ≤ BX)
    (hBY : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, Y omega ≤ BY) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    Integrable (fun omega ↦ exp (t * (X omega + Y omega))) mu
proof:
:= by
  apply Integrable.of_bound
    (((hX.add hY).const_mul t).exp.aestronglyMeasurable)
    (exp (t * (BX + BY)))
  filter_upwards [hBX, hBY] with omega hXomega hYomega
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (exp_pos _)]
  exact exp_le_exp.mpr
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add hXomega hYomega) ht)

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasOneSidedMGF.zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem HasOneSidedMGF.zero [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] :
    HasOneSidedMGF (fun _ : Omega ↦ 0) (fun _ ↦ 0) mu
proof:
:= by
  refine
    { aemeasurable := aemeasurable_const
      integrable_exp_mul := ?_
      mgf_le := ?_ }
  · intro t _ht
    simpa only [mul_zero, exp_zero] using
      (integrable_const (1 : ℝ) : Integrable (fun _ : Omega ↦ (1 : ℝ)) mu)
  · intro t _ht
    simp [mgf]

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasOneSidedMGF.add_of_hasCondOneSidedMGF
statement:
theorem HasOneSidedMGF.add_of_hasCondOneSidedMGF
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {X Y : Omega → ℝ} {psiX psiY : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hm : m ≤ mOmega) (hX : HasOneSidedMGF X psiX mu)
    (hXm : StronglyMeasurable[m] X)
    (hY : HasCondOneSidedMGF m hm Y psiY mu)
    {BX BY : ℝ} (hBX : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, X omega ≤ BX)
    (hBY : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, Y omega ≤ BY) :
    HasOneSidedMGF (fun omega ↦ X omega + Y omega)
      (fun t ↦ psiX t + psiY t) mu
proof:
:= by
  refine
    { aemeasurable := hX.aemeasurable.add hY.aemeasurable
      integrable_exp_mul := ?_
      mgf_le := ?_ }
  · intro t ht
    exact integrable_exp_mul_add_of_ae_le
      hX.aemeasurable hY.aemeasurable hBX hBY ht
  · intro t ht
    let C : ℝ := exp (psiY t)
    let f : Omega → ℝ := fun omega ↦ exp (t * X omega)
    let g : Omega → ℝ := fun omega ↦ exp (t * Y omega)
    have hfMeas : StronglyMeasurable[m] f := by
      simpa only [f, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using
        continuous_exp.comp_stronglyMeasurable (hXm.const_smul t)
    have hgInt : Integrable g mu := hY.integrable_exp_mul t ht
    have hfgInt : Integrable (f * g) mu := by
      have hsum := integrable_exp_mul_add_of_ae_le
        hX.aemeasurable hY.aemeasurable hBX hBY ht
      convert hsum using 1
      ext omega
      simp only [f, g, Pi.mul_apply, mul_add, exp_add]
    have hpull : mu[f * g | m] =ᵐ[mu] f * mu[g | m] :=
      condExp_mul_of_stronglyMeasurable_left hfMeas hfgInt hgInt
    have hrightInt : Integrable (f * mu[g | m]) mu :=
      integrable_condExp.congr hpull
    have hCInt : Integrable (fun omega ↦ f omega * C) mu :=
      (hX.integrable_exp_mul t ht).mul_const C
    have hcond := hY.cond_mgf_le t ht
    have hmono : f * mu[g | m] ≤ᵐ[mu] fun omega ↦ f omega * C := by
      filter_upwards [hcond] with omega homega
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left homega (exp_nonneg _)
    calc
      mgf (fun omega ↦ X omega + Y omega) mu t =
          ∫ omega, (f * g) omega ∂mu := by
        simp only [mgf, f, g, mul_add, exp_add, Pi.mul_apply]
      _ = ∫ omega, mu[f * g | m] omega ∂mu := by
        rw [integral_condExp hm]
      _ = ∫ omega, f omega * mu[g | m] omega ∂mu :=
        integral_congr_ae hpull
      _ ≤ ∫ omega, f omega * C ∂mu :=
        integral_mono_ae hrightInt hCInt hmono
      _ = mgf X mu t * C := by
        rw [integral_mul_const]
        rfl
      _ ≤ exp (psiX t) * C := by
        gcongr
        exact hX.mgf_le t ht
      _ = exp (psiX t + psiY t) := by
        rw [show C = exp (psiY t) by rfl, ← exp_add]

name: ProbabilityTheory.ae_sum_range_le_sum
statement:
theorem ae_sum_range_le_sum
    {Y : ℕ → Omega → ℝ} {B : ℕ → ℝ} {n : ℕ}
    (hbound : ∀ i < n, ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, Y i omega ≤ B i) :
    ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      (∑ i ∈ range n, Y i omega) ≤ ∑ i ∈ range n, B i
proof:
:= by
  have hall : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, ∀ i ∈ range n, Y i omega ≤ B i := by
    rw [(range n).eventually_all]
    intro i hi
    exact hbound i (mem_range.mp hi)
  filter_upwards [hall] with omega homega
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi ↦ homega i hi

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasOneSidedMGF.sum_of_hasCondOneSidedMGF
statement:
theorem HasOneSidedMGF.sum_of_hasCondOneSidedMGF
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {Y : ℕ → Omega → ℝ} {psi : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ} {B : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hAdapted : StronglyAdapted filtration Y)
    (hzero : HasOneSidedMGF (Y 0) (psi 0) mu)
    (n : ℕ)
    (hbound : ∀ i < n, ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, Y i omega ≤ B i)
    (hcond : ∀ i < n - 1,
      HasCondOneSidedMGF (filtration i) (filtration.le i)
        (Y (i + 1)) (psi (i + 1)) mu) :
    HasOneSidedMGF (fun omega ↦ ∑ i ∈ range n, Y i omega)
      (fun t ↦ ∑ i ∈ range n, psi i t) mu
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
      cases n with
      | zero => simpa using hzero
      | succ n =>
          have ih' := ih
            (fun i hi ↦ hbound i (by omega))
            (fun i hi ↦ hcond i (by omega))
          have hSmeas : StronglyMeasurable[filtration n]
              (fun omega ↦ ∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), Y i omega) := by
            apply Finset.stronglyMeasurable_fun_sum
            intro i hi
            exact (hAdapted i).mono (filtration.mono (by
              have hi' := mem_range.mp hi
              omega))
          have hSbound : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
              (∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), Y i omega) ≤
                ∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), B i :=
            ae_sum_range_le_sum
              (fun i hi ↦ hbound i (by omega))
          have hnextBound : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
              Y (n + 1) omega ≤ B (n + 1) :=
            hbound (n + 1) (by omega)
          have hnext : HasCondOneSidedMGF (filtration n)
              (filtration.le n) (Y (n + 1)) (psi (n + 1)) mu :=
            hcond n (by omega)
          simp_rw [sum_range_succ _ (n + 1)]
          exact ih'.add_of_hasCondOneSidedMGF
            (filtration.le n) hSmeas hnext hSbound hnextBound

name: ProbabilityTheory.hasOneSidedMGF_of_strongMoment
statement:
theorem hasOneSidedMGF_of_strongMoment
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : Omega → ℝ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 ≤ y)
    (hX : Integrable X mu)
    (hXsq : Integrable (fun omega ↦ X omega ^ 2) mu)
    (hpow : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      Integrable (fun omega ↦ (max (X omega) 0) ^ k) mu)
    (hupper : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, X omega ≤ y)
    (hcenter : (∫ omega, X omega ∂mu) ≤ 0) :
    HasOneSidedMGF X
      (fun t ↦ strongMomentTaylorExponent q t y
        (∫ omega, X omega ^ 2 ∂mu)
        (fun k ↦ ∫ omega, (max (X omega) 0) ^ k ∂mu)) mu
proof:
:= by
  refine
    { aemeasurable := hX.aemeasurable
      integrable_exp_mul := ?_
      mgf_le := ?_ }
  · intro t ht
    apply Integrable.of_bound
      ((hX.aemeasurable.const_mul t).exp.aestronglyMeasurable)
      (exp (t * y))
    filter_upwards [hupper] with omega homega
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (exp_pos _)]
    exact exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left homega ht)
  · intro t ht
    exact integral_exp_mul_le_exp_strongMomentTaylorExponent
      X q hq ht hy hX hXsq hpow hupper hcenter

name: ProbabilityTheory.hasCondOneSidedMGF_of_strongMoment
statement:
theorem hasCondOneSidedMGF_of_strongMoment
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hm : m ≤ mOmega) (X : Omega → ℝ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    {y second : ℝ} (hy : 0 ≤ y)
    (hX : Integrable X mu)
    (hXsq : Integrable (fun omega ↦ X omega ^ 2) mu)
    (hpow : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      Integrable (fun omega ↦ (max (X omega) 0) ^ k) mu)
    (hupper : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, X omega ≤ y)
    (hcenter : mu[X | m] ≤ᵐ[mu] 0)
    (hsecond : mu[fun omega ↦ X omega ^ 2 | m] ≤ᵐ[mu]
      fun _ ↦ second)
    (moment : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hmoment : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      mu[fun omega ↦ (max (X omega) 0) ^ k | m] ≤ᵐ[mu]
        fun _ ↦ moment k) :
    HasCondOneSidedMGF m hm X
      (fun t ↦ strongMomentTaylorExponent q t y second moment) mu
proof:
:= by
  refine
    { aemeasurable := hX.aemeasurable
      integrable_exp_mul := ?_
      cond_mgf_le := ?_ }
  · intro t ht
    apply Integrable.of_bound
      ((hX.aemeasurable.const_mul t).exp.aestronglyMeasurable)
      (exp (t * y))
    filter_upwards [hupper] with omega homega
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (exp_pos _)]
    exact exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left homega ht)
  · intro t ht
    exact condExp_exp_mul_le_exp_strongMomentTaylorExponent
      hm X q hq ht hy hX hXsq hpow hupper hcenter hsecond moment hmoment

name: RandomSetTheory.nextEffrosSelectionStage_dist_lt
statement:
theorem nextEffrosSelectionStage_dist_lt
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [MetricSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] [Nonempty E]
    {S : Ω → Set E} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty) {n : ℕ}
    (prev : EffrosSelectionStage S n) (ω : Ω) :
    dist ((nextEffrosSelectionStage (S := S) hS hne prev).toFun ω) (prev.toFun ω) <
      selectionAccuracy (n + 1) + selectionAccuracy n
proof:
:= by
  let G : Ω → Set E :=
    fun ω => S ω ∩ Metric.ball (prev.toFun ω) (selectionAccuracy n)
  have hGne : ∀ ω, (G ω).Nonempty :=
    nonempty_inter_ball_of_infDist_lt hne prev.close'
  have hnextG :
      infDist
        (effrosApproximateSelection G hGne (selectionAccuracy (n + 1))
          (selectionAccuracy_pos (n + 1)) ω)
        (G ω) < selectionAccuracy (n + 1) :=
    infDist_effrosApproximateSelection_lt G hGne
      (selectionAccuracy_pos (n + 1)) ω
  obtain ⟨x, hxG, hnextx⟩ := (infDist_lt_iff (hGne ω)).mp hnextG
  change dist
      (effrosApproximateSelection G hGne (selectionAccuracy (n + 1))
        (selectionAccuracy_pos (n + 1)) ω)
      (prev.toFun ω) < selectionAccuracy (n + 1) + selectionAccuracy n
  calc
    dist
        (effrosApproximateSelection G hGne (selectionAccuracy (n + 1))
          (selectionAccuracy_pos (n + 1)) ω)
        (prev.toFun ω) ≤
        dist
          (effrosApproximateSelection G hGne (selectionAccuracy (n + 1))
            (selectionAccuracy_pos (n + 1)) ω) x +
          dist x (prev.toFun ω) := dist_triangle _ _ _
    _ < selectionAccuracy (n + 1) + selectionAccuracy n := by
      apply add_lt_add hnextx
      simpa [G, Metric.mem_ball] using hxG.2

name: RandomSetTheory.krnApproximation_dist_succ_lt
statement:
theorem krnApproximation_dist_succ_lt
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [MetricSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] [Nonempty E]
    {S : Ω → Set E} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :
    dist (krnApproximation hS hne (n + 1) ω)
        (krnApproximation hS hne n ω) <
      selectionAccuracy (n + 1) + selectionAccuracy n
proof:
:= by
  exact nextEffrosSelectionStage_dist_lt hS hne (krnStage hS hne n) ω

name: RandomSetTheory.krnApproximation_cauchySeq
statement:
theorem krnApproximation_cauchySeq
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [MetricSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] [Nonempty E]
    {S : Ω → Set E} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty) (ω : Ω) :
    CauchySeq (fun n => krnApproximation hS hne n ω)
proof:
:= by
  apply cauchySeq_of_dist_le_of_summable
    (fun n => selectionAccuracy (n + 1) + selectionAccuracy n)
  · intro n
    simpa [dist_comm] using (krnApproximation_dist_succ_lt hS hne n ω).le
  · have hsucc : Summable (fun n => selectionAccuracy (n + 1)) := by
      simpa [Function.comp_def] using
        summable_selectionAccuracy.comp_injective Nat.succ_injective
    exact hsucc.add summable_selectionAccuracy

name: RandomSetTheory.kuratowski_ryll_nardzewski
statement:
theorem kuratowski_ryll_nardzewski
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [MetricSpace E] [CompleteSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] [Nonempty E]
    {S : Ω → Set E} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hclosed : ∀ ω, IsClosed (S ω)) (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty) :
    IsMeasurableSelection S (krnSelection hS hne)
proof:
:= by
  apply isMeasurableSelection_of_tendsto_infDist_zero hclosed hne
  · exact krnApproximation_measurable hS hne
  · intro ω
    exact (krnApproximation_cauchySeq hS hne ω).tendsto_limUnder
  · intro ω
    apply squeeze_zero
    · exact fun _ => infDist_nonneg
    · intro n
      exact (krnApproximation_close hS hne n ω).le
    · exact tendsto_selectionAccuracy_zero

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_measurableSelection
statement:
theorem exists_measurableSelection
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [MetricSpace E] [CompleteSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] [Nonempty E]
    {S : Ω → Set E} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hclosed : ∀ ω, IsClosed (S ω)) (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty) :
    ∃ f : Ω → E, Measurable f ∧ ∀ ω, f ω ∈ S ω
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨krnSelection hS hne, kuratowski_ryll_nardzewski hS hclosed hne⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.ProbabilityMeasure.existsUnique_tendsto_of_tight_of_finiteEvaluationProjectionLimits
statement:
theorem ProbabilityMeasure.existsUnique_tendsto_of_tight_of_finiteEvaluationProjectionLimits
    (mu : ℕ → ProbabilityMeasure C(T, ℝ))
    (nu : FiniteEvaluationDual T → ProbabilityMeasure ℝ)
    (htight : IsTightMeasureSet {((mu n : ProbabilityMeasure C(T, ℝ)) :
      Measure C(T, ℝ)) | n})
    (hproj : ∀ w : FiniteEvaluationDual T,
      Tendsto
        (fun n ↦ ProbabilityMeasure.map (mu n)
          w.1.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable)
        atTop
        (nhds (nu w))) :
    ∃! mu0 : ProbabilityMeasure C(T, ℝ),
      Tendsto mu atTop (nhds mu0) ∧
        ∀ w : FiniteEvaluationDual T,
          ProbabilityMeasure.map mu0
            w.1.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable = nu w
proof:
:= by
  have hcompact : IsCompact (closure {mu n | n}) :=
    isCompact_closure_of_isTightMeasureSet (by simpa using htight)
  obtain ⟨mu0, -, phi, hphi, hsub⟩ := hcompact.tendsto_subseq fun n ↦
    subset_closure (Set.mem_range_self n)
  have hmap : ∀ w : FiniteEvaluationDual T,
      ProbabilityMeasure.map mu0
        w.1.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable = nu w := by
    intro w
    have hmapSub : Tendsto
        (fun n ↦ ProbabilityMeasure.map (mu (phi n))
          w.1.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable)
        atTop
        (nhds (ProbabilityMeasure.map mu0
          w.1.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable)) := by
      simpa only [Function.comp_apply] using
        ProbabilityMeasure.tendsto_map_of_tendsto_of_continuous
          (fun n ↦ mu (phi n)) mu0 hsub w.1.continuous
    have hnuSub : Tendsto
        (fun n ↦ ProbabilityMeasure.map (mu (phi n))
          w.1.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable)
        atTop
        (nhds (nu w)) := by
      change Tendsto
        ((fun n ↦ ProbabilityMeasure.map (mu n)
          w.1.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable) ∘ phi)
        atTop
        (nhds (nu w))
      exact (hproj w).comp hphi.tendsto_atTop
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique hmapSub hnuSub
  have hwhole : Tendsto mu atTop (nhds mu0) := by
    apply ProbabilityMeasure.tendsto_of_tight_of_finiteEvaluationProjections T htight
    intro w
    simpa only [hmap w] using hproj w
  refine ⟨mu0, ⟨hwhole, hmap⟩, ?_⟩
  intro mu1 hmu1
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique hmu1.1 hwhole

name: ProbabilityTheory.aemeasurable_centeredTruncation
statement:
theorem aemeasurable_centeredTruncation [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    {X : Omega → ℝ} (hX : AEMeasurable X mu) (y : ℝ) :
    AEMeasurable (centeredTruncation X y mu) mu
proof:
:= by
  unfold centeredTruncation
  exact hX.aestronglyMeasurable.truncation.aemeasurable.sub aemeasurable_const

name: ProbabilityTheory.integrable_centeredTruncation
statement:
theorem integrable_centeredTruncation [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    {X : Omega → ℝ} (hX : AEMeasurable X mu) (y : ℝ) :
    Integrable (centeredTruncation X y mu) mu
proof:
:= by
  unfold centeredTruncation
  exact hX.aestronglyMeasurable.integrable_truncation.sub (integrable_const _)

name: ProbabilityTheory.integral_centeredTruncation
statement:
theorem integral_centeredTruncation [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {X : Omega → ℝ} (hX : AEMeasurable X mu) (y : ℝ) :
    ∫ omega, centeredTruncation X y mu omega ∂mu = 0
proof:
:= by
  have htrunc : Integrable (truncation X y) mu :=
    hX.aestronglyMeasurable.integrable_truncation
  change ∫ omega, (truncation X y omega - ∫ z, truncation X y z ∂mu) ∂mu = 0
  rw [integral_sub htrunc (integrable_const _)]
  simp

name: ProbabilityTheory.abs_integral_truncation_le
statement:
theorem abs_integral_truncation_le [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : Omega → ℝ) (y : ℝ) :
    |∫ omega, truncation X y omega ∂mu| ≤ |y|
proof:
:= by
  have h := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (μ := mu)
    (f := truncation X y) (C := |y|)
    (ae_of_all mu fun omega => by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using abs_truncation_le_bound X y omega)
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, probReal_univ, mul_one] using h

name: ProbabilityTheory.centeredTruncation_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem centeredTruncation_mem_Icc [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : Omega → ℝ) (y : ℝ) (omega : Omega) :
    centeredTruncation X y mu omega ∈ Icc (-2 * |y|) (2 * |y|)
proof:
:= by
  have hpoint : |truncation X y omega| ≤ |y| :=
    abs_truncation_le_bound X y omega
  have hmean : |∫ z, truncation X y z ∂mu| ≤ |y| :=
    abs_integral_truncation_le X y
  have habs : |centeredTruncation X y mu omega| ≤ 2 * |y| := by
    calc
      |centeredTruncation X y mu omega| ≤
          |truncation X y omega| + |∫ z, truncation X y z ∂mu| := by
        simpa only [centeredTruncation] using
          abs_sub (truncation X y omega) (∫ z, truncation X y z ∂mu)
      _ ≤ |y| + |y| := add_le_add hpoint hmean
      _ = 2 * |y| := by ring
  rw [Set.mem_Icc]
  constructor <;> linarith [abs_le.mp habs]

name: ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun_centeredTruncation
statement:
theorem iIndepFun_centeredTruncation
    (X : I → Omega → ℝ) (y : ℝ)
    (h_indep : iIndepFun X mu) :
    iIndepFun (fun i => centeredTruncation (X i) y mu) mu
proof:
:= by
  let g : I → ℝ → ℝ := fun i x =>
    truncation id y x - ∫ z, truncation (X i) y z ∂mu
  have htrunc : Measurable (truncation id y) := by
    simpa only [truncation, Function.comp_id] using
      (measurable_id.indicator measurableSet_Ioc)
  have hg : ∀ i, Measurable (g i) := fun i => htrunc.sub measurable_const
  exact (h_indep.comp g hg).congr (fun i => ae_of_all mu fun omega => by
    simp only [g, centeredTruncation, Function.comp_apply, truncation,
      id_eq])

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_sum_centeredTruncation_abs_ge_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_sum_centeredTruncation_abs_ge_le
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (s : Finset I) (X : I → Omega → ℝ)
    (h_indep : iIndepFun X mu)
    (h_meas : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) mu)
    {y t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    mu.real {omega | t ≤
        |∑ i ∈ s, centeredTruncation (X i) y mu omega|} ≤
      2 * exp (-t ^ 2 / (8 * (s.card : ℝ) * y ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hhoeff := hoeffding_finset_sum_abs_real
    (μ := mu)
    (X := fun i => centeredTruncation (X i) y mu)
    (a := fun _ => -2 * |y|) (b := fun _ => 2 * |y|)
    (iIndepFun_centeredTruncation X y h_indep)
    (fun i => aemeasurable_centeredTruncation (h_meas i) y)
    (fun i => ae_of_all mu fun omega => centeredTruncation_mem_Icc (X i) y omega)
    (fun i => integral_centeredTruncation (h_meas i) y)
    s ht
  have hproxy :
      (↑(∑ i ∈ s,
        (((‖(2 * |y|) - (-2 * |y|)‖₊ / (2 : NNReal)) ^ (2 : ℕ)) :
          NNReal) : NNReal) : ℝ) = 4 * (s.card : ℝ) * y ^ 2 := by
    simp only [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
    have hnorm : ‖2 * |y| - -2 * |y|‖₊ = 4 * ‖y‖₊ := by
      ext
      simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg]
      ring_nf
    rw [hnorm]
    push_cast
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    ring_nf
    rw [sq_abs]
  rw [hproxy] at hhoeff
  convert hhoeff using 1
  all_goals ring_nf

name: ProbabilityTheory.abs_truncation_sub_le_abs_pow_div
statement:
theorem abs_truncation_sub_le_abs_pow_div
    (X : Omega → ℝ) {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y)
    (omega : Omega) :
    |truncation X y omega - X omega| ≤ |X omega| ^ q / y ^ (q - 1)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hsmall : |X omega| < y
  · rw [truncation_eq_self hsmall]
    simp only [sub_self, abs_zero]
    exact div_nonneg (pow_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) _) (pow_nonneg hy.le _)
  · have herror : |truncation X y omega - X omega| ≤ |X omega| := by
      simp only [truncation, Set.indicator, id, Function.comp_apply]
      split_ifs <;> simp
    have hlarge : y ≤ |X omega| := le_of_not_gt hsmall
    have hden : 0 < y ^ (q - 1) := pow_pos hy _
    refine herror.trans ((le_div_iff₀ hden).2 ?_)
    calc
      |X omega| * y ^ (q - 1) ≤ |X omega| * |X omega| ^ (q - 1) := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (pow_le_pow_left₀ hy.le hlarge (q - 1)) (abs_nonneg _)
      _ = |X omega| ^ q := by
        rw [← pow_succ']
        congr 1
        omega

name: ProbabilityTheory.abs_integral_truncation_sub_integral_le_absoluteMoment_div
statement:
theorem abs_integral_truncation_sub_integral_le_absoluteMoment_div
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {X : Omega → ℝ} (hX : AEMeasurable X mu) {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hXq : Integrable (fun omega ↦ |X omega| ^ q) mu)
    {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) :
    |(∫ omega, truncation X y omega ∂mu) - ∫ omega, X omega ∂mu| ≤
      absoluteMoment X q mu / y ^ (q - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have htrunc : Integrable (truncation X y) mu :=
    hX.aestronglyMeasurable.integrable_truncation
  have hXint : Integrable X mu := by
    apply (integrable_norm_iff hX.aestronglyMeasurable).1
    have hpow : Integrable (fun omega ↦ ‖X omega‖ ^ q) mu := by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hXq
    simpa only [pow_one] using
      (integrable_norm_pow_of_le hX.aestronglyMeasurable hq hpow :
        Integrable (fun omega ↦ ‖X omega‖ ^ 1) mu)
  rw [← integral_sub htrunc hXint]
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, integral_div, absoluteMoment] using
    (norm_integral_le_of_norm_le
      (f := fun omega ↦ truncation X y omega - X omega)
      (hXq.div_const (y ^ (q - 1)))
      (ae_of_all mu fun omega ↦ by
        simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
          abs_truncation_sub_le_abs_pow_div X hq hy omega))

name: ProbabilityTheory.abs_totalTruncationBias_le_sum_absoluteMoment_div
statement:
theorem abs_totalTruncationBias_le_sum_absoluteMoment_div
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (s : Finset I) (X : I → Omega → ℝ)
    (h_meas : ∀ i ∈ s, AEMeasurable (X i) mu)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hXq : ∀ i ∈ s, Integrable (fun omega ↦ |X i omega| ^ q) mu)
    {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) :
    |totalTruncationBias s X y mu| ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, absoluteMoment (X i) q mu) / y ^ (q - 1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold totalTruncationBias
  calc
    |∑ i ∈ s,
        ((∫ z, truncation (X i) y z ∂mu) - ∫ z, X i z ∂mu)| ≤
        ∑ i ∈ s,
          |(∫ z, truncation (X i) y z ∂mu) - ∫ z, X i z ∂mu| :=
      Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ s
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, absoluteMoment (X i) q mu / y ^ (q - 1) := by
      gcongr with i hi
      exact abs_integral_truncation_sub_integral_le_absoluteMoment_div
        (h_meas i hi) hq (hXq i hi) hy
    _ = (∑ i ∈ s, absoluteMoment (X i) q mu) / y ^ (q - 1) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_div]

name: ProbabilityTheory.sum_sub_integral_eq_sum_centeredTruncation_add_bias
statement:
theorem sum_sub_integral_eq_sum_centeredTruncation_add_bias
    (s : Finset I) (X : I → Omega → ℝ) (y : ℝ) (omega : Omega)
    (hsmall : ∀ i ∈ s, |X i omega| < y) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, (X i omega - ∫ z, X i z ∂mu)) =
      (∑ i ∈ s, centeredTruncation (X i) y mu omega) +
        totalTruncationBias s X y mu
proof:
:= by
  unfold totalTruncationBias
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  rw [centeredTruncation, truncation_eq_self (hsmall i hi)]
  ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.centered_sum_large_subset_iUnion_large_or_truncation
statement:
theorem centered_sum_large_subset_iUnion_large_or_truncation
    (s : Finset I) (X : I → Omega → ℝ) (y t : ℝ) :
    {omega | t + |totalTruncationBias s X y mu| ≤
        |∑ i ∈ s, (X i omega - ∫ z, X i z ∂mu)|} ⊆
      (⋃ i ∈ s, {omega | y ≤ |X i omega|}) ∪
        {omega | t ≤
          |∑ i ∈ s, centeredTruncation (X i) y mu omega|}
proof:
:= by
  intro omega homega
  by_cases hlarge : ∃ i ∈ s, y ≤ |X i omega|
  · left
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hiy⟩ := hlarge
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨i, Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨hi, hiy⟩⟩
  · right
    have hsmall : ∀ i ∈ s, |X i omega| < y := by
      intro i hi
      exact lt_of_not_ge fun hiy ↦ hlarge ⟨i, hi, hiy⟩
    change t ≤ |∑ i ∈ s, centeredTruncation (X i) y mu omega|
    change t + |totalTruncationBias s X y mu| ≤
      |∑ i ∈ s, (X i omega - ∫ z, X i z ∂mu)| at homega
    rw [sum_sub_integral_eq_sum_centeredTruncation_add_bias
      s X y omega hsmall] at homega
    by_contra hnot
    have htrunc :
        |∑ i ∈ s, centeredTruncation (X i) y mu omega| < t :=
      lt_of_not_ge hnot
    have hstrict :
        |(∑ i ∈ s, centeredTruncation (X i) y mu omega) +
            totalTruncationBias s X y mu| <
          t + |totalTruncationBias s X y mu| :=
      (abs_add_le _ _).trans_lt (add_lt_add_left htrunc _)
    exact (not_lt_of_ge homega) hstrict

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_centered_sum_large_le_sum_large_add_truncation
statement:
theorem measureReal_centered_sum_large_le_sum_large_add_truncation
    [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    (s : Finset I) (X : I → Omega → ℝ) (y t : ℝ) :
    mu.real {omega | t + |totalTruncationBias s X y mu| ≤
        |∑ i ∈ s, (X i omega - ∫ z, X i z ∂mu)|} ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, mu.real {omega | y ≤ |X i omega|}) +
        mu.real {omega | t ≤
          |∑ i ∈ s, centeredTruncation (X i) y mu omega|}
proof:
:= by
  let U : Set Omega := ⋃ i ∈ s, {omega | y ≤ |X i omega|}
  let T : Set Omega := {omega | t ≤
    |∑ i ∈ s, centeredTruncation (X i) y mu omega|}
  calc
    mu.real {omega | t + |totalTruncationBias s X y mu| ≤
        |∑ i ∈ s, (X i omega - ∫ z, X i z ∂mu)|} ≤
        mu.real (U ∪ T) :=
      measureReal_mono
        (centered_sum_large_subset_iUnion_large_or_truncation s X y t)
    _ ≤ mu.real U + mu.real T := measureReal_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, mu.real {omega | y ≤ |X i omega|}) +
        mu.real T := by
      apply add_le_add
      · simpa only [U] using (measureReal_biUnion_finset_le s
          fun i ↦ {omega | y ≤ |X i omega|})
      · exact le_rfl
    _ = (∑ i ∈ s, mu.real {omega | y ≤ |X i omega|}) +
        mu.real {omega | t ≤
          |∑ i ∈ s, centeredTruncation (X i) y mu omega|} := rfl

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_centered_sum_large_le_moment_div_add_truncation
statement:
theorem measureReal_centered_sum_large_le_moment_div_add_truncation
    [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    (s : Finset I) (X : I → Omega → ℝ) {q : ℕ}
    (hXq : ∀ i ∈ s, Integrable (fun omega ↦ |X i omega| ^ q) mu)
    {y t : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) :
    mu.real {omega | t + |totalTruncationBias s X y mu| ≤
        |∑ i ∈ s, (X i omega - ∫ z, X i z ∂mu)|} ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, absoluteMoment (X i) q mu) / y ^ q +
        mu.real {omega | t ≤
          |∑ i ∈ s, centeredTruncation (X i) y mu omega|}
proof:
:= by
  have hdecomp :=
    measureReal_centered_sum_large_le_sum_large_add_truncation
      (mu := mu) s X y t
  calc
    mu.real {omega | t + |totalTruncationBias s X y mu| ≤
        |∑ i ∈ s, (X i omega - ∫ z, X i z ∂mu)|} ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, mu.real {omega | y ≤ |X i omega|}) +
        mu.real {omega | t ≤
          |∑ i ∈ s, centeredTruncation (X i) y mu omega|} := hdecomp
    _ ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, absoluteMoment (X i) q mu / y ^ q) +
        mu.real {omega | t ≤
          |∑ i ∈ s, centeredTruncation (X i) y mu omega|} := by
      gcongr with i hi
      exact measureReal_abs_ge_le_absoluteMoment_div (X i) q (hXq i hi) hy
    _ = (∑ i ∈ s, absoluteMoment (X i) q mu) / y ^ q +
        mu.real {omega | t ≤
          |∑ i ∈ s, centeredTruncation (X i) y mu omega|} := by
      rw [Finset.sum_div]

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_centered_sum_large_le_moment_div_add_exp
statement:
theorem measureReal_centered_sum_large_le_moment_div_add_exp
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (s : Finset I) (X : I → Omega → ℝ) {q : ℕ}
    (h_indep : iIndepFun X mu)
    (h_meas : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) mu)
    (hXq : ∀ i ∈ s, Integrable (fun omega ↦ |X i omega| ^ q) mu)
    {y t : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    mu.real {omega | t + |totalTruncationBias s X y mu| ≤
        |∑ i ∈ s, (X i omega - ∫ z, X i z ∂mu)|} ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, absoluteMoment (X i) q mu) / y ^ q +
        2 * exp (-t ^ 2 / (8 * (s.card : ℝ) * y ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hreduction :=
    measureReal_centered_sum_large_le_moment_div_add_truncation
      (mu := mu) s X hXq (t := t) hy
  have hbounded := measureReal_sum_centeredTruncation_abs_ge_le
    (mu := mu) s X h_indep h_meas (y := y) ht
  exact hreduction.trans (add_le_add_right hbounded _)

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_centered_sum_large_le_moment_bias_add_exp
statement:
theorem measureReal_centered_sum_large_le_moment_bias_add_exp
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (s : Finset I) (X : I → Omega → ℝ) {q : ℕ}
    (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (h_indep : iIndepFun X mu)
    (h_meas : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) mu)
    (hXq : ∀ i ∈ s, Integrable (fun omega ↦ |X i omega| ^ q) mu)
    {y t : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    mu.real {omega |
        t + (∑ i ∈ s, absoluteMoment (X i) q mu) / y ^ (q - 1) ≤
          |∑ i ∈ s, (X i omega - ∫ z, X i z ∂mu)|} ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, absoluteMoment (X i) q mu) / y ^ q +
        2 * exp (-t ^ 2 / (8 * (s.card : ℝ) * y ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hbias := abs_totalTruncationBias_le_sum_absoluteMoment_div
    (mu := mu) s X (fun i hi ↦ h_meas i) hq hXq hy
  have hbase := measureReal_centered_sum_large_le_moment_div_add_exp
    (mu := mu) s X h_indep h_meas hXq hy ht
  exact (measureReal_mono (by
    intro omega homega
    change t + |totalTruncationBias s X y mu| ≤
      |∑ i ∈ s, (X i omega - ∫ z, X i z ∂mu)|
    change t + (∑ i ∈ s, absoluteMoment (X i) q mu) / y ^ (q - 1) ≤
      |∑ i ∈ s, (X i omega - ∫ z, X i z ∂mu)| at homega
    linarith)).trans hbase

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_centered_sum_ge_le_moment_div_add_exp
statement:
theorem measureReal_centered_sum_ge_le_moment_div_add_exp
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (s : Finset I) (X : I → Omega → ℝ) {q : ℕ}
    (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (h_indep : iIndepFun X mu)
    (h_meas : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) mu)
    (hXq : ∀ i ∈ s, Integrable (fun omega ↦ |X i omega| ^ q) mu)
    {y u : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y)
    (hu : (∑ i ∈ s, absoluteMoment (X i) q mu) / y ^ (q - 1) ≤ u) :
    mu.real {omega | u ≤
        |∑ i ∈ s, (X i omega - ∫ z, X i z ∂mu)|} ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, absoluteMoment (X i) q mu) / y ^ q +
        2 * exp (-(u -
          (∑ i ∈ s, absoluteMoment (X i) q mu) / y ^ (q - 1)) ^ 2 /
            (8 * (s.card : ℝ) * y ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
