  let B : ℝ := (∑ i ∈ s, absoluteMoment (X i) q mu) / y ^ (q - 1)
  have hbias : |totalTruncationBias s X y mu| ≤ B := by
    simpa only [B] using abs_totalTruncationBias_le_sum_absoluteMoment_div
      (mu := mu) s X (fun i hi ↦ h_meas i) hq hXq hy
  have ht : 0 ≤ u - B := sub_nonneg.mpr (by simpa only [B] using hu)
  have hbase := measureReal_centered_sum_large_le_moment_div_add_exp
    (mu := mu) s X h_indep h_meas hXq hy ht
  have hmono :
      mu.real {omega | u ≤
          |∑ i ∈ s, (X i omega - ∫ z, X i z ∂mu)|} ≤
        mu.real {omega | (u - B) + |totalTruncationBias s X y mu| ≤
          |∑ i ∈ s, (X i omega - ∫ z, X i z ∂mu)|} :=
    measureReal_mono (by
      intro omega homega
      have hthreshold : (u - B) + |totalTruncationBias s X y mu| ≤ u := by
        linarith
      exact hthreshold.trans homega)
  simpa only [B] using hmono.trans hbase

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_centered_sum_large_le_common_moment_add_truncation
statement:
theorem measureReal_centered_sum_large_le_common_moment_add_truncation
    [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    (s : Finset I) (X : I → Omega → ℝ) {q : ℕ}
    (hXq : ∀ i ∈ s, Integrable (fun omega ↦ |X i omega| ^ q) mu)
    {M y t : ℝ} (hM : ∀ i ∈ s, absoluteMoment (X i) q mu ≤ M)
    (hy : 0 < y) :
    mu.real {omega | t + |totalTruncationBias s X y mu| ≤
        |∑ i ∈ s, (X i omega - ∫ z, X i z ∂mu)|} ≤
      (s.card : ℝ) * M / y ^ q +
        mu.real {omega | t ≤
          |∑ i ∈ s, centeredTruncation (X i) y mu omega|}
proof:
:= by
  have h := measureReal_centered_sum_large_le_moment_div_add_truncation
    (mu := mu) s X hXq (t := t) hy
  refine h.trans ?_
  gcongr
  simpa [nsmul_eq_mul] using
    (Finset.sum_le_card_nsmul s
      (fun i ↦ absoluteMoment (X i) q mu) M hM)

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_centered_sum_large_le_common_moment_add_exp
statement:
theorem measureReal_centered_sum_large_le_common_moment_add_exp
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (s : Finset I) (X : I → Omega → ℝ) {q : ℕ}
    (h_indep : iIndepFun X mu)
    (h_meas : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) mu)
    (hXq : ∀ i ∈ s, Integrable (fun omega ↦ |X i omega| ^ q) mu)
    {M y t : ℝ} (hM : ∀ i ∈ s, absoluteMoment (X i) q mu ≤ M)
    (hy : 0 < y) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    mu.real {omega | t + |totalTruncationBias s X y mu| ≤
        |∑ i ∈ s, (X i omega - ∫ z, X i z ∂mu)|} ≤
      (s.card : ℝ) * M / y ^ q +
        2 * exp (-t ^ 2 / (8 * (s.card : ℝ) * y ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  have h := measureReal_centered_sum_large_le_moment_div_add_exp
    (mu := mu) s X h_indep h_meas hXq hy ht
  refine h.trans ?_
  gcongr
  simpa [nsmul_eq_mul] using
    (Finset.sum_le_card_nsmul s
      (fun i ↦ absoluteMoment (X i) q mu) M hM)

name: ProbabilityTheory.centeredTruncatedEmpiricalContinuousMap_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem centeredTruncatedEmpiricalContinuousMap_apply
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (H : Z → E → ℝ) (R : Z → ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (X : ℕ → Omega → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hHmeas : ∀ t, Measurable (fun z ↦ H z t))
    (hHcont : ∀ z, Continuous (H z)) (hRmeas : Measurable R)
    (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (hLip : ∀ z s t, |H z s - H z t| ≤ R z * dist s t)
    (n : ℕ) (omega : Omega) (t : EuclideanUnitBall E) :
    centeredTruncatedEmpiricalContinuousMap (mu := mu)
        H R ha X hX hHmeas hHcont hRmeas hR hLip n omega t =
      centeredAnchoredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess (mu := mu) H R
        (a * Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ)) (Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ X
        (Finset.range (n + 1)) 0 omega (t : E)
proof: := rfl

name: ProbabilityTheory.isTightMeasureSet_range_centeredTruncatedEmpiricalContinuousMap
statement:
theorem isTightMeasureSet_range_centeredTruncatedEmpiricalContinuousMap
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    [MeasurableSpace C(EuclideanUnitBall E, ℝ)]
    [BorelSpace C(EuclideanUnitBall E, ℝ)]
    (H : Z → E → ℝ) (R : Z → ℝ) {a K : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hK : 0 < K)
    (X : ℕ → Omega → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X mu)
    (hHmeas : ∀ t, Measurable (fun z ↦ H z t))
    (hHcont : ∀ z, Continuous (H z)) (hRmeas : Measurable R)
    (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (hLip : ∀ z s t, |H z s - H z t| ≤ R z * dist s t)
    (hRL2 : ∀ i, MemLp (fun omega ↦ R (X i omega)) 2 mu)
    (hRsecond : ∀ i, ∫ omega, R (X i omega) ^ 2 ∂mu ≤ K ^ 2)
    (hpathMeas : ∀ n, AEMeasurable
      (centeredTruncatedEmpiricalContinuousMap (mu := mu)
        H R ha X hX hHmeas hHcont hRmeas hR hLip n) mu) :
    IsTightMeasureSet (Set.range fun n ↦ mu.map
      (centeredTruncatedEmpiricalContinuousMap (mu := mu)
        H R ha X hX hHmeas hHcont hRmeas hR hLip n))
proof:
:= by
  letI : CompactSpace (EuclideanUnitBall E) :=
    isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp (by
      apply Metric.isCompact_of_isClosed_isBounded
      · exact isClosed_le continuous_norm continuous_const
      · exact (isBounded_iff_forall_norm_le.mpr
          ⟨1, fun _v hv ↦ hv⟩))
  let d := finrank ℝ E
  let Y : ℕ → Omega → C(EuclideanUnitBall E, ℝ) := fun n ↦
    centeredTruncatedEmpiricalContinuousMap (mu := mu)
      H R ha X hX hHmeas hHcont hRmeas hR hLip n
  let delta : ℕ → ℝ := RandomSetTheory.dyadicResolution
  apply isTightMeasureSet_range_map_of_real_norm_and_modulus
    mu Y hpathMeas delta RandomSetTheory.dyadicResolution_pos
  intro epsilon hepsilon
  have hevent : ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, Real.exp (-x) < epsilon / 2 :=
    tendsto_exp_neg_atTop_nhds_zero (Iio_mem_nhds (half_pos hepsilon))
  obtain ⟨x, hxTail, hx⟩ :=
    (hevent.and (eventually_ge_atTop (0 : ℝ))).exists
  let B := mixedEuclideanProcessBound (2 * K) (2 * a) d x
  let eta : ℕ → ℝ := fun k ↦
    2 * mixedEuclideanProcessBound
      (2 * ((2 * delta k) * K)) (2 * ((2 * delta k) * a)) d
        (mixedEuclideanConfidence d x k)
  let p : ℕ → ℝ := mixedEuclideanEntropyCost d x
  refine ⟨B, mixedEuclideanProcessBound_nonneg (by positivity)
      (by positivity) d hx, eta, ?_, p, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hs := summable_dyadic_mixedEuclideanProcessBound
      (4 * K) (4 * a) d hx
    have hs2 := hs.mul_left (2 : ℝ)
    have hetaSummable : Summable eta := by
      apply hs2.congr
      intro k
      dsimp only [eta, delta, RandomSetTheory.dyadicResolution]
      congr 2 <;> ring
    exact hetaSummable.tendsto_atTop_zero
  · intro k
    unfold p mixedEuclideanEntropyCost
    positivity
  · exact summable_mixedEuclideanEntropyCost d x
  · exact (tsum_mixedEuclideanEntropyCost_le d x).trans hxTail.le
  · intro n
    have hglobal :=
      measureReal_unitBall_range_succ_centeredTruncated_largeDeviation_le
        H R ha hK hx X hX hIndep hHmeas hHcont hRmeas hR hLip
          hRL2 hRsecond n
    refine ((measureReal_mono ?_).trans hglobal).trans hxTail.le
    intro omega homega
    have hnotall : ¬ ∀ t : EuclideanUnitBall E,
        |Y n omega t| ≤ B := by
      intro hall
      exact (not_le_of_gt homega)
        (ContinuousMap.norm_le (Y n omega)
          (mixedEuclideanProcessBound_nonneg (by positivity)
            (by positivity) d hx) |>.2 (fun t ↦ by
              simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hall t))
    push Not at hnotall
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hnotall
    refine ⟨t, ?_⟩
    simpa only [Y, B, centeredTruncatedEmpiricalContinuousMap_apply] using ht
  · intro n k
    have hosc :=
      measureReal_unitBall_dyadicOscillation_range_succ_centeredTruncated_le
        H R ha hK hx X hX hIndep hHmeas hHcont hRmeas hR hLip
          hRL2 hRsecond n k
    simpa only [Y, delta, eta, p, Real.dist_eq,
      centeredTruncatedEmpiricalContinuousMap_apply] using hosc

name: RandomSetTheory.KernelSupportedOn.congr_ae
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [hκ, hST] with o hκo hSTo
  rwa [← hSTo]

name: RandomSetTheory.kernelAttainableMoments_congr_ae
statement:
theorem kernelAttainableMoments_congr_ae
    {O X E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace O] [MeasurableSpace X]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {μ : Measure O} {S T : O → Set X} {φ : O × X → E}
    (hST : S =ᵐ[μ] T) :
    kernelAttainableMoments μ S φ = kernelAttainableMoments μ T φ
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · rintro y ⟨κ, hκmarkov, hκsupp, hφint, hφeq⟩
    exact ⟨κ, hκmarkov, hκsupp.congr_ae hST, hφint, hφeq⟩
  · rintro y ⟨κ, hκmarkov, hκsupp, hφint, hφeq⟩
    exact ⟨κ, hκmarkov, hκsupp.congr_ae hST.symm, hφint, hφeq⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.kernelAttainableMoments_eq_aumannExpectation_of_purification_ae
statement:
theorem kernelAttainableMoments_eq_aumannExpectation_of_purification_ae
    {O X E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace O] [MeasurableSpace X]
    [MetricSpace X] [CompleteSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    [SecondCountableTopology X]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    {μ : Measure O} [SFinite μ]
    {A : Set O} (hAmeas : MeasurableSet A) (hA : ∀ᵐ o ∂μ, o ∈ A)
    {S : O → Set X} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ o ∈ A, IsCompact (S o))
    (hne : ∀ o ∈ A, (S o).Nonempty)
    (x₀ : X)
    {φ : O × X → E} (hφMeas : Measurable φ)
    (hφCont : ∀ o, Continuous fun x => φ (o, x))
    (hpurify :
      aumannExpectation μ (fun o => (fun x => φ (o, x)) '' S o) =
        aumannExpectation μ
          (fun o => closedConvexHull ℝ ((fun x => φ (o, x)) '' S o))) :
    kernelAttainableMoments μ S φ =
      aumannExpectation μ (fun o => (fun x => φ (o, x)) '' S o)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : Nonempty X := ⟨x₀⟩
  let T : O → Set X := correspondenceOn A S {x₀}
  have hT : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable T :=
    effrosMeasurable_correspondenceOn hAmeas hS {x₀}
  have hTcompact : ∀ o, IsCompact (T o) := fun o =>
    correspondenceOn_isCompact hcompact isCompact_singleton o
  have hTne : ∀ o, (T o).Nonempty := fun o =>
    correspondenceOn_nonempty hne (Set.singleton_nonempty x₀) o
  have hST : T =ᵐ[μ] S := correspondenceOn_ae_eq hA
  have hPhi :
      (fun o => (fun x => φ (o, x)) '' T o) =ᵐ[μ]
        (fun o => (fun x => φ (o, x)) '' S o) :=
    hST.mono fun o h => congrArg (fun K => (fun x => φ (o, x)) '' K) h
  have hPhiConv :
      (fun o => closedConvexHull ℝ ((fun x => φ (o, x)) '' T o)) =ᵐ[μ]
        (fun o => closedConvexHull ℝ ((fun x => φ (o, x)) '' S o)) :=
    hPhi.mono fun _ h => congrArg (closedConvexHull ℝ) h
  have hRaw :
      aumannExpectation μ (fun o => (fun x => φ (o, x)) '' T o) =
        aumannExpectation μ (fun o => (fun x => φ (o, x)) '' S o) :=
    aumannExpectation_congr_ae hPhi
  have hConv :
      aumannExpectation μ
          (fun o => closedConvexHull ℝ ((fun x => φ (o, x)) '' T o)) =
        aumannExpectation μ
          (fun o => closedConvexHull ℝ ((fun x => φ (o, x)) '' S o)) :=
    aumannExpectation_congr_ae hPhiConv
  have hpurifyT :
      aumannExpectation μ (fun o => (fun x => φ (o, x)) '' T o) =
        aumannExpectation μ
          (fun o => closedConvexHull ℝ ((fun x => φ (o, x)) '' T o)) :=
    hRaw.trans (hpurify.trans hConv.symm)
  have hTmeas : ∀ o, MeasurableSet (T o) := fun o =>
    (hTcompact o).isClosed.measurableSet
  have hsharpT :=
    kernelAttainableMoments_eq_aumannExpectation_of_purification
      hT hTmeas hTcompact hTne hφMeas hφCont hpurifyT
  calc
    kernelAttainableMoments μ S φ = kernelAttainableMoments μ T φ :=
      kernelAttainableMoments_congr_ae hST.symm
    _ = aumannExpectation μ (fun o => (fun x => φ (o, x)) '' T o) := hsharpT
    _ = aumannExpectation μ (fun o => (fun x => φ (o, x)) '' S o) := hRaw

name: RandomSetTheory.kernelAttainableMoments_eq_aumannExpectation_of_atomless_ae
statement:
theorem kernelAttainableMoments_eq_aumannExpectation_of_atomless_ae
    {O X H : Type*} [MeasurableSpace O] [MeasurableSpace X]
    [MetricSpace X] [CompleteSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    [SecondCountableTopology X]
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ H]
    {μ : Measure O} [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (hμ : IsAtomlessMeasure μ)
    {A : Set O} (hAmeas : MeasurableSet A) (hA : ∀ᵐ o ∂μ, o ∈ A)
    {S : O → Set X} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ o ∈ A, IsCompact (S o))
    (hne : ∀ o ∈ A, (S o).Nonempty)
    (x₀ : X)
    {φ : O × X → H} (hφMeas : Measurable φ)
    (hφCont : ∀ o, Continuous fun x => φ (o, x))
    {g : O → ℝ} (hg : Integrable g μ)
    (hdom : ∀ o ∈ A, ∀ x ∈ S o, ‖φ (o, x)‖ ≤ g o) :
    kernelAttainableMoments μ S φ =
      aumannExpectation μ (fun o => (fun x => φ (o, x)) '' S o)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : Nonempty X := ⟨x₀⟩
  let T : O → Set X := correspondenceOn A S {x₀}
  let G : O → ℝ := fun o => if o ∈ A then g o else ‖φ (o, x₀)‖
  have hT : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable T :=
    effrosMeasurable_correspondenceOn hAmeas hS {x₀}
  have hTcompact : ∀ o, IsCompact (T o) := fun o =>
    correspondenceOn_isCompact hcompact isCompact_singleton o
  have hTne : ∀ o, (T o).Nonempty := fun o =>
    correspondenceOn_nonempty hne (Set.singleton_nonempty x₀) o
  have hTmeas : ∀ o, MeasurableSet (T o) := fun o =>
    (hTcompact o).isClosed.measurableSet
  have hST : T =ᵐ[μ] S := correspondenceOn_ae_eq hA
  have hPhi :
      (fun o => (fun x => φ (o, x)) '' T o) =ᵐ[μ]
        (fun o => (fun x => φ (o, x)) '' S o) :=
    hST.mono fun o h => congrArg (fun K => (fun x => φ (o, x)) '' K) h
  have hGae : G =ᵐ[μ] g := hA.mono fun o ho => by simp [G, ho]
  have hGint : Integrable G μ := hg.congr hGae.symm
  have hTdom : ∀ o, ∀ x ∈ T o, ‖φ (o, x)‖ ≤ G o := by
    intro o x hx
    by_cases ho : o ∈ A
    · have hxS : x ∈ S o := by
        simpa [T, correspondenceOn, ho] using hx
      simpa [G, ho] using hdom o ho x hxS
    · have hx0 : x = x₀ := by
        simpa [T, correspondenceOn, ho] using hx
      subst x
      simp [G, ho]
  have hsharpT :=
    kernelAttainableMoments_eq_aumannExpectation_of_atomless
      hμ hT hTmeas hTcompact hTne hφMeas hφCont hGint hTdom
  calc
    kernelAttainableMoments μ S φ = kernelAttainableMoments μ T φ :=
      kernelAttainableMoments_congr_ae hST.symm
    _ = aumannExpectation μ (fun o => (fun x => φ (o, x)) '' T o) := hsharpT
    _ = aumannExpectation μ (fun o => (fun x => φ (o, x)) '' S o) :=
      aumannExpectation_congr_ae hPhi

name: ProbabilityTheory.mixedEuclideanConfidence_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  unfold mixedEuclideanConfidence
  positivity

name: ProbabilityTheory.mixedEuclideanThreshold_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  unfold mixedEuclideanThreshold
  have hc : 0 ≤ mixedEuclideanConfidence d x k :=
    mixedEuclideanConfidence_nonneg d hx k
  have hp : 0 ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k := pow_nonneg (by norm_num) _
  have hs : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * mixedEuclideanConfidence d x k) :=
    Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  exact add_nonneg
    (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity) hσ₂) hp) hs)
    (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity) hσ₁) hp) hc)

name: ProbabilityTheory.sqrt_mixedEuclideanConfidence_le
statement:
theorem sqrt_mixedEuclideanConfidence_le (d : ℕ) {x : ℝ}
    (hx : 0 ≤ x) (k : ℕ) :
    Real.sqrt (2 * mixedEuclideanConfidence d x k) ≤
      Real.sqrt (2 * x) +
        4 * Real.sqrt (d + 1 : ℝ) * (k + 2 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hD : 0 ≤ (d + 1 : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hk : 0 ≤ (k + 2 : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hkone : 1 ≤ (k + 2 : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ k + 2 by omega)
  have hx2 : 0 ≤ 2 * x := by positivity
  have hdim :
      (8 * (d : ℝ) + 4) * (k + 2 : ℝ) ≤
        16 * (d + 1 : ℝ) * (k + 2 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    have hcoef : 8 * (d : ℝ) + 4 ≤
        16 * (d + 1 : ℝ) * (k + 2 : ℝ) := by nlinarith
    simpa only [pow_two, mul_assoc] using
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcoef hk)
  have hcross :
      0 ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * x) *
        (4 * Real.sqrt (d + 1 : ℝ) * (k + 2 : ℝ)) := by
    positivity
  rw [Real.sqrt_le_iff]
  constructor
  · positivity
  · unfold mixedEuclideanConfidence
    nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt hx2, Real.sq_sqrt hD, hcross,
      Real.sqrt_nonneg (2 * x), Real.sqrt_nonneg (d + 1 : ℝ)]

name: ProbabilityTheory.mixedEuclideanThreshold_le_majorant
statement:
private theorem mixedEuclideanThreshold_le_majorant
    {σ₂ σ₁ : ℝ} (hσ₂ : 0 ≤ σ₂) (_hσ₁ : 0 ≤ σ₁)
    (d : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (k : ℕ) :
    mixedEuclideanThreshold σ₂ σ₁ d x k ≤
      mixedEuclideanMajorant σ₂ σ₁ d x k
proof:
:= by
  unfold mixedEuclideanThreshold mixedEuclideanMajorant
  apply add_le_add
  · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (sqrt_mixedEuclideanConfidence_le d hx k) (by positivity)
  · rw [mixedEuclideanConfidence]

name: ProbabilityTheory.hasSum_mixedEuclideanMajorant
statement:
private theorem hasSum_mixedEuclideanMajorant
    (σ₂ σ₁ : ℝ) (d : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    HasSum (mixedEuclideanMajorant σ₂ σ₁ d x)
      (6 * σ₂ * Real.sqrt (2 * x) +
        72 * σ₂ * Real.sqrt (d + 1 : ℝ) +
        12 * σ₁ * x + 36 * σ₁ * (4 * (d : ℝ) + 2))
proof:
:= by
  let q : ℝ := 1 / 2
  have hq : ‖q‖ < 1 := by norm_num [q, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have hgeom : HasSum (fun k : ℕ => q ^ k) 2 := by
    have h := hasSum_geometric_of_norm_lt_one hq
    norm_num [q] at h
    exact h
  have hnat : HasSum (fun k : ℕ => (k : ℝ) * q ^ k) 2 := by
    have h := hasSum_coe_mul_geometric_of_norm_lt_one hq
    norm_num [q] at h
    exact h
  have hlinear : HasSum (fun k : ℕ => (k + 2 : ℝ) * q ^ k) 6 := by
    convert hnat.add (hgeom.mul_left (2 : ℝ)) using 1
    · ext k
      ring
    · ring
  have h1 := hgeom.mul_left (3 * σ₂ * Real.sqrt (2 * x))
  have h2 := hlinear.mul_left (12 * σ₂ * Real.sqrt (d + 1 : ℝ))
  have h3 := hgeom.mul_left (6 * σ₁ * x)
  have h4 := hlinear.mul_left (6 * σ₁ * (4 * (d : ℝ) + 2))
  have hsum := ((h1.add h2).add h3).add h4
  have hfun : mixedEuclideanMajorant σ₂ σ₁ d x = fun k : ℕ =>
      3 * σ₂ * Real.sqrt (2 * x) * q ^ k +
        12 * σ₂ * Real.sqrt (d + 1 : ℝ) * (((k : ℝ) + 2) * q ^ k) +
        6 * σ₁ * x * q ^ k +
        6 * σ₁ * (4 * (d : ℝ) + 2) * (((k : ℝ) + 2) * q ^ k) := by
    funext k
    dsimp only [mixedEuclideanMajorant, q]
    ring
  have hsum' : HasSum (mixedEuclideanMajorant σ₂ σ₁ d x)
      ((3 * σ₂ * Real.sqrt (2 * x)) * 2 +
        (12 * σ₂ * Real.sqrt (d + 1 : ℝ)) * 6 +
        (6 * σ₁ * x) * 2 +
        (6 * σ₁ * (4 * (d : ℝ) + 2)) * 6) := by
    rw [hfun]
    exact hsum
  convert hsum' using 1
  ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.summable_mixedEuclideanThreshold
statement:
theorem summable_mixedEuclideanThreshold {σ₂ σ₁ : ℝ}
    (hσ₂ : 0 ≤ σ₂) (hσ₁ : 0 ≤ σ₁)
    (d : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    Summable (mixedEuclideanThreshold σ₂ σ₁ d x)
proof:
:= by
  apply Summable.of_nonneg_of_le
    (fun k => mixedEuclideanThreshold_nonneg hσ₂ hσ₁ d hx k)
    (fun k => mixedEuclideanThreshold_le_majorant hσ₂ hσ₁ d hx k)
    (hasSum_mixedEuclideanMajorant σ₂ σ₁ d x).summable

name: ProbabilityTheory.tsum_mixedEuclideanThreshold_le
statement:
theorem tsum_mixedEuclideanThreshold_le {σ₂ σ₁ : ℝ}
    (hσ₂ : 0 ≤ σ₂) (hσ₁ : 0 ≤ σ₁)
    (d : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    ∑' k, mixedEuclideanThreshold σ₂ σ₁ d x k ≤
      6 * σ₂ * Real.sqrt (2 * x) +
        72 * σ₂ * Real.sqrt (d + 1 : ℝ) +
        12 * σ₁ * x + 144 * σ₁ * (d + 1 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hthreshold := summable_mixedEuclideanThreshold hσ₂ hσ₁ d hx
  have hmajor := hasSum_mixedEuclideanMajorant σ₂ σ₁ d x
  calc
    ∑' k, mixedEuclideanThreshold σ₂ σ₁ d x k ≤
        ∑' k, mixedEuclideanMajorant σ₂ σ₁ d x k :=
      hthreshold.tsum_le_tsum
        (fun k => mixedEuclideanThreshold_le_majorant hσ₂ hσ₁ d hx k)
        hmajor.summable
    _ = 6 * σ₂ * Real.sqrt (2 * x) +
        72 * σ₂ * Real.sqrt (d + 1 : ℝ) +
        12 * σ₁ * x + 36 * σ₁ * (4 * (d : ℝ) + 2) := hmajor.tsum_eq
    _ ≤ 6 * σ₂ * Real.sqrt (2 * x) +
        72 * σ₂ * Real.sqrt (d + 1 : ℝ) +
        12 * σ₁ * x + 144 * σ₁ * (d + 1 : ℝ) := by
      nlinarith [hσ₁]

name: ProbabilityTheory.mixedEuclideanEntropyCost_eq
statement:
theorem mixedEuclideanEntropyCost_eq (d : ℕ) (x : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    mixedEuclideanEntropyCost d x k =
      2 * Real.exp (-x) * (Real.exp (-2)) ^ 2 *
        (Real.exp (-2)) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  unfold mixedEuclideanEntropyCost mixedEuclideanConfidence
  have hexponent :
      4 * (d : ℝ) * (k + 2 : ℝ) +
          -(x + (4 * (d : ℝ) + 2) * (k + 2 : ℝ)) =
        -x + ((k + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (-2) := by
    push_cast
    ring
  calc
    Real.exp (4 * (d : ℝ) * (k + 2 : ℝ)) *
        (2 * Real.exp (-(x + (4 * (d : ℝ) + 2) * (k + 2 : ℝ)))) =
      2 * Real.exp (4 * (d : ℝ) * (k + 2 : ℝ) +
        -(x + (4 * (d : ℝ) + 2) * (k + 2 : ℝ))) := by
          rw [Real.exp_add]
          ring
    _ = 2 * Real.exp (-x + ((k + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (-2)) := by
      rw [hexponent]
    _ = 2 * Real.exp (-x) * (Real.exp (-2)) ^ (k + 2) := by
      rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_nat_mul]
      ring
    _ = 2 * Real.exp (-x) * (Real.exp (-2)) ^ 2 *
        (Real.exp (-2)) ^ k := by rw [pow_add]; ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.summable_mixedEuclideanEntropyCost
statement:
theorem summable_mixedEuclideanEntropyCost (d : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    Summable (mixedEuclideanEntropyCost d x)
proof:
:= by
  let q : ℝ := Real.exp (-2)
  have hq : ‖q‖ < 1 := by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _), Real.exp_lt_one_iff]
    norm_num [q]
  have hgeom : Summable (fun k : ℕ => q ^ k) :=
    summable_geometric_of_norm_lt_one hq
  have hscaled := hgeom.mul_left (2 * Real.exp (-x) * q ^ 2)
  exact hscaled.congr (fun k => by
    simpa only [q] using (mixedEuclideanEntropyCost_eq d x k).symm)

name: ProbabilityTheory.tsum_mixedEuclideanEntropyCost_le
statement:
theorem tsum_mixedEuclideanEntropyCost_le (d : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    ∑' k, mixedEuclideanEntropyCost d x k ≤ Real.exp (-x)
proof:
:= by
  let q : ℝ := Real.exp (-2)
  have hqpos : 0 < q := Real.exp_pos _
  have hq : ‖q‖ < 1 := by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hqpos, Real.exp_lt_one_iff]
    norm_num [q]
  have hqquarter : q ≤ 1 / 4 := by
    have he : Real.exp (-1) < 0.3678794412 := Real.exp_neg_one_lt_d9
    have hqeq : q = Real.exp (-1) ^ 2 := by
      dsimp only [q]
      rw [pow_two, ← Real.exp_add]
      norm_num
    rw [hqeq]
    nlinarith [Real.exp_pos (-1)]
  have hsum :
      ∑' k, mixedEuclideanEntropyCost d x k =
        2 * Real.exp (-x) * q ^ 2 * (1 - q)⁻¹ := by
    rw [show (∑' k, mixedEuclideanEntropyCost d x k) =
        ∑' k, (2 * Real.exp (-x) * q ^ 2) * q ^ k by
      apply tsum_congr
      intro k
      simpa only [q] using mixedEuclideanEntropyCost_eq d x k]
    rw [tsum_mul_left, tsum_geometric_of_norm_lt_one hq]
  rw [hsum]
  have hden : 0 < 1 - q := by nlinarith
  have hfactor : 2 * q ^ 2 * (1 - q)⁻¹ ≤ 1 := by
    calc
      2 * q ^ 2 * (1 - q)⁻¹ = (2 * q ^ 2) / (1 - q) := by
        rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
      _ ≤ 1 := (div_le_iff₀ hden).2 (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg q])
  calc
    2 * Real.exp (-x) * q ^ 2 * (1 - q)⁻¹ =
        Real.exp (-x) * (2 * q ^ 2 * (1 - q)⁻¹) := by ring
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-x) * 1 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfactor (Real.exp_pos _).le
    _ = Real.exp (-x) := mul_one _

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_mixedEuclideanProcess_largeDeviation_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_mixedEuclideanProcess_largeDeviation_le
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (Z : Ω → T → ℝ) (N0 : Finset T)
    (edges : ℕ → Finset (T × T)) (proj : ℕ → T → T)
    (d : ℕ) {σ₂ σ₁ x : ℝ}
    (hσ₂ : 0 ≤ σ₂) (hσ₁ : 0 ≤ σ₁) (hx : 0 ≤ x)
    (hbase : ∀ t, proj 0 t ∈ N0)
    (hedge : ∀ k t, (proj (k + 1) t, proj k t) ∈ edges k)
    (hremainder : ∀ ω t, Tendsto
      (fun m => |Z ω t - Z ω (proj m t)|) atTop (nhds 0))
    (hbaseZero : ∀ ω, ∀ u ∈ N0, Z ω u = 0)
    (hedgeDist : ∀ k, ∀ e ∈ edges k,
      dist e.1 e.2 ≤ 3 * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k))
    (hedgeCard : ∀ k,
      ((edges k).card : ℝ) ≤
        Real.exp (4 * (d : ℝ) * (k + 2 : ℝ)))
    (hmixedTail : ∀ k, ∀ e ∈ edges k,
      μ.real {ω |
        σ₂ * dist e.1 e.2 *
              Real.sqrt (2 * mixedEuclideanConfidence d x k) +
            2 * σ₁ * dist e.1 e.2 * mixedEuclideanConfidence d x k <
          |Z ω e.1 - Z ω e.2|} ≤
        2 * Real.exp (-mixedEuclideanConfidence d x k)) :
    μ.real {ω | ∃ t,
        6 * σ₂ * Real.sqrt (2 * x) +
            72 * σ₂ * Real.sqrt (d + 1 : ℝ) +
            12 * σ₁ * x + 144 * σ₁ * (d + 1 : ℝ) <
          |Z ω t|} ≤
      Real.exp (-x)
proof:
:= by
  let threshold : ℕ → ℝ := mixedEuclideanThreshold σ₂ σ₁ d x
  let delta : ℕ → ℝ := fun k =>
    2 * Real.exp (-mixedEuclideanConfidence d x k)
  have hthresholdSummable : Summable threshold :=
    summable_mixedEuclideanThreshold hσ₂ hσ₁ d hx
  have hbaseTail : ∀ u ∈ N0,
      μ.real {ω | (0 : ℝ) < |Z ω u|} ≤ 0 := by
    intro u hu
    simp only [hbaseZero _ u hu, abs_zero, lt_self_iff_false,
      Set.setOf_false, measureReal_empty, le_refl]
  have hedgeTail : ∀ k, ∀ e ∈ edges k,
      μ.real {ω | threshold k < |Z ω e.1 - Z ω e.2|} ≤
        delta k := by
    intro k e he
    have hc : 0 ≤ mixedEuclideanConfidence d x k :=
      mixedEuclideanConfidence_nonneg d hx k
    have hlocal :
        σ₂ * dist e.1 e.2 *
              Real.sqrt (2 * mixedEuclideanConfidence d x k) +
            2 * σ₁ * dist e.1 e.2 * mixedEuclideanConfidence d x k ≤
          threshold k := by
      dsimp only [threshold]
      unfold mixedEuclideanThreshold
      apply add_le_add
      · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (by
            calc
              σ₂ * dist e.1 e.2 ≤ σ₂ * (3 * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k)) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hedgeDist k e he) hσ₂
              _ = 3 * σ₂ * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k) := by ring)
          (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
      · have hcoef : 2 * σ₁ * dist e.1 e.2 ≤
            6 * σ₁ * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k) := by
          calc
            2 * σ₁ * dist e.1 e.2 ≤
                2 * σ₁ * (3 * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k)) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hedgeDist k e he) (by positivity)
            _ = 6 * σ₁ * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k) := by ring
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcoef hc
    exact (measureReal_mono (by
      intro ω hω
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt hlocal hω)).trans (hmixedTail k e he)
  have hcostPointwise : ∀ k,
      (edges k).card * delta k ≤ mixedEuclideanEntropyCost d x k := by
    intro k
    unfold mixedEuclideanEntropyCost
    dsimp only [delta]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hedgeCard k) (by positivity)
  have hcostSummable : Summable fun k => (edges k).card * delta k :=
    Summable.of_nonneg_of_le
      (fun k => mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (by positivity))
      hcostPointwise (summable_mixedEuclideanEntropyCost d x)
  have hchain := measureReal_countableChaining_edges_largeDeviation_le
    Z N0 edges proj threshold delta 0 0 hbase hedge hthresholdSummable
      hremainder hcostSummable hbaseTail hedgeTail
  have hchain' :
      μ.real {ω | ∃ t, (∑' k, threshold k) < |Z ω t|} ≤
        ∑' k, (edges k).card * delta k := by
    simpa only [zero_add, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, mul_zero, add_zero] using hchain
  calc
    μ.real {ω | ∃ t,
        6 * σ₂ * Real.sqrt (2 * x) +
            72 * σ₂ * Real.sqrt (d + 1 : ℝ) +
            12 * σ₁ * x + 144 * σ₁ * (d + 1 : ℝ) <
          |Z ω t|} ≤
        μ.real {ω | ∃ t, (∑' k, threshold k) < |Z ω t|} := by
      apply measureReal_mono _ (measure_ne_top μ _)
      rintro ω ⟨t, ht⟩
      refine ⟨t, lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ ht⟩
      exact tsum_mixedEuclideanThreshold_le hσ₂ hσ₁ d hx
    _ ≤ ∑' k, (edges k).card * delta k := hchain'
    _ ≤ ∑' k, mixedEuclideanEntropyCost d x k :=
      hcostSummable.tsum_le_tsum hcostPointwise
        (summable_mixedEuclideanEntropyCost d x)
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-x) := tsum_mixedEuclideanEntropyCost_le d x

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_mixedEuclideanContinuousProcess_largeDeviation_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_mixedEuclideanContinuousProcess_largeDeviation_le
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (Z : Ω → T → ℝ) (N0 : Finset T)
    (edges : ℕ → Finset (T × T)) (proj : ℕ → T → T)
    (d : ℕ) {σ₂ σ₁ x : ℝ}
    (hσ₂ : 0 ≤ σ₂) (hσ₁ : 0 ≤ σ₁) (hx : 0 ≤ x)
    (hcontinuous : ∀ ω, Continuous (Z ω))
    (hbase : ∀ t, proj 0 t ∈ N0)
    (hedge : ∀ k t, (proj (k + 1) t, proj k t) ∈ edges k)
    (hproj : ∀ t, Tendsto (fun k => proj k t) atTop (nhds t))
    (hbaseZero : ∀ ω, ∀ u ∈ N0, Z ω u = 0)
    (hedgeDist : ∀ k, ∀ e ∈ edges k,
      dist e.1 e.2 ≤ 3 * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k))
    (hedgeCard : ∀ k,
      ((edges k).card : ℝ) ≤
        Real.exp (4 * (d : ℝ) * (k + 2 : ℝ)))
    (hmixedTail : ∀ s t (y : ℝ), 0 ≤ y →
      μ.real {ω |
        σ₂ * dist s t * Real.sqrt (2 * y) +
            2 * σ₁ * dist s t * y < |Z ω s - Z ω t|} ≤
        2 * Real.exp (-y)) :
    μ.real {ω | ∃ t,
        6 * σ₂ * Real.sqrt (2 * x) +
            72 * σ₂ * Real.sqrt (d + 1 : ℝ) +
            12 * σ₁ * x + 144 * σ₁ * (d + 1 : ℝ) <
          |Z ω t|} ≤
      Real.exp (-x)
proof:
:= by
  have hremainder : ∀ ω t, Tendsto
      (fun m => |Z ω t - Z ω (proj m t)|) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    intro ω t
    have hZproj : Tendsto (fun m => Z ω (proj m t)) atTop
        (nhds (Z ω t)) := (hcontinuous ω).tendsto t |>.comp (hproj t)
    have hsub : Tendsto (fun m => Z ω t - Z ω (proj m t)) atTop
        (nhds 0) := by
      have hc : Tendsto (fun _m : ℕ => Z ω t) atTop
          (nhds (Z ω t)) := tendsto_const_nhds
      simpa only [sub_self] using hc.sub hZproj
    simpa only [abs_zero] using hsub.abs
  apply measureReal_mixedEuclideanProcess_largeDeviation_le
    Z N0 edges proj d hσ₂ hσ₁ hx hbase hedge hremainder hbaseZero
      hedgeDist hedgeCard
  intro k e he
  exact hmixedTail e.1 e.2 (mixedEuclideanConfidence d x k)
    (mixedEuclideanConfidence_nonneg d hx k)

name: ProbabilityTheory.integrable_cvarExcess
statement:
theorem integrable_cvarExcess [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    {X : Omega → ℝ} (hX : Integrable X mu) (t : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun omega ↦ max (X omega - t) 0) mu
proof:
:= by
  exact (hX.sub (integrable_const t)).sup (integrable_const 0)

name: ProbabilityTheory.max_sub_add_sub_le
statement:
theorem max_sub_add_sub_le (x y s t : ℝ) :
    max (x + y - (s + t)) 0 ≤ max (x - s) 0 + max (y - t) 0
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x - s ≤ max (x - s) 0 := le_max_left _ _
  have hy : y - t ≤ max (y - t) 0 := le_max_left _ _
  have hzero : 0 ≤ max (x - s) 0 + max (y - t) 0 :=
    add_nonneg (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
  rw [max_le_iff]
  constructor
  · linarith
  · exact hzero

name: ProbabilityTheory.cvarObjective_add_le
statement:
theorem cvarObjective_add_le [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    {X Y : Omega → ℝ} (hX : Integrable X mu) (hY : Integrable Y mu)
    {alpha : ℝ} (halpha : 0 ≤ alpha) (s t : ℝ) :
    cvarObjective alpha (fun omega ↦ X omega + Y omega) mu (s + t) ≤
      cvarObjective alpha X mu s + cvarObjective alpha Y mu t
proof:
:= by
  have hXs := integrable_cvarExcess hX s
  have hYt := integrable_cvarExcess hY t
  have hXY := integrable_cvarExcess (hX.add hY) (s + t)
  have hsum : Integrable
      (fun omega ↦ max (X omega - s) 0 + max (Y omega - t) 0) mu :=
    hXs.add hYt
  have hint :
      (∫ omega, max (X omega + Y omega - (s + t)) 0 ∂mu) ≤
        ∫ omega, max (X omega - s) 0 + max (Y omega - t) 0 ∂mu := by
    exact integral_mono hXY hsum (fun omega ↦
      max_sub_add_sub_le (X omega) (Y omega) s t)
  rw [integral_add hXs hYt] at hint
  unfold cvarObjective
  have hinv : 0 ≤ alpha⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr halpha
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hint hinv]

name: ProbabilityTheory.cvarObjective_mono_ae
statement:
theorem cvarObjective_mono_ae [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    {X Y : Omega → ℝ} (hX : Integrable X mu) (hY : Integrable Y mu)
    {alpha : ℝ} (halpha : 0 ≤ alpha) (hXY : X ≤ᵐ[mu] Y) (t : ℝ) :
    cvarObjective alpha X mu t ≤ cvarObjective alpha Y mu t
proof:
:= by
  have hXt := integrable_cvarExcess hX t
  have hYt := integrable_cvarExcess hY t
  have hpoint :
      (fun omega ↦ max (X omega - t) 0) ≤ᵐ[mu]
        (fun omega ↦ max (Y omega - t) 0) := by
    filter_upwards [hXY] with omega homega
    exact max_le_max (sub_le_sub_right homega t) le_rfl
  have hint := integral_mono_ae hXt hYt hpoint
  unfold cvarObjective
  exact add_le_add_right
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hint (inv_nonneg.mpr halpha)) t

name: ProbabilityTheory.integral_le_cvarObjective
statement:
theorem integral_le_cvarObjective [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {X : Omega → ℝ} (hX : Integrable X mu)
    {alpha : ℝ} (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha ≤ 1) (t : ℝ) :
    (∫ omega, X omega ∂mu) ≤ cvarObjective alpha X mu t
proof:
:= by
  have hpos := integrable_cvarExcess hX t
  have hconstPos : Integrable
      (fun omega : Omega ↦ t + max (X omega - t) 0) mu :=
    (integrable_const t).add hpos
  have hpoint : ∀ omega,
      X omega ≤ t + max (X omega - t) 0 := by
    intro omega
    exact le_add_of_sub_left_le (le_max_left _ _)
  have hint :
      (∫ omega, X omega ∂mu) ≤
        ∫ omega, t + max (X omega - t) 0 ∂mu :=
    integral_mono hX hconstPos hpoint
  have hposInt : 0 ≤ ∫ omega, max (X omega - t) 0 ∂mu :=
    integral_nonneg (fun omega ↦ le_max_right _ _)
  have hinv : 1 ≤ alpha⁻¹ := by
    simpa only [inv_one] using
      (inv_le_inv₀ (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 by norm_num) halpha0).2 halpha1
  rw [integral_add (integrable_const t) hpos, integral_const] at hint
  simp only [probReal_univ, smul_eq_mul] at hint
  unfold cvarObjective
  have hscale := le_mul_of_one_le_left hposInt hinv
  nlinarith

name: ProbabilityTheory.bddBelow_range_cvarObjective
statement:
theorem bddBelow_range_cvarObjective [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {X : Omega → ℝ} (hX : Integrable X mu)
    {alpha : ℝ} (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha ≤ 1) :
    BddBelow (Set.range (cvarObjective alpha X mu))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨∫ omega, X omega ∂mu, ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hy
  rw [← ht]
  exact integral_le_cvarObjective hX halpha0 halpha1 t

name: ProbabilityTheory.integral_le_conditionalValueAtRisk
statement:
theorem integral_le_conditionalValueAtRisk [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {X : Omega → ℝ} (hX : Integrable X mu)
    {alpha : ℝ} (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha ≤ 1) :
    (∫ omega, X omega ∂mu) ≤ conditionalValueAtRisk alpha X mu
proof:
:= by
  unfold conditionalValueAtRisk
  apply le_csInf (Set.range_nonempty _)
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hy
  rw [← ht]
  exact integral_le_cvarObjective hX halpha0 halpha1 t

name: ProbabilityTheory.conditionalValueAtRisk_add_le
statement:
theorem conditionalValueAtRisk_add_le [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {X Y : Omega → ℝ} (hX : Integrable X mu) (hY : Integrable Y mu)
    {alpha : ℝ} (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha ≤ 1) :
    conditionalValueAtRisk alpha (fun omega ↦ X omega + Y omega) mu ≤
      conditionalValueAtRisk alpha X mu + conditionalValueAtRisk alpha Y mu
proof:
:= by
  let fX : ℝ → ℝ := cvarObjective alpha X mu
  let fY : ℝ → ℝ := cvarObjective alpha Y mu
  let fXY : ℝ → ℝ := cvarObjective alpha (fun omega ↦ X omega + Y omega) mu
  have hbXY : BddBelow (Set.range fXY) := by
    exact bddBelow_range_cvarObjective (hX.add hY) halpha0 halpha1
  refine le_of_forall_pos_le_add fun epsilon hepsilon ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨ax, ⟨sx, hsx⟩, hax⟩ :=
    Real.lt_sInf_add_pos (Set.range_nonempty fX) (half_pos hepsilon)
  obtain ⟨ay, ⟨sy, hsy⟩, hay⟩ :=
    Real.lt_sInf_add_pos (Set.range_nonempty fY) (half_pos hepsilon)
  subst ax
  subst ay
  have hinf : sInf (Set.range fXY) ≤ fXY (sx + sy) :=
    csInf_le hbXY ⟨sx + sy, rfl⟩
  have hadd : fXY (sx + sy) ≤ fX sx + fY sy := by
    exact cvarObjective_add_le hX hY halpha0.le sx sy
  change sInf (Set.range fXY) ≤
    sInf (Set.range fX) + sInf (Set.range fY) + epsilon
  calc
    sInf (Set.range fXY) ≤ fXY (sx + sy) := hinf
    _ ≤ fX sx + fY sy := hadd
    _ ≤ (sInf (Set.range fX) + epsilon / 2) +
        (sInf (Set.range fY) + epsilon / 2) := (add_lt_add hax hay).le
    _ = sInf (Set.range fX) + sInf (Set.range fY) + epsilon := by ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.conditionalValueAtRisk_mono_ae
statement:
theorem conditionalValueAtRisk_mono_ae [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {X Y : Omega → ℝ} (hX : Integrable X mu) (hY : Integrable Y mu)
    {alpha : ℝ} (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha ≤ 1)
    (hXY : X ≤ᵐ[mu] Y) :
    conditionalValueAtRisk alpha X mu ≤ conditionalValueAtRisk alpha Y mu
proof:
:= by
  have hbX : BddBelow (Set.range (cvarObjective alpha X mu)) :=
    bddBelow_range_cvarObjective hX halpha0 halpha1
  refine le_of_forall_pos_le_add fun epsilon hepsilon ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨ay, ⟨t, ht⟩, hay⟩ :=
    Real.lt_sInf_add_pos
      (Set.range_nonempty (cvarObjective alpha Y mu)) hepsilon
  rw [← ht] at hay
  unfold conditionalValueAtRisk
  calc
    sInf (Set.range (cvarObjective alpha X mu)) ≤
        cvarObjective alpha X mu t :=
      csInf_le hbX ⟨t, rfl⟩
    _ ≤ cvarObjective alpha Y mu t :=
      cvarObjective_mono_ae hX hY halpha0.le hXY t
    _ ≤ sInf (Set.range (cvarObjective alpha Y mu)) + epsilon := hay.le

name: ProbabilityTheory.conditionalValueAtRisk_const
statement:
theorem conditionalValueAtRisk_const [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {alpha : ℝ} (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha ≤ 1) (c : ℝ) :
    conditionalValueAtRisk alpha (fun _ : Omega ↦ c) mu = c
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Integrable (fun _ : Omega ↦ c) mu := integrable_const c
  have hb : BddBelow
      (Set.range (cvarObjective alpha (fun _ : Omega ↦ c) mu)) :=
    bddBelow_range_cvarObjective hc halpha0 halpha1
  apply le_antisymm
  · unfold conditionalValueAtRisk
    have h := csInf_le hb
      (show cvarObjective alpha (fun _ : Omega ↦ c) mu c ∈
        Set.range (cvarObjective alpha (fun _ : Omega ↦ c) mu) from ⟨c, rfl⟩)
    simpa [cvarObjective] using h
  · have hmean := integral_le_conditionalValueAtRisk hc halpha0 halpha1
    simpa using hmean

name: ProbabilityTheory.conditionalValueAtRisk_add_const
statement:
theorem conditionalValueAtRisk_add_const [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {X : Omega → ℝ} (hX : Integrable X mu)
    {alpha : ℝ} (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha ≤ 1) (c : ℝ) :
    conditionalValueAtRisk alpha (fun omega ↦ X omega + c) mu =
      conditionalValueAtRisk alpha X mu + c
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Integrable (fun _ : Omega ↦ c) mu := integrable_const c
  have hnegc : Integrable (fun _ : Omega ↦ -c) mu := integrable_const (-c)
  have hXc : Integrable (fun omega ↦ X omega + c) mu := hX.add hc
  apply le_antisymm
  · have h := conditionalValueAtRisk_add_le hX hc halpha0 halpha1
    rw [conditionalValueAtRisk_const halpha0 halpha1 c] at h
    exact h
  · have h := conditionalValueAtRisk_add_le hXc hnegc halpha0 halpha1
    rw [conditionalValueAtRisk_const halpha0 halpha1 (-c)] at h
    have hsimplify :
        (fun omega ↦ (X omega + c) + -c) = X := by
      funext omega
      ring
    rw [hsimplify] at h
    linarith

name: ProbabilityTheory.setIntegral_le_measureReal_mul_add_cvarExcess
statement:
theorem setIntegral_le_measureReal_mul_add_cvarExcess
    [IsFiniteMeasure mu] {X : Omega → ℝ} (hX : Integrable X mu)
    {A : Set Omega} (hA : MeasurableSet A) (t : ℝ) :
    (∫ omega in A, X omega ∂mu) ≤
      mu.real A * t + ∫ omega, max (X omega - t) 0 ∂mu
proof:
:= by
  have hleft : Integrable (A.indicator X) mu := hX.indicator hA
  have hconst : Integrable (A.indicator (fun _ : Omega ↦ t)) mu :=
    (integrable_const t).indicator hA
  have hpos := integrable_cvarExcess hX t
  have hright : Integrable
      (fun omega ↦ A.indicator (fun _ : Omega ↦ t) omega +
        max (X omega - t) 0) mu := hconst.add hpos
  have hpoint : ∀ omega,
      A.indicator X omega ≤
        A.indicator (fun _ : Omega ↦ t) omega + max (X omega - t) 0 := by
    intro omega
    by_cases homega : omega ∈ A
    · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem homega]
      exact le_add_of_sub_left_le (le_max_left _ _)
    · simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem homega, zero_add]
      exact le_max_right _ _
  have hint := integral_mono hleft hright hpoint
  rw [integral_add hconst hpos, integral_indicator hA,
    integral_indicator_const t hA, smul_eq_mul] at hint
  exact hint

name: ProbabilityTheory.setIntegral_le_mul_conditionalValueAtRisk_of_measureReal_eq
statement:
theorem setIntegral_le_mul_conditionalValueAtRisk_of_measureReal_eq
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] {X : Omega → ℝ} (hX : Integrable X mu)
    {A : Set Omega} (hA : MeasurableSet A)
    {alpha : ℝ} (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (_halpha1 : alpha ≤ 1)
    (hmeasure : mu.real A = alpha) :
    (∫ omega in A, X omega ∂mu) ≤
      alpha * conditionalValueAtRisk alpha X mu
proof:
:= by
  have hnormalized :
      (∫ omega in A, X omega ∂mu) / alpha ≤
        conditionalValueAtRisk alpha X mu := by
    unfold conditionalValueAtRisk
    apply le_csInf (Set.range_nonempty _)
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hy
    rw [← ht]
    have hthreshold :=
      setIntegral_le_measureReal_mul_add_cvarExcess hX hA t
    rw [hmeasure] at hthreshold
    unfold cvarObjective
    apply (div_le_iff₀ halpha0).2
    calc
      (∫ omega in A, X omega ∂mu) ≤
          alpha * t + ∫ omega, max (X omega - t) 0 ∂mu := hthreshold
      _ = (t + alpha⁻¹ * ∫ omega, max (X omega - t) 0 ∂mu) * alpha := by
        field_simp [halpha0.ne']
  simpa only [mul_comm] using (div_le_iff₀ halpha0).1 hnormalized

name: ProbabilityTheory.setIntegral_le_mul_conditionalValueAtRisk_of_measureReal_le_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem setIntegral_le_mul_conditionalValueAtRisk_of_measureReal_le_of_nonneg
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] {X : Omega → ℝ} (hX : Integrable X mu)
    (hXnonneg : 0 ≤ᵐ[mu] X) {A : Set Omega} (hA : MeasurableSet A)
    {alpha : ℝ} (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha ≤ 1)
    (hmeasure : mu.real A ≤ alpha) :
    (∫ omega in A, X omega ∂mu) ≤
      alpha * conditionalValueAtRisk alpha X mu
proof:
:= by
  have hnormalized :
      (∫ omega in A, X omega ∂mu) / alpha ≤
        conditionalValueAtRisk alpha X mu := by
    unfold conditionalValueAtRisk
    apply le_csInf (Set.range_nonempty _)
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨t, htEq⟩ := hy
    rw [← htEq]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ halpha0).2
    by_cases ht : 0 ≤ t
    · have hthreshold :=
        setIntegral_le_measureReal_mul_add_cvarExcess hX hA t
      have hmeasureMul : mu.real A * t ≤ alpha * t :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hmeasure ht
      unfold cvarObjective
      calc
        (∫ omega in A, X omega ∂mu) ≤
            mu.real A * t +
              ∫ omega, max (X omega - t) 0 ∂mu := hthreshold
        _ ≤ alpha * t + ∫ omega, max (X omega - t) 0 ∂mu :=
          add_le_add_left hmeasureMul _
        _ = (t + alpha⁻¹ *
            ∫ omega, max (X omega - t) 0 ∂mu) * alpha := by
          field_simp [halpha0.ne']
    · have htneg : t < 0 := lt_of_not_ge ht
      have hmax :
          (fun omega ↦ max (X omega - t) 0) =ᵐ[mu]
            (fun omega ↦ X omega - t) := by
        filter_upwards [hXnonneg] with omega homega
        change 0 ≤ X omega at homega
        rw [max_eq_left]
        linarith
      have hexcess :
          (∫ omega, max (X omega - t) 0 ∂mu) =
            (∫ omega, X omega ∂mu) - t := by
        rw [integral_congr_ae hmax,
          integral_sub hX (integrable_const t), integral_const]
        simp only [probReal_univ, smul_eq_mul, one_mul]
      have hpartial :
          (∫ omega in A, X omega ∂mu) ≤ ∫ omega, X omega ∂mu :=
        setIntegral_le_integral hX hXnonneg
      have hcorrection : 0 ≤ (alpha - 1) * t :=
        mul_nonneg_of_nonpos_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr halpha1) htneg.le
      unfold cvarObjective
      rw [hexcess]
      calc
        (∫ omega in A, X omega ∂mu) ≤ ∫ omega, X omega ∂mu := hpartial
        _ ≤ (t + alpha⁻¹ * ((∫ omega, X omega ∂mu) - t)) * alpha := by
          field_simp [halpha0.ne']
          nlinarith
  simpa only [mul_comm] using (div_le_iff₀ halpha0).1 hnormalized

name: ProbabilityTheory.mul_conditionalValueAtRisk_eq_setIntegral_of_thresholdEvent
statement:
theorem mul_conditionalValueAtRisk_eq_setIntegral_of_thresholdEvent
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] {X : Omega → ℝ} (hX : Integrable X mu)
    {A : Set Omega} (hA : MeasurableSet A)
    {alpha : ℝ} (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha ≤ 1)
    (hmeasure : mu.real A = alpha) (t : ℝ)
    (hupper : ∀ omega ∈ A, t ≤ X omega)
    (hlower : ∀ omega ∉ A, X omega ≤ t) :
    alpha * conditionalValueAtRisk alpha X mu =
      ∫ omega in A, X omega ∂mu
proof:
:= by
  have hevent :=
    setIntegral_le_mul_conditionalValueAtRisk_of_measureReal_eq
      hX hA halpha0 halpha1 hmeasure
  have hfun :
      (fun omega ↦ max (X omega - t) 0) =
        A.indicator (fun omega ↦ X omega - t) := by
    funext omega
    by_cases homega : omega ∈ A
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem homega, max_eq_left]
      exact sub_nonneg.mpr (hupper omega homega)
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem homega, max_eq_right]
      exact sub_nonpos.mpr (hlower omega homega)
  have hexcess :
      (∫ omega, max (X omega - t) 0 ∂mu) =
        (∫ omega in A, X omega ∂mu) - alpha * t := by
    rw [hfun, integral_indicator hA,
      integral_sub hX.integrableOn (integrable_const t),
      setIntegral_const, smul_eq_mul, hmeasure]
  have hb : BddBelow (Set.range (cvarObjective alpha X mu)) :=
    bddBelow_range_cvarObjective hX halpha0 halpha1
  have hcvarObj :
      conditionalValueAtRisk alpha X mu ≤ cvarObjective alpha X mu t := by
    unfold conditionalValueAtRisk
    exact csInf_le hb ⟨t, rfl⟩
  have hscaled := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcvarObj halpha0.le
  unfold cvarObjective at hscaled
  rw [hexcess] at hscaled
  apply le_antisymm
  · calc
      alpha * conditionalValueAtRisk alpha X mu ≤
          alpha * (t + alpha⁻¹ *
            ((∫ omega in A, X omega ∂mu) - alpha * t)) := hscaled
      _ = ∫ omega in A, X omega ∂mu := by
        field_simp [halpha0.ne']
        ring
  · exact hevent

name: ProbabilityTheory.max_le_exp_mul_sub_one_div
statement:
theorem max_le_exp_mul_sub_one_div {lambda : ℝ} (hlambda : 0 < lambda)
    (x : ℝ) :
    max x 0 ≤ Real.exp (lambda * x - 1) / lambda
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : 0 ≤ x
  · rw [max_eq_left hx]
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hlambda).2
    have h := Real.add_one_le_exp (lambda * x - 1)
    simpa only [sub_add_cancel, mul_comm] using h
  · rw [max_eq_right (le_of_not_ge hx)]
    positivity

name: ProbabilityTheory.cvarObjective_le_of_exponentialMoment
statement:
theorem cvarObjective_le_of_exponentialMoment
    [IsFiniteMeasure mu] {X : Omega → ℝ} (hX : Integrable X mu)
    {alpha lambda : ℝ} (halpha : 0 ≤ alpha) (hlambda : 0 < lambda)
    (hExp : Integrable (fun omega ↦ Real.exp (lambda * X omega)) mu)
    (t : ℝ) :
    cvarObjective alpha X mu t ≤
      t + alpha⁻¹ *
        ((Real.exp (-lambda * t - 1) / lambda) *
          ∫ omega, Real.exp (lambda * X omega) ∂mu)
proof:
:= by
  have hpos := integrable_cvarExcess hX t
  have hright : Integrable
      (fun omega ↦ (Real.exp (-lambda * t - 1) / lambda) *
        Real.exp (lambda * X omega)) mu :=
    hExp.const_mul (Real.exp (-lambda * t - 1) / lambda)
  have hpoint : ∀ omega,
      max (X omega - t) 0 ≤
        (Real.exp (-lambda * t - 1) / lambda) *
          Real.exp (lambda * X omega) := by
    intro omega
    calc
      max (X omega - t) 0 ≤
          Real.exp (lambda * (X omega - t) - 1) / lambda :=
        max_le_exp_mul_sub_one_div hlambda (X omega - t)
      _ = (Real.exp (-lambda * t - 1) / lambda) *
          Real.exp (lambda * X omega) := by
        rw [div_eq_mul_inv, div_eq_mul_inv]
        calc
          Real.exp (lambda * (X omega - t) - 1) * lambda⁻¹ =
              (Real.exp (-lambda * t - 1) *
                Real.exp (lambda * X omega)) * lambda⁻¹ := by
            rw [← Real.exp_add]
            congr 1
            ring_nf
          _ = Real.exp (-lambda * t - 1) * lambda⁻¹ *
              Real.exp (lambda * X omega) := by ring
  have hint := integral_mono hpos hright hpoint
  rw [integral_const_mul] at hint
  unfold cvarObjective
  exact add_le_add_right
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hint (inv_nonneg.mpr halpha)) t

name: ProbabilityTheory.integral_exp_mul_pos
statement:
theorem integral_exp_mul_pos [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : Omega → ℝ) (lambda : ℝ)
    (hExp : Integrable (fun omega ↦ Real.exp (lambda * X omega)) mu) :
    0 < ∫ omega, Real.exp (lambda * X omega) ∂mu
proof:
:= by
  apply (integral_pos_iff_support_of_nonneg_ae
    (ae_of_all mu fun omega ↦ (Real.exp_pos _).le) hExp).2
  have hsupport :
      Function.support (fun omega ↦ Real.exp (lambda * X omega)) = Set.univ := by
    ext omega
    simp [Function.mem_support, Real.exp_ne_zero]
  rw [hsupport, measure_univ]
  norm_num

name: ProbabilityTheory.conditionalValueAtRisk_le_log_integral_exp_div
statement:
theorem conditionalValueAtRisk_le_log_integral_exp_div
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] {X : Omega → ℝ} (hX : Integrable X mu)
    {alpha lambda : ℝ} (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha ≤ 1)
    (hlambda : 0 < lambda)
    (hExp : Integrable (fun omega ↦ Real.exp (lambda * X omega)) mu) :
    conditionalValueAtRisk alpha X mu ≤
      Real.log ((∫ omega, Real.exp (lambda * X omega) ∂mu) / alpha) / lambda
proof:
:= by
  let M : ℝ := ∫ omega, Real.exp (lambda * X omega) ∂mu
  let t : ℝ := (Real.log (M / alpha) - 1) / lambda
  have hExpIntegral : 0 < M := integral_exp_mul_pos X lambda hExp
  have hratio : 0 < M / alpha := div_pos hExpIntegral halpha0
  have hMne : M ≠ 0 := hExpIntegral.ne'
  have hb : BddBelow (Set.range (cvarObjective alpha X mu)) :=
    bddBelow_range_cvarObjective hX halpha0 halpha1
  have hcvarObj :
      conditionalValueAtRisk alpha X mu ≤ cvarObjective alpha X mu t := by
    unfold conditionalValueAtRisk
    exact csInf_le hb ⟨t, rfl⟩
  have hobjExp :
      cvarObjective alpha X mu t ≤
        t + alpha⁻¹ * ((Real.exp (-lambda * t - 1) / lambda) * M) := by
    exact cvarObjective_le_of_exponentialMoment
      hX halpha0.le hlambda hExp t
  have hexponent :
      -lambda * t - 1 = -Real.log (M / alpha) := by
    dsimp only [t]
    field_simp [hlambda.ne']
    ring
  change conditionalValueAtRisk alpha X mu ≤ Real.log (M / alpha) / lambda
  calc
    conditionalValueAtRisk alpha X mu ≤ cvarObjective alpha X mu t := hcvarObj
    _ ≤ t + alpha⁻¹ * ((Real.exp (-lambda * t - 1) / lambda) * M) := hobjExp
    _ = Real.log (M / alpha) / lambda := by
      rw [hexponent, Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log hratio]
      dsimp only [t]
      field_simp [halpha0.ne', hlambda.ne', hMne]
      ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.two_mul_three_pow_sub_le_factorial
statement:
theorem two_mul_three_pow_sub_le_factorial {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    2 * 3 ^ (k - 2) ≤ k.factorial
proof:
:= by
  rcases hk.eq_or_lt with rfl | hk
  · norm_num
  · have hk3 : 3 ≤ k := by omega
    have h := Nat.factorial_mul_pow_sub_le_factorial hk3
    have hsub : k - 2 = (k - 3) + 1 := by omega
    rw [hsub, pow_succ]
    norm_num [Nat.factorial] at h
    calc
      2 * (3 ^ (k - 3) * 3) = 3 ^ (k - 3) * 6 := by ring
      _ ≤ k.factorial := by simpa [mul_comm] using h

name: ProbabilityTheory.sum_Ico_three_pow_sub_two_eq
statement:
theorem sum_Ico_three_pow_sub_two_eq
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) (r : ℝ) :
    (∑ k ∈ Ico 3 q, r ^ (k - 2)) =
      ∑ j ∈ Ico 1 (q - 2), r ^ j
proof:
:= by
  have h := Finset.sum_Ico_add
    (fun k : ℕ => r ^ (k - 2)) 1 (q - 2) 2
  simpa [Nat.sub_add_cancel (show 2 ≤ q by omega), Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
    using h.symm

name: ProbabilityTheory.sum_Ico_three_pow_sub_two_le
statement:
theorem sum_Ico_three_pow_sub_two_le
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) {r : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hr1 : r < 1) :
    (∑ k ∈ Ico 3 q, r ^ (k - 2)) ≤ r / (1 - r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_Ico_three_pow_sub_two_eq q hq r]
  simpa using
    (geom_sum_Ico_le_of_lt_one (x := r) (m := 1) (n := q - 2) hr hr1)

name: ProbabilityTheory.intermediate_term_le_bernstein_geometric
statement:
theorem intermediate_term_le_bernstein_geometric
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) {V c t A : ℝ}
    (hV : 0 ≤ V) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (hA_le : A ≤ V * c ^ (k - 2)) :
    t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ) * A ≤
      gaussianChernoffExponent V t * (c * t / 3) ^ (k - 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hfacNat := two_mul_three_pow_sub_le_factorial hk
  have hfac : (2 : ℝ) * 3 ^ (k - 2) ≤ (k.factorial : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hfacNat
  have hdiv :
      t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ) ≤
        t ^ k / ((2 : ℝ) * 3 ^ (k - 2)) :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (pow_nonneg ht k) (by positivity) hfac
  calc
    t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ) * A ≤
        t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ) * (V * c ^ (k - 2)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hA_le
        (div_nonneg (pow_nonneg ht k) (by positivity))
    _ ≤ t ^ k / ((2 : ℝ) * 3 ^ (k - 2)) *
        (V * c ^ (k - 2)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hdiv
        (mul_nonneg hV (pow_nonneg hc (k - 2)))
    _ = gaussianChernoffExponent V t * (c * t / 3) ^ (k - 2) := by
      unfold gaussianChernoffExponent
      have hpow : t ^ k = t ^ 2 * t ^ (k - 2) := by
        rw [← pow_add]
        congr 1
        omega
      rw [hpow, mul_div_assoc, div_pow]
      ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.strongMomentIntermediateExponent_le_bernstein_geometric
statement:
theorem strongMomentIntermediateExponent_le_bernstein_geometric
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) {V Q c t : ℝ}
    (hV : 0 ≤ V) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (hr : c * t / 3 < 1)
    (hcoeff : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Ico 3 q,
      interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient q V Q k ≤
        V * c ^ (k - 2)) :
    strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V Q t ≤
      gaussianChernoffExponent V t *
        ((c * t / 3) / (1 - c * t / 3))
proof:
:= by
  have hr0 : 0 ≤ c * t / 3 := by positivity
  have hgeom := sum_Ico_three_pow_sub_two_le q hq hr0 hr
  unfold strongMomentIntermediateExponent
  calc
    (∑ k ∈ Ico 3 q,
        t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ) *
          interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient q V Q k) ≤
      ∑ k ∈ Ico 3 q,
        gaussianChernoffExponent V t * (c * t / 3) ^ (k - 2) := by
      exact sum_le_sum fun k hk =>
        intermediate_term_le_bernstein_geometric
          (by have := (mem_Ico.mp hk).1; omega) hV hc ht (hcoeff k hk)
    _ = gaussianChernoffExponent V t *
        (∑ k ∈ Ico 3 q, (c * t / 3) ^ (k - 2)) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ gaussianChernoffExponent V t *
        ((c * t / 3) / (1 - c * t / 3)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hgeom
        (gaussianChernoffExponent_nonneg hV)

name: ProbabilityTheory.gaussian_add_strongMomentIntermediateExponent_le_bernstein
statement:
theorem gaussian_add_strongMomentIntermediateExponent_le_bernstein
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) {V Q c t : ℝ}
    (hV : 0 ≤ V) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (hr : c * t / 3 < 1)
    (hcoeff : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Ico 3 q,
      interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient q V Q k ≤
        V * c ^ (k - 2)) :
    gaussianChernoffExponent V t +
        strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V Q t ≤
      bernsteinRationalExponent V c t
proof:
:= by
  have hmid := strongMomentIntermediateExponent_le_bernstein_geometric
    q hq hV hc ht hr hcoeff
  have hden : 0 < 1 - c * t / 3 := sub_pos.mpr hr
  have hden3 : 3 - t * c ≠ 0 := by nlinarith
  calc
    gaussianChernoffExponent V t +
        strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V Q t ≤
      gaussianChernoffExponent V t +
        gaussianChernoffExponent V t *
          ((c * t / 3) / (1 - c * t / 3)) := add_le_add le_rfl hmid
    _ = bernsteinRationalExponent V c t := by
      unfold gaussianChernoffExponent bernsteinRationalExponent
      field_simp [hden.ne', hden3]
      ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient_one_eq_geometric
statement:
theorem interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient_one_eq_geometric
    {q k : ℕ} (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    {V : ℝ} (hV : 0 < V) :
    interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient q V 1 k =
      V * (V ^ (-(1 / ((q : ℝ) - 2)))) ^ (k - 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hden : (q : ℝ) - 2 ≠ 0 := by
    have hqReal : (3 : ℝ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast hq
    linarith
  have hweight :
      strongMomentSecondWeight q k =
        1 + (-(1 / ((q : ℝ) - 2))) * ((k - 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    unfold strongMomentSecondWeight
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hk]
    field_simp [hden]
    ring
  unfold interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient
  rw [hweight, Real.rpow_add hV]
  simp only [one_rpow, mul_one, Real.rpow_one]
  rw [Real.rpow_mul hV.le, Real.rpow_natCast]

name: ProbabilityTheory.interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient_one_eq_root_pow
statement:
theorem interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient_one_eq_root_pow
    {q k : ℕ} (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hkq : k ≤ q)
    {V : ℝ} (hV : 0 < V) :
    interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient q V 1 k =
      (V ^ (1 / ((q : ℝ) - 2))) ^ (q - k)
proof:
:= by
  have hden : (q : ℝ) - 2 ≠ 0 := by
    have hqReal : (3 : ℝ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast hq
    linarith
  have hweight :
      strongMomentSecondWeight q k =
        (1 / ((q : ℝ) - 2)) * ((q - k : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    unfold strongMomentSecondWeight
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hkq]
    field_simp [hden]
  unfold interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient
  rw [hweight, Real.rpow_mul hV.le, Real.rpow_natCast]
  simp

name: ProbabilityTheory.gaussian_add_strongMomentIntermediateExponent_one_le_bernstein
statement:
theorem gaussian_add_strongMomentIntermediateExponent_one_le_bernstein
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) {V t : ℝ}
    (hV : 0 < V) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (hr : V ^ (-(1 / ((q : ℝ) - 2))) * t / 3 < 1) :
    gaussianChernoffExponent V t +
        strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V 1 t ≤
      bernsteinRationalExponent V
        (V ^ (-(1 / ((q : ℝ) - 2)))) t
proof:
:= by
  let c : ℝ := V ^ (-(1 / ((q : ℝ) - 2)))
  have hc : 0 ≤ c := Real.rpow_nonneg hV.le _
  apply gaussian_add_strongMomentIntermediateExponent_le_bernstein
    q hq hV.le hc ht (by simpa only [c] using hr)
  intro k hk
  have hkBounds := Finset.mem_Ico.mp hk
  rw [interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient_one_eq_geometric hq
    (by omega) hV]

name: ProbabilityTheory.bernsteinOptimalParameter_scale_lt_three
statement:
theorem bernsteinOptimalParameter_scale_lt_three
    {V c x : ℝ} (hV : 0 < V) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hx : 0 < x) :
    c * bernsteinOptimalParameter V c x / 3 < 1
proof:
:= by
  let a : ℝ := Real.sqrt (2 * x / V)
  have ha : 0 < a := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (div_pos (by positivity) hV)
  have hd : 0 < 1 + c * a / 3 := by positivity
  have hfrac : c * a / (1 + c * a / 3) < 3 := by
    apply (div_lt_iff₀ hd).2
    nlinarith
  change c * (a / (1 + c * a / 3)) / 3 < 1
  calc
    c * (a / (1 + c * a / 3)) / 3 =
        (c * a / (1 + c * a / 3)) / 3 := by ring
    _ < 1 := (div_lt_iff₀ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 3)).2 (by
      simpa using hfrac)

name: ProbabilityTheory.chernoffTransform_gaussian_add_intermediate_one_le
statement:
theorem chernoffTransform_gaussian_add_intermediate_one_le
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) {V x : ℝ}
    (hV : 0 < V) (hx : 0 < x) :
    chernoffTransform
        (fun t => gaussianChernoffExponent V t +
          strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V 1 t) x ≤
      Real.sqrt (2 * V * x) +
        V ^ (-(1 / ((q : ℝ) - 2))) * x / 3
proof:
:= by
  let c : ℝ := V ^ (-(1 / ((q : ℝ) - 2)))
  have hc : 0 ≤ c := Real.rpow_nonneg hV.le _
  apply chernoffTransform_le_sqrt_add_linear_of_le_bernsteinOptimal
    hV hc hx
  · intro t ht
    exact add_nonneg
      (gaussianChernoffExponent_nonneg hV.le)
      (strongMomentIntermediateExponent_nonneg q hV.le (by norm_num) ht.le)
  · apply gaussian_add_strongMomentIntermediateExponent_one_le_bernstein
      q hq hV (bernsteinOptimalParameter_pos hV hc hx).le
    simpa only [c] using bernsteinOptimalParameter_scale_lt_three hV hc hx

name: ProbabilityTheory.chernoffTransform_rioStrongMomentExponent_one_second_branch_le
statement:
theorem chernoffTransform_rioStrongMomentExponent_one_second_branch_le
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) {V y x : ℝ}
    (hV : 0 < V) (hy : 0 < y) (hx : 0 < x)
    (hscale : Real.exp x ≤ y ^ q) :
    chernoffTransform (rioStrongMomentExponent q V 1 y) x ≤
      Real.sqrt (2 * V * x) +
        V ^ (-(1 / ((q : ℝ) - 2))) * x / 3 +
          (1 + 1 / (q : ℝ)) * y
proof:
:= by
  let gm : ℝ → ℝ := fun t =>
    gaussianChernoffExponent V t +
      strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V 1 t
  have hgmConv : ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Ici 0) gm := by
    have hg := convexOn_gaussianChernoffExponent hV.le
    have hm := convexOn_strongMomentIntermediateExponent q
      (Q := 1) hV.le (by norm_num)
    refine ⟨convex_Ici 0, ?_⟩
    intro s hs t ht a b ha hb hab
    have hgs := hg.2 hs ht ha hb hab
    have hms := hm.2 hs ht ha hb hab
    simp only [gm, smul_eq_mul] at hgs hms ⊢
    calc
      gaussianChernoffExponent V (a * s + b * t) +
          strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V 1 (a * s + b * t) ≤
        (a * gaussianChernoffExponent V s +
          b * gaussianChernoffExponent V t) +
        (a * strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V 1 s +
          b * strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V 1 t) := add_le_add hgs hms
      _ = a * (gaussianChernoffExponent V s +
            strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V 1 s) +
          b * (gaussianChernoffExponent V t +
            strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V 1 t) := by ring
  have hgmZero : gm 0 = 0 := by simp [gm]
  have hgmNonneg : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → 0 ≤ gm t := by
    intro t ht
    exact add_nonneg
      (gaussianChernoffExponent_nonneg hV.le)
      (strongMomentIntermediateExponent_nonneg q hV.le (by norm_num) ht.le)
  have htailConv := convexOn_exactStrongMomentTailExponent q
    (Q := 1) (by norm_num) hy
  have htailZero : exactStrongMomentTailExponent q 1 y 0 = 0 := by
    exact exactStrongMomentTailExponent_zero (by omega) 1 y
  have htailNonneg : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t →
      0 ≤ exactStrongMomentTailExponent q 1 y t := by
    intro t ht
    exact exactStrongMomentTailExponent_nonneg q (by norm_num) hy ht.le
  have hsplit := chernoffTransform_add_le hx.le hgmConv htailConv
    hgmZero htailZero hgmNonneg htailNonneg
  have hgm := chernoffTransform_gaussian_add_intermediate_one_le
    q hq hV hx
  have htail := chernoffTransform_exactStrongMomentTailExponent_le
    q (by omega) (Q := 1) (by norm_num) hy hx (by simpa using hscale)
  have hexponent : rioStrongMomentExponent q V 1 y =
      fun t => gm t + exactStrongMomentTailExponent q 1 y t := by
    funext t
    unfold rioStrongMomentExponent
    dsimp only [gm]
  rw [hexponent]
  calc
    chernoffTransform
        (fun t => gm t + exactStrongMomentTailExponent q 1 y t) x ≤
      chernoffTransform gm x +
        chernoffTransform (exactStrongMomentTailExponent q 1 y) x := hsplit
    _ ≤ (Real.sqrt (2 * V * x) +
          V ^ (-(1 / ((q : ℝ) - 2))) * x / 3) +
        (1 + 1 / (q : ℝ)) * y :=
      add_le_add (by simpa only [gm] using hgm) htail
    _ = Real.sqrt (2 * V * x) +
        V ^ (-(1 / ((q : ℝ) - 2))) * x / 3 +
          (1 + 1 / (q : ℝ)) * y := by ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.sum_Ico_pow_div_factorial_le_exp
statement:
theorem sum_Ico_pow_div_factorial_le_exp (q : ℕ) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 3 q,
      (q : ℝ) ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) ≤ Real.exp q
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Real.exp_eq_exp_ℝ, NormedSpace.exp_eq_tsum_div] using
    (Real.summable_pow_div_factorial (q : ℝ)).sum_le_tsum
      (Finset.Ico 3 q) (fun k _hk => by positivity)

name: ProbabilityTheory.strongMomentIntermediateExponent_q_div_exp_one_le_one_of_coeff
statement:
theorem strongMomentIntermediateExponent_q_div_exp_one_le_one_of_coeff
    (q : ℕ) {V Q : ℝ}
    (hcoeff : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Ico 3 q,
      interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient q V Q k ≤
        Real.exp ((k : ℝ) - (q : ℝ))) :
    strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V Q
        ((q : ℝ) / Real.exp 1) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hsum := sum_Ico_pow_div_factorial_le_exp q
  unfold strongMomentIntermediateExponent
  calc
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 3 q,
        ((q : ℝ) / Real.exp 1) ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ) *
          interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient q V Q k) ≤
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 3 q,
        ((q : ℝ) / Real.exp 1) ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ) *
          Real.exp ((k : ℝ) - (q : ℝ)) := by
      exact sum_le_sum fun k hk => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (hcoeff k hk) (div_nonneg (pow_nonneg (by positivity) k) (by positivity))
    _ = Real.exp (-(q : ℝ)) *
        (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 3 q,
          (q : ℝ) ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k hk
      rw [div_pow, Real.exp_one_pow, Real.exp_sub]
      have hexpK : Real.exp (k : ℝ) ≠ 0 := (Real.exp_pos _).ne'
      have hexpQ : Real.exp (q : ℝ) ≠ 0 := (Real.exp_pos _).ne'
      rw [Real.exp_neg]
      field_simp [hexpK, hexpQ]
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-(q : ℝ)) * Real.exp q :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum (Real.exp_pos _).le
    _ = 1 := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp

name: ProbabilityTheory.interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient_one_le_exp_sub_of_exp_lt_scale
statement:
theorem interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient_one_le_exp_sub_of_exp_lt_scale
    {q k : ℕ} (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hkq : k ≤ q)
    {V : ℝ} (hV : 0 < V)
    (hscale : Real.exp 1 < V ^ (-(1 / ((q : ℝ) - 2)))) :
    interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient q V 1 k ≤
      Real.exp ((k : ℝ) - (q : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  let r : ℝ := V ^ (1 / ((q : ℝ) - 2))
  have hr : 0 < r := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hV _
  have hcInv : V ^ (-(1 / ((q : ℝ) - 2))) = r⁻¹ := by
    dsimp only [r]
    rw [Real.rpow_neg hV.le]
  have hrlt : r < (Real.exp 1)⁻¹ := by
    exact (lt_inv_comm₀ (Real.exp_pos 1) hr).1 (by
      simpa only [hcInv] using hscale)
  rw [interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient_one_eq_root_pow hq hkq hV]
  calc
    r ^ (q - k) ≤ ((Real.exp 1)⁻¹) ^ (q - k) :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ hr.le hrlt.le _
    _ = Real.exp ((k : ℝ) - (q : ℝ)) := by
      rw [inv_pow, Real.exp_one_pow, ← Real.exp_neg]
      congr 1
      rw [Nat.cast_sub hkq]
      ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.strongMomentIntermediateExponent_q_div_exp_one_le_one_of_exp_lt_scale
statement:
theorem strongMomentIntermediateExponent_q_div_exp_one_le_one_of_exp_lt_scale
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) {V : ℝ} (hV : 0 < V)
    (hscale : Real.exp 1 < V ^ (-(1 / ((q : ℝ) - 2)))) :
    strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V 1
        ((q : ℝ) / Real.exp 1) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  apply strongMomentIntermediateExponent_q_div_exp_one_le_one_of_coeff
  intro k hk
  exact interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient_one_le_exp_sub_of_exp_lt_scale
    hq (by have := (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hk).2; omega) hV hscale

name: ProbabilityTheory.min_exp_mul_intermediate_or_scale_le_exp_one
statement:
theorem min_exp_mul_intermediate_or_scale_le_exp_one
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) {V : ℝ} (hV : 0 < V) :
    min
        (Real.exp 1 * strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V 1
          ((q : ℝ) / Real.exp 1))
        (V ^ (-(1 / ((q : ℝ) - 2)))) ≤
      Real.exp 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hscale : V ^ (-(1 / ((q : ℝ) - 2))) ≤ Real.exp 1
  · exact (min_le_right _ _).trans hscale
  · have hlarge : Real.exp 1 < V ^ (-(1 / ((q : ℝ) - 2))) :=
      lt_of_not_ge hscale
    have hmid :=
      strongMomentIntermediateExponent_q_div_exp_one_le_one_of_exp_lt_scale
        q hq hV hlarge
    calc
      min
          (Real.exp 1 * strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V 1
            ((q : ℝ) / Real.exp 1))
          (V ^ (-(1 / ((q : ℝ) - 2)))) ≤
        Real.exp 1 * strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V 1
          ((q : ℝ) / Real.exp 1) := min_le_left _ _
      _ ≤ Real.exp 1 * 1 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmid (Real.exp_pos 1).le
      _ = Real.exp 1 := mul_one _

name: ProbabilityTheory.rio_intermediate_min_linear_correction_le
statement:
theorem rio_intermediate_min_linear_correction_le
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) {V x : ℝ}
    (hV : 0 < V) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    x / 3 *
        min
          (Real.exp 1 * strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V 1
            ((q : ℝ) / Real.exp 1))
          (V ^ (-(1 / ((q : ℝ) - 2)))) ≤
      Real.exp 1 * x / 3
proof:
:= by
  have hmin := min_exp_mul_intermediate_or_scale_le_exp_one q hq hV
  calc
    x / 3 *
        min
          (Real.exp 1 * strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V 1
            ((q : ℝ) / Real.exp 1))
          (V ^ (-(1 / ((q : ℝ) - 2)))) ≤
      x / 3 * Real.exp 1 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmin (div_nonneg hx (by norm_num))
    _ = Real.exp 1 * x / 3 := by ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasSubgaussianMGF.mono_proxy
statement:
theorem HasSubgaussianMGF.mono_proxy
    {X : Omega → ℝ} {c d : ℝ≥0}
    (hX : HasSubgaussianMGF X c mu) (hcd : c ≤ d) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF X d mu
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hX.integrable_exp_mul, ?_⟩
  intro t
  refine (hX.mgf_le t).trans ?_
  apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
  have hcdReal : (c : ℝ) ≤ (d : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hcd
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcdReal (sq_nonneg t)]

name: ProbabilityTheory.rademacherLipschitzProcess_sub
statement:
theorem rademacherLipschitzProcess_sub
    {ι T : Type*} (epsilon : ι → Omega → ℝ)
    (F : ι → T → ℝ) (I : Finset ι) (c : ℝ)
    (omega : Omega) (s t : T) :
    rademacherLipschitzProcess epsilon F I c omega s -
        rademacherLipschitzProcess epsilon F I c omega t =
      ∑ i ∈ I, (c * (F i s - F i t)) * epsilon i omega
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rademacherLipschitzProcess]
  rw [← mul_sub, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.rademacherLipschitzProcess_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rademacherLipschitzProcess_zero
    {ι T : Type*} [Zero T]
    (epsilon : ι → Omega → ℝ) (F : ι → T → ℝ)
    (I : Finset ι) (c : ℝ) (hzero : ∀ i ∈ I, F i 0 = 0)
    (omega : Omega) :
    rademacherLipschitzProcess epsilon F I c omega 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold rademacherLipschitzProcess
  apply mul_eq_zero_of_right
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro i hi
  rw [hzero i hi, mul_zero]

name: ProbabilityTheory.coe_rademacherLipschitzProxy
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_rademacherLipschitzProxy (x : ℝ) :
    (rademacherLipschitzProxy x : ℝ) = x ^ 2
proof: := rfl

name: ProbabilityTheory.hasSubgaussianMGF_rademacherLipschitzProcess_increment
statement:
theorem hasSubgaussianMGF_rademacherLipschitzProcess_increment
    {ι T : Type*} [Countable ι] [PseudoMetricSpace T]
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (epsilon : ι → Omega → ℝ) (F : ι → T → ℝ)
    (I : Finset ι) (A : ι → ℝ) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hepsilonIndep : iIndepFun epsilon mu)
    (hepsilonRad : ∀ i ∈ I, IsRademacher (epsilon i) mu)
    (hA : ∀ i ∈ I, 0 ≤ A i)
    (hLip : ∀ i ∈ I, ∀ s t, |F i s - F i t| ≤ A i * dist s t)
    (s t : T) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF
      (fun omega ↦
        rademacherLipschitzProcess epsilon F I c omega s -
          rademacherLipschitzProcess epsilon F I c omega t)
      (rademacherLipschitzProxy
        (c * Real.sqrt (∑ i ∈ I, A i ^ 2) * dist s t)) mu
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [rademacherLipschitzProcess_sub]
  have hexact := hasSubgaussianMGF_rademacher_finset_sum
    epsilon (fun i ↦ c * (F i s - F i t)) hepsilonIndep I hepsilonRad
  apply hexact.mono_proxy
  apply NNReal.coe_le_coe.mp
  simp only [NNReal.coe_sum, rademacherSqProxy,
    coe_rademacherLipschitzProxy]
  have hsumNonneg : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ I, A i ^ 2 :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ ↦ sq_nonneg _
  calc
    ∑ i ∈ I, (c * (F i s - F i t)) ^ 2 ≤
        ∑ i ∈ I, (c * (A i * dist s t)) ^ 2 := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i hi
      rw [sq_le_sq]
      have hright : 0 ≤ A i * dist s t :=
        mul_nonneg (hA i hi) dist_nonneg
      simpa only [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hc, abs_of_nonneg hright]
        using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hLip i hi s t) hc
    _ = (c * Real.sqrt (∑ i ∈ I, A i ^ 2) * dist s t) ^ 2 := by
      calc
        ∑ i ∈ I, (c * (A i * dist s t)) ^ 2 =
            c ^ 2 * dist s t ^ 2 * (∑ i ∈ I, A i ^ 2) := by
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i hi
          ring
        _ = c ^ 2 * dist s t ^ 2 *
              Real.sqrt (∑ i ∈ I, A i ^ 2) ^ 2 := by
          rw [Real.sq_sqrt hsumNonneg]
        _ = (c * Real.sqrt (∑ i ∈ I, A i ^ 2) * dist s t) ^ 2 := by
          ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.finiteVectorSupAbs_eq_sup'
statement:
theorem finiteVectorSupAbs_eq_sup' {T : Type*}
    (N : Finset T) (hN : N.Nonempty) (f : T → ℝ) :
    finiteVectorSupAbs N hN (fun t ↦ f t) =
      N.sup' hN (fun t ↦ |f t|)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Nonempty N := hN.to_subtype
  unfold finiteVectorSupAbs
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Finset.sup'_le Finset.univ_nonempty
    intro t ht
    exact Finset.le_sup' (fun u ↦ |f u|) t.property
  · apply Finset.sup'_le hN
    intro t ht
    exact Finset.le_sup' (fun u : N ↦ |f u|)
      (Finset.mem_univ (⟨t, ht⟩ : N))

name: ProbabilityTheory.measurable_finiteVectorSupAbs
proof:
:= by
  letI : Nonempty N := hN.to_subtype
  unfold finiteVectorSupAbs
  have h : Measurable
      ((Finset.univ : Finset N).sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
        (fun t ↦ fun v : N → ℝ ↦ |v t|)) := by
    apply Finset.measurable_sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
    intro t ht
    exact (measurable_pi_apply t).abs
  convert h using 1
  funext v
  exact (Finset.sup'_apply Finset.univ_nonempty
    (fun t ↦ fun w : N → ℝ ↦ |w t|) v).symm

name: ProbabilityTheory.integral_finiteVectorSupAbs_sum_eq_iterated_randomSigns
statement:
theorem integral_finiteVectorSupAbs_sum_eq_iterated_randomSigns
    {OmegaData OmegaSign T ι : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace OmegaData] [MeasurableSpace OmegaSign]
    [Countable ι]
    {muData : Measure OmegaData} {muSign : Measure OmegaSign}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure muData] [IsProbabilityMeasure muSign]
    (D : ι → OmegaData → T → ℝ)
    (N : Finset T) (hN : N.Nonempty)
    (I : Finset ι)
    (hDindep : iIndepFun (fun i x (t : N) ↦ D i x t) muData)
    (hDsymm : ∀ i, HasSymmetricFiniteLaw (D i) N muData)
    (epsilon : OmegaSign → ι → ℝ)
    (hepsilon : ∀ eta i, epsilon eta i = 1 ∨ epsilon eta i = -1)
    (hJointInt : Integrable (fun p : OmegaData × OmegaSign ↦
      finiteVectorSupAbs N hN (fun t ↦
        ∑ i ∈ I, epsilon p.2 i * D i p.1 t))
      (muData.prod muSign)) :
    (∫ x, finiteVectorSupAbs N hN (fun t ↦
        ∑ i ∈ I, D i x t) ∂muData) =
      ∫ x, ∫ eta, finiteVectorSupAbs N hN (fun t ↦
        ∑ i ∈ I, epsilon eta i * D i x t) ∂muSign ∂muData
proof:
:= by
  let Phi : (N → ℝ) → ℝ := finiteVectorSupAbs N hN
  let J : OmegaData × OmegaSign → ℝ := fun p ↦
    Phi (fun t ↦ ∑ i ∈ I, epsilon p.2 i * D i p.1 t)
  let L : ℝ := ∫ x, Phi (fun t ↦ ∑ i ∈ I, D i x t) ∂muData
  have hPhi : Measurable Phi := measurable_finiteVectorSupAbs N hN
  have hfixed : ∀ eta,
      L = ∫ x, J (x, eta) ∂muData := by
    intro eta
    have hid := identDistrib_finiteProcessSum_randomSigns_conditionally
      D N hDindep hDsymm epsilon hepsilon I eta
    have hcomp := hid.comp hPhi
    simpa only [L, J, Phi, Function.comp_apply] using hcomp.integral_eq
  calc
    (∫ x, finiteVectorSupAbs N hN (fun t ↦
        ∑ i ∈ I, D i x t) ∂muData) = L := rfl
    _ = ∫ eta, L ∂muSign := by
      rw [integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul]
    _ = ∫ eta, ∫ x, J (x, eta) ∂muData ∂muSign := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact ae_of_all muSign fun eta ↦ hfixed eta
    _ = ∫ p, J p ∂(muData.prod muSign) :=
      (integral_prod_symm J hJointInt).symm
    _ = ∫ x, ∫ eta, J (x, eta) ∂muSign ∂muData :=
      integral_prod J hJointInt
    _ = ∫ x, ∫ eta, finiteVectorSupAbs N hN (fun t ↦
        ∑ i ∈ I, epsilon eta i * D i x t) ∂muSign ∂muData := rfl

name: ProbabilityTheory.integral_finiteVectorSupAbs_centeredSum_le_ghostDifference
statement:
theorem integral_finiteVectorSupAbs_centeredSum_le_ghostDifference
    {OmegaData T ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace OmegaData]
    [Countable ι]
    {muData : Measure OmegaData} [IsProbabilityMeasure muData]
    (X : ι → OmegaData → T → ℝ)
    (N : Finset T) (hN : N.Nonempty) (I : Finset ι)
    (hXint : ∀ i ∈ I, ∀ t : N, Integrable (fun x ↦ X i x t) muData)
    (hCenteredInt : Integrable (fun x ↦
      finiteVectorSupAbs N hN (fun t ↦
        ∑ i ∈ I, (X i x t - ∫ y, X i y t ∂muData))) muData)
    (hGhostInt : Integrable (fun p : OmegaData × OmegaData ↦
      finiteVectorSupAbs N hN (fun t ↦
        ∑ i ∈ I, (X i p.1 t - X i p.2 t)))
      (muData.prod muData)) :
    (∫ x, finiteVectorSupAbs N hN (fun t ↦
        ∑ i ∈ I, (X i x t - ∫ y, X i y t ∂muData)) ∂muData) ≤
      ∫ p, finiteVectorSupAbs N hN (fun t ↦
        ∑ i ∈ I, (X i p.1 t - X i p.2 t)) ∂(muData.prod muData)
proof:
:= by
  let C : OmegaData → N → ℝ := fun x t ↦
    ∑ i ∈ I, (X i x t - ∫ y, X i y t ∂muData)
  let D : OmegaData × OmegaData → N → ℝ := fun p t ↦
    ∑ i ∈ I, (X i p.1 t - X i p.2 t)
  let Phi : (N → ℝ) → ℝ := finiteVectorSupAbs N hN
  have hfiber := hGhostInt.prod_right_ae
  have hpoint : ∀ᵐ x ∂muData,
      Phi (C x) ≤ ∫ y, Phi (D (x, y)) ∂muData := by
    filter_upwards [hfiber] with x hfiberx
    letI : Nonempty N := hN.to_subtype
    unfold Phi finiteVectorSupAbs
    apply Finset.sup'_le Finset.univ_nonempty
    intro t ht
    have hDiffInt : Integrable (fun y ↦ D (x, y) t) muData := by
      apply integrable_finsetSum I
      intro i hi
      exact (integrable_const (X i x t)).sub (hXint i hi t)
    have hcenterEq : C x t = ∫ y, D (x, y) t ∂muData := by
      dsimp only [C, D]
      rw [integral_finsetSum]
      · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        rw [integral_sub (integrable_const _) (hXint i hi t),
          integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul]
      · intro i hi
        exact (integrable_const (X i x t)).sub (hXint i hi t)
    have habsInt : Integrable (fun y ↦ |D (x, y) t|) muData := hDiffInt.abs
    have hcoordLe : ∀ y, |D (x, y) t| ≤
        Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun u ↦ |D (x, y) u|) := by
      intro y
      exact Finset.le_sup' (fun u ↦ |D (x, y) u|) (Finset.mem_univ t)
    calc
      |C x t| = |∫ y, D (x, y) t ∂muData| := by rw [hcenterEq]
      _ ≤ ∫ y, |D (x, y) t| ∂muData := by
        simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
          (norm_integral_le_integral_norm (fun y ↦ D (x, y) t))
      _ ≤ ∫ y, Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
            (fun u ↦ |D (x, y) u|) ∂muData :=
        integral_mono habsInt hfiberx hcoordLe
  have hInnerInt : Integrable
      (fun x ↦ ∫ y, Phi (D (x, y)) ∂muData) muData :=
    hGhostInt.integral_prod_left
  have hmono : (∫ x, Phi (C x) ∂muData) ≤
      ∫ x, ∫ y, Phi (D (x, y)) ∂muData ∂muData :=
    integral_mono_ae hCenteredInt hInnerInt hpoint
  calc
    (∫ x, finiteVectorSupAbs N hN (fun t ↦
        ∑ i ∈ I, (X i x t - ∫ y, X i y t ∂muData)) ∂muData) =
        ∫ x, Phi (C x) ∂muData := rfl
    _ ≤ ∫ x, ∫ y, Phi (D (x, y)) ∂muData ∂muData := hmono
    _ = ∫ p, Phi (D p) ∂(muData.prod muData) :=
      integral_integral hGhostInt
    _ = ∫ p, finiteVectorSupAbs N hN (fun t ↦
        ∑ i ∈ I, (X i p.1 t - X i p.2 t)) ∂(muData.prod muData) := rfl

name: ProbabilityTheory.integral_finiteVectorSupAbs_centeredSum_le_iterated_randomSigns_of_ghost
statement:
theorem integral_finiteVectorSupAbs_centeredSum_le_iterated_randomSigns_of_ghost
    {OmegaData OmegaSign T ι : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace OmegaData] [MeasurableSpace OmegaSign]
    [Countable ι]
    {muData : Measure OmegaData} {muSign : Measure OmegaSign}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure muData] [IsProbabilityMeasure muSign]
    (X : ι → OmegaData → T → ℝ)
    (N : Finset T) (hN : N.Nonempty) (I : Finset ι)
    (hXmeas : ∀ i, ∀ t ∈ N, Measurable (fun x ↦ X i x t))

      finiteVectorSupAbs N hN (fun t ↦
        ∑ i ∈ I, (X i x t - ∫ y, X i y t ∂muData))) muData)

      finiteVectorSupAbs N hN (fun t ↦
        ∑ i ∈ I, (X i p.1 t - X i p.2 t)))

      X i p.1 t - X i p.2 t) (muData.prod muData))

      (fun z : (OmegaData × OmegaData) × OmegaSign ↦
        finiteVectorSupAbs N hN (fun t ↦
          ∑ i ∈ I, epsilon z.2 i *
            (X i z.1.1 t - X i z.1.2 t)))

proof:

  have hsymm : ∀ i, HasSymmetricFiniteLaw (D i) N (muData.prod muData) := by
    intro i
    exact hasSymmetricFiniteLaw_ghostDifference (X i) N (hXmeas i)
  have hghost := integral_finiteVectorSupAbs_centeredSum_le_ghostDifference
    X N hN I hXint hCenteredInt hGhostInt
  have hsignEq := integral_finiteVectorSupAbs_sum_eq_iterated_randomSigns
    D N hN I hDindep hsymm epsilon hepsilon hSignedJointInt
  exact hghost.trans_eq hsignEq
