name: RandomSetTheory.integral_iSup_abs_le_of_densePrefixBounds
statement:
theorem integral_iSup_abs_le_of_densePrefixBounds
    {T : Type*} [TopologicalSpace T] [SeparableSpace T] [Nonempty T]
    (F : Omega → T → ℝ) (B : Omega → ℝ)
    (hcontinuous : ∀ omega, Continuous (F omega))
    (hmeas : ∀ k, Measurable (fun omega ↦ F omega (denseSeq T k)))
    (hB : Integrable B mu)
    (hdom : ∀ omega t, |F omega t| ≤ |B omega|)
    {C : ℝ}
    (hprefix : ∀ n, (∫ omega,
      densePrefixAbsSupremum (F omega) n ∂mu) ≤ C) :
    (∫ omega, (⨆ t : T, |F omega t|) ∂mu) ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  let G : Omega → T → ℝ := fun omega t ↦ |F omega t|
  let P : ℕ → Omega → ℝ := fun n omega ↦
    densePrefixSupremum (G omega) n
  let S : Omega → ℝ := fun omega ↦ ⨆ t, G omega t
  have hGcontinuous : ∀ omega, Continuous (G omega) := fun omega ↦
    (hcontinuous omega).abs
  have hGmeas : ∀ k, Measurable (fun omega ↦ G omega (denseSeq T k)) :=
    fun k ↦ (hmeas k).abs
  have hGdom : ∀ omega t, |G omega t| ≤ |B omega| := by
    intro omega t
    simpa only [G, abs_abs] using hdom omega t
  have hPmeas : ∀ n, Measurable (P n) := fun n ↦
    measurable_densePrefixSupremum G hGmeas n
  have hSmeas : Measurable S :=
    measurable_iSup_continuous_of_measurable_dense G hGcontinuous hGmeas
  have hPdom : ∀ n omega, |P n omega| ≤ |B omega| := by
    intro n omega
    have heq : P n omega = finiteProcessSupremum
        (Finset.range (n + 1)) Finset.nonempty_range_add_one
          (fun k omega ↦ G omega (denseSeq T k)) omega := by
      dsimp only [P, finiteProcessSupremum]
      exact densePrefixSupremum_eq_sup'_range _ n
    rw [heq]
    apply abs_finiteProcessSupremum_le
      (Finset.range (n + 1)) Finset.nonempty_range_add_one
      (fun k omega ↦ G omega (denseSeq T k)) B
    intro omega' k hk
    exact hGdom omega' (denseSeq T k)
  have hSdom : ∀ omega, |S omega| ≤ |B omega| := by
    intro omega
    have hbdd : BddAbove (Set.range (G omega)) := by
      refine ⟨|B omega|, ?_⟩
      rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩
      exact (le_abs_self (G omega t)).trans (hGdom omega t)
    have hupper : S omega ≤ |B omega| :=
      ciSup_le fun t ↦ (le_abs_self (G omega t)).trans (hGdom omega t)
    let t0 : T := Classical.choice inferInstance
    have hlowerValue : -|B omega| ≤ G omega t0 :=
      (neg_le_neg (hGdom omega t0)).trans (neg_abs_le (G omega t0))
    have hlower : -|B omega| ≤ S omega :=
      hlowerValue.trans (le_ciSup hbdd t0)
    exact (abs_le).2 ⟨hlower, hupper⟩
  have hPint : ∀ n, Integrable (P n) mu := by
    intro n
    apply hB.abs.mono' (hPmeas n).aestronglyMeasurable
    exact ae_of_all mu fun omega ↦ by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_abs] using hPdom n omega
  have hSint : Integrable S mu := by
    apply hB.abs.mono' hSmeas.aestronglyMeasurable
    exact ae_of_all mu fun omega ↦ by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_abs] using hSdom omega
  have hL1 := tendsto_integral_abs_densePrefixSupremum_sub_iSup
    G B hGcontinuous hGmeas hB hGdom
  have hdistLe : ∀ n,
      dist (∫ omega, P n omega ∂mu) (∫ omega, S omega ∂mu) ≤
        ∫ omega, |P n omega - S omega| ∂mu := by
    intro n
    rw [Real.dist_eq, ← integral_sub (hPint n) hSint]
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      (norm_integral_le_integral_norm (fun omega ↦ P n omega - S omega))
  have hdistTendsto : Tendsto
      (fun n ↦ dist (∫ omega, P n omega ∂mu)
        (∫ omega, S omega ∂mu)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    apply squeeze_zero (fun n ↦ dist_nonneg) hdistLe
    simpa only [P, S] using hL1
  have hIntTendsto : Tendsto (fun n ↦ ∫ omega, P n omega ∂mu)
      atTop (nhds (∫ omega, S omega ∂mu)) := by
    apply tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero.2
    exact hdistTendsto
  change (∫ omega, S omega ∂mu) ≤ C
  apply le_of_tendsto hIntTendsto
  filter_upwards [] with n
  simpa only [P, G, densePrefixAbsSupremum] using hprefix n

name: RandomSetTheory.integral_densePrefixAbs_centeredEmpirical_le_rademacherGhost
statement:
theorem integral_densePrefixAbs_centeredEmpirical_le_rademacherGhost
    {OmegaData OmegaSign : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace OmegaData] [MeasurableSpace OmegaSign]
    {muData : Measure OmegaData} {muSign : Measure OmegaSign}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure muData] [IsProbabilityMeasure muSign]
    (n : ℕ) (k : ℕ)
    (epsilon : OmegaSign → Fin n → ℝ)
    (X : Fin n → OmegaData → EuclideanUnitBall E → ℝ)
    (hXmeas : ∀ i t, Measurable (fun x ↦ X i x t))
    (hXint : ∀ i t, Integrable (fun x ↦ X i x t) muData)
    (hXindep : iIndepFun (fun i x
      (j : Finset.range (k + 1)) ↦
        X i x (denseSeq (EuclideanUnitBall E) j)) muData)
    (hepsilon : ∀ eta i, epsilon eta i = 1 ∨ epsilon eta i = -1)
    (hCenteredInt : Integrable (fun x ↦
      densePrefixAbsSupremum
        (centeredEmpiricalLipschitzProcess muData n X x) k) muData)
    (hGhostInt : Integrable
      (fun p : OmegaData × OmegaData ↦
        finiteVectorSupAbs (Finset.range (k + 1))
          Finset.nonempty_range_add_one (fun j ↦
            ∑ i : Fin n, ((n : ℝ)⁻¹ *
              X i p.1 (denseSeq (EuclideanUnitBall E) j) -
              (n : ℝ)⁻¹ *
              X i p.2 (denseSeq (EuclideanUnitBall E) j))))
      (muData.prod muData))
    (hSignedJointInt : Integrable
      (fun z : (OmegaData × OmegaData) × OmegaSign ↦
        finiteVectorSupAbs (Finset.range (k + 1))
          Finset.nonempty_range_add_one (fun j ↦
            ∑ i : Fin n, epsilon z.2 i *
              ((n : ℝ)⁻¹ *
                X i z.1.1 (denseSeq (EuclideanUnitBall E) j) -
               (n : ℝ)⁻¹ *
                X i z.1.2 (denseSeq (EuclideanUnitBall E) j))))
      ((muData.prod muData).prod muSign))
    (hFullSignedJointInt : Integrable
      (fun z : (OmegaData × OmegaData) × OmegaSign ↦
        ⨆ t : EuclideanUnitBall E,
          |rademacherGhostEmpiricalProcess n epsilon X z.1 z.2 t|)
      ((muData.prod muData).prod muSign))
    (hRbdd : ∀ p eta, BddAbove (Set.range fun t : EuclideanUnitBall E ↦
      |rademacherGhostEmpiricalProcess n epsilon X p eta t|)) :
    (∫ x, densePrefixAbsSupremum
        (centeredEmpiricalLipschitzProcess muData n X x) k ∂muData) ≤
      ∫ p, ∫ eta, (⨆ t : EuclideanUnitBall E,
        |rademacherGhostEmpiricalProcess n epsilon X p eta t|)
        ∂muSign ∂(muData.prod muData)
proof:
:= by
  let N : Finset ℕ := Finset.range (k + 1)
  have hN : N.Nonempty := Finset.nonempty_range_add_one
  let Xn : Fin n → OmegaData → ℕ → ℝ := fun i x j ↦
    (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * X i x (denseSeq (EuclideanUnitBall E) j)
  have hXnMeas : ∀ i, Measurable (fun x (j : N) ↦ Xn i x j) := by
    intro i
    apply measurable_pi_lambda
    intro j
    exact measurable_const.mul (hXmeas i _)
  have hXnIndep : iIndepFun (fun i x (j : N) ↦ Xn i x j) muData := by
    have hcomp := hXindep.comp
      (fun _ (v : N → ℝ) j ↦ (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * v j)
      (fun _ ↦ by fun_prop)
    simpa only [N, Xn, Function.comp_def] using hcomp
  have hXnInt : ∀ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)), ∀ j : N,
      Integrable (fun x ↦ Xn i x j) muData := by
    intro i hi j
    exact (hXint i _).const_mul _
  have hGhostInt' : Integrable
      (fun p : OmegaData × OmegaData ↦
        finiteVectorSupAbs N hN (fun j ↦
          ∑ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)),
            (Xn i p.1 j - Xn i p.2 j))) (muData.prod muData) := by
    convert hGhostInt using 1
  have hSignedJointInt' : Integrable
      (fun z : (OmegaData × OmegaData) × OmegaSign ↦
        finiteVectorSupAbs N hN (fun j ↦
          ∑ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)), epsilon z.2 i *
            (Xn i z.1.1 j - Xn i z.1.2 j)))
      ((muData.prod muData).prod muSign) := by
    convert hSignedJointInt using 1
  have hcenterEq : ∀ x,
      finiteVectorSupAbs N hN (fun j ↦
        ∑ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)),
          (Xn i x j - ∫ y, Xn i y j ∂muData)) =
        densePrefixAbsSupremum
          (centeredEmpiricalLipschitzProcess muData n X x) k := by
    intro x
    let fcenter : ℕ → ℝ := fun j ↦
      ∑ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)),
        (Xn i x j - ∫ y, Xn i y j ∂muData)
    calc
      finiteVectorSupAbs N hN (fun j ↦
          ∑ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)),
            (Xn i x j - ∫ y, Xn i y j ∂muData)) =
          N.sup' hN (fun j ↦ |fcenter j|) :=
        finiteVectorSupAbs_eq_sup' N hN fcenter
      _ = densePrefixAbsSupremum
          (centeredEmpiricalLipschitzProcess muData n X x) k := by
        rw [densePrefixAbsSupremum, densePrefixSupremum_eq_sup'_range]
        apply Finset.sup'_congr hN rfl
        intro j hj
        congr 1
  have hCenteredInt' : Integrable (fun x ↦
      finiteVectorSupAbs N hN (fun j ↦
        ∑ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)),
          (Xn i x j - ∫ y, Xn i y j ∂muData))) muData := by
    convert hCenteredInt using 1
    funext x
    exact hcenterEq x
  have hsymm :=
    integral_finiteVectorSupAbs_centeredSum_le_iterated_randomSigns
      Xn N hN Finset.univ hXnMeas hXnIndep hXnInt hCenteredInt'
        hGhostInt' epsilon hepsilon hSignedJointInt'
  have hsignedLe : ∀ z : (OmegaData × OmegaData) × OmegaSign,
      finiteVectorSupAbs N hN (fun j ↦
        ∑ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)), epsilon z.2 i *
          (Xn i z.1.1 j - Xn i z.1.2 j)) ≤
        ⨆ t : EuclideanUnitBall E,
          |rademacherGhostEmpiricalProcess n epsilon X z.1 z.2 t| := by
    intro z
    let fsigned : ℕ → ℝ := fun j ↦
      ∑ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)), epsilon z.2 i *
        (Xn i z.1.1 j - Xn i z.1.2 j)
    calc
      finiteVectorSupAbs N hN (fun j ↦
          ∑ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)), epsilon z.2 i *
            (Xn i z.1.1 j - Xn i z.1.2 j)) =
          N.sup' hN (fun j ↦ |fsigned j|) :=
        finiteVectorSupAbs_eq_sup' N hN fsigned
      _ ≤ ⨆ t : EuclideanUnitBall E,
          |rademacherGhostEmpiricalProcess n epsilon X z.1 z.2 t| := by
        apply Finset.sup'_le hN
        intro j hj
        have hvalue : fsigned j =
            rademacherGhostEmpiricalProcess n epsilon X z.1 z.2
              (denseSeq (EuclideanUnitBall E) j) := by
          simp only [fsigned, rademacherGhostEmpiricalProcess,
            rademacherLipschitzProcess, Xn]
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i hi
          ring
        rw [hvalue]
        exact le_ciSup (hRbdd z.1 z.2) (denseSeq (EuclideanUnitBall E) j)
  have hjointMono :
      (∫ z, finiteVectorSupAbs N hN (fun j ↦
        ∑ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)), epsilon z.2 i *
          (Xn i z.1.1 j - Xn i z.1.2 j))
        ∂((muData.prod muData).prod muSign)) ≤
      ∫ z, (⨆ t : EuclideanUnitBall E,
        |rademacherGhostEmpiricalProcess n epsilon X z.1 z.2 t|)
        ∂((muData.prod muData).prod muSign) := by
    exact integral_mono hSignedJointInt' hFullSignedJointInt hsignedLe
  calc
    (∫ x, densePrefixAbsSupremum
        (centeredEmpiricalLipschitzProcess muData n X x) k ∂muData) =
        ∫ x, finiteVectorSupAbs N hN (fun j ↦
          ∑ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)),
            (Xn i x j - ∫ y, Xn i y j ∂muData)) ∂muData := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact ae_of_all muData fun x ↦ (hcenterEq x).symm
    _ ≤ ∫ p, ∫ eta, finiteVectorSupAbs N hN (fun j ↦
          ∑ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)), epsilon eta i *
            (Xn i p.1 j - Xn i p.2 j)) ∂muSign
          ∂(muData.prod muData) := hsymm
    _ = ∫ z, finiteVectorSupAbs N hN (fun j ↦
          ∑ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)), epsilon z.2 i *
            (Xn i z.1.1 j - Xn i z.1.2 j))
          ∂((muData.prod muData).prod muSign) :=
      integral_integral hSignedJointInt'
    _ ≤ ∫ z, (⨆ t : EuclideanUnitBall E,
          |rademacherGhostEmpiricalProcess n epsilon X z.1 z.2 t|)
          ∂((muData.prod muData).prod muSign) := hjointMono
    _ = ∫ p, ∫ eta, (⨆ t : EuclideanUnitBall E,
          |rademacherGhostEmpiricalProcess n epsilon X p eta t|)
          ∂muSign ∂(muData.prod muData) :=
      integral_prod _ hFullSignedJointInt

name: RandomSetTheory.integral_iSup_abs_rademacherLipschitzProcess_le
statement:
theorem integral_iSup_abs_rademacherLipschitzProcess_le
    [Countable ι] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (epsilon : ι → Omega → ℝ)
    (F : ι → EuclideanUnitBall E → ℝ)
    (I : Finset ι) (A : ι → ℝ) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c)
    (hepsilonMeas : ∀ i ∈ I, Measurable (epsilon i))
    (hepsilonIndep : iIndepFun epsilon mu)
    (hepsilonRad : ∀ i ∈ I, IsRademacher (epsilon i) mu)
    (hA : ∀ i ∈ I, 0 ≤ A i)
    (hcontinuous : ∀ i ∈ I, Continuous (F i))
    (hzero : ∀ i ∈ I, F i ⟨0, by simp⟩ = 0)
    (hLip : ∀ i ∈ I, ∀ s t,
      |F i s - F i t| ≤ A i * dist s t) :
    (∫ omega, (⨆ t : EuclideanUnitBall E,
      |rademacherLipschitzProcess epsilon F I c omega t|) ∂mu) ≤
      84 * (c * Real.sqrt (∑ i ∈ I, A i ^ 2)) *
        Real.sqrt (finrank ℝ E + 1 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let z0 : EuclideanUnitBall E := ⟨0, by simp⟩
  have hsumNonneg : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ I, A i ^ 2 :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ ↦ sq_nonneg _
  have hpathBound : ∀ i ∈ I, ∀ t, |F i t| ≤ A i := by
    intro i hi t
    have hbase := hLip i hi t z0
    have hz : F i z0 = 0 := by simpa only [z0] using hzero i hi
    have hdist : dist t z0 ≤ 1 := by
      change dist (t : E) 0 ≤ 1
      simpa only [dist_zero_right] using t.property
    have hscaled := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdist (hA i hi)
    simpa only [hz, sub_zero, mul_one] using hbase.trans hscaled
  by_cases hsumZero : ∑ i ∈ I, A i ^ 2 = 0
  · have hAzero : ∀ i ∈ I, A i = 0 := by
      intro i hi
      have hiSq : A i ^ 2 = 0 :=
        (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg
          (fun j _ ↦ sq_nonneg (A j))).1 hsumZero i hi
      exact sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hiSq
    have hFzero : ∀ i ∈ I, ∀ t, F i t = 0 := by
      intro i hi t
      have hbound := hpathBound i hi t
      rw [hAzero i hi] at hbound
      exact abs_eq_zero.mp (le_antisymm hbound (abs_nonneg _))
    have hprocessZero : ∀ omega t,
        rademacherLipschitzProcess epsilon F I c omega t = 0 := by
      intro omega t
      simp only [rademacherLipschitzProcess]
      apply mul_eq_zero_of_right
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro i hi
      rw [hFzero i hi t, mul_zero]
    simp only [hprocessZero, abs_zero, ciSup_const, integral_zero,
      hsumZero, Real.sqrt_zero, mul_zero, zero_mul]
    norm_num
  · have hsumPos : 0 < ∑ i ∈ I, A i ^ 2 :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne hsumNonneg (Ne.symm hsumZero)
    let sigma : ℝ := c * Real.sqrt (∑ i ∈ I, A i ^ 2)
    have hsigma : 0 < sigma := by
      exact mul_pos hc (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hsumPos)
    let B : Omega → ℝ := fun omega ↦
      c * ∑ i ∈ I, A i * |epsilon i omega|
    have hBnonneg : ∀ omega, 0 ≤ B omega := by
      intro omega
      exact mul_nonneg hc.le (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i hi ↦
        mul_nonneg (hA i hi) (abs_nonneg _))
    have hBint : Integrable B mu := by
      apply Integrable.const_mul
      apply integrable_finsetSum I
      intro i hi
      exact (hepsilonRad i hi).hasSubgaussianMGF.integrable.abs.const_mul (A i)
    have hcontinuousProcess : ∀ omega,
        Continuous (rademacherLipschitzProcess epsilon F I c omega) := by
      intro omega
      unfold rademacherLipschitzProcess
      apply continuous_const.mul
      apply continuous_finsetSum I
      intro i hi
      exact continuous_const.mul (hcontinuous i hi)
    have hmeasProcess : ∀ t, Measurable (fun omega ↦
        rademacherLipschitzProcess epsilon F I c omega t) := by
      intro t
      unfold rademacherLipschitzProcess
      apply measurable_const.mul
      apply Finset.measurable_fun_sum
      intro i hi
      exact (hepsilonMeas i hi).mul measurable_const
    have hdom : ∀ omega t,
        |rademacherLipschitzProcess epsilon F I c omega t| ≤ |B omega| := by
      intro omega t
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (hBnonneg omega)]
      change |c * ∑ i ∈ I, epsilon i omega * F i t| ≤
        c * ∑ i ∈ I, A i * |epsilon i omega|
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hc]
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hc.le
      calc
        |∑ i ∈ I, epsilon i omega * F i t| ≤
            ∑ i ∈ I, |epsilon i omega * F i t| :=
          Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
        _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ I, A i * |epsilon i omega| := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro i hi
          rw [abs_mul, mul_comm (A i)]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hpathBound i hi t) (abs_nonneg _)
    have hzeroProcess : ∀ omega,
        rademacherLipschitzProcess epsilon F I c omega z0 = 0 := by
      intro omega
      unfold rademacherLipschitzProcess
      apply mul_eq_zero_of_right
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro i hi
      have hz : F i z0 = 0 := by simpa only [z0] using hzero i hi
      rw [hz, mul_zero]
    have htail : ∀ (s t : EuclideanUnitBall E) (y : ℝ), 0 ≤ y →
        mu.real {omega |
          sigma * dist s t * Real.sqrt (2 * y) <
            |rademacherLipschitzProcess epsilon F I c omega s -
              rademacherLipschitzProcess epsilon F I c omega t|} ≤
          2 * Real.exp (-y) := by
      intro s t y hy
      by_cases hst : s = t
      · subst t
        simp
        positivity
      · have hdist : 0 < dist s t := dist_pos.mpr hst
        have hmgf :=
          hasSubgaussianMGF_rademacherLipschitzProcess_increment
            epsilon F I A hc.le hepsilonIndep hepsilonRad hA hLip s t
        have hthreshold : 0 ≤
            sigma * dist s t * Real.sqrt (2 * y) := by positivity
        have hbase := hmgf.measureReal_abs_gt_le hthreshold
        have hsigmaDist : sigma * dist s t ≠ 0 :=
          mul_ne_zero hsigma.ne' hdist.ne'
        have hsqrtSq : Real.sqrt (2 * y) ^ 2 = 2 * y := by
          rw [Real.sq_sqrt]
          positivity
        have hexponent :
            -(sigma * dist s t * Real.sqrt (2 * y)) ^ 2 /
                (2 * (sigma * dist s t) ^ 2) = -y := by
          rw [mul_pow, hsqrtSq]
          field_simp [hsigmaDist]
        have hbase' : mu.real {omega |
            sigma * dist s t * Real.sqrt (2 * y) <
              |rademacherLipschitzProcess epsilon F I c omega s -
                rademacherLipschitzProcess epsilon F I c omega t|} ≤
              2 * Real.exp
                (-(sigma * dist s t * Real.sqrt (2 * y)) ^ 2 /
                  (2 * (sigma * dist s t) ^ 2)) := by
          simpa only [sigma, coe_rademacherLipschitzProxy] using hbase
        rw [hexponent] at hbase'
        exact hbase'
    simpa only [sigma] using
      (integral_iSup_abs_unitBall_subgaussianProcess_le
        (rademacherLipschitzProcess epsilon F I c) B hsigma
        hcontinuousProcess hmeasProcess hBint hdom hzeroProcess htail)

name: RandomSetTheory.integral_integral_iSup_abs_rademacherEmpiricalProcess_le
statement:
theorem integral_integral_iSup_abs_rademacherEmpiricalProcess_le
    {OmegaData : Type*} [MeasurableSpace OmegaData]
    {muData : Measure OmegaData} [IsProbabilityMeasure muData]
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (epsilon : Fin n → Omega → ℝ)
    (F : Fin n → OmegaData → EuclideanUnitBall E → ℝ)
    (A : Fin n → OmegaData → ℝ) (K₂ : ℝ) (hK₂ : 0 ≤ K₂)
    (hepsilonMeas : ∀ i, Measurable (epsilon i))
    (hepsilonIndep : iIndepFun epsilon mu)
    (hepsilonRad : ∀ i, IsRademacher (epsilon i) mu)
    (hAnonneg : ∀ i x, 0 ≤ A i x)
    (hcontinuous : ∀ i x, Continuous (F i x))
    (hzero : ∀ i x, F i x ⟨0, by simp⟩ = 0)
    (hLip : ∀ i x s t,
      |F i x s - F i x t| ≤ A i x * dist s t)
    (hA₂ : ∀ i, MemLp (A i) 2 muData)
    (hsecond : ∀ i, ∫ x, (A i x) ^ 2 ∂muData ≤ K₂ ^ 2)
    (hIterInt : Integrable (fun x ↦
      ∫ omega, (⨆ t : EuclideanUnitBall E,
        |rademacherLipschitzProcess epsilon (fun i ↦ F i x)
          Finset.univ ((n : ℝ)⁻¹) omega t|) ∂mu) muData) :
    (∫ x, ∫ omega, (⨆ t : EuclideanUnitBall E,
      |rademacherLipschitzProcess epsilon (fun i ↦ F i x)
        Finset.univ ((n : ℝ)⁻¹) omega t|) ∂mu ∂muData) ≤
      84 * (K₂ / Real.sqrt n) *
        Real.sqrt (finrank ℝ E + 1 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hnReal : (0 : ℝ) < n := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hn
  have hc : 0 < (n : ℝ)⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hnReal
  let G : OmegaData → ℝ := fun x ↦
    Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin n, (A i x) ^ 2) / (n : ℝ)
  have hGint : Integrable G muData := by
    let V : OmegaData → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) :=
      fun x ↦ WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i ↦ A i x)
    have hV : MemLp V 2 muData := by
      apply MemLp.of_eval_piLp
      intro i
      simpa only [V, Function.comp_apply, PiLp.toLp_apply] using hA₂ i
    have hnorm : Integrable (fun x ↦ ‖V x‖) muData :=
      hV.norm.integrable (by norm_num)
    have heq : G = fun x ↦ ‖V x‖ / (n : ℝ) := by
      funext x
      simp only [G, V, EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
    rw [heq]
    exact hnorm.div_const (n : ℝ)
  have hconditional : ∀ x,
      (∫ omega, (⨆ t : EuclideanUnitBall E,
        |rademacherLipschitzProcess epsilon (fun i ↦ F i x)
          Finset.univ ((n : ℝ)⁻¹) omega t|) ∂mu) ≤
        84 * G x * Real.sqrt (finrank ℝ E + 1 : ℝ) := by
    intro x
    have hbase := integral_iSup_abs_rademacherLipschitzProcess_le
      epsilon (fun i ↦ F i x) Finset.univ (fun i ↦ A i x) hc
      (fun i _ ↦ hepsilonMeas i) hepsilonIndep
      (fun i _ ↦ hepsilonRad i) (fun i _ ↦ hAnonneg i x)
      (fun i _ ↦ hcontinuous i x) (fun i _ ↦ hzero i x)
      (fun i _ s t ↦ hLip i x s t)
    have hscale : (n : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        Real.sqrt (∑ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)), (A i x) ^ 2) =
          G x := by
      dsimp only [G]
      rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
      ring
    rw [hscale] at hbase
    exact hbase
  have hmajorInt : Integrable
      (fun x ↦ 84 * G x * Real.sqrt (finrank ℝ E + 1 : ℝ)) muData :=
    (hGint.const_mul 84).mul_const _
  have hmono :
      (∫ x, ∫ omega, (⨆ t : EuclideanUnitBall E,
        |rademacherLipschitzProcess epsilon (fun i ↦ F i x)
          Finset.univ ((n : ℝ)⁻¹) omega t|) ∂mu ∂muData) ≤
        ∫ x, 84 * G x * Real.sqrt (finrank ℝ E + 1 : ℝ) ∂muData :=
    integral_mono hIterInt hmajorInt hconditional
  have hGbound : (∫ x, G x ∂muData) ≤ K₂ / Real.sqrt n := by
    simpa only [G] using
      (integral_normalized_sqrt_fin_sum_sq_le hn A K₂ hK₂ hA₂ hsecond)
  calc
    (∫ x, ∫ omega, (⨆ t : EuclideanUnitBall E,
        |rademacherLipschitzProcess epsilon (fun i ↦ F i x)
          Finset.univ ((n : ℝ)⁻¹) omega t|) ∂mu ∂muData) ≤
        ∫ x, 84 * G x * Real.sqrt (finrank ℝ E + 1 : ℝ) ∂muData := hmono
    _ = 84 * (∫ x, G x ∂muData) *
          Real.sqrt (finrank ℝ E + 1 : ℝ) := by
      rw [integral_mul_const, integral_const_mul]
    _ ≤ 84 * (K₂ / Real.sqrt n) *
          Real.sqrt (finrank ℝ E + 1 : ℝ) := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hGbound (by norm_num)) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)

name: RandomSetTheory.integral_integral_iSup_abs_rademacherGhostEmpiricalProcess_le
statement:
theorem integral_integral_iSup_abs_rademacherGhostEmpiricalProcess_le
    {OmegaData OmegaSign : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace OmegaData] [MeasurableSpace OmegaSign]
    {muData : Measure OmegaData} {muSign : Measure OmegaSign}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure muData] [IsProbabilityMeasure muSign]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (epsilon : OmegaSign → Fin n → ℝ)
    (X : Fin n → OmegaData → EuclideanUnitBall E → ℝ)
    (A : Fin n → OmegaData → ℝ) (K₂ : ℝ) (hK₂ : 0 ≤ K₂)
    (hepsilonMeas : ∀ i, Measurable (fun eta ↦ epsilon eta i))
    (hepsilonIndep : iIndepFun (fun i eta ↦ epsilon eta i) muSign)
    (hepsilonRad : ∀ i, IsRademacher (fun eta ↦ epsilon eta i) muSign)
    (hAnonneg : ∀ i x, 0 ≤ A i x)
    (hcontinuous : ∀ i x, Continuous (X i x))
    (hzero : ∀ i x, X i x ⟨0, by simp⟩ = 0)
    (hLip : ∀ i x s t,
      |X i x s - X i x t| ≤ A i x * dist s t)
    (hPairA₂ : ∀ i, MemLp
      (fun p : OmegaData × OmegaData ↦ A i p.1 + A i p.2) 2
      (muData.prod muData))
    (hPairSecond : ∀ i,
      ∫ p : OmegaData × OmegaData, (A i p.1 + A i p.2) ^ 2
        ∂(muData.prod muData) ≤ (2 * K₂) ^ 2)
    (hIterInt : Integrable (fun p : OmegaData × OmegaData ↦
      ∫ eta, (⨆ t : EuclideanUnitBall E,
        |rademacherLipschitzProcess (fun i eta ↦ epsilon eta i)
          (fun i t ↦ X i p.1 t - X i p.2 t)
          Finset.univ ((n : ℝ)⁻¹) eta t|) ∂muSign)
      (muData.prod muData)) :
    (∫ p : OmegaData × OmegaData,
      ∫ eta, (⨆ t : EuclideanUnitBall E,
        |rademacherLipschitzProcess (fun i eta ↦ epsilon eta i)
          (fun i t ↦ X i p.1 t - X i p.2 t)
          Finset.univ ((n : ℝ)⁻¹) eta t|) ∂muSign
        ∂(muData.prod muData)) ≤
      168 * (K₂ / Real.sqrt n) *
        Real.sqrt (finrank ℝ E + 1 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let Fpair : Fin n → (OmegaData × OmegaData) →
      EuclideanUnitBall E → ℝ :=
    fun i p t ↦ X i p.1 t - X i p.2 t
  let Apair : Fin n → (OmegaData × OmegaData) → ℝ :=
    fun i p ↦ A i p.1 + A i p.2
  have hPairNonneg : ∀ i p, 0 ≤ Apair i p := by
    intro i p
    exact add_nonneg (hAnonneg i p.1) (hAnonneg i p.2)
  have hPairContinuous : ∀ i p, Continuous (Fpair i p) := by
    intro i p
    exact (hcontinuous i p.1).sub (hcontinuous i p.2)
  have hPairZero : ∀ i p, Fpair i p ⟨0, by simp⟩ = 0 := by
    intro i p
    simp only [Fpair, hzero i p.1, hzero i p.2, sub_self]
  have hPairLip : ∀ i p s t,
      |Fpair i p s - Fpair i p t| ≤ Apair i p * dist s t := by
    intro i p s t
    have hrewrite : Fpair i p s - Fpair i p t =
        (X i p.1 s - X i p.1 t) - (X i p.2 s - X i p.2 t) := by
      simp only [Fpair]
      ring
    rw [hrewrite]
    calc
      |(X i p.1 s - X i p.1 t) - (X i p.2 s - X i p.2 t)| ≤
          |X i p.1 s - X i p.1 t| + |X i p.2 s - X i p.2 t| :=
        abs_sub _ _
      _ ≤ A i p.1 * dist s t + A i p.2 * dist s t :=
        add_le_add (hLip i p.1 s t) (hLip i p.2 s t)
      _ = Apair i p * dist s t := by simp only [Apair]; ring
  have hbase := integral_integral_iSup_abs_rademacherEmpiricalProcess_le
    (muData := muData.prod muData) (mu := muSign)
    n hn (fun i eta ↦ epsilon eta i) Fpair Apair (2 * K₂)
    (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hK₂)
    hepsilonMeas hepsilonIndep hepsilonRad hPairNonneg hPairContinuous
    hPairZero hPairLip hPairA₂ hPairSecond hIterInt
  simpa only [Fpair, Apair] using (hbase.trans_eq (by ring))

name: RandomSetTheory.integral_iSup_abs_centeredEmpiricalLipschitzProcess_le
statement:
theorem integral_iSup_abs_centeredEmpiricalLipschitzProcess_le
    {OmegaData OmegaSign : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace OmegaData] [MeasurableSpace OmegaSign]
    {muData : Measure OmegaData} {muSign : Measure OmegaSign}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure muData] [IsProbabilityMeasure muSign]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (epsilon : OmegaSign → Fin n → ℝ)
    (X : Fin n → OmegaData → EuclideanUnitBall E → ℝ)
    (A : Fin n → OmegaData → ℝ) (K₂ : ℝ) (hK₂ : 0 ≤ K₂)
    (hXmeas : ∀ i t, Measurable (fun x ↦ X i x t))
    (hXint : ∀ i t, Integrable (fun x ↦ X i x t) muData)
    (hXindep : ∀ k, iIndepFun (fun i x
      (j : Finset.range (k + 1)) ↦
        X i x (denseSeq (EuclideanUnitBall E) j)) muData)
    (hepsilonPointwise : ∀ eta i,
      epsilon eta i = 1 ∨ epsilon eta i = -1)
    (hepsilonMeas : ∀ i, Measurable (fun eta ↦ epsilon eta i))
    (hepsilonIndep : iIndepFun (fun i eta ↦ epsilon eta i) muSign)
    (hepsilonRad : ∀ i, IsRademacher (fun eta ↦ epsilon eta i) muSign)
    (hAnonneg : ∀ i x, 0 ≤ A i x)
    (hcontinuous : ∀ i x, Continuous (X i x))
    (hzero : ∀ i x, X i x ⟨0, by simp⟩ = 0)
    (hLip : ∀ i x s t,
      |X i x s - X i x t| ≤ A i x * dist s t)
    (hPairA₂ : ∀ i, MemLp
      (fun p : OmegaData × OmegaData ↦ A i p.1 + A i p.2) 2
      (muData.prod muData))
    (hPairSecond : ∀ i,
      ∫ p : OmegaData × OmegaData, (A i p.1 + A i p.2) ^ 2
        ∂(muData.prod muData) ≤ (2 * K₂) ^ 2)
    (hCenteredInt : ∀ k, Integrable (fun x ↦
      densePrefixAbsSupremum
        (centeredEmpiricalLipschitzProcess muData n X x) k) muData)
    (hGhostInt : ∀ k, Integrable
      (fun p : OmegaData × OmegaData ↦
        finiteVectorSupAbs (Finset.range (k + 1))
          Finset.nonempty_range_add_one (fun j ↦
            ∑ i : Fin n, ((n : ℝ)⁻¹ *
              X i p.1 (denseSeq (EuclideanUnitBall E) j) -
              (n : ℝ)⁻¹ *
              X i p.2 (denseSeq (EuclideanUnitBall E) j))))
      (muData.prod muData))
    (hSignedJointInt : ∀ k, Integrable
      (fun z : (OmegaData × OmegaData) × OmegaSign ↦
        finiteVectorSupAbs (Finset.range (k + 1))
          Finset.nonempty_range_add_one (fun j ↦
            ∑ i : Fin n, epsilon z.2 i *
              ((n : ℝ)⁻¹ *
                X i z.1.1 (denseSeq (EuclideanUnitBall E) j) -
               (n : ℝ)⁻¹ *
                X i z.1.2 (denseSeq (EuclideanUnitBall E) j))))
      ((muData.prod muData).prod muSign))
    (hFullSignedJointInt : Integrable
      (fun z : (OmegaData × OmegaData) × OmegaSign ↦
        ⨆ t : EuclideanUnitBall E,
          |rademacherGhostEmpiricalProcess n epsilon X z.1 z.2 t|)
      ((muData.prod muData).prod muSign))
    (hRbdd : ∀ p eta, BddAbove (Set.range fun t : EuclideanUnitBall E ↦
      |rademacherGhostEmpiricalProcess n epsilon X p eta t|))
    (B : OmegaData → ℝ)
    (hCenteredContinuous : ∀ x,
      Continuous (centeredEmpiricalLipschitzProcess muData n X x))
    (hCenteredMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (fun x ↦
      centeredEmpiricalLipschitzProcess muData n X x
        (denseSeq (EuclideanUnitBall E) k)))
    (hBint : Integrable B muData)
    (hCenteredDom : ∀ x t,
      |centeredEmpiricalLipschitzProcess muData n X x t| ≤ |B x|) :
    (∫ x, (⨆ t : EuclideanUnitBall E,
      |centeredEmpiricalLipschitzProcess muData n X x t|) ∂muData) ≤
      168 * (K₂ / Real.sqrt n) *
        Real.sqrt (finrank ℝ E + 1 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hIterInt : Integrable
      (fun p : OmegaData × OmegaData ↦
        ∫ eta, (⨆ t : EuclideanUnitBall E,
          |rademacherGhostEmpiricalProcess n epsilon X p eta t|)
          ∂muSign) (muData.prod muData) :=
    hFullSignedJointInt.integral_prod_left
  have hghostBound :
      (∫ p : OmegaData × OmegaData,
        ∫ eta, (⨆ t : EuclideanUnitBall E,
          |rademacherGhostEmpiricalProcess n epsilon X p eta t|)
          ∂muSign ∂(muData.prod muData)) ≤
        168 * (K₂ / Real.sqrt n) *
          Real.sqrt (finrank ℝ E + 1 : ℝ) := by
    simpa only [rademacherGhostEmpiricalProcess] using
      (integral_integral_iSup_abs_rademacherGhostEmpiricalProcess_le
        n hn epsilon X A K₂ hK₂ hepsilonMeas hepsilonIndep hepsilonRad
        hAnonneg hcontinuous hzero hLip hPairA₂ hPairSecond hIterInt)
  apply integral_iSup_abs_le_of_densePrefixBounds
    (centeredEmpiricalLipschitzProcess muData n X) B
    hCenteredContinuous hCenteredMeas hBint hCenteredDom
  intro k
  exact (integral_densePrefixAbs_centeredEmpirical_le_rademacherGhost
    n k epsilon X hXmeas hXint (hXindep k) hepsilonPointwise
    (hCenteredInt k) (hGhostInt k) (hSignedJointInt k)
    hFullSignedJointInt hRbdd).trans hghostBound

name: RandomSetTheory.euclideanCovarianceMatrix_posSemidef
statement:
theorem euclideanCovarianceMatrix_posSemidef
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    (X : Omega → EuclideanSpace ℝ kappa) (hX : MemLp X 2 mu) :
    (euclideanCovarianceMatrix X mu).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Matrix.PosSemidef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg
  · apply Matrix.IsHermitian.ext
    intro i j
    simp only [euclideanCovarianceMatrix, star_trivial]
    exact covariance_comm _ _
  · intro a
    have hcoord : ∀ i, MemLp (fun omega => X omega i) 2 mu := by
      intro i
      simpa only [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_inner] using
        hX.const_inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (EuclideanSpace.basisFun kappa ℝ i)
    have hscaled : ∀ i, MemLp (fun omega => a i * X omega i) 2 mu :=
      fun i => (hcoord i).const_mul (a i)
    calc
      0 ≤ Var[fun omega => ∑ i, a i * X omega i; mu] :=
        variance_nonneg _ _
      _ = cov[fun omega => ∑ i, a i * X omega i,
          fun omega => ∑ j, a j * X omega j; mu] := by
        rw [covariance_self]
        exact Finset.aemeasurable_fun_sum _
          (fun i _ => (hscaled i).aemeasurable)
      _ = ∑ i, ∑ j, cov[fun omega => a i * X omega i,
          fun omega => a j * X omega j; mu] :=
        covariance_fun_sum_fun_sum hscaled hscaled
      _ = star a ⬝ᵥ (euclideanCovarianceMatrix X mu *ᵥ a) := by
        simp only [dotProduct, mulVec, euclideanCovarianceMatrix, star_trivial,
          covariance_const_mul_left, covariance_const_mul_right]
        simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j _
        ring

name: RandomSetTheory.euclideanCovarianceMatrix_quadratic_eq_variance
statement:
theorem euclideanCovarianceMatrix_quadratic_eq_variance
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    (X : Omega → EuclideanSpace ℝ kappa) (hX : MemLp X 2 mu)
    (t : EuclideanSpace ℝ kappa) :
    t ⬝ᵥ (euclideanCovarianceMatrix X mu *ᵥ t) =
      Var[fun omega => ⟪t, X omega⟫_ℝ; mu]
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcoord : ∀ i, MemLp (fun omega => X omega i) 2 mu := by
    intro i
    simpa only [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_inner] using
      hX.const_inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (EuclideanSpace.basisFun kappa ℝ i)
  have hscaled : ∀ i, MemLp (fun omega => t i * X omega i) 2 mu :=
    fun i => (hcoord i).const_mul (t i)
  have hfun : (fun omega => ⟪t, X omega⟫_ℝ) =
      fun omega => ∑ i, t i * X omega i := by
    funext omega
    simp [PiLp.inner_apply, mul_comm]
  rw [hfun, ← covariance_self]
  · rw [covariance_fun_sum_fun_sum hscaled hscaled]
    simp only [dotProduct, mulVec, euclideanCovarianceMatrix,
      covariance_const_mul_left, covariance_const_mul_right]
    simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    ring
  · exact Finset.aemeasurable_fun_sum _
      (fun i _ => (hscaled i).aemeasurable)

name: RandomSetTheory.charFun_map_inner_eq_charFun_map_one
statement:
theorem charFun_map_inner_eq_charFun_map_one
    {mu : Measure Omega} (X : Omega → EuclideanSpace ℝ kappa)
    (hX : AEMeasurable X mu) (t : EuclideanSpace ℝ kappa) :
    charFun (mu.map X) t =
      charFun (mu.map (fun omega => ⟪t, X omega⟫_ℝ)) 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [charFun_apply, integral_map hX (by fun_prop),
    charFun_apply_real, integral_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
  congr with omega
  simp [real_inner_comm]

name: RandomSetTheory.tendstoInDistribution_euclidean_inv_sqrt_smul_sum_sub
statement:
theorem tendstoInDistribution_euclidean_inv_sqrt_smul_sum_sub
    [DecidableEq kappa]
    {Omega' : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega']
    {mu : Measure Omega} {mu' : Measure Omega'}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu']
    (X : ℕ → Omega → EuclideanSpace ℝ kappa)
    (Y : Omega' → EuclideanSpace ℝ kappa)
    (hY : HasLaw Y
      (multivariateGaussian 0 (euclideanCovarianceMatrix (X 0) mu)) mu')
    (hL2 : MemLp (X 0) 2 mu)
    (hindep : iIndepFun X mu)
    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu) :
    TendstoInDistribution
      (fun (n : ℕ) omega =>
        (√n)⁻¹ •
          (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, X i omega -
            (n : ℝ) • ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu))
      atTop Y (fun _ => mu) mu'
proof:
:= by
  let Sigma := euclideanCovarianceMatrix (X 0) mu
  have hSigma : Sigma.PosSemidef :=
    euclideanCovarianceMatrix_posSemidef (X 0) hL2
  have hInt : Integrable (X 0) mu := hL2.integrable (by norm_num)
  have hXmeas : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) mu :=
    fun i => (hident i).aemeasurable_fst
  refine
    { forall_aemeasurable := fun n => ?_
      aemeasurable_limit := hY.aemeasurable
      tendsto := ?_ }
  · have hc : AEMeasurable
        (fun _ : Omega => (n : ℝ) • ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu) mu :=
      aemeasurable_const
    exact ((Finset.aemeasurable_fun_sum (Finset.range n)
      (fun i _ => hXmeas i)).sub hc).const_smul ((√n)⁻¹ : ℝ)
  · apply ProbabilityMeasure.tendsto_iff_tendsto_charFun.2
    intro t
    let Xt : ℕ → Omega → ℝ := fun i omega => ⟪t, X i omega⟫_ℝ
    let Yt : Omega' → ℝ := fun omega => ⟪t, Y omega⟫_ℝ
    have hXtL2 : MemLp (Xt 0) 2 mu := hL2.const_inner (𝕜 := ℝ) t
    have hindep_t : iIndepFun Xt mu := by
      simpa only [Xt, Function.comp_def] using
        hindep.comp (fun _ x => ⟪t, x⟫_ℝ) (fun _ => by fun_prop)
    have hident_t : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (Xt i) (Xt 0) mu mu := by
      intro i
      simpa only [Xt, Function.comp_def] using
        (hident i).comp (by fun_prop : Measurable (fun x => ⟪t, x⟫_ℝ))
    have hquad : t ⬝ᵥ (Sigma *ᵥ t) = Var[Xt 0; mu] := by
      simpa only [Sigma, Xt] using
        euclideanCovarianceMatrix_quadratic_eq_variance (X 0) hL2 t
    have hproj : HasLaw (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ kappa => ⟪t, x⟫_ℝ)
        (gaussianReal 0 Var[Xt 0; mu].toNNReal)
        (multivariateGaussian 0 Sigma) := by
      refine ⟨by fun_prop, ?_⟩
      let L : EuclideanSpace ℝ kappa →L[ℝ] ℝ := innerSL ℝ t
      change (multivariateGaussian 0 Sigma).map L = _
      rw [IsGaussian.map_eq_gaussianReal]
      congr 2
      · rw [L.integral_comp_id_comm IsGaussian.integrable_id,
          integral_id_multivariateGaussian]
        simp
      · change Var[fun u => ⟪t, u⟫_ℝ; multivariateGaussian 0 Sigma] = _
        rw [← covarianceBilin_self IsGaussian.memLp_two_id t,
          covarianceBilin_multivariateGaussian hSigma]
        exact hquad
    have hYt : HasLaw Yt (gaussianReal 0 Var[Xt 0; mu].toNNReal) mu' := by
      have hcomp := hproj.comp hY
      simpa only [Yt, Function.comp_def, Sigma] using hcomp
    have ht := tendstoInDistribution_inv_sqrt_mul_sum_sub
      hYt hXtL2 hindep_t hident_t
    have htchar :=
      (ProbabilityMeasure.tendsto_iff_tendsto_charFun.1 ht.tendsto) 1
    simp only [ProbabilityMeasure.coe_mk] at htchar ⊢
    convert htchar using 1
    · funext n
      rw [charFun_map_inner_eq_charFun_map_one]
      · congr 2
        funext omega
        simp only [Xt]
        rw [real_inner_smul_right, inner_sub_right, inner_sum,
          integral_inner hInt, real_inner_smul_right]
      · have hc : AEMeasurable
            (fun _ : Omega => (n : ℝ) • ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu) mu :=
          aemeasurable_const
        exact ((Finset.aemeasurable_fun_sum (Finset.range n)
          (fun i _ => hXmeas i)).sub hc).const_smul ((√n)⁻¹ : ℝ)
    · congr 1
      exact charFun_map_inner_eq_charFun_map_one Y hY.aemeasurable t

@[simp]

name: RandomSetTheory.tendstoInDistribution_finiteDirectionalSupport_minkowskiAverage
statement:
theorem tendstoInDistribution_finiteDirectionalSupport_minkowskiAverage
    [DecidableEq kappa]
    {Omega' : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega']
    {mu : Measure Omega} {mu' : Measure Omega'}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu']
    (S : ℕ → Omega → Set E) (L : Set E) (u : kappa → E)
    (Y : Omega' → EuclideanSpace ℝ kappa)
    (hScompact : ∀ i omega, IsCompact (S i omega))
    (hSne : ∀ i omega, (S i omega).Nonempty)
    (hY : HasLaw Y
      (multivariateGaussian 0
        (finiteDirectionalSupportCovariance S L u mu)) mu')
    (hL2 : MemLp (finiteDirectionalSupportDeviation S L u 0) 2 mu)
    (hindep : iIndepFun (finiteDirectionalSupportDeviation S L u) mu)
    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib
      (finiteDirectionalSupportDeviation S L u i)
      (finiteDirectionalSupportDeviation S L u 0) mu mu)
    (hcenter : ∀ j, mu[directionalSupportDeviation S L (u j) 0] = 0) :
    TendstoInDistribution
      (fun (n : ℕ) omega => toLp 2 (fun j =>
        √((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          (supportFunction
              (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range (n + 1))
                (fun i => S i omega)) (u j) -
            supportFunction L (u j))))
      atTop Y (fun _ => mu) mu'
proof:
:= by
  let V := finiteDirectionalSupportDeviation S L u
  have hVint : Integrable (V 0) mu := hL2.integrable (by norm_num)
  have hcenterV : ∫ omega, V 0 omega ∂mu = 0 := by
    ext j
    rw [eval_integral_piLp (fun l => hVint.eval_piLp l)]
    exact hcenter j
  have hclt := tendstoInDistribution_euclidean_inv_sqrt_smul_sum_sub
    V Y hY hL2 hindep hident
  have hshift : TendstoInDistribution
      (fun (n : ℕ) omega =>
        (√(n + 1 : ℕ))⁻¹ •
          (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), V i omega -
            ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) • ∫ omega, V 0 omega ∂mu))
      atTop Y (fun _ => mu) mu' :=
    { forall_aemeasurable := fun n => hclt.forall_aemeasurable (n + 1)
      aemeasurable_limit := hclt.aemeasurable_limit
      tendsto := hclt.tendsto.comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1) }
  apply hshift.congr
  · intro n
    filter_upwards [] with omega
    rw [hcenterV, smul_zero, sub_zero]
    ext j
    simp only [PiLp.smul_apply]
    have hsum :
        (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), V i omega) j =
          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
            directionalSupportDeviation S L (u j) i omega := by
      change (PiLp.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) 2 (fun _ : kappa => ℝ) j)
          (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), V i omega) = _
      rw [map_sum]
      simp [V, finiteDirectionalSupportDeviation, PiLp.proj_apply]
    rw [hsum]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    rw [supportFunction_minkowskiAverage_sub_eq_average_deviation
      S L (Finset.range (n + 1)) (by simp)
      (fun i _ omega' => hScompact i omega')
      (fun i _ omega' => hSne i omega')]
    have hn : (0 : ℝ) < (n + 1 : ℕ) := by positivity
    have hsqrt : √(n + 1 : ℕ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hn)
    field_simp
    rw [Finset.card_range, Real.sq_sqrt hn.le]
    ring
  · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => rfl)

name: RandomSetTheory.tendstoInDistribution_iid_finiteDirectionalSupport_minkowskiAverage
statement:
theorem tendstoInDistribution_iid_finiteDirectionalSupport_minkowskiAverage
    [DecidableEq kappa]
    {Omega' Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega'] [MeasurableSpace Z]
    {mu : Measure Omega} {mu' : Measure Omega'}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu']
    (X : ℕ → Omega → Z)
    (hindep : iIndepFun X mu)
    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (F : Z → Set E) (hF : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable F)
    (hFcompact : ∀ z, IsCompact (F z))
    (hFne : ∀ z, (F z).Nonempty)
    (L : Set E) (u : kappa → E)
    (Y : Omega' → EuclideanSpace ℝ kappa)
    (hY : HasLaw Y
      (multivariateGaussian 0
        (finiteDirectionalSupportCovariance
          (fun i omega => F (X i omega)) L u mu)) mu')
    (hL2 : MemLp
      (finiteDirectionalSupportDeviation
        (fun i omega => F (X i omega)) L u 0) 2 mu)
    (hLsupport : ∀ j, supportFunction L (u j) =
      ∫ omega, supportFunction (F (X 0 omega)) (u j) ∂mu) :
    TendstoInDistribution
      (fun (n : ℕ) omega => toLp 2 (fun j =>
        √((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          (supportFunction
              (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range (n + 1))
                (fun i => F (X i omega))) (u j) -
            supportFunction L (u j))))
      atTop Y (fun _ => mu) mu'
proof:
:= by
  let S : ℕ → Omega → Set E := fun i omega => F (X i omega)
  let g : Z → EuclideanSpace ℝ kappa := fun z =>
    toLp 2 (fun j => supportFunction (F z) (u j) - supportFunction L (u j))
  have hsupp : ∀ j, Measurable (fun z => supportFunction (F z) (u j)) :=
    fun j => measurable_supportFunction hF hFcompact hFne (u j)
  have hg : Measurable g := by
    exact (WithLp.measurable_toLp 2 (kappa → ℝ)).comp
      (measurable_pi_lambda _ (fun j => (hsupp j).sub_const _))
  have hindepV : iIndepFun (finiteDirectionalSupportDeviation S L u) mu := by
    change iIndepFun (fun i omega => g (X i omega)) mu
    simpa only [Function.comp_def] using
      hindep.comp (fun _ => g) (fun _ => hg)
  have hidentV : ∀ i, IdentDistrib
      (finiteDirectionalSupportDeviation S L u i)
      (finiteDirectionalSupportDeviation S L u 0) mu mu := by
    intro i
    change IdentDistrib (fun omega => g (X i omega))
      (fun omega => g (X 0 omega)) mu mu
    simpa only [Function.comp_def] using (hident i).comp hg
  have hcenter : ∀ j, mu[directionalSupportDeviation S L (u j) 0] = 0 := by
    intro j
    have hdevInt : Integrable (directionalSupportDeviation S L (u j) 0) mu := by
      simpa only [finiteDirectionalSupportDeviation, S] using
        (hL2.eval_piLp j).integrable (by norm_num)
    have hsuppInt : Integrable
        (fun omega => supportFunction (F (X 0 omega)) (u j)) mu := by
      have h := hdevInt.add (integrable_const (supportFunction L (u j)))
      apply h.congr
      filter_upwards [] with omega
      change (supportFunction (F (X 0 omega)) (u j) -
        supportFunction L (u j)) + supportFunction L (u j) = _
      ring
    change ∫ omega,
      (supportFunction (F (X 0 omega)) (u j) -
        supportFunction L (u j)) ∂mu = 0
    rw [integral_sub hsuppInt (integrable_const (supportFunction L (u j))),
      ← hLsupport j]
    simp
  exact tendstoInDistribution_finiteDirectionalSupport_minkowskiAverage
    S L u Y
    (fun i omega => hFcompact (X i omega))
    (fun i omega => hFne (X i omega))
    hY hL2 hindepV hidentV hcenter

name: RandomSetTheory.measurable_infDist_correspondence
statement:
theorem measurable_infDist_correspondence
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [PseudoMetricSpace E]
    {S : Ω → Set E} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty) (x : E) :
    Measurable (fun ω => infDist x (S ω))
proof:
:= by
  apply measurable_of_Iio
  intro r
  by_cases hr : 0 < r
  · have hEq : (fun ω => infDist x (S ω)) ⁻¹' Iio r =
        {ω | (S ω ∩ Metric.ball x r).Nonempty} := by
      ext ω
      simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_Iio, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
      rw [infDist_lt_iff (hne ω)]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
        exact ⟨y, hy, by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm] using hxy⟩
      · rintro ⟨y, hy, hyball⟩
        exact ⟨y, hy, by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm] using hyball⟩
    rw [hEq]
    exact hS (Metric.ball x r) Metric.isOpen_ball
  · have hEq : (fun ω => infDist x (S ω)) ⁻¹' Iio r = (∅ : Set Ω) := by
      ext ω
      simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_Iio, Set.mem_empty_iff_false]
      constructor
      · exact not_lt_of_ge
          ((not_lt.mp hr).trans (infDist_nonneg : 0 ≤ infDist x (S ω)))
      · exact False.elim
    rw [hEq]
    exact MeasurableSet.empty

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_euclideanUnitBall_finset_net_card_le
statement:
theorem exists_euclideanUnitBall_finset_net_card_le
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {eps : ℝ} (heps : 0 < eps) :
    ∃ N : Finset (EuclideanUnitBall E),
      (∀ u : EuclideanUnitBall E, ∃ v ∈ N, dist u v ≤ eps) ∧
      (N.card : ℝ) ≤ (1 + 2 / eps) ^ finrank ℝ E
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨N, hNmem, hNcover, hNcard⟩ :=
    exists_unitBall_finset_net_card_le (E := E) heps
  let liftFun : {v // v ∈ N} → EuclideanUnitBall E := fun v ↦
    ⟨v.1, hNmem v.1 v.2⟩
  have hliftFun : Function.Injective liftFun := by
    intro v w hvw
    exact Subtype.ext
      (congrArg (fun z : EuclideanUnitBall E ↦ z.1) hvw)
  let lift : {v // v ∈ N} ↪ EuclideanUnitBall E :=
    ⟨liftFun, hliftFun⟩
  let M : Finset (EuclideanUnitBall E) := N.attach.map lift
  refine ⟨M, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro u
    obtain ⟨v, hvN, huv⟩ := hNcover u.1 u.2
    let vN : {v // v ∈ N} := ⟨v, hvN⟩
    refine ⟨lift vN, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact Finset.mem_map.2 ⟨vN, by simp [vN], rfl⟩
    · exact huv
  · calc
      (M.card : ℝ) = (N.attach.card : ℝ) := by simp [M]
      _ = (N.card : ℝ) := by simp
      _ ≤ (1 + 2 / eps) ^ finrank ℝ E := hNcard

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_euclideanUnitBall_multiscaleNets
statement:
theorem exists_euclideanUnitBall_multiscaleNets
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (eps : ℕ → ℝ) (heps : ∀ k, 0 < eps k) :
    ∃ N : ℕ → Finset (EuclideanUnitBall E),
      (∀ k, ∀ u : EuclideanUnitBall E,
        ∃ v ∈ N k, dist u v ≤ eps k) ∧
      ∀ k, ((N k).card : ℝ) ≤
        (1 + 2 / eps k) ^ finrank ℝ E
proof:
:= by
  choose N hnet hcard using fun k ↦
    exists_euclideanUnitBall_finset_net_card_le (E := E) (heps k)
  exact ⟨N, hnet, hcard⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_euclideanUnitBall_multiscaleNets_projections
statement:
theorem exists_euclideanUnitBall_multiscaleNets_projections
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (eps : ℕ → ℝ) (heps : ∀ k, 0 < eps k) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ N : ℕ → Finset (EuclideanUnitBall E),
      ∃ proj : ℕ → EuclideanUnitBall E → EuclideanUnitBall E,
        (∀ k, ∀ u : EuclideanUnitBall E,
          ∃ v ∈ N k, dist u v ≤ eps k) ∧
        (∀ k, ((N k).card : ℝ) ≤
          (1 + 2 / eps k) ^ finrank ℝ E) ∧
        (∀ k, k ≤ m → ∀ u, proj k u ∈ N k) ∧
        ∀ k, k ≤ m → ∀ u, dist u (proj k u) ≤ eps k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hnet, hcard⟩ :=
    exists_euclideanUnitBall_multiscaleNets (E := E) eps heps
  obtain ⟨proj, hproj, hnear⟩ :=
    ProbabilityTheory.exists_finiteNetProjections N eps m
      (fun k _ ↦ hnet k)
  exact ⟨N, proj, hnet, hcard, hproj, hnear⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_euclideanUnitBall_netParents
statement:
theorem exists_euclideanUnitBall_netParents
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    (N : ℕ → Finset (EuclideanUnitBall E)) (eps : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hnet : ∀ k, ∀ u : EuclideanUnitBall E,
      ∃ v ∈ N k, dist u v ≤ eps k) :
    ∃ parent : ℕ → EuclideanUnitBall E → EuclideanUnitBall E,
      ∀ k u, parent k u ∈ N k ∧ dist u (parent k u) ≤ eps k
proof:
:= by
  choose parent hparent using fun k u ↦ hnet k u
  exact ⟨parent, hparent⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.finiteParentDescent_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem finiteParentDescent_zero
    {T : Type*} (parent : ℕ → T → T) (m : ℕ) (top : T) :
    finiteParentDescent parent m top 0 = top
proof: := rfl

name: RandomSetTheory.finiteParentDescent_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem finiteParentDescent_succ
    {T : Type*} (parent : ℕ → T → T) (m : ℕ) (top : T) (steps : ℕ) :
    finiteParentDescent parent m top (steps + 1) =
      parent (m - (steps + 1))
        (finiteParentDescent parent m top steps)
proof: := rfl

name: RandomSetTheory.parent_finiteParentDescent_sub_succ
statement:
theorem parent_finiteParentDescent_sub_succ
    {T : Type*} (parent : ℕ → T → T) (m : ℕ) (top : T)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : k < m) :
    parent k (finiteParentDescent parent m top (m - (k + 1))) =
      finiteParentDescent parent m top (m - k)
proof:
:= by
  have hsteps : m - k = (m - (k + 1)) + 1 := by omega
  rw [hsteps, finiteParentDescent_succ]
  congr 1
  omega

name: RandomSetTheory.coherentParentProjection_top
statement:
@[simp] theorem coherentParentProjection_top
    {T : Type*} (parent : ℕ → T → T) (top : T → T)
    (m : ℕ) (t : T) :
    coherentParentProjection parent top m m t = top t
proof:
:= by
  simp [coherentParentProjection]

name: RandomSetTheory.coherentParentProjection_parent
statement:
theorem coherentParentProjection_parent
    {T : Type*} (parent : ℕ → T → T) (top : T → T)
    (m : ℕ) {k : ℕ} (hk : k < m) (t : T) :
    parent k (coherentParentProjection parent top m (k + 1) t) =
      coherentParentProjection parent top m k t
proof:
:= by
  rw [coherentParentProjection, coherentParentProjection,
    if_pos (Nat.succ_le_iff.2 hk), if_pos hk.le]
  exact parent_finiteParentDescent_sub_succ parent m (top t) hk

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_euclideanUnitBall_coherentParentChaining
statement:
theorem exists_euclideanUnitBall_coherentParentChaining
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (eps : ℕ → ℝ) (heps : ∀ k, 0 < eps k) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ N : ℕ → Finset (EuclideanUnitBall E),
      ∃ parent proj : ℕ → EuclideanUnitBall E → EuclideanUnitBall E,
        (∀ k, ∀ u : EuclideanUnitBall E,
          ∃ v ∈ N k, dist u v ≤ eps k) ∧
        (∀ k, ((N k).card : ℝ) ≤
          (1 + 2 / eps k) ^ finrank ℝ E) ∧
        (∀ k u, parent k u ∈ N k ∧
          dist u (parent k u) ≤ eps k) ∧
        (∀ k, k ≤ m → ∀ u, proj k u ∈ N k) ∧
        (∀ u, dist u (proj m u) ≤ eps m) ∧
        (∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ u,
          parent k (proj (k + 1) u) = proj k u) ∧
        (∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ u,
          (proj (k + 1) u, proj k u) ∈
            ProbabilityTheory.finiteChainingParentEdges N parent k) ∧
        ∀ k, (ProbabilityTheory.finiteChainingParentEdges N parent k).card ≤
          (N (k + 1)).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨N, hnet, hcard⟩ :=
    exists_euclideanUnitBall_multiscaleNets (E := E) eps heps
  obtain ⟨parent, hparent⟩ :=
    exists_euclideanUnitBall_netParents N eps hnet
  choose top htop using fun u : EuclideanUnitBall E ↦ hnet m u
  let proj : ℕ → EuclideanUnitBall E → EuclideanUnitBall E :=
    fun k u ↦ coherentParentProjection parent top m k u
  have hcoherent : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ u,
      parent k (proj (k + 1) u) = proj k u := by
    intro k hk u
    exact coherentParentProjection_parent parent top m
      (Finset.mem_range.1 hk) u
  have hproj : ∀ k, k ≤ m → ∀ u, proj k u ∈ N k := by
    intro k hk u
    by_cases hkm : k = m
    · subst k
      simpa [proj] using (htop u).1
    · have hlt : k < m := lt_of_le_of_ne hk hkm
      rw [← hcoherent k (Finset.mem_range.2 hlt) u]
      exact (hparent k (proj (k + 1) u)).1
  have hfinal : ∀ u, dist u (proj m u) ≤ eps m := by
    intro u
    simpa [proj] using (htop u).2
  have hedge : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ u,
      (proj (k + 1) u, proj k u) ∈
        ProbabilityTheory.finiteChainingParentEdges N parent k :=
    ProbabilityTheory.finiteChainingParentEdges_contains_projection
      N parent proj m
      (fun k hk u ↦ hproj (k + 1) (Nat.succ_le_iff.2 (Finset.mem_range.1 hk)) u)
      hcoherent
  refine ⟨N, parent, proj, hnet, hcard, hparent, hproj, hfinal,
    hcoherent, hedge, ?_⟩
  intro k
  exact ProbabilityTheory.card_finiteChainingParentEdges_le N parent k

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_risk_bound_dimensional_of_bernstein
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_risk_bound_dimensional_of_bernstein
    {Ω ι E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (S : ι → Ω → Set E) (L : Set E)
    (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (v : ι → ℝ≥0) (b : ℝ≥0)
    {RS RL eps t : ℝ}
    (hScompact : ∀ i ω, IsCompact (S i ω))
    (hSne : ∀ i ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    (hSconv : ∀ i ω, Convex ℝ (S i ω))
    (hLcompact : IsCompact L) (hLne : L.Nonempty) (hLconv : Convex ℝ L)
    (hRS : ∀ i ω, ∀ x ∈ S i ω, ‖x‖ ≤ RS)
    (hRL : ∀ x ∈ L, ‖x‖ ≤ RL)
    (heps : 0 < eps) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (h_indep : ∀ w : E, ‖w‖ ≤ 1 → ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun
      (directionalSupportDeviation S L w) μ)
    (hB : ∀ w : E, ‖w‖ ≤ 1 → ∀ i ∈ s,
      ProbabilityTheory.HasBernsteinMGF
        (directionalSupportDeviation S L w i) (v i) b μ)
    (hV : 0 < ((∑ i ∈ s, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) :
    μ.real {ω | t + (RS + RL) * eps <
        hausdorffDist (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) L} ≤
      (1 + 2 / eps) ^ finrank ℝ E *
        (2 * exp (-((s.card : ℝ) * t) ^ 2 /
          (2 * (((∑ i ∈ s, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) +
            (b : ℝ) * ((s.card : ℝ) * t)))))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hnet, hcard⟩ :=
    exists_unitBall_finset_net_card_le (E := E) heps
  have hprob := hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_risk_bound_of_bernstein
    S L s hs v b hScompact hSne hSconv hLcompact hLne hLconv
    hRS hRL heps.le ht N hnet
    (fun w hw => h_indep w (hN w hw))
    (fun w hw => hB w (hN w hw)) hV
  exact hprob.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcard (by positivity))

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_risk_bound_dimensional_bernstein_sqrt_add
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_risk_bound_dimensional_bernstein_sqrt_add
    {Ω ι E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (S : ι → Ω → Set E) (L : Set E)
    (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (v : ι → ℝ≥0) (b : ℝ≥0)
    {RS RL eps x : ℝ}
    (hScompact : ∀ i ω, IsCompact (S i ω))
    (hSne : ∀ i ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    (hSconv : ∀ i ω, Convex ℝ (S i ω))
    (hLcompact : IsCompact L) (hLne : L.Nonempty) (hLconv : Convex ℝ L)
    (hRS : ∀ i ω, ∀ y ∈ S i ω, ‖y‖ ≤ RS)
    (hRL : ∀ y ∈ L, ‖y‖ ≤ RL)
    (heps : 0 < eps) (hx : 0 ≤ x)
    (h_indep : ∀ w : E, ‖w‖ ≤ 1 → ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun
      (directionalSupportDeviation S L w) μ)
    (hB : ∀ w : E, ‖w‖ ≤ 1 → ∀ i ∈ s,
      ProbabilityTheory.HasBernsteinMGF
        (directionalSupportDeviation S L w i) (v i) b μ)
    (hV : 0 < ((∑ i ∈ s, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) :
    μ.real {ω |
        (Real.sqrt (2 * ((∑ i ∈ s, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) * x) +
            2 * (b : ℝ) * x) / (s.card : ℝ) + (RS + RL) * eps <
          hausdorffDist (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) L} ≤
      (1 + 2 / eps) ^ finrank ℝ E * (2 * exp (-x))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hnet, hcard⟩ :=
    exists_unitBall_finset_net_card_le (E := E) heps
  have hprob :=
    hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_risk_bound_bernstein_sqrt_add
      S L s hs v b hScompact hSne hSconv hLcompact hLne hLconv
      hRS hRL heps.le hx N hnet
      (fun w hw => h_indep w (hN w hw))
      (fun w hw => hB w (hN w hw)) hV
  exact hprob.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcard (by positivity))

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_risk_bound_dimensional_bernstein_confidence
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_risk_bound_dimensional_bernstein_confidence
    {Ω ι E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (S : ι → Ω → Set E) (L : Set E)
    (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (v : ι → ℝ≥0) (b : ℝ≥0)
    {RS RL eps δ : ℝ}
    (hScompact : ∀ i ω, IsCompact (S i ω))
    (hSne : ∀ i ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    (hSconv : ∀ i ω, Convex ℝ (S i ω))
    (hLcompact : IsCompact L) (hLne : L.Nonempty) (hLconv : Convex ℝ L)
    (hRS : ∀ i ω, ∀ y ∈ S i ω, ‖y‖ ≤ RS)
    (hRL : ∀ y ∈ L, ‖y‖ ≤ RL)
    (heps : 0 < eps) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδone : δ ≤ 1)
    (h_indep : ∀ w : E, ‖w‖ ≤ 1 → ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun
      (directionalSupportDeviation S L w) μ)
    (hB : ∀ w : E, ‖w‖ ≤ 1 → ∀ i ∈ s,
      ProbabilityTheory.HasBernsteinMGF
        (directionalSupportDeviation S L w i) (v i) b μ)
    (hV : 0 < ((∑ i ∈ s, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) :
    μ.real {ω |
        (Real.sqrt (2 * ((∑ i ∈ s, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) *
              Real.log
                (2 * (1 + 2 / eps) ^ finrank ℝ E / δ)) +
            2 * (b : ℝ) *
              Real.log
                (2 * (1 + 2 / eps) ^ finrank ℝ E / δ)) /
            (s.card : ℝ) + (RS + RL) * eps <
          hausdorffDist (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) L} ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  let C : ℝ := (1 + 2 / eps) ^ finrank ℝ E
  let x : ℝ := Real.log (2 * C / δ)
  have hbase : 1 ≤ 1 + 2 / eps := by
    have : 0 ≤ 2 / eps := by positivity
    linarith
  have hC : 1 ≤ C := by
    dsimp [C]
    exact one_le_pow₀ hbase
  have hCpos : 0 < C := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hC
  have harg : 1 ≤ 2 * C / δ := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hδ]
    nlinarith
  have hargpos : 0 < 2 * C / δ := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one harg
  have hx : 0 ≤ x := by
    dsimp [x]
    exact Real.log_nonneg harg
  have hprob :=
    hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_risk_bound_dimensional_bernstein_sqrt_add
      S L s hs v b hScompact hSne hSconv hLcompact hLne hLconv
      hRS hRL heps hx h_indep hB hV
  change μ.real {ω |
      (Real.sqrt (2 * ((∑ i ∈ s, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) * x) +
          2 * (b : ℝ) * x) / (s.card : ℝ) + (RS + RL) * eps <
        hausdorffDist (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) L} ≤ δ
  refine hprob.trans ?_
  change C * (2 * exp (-x)) ≤ δ
  have heq : C * (2 * exp (-x)) = δ := by
    rw [Real.exp_neg]
    have hexp : Real.exp x = 2 * C / δ := by
      dsimp [x]
      exact Real.exp_log hargpos
    rw [hexp]
    field_simp [hδ.ne', hCpos.ne']
  exact heq.le

name: RandomSetTheory.ProbabilityMeasure.existsUnique_tendsto_of_tight_of_finiteEvaluationVectorLimits
statement:
theorem ProbabilityMeasure.existsUnique_tendsto_of_tight_of_finiteEvaluationVectorLimits
    (mu : ℕ → ProbabilityMeasure C(T, ℝ))
    (rho : ∀ k : ℕ, (Fin k → T) →
      ProbabilityMeasure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)))
    (htight : IsTightMeasureSet {((mu n : ProbabilityMeasure C(T, ℝ)) :
      Measure C(T, ℝ)) | n})
    (hvec : ∀ (k : ℕ) (t : Fin k → T),
      Tendsto
        (fun n ↦ ProbabilityMeasure.map (mu n)
          (finiteEvaluationVectorCLM T t).measurable.aemeasurable)
        atTop
        (nhds (rho k t))) :
    ∃! mu0 : ProbabilityMeasure C(T, ℝ),
      Tendsto mu atTop (nhds mu0) ∧
        ∀ (k : ℕ) (t : Fin k → T),
          ProbabilityMeasure.map mu0
            (finiteEvaluationVectorCLM T t).measurable.aemeasurable = rho k t
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose k a t hrep using fun w : FiniteEvaluationDual T ↦
    FiniteEvaluationDual.exists_fin_sum_evalCLM T w
  let nu : FiniteEvaluationDual T → ProbabilityMeasure ℝ := fun w ↦
    ProbabilityMeasure.map (rho (k w) (t w))
      (finiteLinearCombinationCLM (a w)).measurable.aemeasurable
  have hproj : ∀ w : FiniteEvaluationDual T,
      Tendsto
        (fun n ↦ ProbabilityMeasure.map (mu n)
          w.1.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable)
        atTop
        (nhds (nu w)) := by
    intro w
    exact ProbabilityMeasure.tendsto_map_finiteEvaluationDual_of_vector
      T (a w) (t w) w (hrep w) mu (rho (k w) (t w))
        (hvec (k w) (t w))
  obtain ⟨mu0, hmu0, -⟩ :=
    ProbabilityMeasure.existsUnique_tendsto_of_tight_of_finiteEvaluationProjectionLimits
      T mu nu htight hproj
  have hvector : ∀ (k : ℕ) (t : Fin k → T),
      ProbabilityMeasure.map mu0
        (finiteEvaluationVectorCLM T t).measurable.aemeasurable = rho k t := by
    intro k t
    have hmapped : Tendsto
        (fun n ↦ ProbabilityMeasure.map (mu n)
          (finiteEvaluationVectorCLM T t).measurable.aemeasurable)
        atTop
        (nhds (ProbabilityMeasure.map mu0
          (finiteEvaluationVectorCLM T t).measurable.aemeasurable)) :=
      ProbabilityMeasure.tendsto_map_of_tendsto_of_continuous
        mu mu0 hmu0.1 (finiteEvaluationVectorCLM T t).continuous
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique hmapped (hvec k t)
  refine ⟨mu0, ⟨hmu0.1, hvector⟩, ?_⟩
  intro mu1 hmu1
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique hmu1.1 hmu0.1

name: RandomSetTheory.isGaussianProcess_canonical_of_finiteEvaluationVector_isGaussian
statement:
theorem isGaussianProcess_canonical_of_finiteEvaluationVector_isGaussian
    (mu0 : ProbabilityMeasure C(T, ℝ))
    (rho : ∀ k : ℕ, (Fin k → T) →
      ProbabilityMeasure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)))
    (hvector : ∀ (k : ℕ) (t : Fin k → T),
      ProbabilityMeasure.map mu0
        (finiteEvaluationVectorCLM T t).measurable.aemeasurable = rho k t)
    (hgaussian : ∀ (k : ℕ) (t : Fin k → T),
      IsGaussian ((rho k t : ProbabilityMeasure
        (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k))) : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)))) :
    IsGaussianProcess (fun q (f : C(T, ℝ)) ↦ f q) (mu0 : Measure C(T, ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  intro I
  let e : I ≃ Fin I.card := Finset.equivFin I
  let t : Fin I.card → T := fun j ↦ (e.symm j).1
  let evalMap := finiteEvaluationVectorCLM T t
  let reindex : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin I.card) →L[ℝ] (I → ℝ) :=
    { toFun := fun x i ↦ x (e i)
      map_add' := by
        intro x y
        ext i
        simp
      map_smul' := by
        intro c x
        ext i
        simp
      cont := by fun_prop }
  have hfun :
      (fun f : C(T, ℝ) ↦ I.restrict (fun q ↦ f q)) = reindex ∘ evalMap := by
    funext f i
    simp [reindex, evalMap, t, e]
  have hlaw :
      (mu0 : Measure C(T, ℝ)).map evalMap =
        (rho I.card t : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin I.card))) := by
    simpa only [evalMap, ProbabilityMeasure.toMeasure_map] using
      congrArg ProbabilityMeasure.toMeasure (hvector I.card t)
  letI : IsGaussian
      (rho I.card t : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin I.card))) :=
    hgaussian I.card t
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  rw [hfun, ← Measure.map_map reindex.measurable evalMap.measurable, hlaw]
  infer_instance

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_closedBall
statement:
theorem aumannExpectation_closedBall
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {c : Ω → E} {r : Ω → ℝ}
    (hc : Integrable c μ) (hr : Integrable r μ)
    (hrnonneg : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ r ω) :
    aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => closedBall (c ω) (r ω)) =
      closedBall (∫ ω, c ω ∂μ) (∫ ω, r ω ∂μ)
proof:
:= by
  have hRnonneg : 0 ≤ ∫ ω, r ω ∂μ :=
    integral_nonneg hrnonneg
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · rintro x ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
    have hdiff : Integrable (fun ω => f ω - c ω) μ := hf.1.sub hc
    have hnorm : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ‖f ω - c ω‖ ≤ r ω := by
      filter_upwards [hf.2] with ω hω
      simpa [mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hω
    have hint :
        ‖∫ ω, f ω - c ω ∂μ‖ ≤ ∫ ω, r ω ∂μ :=
      norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hr hnorm
    rw [integral_sub hf.1 hc] at hint
    simpa [mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hint
  · intro x hx
    have hxnorm : ‖x - ∫ ω, c ω ∂μ‖ ≤ ∫ ω, r ω ∂μ := by
      simpa [mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hx
    by_cases hR : (∫ ω, r ω ∂μ) = 0
    · have hxcenter : x = ∫ ω, c ω ∂μ := by
        have : x - ∫ ω, c ω ∂μ = 0 :=
          norm_eq_zero.mp (le_antisymm (by simpa [hR] using hxnorm) (norm_nonneg _))
        exact sub_eq_zero.mp this
      refine ⟨c, ⟨hc, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · filter_upwards [] with ω
        simpa [mem_closedBall] using hrnonneg ω
      · simp [hxcenter]
    · let R : ℝ := ∫ ω, r ω ∂μ
      let u : E := R⁻¹ • (x - ∫ ω, c ω ∂μ)
      let f : Ω → E := fun ω => c ω + r ω • u
      have hRpos : 0 < R := lt_of_le_of_ne hRnonneg (Ne.symm hR)
      have hu : ‖u‖ ≤ 1 := by
        dsimp [u, R]
        rw [norm_smul, norm_inv, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_of_pos hRpos, inv_mul_le_one₀ hRpos]
        exact hxnorm
      have hfint : Integrable f μ := hc.add (hr.smul_const u)
      have hfmem : ∀ ω, f ω ∈ closedBall (c ω) (r ω) := by
        intro ω
        change dist (c ω + r ω • u) (c ω) ≤ r ω
        rw [dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul,
          Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hrnonneg ω)]
        exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (hrnonneg ω) hu
      refine ⟨f, ⟨hfint, Filter.Eventually.of_forall hfmem⟩, ?_⟩
      calc
        (∫ ω, f ω ∂μ) =
            (∫ ω, c ω ∂μ) + ∫ ω, r ω • u ∂μ :=
          integral_add hc (hr.smul_const u)
        _ = (∫ ω, c ω ∂μ) + R • u := by rw [integral_smul_const]
        _ = x := by
          dsimp [u]
          rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hR, one_smul, add_sub_cancel]

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_isCompact_closedBall
statement:
theorem aumannExpectation_isCompact_closedBall
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {c : Ω → E} {r : Ω → ℝ}
    (hc : Integrable c μ) (hr : Integrable r μ)
    (hrnonneg : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ r ω) :
    IsCompact (aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => closedBall (c ω) (r ω)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [aumannExpectation_closedBall hc hr hrnonneg]
  exact isCompact_closedBall _ _

name: RandomSetTheory.closure_aumannExpectation_closedBall
statement:
theorem closure_aumannExpectation_closedBall
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {c : Ω → E} {r : Ω → ℝ}
    (hc : Integrable c μ) (hr : Integrable r μ)
    (hrnonneg : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ r ω) :
    closure (aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => closedBall (c ω) (r ω))) =
      aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => closedBall (c ω) (r ω))
proof:
:=
  (aumannExpectation_isCompact_closedBall hc hr hrnonneg).isClosed.closure_eq

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_Icc
statement:
theorem aumannExpectation_Icc
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    {a b : Ω → ℝ} (ha : Integrable a μ) (hb : Integrable b μ)
    (hab : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, a ω ≤ b ω) :
    aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => Icc (a ω) (b ω)) =
      Icc (∫ ω, a ω ∂μ) (∫ ω, b ω ∂μ)
proof:
:= by
  let S : Ω → Set ℝ := fun ω => Icc (a ω) (b ω)
  have haSel : IsIntegrableSelection μ S a := by
    refine ⟨ha, ?_⟩
    filter_upwards [hab] with ω hω
    exact ⟨le_rfl, hω⟩
  have hbSel : IsIntegrableSelection μ S b := by
    refine ⟨hb, ?_⟩
    filter_upwards [hab] with ω hω
    exact ⟨hω, le_rfl⟩
  have haMem : (∫ ω, a ω ∂μ) ∈ aumannExpectation μ S :=
    ⟨a, haSel, rfl⟩
  have hbMem : (∫ ω, b ω ∂μ) ∈ aumannExpectation μ S :=
    ⟨b, hbSel, rfl⟩
  have habInt : (∫ ω, a ω ∂μ) ≤ ∫ ω, b ω ∂μ :=
    integral_mono_ae ha hb hab
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · rintro x ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
    have haf : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, a ω ≤ f ω := by
      filter_upwards [hf.2] with ω hω
      exact hω.1
    have hfb : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, f ω ≤ b ω := by
      filter_upwards [hf.2] with ω hω
      exact hω.2
    exact ⟨integral_mono_ae ha hf.1 haf,
      integral_mono_ae hf.1 hb hfb⟩
  · intro x hx
    have hconv : Convex ℝ (aumannExpectation μ S) :=
      aumannExpectation_convex
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => convex_Icc (a ω) (b ω))
    have hseg := hconv.segment_subset haMem hbMem
    rw [segment_eq_Icc habInt] at hseg
    exact hseg hx

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_const_Icc
statement:
theorem aumannExpectation_const_Icc
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) :
    aumannExpectation μ (fun _ : Ω => Icc a b) = Icc a b
proof:
:= by
  simpa using aumannExpectation_Icc
    (μ := μ) (integrable_const a) (integrable_const b)
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ => hab)

name: RandomSetTheory.iSup_denseSeq_eq_iSup
statement:
theorem iSup_denseSeq_eq_iSup (f : T → ℝ) (hf : Continuous f) :
    (⨆ k : ℕ, f (denseSeq T k)) = ⨆ t : T, f t
proof:
:= by
  let S : Set T := Set.range (denseSeq T)
  have hS : Dense S := by
    change Dense (Set.range (denseSeq T))
    exact denseRange_denseSeq T
  have hsub : (⨆ s : S, f s) = ⨆ t : T, f t := hS.ciSup' hf
  have hrange :
      Set.range (fun k : ℕ ↦ f (denseSeq T k)) =
        Set.range (fun s : S ↦ f s) := by
    ext y
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨⟨denseSeq T k, ⟨k, rfl⟩⟩, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨t, k, hk⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨k, by simpa using congrArg f hk⟩
  rw [← sSup_range, ← sSup_range, hrange]
  exact hsub

name: RandomSetTheory.iSup_abs_denseSeq_eq_iSup_abs
statement:
theorem iSup_abs_denseSeq_eq_iSup_abs (f : T → ℝ) (hf : Continuous f) :
    (⨆ k : ℕ, |f (denseSeq T k)|) = ⨆ t : T, |f t|
proof:
:= by
  exact iSup_denseSeq_eq_iSup (fun t ↦ |f t|) hf.abs

name: RandomSetTheory.densePrefixSupremum_eq_sup'_range
statement:
theorem densePrefixSupremum_eq_sup'_range (f : T → ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    densePrefixSupremum f n =
      (Finset.range (n + 1)).sup' Finset.nonempty_range_add_one
        (fun k ↦ f (denseSeq T k))
proof:
:=
  partialSups_eq_sup'_range _ n

name: RandomSetTheory.densePrefixSupremum_monotone
statement:
theorem densePrefixSupremum_monotone (f : T → ℝ) :
    Monotone (densePrefixSupremum f)
proof:
:= by
  exact partialSups_monotone _

name: RandomSetTheory.iSup_densePrefixSupremum_eq_iSup
statement:
theorem iSup_densePrefixSupremum_eq_iSup (f : T → ℝ)
    (hf : Continuous f) :
    (⨆ n : ℕ, densePrefixSupremum f n) = ⨆ t : T, f t
proof:
:= by
  change (⨆ n : ℕ, partialSups (fun k : ℕ ↦ f (denseSeq T k)) n) = _
  rw [ciSup_partialSups_eq']
  exact iSup_denseSeq_eq_iSup f hf

name: RandomSetTheory.tendsto_densePrefixSupremum
statement:
theorem tendsto_densePrefixSupremum (f : T → ℝ) (hf : Continuous f)
    (hbdd : BddAbove (Set.range f)) :
    Tendsto (densePrefixSupremum f) atTop (nhds (⨆ t : T, f t))
proof:
:= by
  have hbddDense : BddAbove (Set.range (fun k : ℕ ↦ f (denseSeq T k))) :=
    hbdd.mono (by
      rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨denseSeq T k, rfl⟩)
  have hbddPrefix :
      BddAbove (Set.range (partialSups (fun k : ℕ ↦ f (denseSeq T k)))) :=
    bddAbove_range_partialSups.mpr hbddDense
  have hlim := tendsto_atTop_ciSup
    (partialSups_monotone (fun k : ℕ ↦ f (denseSeq T k))) hbddPrefix
  rw [ciSup_partialSups_eq', iSup_denseSeq_eq_iSup f hf] at hlim
  exact hlim

statement:

:=
  densePrefixSupremum_monotone _

name: RandomSetTheory.iSup_densePrefixAbsSupremum_eq_iSup_abs
statement:
theorem iSup_densePrefixAbsSupremum_eq_iSup_abs (f : T → ℝ)
    (hf : Continuous f) :
    (⨆ n : ℕ, densePrefixAbsSupremum f n) = ⨆ t : T, |f t|

name: RandomSetTheory.tendsto_densePrefixAbsSupremum
statement:
theorem tendsto_densePrefixAbsSupremum (f : T → ℝ) (hf : Continuous f)
    (hbdd : BddAbove (Set.range fun t ↦ |f t|)) :
    Tendsto (densePrefixAbsSupremum f) atTop (nhds (⨆ t : T, |f t|))
proof:
:= by
