name: RandomSetTheory.measurable_densePrefixSupremum
statement:
theorem measurable_densePrefixSupremum (F : Omega → T → ℝ)
    (hF : ∀ k : ℕ, Measurable (fun omega ↦ F omega (denseSeq T k))) (n : ℕ) :
    Measurable (fun omega ↦ densePrefixSupremum (F omega) n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (fun omega ↦ densePrefixSupremum (F omega) n) =
      (fun omega ↦
        (Finset.range (n + 1)).sup' Finset.nonempty_range_add_one
          (fun k ↦ F omega (denseSeq T k))) by
    funext omega
    exact densePrefixSupremum_eq_sup'_range _ n]
  exact Finset.measurable_range_sup'' fun k _hk ↦ hF k

name: RandomSetTheory.measurable_densePrefixAbsSupremum
statement:
theorem measurable_densePrefixAbsSupremum (F : Omega → T → ℝ)
    (hF : ∀ k : ℕ, Measurable (fun omega ↦ F omega (denseSeq T k))) (n : ℕ) :
    Measurable (fun omega ↦ densePrefixAbsSupremum (F omega) n)
proof:
:= by
  apply measurable_densePrefixSupremum (fun omega t ↦ |F omega t|) _ n
  intro k
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using (hF k).norm

name: ProbabilityTheory.subgaussian_finset_sum_abs_real
statement:
theorem subgaussian_finset_sum_abs_real [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (c : ι → ℝ≥0)
    (h_indep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (s : Finset ι)
    (h_subG : ∀ i ∈ s, HasSubgaussianMGF (X i) (c i) μ)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε) :
    μ.real {ω | ε ≤ |∑ i ∈ s, X i ω|} ≤
      2 * exp (-ε ^ 2 / (2 * (↑(∑ i ∈ s, c i) : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  let Xneg : ι → Ω → ℝ := fun i ω => -X i ω
  have h_indep_neg : iIndepFun Xneg μ := by
    exact (h_indep.comp (fun _i => fun x : ℝ => -x) (fun _i => measurable_neg)).congr
      (fun _i => ae_of_all μ fun _ω => rfl)
  have h_subG_neg : ∀ i ∈ s, HasSubgaussianMGF (Xneg i) (c i) μ := by
    intro i hi
    exact (h_subG i hi).neg
  have hpos := HasSubgaussianMGF.measure_sum_ge_le_of_iIndepFun
    h_indep h_subG hε
  have hneg := HasSubgaussianMGF.measure_sum_ge_le_of_iIndepFun
    h_indep_neg h_subG_neg hε
  have hset : {ω | ε ≤ |∑ i ∈ s, X i ω|} =
      {ω | ε ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, X i ω} ∪
      {ω | ε ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, Xneg i ω} := by
    ext ω
    simp only [mem_setOf_eq, mem_union, Xneg]
    rw [show (∑ i ∈ s, -X i ω) = -(∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) by simp]
    rw [le_abs]
  rw [hset]
  calc
    _ ≤ μ.real {ω | ε ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, X i ω} +
        μ.real {ω | ε ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, Xneg i ω} :=
      measureReal_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ exp (-ε ^ 2 / (2 * (↑(∑ i ∈ s, c i) : ℝ))) +
        exp (-ε ^ 2 / (2 * (↑(∑ i ∈ s, c i) : ℝ))) :=
      add_le_add hpos hneg
    _ = 2 * exp (-ε ^ 2 / (2 * (↑(∑ i ∈ s, c i) : ℝ))) := by ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.subgaussian_finset_average_abs_real
statement:
theorem subgaussian_finset_average_abs_real [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (c : ι → ℝ≥0)
    (h_indep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (h_subG : ∀ i ∈ s, HasSubgaussianMGF (X i) (c i) μ)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ |(∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) / (s.card : ℝ)|} ≤
      2 * exp (-((s.card : ℝ) * t) ^ 2 /
        (2 * (↑(∑ i ∈ s, c i) : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : 0 < (s.card : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (Finset.card_pos.mpr hs)
  have htail := subgaussian_finset_sum_abs_real X c h_indep s h_subG
    (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg s.card) ht)
  have hset : {ω | t ≤ |(∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) / (s.card : ℝ)|} =
      {ω | (s.card : ℝ) * t ≤ |∑ i ∈ s, X i ω|} := by
    ext ω
    simp only [mem_setOf_eq, abs_div, abs_of_pos hcard]
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hcard]
    ring_nf
  rw [hset]
  exact htail

name: RandomSetTheory.minkowskiAverage_support_subgaussian
statement:
theorem minkowskiAverage_support_subgaussian
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (S : ι → Ω → Set E) (L : Set E) (u : E)
    (c : ι → ℝ≥0)
    (h_indep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun
      (directionalSupportDeviation S L u) μ)
    (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (h_subG : ∀ i ∈ s, ProbabilityTheory.HasSubgaussianMGF
      (directionalSupportDeviation S L u i) (c i) μ)
    (hScompact : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ ω, IsCompact (S i ω))
    (hSne : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ |supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) u -
        supportFunction L u|} ≤
      2 * exp (-((s.card : ℝ) * t) ^ 2 /
        (2 * (↑(∑ i ∈ s, c i) : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  have htail := ProbabilityTheory.subgaussian_finset_average_abs_real
    (directionalSupportDeviation S L u) c h_indep s hs h_subG ht
  have hset :
      {ω | t ≤ |supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) u -
        supportFunction L u|} =
      {ω | t ≤ |(∑ i ∈ s, directionalSupportDeviation S L u i ω) /
        (s.card : ℝ)|} := by
    ext ω
    simp only [mem_setOf_eq]
    rw [supportFunction_minkowskiAverage_sub_eq_average_deviation
      S L s hs hScompact hSne]
  rw [hset]
  exact htail

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_risk_bound_of_subgaussian
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_risk_bound_of_subgaussian
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (S : ι → Ω → Set E) (L : Set E)
    (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty) (c : ι → ℝ≥0)
    {RS RL eps t : ℝ}
    (hScompact : ∀ i ω, IsCompact (S i ω))
    (hSne : ∀ i ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    (hSconv : ∀ i ω, Convex ℝ (S i ω))
    (hLcompact : IsCompact L) (hLne : L.Nonempty) (hLconv : Convex ℝ L)
    (hRS : ∀ i ω, ∀ x ∈ S i ω, ‖x‖ ≤ RS)
    (hRL : ∀ x ∈ L, ‖x‖ ≤ RL)
    (heps : 0 ≤ eps) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (N : Finset E)
    (hnet : ∀ u : E, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 → ∃ v ∈ N, dist u v ≤ eps)
    (h_indep : ∀ v ∈ N, ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun
      (directionalSupportDeviation S L v) μ)
    (h_subG : ∀ v ∈ N, ∀ i ∈ s, ProbabilityTheory.HasSubgaussianMGF
      (directionalSupportDeviation S L v i) (c i) μ) :
    μ.real {ω | t + (RS + RL) * eps <
        hausdorffDist (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) L} ≤
      N.card * (2 * exp (-((s.card : ℝ) * t) ^ 2 /
        (2 * (↑(∑ i ∈ s, c i) : ℝ))))
proof:
:= by
  apply measureReal_hausdorffDist_gt_le_finset_support
    (μ := μ) (fun ω => minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) (fun _ => L)
    (fun ω => isCompact_minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)
      (fun i hi => hScompact i ω))
    (fun _ => hLcompact)
    (fun ω => nonempty_minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)
      (fun i hi => hSne i ω))
    (fun _ => hLne)
    (fun ω => convex_minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)
      (fun i hi => hSconv i ω))
    (fun _ => hLconv)
    (fun ω x hx => norm_le_radius_of_mem_nonempty_minkowskiAverage s hs
      (fun i => S i ω) (fun i hi => hRS i ω) hx)
    (fun _ => hRL) heps ht
    (by positivity)
    N hnet
  intro v hv
  calc
    μ.real {ω | t < |supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) v -
        supportFunction L v|} ≤
        μ.real {ω | t ≤ |supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) v -
          supportFunction L v|} := by
      apply measureReal_mono
      · intro ω hω
        change t < |supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) v -
          supportFunction L v| at hω
        change t ≤ |supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) v -
          supportFunction L v|
        exact hω.le
      · finiteness
    _ ≤ 2 * exp (-((s.card : ℝ) * t) ^ 2 /
        (2 * (↑(∑ i ∈ s, c i) : ℝ))) :=
      minkowskiAverage_support_subgaussian S L v c
        (h_indep v hv) s hs (h_subG v hv)
        (fun i _hi ω => hScompact i ω)
        (fun i _hi ω => hSne i ω) ht

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_finset_unitBall_net_with_centers
statement:
theorem exists_finset_unitBall_net_with_centers
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ N : Finset E,
      (∀ v ∈ N, ‖v‖ ≤ 1) ∧
      ∀ u : E, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 → ∃ v ∈ N, dist u v < ε
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨t, htunit, htfinite, hcover⟩ :=
    finite_cover_balls_of_compact
      (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E) 1) hε
  refine ⟨htfinite.toFinset, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro v hv
    have hvt : v ∈ t := by simpa using hv
    have hvball := htunit hvt
    simpa [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hvball
  · intro u hu
    have hu' : u ∈ closedBall (0 : E) 1 := by
      simpa [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hu
    obtain ⟨v, hvt, huv⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (hcover hu')
    exact ⟨v, by simpa using hvt, by simpa [mem_ball] using huv⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_finset_unitBall_closedNet_with_centers
statement:
theorem exists_finset_unitBall_closedNet_with_centers
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ N : Finset E,
      (∀ v ∈ N, ‖v‖ ≤ 1) ∧
      ∀ u : E, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 → ∃ v ∈ N, dist u v ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hnet⟩ :=
    exists_finset_unitBall_net_with_centers (E := E) hε
  exact ⟨N, hN, fun u hu => by
    obtain ⟨v, hv, huv⟩ := hnet u hu
    exact ⟨v, hv, huv.le⟩⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.integral_eq_finiteWeightedIntegral
statement:
theorem integral_eq_finiteWeightedIntegral
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsFiniteMeasure mu] (f : Omega -> E) :
    (∫ omega, f omega ∂mu) = finiteWeightedIntegral mu f
proof:
:= by
  letI := Fintype.ofFinite Omega
  exact MeasureTheory.integral_fintype Integrable.of_finite

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_eq_image_finiteWeightedIntegral
statement:
theorem aumannExpectation_eq_image_finiteWeightedIntegral
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsFiniteMeasure mu] {S : Omega -> Set E}
    (hfull : ∀ omega, mu {omega} ≠ 0) :
    aumannExpectation mu S =
      finiteWeightedIntegral mu '' Set.pi Set.univ S
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, hf, hfx⟩
    have hf_pointwise : ∀ omega, f omega ∈ S omega := by
      intro omega
      exact (ae_iff_of_countable.mp hf.2) omega (hfull omega)
    refine ⟨f, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [Set.mem_pi, Set.mem_univ, forall_const] using hf_pointwise
    · rw [← integral_eq_finiteWeightedIntegral f]
      exact hfx
  · rintro ⟨f, hfS, rfl⟩
    have hf_pointwise : ∀ omega, f omega ∈ S omega := by
      simpa only [Set.mem_pi, Set.mem_univ, forall_const] using hfS
    refine ⟨f, ⟨Integrable.of_finite, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall hf_pointwise
    · exact integral_eq_finiteWeightedIntegral f

name: RandomSetTheory.continuous_finiteWeightedIntegral
statement:
theorem continuous_finiteWeightedIntegral (mu : Measure Omega) :
    Continuous (finiteWeightedIntegral (E := E) mu)
proof:
:= by
  letI := Fintype.ofFinite Omega
  change Continuous (fun f : Omega -> E =>
    ∑ omega, mu.real {omega} • f omega)
  apply continuous_finsetSum Finset.univ
  intro omega _
  exact (continuous_apply omega).const_smul _

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_isCompact_of_finite_fullSupport
statement:
theorem aumannExpectation_isCompact_of_finite_fullSupport
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsFiniteMeasure mu] {S : Omega -> Set E}
    (hfull : ∀ omega, mu {omega} ≠ 0)
    (hcompact : ∀ omega, IsCompact (S omega)) :
    IsCompact (aumannExpectation mu S)
proof:
:= by
  rw [aumannExpectation_eq_image_finiteWeightedIntegral hfull]
  exact (isCompact_univ_pi hcompact).image
    (continuous_finiteWeightedIntegral mu)

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_isClosed_of_finite_fullSupport
statement:
theorem aumannExpectation_isClosed_of_finite_fullSupport
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsFiniteMeasure mu] {S : Omega -> Set E}
    (hfull : ∀ omega, mu {omega} ≠ 0)
    (hcompact : ∀ omega, IsCompact (S omega)) :
    IsClosed (aumannExpectation mu S)
proof:
:=
  (aumannExpectation_isCompact_of_finite_fullSupport hfull hcompact).isClosed

name: RandomSetTheory.closure_aumannExpectation_eq_of_finite_fullSupport
statement:
theorem closure_aumannExpectation_eq_of_finite_fullSupport
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsFiniteMeasure mu] {S : Omega -> Set E}
    (hfull : ∀ omega, mu {omega} ≠ 0)
    (hcompact : ∀ omega, IsCompact (S omega)) :
    closure (aumannExpectation mu S) = aumannExpectation mu S
proof:
:=
  (aumannExpectation_isClosed_of_finite_fullSupport hfull hcompact).closure_eq

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_isCompact_nonempty_of_finite_fullSupport
statement:
theorem aumannExpectation_isCompact_nonempty_of_finite_fullSupport
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsFiniteMeasure mu] {S : Omega -> Set E}
    (hfull : ∀ omega, mu {omega} ≠ 0)
    (hcompact : ∀ omega, IsCompact (S omega))
    (hne : ∀ omega, (S omega).Nonempty) :
    IsCompact (aumannExpectation mu S) ∧
      (aumannExpectation mu S).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨aumannExpectation_isCompact_of_finite_fullSupport hfull hcompact, ?_⟩
  choose f hf using hne
  exact aumannExpectation_nonempty_of_selection
    ⟨Integrable.of_finite, Filter.Eventually.of_forall hf⟩

name: ProbabilityTheory.integral_canonicalRademacherSign_eq_zero
statement:
theorem integral_canonicalRademacherSign_eq_zero :

name: RandomSetTheory.hitEvent_closed_eq_iInter_thickening_of_compact_values
statement:
theorem hitEvent_closed_eq_iInter_thickening_of_compact_values
    [MetricSpace X] {S : Ω → Set X} (hScompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    {F : Set X} (hF : IsClosed F) :
    hitEvent S F =
      ⋂ n : ℕ, hitEvent S (Metric.thickening (1 / (n + 1 : ℝ)) F)
proof:
:= by
  ext ω
  simp only [Set.mem_iInter, mem_hitEvent]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hxS, hxF⟩ n
    refine ⟨x, hxS, ?_⟩
    exact Metric.self_subset_thickening
      (by positivity : 0 < 1 / (n + 1 : ℝ)) F hxF
  · intro hhit
    by_contra hnot
    have hdisj : Disjoint (S ω) F := by
      rw [Set.disjoint_left]
      intro x hxS hxF
      exact hnot ⟨x, hxS, hxF⟩
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hthick⟩ :=
      hdisj.exists_thickenings (hScompact ω) hF
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_one_div_lt hδ
    rcases hhit n with ⟨x, hxS, hxF⟩
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hthick
      (Metric.self_subset_thickening hδ (S ω) hxS)
      (Metric.thickening_mono hn.le F hxF)

    MeasurableSet (hitEvent S F)

  exact MeasurableSet.iInter fun n =>
    measurableSet_hitEvent_open hS Metric.isOpen_thickening

name: RandomSetTheory.measurableSet_subset_open_of_effros_of_compact_values
proof:
:= by
  have hEq : {ω | S ω ⊆ U} = (hitEvent S Uᶜ)ᶜ := by
    ext ω
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_compl_iff, mem_hitEvent]
    constructor
    · intro h hhit
      rcases hhit with ⟨x, hxS, hxUc⟩
      exact hxUc (h hxS)
    · intro h x hxS
      by_contra hxU
      exact h ⟨x, hxS, hxU⟩
  rw [hEq]
  exact (measurableSet_hitEvent_closed_of_compact_values
    hS hScompact hU.isClosed_compl).compl

    (hScompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω)) (hSne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)

name: RandomSetTheory.measurableSet_preimage_vietorisBasic
statement:
private theorem measurableSet_preimage_vietorisBasic
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MetricSpace X]
    {S : Ω → Set X} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hScompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω)) (hSne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    {u : Set (Set X)} (huFinite : u.Finite)
    (huOpen : ∀ U ∈ u, IsOpen U) :
    MeasurableSet
      (bundleNonemptyCompacts S hScompact hSne ⁻¹'
        {K : NonemptyCompacts X |
          (K : Set X) ⊆ ⋃₀ u ∧ ∀ U ∈ u, ((K : Set X) ∩ U).Nonempty})
proof:
:= by
  have hUnionOpen : IsOpen (⋃₀ u) :=
    isOpen_sUnion fun U hU => huOpen U hU
  have hUpper : MeasurableSet {ω | S ω ⊆ ⋃₀ u} :=
    measurableSet_subset_open_of_effros_of_compact_values
      hS hScompact hUnionOpen
  letI := huFinite.to_subtype
  have hLower : MeasurableSet (⋂ U : u, hitEvent S (U : Set X)) :=
    MeasurableSet.iInter fun U =>
      measurableSet_hitEvent_open hS (huOpen U U.property)
  have hEq :
      bundleNonemptyCompacts S hScompact hSne ⁻¹'
          {K : NonemptyCompacts X |
            (K : Set X) ⊆ ⋃₀ u ∧ ∀ U ∈ u, ((K : Set X) ∩ U).Nonempty} =
        {ω | S ω ⊆ ⋃₀ u} ∩ ⋂ U : u, hitEvent S (U : Set X) := by
    ext ω
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_setOf_eq, coe_bundleNonemptyCompacts,
      Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_iInter, mem_hitEvent]
    exact and_congr_right fun _ => by
      constructor
      · intro h U
        exact h U U.property
      · intro h U hU
        exact h ⟨U, hU⟩
  rw [hEq]
  exact hUpper.inter hLower

name: RandomSetTheory.measurable_bundleNonemptyCompacts
statement:
theorem measurable_bundleNonemptyCompacts
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MetricSpace X] [SecondCountableTopology X]
    [MeasurableSpace (NonemptyCompacts X)] [BorelSpace (NonemptyCompacts X)]
    {S : Ω → Set X} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hScompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω)) (hSne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty) :
    Measurable (bundleNonemptyCompacts S hScompact hSne)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B, hBcountable, _hBempty, hBbasis⟩ :=
    TopologicalSpace.exists_countable_basis X
  let D : Set (Set (Set X)) :=
    {u | u.Finite ∧ u.Nonempty ∧ u ⊆ B}
  let basic : Set (Set X) → Set (NonemptyCompacts X) :=
    fun u => {K | (K : Set X) ⊆ ⋃₀ u ∧
      ∀ U ∈ u, ((K : Set X) ∩ U).Nonempty}
  let C : Set (Set (NonemptyCompacts X)) := basic '' D
  have hDcountable : D.Countable := by
    apply (Set.countable_setOf_finite_subset hBcountable).mono
    intro u hu
    exact ⟨hu.1, hu.2.2⟩
  have hCcountable : C.Countable := hDcountable.image basic
  have hCbasis : IsTopologicalBasis C := by
    simpa only [C, D, basic] using hBbasis.nonemptyCompacts
  apply measurable_of_isOpen
  intro V hV
  obtain ⟨A, hAC, hVA⟩ := hCbasis.open_eq_sUnion hV
  have hAcountable : A.Countable := hCcountable.mono hAC
  letI := hAcountable.to_subtype
  have hPreimage :
      bundleNonemptyCompacts S hScompact hSne ⁻¹' ⋃₀ A =
        ⋃ W : A,
          bundleNonemptyCompacts S hScompact hSne ⁻¹' (W : Set (NonemptyCompacts X)) := by
    ext ω
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_sUnion, Set.mem_iUnion]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨W, hWA, hωW⟩
      exact ⟨⟨W, hWA⟩, hωW⟩
    · rintro ⟨W, hωW⟩
      exact ⟨W, W.property, hωW⟩
  rw [hVA, hPreimage]
  apply MeasurableSet.iUnion
  intro W
  have hWC : (W : Set (NonemptyCompacts X)) ∈ C := hAC W.property
  rcases hWC with ⟨u, huD, huW⟩
  rw [← huW]
  exact measurableSet_preimage_vietorisBasic hS hScompact hSne
    huD.1 (fun U hU => hBbasis.isOpen (huD.2.2 hU))

name: RandomSetTheory.measurable_bundleNonemptyCompacts_borel
statement:
theorem measurable_bundleNonemptyCompacts_borel
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MetricSpace X] [SecondCountableTopology X]
    {S : Ω → Set X} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hScompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω)) (hSne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty) :
    @Measurable Ω (NonemptyCompacts X) _ (borel (NonemptyCompacts X))
      (bundleNonemptyCompacts S hScompact hSne)
proof:
:= by
  letI : MeasurableSpace (NonemptyCompacts X) := borel (NonemptyCompacts X)
  haveI : BorelSpace (NonemptyCompacts X) := ⟨rfl⟩
  exact measurable_bundleNonemptyCompacts hS hScompact hSne

name: RandomSetTheory.effrosMeasurable_coe_of_measurable_nonemptyCompacts
statement:
theorem effrosMeasurable_coe_of_measurable_nonemptyCompacts
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] [TopologicalSpace X]
    [MeasurableSpace (NonemptyCompacts X)]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace (NonemptyCompacts X)]
    {K : Ω → NonemptyCompacts X} (hK : Measurable K) :
    RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable (fun ω => (K ω : Set X))
proof:

  intro U hU
  change MeasurableSet
    (K ⁻¹' {L : NonemptyCompacts X | ((L : Set X) ∩ U).Nonempty})

    (TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts.isOpen_inter_nonempty_of_isOpen hU).measurableSet

name: RandomSetTheory.effrosMeasurable_iff_measurable_bundleNonemptyCompacts
statement:
theorem effrosMeasurable_iff_measurable_bundleNonemptyCompacts
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MetricSpace X] [SecondCountableTopology X]
    [MeasurableSpace (NonemptyCompacts X)] [BorelSpace (NonemptyCompacts X)]
    {S : Ω → Set X} (hScompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hSne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty) :
    RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S ↔
      Measurable (bundleNonemptyCompacts S hScompact hSne)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hS
    exact measurable_bundleNonemptyCompacts hS hScompact hSne
  · intro hBundle
    simpa only [coe_bundleNonemptyCompacts] using
      effrosMeasurable_coe_of_measurable_nonemptyCompacts hBundle

name: RandomSetTheory.measurable_hausdorffDist_compact_correspondence_hyperspace
statement:
theorem measurable_hausdorffDist_compact_correspondence_hyperspace
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MetricSpace X] [SecondCountableTopology X]
    [MeasurableSpace (NonemptyCompacts X)] [BorelSpace (NonemptyCompacts X)]
    {S T : Ω → Set X}
    (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hT : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable T)
    (hScompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hTcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (T ω))
    (hSne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty) (hTne : ∀ ω, (T ω).Nonempty) :
    Measurable (fun ω => hausdorffDist (S ω) (T ω))
proof:
:= by
  have hKS : Measurable (bundleNonemptyCompacts S hScompact hSne) :=
    measurable_bundleNonemptyCompacts hS hScompact hSne
  have hKT : Measurable (bundleNonemptyCompacts T hTcompact hTne) :=
    measurable_bundleNonemptyCompacts hT hTcompact hTne
  have hdist := hKS.dist hKT
  simpa only [Metric.NonemptyCompacts.dist_eq, coe_bundleNonemptyCompacts] using hdist

name: RandomSetTheory.capacityFunctional_eq_map_bundleNonemptyCompacts_hit_open
statement:
theorem capacityFunctional_eq_map_bundleNonemptyCompacts_hit_open
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MetricSpace X] [SecondCountableTopology X]
    [MeasurableSpace (NonemptyCompacts X)] [BorelSpace (NonemptyCompacts X)]
    (μ : Measure Ω) {S : Ω → Set X}

statement:
theorem measurable_bundleCompactConvexSet
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    [MeasurableSpace (NonemptyCompacts E)] [BorelSpace (NonemptyCompacts E)]
    [MeasurableSpace (CompactConvexSet E)] [BorelSpace (CompactConvexSet E)]
    {S : Ω → Set E} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hScompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω)) (hSne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    (hSconvex : ∀ ω, Convex ℝ (S ω)) :
    Measurable (bundleCompactConvexSet S hScompact hSne hSconvex)
proof:
:= by
  have hBundle : Measurable (bundleNonemptyCompacts S hScompact hSne) :=
    measurable_bundleNonemptyCompacts hS hScompact hSne
  apply measurable_of_isOpen
  intro V hV
  have hInducing : Topology.IsInducing
      (fun K : CompactConvexSet E => K.1) := by
    change Topology.IsInducing
      (Subtype.val : {K : NonemptyCompacts E // Convex ℝ (K : Set E)} →
        NonemptyCompacts E)
    exact isometry_subtype_coe.isEmbedding.isInducing
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hVU⟩ := hInducing.isOpen_iff.mp hV
  rw [← hVU]
  change MeasurableSet
    (bundleNonemptyCompacts S hScompact hSne ⁻¹' U)
  exact hBundle hU.measurableSet

theorem IndepFun.condDistrib_ae_eq_const
    {Omega Beta Gamma : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace Omega] [MeasurableSpace Beta]
    [MeasurableSpace Gamma] [StandardBorelSpace Gamma] [Nonempty Gamma]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {X : Omega -> Beta} {Y : Omega -> Gamma}
    (hXY : IndepFun X Y mu)
    (hX : AEMeasurable X mu) (hY : AEMeasurable Y mu) :
    condDistrib Y X mu =ᵐ[mu.map X] Kernel.const Beta (mu.map Y)
proof:
:= by
  apply condDistrib_ae_eq_of_measure_eq_compProd X hY
  rw [Measure.compProd_const]

name: ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun.condExp_prod_ae_eq_integral_map
statement:
theorem IndepFun.condExp_prod_ae_eq_integral_map
    {Omega Beta Gamma : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace Omega] [MeasurableSpace Beta]
    [MeasurableSpace Gamma] [StandardBorelSpace Gamma] [Nonempty Gamma]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {X : Omega -> Beta} {Y : Omega -> Gamma}
    (hXY : IndepFun X Y mu)
    (hX : Measurable X) (hY : Measurable Y)
    (f : Beta × Gamma -> Real) (hf : StronglyMeasurable f)
    (hfint : Integrable (fun omega => f (X omega, Y omega)) mu) :
    mu[fun omega => f (X omega, Y omega) |
        MeasurableSpace.comap X inferInstance] =ᵐ[mu]
      fun omega => integral (mu.map Y) (fun y => f (X omega, y))
proof:
:= by
  have hbase := condExp_prod_ae_eq_integral_condDistrib
    hX hY.aemeasurable hf hfint
  have hkernelMap := hXY.condDistrib_ae_eq_const
    hX.aemeasurable hY.aemeasurable
  have hkernel : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      condDistrib Y X mu (X omega) = mu.map Y := by
    have hcomp := ae_of_ae_map hX.aemeasurable hkernelMap
    filter_upwards [hcomp] with omega homega
    simpa only [Kernel.const_apply] using homega
  filter_upwards [hbase, hkernel] with omega hbaseOmega hkernelOmega
  rw [hbaseOmega, hkernelOmega]

name: ProbabilityTheory.stronglyMeasurable_finiteReplaceOneCenteredSupremum
statement:
theorem stronglyMeasurable_finiteReplaceOneCenteredSupremum
    {Beta : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Beta]
    [IsFiniteMeasure nu]
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (r : Beta -> T -> Real) (X : Z -> T -> Real)
    (hr : forall t, t ∈ s -> Measurable (fun b => r b t))
    (hX : forall t, t ∈ s -> Measurable (fun z => X z t)) :
    StronglyMeasurable
      (finiteReplaceOneCenteredSupremum nu s hs r X)
proof:
:= by
  let G : Beta × Z -> Real := fun bz =>
    finiteReplaceOneSupremum s hs (r bz.1) X bz.2
  have hG : Measurable G := by
    apply measurable_finiteProcessSupremum s hs
    intro t ht
    exact ((hr t ht).comp measurable_fst).add
      ((hX t ht).comp measurable_snd)
  have hmean : StronglyMeasurable
      (fun b => integral nu (fun z => G (b, z))) :=
    hG.stronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_right'
  exact hG.stronglyMeasurable.sub
    (hmean.comp_measurable measurable_fst)

name: ProbabilityTheory.condExp_finiteReplaceOneCenteredSupremum_ae_eq_zero
statement:
theorem condExp_finiteReplaceOneCenteredSupremum_ae_eq_zero
    {Omega Beta : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace Omega] [MeasurableSpace Beta]
    [StandardBorelSpace Z] [Nonempty Z]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (P : Omega -> Beta) (Y : Omega -> Z)
    (hPY : IndepFun P Y mu) (hP : Measurable P) (hY : Measurable Y)
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (r : Beta -> T -> Real) (X : Z -> T -> Real)
    (hr : forall t, t ∈ s -> Measurable (fun b => r b t))
    (hX : forall t, t ∈ s -> Measurable (fun z => X z t))
    (hFiberInt : forall b, Integrable
      (finiteReplaceOneSupremum s hs (r b) X) (mu.map Y))
    (hDint : Integrable (fun omega =>
      finiteReplaceOneCenteredSupremum (mu.map Y) s hs r X
        (P omega, Y omega)) mu) :
    mu[fun omega =>
        finiteReplaceOneCenteredSupremum (mu.map Y) s hs r X
          (P omega, Y omega) |
        MeasurableSpace.comap P inferInstance] =ᵐ[mu] 0
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (mu.map Y) :=
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hY.aemeasurable
  have hstrong := stronglyMeasurable_finiteReplaceOneCenteredSupremum
    (nu := mu.map Y) s hs r X hr hX
  have hbase := hPY.condExp_prod_ae_eq_integral_map hP hY
    (finiteReplaceOneCenteredSupremum (mu.map Y) s hs r X)
    hstrong hDint
  filter_upwards [hbase] with omega hbaseOmega
  rw [hbaseOmega]
  unfold finiteReplaceOneCenteredSupremum
  simp only [Pi.zero_apply]
  rw [integral_sub (hFiberInt (P omega)) (integrable_const _)]
  simp only [integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul, sub_self]

statement:
theorem abs_finiteReplaceOneSupremum_sub_le_add_envelopes
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (r : T -> Real) (X : Z -> T -> Real) (A : Z -> Real)
    (hdom : forall z t, t ∈ s -> |X z t| <= A z)
    (z z' : Z) :
    |finiteReplaceOneSupremum s hs r X z -
        finiteReplaceOneSupremum s hs r X z'| <= A z + A z'
proof:
:= by

name: ProbabilityTheory.sq_finiteReplaceOneSupremum_sub_le_two_mul_add
statement:
theorem sq_finiteReplaceOneSupremum_sub_le_two_mul_add
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (r : T -> Real) (X : Z -> T -> Real) (A : Z -> Real)
    (hA : forall z, 0 <= A z)
    (hdom : forall z t, t ∈ s -> |X z t| <= A z)
    (z z' : Z) :
    (finiteReplaceOneSupremum s hs r X z -
        finiteReplaceOneSupremum s hs r X z') ^ 2 <=
      2 * A z ^ 2 + 2 * A z' ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hreplace := abs_finiteReplaceOneSupremum_sub_le_add_envelopes
    s hs r X A hdom z z'
  have hsum : 0 <= A z + A z' := add_nonneg (hA z) (hA z')
  have hsq :
      (finiteReplaceOneSupremum s hs r X z -
          finiteReplaceOneSupremum s hs r X z') ^ 2 <=
        (A z + A z') ^ 2 := by
    rw [sq_le_sq]
    simpa only [abs_of_nonneg hsum] using hreplace
  calc
    (finiteReplaceOneSupremum s hs r X z -
        finiteReplaceOneSupremum s hs r X z') ^ 2 <=
        (A z + A z') ^ 2 := hsq
    _ <= 2 * A z ^ 2 + 2 * A z' ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (A z - A z')]

name: ProbabilityTheory.memLp_finiteReplaceOneSupremum_two
statement:
theorem memLp_finiteReplaceOneSupremum_two
    [IsFiniteMeasure nu]
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (r : T -> Real) (X : Z -> T -> Real) (A : Z -> Real)
    (hX : forall t, t ∈ s -> Measurable (fun z => X z t))
    (hA : forall z, 0 <= A z)
    (hdom : forall z t, t ∈ s -> |X z t| <= A z)
    (hA2 : MemLp A 2 nu) :
    MemLp (finiteReplaceOneSupremum s hs r X) 2 nu
proof:
:= by
  let C : Real := s.sup' hs (fun t => |r t|)
  have hC : 0 <= C := by
    let t0 : T := hs.choose
    have ht0 : t0 ∈ s := hs.choose_spec
    exact (abs_nonneg (r t0)).trans
      (Finset.le_sup' (fun t => |r t|) ht0)
  have henv : MemLp (fun z => C + A z) 2 nu :=
    (memLp_const C).add hA2
  apply henv.mono'
    (measurable_finiteReplaceOneSupremum s hs r X hX).aestronglyMeasurable
  filter_upwards [] with z
  have hbound : |finiteReplaceOneSupremum s hs r X z| <= C + A z := by
    have hraw := abs_finiteProcessSupremum_le s hs
      (fun t z => r t + X z t) (fun z => C + A z) (fun z' t ht => by
        have henvnonneg' : 0 <= C + A z' := add_nonneg hC (hA z')
        rw [abs_of_nonneg henvnonneg']
        calc
          |r t + X z' t| <= |r t| + |X z' t| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ <= C + A z' := add_le_add
            (Finset.le_sup' (fun u => |r u|) ht) (hdom z' t ht)) z
    change |finiteProcessSupremum s hs (fun t z => r t + X z t) z| <=
      C + A z
    exact hraw.trans_eq (abs_of_nonneg (add_nonneg hC (hA z)))
  have henvnonneg : 0 <= C + A z := add_nonneg hC (hA z)
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg henvnonneg] using hbound

name: ProbabilityTheory.integral_sq_sub_ghost_eq_two_mul_variance
statement:
theorem integral_sq_sub_ghost_eq_two_mul_variance
    [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (F : Z -> Real) (hF : MemLp F 2 nu) :
    integral (nu.prod nu) (fun zz : Z × Z => (F zz.1 - F zz.2) ^ 2) =
      2 * variance F nu
proof:
:= by
  let D : Z × Z -> Real := fun zz => F zz.1 - F zz.2
  have hD : MemLp D 2 (nu.prod nu) := by
    exact (hF.comp_fst nu).sub (hF.comp_snd nu)
  have hDmean : integral (nu.prod nu) D = 0 := by
    have hDint : Integrable D (nu.prod nu) := hD.integrable (by norm_num)
    rw [integral_prod D hDint]
    have hFint : Integrable F nu := hF.integrable (by norm_num)
    have hinner : (fun x => integral nu (fun y => D (x, y))) =
        fun x => F x - integral nu F := by
      funext x
      simp only [D]
      rw [integral_sub (integrable_const _) hFint]
      simp only [integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul]
    rw [hinner, integral_sub hFint (integrable_const _)]
    simp only [integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul, sub_self]
  have hvarD : variance D (nu.prod nu) = 2 * variance F nu := by
    have hbase := variance_add_prod (μ := nu) (ν := nu) hF hF.neg
    calc
      variance D (nu.prod nu) =
          variance (fun p : Z × Z => F p.1 + (-F) p.2) (nu.prod nu) := by
            rfl
      _ = variance F nu + variance (-F) nu := hbase
      _ = 2 * variance F nu := by rw [variance_neg]; ring
  rw [← hvarD, variance_of_integral_eq_zero hD.aemeasurable hDmean]

name: ProbabilityTheory.variance_le_two_mul_integral_sq_of_abs_sub_le_add_envelopes
statement:
theorem variance_le_two_mul_integral_sq_of_abs_sub_le_add_envelopes
    [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (F A : Z -> Real) (hF2 : MemLp F 2 nu) (hA2 : MemLp A 2 nu)
    (hA : forall z, 0 <= A z)
    (hreplace : forall z z', |F z - F z'| <= A z + A z') :
    variance F nu <= 2 * integral nu (fun z => A z ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hghostInt : Integrable
      (fun zz : Z × Z => (F zz.1 - F zz.2) ^ 2) (nu.prod nu) :=
    ((hF2.comp_fst nu).sub (hF2.comp_snd nu)).integrable_sq
  have hAint : Integrable (fun z => A z ^ 2) nu := hA2.integrable_sq
  have hpoint : forall z z',
      (F z - F z') ^ 2 <= 2 * A z ^ 2 + 2 * A z' ^ 2 := by
    intro z z'
    have hsum : 0 <= A z + A z' := add_nonneg (hA z) (hA z')
    have hsq : (F z - F z') ^ 2 <= (A z + A z') ^ 2 := by
      rw [sq_le_sq]
      simpa only [abs_of_nonneg hsum] using hreplace z z'
    calc
      (F z - F z') ^ 2 <= (A z + A z') ^ 2 := hsq
      _ <= 2 * A z ^ 2 + 2 * A z' ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (A z - A z')]
  have hboundInt :
      integral (nu.prod nu) (fun zz : Z × Z => (F zz.1 - F zz.2) ^ 2) <=
        integral (nu.prod nu) (fun zz : Z × Z =>
          2 * A zz.1 ^ 2 + 2 * A zz.2 ^ 2) := by
    apply integral_mono hghostInt
    · exact ((hAint.comp_fst nu).const_mul 2).add
        ((hAint.comp_snd nu).const_mul 2)
    · exact fun zz => hpoint zz.1 zz.2
  have hrhs :
      integral (nu.prod nu) (fun zz : Z × Z =>
          2 * A zz.1 ^ 2 + 2 * A zz.2 ^ 2) =
        4 * integral nu (fun z => A z ^ 2) := by
    rw [integral_add
      ((hAint.comp_fst nu).const_mul 2)
      ((hAint.comp_snd nu).const_mul 2),
      integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]
    have hfst : integral (nu.prod nu) (fun zz : Z × Z => A zz.1 ^ 2) =
        integral nu (fun z => A z ^ 2) := by
      simpa only [probReal_univ, one_smul] using
        (integral_fun_fst (μ := nu) (ν := nu) (fun z => A z ^ 2))
    have hsnd : integral (nu.prod nu) (fun zz : Z × Z => A zz.2 ^ 2) =
        integral nu (fun z => A z ^ 2) := by
      simpa only [probReal_univ, one_smul] using
        (integral_fun_snd (μ := nu) (ν := nu) (fun z => A z ^ 2))
    rw [hfst, hsnd]
    ring
  have hghost := integral_sq_sub_ghost_eq_two_mul_variance F hF2
  rw [hghost, hrhs] at hboundInt
  linarith

name: ProbabilityTheory.condExp_sq_centeredGhostFiber_le
statement:
theorem condExp_sq_centeredGhostFiber_le
    {Omega Beta : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace Omega] [MeasurableSpace Beta]
    [StandardBorelSpace Z] [Nonempty Z]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (P : Omega -> Beta) (Y : Omega -> Z)
    (hPY : IndepFun P Y mu) (hP : Measurable P) (hY : Measurable Y)
    (G : Beta -> Z -> Real) (A : Z -> Real)
    (hG : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry G))
    (hG2 : forall b, MemLp (G b) 2 (mu.map Y))
    (hA2 : MemLp A 2 (mu.map Y)) (hA : forall z, 0 <= A z)
    (hreplace : forall b z z', |G b z - G b z'| <= A z + A z')
    (hD2 : MemLp (fun omega =>
      G (P omega) (Y omega) - integral (mu.map Y) (G (P omega))) 2 mu) :
    ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      mu[fun omega' =>
          (G (P omega') (Y omega') -
            integral (mu.map Y) (G (P omega'))) ^ 2 |
          MeasurableSpace.comap P inferInstance] omega <=
        2 * integral (mu.map Y) (fun z => A z ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (mu.map Y) :=
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hY.aemeasurable
  have hmean : StronglyMeasurable
      (fun b => integral (mu.map Y) (G b)) :=
    hG.integral_prod_right
  have hcentered : StronglyMeasurable (fun bz : Beta × Z =>
      G bz.1 bz.2 - integral (mu.map Y) (G bz.1)) :=
    hG.sub (hmean.comp_measurable measurable_fst)
  have hbase := hPY.condExp_prod_ae_eq_integral_map hP hY
    (fun bz : Beta × Z =>
      (G bz.1 bz.2 - integral (mu.map Y) (G bz.1)) ^ 2)
    (hcentered.pow 2) hD2.integrable_sq
  filter_upwards [hbase] with omega hbaseOmega
  rw [hbaseOmega]
  have hvar := variance_le_two_mul_integral_sq_of_abs_sub_le_add_envelopes
    (nu := mu.map Y) (G (P omega)) A (hG2 (P omega)) hA2 hA
      (hreplace (P omega))
  rw [variance_eq_integral (hG2 (P omega)).aemeasurable] at hvar
  exact hvar

name: ProbabilityTheory.variance_finiteReplaceOneSupremum_le_two_mul_integral_sq
statement:
theorem variance_finiteReplaceOneSupremum_le_two_mul_integral_sq
    [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (r : T -> Real) (X : Z -> T -> Real) (A : Z -> Real)

      2 * integral nu (fun z => A z ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  let F : Z -> Real := finiteReplaceOneSupremum s hs r X
  have hF2 : MemLp F 2 nu :=

      integral (nu.prod nu) (fun zz : Z × Z => (F zz.1 - F zz.2) ^ 2) <=
        integral (nu.prod nu) (fun zz : Z × Z =>
          2 * A zz.1 ^ 2 + 2 * A zz.2 ^ 2) := by
    apply integral_mono hghostInt
    · exact ((hAint.comp_fst nu).const_mul 2).add
        ((hAint.comp_snd nu).const_mul 2)
    · intro zz
      exact sq_finiteReplaceOneSupremum_sub_le_two_mul_add
        s hs r X A hA hdom zz.1 zz.2
  have hrhs :
      integral (nu.prod nu) (fun zz : Z × Z =>
          2 * A zz.1 ^ 2 + 2 * A zz.2 ^ 2) =
        4 * integral nu (fun z => A z ^ 2) := by
    rw [integral_add
      ((hAint.comp_fst nu).const_mul 2)

        integral nu (fun z => A z ^ 2) := by
      simpa only [probReal_univ, one_smul] using
        (integral_fun_fst (μ := nu) (ν := nu) (fun z => A z ^ 2))
    have hsnd : integral (nu.prod nu) (fun zz : Z × Z => A zz.2 ^ 2) =
        integral nu (fun z => A z ^ 2) := by
      simpa only [probReal_univ, one_smul] using
        (integral_fun_snd (μ := nu) (ν := nu) (fun z => A z ^ 2))
    rw [hfst, hsnd]
    ring
  have hghost := integral_sq_sub_ghost_eq_two_mul_variance F hF2
  rw [hghost, hrhs] at hboundInt
  linarith

name: ProbabilityTheory.condExp_sq_finiteReplaceOneCenteredSupremum_le
statement:
theorem condExp_sq_finiteReplaceOneCenteredSupremum_le

    [MeasurableSpace Omega] [MeasurableSpace Beta]

name: ProbabilityTheory.condExp_sq_finiteReplaceOneCenteredSupremum_const_mul_le
statement:
theorem condExp_sq_finiteReplaceOneCenteredSupremum_const_mul_le
    {Omega Beta : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace Omega] [MeasurableSpace Beta]
    [StandardBorelSpace Z] [Nonempty Z]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (P : Omega -> Beta) (Y : Omega -> Z)
    (hPY : IndepFun P Y mu) (hP : Measurable P) (hY : Measurable Y)
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (r : Beta -> T -> Real) (X : Z -> T -> Real) (A : Z -> Real)
    (c : Real)
    (hr : forall t, t ∈ s -> Measurable (fun b => r b t))
    (hX : forall t, t ∈ s -> Measurable (fun z => X z t))
    (hA : forall z, 0 <= A z)
    (hdom : forall z t, t ∈ s -> |X z t| <= A z)
    (hA2 : MemLp A 2 (mu.map Y))
    (hD2 : MemLp (fun omega =>
      finiteReplaceOneCenteredSupremum (mu.map Y) s hs r
        (fun z t => c * X z t) (P omega, Y omega)) 2 mu) :
    ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      mu[fun omega' =>
          finiteReplaceOneCenteredSupremum (mu.map Y) s hs r
            (fun z t => c * X z t) (P omega', Y omega') ^ 2 |
          MeasurableSpace.comap P inferInstance] omega <=
        2 * c ^ 2 * integral (mu.map Y) (fun z => A z ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  let Ac : Z -> Real := fun z => |c| * A z
  have hXc : forall t, t ∈ s ->
      Measurable (fun z => c * X z t) := by
    intro t ht
    exact measurable_const.mul (hX t ht)
  have hAc : forall z, 0 <= Ac z := by
    intro z
    exact mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg c) (hA z)
  have hdomc : forall z t, t ∈ s -> |c * X z t| <= Ac z := by
    intro z t ht
    rw [abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hdom z t ht) (abs_nonneg c)
  have hAc2 : MemLp Ac 2 (mu.map Y) := by
    simpa only [Ac] using hA2.const_mul |c|
  have hbase := condExp_sq_finiteReplaceOneCenteredSupremum_le
    P Y hPY hP hY s hs r (fun z t => c * X z t) Ac
      hr hXc hAc hdomc hAc2 hD2
  have hint : integral (mu.map Y) (fun z => Ac z ^ 2) =
      c ^ 2 * integral (mu.map Y) (fun z => A z ^ 2) := by
    simp only [Ac, mul_pow, sq_abs]
    rw [integral_const_mul]
  filter_upwards [hbase] with omega hbaseOmega
  rw [hint] at hbaseOmega
  simpa only [mul_assoc] using hbaseOmega

theorem variance_finiteReplaceOneSupremum_const_mul_le_two_mul_sq
    [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (r : T -> Real) (X : Z -> T -> Real) (A : Z -> Real)
    (c K2 : Real)
    (hX : forall t, t ∈ s -> Measurable (fun z => X z t))
    (hA : forall z, 0 <= A z)
    (hdom : forall z t, t ∈ s -> |X z t| <= A z)
    (hA2 : MemLp A 2 nu)
    (hsecond : integral nu (fun z => A z ^ 2) <= K2 ^ 2) :
    variance
        (finiteReplaceOneSupremum s hs r (fun z t => c * X z t)) nu <=
      2 * c ^ 2 * K2 ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  calc
    variance
        (finiteReplaceOneSupremum s hs r (fun z t => c * X z t)) nu <=
        2 * c ^ 2 * integral nu (fun z => A z ^ 2) :=
      variance_finiteReplaceOneSupremum_const_mul_le
        s hs r X A c hX hA hdom hA2
    _ <= 2 * c ^ 2 * K2 ^ 2 := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsecond (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (sq_nonneg c))

name: ProbabilityTheory.abs_finiteReplaceOneSupremum_sub_integral_le_two_mul
statement:
theorem abs_finiteReplaceOneSupremum_sub_integral_le_two_mul
    [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (r : T -> Real) (X : Z -> T -> Real) (A : Z -> Real)
    (hX : forall t, t ∈ s -> Measurable (fun z => X z t))
    (hA : forall z, 0 <= A z)
    (hdom : forall z t, t ∈ s -> |X z t| <= A z)
    (hA2 : MemLp A 2 nu)
    {B : Real} (hAbound : forall z, A z <= B)
    (z : Z) :
    |finiteReplaceOneSupremum s hs r X z -
        integral nu (finiteReplaceOneSupremum s hs r X)| <= 2 * B
proof:
:= by
  let F : Z -> Real := finiteReplaceOneSupremum s hs r X
  have hF2 : MemLp F 2 nu :=
    memLp_finiteReplaceOneSupremum_two s hs r X A hX hA hdom hA2
  have hFint : Integrable F nu := hF2.integrable (by norm_num)
  have hdiffInt : Integrable (fun z' => F z - F z') nu :=
    (integrable_const _).sub hFint
  have heq : F z - integral nu F = integral nu (fun z' => F z - F z') := by
    rw [integral_sub (integrable_const _) hFint]
    simp only [integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul]
  rw [heq]
  have hnorm := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
    (μ := nu) (f := fun z' => F z - F z') (C := 2 * B)
    (ae_of_all nu fun z' => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      calc
        |F z - F z'| <= A z + A z' :=
          abs_finiteReplaceOneSupremum_sub_le_add_envelopes
            s hs r X A hdom z z'
        _ <= B + B := add_le_add (hAbound z) (hAbound z')
        _ = 2 * B := by ring)
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, probReal_univ, mul_one] using hnorm

name: ProbabilityTheory.hasBernsteinMGF_finiteReplaceOneSupremum_sub_integral
statement:
theorem hasBernsteinMGF_finiteReplaceOneSupremum_sub_integral
    [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (r : T -> Real) (X : Z -> T -> Real) (A : Z -> Real)
    (hX : forall t, t ∈ s -> Measurable (fun z => X z t))
    (hA : forall z, 0 <= A z)
    (hdom : forall z t, t ∈ s -> |X z t| <= A z)
    (hA2 : MemLp A 2 nu)
    {K2 B : Real} (hB : 0 <= B)
    (hAbound : forall z, A z <= B)
    (hsecond : integral nu (fun z => A z ^ 2) <= K2 ^ 2) :
    HasBernsteinMGF
      (fun z => finiteReplaceOneSupremum s hs r X z -
        integral nu (finiteReplaceOneSupremum s hs r X))
      ⟨4 * K2 ^ 2, mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (sq_nonneg K2)⟩
      ⟨2 * B, mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hB⟩ nu
proof:
:= by
  let F : Z -> Real := finiteReplaceOneSupremum s hs r X
  let D : Z -> Real := fun z => F z - integral nu F
  have hF2 : MemLp F 2 nu :=
    memLp_finiteReplaceOneSupremum_two s hs r X A hX hA hdom hA2
  have hFint : Integrable F nu := hF2.integrable (by norm_num)
  have hD2 : MemLp D 2 nu := hF2.sub (memLp_const (integral nu F))
  have hDbound : forall z, |D z| <= 2 * B := by
    intro z
    exact abs_finiteReplaceOneSupremum_sub_integral_le_two_mul
      s hs r X A hX hA hdom hA2 hAbound z
  have hDcenter : integral nu D = 0 := by
    simp only [D]
    rw [integral_sub hFint (integrable_const _)]
    simp only [integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul, sub_self]
  have hDsecond : integral nu (fun z => D z ^ 2) <= 2 * K2 ^ 2 := by
    have hvar := variance_finiteReplaceOneSupremum_le_two_mul_integral_sq
      s hs r X A hX hA hdom hA2
    have hvarK : variance F nu <= 2 * K2 ^ 2 := by
      calc
        variance F nu <= 2 * integral nu (fun z => A z ^ 2) := hvar
        _ <= 2 * K2 ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsecond (by norm_num)
    rw [← variance_eq_integral hF2.aemeasurable]
    exact hvarK
  have hbase := hasBernsteinMGF_of_memLp_two_of_ae_abs_le_of_integral_eq_zero
    D hD2 (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (sq_nonneg K2))
      (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hB) (ae_of_all nu hDbound) hDcenter hDsecond
  convert hbase using 1
  apply NNReal.eq
  change 4 * K2 ^ 2 = 2 * (2 * K2 ^ 2)
  ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_finiteReplaceOneSupremum_sub_integral_ge_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_finiteReplaceOneSupremum_sub_integral_ge_le
    [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (r : T -> Real) (X : Z -> T -> Real) (A : Z -> Real)
    (hX : forall t, t ∈ s -> Measurable (fun z => X z t))
    (hA : forall z, 0 <= A z)
    (hdom : forall z t, t ∈ s -> |X z t| <= A z)
    (hA2 : MemLp A 2 nu)
    {K2 B epsilon : Real} (hK2 : 0 < K2) (hB : 0 <= B)
    (hAbound : forall z, A z <= B)
    (hsecond : integral nu (fun z => A z ^ 2) <= K2 ^ 2)
    (hepsilon : 0 <= epsilon) :
    nu.real {z | epsilon <=
        finiteReplaceOneSupremum s hs r X z -
          integral nu (finiteReplaceOneSupremum s hs r X)} <=
      exp (-epsilon ^ 2 / (2 * (4 * K2 ^ 2 + 2 * B * epsilon)))
proof:
:= by
  have hmgf := hasBernsteinMGF_finiteReplaceOneSupremum_sub_integral
    s hs r X A hX hA hdom hA2 hB hAbound hsecond
  have hv : 0 < ((⟨4 * K2 ^ 2,
      mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (sq_nonneg K2)⟩ : ℝ≥0) : Real) := by
    change 0 < 4 * K2 ^ 2
    positivity
  have htail := hmgf.measure_ge_le hepsilon hv
  change nu.real {z | epsilon <=
      finiteReplaceOneSupremum s hs r X z -
        integral nu (finiteReplaceOneSupremum s hs r X)} <=
    exp (-epsilon ^ 2 / (2 * (4 * K2 ^ 2 + 2 * B * epsilon))) at htail
  exact htail

name: ProbabilityTheory.factorial_mul_factorial_cast_le_factorial_add_cast
statement:
theorem factorial_mul_factorial_cast_le_factorial_add_cast (q k : ℕ) :
    (q.factorial : ℝ) * (k.factorial : ℝ) ≤ ((q + k).factorial : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  exact_mod_cast Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.factorial_pos (q + k))
    (Nat.factorial_mul_factorial_dvd_factorial_add q k)

name: ProbabilityTheory.pow_add_div_factorial_add_le_mul_pow_div_factorial
statement:
theorem pow_add_div_factorial_add_le_mul_pow_div_factorial
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (q k : ℕ) :
    x ^ (q + k) / ((q + k).factorial : ℝ) ≤
      (x ^ q / (q.factorial : ℝ)) *
        (x ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hfac := factorial_mul_factorial_cast_le_factorial_add_cast q k
  have hfacPos : 0 < (q.factorial : ℝ) * (k.factorial : ℝ) := by
    positivity
  calc
    x ^ (q + k) / ((q + k).factorial : ℝ) =
        (x ^ q * x ^ k) / ((q + k).factorial : ℝ) := by
      rw [pow_add]
    _ ≤ (x ^ q * x ^ k) /
        ((q.factorial : ℝ) * (k.factorial : ℝ)) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hx q) (pow_nonneg hx k))
        hfacPos hfac
    _ = (x ^ q / (q.factorial : ℝ)) *
        (x ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) := by
      field_simp

name: ProbabilityTheory.summable_expSeries_nat_add
statement:
theorem summable_expSeries_nat_add (x : ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    Summable (fun k : ℕ => x ^ (q + k) / ((q + k).factorial : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [add_comm] using
    ((summable_nat_add_iff q).2 (Real.summable_pow_div_factorial x))

name: ProbabilityTheory.summable_expSeriesTail
statement:
theorem summable_expSeriesTail (q : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    Summable (fun k : ℕ => x ^ (q + k) / ((q + k).factorial : ℝ))
proof:
:=
  summable_expSeries_nat_add x q

name: ProbabilityTheory.expSeriesTail_nonneg
statement:
theorem expSeriesTail_nonneg {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (q : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ expSeriesTail q x
proof:
:= by
  exact tsum_nonneg fun k => by positivity

name: ProbabilityTheory.expSeriesTail_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem expSeriesTail_zero {q : ℕ} (hq : q ≠ 0) :
    expSeriesTail q 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [expSeriesTail, hq, Nat.add_eq_zero_iff]

name: ProbabilityTheory.tsum_pow_add_div_factorial_add_le
statement:
theorem tsum_pow_add_div_factorial_add_le (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) (q : ℕ) :
    (∑' k : ℕ, x ^ (q + k) / ((q + k).factorial : ℝ)) ≤
      (x ^ q / (q.factorial : ℝ)) * Real.exp x
proof:
:= by
  have hleft := summable_expSeries_nat_add x q
  have hright : Summable (fun k : ℕ =>
      (x ^ q / (q.factorial : ℝ)) *
        (x ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ))) :=
    (Real.summable_pow_div_factorial x).mul_left
      (x ^ q / (q.factorial : ℝ))
  calc
    (∑' k : ℕ, x ^ (q + k) / ((q + k).factorial : ℝ)) ≤
        ∑' k : ℕ, (x ^ q / (q.factorial : ℝ)) *
          (x ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) :=
      hleft.tsum_le_tsum
        (fun k => pow_add_div_factorial_add_le_mul_pow_div_factorial hx q k)
        hright
    _ = (x ^ q / (q.factorial : ℝ)) *
        (∑' k : ℕ, x ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) := by
      rw [tsum_mul_left]
    _ = (x ^ q / (q.factorial : ℝ)) * Real.exp x := by
      rw [(NormedSpace.expSeries_div_hasSum_exp x).tsum_eq,
        ← Real.exp_eq_exp_ℝ]

name: ProbabilityTheory.exp_eq_sum_range_add_tsum_nat_add
statement:
theorem exp_eq_sum_range_add_tsum_nat_add (x : ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    Real.exp x =
      (∑ k ∈ range q, x ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) +
        ∑' k : ℕ, x ^ (q + k) / ((q + k).factorial : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit :=
    (Real.summable_pow_div_factorial x).sum_add_tsum_nat_add q
  rw [(NormedSpace.expSeries_div_hasSum_exp x).tsum_eq] at hsplit
  calc
    Real.exp x = NormedSpace.exp x := congrFun Real.exp_eq_exp_ℝ x
    _ = (∑ k ∈ range q, x ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) +
        ∑' k : ℕ, x ^ (k + q) / ((k + q).factorial : ℝ) := hsplit.symm
    _ = (∑ k ∈ range q, x ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) +
        ∑' k : ℕ, x ^ (q + k) / ((q + k).factorial : ℝ) := by
      congr 1
      apply tsum_congr
      intro k
      rw [add_comm]

name: ProbabilityTheory.exp_eq_sum_range_add_expSeriesTail
statement:
theorem exp_eq_sum_range_add_expSeriesTail (x : ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    Real.exp x =
      (∑ k ∈ range q, x ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) + expSeriesTail q x
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [expSeriesTail] using exp_eq_sum_range_add_tsum_nat_add x q

name: ProbabilityTheory.expSeriesTail_le_exp
statement:
theorem expSeriesTail_le_exp (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) (q : ℕ) :
    expSeriesTail q x ≤ Real.exp x
proof:
:= by
  have hfinite :
      0 ≤ ∑ k ∈ range q, x ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ) := by
    positivity
  rw [exp_eq_sum_range_add_expSeriesTail x q]
  exact le_add_of_nonneg_left hfinite

name: ProbabilityTheory.expSeriesTail_mul_le_ratio_pow_mul
statement:
theorem expSeriesTail_mul_le_ratio_pow_mul
    (q : ℕ) {t a y : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hay : a ≤ y) (hy : 0 < y) :
    expSeriesTail q (t * a) ≤
      (a / y) ^ q * expSeriesTail q (t * y)
proof:
:= by
  let r : ℝ := a / y
  let u : ℝ := t * y
  have hr0 : 0 ≤ r := div_nonneg ha hy.le
  have hr1 : r ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hy).2 hay
  have hu : 0 ≤ u := mul_nonneg ht hy.le
  have hta : t * a = r * u := by
    dsimp only [r, u]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hy]
  have hleft := summable_expSeries_nat_add (t * a) q
  have hright : Summable (fun k : ℕ =>
      r ^ q * (u ^ (q + k) / ((q + k).factorial : ℝ))) :=
    (summable_expSeries_nat_add u q).mul_left (r ^ q)
  have hterm : ∀ k : ℕ,
      (t * a) ^ (q + k) / ((q + k).factorial : ℝ) ≤
        r ^ q * (u ^ (q + k) / ((q + k).factorial : ℝ)) := by
    intro k
    have hrpow : r ^ (q + k) ≤ r ^ q :=
      pow_le_pow_of_le_one hr0 hr1 (Nat.le_add_right q k)
    calc
      (t * a) ^ (q + k) / ((q + k).factorial : ℝ) =
          r ^ (q + k) *
            (u ^ (q + k) / ((q + k).factorial : ℝ)) := by
        rw [hta, mul_pow]
        ring
      _ ≤ r ^ q *
            (u ^ (q + k) / ((q + k).factorial : ℝ)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hrpow (by positivity)
  unfold expSeriesTail
  calc
    (∑' k : ℕ, (t * a) ^ (q + k) /
        ((q + k).factorial : ℝ)) ≤
        ∑' k : ℕ, r ^ q *
          (u ^ (q + k) / ((q + k).factorial : ℝ)) :=
      hleft.tsum_le_tsum hterm hright
    _ = r ^ q *
        ∑' k : ℕ, u ^ (q + k) / ((q + k).factorial : ℝ) := by
      rw [tsum_mul_left]
    _ = (a / y) ^ q *
        ∑' k : ℕ, (t * y) ^ (q + k) /
          ((q + k).factorial : ℝ) := by rfl

name: ProbabilityTheory.expSeriesTail_succ_le_mul_expSeriesTail
statement:
theorem expSeriesTail_succ_le_mul_expSeriesTail
    (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    expSeriesTail (n + 1) x ≤
      (x / (n + 1 : ℕ)) * expSeriesTail n x
proof:
:= by
  have hleft := summable_expSeries_nat_add x (n + 1)
  have hright : Summable (fun k : ℕ =>
      (x / (n + 1 : ℕ)) *
        (x ^ (n + k) / ((n + k).factorial : ℝ))) :=
    (summable_expSeries_nat_add x n).mul_left (x / (n + 1 : ℕ))
  have hterm : ∀ k : ℕ,
      x ^ (n + 1 + k) / ((n + 1 + k).factorial : ℝ) ≤
        (x / (n + 1 : ℕ)) *
          (x ^ (n + k) / ((n + k).factorial : ℝ)) := by
    intro k
    have hden :
        ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((n + k).factorial : ℝ) ≤
          ((n + k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((n + k).factorial : ℝ) := by
      gcongr
      omega
    have hdenPos :
        0 < ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((n + k).factorial : ℝ) := by
      positivity
    calc
      x ^ (n + 1 + k) / ((n + 1 + k).factorial : ℝ) =
          (x ^ (n + k) * x) /
            (((n + k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((n + k).factorial : ℝ)) := by
        rw [show n + 1 + k = n + k + 1 by omega, pow_succ,
          Nat.factorial_succ]
        norm_num
      _ ≤ (x ^ (n + k) * x) /
            (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((n + k).factorial : ℝ)) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_left
          (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hx _) hx) hdenPos hden
      _ = (x / (n + 1 : ℕ)) *
          (x ^ (n + k) / ((n + k).factorial : ℝ)) := by
        field_simp
  unfold expSeriesTail
  calc
    (∑' k : ℕ, x ^ (n + 1 + k) /
        ((n + 1 + k).factorial : ℝ)) ≤
        ∑' k : ℕ, (x / (n + 1 : ℕ)) *
          (x ^ (n + k) / ((n + k).factorial : ℝ)) :=
      hleft.tsum_le_tsum hterm hright
    _ = (x / (n + 1 : ℕ)) *
        ∑' k : ℕ, x ^ (n + k) /
          ((n + k).factorial : ℝ) := by
      rw [tsum_mul_left]

name: ProbabilityTheory.expSeriesTail_le_div_mul_exp
statement:
theorem expSeriesTail_le_div_mul_exp
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 1 ≤ q) (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    expSeriesTail q x ≤ (x / q) * Real.exp x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hq
  calc
    expSeriesTail (1 + n) x = expSeriesTail (n + 1) x := by
      rw [add_comm]
    _ ≤ (x / (n + 1 : ℕ)) * expSeriesTail n x :=
      expSeriesTail_succ_le_mul_expSeriesTail n x hx
    _ ≤ (x / (n + 1 : ℕ)) * Real.exp x := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (expSeriesTail_le_exp x hx n)
        (div_nonneg hx (by positivity))
    _ = (x / (1 + n : ℕ)) * Real.exp x := by
      rw [add_comm]

name: ProbabilityTheory.convexOn_expSeriesTail
statement:
theorem convexOn_expSeriesTail (q : ℕ) :
    ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Ici 0) (expSeriesTail q)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨convex_Ici 0, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
  have hsx := summable_expSeries_nat_add x q
  have hsy := summable_expSeries_nat_add y q
  have hsax : Summable (fun k : ℕ =>
      a * (x ^ (q + k) / ((q + k).factorial : ℝ))) :=
    hsx.mul_left a
  have hsby : Summable (fun k : ℕ =>
      b * (y ^ (q + k) / ((q + k).factorial : ℝ))) :=
    hsy.mul_left b
  have hright : Summable (fun k : ℕ =>
      a * (x ^ (q + k) / ((q + k).factorial : ℝ)) +
        b * (y ^ (q + k) / ((q + k).factorial : ℝ))) :=
    hsax.add hsby
  have hterm : ∀ k : ℕ,
      (a * x + b * y) ^ (q + k) / ((q + k).factorial : ℝ) ≤
        a * (x ^ (q + k) / ((q + k).factorial : ℝ)) +
          b * (y ^ (q + k) / ((q + k).factorial : ℝ)) := by
    intro k
    have hp := (convexOn_pow (q + k)).2 hx hy ha hb hab
    have hfac : 0 ≤ ((q + k).factorial : ℝ) := by positivity
    calc
      (a * x + b * y) ^ (q + k) / ((q + k).factorial : ℝ) ≤
          (a * x ^ (q + k) + b * y ^ (q + k)) /
            ((q + k).factorial : ℝ) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using hp) hfac
      _ = a * (x ^ (q + k) / ((q + k).factorial : ℝ)) +
          b * (y ^ (q + k) / ((q + k).factorial : ℝ)) := by ring
  unfold expSeriesTail
  calc
    (∑' k : ℕ, (a * x + b * y) ^ (q + k) /
        ((q + k).factorial : ℝ)) ≤
        ∑' k : ℕ, (
          a * (x ^ (q + k) / ((q + k).factorial : ℝ)) +
            b * (y ^ (q + k) / ((q + k).factorial : ℝ))) :=
      (summable_expSeries_nat_add (a * x + b * y) q).tsum_le_tsum
        hterm hright
    _ = a * (∑' k : ℕ,
          x ^ (q + k) / ((q + k).factorial : ℝ)) +
        b * (∑' k : ℕ,
          y ^ (q + k) / ((q + k).factorial : ℝ)) := by
      rw [hsax.tsum_add hsby, tsum_mul_left, tsum_mul_left]

name: ProbabilityTheory.exp_le_sum_range_add_pow_div_factorial_mul_exp
statement:
theorem exp_le_sum_range_add_pow_div_factorial_mul_exp
    (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) (q : ℕ) :
    Real.exp x ≤
      (∑ k ∈ range q, x ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) +
        (x ^ q / (q.factorial : ℝ)) * Real.exp x
proof:
:= by
  calc
    Real.exp x =
        (∑ k ∈ range q, x ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) +
          ∑' k : ℕ, x ^ (q + k) / ((q + k).factorial : ℝ) :=
      exp_eq_sum_range_add_tsum_nat_add x q
    _ ≤ (∑ k ∈ range q, x ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) +
        (x ^ q / (q.factorial : ℝ)) * Real.exp x :=
      add_le_add le_rfl (tsum_pow_add_div_factorial_add_le x hx q)

name: ProbabilityTheory.exp_le_one_add_add_three_quarters_sq_of_nonpos
statement:
theorem exp_le_one_add_add_three_quarters_sq_of_nonpos
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≤ 0) :
    Real.exp x ≤ 1 + x + (3 / 4 : ℝ) * x ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hunit : -1 ≤ x
  · have habs : |x| ≤ 1 := by
      rw [abs_le]
      exact ⟨hunit, hx.trans (by norm_num)⟩
    have h := (abs_le.mp (Real.exp_bound habs (n := 2) (by norm_num))).2
    norm_num [sum_range_succ, Nat.factorial] at h ⊢
    nlinarith
  · have hxlt : x < -1 := lt_of_not_ge hunit
    have hexpMono : Real.exp x ≤ Real.exp (-1) :=
      Real.exp_monotone hxlt.le
    have htwo : (2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 1 := by
      nlinarith [Real.add_one_le_exp 1]
    have hhalf : Real.exp (-1) ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
      rw [Real.exp_neg]
      calc
        (Real.exp 1)⁻¹ ≤ (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ :=
          (inv_le_inv₀ (Real.exp_pos 1) (by norm_num)).2 htwo
        _ = 1 / 2 := by norm_num
    have hquad : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + x + (3 / 4 : ℝ) * x ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (3 * x + 2)]
    exact hexpMono.trans (hhalf.trans hquad)

name: ProbabilityTheory.exp_le_one_add_add_half_sq_of_nonpos
statement:
theorem exp_le_one_add_add_half_sq_of_nonpos
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≤ 0) :
    Real.exp x ≤ 1 + x + x ^ 2 / 2
proof:
:= by
  let u : ℝ := -x
  have hu : 0 ≤ u := neg_nonneg.mpr hx
  have hpolyExp : 1 + u + u ^ 2 / 2 ≤ Real.exp u := by
    have h := Real.sum_le_exp_of_nonneg hu 3
    norm_num [sum_range_succ, Nat.factorial] at h ⊢
    nlinarith
  have hpolyPos : 0 < 1 + u + u ^ 2 / 2 := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg u]
  have hinv : (Real.exp u)⁻¹ ≤ (1 + u + u ^ 2 / 2)⁻¹ :=
    (inv_le_inv₀ (Real.exp_pos u) hpolyPos).2 hpolyExp
  have hprod :
      1 ≤ (1 - u + u ^ 2 / 2) * (1 + u + u ^ 2 / 2) := by
    calc
      (1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + u ^ 4 / 4 := by
        have hu4 : 0 ≤ u ^ 4 / 4 := by positivity
        linarith
      _ = (1 - u + u ^ 2 / 2) * (1 + u + u ^ 2 / 2) := by ring
  have hrecip : (1 + u + u ^ 2 / 2)⁻¹ ≤ 1 - u + u ^ 2 / 2 := by
    rw [inv_eq_one_div]
    exact (div_le_iff₀ hpolyPos).2 hprod
  calc
    Real.exp x = (Real.exp u)⁻¹ := by
      have hxu : x = -u := by simp only [u, neg_neg]
      rw [hxu, Real.exp_neg]
    _ ≤ (1 + u + u ^ 2 / 2)⁻¹ := hinv
    _ ≤ 1 - u + u ^ 2 / 2 := hrecip
    _ = 1 + x + x ^ 2 / 2 := by
      dsimp only [u]
      ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.exp_le_oneSidedExpTaylorBound
statement:
theorem exp_le_oneSidedExpTaylorBound
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) (x : ℝ) :
    Real.exp x ≤ oneSidedExpTaylorBound q x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : 0 ≤ x
  · have hbase :=
      exp_le_sum_range_add_pow_div_factorial_mul_exp x hx q
    let f : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => x ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)
    have hsplit := sum_range_add_sum_Ico f hq
    have hthree : (∑ k ∈ range 3, f k) = 1 + x + x ^ 2 / 2 := by
      simp only [f, sum_range_succ, range_one, sum_singleton, pow_zero,
        Nat.factorial, Nat.cast_one, div_one, pow_one]
      ring
    have hsum : (∑ k ∈ range q, f k) =
        1 + x + x ^ 2 / 2 + ∑ k ∈ Ico 3 q, f k := by
      rw [← hsplit, hthree]
    change Real.exp x ≤ _ at hbase
    rw [hsum] at hbase
    unfold oneSidedExpTaylorBound
    rw [max_eq_left hx]
    calc
      Real.exp x ≤
          1 + x + x ^ 2 / 2 +
            (∑ k ∈ Ico 3 q, x ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) +
            x ^ q / (q.factorial : ℝ) * Real.exp x := hbase
      _ ≤ 1 + x + x ^ 2 / 2 +
            (∑ k ∈ Ico 3 q, x ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) +
            x ^ q / (q.factorial : ℝ) * Real.exp x := le_rfl
  · have hxnonpos : x ≤ 0 := le_of_not_ge hx
    have hbase := exp_le_one_add_add_half_sq_of_nonpos hxnonpos
    have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := by omega
    have hsumzero :
        (∑ k ∈ Ico 3 q, (0 : ℝ) ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) = 0 := by
      apply sum_eq_zero
      intro k hk
      have hk0 : k ≠ 0 := by
        have hk3 := (mem_Ico.mp hk).1
        omega
      simp [hk0]
    unfold oneSidedExpTaylorBound
    rw [max_eq_right hxnonpos, hsumzero, zero_pow hq0]
    simp only [zero_div, zero_mul, add_zero]
    exact hbase

name: ProbabilityTheory.upperTruncationResidual_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem upperTruncationResidual_apply
    (X : Omega → ℝ) (y : ℝ) (omega : Omega) :
    upperTruncationResidual X y omega = X omega - min (X omega) y
proof: := rfl

name: ProbabilityTheory.upperTruncation_add_residual
statement:
theorem upperTruncation_add_residual
    (X : Omega → ℝ) (y : ℝ) (omega : Omega) :
    upperTruncation X y omega + upperTruncationResidual X y omega =
      X omega

:= by
  unfold upperTruncationResidual
