name: ProbabilityTheory.upperTruncationResidual_nonneg
statement:
theorem upperTruncationResidual_nonneg
    (X : Omega → ℝ) (y : ℝ) (omega : Omega) :
    0 ≤ upperTruncationResidual X y omega
proof:
:= by
  unfold upperTruncationResidual upperTruncation
  exact sub_nonneg.mpr (min_le_left _ _)

name: ProbabilityTheory.upperTruncationResidual_eq_max_sub
statement:
theorem upperTruncationResidual_eq_max_sub
    (X : Omega → ℝ) (y : ℝ) (omega : Omega) :
    upperTruncationResidual X y omega = max (X omega - y) 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hxy : X omega ≤ y
  · rw [upperTruncationResidual_apply, min_eq_left hxy,
      max_eq_right (sub_nonpos.mpr hxy), sub_self]
  · have hyx : y ≤ X omega := le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge hxy)
    rw [upperTruncationResidual_apply, min_eq_right hyx,
      max_eq_left (sub_nonneg.mpr hyx)]

name: ProbabilityTheory.upperTruncationResidual_le_pow_div
statement:
theorem upperTruncationResidual_le_pow_div
    (X : Omega → ℝ) {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y)
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 1 ≤ q) (omega : Omega) :
    upperTruncationResidual X y omega ≤
      (max (X omega) 0) ^ q / y ^ (q - 1)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hxy : X omega ≤ y
  · rw [upperTruncationResidual_apply, min_eq_left hxy]
    simp only [sub_self]
    positivity
  · have hyx : y < X omega := lt_of_not_ge hxy
    have hx : 0 < X omega := hy.trans hyx
    have hpowPos : 0 < y ^ (q - 1) := pow_pos hy _
    have hpowLe : y ^ (q - 1) ≤ X omega ^ (q - 1) :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ hy.le hyx.le _
    have hxScaled : X omega * y ^ (q - 1) ≤
        X omega * X omega ^ (q - 1) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpowLe hx.le
    have hqEq : q - 1 + 1 = q := Nat.sub_add_cancel hq
    rw [upperTruncationResidual_apply, min_eq_right hyx.le,
      max_eq_left hx.le]
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hpowPos).2
    calc
      (X omega - y) * y ^ (q - 1) ≤ X omega * y ^ (q - 1) := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (sub_le_self _ hy.le) hpowPos.le
      _ ≤ X omega * X omega ^ (q - 1) := hxScaled
      _ = X omega ^ q := by
        rw [← pow_succ', hqEq]

name: ProbabilityTheory.upperTruncationResidual_le_pow_div_natCast_mul
statement:
theorem upperTruncationResidual_le_pow_div_natCast_mul
    (X : Omega → ℝ) {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y)
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 1 ≤ q) (omega : Omega) :
    upperTruncationResidual X y omega ≤
      (max (X omega) 0) ^ q /
        ((q : ℝ) * y ^ (q - 1))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hxy : X omega ≤ y
  · rw [upperTruncationResidual_apply, min_eq_left hxy]
    simp only [sub_self]
    positivity
  · have hyx : y < X omega := lt_of_not_ge hxy
    have hx : 0 < X omega := hy.trans hyx
    have hqReal : 0 < (q : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one hq)
    have hyPow : 0 < y ^ (q - 1) := pow_pos hy _
    have hden : 0 < (q : ℝ) * y ^ (q - 1) := mul_pos hqReal hyPow
    let r : ℝ := X omega / y
    have hr : 1 ≤ r := (le_div_iff₀ hy).2 (by simpa using hyx.le)
    have hbern := one_add_mul_sub_le_pow
      (a := r) (show (-1 : ℝ) ≤ r by linarith) q
    have hcore : (q : ℝ) * (r - 1) ≤ r ^ q := by
      nlinarith
    have hyq : 0 ≤ y ^ q := (pow_pos hy q).le
    have hscaled := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcore hyq
    rw [upperTruncationResidual_apply, min_eq_right hyx.le,
      max_eq_left hx.le]
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hden).2
    dsimp only [r] at hscaled
    rw [div_pow] at hscaled
    field_simp [hy.ne'] at hscaled
    have hqEq : q - 1 + 1 = q := Nat.sub_add_cancel hq
    have hyPowEq : y ^ (q - 1) * y = y ^ q := by
      rw [← pow_succ, hqEq]
    apply (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ hy).mp
    calc
      y * ((X omega - y) * ((q : ℝ) * y ^ (q - 1))) =
          (q : ℝ) * (X omega - y) * (y ^ (q - 1) * y) := by ring
      _ = (q : ℝ) * (X omega - y) * y ^ q := by rw [hyPowEq]
      _ ≤ y * X omega ^ q := hscaled

name: ProbabilityTheory.integrable_upperTruncationResidual
statement:
theorem integrable_upperTruncationResidual [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    {X : Omega → ℝ} (hX : Integrable X mu) (y : ℝ) :
    Integrable (upperTruncationResidual X y) mu
proof:
:= by
  exact hX.sub (integrable_upperTruncation hX y)

name: ProbabilityTheory.hasOneSidedMGF_upperTruncation_of_strongMoment
statement:
theorem hasOneSidedMGF_upperTruncation_of_strongMoment
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (D : Omega → ℝ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    {y second : ℝ} (hy : 0 ≤ y)
    (hD : Integrable D mu)
    (hDsq : Integrable (fun omega => D omega ^ 2) mu)
    (hpow : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      Integrable (fun omega => (max (D omega) 0) ^ k) mu)
    (hcenter : ∫ omega, D omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hsecond : (∫ omega, D omega ^ 2 ∂mu) ≤ second)
    (moment : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hmoment : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      (∫ omega, (max (D omega) 0) ^ k ∂mu) ≤ moment k) :
    HasOneSidedMGF (upperTruncation D y)
      (fun t => strongMomentTaylorExponent q t y second moment) mu
proof:
:= by
  have hU : Integrable (upperTruncation D y) mu :=
    integrable_upperTruncation hD y
  refine
    { aemeasurable := hU.aemeasurable
      integrable_exp_mul := ?_
      mgf_le := ?_ }
  · intro t ht
    apply Integrable.of_bound
      ((hU.aemeasurable.const_mul t).exp.aestronglyMeasurable)
      (Real.exp (t * y))
    filter_upwards [] with omega
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
    exact Real.exp_monotone
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (upperTruncation_le D y omega) ht)
  · intro t ht
    exact integral_exp_mul_upperTruncation_le_exp_strongMomentTaylorExponent
      D q hq ht hy hD hDsq hpow hcenter hsecond moment hmoment

name: ProbabilityTheory.hasCondOneSidedMGF_upperTruncation_of_strongMoment
statement:
theorem hasCondOneSidedMGF_upperTruncation_of_strongMoment
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hm : m ≤ mOmega) (D : Omega → ℝ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    {y second : ℝ} (hy : 0 ≤ y)
    (hD : Integrable D mu)
    (hDsq : Integrable (fun omega => D omega ^ 2) mu)
    (hpow : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      Integrable (fun omega => (max (D omega) 0) ^ k) mu)
    (hcenter : mu[D | m] =ᵐ[mu] 0)
    (hsecond : mu[fun omega => D omega ^ 2 | m] ≤ᵐ[mu]
      fun _ => second)
    (moment : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hmoment : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      mu[fun omega => (max (D omega) 0) ^ k | m] ≤ᵐ[mu]
        fun _ => moment k) :
    HasCondOneSidedMGF m hm (upperTruncation D y)
      (fun t => strongMomentTaylorExponent q t y second moment) mu
proof:
:= by
  have hU : Integrable (upperTruncation D y) mu :=
    integrable_upperTruncation hD y
  refine
    { aemeasurable := hU.aemeasurable
      integrable_exp_mul := ?_
      cond_mgf_le := ?_ }
  · intro t ht
    apply Integrable.of_bound
      ((hU.aemeasurable.const_mul t).exp.aestronglyMeasurable)
      (Real.exp (t * y))
    filter_upwards [] with omega
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
    exact Real.exp_monotone
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (upperTruncation_le D y omega) ht)
  · intro t ht
    exact condExp_exp_mul_upperTruncation_le_exp_strongMomentTaylorExponent
      hm D q hq ht hy hD hDsq hpow hcenter hsecond moment hmoment

name: ProbabilityTheory.hasOneSidedMGF_sum_upperTruncation_of_strongMoment
statement:
theorem hasOneSidedMGF_sum_upperTruncation_of_strongMoment
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (D : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hAdapted : StronglyAdapted filtration D)
    (second : ℕ → ℝ) (moment : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (n q : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 ≤ y)
    (hD : ∀ i < n, Integrable (D i) mu)
    (hDsq : ∀ i < n, Integrable (fun omega => D i omega ^ 2) mu)
    (hpow : ∀ i < n, ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      Integrable (fun omega => (max (D i omega) 0) ^ k) mu)
    (hcenter0 : ∫ omega, D 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hcenterSucc : ∀ i < n - 1,
      mu[D (i + 1) | filtration i] =ᵐ[mu] 0)
    (hsecond0 : (∫ omega, D 0 omega ^ 2 ∂mu) ≤ second 0)
    (hsecondSucc : ∀ i < n - 1,
      mu[fun omega => D (i + 1) omega ^ 2 | filtration i] ≤ᵐ[mu]
        fun _ => second (i + 1))
    (hmoment0 : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      (∫ omega, (max (D 0 omega) 0) ^ k ∂mu) ≤ moment 0 k)
    (hmomentSucc : ∀ i < n - 1, ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      mu[fun omega => (max (D (i + 1) omega) 0) ^ k | filtration i]
        ≤ᵐ[mu] fun _ => moment (i + 1) k) :
    HasOneSidedMGF
      (fun omega => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, upperTruncation (D i) y omega)
      (fun t => strongMomentTaylorExponent q t y
        (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, second i)
        (fun k => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, moment i k)) mu
proof:
:= by
  let U : ℕ → Omega → ℝ := fun i => upperTruncation (D i) y
  let psi : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun i t =>
    strongMomentTaylorExponent q t y (second i) (moment i)
  let B : ℕ → ℝ := fun _ => y
  have hUAdapted : StronglyAdapted filtration U := by
    intro i
    change StronglyMeasurable[filtration i]
      (fun omega => min (D i omega) y)
    exact ((hAdapted i).measurable.min measurable_const).stronglyMeasurable
  have hzero : HasOneSidedMGF (U 0) (psi 0) mu := by
    dsimp only [U, psi]
    exact hasOneSidedMGF_upperTruncation_of_strongMoment
      (D 0) q hq hy (hD 0 hn) (hDsq 0 hn) (hpow 0 hn)
        hcenter0 hsecond0 (moment 0) hmoment0
  have hcond : ∀ i < n - 1,
      HasCondOneSidedMGF (filtration i) (filtration.le i)
        (U (i + 1)) (psi (i + 1)) mu := by
    intro i hi
    dsimp only [U, psi]
    exact hasCondOneSidedMGF_upperTruncation_of_strongMoment
      (filtration.le i) (D (i + 1)) q hq hy
        (hD (i + 1) (by omega)) (hDsq (i + 1) (by omega))
        (hpow (i + 1) (by omega)) (hcenterSucc i hi)
        (hsecondSucc i hi) (moment (i + 1)) (hmomentSucc i hi)
  have hbound : ∀ i < n, ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, U i omega ≤ B i := by
    intro i hi
    exact ae_of_all mu fun omega => upperTruncation_le (D i) y omega
  have hsum := HasOneSidedMGF.sum_of_hasCondOneSidedMGF
    filtration hUAdapted hzero n hbound hcond
  convert hsum using 1
  funext t
  dsimp only [psi]
  exact (sum_strongMomentTaylorExponent
    (Finset.range n) q t y second moment).symm

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasOneSidedMGF.measureReal_ge_le
statement:
theorem HasOneSidedMGF.measureReal_ge_le
    [IsFiniteMeasure mu] {X : Omega → ℝ} {psi : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hX : HasOneSidedMGF X psi mu) {epsilon t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    mu.real {omega | epsilon ≤ X omega} ≤
      Real.exp (-t * epsilon + psi t)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    mu.real {omega | epsilon ≤ X omega} ≤
        Real.exp (-t * epsilon) * mgf X mu t :=
      measure_ge_le_exp_mul_mgf epsilon ht (hX.integrable_exp_mul t ht)
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-t * epsilon) * Real.exp (psi t) := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hX.mgf_le t ht) (Real.exp_nonneg _)
    _ = Real.exp (-t * epsilon + psi t) := by rw [Real.exp_add]

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasOneSidedMGF.conditionalValueAtRisk_le
statement:
theorem HasOneSidedMGF.conditionalValueAtRisk_le
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {X : Omega → ℝ} {psi : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hmgf : HasOneSidedMGF X psi mu) (hX : Integrable X mu)
    {alpha t : ℝ} (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha ≤ 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) :
    conditionalValueAtRisk alpha X mu ≤
      (psi t - Real.log alpha) / t
proof:
:= by
  let I : ℝ := ∫ omega, Real.exp (t * X omega) ∂mu
  have hExp := hmgf.integrable_exp_mul t ht.le
  have hIpos : 0 < I := integral_exp_mul_pos X t hExp
  have hmgfLe : I ≤ Real.exp (psi t) := by
    simpa only [mgf, I] using hmgf.mgf_le t ht.le
  have hratioLe : I / alpha ≤ Real.exp (psi t) / alpha :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hmgfLe halpha0.le
  have hlogLe : Real.log (I / alpha) ≤
      Real.log (Real.exp (psi t) / alpha) :=
    Real.log_le_log (div_pos hIpos halpha0) hratioLe
  have hbase := conditionalValueAtRisk_le_log_integral_exp_div
    hX halpha0 halpha1 ht hExp
  calc
    conditionalValueAtRisk alpha X mu ≤ Real.log (I / alpha) / t := by
      simpa only [I] using hbase
    _ ≤ Real.log (Real.exp (psi t) / alpha) / t :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hlogLe ht.le
    _ = (psi t - Real.log alpha) / t := by
      rw [Real.log_div (Real.exp_pos _).ne' halpha0.ne', Real.log_exp]

name: ProbabilityTheory.conditionalValueAtRisk_le_inv_mul_integral_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem conditionalValueAtRisk_le_inv_mul_integral_of_nonneg
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {X : Omega → ℝ} (hX : Integrable X mu) (hXnonneg : 0 ≤ᵐ[mu] X)
    {alpha : ℝ} (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha ≤ 1) :
    conditionalValueAtRisk alpha X mu ≤
      alpha⁻¹ * ∫ omega, X omega ∂mu
proof:
:= by
  have hb : BddBelow (Set.range (cvarObjective alpha X mu)) :=
    bddBelow_range_cvarObjective hX halpha0 halpha1
  unfold conditionalValueAtRisk
  calc
    sInf (Set.range (cvarObjective alpha X mu)) ≤
        cvarObjective alpha X mu 0 :=
      csInf_le hb ⟨0, rfl⟩
    _ = alpha⁻¹ * ∫ omega, X omega ∂mu := by
      unfold cvarObjective
      simp only [zero_add, sub_zero]
      congr 1
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [hXnonneg] with omega homega
      exact max_eq_left homega

name: ProbabilityTheory.conditionalValueAtRisk_upperTruncationResidual_le
statement:
theorem conditionalValueAtRisk_upperTruncationResidual_le
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : Omega → ℝ) (hX : Integrable X mu)
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hpow : Integrable (fun omega => (max (X omega) 0) ^ q) mu)
    {y alpha : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y)
    (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha ≤ 1) :
    conditionalValueAtRisk alpha (upperTruncationResidual X y) mu ≤
      alpha⁻¹ *
        ((∫ omega, (max (X omega) 0) ^ q ∂mu) /
          ((q : ℝ) * y ^ (q - 1)))
proof:
:= by
  have hR : Integrable (upperTruncationResidual X y) mu :=
    integrable_upperTruncationResidual hX y
  have hmajor : Integrable
      (fun omega => (max (X omega) 0) ^ q /
        ((q : ℝ) * y ^ (q - 1))) mu :=
    hpow.div_const _
  have hint :
      (∫ omega, upperTruncationResidual X y omega ∂mu) ≤
        ∫ omega, (max (X omega) 0) ^ q /
          ((q : ℝ) * y ^ (q - 1)) ∂mu := by
    exact integral_mono hR hmajor
      (fun omega =>
        upperTruncationResidual_le_pow_div_natCast_mul X hy q hq omega)
  calc
    conditionalValueAtRisk alpha (upperTruncationResidual X y) mu ≤
        alpha⁻¹ * ∫ omega, upperTruncationResidual X y omega ∂mu :=
      conditionalValueAtRisk_le_inv_mul_integral_of_nonneg hR
        (ae_of_all mu fun omega => upperTruncationResidual_nonneg X y omega)
        halpha0 halpha1
    _ ≤ alpha⁻¹ *
        ∫ omega, (max (X omega) 0) ^ q /
          ((q : ℝ) * y ^ (q - 1)) ∂mu :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hint (inv_nonneg.mpr halpha0.le)
    _ = alpha⁻¹ *
        ((∫ omega, (max (X omega) 0) ^ q ∂mu) /
          ((q : ℝ) * y ^ (q - 1))) := by
      rw [integral_div]

name: ProbabilityTheory.conditionalValueAtRisk_sum_upperTruncationResidual_le
statement:
theorem conditionalValueAtRisk_sum_upperTruncationResidual_le
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (D : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (n q : ℕ) (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hD : ∀ i < n, Integrable (D i) mu)
    (hpow : ∀ i < n,
      Integrable (fun omega => (max (D i omega) 0) ^ q) mu)
    {y alpha : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y)
    (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha ≤ 1) :
    conditionalValueAtRisk alpha
        (fun omega => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
          upperTruncationResidual (D i) y omega) mu ≤
      alpha⁻¹ *
        ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
          ∫ omega, (max (D i omega) 0) ^ q ∂mu) /
            ((q : ℝ) * y ^ (q - 1)))
proof:
:= by
  have hR : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range n,
      Integrable (upperTruncationResidual (D i) y) mu := by
    intro i hi
    exact integrable_upperTruncationResidual (hD i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)) y
  have hRsum : Integrable
      (fun omega => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
        upperTruncationResidual (D i) y omega) mu :=
    integrable_finsetSum (Finset.range n) hR
  have hIntLe :
      (∫ omega, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
          upperTruncationResidual (D i) y omega ∂mu) ≤
        (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
          ∫ omega, (max (D i omega) 0) ^ q ∂mu) /
            ((q : ℝ) * y ^ (q - 1)) := by
    rw [integral_finsetSum (Finset.range n) hR, Finset.sum_div]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => by
      have hmajor : Integrable
          (fun omega => (max (D i omega) 0) ^ q /
            ((q : ℝ) * y ^ (q - 1))) mu :=
        (hpow i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)).div_const _
      have hiInt := integral_mono (hR i hi) hmajor
        (fun omega =>
          upperTruncationResidual_le_pow_div_natCast_mul (D i) hy q hq omega)
      simpa only [integral_div] using hiInt
  calc
    conditionalValueAtRisk alpha
        (fun omega => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
          upperTruncationResidual (D i) y omega) mu ≤
        alpha⁻¹ *
          ∫ omega, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
            upperTruncationResidual (D i) y omega ∂mu :=
      conditionalValueAtRisk_le_inv_mul_integral_of_nonneg hRsum
        (ae_of_all mu fun omega => Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ =>
          upperTruncationResidual_nonneg (D i) y omega)
        halpha0 halpha1
    _ ≤ alpha⁻¹ *
        ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
          ∫ omega, (max (D i omega) 0) ^ q ∂mu) /
            ((q : ℝ) * y ^ (q - 1))) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hIntLe (inv_nonneg.mpr halpha0.le)

name: ProbabilityTheory.conditionalValueAtRisk_sum_le_of_upperTruncation_mgf
statement:
theorem conditionalValueAtRisk_sum_le_of_upperTruncation_mgf
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (D : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (n q : ℕ) (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hD : ∀ i < n, Integrable (D i) mu)
    (hpow : ∀ i < n,
      Integrable (fun omega => (max (D i omega) 0) ^ q) mu)
    (psi : ℝ → ℝ)
    {y alpha t : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y)
    (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha ≤ 1) (ht : 0 < t)
    (hmgf : HasOneSidedMGF
      (fun omega => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
        upperTruncation (D i) y omega) psi mu) :
    conditionalValueAtRisk alpha
        (fun omega => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, D i omega) mu ≤
      (psi t - Real.log alpha) / t +
        alpha⁻¹ *
          ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
            ∫ omega, (max (D i omega) 0) ^ q ∂mu) /
              ((q : ℝ) * y ^ (q - 1)))
proof:
:= by
  let U : Omega → ℝ := fun omega => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
    upperTruncation (D i) y omega
  let R : Omega → ℝ := fun omega => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
    upperTruncationResidual (D i) y omega
  have hUInt : Integrable U mu := by
    dsimp only [U]
    apply integrable_finsetSum
    intro i hi
    exact integrable_upperTruncation (hD i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)) y
  have hRInt : Integrable R mu := by
    dsimp only [R]
    apply integrable_finsetSum
    intro i hi
    exact integrable_upperTruncationResidual
      (hD i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)) y
  have hdecomp :
      (fun omega => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, D i omega) =
        (fun omega => U omega + R omega) := by
    funext omega
    dsimp only [U, R]
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    exact (upperTruncation_add_residual (D i) y omega).symm
  rw [hdecomp]
  calc
    conditionalValueAtRisk alpha (fun omega => U omega + R omega) mu ≤
        conditionalValueAtRisk alpha U mu +
          conditionalValueAtRisk alpha R mu :=
      conditionalValueAtRisk_add_le hUInt hRInt halpha0 halpha1
    _ ≤ (psi t - Real.log alpha) / t +
        alpha⁻¹ *
          ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
            ∫ omega, (max (D i omega) 0) ^ q ∂mu) /
              ((q : ℝ) * y ^ (q - 1))) := by
      apply add_le_add
      · exact hmgf.conditionalValueAtRisk_le hUInt halpha0 halpha1 ht
      · dsimp only [R]
        exact conditionalValueAtRisk_sum_upperTruncationResidual_le
          D n q hq hD hpow hy halpha0 halpha1

name: ProbabilityTheory.conditionalValueAtRisk_sum_le_strongMomentTaylorExponent_add_residual
statement:
theorem conditionalValueAtRisk_sum_le_strongMomentTaylorExponent_add_residual
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (D : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hAdapted : StronglyAdapted filtration D)
    (second : ℕ → ℝ) (moment : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (n q : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    {y alpha t : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y)
    (hD : ∀ i < n, Integrable (D i) mu)
    (hDsq : ∀ i < n, Integrable (fun omega => D i omega ^ 2) mu)
    (hpow : ∀ i < n, ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      Integrable (fun omega => (max (D i omega) 0) ^ k) mu)
    (hcenter0 : ∫ omega, D 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hcenterSucc : ∀ i < n - 1,
      mu[D (i + 1) | filtration i] =ᵐ[mu] 0)
    (hsecond0 : (∫ omega, D 0 omega ^ 2 ∂mu) ≤ second 0)
    (hsecondSucc : ∀ i < n - 1,
      mu[fun omega => D (i + 1) omega ^ 2 | filtration i] ≤ᵐ[mu]
        fun _ => second (i + 1))
    (hmoment0 : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      (∫ omega, (max (D 0 omega) 0) ^ k ∂mu) ≤ moment 0 k)
    (hmomentSucc : ∀ i < n - 1, ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      mu[fun omega => (max (D (i + 1) omega) 0) ^ k | filtration i]
        ≤ᵐ[mu] fun _ => moment (i + 1) k)
    (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha ≤ 1) (ht : 0 < t) :
    conditionalValueAtRisk alpha
        (fun omega => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, D i omega) mu ≤
      (strongMomentTaylorExponent q t y
          (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, second i)
          (fun k => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, moment i k) -
        Real.log alpha) / t +
      alpha⁻¹ *
        ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, moment i q) /
          ((q : ℝ) * y ^ (q - 1)))
proof:
:= by
  have hqOne : 1 ≤ q := by omega
  have hqIcc : q ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q := Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨by omega, le_rfl⟩
  have hpowq : ∀ i < n,
      Integrable (fun omega => (max (D i omega) 0) ^ q) mu := by
    intro i hi
    exact hpow i hi q hqIcc
  have hmgf := hasOneSidedMGF_sum_upperTruncation_of_strongMoment
    filtration D hAdapted second moment n q hn hq hy.le hD hDsq hpow
      hcenter0 hcenterSucc hsecond0 hsecondSucc hmoment0 hmomentSucc
  have hraw := conditionalValueAtRisk_sum_le_of_upperTruncation_mgf
      D n q hqOne hD hpowq
        (fun t => strongMomentTaylorExponent q t y
          (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, second i)
          (fun k => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, moment i k))
        hy halpha0 halpha1 ht hmgf
  have hmomentQ : ∀ i < n,
      (∫ omega, (max (D i omega) 0) ^ q ∂mu) ≤ moment i q := by
    intro i hi
    cases i with
    | zero => exact hmoment0 q hqIcc
    | succ i =>
        have hiPred : i < n - 1 := by omega
        have hcond := hmomentSucc i hiPred q hqIcc
        have hint :
            (∫ omega,
                mu[fun z => (max (D (i + 1) z) 0) ^ q |
                  filtration i] omega ∂mu) ≤
              ∫ _ : Omega, moment (i + 1) q ∂mu :=
          integral_mono_ae integrable_condExp (integrable_const _) hcond
        rw [integral_condExp (filtration.le i), integral_const] at hint
        simpa only [probReal_univ, smul_eq_mul, one_mul] using hint
  have hsumMoment :
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
        ∫ omega, (max (D i omega) 0) ^ q ∂mu) ≤
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, moment i q := by
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi =>
      hmomentQ i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
  have hden : 0 < (q : ℝ) * y ^ (q - 1) := by positivity
  have hresidual :
      alpha⁻¹ *
          ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
            ∫ omega, (max (D i omega) 0) ^ q ∂mu) /
              ((q : ℝ) * y ^ (q - 1))) ≤
        alpha⁻¹ *
          ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, moment i q) /
            ((q : ℝ) * y ^ (q - 1))) := by
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hsumMoment hden.le)
      (inv_nonneg.mpr halpha0.le)
  exact hraw.trans (add_le_add le_rfl hresidual)

name: RandomSetTheory.mem_aumannExpectation_iff
statement:
theorem mem_aumannExpectation_iff {μ : Measure Ω} {S : Ω → Set E} {x : E} :
    x ∈ aumannExpectation μ S ↔
      ∃ f : Ω → E, IsIntegrableSelection μ S f ∧ ∫ ω, f ω ∂μ = x
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_nonempty_of_selection
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨∫ ω, f ω ∂μ, f, hf, rfl⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_mono_ae
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨f, ⟨hf.1, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
  filter_upwards [hf.2, hST] with ω hfω hSTω
  exact hSTω hfω

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_mono
proof:
:=
  aumannExpectation_mono_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hST)

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_congr_ae
statement:
theorem aumannExpectation_congr_ae {μ : Measure Ω} {S T : Ω → Set E}
    (hST : S =ᵐ[μ] T) : aumannExpectation μ S = aumannExpectation μ T
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · exact aumannExpectation_mono_ae (hST.mono fun _ h => h.subset)
  · exact aumannExpectation_mono_ae (hST.symm.mono fun _ h => h.subset)

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_singleton
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
    have hgf : g =ᵐ[μ] f := hg.2.mono fun ω hω => by simpa using hω
    simp [integral_congr_ae hgf]
  · intro hx
    have hx' : x = ∫ ω, f ω ∂μ := by simpa using hx
    subst x
    refine ⟨f, ⟨hf, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
    filter_upwards [] with ω
    simp

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_const_singleton
statement:
theorem aumannExpectation_const_singleton {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    [CompleteSpace E]
    (x : E) :
    aumannExpectation μ (fun _ => ({x} : Set E)) = {μ.real Set.univ • x}
proof:
:= by
  rw [aumannExpectation_singleton (integrable_const x)]
  rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const]

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_const
statement:
theorem aumannExpectation_const {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    [CompleteSpace E] {K : Set E} (hKconv : Convex ℝ K)
    (hKclosed : IsClosed K) :
    aumannExpectation μ (fun _ => K) = K
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · rintro x ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
    exact hKconv.integral_mem hKclosed hf.2 hf.1
  · intro x hx
    refine ⟨fun _ => x, ⟨integrable_const x, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · filter_upwards [] with ω
      exact hx
    · rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const]
      simp

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_convex
statement:
theorem aumannExpectation_convex {μ : Measure Ω} {S : Ω → Set E}
    (hS : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Convex ℝ (S ω)) : Convex ℝ (aumannExpectation μ S)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
  rcases hx with ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
  rcases hy with ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨fun ω => a • f ω + b • g ω,
    ⟨(hf.1.smul a).add (hg.1.smul b), ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · filter_upwards [hf.2, hg.2, hS] with ω hfω hgω hSω
    exact hSω hfω hgω ha hb hab
  · calc
      (∫ ω, a • f ω + b • g ω ∂μ) =
          (∫ ω, a • f ω ∂μ) + ∫ ω, b • g ω ∂μ :=
        integral_add (hf.1.smul a) (hg.1.smul b)
      _ = a • (∫ ω, f ω ∂μ) + b • ∫ ω, g ω ∂μ := by
        rw [integral_smul, integral_smul]

name: RandomSetTheory.inner_integral_selection_le_integral_supportFunction
statement:
theorem inner_integral_selection_le_integral_supportFunction
    [CompleteSpace H]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S : Ω → Set H} {f : Ω → H}
    (hf : IsIntegrableSelection μ S f)
    (hcompact : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, IsCompact (S ω))
    (u : H) (hsupport : Integrable (fun ω => supportFunction (S ω) u) μ) :
    ⟪u, ∫ ω, f ω ∂μ⟫_ℝ ≤ ∫ ω, supportFunction (S ω) u ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← integral_inner hf.1 u]
  apply integral_mono_ae (hf.1.const_inner u) hsupport
  filter_upwards [hf.2, hcompact] with ω hfω hcompactω
  exact inner_le_supportFunction hcompactω hfω u

name: RandomSetTheory.inner_le_integral_supportFunction_of_mem_aumannExpectation
statement:
theorem inner_le_integral_supportFunction_of_mem_aumannExpectation
    [CompleteSpace H]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S : Ω → Set H}
    (hcompact : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, IsCompact (S ω))
    (u : H) (hsupport : Integrable (fun ω => supportFunction (S ω) u) μ)
    {x : H} (hx : x ∈ aumannExpectation μ S) :
    ⟪u, x⟫_ℝ ≤ ∫ ω, supportFunction (S ω) u ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rcases hx with ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
  exact inner_integral_selection_le_integral_supportFunction
    hf hcompact u hsupport

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_mem_aumannExpectation_inner_eq_integral_supportFunction
statement:
theorem exists_mem_aumannExpectation_inner_eq_integral_supportFunction
    [CompleteSpace H]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S : Ω → Set H} {u : H}
    (hsel : HasIntegrableSupportSelection μ S u) :
    ∃ x ∈ aumannExpectation μ S,
      ⟪u, x⟫_ℝ = ∫ ω, supportFunction (S ω) u ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rcases hsel with ⟨f, hf, hmax⟩
  refine ⟨∫ ω, f ω ∂μ, ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [← integral_inner hf.1 u]
  exact integral_congr_ae hmax

name: RandomSetTheory.supportFunction_aumannExpectation
statement:
theorem supportFunction_aumannExpectation
    [CompleteSpace H]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S : Ω → Set H}
    (hcompact : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hAcompact : IsCompact (aumannExpectation μ S))
    (hAne : (aumannExpectation μ S).Nonempty)
    (u : H) (hsupport : Integrable (fun ω => supportFunction (S ω) u) μ)
    (hsel : HasIntegrableSupportSelection μ S u) :
    supportFunction (aumannExpectation μ S) u =
      ∫ ω, supportFunction (S ω) u ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxEq⟩ :=
    exists_mem_aumannExpectation_inner_eq_integral_supportFunction hsel
  apply le_antisymm
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, hyEq⟩ := supportFunction_attains hAcompact hAne u
    rw [hyEq]
    exact inner_le_integral_supportFunction_of_mem_aumannExpectation
      hcompact u hsupport hy
  · rw [← hxEq]
    exact inner_le_supportFunction hAcompact hx u

name: RandomSetTheory.IsAtomlessMeasure.toNullSingletonClass
statement:
theorem IsAtomlessMeasure.toNullSingletonClass
    [MeasurableSingletonClass Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} (hμ : IsAtomlessMeasure μ) :
    NullSingletonClass μ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun x => ?_⟩
  by_contra hne
  obtain ⟨t, hts, _, htpos, htlt⟩ :=
    hμ {x} (measurableSet_singleton x) (pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hne)
  rcases Set.subset_singleton_iff_eq.mp hts with rfl | rfl
  · simp at htpos
  · exact lt_irrefl _ htlt

name: RandomSetTheory.IsAtomlessMeasure.exists_measurable_split
statement:
theorem IsAtomlessMeasure.exists_measurable_split
    {μ : Measure Ω} (hμ : IsAtomlessMeasure μ)
    {s : Set Ω} (hs : MeasurableSet s) (hspos : 0 < μ s) :
    ∃ t : Set Ω,
      t ⊆ s ∧ MeasurableSet t ∧ 0 < μ t ∧ 0 < μ (s \ t)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, hts, htmeas, htpos, htlt⟩ := hμ s hs hspos
  refine ⟨t, hts, htmeas, htpos, ?_⟩
  rw [measure_sdiff hts htmeas.nullMeasurableSet (ne_top_of_lt htlt)]
  exact tsub_pos_iff_lt.mpr htlt

name: RandomSetTheory.IsAtomlessMeasure.restrict
statement:
theorem IsAtomlessMeasure.restrict
    {μ : Measure Ω} (hμ : IsAtomlessMeasure μ)
    {s : Set Ω} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    IsAtomlessMeasure (μ.restrict s)
proof:
:= by
  intro A hA hApos
  have hAs : MeasurableSet (A ∩ s) := hA.inter hs
  have hApos' : 0 < μ (A ∩ s) := by
    simpa [Measure.restrict_apply hA] using hApos
  obtain ⟨t, htAs, htmeas, htpos, htlt⟩ := hμ (A ∩ s) hAs hApos'
  have hts : t ⊆ s := htAs.trans inter_subset_right
  refine ⟨t, htAs.trans inter_subset_left, htmeas, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [Measure.restrict_apply htmeas, inter_eq_self_of_subset_left hts]
      using htpos
  · simpa [Measure.restrict_apply htmeas, Measure.restrict_apply hA,
      inter_eq_self_of_subset_left hts] using htlt

name: RandomSetTheory.zero_mem_measurableSetIntegralRange
statement:
theorem zero_mem_measurableSetIntegralRange (μ : Measure Ω) (f : Ω → E) :
    0 ∈ measurableSetIntegralRange μ f
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨∅, MeasurableSet.empty, by simp⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.integral_mem_measurableSetIntegralRange
statement:
theorem integral_mem_measurableSetIntegralRange (μ : Measure Ω) (f : Ω → E) :
    (∫ ω, f ω ∂μ) ∈ measurableSetIntegralRange μ f
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨Set.univ, MeasurableSet.univ, by simp⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.HasLyapunovConvexity.of_continuousLinearEquiv
statement:
theorem HasLyapunovConvexity.of_continuousLinearEquiv
    {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
    {μ : Measure Ω} (hF : HasLyapunovConvexity μ F)
    (e : E ≃L[ℝ] F) : HasLyapunovConvexity μ E
proof:
:= by
  intro f hf
  have hef : Integrable (fun ω => e (f ω)) μ :=
    (e.integrable_comp_iff).2 hf
  have hconv := hF (fun ω => e (f ω)) hef
  intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
  have hex : e x ∈ measurableSetIntegralRange μ (fun ω => e (f ω)) := by
    rcases hx with ⟨A, hA, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨A, hA, ?_⟩
    exact e.integral_comp_comm f
  have hey : e y ∈ measurableSetIntegralRange μ (fun ω => e (f ω)) := by
    rcases hy with ⟨B, hB, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨B, hB, ?_⟩
    exact e.integral_comp_comm f
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hCeq⟩ := hconv hex hey ha hb hab
  refine ⟨C, hC, ?_⟩
  apply e.injective
  calc
    e (∫ ω in C, f ω ∂μ) = ∫ ω in C, e (f ω) ∂μ :=
      (e.integral_comp_comm f).symm
    _ = a • e x + b • e y := hCeq
    _ = e (a • x + b • y) := by simp

name: RandomSetTheory.hasLyapunovConvexity_continuousLinearEquiv_iff
statement:
theorem hasLyapunovConvexity_continuousLinearEquiv_iff
    {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
    {μ : Measure Ω} (e : E ≃L[ℝ] F) :
    HasLyapunovConvexity μ E ↔ HasLyapunovConvexity μ F
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hE
    exact hE.of_continuousLinearEquiv e.symm
  · intro hF
    exact hF.of_continuousLinearEquiv e

name: RandomSetTheory.HasLyapunovConvexity.exists_setIntegral_eq_smul
statement:
theorem HasLyapunovConvexity.exists_setIntegral_eq_smul
    {μ : Measure Ω} (hμ : HasLyapunovConvexity μ E)
    {f : Ω → E} (hf : Integrable f μ) {a : ℝ} (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1) :
    ∃ A : Set Ω, MeasurableSet A ∧
      (∫ ω in A, f ω ∂μ) = a • ∫ ω, f ω ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have hmem := hμ f hf
    (integral_mem_measurableSetIntegralRange μ f)
    (zero_mem_measurableSetIntegralRange μ f)
    ha0 (sub_nonneg.mpr ha1) (by ring)
  rcases hmem with ⟨A, hA, hEq⟩
  exact ⟨A, hA, by simpa using hEq⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_convex_of_lyapunov
statement:
theorem aumannExpectation_convex_of_lyapunov
    {μ : Measure Ω} (hμ : HasLyapunovConvexity μ E) (S : Ω → Set E) :
    Convex ℝ (aumannExpectation μ S)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
  rcases hx with ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
  rcases hy with ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
  have hfg : Integrable (fun ω => f ω - g ω) μ := hf.1.sub hg.1
  obtain ⟨A, hA, hsplit⟩ :=
    hμ.exists_setIntegral_eq_smul hfg ha (by linarith)
  let q : Ω → E := fun ω => g ω + A.indicator (fun ω => f ω - g ω) ω
  have hqint : Integrable q μ :=
    hg.1.add (hfg.integrableOn.integrable_indicator hA)
  refine ⟨q, ⟨hqint, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · filter_upwards [hf.2, hg.2] with ω hfω hgω
    by_cases hω : ω ∈ A
    · simpa [q, Set.indicator_of_mem hω] using hfω
    · simpa [q, Set.indicator_of_notMem hω] using hgω
  · rw [show q = fun ω => g ω + A.indicator (fun ω => f ω - g ω) ω from rfl]
    rw [integral_add hg.1 (hfg.integrableOn.integrable_indicator hA)]
    rw [integral_indicator hA, hsplit, integral_sub hf.1 hg.1]
    have hb' : b = 1 - a := by linarith
    rw [hb']
    module

name: RandomSetTheory.closure_aumannExpectation_convex_of_lyapunov
statement:
theorem closure_aumannExpectation_convex_of_lyapunov
    {μ : Measure Ω} (hμ : HasLyapunovConvexity μ E) (S : Ω → Set E) :
    Convex ℝ (closure (aumannExpectation μ S))
proof:
:=
  (aumannExpectation_convex_of_lyapunov hμ S).closure

name: RandomSetTheory.add_mem_aumannExpectation
statement:
theorem add_mem_aumannExpectation {μ : Measure Ω} {S T : Ω → Set E}
    {x y : E} (hx : x ∈ aumannExpectation μ S)
    (hy : y ∈ aumannExpectation μ T) :
    x + y ∈ aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => S ω + T ω)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hx with ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
  rcases hy with ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨fun ω => f ω + g ω, ⟨hf.1.add hg.1, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · filter_upwards [hf.2, hg.2] with ω hfω hgω
    exact Set.add_mem_add hfω hgω
  · exact integral_add hf.1 hg.1

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_add_subset
statement:
theorem aumannExpectation_add_subset {μ : Measure Ω} {S T : Ω → Set E} :
    aumannExpectation μ S + aumannExpectation μ T ⊆
      aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => S ω + T ω)
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨x, hx, y, hy, rfl⟩
  exact add_mem_aumannExpectation hx hy

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_add
statement:
theorem aumannExpectation_add
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S T : Ω → Set E}
    (hdecomp : HasIntegrableMinkowskiDecomposition μ S T) :
    aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => S ω + T ω) =
      aumannExpectation μ S + aumannExpectation μ T
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · rintro x ⟨f, hf, hfx⟩
    obtain ⟨g, h, hg, hh, hfgh⟩ := hdecomp f hf
    refine ⟨∫ ω, g ω ∂μ, ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩,
      ∫ ω, h ω ∂μ, ⟨h, hh, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    calc
      (∫ ω, g ω ∂μ) + ∫ ω, h ω ∂μ =
          ∫ ω, g ω + h ω ∂μ := (integral_add hg.1 hh.1).symm
      _ = ∫ ω, f ω ∂μ := integral_congr_ae hfgh.symm
      _ = x := hfx
  · exact aumannExpectation_add_subset

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_add_singleton
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · rintro x ⟨h, hh, rfl⟩
    let f : Ω → E := fun ω => h ω - g ω
    have hfmem : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, f ω ∈ S ω := by
      filter_upwards [hh.2] with ω hω
      rcases hω with ⟨s, hs, t, ht, hst⟩
      simp only [mem_singleton_iff] at ht
      subst t
      simp [f, ← hst, hs]
    have hf : IsIntegrableSelection μ S f := ⟨hh.1.sub hg, hfmem⟩
    refine ⟨∫ ω, f ω ∂μ, ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩,
      ∫ ω, g ω ∂μ, Set.mem_singleton _, ?_⟩
    change (∫ ω, f ω ∂μ) + (∫ ω, g ω ∂μ) = ∫ ω, h ω ∂μ
    rw [← integral_add hf.1 hg]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [] with ω
    simp [f]
  · rintro x ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩
    simp only [mem_singleton_iff] at hb
    subst b
    have hgmem : (∫ ω, g ω ∂μ) ∈
        aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => ({g ω} : Set E)) := by
      rw [aumannExpectation_singleton hg]
      exact Set.mem_singleton _
    exact add_mem_aumannExpectation ha hgmem

name: RandomSetTheory.smul_mem_aumannExpectation
proof:
:= by
  rcases hx with ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨fun ω => c • f ω, ⟨hf.1.smul c, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · filter_upwards [hf.2] with ω hfω
    exact Set.smul_mem_smul_set hfω
  · exact integral_smul c f

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_smul_subset
statement:
theorem aumannExpectation_smul_subset {μ : Measure Ω} {S : Ω → Set E}
    (c : ℝ) :
    c • aumannExpectation μ S ⊆
      aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => c • S ω)
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  exact smul_mem_aumannExpectation c hx

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_smul_of_ne
statement:
theorem aumannExpectation_smul_of_ne {μ : Measure Ω} {S : Ω → Set E}
    (c : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => c • S ω) =
      c • aumannExpectation μ S
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · rintro y ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
    let f : Ω → E := fun ω => c⁻¹ • g ω
    have hfmem : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, f ω ∈ S ω := by
      filter_upwards [hg.2] with ω hω
      rcases hω with ⟨x, hx, hcx⟩
      simpa [f, ← hcx, hc] using hx
    refine ⟨∫ ω, f ω ∂μ, ⟨f, ⟨hg.1.smul c⁻¹, hfmem⟩, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [integral_smul]
    simp [hc]
  · exact aumannExpectation_smul_subset c

name: RandomSetTheory.zero_mem_aumannExpectation
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun _ => 0, ⟨integrable_zero _ _ _, hzero⟩, ?_⟩
  simp

name: RandomSetTheory.norm_le_integral_envelope_of_mem_aumannExpectation
statement:
theorem norm_le_integral_envelope_of_mem_aumannExpectation
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S : Ω → Set E} {g : Ω → ℝ}
    (hg : Integrable g μ)
    (hdom : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∀ x ∈ S ω, ‖x‖ ≤ g ω)
    {x : E} (hx : x ∈ aumannExpectation μ S) :
    ‖x‖ ≤ ∫ ω, g ω ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rcases hx with ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
  apply norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hg
  filter_upwards [hf.2, hdom] with ω hfω hdomω
  exact hdomω (f ω) hfω

name: RandomSetTheory.norm_le_integral_envelope_of_mem_closure_aumannExpectation
statement:
theorem norm_le_integral_envelope_of_mem_closure_aumannExpectation
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S : Ω → Set E} {g : Ω → ℝ}
    (hg : Integrable g μ)
    (hdom : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∀ x ∈ S ω, ‖x‖ ≤ g ω)
    {x : E} (hx : x ∈ closure (aumannExpectation μ S)) :
    ‖x‖ ≤ ∫ ω, g ω ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : aumannExpectation μ S ⊆
      {y : E | ‖y‖ ≤ ∫ ω, g ω ∂μ} := fun _ hy =>
    norm_le_integral_envelope_of_mem_aumannExpectation hg hdom hy
  exact closure_minimal hsub
    (isClosed_le continuous_norm continuous_const) hx

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_isBounded_of_integrable_envelope
statement:
theorem aumannExpectation_isBounded_of_integrable_envelope
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S : Ω → Set E} {g : Ω → ℝ}
    (hg : Integrable g μ)
    (hdom : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∀ x ∈ S ω, ‖x‖ ≤ g ω) :
    Bornology.IsBounded (aumannExpectation μ S)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isBounded_iff_forall_norm_le]
  refine ⟨∫ ω, g ω ∂μ, ?_⟩
  exact fun _ hx =>
    norm_le_integral_envelope_of_mem_aumannExpectation hg hdom hx

name: RandomSetTheory.closure_aumannExpectation_compact_of_integrable_envelope
statement:
theorem closure_aumannExpectation_compact_of_integrable_envelope
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S : Ω → Set E} {g : Ω → ℝ}
    (hg : Integrable g μ)
    (hdom : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∀ x ∈ S ω, ‖x‖ ≤ g ω) :

proof:
:=
  (aumannExpectation_isBounded_of_integrable_envelope hg hdom).isCompact_closure

name: RandomSetTheory.closure_aumannExpectation_compact_convex
statement:
theorem closure_aumannExpectation_compact_convex
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S : Ω → Set E} {g : Ω → ℝ}
    (hconv : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Convex ℝ (S ω))
    (hg : Integrable g μ)
    (hdom : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∀ x ∈ S ω, ‖x‖ ≤ g ω) :
    IsCompact (closure (aumannExpectation μ S)) ∧
      Convex ℝ (closure (aumannExpectation μ S))
proof:
:=
  ⟨closure_aumannExpectation_compact_of_integrable_envelope hg hdom,
    (aumannExpectation_convex hconv).closure⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.closure_aumannExpectation_compact_convex_of_lyapunov
statement:
theorem closure_aumannExpectation_compact_convex_of_lyapunov
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} (hμ : HasLyapunovConvexity μ E)
    {S : Ω → Set E} {g : Ω → ℝ}
    (hg : Integrable g μ)
    (hdom : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∀ x ∈ S ω, ‖x‖ ≤ g ω) :

proof:

  ⟨closure_aumannExpectation_compact_of_integrable_envelope hg hdom,
    closure_aumannExpectation_convex_of_lyapunov hμ S⟩

name: ProbabilityTheory.ae_abs_doobCenteredDifference_le_two_mul
statement:
theorem ae_abs_doobCenteredDifference_le_two_mul
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (F : Omega → ℝ) {B : ℝ}
    (hFbound : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, |F omega| ≤ B) (k : ℕ) :
    ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      |doobCenteredDifference filtration mu F k omega| ≤ 2 * B
proof:
:= by
  have hFboundNorm : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, ‖F omega‖ ≤ B := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hFbound
  have hmean : |∫ omega, F omega ∂mu| ≤ B := by
    have h := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const hFboundNorm
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, probReal_univ, mul_one] using h
  cases k with
  | zero =>
      have hcond : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, ‖mu[F | filtration 0] omega‖ ≤ B :=
        ae_bdd_norm_condExp_of_ae_bdd_norm hFboundNorm
      filter_upwards [hcond] with omega hcondOmega
      change |mu[F | filtration 0] omega - ∫ z, F z ∂mu| ≤ 2 * B
      calc
        |mu[F | filtration 0] omega - ∫ z, F z ∂mu| ≤
            |mu[F | filtration 0] omega| + |∫ z, F z ∂mu| := abs_sub _ _
        _ ≤ B + B := by
          exact add_le_add (by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hcondOmega) hmean
        _ = 2 * B := by ring
  | succ k =>
      have hcondNext : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
          ‖mu[F | filtration (k + 1)] omega‖ ≤ B :=
        ae_bdd_norm_condExp_of_ae_bdd_norm hFboundNorm
      have hcondPrev : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
          ‖mu[F | filtration k] omega‖ ≤ B :=
        ae_bdd_norm_condExp_of_ae_bdd_norm hFboundNorm
      filter_upwards [hcondNext, hcondPrev]
        with omega hnextOmega hprevOmega
      change |mu[F | filtration (k + 1)] omega -
        mu[F | filtration k] omega| ≤ 2 * B
      calc
        |mu[F | filtration (k + 1)] omega -
            mu[F | filtration k] omega| ≤
            |mu[F | filtration (k + 1)] omega| +
              |mu[F | filtration k] omega| := abs_sub _ _
        _ ≤ B + B := by
          exact add_le_add
            (by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hnextOmega)
            (by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hprevOmega)
        _ = 2 * B := by ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.memLp_doobCenteredDifference_two_of_ae_abs_le
statement:
theorem memLp_doobCenteredDifference_two_of_ae_abs_le
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (F : Omega → ℝ) {B : ℝ}
    (hFbound : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, |F omega| ≤ B) (k : ℕ) :
    MemLp (doobCenteredDifference filtration mu F k) 2 mu
proof:
:= by
  apply MemLp.of_bound
    (((stronglyAdapted_doobCenteredDifference filtration mu F k).mono
      (filtration.le k)).aestronglyMeasurable) (2 * B)
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
    ae_abs_doobCenteredDifference_le_two_mul filtration F hFbound k

name: ProbabilityTheory.hasBernsteinMGF_finiteProcessSupremum_sub_integral_of_condSecondMoment_le
statement:
theorem hasBernsteinMGF_finiteProcessSupremum_sub_integral_of_condSecondMoment_le
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    [SigmaFiniteFiltration mu filtration]
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty) (X : T → Omega → ℝ)
    (A : Omega → ℝ) (hA : Integrable A mu)
    (hX : ∀ t ∈ s, Measurable (X t))
    (hdom : ∀ omega t, t ∈ s → |X t omega| ≤ |A omega|)
    (B : ℝ≥0) (hAbound : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, |A omega| ≤ (B : ℝ))
    (v : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ)
    (hterminal : mu[finiteProcessSupremum s hs X | filtration n]
      =ᵐ[mu] finiteProcessSupremum s hs X)
    (hsecond0 : ∫ omega,
      doobCenteredDifference filtration mu (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X)
        0 omega ^ 2 ∂mu ≤ (v 0 : ℝ))
    (hsecondSucc : ∀ k < n,
      ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
        mu[fun z ↦
          doobCenteredDifference filtration mu
            (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X) (k + 1) z ^ 2 |
              filtration k] omega ≤ (v (k + 1) : ℝ)) :
    HasBernsteinMGF
      (fun omega ↦ finiteProcessSupremum s hs X omega -
        ∫ z, finiteProcessSupremum s hs X z ∂mu)
      (2 * ∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), v k) (2 * B) mu
proof:
:= by
  let F : Omega → ℝ := finiteProcessSupremum s hs X
  let D : ℕ → Omega → ℝ := doobCenteredDifference filtration mu F
  have hFint : Integrable F mu := by
    exact integrable_finiteProcessSupremum s hs X A hA hX hdom
  have hFbound : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, |F omega| ≤ (B : ℝ) := by
    filter_upwards [hAbound] with omega hAOmega
    exact (abs_finiteProcessSupremum_le s hs X A hdom omega).trans hAOmega
  have hDAdapted : StronglyAdapted filtration D :=
    stronglyAdapted_doobCenteredDifference filtration mu F
  have hDlp : ∀ k < n + 1, MemLp (D k) 2 mu := by
    intro k _hk
    exact memLp_doobCenteredDifference_two_of_ae_abs_le
      filtration F hFbound k
  have hDbound : ∀ k < n + 1,
      ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, |D k omega| ≤ ((2 * B : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) := by
    intro k _hk
    simpa only [NNReal.coe_mul, NNReal.coe_ofNat] using
      ae_abs_doobCenteredDifference_le_two_mul filtration F hFbound k
  have hDcenter0 : ∫ omega, D 0 omega ∂mu = 0 :=
    integral_doobCenteredDifference_zero filtration F
  have hDcenterSucc : ∀ k < n + 1 - 1,
      mu[D (k + 1) | filtration k] =ᵐ[mu] 0 := by
    intro k _hk
    exact condExp_doobCenteredDifference_succ_ae_eq_zero filtration F k
  have hDsecond0 : ∫ omega, D 0 omega ^ 2 ∂mu ≤ (v 0 : ℝ) := by
    simpa only [D, F] using hsecond0
  have hDsecondSucc : ∀ k < n + 1 - 1, ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      mu[fun z ↦ D (k + 1) z ^ 2 | filtration k] omega ≤
        (v (k + 1) : ℝ) := by
    intro k hk
    simpa only [D, F] using hsecondSucc k (by omega)
  have hsum :=
    hasBernsteinMGF_sum_martingaleDiff_of_condSecondMoment_le
      filtration D hDAdapted v (2 * B) (n + 1) hDlp hDbound
        hDcenter0 hDcenterSucc hDsecond0 hDsecondSucc
  have hsumEq : (fun omega ↦ ∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), D k omega) =ᵐ[mu]
      fun omega ↦ F omega - ∫ z, F z ∂mu := by
    filter_upwards [hterminal] with omega hterminalOmega
    rw [sum_doobCenteredDifference filtration mu F n omega]
    exact sub_left_inj.mpr hterminalOmega
  exact hsum.congr hsumEq

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_finiteProcessSupremum_sub_integral_ge_le_of_condSecondMoment_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_finiteProcessSupremum_sub_integral_ge_le_of_condSecondMoment_le
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    [SigmaFiniteFiltration mu filtration]
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty) (X : T → Omega → ℝ)
    (A : Omega → ℝ) (hA : Integrable A mu)
    (hX : ∀ t ∈ s, Measurable (X t))
    (hdom : ∀ omega t, t ∈ s → |X t omega| ≤ |A omega|)
    (B : ℝ≥0) (hAbound : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, |A omega| ≤ (B : ℝ))
    (v : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ)
    (hterminal : mu[finiteProcessSupremum s hs X | filtration n]
      =ᵐ[mu] finiteProcessSupremum s hs X)
    (hsecond0 : ∫ omega,
      doobCenteredDifference filtration mu (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X)
        0 omega ^ 2 ∂mu ≤ (v 0 : ℝ))
    (hsecondSucc : ∀ k < n,
      ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
        mu[fun z ↦
          doobCenteredDifference filtration mu
            (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X) (k + 1) z ^ 2 |
              filtration k] omega ≤ (v (k + 1) : ℝ))
    {epsilon : ℝ} (hepsilon : 0 ≤ epsilon)
    (hV : 0 < ((∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), v k : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) :
    mu.real {omega | epsilon ≤
        finiteProcessSupremum s hs X omega -
          ∫ z, finiteProcessSupremum s hs X z ∂mu} ≤
      exp (-epsilon ^ 2 /
        (2 * (2 * ((∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), v k : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) +
          2 * (B : ℝ) * epsilon)))
proof:
:= by
  have hmgf :=
    hasBernsteinMGF_finiteProcessSupremum_sub_integral_of_condSecondMoment_le
      filtration s hs X A hA hX hdom B hAbound v n hterminal
        hsecond0 hsecondSucc
  have hproxy :
      0 < ((2 * ∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), v k : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) := by
    simpa only [NNReal.coe_mul, NNReal.coe_ofNat, NNReal.coe_sum] using
      mul_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) hV
  simpa only [NNReal.coe_mul, NNReal.coe_ofNat] using
    hmgf.measure_ge_le hepsilon hproxy

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_abs_finiteProcessSupremum_sub_integral_ge_le_of_condSecondMoment_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_abs_finiteProcessSupremum_sub_integral_ge_le_of_condSecondMoment_le
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    [SigmaFiniteFiltration mu filtration]
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty) (X : T → Omega → ℝ)
    (A : Omega → ℝ) (hA : Integrable A mu)
    (hX : ∀ t ∈ s, Measurable (X t))
    (hdom : ∀ omega t, t ∈ s → |X t omega| ≤ |A omega|)
    (B : ℝ≥0) (hAbound : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, |A omega| ≤ (B : ℝ))
    (v : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ)
    (hterminal : mu[finiteProcessSupremum s hs X | filtration n]
      =ᵐ[mu] finiteProcessSupremum s hs X)
    (hsecond0 : ∫ omega,
      doobCenteredDifference filtration mu (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X)
        0 omega ^ 2 ∂mu ≤ (v 0 : ℝ))
    (hsecondSucc : ∀ k < n,
      ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
        mu[fun z ↦
          doobCenteredDifference filtration mu
            (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X) (k + 1) z ^ 2 |
              filtration k] omega ≤ (v (k + 1) : ℝ))
    {epsilon : ℝ} (hepsilon : 0 ≤ epsilon)
    (hV : 0 < ((∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), v k : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) :
    mu.real {omega | epsilon ≤
        |finiteProcessSupremum s hs X omega -
          ∫ z, finiteProcessSupremum s hs X z ∂mu|} ≤
      2 * exp (-epsilon ^ 2 /
        (2 * (2 * ((∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), v k : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) +
          2 * (B : ℝ) * epsilon)))
proof:
:= by
  have hmgf :=
    hasBernsteinMGF_finiteProcessSupremum_sub_integral_of_condSecondMoment_le
      filtration s hs X A hA hX hdom B hAbound v n hterminal
        hsecond0 hsecondSucc
  have hproxy :
      0 < ((2 * ∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), v k : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) := by
    simpa only [NNReal.coe_mul, NNReal.coe_ofNat, NNReal.coe_sum] using
      mul_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) hV
  simpa only [NNReal.coe_mul, NNReal.coe_ofNat] using
    hmgf.measure_abs_ge_le hepsilon hproxy

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_aumannExpectation_le_integral
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_aumannExpectation_le_integral
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S T : Ω → Set E}
    (hScompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hTcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (T ω))
    (hSne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty) (hTne : ∀ ω, (T ω).Nonempty)
    (hSconv : ∀ ω, Convex ℝ (S ω))
    (hTconv : ∀ ω, Convex ℝ (T ω))
    (hAScompact : IsCompact (aumannExpectation μ S))
    (hATcompact : IsCompact (aumannExpectation μ T))
    (hASne : (aumannExpectation μ S).Nonempty)
    (hATne : (aumannExpectation μ T).Nonempty)
    (hSupportS : ∀ u, Integrable (fun ω => supportFunction (S ω) u) μ)
    (hSupportT : ∀ u, Integrable (fun ω => supportFunction (T ω) u) μ)
    (hSelectionS : ∀ u, HasIntegrableSupportSelection μ S u)
    (hSelectionT : ∀ u, HasIntegrableSupportSelection μ T u)
    (hDist : Integrable (fun ω => hausdorffDist (S ω) (T ω)) μ) :
    hausdorffDist (aumannExpectation μ S) (aumannExpectation μ T) ≤
      ∫ ω, hausdorffDist (S ω) (T ω) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have hASconv : Convex ℝ (aumannExpectation μ S) :=
    aumannExpectation_convex (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hSconv)
  have hATconv : Convex ℝ (aumannExpectation μ T) :=
    aumannExpectation_convex (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hTconv)
  apply hausdorffDist_le_of_unitBall_supportFunction_sub_le
    hAScompact hATcompact hASne hATne hASconv hATconv
  · exact integral_nonneg fun _ => hausdorffDist_nonneg
  · intro u hu
    rw [supportFunction_aumannExpectation
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hScompact) hAScompact hASne u
      (hSupportS u) (hSelectionS u)]
    rw [supportFunction_aumannExpectation
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hTcompact) hATcompact hATne u
      (hSupportT u) (hSelectionT u)]
    calc
      |(∫ ω, supportFunction (S ω) u ∂μ) -
          ∫ ω, supportFunction (T ω) u ∂μ| =
          |∫ ω, supportFunction (S ω) u - supportFunction (T ω) u ∂μ| := by
            rw [integral_sub (hSupportS u) (hSupportT u)]
      _ ≤ ∫ ω, |supportFunction (S ω) u - supportFunction (T ω) u| ∂μ :=
        abs_integral_le_integral_abs
      _ ≤ ∫ ω, hausdorffDist (S ω) (T ω) ∂μ := by
        apply integral_mono (hSupportS u |>.sub (hSupportT u) |>.abs) hDist
        intro ω
        calc
          |supportFunction (S ω) u - supportFunction (T ω) u| ≤
              ‖u‖ * hausdorffDist (S ω) (T ω) :=
            abs_supportFunction_sub_le_hausdorffDist
              (hScompact ω) (hTcompact ω) (hSne ω) (hTne ω) u
          _ ≤ 1 * hausdorffDist (S ω) (T ω) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hu hausdorffDist_nonneg
          _ = hausdorffDist (S ω) (T ω) := one_mul _

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_aumannExpectation_le_integral_of_effros_of_envelope
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_aumannExpectation_le_integral_of_effros_of_envelope
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E] [Nonempty E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S T : Ω → Set E}
    (hSEffros : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hTEffros : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable T)
    (hScompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hTcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (T ω))
    (hSne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty) (hTne : ∀ ω, (T ω).Nonempty)
    (hSconv : ∀ ω, Convex ℝ (S ω))
    (hTconv : ∀ ω, Convex ℝ (T ω))
    {gS gT : Ω → ℝ} (hgS : Integrable gS μ) (hgT : Integrable gT μ)
    (hdomS : ∀ ω, ∀ x ∈ S ω, ‖x‖ ≤ gS ω)
    (hdomT : ∀ ω, ∀ x ∈ T ω, ‖x‖ ≤ gT ω)
    (hAScompact : IsCompact (aumannExpectation μ S))
    (hATcompact : IsCompact (aumannExpectation μ T))
    (hDist : Integrable (fun ω => hausdorffDist (S ω) (T ω)) μ) :
    hausdorffDist (aumannExpectation μ S) (aumannExpectation μ T) ≤
      ∫ ω, hausdorffDist (S ω) (T ω) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have hSupportS : ∀ u,
      Integrable (fun ω => supportFunction (S ω) u) μ := fun u =>
    integrable_supportFunction_of_envelope
      hSEffros hScompact hSne hgS hdomS u
  have hSupportT : ∀ u,
      Integrable (fun ω => supportFunction (T ω) u) μ := fun u =>
    integrable_supportFunction_of_envelope
      hTEffros hTcompact hTne hgT hdomT u
  have hSelectionS : ∀ u, HasIntegrableSupportSelection μ S u := fun u =>
    hasIntegrableSupportSelection_of_effros_of_envelope
      hSEffros hScompact hSne hgS hdomS u
  have hSelectionT : ∀ u, HasIntegrableSupportSelection μ T u := fun u =>
    hasIntegrableSupportSelection_of_effros_of_envelope
      hTEffros hTcompact hTne hgT hdomT u
  have hASne : (aumannExpectation μ S).Nonempty := by
    rcases hSelectionS 0 with ⟨f, hf, _⟩
    exact aumannExpectation_nonempty_of_selection hf
  have hATne : (aumannExpectation μ T).Nonempty := by
    rcases hSelectionT 0 with ⟨f, hf, _⟩
    exact aumannExpectation_nonempty_of_selection hf
  exact hausdorffDist_aumannExpectation_le_integral
    hScompact hTcompact hSne hTne hSconv hTconv
    hAScompact hATcompact hASne hATne hSupportS hSupportT
    hSelectionS hSelectionT hDist

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_closure_aumannExpectation_le_integral_of_envelope
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_closure_aumannExpectation_le_integral_of_envelope
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E] [Nonempty E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {S T : Ω → Set E}
    (hSEffros : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hTEffros : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable T)
    (hScompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hTcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (T ω))
    (hSne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty) (hTne : ∀ ω, (T ω).Nonempty)
    (hSconv : ∀ ω, Convex ℝ (S ω))
    (hTconv : ∀ ω, Convex ℝ (T ω))
    {gS gT : Ω → ℝ} (hgS : Integrable gS μ) (hgT : Integrable gT μ)
    (hdomS : ∀ ω, ∀ x ∈ S ω, ‖x‖ ≤ gS ω)

      Integrable (fun ω => supportFunction (T ω) u) μ := fun u =>
    integrable_supportFunction_of_envelope
      hTEffros hTcompact hTne hgT hdomT u
  have hfS : IsIntegrableSelection μ S
      (supportApproximateSelection hSEffros hScompact hSne 0 1 (by norm_num)) :=

  have hASne : (closure (aumannExpectation μ S)).Nonempty :=
    (aumannExpectation_nonempty_of_selection hfS).closure
  have hATne : (closure (aumannExpectation μ T)).Nonempty :=
    (aumannExpectation_nonempty_of_selection hfT).closure
  have hASconv : Convex ℝ (closure (aumannExpectation μ S)) :=

    (aumannExpectation_convex (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hTconv)).closure
  apply hausdorffDist_le_of_unitBall_supportFunction_sub_le
    hAScompact hATcompact hASne hATne hASconv hATconv
  · exact integral_nonneg fun _ => hausdorffDist_nonneg
  · intro u hu
    rw [supportFunction_closure_aumannExpectation_of_envelope
      hSEffros hScompact hSne hgS hdomS hAScompact u]
    rw [supportFunction_closure_aumannExpectation_of_envelope
      hTEffros hTcompact hTne hgT hdomT hATcompact u]
    calc
      |(∫ ω, supportFunction (S ω) u ∂μ) -
          ∫ ω, supportFunction (T ω) u ∂μ| =
          |∫ ω, supportFunction (S ω) u - supportFunction (T ω) u ∂μ| := by
            rw [integral_sub (hSupportS u) (hSupportT u)]
      _ ≤ ∫ ω, |supportFunction (S ω) u - supportFunction (T ω) u| ∂μ :=
        abs_integral_le_integral_abs
      _ ≤ ∫ ω, hausdorffDist (S ω) (T ω) ∂μ := by
        apply integral_mono (hSupportS u |>.sub (hSupportT u) |>.abs) hDist
        intro ω
        calc
          |supportFunction (S ω) u - supportFunction (T ω) u| ≤
              ‖u‖ * hausdorffDist (S ω) (T ω) :=
            abs_supportFunction_sub_le_hausdorffDist
              (hScompact ω) (hTcompact ω) (hSne ω) (hTne ω) u
          _ ≤ 1 * hausdorffDist (S ω) (T ω) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hu hausdorffDist_nonneg
          _ = hausdorffDist (S ω) (T ω) := one_mul _

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_closure_aumannExpectation_le_integral

theorem hausdorffDist_closure_aumannExpectation_le_integral
