name: ProbabilityTheory.convexOn_Ici_mul_le_mul
statement:
theorem convexOn_Ici_mul_le_mul
    {psi : ℝ → ℝ} (hconv : ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Ici 0) psi)
    (hzero : psi 0 = 0) {a t : ℝ}
    (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    psi (a * t) ≤ a * psi t
proof:
:= by
  have hweight : a + (1 - a) = 1 := by ring
  have htmem : t ∈ Set.Ici (0 : ℝ) := ht
  have h0mem : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ici (0 : ℝ) := by simp
  have hbase := hconv.2 htmem h0mem ha0 (sub_nonneg.mpr ha1) hweight
  simpa only [smul_eq_mul, mul_zero, add_zero, hzero] using hbase

name: ProbabilityTheory.chernoffObjective_add_harmonic_le
statement:
theorem chernoffObjective_add_harmonic_le
    {psi0 psi1 : ℝ → ℝ} {x s t : ℝ}
    (hconv0 : ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Ici 0) psi0)
    (hconv1 : ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Ici 0) psi1)
    (hzero0 : psi0 0 = 0) (hzero1 : psi1 0 = 0)
    (hs : 0 < s) (ht : 0 < t) :
    ((psi0 (s * t / (s + t)) + psi1 (s * t / (s + t))) + x) /
        (s * t / (s + t)) ≤
      (psi0 t + x) / t + (psi1 s + x) / s
proof:
:= by
  have hst : 0 < s + t := add_pos hs ht
  have hsweight0 : 0 ≤ s / (s + t) := (div_pos hs hst).le
  have hsweight1 : s / (s + t) ≤ 1 := by
    exact (div_le_one hst).2 (le_add_of_nonneg_right ht.le)
  have htweight0 : 0 ≤ t / (s + t) := (div_pos ht hst).le
  have htweight1 : t / (s + t) ≤ 1 := by
    exact (div_le_one hst).2 (le_add_of_nonneg_left hs.le)
  have hpsi0 : psi0 (s * t / (s + t)) ≤
      (s / (s + t)) * psi0 t := by
    have h := convexOn_Ici_mul_le_mul hconv0 hzero0
      hsweight0 hsweight1 ht.le
    have heq : (s / (s + t)) * t = s * t / (s + t) := by ring
    rw [← heq]
    exact h
  have hpsi1 : psi1 (s * t / (s + t)) ≤
      (t / (s + t)) * psi1 s := by
    have h := convexOn_Ici_mul_le_mul hconv1 hzero1
      htweight0 htweight1 hs.le
    have heq : (t / (s + t)) * s = s * t / (s + t) := by ring
    rw [← heq]
    exact h
  have hz : 0 < s * t / (s + t) := div_pos (mul_pos hs ht) hst
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hz).2
  have hstne : s + t ≠ 0 := hst.ne'
  have hsne : s ≠ 0 := hs.ne'
  have htne : t ≠ 0 := ht.ne'
  calc
    psi0 (s * t / (s + t)) + psi1 (s * t / (s + t)) + x
        ≤ (s / (s + t)) * psi0 t +
            (t / (s + t)) * psi1 s + x := by linarith
    _ = ((psi0 t + x) / t + (psi1 s + x) / s) *
          (s * t / (s + t)) := by
      field_simp [hstne, hsne, htne]
      ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.chernoffTransform_add_le
statement:
theorem chernoffTransform_add_le
    {psi0 psi1 : ℝ → ℝ} {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x)
    (hconv0 : ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Ici 0) psi0)
    (hconv1 : ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Ici 0) psi1)
    (hzero0 : psi0 0 = 0) (hzero1 : psi1 0 = 0)
    (hnonneg0 : ∀ t, 0 < t → 0 ≤ psi0 t)
    (hnonneg1 : ∀ t, 0 < t → 0 ≤ psi1 t) :
    chernoffTransform (fun t => psi0 t + psi1 t) x ≤
      chernoffTransform psi0 x + chernoffTransform psi1 x
proof:
:= by
  let f0 : PositiveLaplaceParameter → ℝ := chernoffObjective psi0 x
  let f1 : PositiveLaplaceParameter → ℝ := chernoffObjective psi1 x
  let fsum : PositiveLaplaceParameter → ℝ :=
    chernoffObjective (fun t => psi0 t + psi1 t) x
  have hb0 : BddBelow (Set.range f0) := by
    simpa only [f0] using bddBelow_range_chernoffObjective hx hnonneg0
  have hb1 : BddBelow (Set.range f1) := by
    simpa only [f1] using bddBelow_range_chernoffObjective hx hnonneg1
  have hnonnegSum : ∀ t, 0 < t → 0 ≤ psi0 t + psi1 t := by
    intro t ht
    exact add_nonneg (hnonneg0 t ht) (hnonneg1 t ht)
  have hbsum : BddBelow (Set.range fsum) := by
    simpa only [fsum] using
      bddBelow_range_chernoffObjective hx hnonnegSum
  refine le_of_forall_pos_le_add fun epsilon hepsilon => ?_
  obtain ⟨a0, ⟨t, ht⟩, ha0⟩ :=
    Real.lt_sInf_add_pos (Set.range_nonempty f0) (half_pos hepsilon)
  obtain ⟨a1, ⟨s, hs⟩, ha1⟩ :=
    Real.lt_sInf_add_pos (Set.range_nonempty f1) (half_pos hepsilon)
  subst a0
  subst a1
  let z : PositiveLaplaceParameter :=
    ⟨s * t / (s + t), div_pos (mul_pos s.property t.property)
      (add_pos s.property t.property)⟩
  have hsumAtZ : sInf (Set.range fsum) ≤ fsum z :=
    csInf_le hbsum ⟨z, rfl⟩
  have hharmonic : fsum z ≤ f0 t + f1 s := by
    dsimp only [fsum, f0, f1, chernoffObjective, z]
    exact chernoffObjective_add_harmonic_le hconv0 hconv1
      hzero0 hzero1 s.property t.property
  change sInf (Set.range fsum) ≤
    sInf (Set.range f0) + sInf (Set.range f1) + epsilon
  calc
    sInf (Set.range fsum) ≤ fsum z := hsumAtZ
    _ ≤ f0 t + f1 s := hharmonic
    _ ≤ (sInf (Set.range f0) + epsilon / 2) +
        (sInf (Set.range f1) + epsilon / 2) := (add_lt_add ha0 ha1).le
    _ = sInf (Set.range f0) + sInf (Set.range f1) + epsilon := by ring

name: RandomSetTheory.strongMonotonicityOn_of_hasFDerivWithinAt
statement:
theorem strongMonotonicityOn_of_hasFDerivWithinAt
    (Theta : Set E) (kappa : ℝ) (f : E → E) (Df : E → E →L[ℝ] E)
    (hTheta : Convex ℝ Theta)
    (hderiv : ∀ x, x ∈ Theta → HasFDerivWithinAt f (Df x) Theta x)
    (hlower : ∀ x, x ∈ Theta → ∀ v,
      kappa * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪Df x v, v⟫_ℝ) :
    StrongMonotonicityOn Theta kappa f
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy
  let d : E := x - y
  let line : ℝ → E := AffineMap.lineMap y x
  let phi : ℝ → ℝ := fun t ↦ ⟪f (line t), d⟫_ℝ
  have hmaps : MapsTo line (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) Theta := by
    intro t ht
    exact hTheta.lineMap_mem hy hx ht
  have hlineDeriv (t : ℝ) :
      HasDerivWithinAt line d (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) t := by
    simpa [line, d] using
      (AffineMap.hasDerivWithinAt_lineMap
        (a := y) (b := x) (s := Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (x := t))
  have hphiDeriv (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
      HasDerivWithinAt phi ⟪Df (line t) d, d⟫_ℝ
        (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) t := by
    have hcomp :
        HasDerivWithinAt (f ∘ line) (Df (line t) d)
          (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) t :=
      (hderiv (line t) (hmaps ht)).comp_hasDerivWithinAt t
        (hlineDeriv t) hmaps
    have hconst :
        HasDerivWithinAt (fun _ : ℝ ↦ d) 0 (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) t :=
      hasDerivWithinAt_const t (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) d
    simpa [phi, Function.comp_def] using hcomp.inner ℝ hconst
  have hcont : ContinuousOn phi (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
    intro t ht
    exact (hphiDeriv t ht).continuousWithinAt
  have hdiff : DifferentiableOn ℝ phi (interior (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)) := by
    intro t ht
    have htIcc : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := interior_subset ht
    exact ((hphiDeriv t htIcc).hasDerivAt
      (mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.mp ht)).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
  have hlowerDeriv : ∀ t ∈ interior (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1),
      kappa * ‖d‖ ^ 2 ≤ deriv phi t := by
    intro t ht
    have htIcc : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := interior_subset ht
    have hfull := (hphiDeriv t htIcc).hasDerivAt
      (mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.mp ht)
    rw [hfull.deriv]
    exact hlower (line t) (hmaps htIcc) d
  have hmvt :=
    (convex_Icc (0 : ℝ) 1).mul_sub_le_image_sub_of_le_deriv
      hcont hdiff hlowerDeriv 0 (left_mem_Icc.mpr zero_le_one)
      1 (right_mem_Icc.mpr zero_le_one) zero_le_one
  simpa [phi, line, d, AffineMap.lineMap_apply_zero,
    AffineMap.lineMap_apply_one, inner_sub_left] using hmvt

name: RandomSetTheory.measurable_hausdorffEDist_correspondence
statement:
theorem measurable_hausdorffEDist_correspondence
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [MetricSpace E] [CompleteSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] [Nonempty E]
    {S T : Ω → Set E}
    (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hT : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable T)
    (hSclosed : ∀ ω, IsClosed (S ω)) (hTclosed : ∀ ω, IsClosed (T ω))
    (hSne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty) (hTne : ∀ ω, (T ω).Nonempty) :
    Measurable (fun ω => hausdorffEDist (S ω) (T ω))
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℕ → Ω → E := castaingRepresentation hS hSclosed hSne
  let g : ℕ → Ω → E := castaingRepresentation hT hTclosed hTne
  have hf : ∀ n, Measurable (f n) :=
    castaingRepresentation_measurable hS hSclosed hSne
  have hg : ∀ n, Measurable (g n) :=
    castaingRepresentation_measurable hT hTclosed hTne
  have hEq : (fun ω => hausdorffEDist (S ω) (T ω)) =
      fun ω =>
        (⨆ n : ℕ, ⨅ m : ℕ, edist (f n ω) (g m ω)) ⊔
          (⨆ m : ℕ, ⨅ n : ℕ, edist (g m ω) (f n ω)) := by
    funext ω
    calc
      hausdorffEDist (S ω) (T ω) =
          hausdorffEDist
            (closure (Set.range fun n => f n ω))
            (closure (Set.range fun n => g n ω)) := by
              rw [closure_range_castaingRepresentation hS hSclosed hSne ω,
                closure_range_castaingRepresentation hT hTclosed hTne ω]
      _ = hausdorffEDist
          (Set.range fun n => f n ω) (Set.range fun n => g n ω) :=
        hausdorffEDist_closure
      _ = (⨆ n : ℕ, ⨅ m : ℕ, edist (f n ω) (g m ω)) ⊔
          (⨆ m : ℕ, ⨅ n : ℕ, edist (g m ω) (f n ω)) := by
        simp only [hausdorffEDist_def, ← Set.image_univ, iSup_image,
          infEDist, iInf_image, Set.mem_univ, iSup_true, iInf_true]
  rw [hEq]
  exact (Measurable.iSup fun n => Measurable.iInf fun m =>
    (hf n).edist (hg m)).sup
      (Measurable.iSup fun m => Measurable.iInf fun n =>
        (hg m).edist (hf n))

name: RandomSetTheory.measurable_hausdorffDist_correspondence
statement:
theorem measurable_hausdorffDist_correspondence
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [MetricSpace E] [CompleteSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] [Nonempty E]
    {S T : Ω → Set E}
    (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hT : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable T)
    (hSclosed : ∀ ω, IsClosed (S ω)) (hTclosed : ∀ ω, IsClosed (T ω))
    (hSne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty) (hTne : ∀ ω, (T ω).Nonempty) :
    Measurable (fun ω => hausdorffDist (S ω) (T ω))
proof:
:= by
  exact (measurable_hausdorffEDist_correspondence
    hS hT hSclosed hTclosed hSne hTne).ennreal_toReal

name: RandomSetTheory.prefixMax_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem prefixMax_zero (a : ℕ → ℝ) : prefixMax a 0 = 0
proof: := rfl

name: RandomSetTheory.prefixMax_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem prefixMax_succ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    prefixMax a (n + 1) = max (prefixMax a n) (a n)
proof: := rfl

name: RandomSetTheory.prefixMax_nonneg
statement:
theorem prefixMax_nonneg {a : ℕ → ℝ} (ha : ∀ n, 0 ≤ a n) :
    ∀ n, 0 ≤ prefixMax a n
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => simp [prefixMax, ih, ha n]

name: RandomSetTheory.le_prefixMax_of_lt
statement:
theorem le_prefixMax_of_lt {a : ℕ → ℝ} {i n : ℕ} (hi : i < n) :
    a i ≤ prefixMax a n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => omega
  | succ n ih =>
      by_cases hin : i = n
      · subst i
        simp [prefixMax]
      · have hi' : i < n := by omega
        exact (ih hi').trans (le_max_left _ _)

name: RandomSetTheory.prefixMax_le
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using hC
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [prefixMax_succ]
      apply max_le
      · exact ih (fun i hi => ha i (hi.trans (Nat.lt_succ_self n)))
      · exact ha n (Nat.lt_succ_self n)

name: RandomSetTheory.tendsto_prefixMax_div_of_tendsto_div
statement:
theorem tendsto_prefixMax_div_of_tendsto_div
    (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha : ∀ n, 0 ≤ a n)
    (h : Tendsto (fun n => a n / ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => prefixMax a n / (n : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  refine Metric.tendsto_atTop.mpr ?_
  intro ε hε
  have hε2 : 0 < ε / 2 := half_pos hε
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp h (ε / 2) hε2
  let C : ℝ := prefixMax a N
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := prefixMax_nonneg ha N
  have hClim : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => C / (n : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa [div_eq_mul_inv] using
      (tendsto_const_nhds.mul
        (tendsto_inv_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (𝕜 := ℝ)) :
        Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => C * (n : ℝ)⁻¹) atTop (𝓝 (C * 0)))
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hClim (ε / 2) hε2
  refine ⟨max N (max M 1), ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  have hnN : N ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn
  have hnM : M ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_left M 1) <|
    le_trans (le_max_right N (max M 1)) hn
  have hn1 : 1 ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_right M 1) <|
    le_trans (le_max_right N (max M 1)) hn
  have hnpos : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hn1)
  have hCdiv : C / (n : ℝ) < ε / 2 := by
    have hm := hM n hnM
    rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero,
      abs_of_nonneg (div_nonneg hC (le_of_lt hnpos))] at hm
    exact hm
  have hCbound : C ≤ (ε / 2) * (n : ℝ) := by
    exact (le_of_lt ((div_lt_iff₀ hnpos).mp hCdiv))
  have hall : ∀ i, i < n → a i ≤ (ε / 2) * (n : ℝ) := by
    intro i hi
    by_cases hiN : i < N
    · exact (le_prefixMax_of_lt hiN).trans hCbound
    · have hNi : N ≤ i := Nat.le_of_not_gt hiN
      have hratioDist := hN i hNi
      have hdenpos : (0 : ℝ) < ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by positivity
      have hratioNonneg : 0 ≤ a i / ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
        div_nonneg (ha i) hdenpos.le
      have hratio : a i / ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) < ε / 2 := by
        rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg hratioNonneg] at hratioDist
        exact hratioDist
      have hai : a i < (ε / 2) * ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
        (div_lt_iff₀ hdenpos).mp hratio
      have hicast : (((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast (Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr hi)
      exact (le_of_lt hai).trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hicast hε2.le)
  have hmax : prefixMax a n ≤ (ε / 2) * (n : ℝ) :=
    prefixMax_le (mul_nonneg hε2.le hnpos.le) hall
  have hquot : prefixMax a n / (n : ℝ) ≤ ε / 2 := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hnpos).2
    simpa [mul_comm] using hmax
  have hquotNonneg : 0 ≤ prefixMax a n / (n : ℝ) :=
    div_nonneg (prefixMax_nonneg ha n) hnpos.le
  rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg hquotNonneg]
  exact hquot.trans_lt (by linarith)

name: RandomSetTheory.tendsto_term_div_succ_of_tendsto_average
statement:
theorem tendsto_term_div_succ_of_tendsto_average
    (a : ℕ → ℝ) (m : ℝ)
    (h : Tendsto
      (fun n => (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, a i) / (n : ℝ))
      atTop (𝓝 m)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => a n / ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  let A : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, a i) / (n : ℝ)
  have hA : Tendsto A atTop (𝓝 m) := by simpa only [A] using h
  have hAshift : Tendsto (fun n => A (n + 1)) atTop (𝓝 m) :=
    hA.comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)
  have hratio : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) + 1))
      atTop (𝓝 1) := tendsto_natCast_div_add_atTop (𝕜 := ℝ) 1
  have hdiff : Tendsto
      (fun n => A (n + 1) - ((n : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) * A n)
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have hprod := hratio.mul hA
    simpa using hAshift.sub hprod
  apply Tendsto.congr' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n => ?_) hdiff
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · subst n
    simp [A]
  · have hnR : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hn
    rw [show ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (n : ℝ) + 1 by norm_num]
    simp only [A, Finset.sum_range_succ]
    field_simp [hnR]
    push_cast
    ring

name: RandomSetTheory.tendsto_prefixMax_div_of_tendsto_average
statement:
theorem tendsto_prefixMax_div_of_tendsto_average
    (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha : ∀ n, 0 ≤ a n) (m : ℝ)
    (h : Tendsto
      (fun n => (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, a i) / (n : ℝ))
      atTop (𝓝 m)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => prefixMax a n / (n : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:=
  tendsto_prefixMax_div_of_tendsto_div a ha
    (tendsto_term_div_succ_of_tendsto_average a m h)

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_closedConvexHull_le_starr
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_closedConvexHull_le_starr
    {E ι : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (s : Finset ι) (K : ι → Set E) (D : ℝ)
    (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hcompact : ∀ i ∈ s, IsCompact (K i))
    (hne : ∀ i ∈ s, (K i).Nonempty)
    (hdiam : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ x ∈ K i, ∀ y ∈ K i, ‖x - y‖ ≤ D) :
    hausdorffDist (minkowskiAverage s K)
        (closedConvexHull ℝ (minkowskiAverage s K)) ≤
      (s.card : ℝ)⁻¹ * (Real.sqrt (finrank ℝ E) * D)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hs : s.Nonempty
  · letI : Nonempty s := hs.to_subtype
    let S : s → Set E := fun i => K i
    have hbound :=
      hausdorffDist_average_sum_closedConvexHull_le_starr
        (S := S) D hD
        (fun i => hcompact i i.property)
        (fun i => hne i i.property)
        (fun i => hdiam i i.property)
    simpa only [minkowskiAverage, S, Fintype.card_coe,
      ← s.sum_attach, Finset.attach_eq_univ] using hbound
  · have hs0 : s = ∅ := Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hs
    subst s
    rw [closedConvexHull_eq_closure_convexHull]
    simp [minkowskiAverage]

name: RandomSetTheory.tendsto_hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_closedConvexHull
statement:
theorem tendsto_hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_closedConvexHull
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (K : ℕ → Set E) (D : ℝ) (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hcompact : ∀ i, IsCompact (K i))
    (hne : ∀ i, (K i).Nonempty)
    (hdiam : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ K i, ∀ y ∈ K i, ‖x - y‖ ≤ D) :
    Tendsto
      (fun n => hausdorffDist
        (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n) K)
        (closedConvexHull ℝ (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n) K)))
      atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  refine squeeze_zero
    (f := fun n : ℕ => hausdorffDist
      (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n) K)
      (closedConvexHull ℝ (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n) K)))
    (g := fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)⁻¹ *
      (Real.sqrt (finrank ℝ E) * D))
    (fun _ => hausdorffDist_nonneg) (fun n => ?_) ?_
  · simpa only [Finset.card_range] using
      (hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_closedConvexHull_le_starr
      (Finset.range n) K D hD
      (fun i _ => hcompact i) (fun i _ => hne i)
      (fun i _ => hdiam i))
  · simpa only [Finset.card_range, zero_mul] using
      (tendsto_inv_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (𝕜 := ℝ)).mul_const
        (Real.sqrt (finrank ℝ E) * D)

name: RandomSetTheory.tendsto_hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_closedConvexHull_of_sublinear_diameter
statement:
theorem tendsto_hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_closedConvexHull_of_sublinear_diameter
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (K : ℕ → Set E) (D : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hD : ∀ n, 0 ≤ D n)
    (hcompact : ∀ i, IsCompact (K i))
    (hne : ∀ i, (K i).Nonempty)
    (hdiam : ∀ n i, i < n →
      ∀ x ∈ K i, ∀ y ∈ K i, ‖x - y‖ ≤ D n)
    (hsublinear : Tendsto (fun n => D n / (n : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto
      (fun n => hausdorffDist
        (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n) K)
        (closedConvexHull ℝ (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n) K)))
      atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  let c : ℝ := Real.sqrt (finrank ℝ E)
  refine squeeze_zero
    (f := fun n : ℕ => hausdorffDist
      (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n) K)
      (closedConvexHull ℝ (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n) K)))
    (g := fun n : ℕ => c * (D n / (n : ℝ)))
    (fun _ => hausdorffDist_nonneg) (fun n => ?_) ?_
  · have hbound :=
      hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_closedConvexHull_le_starr
        (Finset.range n) K (D n) (hD n)
        (fun i _ => hcompact i) (fun i _ => hne i)
        (fun i hi => hdiam n i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi))
    calc
      hausdorffDist
          (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n) K)
          (closedConvexHull ℝ (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n) K)) ≤
          (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * (Real.sqrt (finrank ℝ E) * D n) := by
            simpa only [Finset.card_range] using hbound
      _ = c * (D n / (n : ℝ)) := by
        simp only [c, div_eq_mul_inv]
        ring
  · simpa only [mul_zero] using
      (tendsto_const_nhds.mul hsublinear :
        Tendsto (fun n => c * (D n / (n : ℝ))) atTop (𝓝 (c * 0)))

name: RandomSetTheory.tendsto_hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_closedConvexHull_of_sublinear_radius
statement:
theorem tendsto_hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_closedConvexHull_of_sublinear_radius
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (K : ℕ → Set E) (B : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ n, 0 ≤ B n)
    (hcompact : ∀ i, IsCompact (K i))
    (hne : ∀ i, (K i).Nonempty)
    (hbound : ∀ n i, i < n → ∀ x ∈ K i, ‖x‖ ≤ B n)
    (hsublinear : Tendsto (fun n => B n / (n : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto
      (fun n => hausdorffDist
        (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n) K)
        (closedConvexHull ℝ (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n) K)))
      atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  let D : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => 2 * B n
  apply
    tendsto_hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_closedConvexHull_of_sublinear_diameter
      K D (fun n => mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (hB n)) hcompact hne
  · intro n i hi x hx y hy
    calc
      ‖x - y‖ ≤ ‖x‖ + ‖y‖ := norm_sub_le x y
      _ ≤ B n + B n := add_le_add (hbound n i hi x hx) (hbound n i hi y hy)
      _ = D n := by simp [D, two_mul]
  · have hlim := (tendsto_const_nhds.mul hsublinear :
      Tendsto (fun n => (2 : ℝ) * (B n / (n : ℝ))) atTop (𝓝 ((2 : ℝ) * 0)))
    have hlim' : Tendsto (fun n => (2 : ℝ) * (B n / (n : ℝ)))
        atTop (𝓝 0) := by simpa using hlim
    apply Tendsto.congr' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n => ?_) hlim'
    simp only [D, mul_div_assoc]

name: RandomSetTheory.tendsto_hausdorffDist_of_closedConvexHull
statement:
theorem tendsto_hausdorffDist_of_closedConvexHull
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (K : ℕ → Set E) (L : Set E)
    (hKcompact : ∀ n, IsCompact (K n))
    (hKne : ∀ n, (K n).Nonempty)
    (hdefect : Tendsto
      (fun n => hausdorffDist (K n) (closedConvexHull ℝ (K n)))
      atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hconvexified : Tendsto
      (fun n => hausdorffDist (closedConvexHull ℝ (K n)) L)
      atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => hausdorffDist (K n) L) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  refine squeeze_zero
    (f := fun n => hausdorffDist (K n) L)
    (g := fun n => hausdorffDist (K n) (closedConvexHull ℝ (K n)) +
      hausdorffDist (closedConvexHull ℝ (K n)) L)
    (fun _ => hausdorffDist_nonneg) (fun n => ?_) ?_
  · apply hausdorffDist_triangle
    exact hausdorffEDist_ne_top_of_nonempty_of_bounded
      (hKne n) ((hKne n).mono subset_closedConvexHull)
      (hKcompact n).isBounded
      (closedConvexHull_compact (hKcompact n)).isBounded
  · simpa only [zero_add] using hdefect.add hconvexified

name: RandomSetTheory.tendsto_hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_of_convexified
statement:
theorem tendsto_hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_of_convexified
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (K : ℕ → Set E) (L : Set E) (D : ℝ) (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hcompact : ∀ i, IsCompact (K i))
    (hne : ∀ i, (K i).Nonempty)
    (hdiam : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ K i, ∀ y ∈ K i, ‖x - y‖ ≤ D)
    (hconvexified : Tendsto
      (fun n => hausdorffDist
        (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n)
          (fun i => closedConvexHull ℝ (K i))) L)
      atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto
      (fun n => hausdorffDist
        (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n) K) L)
      atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  let A : ℕ → Set E := fun n => minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n) K
  have hAcompact : ∀ n, IsCompact (A n) := fun n =>
    isCompact_minkowskiAverage _ _ (fun i _ => hcompact i)
  have hAne : ∀ n, (A n).Nonempty := fun n =>
    nonempty_minkowskiAverage _ _ (fun i _ => hne i)
  have hdefect : Tendsto
      (fun n => hausdorffDist (A n) (closedConvexHull ℝ (A n)))
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [A] using
      tendsto_hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_closedConvexHull
        K D hD hcompact hne hdiam
  have hconvexified' : Tendsto
      (fun n => hausdorffDist (closedConvexHull ℝ (A n)) L)
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    apply Tendsto.congr' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n => ?_)
      hconvexified
    rw [show A n = minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n) K from rfl]
    rw [closedConvexHull_minkowskiAverage]
    · exact fun i _ => hcompact i
    · exact fun i _ => hne i
  exact tendsto_hausdorffDist_of_closedConvexHull
    A L hAcompact hAne hdefect hconvexified'

name: RandomSetTheory.ae_tendsto_hausdorffDist_nonconvexAverage_of_scalar_slln
statement:
theorem ae_tendsto_hausdorffDist_nonconvexAverage_of_scalar_slln
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S : ℕ → Ω → Set E} {L : Set E} {R D : ℝ}
    (hScompact : ∀ i ω, IsCompact (S i ω))
    (hSne : ∀ i ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    (hLcompact : IsCompact L) (hLne : L.Nonempty)
    (hLconv : Convex ℝ L) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hSbound : ∀ i ω, ∀ x ∈ S i ω, ‖x‖ ≤ R)
    (hLbound : ∀ x ∈ L, ‖x‖ ≤ R)
    (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hSdiam : ∀ i ω, ∀ x ∈ S i ω, ∀ y ∈ S i ω, ‖x - y‖ ≤ D)
    (hint : ∀ k : ℕ,
      Integrable (fun ω => supportFunction (S 0 ω) (denseSeq E k)) μ)
    (hindep : ∀ k : ℕ, Pairwise (fun i j =>
      IndepFun
        (fun ω => supportFunction (S i ω) (denseSeq E k))
        (fun ω => supportFunction (S j ω) (denseSeq E k)) μ))
    (hident : ∀ k i : ℕ,
      IdentDistrib
        (fun ω => supportFunction (S i ω) (denseSeq E k))
        (fun ω => supportFunction (S 0 ω) (denseSeq E k)) μ μ)
    (hLsupport : ∀ k : ℕ,
      supportFunction L (denseSeq E k) =
        ∫ ω, supportFunction (S 0 ω) (denseSeq E k) ∂μ) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Tendsto
      (fun n => hausdorffDist
        (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n) (fun i => S i ω)) L)
      atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hconvexified :=
    ae_tendsto_hausdorffDist_convexifiedAverage_of_scalar_slln
      (μ := μ) (S := S) (L := L) (R := R)
      hScompact hSne hLcompact hLne hLconv hR hSbound hLbound
      hint hindep hident hLsupport
  filter_upwards [hconvexified] with ω hω
  exact tendsto_hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_of_convexified
    (fun i => S i ω) L D hD
    (fun i => hScompact i ω) (fun i => hSne i ω)
    (fun i => hSdiam i ω) hω

name: RandomSetTheory.ae_tendsto_hausdorffDist_nonconvex_of_convexified_of_sublinear_diameter
statement:
theorem ae_tendsto_hausdorffDist_nonconvex_of_convexified_of_sublinear_diameter
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S : ℕ → Ω → Set E} {L : Set E}
    (hScompact : ∀ i ω, IsCompact (S i ω))
    (hSne : ∀ i ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    (hprefix : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∃ D : ℕ → ℝ,
      (∀ n, 0 ≤ D n) ∧
      (∀ n i, i < n →
        ∀ x ∈ S i ω, ∀ y ∈ S i ω, ‖x - y‖ ≤ D n) ∧
      Tendsto (fun n => D n / (n : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hconvexified : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Tendsto
      (fun n => hausdorffDist
        (closedConvexHull ℝ
          (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n) (fun i => S i ω))) L)
      atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Tendsto
      (fun n => hausdorffDist
        (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n) (fun i => S i ω)) L)
      atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [hprefix, hconvexified] with ω hω hconvω
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hdiam, hsublinear⟩ := hω
  let K : ℕ → Set E := fun i => S i ω
  let A : ℕ → Set E := fun n => minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n) K
  have hAcompact : ∀ n, IsCompact (A n) := fun n =>
    isCompact_minkowskiAverage _ _ (fun i _ => hScompact i ω)
  have hAne : ∀ n, (A n).Nonempty := fun n =>
    nonempty_minkowskiAverage _ _ (fun i _ => hSne i ω)
  have hdefect : Tendsto
      (fun n => hausdorffDist (A n) (closedConvexHull ℝ (A n)))
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [A, K] using
      (tendsto_hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_closedConvexHull_of_sublinear_diameter
        K D hD (fun i => hScompact i ω) (fun i => hSne i ω)
        (fun n i hi => hdiam n i hi) hsublinear)
  have hconvexified' : Tendsto
      (fun n => hausdorffDist (closedConvexHull ℝ (A n)) L)
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [A, K] using hconvω
  exact tendsto_hausdorffDist_of_closedConvexHull
    A L hAcompact hAne hdefect hconvexified'

name: RandomSetTheory.ae_tendsto_hausdorffDist_nonconvex_iid
statement:
theorem ae_tendsto_hausdorffDist_nonconvex_iid
    {Ω Z E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Z]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [Nonempty E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : ℕ → Ω → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hindep : Pairwise (fun i j => IndepFun (X i) (X j) μ))
    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) μ μ)
    (F : Z → Set E) (hF : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable F)
    (hFcompact : ∀ z, IsCompact (F z)) (hFne : ∀ z, (F z).Nonempty)
    {R D : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hFbound : ∀ z, ∀ x ∈ F z, ‖x‖ ≤ R)
    (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hFdiam : ∀ z, ∀ x ∈ F z, ∀ y ∈ F z, ‖x - y‖ ≤ D) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Tendsto
      (fun n => hausdorffDist
        (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n) (fun i => F (X i ω)))
        (closedConvexHull ℝ
          (closure (aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => F (X 0 ω))))))
      atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hconvexified := ae_tendsto_hausdorffDist_convexified_iid
    (μ := μ) X hX hindep hident F hF hFcompact hFne hR hFbound
  filter_upwards [hconvexified] with ω hω
  let K : ℕ → Set E := fun i => F (X i ω)
  let A : ℕ → Set E := fun n => minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n) K
  let L : Set E := closedConvexHull ℝ
    (closure (aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => F (X 0 ω))))
  have hAcompact : ∀ n, IsCompact (A n) := fun n =>
    isCompact_minkowskiAverage _ _ (fun i _ => hFcompact (X i ω))
  have hAne : ∀ n, (A n).Nonempty := fun n =>
    nonempty_minkowskiAverage _ _ (fun i _ => hFne (X i ω))
  have hdefect : Tendsto
      (fun n => hausdorffDist (A n) (closedConvexHull ℝ (A n)))
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [A, K] using
      (tendsto_hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_closedConvexHull
        K D hD (fun i => hFcompact (X i ω))
        (fun i => hFne (X i ω)) (fun i => hFdiam (X i ω)))
  have hconvexified' : Tendsto
      (fun n => hausdorffDist (closedConvexHull ℝ (A n)) L)
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [A, K, L] using hω
  exact tendsto_hausdorffDist_of_closedConvexHull
    A L hAcompact hAne hdefect hconvexified'

name: RandomSetTheory.ae_tendsto_hausdorffDist_nonconvex_iid_of_integrable_envelope_of_sublinear_prefix
statement:
theorem ae_tendsto_hausdorffDist_nonconvex_iid_of_integrable_envelope_of_sublinear_prefix
    {Ω Z E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Z]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [Nonempty E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : ℕ → Ω → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hindep : Pairwise (fun i j => IndepFun (X i) (X j) μ))
    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) μ μ)
    (F : Z → Set E) (hF : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable F)
    (hFcompact : ∀ z, IsCompact (F z)) (hFne : ∀ z, (F z).Nonempty)
    (g : Z → ℝ) (hg : Measurable g)
    (hgint : Integrable (fun ω => g (X 0 ω)) μ)
    (hFbound : ∀ z, ∀ x ∈ F z, ‖x‖ ≤ g z)
    (hprefix : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∃ D : ℕ → ℝ,
      (∀ n, 0 ≤ D n) ∧
      (∀ n i, i < n →
        ∀ x ∈ F (X i ω), ∀ y ∈ F (X i ω), ‖x - y‖ ≤ D n) ∧
      Tendsto (fun n => D n / (n : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Tendsto
      (fun n => hausdorffDist
        (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n) (fun i => F (X i ω)))
        (closedConvexHull ℝ
          (closure (aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => F (X 0 ω))))))
      atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hconvexified :=
    ae_tendsto_hausdorffDist_convexified_iid_of_integrable_envelope
      (μ := μ) X hX hindep hident F hF hFcompact hFne
      g hg hgint hFbound
  exact
    ae_tendsto_hausdorffDist_nonconvex_of_convexified_of_sublinear_diameter
      (μ := μ) (S := fun i ω => F (X i ω))
      (L := closedConvexHull ℝ
        (closure (aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => F (X 0 ω)))))
      (fun i ω => hFcompact (X i ω))
      (fun i ω => hFne (X i ω)) hprefix hconvexified

name: RandomSetTheory.ae_tendsto_hausdorffDist_nonconvex_iid_of_integrable_envelope
statement:
theorem ae_tendsto_hausdorffDist_nonconvex_iid_of_integrable_envelope
    {Ω Z E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Z]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [Nonempty E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : ℕ → Ω → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hindep : Pairwise (fun i j => IndepFun (X i) (X j) μ))
    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) μ μ)
    (F : Z → Set E) (hF : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable F)
    (hFcompact : ∀ z, IsCompact (F z)) (hFne : ∀ z, (F z).Nonempty)
    (g : Z → ℝ) (hg : Measurable g)
    (hgint : Integrable (fun ω => g (X 0 ω)) μ)
    (hFbound : ∀ z, ∀ x ∈ F z, ‖x‖ ≤ g z) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Tendsto
      (fun n => hausdorffDist
        (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n) (fun i => F (X i ω)))
        (closedConvexHull ℝ
          (closure (aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => F (X 0 ω))))))
      atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  let m : ℝ := ∫ ω, g (X 0 ω) ∂μ
  have hgnonneg : ∀ z, 0 ≤ g z := by
    intro z
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hFne z
    exact (norm_nonneg x).trans (hFbound z x hx)
  have hindepEnvelope : Pairwise (fun i j =>
      IndepFun (fun ω => g (X i ω)) (fun ω => g (X j ω)) μ) := by
    intro i j hij
    exact (hindep hij).comp hg hg
  have hidentEnvelope : ∀ i,
      IdentDistrib (fun ω => g (X i ω)) (fun ω => g (X 0 ω)) μ μ := by
    intro i
    exact (hident i).comp hg
  have henvelope : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ,
      Tendsto (fun n : ℕ =>
        (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, g (X i ω)) / (n : ℝ))
        atTop (𝓝 m) := by
    simpa only [m] using ProbabilityTheory.strong_law_ae_real
      (fun i ω => g (X i ω)) hgint hindepEnvelope hidentEnvelope
  have hprefix : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∃ D : ℕ → ℝ,
      (∀ n, 0 ≤ D n) ∧
      (∀ n i, i < n →
        ∀ x ∈ F (X i ω), ∀ y ∈ F (X i ω), ‖x - y‖ ≤ D n) ∧
      Tendsto (fun n => D n / (n : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    filter_upwards [henvelope] with ω henvω
    let a : ℕ → ℝ := fun i => g (X i ω)
    let D : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => 2 * prefixMax a n
    have ha : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i := fun i => hgnonneg (X i ω)
    refine ⟨D, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro n
      exact mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (prefixMax_nonneg ha n)
    · intro n i hi x hx y hy
      have hai : a i ≤ prefixMax a n := le_prefixMax_of_lt hi
      calc
        ‖x - y‖ ≤ ‖x‖ + ‖y‖ := norm_sub_le x y
        _ ≤ a i + a i := add_le_add
          (hFbound (X i ω) x hx) (hFbound (X i ω) y hy)
        _ ≤ prefixMax a n + prefixMax a n := add_le_add hai hai
        _ = D n := by simp [D, two_mul]
    · have hp : Tendsto (fun n => prefixMax a n / (n : ℝ))
          atTop (𝓝 0) :=
        tendsto_prefixMax_div_of_tendsto_average a ha m (by
          simpa only [a] using henvω)
      have htwo : Tendsto (fun n => (2 : ℝ) *
          (prefixMax a n / (n : ℝ))) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
        simpa using (tendsto_const_nhds.mul hp :
          Tendsto (fun n => (2 : ℝ) * (prefixMax a n / (n : ℝ)))
            atTop (𝓝 ((2 : ℝ) * 0)))
      apply Tendsto.congr' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n => ?_) htwo
      simp only [D, mul_div_assoc]
  exact
    ae_tendsto_hausdorffDist_nonconvex_iid_of_integrable_envelope_of_sublinear_prefix
      (μ := μ) X hX hindep hident F hF hFcompact hFne
      g hg hgint hFbound hprefix

name: ProbabilityTheory.bernsteinOptimalParameter_pos
statement:
theorem bernsteinOptimalParameter_pos
    {V c x : ℝ} (hV : 0 < V) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hx : 0 < x) :
    0 < bernsteinOptimalParameter V c x
proof:
:= by
  let a := Real.sqrt (2 * x / V)
  have ha : 0 < a := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (div_pos (by positivity) hV)
  have hden : 0 < 1 + c * a / 3 := by positivity
  exact div_pos ha hden

name: ProbabilityTheory.bernsteinRationalObjective_optimal
statement:
theorem bernsteinRationalObjective_optimal
    {V c x : ℝ} (hV : 0 < V) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hx : 0 < x) :
    (bernsteinRationalExponent V c
          (bernsteinOptimalParameter V c x) + x) /
        bernsteinOptimalParameter V c x =
      Real.sqrt (2 * V * x) + c * x / 3
proof:
:= by
  let a : ℝ := Real.sqrt (2 * x / V)
  let d : ℝ := 1 + c * a / 3
  have haArg : 0 < 2 * x / V := div_pos (by positivity) hV
  have ha : 0 < a := Real.sqrt_pos.2 haArg
  have haSq : a ^ 2 = 2 * x / V := by
    dsimp only [a]
    exact Real.sq_sqrt haArg.le
  have hd : 0 < d := by
    dsimp only [d]
    positivity
  have hsqrtSq : Real.sqrt (2 * V * x) ^ 2 = 2 * V * x :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hrootProduct : a * Real.sqrt (2 * V * x) = 2 * x := by
    have hsq : (a * Real.sqrt (2 * V * x)) ^ 2 = (2 * x) ^ 2 := by
      rw [mul_pow, haSq, hsqrtSq]
      field_simp [hV.ne']
    have hleft : 0 ≤ a * Real.sqrt (2 * V * x) := by positivity
    have hright : 0 ≤ 2 * x := by positivity
    nlinarith
  have hpole : 1 - c * (a / d) / 3 = 1 / d := by
    dsimp only [d]
    field_simp [hd.ne']
    ring
  have hbern : bernsteinRationalExponent V c (a / d) = x / d := by
    unfold bernsteinRationalExponent
    rw [hpole, div_pow]
    field_simp [hV.ne', hd.ne']
    nlinarith [haSq]
  have ht : bernsteinOptimalParameter V c x = a / d := by rfl
  rw [ht, hbern]
  dsimp only [d]
  field_simp [ha.ne', hd.ne']
  ring_nf at hrootProduct ⊢
  nlinarith [hrootProduct]

name: ProbabilityTheory.chernoffTransform_le_sqrt_add_linear_of_le_bernsteinOptimal
statement:
theorem chernoffTransform_le_sqrt_add_linear_of_le_bernsteinOptimal
    {psi : ℝ → ℝ} {V c x : ℝ}
    (hV : 0 < V) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hx : 0 < x)
    (hnonneg : ∀ t, 0 < t → 0 ≤ psi t)
    (hbound : psi (bernsteinOptimalParameter V c x) ≤
      bernsteinRationalExponent V c
        (bernsteinOptimalParameter V c x)) :
    chernoffTransform psi x ≤
      Real.sqrt (2 * V * x) + c * x / 3
proof:
:= by
  have ht := bernsteinOptimalParameter_pos hV hc hx
  have hb := bddBelow_range_chernoffObjective hx.le hnonneg
  have heval := chernoffTransform_le_objective
    (psi := psi) (x := x) ht hb
  calc
    chernoffTransform psi x ≤
        (psi (bernsteinOptimalParameter V c x) + x) /
          bernsteinOptimalParameter V c x := heval
    _ ≤ (bernsteinRationalExponent V c
          (bernsteinOptimalParameter V c x) + x) /
          bernsteinOptimalParameter V c x :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (add_le_add hbound le_rfl) ht.le
    _ = Real.sqrt (2 * V * x) + c * x / 3 :=
      bernsteinRationalObjective_optimal hV hc hx

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_measurableSet_setIntegral_eq_integral_weighted_of_atomless
statement:
theorem exists_measurableSet_setIntegral_eq_integral_weighted_of_atomless
    (mu : Measure Omega) [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    (hmu : IsAtomlessMeasure mu) [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {f : Omega → E} (hf : Integrable f mu)
    {a : Omega → ℝ} (ha : Measurable a)
    (ha0 : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, 0 ≤ a omega)
    (ha1 : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, a omega ≤ 1) :
    ∃ A : Set Omega, MeasurableSet A ∧
      (∫ omega in A, f omega ∂mu) =
        ∫ omega, a omega • f omega ∂mu
proof:
:= by
  let g : Omega → E := hf.aestronglyMeasurable.mk f
  have hfg : f =ᵐ[mu] g := hf.aestronglyMeasurable.ae_eq_mk
  have hg : Integrable g mu := hf.congr hfg
  have hgm : Measurable g := hf.aestronglyMeasurable.measurable_mk
  let z : E := ∫ omega, a omega • g omega ∂mu
  let m0 : MeasurableSubset Omega → ℝ := clippedDensityContent mu a
  have hm0dom : m0 ∈ dominatedContents mu :=
    clippedDensityContent_mem_dominatedContents mu a
  have hm0Moment :
      dominatedContentIntegral mu g ⟨m0, hm0dom⟩ = z := by
    exact dominatedContentIntegral_clippedDensityContent
      mu g ha ha0 ha1
  have hm0Fiber : m0 ∈ dominatedIntegralFiber mu g z :=
    (mem_dominatedIntegralFiber_iff mu g z m0).2 ⟨hm0dom, hm0Moment⟩
  have hfiber : (dominatedIntegralFiber mu g z).Nonempty := ⟨m0, hm0Fiber⟩
  obtain ⟨m, hmext⟩ :=
    (isCompact_dominatedIntegralFiber mu hg hgm z).extremePoints_nonempty
      hfiber
  obtain ⟨A, hA, hmA⟩ :=
    extreme_dominatedIntegralFiber_is_restriction mu hmu hg hmext
  have hmfiber : m ∈ dominatedIntegralFiber mu g z :=
    (mem_extremePoints_iff_left.mp hmext).1
  obtain ⟨hm, hmz⟩ :=
    (mem_dominatedIntegralFiber_iff mu g z m).mp hmfiber
  subst m
  have hset : (∫ omega in A, g omega ∂mu) = z := by
    rw [← dominatedContentIntegral_restrictionContent mu g A]
    exact hmz
  refine ⟨A, hA, ?_⟩
  calc
    (∫ omega in A, f omega ∂mu) = ∫ omega in A, g omega ∂mu :=
      integral_congr_ae (ae_restrict_of_ae hfg)
    _ = z := hset
    _ = ∫ omega, a omega • g omega ∂mu := rfl
    _ = ∫ omega, a omega • f omega ∂mu := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [hfg] with omega homega
      rw [homega]

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_integrable_binarySelection_integral_eq_of_atomless
statement:
theorem exists_integrable_binarySelection_integral_eq_of_atomless
    (mu : Measure Omega) [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    (hmu : IsAtomlessMeasure mu) [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {f g : Omega → E} (hf : Integrable f mu) (hg : Integrable g mu)
    {a : Omega → ℝ} (ha : Measurable a)
    (ha0 : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, 0 ≤ a omega)
    (ha1 : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, a omega ≤ 1) :
    ∃ q : Omega → E, Integrable q mu ∧
      (∀ omega, q omega = f omega ∨ q omega = g omega) ∧
      (∫ omega, q omega ∂mu) =
        ∫ omega, a omega • f omega +
          (1 - a omega) • g omega ∂mu
proof:
:= by
  have hfg : Integrable (fun omega ↦ f omega - g omega) mu := hf.sub hg
  have haNorm : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, ‖a omega‖ ≤ 1 := by
    filter_upwards [ha0, ha1] with omega h0 h1
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg h0]
    exact h1
  have haWeighted :
      Integrable (fun omega ↦ a omega • (f omega - g omega)) mu :=
    hfg.bdd_smul 1 ha.aestronglyMeasurable haNorm
  obtain ⟨A, hA, hsplit⟩ :=
    exists_measurableSet_setIntegral_eq_integral_weighted_of_atomless
      mu hmu hfg ha ha0 ha1
  let q : Omega → E := fun omega ↦
    g omega + A.indicator (fun omega ↦ f omega - g omega) omega
  have hq : Integrable q mu :=
    hg.add (hfg.integrableOn.integrable_indicator hA)
  refine ⟨q, hq, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro omega
    by_cases homega : omega ∈ A
    · left
      simp [q, Set.indicator_of_mem homega]
    · right
      simp [q, Set.indicator_of_notMem homega]
  · rw [show q = fun omega ↦
        g omega + A.indicator (fun omega ↦ f omega - g omega) omega
      from rfl]
    rw [integral_add hg (hfg.integrableOn.integrable_indicator hA)]
    rw [integral_indicator hA, hsplit]
    rw [← integral_add hg haWeighted]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun omega ↦ by module

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_binary_purification_of_integrableSelections_of_atomless
statement:
theorem exists_binary_purification_of_integrableSelections_of_atomless
    (mu : Measure Omega) [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    (hmu : IsAtomlessMeasure mu) [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {S : Omega → Set E} {f g : Omega → E}
    (hf : IsIntegrableSelection mu S f)
    (hg : IsIntegrableSelection mu S g)
    {a : Omega → ℝ} (ha : Measurable a)
    (ha0 : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, 0 ≤ a omega)
    (ha1 : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, a omega ≤ 1) :
    ∃ q : Omega → E, IsIntegrableSelection mu S q ∧
      (∀ omega, q omega = f omega ∨ q omega = g omega) ∧
      (∫ omega, q omega ∂mu) =
        ∫ omega, a omega • f omega +
          (1 - a omega) • g omega ∂mu
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hchoice, hqIntegral⟩ :=
    exists_integrable_binarySelection_integral_eq_of_atomless
      mu hmu hf.1 hg.1 ha ha0 ha1
  refine ⟨q, ⟨hq, ?_⟩, hchoice, hqIntegral⟩
  filter_upwards [hf.2, hg.2] with omega hfmem hgmem
  rcases hchoice omega with hqf | hqg
  · simpa [hqf] using hfmem
  · simpa [hqg] using hgmem

name: RandomSetTheory.effrosMeasurable_caratheodoryImage
statement:
theorem effrosMeasurable_caratheodoryImage
    {Ω X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [MetricSpace X] [CompleteSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    [SecondCountableTopology X] [Nonempty X]
    [TopologicalSpace Y] [MeasurableSpace Y] [BorelSpace Y]
    {S : Ω → Set X} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hclosed : ∀ ω, IsClosed (S ω)) (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    {φ : Ω × X → Y} (hφmeas : Measurable φ)
    (hφcont : ∀ ω, Continuous fun x => φ (ω, x)) :
    RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable
      (fun ω => (fun x => φ (ω, x)) '' S ω)
proof:
:= by
  let c : ℕ → Ω → X := castaingRepresentation hS hclosed hne
  have hcmeas : ∀ n, Measurable (c n) :=
    castaingRepresentation_measurable hS hclosed hne
  have hcmem : ∀ n ω, c n ω ∈ S ω :=
    castaingRepresentation_mem hS hclosed hne
  have hcclosure : ∀ ω, closure (Set.range fun n => c n ω) = S ω :=
    closure_range_castaingRepresentation hS hclosed hne
  intro U hU
  have hevalMeas : ∀ n, Measurable (fun ω => φ (ω, c n ω)) := by
    intro n
    exact hφmeas.comp (measurable_id.prodMk (hcmeas n))
  have hEq :
      {ω | (((fun x => φ (ω, x)) '' S ω) ∩ U).Nonempty} =
        ⋃ n : ℕ, (fun ω => φ (ω, c n ω)) ⁻¹' U := by
    ext ω
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_preimage]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, ⟨x, hxS, rfl⟩, hφxU⟩
      have hopen : IsOpen ((fun z => φ (ω, z)) ⁻¹' U) :=
        (hφcont ω).isOpen_preimage U hU
      have hhit :
          (closure (Set.range fun n => c n ω) ∩
            (fun z => φ (ω, z)) ⁻¹' U).Nonempty := by
        refine ⟨x, ?_, hφxU⟩
        rw [hcclosure ω]
        exact hxS
      rw [closure_inter_open_nonempty_iff hopen] at hhit
      rcases hhit with ⟨z, ⟨n, rfl⟩, hnU⟩
      exact ⟨n, hnU⟩
    · rintro ⟨n, hnU⟩
      exact ⟨φ (ω, c n ω), ⟨c n ω, hcmem n ω, rfl⟩, hnU⟩
  rw [hEq]
  exact MeasurableSet.iUnion fun n => hevalMeas n hU.measurableSet

name: RandomSetTheory.effrosMeasurable_caratheodoryImage_param
statement:
theorem effrosMeasurable_caratheodoryImage_param
    {Ω Θ X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Θ]
    [MetricSpace X] [CompleteSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    [SecondCountableTopology X] [Nonempty X]
    [TopologicalSpace Y] [MeasurableSpace Y] [BorelSpace Y]
    {S : Ω → Set X} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hclosed : ∀ ω, IsClosed (S ω)) (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    {φ : (Ω × Θ) × X → Y} (hφmeas : Measurable φ)
    (hφcont : ∀ p : Ω × Θ, Continuous fun x => φ (p, x)) :
    RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable
      (fun p : Ω × Θ => (fun x => φ (p, x)) '' S p.1)
proof:
:= by
  have hSlift : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable
      (fun p : Ω × Θ => S p.1) := by
    intro U hU
    have hEq :
        {p : Ω × Θ | (S p.1 ∩ U).Nonempty} =
          Prod.fst ⁻¹' {ω | (S ω ∩ U).Nonempty} := by
      ext p
      rfl
    rw [hEq]
    exact measurable_fst (hS U hU)
  exact effrosMeasurable_caratheodoryImage hSlift
    (fun p => hclosed p.1) (fun p => hne p.1) hφmeas hφcont

name: RandomSetTheory.measurable_supportFunction_caratheodoryImage_joint
statement:
theorem measurable_supportFunction_caratheodoryImage_joint
    {Ω X H : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [MetricSpace X] [CompleteSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    [SecondCountableTopology X] [Nonempty X]
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H] [Nonempty H]
    {S : Ω → Set X} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω)) (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    {φ : Ω × X → H} (hφmeas : Measurable φ)
    (hφcont : ∀ ω, Continuous fun x => φ (ω, x)) :
    Measurable (fun p : Ω × H =>
      supportFunction ((fun x => φ (p.1, x)) '' S p.1) p.2)
proof:
:= by
  apply measurable_supportFunction_joint
    (effrosMeasurable_caratheodoryImage hS
      (fun ω => (hcompact ω).isClosed) hne hφmeas hφcont)
  · exact fun ω => (hcompact ω).image (hφcont ω)
  · exact fun ω => (hne ω).image (fun x => φ (ω, x))

name: RandomSetTheory.measurable_supportFunction_caratheodoryImage_param_joint
statement:
theorem measurable_supportFunction_caratheodoryImage_param_joint
    {Ω Θ X H : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Θ]
    [MetricSpace X] [CompleteSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    [SecondCountableTopology X] [Nonempty X]
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H] [Nonempty H]
    {S : Ω → Set X} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω)) (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    {φ : (Ω × Θ) × X → H} (hφmeas : Measurable φ)
    (hφcont : ∀ p : Ω × Θ, Continuous fun x => φ (p, x)) :
    Measurable (fun q : (Ω × Θ) × H =>
      supportFunction ((fun x => φ (q.1, x)) '' S q.1.1) q.2)
proof:
:= by
  have hEffros := effrosMeasurable_caratheodoryImage_param
    hS (fun ω => (hcompact ω).isClosed) hne hφmeas hφcont
  apply measurable_supportFunction_joint hEffros
  · exact fun p => (hcompact p.1).image (hφcont p)
  · exact fun p => (hne p.1).image (fun x => φ (p, x))

name: RandomSetTheory.IsBoundedInProbability.mono_norm
statement:
theorem IsBoundedInProbability.mono_norm
    {Ω ι F G : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [SeminormedAddCommGroup F] [SeminormedAddCommGroup G]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {l : Filter ι} {X : ι → Ω → F} {Y : ι → Ω → G}
    (hX : IsBoundedInProbability μ l X) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hdom : ∀ᶠ i in l, ∀ ω, ‖Y i ω‖ ≤ c * ‖X i ω‖) :
    IsBoundedInProbability μ l Y
proof:
:= by
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨M, hM, hXM⟩ := hX ε hε
  refine ⟨c * M, mul_nonneg hc hM, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hXM, hdom] with i hXi hdomi
  apply hXi.trans'
  apply measure_mono
  intro ω hω
  change c * M < ‖Y i ω‖ at hω
  change M < ‖X i ω‖
  by_cases hc0 : c = 0
  · have hY0 : ‖Y i ω‖ = 0 := by
      apply le_antisymm
      · simpa [hc0] using hdomi ω
      · exact norm_nonneg _
    simp [hc0, hY0] at hω
  · have hcpos : 0 < c := lt_of_le_of_ne hc (Ne.symm hc0)
    nlinarith [hω, hdomi ω]

name: RandomSetTheory.isBoundedInProbability_of_tendsto_law
statement:
theorem isBoundedInProbability_of_tendsto_law
    {Ω ι E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [CompleteSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    [BorelSpace E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {l : Filter ι} {X : ι → Ω → E} (hX : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) μ)
    (ν : ProbabilityMeasure E)
    (hLaw : Tendsto (β := ProbabilityMeasure E)
      (fun i ↦ (⟨μ.map (X i), Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (hX i)⟩ :
        ProbabilityMeasure E)) l (nhds ν)) :
    IsBoundedInProbability μ l X
proof:
:= by
  intro ε hε
  have hν_tight : IsTightMeasureSet {(ν : Measure E)} :=
    isTightMeasureSet_singleton
  have htail : Tendsto
      (fun r : ℝ ↦ (ν : Measure E) {x | r < ‖x‖}) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa using tendsto_measure_norm_gt_of_isTightMeasureSet hν_tight
  have hε_ennreal : (0 : ENNReal) < ENNReal.ofReal ε := ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr hε
  have hsmall : ∀ᶠ r : ℝ in atTop,
      (ν : Measure E) {x | r < ‖x‖} < ENNReal.ofReal ε :=
    htail.eventually_lt_const hε_ennreal
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hν_tail⟩ :=
    ((eventually_ge_atTop (0 : ℝ)).and hsmall).exists
  let M : ℝ := r + 1
  let F : Set E := {x | M ≤ ‖x‖}
  have hM : 0 ≤ M := by
    dsimp [M]
    linarith
  have hF_closed : IsClosed F := by
    exact isClosed_le continuous_const continuous_norm
  have hν_F : (ν : Measure E) F < ENNReal.ofReal ε := by
    apply (measure_mono ?_).trans_lt hν_tail
    intro x hx
    change M ≤ ‖x‖ at hx
    change r < ‖x‖
    dsimp [M] at hx
    linarith
  have hlimsup :
      (l.limsup fun i ↦
        ((⟨μ.map (X i), Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (hX i)⟩ :
          ProbabilityMeasure E) : Measure E) F) ≤ (ν : Measure E) F :=
    ProbabilityMeasure.limsup_measure_closed_le_of_tendsto hLaw hF_closed
  have heventually : ∀ᶠ i in l,
      ((⟨μ.map (X i), Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (hX i)⟩ :
        ProbabilityMeasure E) : Measure E) F < ENNReal.ofReal ε :=
    eventually_lt_of_limsup_lt (hlimsup.trans_lt hν_F)
  refine ⟨M, hM, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [heventually] with i hi
  change (μ.map (X i)) F < ENNReal.ofReal ε at hi
  rw [Measure.map_apply_of_aemeasurable (hX i) hF_closed.measurableSet] at hi
  apply (measure_mono ?_).trans hi.le
  intro ω hω
  change M < ‖X i ω‖ at hω
  change X i ω ∈ F
  exact hω.le

name: MeasureTheory.TendstoInDistribution.isBoundedInProbability
statement:
theorem _root_.MeasureTheory.TendstoInDistribution.isBoundedInProbability
    {Ω Ω' ι E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Ω']
    [MeasurableSpace E] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] [BorelSpace E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {μ' : Measure Ω'} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ']
    {l : Filter ι} {X : ι → Ω → E} {Z : Ω' → E}
    (h : MeasureTheory.TendstoInDistribution X l Z (fun _ ↦ μ) μ') :
    IsBoundedInProbability μ l X
proof:
:= by
  exact isBoundedInProbability_of_tendsto_law h.forall_aemeasurable
    ⟨μ'.map Z, Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map h.aemeasurable_limit⟩ h.tendsto

name: RandomSetTheory.mem_hitEvent
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_hitEvent {S : Ω → Set X} {K : Set X} {ω : Ω} :
    ω ∈ hitEvent S K ↔ (S ω ∩ K).Nonempty
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: RandomSetTheory.mem_avoidEvent
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_avoidEvent {S : Ω → Set X} {K : Set X} {ω : Ω} :
    ω ∈ avoidEvent S K ↔ ¬(S ω ∩ K).Nonempty
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: RandomSetTheory.avoidEvent_eq_compl
statement:
theorem avoidEvent_eq_compl (S : Ω → Set X) (K : Set X) :
    avoidEvent S K = (hitEvent S K)ᶜ
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: RandomSetTheory.hitEvent_empty
statement:
@[simp] theorem hitEvent_empty (S : Ω → Set X) :
    hitEvent S ∅ = ∅
proof:
:= by
  ext ω
  simp [hitEvent]

name: RandomSetTheory.avoidEvent_empty
statement:
@[simp] theorem avoidEvent_empty (S : Ω → Set X) :
    avoidEvent S ∅ = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  rw [avoidEvent_eq_compl, hitEvent_empty, compl_empty]

name: RandomSetTheory.hitEvent_univ
statement:
theorem hitEvent_univ (S : Ω → Set X) :
    hitEvent S Set.univ = {ω | (S ω).Nonempty}
proof:
:= by
  ext ω
  simp [hitEvent]

name: RandomSetTheory.avoidEvent_univ
statement:
theorem avoidEvent_univ (S : Ω → Set X) :
    avoidEvent S Set.univ = {ω | ¬(S ω).Nonempty}
proof:
:= by
  ext ω
  simp [avoidEvent]

name: RandomSetTheory.hitEvent_union
statement:
theorem hitEvent_union (S : Ω → Set X) (K L : Set X) :
    hitEvent S (K ∪ L) = hitEvent S K ∪ hitEvent S L
proof:
:= by
  ext ω
  simp only [mem_hitEvent, Set.mem_union]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hxS, hxK | hxL⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨x, hxS, hxK⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨x, hxS, hxL⟩
  · rintro (⟨x, hxS, hxK⟩ | ⟨x, hxS, hxL⟩)
    · exact ⟨x, hxS, Or.inl hxK⟩
    · exact ⟨x, hxS, Or.inr hxL⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.avoidEvent_union
statement:
theorem avoidEvent_union (S : Ω → Set X) (K L : Set X) :
    avoidEvent S (K ∪ L) = avoidEvent S K ∩ avoidEvent S L
proof:
:= by
  simp only [avoidEvent_eq_compl, hitEvent_union, compl_union]

name: RandomSetTheory.hitEvent_iUnion
statement:
theorem hitEvent_iUnion {ι : Sort*} (S : Ω → Set X) (K : ι → Set X) :
    hitEvent S (⋃ i, K i) = ⋃ i, hitEvent S (K i)
proof:
:= by
  ext ω
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hxS, hxK⟩
    rcases Set.mem_iUnion.1 hxK with ⟨i, hxi⟩
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨i, ⟨x, hxS, hxi⟩⟩
  · intro hω
    rcases Set.mem_iUnion.1 hω with ⟨i, x, hxS, hxi⟩
    exact ⟨x, hxS, Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨i, hxi⟩⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.avoidEvent_iUnion
statement:
theorem avoidEvent_iUnion {ι : Type*} (S : Ω → Set X) (K : ι → Set X) :
    avoidEvent S (⋃ i, K i) = ⋂ i, avoidEvent S (K i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [avoidEvent_eq_compl, hitEvent_iUnion, compl_iUnion]

name: RandomSetTheory.hitEvent_mono
statement: theorem hitEvent_mono {S : Ω → Set X} : Monotone (hitEvent S)
proof:
:= by
  intro K L hKL ω
  rintro ⟨x, hxS, hxK⟩
  exact ⟨x, hxS, hKL hxK⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.avoidEvent_antitone
statement: theorem avoidEvent_antitone {S : Ω → Set X} : Antitone (avoidEvent S)
proof:
:= by
  intro K L hKL
  rw [avoidEvent_eq_compl, avoidEvent_eq_compl]
  exact compl_subset_compl.mpr (hitEvent_mono hKL)

name: RandomSetTheory.hitEvent_mono_correspondence
proof:
:= by
  intro ω
  rintro ⟨x, hxS, hxK⟩
  exact ⟨x, hST ω hxS, hxK⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.hitEvent_inter_subset
statement:
theorem hitEvent_inter_subset (S : Ω → Set X) (K L : Set X) :
    hitEvent S (K ∩ L) ⊆ hitEvent S K ∩ hitEvent S L
proof:
:= by
  intro ω
  rintro ⟨x, hxS, hxK, hxL⟩
  exact ⟨⟨x, hxS, hxK⟩, ⟨x, hxS, hxL⟩⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.measurableSet_hitEvent_open
statement:
theorem measurableSet_hitEvent_open [TopologicalSpace X]
    {S : Ω → Set X} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    {U : Set X} (hU : IsOpen U) :
    MeasurableSet (hitEvent S U)
proof:
:=
  hS U hU

name: RandomSetTheory.measurableSet_avoidEvent_open
statement:
theorem measurableSet_avoidEvent_open [TopologicalSpace X]
    {S : Ω → Set X} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    {U : Set X} (hU : IsOpen U) :
    MeasurableSet (avoidEvent S U)
proof:
:= by
  rw [avoidEvent_eq_compl]
  exact (measurableSet_hitEvent_open hS hU).compl

name: RandomSetTheory.measurableSet_hitEvent_countable
statement:
theorem measurableSet_hitEvent_countable [TopologicalSpace X]
    (S : RandomSet Ω X) {K : Set X} (hK : K.Countable) :
    MeasurableSet (hitEvent S K)
proof:
:= by
  letI := hK.to_subtype
  have hEq : hitEvent (fun ω => S ω) K =
      ⋃ x : K, {ω | (x : X) ∈ S ω} := by
    ext ω
    simp only [mem_hitEvent, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, hxS, hxK⟩
      exact ⟨⟨x, hxK⟩, hxS⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨x, hxK⟩, hxS⟩
      exact ⟨x, hxS, hxK⟩
  rw [hEq]
  exact MeasurableSet.iUnion fun x =>
    S.measurable' (measurableSet_mem (x : X))

name: RandomSetTheory.measurableSet_avoidEvent_countable
statement:
theorem measurableSet_avoidEvent_countable [TopologicalSpace X]
    (S : RandomSet Ω X) {K : Set X} (hK : K.Countable) :
    MeasurableSet (avoidEvent (fun ω => S ω) K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [avoidEvent_eq_compl]
  exact (measurableSet_hitEvent_countable S hK).compl

name: RandomSetTheory.hitEvent_compact_eq_iInter_thickening
statement:
theorem hitEvent_compact_eq_iInter_thickening
    {S : Ω → Set X} (hSclosed : ∀ ω, IsClosed (S ω))
    {K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K) :
    hitEvent S K =
      ⋂ n : ℕ, hitEvent S (Metric.thickening (1 / (n + 1 : ℝ)) K)
proof:
:= by
  ext ω
  simp only [Set.mem_iInter, mem_hitEvent]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hxS, hxK⟩ n
    refine ⟨x, hxS, ?_⟩
    exact Metric.self_subset_thickening (by positivity : 0 < 1 / (n + 1 : ℝ)) K hxK
  · intro hhit
    by_contra hnot
    have hsubset : K ⊆ (S ω)ᶜ := by
      intro x hxK hxS
      exact hnot ⟨x, hxS, hxK⟩
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hthick⟩ :=
      hK.exists_thickening_subset_open (hSclosed ω).isOpen_compl hsubset
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_one_div_lt hδ
    rcases hhit n with ⟨x, hxS, hxthick⟩
    have hxcompl : x ∈ (S ω)ᶜ :=
      hthick (Metric.thickening_mono hn.le K hxthick)
    exact hxcompl hxS

name: RandomSetTheory.measurableSet_hitEvent_compact
statement:
theorem measurableSet_hitEvent_compact
    {S : Ω → Set X} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hSclosed : ∀ ω, IsClosed (S ω)) {K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K) :
    MeasurableSet (hitEvent S K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hitEvent_compact_eq_iInter_thickening hSclosed hK]
  exact MeasurableSet.iInter fun n =>
    measurableSet_hitEvent_open hS Metric.isOpen_thickening

name: RandomSetTheory.measurableSet_avoidEvent_compact
statement:
theorem measurableSet_avoidEvent_compact
    {S : Ω → Set X} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hSclosed : ∀ ω, IsClosed (S ω)) {K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K) :
    MeasurableSet (avoidEvent S K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [avoidEvent_eq_compl]
  exact (measurableSet_hitEvent_compact hS hSclosed hK).compl

name: RandomSetTheory.RandomSet.EffrosRandomClosedSet.measurableSet_hitEvent_compact
statement:
theorem RandomSet.EffrosRandomClosedSet.measurableSet_hitEvent_compact
    (S : RandomSet.EffrosRandomClosedSet Ω X) {K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K) :
    MeasurableSet (hitEvent (fun ω => S ω) K)
proof:
:=
  RandomSetTheory.measurableSet_hitEvent_compact S.measurable' S.isClosed' hK

name: RandomSetTheory.RandomSet.EffrosRandomClosedSet.measurableSet_avoidEvent_compact
statement:
theorem RandomSet.EffrosRandomClosedSet.measurableSet_avoidEvent_compact
    (S : RandomSet.EffrosRandomClosedSet Ω X) {K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K) :
    MeasurableSet (avoidEvent (fun ω => S ω) K)
proof:
:=
  RandomSetTheory.measurableSet_avoidEvent_compact S.measurable' S.isClosed' hK

name: RandomSetTheory.capacityFunctional_empty
statement:
@[simp] theorem capacityFunctional_empty (μ : Measure Ω) (S : Ω → Set X) :
    capacityFunctional μ S ∅ = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [capacityFunctional]

name: RandomSetTheory.avoidanceFunctional_empty
statement:
@[simp] theorem avoidanceFunctional_empty (μ : Measure Ω) (S : Ω → Set X) :
    avoidanceFunctional μ S ∅ = μ Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  simp [avoidanceFunctional]

name: RandomSetTheory.capacityFunctional_le_measure_univ
statement:
theorem capacityFunctional_le_measure_univ (μ : Measure Ω)
    (S : Ω → Set X) (K : Set X) :
    capacityFunctional μ S K ≤ μ Set.univ
proof:
:=
  measure_mono (Set.subset_univ _)

name: RandomSetTheory.capacityFunctional_mono
statement:
theorem capacityFunctional_mono (μ : Measure Ω) (S : Ω → Set X) :
    Monotone (capacityFunctional μ S)
proof:
:= by
  intro K L hKL
  exact measure_mono (hitEvent_mono hKL)

name: RandomSetTheory.avoidanceFunctional_antitone
statement:
theorem avoidanceFunctional_antitone (μ : Measure Ω) (S : Ω → Set X) :
    Antitone (avoidanceFunctional μ S)
proof:
:= by
  intro K L hKL
  exact measure_mono (avoidEvent_antitone hKL)

name: RandomSetTheory.capacityFunctional_mono_correspondence
statement:
theorem capacityFunctional_mono_correspondence (μ : Measure Ω)
    {S T : Ω → Set X} (hST : ∀ ω, S ω ⊆ T ω) (K : Set X) :
    capacityFunctional μ S K ≤ capacityFunctional μ T K
proof:
:=
  measure_mono (hitEvent_mono_correspondence hST K)

name: RandomSetTheory.capacityFunctional_union
statement:
theorem capacityFunctional_union (μ : Measure Ω) (S : Ω → Set X)
    (K L : Set X) :
    capacityFunctional μ S (K ∪ L) =
      μ (hitEvent S K ∪ hitEvent S L)
proof:
:= by
  rw [capacityFunctional, hitEvent_union]

name: RandomSetTheory.capacityFunctional_union_le
statement:
theorem capacityFunctional_union_le (μ : Measure Ω) (S : Ω → Set X)
    (K L : Set X) :
    capacityFunctional μ S (K ∪ L) ≤
      capacityFunctional μ S K + capacityFunctional μ S L
proof:
:= by
  rw [capacityFunctional, hitEvent_union]
  exact measure_union_le _ _

name: RandomSetTheory.capacityFunctional_iUnion_le
statement:
theorem capacityFunctional_iUnion_le [Countable ι] (μ : Measure Ω)
    (S : Ω → Set X) (K : ι → Set X) :
    capacityFunctional μ S (⋃ i, K i) ≤
      ∑' i, capacityFunctional μ S (K i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [capacityFunctional, hitEvent_iUnion]
  exact measure_iUnion_le _

name: RandomSetTheory.capacityFunctional_biUnion_finset_le
statement:
theorem capacityFunctional_biUnion_finset_le {ι : Type*} (μ : Measure Ω)
    (S : Ω → Set X) (I : Finset ι) (K : ι → Set X) :
    capacityFunctional μ S (⋃ i ∈ I, K i) ≤
      ∑ i ∈ I, capacityFunctional μ S (K i)
proof:
:= by
  have hEvent : hitEvent S (⋃ i ∈ I, K i) =
      ⋃ i ∈ I, hitEvent S (K i) := by
    rw [hitEvent_iUnion]
    congr 1
    funext i
    rw [hitEvent_iUnion]
  rw [capacityFunctional, hEvent]
  exact measure_biUnion_finset_le I (fun i => hitEvent S (K i))

name: RandomSetTheory.capacityFunctional_union_add_inter_le
statement:
theorem capacityFunctional_union_add_inter_le
    (μ : Measure Ω) (S : Ω → Set X) (K L : Set X)
    (hL : MeasurableSet (hitEvent S L)) :
    capacityFunctional μ S (K ∪ L) + capacityFunctional μ S (K ∩ L) ≤
      capacityFunctional μ S K + capacityFunctional μ S L
proof:
:= by
  calc
    capacityFunctional μ S (K ∪ L) + capacityFunctional μ S (K ∩ L) =
        μ (hitEvent S K ∪ hitEvent S L) + μ (hitEvent S (K ∩ L)) := by
          rw [capacityFunctional_union]
          rfl
    _ ≤ μ (hitEvent S K ∪ hitEvent S L) +
        μ (hitEvent S K ∩ hitEvent S L) := by
          exact add_le_add le_rfl
            (measure_mono (μ := μ) (hitEvent_inter_subset S K L))
    _ = capacityFunctional μ S K + capacityFunctional μ S L := by
          simpa only [capacityFunctional] using
            measure_union_add_inter (μ := μ) (hitEvent S K) hL

name: RandomSetTheory.capacityFunctional_add_avoidance
statement:
theorem capacityFunctional_add_avoidance
    (μ : Measure Ω) (S : Ω → Set X) (K : Set X)
    (hK : MeasurableSet (hitEvent S K)) :
    capacityFunctional μ S K + avoidanceFunctional μ S K = μ Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [capacityFunctional, avoidanceFunctional, avoidEvent_eq_compl] using
    measure_add_measure_compl (μ := μ) hK

name: RandomSetTheory.avoidanceFunctional_eq_measure_univ_sub
statement:
theorem avoidanceFunctional_eq_measure_univ_sub
    (μ : Measure Ω) (S : Ω → Set X) (K : Set X)
    (hK : MeasurableSet (hitEvent S K)) (hfin : μ (hitEvent S K) ≠ ∞) :
    avoidanceFunctional μ S K = μ Set.univ - capacityFunctional μ S K
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [capacityFunctional, avoidanceFunctional, avoidEvent_eq_compl] using
    measure_compl (μ := μ) hK hfin

name: RandomSetTheory.capacityFunctional_univ_of_ae_nonempty
statement:
theorem capacityFunctional_univ_of_ae_nonempty
    (μ : Measure Ω) (S : Ω → Set X) (hne : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (S ω).Nonempty) :
    capacityFunctional μ S Set.univ = μ Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  rw [capacityFunctional, hitEvent_univ]
  apply measure_congr
  filter_upwards [hne] with ω hω
  exact propext (iff_true_intro hω)

name: RandomSetTheory.capacityFunctional_univ_eq_one
statement:
theorem capacityFunctional_univ_eq_one
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (S : Ω → Set X)
    (hne : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (S ω).Nonempty) :
    capacityFunctional μ S Set.univ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [capacityFunctional_univ_of_ae_nonempty μ S hne, measure_univ]

name: RandomSetTheory.capacityFunctional_le_one
statement:
theorem capacityFunctional_le_one
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (S : Ω → Set X) (K : Set X) :
    capacityFunctional μ S K ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [measure_univ] using capacityFunctional_le_measure_univ μ S K

name: RandomSetTheory.avoidanceFunctional_eq_one_sub
statement:
theorem avoidanceFunctional_eq_one_sub
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (S : Ω → Set X) (K : Set X)
    (hK : MeasurableSet (hitEvent S K)) :
    avoidanceFunctional μ S K = 1 - capacityFunctional μ S K
proof:
:= by
  have hfin : μ (hitEvent S K) ≠ ∞ := by
    exact ne_top_of_le_ne_top (by simp)
      (capacityFunctional_le_one μ S K)
  simpa only [measure_univ] using
    avoidanceFunctional_eq_measure_univ_sub μ S K hK hfin

name: RandomSetTheory.hitEvent_ae_eq_of_ae_eq
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [hST] with ω hω
  exact congrArg (fun A : Set X => (A ∩ K).Nonempty) hω

name: RandomSetTheory.avoidEvent_ae_eq_of_ae_eq
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [hST] with ω hω
  exact congrArg (fun A : Set X => ¬(A ∩ K).Nonempty) hω

name: RandomSetTheory.capacityFunctional_congr_ae
proof:
:= by
  exact measure_congr (hitEvent_ae_eq_of_ae_eq μ hST K)

name: RandomSetTheory.avoidanceFunctional_congr_ae
proof:
:= by
  exact measure_congr (avoidEvent_ae_eq_of_ae_eq μ hST K)

name: RandomSetTheory.capacityFunctional_iUnion_of_monotone
statement:
theorem capacityFunctional_iUnion_of_monotone
    (μ : Measure Ω) (S : Ω → Set X) {K : ℕ → Set X} (hK : Monotone K) :
    capacityFunctional μ S (⋃ n, K n) =
      ⨆ n, capacityFunctional μ S (K n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [capacityFunctional, hitEvent_iUnion]
  exact (hitEvent_mono.comp hK).measure_iUnion

name: RandomSetTheory.tendsto_capacityFunctional_iUnion_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_capacityFunctional_iUnion_atTop
    (μ : Measure Ω) (S : Ω → Set X) {K : ℕ → Set X} (hK : Monotone K) :
    Tendsto (fun n => capacityFunctional μ S (K n)) atTop
      (𝓝 (capacityFunctional μ S (⋃ n, K n)))
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [capacityFunctional, hitEvent_iUnion, Function.comp_def] using
    tendsto_measure_iUnion_atTop (μ := μ) (hitEvent_mono.comp hK)

name: RandomSetTheory.hitEvent_iInter_of_antitone_compact
statement:
theorem hitEvent_iInter_of_antitone_compact
    {S : Ω → Set X} (hSclosed : ∀ ω, IsClosed (S ω))
    {K : ℕ → Set X} (hKanti : Antitone K)
    (hKcompact : ∀ n, IsCompact (K n)) :
    hitEvent S (⋂ n, K n) = ⋂ n, hitEvent S (K n)
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · intro ω
    rintro ⟨x, hxS, hxK⟩
    exact Set.mem_iInter.2 fun n => ⟨x, hxS, Set.mem_iInter.1 hxK n⟩
  · intro ω hω
    have hne : ∀ n, (S ω ∩ K n).Nonempty := fun n => Set.mem_iInter.1 hω n
    have hanti : Antitone (fun n => S ω ∩ K n) := fun i j hij =>
      Set.inter_subset_inter_right _ (hKanti hij)
    have hcompact : ∀ n, IsCompact (S ω ∩ K n) := fun n =>
      (hKcompact n).inter_left (hSclosed ω)
    have hclosed : ∀ n, IsClosed (S ω ∩ K n) := fun n =>
      (hSclosed ω).inter (hKcompact n).isClosed
    rcases IsCompact.nonempty_iInter_of_directed_nonempty_isCompact_isClosed
        (fun n => S ω ∩ K n) hanti.directed_ge hne hcompact hclosed with
      ⟨x, hx⟩
    have hxall : ∀ n, x ∈ S ω ∩ K n := Set.mem_iInter.1 hx
    exact ⟨x, (hxall 0).1, Set.mem_iInter.2 fun n => (hxall n).2⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.capacityFunctional_iInter_of_antitone_compact
statement:
theorem capacityFunctional_iInter_of_antitone_compact
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {S : Ω → Set X} (hSclosed : ∀ ω, IsClosed (S ω))
    {K : ℕ → Set X} (hKanti : Antitone K)
    (hKcompact : ∀ n, IsCompact (K n))
    (hKmeas : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (hitEvent S (K n))) :
    capacityFunctional μ S (⋂ n, K n) =
      ⨅ n, capacityFunctional μ S (K n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [capacityFunctional, hitEvent_iInter_of_antitone_compact
    hSclosed hKanti hKcompact]
  exact (hitEvent_mono.comp_antitone hKanti).measure_iInter
    (fun n => (hKmeas n).nullMeasurableSet)
    ⟨0, measure_ne_top μ _⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.tendsto_capacityFunctional_iInter_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_capacityFunctional_iInter_atTop
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {S : Ω → Set X} (hSclosed : ∀ ω, IsClosed (S ω))
    {K : ℕ → Set X} (hKanti : Antitone K)
    (hKcompact : ∀ n, IsCompact (K n))
    (hKmeas : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (hitEvent S (K n))) :
    Tendsto (fun n => capacityFunctional μ S (K n)) atTop
      (𝓝 (capacityFunctional μ S (⋂ n, K n)))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [capacityFunctional]
  rw [hitEvent_iInter_of_antitone_compact hSclosed hKanti hKcompact]
  simpa only [Function.comp_def] using
    tendsto_measure_iInter_atTop (μ := μ)
      (fun n => (hKmeas n).nullMeasurableSet)
      (hitEvent_mono.comp_antitone hKanti)
      ⟨0, measure_ne_top μ _⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.capacityFunctional_iInter_compact_of_effros
statement:
theorem capacityFunctional_iInter_compact_of_effros
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {S : Ω → Set X} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hSclosed : ∀ ω, IsClosed (S ω))
    {K : ℕ → Set X} (hKanti : Antitone K)
    (hKcompact : ∀ n, IsCompact (K n)) :
    capacityFunctional μ S (⋂ n, K n) =
      ⨅ n, capacityFunctional μ S (K n)
proof:
:=
  capacityFunctional_iInter_of_antitone_compact μ hSclosed hKanti hKcompact
    (fun n => measurableSet_hitEvent_compact hS hSclosed (hKcompact n))

name: RandomSetTheory.tendsto_capacityFunctional_iInter_compact_of_effros
statement:
theorem tendsto_capacityFunctional_iInter_compact_of_effros
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {S : Ω → Set X} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hSclosed : ∀ ω, IsClosed (S ω))
    {K : ℕ → Set X} (hKanti : Antitone K)
    (hKcompact : ∀ n, IsCompact (K n)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => capacityFunctional μ S (K n)) atTop
      (𝓝 (capacityFunctional μ S (⋂ n, K n)))
proof:
:=
  tendsto_capacityFunctional_iInter_atTop μ hSclosed hKanti hKcompact
    (fun n => measurableSet_hitEvent_compact hS hSclosed (hKcompact n))

name: ProbabilityTheory.strongMomentTaylorExponent_mono
statement:
theorem strongMomentTaylorExponent_mono
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) {t y second second' : ℝ}
    (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hsecond : second ≤ second')
    {moment moment' : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hmoment : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q, moment k ≤ moment' k) :
    strongMomentTaylorExponent q t y second moment ≤
      strongMomentTaylorExponent q t y second' moment'
proof:
:= by
  unfold strongMomentTaylorExponent
  apply add_le_add
  · apply add_le_add
    · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsecond (by positivity)
    · apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro k hk
      have hkBounds := Finset.mem_Ico.mp hk
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (hmoment k (Finset.mem_Icc.mpr
          ⟨(by omega : 2 ≤ k), hkBounds.2.le⟩))
      positivity
  · apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (hmoment q (Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨by omega, le_rfl⟩))
    positivity

name: ProbabilityTheory.condExp_exp_mul_le_exp_strongMomentTaylorExponent
statement:
theorem condExp_exp_mul_le_exp_strongMomentTaylorExponent
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hm : m ≤ mOmega) (X : Omega → ℝ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    {t y second : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hy : 0 ≤ y)
    (hX : Integrable X mu)
    (hXsq : Integrable (fun omega ↦ X omega ^ 2) mu)
    (hpow : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      Integrable (fun omega ↦ (max (X omega) 0) ^ k) mu)
    (hupper : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, X omega ≤ y)
    (hcenter : mu[X | m] ≤ᵐ[mu] 0)
    (hsecond : mu[fun omega ↦ X omega ^ 2 | m] ≤ᵐ[mu]
      fun _ ↦ second)
    (moment : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hmoment : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      mu[fun omega ↦ (max (X omega) 0) ^ k | m] ≤ᵐ[mu]
        fun _ ↦ moment k) :
    ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      mu[fun z ↦ Real.exp (t * X z) | m] omega ≤
        Real.exp (strongMomentTaylorExponent q t y second moment)
proof:
:= by
  have hExp : Integrable (fun omega ↦ Real.exp (t * X omega)) mu := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound
      ((hX.aemeasurable.const_mul t).exp.aestronglyMeasurable)
      (Real.exp (t * y))
    filter_upwards [hupper] with omega homega
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
    exact Real.exp_monotone (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left homega ht)
  have hXKernel : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu.trim hm,
      Integrable X (condExpKernel mu m omega) := by
    apply Measure.ae_integrable_of_integrable_comp
    rw [condExpKernel_comp_trim hm]
    exact hX
  have hXsqKernel : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu.trim hm,
      Integrable (fun z ↦ X z ^ 2) (condExpKernel mu m omega) := by
    apply Measure.ae_integrable_of_integrable_comp
    rw [condExpKernel_comp_trim hm]
    exact hXsq
  have hpowKernel : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu.trim hm,
      ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
        Integrable (fun z ↦ (max (X z) 0) ^ k)
          (condExpKernel mu m omega) := by
    rw [(Finset.Icc 2 q).eventually_all]
    intro k hk
    apply Measure.ae_integrable_of_integrable_comp
    rw [condExpKernel_comp_trim hm]
    exact hpow k hk
  have hupperKernel : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu.trim hm,
      ∀ᵐ z ∂condExpKernel mu m omega, X z ≤ y := by
    apply Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_comp
    rw [condExpKernel_comp_trim hm]
    exact hupper
  have hmeanKernel : mu[X | m] =ᵐ[mu.trim hm]
      fun omega ↦ ∫ z, X z ∂condExpKernel mu m omega :=
    condExp_ae_eq_trim_integral_condExpKernel hm hX
  have hsecondKernel : mu[fun z ↦ X z ^ 2 | m] =ᵐ[mu.trim hm]
      fun omega ↦ ∫ z, X z ^ 2 ∂condExpKernel mu m omega :=
    condExp_ae_eq_trim_integral_condExpKernel hm hXsq
  have hmomentKernel : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu.trim hm,
      ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
        mu[fun z ↦ (max (X z) 0) ^ k | m] omega =
          ∫ z, (max (X z) 0) ^ k ∂condExpKernel mu m omega := by
    rw [(Finset.Icc 2 q).eventually_all]
    intro k hk
    exact condExp_ae_eq_trim_integral_condExpKernel hm (hpow k hk)
  have hcenterTrim : mu[X | m] ≤ᵐ[mu.trim hm] 0 :=
    StronglyMeasurable.ae_le_trim_of_stronglyMeasurable
      hm stronglyMeasurable_condExp stronglyMeasurable_zero hcenter
  have hsecondTrim :
      mu[fun z ↦ X z ^ 2 | m] ≤ᵐ[mu.trim hm] fun _ ↦ second :=
    StronglyMeasurable.ae_le_trim_of_stronglyMeasurable
      hm stronglyMeasurable_condExp stronglyMeasurable_const hsecond
  have hmomentTrim : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu.trim hm,
      ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
        mu[fun z ↦ (max (X z) 0) ^ k | m] omega ≤ moment k := by
    rw [(Finset.Icc 2 q).eventually_all]
    intro k hk
    exact StronglyMeasurable.ae_le_trim_of_stronglyMeasurable
      hm stronglyMeasurable_condExp stronglyMeasurable_const (hmoment k hk)
  have hExpKernel : mu[fun z ↦ Real.exp (t * X z) | m] =ᵐ[mu.trim hm]
      fun omega ↦ ∫ z, Real.exp (t * X z) ∂condExpKernel mu m omega :=
    condExp_ae_eq_trim_integral_condExpKernel hm hExp
  apply ae_of_ae_trim hm
  filter_upwards [hXKernel, hXsqKernel, hpowKernel,
      hupperKernel, hmeanKernel, hsecondKernel, hmomentKernel,
      hcenterTrim, hsecondTrim, hmomentTrim, hExpKernel]
    with omega hXOmega hXsqOmega hpowOmega hupperOmega
      hmeanOmega hsecondOmega hmomentOmega hcenterOmega
      hsecondBoundOmega hmomentBoundOmega hExpOmega
  have hcenterFiber : (∫ z, X z ∂condExpKernel mu m omega) ≤ 0 := by
    rw [← hmeanOmega]
    exact hcenterOmega
  have hsecondFiber : (∫ z, X z ^ 2 ∂condExpKernel mu m omega) ≤
      second := by
    rw [← hsecondOmega]
    exact hsecondBoundOmega
  let fiberMoment : ℕ → ℝ := fun k ↦
    ∫ z, (max (X z) 0) ^ k ∂condExpKernel mu m omega
  have hmomentFiber : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      fiberMoment k ≤ moment k := by
    intro k hk
    unfold fiberMoment
    rw [← hmomentOmega k hk]
    exact hmomentBoundOmega k hk
  have hbase := integral_exp_mul_le_exp_strongMomentTaylorExponent
    (mu := condExpKernel mu m omega) X q hq ht hy hXOmega hXsqOmega
      hpowOmega hupperOmega hcenterFiber
  have hexponent :
      strongMomentTaylorExponent q t y
          (∫ z, X z ^ 2 ∂condExpKernel mu m omega) fiberMoment ≤
        strongMomentTaylorExponent q t y second moment :=
    strongMomentTaylorExponent_mono q hq (y := y) ht
      hsecondFiber hmomentFiber
  rw [hExpOmega]
  exact hbase.trans (Real.exp_monotone hexponent)

name: RandomSetTheory.HasExactDivisibility.isAtomlessMeasure
statement:
theorem HasExactDivisibility.isAtomlessMeasure
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hμ : HasExactDivisibility μ) :
    IsAtomlessMeasure μ
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs hspos
  obtain ⟨A, hAs, hA, hmeasure⟩ :=
    hμ s hs (a := (1 / 2 : ℝ)) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  refine ⟨A, hAs, hA, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply (ENNReal.toReal_lt_toReal (by simp) (measure_ne_top μ A)).mp
    change 0 < μ.real A
    rw [hmeasure]
    have hsreal : 0 < μ.real s :=
      ENNReal.toReal_pos hspos.ne' (measure_ne_top μ s)
    positivity
  · apply (ENNReal.toReal_lt_toReal (measure_ne_top μ A)
      (measure_ne_top μ s)).mp
    change μ.real A < μ.real s
    rw [hmeasure]
    have hsreal : 0 < μ.real s :=
      ENNReal.toReal_pos hspos.ne' (measure_ne_top μ s)
    linarith

name: RandomSetTheory.HasExactDivisibility.restrict
statement:
theorem HasExactDivisibility.restrict
    {μ : Measure Ω} (hμ : HasExactDivisibility μ)
    {s : Set Ω} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    HasExactDivisibility (μ.restrict s)
proof:
:= by
  intro B hB a ha0 ha1
  obtain ⟨A, hABs, hA, hmeasure⟩ := hμ (B ∩ s) (hB.inter hs) ha0 ha1
  have hAs : A ⊆ s := hABs.trans inter_subset_right
  refine ⟨A, hABs.trans inter_subset_left, hA, ?_⟩
  rw [measureReal_restrict_apply hA, measureReal_restrict_apply hB,
    inter_eq_self_of_subset_left hAs]
  exact hmeasure

name: RandomSetTheory.measureReal_map_measurableEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem measureReal_map_measurableEquiv_apply
    (μ : Measure Ω) (e : Ω ≃ᵐ Ω') {s : Set Ω'} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    (Measure.map e μ).real s = μ.real (e ⁻¹' s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [measureReal_def, measureReal_def,
    Measure.map_apply_of_aemeasurable e.measurable.aemeasurable hs]

name: RandomSetTheory.measureReal_map_measurableEquiv_image
statement:
theorem measureReal_map_measurableEquiv_image
    (μ : Measure Ω) (e : Ω ≃ᵐ Ω') {s : Set Ω} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    (Measure.map e μ).real (e '' s) = μ.real s
proof:
:= by
  rw [measureReal_map_measurableEquiv_apply μ e ((e.measurableSet_image).2 hs),
    Set.preimage_image_eq _ e.injective]

name: RandomSetTheory.HasExactDivisibility.map_measurableEquiv
statement:
theorem HasExactDivisibility.map_measurableEquiv
    {μ : Measure Ω} (hμ : HasExactDivisibility μ) (e : Ω ≃ᵐ Ω') :
    HasExactDivisibility (Measure.map e μ)
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs a ha0 ha1
  obtain ⟨A, hAs, hA, hmeasure⟩ := hμ (e ⁻¹' s) (e.measurable hs) ha0 ha1
  refine ⟨e '' A, ?_, (e.measurableSet_image).2 hA, ?_⟩
  · intro y hy
    rcases hy with ⟨x, hxA, rfl⟩
    exact hAs hxA
  · rw [measureReal_map_measurableEquiv_image μ e hA,
      measureReal_map_measurableEquiv_apply μ e hs, hmeasure]

name: RandomSetTheory.hasExactDivisibility_map_measurableEquiv_iff
statement:
theorem hasExactDivisibility_map_measurableEquiv_iff
    (μ : Measure Ω) (e : Ω ≃ᵐ Ω') :
    HasExactDivisibility (Measure.map e μ) ↔ HasExactDivisibility μ
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hmap s hs a ha0 ha1
