    obtain ⟨B, hBes, hB, hmeasure⟩ :=
      hmap (e '' s) ((e.measurableSet_image).2 hs) ha0 ha1
    refine ⟨e ⁻¹' B, ?_, e.measurable hB, ?_⟩
    · intro x hx
      have hex : e x ∈ e '' s := hBes hx
      rcases hex with ⟨y, hy, hey⟩
      exact (e.injective hey).symm ▸ hy
    · have hpre : μ.real (e ⁻¹' B) = (Measure.map e μ).real B :=
        (measureReal_map_measurableEquiv_apply μ e hB).symm
      rw [hpre, hmeasure, measureReal_map_measurableEquiv_image μ e hs]
  · exact fun hμ ↦ hμ.map_measurableEquiv e

name: RandomSetTheory.IsAtomlessMeasure.map_measurableEquiv
statement:
theorem IsAtomlessMeasure.map_measurableEquiv
    {μ : Measure Ω} (hμ : IsAtomlessMeasure μ) (e : Ω ≃ᵐ Ω') :
    IsAtomlessMeasure (Measure.map e μ)
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs hspos
  have hspos' : 0 < μ (e ⁻¹' s) := by
    simpa [Measure.map_apply_of_aemeasurable e.measurable.aemeasurable hs]
      using hspos
  obtain ⟨A, hAs, hA, hApos, hAlt⟩ := hμ (e ⁻¹' s) (e.measurable hs) hspos'
  refine ⟨e '' A, ?_, (e.measurableSet_image).2 hA, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro y hy
    rcases hy with ⟨x, hxA, rfl⟩
    exact hAs hxA
  · simpa [Measure.map_apply_of_aemeasurable e.measurable.aemeasurable
      ((e.measurableSet_image).2 hA), Set.preimage_image_eq _ e.injective]
      using hApos
  · simpa [Measure.map_apply_of_aemeasurable e.measurable.aemeasurable
      ((e.measurableSet_image).2 hA),
      Measure.map_apply_of_aemeasurable e.measurable.aemeasurable hs,
      Set.preimage_image_eq _ e.injective] using hAlt

name: RandomSetTheory.hasExactDivisibility_real_of_nullSingletonClass
statement:
theorem hasExactDivisibility_real_of_nullSingletonClass
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [NullSingletonClass μ] :
    HasExactDivisibility μ
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs a ha0 ha1
  exact exists_measurable_subset_measureReal_eq_mul μ hs ha0 ha1

name: RandomSetTheory.hasExactDivisibility_of_measurableEquiv_real
statement:
theorem hasExactDivisibility_of_measurableEquiv_real
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (e : Ω ≃ᵐ ℝ)
    [NullSingletonClass (Measure.map e μ)] :
    HasExactDivisibility μ
proof:
:= by
  exact (hasExactDivisibility_map_measurableEquiv_iff μ e).mp
    (hasExactDivisibility_real_of_nullSingletonClass (Measure.map e μ))

name: RandomSetTheory.hasExactDivisibility_of_atomless_measurableEquiv_real
statement:
theorem hasExactDivisibility_of_atomless_measurableEquiv_real
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hμ : IsAtomlessMeasure μ)
    (e : Ω ≃ᵐ ℝ) :
    HasExactDivisibility μ
proof:
:= by
  have hmapAtomless : IsAtomlessMeasure (Measure.map e μ) :=
    hμ.map_measurableEquiv e
  letI : NullSingletonClass (Measure.map e μ) :=
    hmapAtomless.toNullSingletonClass
  exact hasExactDivisibility_of_measurableEquiv_real μ e

name: RandomSetTheory.HasExactDivisibility.exists_isMeasurableFinpartition_measureReal_eq
statement:
theorem HasExactDivisibility.exists_isMeasurableFinpartition_measureReal_eq
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hμ : HasExactDivisibility μ)
    (s : Finset ι) (B : Set Ω) (hB : MeasurableSet B)
    (w : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i)
    (hsum : ∑ i ∈ s, w i = 1) :
    ∃ A : ι → Set Ω, IsMeasurableFinpartition s B A ∧
      ∀ i ∈ s, μ.real (A i) = w i * μ.real B
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on generalizing B w with
  | empty => simp at hsum
  | @insert a s ha ih =>
      let r : ℝ := ∑ i ∈ s, w i
      have hwa : 0 ≤ w a := hw a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)
      have hwr : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i := fun i hi ↦
        hw i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)
      have hr : 0 ≤ r := Finset.sum_nonneg hwr
      have hsum' : w a + r = 1 := by
        simpa [r, Finset.sum_insert ha] using hsum
      have hwa_le : w a ≤ 1 := by linarith
      by_cases hr0 : r = 0
      · have hwa1 : w a = 1 := by linarith
        have hwzero : ∀ i ∈ s, w i = 0 :=
          (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg hwr).mp (by simpa [r] using hr0)
        let A : ι → Set Ω := fun i ↦ if i = a then B else ∅
        refine ⟨A, ?_, ?_⟩
        · refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
          · intro i hi
            by_cases hia : i = a
            · simp [A, hia, hB]
            · simp [A, hia]
          · intro i hi
            by_cases hia : i = a
            · simp [A, hia]
            · change (if i = a then B else ∅) ⊆ B
              simp [hia]
          · intro i hi j hj hij
            by_cases hia : i = a
            · by_cases hja : j = a
              · exact (hij (hia.trans hja.symm)).elim
              · simp [A, hia, hja]
            · simp [A, hia]
          · rw [Finset.set_biUnion_insert]
            simp only [A, if_pos]
            have hrest : (⋃ i ∈ s, A i) = ∅ := by
              ext x
              simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
              rintro ⟨i, hi, hxi⟩
              have hia : i ≠ a := fun hEq ↦ ha (hEq ▸ hi)
              simp [A, hia] at hxi
            rw [hrest, union_empty]
        · intro i hi
          by_cases hia : i = a
          · subst i
            simp [A, hwa1]
          · have his : i ∈ s := (Finset.mem_insert.mp hi).resolve_left hia
            simp [A, hia, hwzero i his]
      · have hrpos : 0 < r := lt_of_le_of_ne hr (Ne.symm hr0)
        obtain ⟨Aa, hAaB, hAa, hAaMeasure⟩ := hμ B hB hwa hwa_le
        let C : Set Ω := B \ Aa
        have hC : MeasurableSet C := hB.diff hAa
        have hCMeasure : μ.real C = r * μ.real B := by
          rw [show C = B \ Aa from rfl, measureReal_sdiff hAaB hAa, hAaMeasure]
          have hrEq : 1 - w a = r := by linarith [hsum']
          rw [← hrEq]
          ring
        let w' : ι → ℝ := fun i ↦ w i / r
        have hw' : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w' i := by
          intro i hi
          exact div_nonneg (hwr i hi) (le_of_lt hrpos)
        have hsumw' : ∑ i ∈ s, w' i = 1 := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_div]
          simp only [r]
          exact div_self hr0
        obtain ⟨Ar, hArPart, hArMeasure⟩ := ih C hC w' hw' hsumw'
        rcases hArPart with ⟨hArMeas, hArSub, hArDisj, hArUnion⟩
        let A : ι → Set Ω := fun i ↦ if i = a then Aa else Ar i
        refine ⟨A, ?_, ?_⟩
        · refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
          · intro i hi
            by_cases hia : i = a
            · simpa [A, hia] using hAa
            · have his : i ∈ s := (Finset.mem_insert.mp hi).resolve_left hia
              simpa [A, hia] using (hArMeas i his)
          · intro i hi
            by_cases hia : i = a
            · simpa [A, hia] using hAaB
            · have his : i ∈ s := (Finset.mem_insert.mp hi).resolve_left hia
              simpa [A, hia] using (hArSub i his).trans Set.sdiff_subset
          · intro i hi j hj hij
            by_cases hia : i = a
            · by_cases hja : j = a
              · exact (hij (hia.trans hja.symm)).elim
              · subst i
                have hjs : j ∈ s := (Finset.mem_insert.mp hj).resolve_left hja
                rw [show A a = Aa by simp [A], show A j = Ar j by simp [A, hja]]
                rw [Set.disjoint_left]
                intro x hxAa hxAr
                exact (hArSub j hjs hxAr).2 hxAa
            · by_cases hja : j = a
              · subst j
                have his : i ∈ s := (Finset.mem_insert.mp hi).resolve_left hia
                rw [show A i = Ar i by simp [A, hia], show A a = Aa by simp [A]]
                rw [Set.disjoint_left]
                intro x hxAr hxAa
                exact (hArSub i his hxAr).2 hxAa
              · have his : i ∈ s := (Finset.mem_insert.mp hi).resolve_left hia
                have hjs : j ∈ s := (Finset.mem_insert.mp hj).resolve_left hja
                simpa [A, hia, hja] using hArDisj i his j hjs hij
          · rw [Finset.set_biUnion_insert]
            simp only [A, if_pos]
            have hrest : (⋃ i ∈ s, A i) = C := by
              calc
                (⋃ i ∈ s, A i) = ⋃ i ∈ s, Ar i := by
                  apply iUnion_congr
                  intro i
                  apply iUnion_congr
                  intro hi
                  have hia : i ≠ a := fun hEq ↦ ha (hEq ▸ hi)
                  simp [A, hia]
                _ = C := hArUnion
            rw [hrest]
            exact Set.union_sdiff_cancel hAaB
        · intro i hi
          by_cases hia : i = a
          · subst i
            simpa [A] using hAaMeasure
          · have his : i ∈ s := (Finset.mem_insert.mp hi).resolve_left hia
            rw [show A i = Ar i by simp [A, hia], hArMeasure i his, hCMeasure]
            simp only [w']
            field_simp

name: RandomSetTheory.measurable_supportFunction_closedConvexHull_of_effros
statement:
theorem measurable_supportFunction_closedConvexHull_of_effros
    {Z E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {F : Z → Set E} (hF : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable F)
    (hFcompact : ∀ z, IsCompact (F z)) (hFne : ∀ z, (F z).Nonempty)
    (u : E) :
    Measurable (fun z => supportFunction (closedConvexHull ℝ (F z)) u)
proof:
:= by
  have hraw : Measurable (fun z => supportFunction (F z) u) :=
    measurable_supportFunction hF hFcompact hFne u
  rw [show (fun z => supportFunction (closedConvexHull ℝ (F z)) u) =
      (fun z => supportFunction (F z) u) by
    funext z
    exact supportFunction_closedConvexHull (hFcompact z) (hFne z) u]
  exact hraw

name: RandomSetTheory.measurable_convexifiedDirectionalSupportDeviation
statement:
theorem measurable_convexifiedDirectionalSupportDeviation
    {Ω Z E ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Z]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (X : ι → Ω → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (F : Z → Set E) (hF : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable F)
    (hFcompact : ∀ z, IsCompact (F z)) (hFne : ∀ z, (F z).Nonempty)
    (L : Set E) (u : E) (i : ι) :
    Measurable (directionalSupportDeviation
      (fun j ω => closedConvexHull ℝ (F (X j ω))) L u i)
proof:
:= by
  have hsupp := (measurable_supportFunction_closedConvexHull_of_effros
    hF hFcompact hFne u).comp (hX i)
  change Measurable (fun ω =>
    supportFunction (closedConvexHull ℝ (F (X i ω))) u - supportFunction L u)
  exact hsupp.sub_const (supportFunction L u)

name: RandomSetTheory.iIndepFun_convexifiedDirectionalSupportDeviation
statement:
theorem iIndepFun_convexifiedDirectionalSupportDeviation
    {Ω Z E ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Z]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} (X : ι → Ω → Z)
    (hindep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X μ)
    (F : Z → Set E) (hF : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable F)
    (hFcompact : ∀ z, IsCompact (F z)) (hFne : ∀ z, (F z).Nonempty)
    (L : Set E) (u : E) :
    ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun
      (directionalSupportDeviation
        (fun i ω => closedConvexHull ℝ (F (X i ω))) L u) μ
proof:
:= by
  have hsupp : Measurable
      (fun z => supportFunction (closedConvexHull ℝ (F z)) u) :=
    measurable_supportFunction_closedConvexHull_of_effros
      hF hFcompact hFne u
  have hcomp := hindep.comp
    (fun _ z => supportFunction (closedConvexHull ℝ (F z)) u -
      supportFunction L u)
    (fun _ => hsupp.sub_const (supportFunction L u))
  change ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun (fun i ω =>
    supportFunction (closedConvexHull ℝ (F (X i ω))) u - supportFunction L u) μ
  simpa only [Function.comp_def] using hcomp

name: RandomSetTheory.integral_convexifiedDirectionalSupportDeviation_eq_zero
statement:
theorem integral_convexifiedDirectionalSupportDeviation_eq_zero
    {Ω Z E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Z]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : ℕ → Ω → Z)
    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) μ μ)
    (F : Z → Set E) (hF : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable F)
    (hFcompact : ∀ z, IsCompact (F z)) (hFne : ∀ z, (F z).Nonempty)
    (L : Set E) (u : E)
    (hbaseInt : Integrable (fun ω => supportFunction (F (X 0 ω)) u) μ)
    (hLsupport : supportFunction L u =
      ∫ ω, supportFunction (F (X 0 ω)) u ∂μ)
    (i : ℕ) :
    μ[directionalSupportDeviation
      (fun j ω => closedConvexHull ℝ (F (X j ω))) L u i] = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hsupp : Measurable
      (fun z => supportFunction (closedConvexHull ℝ (F z)) u) :=
    measurable_supportFunction_closedConvexHull_of_effros
      hF hFcompact hFne u
  have hid : IdentDistrib
      (fun ω => supportFunction (closedConvexHull ℝ (F (X i ω))) u)
      (fun ω => supportFunction (closedConvexHull ℝ (F (X 0 ω))) u) μ μ :=
    (hident i).comp hsupp
  have hbaseHullInt : Integrable
      (fun ω => supportFunction (closedConvexHull ℝ (F (X 0 ω))) u) μ := by
    apply hbaseInt.congr
    filter_upwards [] with ω
    exact (supportFunction_closedConvexHull
      (hFcompact (X 0 ω)) (hFne (X 0 ω)) u).symm
  have hiInt : Integrable
      (fun ω => supportFunction (closedConvexHull ℝ (F (X i ω))) u) μ :=
    hid.integrable_iff.mpr hbaseHullInt
  have hbaseIntegral :
      (∫ ω, supportFunction (closedConvexHull ℝ (F (X 0 ω))) u ∂μ) =
        ∫ ω, supportFunction (F (X 0 ω)) u ∂μ := by
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [] with ω
    exact supportFunction_closedConvexHull
      (hFcompact (X 0 ω)) (hFne (X 0 ω)) u
  simp only [directionalSupportDeviation]
  rw [integral_sub hiInt (integrable_const (supportFunction L u))]
  rw [hid.integral_eq, hbaseIntegral, ← hLsupport]
  simp

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_convexified_iid_risk_bound_of_hoeffding
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_convexified_iid_risk_bound_of_hoeffding
    {Ω Z E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Z]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [Nonempty E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : ℕ → Ω → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hindep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X μ)
    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) μ μ)
    (F : Z → Set E) (hF : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable F)
    (hFcompact : ∀ z, IsCompact (F z)) (hFne : ∀ z, (F z).Nonempty)
    {R : ℝ}
    (hFbound : ∀ z, ∀ x ∈ F z, ‖x‖ ≤ R)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {eps t : ℝ}
    (heps : 0 ≤ eps) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (N : Finset E) (hN : ∀ v ∈ N, ‖v‖ ≤ 1)
    (hnet : ∀ u : E, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 → ∃ v ∈ N, dist u v ≤ eps) :
    μ.real {ω | t + (R + R) * eps <
        hausdorffDist
          (closedConvexHull ℝ
            (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n) (fun i => F (X i ω))))
          (iidAumannTarget μ (X 0) F)} ≤
      N.card * symmetricSupportHoeffdingTail n t (R + R)
proof:
:= by
  let S₀ : Ω → Set E := fun ω => F (X 0 ω)
  let A : Set E := closure (aumannExpectation μ S₀)
  let L : Set E := closedConvexHull ℝ A
  have hS₀Effros : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S₀ :=
    hF.comp_measurable (hX 0)
  have hS₀compact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S₀ ω) := fun ω =>
    hFcompact (X 0 ω)
  have hS₀ne : ∀ ω, (S₀ ω).Nonempty := fun ω =>
    hFne (X 0 ω)
  have hg : Integrable (fun _ : Ω => R) μ := integrable_const R
  have hS₀dom : ∀ ω, ∀ x ∈ S₀ ω, ‖x‖ ≤ R := fun ω =>
    hFbound (X 0 ω)
  have hAcompact : IsCompact A :=
    closure_aumannExpectation_compact_of_integrable_envelope hg
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hS₀dom)
  have hfOne : IsIntegrableSelection μ S₀
      (supportApproximateSelection
        hS₀Effros hS₀compact hS₀ne 0 1 (by norm_num)) :=
    integrableSelection_supportApproximateSelection_of_envelope
      hS₀Effros hS₀compact hS₀ne hg hS₀dom 0 (by norm_num)
  have hAne : A.Nonempty :=
    (aumannExpectation_nonempty_of_selection hfOne).closure
  have hLcompact : IsCompact L := closedConvexHull_compact hAcompact
  have hLne : L.Nonempty := hAne.mono subset_closedConvexHull
  have hLconv : Convex ℝ L := convex_closedConvexHull
  have hLbound : ∀ x ∈ L, ‖x‖ ≤ R := by
    have hAsub : A ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) R := by
      intro x hx
      have hxR := norm_le_integral_envelope_of_mem_closure_aumannExpectation
        hg (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hS₀dom) hx
      have hxR' : ‖x‖ ≤ R := by simpa using hxR
      simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hxR'
    have hLsub : L ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) R :=
      closedConvexHull_min hAsub (convex_closedBall (0 : E) R)
        Metric.isClosed_closedBall
    intro x hx
    simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hLsub hx
  have hHullCompact : ∀ i ω,
      IsCompact (closedConvexHull ℝ (F (X i ω))) := fun i ω =>
    closedConvexHull_compact (hFcompact (X i ω))
  have hHullNe : ∀ i ω,
      (closedConvexHull ℝ (F (X i ω))).Nonempty := fun i ω =>
    (hFne (X i ω)).mono subset_closedConvexHull
  have hHullBound : ∀ i ω, ∀ x ∈ closedConvexHull ℝ (F (X i ω)),
      ‖x‖ ≤ R := by
    intro i ω
    have hsub : closedConvexHull ℝ (F (X i ω)) ⊆
        Metric.closedBall (0 : E) R := by
      apply closedConvexHull_min
      · intro x hx
        simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using
          hFbound (X i ω) x hx
      · exact convex_closedBall (0 : E) R
      · exact Metric.isClosed_closedBall
    intro x hx
    simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hsub hx
  have hbaseInt : ∀ u : E,
      Integrable (fun ω => supportFunction (F (X 0 ω)) u) μ := fun u =>
    integrable_supportFunction_of_envelope
      hS₀Effros hS₀compact hS₀ne hg hS₀dom u
  have hLsupport : ∀ u : E,
      supportFunction L u =
        ∫ ω, supportFunction (F (X 0 ω)) u ∂μ := by
    intro u
    rw [supportFunction_closedConvexHull hAcompact hAne]
    exact supportFunction_closure_aumannExpectation_of_envelope
      hS₀Effros hS₀compact hS₀ne hg hS₀dom hAcompact u
  have hbound := hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_risk_bound_of_hoeffding
    (μ := μ)
    (S := fun i ω => closedConvexHull ℝ (F (X i ω)))
    (L := L) (Finset.range n) (Finset.nonempty_range_iff.mpr hn.ne')
    hHullCompact hHullNe (fun _ _ => convex_closedConvexHull)
    hLcompact hLne hLconv hHullBound hLbound heps ht N hN hnet
    (fun v _hv =>
      iIndepFun_convexifiedDirectionalSupportDeviation
        X hindep F hF hFcompact hFne L v)
    (fun v _hv i =>
      (measurable_convexifiedDirectionalSupportDeviation
        X hX F hF hFcompact hFne L v i).aemeasurable)
    (fun v _hv i =>
      integral_convexifiedDirectionalSupportDeviation_eq_zero
        X hident F hF hFcompact hFne L v (hbaseInt v) (hLsupport v) i)
  have hEvent :
      {ω | t + (R + R) * eps <
        hausdorffDist
          (closedConvexHull ℝ
            (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n) (fun i => F (X i ω)))) L} =
      {ω | t + (R + R) * eps <
        hausdorffDist
          (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n)
            (fun i => closedConvexHull ℝ (F (X i ω)))) L} := by
    ext ω
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    rw [closedConvexHull_minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n)
      (fun i => F (X i ω))
      (fun i _ => hFcompact (X i ω))
      (fun i _ => hFne (X i ω))]
  change μ.real {ω | t + (R + R) * eps <
      hausdorffDist
        (closedConvexHull ℝ
          (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n) (fun i => F (X i ω)))) L} ≤ _
  rw [hEvent]
  simpa only [Finset.card_range] using hbound

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_convexified_iid_risk_bound_standard
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_convexified_iid_risk_bound_standard
    {Ω Z E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Z]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [Nonempty E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : ℕ → Ω → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hindep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X μ)
    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) μ μ)
    (F : Z → Set E) (hF : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable F)
    (hFcompact : ∀ z, IsCompact (F z)) (hFne : ∀ z, (F z).Nonempty)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R)
    (hFbound : ∀ z, ∀ x ∈ F z, ‖x‖ ≤ R)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {eps t : ℝ}
    (heps : 0 ≤ eps) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (N : Finset E) (hN : ∀ v ∈ N, ‖v‖ ≤ 1)
    (hnet : ∀ u : E, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 → ∃ v ∈ N, dist u v ≤ eps) :
    μ.real {ω | t + (R + R) * eps <
        hausdorffDist
          (closedConvexHull ℝ
            (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n) (fun i => F (X i ω))))
          (iidAumannTarget μ (X 0) F)} ≤
      N.card * (2 * exp (-(n : ℝ) * t ^ 2 /
        (2 * (R + R) ^ 2)))
proof:
:= by
  have hbound := hausdorffDist_convexified_iid_risk_bound_of_hoeffding
    (μ := μ) X hX hindep hident F hF hFcompact hFne hFbound
    hn heps ht N hN hnet
  rw [symmetricSupportHoeffdingTail_eq hn t (by linarith : 0 < R + R)] at hbound
  exact hbound

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_finset_hausdorffDist_convexified_iid_risk_bound_of_hoeffding
statement:
theorem exists_finset_hausdorffDist_convexified_iid_risk_bound_of_hoeffding
    {Ω Z E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Z]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [Nonempty E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : ℕ → Ω → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hindep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X μ)
    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) μ μ)
    (F : Z → Set E) (hF : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable F)
    (hFcompact : ∀ z, IsCompact (F z)) (hFne : ∀ z, (F z).Nonempty)
    {R : ℝ} (hFbound : ∀ z, ∀ x ∈ F z, ‖x‖ ≤ R)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {eps t : ℝ}
    (heps : 0 < eps) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    ∃ N : Finset E,
      (∀ v ∈ N, ‖v‖ ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ u : E, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 → ∃ v ∈ N, dist u v ≤ eps) ∧
      μ.real {ω | t + (R + R) * eps <
          hausdorffDist
            (closedConvexHull ℝ
              (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n) (fun i => F (X i ω))))
            (iidAumannTarget μ (X 0) F)} ≤
        N.card * symmetricSupportHoeffdingTail n t (R + R)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hnet⟩ :=
    exists_finset_unitBall_closedNet_with_centers (E := E) heps
  exact ⟨N, hN, hnet,
    hausdorffDist_convexified_iid_risk_bound_of_hoeffding
      (μ := μ) X hX hindep hident F hF hFcompact hFne hFbound
      hn heps.le ht N hN hnet⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_finset_hausdorffDist_convexified_iid_risk_bound_standard
statement:
theorem exists_finset_hausdorffDist_convexified_iid_risk_bound_standard
    {Ω Z E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Z]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [Nonempty E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : ℕ → Ω → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hindep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X μ)
    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) μ μ)
    (F : Z → Set E) (hF : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable F)
    (hFcompact : ∀ z, IsCompact (F z)) (hFne : ∀ z, (F z).Nonempty)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R)
    (hFbound : ∀ z, ∀ x ∈ F z, ‖x‖ ≤ R)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {eps t : ℝ}
    (heps : 0 < eps) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    ∃ N : Finset E,
      (∀ v ∈ N, ‖v‖ ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ u : E, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 → ∃ v ∈ N, dist u v ≤ eps) ∧
      μ.real {ω | t + (R + R) * eps <
          hausdorffDist
            (closedConvexHull ℝ
              (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n) (fun i => F (X i ω))))
            (iidAumannTarget μ (X 0) F)} ≤
        N.card * (2 * exp (-(n : ℝ) * t ^ 2 /
          (2 * (R + R) ^ 2)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hnet⟩ :=
    exists_finset_unitBall_closedNet_with_centers (E := E) heps
  exact ⟨N, hN, hnet,
    hausdorffDist_convexified_iid_risk_bound_standard
      (μ := μ) X hX hindep hident F hF hFcompact hFne hR hFbound
      hn heps.le ht N hN hnet⟩

name: ProbabilityTheory.conditionalValueAtRisk_iSup_empiricalAverageProcess_le_rioConfidence
statement:
theorem conditionalValueAtRisk_iSup_empiricalAverageProcess_le_rioConfidence
    {mu : Measure Omega} {nu : Measure Z}
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    [StandardBorelSpace Z] [Nonempty Z] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (z0 : Z) (Y : Nat → Omega → Z)
    (hY : forall i, Measurable (Y i)) (hIndep : iIndepFun Y mu)
    (n q : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    (W : Fin n → Z → T → Real) (A : Fin n → Z → Real)
    (hYlaw : forall i, i < n → mu.map (Y i) = nu)
    (hWmeas : forall i t, Measurable (fun z ↦ W i z t))
    (hWcontinuous : forall i z, Continuous (W i z))
    (hAq : forall i, MemLp (A i) q nu)
    (hA : forall i z, 0 ≤ A i z)
    (hdom : forall i z t, abs (W i z t) ≤ A i z)
    (Ktwo Kq : Real) (hKtwo : 0 < Ktwo) (hKq : 0 < Kq)
    (hsecond : forall i, (∫ z, A i z ^ 2 ∂nu) ≤ Ktwo ^ 2)
    (hqmoment : forall i, (∫ z, A i z ^ q ∂nu) ≤ Kq ^ q)
    {alpha : Real} (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha < 1) :
    conditionalValueAtRisk alpha
        (fun omega ↦
          (⨆ t, finiteCoordinateSumProcess Y
              (empiricalNormalizedKernel n W) t omega) -
            ∫ z, (⨆ t, finiteCoordinateSumProcess Y
              (empiricalNormalizedKernel n W) t z) ∂mu) mu ≤
      rioStrongMomentConfidenceRadius q
        (4 * Ktwo ^ 2 / (n : Real))
        ((2 : Real) ^ q * Kq ^ q / (n : Real) ^ (q - 1)) alpha
proof:
:= by
  have hnReal : 0 < (n : Real) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hV : 0 < 4 * Ktwo ^ 2 / (n : Real) := by positivity
  have hQ :
      0 < (2 : Real) ^ q * Kq ^ q / (n : Real) ^ (q - 1) := by
    positivity
  have hsecondNormalized :
      (∑ i : Fin n, replaceOneCenteredMoment nu
        (empiricalNormalizedEnvelope n (A i)) 2) ≤
        4 * Ktwo ^ 2 / (n : Real) :=
    sum_replaceOneCenteredMoment_empiricalNormalizedEnvelope_two_le
      n q hn (by omega) A Ktwo hAq hA hsecond
  have hqmomentNormalized :
      (∑ i : Fin n, replaceOneCenteredMoment nu
        (empiricalNormalizedEnvelope n (A i)) q) ≤
        (2 : Real) ^ q * Kq ^ q / (n : Real) ^ (q - 1) :=
    sum_replaceOneCenteredMoment_empiricalNormalizedEnvelope_q_le
      n q hn (by omega) A Kq hAq hA hqmoment
  have hdomNormalized : forall i z t,
      abs (empiricalNormalizedKernel n W i z t) ≤
        empiricalNormalizedEnvelope n (A i) z := by
    intro i z t
    have hscale : 0 ≤ (n : Real)⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg n)
    change abs (((n : Real)⁻¹ * W i z t)) ≤ (n : Real)⁻¹ * A i z
    rw [abs_mul, abs_inv, abs_of_nonneg hnReal.le]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hdom i z t) hscale
  exact conditionalValueAtRisk_iSup_finiteCoordinateSumProcess_le_rioConfidence
    z0 Y hY hIndep n q hq (empiricalNormalizedKernel n W)
      (fun i ↦ empiricalNormalizedEnvelope n (A i)) hYlaw
      (fun i t ↦ measurable_const.mul (hWmeas i t))
      (fun i z ↦ continuous_const.mul (hWcontinuous i z))
      (fun i ↦ memLp_empiricalNormalizedEnvelope n (A i) q (hAq i))
      (fun i z ↦ empiricalNormalizedEnvelope_nonneg n (A i) (hA i) z)
      hdomNormalized
      (V := 4 * Ktwo ^ 2 / (n : Real))
      (Q := (2 : Real) ^ q * Kq ^ q / (n : Real) ^ (q - 1))
      hV hQ hsecondNormalized hqmomentNormalized halpha0 halpha1

name: ProbabilityTheory.conditionalValueAtRisk_iSup_empiricalAverageProcess_le_polynomialRate
statement:
theorem conditionalValueAtRisk_iSup_empiricalAverageProcess_le_polynomialRate
    {mu : Measure Omega} {nu : Measure Z}
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    [StandardBorelSpace Z] [Nonempty Z] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (z0 : Z) (Y : Nat → Omega → Z)
    (hY : forall i, Measurable (Y i)) (hIndep : iIndepFun Y mu)
    (n q : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    (W : Fin n → Z → T → Real) (A : Fin n → Z → Real)
    (hYlaw : forall i, i < n → mu.map (Y i) = nu)
    (hWmeas : forall i t, Measurable (fun z ↦ W i z t))
    (hWcontinuous : forall i z, Continuous (W i z))
    (hAq : forall i, MemLp (A i) q nu)
    (hA : forall i z, 0 ≤ A i z)
    (hdom : forall i z t, abs (W i z t) ≤ A i z)
    (Ktwo Kq : Real) (hKtwo : 0 < Ktwo) (hKq : 0 < Kq)
    (hsecond : forall i, (∫ z, A i z ^ 2 ∂nu) ≤ Ktwo ^ 2)
    (hqmoment : forall i, (∫ z, A i z ^ q ∂nu) ≤ Kq ^ q)
    {alpha : Real} (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha < 1) :
    conditionalValueAtRisk alpha
        (fun omega ↦
          (⨆ t, finiteCoordinateSumProcess Y
              (empiricalNormalizedKernel n W) t omega) -
            ∫ z, (⨆ t, finiteCoordinateSumProcess Y
              (empiricalNormalizedKernel n W) t z) ∂mu) mu ≤
      Real.sqrt
          (2 * (4 * Ktwo ^ 2 / (n : Real)) * (-Real.log alpha)) +
        rioPolynomialCoefficient q * empiricalPolynomialScale q n Kq *
          (1 / alpha) ^ (1 / (q : Real))
proof:
:= by
  exact (conditionalValueAtRisk_iSup_empiricalAverageProcess_le_rioConfidence
    z0 Y hY hIndep n q hn hq W A hYlaw hWmeas hWcontinuous hAq hA hdom
      Ktwo Kq hKtwo hKq hsecond hqmoment halpha0 halpha1).trans
    (rioStrongMomentConfidenceRadius_empiricalMoment_le
      (by omega) hn hKq halpha0)

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_Icc_eq_aumannExpectation_real
statement:
theorem exists_Icc_eq_aumannExpectation_real
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S : Ω → Set ℝ}
    (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    (hconv : ∀ ω, Convex ℝ (S ω))
    {g : Ω → ℝ} (hg : Integrable g μ)
    (hdom : ∀ ω, ∀ x ∈ S ω, ‖x‖ ≤ g ω) :
    ∃ a b : ℝ, a ≤ b ∧ aumannExpectation μ S = Icc a b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨fmin, hfmin, hmin⟩ :=
    hasIntegrableSupportSelection_of_effros_of_envelope
      hS hcompact hne hg hdom (-1 : ℝ)
  obtain ⟨fmax, hfmax, hmax⟩ :=
    hasIntegrableSupportSelection_of_effros_of_envelope
      hS hcompact hne hg hdom (1 : ℝ)
  let a : ℝ := ∫ ω, fmin ω ∂μ
  let b : ℝ := ∫ ω, fmax ω ∂μ
  have hmin_le_max : fmin ≤ᵐ[μ] fmax := by
    filter_upwards [hfmin.2, hfmax.2, hmax] with ω hfminω hfmaxω hmaxω
    have hle := inner_le_supportFunction (hcompact ω) hfminω (1 : ℝ)
    rw [← hmaxω] at hle
    simpa using hle
  have hab : a ≤ b := by
    exact integral_mono_ae hfmin.1 hfmax.1 hmin_le_max
  have ha : a ∈ aumannExpectation μ S :=
    ⟨fmin, hfmin, rfl⟩
  have hb : b ∈ aumannExpectation μ S :=
    ⟨fmax, hfmax, rfl⟩
  have hAconv : Convex ℝ (aumannExpectation μ S) :=
    aumannExpectation_convex (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hconv)
  refine ⟨a, b, hab, Set.Subset.antisymm ?_ ?_⟩
  · rintro x ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
    constructor
    · apply integral_mono_ae hfmin.1 hf.1
      filter_upwards [hfmin.2, hf.2, hmin] with ω hfminω hfω hminω
      have hle := inner_le_supportFunction (hcompact ω) hfω (-1 : ℝ)
      rw [← hminω] at hle
      simpa using hle
    · apply integral_mono_ae hf.1 hfmax.1
      filter_upwards [hf.2, hfmax.2, hmax] with ω hfω hfmaxω hmaxω
      have hle := inner_le_supportFunction (hcompact ω) hfω (1 : ℝ)
      rw [← hmaxω] at hle
      simpa using hle
  · exact hAconv.ordConnected.out ha hb

name: ProbabilityTheory.conditionalValueAtRisk_finiteSupremum_le_rio_of_iidGhostFibers
statement:
theorem conditionalValueAtRisk_finiteSupremum_le_rio_of_iidGhostFibers
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    [StandardBorelSpace Z] [Nonempty Z] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (z0 : Z) (Y : Nat -> Omega -> Z)
    (hY : ∀ i, Measurable (Y i)) (hIndep : iIndepFun Y mu)
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty) (X : T -> Omega -> Real)
    (B : Omega -> Real) (hB : Integrable B mu)
    (hdom : ∀ omega u, u ∈ s -> abs (X u omega) <= abs (B omega))
    (G : Nat -> (Nat -> Z) -> Z -> Real) (Acoord : Nat -> Z -> Real)
    (n q : Nat) (hq : 3 <= q)
    {V Q y alpha : Real} (hV : 0 < V) (hQ : 0 < Q) (hy : 0 < y)
    (hYlaw : ∀ i < n, mu.map (Y i) = nu)
    (hXprefix : ∀ u ∈ s,
      Measurable[strictPrefixFiltration Y hY n] (X u))
    (hG : ∀ i < n, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (G i)))
    (hAq : ∀ j < n + 1, MemLp (Acoord j) q nu)
    (hA : ∀ j < n + 1, ∀ z, 0 <= Acoord j z)
    (hreplace : ∀ i < n, ∀ b z z',
      abs (G i b z - G i b z') <=
        Acoord (i + 1) z + Acoord (i + 1) z')
    (hnext : ∀ i < n,
      mu[finiteProcessSupremum s hs X |
          strictPrefixFiltration Y hY (i + 1)] =ᵐ[mu]
        fun omega =>
          G i (paddedStrictPrefix z0 Y i omega) (Y i omega))
    (hsecond :
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        replaceOneCenteredMoment nu (Acoord j) 2) <= V)
    (hmomentQ :
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        replaceOneCenteredMoment nu (Acoord j) q) <= Q)
    (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha < 1)
    (hscale : Q * Real.exp (-Real.log alpha) <= y ^ q) :
    conditionalValueAtRisk alpha
        (fun omega => finiteProcessSupremum s hs X omega -
          ∫ z, finiteProcessSupremum s hs X z ∂mu) mu <=
      Real.sqrt (2 * V * (-Real.log alpha)) +
        (1 + 1 / (q : Real)) * y +
          Real.exp 1 * strongMomentQScale q Q * (-Real.log alpha) / 3 +
        alpha⁻¹ * (Q / ((q : Real) * y ^ (q - 1)))
proof:
:= by
  let filtration : Filtration Nat mOmega := strictPrefixFiltration Y hY
  have hX : ∀ u ∈ s, Measurable (X u) := by
    intro u hu
    exact (hXprefix u hu).mono (filtration.le n) le_rfl
  have hFint : Integrable (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X) mu :=
    integrable_finiteProcessSupremum s hs X B hB hX hdom
  have hFmeas : StronglyMeasurable[filtration n]
      (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X) :=
    (measurable_finiteProcessSupremum
      (mOmega := filtration n) s hs X hXprefix).stronglyMeasurable
  have hterminalEq :
      mu[finiteProcessSupremum s hs X | filtration n] =
        finiteProcessSupremum s hs X :=
    condExp_of_stronglyMeasurable (filtration.le n) hFmeas hFint
  have hterminal :
      mu[finiteProcessSupremum s hs X | filtration n] =ᵐ[mu]
        finiteProcessSupremum s hs X :=
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun omega => congrFun hterminalEq omega
  have hzero : doobCenteredDifference filtration mu
      (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X) 0 =ᵐ[mu] 0 := by
    apply doobCenteredDifference_zero_ae_eq_zero_of_filtration_zero_eq_bot
    exact strictPrefixFiltration_zero Y hY
  have hrepresentation : ∀ i < n,
      doobCenteredDifference filtration mu
          (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X) (i + 1) =ᵐ[mu]
        fun omega =>
          G i (paddedStrictPrefix z0 Y i omega) (Y i omega) -
            ∫ z, G i (paddedStrictPrefix z0 Y i omega) z ∂(mu.map (Y i)) := by
    intro i hi
    apply doobCenteredDifference_succ_ae_eq_centeredGhostFiber_of_condExp_next
      filtration (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X) i
        (paddedStrictPrefix z0 Y i) (Y i)
    · exact hIndep.indepFun_paddedStrictPrefix z0 Y hY i
    · exact measurable_paddedStrictPrefix z0 Y hY i
    · exact hY i
    · exact strictPrefixFiltration_eq_comap_paddedStrictPrefix z0 Y hY i
    · exact hG i hi
    · simpa only [filtration] using hnext i hi
  apply conditionalValueAtRisk_finiteSupremum_le_rio_of_centeredGhostFibers
      (nu := nu) filtration s hs X B hB hX hdom
      (fun i => paddedStrictPrefix z0 Y i) Y G Acoord n q hq
      hV hQ hy hterminal hzero
  · intro i hi
    exact hIndep.indepFun_paddedStrictPrefix z0 Y hY i
  · intro i hi
    exact measurable_paddedStrictPrefix z0 Y hY i
  · exact fun i hi => hY i
  · exact hYlaw
  · intro i hi
    exact strictPrefixFiltration_eq_comap_paddedStrictPrefix z0 Y hY i
  · exact hG
  · exact hAq
  · exact hA
  · exact hreplace
  · simpa only [filtration] using hrepresentation
  · exact hsecond
  · exact hmomentQ
  · exact halpha0
  · exact halpha1
  · exact hscale
