name: RandomSetTheory.closedConvexHull_closure_aumannExpectation_add
statement:
theorem closedConvexHull_closure_aumannExpectation_add
    {Ω H : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ H] [Nonempty H]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {S T : Ω → Set H}
    (hSEffros : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hTEffros : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable T)
    (hScompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hTcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (T ω))
    (hSne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    (hTne : ∀ ω, (T ω).Nonempty)
    {gS gT : Ω → ℝ} (hgS : Integrable gS μ) (hgT : Integrable gT μ)
    (hdomS : ∀ ω, ∀ x ∈ S ω, ‖x‖ ≤ gS ω)
    (hdomT : ∀ ω, ∀ x ∈ T ω, ‖x‖ ≤ gT ω) :
    closedConvexHull ℝ
        (closure (aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => S ω + T ω))) =
      closedConvexHull ℝ (closure (aumannExpectation μ S)) +
        closedConvexHull ℝ (closure (aumannExpectation μ T))
proof:
:= by
  have hSTEffros : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable
      (fun ω => S ω + T ω) :=
    hSEffros.add hTEffros
      (fun ω => (hScompact ω).isClosed)
      (fun ω => (hTcompact ω).isClosed) hSne hTne
  have hSTcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω + T ω) := fun ω =>
    (hScompact ω).add (hTcompact ω)
  have hSTne : ∀ ω, (S ω + T ω).Nonempty := fun ω =>
    (hSne ω).add (hTne ω)
  have hgST : Integrable (fun ω => gS ω + gT ω) μ := hgS.add hgT
  have hdomST : ∀ ω, ∀ z ∈ S ω + T ω,
      ‖z‖ ≤ gS ω + gT ω := by
    intro ω z hz
    rcases hz with ⟨x, hx, y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact (norm_add_le x y).trans
      (add_le_add (hdomS ω x hx) (hdomT ω y hy))
  have hAScompact : IsCompact (closure (aumannExpectation μ S)) :=
    closure_aumannExpectation_compact_of_integrable_envelope hgS
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hdomS)
  have hATcompact : IsCompact (closure (aumannExpectation μ T)) :=
    closure_aumannExpectation_compact_of_integrable_envelope hgT
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hdomT)
  have hASTcompact : IsCompact
      (closure (aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => S ω + T ω))) :=
    closure_aumannExpectation_compact_of_integrable_envelope hgST
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hdomST)
  have hfS : IsIntegrableSelection μ S
      (supportApproximateSelection hSEffros hScompact hSne 0 1 (by norm_num)) :=
    integrableSelection_supportApproximateSelection_of_envelope
      hSEffros hScompact hSne hgS hdomS 0 (by norm_num)
  have hfT : IsIntegrableSelection μ T
      (supportApproximateSelection hTEffros hTcompact hTne 0 1 (by norm_num)) :=
    integrableSelection_supportApproximateSelection_of_envelope
      hTEffros hTcompact hTne hgT hdomT 0 (by norm_num)
  have hfST : IsIntegrableSelection μ (fun ω => S ω + T ω)
      (supportApproximateSelection
        hSTEffros hSTcompact hSTne 0 1 (by norm_num)) :=
    integrableSelection_supportApproximateSelection_of_envelope
      hSTEffros hSTcompact hSTne hgST hdomST 0 (by norm_num)
  have hASne : (closure (aumannExpectation μ S)).Nonempty :=
    (aumannExpectation_nonempty_of_selection hfS).closure
  have hATne : (closure (aumannExpectation μ T)).Nonempty :=
    (aumannExpectation_nonempty_of_selection hfT).closure
  have hASTne :
      (closure (aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => S ω + T ω))).Nonempty :=
    (aumannExpectation_nonempty_of_selection hfST).closure
  have hCScompact : IsCompact
      (closedConvexHull ℝ (closure (aumannExpectation μ S))) :=
    closedConvexHull_compact hAScompact
  have hCTcompact : IsCompact
      (closedConvexHull ℝ (closure (aumannExpectation μ T))) :=
    closedConvexHull_compact hATcompact
  have hCSne :
      (closedConvexHull ℝ (closure (aumannExpectation μ S))).Nonempty :=
    hASne.mono subset_closedConvexHull
  have hCTne :
      (closedConvexHull ℝ (closure (aumannExpectation μ T))).Nonempty :=
    hATne.mono subset_closedConvexHull
  have hSupportS : ∀ u : H,
      Integrable (fun ω => supportFunction (S ω) u) μ := fun u =>
    integrable_supportFunction_of_envelope
      hSEffros hScompact hSne hgS hdomS u
  have hSupportT : ∀ u : H,
      Integrable (fun ω => supportFunction (T ω) u) μ := fun u =>
    integrable_supportFunction_of_envelope
      hTEffros hTcompact hTne hgT hdomT u
  apply eq_of_supportFunction_eq
    (closedConvexHull_compact hASTcompact)
    (hCScompact.add hCTcompact)
    (hASTne.mono subset_closedConvexHull)
    (hCSne.add hCTne)
    convex_closedConvexHull
    (convex_closedConvexHull.add convex_closedConvexHull)
  intro u
  calc
    supportFunction
        (closedConvexHull ℝ
          (closure (aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => S ω + T ω)))) u =
        supportFunction
          (closure (aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => S ω + T ω))) u :=
      supportFunction_closedConvexHull hASTcompact hASTne u
    _ = ∫ ω, supportFunction (S ω + T ω) u ∂μ :=
      supportFunction_closure_aumannExpectation_of_envelope
        hSTEffros hSTcompact hSTne hgST hdomST hASTcompact u
    _ = ∫ ω, supportFunction (S ω) u + supportFunction (T ω) u ∂μ := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [] with ω
      exact supportFunction_add
        (hScompact ω) (hTcompact ω) (hSne ω) (hTne ω) u
    _ = (∫ ω, supportFunction (S ω) u ∂μ) +
        ∫ ω, supportFunction (T ω) u ∂μ :=
      integral_add (hSupportS u) (hSupportT u)
    _ = supportFunction (closure (aumannExpectation μ S)) u +
        supportFunction (closure (aumannExpectation μ T)) u := by
      rw [supportFunction_closure_aumannExpectation_of_envelope
          hSEffros hScompact hSne hgS hdomS hAScompact u,
        supportFunction_closure_aumannExpectation_of_envelope
          hTEffros hTcompact hTne hgT hdomT hATcompact u]
    _ = supportFunction
          (closedConvexHull ℝ (closure (aumannExpectation μ S))) u +
        supportFunction
          (closedConvexHull ℝ (closure (aumannExpectation μ T))) u := by
      rw [supportFunction_closedConvexHull hAScompact hASne u,
        supportFunction_closedConvexHull hATcompact hATne u]
    _ = supportFunction
        (closedConvexHull ℝ (closure (aumannExpectation μ S)) +
          closedConvexHull ℝ (closure (aumannExpectation μ T))) u :=
      (supportFunction_add hCScompact hCTcompact hCSne hCTne u).symm

name: RandomSetTheory.closedConvexHull_closure_aumannExpectation_smul
statement:
theorem closedConvexHull_closure_aumannExpectation_smul
    {Ω H : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ H] [Nonempty H]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {S : Ω → Set H}
    (hSEffros : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hScompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hSne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    {g : Ω → ℝ} (hg : Integrable g μ)
    (hdom : ∀ ω, ∀ x ∈ S ω, ‖x‖ ≤ g ω) (c : ℝ) :
    closedConvexHull ℝ
        (closure (aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => c • S ω))) =
      c • closedConvexHull ℝ (closure (aumannExpectation μ S))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hc : c = 0
  · subst c
    have hfS : IsIntegrableSelection μ S
        (supportApproximateSelection
          hSEffros hScompact hSne 0 1 (by norm_num)) :=
      integrableSelection_supportApproximateSelection_of_envelope
        hSEffros hScompact hSne hg hdom 0 (by norm_num)
    have hASne : (closure (aumannExpectation μ S)).Nonempty :=
      (aumannExpectation_nonempty_of_selection hfS).closure
    have hCSne :
        (closedConvexHull ℝ (closure (aumannExpectation μ S))).Nonempty :=
      hASne.mono subset_closedConvexHull
    have hzeroCorrespondence :
        (fun ω => (0 : ℝ) • S ω) =
          (fun _ : Ω => ({0} : Set H)) := by
      funext ω
      exact zero_smul_set (hSne ω)
    have hzeroAumann :
        aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => (0 : ℝ) • S ω) = ({0} : Set H) := by
      rw [hzeroCorrespondence]
      have hsingleton := aumannExpectation_singleton
        (μ := μ) (f := fun _ : Ω => (0 : H)) (integrable_zero Ω H μ)
      simpa using hsingleton
    rw [hzeroAumann, closure_singleton]
    have hzeroHull : closedConvexHull ℝ ({0} : Set H) = {0} := by
      apply Set.Subset.antisymm
      · exact closedConvexHull_min Subset.rfl
          (convex_singleton 0) isClosed_singleton
      · exact subset_closedConvexHull
    rw [hzeroHull]
    exact Set.singleton_zero.trans (zero_smul_set hCSne).symm
  · rw [aumannExpectation_smul_of_ne c hc, closure_smul₀,
      closedConvexHull_smul_set_eq]

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasOneSidedMGF.mono_exponent
statement:
theorem HasOneSidedMGF.mono_exponent
    {X : Omega → ℝ} {psi phi : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hmgf : HasOneSidedMGF X psi mu)
    (hpsi : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → psi t ≤ phi t) :
    HasOneSidedMGF X phi mu
proof:
:= by
  refine
    { aemeasurable := hmgf.aemeasurable
      integrable_exp_mul := hmgf.integrable_exp_mul
      mgf_le := ?_ }
  intro t ht
  exact (hmgf.mgf_le t ht).trans (Real.exp_monotone (hpsi t ht))

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasOneSidedMGF.conditionalValueAtRisk_le_chernoffTransform
statement:
theorem HasOneSidedMGF.conditionalValueAtRisk_le_chernoffTransform
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {X : Omega → ℝ} {psi : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hmgf : HasOneSidedMGF X psi mu) (hX : Integrable X mu)
    {alpha : ℝ} (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha ≤ 1) :
    conditionalValueAtRisk alpha X mu ≤
      chernoffTransform psi (-Real.log alpha)
proof:
:= by
  unfold chernoffTransform
  apply le_csInf (Set.range_nonempty _)
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hz
  unfold chernoffObjective
  have h := hmgf.conditionalValueAtRisk_le
    hX halpha0 halpha1 t.property
  rw [← sub_eq_add_neg]
  exact h

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasOneSidedMGF.conditionalValueAtRisk_le_rioStrongMoment
statement:
theorem HasOneSidedMGF.conditionalValueAtRisk_le_rioStrongMoment
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {X : Omega → ℝ} (hX : Integrable X mu)
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    {y second V Q alpha : ℝ} {moment : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hy : 0 < y) (hV : 0 < V) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q)
    (hsecond : second ≤ V)
    (hmiddle : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Ico 3 q,
      moment k ≤ interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient q V Q k)
    (hmomentQ : moment q ≤ Q)
    (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha < 1)
    (hscale : Q * Real.exp (-Real.log alpha) ≤ y ^ q)
    (hmgf : HasOneSidedMGF X
      (strongMomentSeriesExponent q · y second moment) mu) :
    conditionalValueAtRisk alpha X mu ≤
      Real.sqrt (2 * V * (-Real.log alpha)) +
        y + y / (q : ℝ) +
          (y / (-Real.log alpha)) *
            strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V Q
              ((-Real.log alpha) / y)
proof:
:= by
  have hx : 0 < -Real.log alpha := neg_pos.mpr
    (Real.log_neg halpha0 halpha1)
  have hseriesLe : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t →
      strongMomentSeriesExponent q t y second moment ≤
        rioStrongMomentExponent q V Q y t := by
    intro t ht
    exact strongMomentSeriesExponent_le_rioStrongMomentExponent
      q ht hy hsecond hmiddle hmomentQ
  have hrio : HasOneSidedMGF X (rioStrongMomentExponent q V Q y) mu :=
    hmgf.mono_exponent hseriesLe
  have hcvar := hrio.conditionalValueAtRisk_le_chernoffTransform
    hX halpha0 halpha1.le
  exact hcvar.trans
    (chernoffTransform_rioStrongMomentExponent_le q hq hV hQ hy hx hscale)

name: RandomSet.isEffrosMeasurable_singleton
statement:
theorem isEffrosMeasurable_singleton
    {Ω X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [TopologicalSpace X]
    [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    {f : Ω → X} (hf : Measurable f) :
    IsEffrosMeasurable (fun ω => ({f ω} : Set X))
proof:
:= by
  intro U hU
  have hEq : {ω | (({f ω} : Set X) ∩ U).Nonempty} = f ⁻¹' U := by
    ext ω
    simp
  rw [hEq]
  exact hf hU.measurableSet

name: RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable.prod
statement:
theorem IsEffrosMeasurable.prod
    {Ω X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [MetricSpace X] [CompleteSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    [SecondCountableTopology X] [Nonempty X]
    [MetricSpace Y] [CompleteSpace Y] [MeasurableSpace Y] [BorelSpace Y]
    [SecondCountableTopology Y] [Nonempty Y]
    {S : Ω → Set X} {T : Ω → Set Y}
    (hS : IsEffrosMeasurable S) (hT : IsEffrosMeasurable T)
    (hSclosed : ∀ ω, IsClosed (S ω)) (hTclosed : ∀ ω, IsClosed (T ω))
    (hSne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty) (hTne : ∀ ω, (T ω).Nonempty) :
    IsEffrosMeasurable (fun ω => S ω ×ˢ T ω)
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℕ → Ω → X := castaingRepresentation hS hSclosed hSne
  let g : ℕ → Ω → Y := castaingRepresentation hT hTclosed hTne
  let q : ℕ → Ω → X × Y := fun n ω =>
    (f (Nat.unpair n).1 ω, g (Nat.unpair n).2 ω)
  have hqmeas : ∀ n, Measurable (q n) := by
    intro n
    exact (castaingRepresentation_measurable hS hSclosed hSne
      (Nat.unpair n).1).prodMk
        (castaingRepresentation_measurable hT hTclosed hTne
          (Nat.unpair n).2)
  apply effrosMeasurable_of_closure_range hqmeas
  intro ω
  have hrange : Set.range (fun n => q n ω) =
      Set.range (fun n => f n ω) ×ˢ Set.range (fun n => g n ω) := by
    ext z
    rcases z with ⟨x, y⟩
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
      rw [← hn]
      exact ⟨⟨(Nat.unpair n).1, rfl⟩, ⟨(Nat.unpair n).2, rfl⟩⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, ⟨j, hj⟩⟩
      refine ⟨Nat.pair i j, ?_⟩
      simp [q, f, g, hi, hj]
  rw [hrange, closure_prod_eq,
    closure_range_castaingRepresentation hS hSclosed hSne ω,
    closure_range_castaingRepresentation hT hTclosed hTne ω]

name: RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable.add
statement:
theorem IsEffrosMeasurable.add
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] [Nonempty E]
    {S T : Ω → Set E}
    (hS : IsEffrosMeasurable S) (hT : IsEffrosMeasurable T)
    (hSclosed : ∀ ω, IsClosed (S ω)) (hTclosed : ∀ ω, IsClosed (T ω))
    (hSne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty) (hTne : ∀ ω, (T ω).Nonempty) :
    IsEffrosMeasurable (fun ω => S ω + T ω)
proof:
:= by
  have hprod := hS.prod hT hSclosed hTclosed hSne hTne
  have himage := hprod.image (continuous_fst.add continuous_snd)
  simpa only [Pi.add_apply, Set.add_image_prod] using himage

name: RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable.const_smul
statement:
theorem IsEffrosMeasurable.const_smul
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {S : Ω → Set E} (hS : IsEffrosMeasurable S) (c : ℝ) :
    IsEffrosMeasurable (fun ω => c • S ω)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Set.image_smul] using
    hS.image (continuous_const_smul c : Continuous (fun x : E => c • x))

name: ProbabilityTheory.strongMomentQScale_empiricalMoment
statement:
theorem strongMomentQScale_empiricalMoment
    {q n : Nat} (hq : 1 <= q) (hn : 0 < n) {K : Real} (hK : 0 < K) :
    strongMomentQScale q
        ((2 : Real) ^ q * K ^ q / (n : Real) ^ (q - 1)) =
      empiricalPolynomialScale q n K
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := by omega
  have hqReal : (q : Real) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hq0
  have hnReal : 0 < (n : Real) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have htwoK : 0 <= 2 * K := (mul_pos (by norm_num) hK).le
  have hden : 0 <= (n : Real) ^ (q - 1) := pow_nonneg hnReal.le _
  have hexponent :
      ((q - 1 : Nat) : Real) * (q : Real)⁻¹ =
        1 - (q : Real)⁻¹ := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 <= q)]
    norm_num
    field_simp [hqReal]
  unfold strongMomentQScale empiricalPolynomialScale
  rw [show (2 : Real) ^ q * K ^ q = (2 * K) ^ q by rw [mul_pow]]
  rw [Real.div_rpow (pow_nonneg htwoK q) hden]
  simp only [one_div]
  rw [Real.pow_rpow_inv_natCast htwoK hq0]
  rw [← Real.rpow_natCast_mul hnReal.le (q - 1) (q : Real)⁻¹]
  rw [hexponent]

name: ProbabilityTheory.rioConfidenceScale_empiricalMoment
statement:
theorem rioConfidenceScale_empiricalMoment
    {q n : Nat} (hq : 1 <= q) (hn : 0 < n) {K alpha : Real}
    (hK : 0 < K) :
    rioConfidenceScale q
        ((2 : Real) ^ q * K ^ q / (n : Real) ^ (q - 1)) alpha =
      empiricalPolynomialScale q n K *
        (1 / alpha) ^ (1 / (q : Real))
proof:
:= by
  unfold rioConfidenceScale
  rw [strongMomentQScale_empiricalMoment hq hn hK]

name: ProbabilityTheory.neg_log_le_natCast_mul_inv_rpow
statement:
theorem neg_log_le_natCast_mul_inv_rpow
    {q : Nat} (hq : 1 <= q) {alpha : Real}
    (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) :
    -Real.log alpha <=
      (q : Real) * (1 / alpha) ^ (1 / (q : Real))
proof:
:= by
  have hqReal : 0 < (q : Real) := by exact_mod_cast (lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one hq)
  have hepsilon : 0 < 1 / (q : Real) := one_div_pos.mpr hqReal
  have hlog := Real.log_le_rpow_div
    (show 0 <= 1 / alpha from (one_div_pos.mpr halpha0).le) hepsilon
  have hlog' :
      -Real.log alpha <=
        (1 / alpha) ^ (1 / (q : Real)) / (1 / (q : Real)) := by
    simpa only [one_div, Real.log_inv] using hlog
  calc
    -Real.log alpha <=
        (1 / alpha) ^ (1 / (q : Real)) / (1 / (q : Real)) := hlog'
    _ = (q : Real) * (1 / alpha) ^ (1 / (q : Real)) := by
      field_simp [hqReal.ne']

name: ProbabilityTheory.rioStrongMomentConfidenceRadius_le_polynomialRate
statement:
theorem rioStrongMomentConfidenceRadius_le_polynomialRate
    {q : Nat} (hq : 1 <= q) {V Q alpha : Real}
    (hQ : 0 < Q) (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) :
    rioStrongMomentConfidenceRadius q V Q alpha <=
      Real.sqrt (2 * V * (-Real.log alpha)) +
        rioPolynomialCoefficient q * rioConfidenceScale q Q alpha
proof:
:= by
  have hscalePos : 0 < strongMomentQScale q Q :=
    strongMomentQScale_pos hQ
  have hpowerPos : 0 < (1 / alpha) ^ (1 / (q : Real)) :=
    Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (one_div_pos.mpr halpha0) _
  have hlog := neg_log_le_natCast_mul_inv_rpow hq halpha0
  have hlogTerm :
      Real.exp 1 * strongMomentQScale q Q * (-Real.log alpha) / 3 <=
        (Real.exp 1 * (q : Real) / 3) *
          rioConfidenceScale q Q alpha := by
    unfold rioConfidenceScale
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog
      (mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos 1).le hscalePos.le)
    nlinarith
  unfold rioStrongMomentConfidenceRadius rioPolynomialCoefficient
  linarith

name: ProbabilityTheory.rioStrongMomentConfidenceRadius_empiricalMoment_le
statement:
theorem rioStrongMomentConfidenceRadius_empiricalMoment_le
    {q n : Nat} (hq : 1 <= q) (hn : 0 < n)
    {Ktwo Kq alpha : Real} (hKq : 0 < Kq) (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) :
    rioStrongMomentConfidenceRadius q
        (4 * Ktwo ^ 2 / (n : Real))
        ((2 : Real) ^ q * Kq ^ q / (n : Real) ^ (q - 1)) alpha <=
      Real.sqrt
          (2 * (4 * Ktwo ^ 2 / (n : Real)) * (-Real.log alpha)) +
        rioPolynomialCoefficient q * empiricalPolynomialScale q n Kq *
          (1 / alpha) ^ (1 / (q : Real))
proof:
:= by
  have hnReal : 0 < (n : Real) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hQ : 0 < (2 : Real) ^ q * Kq ^ q / (n : Real) ^ (q - 1) := by
    exact div_pos
      (mul_pos (pow_pos (by norm_num) q) (pow_pos hKq q))
      (pow_pos hnReal (q - 1))
  have hbound := rioStrongMomentConfidenceRadius_le_polynomialRate
    (V := 4 * Ktwo ^ 2 / (n : Real)) hq hQ halpha0
  rw [rioConfidenceScale_empiricalMoment hq hn hKq] at hbound
  simpa only [mul_assoc] using hbound

name: ProbabilityTheory.gaussianChernoffExponent_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem gaussianChernoffExponent_zero (V : ℝ) :
    gaussianChernoffExponent V 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [gaussianChernoffExponent]

name: ProbabilityTheory.gaussianChernoffExponent_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  unfold gaussianChernoffExponent
  positivity

name: ProbabilityTheory.convexOn_gaussianChernoffExponent
statement:
theorem convexOn_gaussianChernoffExponent {V : ℝ} (hV : 0 ≤ V) :
    ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Ici 0) (gaussianChernoffExponent V)
proof:
:= by
  have hcoef : 0 ≤ V / 2 := by positivity
  refine ⟨convex_Ici 0, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
  have hp := (convexOn_pow (𝕜 := ℝ) 2).2 hx hy ha hb hab
  simp only [smul_eq_mul] at hp ⊢
  unfold gaussianChernoffExponent
  calc
    V / 2 * (a * x + b * y) ^ 2 ≤
        V / 2 * (a * x ^ 2 + b * y ^ 2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp hcoef
    _ = a * (V / 2 * x ^ 2) + b * (V / 2 * y ^ 2) := by ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.chernoffTransform_gaussianChernoffExponent_le
statement:
theorem chernoffTransform_gaussianChernoffExponent_le
    {V x : ℝ} (hV : 0 < V) (hx : 0 < x) :
    chernoffTransform (gaussianChernoffExponent V) x ≤
      Real.sqrt (2 * V * x)
proof:
:= by
  let t : ℝ := Real.sqrt (2 * x / V)
  have harg : 0 < 2 * x / V := div_pos (by positivity) hV
  have ht : 0 < t := Real.sqrt_pos.2 harg
  have htSq : t ^ 2 = 2 * x / V := by
    dsimp only [t]
    exact Real.sq_sqrt harg.le
  have hnonneg : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s →
      0 ≤ gaussianChernoffExponent V s := by
    intro s _hs
    exact gaussianChernoffExponent_nonneg hV.le
  have hb := bddBelow_range_chernoffObjective hx.le hnonneg
  have heval := chernoffTransform_le_objective
    (psi := gaussianChernoffExponent V) (x := x) ht hb
  have hsqrtSq : (Real.sqrt (2 * V * x)) ^ 2 = 2 * V * x := by
    exact Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hobjective :
      (gaussianChernoffExponent V t + x) / t =
        Real.sqrt (2 * V * x) := by
    unfold gaussianChernoffExponent
    have hrootProduct : t * Real.sqrt (2 * V * x) = 2 * x := by
      have hsq : (t * Real.sqrt (2 * V * x)) ^ 2 = (2 * x) ^ 2 := by
        rw [mul_pow, htSq, hsqrtSq]
        field_simp [hV.ne']
      have hprodNonneg : 0 ≤ t * Real.sqrt (2 * V * x) := by positivity
      have htwoXNonneg : 0 ≤ 2 * x := by positivity
      nlinarith
    apply (div_eq_iff ht.ne').2
    rw [htSq]
    have hnum : V / 2 * (2 * x / V) + x = 2 * x := by
      field_simp [hV.ne']
      ring
    rw [hnum]
    simpa only [mul_comm] using hrootProduct.symm
  rw [hobjective] at heval
  exact heval

name: ProbabilityTheory.convexOn_exactStrongMomentTailExponent
statement:
theorem convexOn_exactStrongMomentTailExponent
    (q : ℕ) {Q y : ℝ} (hQ : 0 ≤ Q) (hy : 0 < y) :
    ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Ici 0) (exactStrongMomentTailExponent q Q y)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨convex_Ici 0, ?_⟩
  intro s hs t ht a b ha hb hab
  have htail := (convexOn_expSeriesTail q).2
    (mul_nonneg hs hy.le) (mul_nonneg ht hy.le) ha hb hab
  have hcoef : 0 ≤ Q / y ^ q :=
    div_nonneg hQ (pow_nonneg hy.le q)
  unfold exactStrongMomentTailExponent
  simp only [smul_eq_mul] at htail ⊢
  have harg : (a * s + b * t) * y = a * (s * y) + b * (t * y) := by ring
  rw [harg]
  calc
    (Q / y ^ q) * expSeriesTail q (a * (s * y) + b * (t * y)) ≤
        (Q / y ^ q) *
          (a * expSeriesTail q (s * y) +
            b * expSeriesTail q (t * y)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (by simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using htail) hcoef
    _ = a * ((Q / y ^ q) * expSeriesTail q (s * y)) +
        b * ((Q / y ^ q) * expSeriesTail q (t * y)) := by ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient_nonneg
statement:
theorem interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient_nonneg
    (q k : ℕ) {V Q : ℝ} (hV : 0 ≤ V) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q) :
    0 ≤ interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient q V Q k
proof:
:= by
  unfold interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient
  exact mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hV _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hQ _)

name: ProbabilityTheory.strongMomentIntermediateExponent_nonneg
statement:
theorem strongMomentIntermediateExponent_nonneg
    (q : ℕ) {V Q t : ℝ} (hV : 0 ≤ V) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q)
    (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    0 ≤ strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V Q t
proof:
:= by
  unfold strongMomentIntermediateExponent
  exact sum_nonneg fun k _hk => mul_nonneg
    (div_nonneg (pow_nonneg ht k) (by positivity))
    (interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient_nonneg q k hV hQ)

name: ProbabilityTheory.strongMomentIntermediateExponent_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem strongMomentIntermediateExponent_zero
    (q : ℕ) (V Q : ℝ) :
    strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V Q 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold strongMomentIntermediateExponent
  apply sum_eq_zero
  intro k hk
  have hk0 : k ≠ 0 := by
    have hk3 := (mem_Ico.mp hk).1
    omega
  simp [hk0]

name: ProbabilityTheory.convexOn_strongMomentIntermediateExponent
statement:
theorem convexOn_strongMomentIntermediateExponent
    (q : ℕ) {V Q : ℝ} (hV : 0 ≤ V) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q) :
    ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Ici 0) (strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V Q)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨convex_Ici 0, ?_⟩
  intro s hs t ht a b ha hb hab
  simp only [smul_eq_mul] at ⊢
  unfold strongMomentIntermediateExponent
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply sum_le_sum
  intro k hk
  have hp := (convexOn_pow (𝕜 := ℝ) k).2 hs ht ha hb hab
  simp only [smul_eq_mul] at hp
  have hfac : 0 ≤ ((k.factorial : ℕ) : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hc := interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient_nonneg q k hV hQ
  calc
    (a * s + b * t) ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ) *
        interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient q V Q k ≤
      (a * s ^ k + b * t ^ k) / (k.factorial : ℝ) *
        interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient q V Q k :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hp hfac) hc
    _ = a * (s ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ) *
          interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient q V Q k) +
        b * (t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ) *
          interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient q V Q k) := by ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.rioStrongMomentExponent_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem rioStrongMomentExponent_zero
    {q : ℕ} (hq : q ≠ 0) (V Q y : ℝ) :
    rioStrongMomentExponent q V Q y 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [rioStrongMomentExponent, hq]

name: ProbabilityTheory.rioStrongMomentExponent_nonneg
statement:
theorem rioStrongMomentExponent_nonneg
    (q : ℕ) {V Q y t : ℝ}
    (hV : 0 ≤ V) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q) (hy : 0 < y) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    0 ≤ rioStrongMomentExponent q V Q y t
proof:
:= by
  unfold rioStrongMomentExponent
  exact add_nonneg
    (add_nonneg (gaussianChernoffExponent_nonneg hV)
      (strongMomentIntermediateExponent_nonneg q hV hQ ht))
    (exactStrongMomentTailExponent_nonneg q hQ hy ht)

name: ProbabilityTheory.convexOn_rioStrongMomentExponent
statement:
theorem convexOn_rioStrongMomentExponent
    (q : ℕ) {V Q y : ℝ}
    (hV : 0 ≤ V) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q) (hy : 0 < y) :
    ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Ici 0) (rioStrongMomentExponent q V Q y)
proof:
:= by
  have hgauss := convexOn_gaussianChernoffExponent hV
  have hmid := convexOn_strongMomentIntermediateExponent q hV hQ
  have htail := convexOn_exactStrongMomentTailExponent q hQ hy
  refine ⟨convex_Ici 0, ?_⟩
  intro s hs t ht a b ha hb hab
  have hg := hgauss.2 hs ht ha hb hab
  have hm := hmid.2 hs ht ha hb hab
  have htl := htail.2 hs ht ha hb hab
  simp only [smul_eq_mul] at hg hm htl ⊢
  unfold rioStrongMomentExponent
  calc
    gaussianChernoffExponent V (a * s + b * t) +
          strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V Q (a * s + b * t) +
          exactStrongMomentTailExponent q Q y (a * s + b * t) ≤
        (a * gaussianChernoffExponent V s +
            b * gaussianChernoffExponent V t) +
          (a * strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V Q s +
            b * strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V Q t) +
          (a * exactStrongMomentTailExponent q Q y s +
            b * exactStrongMomentTailExponent q Q y t) :=
      add_le_add (add_le_add hg hm) htl
    _ = a * (gaussianChernoffExponent V s +
          strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V Q s +
          exactStrongMomentTailExponent q Q y s) +
        b * (gaussianChernoffExponent V t +
          strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V Q t +
          exactStrongMomentTailExponent q Q y t) := by ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.strongMomentSeriesExponent_le_rioStrongMomentExponent
statement:
theorem strongMomentSeriesExponent_le_rioStrongMomentExponent
    (q : ℕ) {t y second V Q : ℝ} {moment : ℕ → ℝ}
    (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hy : 0 < y)
    (hsecond : second ≤ V)
    (hmiddle : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Ico 3 q,
      moment k ≤ interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient q V Q k)
    (hmomentQ : moment q ≤ Q) :
    strongMomentSeriesExponent q t y second moment ≤
      rioStrongMomentExponent q V Q y t
proof:
:= by
  have hgauss :
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * t ^ 2 * second ≤ gaussianChernoffExponent V t := by
    unfold gaussianChernoffExponent
    have hcoef : 0 ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * t ^ 2 := by positivity
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsecond hcoef]
  have hmiddleSum :
      (∑ k ∈ Ico 3 q,
        t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ) * moment k) ≤
        strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V Q t := by
    unfold strongMomentIntermediateExponent
    exact sum_le_sum fun k hk =>
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hmiddle k hk)
        (div_nonneg (pow_nonneg ht k) (by positivity))
  have htailCoef : 0 ≤ expSeriesTail q (t * y) / y ^ q := by
    exact div_nonneg (expSeriesTail_nonneg (mul_nonneg ht hy.le) q)
      (pow_nonneg hy.le q)
  have htail :
      expSeriesTail q (t * y) / y ^ q * moment q ≤
        exactStrongMomentTailExponent q Q y t := by
    unfold exactStrongMomentTailExponent
    calc
      expSeriesTail q (t * y) / y ^ q * moment q ≤
          expSeriesTail q (t * y) / y ^ q * Q :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmomentQ htailCoef
      _ = Q / y ^ q * expSeriesTail q (t * y) := by ring
  unfold strongMomentSeriesExponent rioStrongMomentExponent
  exact add_le_add (add_le_add hgauss hmiddleSum) htail

name: ProbabilityTheory.chernoffTransform_intermediate_add_tail_le
statement:
theorem chernoffTransform_intermediate_add_tail_le
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 1 ≤ q) {V Q y x : ℝ}
    (hV : 0 ≤ V) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q) (hy : 0 < y) (hx : 0 < x)
    (hscale : Q * Real.exp x ≤ y ^ q) :
    chernoffTransform
        (fun t => strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V Q t +
          exactStrongMomentTailExponent q Q y t) x ≤
      y + y / (q : ℝ) +
        (y / x) * strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V Q (x / y)
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 : (q : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hq)
  have hyq : 0 < y ^ q := pow_pos hy q
  have hcoef : 0 ≤ Q / y ^ q := div_nonneg hQ hyq.le
  have hcoefExp : (Q / y ^ q) * Real.exp x ≤ 1 := by
    calc
      (Q / y ^ q) * Real.exp x = (Q * Real.exp x) / y ^ q := by ring
      _ ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hyq).2 hscale
  have htail := expSeriesTail_le_div_mul_exp q hq x hx.le
  have hscaledTail :
      (Q / y ^ q) * expSeriesTail q x ≤ x / (q : ℝ) := by
    calc
      (Q / y ^ q) * expSeriesTail q x ≤
          (Q / y ^ q) * ((x / (q : ℝ)) * Real.exp x) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htail hcoef
      _ = (x / (q : ℝ)) *
          ((Q / y ^ q) * Real.exp x) := by ring
      _ ≤ (x / (q : ℝ)) * 1 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcoefExp (div_nonneg hx.le (by positivity))
      _ = x / (q : ℝ) := by ring
  have hnonneg : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t →
      0 ≤ strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V Q t +
        exactStrongMomentTailExponent q Q y t := by
    intro t ht
    exact add_nonneg
      (strongMomentIntermediateExponent_nonneg q hV hQ ht.le)
      (exactStrongMomentTailExponent_nonneg q hQ hy ht.le)
  have hb := bddBelow_range_chernoffObjective hx.le hnonneg
  have heval := chernoffTransform_le_objective
    (psi := fun t => strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V Q t +
      exactStrongMomentTailExponent q Q y t)
    (x := x) (t := x / y) (div_pos hx hy) hb
  have harg : (x / y) * y = x := by field_simp
  unfold exactStrongMomentTailExponent at heval
  rw [harg] at heval
  calc
    chernoffTransform
        (fun t => strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V Q t +
          exactStrongMomentTailExponent q Q y t) x ≤
      (strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V Q (x / y) +
          (Q / y ^ q) * expSeriesTail q x + x) / (x / y) := heval
    _ ≤ (strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V Q (x / y) +
          x / (q : ℝ) + x) / (x / y) := by
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
        (add_le_add
          (add_le_add le_rfl hscaledTail) le_rfl)
        (div_pos hx hy).le
    _ = y + y / (q : ℝ) +
        (y / x) * strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V Q (x / y) := by
      field_simp [hx.ne', hy.ne', hq0]
      ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.chernoffTransform_rioStrongMomentExponent_le
statement:
theorem chernoffTransform_rioStrongMomentExponent_le
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) {V Q y x : ℝ}
    (hV : 0 < V) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q) (hy : 0 < y) (hx : 0 < x)
    (hscale : Q * Real.exp x ≤ y ^ q) :
    chernoffTransform (rioStrongMomentExponent q V Q y) x ≤
      Real.sqrt (2 * V * x) +
        y + y / (q : ℝ) +
          (y / x) * strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V Q (x / y)
proof:
:= by
  let middleTail : ℝ → ℝ := fun t =>
    strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V Q t +
      exactStrongMomentTailExponent q Q y t
  have hmidConv := convexOn_strongMomentIntermediateExponent q hV.le hQ
  have htailConv := convexOn_exactStrongMomentTailExponent q hQ hy
  have hmiddleTailConv : ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Ici 0) middleTail := by
    refine ⟨convex_Ici 0, ?_⟩
    intro s hs t ht a b ha hb hab
    have hm := hmidConv.2 hs ht ha hb hab
    have htl := htailConv.2 hs ht ha hb hab
    simp only [middleTail, smul_eq_mul] at hm htl ⊢
    calc
      strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V Q (a * s + b * t) +
          exactStrongMomentTailExponent q Q y (a * s + b * t) ≤
        (a * strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V Q s +
          b * strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V Q t) +
        (a * exactStrongMomentTailExponent q Q y s +
          b * exactStrongMomentTailExponent q Q y t) := add_le_add hm htl
      _ = a * (strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V Q s +
            exactStrongMomentTailExponent q Q y s) +
          b * (strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V Q t +
            exactStrongMomentTailExponent q Q y t) := by ring
  have hmiddleTailZero : middleTail 0 = 0 := by
    dsimp only [middleTail]
    rw [strongMomentIntermediateExponent_zero,
      exactStrongMomentTailExponent_zero (q := q) (by omega)]
    exact add_zero 0
  have hmiddleTailNonneg : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → 0 ≤ middleTail t := by
    intro t ht
    exact add_nonneg
      (strongMomentIntermediateExponent_nonneg q hV.le hQ ht.le)
      (exactStrongMomentTailExponent_nonneg q hQ hy ht.le)
  have hsplit := chernoffTransform_add_le hx.le
    (convexOn_gaussianChernoffExponent hV.le) hmiddleTailConv
    (gaussianChernoffExponent_zero V) hmiddleTailZero
    (fun t _ht => gaussianChernoffExponent_nonneg hV.le)
    hmiddleTailNonneg
  have hgauss := chernoffTransform_gaussianChernoffExponent_le hV hx
  have htail := chernoffTransform_intermediate_add_tail_le q (by omega)
    hV.le hQ hy hx hscale
  have htotal : chernoffTransform
      (fun t => gaussianChernoffExponent V t + middleTail t) x ≤
      Real.sqrt (2 * V * x) + y + y / (q : ℝ) +
        (y / x) * strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V Q (x / y) :=
    hsplit.trans <| by
    calc
      chernoffTransform (gaussianChernoffExponent V) x +
          chernoffTransform middleTail x ≤
        Real.sqrt (2 * V * x) +
          (y + y / (q : ℝ) +
            (y / x) * strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V Q (x / y)) :=
        add_le_add hgauss (by simpa only [middleTail] using htail)
      _ = Real.sqrt (2 * V * x) + y + y / (q : ℝ) +
          (y / x) * strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V Q (x / y) := by ring
  have hexponent : rioStrongMomentExponent q V Q y =
      fun t => gaussianChernoffExponent V t + middleTail t := by
    funext t
    unfold rioStrongMomentExponent
    dsimp only [middleTail]
    ring
  rw [hexponent]
  exact htotal

name: RandomSetTheory.IsIntegrableSelection.exists_lift_caratheodory_image
statement:
theorem IsIntegrableSelection.exists_lift_caratheodory_image
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S : Ω → Set X} {v : Ω → Y}
    {φ : Ω × X → Y}
    (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    (hφmeas : Measurable φ)
    (hφcont : ∀ ω, Continuous fun x => φ (ω, x))
    {g : Ω → ℝ} (hg : Integrable g μ)
    (hdom : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∀ x ∈ S ω, ‖x‖ ≤ g ω)
    (hv : IsIntegrableSelection μ
      (fun ω => (fun x => φ (ω, x)) '' S ω) v) :
    ∃ f : Ω → X,
      IsIntegrableSelection μ S f ∧
      Integrable (fun ω => φ (ω, f ω)) μ ∧
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, φ (ω, f ω) = v ω
proof:
:= by
  let v' : Ω → Y := hv.1.aestronglyMeasurable.mk v
  have hv'meas : Measurable v' :=
    hv.1.aestronglyMeasurable.measurable_mk
  have hvv' : v =ᵐ[μ] v' :=
    hv.1.aestronglyMeasurable.ae_eq_mk
  have hv'mem :
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, v' ω ∈ (fun x => φ (ω, x)) '' S ω := by
    filter_upwards [hv.2, hvv'] with ω hvω heq
    rw [← heq]
    exact hvω
  obtain ⟨f, hfmeas, hfmem, hφfv'⟩ :=
    exists_measurable_lifting_of_ae_mem_image
      hS hcompact hne hφmeas hφcont hv'meas hv'mem
  have hfint : Integrable f μ := by
    apply hg.mono' hfmeas.aestronglyMeasurable
    filter_upwards [hdom] with ω hdomω
    exact hdomω (f ω) (hfmem ω)
  have hφfv : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, φ (ω, f ω) = v ω := by
    filter_upwards [hφfv', hvv'] with ω hφfv'ω hvv'ω
    exact hφfv'ω.trans hvv'ω.symm
  have hφfint : Integrable (fun ω => φ (ω, f ω)) μ :=
    hv.1.congr (Filter.EventuallyEq.symm hφfv)
  exact ⟨f, ⟨hfint, Filter.Eventually.of_forall hfmem⟩,
    hφfint, hφfv⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_caratheodory_image
statement:
theorem aumannExpectation_caratheodory_image
    [NormedSpace ℝ Y]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S : Ω → Set X} {φ : Ω × X → Y}
    (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    (hφmeas : Measurable φ)
    (hφcont : ∀ ω, Continuous fun x => φ (ω, x))
    {g : Ω → ℝ} (hg : Integrable g μ)
    (hdom : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∀ x ∈ S ω, ‖x‖ ≤ g ω) :
    aumannExpectation μ
        (fun ω => (fun x => φ (ω, x)) '' S ω) =
      {y | ∃ f : Ω → X,
        IsIntegrableSelection μ S f ∧
        Integrable (fun ω => φ (ω, f ω)) μ ∧
        ∫ ω, φ (ω, f ω) ∂μ = y}
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · rintro y ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hφfint, hφfv⟩ :=
      hv.exists_lift_caratheodory_image
        hS hcompact hne hφmeas hφcont hg hdom
    exact ⟨f, hf, hφfint, integral_congr_ae hφfv⟩
  · rintro y ⟨f, hf, hφfint, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨fun ω => φ (ω, f ω), ⟨hφfint, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
    filter_upwards [hf.2] with ω hfω
    exact ⟨f ω, hfω, rfl⟩

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasPsiOneNormBound.identDistrib
proof:
:= by
  let transform : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => exp (|x| / (K : ℝ))
  have htransform : Measurable transform := by
    dsimp only [transform]
    fun_prop
  have hdist : IdentDistrib (transform ∘ X) (transform ∘ Y) μ ν :=
    hXY.comp htransform
  refine
    { aemeasurable := hXY.aemeasurable_snd
      scale_pos := hX.scale_pos
      integrable_exp_abs_div := ?_
      integral_exp_abs_div_le_two := ?_ }
  · change Integrable (transform ∘ Y) ν
    apply hdist.integrable_snd
    change Integrable (transform ∘ X) μ
    exact hX.integrable_exp_abs_div
  · calc
      (∫ ω, exp (|Y ω| / (K : ℝ)) ∂ν) =
          ∫ ω, exp (|X ω| / (K : ℝ)) ∂μ := by
            simpa only [transform, Function.comp_apply] using
              hdist.integral_eq.symm
      _ ≤ 2 := hX.integral_exp_abs_div_le_two

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasPsiOneNormBound.exp_scaled_sub_one_sub_id_le
statement:
private lemma exp_scaled_sub_one_sub_id_le
    {r z : ℝ} (hr0 : 0 ≤ r) (hr1 : r ≤ 1) (hz : 0 ≤ z) :
    exp (r * z) - 1 - r * z ≤ r ^ 2 * exp z
proof:
:= by
  have hsum_rz : Summable (fun n : ℕ => (r * z) ^ n / n.factorial) :=
    Real.summable_pow_div_factorial (r * z)
  have hsum_z : Summable (fun n : ℕ => z ^ n / n.factorial) :=
    Real.summable_pow_div_factorial z
  have htail_rz :
      Summable (fun n : ℕ => (r * z) ^ (n + 2) / (n + 2).factorial) :=
    (summable_nat_add_iff 2).2 hsum_rz
  have htail_z :
      Summable (fun n : ℕ => z ^ (n + 2) / (n + 2).factorial) :=
    (summable_nat_add_iff 2).2 hsum_z
  have hterm (n : ℕ) :
      (r * z) ^ (n + 2) / (n + 2).factorial ≤
        r ^ 2 * (z ^ (n + 2) / (n + 2).factorial) := by
    rw [mul_pow]
    have hrpow : r ^ (n + 2) ≤ r ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_of_le_one hr0 hr1 (by omega)
    have hquot : 0 ≤ z ^ (n + 2) / (n + 2).factorial := by positivity
    calc
      r ^ (n + 2) * z ^ (n + 2) / (n + 2).factorial =
          r ^ (n + 2) * (z ^ (n + 2) / (n + 2).factorial) := by ring
      _ ≤ r ^ 2 * (z ^ (n + 2) / (n + 2).factorial) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hrpow hquot
  have htail_le :
      (∑' n : ℕ, (r * z) ^ (n + 2) / (n + 2).factorial) ≤
        ∑' n : ℕ, r ^ 2 * (z ^ (n + 2) / (n + 2).factorial) := by
    exact Summable.tsum_le_tsum hterm htail_rz
      (htail_z.mul_left (r ^ 2))
  have hexp_rz :
      exp (r * z) - 1 - r * z =
        ∑' n : ℕ, (r * z) ^ (n + 2) / (n + 2).factorial := by
    rw [show exp (r * z) =
        ∑' n : ℕ, (r * z) ^ n / n.factorial by
      simp only [Real.exp_eq_exp_ℝ, NormedSpace.exp_eq_tsum_div]]
    have hsplit := hsum_rz.sum_add_tsum_nat_add 2
    simp only [sum_range_succ, sum_range_zero, zero_add, pow_zero,
      Nat.factorial_zero, Nat.cast_one, div_one, pow_one,
      Nat.factorial_one] at hsplit
    linarith
  rw [hexp_rz]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑' n : ℕ,
        r ^ 2 * (z ^ (n + 2) / (n + 2).factorial) := htail_le
    _ = r ^ 2 * (∑' n : ℕ,
        z ^ (n + 2) / (n + 2).factorial) := tsum_mul_left
    _ ≤ r ^ 2 * exp z := by
      gcongr
      have hsplit := hsum_z.sum_add_tsum_nat_add 2
      simp only [sum_range_succ, sum_range_zero, zero_add, pow_zero,
        Nat.factorial_zero, Nat.cast_one, div_one, pow_one,
        Nat.factorial_one] at hsplit
      rw [show exp z = ∑' n : ℕ, z ^ n / n.factorial by
        simp only [Real.exp_eq_exp_ℝ, NormedSpace.exp_eq_tsum_div]]
      linarith [hsplit]

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasPsiOneNormBound.abs_exp_sub_one_sub_id_le_exp_abs_sub_one_sub_abs
statement:
private lemma abs_exp_sub_one_sub_id_le_exp_abs_sub_one_sub_abs (y : ℝ) :
    |exp y - 1 - y| ≤ exp |y| - 1 - |y|
proof:
:= by
  have h := Complex.norm_exp_sub_sum_le_exp_norm_sub_sum (y : ℂ) 2
  norm_num [Finset.sum_range_succ] at h ⊢
  have hleft : |exp y - 1 - y| =
      ‖Complex.exp (y : ℂ) - (1 + (y : ℂ))‖ := by
    rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs, ← Complex.norm_real]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [hleft]
  linarith

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasPsiOneNormBound.exp_mul_le_one_add_add_sq_mul_exp_abs_div
statement:
private lemma exp_mul_le_one_add_add_sq_mul_exp_abs_div
    {K t x : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (ht : K * |t| ≤ 1) :
    exp (t * x) ≤
      1 + t * x + (K * |t|) ^ 2 * exp (|x| / K)
proof:
:= by
  let r := K * |t|
  let z := |x| / K
  have hr0 : 0 ≤ r := by
    dsimp [r]
    positivity
  have hz : 0 ≤ z := by
    dsimp [z]
    positivity
  have habs : |t * x| = r * z := by
    dsimp [r, z]
    rw [abs_mul]
    field_simp
  have hrem := abs_exp_sub_one_sub_id_le_exp_abs_sub_one_sub_abs (t * x)
  have hscaled := exp_scaled_sub_one_sub_id_le hr0 ht hz
  rw [habs] at hrem
  have hle : exp (t * x) - 1 - t * x ≤ r ^ 2 * exp z := by
    calc
      _ ≤ |exp (t * x) - 1 - t * x| := le_abs_self _
      _ ≤ exp (r * z) - 1 - r * z := hrem
      _ ≤ r ^ 2 * exp z := hscaled
  dsimp [r, z] at hle ⊢
  linarith

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasPsiOneNormBound.integrable_exp_mul
statement:
theorem integrable_exp_mul
    {X : Ω → ℝ} {K : ℝ≥0} (hX : HasPsiOneNormBound X K μ)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : (K : ℝ) * |t| < 1) :
    Integrable (fun ω => exp (t * X ω)) μ
proof:
:= by
  apply hX.integrable_exp_abs_div.mono'
  · exact (hX.aemeasurable.const_mul t).exp.aestronglyMeasurable
  · filter_upwards with ω
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (exp_pos _)]
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    calc
      t * X ω ≤ |t * X ω| := le_abs_self _
      _ = |t| * |X ω| := abs_mul _ _
      _ ≤ (1 / (K : ℝ)) * |X ω| := by
        gcongr
        rw [le_div_iff₀ hX.scale_pos]
        simpa [mul_comm] using ht.le
      _ = |X ω| / (K : ℝ) := by ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasPsiOneNormBound.integrable
statement:
theorem integrable
    {X : Ω → ℝ} {K : ℝ≥0} (hX : HasPsiOneNormBound X K μ) :
    Integrable X μ
proof:
:= by
  apply (hX.integrable_exp_abs_div.const_mul (K : ℝ)).mono'
  · exact hX.aemeasurable.aestronglyMeasurable
  · filter_upwards with ω
    simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have hz : 0 ≤ |X ω| / (K : ℝ) := by positivity
    have hzexp : |X ω| / (K : ℝ) ≤ exp (|X ω| / (K : ℝ)) := by
      have := Real.pow_div_factorial_le_exp (|X ω| / (K : ℝ)) hz 1
      simpa using this
    calc
      |X ω| = (K : ℝ) * (|X ω| / (K : ℝ)) := by
        field_simp [hX.scale_pos.ne']
      _ ≤ (K : ℝ) * exp (|X ω| / (K : ℝ)) := by
        gcongr

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasPsiOneNormBound.integral_abs_le_scale
statement:
theorem integral_abs_le_scale
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {X : Ω → ℝ} {K : ℝ≥0} (hX : HasPsiOneNormBound X K μ) :
    (∫ ω, |X ω| ∂μ) ≤ (K : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let G : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => exp (|X ω| / (K : ℝ))
  have hGint : Integrable G μ := by
    simpa only [G] using hX.integrable_exp_abs_div
  have habsInt : Integrable (fun ω => |X ω|) μ := hX.integrable.abs
  have hpoint : ∀ ω, |X ω| ≤ (K : ℝ) * (G ω - 1) := by
    intro ω
    have hz : 0 ≤ |X ω| / (K : ℝ) := by positivity
    have hexp := Real.add_one_le_exp (|X ω| / (K : ℝ))
    calc
      |X ω| = (K : ℝ) * (|X ω| / (K : ℝ)) := by
        field_simp [hX.scale_pos.ne']
      _ ≤ (K : ℝ) * (G ω - 1) := by
        dsimp only [G]
        gcongr
        linarith
  have hrightInt : Integrable (fun ω => (K : ℝ) * (G ω - 1)) μ :=
    (hGint.sub (integrable_const 1)).const_mul _
  have hmono : (∫ ω, |X ω| ∂μ) ≤
      ∫ ω, (K : ℝ) * (G ω - 1) ∂μ :=
    integral_mono habsInt hrightInt hpoint
  calc
    (∫ ω, |X ω| ∂μ) ≤
        ∫ ω, (K : ℝ) * (G ω - 1) ∂μ := hmono
    _ = (K : ℝ) * ((∫ ω, G ω ∂μ) - 1) := by
      rw [integral_const_mul, integral_sub hGint (integrable_const 1),
        integral_const]
      simp
    _ ≤ (K : ℝ) := by
      have hGle : (∫ ω, G ω ∂μ) ≤ 2 := by
        simpa only [G] using hX.integral_exp_abs_div_le_two
      nlinarith

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasPsiOneNormBound.integral_le_scale
statement:
theorem integral_le_scale
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {X : Ω → ℝ} {K : ℝ≥0} (hX : HasPsiOneNormBound X K μ) :
    (∫ ω, X ω ∂μ) ≤ (K : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∫ ω, X ω ∂μ) ≤ ∫ ω, |X ω| ∂μ :=
      integral_mono_ae hX.integrable hX.integrable.abs
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => le_abs_self (X ω))
    _ ≤ (K : ℝ) := hX.integral_abs_le_scale

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasPsiOneNormBound.mono_abs
statement:
theorem mono_abs
    {X Y : Ω → ℝ} {K c : ℝ≥0}
    (hX : HasPsiOneNormBound X K μ) (hc : 0 < (c : ℝ))
    (hY : AEMeasurable Y μ)
    (hdom : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, |Y ω| ≤ (c : ℝ) * |X ω|) :
    HasPsiOneNormBound Y (c * K) μ
proof:
:= by
  have hscale : 0 < ((c * K : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) := by
    simpa only [NNReal.coe_mul] using mul_pos hc hX.scale_pos
  have hpoint : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ,
      exp (|Y ω| / ((c * K : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) ≤
        exp (|X ω| / (K : ℝ)) := by
    filter_upwards [hdom] with ω hω
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    rw [NNReal.coe_mul]
    calc
      |Y ω| / ((c : ℝ) * (K : ℝ)) ≤
          ((c : ℝ) * |X ω|) / ((c : ℝ) * (K : ℝ)) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hω (mul_pos hc hX.scale_pos).le
      _ = |X ω| / (K : ℝ) := by
        field_simp [hc.ne', hX.scale_pos.ne']
  have hint : Integrable
      (fun ω => exp (|Y ω| / ((c * K : ℝ≥0) : ℝ))) μ := by
    apply hX.integrable_exp_abs_div.mono'
    · exact (hY.abs.div_const _).exp.aestronglyMeasurable
    · filter_upwards [hpoint] with ω hω
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)] using hω
  refine
    { aemeasurable := hY
      scale_pos := hscale
      integrable_exp_abs_div := hint
      integral_exp_abs_div_le_two := ?_ }
  exact (integral_mono_ae hint hX.integrable_exp_abs_div hpoint).trans
    hX.integral_exp_abs_div_le_two

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasPsiOneNormBound.center
statement:
theorem center
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {X : Ω → ℝ} {K : ℝ≥0} (hX : HasPsiOneNormBound X K μ) :
    HasPsiOneNormBound
      (fun ω => X ω - ∫ x, X x ∂μ) (3 * K) μ
proof:
:= by
  let EX : ℝ := ∫ x, X x ∂μ
  let G : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => exp (|X ω| / (K : ℝ))
  let Gthird : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => exp (|X ω| / (3 * (K : ℝ)))
  have hK0 : 0 ≤ (K : ℝ) := K.2
  have hGint : Integrable G μ := by
    simpa only [G] using hX.integrable_exp_abs_div
  have habsInt : Integrable (fun ω => |X ω|) μ := hX.integrable.abs
  have hmomentPoint : ∀ ω,
      |X ω| ≤ (K : ℝ) * (G ω - 1) := by
    intro ω
    have hz : 0 ≤ |X ω| / (K : ℝ) := by positivity
    have hexp := Real.add_one_le_exp (|X ω| / (K : ℝ))
    calc
      |X ω| = (K : ℝ) * (|X ω| / (K : ℝ)) := by
        field_simp [hX.scale_pos.ne']
      _ ≤ (K : ℝ) * (G ω - 1) := by
        dsimp only [G]
        gcongr
        linarith
  have hrightInt : Integrable (fun ω => (K : ℝ) * (G ω - 1)) μ :=
    (hGint.sub (integrable_const 1)).const_mul _
  have habsIntegral_le : (∫ ω, |X ω| ∂μ) ≤ (K : ℝ) := by
    have hmono : (∫ ω, |X ω| ∂μ) ≤
        ∫ ω, (K : ℝ) * (G ω - 1) ∂μ :=
      integral_mono habsInt hrightInt hmomentPoint
    calc
      (∫ ω, |X ω| ∂μ) ≤
          ∫ ω, (K : ℝ) * (G ω - 1) ∂μ := hmono
      _ = (K : ℝ) * ((∫ ω, G ω ∂μ) - 1) := by
        rw [integral_const_mul, integral_sub hGint (integrable_const 1),
          integral_const]
        simp
      _ ≤ (K : ℝ) := by
        have hGle : (∫ ω, G ω ∂μ) ≤ 2 := by
          simpa only [G] using hX.integral_exp_abs_div_le_two
        nlinarith
  have hEXabs : |EX| ≤ (K : ℝ) := by
    calc
      |EX| = |∫ x, X x ∂μ| := rfl
      _ ≤ ∫ x, |X x| ∂μ := abs_integral_le_integral_abs
      _ ≤ (K : ℝ) := habsIntegral_le
  have hthirdPoint (ω : Ω) :
      Gthird ω ≤ (2 / 3 : ℝ) + (1 / 3 : ℝ) * G ω := by
    have hconv := convexOn_exp.2
      (show (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.univ by simp)
      (show |X ω| / (K : ℝ) ∈ Set.univ by simp)
      (show 0 ≤ (2 / 3 : ℝ) by norm_num)
      (show 0 ≤ (1 / 3 : ℝ) by norm_num)
      (show (2 / 3 : ℝ) + 1 / 3 = 1 by norm_num)
    calc
      Gthird ω = exp ((2 / 3 : ℝ) * 0 +
          (1 / 3 : ℝ) * (|X ω| / (K : ℝ))) := by
        dsimp only [Gthird]
        congr 1
        field_simp [hX.scale_pos.ne']
        ring
      _ ≤ (2 / 3 : ℝ) * exp 0 +
          (1 / 3 : ℝ) * exp (|X ω| / (K : ℝ)) := by
        simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using hconv
      _ = (2 / 3 : ℝ) + (1 / 3 : ℝ) * G ω := by
        simp only [Real.exp_zero, mul_one, G]
  have hGthirdInt : Integrable Gthird μ := by
    apply ((integrable_const (2 / 3 : ℝ)).add
      (hGint.const_mul (1 / 3 : ℝ))).mono'
    · exact ((hX.aemeasurable.abs.div_const _).exp).aestronglyMeasurable
    · filter_upwards with ω
      change |Gthird ω| ≤ (2 / 3 : ℝ) + (1 / 3 : ℝ) * G ω
      rw [abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
      exact hthirdPoint ω
  have hGthirdIntegral_le : (∫ ω, Gthird ω ∂μ) ≤ 4 / 3 := by
    calc
      (∫ ω, Gthird ω ∂μ) ≤
          ∫ ω, ((2 / 3 : ℝ) + (1 / 3 : ℝ) * G ω) ∂μ :=
        integral_mono hGthirdInt
          ((integrable_const (2 / 3 : ℝ)).add
            (hGint.const_mul (1 / 3 : ℝ))) hthirdPoint
      _ = (2 / 3 : ℝ) + (1 / 3 : ℝ) * (∫ ω, G ω ∂μ) := by
        rw [integral_add (integrable_const (2 / 3 : ℝ))
          (hGint.const_mul (1 / 3 : ℝ)), integral_const,
          integral_const_mul]
        simp
      _ ≤ 4 / 3 := by
        have hGle : (∫ ω, G ω ∂μ) ≤ 2 := by
          simpa only [G] using hX.integral_exp_abs_div_le_two
        linarith
  have hExpEX : exp (|EX| / (3 * (K : ℝ))) ≤ 3 / 2 := by
    calc
      exp (|EX| / (3 * (K : ℝ))) ≤ exp (1 / 3 : ℝ) := by
        apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
        rw [div_le_iff₀ (mul_pos (by norm_num) hX.scale_pos)]
        nlinarith
      _ ≤ 1 / (1 - (1 / 3 : ℝ)) :=
        Real.exp_bound_div_one_sub_of_interval (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
      _ = 3 / 2 := by norm_num
  have hcenterPoint (ω : Ω) :
      exp (|X ω - EX| / (3 * (K : ℝ))) ≤
        exp (|EX| / (3 * (K : ℝ))) * Gthird ω := by
    calc
      exp (|X ω - EX| / (3 * (K : ℝ))) ≤
          exp ((|X ω| + |EX|) / (3 * (K : ℝ))) := by
        apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
        exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (abs_sub _ _)
          (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hX.scale_pos.le)
      _ = exp (|EX| / (3 * (K : ℝ))) * Gthird ω := by
        rw [add_div, Real.exp_add, mul_comm]
  have hcenterInt : Integrable
      (fun ω => exp (|X ω - EX| / (3 * (K : ℝ)))) μ := by
    apply (hGthirdInt.const_mul (exp (|EX| / (3 * (K : ℝ))))).mono'
    · exact (((hX.aemeasurable.sub aemeasurable_const).abs.div_const _).exp)
        |>.aestronglyMeasurable
    · filter_upwards with ω
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _),
        abs_of_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le, norm_eq_abs] using hcenterPoint ω
  refine
    { aemeasurable := hX.aemeasurable.sub aemeasurable_const
      scale_pos := by
        simpa only [NNReal.coe_mul] using mul_pos (by norm_num) hX.scale_pos
      integrable_exp_abs_div := by
        convert hcenterInt using 1 <;> norm_num [NNReal.coe_mul, EX]
      integral_exp_abs_div_le_two := ?_ }
  change (∫ ω, exp (|X ω - EX| / (3 * (K : ℝ))) ∂μ) ≤ 2
  calc
    (∫ ω, exp (|X ω - EX| / (3 * (K : ℝ))) ∂μ) ≤
        ∫ ω, exp (|EX| / (3 * (K : ℝ))) * Gthird ω ∂μ :=
      integral_mono hcenterInt
        (hGthirdInt.const_mul (exp (|EX| / (3 * (K : ℝ))))) hcenterPoint
    _ = exp (|EX| / (3 * (K : ℝ))) * (∫ ω, Gthird ω ∂μ) := by
      rw [integral_const_mul]
    _ ≤ (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (4 / 3 : ℝ) :=
      mul_le_mul hExpEX hGthirdIntegral_le (by positivity) (by positivity)
    _ = 2 := by norm_num

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasPsiOneNormBound.measureReal_gt_le_two_mul_exp
statement:
theorem measureReal_gt_le_two_mul_exp
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {X : Ω → ℝ} {K : ℝ≥0} (hX : HasPsiOneNormBound X K μ)
    (t : ℝ) :
    μ.real {ω | t < X ω} ≤ 2 * exp (-t / (K : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hq : 0 ≤ (1 / (K : ℝ)) := by positivity
  have hsubset : {ω | t < X ω} ⊆ {ω | t ≤ |X ω|} := by
    intro ω hω
    exact hω.le.trans (le_abs_self (X ω))
  calc
    μ.real {ω | t < X ω} ≤ μ.real {ω | t ≤ |X ω|} :=
      measureReal_mono hsubset (by finiteness)
    _ ≤ (∫ ω, exp ((1 / (K : ℝ)) * |X ω|) ∂μ) /
        exp ((1 / (K : ℝ)) * t) :=
      exponential_markov_real (fun ω ↦ |X ω|) (1 / (K : ℝ)) t hq
        (by simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using hX.integrable_exp_abs_div)
    _ ≤ 2 / exp ((1 / (K : ℝ)) * t) := by
      have hint : (∫ ω, exp ((1 / (K : ℝ)) * |X ω|) ∂μ) ≤ 2 := by
        simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using
          hX.integral_exp_abs_div_le_two
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hint
        (le_of_lt (exp_pos _))
    _ = 2 * exp (-t / (K : ℝ)) := by
      rw [div_eq_mul_inv, ← exp_neg]
      congr 1
      simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, one_mul]
      ring_nf

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasPsiOneNormBound.measureReal_exists_gt_le_card_mul_two_mul_exp
statement:
theorem measureReal_exists_gt_le_card_mul_two_mul_exp
    {I : Type*} [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (s : Finset I) (X : I → Ω → ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0)
    (hX : ∀ i ∈ s, HasPsiOneNormBound (X i) K μ) (t : ℝ) :
    μ.real {ω | ∃ i ∈ s, t < X i ω} ≤
      s.card * (2 * exp (-t / (K : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  have hset : {ω | ∃ i ∈ s, t < X i ω} =
      ⋃ i ∈ s, {ω | t < X i ω} := by
    ext ω
    simp
  rw [hset]
  exact measureReal_biUnion_finset_le_card_mul s _ fun i hi ↦
    (hX i hi).measureReal_gt_le_two_mul_exp t

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasPsiOneNormBound.one_sub_le_measureReal_forall_le_mul_log
statement:
theorem one_sub_le_measureReal_forall_le_mul_log
    {I : Type*} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (s : Finset I) (hs : s.Nonempty) (X : I → Ω → ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0)
    (hX : ∀ i ∈ s, HasPsiOneNormBound (X i) K μ)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    1 - δ ≤ μ.real {ω | ∀ i ∈ s,
      X i ω ≤ (K : ℝ) * log (2 * s.card / δ)}
proof:
:= by
  let t : ℝ := (K : ℝ) * log (2 * s.card / δ)
  let B : Set Ω := {ω | ∃ i ∈ s, t < X i ω}
  have hcard : 0 < (s.card : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast s.card_pos.mpr hs
  have hratio : 0 < 2 * (s.card : ℝ) / δ := by positivity
  have hbad : μ.real B ≤ δ := by
    have htail := measureReal_exists_gt_le_card_mul_two_mul_exp
      s X K hX t
    calc
      μ.real B ≤ s.card * (2 * exp (-t / (K : ℝ))) := by
        simpa [B] using htail
      _ = δ := by
        have hK : 0 < (K : ℝ) := (hX hs.choose hs.choose_spec).scale_pos
        rw [show -t / (K : ℝ) = -log (2 * s.card / δ) by
          dsimp [t]
          field_simp]
        rw [exp_neg, exp_log hratio]
        field_simp
  have hBnull : NullMeasurableSet B μ := by
    have hunion : B = ⋃ i ∈ s, {ω | t < X i ω} := by
      ext ω
      simp [B]
    rw [hunion]
    apply s.nullMeasurableSet_biUnion
    intro i hi
    exact (hX i hi).aemeasurable.nullMeasurableSet_preimage measurableSet_Ioi
  have hsum := measureReal_add_measureReal_compl₀ hBnull
  have hcompl : Bᶜ = {ω | ∀ i ∈ s, X i ω ≤ t} := by
    ext ω
    simp [B, not_lt]
  rw [probReal_univ, hcompl] at hsum
  dsimp [t] at hsum ⊢
  linarith

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasPsiOneNormBound.hasBernsteinMGF_of_integral_eq_zero
statement:
theorem hasBernsteinMGF_of_integral_eq_zero
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {X : Ω → ℝ} {K : ℝ≥0} (hX : HasPsiOneNormBound X K μ)
    (hcenter : μ[X] = 0) :
    HasBernsteinMGF X (4 * K ^ 2) K μ where
  aemeasurable
proof:
:= hX.aemeasurable
  integrable_exp_mul t ht := hX.integrable_exp_mul ht
  mgf_le t ht := by
    let r : ℝ := (K : ℝ) * |t|
    let G : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => exp (|X ω| / (K : ℝ))
    have hr0 : 0 ≤ r := by
      dsimp [r]
      positivity
    have hr1 : r ≤ 1 := ht.le
    have hexp_int : Integrable (fun ω => exp (t * X ω)) μ :=
      hX.integrable_exp_mul ht
    have hG_int : Integrable G μ := by
      simpa [G] using hX.integrable_exp_abs_div
    have hright_int : Integrable
        (fun ω => 1 + t * X ω + r ^ 2 * G ω) μ :=
      (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).add
        (hX.integrable.const_mul t) |>.add
          (hG_int.const_mul (r ^ 2))
    have hint_le :
        (∫ ω, exp (t * X ω) ∂μ) ≤
          ∫ ω, (1 + t * X ω + r ^ 2 * G ω) ∂μ := by
      apply integral_mono_ae hexp_int hright_int
      filter_upwards with ω
      exact exp_mul_le_one_add_add_sq_mul_exp_abs_div
        hX.scale_pos hr1
    have hG_le : (∫ ω, G ω ∂μ) ≤ 2 := by
      simpa [G] using hX.integral_exp_abs_div_le_two
    have hmgf_quad : mgf X μ t ≤ 1 + 2 * r ^ 2 := by
      calc
        mgf X μ t = ∫ ω, exp (t * X ω) ∂μ := rfl
        _ ≤ ∫ ω, (1 + t * X ω + r ^ 2 * G ω) ∂μ := hint_le
        _ = 1 + r ^ 2 * (∫ ω, G ω ∂μ) := by
          calc
            (∫ ω, (1 + t * X ω + r ^ 2 * G ω) ∂μ) =
                (∫ ω, (1 + t * X ω) ∂μ) +
                  ∫ ω, r ^ 2 * G ω ∂μ :=
              integral_add
                ((integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).add (hX.integrable.const_mul t))
                (hG_int.const_mul (r ^ 2))
            _ = ((∫ _ω : Ω, (1 : ℝ) ∂μ) +
                  ∫ ω, t * X ω ∂μ) +
                    ∫ ω, r ^ 2 * G ω ∂μ := by
              rw [integral_add (integrable_const (1 : ℝ))
                (hX.integrable.const_mul t)]
            _ = 1 + r ^ 2 * (∫ ω, G ω ∂μ) := by
              rw [integral_const, integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul, hcenter]
              simp
        _ ≤ 1 + 2 * r ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg r]
    calc
      mgf X μ t ≤ 1 + 2 * r ^ 2 := hmgf_quad
      _ ≤ exp (2 * r ^ 2) := by
        simpa [add_comm] using Real.add_one_le_exp (2 * r ^ 2)
      _ ≤ exp (((4 * K ^ 2 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) * t ^ 2 /
          (2 * (1 - (K : ℝ) * |t|))) := by
        apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
        have hden : 0 < 1 - r := sub_pos.mpr ht
        have hfrac : 2 * r ^ 2 ≤ 2 * r ^ 2 / (1 - r) := by
          rw [le_div_iff₀ hden]
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg r]
        calc
          2 * r ^ 2 ≤ 2 * r ^ 2 / (1 - r) := hfrac
          _ = ((4 * K ^ 2 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) * t ^ 2 /
              (2 * (1 - (K : ℝ) * |t|)) := by
            dsimp [r] at hden ⊢
            rw [mul_pow, sq_abs]
            field_simp [hden.ne'] <;> ring_nf

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasPsiOneNormBound.measureReal_average_gt_three_mul_scale_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_average_gt_three_mul_scale_le
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0)
    (hX : ∀ i ∈ s, HasPsiOneNormBound (X i) K μ)
    (hindep : iIndepFun X μ)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hsize : 21 * log (2 / δ) ≤ (s.card : ℝ)) :
    μ.real {ω | 3 * (K : ℝ) <
      (∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) / (s.card : ℝ)} ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  let Xc : ι → Ω → ℝ := fun i ω => X i ω - ∫ ω, X i ω ∂μ
  let B : ℝ≥0 := 3 * K
  let V : ℝ≥0 := 4 * B ^ 2
  let N : ℝ := s.card
  let t : ℝ := 2 * (K : ℝ)
  have hN : 0 < N := by
    dsimp only [N]
    exact_mod_cast s.card_pos.mpr hs
  have hK : 0 < (K : ℝ) := (hX hs.choose hs.choose_spec).scale_pos
  have hB : 0 < (B : ℝ) := by
    dsimp only [B]
    push_cast
    positivity
  have hV : 0 < (V : ℝ) := by
    dsimp only [V]
    push_cast
    positivity
  have hcenter : ∀ i ∈ s, μ[Xc i] = 0 := by
    intro i hi
    dsimp only [Xc]
    rw [integral_sub (hX i hi).integrable (integrable_const _),
      integral_const]
    simp
  have hpsiCenter : ∀ i ∈ s, HasPsiOneNormBound (Xc i) B μ := by
    intro i hi
    simpa only [Xc, B] using (hX i hi).center
  have hBernstein : ∀ i ∈ s, HasBernsteinMGF (Xc i) V B μ := by
    intro i hi
    simpa only [V] using
      (hpsiCenter i hi).hasBernsteinMGF_of_integral_eq_zero (hcenter i hi)
  have hindepCenter : iIndepFun Xc μ := by
    have hcomp := hindep.comp
      (fun i (x : ℝ) => x - ∫ ω, X i ω ∂μ)
      (fun _i => measurable_id.sub measurable_const)
    simpa only [Xc, Function.comp_def] using hcomp
  have hsumV :
      (((∑ _i ∈ s, V : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) = N * (V : ℝ) := by
    simp only [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, N]
    push_cast
    rfl
  have hsumVpos : 0 <
      (((∑ _i ∈ s, V : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) := by
    rw [hsumV]
    exact mul_pos hN hV
  have htail := bernstein_finset_average_abs_real
    Xc (fun _i => V) B hindepCenter s hs hBernstein
    (show 0 ≤ t by dsimp only [t]; positivity) hsumVpos
  have hexponent :
      -((N * t) ^ 2) /
          (2 * ((((∑ _i ∈ s, V : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) +
            (B : ℝ) * (N * t))) = -N / 21 := by
    rw [hsumV]
    dsimp only [N, t, V, B]
    push_cast
    field_simp [hK.ne', (show (s.card : ℝ) ≠ 0 by positivity)]
    <;> ring
  have htail' :
      μ.real {ω | t ≤ |(∑ i ∈ s, Xc i ω) /
        (s.card : ℝ)|} ≤
        2 * exp (-N / 21) := by
    simpa only [N, hexponent] using htail
  have hmean :
      (∑ i ∈ s, ∫ ω, X i ω ∂μ) / N ≤ (K : ℝ) := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hN]
    calc
      (∑ i ∈ s, ∫ ω, X i ω ∂μ) ≤
          ∑ _i ∈ s, (K : ℝ) := by
        exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => (hX i hi).integral_le_scale
      _ = (K : ℝ) * N := by
        simp [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, N, mul_comm]
  have hsubset :
      {ω | 3 * (K : ℝ) <
        (∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) / (s.card : ℝ)} ⊆
      {ω | t ≤ |(∑ i ∈ s, Xc i ω) /
        (s.card : ℝ)|} := by
    intro ω hω
    change 3 * (K : ℝ) <
      (∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) / (s.card : ℝ) at hω
    have hcenterAvg :
        (∑ i ∈ s, Xc i ω) / (s.card : ℝ) =
          (∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) / (s.card : ℝ) -
            (∑ i ∈ s, ∫ ω, X i ω ∂μ) / (s.card : ℝ) := by
      dsimp only [Xc]
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      ring
    have hdev : t <
        (∑ i ∈ s, Xc i ω) / (s.card : ℝ) := by
      dsimp only [t]
      dsimp only [N] at hmean
      rw [hcenterAvg]
      linarith
    exact hdev.le.trans (le_abs_self _)
  have hbad :
      μ.real {ω | 3 * (K : ℝ) <
        (∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) / (s.card : ℝ)} ≤
        2 * exp (-N / 21) :=
    (measureReal_mono hsubset (by finiteness)).trans htail'
  have hlog : log (2 / δ) ≤ N / 21 := by
    dsimp only [N]
    linarith
  have hexp : 2 * exp (-N / 21) ≤ δ := by
    calc
      2 * exp (-N / 21) ≤ 2 * exp (-log (2 / δ)) := by
        gcongr
        linarith
      _ = δ := by
        rw [exp_neg, exp_log (by positivity : 0 < 2 / δ)]
        field_simp
  exact hbad.trans hexp

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_convexified_iid_risk_bound_dimensional_psiOne
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_convexified_iid_risk_bound_dimensional_psiOne
    {Ω Z E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Z]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [Nonempty E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : ℕ → Ω → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hindep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X μ)
    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) μ μ)
    (F : Z → Set E) (hF : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable F)
    (hFcompact : ∀ z, IsCompact (F z)) (hFne : ∀ z, (F z).Nonempty)
    {R : ℝ} (hFbound : ∀ z, ∀ y ∈ F z, ‖y‖ ≤ R)
    (K : ℝ≥0)
    (hpsi₀ : ∀ w : E, ‖w‖ ≤ 1 →
      ProbabilityTheory.HasPsiOneNormBound
        (directionalSupportDeviation
          (fun i ω => closedConvexHull ℝ (F (X i ω)))
          (iidAumannTarget μ (X 0) F) w 0) K μ)
    (hcenter₀ : ∀ w : E, ‖w‖ ≤ 1 →
      μ[directionalSupportDeviation
          (fun i ω => closedConvexHull ℝ (F (X i ω)))
          (iidAumannTarget μ (X 0) F) w 0] = 0)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {eps x : ℝ}
    (heps : 0 < eps) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    μ.real {ω |
        (Real.sqrt (2 *
              (((∑ _i ∈ Finset.range n, (4 * K ^ 2 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) * x) +
            2 * (K : ℝ) * x) / (n : ℝ) + (R + R) * eps <
          hausdorffDist
            (closedConvexHull ℝ
              (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n) (fun i => F (X i ω))))
            (iidAumannTarget μ (X 0) F)} ≤
      (1 + 2 / eps) ^ finrank ℝ E * (2 * exp (-x))
proof:
:= by
  have hK : 0 < (K : ℝ) := (hpsi₀ 0 (by simp)).scale_pos
  have hv : 0 < (((4 * K ^ 2 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) := by
    push_cast
    positivity
  have hB₀ : ∀ w : E, ‖w‖ ≤ 1 →
      ProbabilityTheory.HasBernsteinMGF
        (directionalSupportDeviation
          (fun i ω => closedConvexHull ℝ (F (X i ω)))
          (iidAumannTarget μ (X 0) F) w 0) (4 * K ^ 2) K μ := by
    intro w hw
    exact (hpsi₀ w hw).hasBernsteinMGF_of_integral_eq_zero
      (hcenter₀ w hw)
  exact
    hausdorffDist_convexified_iid_risk_bound_dimensional_bernstein
      X hX hindep hident F hF hFcompact hFne hFbound
      (4 * K ^ 2) K hv hB₀ hn heps hx

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_convexified_iid_risk_bound_dimensional_psiOne_auto
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_convexified_iid_risk_bound_dimensional_psiOne_auto
    {Ω Z E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Z]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [Nonempty E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : ℕ → Ω → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hindep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X μ)
    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) μ μ)
    (F : Z → Set E) (hF : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable F)
    (hFcompact : ∀ z, IsCompact (F z)) (hFne : ∀ z, (F z).Nonempty)
    {R : ℝ} (hFbound : ∀ z, ∀ y ∈ F z, ‖y‖ ≤ R)
    (K : ℝ≥0)
    (hpsi₀ : ∀ w : E, ‖w‖ ≤ 1 →
      ProbabilityTheory.HasPsiOneNormBound
        (directionalSupportDeviation
          (fun i ω => closedConvexHull ℝ (F (X i ω)))
          (iidAumannTarget μ (X 0) F) w 0) K μ)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {eps x : ℝ}
    (heps : 0 < eps) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    μ.real {ω |
        (Real.sqrt (2 *
              (((∑ _i ∈ Finset.range n, (4 * K ^ 2 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) * x) +
            2 * (K : ℝ) * x) / (n : ℝ) + (R + R) * eps <
          hausdorffDist
            (closedConvexHull ℝ
              (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n) (fun i => F (X i ω))))
            (iidAumannTarget μ (X 0) F)} ≤
      (1 + 2 / eps) ^ finrank ℝ E * (2 * exp (-x))
proof:
:= by
  let S₀ : Ω → Set E := fun ω => F (X 0 ω)
  let A : Set E := closure (aumannExpectation μ S₀)
  let L : Set E := closedConvexHull ℝ A
  have hS₀Effros : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S₀ :=
    hF.comp_measurable (hX 0)
  have hS₀compact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S₀ ω) := fun ω =>
    hFcompact (X 0 ω)
  have hS₀ne : ∀ ω, (S₀ ω).Nonempty := fun ω =>
    hFne (X 0 ω)
  have hg : Integrable (fun _ : Ω => R) μ := integrable_const R
  have hS₀dom : ∀ ω, ∀ y ∈ S₀ ω, ‖y‖ ≤ R := fun ω =>
    hFbound (X 0 ω)
  have hAcompact : IsCompact A :=
    closure_aumannExpectation_compact_of_integrable_envelope hg
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hS₀dom)
  have hfOne : IsIntegrableSelection μ S₀
      (supportApproximateSelection
        hS₀Effros hS₀compact hS₀ne 0 1 (by norm_num)) :=
    integrableSelection_supportApproximateSelection_of_envelope
      hS₀Effros hS₀compact hS₀ne hg hS₀dom 0 (by norm_num)
  have hAne : A.Nonempty :=
    (aumannExpectation_nonempty_of_selection hfOne).closure
  have hbaseInt : ∀ w : E,
      Integrable (fun ω => supportFunction (F (X 0 ω)) w) μ := fun w =>
    integrable_supportFunction_of_envelope
      hS₀Effros hS₀compact hS₀ne hg hS₀dom w
  have hLsupport : ∀ w : E,
      supportFunction L w =
        ∫ ω, supportFunction (F (X 0 ω)) w ∂μ := by
    intro w
    rw [supportFunction_closedConvexHull hAcompact hAne]
    exact supportFunction_closure_aumannExpectation_of_envelope
      hS₀Effros hS₀compact hS₀ne hg hS₀dom hAcompact w
  have hcenter₀ : ∀ w : E, ‖w‖ ≤ 1 →
      μ[directionalSupportDeviation
          (fun i ω => closedConvexHull ℝ (F (X i ω)))
          (iidAumannTarget μ (X 0) F) w 0] = 0 := by
    intro w _hw
    have hzero := integral_convexifiedDirectionalSupportDeviation_eq_zero
      X hident F hF hFcompact hFne L w (hbaseInt w) (hLsupport w) 0
    simpa [L, A, S₀, iidAumannTarget] using hzero
  exact hausdorffDist_convexified_iid_risk_bound_dimensional_psiOne
    X hX hindep hident F hF hFcompact hFne hFbound K hpsi₀ hcenter₀
      hn heps hx
