name: RandomSetTheory.tendstoInDistribution_bundleNonemptyCompacts_of_tendsto_map
statement:
theorem tendstoInDistribution_bundleNonemptyCompacts_of_tendsto_map
    {νs : ι → ProbabilityMeasure Ω} {ν : ProbabilityMeasure Ω'}
    {S : ι → Ω → Set X} {T : Ω' → Set X}
    (hS : ∀ i, RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable (S i))
    (hT : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable T)
    (hScompact : ∀ i ω, IsCompact (S i ω))
    (hTcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (T ω))
    (hSne : ∀ i ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    (hTne : ∀ ω, (T ω).Nonempty)
    (hLaw : Tendsto
      (fun i => (νs i).map
        (measurable_bundleNonemptyCompacts
          (hS i) (hScompact i) (hSne i)).aemeasurable) L
      (𝓝 (ν.map
        (measurable_bundleNonemptyCompacts
          hT hTcompact hTne).aemeasurable))) :
    TendstoInDistribution
      (fun i => bundleNonemptyCompacts (S i) (hScompact i) (hSne i)) L
      (bundleNonemptyCompacts T hTcompact hTne)
      (fun i => (νs i : Measure Ω)) (ν : Measure Ω')
proof:
:= by
  refine
    { forall_aemeasurable := fun i =>
        (measurable_bundleNonemptyCompacts
          (hS i) (hScompact i) (hSne i)).aemeasurable
      aemeasurable_limit :=
        (measurable_bundleNonemptyCompacts
          hT hTcompact hTne).aemeasurable
      tendsto := ?_ }
  simpa only [ProbabilityMeasure.map] using hLaw

name: RandomSetTheory.capacity_portmanteau_effros_of_tendsto_map
statement:
theorem capacity_portmanteau_effros_of_tendsto_map
    {νs : ι → ProbabilityMeasure Ω} {ν : ProbabilityMeasure Ω'}
    {S : ι → Ω → Set X} {T : Ω' → Set X}
    (hS : ∀ i, RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable (S i))
    (hT : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable T)
    (hScompact : ∀ i ω, IsCompact (S i ω))
    (hTcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (T ω))
    (hSne : ∀ i ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    (hTne : ∀ ω, (T ω).Nonempty)
    (hLaw : Tendsto
      (fun i => (νs i).map
        (measurable_bundleNonemptyCompacts
          (hS i) (hScompact i) (hSne i)).aemeasurable) L
      (𝓝 (ν.map
        (measurable_bundleNonemptyCompacts
          hT hTcompact hTne).aemeasurable))) :
    (∀ U : Set X, IsOpen U →
      capacityFunctional (ν : Measure Ω') T U ≤
        L.liminf (fun i =>
          capacityFunctional (νs i : Measure Ω) (S i) U)) ∧
    (∀ F : Set X, IsClosed F →
      L.limsup (fun i =>
          capacityFunctional (νs i : Measure Ω) (S i) F) ≤
        capacityFunctional (ν : Measure Ω') T F)
proof:
:= by
  have hDist :=
    tendstoInDistribution_bundleNonemptyCompacts_of_tendsto_map
      hS hT hScompact hTcompact hSne hTne hLaw
  constructor
  · intro U hU
    simpa only [coe_bundleNonemptyCompacts] using
      (le_liminf_capacityFunctional_open_of_tendstoInDistribution
        hDist hU)
  · intro F hF
    simpa only [coe_bundleNonemptyCompacts] using
      (limsup_capacityFunctional_closed_le_of_tendstoInDistribution
        hDist hF)

name: ProbabilityTheory.abs_conditionalValueAtRisk_sub_le_integral_abs_sub
statement:
theorem abs_conditionalValueAtRisk_sub_le_integral_abs_sub
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {X Y : Omega → ℝ} (hX : Integrable X mu) (hY : Integrable Y mu)
    {alpha : ℝ} (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha ≤ 1) :
    |conditionalValueAtRisk alpha X mu -
        conditionalValueAtRisk alpha Y mu| ≤
      alpha⁻¹ * ∫ omega, |X omega - Y omega| ∂mu
proof:
:= by
  let A : Omega → ℝ := fun omega ↦ |X omega - Y omega|
  have hA : Integrable A mu := (hX.sub hY).abs
  have hAnonneg : 0 ≤ᵐ[mu] A :=
    ae_of_all mu fun omega ↦ abs_nonneg (X omega - Y omega)
  have hAcvar : conditionalValueAtRisk alpha A mu ≤
      alpha⁻¹ * ∫ omega, A omega ∂mu :=
    conditionalValueAtRisk_le_inv_mul_integral_of_nonneg
      hA hAnonneg halpha0 halpha1
  have hXY : X ≤ᵐ[mu] fun omega ↦ Y omega + A omega := by
    filter_upwards [] with omega
    dsimp only [A]
    exact le_add_of_sub_left_le (le_abs_self (X omega - Y omega))
  have hYX : Y ≤ᵐ[mu] fun omega ↦ X omega + A omega := by
    filter_upwards [] with omega
    dsimp only [A]
    have h := neg_le_abs (X omega - Y omega)
    linarith
  have hYA : Integrable (fun omega ↦ Y omega + A omega) mu := hY.add hA
  have hXA : Integrable (fun omega ↦ X omega + A omega) mu := hX.add hA
  have hforward : conditionalValueAtRisk alpha X mu ≤
      conditionalValueAtRisk alpha Y mu +
        alpha⁻¹ * ∫ omega, A omega ∂mu := by
    calc
      conditionalValueAtRisk alpha X mu ≤
          conditionalValueAtRisk alpha (fun omega ↦ Y omega + A omega) mu :=
        conditionalValueAtRisk_mono_ae hX hYA halpha0 halpha1 hXY
      _ ≤ conditionalValueAtRisk alpha Y mu +
          conditionalValueAtRisk alpha A mu :=
        conditionalValueAtRisk_add_le hY hA halpha0 halpha1
      _ ≤ conditionalValueAtRisk alpha Y mu +
          alpha⁻¹ * ∫ omega, A omega ∂mu := add_le_add le_rfl hAcvar
  have hbackward : conditionalValueAtRisk alpha Y mu ≤
      conditionalValueAtRisk alpha X mu +
        alpha⁻¹ * ∫ omega, A omega ∂mu := by
    calc
      conditionalValueAtRisk alpha Y mu ≤
          conditionalValueAtRisk alpha (fun omega ↦ X omega + A omega) mu :=
        conditionalValueAtRisk_mono_ae hY hXA halpha0 halpha1 hYX
      _ ≤ conditionalValueAtRisk alpha X mu +
          conditionalValueAtRisk alpha A mu :=
        conditionalValueAtRisk_add_le hX hA halpha0 halpha1
      _ ≤ conditionalValueAtRisk alpha X mu +
          alpha⁻¹ * ∫ omega, A omega ∂mu := add_le_add le_rfl hAcvar
  rw [show (∫ omega, |X omega - Y omega| ∂mu) =
      ∫ omega, A omega ∂mu by rfl]
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor <;> linarith

name: ProbabilityTheory.tendsto_conditionalValueAtRisk_of_tendsto_integral_abs_sub
statement:
theorem tendsto_conditionalValueAtRisk_of_tendsto_integral_abs_sub
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ} {Y : Omega → ℝ}
    (hX : ∀ n, Integrable (X n) mu) (hY : Integrable Y mu)
    {alpha : ℝ} (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha ≤ 1)
    (hL1 : Tendsto (fun n ↦ ∫ omega, |X n omega - Y omega| ∂mu)
      atTop (nhds 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun n ↦ conditionalValueAtRisk alpha (X n) mu)
      atTop (nhds (conditionalValueAtRisk alpha Y mu))
proof:
:= by
  rw [tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero]
  apply squeeze_zero'
  · exact Eventually.of_forall fun n ↦ norm_nonneg _
  · exact Eventually.of_forall fun n ↦ by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
        abs_conditionalValueAtRisk_sub_le_integral_abs_sub
          (hX n) hY halpha0 halpha1
  · simpa using (tendsto_const_nhds.mul hL1 :
      Tendsto
        (fun n ↦ alpha⁻¹ * ∫ omega, |X n omega - Y omega| ∂mu)
        atTop (nhds (alpha⁻¹ * 0)))

name: ProbabilityTheory.tendsto_integral_abs_centered_sub_centered
statement:
theorem tendsto_integral_abs_centered_sub_centered
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ} {Y : Omega → ℝ}
    (hX : ∀ n, Integrable (X n) mu) (hY : Integrable Y mu)
    (hL1 : Tendsto (fun n ↦ ∫ omega, |X n omega - Y omega| ∂mu)
      atTop (nhds 0)) :
    Tendsto
      (fun n ↦ ∫ omega,
        |(X n omega - ∫ z, X n z ∂mu) -
          (Y omega - ∫ z, Y z ∂mu)| ∂mu)
      atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  let d : ℕ → ℝ := fun n ↦ ∫ omega, |X n omega - Y omega| ∂mu
  have hbound : ∀ n,
      (∫ omega,
          |(X n omega - ∫ z, X n z ∂mu) -
            (Y omega - ∫ z, Y z ∂mu)| ∂mu) ≤ 2 * d n := by
    intro n
    have hdiff : Integrable (fun omega ↦ |X n omega - Y omega|) mu :=
      ((hX n).sub hY).abs
    have hleft : Integrable (fun omega ↦
        |(X n omega - ∫ z, X n z ∂mu) -
          (Y omega - ∫ z, Y z ∂mu)|) mu :=
      (((hX n).sub (integrable_const _)).sub
        (hY.sub (integrable_const _))).abs
    have hright : Integrable (fun omega ↦
        |X n omega - Y omega| +
          |(∫ z, X n z ∂mu) - ∫ z, Y z ∂mu|) mu :=
      hdiff.add (integrable_const _)
    have hpoint : ∀ omega,
        |(X n omega - ∫ z, X n z ∂mu) -
            (Y omega - ∫ z, Y z ∂mu)| ≤
          |X n omega - Y omega| +
            |(∫ z, X n z ∂mu) - ∫ z, Y z ∂mu| := by
      intro omega
      rw [show
        (X n omega - ∫ z, X n z ∂mu) -
            (Y omega - ∫ z, Y z ∂mu) =
          (X n omega - Y omega) -
            ((∫ z, X n z ∂mu) - ∫ z, Y z ∂mu) by ring]
      exact abs_sub _ _
    have hint := integral_mono hleft hright hpoint
    rw [integral_add hdiff (integrable_const _), integral_const,
      probReal_univ, one_smul] at hint
    have hmean :
        |(∫ z, X n z ∂mu) - ∫ z, Y z ∂mu| ≤ d n := by
      rw [← integral_sub (hX n) hY]
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, d] using
        (norm_integral_le_integral_norm
          (μ := mu) (f := fun z ↦ X n z - Y z))
    exact hint.trans (by linarith)
  apply squeeze_zero'
  · exact Eventually.of_forall fun n ↦ integral_nonneg fun _ ↦ abs_nonneg _
  · exact Eventually.of_forall hbound
  · simpa only [d, mul_zero] using
      (tendsto_const_nhds.mul hL1 :
        Tendsto (fun n ↦ 2 * d n) atTop (nhds (2 * 0)))

name: ProbabilityTheory.tendsto_conditionalValueAtRisk_centered_of_tendsto_integral_abs_sub
statement:
theorem tendsto_conditionalValueAtRisk_centered_of_tendsto_integral_abs_sub
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ} {Y : Omega → ℝ}
    (hX : ∀ n, Integrable (X n) mu) (hY : Integrable Y mu)
    {alpha : ℝ} (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha ≤ 1)
    (hL1 : Tendsto (fun n ↦ ∫ omega, |X n omega - Y omega| ∂mu)
      atTop (nhds 0)) :
    Tendsto
      (fun n ↦ conditionalValueAtRisk alpha
        (fun omega ↦ X n omega - ∫ z, X n z ∂mu) mu)
      atTop
      (nhds (conditionalValueAtRisk alpha
        (fun omega ↦ Y omega - ∫ z, Y z ∂mu) mu))
proof:
:= by
  apply tendsto_conditionalValueAtRisk_of_tendsto_integral_abs_sub
    (fun n ↦ (hX n).sub (integrable_const _))
    (hY.sub (integrable_const _)) halpha0 halpha1
  exact tendsto_integral_abs_centered_sub_centered hX hY hL1

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_lt_le_of_conditionalValueAtRisk_le_of_atomless
statement:
theorem measureReal_lt_le_of_conditionalValueAtRisk_le_of_atomless
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu : RandomSetTheory.IsAtomlessMeasure mu)
    {X : Omega → ℝ} (hXmeas : Measurable X) (hX : Integrable X mu)
    {alpha C : ℝ} (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha ≤ 1)
    (hcvar : conditionalValueAtRisk alpha X mu ≤ C) :
    mu.real {omega | C < X omega} ≤ alpha
proof:
:= by
  let U : Set Omega := {omega | C < X omega}
  have hU : MeasurableSet U := hXmeas measurableSet_Ioi
  by_contra htail
  have halphaU : alpha < mu.real U := lt_of_not_ge htail
  obtain ⟨A, hAU, hAmeas, hAmeasure⟩ :=
    hmu.exists_subset_measureReal_eq hU halpha0.le halphaU.le
  have hArealPos : 0 < mu.real A := by simpa only [hAmeasure] using halpha0
  have hApos : 0 < mu A := (ENNReal.toReal_pos_iff.mp hArealPos).1
  let G : Omega → ℝ := A.indicator fun omega ↦ X omega - C
  have hGint : Integrable G mu :=
    (hX.sub (integrable_const C)).indicator hAmeas
  have hGnonneg : (fun _ : Omega ↦ (0 : ℝ)) ≤ᵐ[mu] G := by
    exact ae_of_all mu fun omega ↦ by
      by_cases homega : omega ∈ A
      · rw [show G omega = X omega - C by
          simp only [G, Set.indicator_of_mem homega]]
        have hstrict := hAU homega
        change C < X omega at hstrict
        linarith
      · simp only [G, Set.indicator_of_notMem homega, le_refl]
  have hAsupport : A ⊆ Function.support G := by
    intro omega homega
    have hstrict := hAU homega
    change C < X omega at hstrict
    change G omega ≠ 0
    simp only [G, Set.indicator_of_mem homega]
    linarith
  have hsupport : 0 < mu (Function.support G) :=
    hApos.trans_le (measure_mono hAsupport)
  have hGpos : 0 < ∫ omega, G omega ∂mu :=
    (integral_pos_iff_support_of_nonneg_ae hGnonneg hGint).2 hsupport
  have hstrictIntegral : alpha * C < ∫ omega in A, X omega ∂mu := by
    dsimp only [G] at hGpos
    rw [integral_indicator hAmeas,
      integral_sub hX.integrableOn (integrable_const C),
      setIntegral_const, smul_eq_mul, hAmeasure] at hGpos
    linarith
  have hevent :=
    setIntegral_le_mul_conditionalValueAtRisk_of_measureReal_eq
      hX hAmeas halpha0 halpha1 hAmeasure
  have hscaled : alpha * conditionalValueAtRisk alpha X mu ≤ alpha * C :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcvar halpha0.le
  linarith

name: RandomSetTheory.measurable_iSup_continuous_of_measurable_dense
statement:
theorem measurable_iSup_continuous_of_measurable_dense
    (F : Omega → T → ℝ) (hcontinuous : ∀ omega, Continuous (F omega))
    (hmeas : ∀ k, Measurable (fun omega ↦ F omega (denseSeq T k))) :
    Measurable (fun omega ↦ ⨆ t, F omega t)
proof:
:= by
  have hdense : (fun omega ↦ ⨆ k : ℕ, F omega (denseSeq T k)) =
      fun omega ↦ ⨆ t, F omega t := by
    funext omega
    exact iSup_denseSeq_eq_iSup (F omega) (hcontinuous omega)
  rw [← hdense]
  exact Measurable.iSup hmeas

name: RandomSetTheory.tendsto_integral_abs_densePrefixSupremum_sub_iSup
statement:
theorem tendsto_integral_abs_densePrefixSupremum_sub_iSup
    (F : Omega → T → ℝ) (B : Omega → ℝ)
    (hcontinuous : ∀ omega, Continuous (F omega))
    (hmeas : ∀ k, Measurable (fun omega ↦ F omega (denseSeq T k)))
    (hB : Integrable B mu)
    (hdom : ∀ omega t, |F omega t| ≤ |B omega|) :
    Tendsto
      (fun n ↦ ∫ omega,
        |densePrefixSupremum (F omega) n - (⨆ t, F omega t)| ∂mu)
      atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  let P : ℕ → Omega → ℝ := fun n omega ↦ densePrefixSupremum (F omega) n
  let S : Omega → ℝ := fun omega ↦ ⨆ t, F omega t
  have hPmeas : ∀ n, Measurable (P n) := fun n ↦
    measurable_densePrefixSupremum F hmeas n
  have hSmeas : Measurable S :=
    measurable_iSup_continuous_of_measurable_dense F hcontinuous hmeas
  have hPdom : ∀ n omega, |P n omega| ≤ |B omega| := by
    intro n omega
    have heq : P n omega = ProbabilityTheory.finiteProcessSupremum
        (Finset.range (n + 1)) Finset.nonempty_range_add_one
          (fun k omega ↦ F omega (denseSeq T k)) omega := by
      dsimp only [P, ProbabilityTheory.finiteProcessSupremum]
      exact densePrefixSupremum_eq_sup'_range _ n
    rw [heq]
    apply ProbabilityTheory.abs_finiteProcessSupremum_le
      (Finset.range (n + 1)) Finset.nonempty_range_add_one
      (fun k omega ↦ F omega (denseSeq T k)) B
    · intro omega' k _hk
      exact hdom omega' (denseSeq T k)
  have hSdom : ∀ omega, |S omega| ≤ |B omega| := by
    intro omega
    have hbdd : BddAbove (Set.range (F omega)) := by
      refine ⟨|B omega|, ?_⟩
      rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩
      exact (le_abs_self (F omega t)).trans (hdom omega t)
    have hupper : S omega ≤ |B omega| := by
      exact ciSup_le fun t ↦ (le_abs_self (F omega t)).trans (hdom omega t)
    let t0 : T := Classical.choice inferInstance
    have hlowerValue : -|B omega| ≤ F omega t0 := by
      exact (neg_le_neg (hdom omega t0)).trans (neg_abs_le (F omega t0))
    have hlower : -|B omega| ≤ S omega :=
      hlowerValue.trans (le_ciSup hbdd t0)
    exact (abs_le).2 ⟨hlower, hupper⟩
  have hpoint : ∀ omega, Tendsto (fun n ↦ P n omega) atTop (nhds (S omega)) := by
    intro omega
    apply tendsto_densePrefixSupremum (F omega) (hcontinuous omega)
    refine ⟨|B omega|, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩
    exact (le_abs_self (F omega t)).trans (hdom omega t)
  have hdiffMeas : ∀ n, AEStronglyMeasurable
      (fun omega ↦ |P n omega - S omega|) mu := fun n ↦
    ((hPmeas n).sub hSmeas).abs.aestronglyMeasurable
  have hboundInt : Integrable (fun omega ↦ 2 * |B omega|) mu :=
    hB.abs.const_mul 2
  have hdiffBound : ∀ n, ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      ‖|P n omega - S omega|‖ ≤ 2 * |B omega| := by
    intro n
    exact ae_of_all mu fun omega ↦ by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_abs]
      calc
        |P n omega - S omega| ≤ |P n omega| + |S omega| := abs_sub _ _
        _ ≤ |B omega| + |B omega| := add_le_add (hPdom n omega) (hSdom omega)
        _ = 2 * |B omega| := by ring
  have hdiffTendsto : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      Tendsto (fun n ↦ |P n omega - S omega|) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    exact ae_of_all mu fun omega ↦ by
      have hsub : Tendsto (fun n ↦ P n omega - S omega)
          atTop (nhds 0) := by
        simpa using (hpoint omega).sub
          (tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ ↦ S omega)
            atTop (nhds (S omega)))
      simpa only [Function.comp_def, abs_zero] using
        (continuous_abs.tendsto 0).comp hsub
  have hDCT := tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence
    (fun omega ↦ 2 * |B omega|) hdiffMeas hboundInt hdiffBound hdiffTendsto
  simpa only [P, S, integral_zero] using hDCT

name: RandomSetTheory.tendsto_conditionalValueAtRisk_centered_densePrefixSupremum
statement:
theorem tendsto_conditionalValueAtRisk_centered_densePrefixSupremum
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (F : Omega → T → ℝ) (B : Omega → ℝ)
    (hcontinuous : ∀ omega, Continuous (F omega))
    (hmeas : ∀ k, Measurable (fun omega ↦ F omega (denseSeq T k)))
    (hB : Integrable B mu)
    (hdom : ∀ omega t, |F omega t| ≤ |B omega|)
    {alpha : ℝ} (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha ≤ 1) :
    Tendsto
      (fun n ↦ ProbabilityTheory.conditionalValueAtRisk alpha
        (fun omega ↦
          densePrefixSupremum (F omega) n -
            ∫ z, densePrefixSupremum (F z) n ∂mu) mu)
      atTop
      (nhds (ProbabilityTheory.conditionalValueAtRisk alpha
        (fun omega ↦
          (⨆ t, F omega t) - ∫ z, (⨆ t, F z t) ∂mu) mu))
proof:
:= by
  let P : ℕ → Omega → ℝ := fun n omega ↦ densePrefixSupremum (F omega) n
  let S : Omega → ℝ := fun omega ↦ ⨆ t, F omega t
  have hPmeas : ∀ n, Measurable (P n) := fun n ↦
    measurable_densePrefixSupremum F hmeas n
  have hSmeas : Measurable S :=
    measurable_iSup_continuous_of_measurable_dense F hcontinuous hmeas
  have hPdom : ∀ n omega, |P n omega| ≤ |B omega| := by
    intro n omega
    have heq : P n omega = ProbabilityTheory.finiteProcessSupremum
        (Finset.range (n + 1)) Finset.nonempty_range_add_one
          (fun k omega ↦ F omega (denseSeq T k)) omega := by
      dsimp only [P, ProbabilityTheory.finiteProcessSupremum]
      exact densePrefixSupremum_eq_sup'_range _ n
    rw [heq]
    apply ProbabilityTheory.abs_finiteProcessSupremum_le
      (Finset.range (n + 1)) Finset.nonempty_range_add_one
      (fun k omega ↦ F omega (denseSeq T k)) B
    · intro omega' k _hk
      exact hdom omega' (denseSeq T k)
  have hSdom : ∀ omega, |S omega| ≤ |B omega| := by
    intro omega
    have hbdd : BddAbove (Set.range (F omega)) := by
      refine ⟨|B omega|, ?_⟩
      rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩
      exact (le_abs_self (F omega t)).trans (hdom omega t)
    have hupper : S omega ≤ |B omega| :=
      ciSup_le fun t ↦ (le_abs_self (F omega t)).trans (hdom omega t)
    let t0 : T := Classical.choice inferInstance
    have hlowerValue : -|B omega| ≤ F omega t0 :=
      (neg_le_neg (hdom omega t0)).trans (neg_abs_le (F omega t0))
    have hlower : -|B omega| ≤ S omega :=
      hlowerValue.trans (le_ciSup hbdd t0)
    exact (abs_le).2 ⟨hlower, hupper⟩
  have hPint : ∀ n, Integrable (P n) mu := by
    intro n
    apply hB.norm.mono' (hPmeas n).aestronglyMeasurable
    exact ae_of_all mu fun omega ↦ by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_abs] using hPdom n omega
  have hSint : Integrable S mu := by
    apply hB.norm.mono' hSmeas.aestronglyMeasurable
    exact ae_of_all mu fun omega ↦ by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_abs] using hSdom omega
  have hL1 : Tendsto (fun n ↦ ∫ omega, |P n omega - S omega| ∂mu)
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [P, S] using
      tendsto_integral_abs_densePrefixSupremum_sub_iSup
        F B hcontinuous hmeas hB hdom
  simpa only [P, S] using
    (ProbabilityTheory.tendsto_conditionalValueAtRisk_centered_of_tendsto_integral_abs_sub
        hPint hSint halpha0 halpha1 hL1)

name: RandomSetTheory.conditionalValueAtRisk_centered_iSup_le_of_densePrefixes
statement:
theorem conditionalValueAtRisk_centered_iSup_le_of_densePrefixes
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (F : Omega → T → ℝ) (B : Omega → ℝ)
    (hcontinuous : ∀ omega, Continuous (F omega))
    (hmeas : ∀ k, Measurable (fun omega ↦ F omega (denseSeq T k)))
    (hB : Integrable B mu)
    (hdom : ∀ omega t, |F omega t| ≤ |B omega|)
    {alpha C : ℝ} (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha ≤ 1)
    (hfinite : ∀ n,
      ProbabilityTheory.conditionalValueAtRisk alpha
        (fun omega ↦
          densePrefixSupremum (F omega) n -
            ∫ z, densePrefixSupremum (F z) n ∂mu) mu ≤ C) :
    ProbabilityTheory.conditionalValueAtRisk alpha
        (fun omega ↦
          (⨆ t, F omega t) - ∫ z, (⨆ t, F z t) ∂mu) mu ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  exact le_of_tendsto
    (tendsto_conditionalValueAtRisk_centered_densePrefixSupremum
      F B hcontinuous hmeas hB hdom halpha0 halpha1)
    (Eventually.of_forall hfinite)

name: RandomSetTheory.measureReal_centered_iSup_lt_le_of_densePrefixes
statement:
theorem measureReal_centered_iSup_lt_le_of_densePrefixes
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu : IsAtomlessMeasure mu)
    (F : Omega → T → ℝ) (B : Omega → ℝ)
    (hcontinuous : ∀ omega, Continuous (F omega))
    (hmeas : ∀ k, Measurable (fun omega ↦ F omega (denseSeq T k)))
    (hB : Integrable B mu)
    (hdom : ∀ omega t, |F omega t| ≤ |B omega|)
    {alpha C : ℝ} (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha ≤ 1)
    (hfinite : ∀ n,
      ProbabilityTheory.conditionalValueAtRisk alpha
        (fun omega ↦
          densePrefixSupremum (F omega) n -
            ∫ z, densePrefixSupremum (F z) n ∂mu) mu ≤ C) :
    mu.real {omega |
      C < (⨆ t, F omega t) - ∫ z, (⨆ t, F z t) ∂mu} ≤ alpha
proof:
:= by
  let S : Omega → ℝ := fun omega ↦ ⨆ t, F omega t
  have hSmeas : Measurable S :=
    measurable_iSup_continuous_of_measurable_dense F hcontinuous hmeas
  have hSdom : ∀ omega, |S omega| ≤ |B omega| := by
    intro omega
    have hbdd : BddAbove (Set.range (F omega)) := by
      refine ⟨|B omega|, ?_⟩
      rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩
      exact (le_abs_self (F omega t)).trans (hdom omega t)
    have hupper : S omega ≤ |B omega| :=
      ciSup_le fun t ↦ (le_abs_self (F omega t)).trans (hdom omega t)
    let t0 : T := Classical.choice inferInstance
    have hlowerValue : -|B omega| ≤ F omega t0 :=
      (neg_le_neg (hdom omega t0)).trans (neg_abs_le (F omega t0))
    have hlower : -|B omega| ≤ S omega :=
      hlowerValue.trans (le_ciSup hbdd t0)
    exact (abs_le).2 ⟨hlower, hupper⟩
  have hSint : Integrable S mu := by
    apply hB.norm.mono' hSmeas.aestronglyMeasurable
    exact ae_of_all mu fun omega ↦ by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_abs] using hSdom omega
  have hcenteredMeas : Measurable
      (fun omega ↦ S omega - ∫ z, S z ∂mu) := hSmeas.sub measurable_const
  have hcenteredInt : Integrable
      (fun omega ↦ S omega - ∫ z, S z ∂mu) mu :=
    hSint.sub (integrable_const _)
  have hcvar : ProbabilityTheory.conditionalValueAtRisk alpha
      (fun omega ↦ S omega - ∫ z, S z ∂mu) mu ≤ C := by
    simpa only [S] using
      conditionalValueAtRisk_centered_iSup_le_of_densePrefixes
        F B hcontinuous hmeas hB hdom halpha0 halpha1 hfinite
  simpa only [S] using
    (ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_lt_le_of_conditionalValueAtRisk_le_of_atomless
        hmu hcenteredMeas hcenteredInt halpha0 halpha1 hcvar)

name: RandomSetTheory.kernelSupportedOn_deterministic
statement:
theorem kernelSupportedOn_deterministic
    [MeasurableSingletonClass X]
    {mu : Measure O} {S : O → Set X} {T : O → X}
    (hTmeas : Measurable T) (hTmem : ∀ᵐ o ∂mu, T o ∈ S o) :
    KernelSupportedOn mu S
      (ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.deterministic T hTmeas)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [hTmem] with o ho
  simp [ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.deterministic_apply, ho]

name: RandomSetTheory.integral_compProd_deterministic
statement:
theorem integral_compProd_deterministic
    [MeasurableSingletonClass X] [CompleteSpace E]
    {mu : Measure O} [SFinite mu] {T : O → X} (hT : Measurable T)
    {phi : O × X → E} (hphi : StronglyMeasurable phi) :
    ∫ p, phi p ∂(mu ⊗ₘ ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.deterministic T hT) =
      ∫ o, phi (o, T o) ∂mu
proof:
:= by
  rw [Measure.compProd_deterministic hT]
  exact integral_map_of_stronglyMeasurable
    (measurable_id.prodMk hT) hphi

name: RandomSetTheory.kernelBarycenter_isIntegrableSelection_closedConvexHull
statement:
theorem kernelBarycenter_isIntegrableSelection_closedConvexHull
    [CompleteSpace E]
    {mu : Measure O} [SFinite mu]
    {S : O → Set X} (hSmeas : ∀ o, MeasurableSet (S o))
    {kappa : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel O X}
    [ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel kappa]
    (hsupp : KernelSupportedOn mu S kappa)
    {phi : O × X → E} (hphi : StronglyMeasurable phi)
    (hint : Integrable phi (mu ⊗ₘ kappa)) :
    IsIntegrableSelection mu
      (fun o => closedConvexHull ℝ ((fun x => phi (o, x)) '' S o))
      (kernelBarycenter kappa phi)
proof:
:= by
  have hfiberInt : ∀ᵐ o ∂mu, Integrable (fun x => phi (o, x)) (kappa o) :=
    hint.ae_of_compProd
  have hnormInt :
      Integrable (fun o => ∫ x, ‖phi (o, x)‖ ∂(kappa o)) mu :=
    (Measure.integrable_compProd_iff hint.aestronglyMeasurable).mp hint |>.2
  have hbaryStrong : StronglyMeasurable (kernelBarycenter kappa phi) := by
    change StronglyMeasurable (fun o => ∫ x, phi (o, x) ∂(kappa o))
    exact hphi.integral_kernel_prod_right'
  have hbaryInt : Integrable (kernelBarycenter kappa phi) mu := by
    apply hnormInt.mono' hbaryStrong.aestronglyMeasurable
    filter_upwards [] with o
    exact norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
  refine ⟨hbaryInt, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hsupp, hfiberInt] with o hsuppo hfiberInto
  have haeS : ∀ᵐ x ∂(kappa o), x ∈ S o := by
    apply (ae_mem_iff_measure_eq (hSmeas o).nullMeasurableSet).2
    simpa using hsuppo
  apply convex_closedConvexHull.integral_mem isClosed_closedConvexHull
      (f := fun x => phi (o, x))
  · filter_upwards [haeS] with x hx
    exact subset_closedConvexHull ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  · exact hfiberInto

name: RandomSetTheory.kernelMoment_mem_aumannExpectation_closedConvexHull
statement:
theorem kernelMoment_mem_aumannExpectation_closedConvexHull
    [CompleteSpace E]
    {mu : Measure O} [SFinite mu]
    {S : O → Set X} (hSmeas : ∀ o, MeasurableSet (S o))
    {kappa : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel O X}
    [ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel kappa]
    (hsupp : KernelSupportedOn mu S kappa)
    {phi : O × X → E} (hphi : StronglyMeasurable phi)
    (hint : Integrable phi (mu ⊗ₘ kappa)) :
    (∫ p, phi p ∂(mu ⊗ₘ kappa)) ∈
      aumannExpectation mu
        (fun o => closedConvexHull ℝ ((fun x => phi (o, x)) '' S o))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨kernelBarycenter kappa phi,
    kernelBarycenter_isIntegrableSelection_closedConvexHull
      hSmeas hsupp hphi hint, ?_⟩
  exact (Measure.integral_compProd hint).symm

name: RandomSetTheory.kernelAttainableMoments_subset_aumannExpectation_closedConvexHull
statement:
theorem kernelAttainableMoments_subset_aumannExpectation_closedConvexHull
    [CompleteSpace E]
    {mu : Measure O} [SFinite mu]
    {S : O → Set X} (hSmeas : ∀ o, MeasurableSet (S o))
    {phi : O × X → E} (hphi : StronglyMeasurable phi) :
    kernelAttainableMoments mu S phi ⊆
      aumannExpectation mu
        (fun o => closedConvexHull ℝ ((fun x => phi (o, x)) '' S o))
proof:
:= by
  rintro y ⟨kappa, hkappa, hsupp, hint, rfl⟩
  letI : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel kappa := hkappa
  exact kernelMoment_mem_aumannExpectation_closedConvexHull
    hSmeas hsupp hphi hint

name: RandomSetTheory.disintegrate_jointLaw
statement:
theorem disintegrate_jointLaw
    [StandardBorelSpace X] [Nonempty X]
    (rho : Measure (O × X)) [IsFiniteMeasure rho] :
    rho.fst ⊗ₘ rho.condKernel = rho
proof:
:=
  Measure.disintegrate rho rho.condKernel

name: RandomSetTheory.condKernel_supportedOn_of_jointLaw
statement:
theorem condKernel_supportedOn_of_jointLaw
    [StandardBorelSpace X] [Nonempty X]
    {rho : Measure (O × X)} [IsProbabilityMeasure rho]
    {S : O → Set X}
    (hgraph : MeasurableSet {p : O × X | p.2 ∈ S p.1})
    (hSmeas : ∀ o, MeasurableSet (S o))
    (hsupp : rho {p : O × X | p.2 ∈ S p.1} = 1) :
    KernelSupportedOn rho.fst S rho.condKernel
proof:
:= by
  have hJointAE : ∀ᵐ p ∂rho, p.2 ∈ S p.1 :=
    (mem_ae_iff_prob_eq_one hgraph).2 hsupp
  have hDisAE :
      ∀ᵐ p ∂(rho.fst ⊗ₘ rho.condKernel), p.2 ∈ S p.1 := by
    rw [Measure.disintegrate rho rho.condKernel]
    exact hJointAE
  have hFiberAE :
      ∀ᵐ o ∂rho.fst, ∀ᵐ x ∂rho.condKernel o, x ∈ S o :=
    Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_compProd hDisAE
  filter_upwards [hFiberAE] with o ho
  exact (mem_ae_iff_prob_eq_one (hSmeas o)).mp ho

name: RandomSetTheory.integral_jointLaw_eq_integral_condKernel
statement:
theorem integral_jointLaw_eq_integral_condKernel
    [StandardBorelSpace X] [Nonempty X] [CompleteSpace E]
    {rho : Measure (O × X)} [IsFiniteMeasure rho]
    {phi : O × X → E} (hphi : Integrable phi rho) :
    ∫ p, phi p ∂rho =
      ∫ o, ∫ x, phi (o, x) ∂(rho.condKernel o) ∂rho.fst
proof:
:= by
  have hdis : rho.fst ⊗ₘ rho.condKernel = rho :=
    Measure.disintegrate rho rho.condKernel
  have hphi' : Integrable phi (rho.fst ⊗ₘ rho.condKernel) := by
    rw [hdis]
    exact hphi
  calc
    ∫ p, phi p ∂rho = ∫ p, phi p ∂(rho.fst ⊗ₘ rho.condKernel) := by
      rw [hdis]
    _ = ∫ o, ∫ x, phi (o, x) ∂(rho.condKernel o) ∂rho.fst :=
      Measure.integral_compProd hphi'

name: RandomSetTheory.jointLawMoment_mem_aumannExpectation_closedConvexHull
statement:
theorem jointLawMoment_mem_aumannExpectation_closedConvexHull
    [StandardBorelSpace X] [Nonempty X] [CompleteSpace E]
    {rho : Measure (O × X)} [IsProbabilityMeasure rho]
    {S : O → Set X}
    (hgraph : MeasurableSet {p : O × X | p.2 ∈ S p.1})
    (hSmeas : ∀ o, MeasurableSet (S o))
    (hsupp : rho {p : O × X | p.2 ∈ S p.1} = 1)
    {phi : O × X → E} (hphiMeas : StronglyMeasurable phi)
    (hphiInt : Integrable phi rho) :
    (∫ p, phi p ∂rho) ∈
      aumannExpectation rho.fst
        (fun o => closedConvexHull ℝ ((fun x => phi (o, x)) '' S o))
proof:
:= by
  let kappa := rho.condKernel
  have hsuppK : KernelSupportedOn rho.fst S kappa :=
    condKernel_supportedOn_of_jointLaw hgraph hSmeas hsupp
  have hdis : rho.fst ⊗ₘ kappa = rho :=
    Measure.disintegrate rho kappa
  have hphiInt' : Integrable phi (rho.fst ⊗ₘ kappa) := by
    rw [hdis]
    exact hphiInt
  have hmem := kernelMoment_mem_aumannExpectation_closedConvexHull
    hSmeas hsuppK hphiMeas hphiInt'
  rwa [hdis] at hmem

name: RandomSetTheory.completeLawMoment_mem_aumannExpectation_closedConvexHull
statement:
theorem completeLawMoment_mem_aumannExpectation_closedConvexHull
    [StandardBorelSpace X] [Nonempty X] [CompleteSpace E]
    {P : Measure X} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    {obs : X → O} (hobs : Measurable obs)
    {S : O → Set X}
    (hgraph : MeasurableSet {p : O × X | p.2 ∈ S p.1})
    (hSmeas : ∀ o, MeasurableSet (S o))
    (hsupp : P {x | x ∈ S (obs x)} = 1)
    {phi : O × X → E} (hphiMeas : StronglyMeasurable phi)
    (hphiInt : Integrable (fun x => phi (obs x, x)) P) :
    (∫ x, phi (obs x, x) ∂P) ∈
      aumannExpectation (P.map obs)
        (fun o => closedConvexHull ℝ ((fun x => phi (o, x)) '' S o))
proof:
:= by
  let rho : Measure (O × X) := P.map fun x => (obs x, x)
  have hpair : Measurable (fun x => (obs x, x)) :=
    hobs.prodMk measurable_id
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure rho := by
    dsimp only [rho]
    exact Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hpair.aemeasurable
  have hrhoSupp : rho {p : O × X | p.2 ∈ S p.1} = 1 := by
    rw [show rho = P.map (fun x => (obs x, x)) by rfl,
      Measure.map_apply hpair hgraph]
    rw [show (fun x => (obs x, x)) ⁻¹' {p : O × X | p.2 ∈ S p.1} =
        {x | x ∈ S (obs x)} by rfl]
    exact hsupp
  have hrhoInt : Integrable phi rho := by
    rw [show rho = P.map (fun x => (obs x, x)) by rfl]
    exact (integrable_map_measure hphiMeas.aestronglyMeasurable
      hpair.aemeasurable).2 (by simpa [Function.comp_def] using hphiInt)
  have hmem := jointLawMoment_mem_aumannExpectation_closedConvexHull
    (rho := rho) hgraph hSmeas hrhoSupp hphiMeas hrhoInt
  have hfst : rho.fst = P.map obs := by
    simpa only [rho] using
      (Measure.fst_map_prodMk (μ := P) (X := obs)
        (Y := fun x : X => x) measurable_id)
  have hint : ∫ p, phi p ∂rho = ∫ x, phi (obs x, x) ∂P := by
    rw [show rho = P.map (fun x => (obs x, x)) by rfl]
    exact integral_map_of_stronglyMeasurable hpair hphiMeas
  rwa [hint, hfst] at hmem

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_caratheodoryImage_subset_kernelAttainableMoments
statement:
theorem aumannExpectation_caratheodoryImage_subset_kernelAttainableMoments
    [MetricSpace X] [CompleteSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    [SecondCountableTopology X] [Nonempty X]
    [CompleteSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E]
    {mu : Measure O} [SFinite mu]
    {S : O → Set X} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ o, IsCompact (S o)) (hne : ∀ o, (S o).Nonempty)
    {phi : O × X → E} (hphiMeas : Measurable phi)
    (hphiCont : ∀ o, Continuous fun x => phi (o, x)) :
    aumannExpectation mu (fun o => (fun x => phi (o, x)) '' S o) ⊆
      kernelAttainableMoments mu S phi
proof:
:= by
  rintro y ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
  let v' : O → E := hv.1.aestronglyMeasurable.mk v
  have hv'Meas : Measurable v' :=
    hv.1.aestronglyMeasurable.measurable_mk
  have hvv' : v =ᵐ[mu] v' :=
    hv.1.aestronglyMeasurable.ae_eq_mk
  have hv'Mem :
      ∀ᵐ o ∂mu, v' o ∈ (fun x => phi (o, x)) '' S o := by
    filter_upwards [hv.2, hvv'] with o hvo heq
    rwa [← heq]
  obtain ⟨T, hTMeas, hTMem, hphiT⟩ :=
    exists_measurable_lifting_of_ae_mem_image
      hS hcompact hne hphiMeas hphiCont hv'Meas hv'Mem
  have hphiTv : (fun o => phi (o, T o)) =ᵐ[mu] v := by
    filter_upwards [hphiT, hvv'] with o hTo hvo
    exact hTo.trans hvo.symm
  have hphiTInt : Integrable (fun o => phi (o, T o)) mu :=
    hv.1.congr hphiTv.symm
  let kappa : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel O X :=
    ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.deterministic T hTMeas
  letI : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel kappa := by
    dsimp only [kappa]
    infer_instance
  have hkappaSupp : KernelSupportedOn mu S kappa := by
    exact kernelSupportedOn_deterministic hTMeas
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hTMem)
  have hgraphMeas : Measurable (fun o => (o, T o)) :=
    measurable_id.prodMk hTMeas
  have hphiStrong : StronglyMeasurable phi :=
    hphiMeas.stronglyMeasurable
  have hphiJointInt : Integrable phi (mu ⊗ₘ kappa) := by
    rw [show kappa = ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.deterministic T hTMeas by rfl,
      Measure.compProd_deterministic hTMeas]
    exact (integrable_map_measure hphiStrong.aestronglyMeasurable
      hgraphMeas.aemeasurable).2 (by simpa [Function.comp_def] using hphiTInt)
  refine ⟨kappa, inferInstance, hkappaSupp, hphiJointInt, ?_⟩
  calc
    ∫ p, phi p ∂(mu ⊗ₘ kappa) = ∫ o, phi (o, T o) ∂mu := by
      simpa only [kappa] using
        integral_compProd_deterministic hTMeas hphiStrong
    _ = ∫ o, v o ∂mu := integral_congr_ae hphiTv

name: RandomSetTheory.kernelAttainableMoments_eq_aumannExpectation_of_purification
statement:
theorem kernelAttainableMoments_eq_aumannExpectation_of_purification
    [MetricSpace X] [CompleteSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    [SecondCountableTopology X] [Nonempty X]
    [CompleteSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E]
    {mu : Measure O} [SFinite mu]
    {S : O → Set X} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hSmeas : ∀ o, MeasurableSet (S o))
    (hcompact : ∀ o, IsCompact (S o)) (hne : ∀ o, (S o).Nonempty)
    {phi : O × X → E} (hphiMeas : Measurable phi)
    (hphiCont : ∀ o, Continuous fun x => phi (o, x))
    (hpurify :
      aumannExpectation mu (fun o => (fun x => phi (o, x)) '' S o) =
        aumannExpectation mu
          (fun o => closedConvexHull ℝ ((fun x => phi (o, x)) '' S o))) :
    kernelAttainableMoments mu S phi =
      aumannExpectation mu (fun o => (fun x => phi (o, x)) '' S o)
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · rw [hpurify]
    exact kernelAttainableMoments_subset_aumannExpectation_closedConvexHull
      hSmeas hphiMeas.stronglyMeasurable
  · exact aumannExpectation_caratheodoryImage_subset_kernelAttainableMoments
      hS hcompact hne hphiMeas hphiCont

name: RandomSetTheory.kernelAttainableMoments_eq_aumannExpectation_of_atomless
statement:
theorem kernelAttainableMoments_eq_aumannExpectation_of_atomless
    {H : Type*}
    [MetricSpace X] [CompleteSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    [SecondCountableTopology X] [Nonempty X]
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ H]
    {mu : Measure O} [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    (hmu : IsAtomlessMeasure mu)
    {S : O → Set X} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hSmeas : ∀ o, MeasurableSet (S o))
    (hcompact : ∀ o, IsCompact (S o)) (hne : ∀ o, (S o).Nonempty)
    {phi : O × X → H} (hphiMeas : Measurable phi)
    (hphiCont : ∀ o, Continuous fun x => phi (o, x))
    {g : O → ℝ} (hg : Integrable g mu)
    (hdom : ∀ o, ∀ x ∈ S o, ‖phi (o, x)‖ ≤ g o) :
    kernelAttainableMoments mu S phi =
      aumannExpectation mu (fun o => (fun x => phi (o, x)) '' S o)
proof:
:= by
  let Phi : O → Set H := fun o => (fun x => phi (o, x)) '' S o
  have hPhi : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable Phi :=
    effrosMeasurable_caratheodoryImage hS
      (fun o => (hcompact o).isClosed) hne hphiMeas hphiCont
  have hPhiCompact : ∀ o, IsCompact (Phi o) := fun o =>
    (hcompact o).image (hphiCont o)
  have hPhiNe : ∀ o, (Phi o).Nonempty := fun o =>
    (hne o).image fun x => phi (o, x)
  have hPhiDom : ∀ o, ∀ y ∈ Phi o, ‖y‖ ≤ g o := by
    rintro o y ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact hdom o x hx
  have hpurify :
      aumannExpectation mu Phi =
        aumannExpectation mu (fun o => closedConvexHull ℝ (Phi o)) :=
    (aumannExpectation_closedConvexHull_eq_of_atomless
      mu hmu hPhi hPhiCompact hPhiNe hg hPhiDom).symm
  exact kernelAttainableMoments_eq_aumannExpectation_of_purification
    hS hSmeas hcompact hne hphiMeas hphiCont
      (by simpa only [Phi] using hpurify)

name: RandomSetTheory.kernelAttainableMoments_eq_aumannExpectation_of_lyapunov
statement:
theorem kernelAttainableMoments_eq_aumannExpectation_of_lyapunov
    {H : Type*}
    [MetricSpace X] [CompleteSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    [SecondCountableTopology X] [Nonempty X]
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ H] [Nonempty H]
    {mu : Measure O} [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    (hmu : HasLyapunovConvexity mu H)
    {S : O → Set X} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hSmeas : ∀ o, MeasurableSet (S o))
    (hcompact : ∀ o, IsCompact (S o)) (hne : ∀ o, (S o).Nonempty)
    {phi : O × X → H} (hphiMeas : Measurable phi)
    (hphiCont : ∀ o, Continuous fun x => phi (o, x))
    {g : O → ℝ} (hg : Integrable g mu)
    (hdom : ∀ o, ∀ x ∈ S o, ‖phi (o, x)‖ ≤ g o)
    (hAclosed : IsClosed
      (aumannExpectation mu (fun o => (fun x => phi (o, x)) '' S o)))
    (hACclosed : IsClosed
      (aumannExpectation mu
        (fun o => closedConvexHull ℝ ((fun x => phi (o, x)) '' S o)))) :
    kernelAttainableMoments mu S phi =
      aumannExpectation mu (fun o => (fun x => phi (o, x)) '' S o)
proof:
:= by
  let Phi : O → Set H := fun o => (fun x => phi (o, x)) '' S o
  have hPhi : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable Phi :=
    effrosMeasurable_caratheodoryImage hS
      (fun o => (hcompact o).isClosed) hne hphiMeas hphiCont
  have hPhiCompact : ∀ o, IsCompact (Phi o) := fun o =>
    (hcompact o).image (hphiCont o)
  have hPhiNe : ∀ o, (Phi o).Nonempty := fun o =>
    (hne o).image fun x => phi (o, x)
  have hPhiDom : ∀ o, ∀ y ∈ Phi o, ‖y‖ ≤ g o := by
    rintro o y ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact hdom o x hx
  have hpurify :
      aumannExpectation mu Phi =
        aumannExpectation mu (fun o => closedConvexHull ℝ (Phi o)) :=
    aumannExpectation_closedConvexHull_eq_of_lyapunov_of_effros
      hmu hPhi hPhiCompact hPhiNe hg hPhiDom hAclosed hACclosed
  exact kernelAttainableMoments_eq_aumannExpectation_of_purification
    hS hSmeas hcompact hne hphiMeas hphiCont (by simpa only [Phi] using hpurify)

name: ProbabilityTheory.integral_nonnegative_le_sqrt_integral_sq
statement:
theorem integral_nonnegative_le_sqrt_integral_sq
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (f : Omega → ℝ) (hf : MemLp f 2 mu)
    (hf_nonneg : 0 ≤ᵐ[mu] f) :
    ∫ omega, f omega ∂mu ≤ Real.sqrt (∫ omega, (f omega) ^ 2 ∂mu)
proof:
:= by
  have hone : MemLp (fun _ : Omega ↦ (1 : ℝ)) 2 mu := by
    exact memLp_const 1
  have hf' : MemLp f (ENNReal.ofReal (2 : ℝ)) mu := by
    norm_num
    exact hf
  have hone' : MemLp (fun _ : Omega ↦ (1 : ℝ))
      (ENNReal.ofReal (2 : ℝ)) mu := by
    norm_num
    exact hone
  have hholder := integral_mul_le_Lp_mul_Lq_of_nonneg
    (μ := mu) (p := (2 : ℝ)) (q := (2 : ℝ)) Real.HolderConjugate.two_two
    hf_nonneg (ae_of_all mu fun _ ↦ zero_le_one) hf' hone'
  simpa only [mul_one, one_pow, integral_const, probReal_univ,
    one_smul, one_rpow, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, one_div,
    Real.rpow_two] using hholder

name: ProbabilityTheory.integral_sqrt_fin_sum_sq_le
statement:
theorem integral_sqrt_fin_sum_sq_le
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {n : Nat} (A : Fin n → Omega → ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ i, MemLp (A i) 2 mu) :
    ∫ omega, Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin n, (A i omega) ^ 2) ∂mu ≤
      Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin n, ∫ omega, (A i omega) ^ 2 ∂mu)
proof:
:= by
  let F : Omega → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) :=
    fun omega ↦ WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i ↦ A i omega)
  have hF : MemLp F 2 mu := by
    apply MemLp.of_eval_piLp
    intro i
    simpa only [F, Function.comp_apply, PiLp.toLp_apply] using hA i
  have hnorm := integral_nonnegative_le_sqrt_integral_sq
    (mu := mu) (fun omega ↦ ‖F omega‖) hF.norm
    (ae_of_all mu fun _ ↦ norm_nonneg _)
  have hpoint : ∀ omega,
      ‖F omega‖ = Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin n, (A i omega) ^ 2) := by
    intro omega
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq]
    simp only [F, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have hsq : (∫ omega, ‖F omega‖ ^ 2 ∂mu) =
      ∑ i : Fin n, ∫ omega, (A i omega) ^ 2 ∂mu := by
    simp_rw [EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq]
    rw [integral_finsetSum]
    intro i hi
    exact (hA i).integrable_sq
  rw [hsq] at hnorm
  simpa only [hpoint] using hnorm

name: ProbabilityTheory.integral_sqrt_fin_sum_sq_le_sqrt_nat_mul
statement:
theorem integral_sqrt_fin_sum_sq_le_sqrt_nat_mul
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {n : Nat} (A : Fin n → Omega → ℝ) (K₂ : ℝ)
    (hK₂ : 0 ≤ K₂)
    (hA : ∀ i, MemLp (A i) 2 mu)
    (hsecond : ∀ i, ∫ omega, (A i omega) ^ 2 ∂mu ≤ K₂ ^ 2) :
    ∫ omega, Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin n, (A i omega) ^ 2) ∂mu ≤
      Real.sqrt n * K₂
proof:
:= by
  calc
    ∫ omega, Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin n, (A i omega) ^ 2) ∂mu ≤
        Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin n, ∫ omega, (A i omega) ^ 2 ∂mu) :=
      integral_sqrt_fin_sum_sq_le A hA
    _ ≤ Real.sqrt (∑ _i : Fin n, K₂ ^ 2) := by
      apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _hi ↦ hsecond i
    _ = Real.sqrt n * K₂ := by
      rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, Finset.card_univ,
        Fintype.card_fin, Real.sqrt_mul (Nat.cast_nonneg n),
        Real.sqrt_sq hK₂]

name: ProbabilityTheory.integral_normalized_sqrt_fin_sum_sq_le
statement:
theorem integral_normalized_sqrt_fin_sum_sq_le
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {n : Nat} (hn : 0 < n) (A : Fin n → Omega → ℝ) (K₂ : ℝ)
    (hK₂ : 0 ≤ K₂)
    (hA : ∀ i, MemLp (A i) 2 mu)
    (hsecond : ∀ i, ∫ omega, (A i omega) ^ 2 ∂mu ≤ K₂ ^ 2) :
    ∫ omega, Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin n, (A i omega) ^ 2) / (n : ℝ) ∂mu ≤
      K₂ / Real.sqrt n
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_div]
  have hnreal : 0 < (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hn
  calc
    (∫ omega, Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin n, (A i omega) ^ 2) ∂mu) / (n : ℝ) ≤
        (Real.sqrt n * K₂) / (n : ℝ) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
        (integral_sqrt_fin_sum_sq_le_sqrt_nat_mul A K₂ hK₂ hA hsecond)
        hnreal.le
    _ = K₂ / Real.sqrt n := by
      have hsqrt : 0 < Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hnreal
      apply (div_eq_div_iff hnreal.ne' hsqrt.ne').2
      nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt hnreal.le]

name: RandomSetTheory.convexHull_finset_subset_convexJoinIterate_card
statement:
theorem convexHull_finset_subset_convexJoinIterate_card
    {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    {S : Set E} (hS : S.Nonempty) (T : Finset E)
    (hTS : (T : Set E) ⊆ S) :
    convexHull ℝ (T : Set E) ⊆ convexJoinIterate S T.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction T using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert a T ha ih =>
      have haS : a ∈ S := hTS (by simp)
      have hTS' : (T : Set E) ⊆ S := by
        intro x hx
        exact hTS (by simp [hx])
      rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem ha]
      by_cases hT : T.Nonempty
      · rw [Finset.coe_insert, convexHull_insert (by simpa using hT),
          convexJoinIterate_succ]
        apply convexJoin_mono
        · intro x hx
          rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
          subst x
          exact convexJoinIterate_mono_nat hS (Nat.zero_le T.card) haS
        · exact ih hTS'
      · rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hT
        subst T
        simpa only [Finset.coe_insert, Finset.coe_empty, insert_empty_eq,
          Finset.coe_singleton, convexHull_singleton, Finset.card_empty,
          convexJoinIterate_succ,
          convexJoinIterate_zero] using
          (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr haS).trans
            (subset_convexJoin_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (s := S) (t := S) hS)

name: RandomSetTheory.convexHull_subset_convexJoinIterate_finrank_add_one
statement:
theorem convexHull_subset_convexJoinIterate_finrank_add_one
    {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {S : Set E} (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    convexHull ℝ S ⊆
      convexJoinIterate S (finrank ℝ E + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [convexHull_eq_union]
  intro x hx
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, exists_prop] at hx
  obtain ⟨T, hTS, hTind, hxT⟩ := hx
  have hcard : T.card ≤ finrank ℝ E + 1 := by
    simpa only [Fintype.card_coe] using
      hTind.card_le_finrank_succ.trans
        (Nat.add_le_add_right (Submodule.finrank_le _) 1)
  exact convexJoinIterate_mono_nat hS hcard
    (convexHull_finset_subset_convexJoinIterate_card hS T hTS hxT)

name: RandomSetTheory.convexJoinIterate_finrank_add_one_eq_convexHull
statement:
theorem convexJoinIterate_finrank_add_one_eq_convexHull
    {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {S : Set E} (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    convexJoinIterate S (finrank ℝ E + 1) = convexHull ℝ S
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · exact convexJoinIterate_subset_convex
      (subset_convexHull ℝ S) (convex_convexHull ℝ S) _
  · exact convexHull_subset_convexJoinIterate_finrank_add_one hS

name: RandomSetTheory.convexJoinIterate_finrank_add_one_eq_closedConvexHull
statement:
theorem convexJoinIterate_finrank_add_one_eq_closedConvexHull
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {S : Set E} (hScompact : IsCompact S) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    convexJoinIterate S (finrank ℝ E + 1) = closedConvexHull ℝ S
proof:
:= by
  have hstage := convexJoinIterate_finrank_add_one_eq_convexHull hS
  have hhullClosed : IsClosed (convexHull ℝ S) := by
    rw [← hstage]
    exact (convexJoinIterate_compact hScompact _).isClosed
  rw [hstage, closedConvexHull_eq_closure_convexHull,
    hhullClosed.closure_eq]

name: RandomSetTheory.convexHull_eq_closedConvexHull_of_compact
statement:
theorem convexHull_eq_closedConvexHull_of_compact
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {S : Set E} (hScompact : IsCompact S) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    convexHull ℝ S = closedConvexHull ℝ S
proof:
:= by
  rw [← convexJoinIterate_finrank_add_one_eq_convexHull hS,
    convexJoinIterate_finrank_add_one_eq_closedConvexHull hScompact hS]

name: RandomSetTheory.convexHull_compact_of_compact
statement:
theorem convexHull_compact_of_compact
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {S : Set E} (hScompact : IsCompact S) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    IsCompact (convexHull ℝ S)
proof:
:= by
  rw [convexHull_eq_closedConvexHull_of_compact hScompact hS]
  exact closedConvexHull_compact hScompact

name: ProbabilityTheory.chernoffTransform_comp_mul_le_mul
statement:
theorem chernoffTransform_comp_mul_le_mul
    {psi : ℝ → ℝ} {a x : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hx : 0 ≤ x)
    (hpsi : ∀ t, 0 < t → 0 ≤ psi t) :
    chernoffTransform (fun t => psi (a * t)) x ≤
      a * chernoffTransform psi x
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → 0 ≤ psi (a * t) := by
    intro t ht
    exact hpsi (a * t) (mul_pos ha ht)
  have hbComp := bddBelow_range_chernoffObjective hx hcomp
  refine le_of_forall_pos_le_add fun epsilon hepsilon => ?_
  obtain ⟨r, ⟨s, hs⟩, hrs⟩ := Real.lt_sInf_add_pos
    (Set.range_nonempty (chernoffObjective psi x))
    (div_pos hepsilon ha)
  subst r
  have heval := chernoffTransform_le_objective
    (psi := fun t => psi (a * t)) (x := x)
    (t := s / a) (div_pos s.property ha) hbComp
  have harg : a * (s / a) = s := by field_simp [ha.ne']
  rw [harg] at heval
  have hobjective :
      (psi s + x) / (s / a) =
        a * chernoffObjective psi x s := by
    unfold chernoffObjective
    field_simp [ha.ne', s.property.ne']
  rw [hobjective] at heval
  calc
    chernoffTransform (fun t => psi (a * t)) x ≤
        a * chernoffObjective psi x s := heval
    _ ≤ a * (chernoffTransform psi x + epsilon / a) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrs.le ha.le
    _ = a * chernoffTransform psi x + epsilon := by
      field_simp [ha.ne']

name: ProbabilityTheory.strongMomentQScale_pos
statement:
theorem strongMomentQScale_pos
    {q : ℕ} {Q : ℝ} (hQ : 0 < Q) :
    0 < strongMomentQScale q Q
proof:
:=
  Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQ _

name: ProbabilityTheory.strongMomentQScale_pow
statement:
theorem strongMomentQScale_pow
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) {Q : ℝ} (hQ : 0 < Q) :
    strongMomentQScale q Q ^ q = Q
proof:
:= by
  unfold strongMomentQScale
  simpa only [one_div] using
    (Real.rpow_inv_natCast_pow hQ.le (by omega : q ≠ 0))

name: ProbabilityTheory.interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient_eq_scale_pow_mul
statement:
theorem interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient_eq_scale_pow_mul
    (q k : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) {V Q : ℝ}
    (hV : 0 < V) (hQ : 0 < Q) :
    interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient q V Q k =
      strongMomentQScale q Q ^ k *
        interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient q
          (V / strongMomentQScale q Q ^ 2) 1 k
proof:
:= by
  let a : ℝ := strongMomentQScale q Q
  have ha : 0 < a := strongMomentQScale_pos hQ
  have hVeq : V = a ^ 2 * (V / a ^ 2) := by
    field_simp [ha.ne']
  have hQeq : Q = a ^ q :=
    (strongMomentQScale_pow (by omega) hQ).symm
  have hV0 : 0 ≤ V / a ^ 2 := (div_pos hV (sq_pos_of_pos ha)).le
  unfold interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient
  change V ^ strongMomentSecondWeight q k *
      Q ^ strongMomentQWeight q k =
    a ^ k *
      ((V / a ^ 2) ^ strongMomentSecondWeight q k *
        1 ^ strongMomentQWeight q k)
  nth_rewrite 1 [hVeq]
  nth_rewrite 1 [hQeq]
  rw [Real.mul_rpow (sq_nonneg a) hV0,
    ← Real.rpow_natCast_mul ha.le 2 (strongMomentSecondWeight q k),
    ← Real.rpow_natCast_mul ha.le q (strongMomentQWeight q k)]
  have hpowers :
      a ^ ((2 : ℝ) * strongMomentSecondWeight q k) *
          a ^ ((q : ℝ) * strongMomentQWeight q k) = a ^ k := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_add ha,
      two_mul_strongMomentSecondWeight_add_q_mul_strongMomentQWeight hq,
      Real.rpow_natCast]
  rw [one_rpow]
  calc
    a ^ ((2 : ℝ) * strongMomentSecondWeight q k) *
          (V / a ^ 2) ^ strongMomentSecondWeight q k *
          a ^ ((q : ℝ) * strongMomentQWeight q k) =
      (a ^ ((2 : ℝ) * strongMomentSecondWeight q k) *
          a ^ ((q : ℝ) * strongMomentQWeight q k)) *
        (V / a ^ 2) ^ strongMomentSecondWeight q k := by ring
    _ = a ^ k * (V / a ^ 2) ^ strongMomentSecondWeight q k := by
      rw [hpowers]
    _ = a ^ k *
        ((V / a ^ 2) ^ strongMomentSecondWeight q k * 1) := by ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.strongMomentIntermediateExponent_eq_scaled_one
statement:
theorem strongMomentIntermediateExponent_eq_scaled_one
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) {V Q t : ℝ}
    (hV : 0 < V) (hQ : 0 < Q) :
    strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V Q t =
      strongMomentIntermediateExponent q
        (V / strongMomentQScale q Q ^ 2) 1
        (strongMomentQScale q Q * t)
proof:
:= by
  unfold strongMomentIntermediateExponent
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  rw [interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient_eq_scale_pow_mul q k hq hV hQ,
    mul_pow]
  ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.rioStrongMomentExponent_eq_scaled_one
statement:
theorem rioStrongMomentExponent_eq_scaled_one
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) {V Q y t : ℝ}
    (hV : 0 < V) (hQ : 0 < Q) (hy : 0 < y) :
    rioStrongMomentExponent q V Q y t =
      rioStrongMomentExponent q
        (V / strongMomentQScale q Q ^ 2) 1
        (y / strongMomentQScale q Q)
        (strongMomentQScale q Q * t)
proof:
:= by
  let a : ℝ := strongMomentQScale q Q
  have ha : 0 < a := strongMomentQScale_pos hQ
  have haPow : a ^ q = Q := strongMomentQScale_pow (by omega) hQ
  have hgaussian : gaussianChernoffExponent V t =
      gaussianChernoffExponent (V / a ^ 2) (a * t) := by
    unfold gaussianChernoffExponent
    field_simp [ha.ne']
  have hintermediate : strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V Q t =
      strongMomentIntermediateExponent q (V / a ^ 2) 1 (a * t) := by
    simpa only [a] using
      strongMomentIntermediateExponent_eq_scaled_one q hq hV hQ
  have harg : (a * t) * (y / a) = t * y := by
    field_simp [ha.ne']
  have hcoefficient : 1 / (y / a) ^ q = Q / y ^ q := by
    rw [div_pow, haPow]
    field_simp [ha.ne', hy.ne']
  have htail : exactStrongMomentTailExponent q Q y t =
      exactStrongMomentTailExponent q 1 (y / a) (a * t) := by
    unfold exactStrongMomentTailExponent
    rw [harg, ← hcoefficient]
  unfold rioStrongMomentExponent
  change gaussianChernoffExponent V t +
      strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V Q t +
        exactStrongMomentTailExponent q Q y t =
    gaussianChernoffExponent (V / a ^ 2) (a * t) +
      strongMomentIntermediateExponent q (V / a ^ 2) 1 (a * t) +
        exactStrongMomentTailExponent q 1 (y / a) (a * t)
  rw [hgaussian, hintermediate, htail]

name: ProbabilityTheory.strongMomentIntermediateExponent_eq_sq_mul_normalized
statement:
theorem strongMomentIntermediateExponent_eq_sq_mul_normalized
    (q : ℕ) (V Q t : ℝ) :
    strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V Q t =
      t ^ 2 * normalizedStrongMomentIntermediateExponent q V Q t
proof:
:= by
  unfold strongMomentIntermediateExponent
    normalizedStrongMomentIntermediateExponent
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  have hk2 : 2 ≤ k := by
    have := (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hk).1
    omega
  have hpow : t ^ k = t ^ 2 * t ^ (k - 2) := by
    rw [← pow_add]
    congr 1
    omega
  rw [hpow]
  ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.monotoneOn_normalizedStrongMomentIntermediateExponent
statement:
theorem monotoneOn_normalizedStrongMomentIntermediateExponent
    (q : ℕ) {V Q : ℝ} (hV : 0 ≤ V) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q) :
    MonotoneOn (normalizedStrongMomentIntermediateExponent q V Q)
      (Set.Ici 0)
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha b hb hab
  unfold normalizedStrongMomentIntermediateExponent
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro k hk
  have hpow : a ^ (k - 2) ≤ b ^ (k - 2) :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ ha hab _
  have hfac : 0 ≤ (k.factorial : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hcoeff : 0 ≤ interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient q V Q k :=
    interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient_nonneg q k hV hQ
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
    (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hpow hfac) hcoeff

name: ProbabilityTheory.one_div_mul_strongMomentIntermediateExponent_le
statement:
theorem one_div_mul_strongMomentIntermediateExponent_le
    (q : ℕ) {V Q a b : ℝ}
    (hV : 0 ≤ V) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    (1 / a) * strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V Q a ≤
      (a / b ^ 2) * strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V Q b
proof:
:= by
  rw [strongMomentIntermediateExponent_eq_sq_mul_normalized,
    strongMomentIntermediateExponent_eq_sq_mul_normalized]
  have hmono := monotoneOn_normalizedStrongMomentIntermediateExponent
    q hV hQ ha.le hb.le hab
  calc
    (1 / a) *
        (a ^ 2 * normalizedStrongMomentIntermediateExponent q V Q a) =
      a * normalizedStrongMomentIntermediateExponent q V Q a := by
        field_simp [ha.ne']
    _ ≤ a * normalizedStrongMomentIntermediateExponent q V Q b :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmono ha.le
    _ = (a / b ^ 2) *
        (b ^ 2 * normalizedStrongMomentIntermediateExponent q V Q b) := by
      field_simp [hb.ne']

name: ProbabilityTheory.div_le_natCast_div_exp_one_of_exp_le_pow
statement:
theorem div_le_natCast_div_exp_one_of_exp_le_pow
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 1 ≤ q) {x y : ℝ}
    (hy : 0 < y) (hscale : Real.exp x ≤ y ^ q) :
    x / y ≤ (q : ℝ) / Real.exp 1
proof:
:= by
  have hlogScale : x ≤ (q : ℝ) * Real.log y := by
    have hlog := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos x) hscale
    simpa only [Real.log_exp, Real.log_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat] using hlog
  have hlogY : Real.log y ≤ y / Real.exp 1 := by
    have h := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos
      (div_pos hy (Real.exp_pos 1))
    rw [Real.log_div hy.ne' (Real.exp_pos 1).ne', Real.log_exp] at h
    linarith
  have hq0 : 0 ≤ (q : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (show 0 ≤ q by omega)
  have hxy : x ≤ (q : ℝ) * (y / Real.exp 1) :=
    hlogScale.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogY hq0)
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hy).2
  calc
    x ≤ (q : ℝ) * (y / Real.exp 1) := hxy
    _ = ((q : ℝ) / Real.exp 1) * y := by ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.one_lt_of_exp_le_pow
statement:
theorem one_lt_of_exp_le_pow
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 1 ≤ q) {x y : ℝ}
    (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hscale : Real.exp x ≤ y ^ q) :
    1 < y
proof:
:= by
  have honePow : 1 < y ^ q := (Real.one_lt_exp_iff.2 hx).trans_le hscale
  exact (one_lt_pow_iff_of_nonneg hy.le (by omega)).mp honePow

name: ProbabilityTheory.scaled_strongMomentIntermediateExponent_le_exp_linear
statement:
theorem scaled_strongMomentIntermediateExponent_le_exp_linear
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) {V y x : ℝ}
    (hV : 0 ≤ V) (hy : 0 < y) (hx : 0 < x)
    (hscale : Real.exp x ≤ y ^ q) :
    (y / x) * strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V 1 (x / y) ≤
      Real.exp 1 * x / 3 *
        strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V 1
          ((q : ℝ) / Real.exp 1)
proof:
:= by
  let a : ℝ := x / y
  let b : ℝ := (q : ℝ) / Real.exp 1
  have ha : 0 < a := div_pos hx hy
  have hb : 0 < b := div_pos (by positivity) (Real.exp_pos 1)
  have hab : a ≤ b := by
    dsimp only [a, b]
    exact div_le_natCast_div_exp_one_of_exp_le_pow q (by omega) hy hscale
  have hnormalized := one_div_mul_strongMomentIntermediateExponent_le
    q hV (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) ha hb hab
  have hy1 : 1 ≤ y :=
    (one_lt_of_exp_le_pow q (by omega) hx hy hscale).le
  have hqReal : (3 : ℝ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hqSq : (9 : ℝ) ≤ (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((q : ℝ) - 3)]
  have hqSqY : (q : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * y :=
    by simpa using
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy1 (sq_nonneg (q : ℝ)))
  have hcore : 3 * Real.exp 1 ≤ (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * y := by
    calc
      3 * Real.exp 1 ≤ 9 := by nlinarith [Real.exp_one_lt_three]
      _ ≤ (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := hqSq
      _ ≤ (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * y := hqSqY
  have hcoeff : a / b ^ 2 ≤ Real.exp 1 * x / 3 := by
    dsimp only [a, b]
    have hq0 : (q : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have he0 : Real.exp 1 ≠ 0 := (Real.exp_pos 1).ne'
    have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := hy.ne'
    field_simp [hq0, he0, hy0]
    nlinarith
  have hmidNonneg : 0 ≤
      strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V 1 b :=
    strongMomentIntermediateExponent_nonneg q hV (by norm_num) hb.le
  have hleft : y / x = 1 / a := by
    dsimp only [a]
    field_simp [hx.ne', hy.ne']
  rw [hleft]
  exact hnormalized.trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcoeff hmidNonneg)

name: ProbabilityTheory.chernoffTransform_rioStrongMomentExponent_one_first_branch_le
statement:
theorem chernoffTransform_rioStrongMomentExponent_one_first_branch_le
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) {V y x : ℝ}
    (hV : 0 < V) (hy : 0 < y) (hx : 0 < x)
    (hscale : Real.exp x ≤ y ^ q) :
    chernoffTransform (rioStrongMomentExponent q V 1 y) x ≤
      Real.sqrt (2 * V * x) +
        (1 + 1 / (q : ℝ)) * y +
          Real.exp 1 * x / 3 *
            strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V 1
              ((q : ℝ) / Real.exp 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hbase := chernoffTransform_rioStrongMomentExponent_le
    q hq hV (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) hy hx (by simpa using hscale)
  have hcorrection := scaled_strongMomentIntermediateExponent_le_exp_linear
    q hq hV.le hy hx hscale
  calc
    chernoffTransform (rioStrongMomentExponent q V 1 y) x ≤
      Real.sqrt (2 * V * x) + y + y / (q : ℝ) +
        (y / x) * strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V 1 (x / y) := hbase
    _ ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * V * x) + y + y / (q : ℝ) +
        Real.exp 1 * x / 3 *
          strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V 1
            ((q : ℝ) / Real.exp 1) :=
      add_le_add le_rfl hcorrection
    _ = Real.sqrt (2 * V * x) +
        (1 + 1 / (q : ℝ)) * y +
          Real.exp 1 * x / 3 *
            strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V 1
              ((q : ℝ) / Real.exp 1) := by ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.chernoffTransform_rioStrongMomentExponent_one_min_le
statement:
theorem chernoffTransform_rioStrongMomentExponent_one_min_le
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) {V y x : ℝ}
    (hV : 0 < V) (hy : 0 < y) (hx : 0 < x)
    (hscale : Real.exp x ≤ y ^ q) :
    chernoffTransform (rioStrongMomentExponent q V 1 y) x ≤
      Real.sqrt (2 * V * x) +
        (1 + 1 / (q : ℝ)) * y +
          x / 3 *
            min
              (Real.exp 1 *
                strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V 1
                  ((q : ℝ) / Real.exp 1))
              (V ^ (-(1 / ((q : ℝ) - 2))))
proof:
:= by
  have hfirst :=
    chernoffTransform_rioStrongMomentExponent_one_first_branch_le
      q hq hV hy hx hscale
  have hsecond :=
    chernoffTransform_rioStrongMomentExponent_one_second_branch_le
      q hq hV hy hx hscale
  by_cases hbranch :
      Real.exp 1 * strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V 1
          ((q : ℝ) / Real.exp 1) ≤
        V ^ (-(1 / ((q : ℝ) - 2)))
  · rw [min_eq_left hbranch]
    convert hfirst using 1
    ring
  · have hreverse : V ^ (-(1 / ((q : ℝ) - 2))) ≤
        Real.exp 1 * strongMomentIntermediateExponent q V 1
          ((q : ℝ) / Real.exp 1) := le_of_not_ge hbranch
    rw [min_eq_right hreverse]
    convert hsecond using 1
    ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.chernoffTransform_rioStrongMomentExponent_one_le
statement:
theorem chernoffTransform_rioStrongMomentExponent_one_le
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) {V y x : ℝ}
    (hV : 0 < V) (hy : 0 < y) (hx : 0 < x)
    (hscale : Real.exp x ≤ y ^ q) :
    chernoffTransform (rioStrongMomentExponent q V 1 y) x ≤
      Real.sqrt (2 * V * x) +
        (1 + 1 / (q : ℝ)) * y + Real.exp 1 * x / 3
proof:
:= by
  have hminimum := chernoffTransform_rioStrongMomentExponent_one_min_le
    q hq hV hy hx hscale
  have hlinear := rio_intermediate_min_linear_correction_le
    q hq hV hx.le
  exact hminimum.trans <| by
    gcongr

name: ProbabilityTheory.chernoffTransform_rioStrongMomentExponent_le_explicit
statement:
theorem chernoffTransform_rioStrongMomentExponent_le_explicit
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) {V Q y x : ℝ}
    (hV : 0 < V) (hQ : 0 < Q) (hy : 0 < y) (hx : 0 < x)
    (hscale : Q * Real.exp x ≤ y ^ q) :
    chernoffTransform (rioStrongMomentExponent q V Q y) x ≤
      Real.sqrt (2 * V * x) +
        (1 + 1 / (q : ℝ)) * y +
          Real.exp 1 * strongMomentQScale q Q * x / 3
proof:
:= by
  let a : ℝ := strongMomentQScale q Q
  let V₀ : ℝ := V / a ^ 2
  let y₀ : ℝ := y / a
  let psi₀ : ℝ → ℝ := rioStrongMomentExponent q V₀ 1 y₀
  have ha : 0 < a := strongMomentQScale_pos hQ
  have hV₀ : 0 < V₀ := div_pos hV (sq_pos_of_pos ha)
  have hy₀ : 0 < y₀ := div_pos hy ha
  have haPow : a ^ q = Q := strongMomentQScale_pow (by omega) hQ
  have hy₀Pow : y₀ ^ q = y ^ q / Q := by
    dsimp only [y₀]
    rw [div_pow, haPow]
  have hscale₀ : Real.exp x ≤ y₀ ^ q := by
    rw [hy₀Pow]
    exact (le_div_iff₀ hQ).2 (by simpa [mul_comm] using hscale)
  have hpsi₀ : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → 0 ≤ psi₀ t := by
    intro t ht
    exact rioStrongMomentExponent_nonneg q hV₀.le
      (by norm_num) hy₀ ht.le
  have hexponent : rioStrongMomentExponent q V Q y =
      fun t => psi₀ (a * t) := by
    funext t
    dsimp only [psi₀, V₀, y₀]
    exact rioStrongMomentExponent_eq_scaled_one q hq hV hQ hy
  have hrescale :
      chernoffTransform (rioStrongMomentExponent q V Q y) x ≤
        a * chernoffTransform psi₀ x := by
    rw [hexponent]
    exact chernoffTransform_comp_mul_le_mul ha hx.le hpsi₀
  have hnormalized : chernoffTransform psi₀ x ≤
      Real.sqrt (2 * V₀ * x) +
        (1 + 1 / (q : ℝ)) * y₀ + Real.exp 1 * x / 3 := by
    dsimp only [psi₀]
    exact chernoffTransform_rioStrongMomentExponent_one_le
      q hq hV₀ hy₀ hx hscale₀
  have hsqrt₀Sq : (Real.sqrt (2 * V₀ * x)) ^ 2 =
      2 * V₀ * x := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hsqrtSq : (Real.sqrt (2 * V * x)) ^ 2 =
      2 * V * x := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hsqrtScale :
      a * Real.sqrt (2 * V₀ * x) = Real.sqrt (2 * V * x) := by
    have hsq : (a * Real.sqrt (2 * V₀ * x)) ^ 2 =
        (Real.sqrt (2 * V * x)) ^ 2 := by
      rw [mul_pow, hsqrt₀Sq, hsqrtSq]
      dsimp only [V₀]
      field_simp [ha.ne']
    have hleft : 0 ≤ a * Real.sqrt (2 * V₀ * x) := by positivity
    have hright : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * V * x) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    nlinarith
  have haMulY₀ : a * y₀ = y := by
    dsimp only [y₀]
    field_simp [ha.ne']
  calc
    chernoffTransform (rioStrongMomentExponent q V Q y) x ≤
        a * chernoffTransform psi₀ x := hrescale
    _ ≤ a * (Real.sqrt (2 * V₀ * x) +
          (1 + 1 / (q : ℝ)) * y₀ + Real.exp 1 * x / 3) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnormalized ha.le
    _ = Real.sqrt (2 * V * x) +
        (1 + 1 / (q : ℝ)) * y +
          Real.exp 1 * strongMomentQScale q Q * x / 3 := by
      calc
        a * (Real.sqrt (2 * V₀ * x) +
            (1 + 1 / (q : ℝ)) * y₀ + Real.exp 1 * x / 3) =
          a * Real.sqrt (2 * V₀ * x) +
            (1 + 1 / (q : ℝ)) * (a * y₀) +
              Real.exp 1 * a * x / 3 := by ring
        _ = Real.sqrt (2 * V * x) +
            (1 + 1 / (q : ℝ)) * y +
              Real.exp 1 * strongMomentQScale q Q * x / 3 := by
          rw [hsqrtScale, haMulY₀]

name: RandomSetTheory.matrix_posDef_of_loewnerLowerBound
statement:
theorem matrix_posDef_of_loewnerLowerBound
    {n : Type*} [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hA : a • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) ≤ A) :
    A.PosDef
proof:
:= by
  have hbase : (a • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)).PosDef :=
    Matrix.PosDef.one.smul ha
  have hdiff : (A - a • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)).PosSemidef := hA
  rw [show A = a • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) + (A - a • 1) by abel]
  exact hbase.add_posSemidef hdiff

name: RandomSetTheory.matrix_isUnit_of_loewnerLowerBound
statement:
theorem matrix_isUnit_of_loewnerLowerBound
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]

    (hA : a • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) ≤ A) :
    IsUnit A
proof:
:=
  (matrix_posDef_of_loewnerLowerBound A ha hA).isUnit

name: RandomSetTheory.matrix_det_pos_of_loewnerLowerBound
statement:
theorem matrix_det_pos_of_loewnerLowerBound
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
