    (hA : a • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) ≤ A) :
    0 < A.det
proof:
:=
  (matrix_posDef_of_loewnerLowerBound A ha hA).det_pos

name: RandomSetTheory.matrix_norm_inv_le_of_loewnerLowerBound
statement:
theorem matrix_norm_inv_le_of_loewnerLowerBound
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Nonempty n]
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hA : a • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) ≤ A) :
    ‖A⁻¹‖ ≤ 1 / a
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : A.PosDef := matrix_posDef_of_loewnerLowerBound A ha hA
  have hspectrum : ∀ x ∈ spectrum ℝ A, a ≤ x := by
    rw [← Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one] at hA
    exact (algebraMap_le_iff_le_spectrum
      hpos.isHermitian.isSelfAdjoint).mp hA
  have hcfc : ‖cfc (fun x : ℝ => x⁻¹) A‖ ≤ 1 / a := by
    apply norm_cfc_le (one_div_nonneg.mpr ha.le)
    intro x hx
    have hxpos : 0 < x := ha.trans_le (hspectrum x hx)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hxpos)]
    simpa only [one_div] using
      one_div_le_one_div_of_le ha (hspectrum x hx)
  rw [cfc_ringInverse_id (R := ℝ) (a := A) hpos.isUnit
    hpos.isHermitian.isSelfAdjoint] at hcfc
  simpa only [Matrix.nonsing_inv_eq_ringInverse] using hcfc

name: RandomSetTheory.matrix_norm_inv_sub_inv_le_of_loewnerLowerBound
statement:
theorem matrix_norm_inv_sub_inv_le_of_loewnerLowerBound
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Nonempty n]
    (A B : Matrix n n ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hA : a • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) ≤ A)
    (hB : a • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) ≤ B) :
    ‖A⁻¹ - B⁻¹‖ ≤ (1 / a) ^ 2 * ‖A - B‖
proof:
:= by
  have hAp : A.PosDef := matrix_posDef_of_loewnerLowerBound A ha hA
  have hBp : B.PosDef := matrix_posDef_of_loewnerLowerBound B ha hB
  rw [Matrix.inv_sub_inv (iff_of_true hAp.isUnit hBp.isUnit)]
  calc
    ‖A⁻¹ * (B - A) * B⁻¹‖ ≤ ‖A⁻¹ * (B - A)‖ * ‖B⁻¹‖ :=
      Matrix.l2_opNorm_mul _ _
    _ ≤ (‖A⁻¹‖ * ‖B - A‖) * ‖B⁻¹‖ := by
      gcongr
      exact Matrix.l2_opNorm_mul _ _
    _ ≤ ((1 / a) * ‖B - A‖) * (1 / a) := by
      gcongr
      · exact matrix_norm_inv_le_of_loewnerLowerBound A ha hA
      · exact matrix_norm_inv_le_of_loewnerLowerBound B ha hB
    _ = (1 / a) ^ 2 * ‖A - B‖ := by
      rw [norm_sub_rev]
      ring

name: RandomSetTheory.inverseCoefficientDomain_matrix_isUnit
statement:
theorem inverseCoefficientDomain_matrix_isUnit
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {x : InverseCoefficientMomentSpace n} {a G : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hx : x ∈ inverseCoefficientDomain (n := n) a G) :
    IsUnit x.fst
proof:
:=
  matrix_isUnit_of_loewnerLowerBound x.fst ha hx.1

name: RandomSetTheory.inverseCoefficientMap_norm_sub_le_add
statement:
theorem inverseCoefficientMap_norm_sub_le_add
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Nonempty n]
    (A B : Matrix n n ℝ) (b c : n → ℝ) {a G : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a)
    (hA : a • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) ≤ A)
    (hB : a • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) ≤ B)
    (hc : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 c‖ ≤ G) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A⁻¹ *ᵥ b - B⁻¹ *ᵥ c)‖ ≤
      (1 / a) * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - c)‖ +
        (G / a ^ 2) * ‖A - B‖
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit : A⁻¹ *ᵥ b - B⁻¹ *ᵥ c =
      A⁻¹ *ᵥ (b - c) + (A⁻¹ - B⁻¹) *ᵥ c := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub, Matrix.sub_mulVec]
    abel
  rw [hsplit, WithLp.toLp_add]
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A⁻¹ *ᵥ (b - c))‖ +
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 ((A⁻¹ - B⁻¹) *ᵥ c)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ (‖A⁻¹‖ * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - c)‖) +
        (‖A⁻¹ - B⁻¹‖ * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 c‖) := by
      gcongr
      · simpa using Matrix.l2_opNorm_mulVec A⁻¹ (WithLp.toLp 2 (b - c))
      · simpa using
          Matrix.l2_opNorm_mulVec (A⁻¹ - B⁻¹) (WithLp.toLp 2 c)
    _ ≤ ((1 / a) * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - c)‖) +
        (((1 / a) ^ 2 * ‖A - B‖) * G) := by
      gcongr
      · exact matrix_norm_inv_le_of_loewnerLowerBound A ha hA
      · exact matrix_norm_inv_sub_inv_le_of_loewnerLowerBound A B ha hA hB
    _ = (1 / a) * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - c)‖ +
        (G / a ^ 2) * ‖A - B‖ := by
      field_simp [ha.ne']

name: RandomSetTheory.weighted_two_le_sqrt_two_max
statement:
private theorem weighted_two_le_sqrt_two_max
    {u v x y : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hv : 0 ≤ v) :
    u * y + v * x ≤
      Real.sqrt 2 * max u v * Real.sqrt (x ^ 2 + y ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hcs := Real.sum_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt
    (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2)) ![u, v] ![y, x]
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.cons_val_zero,
    Matrix.cons_val_one] at hcs
  have huv : Real.sqrt (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt 2 * max u v := by
    simpa [Complex.norm_def, abs_of_nonneg hu, abs_of_nonneg hv, pow_two] using
      Complex.norm_le_sqrt_two_mul_max (⟨u, v⟩ : ℂ)
  calc
    u * y + v * x ≤
        Real.sqrt (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) * Real.sqrt (y ^ 2 + x ^ 2) := hcs
    _ ≤ (Real.sqrt 2 * max u v) * Real.sqrt (y ^ 2 + x ^ 2) := by
      gcongr
    _ = Real.sqrt 2 * max u v * Real.sqrt (x ^ 2 + y ^ 2) := by
      ring_nf

name: RandomSetTheory.inverseCoefficientMap_dist_le
statement:
theorem inverseCoefficientMap_dist_le
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Nonempty n]
    {x y : InverseCoefficientMomentSpace n} {a G : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hG : 0 ≤ G)
    (hx : x ∈ inverseCoefficientDomain (n := n) a G)
    (hy : y ∈ inverseCoefficientDomain (n := n) a G) :
    dist (inverseCoefficientMap x) (inverseCoefficientMap y) ≤
      inverseCoefficientLipschitzConstant a G * dist x y
proof:
:= by
  have hmain := inverseCoefficientMap_norm_sub_le_add
    x.fst y.fst x.snd.ofLp y.snd.ofLp ha hx.1 hy.1 hy.2
  have hbound := hmain.trans
    (weighted_two_le_sqrt_two_max
      (one_div_nonneg.mpr ha.le) (div_nonneg hG (sq_nonneg a)))
  rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]
  change ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (x.fst⁻¹ *ᵥ x.snd) -
    WithLp.toLp 2 (y.fst⁻¹ *ᵥ y.snd)‖ ≤ _
  rw [← WithLp.toLp_sub]
  rw [WithLp.prod_norm_eq_of_L2]
  change _ ≤ inverseCoefficientLipschitzConstant a G * Real.sqrt
    (‖x.fst - y.fst‖ ^ 2 + ‖x.snd - y.snd‖ ^ 2)
  simpa only [inverseCoefficientLipschitzConstant, WithLp.ofLp_sub,
    WithLp.ofLp_toLp, WithLp.toLp_sub] using hbound

name: RandomSetTheory.inverseCoefficientMap_lipschitzOnWith
statement:
theorem inverseCoefficientMap_lipschitzOnWith
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Nonempty n]
    {a G : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hG : 0 ≤ G) :
    LipschitzOnWith (inverseCoefficientLipschitzNN a G ha)
      inverseCoefficientMap (inverseCoefficientDomain (n := n) a G)
proof:
:= by
  apply LipschitzOnWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro x hx y hy
  change dist (inverseCoefficientMap x) (inverseCoefficientMap y) ≤
    inverseCoefficientLipschitzConstant a G * dist x y
  exact inverseCoefficientMap_dist_le ha hG hx hy

name: RandomSetTheory.inverseCoefficientMap_continuousOn
statement:
theorem inverseCoefficientMap_continuousOn
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Nonempty n]
    {a G : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hG : 0 ≤ G) :
    ContinuousOn inverseCoefficientMap
      (inverseCoefficientDomain (n := n) a G)
proof:
:=
  (inverseCoefficientMap_lipschitzOnWith ha hG).continuousOn

name: RandomSetTheory.inverseCoefficientMap_norm_le
statement:
theorem inverseCoefficientMap_norm_le
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Nonempty n]
    {x : InverseCoefficientMomentSpace n} {a G : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a)
    (hx : x ∈ inverseCoefficientDomain (n := n) a G) :
    ‖inverseCoefficientMap x‖ ≤ G / a
proof:
:= by
  change ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (x.fst⁻¹ *ᵥ x.snd)‖ ≤ G / a
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖x.fst⁻¹‖ * ‖x.snd‖ := by
      simpa using Matrix.l2_opNorm_mulVec x.fst⁻¹ x.snd
    _ ≤ (1 / a) * G := by
      exact mul_le_mul
        (matrix_norm_inv_le_of_loewnerLowerBound x.fst ha hx.1)
        hx.2 (norm_nonneg _) (one_div_nonneg.mpr ha.le)
    _ = G / a := by ring

name: RandomSetTheory.inverseCoefficientImage_subset_closedBall
statement:
theorem inverseCoefficientImage_subset_closedBall
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Nonempty n]
    {a G : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    {K : Set (InverseCoefficientMomentSpace n)}
    (hKD : K ⊆ inverseCoefficientDomain (n := n) a G) :
    inverseCoefficientImage K ⊆ closedBall 0 (G / a)
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨x, hxK, rfl⟩
  simpa [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using
    inverseCoefficientMap_norm_le ha (hKD hxK)

name: RandomSetTheory.inverseCoefficientImage_nonempty
statement:
theorem inverseCoefficientImage_nonempty
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {K : Set (InverseCoefficientMomentSpace n)} (hK : K.Nonempty) :
    (inverseCoefficientImage K).Nonempty
proof:
:=
  hK.image inverseCoefficientMap

name: RandomSetTheory.inverseCoefficientImage_isCompact
statement:
theorem inverseCoefficientImage_isCompact
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Nonempty n]
    {a G : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hG : 0 ≤ G)
    {K : Set (InverseCoefficientMomentSpace n)}
    (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hKD : K ⊆ inverseCoefficientDomain (n := n) a G) :
    IsCompact (inverseCoefficientImage K)
proof:
:= by
  exact hK.image_of_continuousOn
    ((inverseCoefficientMap_continuousOn ha hG).mono hKD)

name: RandomSetTheory.inverseCoefficientImage_closedConvexHull_isCompact
statement:
theorem inverseCoefficientImage_closedConvexHull_isCompact
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Nonempty n]
    {a G : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hG : 0 ≤ G)
    {K : Set (InverseCoefficientMomentSpace n)}
    (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hKD : K ⊆ inverseCoefficientDomain (n := n) a G) :
    IsCompact (closedConvexHull ℝ (inverseCoefficientImage K))
proof:
:=
  closedConvexHull_compact
    (inverseCoefficientImage_isCompact ha hG hK hKD)

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_inverseCoefficientImage_le
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_inverseCoefficientImage_le
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Nonempty n]
    {a G : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hG : 0 ≤ G)
    {K L : Set (InverseCoefficientMomentSpace n)}
    (hK : IsCompact K) (hL : IsCompact L)
    (hKne : K.Nonempty) (hLne : L.Nonempty)
    (hKD : K ⊆ inverseCoefficientDomain (n := n) a G)
    (hLD : L ⊆ inverseCoefficientDomain (n := n) a G) :
    hausdorffDist (inverseCoefficientImage K) (inverseCoefficientImage L) ≤
      inverseCoefficientLipschitzConstant a G * hausdorffDist K L
proof:
:= by
  exact hausdorffDist_image_le_of_lipschitzOnWith
    ((inverseCoefficientMap_lipschitzOnWith ha hG).mono
      (union_subset hKD hLD)) hK hL hKne hLne

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_closedConvexHull_inverseCoefficientImage_le
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_closedConvexHull_inverseCoefficientImage_le
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Nonempty n]
    {a G : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hG : 0 ≤ G)
    {K L : Set (InverseCoefficientMomentSpace n)}
    (hK : IsCompact K) (hL : IsCompact L)
    (hKne : K.Nonempty) (hLne : L.Nonempty)
    (hKD : K ⊆ inverseCoefficientDomain (n := n) a G)
    (hLD : L ⊆ inverseCoefficientDomain (n := n) a G) :
    hausdorffDist
        (closedConvexHull ℝ (inverseCoefficientImage K))
        (closedConvexHull ℝ (inverseCoefficientImage L)) ≤
      inverseCoefficientLipschitzConstant a G * hausdorffDist K L
proof:
:= by
  exact hausdorffDist_closedConvexHull_image_le_of_lipschitzOnWith
    ((inverseCoefficientMap_lipschitzOnWith ha hG).mono
      (union_subset hKD hLD)) hK hL hKne hLne

name: RandomSetTheory.tendsto_hausdorffDist_inverseCoefficientImage
statement:
theorem tendsto_hausdorffDist_inverseCoefficientImage
    {n ι : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Nonempty n]
    {l : Filter ι} {a G : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hG : 0 ≤ G)
    {K : ι → Set (InverseCoefficientMomentSpace n)}
    {L : Set (InverseCoefficientMomentSpace n)}
    (hK : ∀ i, IsCompact (K i)) (hL : IsCompact L)
    (hKne : ∀ i, (K i).Nonempty) (hLne : L.Nonempty)
    (hKD : ∀ i, K i ⊆ inverseCoefficientDomain (n := n) a G)
    (hLD : L ⊆ inverseCoefficientDomain (n := n) a G)
    (hKL : Tendsto (fun i => hausdorffDist (K i) L) l (nhds 0)) :
    Tendsto
      (fun i => hausdorffDist (inverseCoefficientImage (K i))
        (inverseCoefficientImage L)) l (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply tendsto_hausdorffDist_image_of_lipschitzOnWith
    (c := inverseCoefficientLipschitzNN a G ha)
  · intro i
    exact (inverseCoefficientMap_lipschitzOnWith ha hG).mono
      (union_subset (hKD i) hLD)
  · exact hK
  · exact hL
  · exact hKne
  · exact hLne
  · exact hKL

name: RandomSetTheory.tendsto_hausdorffDist_closedConvexHull_inverseCoefficientImage
statement:
theorem tendsto_hausdorffDist_closedConvexHull_inverseCoefficientImage
    {n ι : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Nonempty n]
    {l : Filter ι} {a G : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hG : 0 ≤ G)
    {K : ι → Set (InverseCoefficientMomentSpace n)}
    {L : Set (InverseCoefficientMomentSpace n)}
    (hK : ∀ i, IsCompact (K i)) (hL : IsCompact L)
    (hKne : ∀ i, (K i).Nonempty) (hLne : L.Nonempty)
    (hKD : ∀ i, K i ⊆ inverseCoefficientDomain (n := n) a G)
    (hLD : L ⊆ inverseCoefficientDomain (n := n) a G)
    (hKL : Tendsto (fun i => hausdorffDist (K i) L) l (nhds 0)) :
    Tendsto
      (fun i => hausdorffDist
        (closedConvexHull ℝ (inverseCoefficientImage (K i)))
        (closedConvexHull ℝ (inverseCoefficientImage L))) l (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply tendsto_hausdorffDist_closedConvexHull_image_of_lipschitzOnWith
    (c := inverseCoefficientLipschitzNN a G ha)
  · intro i
    exact (inverseCoefficientMap_lipschitzOnWith ha hG).mono
      (union_subset (hKD i) hLD)
  · exact hK
  · exact hL
  · exact hKne
  · exact hLne
  · exact hKL

name: ProbabilityTheory.continuous_continuousMapDenseEvaluation
statement:
theorem continuous_continuousMapDenseEvaluation :
    Continuous (continuousMapDenseEvaluation K)
proof:
:= by
  apply continuous_pi
  intro n
  exact continuous_eval_const (denseSeq K n)

name: ProbabilityTheory.injective_continuousMapDenseEvaluation
statement:
theorem injective_continuousMapDenseEvaluation :
    Function.Injective (continuousMapDenseEvaluation K)
proof:
:= by
  intro f g hfg
  apply DFunLike.ext'
  exact f.continuous.ext_on (denseRange_denseSeq K) g.continuous
    (Set.eqOn_range.mpr hfg)

name: ProbabilityTheory.measurable_continuousMap_of_apply
statement:
theorem measurable_continuousMap_of_apply
    [MeasurableSpace C(K, ℝ)] [BorelSpace C(K, ℝ)]
    (f : Omega → C(K, ℝ))
    (hf : ∀ x : K, Measurable (fun omega ↦ f omega x)) :
    Measurable f
proof:
:= by
  let e : C(K, ℝ) → (ℕ → ℝ) := continuousMapDenseEvaluation K
  have he : MeasurableEmbedding e :=
    continuous_continuousMapDenseEvaluation.measurableEmbedding
      injective_continuousMapDenseEvaluation
  rw [← he.measurable_comp_iff]
  exact measurable_pi_iff.mpr fun n ↦ hf (denseSeq K n)

name: ProbabilityTheory.aemeasurable_continuousMap_of_apply
statement:
theorem aemeasurable_continuousMap_of_apply
    [MeasurableSpace C(K, ℝ)] [BorelSpace C(K, ℝ)]
    {mu : Measure Omega} (f : Omega → C(K, ℝ))
    (hf : ∀ x : K, AEMeasurable (fun omega ↦ f omega x) mu) :
    AEMeasurable f mu
proof:
:= by
  let e : C(K, ℝ) → (ℕ → ℝ) := continuousMapDenseEvaluation K
  have he : MeasurableEmbedding e :=
    continuous_continuousMapDenseEvaluation.measurableEmbedding
      injective_continuousMapDenseEvaluation
  rw [← he.aemeasurable_comp_iff]
  exact aemeasurable_pi_iff.mpr fun n ↦ hf (denseSeq K n)

statement: lemma mem_support {S : RandomSet Ω X} {x : X} : x ∈ S.support ↔ ∃ ω, x ∈ S ω

statement: lemma mem_range_iff {S : RandomSet Ω X} {x : X} : x ∈ S.range ↔ ∃ ω, x ∈ S ω

name: RandomSet.isEffrosMeasurable_const
statement:
theorem isEffrosMeasurable_const (K : Set X) :
    IsEffrosMeasurable (fun _ : Ω => K)
proof:
:= by
  intro U _
  by_cases h : (K ∩ U).Nonempty
  · simp [h]
  · simp [h]

name: RandomSet.isEffrosMeasurable_empty
statement:
theorem isEffrosMeasurable_empty :
    IsEffrosMeasurable (fun _ : Ω => (∅ : Set X))
proof:
:=
  isEffrosMeasurable_const ∅

name: RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable.union
proof:
:= by
  intro U hU
  have hEq : {ω | ((S ω ∪ T ω) ∩ U).Nonempty} =
      {ω | (S ω ∩ U).Nonempty} ∪ {ω | (T ω ∩ U).Nonempty} := by
    ext ω
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_union]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, hx, hxU⟩
      rcases hx with hxS | hxT
      · exact Or.inl ⟨x, hxS, hxU⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨x, hxT, hxU⟩
    · rintro (⟨x, hxS, hxU⟩ | ⟨x, hxT, hxU⟩)
      · exact ⟨x, Or.inl hxS, hxU⟩
      · exact ⟨x, Or.inr hxT, hxU⟩
  rw [hEq]
  exact (hS U hU).union (hT U hU)

name: RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable.congr
proof:
:= by
  intro U hU
  convert hS U hU using 1
  ext ω
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  rw [← hST ω]

name: RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable.image
statement:
theorem IsEffrosMeasurable.image {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y]
    {S : Ω → Set X} (hS : IsEffrosMeasurable S) {f : X → Y}
    (hf : Continuous f) :
    IsEffrosMeasurable (fun ω => f '' S ω)
proof:
:= by
  intro U hU
  have hEq : {ω | ((f '' S ω) ∩ U).Nonempty} =
      {ω | (S ω ∩ f ⁻¹' U).Nonempty} := by
    ext ω
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, ⟨x, hxS, rfl⟩, hfxU⟩
      exact ⟨x, hxS, hfxU⟩
    · rintro ⟨x, hxS, hfxU⟩
      exact ⟨f x, ⟨x, hxS, rfl⟩, hfxU⟩
  rw [hEq]
  exact hS (f ⁻¹' U) (hf.isOpen_preimage U hU)

@[simp] theorem const_apply (K : Set X) (hK : IsClosed K) (ω : Ω) :

statement: @[simp] theorem empty_apply (ω : Ω) : (empty : EffrosRandomClosedSet Ω X) ω = ∅

name: RandomSetTheory.iteratedUnionDifference_nil
statement:
@[simp] theorem iteratedUnionDifference_nil (F : Set X -> Real) (K : Set X) :
    iteratedUnionDifference [] F K = F K
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: RandomSetTheory.iteratedUnionDifference_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem iteratedUnionDifference_cons (A : Set X)
    (tests : List (Set X)) (F : Set X -> Real) (K : Set X) :
    iteratedUnionDifference (A :: tests) F K =
      iteratedUnionDifference tests F K -
        iteratedUnionDifference tests F (K ∪ A)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: RandomSetTheory.hitEveryEvent_nil
statement:
@[simp] theorem hitEveryEvent_nil (S : Omega -> Set X) :
    hitEveryEvent S [] = Set.univ
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: RandomSetTheory.hitEveryEvent_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem hitEveryEvent_cons (S : Omega -> Set X) (A : Set X)
    (tests : List (Set X)) :
    hitEveryEvent S (A :: tests) = hitEvent S A ∩ hitEveryEvent S tests
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: RandomSetTheory.mem_hitEveryEvent
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_hitEveryEvent {S : Omega -> Set X}
    {tests : List (Set X)} {omega : Omega} :
    omega ∈ hitEveryEvent S tests <->
      ∀ A ∈ tests, omega ∈ hitEvent S A
proof:
:= by
  induction tests with
  | nil => simp
  | cons A tests ih => simp [hitEveryEvent, ih]

name: RandomSetTheory.mem_alternationWitnessEvent
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_alternationWitnessEvent {S : Omega -> Set X}
    {K : Set X} {tests : List (Set X)} {omega : Omega} :
    omega ∈ alternationWitnessEvent S K tests <->
      omega ∈ avoidEvent S K ∧
        ∀ A ∈ tests, omega ∈ hitEvent S A
proof:
:= by
  simp [alternationWitnessEvent]

name: RandomSetTheory.alternationWitnessEvent_union_subset
statement:
theorem alternationWitnessEvent_union_subset (S : Omega -> Set X)
    (K A : Set X) (tests : List (Set X)) :
    alternationWitnessEvent S (K ∪ A) tests ⊆
      alternationWitnessEvent S K tests
proof:
:= by
  intro omega homega
  rcases homega with ⟨havoid, hall⟩
  exact ⟨(avoidEvent_antitone (Set.subset_union_left : K ⊆ K ∪ A)) havoid, hall⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.alternationWitnessEvent_sdiff_union
statement:
theorem alternationWitnessEvent_sdiff_union (S : Omega -> Set X)
    (K A : Set X) (tests : List (Set X)) :
    alternationWitnessEvent S K tests \
        alternationWitnessEvent S (K ∪ A) tests =
      alternationWitnessEvent S K (A :: tests)
proof:
:= by
  ext omega
  simp only [alternationWitnessEvent, hitEveryEvent_cons,
    Set.mem_sdiff, Set.mem_inter_iff, mem_avoidEvent, mem_hitEvent]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨hKavoid, hTailHit⟩, hnot⟩
    refine ⟨hKavoid, ?_, hTailHit⟩
    by_contra hSA
    apply hnot
    refine ⟨?_, hTailHit⟩
    intro hhitUnion
    rcases hhitUnion with ⟨x, hxS, hxK | hxA⟩
    · exact hKavoid ⟨x, hxS, hxK⟩
    · exact hSA ⟨x, hxS, hxA⟩
  · rintro ⟨hKavoid, hAhit, hTailHit⟩
    refine ⟨⟨hKavoid, hTailHit⟩, ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨hKAavoid, _⟩
    exact hKAavoid (by
      rcases hAhit with ⟨x, hxS, hxA⟩
      exact ⟨x, hxS, Or.inr hxA⟩)

name: RandomSetTheory.measurableSet_hitEveryEvent
proof:
:= by
  induction tests with
  | nil => simp
  | cons A tests ih =>
      exact (h A (by simp)).inter (ih (fun B hB => h B (by simp [hB])))

name: RandomSetTheory.measurableSet_alternationWitnessEvent
proof:
:= by
  exact hK.compl.inter (measurableSet_hitEveryEvent h)

name: RandomSetTheory.capacityFunctionalReal_eq_toReal
statement:
@[simp] theorem capacityFunctionalReal_eq_toReal (mu : Measure Omega)
    (S : Omega -> Set X) (K : Set X) :
    capacityFunctionalReal mu S K = (capacityFunctional mu S K).toReal
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: RandomSetTheory.avoidanceFunctionalReal_eq_toReal
statement:
@[simp] theorem avoidanceFunctionalReal_eq_toReal (mu : Measure Omega)
    (S : Omega -> Set X) (K : Set X) :
    avoidanceFunctionalReal mu S K = (avoidanceFunctional mu S K).toReal
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: RandomSetTheory.iteratedUnionDifference_avoidanceFunctionalReal_eq
statement:
theorem iteratedUnionDifference_avoidanceFunctionalReal_eq
    (mu : Measure Omega) [IsFiniteMeasure mu] (S : Omega -> Set X)
    (K : Set X) (tests : List (Set X))
    (hK : MeasurableSet (hitEvent S K))
    (hTests : ∀ A ∈ tests, MeasurableSet (hitEvent S A)) :
    iteratedUnionDifference tests (avoidanceFunctionalReal mu S) K =
      mu.real (alternationWitnessEvent S K tests)
proof:
:= by
  induction tests generalizing K with
  | nil =>
      simp [iteratedUnionDifference, avoidanceFunctionalReal,
        alternationWitnessEvent]
  | cons A tests ih =>
      have hA : MeasurableSet (hitEvent S A) := hTests A (by simp)
      have hTail : ∀ B ∈ tests, MeasurableSet (hitEvent S B) := by
        intro B hB
        exact hTests B (by simp [hB])
      have hKUnion : MeasurableSet (hitEvent S (K ∪ A)) := by
        rw [hitEvent_union]
        exact hK.union hA
      rw [iteratedUnionDifference_cons,
        ih K hK hTail, ih (K ∪ A) hKUnion hTail]
      let E : Set Omega := alternationWitnessEvent S K tests
      let F : Set Omega := alternationWitnessEvent S (K ∪ A) tests
      have hFE : F ⊆ E :=
        alternationWitnessEvent_union_subset S K A tests
      have hFmeas : MeasurableSet F :=
        measurableSet_alternationWitnessEvent hKUnion hTail
      rw [← measureReal_sdiff hFE hFmeas]
      exact congrArg mu.real (alternationWitnessEvent_sdiff_union S K A tests)

name: RandomSetTheory.avoidanceFunctionalReal_completeMonotonicity
statement:
theorem avoidanceFunctionalReal_completeMonotonicity
    (mu : Measure Omega) [IsFiniteMeasure mu] (S : Omega -> Set X)
    (K : Set X) (tests : List (Set X))
    (hK : MeasurableSet (hitEvent S K))
    (hTests : ∀ A ∈ tests, MeasurableSet (hitEvent S A)) :
    0 ≤ iteratedUnionDifference tests (avoidanceFunctionalReal mu S) K
proof:
:= by
  rw [iteratedUnionDifference_avoidanceFunctionalReal_eq mu S K tests hK hTests]
  exact measureReal_nonneg

name: RandomSetTheory.capacityFunctionalReal_add_avoidanceFunctionalReal
statement:
theorem capacityFunctionalReal_add_avoidanceFunctionalReal
    (mu : Measure Omega) [IsFiniteMeasure mu] (S : Omega -> Set X)
    (K : Set X) (hK : MeasurableSet (hitEvent S K)) :
    capacityFunctionalReal mu S K + avoidanceFunctionalReal mu S K =
      mu.real Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [capacityFunctionalReal, avoidanceFunctionalReal,
    avoidEvent_eq_compl] using
      measureReal_add_measureReal_compl (μ := mu) hK

name: RandomSetTheory.iteratedUnionDifference_capacityFunctionalReal_eq
statement:
theorem iteratedUnionDifference_capacityFunctionalReal_eq
    (mu : Measure Omega) [IsFiniteMeasure mu] (S : Omega -> Set X)
    (K : Set X) (tests : List (Set X))
    (hK : MeasurableSet (hitEvent S K))
    (hTests : ∀ A ∈ tests, MeasurableSet (hitEvent S A)) :
    iteratedUnionDifference tests (capacityFunctionalReal mu S) K =
      (if tests = [] then mu.real Set.univ else 0) -
        mu.real (alternationWitnessEvent S K tests)
proof:
:= by
  induction tests generalizing K with
  | nil =>
      have hdual :=
        capacityFunctionalReal_add_avoidanceFunctionalReal mu S K hK
      simp only [iteratedUnionDifference_nil, if_pos]
      simp only [alternationWitnessEvent, hitEveryEvent_nil,
        Set.inter_univ, avoidanceFunctionalReal] at hdual ⊢
      linarith
  | cons A tests ih =>
      have hA : MeasurableSet (hitEvent S A) := hTests A (by simp)
      have hTail : ∀ B ∈ tests, MeasurableSet (hitEvent S B) := by
        intro B hB
        exact hTests B (by simp [hB])
      have hKUnion : MeasurableSet (hitEvent S (K ∪ A)) := by
        rw [hitEvent_union]
        exact hK.union hA
      rw [iteratedUnionDifference_cons,
        ih K hK hTail, ih (K ∪ A) hKUnion hTail]
      let E : Set Omega := alternationWitnessEvent S K tests
      let F : Set Omega := alternationWitnessEvent S (K ∪ A) tests
      have hFE : F ⊆ E :=
        alternationWitnessEvent_union_subset S K A tests
      have hFmeas : MeasurableSet F :=
        measurableSet_alternationWitnessEvent hKUnion hTail
      have hmeasure :
          mu.real E - mu.real F =
            mu.real (alternationWitnessEvent S K (A :: tests)) := by
        rw [← measureReal_sdiff hFE hFmeas]
        exact congrArg mu.real (alternationWitnessEvent_sdiff_union S K A tests)
      simp only [List.cons_ne_nil, if_false]
      linarith

name: RandomSetTheory.iteratedUnionDifference_capacityFunctionalReal_eq_neg
statement:
theorem iteratedUnionDifference_capacityFunctionalReal_eq_neg
    (mu : Measure Omega) [IsFiniteMeasure mu] (S : Omega -> Set X)
    (K : Set X) (tests : List (Set X)) (htests : tests ≠ [])
    (hK : MeasurableSet (hitEvent S K))
    (hTests : ∀ A ∈ tests, MeasurableSet (hitEvent S A)) :
    iteratedUnionDifference tests (capacityFunctionalReal mu S) K =
      -mu.real (alternationWitnessEvent S K tests)
proof:
:= by
  rw [iteratedUnionDifference_capacityFunctionalReal_eq
    mu S K tests hK hTests, if_neg htests]
  ring

name: RandomSetTheory.capacityFunctionalReal_completeAlternation
statement:
theorem capacityFunctionalReal_completeAlternation
    (mu : Measure Omega) [IsFiniteMeasure mu] (S : Omega -> Set X)
    (K : Set X) (tests : List (Set X)) (htests : tests ≠ [])
    (hK : MeasurableSet (hitEvent S K))
    (hTests : ∀ A ∈ tests, MeasurableSet (hitEvent S A)) :
    iteratedUnionDifference tests (capacityFunctionalReal mu S) K ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [iteratedUnionDifference_capacityFunctionalReal_eq_neg
    mu S K tests htests hK hTests]
  exact neg_nonpos.mpr measureReal_nonneg

name: RandomSetTheory.iteratedUnionDifference_capacity_eq_neg_avoidance
statement:
theorem iteratedUnionDifference_capacity_eq_neg_avoidance
    (mu : Measure Omega) [IsFiniteMeasure mu] (S : Omega -> Set X)
    (K : Set X) (tests : List (Set X)) (htests : tests ≠ [])
    (hK : MeasurableSet (hitEvent S K))
    (hTests : ∀ A ∈ tests, MeasurableSet (hitEvent S A)) :
    iteratedUnionDifference tests (capacityFunctionalReal mu S) K =
      -iteratedUnionDifference tests (avoidanceFunctionalReal mu S) K
proof:
:= by
  rw [iteratedUnionDifference_capacityFunctionalReal_eq_neg
      mu S K tests htests hK hTests,
    iteratedUnionDifference_avoidanceFunctionalReal_eq
      mu S K tests hK hTests]

name: RandomSetTheory.capacityFunctionalReal_completeAlternation_compact_of_effros
statement:
theorem capacityFunctionalReal_completeAlternation_compact_of_effros
    (mu : Measure Omega) [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    {S : Omega -> Set X} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hSclosed : ∀ omega, IsClosed (S omega))
    (K : Set X) (tests : List (Set X)) (htests : tests ≠ [])
    (hK : IsCompact K) (hTests : ∀ A ∈ tests, IsCompact A) :
    iteratedUnionDifference tests (capacityFunctionalReal mu S) K ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  apply capacityFunctionalReal_completeAlternation mu S K tests htests
  · exact measurableSet_hitEvent_compact hS hSclosed hK
  · intro A hA
    exact measurableSet_hitEvent_compact hS hSclosed (hTests A hA)

name: RandomSetTheory.iteratedUnionDifference_avoidance_compact_of_effros_eq
statement:
theorem iteratedUnionDifference_avoidance_compact_of_effros_eq
    (mu : Measure Omega) [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    {S : Omega -> Set X} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hSclosed : ∀ omega, IsClosed (S omega))
    (K : Set X) (tests : List (Set X))
    (hK : IsCompact K) (hTests : ∀ A ∈ tests, IsCompact A) :
    iteratedUnionDifference tests (avoidanceFunctionalReal mu S) K =
      mu.real (alternationWitnessEvent S K tests)
proof:
:= by
  apply iteratedUnionDifference_avoidanceFunctionalReal_eq mu S K tests
  · exact measurableSet_hitEvent_compact hS hSclosed hK
  · intro A hA
    exact measurableSet_hitEvent_compact hS hSclosed (hTests A hA)

name: RandomSetTheory.setValuedZeroSet_eq_zeroLevel
statement:
theorem setValuedZeroSet_eq_zeroLevel
    {Θ E : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace E] [Zero E]
    (G : Θ → Set E) (hclosed : ∀ θ, IsClosed (G θ))
    (hne : ∀ θ, (G θ).Nonempty) :
    setValuedZeroSet G = {θ | infDist 0 (G θ) = 0}
proof:
:= by
  ext θ
  change 0 ∈ G θ ↔ infDist 0 (G θ) = 0
  exact (hclosed θ).mem_iff_infDist_zero (hne θ)

name: RandomSetTheory.enlargedSetValuedZeroSet_zero
statement:
theorem enlargedSetValuedZeroSet_zero
    {Θ E : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace E] [Zero E]
    (G : Θ → Set E) (hclosed : ∀ θ, IsClosed (G θ))
    (hne : ∀ θ, (G θ).Nonempty) :
    enlargedSetValuedZeroSet G 0 = setValuedZeroSet G
proof:
:= by
  ext θ
  change infDist 0 (G θ) ≤ 0 ↔ 0 ∈ G θ
  rw [(hclosed θ).mem_iff_infDist_zero (hne θ)]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact le_antisymm h infDist_nonneg
  · intro h
    exact h.le

name: RandomSetTheory.enlargedSetValuedZeroSet_mono

name: RandomSetTheory.setValuedZeroSet_subset_enlarged_of_nonneg

    setValuedZeroSet G ⊆ enlargedSetValuedZeroSet G τ
proof:
:= by
  intro θ hθ
  change 0 ∈ G θ at hθ
  change infDist 0 (G θ) ≤ τ
  rw [infDist_zero_of_mem hθ]

name: RandomSetTheory.HausdorffContinuousAt.continuousAt_infDist
statement:
theorem HausdorffContinuousAt.continuousAt_infDist
    {Θ E : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Θ] [PseudoMetricSpace E]
    {G : Θ → Set E} {θ : Θ} (hG : HausdorffContinuousAt G θ)
    (x : E)
    (hfin : ∀ᶠ η in 𝓝 θ, hausdorffEDist (G η) (G θ) ≠ ⊤) :
    ContinuousAt (fun η => infDist x (G η)) θ
proof:
:= by
  change Tendsto (fun η => infDist x (G η)) (𝓝 θ)
    (𝓝 (infDist x (G θ)))
  rw [Metric.tendsto_nhds]
  intro ε hε
  have hhaus := (Metric.tendsto_nhds.1 hG) ε hε
  filter_upwards [hhaus, hfin] with η hη hηfin
  have hη' : hausdorffDist (G η) (G θ) < ε := by
    simpa [Real.dist_eq, abs_of_nonneg hausdorffDist_nonneg] using hη
  have hstab := abs_infDist_sub_infDist_le_hausdorffDist
    x (G η) (G θ) hηfin
  simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hstab.trans_lt hη'

  intro θ
  exact (hG θ).continuousAt_infDist x (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun η => hfin η θ))

    (hne η) (hne θ) (hcompact η).isBounded (hcompact θ).isBounded

name: ProbabilityTheory.empiricalNormalizedEnvelope_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem empiricalNormalizedEnvelope_apply
    (n : Nat) (A : Z → Real) (z : Z) :
    empiricalNormalizedEnvelope n A z = A z / (n : Real)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [empiricalNormalizedEnvelope, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]

name: ProbabilityTheory.memLp_empiricalNormalizedEnvelope
statement:
theorem memLp_empiricalNormalizedEnvelope
    (n : Nat) (A : Z → Real) (q : ENNReal) (hA : MemLp A q nu) :
    MemLp (empiricalNormalizedEnvelope n A) q nu
proof:
:= by
  change MemLp (fun z ↦ ((n : Real)⁻¹) * A z) q nu
  exact hA.const_mul ((n : Real)⁻¹)

name: ProbabilityTheory.empiricalNormalizedEnvelope_nonneg
statement:
theorem empiricalNormalizedEnvelope_nonneg
    (n : Nat) (A : Z → Real)
    (hA : forall z, 0 ≤ A z) (z : Z) :
    0 ≤ empiricalNormalizedEnvelope n A z
proof:
:= by
  exact mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg n)) (hA z)

name: ProbabilityTheory.replaceOneCenteredEnvelope_const_mul
statement:
theorem replaceOneCenteredEnvelope_const_mul
    (c : Real) (A : Z → Real) (z : Z) :
    replaceOneCenteredEnvelope nu (fun z ↦ c * A z) z =
      c * replaceOneCenteredEnvelope nu A z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [replaceOneCenteredEnvelope, integral_const_mul]
  ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.replaceOneCenteredMoment_const_mul
statement:
theorem replaceOneCenteredMoment_const_mul
    (c : Real) (A : Z → Real) (k : Nat) :
    replaceOneCenteredMoment nu (fun z ↦ c * A z) k =
      c ^ k * replaceOneCenteredMoment nu A k
proof:
:= by
  unfold replaceOneCenteredMoment
  simp_rw [replaceOneCenteredEnvelope_const_mul (nu := nu), mul_pow,
    integral_const_mul]

name: ProbabilityTheory.replaceOneCenteredMoment_empiricalNormalizedEnvelope
statement:
theorem replaceOneCenteredMoment_empiricalNormalizedEnvelope
    (n k : Nat) (A : Z → Real) :
    replaceOneCenteredMoment nu (empiricalNormalizedEnvelope n A) k =
      ((n : Real)⁻¹) ^ k * replaceOneCenteredMoment nu A k
proof:
:= by
  change replaceOneCenteredMoment nu (fun z ↦ ((n : Real)⁻¹) * A z) k = _
  exact replaceOneCenteredMoment_const_mul (nu := nu) ((n : Real)⁻¹) A k

name: ProbabilityTheory.replaceOneCenteredMoment_empiricalNormalizedEnvelope_div
statement:
theorem replaceOneCenteredMoment_empiricalNormalizedEnvelope_div
    (n k : Nat) (A : Z → Real) :
    replaceOneCenteredMoment nu (empiricalNormalizedEnvelope n A) k =
      replaceOneCenteredMoment nu A k / (n : Real) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [replaceOneCenteredMoment_empiricalNormalizedEnvelope,
    div_eq_mul_inv, inv_pow]
  ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.replaceOneCenteredMoment_le_two_pow_mul_integral_pow
statement:
theorem replaceOneCenteredMoment_le_two_pow_mul_integral_pow
    [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (A : Z → Real) (k : Nat) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (hAk : MemLp A k nu) (hA : forall z, 0 ≤ A z) :
    replaceOneCenteredMoment nu A k ≤
      (2 : Real) ^ k * ∫ z, A z ^ k ∂nu
proof:
:= by
  have hone : (1 : ENNReal) ≤ (k : ENNReal) := by
    exact_mod_cast hk
  have hAint : Integrable A nu :=
    (hAk.mono_exponent hone).integrable (by norm_num)
  have hpowInt : Integrable (fun z ↦ A z ^ k) nu := by
    have hnorm := hAk.integrable_norm_pow'
    convert hnorm using 1
    funext z
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hA z)]
  have hmeanNonneg : 0 ≤ ∫ z, A z ∂nu := integral_nonneg hA
  have hJensen : (∫ z, A z ∂nu) ^ k ≤ ∫ z, A z ^ k ∂nu := by
    have h := (convexOn_pow k).map_integral_le
      (continuousOn_pow k) isClosed_Ici (ae_of_all nu hA)
      hAint hpowInt
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply] using h
  have hleft : Integrable
      (fun z ↦ replaceOneCenteredEnvelope nu A z ^ k) nu :=
    integrable_pow_replaceOneCenteredEnvelope A k k le_rfl hAk hA
  have hright : Integrable (fun z ↦
      (2 : Real) ^ (k - 1) *
        (A z ^ k + (∫ z', A z' ∂nu) ^ k)) nu :=
    (hpowInt.add (integrable_const _)).const_mul _
  unfold replaceOneCenteredMoment
  calc
    (∫ z, replaceOneCenteredEnvelope nu A z ^ k ∂nu) ≤
        ∫ z, (2 : Real) ^ (k - 1) *
          (A z ^ k + (∫ z', A z' ∂nu) ^ k) ∂nu := by
      apply integral_mono hleft hright
      intro z
      exact add_pow_le (hA z) hmeanNonneg k
    _ = (2 : Real) ^ (k - 1) *
        ((∫ z, A z ^ k ∂nu) + (∫ z, A z ∂nu) ^ k) := by
      rw [integral_const_mul,
        integral_add hpowInt (integrable_const _), integral_const,
        probReal_univ, one_smul]
    _ ≤ (2 : Real) ^ (k - 1) *
        ((∫ z, A z ^ k ∂nu) + (∫ z, A z ^ k ∂nu)) := by
      gcongr
    _ = (2 : Real) ^ k * ∫ z, A z ^ k ∂nu := by
      have hkpred : k - 1 + 1 = k := Nat.sub_add_cancel hk
      calc
        (2 : Real) ^ (k - 1) *
            ((∫ z, A z ^ k ∂nu) + (∫ z, A z ^ k ∂nu)) =
            ((2 : Real) ^ (k - 1) * 2) * ∫ z, A z ^ k ∂nu := by
          ring
        _ = (2 : Real) ^ k * ∫ z, A z ^ k ∂nu := by
          rw [← pow_succ, hkpred]

name: ProbabilityTheory.sum_replaceOneCenteredMoment_empiricalNormalizedEnvelope_le
statement:
theorem sum_replaceOneCenteredMoment_empiricalNormalizedEnvelope_le
    [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (n k : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (A : Fin n → Z → Real) (K : Real)
    (hAk : forall i, MemLp (A i) k nu)
    (hA : forall i z, 0 ≤ A i z)
    (hmoment : forall i, (∫ z, A i z ^ k ∂nu) ≤ K ^ k) :
    (∑ i : Fin n,
        replaceOneCenteredMoment nu
          (empiricalNormalizedEnvelope n (A i)) k) ≤
      (2 : Real) ^ k * K ^ k / (n : Real) ^ (k - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hnReal : (n : Real) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hn)
  calc
    (∑ i : Fin n,
        replaceOneCenteredMoment nu
          (empiricalNormalizedEnvelope n (A i)) k) =
        ∑ i : Fin n, ((n : Real)⁻¹) ^ k *
          replaceOneCenteredMoment nu (A i) k := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      exact replaceOneCenteredMoment_empiricalNormalizedEnvelope
        (nu := nu) n k (A i)
    _ ≤ ∑ _i : Fin n, ((n : Real)⁻¹) ^ k *
        ((2 : Real) ^ k * K ^ k) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i _
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (pow_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr
        (Nat.cast_nonneg n)) k)
      exact (replaceOneCenteredMoment_le_two_pow_mul_integral_pow
        (nu := nu) (A i) k hk (hAk i) (hA i)).trans
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hmoment i)
            (pow_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : Real) ≤ 2) k))
    _ = (n : Real) * (((n : Real)⁻¹) ^ k *
        ((2 : Real) ^ k * K ^ k)) := by
      simp
    _ = (2 : Real) ^ k * K ^ k / (n : Real) ^ (k - 1) := by
      have hkpred : k - 1 + 1 = k := Nat.sub_add_cancel hk
      have hscale : (n : Real) * ((n : Real)⁻¹) ^ k =
          ((n : Real)⁻¹) ^ (k - 1) := by
        calc
          (n : Real) * ((n : Real)⁻¹) ^ k =
              (n : Real) * ((n : Real)⁻¹) ^ (k - 1 + 1) := by
            rw [hkpred]
          _ = (n : Real) *
              (((n : Real)⁻¹) ^ (k - 1) * (n : Real)⁻¹) := by
            rw [pow_succ]
          _ = ((n : Real) * (n : Real)⁻¹) *
              ((n : Real)⁻¹) ^ (k - 1) := by ring
          _ = ((n : Real)⁻¹) ^ (k - 1) := by
            rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hnReal, one_mul]
      rw [← mul_assoc, hscale, div_eq_mul_inv, inv_pow]
      ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.sum_replaceOneCenteredMoment_empiricalNormalizedEnvelope_two_le
statement:
theorem sum_replaceOneCenteredMoment_empiricalNormalizedEnvelope_two_le
    [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (n q : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) (hq : 2 ≤ q)
    (A : Fin n → Z → Real) (Ktwo : Real)
    (hAq : forall i, MemLp (A i) q nu)
    (hA : forall i z, 0 ≤ A i z)
    (hsecond : forall i, (∫ z, A i z ^ 2 ∂nu) ≤ Ktwo ^ 2) :
    (∑ i : Fin n,
        replaceOneCenteredMoment nu
          (empiricalNormalizedEnvelope n (A i)) 2) ≤
      4 * Ktwo ^ 2 / (n : Real)
proof:
:= by
  have hA2 : forall i, MemLp (A i) 2 nu := by
    intro i
    exact (hAq i).mono_exponent (by exact_mod_cast hq)
  have h := sum_replaceOneCenteredMoment_empiricalNormalizedEnvelope_le
    (nu := nu) n 2 hn (by norm_num) A Ktwo hA2 hA hsecond
  norm_num at h ⊢
  exact h

name: ProbabilityTheory.sum_replaceOneCenteredMoment_empiricalNormalizedEnvelope_q_le
statement:
theorem sum_replaceOneCenteredMoment_empiricalNormalizedEnvelope_q_le
    [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (n q : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (A : Fin n → Z → Real) (Kq : Real)
    (hAq : forall i, MemLp (A i) q nu)
    (hA : forall i z, 0 ≤ A i z)
    (hqmoment : forall i, (∫ z, A i z ^ q ∂nu) ≤ Kq ^ q) :
    (∑ i : Fin n,
        replaceOneCenteredMoment nu
          (empiricalNormalizedEnvelope n (A i)) q) ≤
      (2 : Real) ^ q * Kq ^ q / (n : Real) ^ (q - 1)
proof:
:= by
  exact sum_replaceOneCenteredMoment_empiricalNormalizedEnvelope_le
    n q hn hq A Kq hAq hA hqmoment

name: ProbabilityTheory.exists_finiteNetProjections
statement:
theorem exists_finiteNetProjections [PseudoMetricSpace T] [Nonempty T]
    (N : ℕ → Finset T) (eps : ℕ → ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (hnet : ∀ k, k ≤ m → ∀ t, ∃ u ∈ N k, dist t u ≤ eps k) :
    ∃ proj : ℕ → T → T,
      (∀ k, k ≤ m → ∀ t, proj k t ∈ N k) ∧
      ∀ k, k ≤ m → ∀ t, dist t (proj k t) ≤ eps k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let fallback : T := Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty T)
  let proj : ℕ → T → T := fun k t ↦
    if hk : k ≤ m then Classical.choose (hnet k hk t) else fallback
  refine ⟨proj, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro k hk t
    rw [show proj k t = Classical.choose (hnet k hk t) by simp [proj, hk]]
    exact (Classical.choose_spec (hnet k hk t)).1
  · intro k hk t
    rw [show proj k t = Classical.choose (hnet k hk t) by simp [proj, hk]]
    exact (Classical.choose_spec (hnet k hk t)).2

name: ProbabilityTheory.abs_process_le_finiteChainingSum
statement:
theorem abs_process_le_finiteChainingSum
    (Z : Omega → T → ℝ) (proj : ℕ → T → T)
    (m : ℕ) (omega : Omega) (t : T) :
    |Z omega t| ≤
      |Z omega (proj 0 t)| +
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range m,
          |Z omega (proj (k + 1) t) - Z omega (proj k t)|
        + |Z omega t - Z omega (proj m t)|
proof:
:= by
  have htel := Finset.sum_range_sub
    (fun k ↦ Z omega (proj k t)) m
  have hid :
      Z omega t = Z omega (proj 0 t) +
          (∑ k ∈ Finset.range m,
            (Z omega (proj (k + 1) t) - Z omega (proj k t))) +
          (Z omega t - Z omega (proj m t)) := by
    rw [htel]
    ring
  calc
    |Z omega t| =
        |Z omega (proj 0 t) +
          (∑ k ∈ Finset.range m,
            (Z omega (proj (k + 1) t) - Z omega (proj k t))) +
          (Z omega t - Z omega (proj m t))| := congrArg abs hid
    _ ≤
        |Z omega (proj 0 t) +
          (∑ k ∈ Finset.range m,
            (Z omega (proj (k + 1) t) - Z omega (proj k t)))| +
          |Z omega t - Z omega (proj m t)| := abs_add_le _ _
    _ ≤
        |Z omega (proj 0 t)| +
          |∑ k ∈ Finset.range m,
            (Z omega (proj (k + 1) t) - Z omega (proj k t))| +
          |Z omega t - Z omega (proj m t)| := by
      have hadd :
          |Z omega (proj 0 t) +
              (∑ k ∈ Finset.range m,
                (Z omega (proj (k + 1) t) - Z omega (proj k t)))| ≤
            |Z omega (proj 0 t)| +
              |∑ k ∈ Finset.range m,
                (Z omega (proj (k + 1) t) - Z omega (proj k t))| :=
        abs_add_le _ _
      exact add_le_add_left hadd _
    _ ≤ |Z omega (proj 0 t)| +
          ∑ k ∈ Finset.range m,
            |Z omega (proj (k + 1) t) - Z omega (proj k t)| +
          |Z omega t - Z omega (proj m t)| := by
      have hsum :
          |∑ k ∈ Finset.range m,
              (Z omega (proj (k + 1) t) - Z omega (proj k t))| ≤
            ∑ k ∈ Finset.range m,
              |Z omega (proj (k + 1) t) - Z omega (proj k t)| :=
        Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      exact add_le_add_left
        (add_le_add_right hsum |Z omega (proj 0 t)|)
        |Z omega t - Z omega (proj m t)|

name: ProbabilityTheory.finiteChaining_largeDeviation_subset
statement:
theorem finiteChaining_largeDeviation_subset
    (Z : Omega → T → ℝ) (N : ℕ → Finset T)
    (proj : ℕ → T → T) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (b r : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (hproj : ∀ k, k ≤ m → ∀ t, proj k t ∈ N k)
    (hrem : ∀ omega t, |Z omega t - Z omega (proj m t)| ≤ r) :
    {omega | ∃ t, b + (∑ k ∈ Finset.range m, a k) + r < |Z omega t|} ⊆
      finiteChainingBaseEvent Z (N 0) b ∪
        finiteChainingIncrementEvent Z N a m
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro omega homega
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := homega
  by_cases hbase : omega ∈ finiteChainingBaseEvent Z (N 0) b
  · exact Or.inl hbase
  right
  by_contra hincr
  have hbase_le : |Z omega (proj 0 t)| ≤ b := by
    by_contra hbad
    apply hbase
    refine Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨proj 0 t, Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · exact hproj 0 (Nat.zero_le m) t
    · exact lt_of_not_ge hbad
  have hincr_le : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m,
      |Z omega (proj (k + 1) t) - Z omega (proj k t)| ≤ a k := by
    intro k hk
    have hkm : k < m := Finset.mem_range.1 hk
    by_contra hbad
    apply hincr
    refine Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨k, Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨hk,
      Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨proj (k + 1) t, Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨?_,
        Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨proj k t, Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩⟩⟩⟩⟩
    · exact hproj (k + 1) (Nat.succ_le_iff.2 hkm) t
    · exact hproj k (Nat.le_of_lt hkm) t
    · exact lt_of_not_ge hbad
  have hchain := abs_process_le_finiteChainingSum Z proj m omega t
  have hsum :
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.range m,
        |Z omega (proj (k + 1) t) - Z omega (proj k t)|) ≤
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range m, a k :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum hincr_le
  have htotal : |Z omega t| ≤
      b + (∑ k ∈ Finset.range m, a k) + r :=
    hchain.trans (add_le_add (add_le_add hbase_le hsum) (hrem omega t))
  exact (not_lt_of_ge htotal) ht

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_finiteChaining_largeDeviation_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_finiteChaining_largeDeviation_le [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    (Z : Omega → T → ℝ) (N : ℕ → Finset T)
    (proj : ℕ → T → T) (a delta : ℕ → ℝ)
    (b r delta0 : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (hproj : ∀ k, k ≤ m → ∀ t, proj k t ∈ N k)
    (hrem : ∀ omega t, |Z omega t - Z omega (proj m t)| ≤ r)
    (hbaseTail : ∀ u ∈ N 0,
      mu.real {omega | b < |Z omega u|} ≤ delta0)
    (hincrTail : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ u ∈ N (k + 1),
      ∀ v ∈ N k,
        mu.real {omega | a k < |Z omega u - Z omega v|} ≤ delta k) :
    mu.real {omega | ∃ t,
        b + (∑ k ∈ Finset.range m, a k) + r < |Z omega t|} ≤
      (N 0).card * delta0 +
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range m,
          ((N (k + 1)).card * (N k).card : ℕ) * delta k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let B : Set Omega := finiteChainingBaseEvent Z (N 0) b
  let I : Set Omega := finiteChainingIncrementEvent Z N a m
  have hsubset :
      {omega | ∃ t,
          b + (∑ k ∈ Finset.range m, a k) + r < |Z omega t|} ⊆
        B ∪ I := by
    simpa only [B, I] using
      finiteChaining_largeDeviation_subset Z N proj a b r m hproj hrem
  have hB : mu.real B ≤ (N 0).card * delta0 := by
    calc
      mu.real B ≤
          ∑ u ∈ N 0, mu.real {omega | b < |Z omega u|} := by
        simpa only [B, finiteChainingBaseEvent] using
          (measureReal_biUnion_finset_le (μ := mu) (N 0)
            (fun u ↦ {omega | b < |Z omega u|}))
      _ ≤ ∑ _u ∈ N 0, delta0 :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum hbaseTail
      _ = (N 0).card * delta0 := by
        simp only [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
  have hlevel : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m,
      mu.real (⋃ u ∈ N (k + 1), ⋃ v ∈ N k,
          {omega | a k < |Z omega u - Z omega v|}) ≤
        ((N (k + 1)).card * (N k).card : ℕ) * delta k := by
    intro k hk
    calc
      mu.real (⋃ u ∈ N (k + 1), ⋃ v ∈ N k,
          {omega | a k < |Z omega u - Z omega v|}) ≤
          ∑ u ∈ N (k + 1),
            mu.real (⋃ v ∈ N k,
              {omega | a k < |Z omega u - Z omega v|}) :=
        measureReal_biUnion_finset_le (N (k + 1)) _
      _ ≤ ∑ u ∈ N (k + 1),
          ∑ v ∈ N k,
            mu.real {omega | a k < |Z omega u - Z omega v|} := by
        exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun u hu ↦
          measureReal_biUnion_finset_le (N k)
            (fun v ↦ {omega | a k < |Z omega u - Z omega v|})
      _ ≤ ∑ _u ∈ N (k + 1), ∑ _v ∈ N k, delta k := by
        exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun u hu ↦
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun v hv ↦ hincrTail k hk u hu v hv
      _ = ((N (k + 1)).card * (N k).card : ℕ) * delta k := by
        simp only [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
        push_cast
        ring
  have hI : mu.real I ≤
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range m,
        ((N (k + 1)).card * (N k).card : ℕ) * delta k := by
    calc
      mu.real I ≤
          ∑ k ∈ Finset.range m,
            mu.real (⋃ u ∈ N (k + 1), ⋃ v ∈ N k,
              {omega | a k < |Z omega u - Z omega v|}) := by
        simpa only [I, finiteChainingIncrementEvent] using
          (measureReal_biUnion_finset_le (μ := mu) (Finset.range m)
            (fun k ↦ ⋃ u ∈ N (k + 1), ⋃ v ∈ N k,
              {omega | a k < |Z omega u - Z omega v|}))
      _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range m,
          ((N (k + 1)).card * (N k).card : ℕ) * delta k :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum hlevel
  calc
    mu.real {omega | ∃ t,
        b + (∑ k ∈ Finset.range m, a k) + r < |Z omega t|} ≤
        mu.real (B ∪ I) := measureReal_mono hsubset
    _ ≤ mu.real B + mu.real I := measureReal_union_le B I
    _ ≤ (N 0).card * delta0 +
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range m,
          ((N (k + 1)).card * (N k).card : ℕ) * delta k :=
      add_le_add hB hI

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasSubgaussianMGF.measureReal_abs_ge_le
statement:
theorem HasSubgaussianMGF.measureReal_abs_ge_le
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {X : Omega → ℝ} {c : ℝ≥0}
    (hX : HasSubgaussianMGF X c mu) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    mu.real {omega | t ≤ |X omega|} ≤
      2 * exp (-t ^ 2 / (2 * (c : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  have hpos := hX.measure_ge_le ht
  have hneg := hX.neg.measure_ge_le ht
  have hset : {omega | t ≤ |X omega|} =
      {omega | t ≤ X omega} ∪ {omega | t ≤ -X omega} := by
    ext omega
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_union]
    rw [le_abs]
  rw [hset]
  calc
    mu.real ({omega | t ≤ X omega} ∪ {omega | t ≤ -X omega}) ≤
        mu.real {omega | t ≤ X omega} +
          mu.real {omega | t ≤ -X omega} :=
      measureReal_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ exp (-t ^ 2 / (2 * (c : ℝ))) +
        exp (-t ^ 2 / (2 * (c : ℝ))) :=
      add_le_add hpos hneg
    _ = 2 * exp (-t ^ 2 / (2 * (c : ℝ))) := by ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasSubgaussianMGF.measureReal_abs_gt_le
statement:
theorem HasSubgaussianMGF.measureReal_abs_gt_le
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {X : Omega → ℝ} {c : ℝ≥0}
    (hX : HasSubgaussianMGF X c mu) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    mu.real {omega | t < |X omega|} ≤
      2 * exp (-t ^ 2 / (2 * (c : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  exact (measureReal_mono (by
    intro omega homega
    change t < |X omega| at homega
    change t ≤ |X omega|
    exact homega.le)).trans (hX.measureReal_abs_ge_le ht)

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_finiteChaining_largeDeviation_le_of_subgaussian
statement:
theorem measureReal_finiteChaining_largeDeviation_le_of_subgaussian
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (Z : Omega → T → ℝ) (N : ℕ → Finset T)
    (proj : ℕ → T → T) (a : ℕ → ℝ)
    (c : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (b r : ℝ) (c0 : ℝ≥0) (m : ℕ)
    (hproj : ∀ k, k ≤ m → ∀ t, proj k t ∈ N k)
    (hrem : ∀ omega t, |Z omega t - Z omega (proj m t)| ≤ r)
    (hb : 0 ≤ b) (ha : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, 0 ≤ a k)
    (hbaseSubG : ∀ u ∈ N 0,
      HasSubgaussianMGF (fun omega ↦ Z omega u) c0 mu)
    (hincrSubG : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ u ∈ N (k + 1),
      ∀ v ∈ N k,
        HasSubgaussianMGF (fun omega ↦ Z omega u - Z omega v) (c k) mu) :
    mu.real {omega | ∃ t,
        b + (∑ k ∈ Finset.range m, a k) + r < |Z omega t|} ≤
      (N 0).card *
          (2 * exp (-b ^ 2 / (2 * (c0 : ℝ)))) +
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range m,
          ((N (k + 1)).card * (N k).card : ℕ) *
            (2 * exp (-(a k) ^ 2 / (2 * (c k : ℝ))))
proof:
:= by
  apply measureReal_finiteChaining_largeDeviation_le
    Z N proj a
      (fun k ↦ 2 * exp (-(a k) ^ 2 / (2 * (c k : ℝ))))
      b r (2 * exp (-b ^ 2 / (2 * (c0 : ℝ)))) m hproj hrem
  · intro u hu
    exact (hbaseSubG u hu).measureReal_abs_gt_le hb
  · intro k hk u hu v hv
    exact (hincrSubG k hk u hu v hv).measureReal_abs_gt_le (ha k hk)

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_finiteChaining_largeDeviation_le_of_hoeffding
statement:
theorem measureReal_finiteChaining_largeDeviation_le_of_hoeffding
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (Z : Omega → T → ℝ) (N : ℕ → Finset T)
    (proj : ℕ → T → T) (a : ℕ → ℝ)
    (lower upper : ℕ → ℝ)
    (b r lower0 upper0 : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (hproj : ∀ k, k ≤ m → ∀ t, proj k t ∈ N k)
    (hrem : ∀ omega t, |Z omega t - Z omega (proj m t)| ≤ r)
    (hb : 0 ≤ b) (ha : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, 0 ≤ a k)
    (hbaseMeas : ∀ u ∈ N 0, AEMeasurable (fun omega ↦ Z omega u) mu)
    (hbaseBounds : ∀ u ∈ N 0,
      ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, Z omega u ∈ Set.Icc lower0 upper0)
    (hbaseCentered : ∀ u ∈ N 0, ∫ omega, Z omega u ∂mu = 0)
    (hincrMeas : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ u ∈ N (k + 1),
      ∀ v ∈ N k,
        AEMeasurable (fun omega ↦ Z omega u - Z omega v) mu)
    (hincrBounds : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ u ∈ N (k + 1),
      ∀ v ∈ N k, ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
        Z omega u - Z omega v ∈ Set.Icc (lower k) (upper k))
    (hincrCentered : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ u ∈ N (k + 1),
      ∀ v ∈ N k, ∫ omega, (Z omega u - Z omega v) ∂mu = 0) :
    mu.real {omega | ∃ t,
        b + (∑ k ∈ Finset.range m, a k) + r < |Z omega t|} ≤
      (N 0).card *
          (2 * exp (-b ^ 2 / (2 * (hoeffdingMGFProxy lower0 upper0 : ℝ)))) +
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range m,
          ((N (k + 1)).card * (N k).card : ℕ) *
            (2 * exp (-(a k) ^ 2 /
              (2 * (hoeffdingMGFProxy (lower k) (upper k) : ℝ))))
proof:
:= by
  apply measureReal_finiteChaining_largeDeviation_le_of_subgaussian
    Z N proj a (fun k ↦ hoeffdingMGFProxy (lower k) (upper k))
      b r (hoeffdingMGFProxy lower0 upper0) m hproj hrem hb ha
  · intro u hu
    simpa only [hoeffdingMGFProxy] using
      (hasSubgaussianMGF_of_mem_Icc_of_integral_eq_zero
        (hbaseMeas u hu) (hbaseBounds u hu) (hbaseCentered u hu))
  · intro k hk u hu v hv
    simpa only [hoeffdingMGFProxy] using
      (hasSubgaussianMGF_of_mem_Icc_of_integral_eq_zero
        (hincrMeas k hk u hu v hv) (hincrBounds k hk u hu v hv)
        (hincrCentered k hk u hu v hv))

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_finiteChaining_lipschitz_le_of_subgaussian
statement:
theorem measureReal_finiteChaining_lipschitz_le_of_subgaussian
    [PseudoMetricSpace T] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (Z : Omega → T → ℝ) (N : ℕ → Finset T)
    (proj : ℕ → T → T) (a : ℕ → ℝ)
    (c : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (b L eps : ℝ) (c0 : ℝ≥0) (m : ℕ)
    (hproj : ∀ k, k ≤ m → ∀ t, proj k t ∈ N k)
    (hnear : ∀ t, dist t (proj m t) ≤ eps)
    (hlip : ∀ omega s t, |Z omega s - Z omega t| ≤ L * dist s t)
    (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (ha : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, 0 ≤ a k)
    (hbaseSubG : ∀ u ∈ N 0,
      HasSubgaussianMGF (fun omega ↦ Z omega u) c0 mu)
    (hincrSubG : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ u ∈ N (k + 1),
      ∀ v ∈ N k,
        HasSubgaussianMGF (fun omega ↦ Z omega u - Z omega v) (c k) mu) :
    mu.real {omega | ∃ t,
        b + (∑ k ∈ Finset.range m, a k) + L * eps < |Z omega t|} ≤
      (N 0).card *
          (2 * exp (-b ^ 2 / (2 * (c0 : ℝ)))) +
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range m,
          ((N (k + 1)).card * (N k).card : ℕ) *
            (2 * exp (-(a k) ^ 2 / (2 * (c k : ℝ))))
proof:
:= by
  apply measureReal_finiteChaining_largeDeviation_le_of_subgaussian
    Z N proj a c b (L * eps) c0 m hproj
  · intro omega t
    exact (hlip omega t (proj m t)).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hnear t) hL)
  · exact hb
  · exact ha
  · exact hbaseSubG
  · exact hincrSubG

name: ProbabilityTheory.exists_countableNetProjections
statement:
theorem exists_countableNetProjections [PseudoMetricSpace T] [Nonempty T]
    (N : ℕ → Finset T) (eps : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hnet : ∀ k t, ∃ u ∈ N k, dist t u ≤ eps k) :
    ∃ proj : ℕ → T → T,
      (∀ k t, proj k t ∈ N k) ∧
      ∀ k t, dist t (proj k t) ≤ eps k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let proj : ℕ → T → T := fun k t ↦ Classical.choose (hnet k t)
  refine ⟨proj, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro k t
    exact (Classical.choose_spec (hnet k t)).1
  · intro k t
    exact (Classical.choose_spec (hnet k t)).2

name: ProbabilityTheory.abs_process_le_countableChainingSum
statement:
theorem abs_process_le_countableChainingSum
    (Z : Omega → T → ℝ) (proj : ℕ → T → T)
    (threshold : ℕ → ℝ) (omega : Omega) (t : T)
    (hthreshold : ∀ k,
      |Z omega (proj (k + 1) t) - Z omega (proj k t)| ≤ threshold k)
    (hsummable : Summable threshold)
    (hremainder : Tendsto
      (fun m ↦ |Z omega t - Z omega (proj m t)|) atTop (nhds 0)) :
    |Z omega t| ≤ |Z omega (proj 0 t)| + ∑' k, threshold k
proof:
:= by
  have hprojLimit :
      Tendsto (fun m ↦ Z omega (proj m t)) atTop (nhds (Z omega t)) := by
    apply tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero.2
    simpa only [Real.dist_eq, abs_sub_comm] using hremainder
  have hincrements : ∀ k,
      dist (Z omega (proj k t)) (Z omega (proj (k + 1) t)) ≤ threshold k := by
    intro k
    simpa only [Real.dist_eq, abs_sub_comm] using hthreshold k
  have hdistance :
      dist (Z omega (proj 0 t)) (Z omega t) ≤ ∑' k, threshold k :=
    dist_le_tsum_of_dist_le_of_tendsto₀ threshold hincrements hsummable hprojLimit
  calc
    |Z omega t| =
        |Z omega (proj 0 t) +
          (Z omega t - Z omega (proj 0 t))| := by ring_nf
    _ ≤ |Z omega (proj 0 t)| +
          |Z omega t - Z omega (proj 0 t)| := abs_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ |Z omega (proj 0 t)| + ∑' k, threshold k := by
      apply add_le_add_right
      simpa only [Real.dist_eq, abs_sub_comm] using hdistance

name: ProbabilityTheory.countableChaining_largeDeviation_subset_edges
statement:
theorem countableChaining_largeDeviation_subset_edges
    (Z : Omega → T → ℝ) (N0 : Finset T)
    (edges : ℕ → Finset (T × T)) (proj : ℕ → T → T)
    (threshold : ℕ → ℝ) (baseThreshold : ℝ)
    (hbase : ∀ t, proj 0 t ∈ N0)
    (hedge : ∀ k t, (proj (k + 1) t, proj k t) ∈ edges k)
    (hthresholdSummable : Summable threshold)
    (hremainder : ∀ omega t, Tendsto
      (fun m ↦ |Z omega t - Z omega (proj m t)|) atTop (nhds 0)) :
    {omega | ∃ t,
        baseThreshold + (∑' k, threshold k) < |Z omega t|} ⊆
      finiteChainingBaseEvent Z N0 baseThreshold ∪
        countableChainingEdgeEvent Z edges threshold
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro omega homega
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := homega
  by_cases hbaseBad : omega ∈ finiteChainingBaseEvent Z N0 baseThreshold
  · exact Or.inl hbaseBad
  right
  by_contra hedgeBad
  have hbase_le : |Z omega (proj 0 t)| ≤ baseThreshold := by
    by_contra hbad
    apply hbaseBad
    refine Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨proj 0 t, Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨hbase t, ?_⟩⟩
    exact lt_of_not_ge hbad
  have hincrement_le : ∀ k,
      |Z omega (proj (k + 1) t) - Z omega (proj k t)| ≤ threshold k := by
    intro k
    by_contra hbad
    apply hedgeBad
    refine Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨k,
      Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨(proj (k + 1) t, proj k t),
        Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨hedge k t, ?_⟩⟩⟩
    exact lt_of_not_ge hbad
  have hchain := abs_process_le_countableChainingSum
    Z proj threshold omega t hincrement_le hthresholdSummable
      (hremainder omega t)
  have htotal : |Z omega t| ≤
      baseThreshold + ∑' k, threshold k :=
    hchain.trans (add_le_add hbase_le le_rfl)
  exact (not_lt_of_ge htotal) ht

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_iUnion_nat_le_of_summable
statement:
theorem measureReal_iUnion_nat_le_of_summable [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    (A : ℕ → Set Omega)
    (hA : Summable fun k ↦ mu.real (A k)) :
    mu.real (⋃ k, A k) ≤ ∑' k, mu.real (A k)
proof:
:= by
  let c : ℕ → ℝ≥0 := fun k ↦ (mu (A k)).toNNReal
  have hcReal : (fun k ↦ (c k : ℝ)) = fun k ↦ mu.real (A k) := by
    funext k
    exact ENNReal.coe_toNNReal_eq_toReal (mu (A k))
  have hc : Summable c := by
    rw [← NNReal.summable_coe]
    simpa only [hcReal] using hA
  have hterm : ∀ k, (c k : ℝ≥0∞) = mu (A k) := by
    intro k
    exact ENNReal.coe_toNNReal (measure_ne_top mu (A k))
  have hsumFinite : (∑' k, mu (A k)) ≠ ∞ := by
    have hsumEq :
        (∑' k, mu (A k)) = ((∑' k, c k : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞) := by
      calc
        (∑' k, mu (A k)) = ∑' k, (c k : ℝ≥0∞) :=
          tsum_congr fun k ↦ (hterm k).symm
        _ = ((∑' k, c k : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞) := (ENNReal.coe_tsum hc).symm
    rw [hsumEq]
    exact ENNReal.coe_ne_top
  have hmeasure := measure_iUnion_le (μ := mu) A
  have htoReal :
      (mu (⋃ k, A k)).toReal ≤ (∑' k, mu (A k)).toReal :=
    (ENNReal.toReal_le_toReal (measure_ne_top mu _) hsumFinite).2 hmeasure
  rw [ENNReal.tsum_toReal_eq (fun k ↦ measure_ne_top mu (A k))] at htoReal
  simpa only [measureReal_def] using htoReal

name: ProbabilityTheory.measure_countableChaining_edges_largeDeviation_le
statement:
theorem measure_countableChaining_edges_largeDeviation_le
    (Z : Omega → T → ℝ) (N0 : Finset T)
    (edges : ℕ → Finset (T × T)) (proj : ℕ → T → T)
    (threshold : ℕ → ℝ) (delta : ℕ → ℝ≥0∞)
    (baseThreshold : ℝ) (delta0 : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hbase : ∀ t, proj 0 t ∈ N0)
    (hedge : ∀ k t, (proj (k + 1) t, proj k t) ∈ edges k)
    (hthresholdSummable : Summable threshold)
    (hremainder : ∀ omega t, Tendsto
      (fun m ↦ |Z omega t - Z omega (proj m t)|) atTop (nhds 0))
    (hbaseTail : ∀ u ∈ N0,
      mu {omega | baseThreshold < |Z omega u|} ≤ delta0)
    (hedgeTail : ∀ k, ∀ e ∈ edges k,
      mu {omega | threshold k < |Z omega e.1 - Z omega e.2|} ≤ delta k) :
    mu {omega | ∃ t,
        baseThreshold + (∑' k, threshold k) < |Z omega t|} ≤
      N0.card * delta0 +
        ∑' k, (edges k).card * delta k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Base : Set Omega := finiteChainingBaseEvent Z N0 baseThreshold
  let Level : ℕ → Set Omega := fun k ↦
    ⋃ e ∈ edges k,
      {omega | threshold k < |Z omega e.1 - Z omega e.2|}
  have hsubset :
      {omega | ∃ t,
          baseThreshold + (∑' k, threshold k) < |Z omega t|} ⊆
        Base ∪ ⋃ k, Level k := by
    simpa only [Base, Level, countableChainingEdgeEvent] using
      countableChaining_largeDeviation_subset_edges
        Z N0 edges proj threshold baseThreshold hbase hedge
          hthresholdSummable hremainder
  have hBase : mu Base ≤ N0.card * delta0 := by
    calc
      mu Base ≤ ∑ u ∈ N0,
          mu {omega | baseThreshold < |Z omega u|} := by
        simpa only [Base, finiteChainingBaseEvent] using
          (measure_biUnion_finset_le (μ := mu) N0
            (fun u ↦ {omega | baseThreshold < |Z omega u|}))
      _ ≤ ∑ _u ∈ N0, delta0 := Finset.sum_le_sum hbaseTail
      _ = N0.card * delta0 := by
        simp only [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
  have hLevel : ∀ k, mu (Level k) ≤ (edges k).card * delta k := by
    intro k
    calc
      mu (Level k) ≤ ∑ e ∈ edges k,
          mu {omega | threshold k < |Z omega e.1 - Z omega e.2|} := by
        simpa only [Level] using
          (measure_biUnion_finset_le (μ := mu) (edges k)
            (fun e ↦
              {omega | threshold k < |Z omega e.1 - Z omega e.2|}))
      _ ≤ ∑ _e ∈ edges k, delta k :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun e he ↦ hedgeTail k e he
      _ = (edges k).card * delta k := by
        simp only [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
  calc
    mu {omega | ∃ t,
        baseThreshold + (∑' k, threshold k) < |Z omega t|} ≤
        mu (Base ∪ ⋃ k, Level k) := measure_mono hsubset
    _ ≤ mu Base + mu (⋃ k, Level k) := measure_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ mu Base + ∑' k, mu (Level k) :=
      add_le_add_right (measure_iUnion_le Level) _
    _ ≤ N0.card * delta0 +
        ∑' k, (edges k).card * delta k :=
      add_le_add hBase (ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum hLevel)

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_countableChaining_edges_largeDeviation_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_countableChaining_edges_largeDeviation_le
    [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    (Z : Omega → T → ℝ) (N0 : Finset T)
    (edges : ℕ → Finset (T × T)) (proj : ℕ → T → T)
    (threshold delta : ℕ → ℝ)
    (baseThreshold delta0 : ℝ)
    (hbase : ∀ t, proj 0 t ∈ N0)
    (hedge : ∀ k t, (proj (k + 1) t, proj k t) ∈ edges k)
    (hthresholdSummable : Summable threshold)
    (hremainder : ∀ omega t, Tendsto
      (fun m ↦ |Z omega t - Z omega (proj m t)|) atTop (nhds 0))
    (hcostSummable : Summable fun k ↦ (edges k).card * delta k)
    (hbaseTail : ∀ u ∈ N0,
      mu.real {omega | baseThreshold < |Z omega u|} ≤ delta0)
    (hedgeTail : ∀ k, ∀ e ∈ edges k,
      mu.real {omega | threshold k < |Z omega e.1 - Z omega e.2|} ≤
        delta k) :
    mu.real {omega | ∃ t,
        baseThreshold + (∑' k, threshold k) < |Z omega t|} ≤
      N0.card * delta0 +
        ∑' k, (edges k).card * delta k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Base : Set Omega := finiteChainingBaseEvent Z N0 baseThreshold
  let Level : ℕ → Set Omega := fun k ↦
    ⋃ e ∈ edges k,
      {omega | threshold k < |Z omega e.1 - Z omega e.2|}
  have hsubset :
      {omega | ∃ t,
          baseThreshold + (∑' k, threshold k) < |Z omega t|} ⊆
        Base ∪ ⋃ k, Level k := by
    simpa only [Base, Level, countableChainingEdgeEvent] using
      countableChaining_largeDeviation_subset_edges
        Z N0 edges proj threshold baseThreshold hbase hedge
          hthresholdSummable hremainder
  have hBase : mu.real Base ≤ N0.card * delta0 := by
    calc
      mu.real Base ≤ ∑ u ∈ N0,
          mu.real {omega | baseThreshold < |Z omega u|} := by
        simpa only [Base, finiteChainingBaseEvent] using
          (measureReal_biUnion_finset_le (μ := mu) N0
            (fun u ↦ {omega | baseThreshold < |Z omega u|}))
      _ ≤ ∑ _u ∈ N0, delta0 := Finset.sum_le_sum hbaseTail
      _ = N0.card * delta0 := by
        simp only [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
  have hLevel : ∀ k,
      mu.real (Level k) ≤ (edges k).card * delta k := by
    intro k
    calc
      mu.real (Level k) ≤ ∑ e ∈ edges k,
          mu.real {omega |
            threshold k < |Z omega e.1 - Z omega e.2|} := by
        simpa only [Level] using
          (measureReal_biUnion_finset_le (μ := mu) (edges k)
            (fun e ↦
              {omega | threshold k < |Z omega e.1 - Z omega e.2|}))
      _ ≤ ∑ _e ∈ edges k, delta k :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun e he ↦ hedgeTail k e he
      _ = (edges k).card * delta k := by
        simp only [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
  have hLevelSummable : Summable fun k ↦ mu.real (Level k) :=
    Summable.of_nonneg_of_le
      (fun _ ↦ measureReal_nonneg) hLevel hcostSummable
  have hIncr : mu.real (⋃ k, Level k) ≤
      ∑' k, (edges k).card * delta k := by
    calc
      mu.real (⋃ k, Level k) ≤ ∑' k, mu.real (Level k) :=
        measureReal_iUnion_nat_le_of_summable Level hLevelSummable
      _ ≤ ∑' k, (edges k).card * delta k :=
        Summable.tsum_le_tsum hLevel hLevelSummable hcostSummable
  calc
    mu.real {omega | ∃ t,
        baseThreshold + (∑' k, threshold k) < |Z omega t|} ≤
        mu.real (Base ∪ ⋃ k, Level k) := measureReal_mono hsubset
    _ ≤ mu.real Base + mu.real (⋃ k, Level k) :=
      measureReal_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ N0.card * delta0 +
        ∑' k, (edges k).card * delta k := add_le_add hBase hIncr

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_countableChaining_edges_largeDeviation_le_of_bernstein
statement:
theorem measureReal_countableChaining_edges_largeDeviation_le_of_bernstein
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (Z : Omega → T → ℝ) (N0 : Finset T)
    (edges : ℕ → Finset (T × T)) (proj : ℕ → T → T)
    (baseVariance baseScale : T → ℝ≥0)
    (edgeVariance edgeScale : ℕ → T → T → ℝ≥0)
    (V B : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (V0 B0 : ℝ≥0)
    (x : ℕ → ℝ) (x0 : ℝ)
    (hbase : ∀ t, proj 0 t ∈ N0)
    (hedge : ∀ k t, (proj (k + 1) t, proj k t) ∈ edges k)
    (hremainder : ∀ omega t, Tendsto
      (fun m ↦ |Z omega t - Z omega (proj m t)|) atTop (nhds 0))
    (hx0 : 0 ≤ x0) (hx : ∀ k, 0 ≤ x k)
    (hthresholdSummable : Summable fun k ↦
      bernsteinMixedThreshold (V k : ℝ) (B k : ℝ) (x k))
    (hcostSummable : Summable fun k ↦
      (edges k).card * (2 * exp (-x k)))
    (hbaseVariance : ∀ u ∈ N0, 0 < (baseVariance u : ℝ))
    (hedgeVariance : ∀ k, ∀ e ∈ edges k,
      0 < (edgeVariance k e.1 e.2 : ℝ))
    (hbaseVariance_le : ∀ u ∈ N0, baseVariance u ≤ V0)
    (hbaseScale_le : ∀ u ∈ N0, baseScale u ≤ B0)
    (hedgeVariance_le : ∀ k, ∀ e ∈ edges k,
      edgeVariance k e.1 e.2 ≤ V k)
    (hedgeScale_le : ∀ k, ∀ e ∈ edges k,
      edgeScale k e.1 e.2 ≤ B k)
    (hbaseBernstein : ∀ u ∈ N0,
      HasBernsteinMGF (fun omega ↦ Z omega u)
        (baseVariance u) (baseScale u) mu)
    (hedgeBernstein : ∀ k, ∀ e ∈ edges k,
      HasBernsteinMGF (fun omega ↦ Z omega e.1 - Z omega e.2)
        (edgeVariance k e.1 e.2) (edgeScale k e.1 e.2) mu) :
    mu.real {omega | ∃ t,
        bernsteinMixedThreshold (V0 : ℝ) (B0 : ℝ) x0 +
            (∑' k, bernsteinMixedThreshold
              (V k : ℝ) (B k : ℝ) (x k)) < |Z omega t|} ≤
      N0.card * (2 * exp (-x0)) +
        ∑' k, (edges k).card * (2 * exp (-x k))
proof:
:= by
  apply measureReal_countableChaining_edges_largeDeviation_le
    Z N0 edges proj
      (fun k ↦ bernsteinMixedThreshold (V k : ℝ) (B k : ℝ) (x k))
      (fun k ↦ 2 * exp (-x k))
      (bernsteinMixedThreshold (V0 : ℝ) (B0 : ℝ) x0)
      (2 * exp (-x0)) hbase hedge hthresholdSummable hremainder
      hcostSummable
  · intro u hu
    have hthreshold :
        bernsteinMixedThreshold (baseVariance u : ℝ)
            (baseScale u : ℝ) x0 ≤
          bernsteinMixedThreshold (V0 : ℝ) (B0 : ℝ) x0 :=
      bernsteinMixedThreshold_mono
        (by exact_mod_cast hbaseVariance_le u hu)
        (by exact_mod_cast hbaseScale_le u hu) hx0
    have htail :=
      (hbaseBernstein u hu).measureReal_abs_gt_mixedThreshold_le
        hx0 (hbaseVariance u hu)
    exact (measureReal_mono (by
      intro omega homega
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt hthreshold homega)).trans htail
  · intro k e he
    have hthreshold :
        bernsteinMixedThreshold (edgeVariance k e.1 e.2 : ℝ)
            (edgeScale k e.1 e.2 : ℝ) (x k) ≤
          bernsteinMixedThreshold (V k : ℝ) (B k : ℝ) (x k) :=
      bernsteinMixedThreshold_mono
        (by exact_mod_cast hedgeVariance_le k e he)
        (by exact_mod_cast hedgeScale_le k e he) (hx k)
    have htail :=
      (hedgeBernstein k e he).measureReal_abs_gt_mixedThreshold_le
        (hx k) (hedgeVariance k e he)
    exact (measureReal_mono (by
      intro omega homega
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt hthreshold homega)).trans htail

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_countableChaining_edges_largeDeviation_le_of_bernstein_anchored
statement:
theorem measureReal_countableChaining_edges_largeDeviation_le_of_bernstein_anchored
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (Z : Omega → T → ℝ) (N0 : Finset T)
    (edges : ℕ → Finset (T × T)) (proj : ℕ → T → T)
    (edgeVariance edgeScale : ℕ → T → T → ℝ≥0)
    (V B : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (x : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hbase : ∀ t, proj 0 t ∈ N0)
    (hedge : ∀ k t, (proj (k + 1) t, proj k t) ∈ edges k)
    (hremainder : ∀ omega t, Tendsto
      (fun m ↦ |Z omega t - Z omega (proj m t)|) atTop (nhds 0))
    (hbaseZero : ∀ omega, ∀ u ∈ N0, Z omega u = 0)
    (hx : ∀ k, 0 ≤ x k)
    (hthresholdSummable : Summable fun k ↦
      bernsteinMixedThreshold (V k : ℝ) (B k : ℝ) (x k))
    (hcostSummable : Summable fun k ↦
      (edges k).card * (2 * exp (-x k)))
    (hedgeVariance : ∀ k, ∀ e ∈ edges k,
      0 < (edgeVariance k e.1 e.2 : ℝ))
    (hedgeVariance_le : ∀ k, ∀ e ∈ edges k,
      edgeVariance k e.1 e.2 ≤ V k)
    (hedgeScale_le : ∀ k, ∀ e ∈ edges k,
      edgeScale k e.1 e.2 ≤ B k)
    (hedgeBernstein : ∀ k, ∀ e ∈ edges k,
      HasBernsteinMGF (fun omega ↦ Z omega e.1 - Z omega e.2)
        (edgeVariance k e.1 e.2) (edgeScale k e.1 e.2) mu) :
    mu.real {omega | ∃ t,
        (∑' k, bernsteinMixedThreshold
          (V k : ℝ) (B k : ℝ) (x k)) < |Z omega t|} ≤
      ∑' k, (edges k).card * (2 * exp (-x k))
proof:
:= by
  have hbaseTail : ∀ u ∈ N0,
      mu.real {omega | (0 : ℝ) < |Z omega u|} ≤ 0 := by
    intro u hu
    simp only [hbaseZero _ u hu, abs_zero, lt_self_iff_false,
      Set.setOf_false, measureReal_empty, le_refl]
  have hedgeTail : ∀ k, ∀ e ∈ edges k,
      mu.real {omega |
        bernsteinMixedThreshold (V k : ℝ) (B k : ℝ) (x k) <
          |Z omega e.1 - Z omega e.2|} ≤ 2 * exp (-x k) := by
    intro k e he
    have hthreshold :
        bernsteinMixedThreshold (edgeVariance k e.1 e.2 : ℝ)
            (edgeScale k e.1 e.2 : ℝ) (x k) ≤
          bernsteinMixedThreshold (V k : ℝ) (B k : ℝ) (x k) :=
      bernsteinMixedThreshold_mono
        (by exact_mod_cast hedgeVariance_le k e he)
        (by exact_mod_cast hedgeScale_le k e he) (hx k)
    have htail :=
      (hedgeBernstein k e he).measureReal_abs_gt_mixedThreshold_le
        (hx k) (hedgeVariance k e he)
    exact (measureReal_mono (by
      intro omega homega
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt hthreshold homega)).trans htail
  simpa only [zero_add, Nat.cast_ofNat, Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero] using
    (measureReal_countableChaining_edges_largeDeviation_le
      Z N0 edges proj
        (fun k ↦ bernsteinMixedThreshold (V k : ℝ) (B k : ℝ) (x k))
        (fun k ↦ 2 * exp (-x k)) 0 0 hbase hedge
        hthresholdSummable hremainder hcostSummable hbaseTail hedgeTail)

name: RandomSetTheory.SimpleFunc.exists_setIntegral_eq_smul_of_exactDivisibility
statement:
theorem exists_setIntegral_eq_smul_of_exactDivisibility
    {Omega E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    (mu : Measure Omega) [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    (hmu : HasExactDivisibility mu) (f : SimpleFunc Omega E)
    {a : ℝ} (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1) :
    ∃ A : Set Omega, MeasurableSet A ∧
      (∫ x in A, f x ∂mu) = a • ∫ x, f x ∂mu
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfiber : ∀ y : E, MeasurableSet (f ⁻¹' {y}) := fun y ↦
    f.measurableSet_fiber y
  have hexists : ∀ y : E, ∃ A : Set Omega,
      A ⊆ f ⁻¹' {y} ∧ MeasurableSet A ∧
        mu.real A = a * mu.real (f ⁻¹' {y}) := fun y ↦
    hmu (f ⁻¹' {y}) (hfiber y) ha0 ha1
  choose As hAs hAsmeas hAsmeasure using hexists
  let A : Set Omega := ⋃ y ∈ f.range, As y
  have hA : MeasurableSet A := by
    exact Finset.measurableSet_biUnion f.range fun y _ ↦ hAsmeas y
  have hinter : ∀ y ∈ f.range, f ⁻¹' {y} ∩ A = As y := by
    intro y hy
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · intro x hx
      rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx.2 with ⟨z, hxz⟩
      rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hxz with ⟨hz, hxAs⟩
      have hfxz : f x = z := hAs z hxAs
      have hfxy : f x = y := hx.1
      have hzy : z = y := hfxz.symm.trans hfxy
      simpa [hzy] using hxAs
    · intro x hx
      refine ⟨hAs y hx, ?_⟩
      exact Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem y (Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem hy hx)
  refine ⟨A, hA, ?_⟩
  rw [f.integral_eq_sum f.integrable_of_isFiniteMeasure.integrableOn,
    f.integral_eq_sum f.integrable_of_isFiniteMeasure]
  simp_rw [measureReal_restrict_apply (hfiber _)]
  have hsum :
      ∑ y ∈ f.range, mu.real (f ⁻¹' {y} ∩ A) • y =
        ∑ y ∈ f.range, (a * mu.real (f ⁻¹' {y})) • y := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro y hy
    rw [hinter y hy, hAsmeasure y]
  rw [hsum, Finset.smul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro y hy
  rw [smul_smul]

name: RandomSetTheory.SimpleFunc.convex_measurableSetIntegralRange_of_exactDivisibility
statement:
theorem convex_measurableSetIntegralRange_of_exactDivisibility
    {Omega E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    (mu : Measure Omega) [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    (hmu : HasExactDivisibility mu) (f : SimpleFunc Omega E) :
    Convex ℝ (measurableSetIntegralRange mu fun omega ↦ f omega)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
  rcases hx with ⟨A, hA, rfl⟩
  rcases hy with ⟨B, hB, rfl⟩
  let p : SimpleFunc Omega E := f.piecewise A hA 0
  let q : SimpleFunc Omega E := f.piecewise B hB 0
  have hp : Integrable (fun omega ↦ p omega) mu :=
    p.integrable_of_isFiniteMeasure
  have hq : Integrable (fun omega ↦ q omega) mu :=
    q.integrable_of_isFiniteMeasure
  have hpq : Integrable (fun omega ↦ p omega - q omega) mu := hp.sub hq
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hsplitD⟩ :=
    exists_setIntegral_eq_smul_of_exactDivisibility mu hmu (p - q)
      ha (by linarith)
  let C : Set Omega := (D ∩ A) ∪ (Dᶜ ∩ B)
  have hC : MeasurableSet C := (hD.inter hA).union (hD.compl.inter hB)
  have hp_apply : ∀ omega, p omega = A.indicator (fun z ↦ f z) omega := by
    intro omega
    by_cases homega : omega ∈ A <;> simp [p, homega]
  have hq_apply : ∀ omega, q omega = B.indicator (fun z ↦ f z) omega := by
    intro omega
    by_cases homega : omega ∈ B <;> simp [q, homega]
  have hind : C.indicator (fun omega ↦ f omega) =
      fun omega ↦ q omega +
        D.indicator (fun z ↦ p z - q z) omega := by
    funext omega
    by_cases homegaD : omega ∈ D <;>
      by_cases homegaA : omega ∈ A <;>
      by_cases homegaB : omega ∈ B <;>
      simp [C, hp_apply, hq_apply, homegaD, homegaA, homegaB]
  have hpint : (∫ omega, p omega ∂mu) = ∫ omega in A, f omega ∂mu := by
    rw [← integral_indicator hA]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun omega ↦ hp_apply omega
  have hqint : (∫ omega, q omega ∂mu) = ∫ omega in B, f omega ∂mu := by
    rw [← integral_indicator hB]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun omega ↦ hq_apply omega
  have hsplitD' : (∫ omega in D, (p omega - q omega) ∂mu) =
      a • ∫ omega, (p omega - q omega) ∂mu := by
    simpa using hsplitD
  refine ⟨C, hC, ?_⟩
  calc
    (∫ omega in C, f omega ∂mu) =
        ∫ omega, C.indicator (fun z ↦ f z) omega ∂mu := by
      rw [integral_indicator hC]
    _ = (∫ omega, q omega ∂mu) +
        ∫ omega in D, (p omega - q omega) ∂mu := by
      rw [hind, integral_add hq
        (hpq.integrableOn.integrable_indicator hD), integral_indicator hD]
    _ = (∫ omega, q omega ∂mu) +
        a • ∫ omega, (p omega - q omega) ∂mu := by rw [hsplitD']
    _ = (∫ omega, q omega ∂mu) +
        a • ((∫ omega, p omega ∂mu) - ∫ omega, q omega ∂mu) := by
      rw [integral_sub hp hq]
    _ = a • (∫ omega, p omega ∂mu) +
        b • ∫ omega, q omega ∂mu := by
      have hb' : b = 1 - a := by linarith
      rw [hb']
      module
    _ = a • (∫ omega in A, f omega ∂mu) +
        b • ∫ omega in B, f omega ∂mu := by rw [hpint, hqint]

statement:

    {Omega E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
