name: RandomSetTheory.exists_measurableSet_setIntegral_tendsto_smul_of_exactDivisibility
statement:
theorem exists_measurableSet_setIntegral_tendsto_smul_of_exactDivisibility
    {Omega E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    (mu : Measure Omega) [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    (hmu : HasExactDivisibility mu) {f : Omega → E}
    (hf : Integrable f mu) (hfm : Measurable f)
    {a : ℝ} (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1) :
    ∃ A : ℕ → Set Omega, (∀ n, MeasurableSet (A n)) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n ↦ ∫ omega in A n, f omega ∂mu)
        Filter.atTop (nhds (a • ∫ omega, f omega ∂mu))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F : ℕ → SimpleFunc Omega E := fun n ↦
    SimpleFunc.approxOn f hfm (Set.range f ∪ {0}) 0 (by simp) n
  have hFint : ∀ n, Integrable (fun omega ↦ F n omega) mu := fun n ↦
    SimpleFunc.integrable_approxOn_range hfm hf n
  have hexists : ∀ n, ∃ A : Set Omega, MeasurableSet A ∧
      (∫ omega in A, F n omega ∂mu) =
        a • ∫ omega, F n omega ∂mu := fun n ↦
    SimpleFunc.exists_setIntegral_eq_smul_of_exactDivisibility
      mu hmu (F n) ha0 ha1
  choose A hA hsplit using hexists
  let err : ℕ → ℝ := fun n ↦ ∫ omega, ‖F n omega - f omega‖ ∂mu
  have herr : Filter.Tendsto err Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [err, F] using
      (MeasureTheory.tendsto_integral_norm_approxOn_sub hfm hf)
  have hfirst : ∀ n,
      ‖(∫ omega in A n, f omega ∂mu) -
          ∫ omega in A n, F n omega ∂mu‖ ≤ err n := by
    intro n
    calc
      ‖(∫ omega in A n, f omega ∂mu) -
          ∫ omega in A n, F n omega ∂mu‖ =
          ‖∫ omega in A n, (f omega - F n omega) ∂mu‖ := by
        rw [integral_sub hf.restrict (hFint n).restrict]
      _ ≤ ∫ omega in A n, ‖f omega - F n omega‖ ∂mu :=
        norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
      _ ≤ ∫ omega, ‖f omega - F n omega‖ ∂mu := by
        exact setIntegral_le_integral
          (hf.sub (hFint n)).norm
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun omega ↦ norm_nonneg _)
      _ = err n := by
        apply integral_congr_ae
        exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun omega ↦ by
          simpa only using (norm_sub_rev (f omega) (F n omega))
  have hsecond : ∀ n,
      ‖(∫ omega, F n omega ∂mu) - ∫ omega, f omega ∂mu‖ ≤ err n := by
    intro n
    calc
      ‖(∫ omega, F n omega ∂mu) - ∫ omega, f omega ∂mu‖ =
          ‖∫ omega, (F n omega - f omega) ∂mu‖ := by
        rw [integral_sub (hFint n) hf]
      _ ≤ ∫ omega, ‖F n omega - f omega‖ ∂mu :=
        norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
      _ = err n := rfl
  have hbound : ∀ n,
      ‖(∫ omega in A n, f omega ∂mu) -
          a • ∫ omega, f omega ∂mu‖ ≤
        (1 + |a|) * err n := by
    intro n
    have hid :
        (∫ omega in A n, f omega ∂mu) -
            a • ∫ omega, f omega ∂mu =
          ((∫ omega in A n, f omega ∂mu) -
              ∫ omega in A n, F n omega ∂mu) +
            a • ((∫ omega, F n omega ∂mu) -
              ∫ omega, f omega ∂mu) := by
      rw [hsplit n]
      module
    rw [hid]
    calc
      ‖((∫ omega in A n, f omega ∂mu) -
            ∫ omega in A n, F n omega ∂mu) +
          a • ((∫ omega, F n omega ∂mu) -
            ∫ omega, f omega ∂mu)‖ ≤
          ‖(∫ omega in A n, f omega ∂mu) -
            ∫ omega in A n, F n omega ∂mu‖ +
          ‖a • ((∫ omega, F n omega ∂mu) -
            ∫ omega, f omega ∂mu)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ = ‖(∫ omega in A n, f omega ∂mu) -
            ∫ omega in A n, F n omega ∂mu‖ +
          |a| * ‖(∫ omega, F n omega ∂mu) -
            ∫ omega, f omega ∂mu‖ := by
        rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      _ ≤ err n + |a| * err n :=
        add_le_add (hfirst n)
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hsecond n) (abs_nonneg a))
      _ = (1 + |a|) * err n := by ring
  have hupper : Filter.Tendsto (fun n ↦ (1 + |a|) * err n)
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa using (tendsto_const_nhds.mul herr :
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n ↦ (1 + |a|) * err n) Filter.atTop
        (nhds ((1 + |a|) * 0)))
  refine ⟨A, hA, tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero.mpr ?_⟩
  exact tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le
    tendsto_const_nhds hupper
    (fun n ↦ norm_nonneg _)
    hbound

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_measurableSet_setIntegral_tendsto_smul_of_exactDivisibility'
statement:
theorem exists_measurableSet_setIntegral_tendsto_smul_of_exactDivisibility'
    {Omega E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    (mu : Measure Omega) [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    (hmu : HasExactDivisibility mu) {f : Omega → E}
    (hf : Integrable f mu) {a : ℝ} (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1) :
    ∃ A : ℕ → Set Omega, (∀ n, MeasurableSet (A n)) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n ↦ ∫ omega in A n, f omega ∂mu)
        Filter.atTop (nhds (a • ∫ omega, f omega ∂mu))
proof:
:= by
  let g : Omega → E := hf.aestronglyMeasurable.mk f
  have hfg : f =ᵐ[mu] g := hf.aestronglyMeasurable.ae_eq_mk
  have hg : Integrable g mu := hf.congr hfg
  have hgm : Measurable g := hf.aestronglyMeasurable.measurable_mk
  obtain ⟨A, hA, hlim⟩ :=
    exists_measurableSet_setIntegral_tendsto_smul_of_exactDivisibility
      mu hmu hg hgm ha0 ha1
  refine ⟨A, hA, ?_⟩
  have htotal : (∫ omega, f omega ∂mu) = ∫ omega, g omega ∂mu :=
    integral_congr_ae hfg
  rw [htotal]
  apply hlim.congr'
  exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n ↦
    integral_congr_ae (ae_restrict_of_ae hfg.symm)

name: RandomSetTheory.smul_integral_mem_closure_measurableSetIntegralRange_of_exactDivisibility
statement:
theorem smul_integral_mem_closure_measurableSetIntegralRange_of_exactDivisibility
    {Omega E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    (mu : Measure Omega) [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    (hmu : HasExactDivisibility mu) {f : Omega → E}
    (hf : Integrable f mu) {a : ℝ} (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1) :
    a • ∫ omega, f omega ∂mu ∈
      closure (measurableSetIntegralRange mu f)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A, hA, hlim⟩ :=
    exists_measurableSet_setIntegral_tendsto_smul_of_exactDivisibility'
      mu hmu hf ha0 ha1
  exact mem_closure_of_tendsto hlim <|
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n ↦ ⟨A n, hA n, rfl⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.combo_mem_closure_measurableSetIntegralRange_of_exactDivisibility
statement:
theorem combo_mem_closure_measurableSetIntegralRange_of_exactDivisibility
    {Omega E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    (mu : Measure Omega) [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    (hmu : HasExactDivisibility mu) {f : Omega → E}
    (hf : Integrable f mu) {x y : E}
    (hx : x ∈ measurableSetIntegralRange mu f)
    (hy : y ∈ measurableSetIntegralRange mu f)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hab : a + b = 1) :
    a • x + b • y ∈ closure (measurableSetIntegralRange mu f)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hx with ⟨A, hA, rfl⟩
  rcases hy with ⟨B, hB, rfl⟩
  let p : Omega → E := A.indicator f
  let q : Omega → E := B.indicator f
  let g : Omega → E := fun omega ↦ p omega - q omega
  have hp : Integrable p mu := hf.integrableOn.integrable_indicator hA
  have hq : Integrable q mu := hf.integrableOn.integrable_indicator hB
  have hg : Integrable g mu := hp.sub hq
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hlim⟩ :=
    exists_measurableSet_setIntegral_tendsto_smul_of_exactDivisibility'
      mu hmu hg ha (by linarith)
  let C : ℕ → Set Omega := fun n ↦ (D n ∩ A) ∪ ((D n)ᶜ ∩ B)
  have hC : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (C n) := fun n ↦
    ((hD n).inter hA).union ((hD n).compl.inter hB)
  have hind : ∀ n, (C n).indicator f =
      fun omega ↦ q omega + (D n).indicator g omega := by
    intro n
    funext omega
    by_cases homegaD : omega ∈ D n <;>
      by_cases homegaA : omega ∈ A <;>
      by_cases homegaB : omega ∈ B <;>
      simp [C, p, q, g, homegaD, homegaA, homegaB]
  have heq : ∀ n, (∫ omega in C n, f omega ∂mu) =
      (∫ omega, q omega ∂mu) + ∫ omega in D n, g omega ∂mu := by
    intro n
    calc
      (∫ omega in C n, f omega ∂mu) =
          ∫ omega, (C n).indicator f omega ∂mu := by
        rw [integral_indicator (hC n)]
      _ = (∫ omega, q omega ∂mu) +
          ∫ omega, (D n).indicator g omega ∂mu := by
        rw [hind n, integral_add hq
          (hg.integrableOn.integrable_indicator (hD n))]
      _ = (∫ omega, q omega ∂mu) +
          ∫ omega in D n, g omega ∂mu := by
        rw [integral_indicator (hD n)]
  have hseq : Filter.Tendsto (fun n ↦ ∫ omega in C n, f omega ∂mu)
      Filter.atTop
      (nhds ((∫ omega, q omega ∂mu) +
        a • ∫ omega, g omega ∂mu)) := by
    apply (tendsto_const_nhds.add hlim).congr'
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n ↦ (heq n).symm
  have htarget : (∫ omega, q omega ∂mu) +
      a • ∫ omega, g omega ∂mu =
      a • (∫ omega in A, f omega ∂mu) +
        b • ∫ omega in B, f omega ∂mu := by
    calc
      (∫ omega, q omega ∂mu) +
          a • ∫ omega, g omega ∂mu =
          (∫ omega, q omega ∂mu) +
            a • ((∫ omega, p omega ∂mu) -
              ∫ omega, q omega ∂mu) := by
        rw [show (∫ omega, g omega ∂mu) =
          (∫ omega, p omega ∂mu) - ∫ omega, q omega ∂mu by
            exact integral_sub hp hq]
      _ = a • (∫ omega, p omega ∂mu) +
          b • ∫ omega, q omega ∂mu := by
        have hb' : b = 1 - a := by linarith
        rw [hb']
        module
      _ = a • (∫ omega in A, f omega ∂mu) +
          b • ∫ omega in B, f omega ∂mu := by
        rw [show (∫ omega, p omega ∂mu) =
            ∫ omega in A, f omega ∂mu by
              exact integral_indicator hA,
          show (∫ omega, q omega ∂mu) =
            ∫ omega in B, f omega ∂mu by
              exact integral_indicator hB]
  rw [htarget] at hseq
  exact mem_closure_of_tendsto hseq <|
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n ↦ ⟨C n, hC n, rfl⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.convex_measurableSetIntegralRange_of_exactDivisibility_of_isClosed
statement:
theorem convex_measurableSetIntegralRange_of_exactDivisibility_of_isClosed
    {Omega E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    (mu : Measure Omega) [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    (hmu : HasExactDivisibility mu) {f : Omega → E}
    (hf : Integrable f mu)
    (hclosed : IsClosed (measurableSetIntegralRange mu f)) :
    Convex ℝ (measurableSetIntegralRange mu f)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
  have hcombo :=
    combo_mem_closure_measurableSetIntegralRange_of_exactDivisibility
      mu hmu hf hx hy ha hb hab
  rwa [hclosed.closure_eq] at hcombo

name: RandomSetTheory.hasLyapunovConvexity_of_exactDivisibility_of_isClosedRange
statement:
theorem hasLyapunovConvexity_of_exactDivisibility_of_isClosedRange
    {Omega E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]

    (hmu : HasExactDivisibility mu)
    (hclosed : ∀ f : Omega → E, Integrable f mu →
      IsClosed (measurableSetIntegralRange mu f)) :
    HasLyapunovConvexity mu E
proof:
:= by
  intro f hf
  exact convex_measurableSetIntegralRange_of_exactDivisibility_of_isClosed
    mu hmu hf (hclosed f hf)

name: RandomSetTheory.supportFunction_bad_event_subset_finset
statement:
theorem supportFunction_bad_event_subset_finset
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (K : Ω → Set E) (L : Set E)
    (hK : ∀ ω, IsCompact (K ω)) (hL : IsCompact L)
    (hKne : ∀ ω, (K ω).Nonempty) (hLne : L.Nonempty)
    (hKconv : ∀ ω, Convex ℝ (K ω)) (hLconv : Convex ℝ L)
    {RK RL eps s : ℝ}
    (hRK : ∀ ω, ∀ x ∈ K ω, ‖x‖ ≤ RK)
    (hRL : ∀ x ∈ L, ‖x‖ ≤ RL)
    (heps : 0 ≤ eps) (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (N : Finset E)
    (hnet : ∀ u : E, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 → ∃ v ∈ N, dist u v ≤ eps) :
    {ω | s + (RK + RL) * eps < hausdorffDist (K ω) L} ⊆
      {ω | ∃ v ∈ N,
        s ≤ |supportFunction (K ω) v - supportFunction L v|}
proof:
:= by
  intro ω hbad
  by_contra hlarge
  have hsmall : ∀ v ∈ N,
      |supportFunction (K ω) v - supportFunction L v| < s := by
    intro v hv
    exact lt_of_not_ge fun hvlarge => hlarge ⟨v, hv, hvlarge⟩
  have hdist := hausdorffDist_le_of_finset_net_supportFunction
    (hK ω) hL (hKne ω) hLne (hKconv ω) hLconv
    (hRK ω) hRL heps hs N hnet
    (fun v hv => (hsmall v hv).le)
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hdist) hbad

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_risk_bound_of_finset_supportFunction
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_risk_bound_of_finset_supportFunction
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (K : Ω → Set E) (L : Set E)
    (hK : ∀ ω, IsCompact (K ω)) (hL : IsCompact L)
    (hKne : ∀ ω, (K ω).Nonempty) (hLne : L.Nonempty)
    (hKconv : ∀ ω, Convex ℝ (K ω)) (hLconv : Convex ℝ L)
    {RK RL eps s q : ℝ}
    (hRK : ∀ ω, ∀ x ∈ K ω, ‖x‖ ≤ RK)
    (hRL : ∀ x ∈ L, ‖x‖ ≤ RL)
    (heps : 0 ≤ eps) (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (N : Finset E)
    (hnet : ∀ u : E, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 → ∃ v ∈ N, dist u v ≤ eps)
    (htail : ∀ v ∈ N, μ.real {ω |
      s ≤ |supportFunction (K ω) v - supportFunction L v|} ≤ q) :
    μ.real {ω | s + (RK + RL) * eps < hausdorffDist (K ω) L} ≤
      N.card * q
proof:
:= by
  calc
    μ.real {ω | s + (RK + RL) * eps < hausdorffDist (K ω) L} ≤
        μ.real {ω | ∃ v ∈ N,
          s ≤ |supportFunction (K ω) v - supportFunction L v|} :=
      measureReal_mono
        (supportFunction_bad_event_subset_finset K L hK hL hKne hLne
          hKconv hLconv hRK hRL heps hs N hnet)
        (by finiteness)
    _ ≤ N.card * q :=
      ProbabilityTheory.finite_family_deviation_bound N
        (fun v ω => supportFunction (K ω) v - supportFunction L v) htail

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_hausdorffDist_risk_bound_supportFunction_net
statement:
theorem exists_hausdorffDist_risk_bound_supportFunction_net
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (K : Ω → Set E) (L : Set E)
    (hK : ∀ ω, IsCompact (K ω)) (hL : IsCompact L)
    (hKne : ∀ ω, (K ω).Nonempty) (hLne : L.Nonempty)
    (hKconv : ∀ ω, Convex ℝ (K ω)) (hLconv : Convex ℝ L)
    {RK RL eps s q : ℝ}
    (hRK : ∀ ω, ∀ x ∈ K ω, ‖x‖ ≤ RK)
    (hRL : ∀ x ∈ L, ‖x‖ ≤ RL)
    (heps : 0 < eps) (heps_one : eps ≤ 1)
    (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hq : 0 ≤ q)
    (htail : ∀ v : E, ‖v‖ ≤ 1 → μ.real {ω |
      s ≤ |supportFunction (K ω) v - supportFunction L v|} ≤ q) :
    ∃ N : Finset E,
      (∀ v ∈ N, ‖v‖ ≤ 1) ∧
      (N.card : ℝ) ≤ (3 / eps) ^ Module.finrank ℝ E ∧
      μ.real {ω | s + (RK + RL) * eps < hausdorffDist (K ω) L} ≤
        (3 / eps) ^ Module.finrank ℝ E * q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hNmem, hnet, hcard⟩ :=
    ProbabilityTheory.exists_unitBall_finset_net_card_le_three_div
      (E := E) heps heps_one
  refine ⟨N, hNmem, hcard, ?_⟩
  have hprob := hausdorffDist_risk_bound_of_finset_supportFunction
    (μ := μ) K L hK hL hKne hLne hKconv hLconv hRK hRL
    heps.le hs N hnet (fun v hv => htail v (hNmem v hv))
  exact hprob.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcard hq)

name: ProbabilityTheory.hasCondSubgaussianMGF_of_mem_Icc_of_condExp_ae_eq_zero
statement:
theorem hasCondSubgaussianMGF_of_mem_Icc_of_condExp_ae_eq_zero
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hm : m ≤ mOmega) {X : Omega → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (hX : AEMeasurable X mu)
    (hb : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, X omega ∈ Icc a b)
    (hcenter : mu[X | m] =ᵐ[mu] 0) :
    HasCondSubgaussianMGF m hm X ((‖b - a‖₊ / 2) ^ 2) mu
proof:
:= by
  have hXint : Integrable X mu := Integrable.of_mem_Icc a b hX hb
  have hXkernel : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu.trim hm,
      Integrable X (condExpKernel mu m omega) := by
    apply Measure.ae_integrable_of_integrable_comp
    rw [condExpKernel_comp_trim hm]
    exact hXint
  have hbkernel : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu.trim hm,
      ∀ᵐ z ∂condExpKernel mu m omega, X z ∈ Icc a b := by
    apply Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_comp
    rw [condExpKernel_comp_trim hm]
    exact hb
  have hcondKernel : mu[X | m] =ᵐ[mu.trim hm]
      fun omega ↦ ∫ z, X z ∂condExpKernel mu m omega :=
    condExp_ae_eq_trim_integral_condExpKernel hm hXint
  have hcenterTrim : mu[X | m] =ᵐ[mu.trim hm] 0 := by
    exact stronglyMeasurable_condExp.ae_eq_trim_of_stronglyMeasurable
      hm stronglyMeasurable_zero hcenter
  rw [HasCondSubgaussianMGF]
  constructor
  · intro t
    rw [condExpKernel_comp_trim hm]
    exact integrable_exp_mul_of_mem_Icc hX hb
  · filter_upwards [hXkernel, hbkernel, hcondKernel, hcenterTrim]
      with omega hXi hbi hcond hzero
    have hmean : ∫ z, X z ∂condExpKernel mu m omega = 0 := by
      rw [← hcond, hzero]
      rfl
    exact (hasSubgaussianMGF_of_mem_Icc_of_integral_eq_zero
      hXi.aemeasurable hbi hmean).mgf_le

name: ProbabilityTheory.aemeasurable_conditionallyCenteredTruncation
statement:
theorem aemeasurable_conditionallyCenteredTruncation
    [IsFiniteMeasure mu] {X : Omega → ℝ} (hX : AEMeasurable X mu)
    (hm : m ≤ mOmega) (y : ℝ) :
    AEMeasurable (conditionallyCenteredTruncation mu m X y) mu
proof:
:= by
  unfold conditionallyCenteredTruncation
  have hCEmeas : AEMeasurable (mu[truncation X y | m]) mu :=
    (stronglyMeasurable_condExp (m := m) (μ := mu)
      (f := truncation X y)).mono hm |>.aemeasurable
  exact hX.aestronglyMeasurable.truncation.aemeasurable.sub hCEmeas

name: ProbabilityTheory.integrable_conditionallyCenteredTruncation
statement:
theorem integrable_conditionallyCenteredTruncation
    [IsFiniteMeasure mu] {X : Omega → ℝ} (hX : AEMeasurable X mu)
    (y : ℝ) :
    Integrable (conditionallyCenteredTruncation mu m X y) mu
proof:
:= by
  unfold conditionallyCenteredTruncation
  exact hX.aestronglyMeasurable.integrable_truncation.sub integrable_condExp

name: ProbabilityTheory.condExp_conditionallyCenteredTruncation_ae_eq_zero
statement:
theorem condExp_conditionallyCenteredTruncation_ae_eq_zero
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] (hm : m ≤ mOmega)
    {X : Omega → ℝ} (hX : AEMeasurable X mu) (y : ℝ) :
    mu[conditionallyCenteredTruncation mu m X y | m] =ᵐ[mu] 0
proof:
:= by
  let W : Omega → ℝ := truncation X y
  have hWint : Integrable W mu :=
    hX.aestronglyMeasurable.integrable_truncation
  have hCEint : Integrable (mu[W | m]) mu := integrable_condExp
  have hsub := condExp_sub hWint hCEint m
  have htwice : mu[mu[W | m] | m] =ᵐ[mu] mu[W | m] :=
    condExp_of_aestronglyMeasurable' hm
      stronglyMeasurable_condExp.aestronglyMeasurable integrable_condExp
  change mu[W - mu[W | m] | m] =ᵐ[mu] 0
  exact hsub.trans (htwice.mono fun omega homega ↦ by simp [homega])

name: ProbabilityTheory.conditionallyCenteredTruncation_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem conditionallyCenteredTruncation_mem_Icc
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] (X : Omega → ℝ) (y : ℝ) :
    ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      conditionallyCenteredTruncation mu m X y omega ∈
        Icc (-2 * |y|) (2 * |y|)
proof:
:= by
  let W : Omega → ℝ := truncation X y
  have hWbound : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, ‖W omega‖ ≤ |y| :=
    ae_of_all mu fun omega ↦ by
      simpa only [W, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
        abs_truncation_le_bound X y omega
  have hmeanBound : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, ‖mu[W | m] omega‖ ≤ |y| :=
    ae_bdd_norm_condExp_of_ae_bdd_norm hWbound
  filter_upwards [hmeanBound] with omega hmean
  have hpoint : |W omega| ≤ |y| := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      abs_truncation_le_bound X y omega
  have hmean' : |mu[W | m] omega| ≤ |y| := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hmean
  have habs : |W omega - mu[W | m] omega| ≤ 2 * |y| := by
    calc
      |W omega - mu[W | m] omega| ≤
          |W omega| + |mu[W | m] omega| := abs_sub _ _
      _ ≤ |y| + |y| := add_le_add hpoint hmean'
      _ = 2 * |y| := by ring
  change W omega - mu[W | m] omega ∈ Icc (-2 * |y|) (2 * |y|)
  rcases abs_le.mp habs with ⟨hlower, hupper⟩
  constructor <;> linarith

name: ProbabilityTheory.hasCondSubgaussianMGF_conditionallyCenteredTruncation
statement:
theorem hasCondSubgaussianMGF_conditionallyCenteredTruncation
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hm : m ≤ mOmega) {X : Omega → ℝ} (hX : AEMeasurable X mu)
    (y : ℝ) :
    HasCondSubgaussianMGF m hm
      (conditionallyCenteredTruncation mu m X y)
      ((‖(2 * |y|) - (-2 * |y|)‖₊ / 2) ^ 2) mu
proof:
:= by
  apply hasCondSubgaussianMGF_of_mem_Icc_of_condExp_ae_eq_zero hm
    (aemeasurable_conditionallyCenteredTruncation hX hm y)
    (conditionallyCenteredTruncation_mem_Icc X y)
  exact condExp_conditionallyCenteredTruncation_ae_eq_zero hm hX y

name: ProbabilityTheory.abs_condExp_truncation_le_condExp_abs_pow_div
statement:
theorem abs_condExp_truncation_le_condExp_abs_pow_div
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] (_hm : m ≤ mOmega)
    {X : Omega → ℝ} (hX : AEMeasurable X mu)
    (hcenter : mu[X | m] =ᵐ[mu] 0)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hXq : Integrable (fun omega ↦ |X omega| ^ q) mu)
    {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) :
    ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      |mu[truncation X y | m] omega| ≤
        mu[fun z ↦ |X z| ^ q / y ^ (q - 1) | m] omega
proof:
:= by
  have hXint : Integrable X mu := by
    apply (integrable_norm_iff hX.aestronglyMeasurable).1
    have hpow : Integrable (fun omega ↦ ‖X omega‖ ^ q) mu := by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hXq
    simpa only [pow_one] using
      (integrable_norm_pow_of_le hX.aestronglyMeasurable hq hpow :
        Integrable (fun omega ↦ ‖X omega‖ ^ 1) mu)
  have htrunc : Integrable (truncation X y) mu :=
    hX.aestronglyMeasurable.integrable_truncation
  have herr : Integrable (fun omega ↦ truncation X y omega - X omega) mu :=
    htrunc.sub hXint
  have hbound : Integrable
      (fun omega ↦ |X omega| ^ q / y ^ (q - 1)) mu :=
    hXq.div_const (y ^ (q - 1))
  have hsub := condExp_sub htrunc hXint m
  have herrorCenter :
      mu[fun omega ↦ truncation X y omega - X omega | m] =ᵐ[mu]
        mu[truncation X y | m] :=
    hsub.trans (hcenter.mono fun omega homega ↦ by simp [homega])
  have habs := abs_condExp_ae_le_condExp_abs
    (m := m) (μ := mu) (fun omega ↦ truncation X y omega - X omega)
  have hmono := condExp_mono (m := m) herr.abs hbound
    (ae_of_all mu fun omega ↦
      abs_truncation_sub_le_abs_pow_div X hq hy omega)
  filter_upwards [herrorCenter, habs, hmono] with omega heq habs hle
  rw [← heq]
  exact habs.trans hle

name: ProbabilityTheory.abs_condExp_truncation_le_moment_div
statement:
theorem abs_condExp_truncation_le_moment_div
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] (hm : m ≤ mOmega)
    {X : Omega → ℝ} (hX : AEMeasurable X mu)
    (hcenter : mu[X | m] =ᵐ[mu] 0)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hXq : Integrable (fun omega ↦ |X omega| ^ q) mu)
    {K y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y)
    (hcondMoment : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      mu[fun z ↦ |X z| ^ q | m] omega ≤ K) :
    ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      |mu[truncation X y | m] omega| ≤ K / y ^ (q - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hbase := abs_condExp_truncation_le_condExp_abs_pow_div
    hm hX hcenter hq hXq hy
  have hscale := condExp_smul (𝕜 := ℝ) (μ := mu)
    ((y ^ (q - 1))⁻¹) (fun z ↦ |X z| ^ q) m
  have hinv : 0 ≤ (y ^ (q - 1))⁻¹ := (pow_pos hy _).le |> inv_nonneg.mpr
  filter_upwards [hbase, hscale, hcondMoment]
      with omega hbase hscale hmoment
  calc
    |mu[truncation X y | m] omega| ≤
        mu[fun z ↦ |X z| ^ q / y ^ (q - 1) | m] omega := hbase
    _ = (y ^ (q - 1))⁻¹ *
        mu[fun z ↦ |X z| ^ q | m] omega := by
      have hfun : (fun z ↦ |X z| ^ q / y ^ (q - 1)) =
          (y ^ (q - 1))⁻¹ • (fun z ↦ |X z| ^ q) := by
        funext z
        simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, div_eq_inv_mul]
      rw [hfun, hscale]
      rfl
    _ ≤ (y ^ (q - 1))⁻¹ * K :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmoment hinv
    _ = K / y ^ (q - 1) := by rw [div_eq_inv_mul]

name: ProbabilityTheory.centeredTruncation_proxy_coe
statement:
theorem centeredTruncation_proxy_coe (y : ℝ) :
    (((‖(2 * |y|) - (-2 * |y|)‖₊ / 2) ^ 2 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) =
      4 * y ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  push_cast
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg]
  · ring_nf
    rw [sq_abs]
  · linarith [abs_nonneg y]

name: ProbabilityTheory.martingaleCenteredTruncation_add_center_eq
statement:
theorem martingaleCenteredTruncation_add_center_eq
    (mu : Measure Omega) (D : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (y : ℝ)
    (k : ℕ) (omega : Omega) (hsmall : |D k omega| < y) :
    martingaleCenteredTruncation filtration mu D y k omega +
        martingaleTruncationCenter filtration mu D y k omega =
      D k omega
proof:
:= by
  cases k with
  | zero =>
      simp only [martingaleCenteredTruncation, martingaleTruncationCenter,
        centeredTruncation]
      rw [truncation_eq_self hsmall]
      ring
  | succ k =>
      simp only [martingaleCenteredTruncation, martingaleTruncationCenter,
        conditionallyCenteredTruncation]
      rw [truncation_eq_self hsmall]
      ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.sum_martingaleCenteredTruncation_add_center_eq
statement:
theorem sum_martingaleCenteredTruncation_add_center_eq
    (mu : Measure Omega) (D : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (y : ℝ)
    (n : ℕ) (omega : Omega)
    (hsmall : ∀ k < n, |D k omega| < y) :
    (∑ k ∈ range n,
        martingaleCenteredTruncation filtration mu D y k omega) +
      (∑ k ∈ range n,
        martingaleTruncationCenter filtration mu D y k omega) =
      ∑ k ∈ range n, D k omega
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sum_add_distrib]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  exact martingaleCenteredTruncation_add_center_eq filtration mu D y k omega
    (hsmall k (mem_range.mp hk))

name: ProbabilityTheory.StronglyMeasurable.truncation
statement:
theorem StronglyMeasurable.truncation
    {m' : MeasurableSpace Omega} {X : Omega → ℝ}
    (hX : StronglyMeasurable[m'] X) (y : ℝ) :
    StronglyMeasurable[m'] (ProbabilityTheory.truncation X y)
proof:
:= by
  unfold ProbabilityTheory.truncation
  exact (stronglyMeasurable_id.indicator measurableSet_Ioc).comp_measurable
    hX.measurable

name: ProbabilityTheory.stronglyAdapted_martingaleCenteredTruncation
statement:
theorem stronglyAdapted_martingaleCenteredTruncation
    [IsFiniteMeasure mu] (D : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (y : ℝ)
    (hD : StronglyAdapted filtration D) :
    StronglyAdapted filtration
      (martingaleCenteredTruncation filtration mu D y)
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  cases k with
  | zero =>
      change StronglyMeasurable[filtration 0]
        (fun omega ↦ truncation (D 0) y omega -
          ∫ z, truncation (D 0) y z ∂mu)
      exact (StronglyMeasurable.truncation (hD 0) y).sub
        stronglyMeasurable_const
  | succ k =>
      change StronglyMeasurable[filtration (k + 1)]
        (fun omega ↦ truncation (D (k + 1)) y omega -
          mu[truncation (D (k + 1)) y | filtration k] omega)
      exact (StronglyMeasurable.truncation (hD (k + 1)) y).sub
        (stronglyMeasurable_condExp.mono
          (filtration.mono (Nat.le_succ k)))

name: ProbabilityTheory.hasSubgaussianMGF_martingaleCenteredTruncation_zero
statement:
theorem hasSubgaussianMGF_martingaleCenteredTruncation_zero
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] (D : ℕ → Omega → ℝ)
    (hD0 : AEMeasurable (D 0) mu) (y : ℝ) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF
      (martingaleCenteredTruncation filtration mu D y 0)
      ((‖(2 * |y|) - (-2 * |y|)‖₊ / 2) ^ 2) mu
proof:
:= by
  change HasSubgaussianMGF (centeredTruncation (D 0) y mu)
    ((‖(2 * |y|) - (-2 * |y|)‖₊ / 2) ^ 2) mu
  apply hasSubgaussianMGF_of_mem_Icc_of_integral_eq_zero
    (aemeasurable_centeredTruncation hD0 y)
  · exact ae_of_all mu fun omega ↦ centeredTruncation_mem_Icc (D 0) y omega
  · exact integral_centeredTruncation hD0 y

name: ProbabilityTheory.hasCondSubgaussianMGF_martingaleCenteredTruncation_succ
statement:
theorem hasCondSubgaussianMGF_martingaleCenteredTruncation_succ
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (D : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hD : StronglyAdapted filtration D)
    (y : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    HasCondSubgaussianMGF (filtration k) (filtration.le k)
      (martingaleCenteredTruncation filtration mu D y (k + 1))
      ((‖(2 * |y|) - (-2 * |y|)‖₊ / 2) ^ 2) mu
proof:
:= by
  change HasCondSubgaussianMGF (filtration k) (filtration.le k)
    (conditionallyCenteredTruncation mu (filtration k) (D (k + 1)) y)
    ((‖(2 * |y|) - (-2 * |y|)‖₊ / 2) ^ 2) mu
  apply hasCondSubgaussianMGF_conditionallyCenteredTruncation
    (filtration.le k)
  exact ((hD (k + 1)).mono (filtration.le (k + 1))).aemeasurable

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_sum_martingaleCenteredTruncation_ge_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_sum_martingaleCenteredTruncation_ge_le
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (D : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hD : StronglyAdapted filtration D)
    (y : ℝ) (n : ℕ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    mu.real {omega | t ≤
        ∑ k ∈ range n,
          martingaleCenteredTruncation filtration mu D y k omega} ≤
      exp (-t ^ 2 / (8 * (n : ℝ) * y ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  let c : ℝ≥0 := (‖(2 * |y|) - (-2 * |y|)‖₊ / 2) ^ 2
  let Y : ℕ → Omega → ℝ :=
    martingaleCenteredTruncation filtration mu D y
  have hYadapted : StronglyAdapted filtration Y :=
    stronglyAdapted_martingaleCenteredTruncation filtration D y hD
  have hYzero : HasSubgaussianMGF (Y 0) c mu := by
    exact hasSubgaussianMGF_martingaleCenteredTruncation_zero
      filtration D ((hD 0).mono (filtration.le 0) |>.aemeasurable) y
  have hYsucc : ∀ i < n - 1,
      HasCondSubgaussianMGF (filtration i) (filtration.le i)
        (Y (i + 1)) c mu := by
    intro i _hi
    exact hasCondSubgaussianMGF_martingaleCenteredTruncation_succ
      filtration D hD y i
  have htail := measure_sum_ge_le_of_hasCondSubgaussianMGF
    (Y := Y) (cY := fun _ ↦ c) (ℱ := filtration) (μ := mu)
    hYadapted hYzero n hYsucc ht
  change mu.real {omega | t ≤ ∑ k ∈ range n, Y k omega} ≤ _
  rw [show (8 : ℝ) * n * y ^ 2 =
      2 * ∑ _k ∈ range n, (c : ℝ) by
    simp only [sum_const, card_range, nsmul_eq_mul, c,
      centeredTruncation_proxy_coe]
    ring]
  simpa only [NNReal.coe_sum] using htail

name: ProbabilityTheory.martingale_sum_large_subset_iUnion_large_or_truncation
statement:
theorem martingale_sum_large_subset_iUnion_large_or_truncation
    (mu : Measure Omega) (D : ℕ → Omega → ℝ)
    (y t : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    {omega | t +
        |∑ k ∈ range n,
          martingaleTruncationCenter filtration mu D y k omega| ≤
        ∑ k ∈ range n, D k omega} ⊆
      (⋃ k ∈ range n, {omega | y ≤ |D k omega|}) ∪
        {omega | t ≤
          ∑ k ∈ range n,
            martingaleCenteredTruncation filtration mu D y k omega}
proof:
:= by
  intro omega homega
  by_cases hlarge : ∃ k < n, y ≤ |D k omega|
  · left
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hky⟩ := hlarge
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨k,
      Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨mem_range.mpr hk, hky⟩⟩
  · right
    have hsmall : ∀ k < n, |D k omega| < y := by
      intro k hk
      exact lt_of_not_ge fun hky ↦ hlarge ⟨k, hk, hky⟩
    have hid := sum_martingaleCenteredTruncation_add_center_eq
      filtration mu D y n omega hsmall
    let S : ℝ := ∑ k ∈ range n,
      martingaleCenteredTruncation filtration mu D y k omega
    let C : ℝ := ∑ k ∈ range n,
      martingaleTruncationCenter filtration mu D y k omega
    change t ≤ S
    change t + |C| ≤ ∑ k ∈ range n, D k omega at homega
    change S + C = ∑ k ∈ range n, D k omega at hid
    rw [← hid] at homega
    linarith [le_abs_self C]

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_martingale_sum_large_le_sum_large_add_truncation
statement:
theorem measureReal_martingale_sum_large_le_sum_large_add_truncation
    [IsFiniteMeasure mu] (D : ℕ → Omega → ℝ)
    (y t : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    mu.real {omega | t +
        |∑ k ∈ range n,
          martingaleTruncationCenter filtration mu D y k omega| ≤
        ∑ k ∈ range n, D k omega} ≤
      (∑ k ∈ range n, mu.real {omega | y ≤ |D k omega|}) +
        mu.real {omega | t ≤
          ∑ k ∈ range n,
            martingaleCenteredTruncation filtration mu D y k omega}
proof:
:= by
  let U : Set Omega := ⋃ k ∈ range n, {omega | y ≤ |D k omega|}
  let T : Set Omega := {omega | t ≤
    ∑ k ∈ range n,
      martingaleCenteredTruncation filtration mu D y k omega}
  calc
    mu.real {omega | t +
        |∑ k ∈ range n,
          martingaleTruncationCenter filtration mu D y k omega| ≤
        ∑ k ∈ range n, D k omega} ≤ mu.real (U ∪ T) :=
      measureReal_mono
        (martingale_sum_large_subset_iUnion_large_or_truncation
          filtration mu D y t n)
    _ ≤ mu.real U + mu.real T := measureReal_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ (∑ k ∈ range n, mu.real {omega | y ≤ |D k omega|}) +
        mu.real T := by
      apply add_le_add
      · simpa only [U] using measureReal_biUnion_finset_le (range n)
          (fun k ↦ {omega | y ≤ |D k omega|})
      · exact le_rfl
    _ = (∑ k ∈ range n, mu.real {omega | y ≤ |D k omega|}) +
        mu.real {omega | t ≤
          ∑ k ∈ range n,
            martingaleCenteredTruncation filtration mu D y k omega} := rfl

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_martingale_sum_large_le_moment_div_add_exp
statement:
theorem measureReal_martingale_sum_large_le_moment_div_add_exp
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (D : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hD : StronglyAdapted filtration D)
    {q : ℕ}
    (hDq : ∀ k < n, Integrable (fun omega ↦ |D k omega| ^ q) mu)
    {y t : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    mu.real {omega | t +
        |∑ k ∈ range n,
          martingaleTruncationCenter filtration mu D y k omega| ≤
        ∑ k ∈ range n, D k omega} ≤
      (∑ k ∈ range n, absoluteMoment (D k) q mu) / y ^ q +
        exp (-t ^ 2 / (8 * (n : ℝ) * y ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hdecomp :=
    measureReal_martingale_sum_large_le_sum_large_add_truncation
      (mu := mu) filtration D y t n
  have htrunc := measureReal_sum_martingaleCenteredTruncation_ge_le
    (mu := mu) filtration D hD y n ht
  calc
    mu.real {omega | t +
        |∑ k ∈ range n,
          martingaleTruncationCenter filtration mu D y k omega| ≤
        ∑ k ∈ range n, D k omega} ≤
      (∑ k ∈ range n, mu.real {omega | y ≤ |D k omega|}) +
        mu.real {omega | t ≤
          ∑ k ∈ range n,
            martingaleCenteredTruncation filtration mu D y k omega} := hdecomp
    _ ≤ (∑ k ∈ range n, absoluteMoment (D k) q mu / y ^ q) +
        exp (-t ^ 2 / (8 * (n : ℝ) * y ^ 2)) := by
      apply add_le_add
      · gcongr with k hk
        exact measureReal_abs_ge_le_absoluteMoment_div
          (D k) q (hDq k (mem_range.mp hk)) hy
      · exact htrunc
    _ = (∑ k ∈ range n, absoluteMoment (D k) q mu) / y ^ q +
        exp (-t ^ 2 / (8 * (n : ℝ) * y ^ 2)) := by
      rw [sum_div]

name: ProbabilityTheory.abs_sum_martingaleTruncationCenter_le_moment_div
statement:
theorem abs_sum_martingaleTruncationCenter_le_moment_div
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (D : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hD : StronglyAdapted filtration D)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hDq : ∀ k < n, Integrable (fun omega ↦ |D k omega| ^ q) mu)
    (hcenter0 : ∫ omega, D 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hcenterSucc : ∀ k < n - 1,
      mu[D (k + 1) | filtration k] =ᵐ[mu] 0)
    (K : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hmoment0 : absoluteMoment (D 0) q mu ≤ K 0)
    (hcondMoment : ∀ k < n - 1, ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      mu[fun z ↦ |D (k + 1) z| ^ q | filtration k] omega ≤ K (k + 1))
    {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) :
    ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      |∑ k ∈ range n,
          martingaleTruncationCenter filtration mu D y k omega| ≤
        (∑ k ∈ range n, K k) / y ^ (q - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hDmeas : ∀ k, AEMeasurable (D k) mu := fun k ↦
    ((hD k).mono (filtration.le k)).aemeasurable
  have hcenterEach : ∀ k < n, ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      |martingaleTruncationCenter filtration mu D y k omega| ≤
        K k / y ^ (q - 1) := by
    intro k hk
    cases k with
    | zero =>
        have hbias :=
          abs_integral_truncation_sub_integral_le_absoluteMoment_div
            (hDmeas 0) hq (hDq 0 hk) hy
        exact ae_of_all mu fun omega ↦ by
          change |∫ z, truncation (D 0) y z ∂mu| ≤ K 0 / y ^ (q - 1)
          calc
            |∫ z, truncation (D 0) y z ∂mu| =
                |(∫ z, truncation (D 0) y z ∂mu) -
                  ∫ z, D 0 z ∂mu| := by rw [hcenter0, sub_zero]
            _ ≤ absoluteMoment (D 0) q mu / y ^ (q - 1) := hbias
            _ ≤ K 0 / y ^ (q - 1) := by
              exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hmoment0
                (pow_nonneg hy.le (q - 1))
    | succ k =>
        have hk' : k < n - 1 := by omega
        change ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
          |mu[truncation (D (k + 1)) y | filtration k] omega| ≤
            K (k + 1) / y ^ (q - 1)
        exact abs_condExp_truncation_le_moment_div
          (filtration.le k) (hDmeas (k + 1)) (hcenterSucc k hk')
          hq (hDq (k + 1) hk) hy (hcondMoment k hk')
  have hcenterAll : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, ∀ k, k < n →
      |martingaleTruncationCenter filtration mu D y k omega| ≤
        K k / y ^ (q - 1) := by
    rw [ae_all_iff]
    intro k
    by_cases hk : k < n
    · exact (hcenterEach k hk).mono fun omega homega _ ↦ homega
    · exact ae_of_all mu fun _ hk' ↦ (hk hk').elim
  filter_upwards [hcenterAll] with omega hall
  calc
    |∑ k ∈ range n,
        martingaleTruncationCenter filtration mu D y k omega| ≤
        ∑ k ∈ range n,
          |martingaleTruncationCenter filtration mu D y k omega| :=
      Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ (range n)
    _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ range n, K k / y ^ (q - 1) := by
      gcongr with k hk
      exact hall k (mem_range.mp hk)
    _ = (∑ k ∈ range n, K k) / y ^ (q - 1) := by rw [sum_div]

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_martingale_sum_large_le_condMoment_bias_add_exp
statement:
theorem measureReal_martingale_sum_large_le_condMoment_bias_add_exp
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (D : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hD : StronglyAdapted filtration D)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hDq : ∀ k < n, Integrable (fun omega ↦ |D k omega| ^ q) mu)
    (hcenter0 : ∫ omega, D 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hcenterSucc : ∀ k < n - 1,
      mu[D (k + 1) | filtration k] =ᵐ[mu] 0)
    (K : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hmoment0 : absoluteMoment (D 0) q mu ≤ K 0)
    (hcondMoment : ∀ k < n - 1, ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      mu[fun z ↦ |D (k + 1) z| ^ q | filtration k] omega ≤ K (k + 1))
    {y t : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    mu.real {omega |
        t + (∑ k ∈ range n, K k) / y ^ (q - 1) ≤
          ∑ k ∈ range n, D k omega} ≤
      (∑ k ∈ range n, absoluteMoment (D k) q mu) / y ^ q +
        exp (-t ^ 2 / (8 * (n : ℝ) * y ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  let B : ℝ := (∑ k ∈ range n, K k) / y ^ (q - 1)
  let C : Omega → ℝ := fun omega ↦
    ∑ k ∈ range n,
      martingaleTruncationCenter filtration mu D y k omega
  have hcenterBound : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, |C omega| ≤ B := by
    simpa only [B, C] using
      abs_sum_martingaleTruncationCenter_le_moment_div
        filtration D hD hq hDq hcenter0 hcenterSucc K hmoment0
          hcondMoment hy
  have hmono :
      mu.real {omega | t + B ≤ ∑ k ∈ range n, D k omega} ≤
        mu.real {omega | t + |C omega| ≤
          ∑ k ∈ range n, D k omega} := by
    rw [measureReal_def, measureReal_def]
    apply ENNReal.toReal_mono (measure_ne_top _ _)
    apply measure_mono_ae
    filter_upwards [hcenterBound] with omega hcenter
    intro homega
    change t + B ≤ ∑ k ∈ range n, D k omega at homega
    change t + |C omega| ≤ ∑ k ∈ range n, D k omega
    linarith
  have hbase := measureReal_martingale_sum_large_le_moment_div_add_exp
    (mu := mu) filtration D hD hDq hy ht
  change mu.real {omega | t + B ≤ ∑ k ∈ range n, D k omega} ≤ _
  exact hmono.trans (by simpa only [C] using hbase)

name: ProbabilityTheory.sum_doobCenteredDifference
statement:
theorem sum_doobCenteredDifference
    (mu : Measure Omega) (F : Omega → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (omega : Omega) :
    ∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), doobCenteredDifference filtration mu F k omega =
      mu[F | filtration n] omega - ∫ z, F z ∂mu
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [doobCenteredDifference]
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [sum_range_succ]
      rw [ih]
      simp only [doobCenteredDifference]
      ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.stronglyAdapted_doobCenteredDifference
statement:
theorem stronglyAdapted_doobCenteredDifference
    (mu : Measure Omega) (F : Omega → ℝ) :
    StronglyAdapted filtration (doobCenteredDifference filtration mu F)
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  cases k with
  | zero =>
      change StronglyMeasurable[filtration 0]
        (fun omega ↦ mu[F | filtration 0] omega - ∫ z, F z ∂mu)
      exact stronglyMeasurable_condExp.sub stronglyMeasurable_const
  | succ k =>
      change StronglyMeasurable[filtration (k + 1)]
        (fun omega ↦ mu[F | filtration (k + 1)] omega -
          mu[F | filtration k] omega)
      exact stronglyMeasurable_condExp.sub
        (stronglyMeasurable_condExp.mono
          (filtration.mono (Nat.le_succ k)))

name: ProbabilityTheory.integral_doobCenteredDifference_zero
statement:
theorem integral_doobCenteredDifference_zero
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [SigmaFiniteFiltration mu filtration]
    (F : Omega → ℝ) :
    ∫ omega, doobCenteredDifference filtration mu F 0 omega ∂mu = 0
proof:
:= by
  change ∫ omega,
    (mu[F | filtration 0] omega - ∫ z, F z ∂mu) ∂mu = 0
  rw [integral_sub integrable_condExp (integrable_const _),
    integral_condExp (filtration.le 0)]
  simp

name: ProbabilityTheory.condExp_doobCenteredDifference_succ_ae_eq_zero
statement:
theorem condExp_doobCenteredDifference_succ_ae_eq_zero
    [IsFiniteMeasure mu] [SigmaFiniteFiltration mu filtration]
    (F : Omega → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    mu[doobCenteredDifference filtration mu F (k + 1) | filtration k]
      =ᵐ[mu] 0
proof:
:= by
  let M : ℕ → Omega → ℝ := fun j ↦ mu[F | filtration j]
  have hM : Martingale M filtration mu := martingale_condExp F filtration mu
  have hsub := condExp_sub (hM.integrable (k + 1)) (hM.integrable k)
    (filtration k)
  have hnext : mu[M (k + 1) | filtration k] =ᵐ[mu] M k :=
    hM.condExp_ae_eq (Nat.le_succ k)
  have hself : mu[M k | filtration k] =ᵐ[mu] M k :=
    hM.condExp_ae_eq le_rfl
  have hdiff :
      mu[M (k + 1) | filtration k] - mu[M k | filtration k] =ᵐ[mu] 0 := by
    filter_upwards [hnext, hself] with omega hnext hself
    simp [hnext, hself]
  change mu[M (k + 1) - M k | filtration k] =ᵐ[mu] 0
  exact hsub.trans hdiff

name: ProbabilityTheory.measurable_finiteProcessSupremum
statement:
theorem measurable_finiteProcessSupremum
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty) (X : T → Omega → ℝ)
    (hX : ∀ t ∈ s, Measurable (X t)) :
    Measurable (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : finiteProcessSupremum s hs X = s.sup' hs X := by
    funext omega
    exact (Finset.sup'_apply hs X omega).symm
  rw [heq]
  exact Finset.measurable_sup' hs hX

name: ProbabilityTheory.abs_finiteProcessSupremum_le
statement:
theorem abs_finiteProcessSupremum_le
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty) (X : T → Omega → ℝ)
    (A : Omega → ℝ)
    (hdom : ∀ omega t, t ∈ s → |X t omega| ≤ |A omega|)
    (omega : Omega) :
    |finiteProcessSupremum s hs X omega| ≤ |A omega|
proof:
:= by
  have hupper : finiteProcessSupremum s hs X omega ≤ |A omega| := by
    apply Finset.sup'_le hs
    intro t ht
    exact (le_abs_self (X t omega)).trans (hdom omega t ht)
  let t : T := hs.choose
  have ht : t ∈ s := hs.choose_spec
  have hlower : -|A omega| ≤ finiteProcessSupremum s hs X omega := by
    exact (neg_le_of_abs_le (hdom omega t ht)).trans
      (Finset.le_sup' (fun u ↦ X u omega) ht)
  exact abs_le.mpr ⟨hlower, hupper⟩

name: ProbabilityTheory.integrable_finiteProcessSupremum
statement:
theorem integrable_finiteProcessSupremum
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty) (X : T → Omega → ℝ)
    (A : Omega → ℝ) (hA : Integrable A mu)
    (hX : ∀ t ∈ s, Measurable (X t))
    (hdom : ∀ omega t, t ∈ s → |X t omega| ≤ |A omega|) :
    Integrable (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X) mu
proof:
:= by
  apply hA.norm.mono'
    (measurable_finiteProcessSupremum s hs X hX).aestronglyMeasurable
  exact ae_of_all mu fun omega ↦ by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      abs_finiteProcessSupremum_le s hs X A hdom omega

name: ProbabilityTheory.abs_finset_sup'_sub_sup'_le_sup'_abs_sub
statement:
theorem abs_finset_sup'_sub_sup'_le_sup'_abs_sub
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty) (f g : T → ℝ) :
    |s.sup' hs f - s.sup' hs g| ≤
      s.sup' hs (fun t ↦ |f t - g t|)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨tf, htf, htfmax⟩ := s.exists_mem_eq_sup' hs f
  obtain ⟨tg, htg, htgmax⟩ := s.exists_mem_eq_sup' hs g
  have hforward : s.sup' hs f - s.sup' hs g ≤
      s.sup' hs (fun t ↦ |f t - g t|) := by
    calc
      s.sup' hs f - s.sup' hs g = f tf - s.sup' hs g := by rw [htfmax]
      _ ≤ f tf - g tf := sub_le_sub_left (s.le_sup' g htf) _
      _ ≤ |f tf - g tf| := le_abs_self _
      _ ≤ s.sup' hs (fun t ↦ |f t - g t|) :=
        Finset.le_sup' (fun t : T ↦ |f t - g t|) htf
  have hbackward : -(s.sup' hs (fun t ↦ |f t - g t|)) ≤
      s.sup' hs f - s.sup' hs g := by
    have hreverse : s.sup' hs g - s.sup' hs f ≤
        s.sup' hs (fun t ↦ |f t - g t|) := by
      calc
        s.sup' hs g - s.sup' hs f = g tg - s.sup' hs f := by rw [htgmax]
        _ ≤ g tg - f tg := sub_le_sub_left (s.le_sup' f htg) _
        _ ≤ |f tg - g tg| := by rw [abs_sub_comm]; exact le_abs_self _
        _ ≤ s.sup' hs (fun t ↦ |f t - g t|) :=
          Finset.le_sup' (fun t : T ↦ |f t - g t|) htg
    linarith
  exact abs_le.mpr ⟨hbackward, hforward⟩

name: ProbabilityTheory.abs_finset_sup'_sum_replace_one_le
statement:
theorem abs_finset_sup'_sum_replace_one_le
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (r : T → ℝ) (X X' : T → ℝ) :
    |s.sup' hs (fun t ↦ r t + X t) -
        s.sup' hs (fun t ↦ r t + X' t)| ≤
      s.sup' hs (fun t ↦ |X t - X' t|)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [add_sub_add_left_eq_sub] using
    abs_finset_sup'_sub_sup'_le_sup'_abs_sub s hs
      (fun t ↦ r t + X t) (fun t ↦ r t + X' t)

name: ProbabilityTheory.abs_finset_sup'_sum_replace_one_le_add_envelopes
statement:
theorem abs_finset_sup'_sum_replace_one_le_add_envelopes
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (r : T → ℝ) (X X' : T → ℝ) {A A' : ℝ}
    (hX : ∀ t ∈ s, |X t| ≤ A)
    (hX' : ∀ t ∈ s, |X' t| ≤ A') :
    |s.sup' hs (fun t ↦ r t + X t) -
        s.sup' hs (fun t ↦ r t + X' t)| ≤ A + A'
proof:
:= by
  refine (abs_finset_sup'_sum_replace_one_le s hs r X X').trans ?_
  apply Finset.sup'_le hs
  intro t ht
  exact (abs_sub (X t) (X' t)).trans (add_le_add (hX t ht) (hX' t ht))

name: ProbabilityTheory.integral_exp_mul_upperTruncation_le_exp_strongMomentTaylorExponent
statement:
theorem integral_exp_mul_upperTruncation_le_exp_strongMomentTaylorExponent
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (D : Omega → ℝ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    {t y second : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hy : 0 ≤ y)
    (hD : Integrable D mu)
    (hDsq : Integrable (fun omega => D omega ^ 2) mu)
    (hpow : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      Integrable (fun omega => (max (D omega) 0) ^ k) mu)
    (hcenter : ∫ omega, D omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hsecond : (∫ omega, D omega ^ 2 ∂mu) ≤ second)
    (moment : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hmoment : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      (∫ omega, (max (D omega) 0) ^ k ∂mu) ≤ moment k) :
    (∫ omega, Real.exp (t * upperTruncation D y omega) ∂mu) ≤
      Real.exp (strongMomentTaylorExponent q t y second moment)
proof:
:= by
  let U : Omega → ℝ := upperTruncation D y
  have hU : Integrable U mu := integrable_upperTruncation hD y
  have hUsq : Integrable (fun omega => U omega ^ 2) mu := by
    exact integrable_sq_upperTruncation hD.aemeasurable hDsq hy
  have hUpow : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      Integrable (fun omega => (max (U omega) 0) ^ k) mu := by
    intro k hk
    exact integrable_pow_max_upperTruncation_zero hD.aemeasurable y k (hpow k hk)
  have hmeanU : (∫ omega, U omega ∂mu) ≤ 0 := by
    calc
      (∫ omega, U omega ∂mu) ≤ ∫ omega, D omega ∂mu :=
        integral_mono hU hD (fun omega => upperTruncation_le_self D y omega)
      _ = 0 := hcenter
  have hsecondU : (∫ omega, U omega ^ 2 ∂mu) ≤ second := by
    calc
      (∫ omega, U omega ^ 2 ∂mu) ≤ ∫ omega, D omega ^ 2 ∂mu :=
        integral_mono hUsq hDsq
          (fun omega => sq_upperTruncation_le_sq_self D hy omega)
      _ ≤ second := hsecond
  let UMoment : ℕ → ℝ := fun k =>
    ∫ omega, (max (U omega) 0) ^ k ∂mu
  have hmomentU : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q, UMoment k ≤ moment k := by
    intro k hk
    unfold UMoment
    calc
      (∫ omega, (max (U omega) 0) ^ k ∂mu) ≤
          ∫ omega, (max (D omega) 0) ^ k ∂mu :=
        integral_mono (hUpow k hk) (hpow k hk)
          (fun omega =>
            pow_max_upperTruncation_zero_le_pow_max_self D y k omega)
      _ ≤ moment k := hmoment k hk
  have hbase := integral_exp_mul_le_exp_strongMomentTaylorExponent
    U q hq ht hy hU hUsq hUpow
      (ae_of_all mu fun omega => upperTruncation_le D y omega) hmeanU
  exact hbase.trans (Real.exp_monotone
    (strongMomentTaylorExponent_mono q hq (y := y) ht hsecondU hmomentU))

name: ProbabilityTheory.condExp_exp_mul_upperTruncation_le_exp_strongMomentTaylorExponent
statement:
theorem condExp_exp_mul_upperTruncation_le_exp_strongMomentTaylorExponent
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hm : m ≤ mOmega) (D : Omega → ℝ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    {t y second : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hy : 0 ≤ y)
    (hD : Integrable D mu)
    (hDsq : Integrable (fun omega => D omega ^ 2) mu)
    (hpow : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      Integrable (fun omega => (max (D omega) 0) ^ k) mu)
    (hcenter : mu[D | m] =ᵐ[mu] 0)
    (hsecond : mu[fun omega => D omega ^ 2 | m] ≤ᵐ[mu]
      fun _ => second)
    (moment : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hmoment : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      mu[fun omega => (max (D omega) 0) ^ k | m] ≤ᵐ[mu]
        fun _ => moment k) :
    ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      mu[fun z => Real.exp (t * upperTruncation D y z) | m] omega ≤
        Real.exp (strongMomentTaylorExponent q t y second moment)
proof:
:= by
  let U : Omega → ℝ := upperTruncation D y
  have hU : Integrable U mu := integrable_upperTruncation hD y
  have hUsq : Integrable (fun omega => U omega ^ 2) mu := by
    exact integrable_sq_upperTruncation hD.aemeasurable hDsq hy
  have hUpow : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      Integrable (fun omega => (max (U omega) 0) ^ k) mu := by
    intro k hk
    exact integrable_pow_max_upperTruncation_zero hD.aemeasurable y k (hpow k hk)
  have hcenterU : mu[U | m] ≤ᵐ[mu] 0 := by
    have hmono := condExp_mono (m := m) hU hD
      (ae_of_all mu fun omega => upperTruncation_le_self D y omega)
    filter_upwards [hmono, hcenter] with omega hle heq
    simpa only [heq] using hle
  have hsecondU : mu[fun omega => U omega ^ 2 | m] ≤ᵐ[mu]
      fun _ => second := by
    have hmono := condExp_mono (m := m) hUsq hDsq
      (ae_of_all mu fun omega => sq_upperTruncation_le_sq_self D hy omega)
    exact hmono.trans hsecond
  have hmomentU : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      mu[fun omega => (max (U omega) 0) ^ k | m] ≤ᵐ[mu]
        fun _ => moment k := by
    intro k hk
    have hmono := condExp_mono (m := m) (hUpow k hk) (hpow k hk)
      (ae_of_all mu fun omega =>
        pow_max_upperTruncation_zero_le_pow_max_self D y k omega)
    exact hmono.trans (hmoment k hk)
  exact condExp_exp_mul_le_exp_strongMomentTaylorExponent
    hm U q hq ht hy hU hUsq hUpow
      (ae_of_all mu fun omega => upperTruncation_le D y omega)
      hcenterU hsecondU moment hmomentU

    (hsum : ∑ i ∈ s, w i = 1) :
    ∃ A : ι → Set ℝ, IsMeasurableFinpartition s B A ∧
      ∀ i ∈ s, mu.real (A i) = w i * mu.real B

name: RandomSetTheory.HasExactDivisibility.exists_integrable_finsetSelection_integral_eq
statement:
theorem HasExactDivisibility.exists_integrable_finsetSelection_integral_eq
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    (mu : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu : HasExactDivisibility mu)
    (K : Finset E) (w : E → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ x ∈ K, 0 ≤ w x) (hsum : ∑ x ∈ K, w x = 1) :
    ∃ f : Ω → E, Integrable f mu ∧
      (∀ ω, f ω ∈ (K : Set E)) ∧
      (∫ ω, f ω ∂mu) = ∑ x ∈ K, w x • x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨A, hApart, hAmeasure⟩ :=
    hmu.exists_isMeasurableFinpartition_measureReal_eq
      K Set.univ MeasurableSet.univ w hw hsum
  rcases hApart with ⟨hAmeas, _hAsub, hAdisj, hAunion⟩
  let f : Ω → E := fun ω ↦
    ∑ x ∈ K, (A x).indicator (fun _ ↦ x) ω
  have hfvalue : ∀ ω, ∃ x ∈ K, f ω = x := by
    intro ω
    have hωUnion : ω ∈ ⋃ x ∈ K, A x := by
      rw [hAunion]
      exact Set.mem_univ ω
    rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hωUnion with ⟨x, hωUnion⟩
    rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hωUnion with ⟨hxK, hωA⟩
    refine ⟨x, hxK, ?_⟩
    dsimp only [f]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single x]
    · exact Set.indicator_of_mem hωA (fun _ ↦ x)
    · intro y hyK hyx
      have hdisj : Disjoint (A y) (A x) :=
        hAdisj y hyK x hxK hyx
      have hωnot : ω ∉ A y := fun hωy ↦
        Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisj hωy hωA
      exact Set.indicator_of_notMem hωnot (fun _ ↦ y)
    · exact fun hx ↦ (hx hxK).elim
  have hfInt : Integrable f mu := by
    dsimp only [f]
    exact integrable_finsetSum K fun x hx ↦
      (integrable_const x).indicator (hAmeas x hx)
  refine ⟨f, hfInt, fun ω ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨x, hxK, hfx⟩ := hfvalue ω
    rw [hfx]
    exact hxK
  · calc
      (∫ ω, f ω ∂mu) =
          ∑ x ∈ K, ∫ ω, (A x).indicator (fun _ ↦ x) ω ∂mu := by
        dsimp only [f]
        exact integral_finsetSum K fun x hx ↦
          (integrable_const x).indicator (hAmeas x hx)
      _ = ∑ x ∈ K, mu.real (A x) • x := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro x hx
        exact integral_indicator_const x (hAmeas x hx)
      _ = ∑ x ∈ K, w x • x := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro x hx
        rw [hAmeasure x hx, probReal_univ, mul_one]

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_const_finset_eq_convexHull_of_exactDivisibility
statement:
theorem aumannExpectation_const_finset_eq_convexHull_of_exactDivisibility
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    (mu : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu : HasExactDivisibility mu) (K : Finset E) :
    aumannExpectation mu (fun _ ↦ (K : Set E)) =
      convexHull ℝ (K : Set E)
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · rintro x ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
    apply (convex_convexHull ℝ (K : Set E)).integral_mem
      (K.finite_toSet.isClosed_convexHull ℝ) _ hf.1
    filter_upwards [hf.2] with ω hω
    exact subset_convexHull ℝ (K : Set E) hω
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hsum, hweighted⟩ :=
      (Finset.mem_convexHull' (R := ℝ)).mp hx
    obtain ⟨f, hfInt, hfK, hfIntegral⟩ :=
      hmu.exists_integrable_finsetSelection_integral_eq mu K w hw hsum
    refine ⟨f, ⟨hfInt, Filter.Eventually.of_forall hfK⟩, ?_⟩
    exact hfIntegral.trans hweighted
