name: RandomSetTheory.norm_moment_ge_of_uniformStrongMonotonicity
statement:
theorem norm_moment_ge_of_uniformStrongMonotonicity
    (Theta : Set E) {kappa : ℝ} (g : P → Theta → E) (root : P → Theta)
    (hmono : UniformStrongMonotonicity Theta kappa g)
    (hroot : ∀ p, g p (root p) = 0) (p : P) (theta : Theta) :
    kappa * ‖(theta : E) - (root p : E)‖ ≤ ‖g p theta‖
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hzero : ‖(theta : E) - (root p : E)‖ = 0
  · simp [hzero]
  · have hdist : 0 < ‖(theta : E) - (root p : E)‖ :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne (norm_nonneg _) (Ne.symm hzero)
    have hmon := hmono p theta (root p)
    rw [hroot p, sub_zero] at hmon
    have hcauchy :
        ⟪g p theta, (theta : E) - (root p : E)⟫_ℝ ≤
          ‖g p theta‖ * ‖(theta : E) - (root p : E)‖ :=
      real_inner_le_norm _ _
    nlinarith

name: RandomSetTheory.root_unique_of_uniformStrongMonotonicity
statement:
theorem root_unique_of_uniformStrongMonotonicity
    (Theta : Set E) {kappa : ℝ} (g : P → Theta → E) (root : P → Theta)
    (hkappa : 0 < kappa)
    (hmono : UniformStrongMonotonicity Theta kappa g)
    (hroot : ∀ p, g p (root p) = 0) {p : P} {theta : Theta}
    (htheta : g p theta = 0) :
    theta = root p
proof:
:= by
  have hbound := norm_moment_ge_of_uniformStrongMonotonicity
    Theta g root hmono hroot p theta
  rw [htheta, norm_zero] at hbound
  have hnorm : ‖(theta : E) - (root p : E)‖ = 0 := by
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg ((theta : E) - (root p : E))]
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_eq_zero.mp hnorm)

name: RandomSetTheory.setValuedZeroSet_momentCorrespondence_eq_designatedRootSet
statement:
theorem setValuedZeroSet_momentCorrespondence_eq_designatedRootSet
    (Theta : Set E) {kappa : ℝ} (g : P → Theta → E) (root : P → Theta)
    (hkappa : 0 < kappa)
    (hmono : UniformStrongMonotonicity Theta kappa g)
    (hroot : ∀ p, g p (root p) = 0) :
    setValuedZeroSet (momentCorrespondence Theta g) =
      designatedRootSet Theta root
proof:
:= by
  ext theta
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, hp⟩
    exact ⟨p, root_unique_of_uniformStrongMonotonicity
      Theta g root hkappa hmono hroot hp |>.symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨p, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨p, hroot p⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.infDist_momentCorrespondence_ge_designatedRootSet
statement:
theorem infDist_momentCorrespondence_ge_designatedRootSet
    (Theta : Set E) [Nonempty P] {kappa : ℝ}
    (g : P → Theta → E) (root : P → Theta)
    (hkappa : 0 < kappa)
    (hmono : UniformStrongMonotonicity Theta kappa g)
    (hroot : ∀ p, g p (root p) = 0) (theta : Theta) :
    kappa * infDist theta (designatedRootSet Theta root) ≤
      infDist 0 (momentCorrespondence Theta g theta)
proof:
:= by
  apply (Metric.le_infDist (Set.range_nonempty fun p ↦ g p theta)).2
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hy
  have hrootDist :
      infDist theta (designatedRootSet Theta root) ≤ dist theta (root p) :=
    infDist_le_dist_of_mem ⟨p, rfl⟩
  have hscaled :
      kappa * infDist theta (designatedRootSet Theta root) ≤
        kappa * dist theta (root p) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrootDist hkappa.le
  calc
    kappa * infDist theta (designatedRootSet Theta root)
        ≤ kappa * dist theta (root p) := hscaled
    _ = kappa * ‖(theta : E) - (root p : E)‖ := by
      simp only [Subtype.dist_eq, dist_eq_norm]
    _ ≤ ‖g p theta‖ :=
      norm_moment_ge_of_uniformStrongMonotonicity
        Theta g root hmono hroot p theta
    _ = dist 0 (g p theta) := by simp

name: RandomSetTheory.uniformStrongMonotonicity_zeroSet_errorBound
statement:
theorem uniformStrongMonotonicity_zeroSet_errorBound
    (Theta : Set E) [Nonempty P] {kappa : ℝ}
    (g : P → Theta → E) (root : P → Theta)
    (hkappa : 0 < kappa)
    (hmono : UniformStrongMonotonicity Theta kappa g)
    (hroot : ∀ p, g p (root p) = 0) (theta : Theta) :
    kappa * infDist theta
        (setValuedZeroSet (momentCorrespondence Theta g)) ≤
      infDist 0 (momentCorrespondence Theta g theta)
proof:
:= by
  rw [setValuedZeroSet_momentCorrespondence_eq_designatedRootSet
    Theta g root hkappa hmono hroot]
  exact infDist_momentCorrespondence_ge_designatedRootSet
    Theta g root hkappa hmono hroot theta

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_enlarged_momentCorrespondence_le_of_uniformStrongMonotonicity
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_enlarged_momentCorrespondence_le_of_uniformStrongMonotonicity
    (Theta : Set E) [Nonempty P] {kappa Delta : ℝ}
    (g : P → Theta → E) (root : P → Theta)
    (hkappa : 0 < kappa) (hDelta : 0 ≤ Delta)
    (hmono : UniformStrongMonotonicity Theta kappa g)
    (hroot : ∀ p, g p (root p) = 0)
    (Ghat : Theta → Set E)
    (hfin : ∀ theta,
      hausdorffEDist (Ghat theta) (momentCorrespondence Theta g theta) ≠ ⊤)
    (hhaus : ∀ theta,
      hausdorffDist (Ghat theta) (momentCorrespondence Theta g theta) ≤ Delta) :
    hausdorffDist (enlargedSetValuedZeroSet Ghat Delta)
        (designatedRootSet Theta root) ≤ 2 * Delta / kappa
proof:
:= by
  rw [← setValuedZeroSet_momentCorrespondence_eq_designatedRootSet
    Theta g root hkappa hmono hroot]
  exact hausdorffDist_enlargedSetValuedZeroSet_le Ghat
    (momentCorrespondence Theta g) hDelta hkappa hfin hhaus
    (uniformStrongMonotonicity_zeroSet_errorBound
      Theta g root hkappa hmono hroot)

name: ProbabilityTheory.conditionalValueAtRisk_finiteCoordinateSumSupremum_le_rioConfidence
statement:
theorem conditionalValueAtRisk_finiteCoordinateSumSupremum_le_rioConfidence
    {mu : Measure Omega} {nu : Measure Z}
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    [StandardBorelSpace Z] [Nonempty Z] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (z0 : Z) (Y : Nat -> Omega -> Z)
    (hY : forall i, Measurable (Y i)) (hIndep : iIndepFun Y mu)
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (n q : Nat) (hq : 3 <= q)
    (W : Fin n -> Z -> T -> Real) (A : Fin n -> Z -> Real)
    (hYlaw : forall i, i < n -> mu.map (Y i) = nu)
    (hW : forall j t, t ∈ s -> Measurable (fun z => W j z t))
    (hAq : forall j, MemLp (A j) q nu)
    (hA : forall j z, 0 <= A j z)
    (hdom : forall j z t, t ∈ s -> abs (W j z t) <= A j z)
    {V Q alpha : Real} (hV : 0 < V) (hQ : 0 < Q)
    (hsecond :
      (∑ i : Fin n, replaceOneCenteredMoment nu (A i) 2) <= V)
    (hmomentQ :
      (∑ i : Fin n, replaceOneCenteredMoment nu (A i) q) <= Q)
    (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha < 1) :
    conditionalValueAtRisk alpha
        (fun omega =>
          finiteCoordinateSumSupremum s hs W (fun j => Y j omega) -
            ∫ z, finiteCoordinateSumSupremum s hs W
              (fun j => Y j z) ∂mu) mu <=
      rioStrongMomentConfidenceRadius q V Q alpha
proof:
:= by
  have hRio := conditionalValueAtRisk_finiteCoordinateSumSupremum_le_rio
    z0 Y hY hIndep s hs n q hq W A hYlaw hW hAq hA hdom
      hV hQ (rioConfidenceScale_pos hQ halpha0) hsecond hmomentQ
      halpha0 halpha1 (rio_scale_condition (by omega) hQ halpha0)
  exact conditionalValueAtRisk_le_rioStrongMomentConfidenceRadius
    hq hQ halpha0 hRio

name: RandomSetTheory.abs_infDist_sub_infDist_le_hausdorffDist
statement:
theorem abs_infDist_sub_infDist_le_hausdorffDist
    {X : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace X] (x : X) (s t : Set X)
    (hfin : hausdorffEDist s t ≠ ⊤) :
    |infDist x s - infDist x t| ≤ hausdorffDist s t
proof:
:= by
  rw [abs_sub_le_iff]
  have hst := infDist_le_infDist_add_hausdorffDist (x := x) hfin
  have hfin' : hausdorffEDist t s ≠ ⊤ := by
    simpa [hausdorffEDist_comm] using hfin
  have hts := infDist_le_infDist_add_hausdorffDist (x := x) hfin'
  rw [hausdorffDist_comm] at hts
  constructor <;> linarith

name: RandomSetTheory.abs_infDist_zero_sub_infDist_zero_le_hausdorffDist
statement:
theorem abs_infDist_zero_sub_infDist_zero_le_hausdorffDist
    {X : Type*} [SeminormedAddCommGroup X] (s t : Set X)
    (hfin : hausdorffEDist s t ≠ ⊤) :
    |infDist 0 s - infDist 0 t| ≤ hausdorffDist s t
proof:
:=
  abs_infDist_sub_infDist_le_hausdorffDist 0 s t hfin

name: RandomSetTheory.closedConvexHull_compact
statement:
theorem closedConvexHull_compact {E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {K : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K) :
    IsCompact (closedConvexHull ℝ K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [closedConvexHull_eq_closure_convexHull]
  exact (isBounded_convexHull.mpr hK.isBounded).isCompact_closure

name: RandomSetTheory.supportFunction_closedConvexHull
statement:
theorem supportFunction_closedConvexHull {E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {K : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K) (hKne : K.Nonempty) (u : E) :
    supportFunction (closedConvexHull ℝ K) u = supportFunction K u
proof:
:= by
  have hc : IsCompact (closedConvexHull ℝ K) := closedConvexHull_compact hK
  have hinner : Continuous (fun y : E => ⟪u, y⟫_ℝ) := by fun_prop
  apply le_antisymm
  · obtain ⟨x, hx, hsup⟩ := supportFunction_attains hc
      (hKne.mono subset_closedConvexHull) u
    rw [hsup]
    have hsub : K ⊆ {y | ⟪u, y⟫_ℝ ≤ supportFunction K u} :=
      fun y hy => inner_le_supportFunction hK hy u
    exact closedConvexHull_min hsub
      (by simpa only [innerₗ_apply_apply] using
        convex_halfSpace_le (innerₗ E u).isLinear (supportFunction K u))
      (isClosed_Iic.preimage hinner) hx
  · exact supportFunction_mono hK hc hKne subset_closedConvexHull u

name: RandomSetTheory.mem_iff_inner_le_supportFunction
statement:
theorem mem_iff_inner_le_supportFunction {E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    {K : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K) (hKne : K.Nonempty)
    (hKconv : Convex ℝ K) (x : E) :
    x ∈ K ↔ ∀ u : E, ⟪u, x⟫_ℝ ≤ supportFunction K u
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx u
    exact inner_le_supportFunction hK hx u
  · intro hx
    by_contra hxK
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hmin⟩ :=
      exists_norm_eq_iInf_of_complete_convex hKne hK.isComplete hKconv x
    let u := x - y
    have hproj : ∀ z ∈ K, ⟪u, z - y⟫_ℝ ≤ 0 := by
      simpa [u] using
        (norm_eq_iInf_iff_real_inner_le_zero hKconv hy).mp hmin
    have hsupport_y : supportFunction K u = ⟪u, y⟫_ℝ := by
      apply le_antisymm
      · obtain ⟨z, hz, hatt⟩ := supportFunction_attains hK hKne u
        rw [hatt]
        have hzproj := hproj z hz
        rw [inner_sub_right] at hzproj
        linarith
      · exact inner_le_supportFunction hK hy u
    have hxy : x ≠ y := fun hxy => hxK (hxy ▸ hy)
    have hu : u ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hxy
    have hstrict : supportFunction K u < ⟪u, x⟫_ℝ := by
      rw [hsupport_y]
      have hpos : 0 < ⟪u, u⟫_ℝ := real_inner_self_pos.mpr hu
      rw [show u = x - y from rfl, inner_sub_right] at hpos
      linarith
    exact (not_lt_of_ge (hx u)) hstrict

name: RandomSetTheory.eq_of_supportFunction_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_supportFunction_eq {E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    {K L : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K) (hL : IsCompact L)
    (hKne : K.Nonempty) (hLne : L.Nonempty)
    (hKconv : Convex ℝ K) (hLconv : Convex ℝ L)
    (h : ∀ u : E, supportFunction K u = supportFunction L u) :
    K = L
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [mem_iff_inner_le_supportFunction hK hKne hKconv,
    mem_iff_inner_le_supportFunction hL hLne hLconv]
  simp_rw [h]

name: RandomSetTheory.closedConvexHull_minkowskiAverage
statement:
theorem closedConvexHull_minkowskiAverage {E ι : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (s : Finset ι) (K : ι → Set E)
    (hK : ∀ i ∈ s, IsCompact (K i))
    (hKne : ∀ i ∈ s, (K i).Nonempty) :
    closedConvexHull ℝ (minkowskiAverage s K) =
      minkowskiAverage s (fun i => closedConvexHull ℝ (K i))
proof:
:= by
  have hAvgCompact : IsCompact (minkowskiAverage s K) :=
    isCompact_minkowskiAverage s K hK
  have hAvgNe : (minkowskiAverage s K).Nonempty :=
    nonempty_minkowskiAverage s K hKne
  have hHullCompact : ∀ i ∈ s, IsCompact (closedConvexHull ℝ (K i)) :=
    fun i hi => closedConvexHull_compact (hK i hi)
  have hHullNe : ∀ i ∈ s, (closedConvexHull ℝ (K i)).Nonempty :=
    fun i hi => (hKne i hi).mono subset_closedConvexHull
  apply eq_of_supportFunction_eq
    (closedConvexHull_compact hAvgCompact)
    (isCompact_minkowskiAverage s _ hHullCompact)
    (hAvgNe.mono subset_closedConvexHull)
    (nonempty_minkowskiAverage s _ hHullNe)
    convex_closedConvexHull
    (convex_minkowskiAverage s _ (fun _ _ => convex_closedConvexHull))
  intro u
  rw [supportFunction_closedConvexHull hAvgCompact hAvgNe u]
  rw [supportFunction_minkowskiAverage s K hK hKne u]
  rw [supportFunction_minkowskiAverage s _ hHullCompact hHullNe u]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  exact (supportFunction_closedConvexHull (hK i hi) (hKne i hi) u).symm

name: RandomSetTheory.supportFunction_sub_le_norm_mul_hausdorffDist
statement:
theorem supportFunction_sub_le_norm_mul_hausdorffDist {E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    {K L : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K) (hL : IsCompact L)
    (hKne : K.Nonempty) (hLne : L.Nonempty) (u : E) :
    supportFunction K u - supportFunction L u ≤ ‖u‖ * hausdorffDist K L
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxsup⟩ := supportFunction_attains hK hKne u
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := hL.exists_infDist_eq_dist hLne x
  have hdist : dist x y ≤ hausdorffDist K L := by
    rw [← hxy]
    exact infDist_le_hausdorffDist_of_mem hx
      (hausdorffEDist_ne_top_of_nonempty_of_bounded
        hKne hLne hK.isBounded hL.isBounded)
  have hinner : ⟪u, y⟫_ℝ ≤ supportFunction L u :=
    inner_le_supportFunction hL hy u
  calc
    supportFunction K u - supportFunction L u =
        ⟪u, x⟫_ℝ - supportFunction L u := by rw [hxsup]
    _ ≤ ⟪u, x⟫_ℝ - ⟪u, y⟫_ℝ := sub_le_sub_left hinner _
    _ = ⟪u, x - y⟫_ℝ := (inner_sub_right _ _ _).symm
    _ ≤ |⟪u, x - y⟫_ℝ| := le_abs_self _
    _ ≤ ‖u‖ * ‖x - y‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
    _ = ‖u‖ * dist x y := by rw [dist_eq_norm]
    _ ≤ ‖u‖ * hausdorffDist K L :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdist (norm_nonneg _)

name: RandomSetTheory.abs_supportFunction_sub_le_hausdorffDist
statement:
theorem abs_supportFunction_sub_le_hausdorffDist {E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    {K L : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K) (hL : IsCompact L)
    (hKne : K.Nonempty) (hLne : L.Nonempty) (u : E) :
    |supportFunction K u - supportFunction L u| ≤ ‖u‖ * hausdorffDist K L
proof:
:= by
  rw [abs_sub_le_iff]
  constructor
  · exact supportFunction_sub_le_norm_mul_hausdorffDist hK hL hKne hLne u
  · rw [hausdorffDist_comm]
    exact supportFunction_sub_le_norm_mul_hausdorffDist hL hK hLne hKne u

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_mem_dist_le_of_supportFunction_sub_le
statement:
private theorem exists_mem_dist_le_of_supportFunction_sub_le
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    {K L : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K) (hL : IsCompact L)
    (hLne : L.Nonempty) (hLconv : Convex ℝ L)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hsupport : ∀ u : E,
      supportFunction K u - supportFunction L u ≤ r * ‖u‖)
    {x : E} (hx : x ∈ K) :
    ∃ y ∈ L, dist x y ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hmin⟩ :=
    exists_norm_eq_iInf_of_complete_convex hLne hL.isComplete hLconv x
  have hproj : ∀ z ∈ L, ⟪x - y, z - y⟫_ℝ ≤ 0 :=
    (norm_eq_iInf_iff_real_inner_le_zero hLconv hy).mp hmin
  have hsupport_y :
      supportFunction L (x - y) = ⟪x - y, y⟫_ℝ := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · obtain ⟨z, hz, hatt⟩ := supportFunction_attains hL hLne (x - y)
      rw [hatt]
      have hzproj := hproj z hz
      rw [inner_sub_right] at hzproj
      linarith
    · exact inner_le_supportFunction hL hy (x - y)
  have hsupport_x :
      ⟪x - y, x⟫_ℝ ≤ supportFunction K (x - y) :=
    inner_le_supportFunction hK hx (x - y)
  have hsq : ‖x - y‖ * ‖x - y‖ ≤ r * ‖x - y‖ := by
    calc
      ‖x - y‖ * ‖x - y‖ = ⟪x - y, x - y⟫_ℝ :=
        (real_inner_self_eq_norm_mul_norm (x - y)).symm
      _ = ⟪x - y, x⟫_ℝ - ⟪x - y, y⟫_ℝ := inner_sub_right _ _ _
      _ ≤ supportFunction K (x - y) - supportFunction L (x - y) := by
        rw [hsupport_y]
        exact sub_le_sub_right hsupport_x _
      _ ≤ r * ‖x - y‖ := hsupport (x - y)
  have hnorm : ‖x - y‖ ≤ r := by
    by_cases hzero : ‖x - y‖ = 0
    · simpa [hzero] using hr
    · have hpos : 0 < ‖x - y‖ :=
        lt_of_le_of_ne (norm_nonneg _) (Ne.symm hzero)
      nlinarith
  exact ⟨y, hy, by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hnorm⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_le_of_supportFunction_sub_le
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_le_of_supportFunction_sub_le {E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    {K L : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K) (hL : IsCompact L)
    (hKne : K.Nonempty) (hLne : L.Nonempty)
    (hKconv : Convex ℝ K) (hLconv : Convex ℝ L)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hKL : ∀ u : E,
      supportFunction K u - supportFunction L u ≤ r * ‖u‖)
    (hLK : ∀ u : E,
      supportFunction L u - supportFunction K u ≤ r * ‖u‖) :
    hausdorffDist K L ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  apply hausdorffDist_le_of_mem_dist hr
  · intro x hx
    exact exists_mem_dist_le_of_supportFunction_sub_le
      hK hL hLne hLconv hr hKL hx
  · intro y hy
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hdist⟩ := exists_mem_dist_le_of_supportFunction_sub_le
      hL hK hKne hKconv hr hLK hy
    exact ⟨x, hx, by simpa [dist_comm] using hdist⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_le_of_abs_supportFunction_sub_le
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_le_of_abs_supportFunction_sub_le {E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    {K L : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K) (hL : IsCompact L)
    (hKne : K.Nonempty) (hLne : L.Nonempty)
    (hKconv : Convex ℝ K) (hLconv : Convex ℝ L)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (h : ∀ u : E,
      |supportFunction K u - supportFunction L u| ≤ r * ‖u‖) :
    hausdorffDist K L ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  apply hausdorffDist_le_of_supportFunction_sub_le hK hL hKne hLne
    hKconv hLconv hr
  · intro u
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans (h u)
  · intro u
    have hu := h u
    rw [abs_sub_comm] at hu
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans hu

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_le_of_unitBall_supportFunction_sub_le
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_le_of_unitBall_supportFunction_sub_le {E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    {K L : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K) (hL : IsCompact L)
    (hKne : K.Nonempty) (hLne : L.Nonempty)
    (hKconv : Convex ℝ K) (hLconv : Convex ℝ L)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (h : ∀ u : E, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 →
      |supportFunction K u - supportFunction L u| ≤ r) :
    hausdorffDist K L ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  apply hausdorffDist_le_of_abs_supportFunction_sub_le
    hK hL hKne hLne hKconv hLconv hr
  intro u
  by_cases hu : u = 0
  · subst u
    simp [supportFunction_zero hK hKne, supportFunction_zero hL hLne]
  · let v : E := ‖u‖⁻¹ • u
    have hunorm : ‖u‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hu
    have hvnorm : ‖v‖ = 1 := by
      simp [v, norm_smul, hunorm]
    have huv : ‖u‖ • v = u := by
      simp [v, smul_smul, hunorm]
    have hKu : supportFunction K u = ‖u‖ * supportFunction K v := by
      calc
        supportFunction K u = supportFunction K (‖u‖ • v) := congrArg _ huv.symm
        _ = ‖u‖ * supportFunction K v :=
          supportFunction_smul_direction hK hKne (norm_nonneg u) v
    have hLu : supportFunction L u = ‖u‖ * supportFunction L v := by
      calc
        supportFunction L u = supportFunction L (‖u‖ • v) := congrArg _ huv.symm
        _ = ‖u‖ * supportFunction L v :=
          supportFunction_smul_direction hL hLne (norm_nonneg u) v
    rw [hKu, hLu, ← mul_sub, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg u)]
    calc
      ‖u‖ * |supportFunction K v - supportFunction L v| ≤ ‖u‖ * r :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h v hvnorm.le) (norm_nonneg u)
      _ = r * ‖u‖ := mul_comm _ _

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_le_of_finset_net_supportFunction
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_le_of_finset_net_supportFunction {E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    {K L : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K) (hL : IsCompact L)
    (hKne : K.Nonempty) (hLne : L.Nonempty)
    (hKconv : Convex ℝ K) (hLconv : Convex ℝ L)
    {RK RL eps s : ℝ}
    (hRK : ∀ x ∈ K, ‖x‖ ≤ RK) (hRL : ∀ x ∈ L, ‖x‖ ≤ RL)
    (heps : 0 ≤ eps) (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (N : Finset E)
    (hnet : ∀ u : E, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 → ∃ v ∈ N, dist u v ≤ eps)
    (hN : ∀ v ∈ N,
      |supportFunction K v - supportFunction L v| ≤ s) :
    hausdorffDist K L ≤ s + (RK + RL) * eps
proof:
:= by
  have hRK0 : 0 ≤ RK := by
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hKne
    exact (norm_nonneg x).trans (hRK x hx)
  have hRL0 : 0 ≤ RL := by
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hLne
    exact (norm_nonneg x).trans (hRL x hx)
  apply hausdorffDist_le_of_unitBall_supportFunction_sub_le
    hK hL hKne hLne hKconv hLconv
    (add_nonneg hs (mul_nonneg (add_nonneg hRK0 hRL0) heps))
  intro u hu
  obtain ⟨v, hvN, huv⟩ := hnet u hu
  have hLip := abs_supportFunctionDifference_sub_le
    hK hL hKne hLne hRK hRL u v
  have hdistnorm : ‖u - v‖ = dist u v := by rw [dist_eq_norm]
  calc
    |supportFunction K u - supportFunction L u| =
        |(supportFunction K v - supportFunction L v) +
          ((supportFunction K u - supportFunction L u) -
            (supportFunction K v - supportFunction L v))| := by
              congr 1
              ring
    _ ≤ |supportFunction K v - supportFunction L v| +
        |(supportFunction K u - supportFunction L u) -
          (supportFunction K v - supportFunction L v)| := abs_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ s + (RK + RL) * ‖u - v‖ := add_le_add (hN v hvN) hLip
    _ = s + (RK + RL) * dist u v := by rw [hdistnorm]
    _ ≤ s + (RK + RL) * eps := by
      gcongr

name: RandomSetTheory.supportHausdorffGap_eq_hausdorffDist
statement:
theorem supportHausdorffGap_eq_hausdorffDist {E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    {K L : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K) (hL : IsCompact L)
    (hKne : K.Nonempty) (hLne : L.Nonempty)
    (hKconv : Convex ℝ K) (hLconv : Convex ℝ L) :
    supportHausdorffGap K L = hausdorffDist K L
proof:
:= by
  let A : Set ℝ :=
    (fun u : E => |supportFunction K u - supportFunction L u|) ''
      Metric.closedBall 0 1
  have hupper : ∀ z ∈ A, z ≤ hausdorffDist K L := by
    rintro z ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
    have hunorm : ‖u‖ ≤ 1 := by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall] using hu
    calc
      |supportFunction K u - supportFunction L u| ≤
          ‖u‖ * hausdorffDist K L :=
        abs_supportFunction_sub_le_hausdorffDist hK hL hKne hLne u
      _ ≤ 1 * hausdorffDist K L :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hunorm hausdorffDist_nonneg
      _ = hausdorffDist K L := one_mul _
  have hAne : A.Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨|supportFunction K 0 - supportFunction L 0|, ?_⟩
    exact ⟨0, by simp, rfl⟩
  have hAbdd : BddAbove A := ⟨hausdorffDist K L, hupper⟩
  apply le_antisymm
  · change sSup A ≤ hausdorffDist K L
    exact csSup_le hAne hupper
  · apply hausdorffDist_le_of_unitBall_supportFunction_sub_le
      hK hL hKne hLne hKconv hLconv
    · change 0 ≤ sSup A
      have hzero : (0 : ℝ) ∈ A := by
        refine ⟨0, by simp, ?_⟩
        simp [supportFunction_zero hK hKne, supportFunction_zero hL hLne]
      exact le_csSup hAbdd hzero
    · intro u hu
      change |supportFunction K u - supportFunction L u| ≤ sSup A
      apply le_csSup hAbdd
      exact ⟨u, by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall] using hu, rfl⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_closedConvexHull_le
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_closedConvexHull_le {E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {s t : Set E} (hs : IsCompact s) (ht : IsCompact t)
    (sne : s.Nonempty) (tne : t.Nonempty) :
    hausdorffDist (closedConvexHull ℝ s) (closedConvexHull ℝ t) ≤
      hausdorffDist s t
proof:
:= by
  let r := hausdorffDist s t
  have hfin : hausdorffEDist s t ≠ ⊤ :=
    hausdorffEDist_ne_top_of_nonempty_of_bounded sne tne hs.isBounded ht.isBounded
  have hst : s ⊆ cthickening r (closedConvexHull ℝ t) := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := ht.exists_infDist_eq_dist tne x
    apply mem_cthickening_of_dist_le x y r (closedConvexHull ℝ t)
    · exact subset_closedConvexHull hy
    · rw [← hxy]
      exact infDist_le_hausdorffDist_of_mem hx hfin
  have hts : t ⊆ cthickening r (closedConvexHull ℝ s) := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hyx⟩ := hs.exists_infDist_eq_dist sne y
    apply mem_cthickening_of_dist_le y x r (closedConvexHull ℝ s)
    · exact subset_closedConvexHull hx
    · rw [← hyx]
      change infDist y s ≤ hausdorffDist s t
      rw [hausdorffDist_comm]
      apply infDist_le_hausdorffDist_of_mem hy
      rwa [hausdorffEDist_comm]
  have hcst : closedConvexHull ℝ s ⊆ cthickening r (closedConvexHull ℝ t) :=
    closedConvexHull_min hst (convex_closedConvexHull.cthickening r)
      isClosed_cthickening
  have hcts : closedConvexHull ℝ t ⊆ cthickening r (closedConvexHull ℝ s) :=
    closedConvexHull_min hts (convex_closedConvexHull.cthickening r)
      isClosed_cthickening
  apply hausdorffDist_le_of_infDist hausdorffDist_nonneg
  · intro x hx
    exact calc
      infDist x (closedConvexHull ℝ t) =
          (infEDist x (closedConvexHull ℝ t)).toReal := rfl
      _ ≤ (ENNReal.ofReal r).toReal :=
        ENNReal.toReal_mono ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top (hcst hx)
      _ = r := ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hausdorffDist_nonneg
  · intro y hy
    exact calc
      infDist y (closedConvexHull ℝ s) =
          (infEDist y (closedConvexHull ℝ s)).toReal := rfl
      _ ≤ (ENNReal.ofReal r).toReal :=
        ENNReal.toReal_mono ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top (hcts hy)
      _ = r := ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hausdorffDist_nonneg

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_image_le_of_lipschitzWith
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_image_le_of_lipschitzWith
    {X Y : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace X] [PseudoMetricSpace Y]
    {f : X → Y} {K L : Set X} {c : NNReal}
    (hf : LipschitzWith c f) (hK : IsCompact K) (hL : IsCompact L)
    (hKne : K.Nonempty) (hLne : L.Nonempty) :
    hausdorffDist (f '' K) (f '' L) ≤
      (c : ℝ) * hausdorffDist K L
proof:
:= by
  have hfin : hausdorffEDist K L ≠ ⊤ :=
    hausdorffEDist_ne_top_of_nonempty_of_bounded
      hKne hLne hK.isBounded hL.isBounded
  apply hausdorffDist_le_of_mem_dist
    (mul_nonneg c.coe_nonneg hausdorffDist_nonneg)
  · rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := hL.exists_infDist_eq_dist hLne x
    refine ⟨f y, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    calc
      dist (f x) (f y) ≤ (c : ℝ) * dist x y := hf.dist_le_mul x y
      _ = (c : ℝ) * infDist x L := by rw [hxy]
      _ ≤ (c : ℝ) * hausdorffDist K L := by
        gcongr
        exact infDist_le_hausdorffDist_of_mem hx hfin
  · rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hyx⟩ := hK.exists_infDist_eq_dist hKne y
    refine ⟨f x, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    calc
      dist (f y) (f x) ≤ (c : ℝ) * dist y x := hf.dist_le_mul y x
      _ = (c : ℝ) * infDist y K := by rw [hyx]
      _ ≤ (c : ℝ) * hausdorffDist K L := by
        gcongr
        rw [hausdorffDist_comm]
        apply infDist_le_hausdorffDist_of_mem hy
        simpa [hausdorffEDist_comm] using hfin

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_self_closedConvexHull_le_of_approx
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_self_closedConvexHull_le_of_approx
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {s : Set E} {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (happrox : ∀ x ∈ closedConvexHull ℝ s, ∃ y ∈ s, dist x y ≤ r) :
    hausdorffDist s (closedConvexHull ℝ s) ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  apply hausdorffDist_le_of_mem_dist hr
  · intro x hx
    exact ⟨x, subset_closedConvexHull hx, by simpa using hr⟩
  · exact happrox

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_mem_infDist_eq_directedHausdorffDist
statement:
theorem exists_mem_infDist_eq_directedHausdorffDist
    {K L : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K) (hKne : K.Nonempty) :
    ∃ x ∈ K, infDist x L = directedHausdorffDist K L
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hmax⟩ := hK.exists_sSup_image_eq hKne
    ((continuous_infDist_pt L).continuousOn :
      ContinuousOn (fun x => infDist x L) K)
  exact ⟨x, hx, hmax.symm⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.infDist_le_directedHausdorffDist
statement:
theorem infDist_le_directedHausdorffDist
    {K L : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K)
    {x : E} (hx : x ∈ K) :
    infDist x L ≤ directedHausdorffDist K L
proof:
:= by
  unfold directedHausdorffDist
  exact le_csSup (hK.image (continuous_infDist_pt L)).bddAbove
    (mem_image_of_mem _ hx)

name: RandomSetTheory.directedHausdorffDist_nonneg
statement:
theorem directedHausdorffDist_nonneg
    {K L : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K) (hKne : K.Nonempty) :
    0 ≤ directedHausdorffDist K L
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hKne
  exact infDist_nonneg.trans
    (infDist_le_directedHausdorffDist hK hx)

name: RandomSetTheory.directedHausdorffDist_le_hausdorffDist
statement:
theorem directedHausdorffDist_le_hausdorffDist
    {K L : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K) (hL : IsCompact L)
    (hKne : K.Nonempty) (hLne : L.Nonempty) :
    directedHausdorffDist K L ≤ hausdorffDist K L
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hmax⟩ :=
    exists_mem_infDist_eq_directedHausdorffDist hK hKne (L := L)
  rw [← hmax]
  exact infDist_le_hausdorffDist_of_mem hx
    (hausdorffEDist_ne_top_of_nonempty_of_bounded
      hKne hLne hK.isBounded hL.isBounded)

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_eq_max_directedHausdorffDist
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_eq_max_directedHausdorffDist
    {K L : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K) (hL : IsCompact L)
    (hKne : K.Nonempty) (hLne : L.Nonempty) :
    hausdorffDist K L =
      max (directedHausdorffDist K L) (directedHausdorffDist L K)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · have hr : 0 ≤
        max (directedHausdorffDist K L) (directedHausdorffDist L K) :=
      (directedHausdorffDist_nonneg hK hKne).trans
        (le_max_left _ _)
    apply hausdorffDist_le_of_infDist hr
    · intro x hx
      exact (infDist_le_directedHausdorffDist hK hx).trans
        (le_max_left _ _)
    · intro y hy
      exact (infDist_le_directedHausdorffDist hL hy).trans
        (le_max_right _ _)
  · apply max_le
    · exact directedHausdorffDist_le_hausdorffDist hK hL hKne hLne
    · simpa only [hausdorffDist_comm] using
        (directedHausdorffDist_le_hausdorffDist hL hK hLne hKne)

name: RandomSetTheory.continuous_supportFunction_sub
statement:
private theorem continuous_supportFunction_sub
    {K L : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K) (hL : IsCompact L)
    (hKne : K.Nonempty) (hLne : L.Nonempty) :
    Continuous (fun u : E => supportFunction K u - supportFunction L u)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨RK, hRK⟩ := hK.isBounded.exists_norm_le
  obtain ⟨RL, hRL⟩ := hL.isBounded.exists_norm_le
  have hRK0 : 0 ≤ RK := by
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hKne
    exact (norm_nonneg x).trans (hRK x hx)
  have hRL0 : 0 ≤ RL := by
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hLne
    exact (norm_nonneg y).trans (hRL y hy)
  let C : NNReal := ⟨RK + RL, add_nonneg hRK0 hRL0⟩
  apply (LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul (K := C) ?_).continuous
  intro u v
  rw [show (C : ℝ) = RK + RL by rfl]
  simpa only [Real.dist_eq, dist_eq_norm, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      (abs_supportFunctionDifference_sub_le
        hK hL hKne hLne hRK hRL u v)

name: RandomSetTheory.directedSupportGap_nonneg
statement:
theorem directedSupportGap_nonneg
    {K L : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K) (hL : IsCompact L)
    (hKne : K.Nonempty) (hLne : L.Nonempty) :
    0 ≤ directedSupportGap K L
proof:
:= by
  unfold directedSupportGap
  have hcompact : IsCompact
      ((fun u : E => supportFunction K u - supportFunction L u) ''
        Metric.closedBall 0 1) := by
    exact (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E) 1).image
      (continuous_supportFunction_sub hK hL hKne hLne)
  have hzero : 0 ∈
      (fun u : E => supportFunction K u - supportFunction L u) ''
        Metric.closedBall 0 1 := by
    refine ⟨0, by simp, ?_⟩
    simp [supportFunction_zero hK hKne, supportFunction_zero hL hLne]
  exact (le_csSup hcompact.bddAbove hzero)

name: RandomSetTheory.supportFunction_sub_le_directedSupportGap
statement:
theorem supportFunction_sub_le_directedSupportGap
    {K L : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K) (hL : IsCompact L)
    (hKne : K.Nonempty) (hLne : L.Nonempty)
    {u : E} (hu : ‖u‖ ≤ 1) :
    supportFunction K u - supportFunction L u ≤ directedSupportGap K L
proof:
:= by
  unfold directedSupportGap
  have hcompact : IsCompact
      ((fun v : E => supportFunction K v - supportFunction L v) ''
        Metric.closedBall 0 1) := by
    exact (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E) 1).image
      (continuous_supportFunction_sub hK hL hKne hLne)
  apply le_csSup hcompact.bddAbove
  exact ⟨u, by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hu, rfl⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.supportFunction_sub_le_directedHausdorffDist
statement:
theorem supportFunction_sub_le_directedHausdorffDist
    {K L : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K) (hL : IsCompact L)
    (hKne : K.Nonempty) (hLne : L.Nonempty) (u : E) :
    supportFunction K u - supportFunction L u ≤
      ‖u‖ * directedHausdorffDist K L
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxsup⟩ := supportFunction_attains hK hKne u
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := hL.exists_infDist_eq_dist hLne x
  have hdist : dist x y ≤ directedHausdorffDist K L := by
    rw [← hxy]
    exact infDist_le_directedHausdorffDist hK hx
  have hinner : ⟪u, y⟫_ℝ ≤ supportFunction L u :=
    inner_le_supportFunction hL hy u
  calc
    supportFunction K u - supportFunction L u =
        ⟪u, x⟫_ℝ - supportFunction L u := by rw [hxsup]
    _ ≤ ⟪u, x⟫_ℝ - ⟪u, y⟫_ℝ := sub_le_sub_left hinner _
    _ = ⟪u, x - y⟫_ℝ := (inner_sub_right _ _ _).symm
    _ ≤ |⟪u, x - y⟫_ℝ| := le_abs_self _
    _ ≤ ‖u‖ * ‖x - y‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
    _ = ‖u‖ * dist x y := by rw [dist_eq_norm]
    _ ≤ ‖u‖ * directedHausdorffDist K L :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdist (norm_nonneg _)

name: RandomSetTheory.directedSupportGap_le_directedHausdorffDist
statement:
theorem directedSupportGap_le_directedHausdorffDist
    {K L : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K) (hL : IsCompact L)
    (hKne : K.Nonempty) (hLne : L.Nonempty) :
    directedSupportGap K L ≤ directedHausdorffDist K L
proof:
:= by
  unfold directedSupportGap
  apply csSup_le
  · exact ⟨0, by
      refine ⟨0, by simp, ?_⟩
      simp [supportFunction_zero hK hKne, supportFunction_zero hL hLne]⟩
  · rintro z ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
    have hu' : ‖u‖ ≤ 1 := by
      simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hu
    calc
      supportFunction K u - supportFunction L u ≤
          ‖u‖ * directedHausdorffDist K L :=
        supportFunction_sub_le_directedHausdorffDist hK hL hKne hLne u
      _ ≤ 1 * directedHausdorffDist K L :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hu'
          (directedHausdorffDist_nonneg hK hKne)
      _ = directedHausdorffDist K L := one_mul _

name: RandomSetTheory.supportFunction_displacement_eq_inner_nearest
statement:
private theorem supportFunction_displacement_eq_inner_nearest
    {L : Set E} (hL : IsCompact L) (hLne : L.Nonempty)
    (hLconv : Convex ℝ L) {x y : E} (hy : y ∈ L)
    (hxy : infDist x L = dist x y) :
    supportFunction L (x - y) = ⟪x - y, y⟫_ℝ
proof:
:= by
  have hmin : ‖x - y‖ = ⨅ z : L, ‖x - z‖ := by
    rw [← dist_eq_norm, ← hxy, infDist_eq_iInf]
    congr 1
    funext z
    rw [dist_eq_norm]
  have hproj : ∀ z ∈ L, ⟪x - y, z - y⟫_ℝ ≤ 0 :=
    (norm_eq_iInf_iff_real_inner_le_zero hLconv hy).mp hmin
  apply le_antisymm
  · obtain ⟨z, hz, hatt⟩ := supportFunction_attains hL hLne (x - y)
    rw [hatt]
    have hzproj := hproj z hz
    rw [inner_sub_right] at hzproj
    linarith
  · exact inner_le_supportFunction hL hy (x - y)

name: RandomSetTheory.directedHausdorffDist_le_directedSupportGap
statement:
theorem directedHausdorffDist_le_directedSupportGap
    {K L : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K) (hL : IsCompact L)
    (hKne : K.Nonempty) (hLne : L.Nonempty) (hLconv : Convex ℝ L) :
    directedHausdorffDist K L ≤ directedSupportGap K L
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxd⟩ :=
    exists_mem_infDist_eq_directedHausdorffDist hK hKne (L := L)
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := hL.exists_infDist_eq_dist hLne x
  by_cases hzero : ‖x - y‖ = 0
  · have hd0 : directedHausdorffDist K L = 0 := by
      rw [← hxd, hxy, dist_eq_norm, hzero]
    rw [hd0]
    exact directedSupportGap_nonneg hK hL hKne hLne
  · let u : E := ‖x - y‖⁻¹ • (x - y)
    have hnormpos : 0 < ‖x - y‖ :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne (norm_nonneg _) (Ne.symm hzero)
    have huNorm : ‖u‖ = 1 := by
      change ‖‖x - y‖⁻¹ • (x - y)‖ = 1
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hnormpos), inv_mul_cancel₀ hzero]
    have huBall : ‖u‖ ≤ 1 := huNorm.le
    have hsupportL : supportFunction L u = ⟪u, y⟫_ℝ := by
      calc
        supportFunction L u = ‖x - y‖⁻¹ * supportFunction L (x - y) := by
          change supportFunction L (‖x - y‖⁻¹ • (x - y)) = _
          rw [supportFunction_smul_direction hL hLne
            (inv_nonneg.mpr hnormpos.le)]
        _ = ‖x - y‖⁻¹ * ⟪x - y, y⟫_ℝ := by
          rw [supportFunction_displacement_eq_inner_nearest
            hL hLne hLconv hy hxy]
        _ = ⟪u, y⟫_ℝ := by
          change _ = ⟪‖x - y‖⁻¹ • (x - y), y⟫_ℝ
          rw [real_inner_smul_left]
    have hsupportX : ⟪u, x⟫_ℝ ≤ supportFunction K u :=
      inner_le_supportFunction hK hx u
    have hgap : ‖x - y‖ ≤
        supportFunction K u - supportFunction L u := by
      rw [hsupportL]
      calc
        ‖x - y‖ = ⟪u, x - y⟫_ℝ := by
          change ‖x - y‖ = ⟪‖x - y‖⁻¹ • (x - y), x - y⟫_ℝ
          rw [real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
          field_simp
        _ = ⟪u, x⟫_ℝ - ⟪u, y⟫_ℝ := inner_sub_right _ _ _
        _ ≤ supportFunction K u - ⟪u, y⟫_ℝ :=
          sub_le_sub_right hsupportX _
    calc
      directedHausdorffDist K L = ‖x - y‖ := by
        rw [← hxd, hxy, dist_eq_norm]
      _ ≤ supportFunction K u - supportFunction L u := hgap
      _ ≤ directedSupportGap K L :=
        supportFunction_sub_le_directedSupportGap
          hK hL hKne hLne huBall

name: RandomSetTheory.directedSupportGap_eq_directedHausdorffDist
statement:
theorem directedSupportGap_eq_directedHausdorffDist
    {K L : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K) (hL : IsCompact L)
    (hKne : K.Nonempty) (hLne : L.Nonempty) (hLconv : Convex ℝ L) :
    directedSupportGap K L = directedHausdorffDist K L
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact directedSupportGap_le_directedHausdorffDist hK hL hKne hLne
  · exact directedHausdorffDist_le_directedSupportGap
      hK hL hKne hLne hLconv

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_eq_max_directedSupportGap
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_eq_max_directedSupportGap
    {K L : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K) (hL : IsCompact L)
    (hKne : K.Nonempty) (hLne : L.Nonempty)
    (hKconv : Convex ℝ K) (hLconv : Convex ℝ L) :
    hausdorffDist K L =
      max (directedSupportGap K L) (directedSupportGap L K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [directedSupportGap_eq_directedHausdorffDist
      hK hL hKne hLne hLconv,
    directedSupportGap_eq_directedHausdorffDist
      hL hK hLne hKne hKconv]
  exact hausdorffDist_eq_max_directedHausdorffDist hK hL hKne hLne

name: RandomSetTheory.continuous_continuousSup
statement:
theorem continuous_continuousSup :
    Continuous (continuousSup : C(T, ℝ) → ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have heval : Continuous (fun p : C(T, ℝ) × T => p.1 p.2) := by fun_prop
  change Continuous (fun f : C(T, ℝ) => sSup (Set.range f))
  simpa only [Set.image_univ] using
    (isCompact_univ.continuous_sSup heval)

name: RandomSetTheory.continuousSup_smul_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem continuousSup_smul_of_nonneg
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (f : C(T, ℝ)) :
    continuousSup (c • f) = c * continuousSup f
proof:
:= by
  unfold continuousSup
  have hrange : Set.range (c • f) = c • Set.range f := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨u, rfl⟩
      exact Set.mem_smul_set.mpr ⟨f u, ⟨u, rfl⟩, by simp⟩
    · rintro hz
      rcases Set.mem_smul_set.mp hz with ⟨w, ⟨u, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨u, by simp⟩
  rw [hrange, Real.sSup_smul_of_nonneg hc]
  rfl

name: RandomSetTheory.continuousSup_supportDifferenceContinuousMap_eq_directedHausdorffDist

name: RandomSetTheory.tendstoInDistribution_scale_mul_directedHausdorffDist_of_process
statement:
theorem tendstoInDistribution_scale_mul_directedHausdorffDist_of_process
    {I Omega' : Type*} {Omega : I → Type*}
    {mOmega : ∀ i, MeasurableSpace (Omega i)}
    {mu : ∀ i, Measure (Omega i)} [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (mu i)]
    {mOmega' : MeasurableSpace Omega'} {mu' : Measure Omega'}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu']
    [MeasurableSpace C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ)]
    [BorelSpace C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ)]
    (c : I → ℝ) (K : (i : I) → Omega i → Set E) (L : Set E)
    (Z : Omega' → C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ))
    (hc : ∀ i, 0 ≤ c i)
    (hKcompact : ∀ i omega, IsCompact (K i omega))
    (hKne : ∀ i omega, (K i omega).Nonempty)
    (hLcompact : IsCompact L) (hLne : L.Nonempty) (hLconv : Convex ℝ L)
    {l : Filter I}
    (hprocess : TendstoInDistribution
      (fun i omega => scaledSupportDifferenceContinuousMap
        (c i) (K i omega) L (hKcompact i omega) hLcompact
          (hKne i omega) hLne)
      l Z mu mu') :
    TendstoInDistribution
      (fun i omega => c i * directedHausdorffDist (K i omega) L)
      l (fun omega => continuousSup (Z omega)) mu mu'
proof:
:= by
  have hsup := RandomSetTheory.TendstoInDistribution.continuousSup hprocess
  apply hsup.congr
  · intro i
    filter_upwards [] with omega
    change continuousSup (scaledSupportDifferenceContinuousMap
      (c i) (K i omega) L (hKcompact i omega) hLcompact
        (hKne i omega) hLne) =
      c i * directedHausdorffDist (K i omega) L
    unfold scaledSupportDifferenceContinuousMap
    rw [continuousSup_smul_of_nonneg (c i) (hc i)]
    rw [continuousSup_supportDifferenceContinuousMap_eq_directedHausdorffDist
      (K i omega) L (hKcompact i omega) hLcompact
      (hKne i omega) hLne hLconv]
  · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => rfl)

name: RandomSetTheory.tendstoInDistribution_scale_mul_reverseDirectedHausdorffDist_of_process
statement:
theorem tendstoInDistribution_scale_mul_reverseDirectedHausdorffDist_of_process
    {I Omega' : Type*} {Omega : I → Type*}
    {mOmega : ∀ i, MeasurableSpace (Omega i)}
    {mu : ∀ i, Measure (Omega i)} [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (mu i)]
    {mOmega' : MeasurableSpace Omega'} {mu' : Measure Omega'}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu']
    [MeasurableSpace C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ)]
    [BorelSpace C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ)]
    (c : I → ℝ) (K : (i : I) → Omega i → Set E) (L : Set E)
    (Z : Omega' → C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ))
    (hc : ∀ i, 0 ≤ c i)
    (hKcompact : ∀ i omega, IsCompact (K i omega))
    (hKne : ∀ i omega, (K i omega).Nonempty)
    (hKconv : ∀ i omega, Convex ℝ (K i omega))
    (hLcompact : IsCompact L) (hLne : L.Nonempty)
    {l : Filter I}
    (hprocess : TendstoInDistribution
      (fun i omega => scaledSupportDifferenceContinuousMap
        (c i) (K i omega) L (hKcompact i omega) hLcompact
          (hKne i omega) hLne)
      l Z mu mu') :
    TendstoInDistribution
      (fun i omega => c i * directedHausdorffDist L (K i omega))
      l (fun omega => continuousSup (-Z omega)) mu mu'
proof:
:= by
  have hneg : TendstoInDistribution
      (fun i omega => -scaledSupportDifferenceContinuousMap
        (c i) (K i omega) L (hKcompact i omega) hLcompact
          (hKne i omega) hLne)
      l (fun omega => -Z omega) mu mu' :=
    hprocess.continuous_comp continuous_neg
  have hsup := RandomSetTheory.TendstoInDistribution.continuousSup hneg
  apply hsup.congr
  · intro i
    filter_upwards [] with omega
    change continuousSup
      (-scaledSupportDifferenceContinuousMap
        (c i) (K i omega) L (hKcompact i omega) hLcompact
          (hKne i omega) hLne) =
      c i * directedHausdorffDist L (K i omega)
    have heq :
        -scaledSupportDifferenceContinuousMap
            (c i) (K i omega) L (hKcompact i omega) hLcompact
              (hKne i omega) hLne =
          c i • supportDifferenceContinuousMap L (K i omega)
            hLcompact (hKcompact i omega) hLne (hKne i omega) := by
      ext u
      simp only [scaledSupportDifferenceContinuousMap_apply,
        supportDifferenceContinuousMap_apply, ContinuousMap.neg_apply,
        ContinuousMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    rw [heq, continuousSup_smul_of_nonneg (c i) (hc i)]
    rw [continuousSup_supportDifferenceContinuousMap_eq_directedHausdorffDist
      L (K i omega) hLcompact (hKcompact i omega)
      hLne (hKne i omega) (hKconv i omega)]
  · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => rfl)

name: RandomSetTheory.measurable_integral_supportFunction_caratheodoryImage_param
statement:
theorem measurable_integral_supportFunction_caratheodoryImage_param
    {Ω Θ X H : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Θ]
    [MetricSpace X] [CompleteSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    [SecondCountableTopology X] [Nonempty X]
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H] [Nonempty H]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [SFinite μ]
    {S : Ω → Set X} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω)) (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    {φ : (Ω × Θ) × X → H} (hφmeas : Measurable φ)
    (hφcont : ∀ p : Ω × Θ, Continuous fun x => φ (p, x)) :
    Measurable (fun q : Θ × H =>
      ∫ ω, supportFunction
        ((fun x => φ ((ω, q.1), x)) '' S ω) q.2 ∂μ)
proof:
:= by
  have hsupp := measurable_supportFunction_caratheodoryImage_param_joint
    hS hcompact hne hφmeas hφcont
  have hreassoc : Measurable
      (fun q : (Θ × H) × Ω => ((q.2, q.1.1), q.1.2)) :=
    (measurable_snd.prodMk measurable_fst.fst).prodMk measurable_fst.snd
  have hintegrand : Measurable (fun q : (Θ × H) × Ω =>
      supportFunction
        ((fun x => φ ((q.2, q.1.1), x)) '' S q.2) q.1.2) :=
    hsupp.comp hreassoc
  exact measurable_integral_prod_right_of_measurable μ hintegrand

name: RandomSetTheory.measurable_supportFunction_closure_aumannExpectation_caratheodoryImage_param
statement:
theorem measurable_supportFunction_closure_aumannExpectation_caratheodoryImage_param
    {Ω Θ X H : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Θ]
    [MetricSpace X] [CompleteSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    [SecondCountableTopology X] [Nonempty X]
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H] [Nonempty H]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ H]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {S : Ω → Set X} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω)) (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    {φ : (Ω × Θ) × X → H} (hφmeas : Measurable φ)
    (hφcont : ∀ p : Ω × Θ, Continuous fun x => φ (p, x))
    {g : Ω → ℝ} (hg : Integrable g μ)
    (hdom : ∀ ω θ, ∀ y ∈ (fun x => φ ((ω, θ), x)) '' S ω,
      ‖y‖ ≤ g ω) :
    Measurable (fun q : Θ × H =>
      supportFunction
        (closure (aumannExpectation μ
          (fun ω => (fun x => φ ((ω, q.1), x)) '' S ω))) q.2)
proof:
:= by
  let Φ : Θ → Ω → Set H := fun θ ω =>
    (fun x => φ ((ω, θ), x)) '' S ω
  have hΦparam : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable
      (fun p : Ω × Θ => Φ p.2 p.1) := by
    simpa only [Φ] using
      effrosMeasurable_caratheodoryImage_param
        hS (fun ω => (hcompact ω).isClosed) hne hφmeas hφcont
  have hΦ : ∀ θ, RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable (Φ θ) := by
    intro θ U hU
    have hEq :
        {ω | (Φ θ ω ∩ U).Nonempty} =
          (fun ω => (ω, θ)) ⁻¹'
            {p : Ω × Θ | (Φ p.2 p.1 ∩ U).Nonempty} := by
      ext ω
      rfl
    rw [hEq]
    exact (measurable_id.prodMk measurable_const) (hΦparam U hU)
  have hΦcompact : ∀ θ ω, IsCompact (Φ θ ω) := fun θ ω =>
    (hcompact ω).image (hφcont (ω, θ))
  have hΦne : ∀ θ ω, (Φ θ ω).Nonempty := fun θ ω =>
    (hne ω).image (fun x => φ ((ω, θ), x))
  have hAcompact : ∀ θ,
      IsCompact (closure (aumannExpectation μ (Φ θ))) := by
    intro θ
    exact closure_aumannExpectation_compact_of_integrable_envelope hg
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω y hy => hdom ω θ y hy)
  have hEq : (fun q : Θ × H =>
      supportFunction (closure (aumannExpectation μ (Φ q.1))) q.2) =
      (fun q : Θ × H =>
        ∫ ω, supportFunction (Φ q.1 ω) q.2 ∂μ) := by
    funext q
    exact supportFunction_closure_aumannExpectation_of_envelope
      (hΦ q.1) (hΦcompact q.1) (hΦne q.1) hg
      (fun ω y hy => hdom ω q.1 y hy) (hAcompact q.1) q.2
  change Measurable (fun q : Θ × H =>
    supportFunction (closure (aumannExpectation μ (Φ q.1))) q.2)
  rw [hEq]
  simpa only [Φ] using
    measurable_integral_supportFunction_caratheodoryImage_param
      μ hS hcompact hne hφmeas hφcont

name: ProbabilityTheory.hoeffding_finset_sum_real
statement:
theorem hoeffding_finset_sum_real [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (a b : ι → ℝ)
    (h_indep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (h_meas : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) μ)
    (h_bounds : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, X i ω ∈ Icc (a i) (b i))
    (h_centered : ∀ i, μ[X i] = 0)
    (s : Finset ι) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε) :
    μ.real {ω | ε ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, X i ω} ≤
      exp (-ε ^ 2 / (2 * (↑(∑ i ∈ s,
        (((‖b i - a i‖₊ / (2 : NNReal)) ^ (2 : ℕ)) : NNReal) : NNReal) : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  apply HasSubgaussianMGF.measure_sum_ge_le_of_iIndepFun
    (c := fun i => (‖b i - a i‖₊ / 2) ^ 2) h_indep _ hε
  intro i _hi
  exact hasSubgaussianMGF_of_mem_Icc_of_integral_eq_zero
    (h_meas i) (h_bounds i) (h_centered i)

name: ProbabilityTheory.hoeffding_finset_sum_abs_real
statement:
theorem hoeffding_finset_sum_abs_real [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (a b : ι → ℝ)
    (h_indep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (h_meas : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) μ)
    (h_bounds : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, X i ω ∈ Icc (a i) (b i))
    (h_centered : ∀ i, μ[X i] = 0)
    (s : Finset ι) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ |∑ i ∈ s, X i ω|} ≤
      2 * exp (-t ^ 2 / (2 * (↑(∑ i ∈ s,
        (((‖b i - a i‖₊ / (2 : NNReal)) ^ (2 : ℕ)) : NNReal) : NNReal) : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  let Xneg : ι → Ω → ℝ := fun i ω => -X i ω
  have h_indep_neg : iIndepFun Xneg μ := by
    exact (h_indep.comp (fun _i => fun x : ℝ => -x) (fun _i => measurable_neg)).congr
      (fun _i => ae_of_all μ fun _ω => rfl)
  have h_meas_neg : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (Xneg i) μ := fun i => (h_meas i).neg
  have h_bounds_neg : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Xneg i ω ∈ Icc (-b i) (-a i) := by
    intro i
    filter_upwards [h_bounds i] with ω hω
    exact ⟨neg_le_neg hω.2, neg_le_neg hω.1⟩
  have h_centered_neg : ∀ i, μ[Xneg i] = 0 := by
    intro i
    simp only [Xneg]
    rw [integral_neg, h_centered i, neg_zero]
  have hpos := hoeffding_finset_sum_real X a b h_indep h_meas h_bounds
    h_centered s ht
  have hneg := hoeffding_finset_sum_real Xneg (-b) (-a) h_indep_neg h_meas_neg
    h_bounds_neg h_centered_neg s ht
  have hset : {ω | t ≤ |∑ i ∈ s, X i ω|} =
      {ω | t ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, X i ω} ∪
      {ω | t ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, Xneg i ω} := by
    ext ω
    simp only [mem_setOf_eq, mem_union, Xneg]
    rw [show (∑ i ∈ s, -X i ω) = -(∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) by simp]
    rw [le_abs]
  rw [hset]
  calc
    _ ≤ μ.real {ω | t ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, X i ω} +
        μ.real {ω | t ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, Xneg i ω} :=
      measureReal_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ exp (-t ^ 2 / (2 * (↑(∑ i ∈ s,
          (((‖b i - a i‖₊ / (2 : NNReal)) ^ (2 : ℕ)) : NNReal) : NNReal) : ℝ))) +
        exp (-t ^ 2 / (2 * (↑(∑ i ∈ s,
          (((‖b i - a i‖₊ / (2 : NNReal)) ^ (2 : ℕ)) : NNReal) : NNReal) : ℝ))) := by
      apply add_le_add hpos
      simpa [Xneg, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using hneg
    _ = 2 * exp (-t ^ 2 / (2 * (↑(∑ i ∈ s,
          (((‖b i - a i‖₊ / (2 : NNReal)) ^ (2 : ℕ)) : NNReal) : NNReal) : ℝ))) := by
      ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.hoeffding_finset_average_real
statement:
theorem hoeffding_finset_average_real [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (a b : ι → ℝ)
    (h_indep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (h_meas : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) μ)
    (h_bounds : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, X i ω ∈ Icc (a i) (b i))
    (h_centered : ∀ i, μ[X i] = 0)
    (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) / (s.card : ℝ)} ≤
      exp (-((s.card : ℝ) * t) ^ 2 / (2 * (↑(∑ i ∈ s,
        (((‖b i - a i‖₊ / (2 : NNReal)) ^ (2 : ℕ)) : NNReal) : NNReal) : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  have h := hoeffding_finset_sum_real X a b h_indep h_meas h_bounds h_centered
    s (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg s.card) ht)
  have hcard : 0 < (s.card : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (Finset.card_pos.mpr hs)
  have hset : {ω | t ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) / (s.card : ℝ)} =
      {ω | (s.card : ℝ) * t ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, X i ω} := by
    ext ω
    simp only [mem_setOf_eq]
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hcard]
    ring_nf
  rw [hset]
  exact h

name: ProbabilityTheory.hoeffding_finset_average_abs_real
statement:
theorem hoeffding_finset_average_abs_real [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (a b : ι → ℝ)
    (h_indep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (h_meas : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) μ)
    (h_bounds : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, X i ω ∈ Icc (a i) (b i))
    (h_centered : ∀ i, μ[X i] = 0)

    μ.real {ω | t ≤ |(∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) / (s.card : ℝ)|} ≤
      2 * exp (-((s.card : ℝ) * t) ^ 2 / (2 * (↑(∑ i ∈ s,
        (((‖b i - a i‖₊ / (2 : NNReal)) ^ (2 : ℕ)) : NNReal) : NNReal) : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  let Xneg : ι → Ω → ℝ := fun i ω => -X i ω
  have h_indep_neg : iIndepFun Xneg μ := by
    exact (h_indep.comp (fun _i => fun x : ℝ => -x) (fun _i => measurable_neg)).congr
      (fun _i => ae_of_all μ fun _ω => rfl)
  have h_meas_neg : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (Xneg i) μ := fun i => (h_meas i).neg
  have h_bounds_neg : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Xneg i ω ∈ Icc (-b i) (-a i) := by
    intro i
    filter_upwards [h_bounds i] with ω hω
    exact ⟨neg_le_neg hω.2, neg_le_neg hω.1⟩
  have h_centered_neg : ∀ i, μ[Xneg i] = 0 := by
    intro i
    simp only [Xneg]
    rw [integral_neg, h_centered i, neg_zero]
  have hpos := hoeffding_finset_average_real X a b h_indep h_meas h_bounds
    h_centered s hs ht
  have hneg := hoeffding_finset_average_real Xneg (-b) (-a) h_indep_neg h_meas_neg
    h_bounds_neg h_centered_neg s hs ht
  have hset : {ω | t ≤ |(∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) / (s.card : ℝ)|} =
      {ω | t ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) / (s.card : ℝ)} ∪
      {ω | t ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, Xneg i ω) / (s.card : ℝ)} := by
    ext ω
    simp only [mem_setOf_eq, mem_union, Xneg]
    rw [show (∑ i ∈ s, -X i ω) = -(∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) by simp]
    rw [neg_div, le_abs]
  rw [hset]
  calc
    _ ≤ μ.real {ω | t ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) / (s.card : ℝ)} +
        μ.real {ω | t ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, Xneg i ω) / (s.card : ℝ)} :=
      measureReal_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ exp (-((s.card : ℝ) * t) ^ 2 / (2 * (↑(∑ i ∈ s,
          (((‖b i - a i‖₊ / (2 : NNReal)) ^ (2 : ℕ)) : NNReal) : NNReal) : ℝ))) +
        exp (-((s.card : ℝ) * t) ^ 2 / (2 * (↑(∑ i ∈ s,
          (((‖b i - a i‖₊ / (2 : NNReal)) ^ (2 : ℕ)) : NNReal) : NNReal) : ℝ))) := by
      apply add_le_add hpos
      simpa [Xneg, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using hneg
    _ = 2 * exp (-((s.card : ℝ) * t) ^ 2 / (2 * (↑(∑ i ∈ s,
          (((‖b i - a i‖₊ / (2 : NNReal)) ^ (2 : ℕ)) : NNReal) : NNReal) : ℝ))) := by

name: RandomSetTheory.abs_supportFunction_le_radius
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hmax⟩ := supportFunction_attains hK hKne u
  rw [hmax]
  calc
    |⟪u, x⟫_ℝ| ≤ ‖u‖ * ‖x‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
    _ ≤ 1 * R := mul_le_mul hu (hR x hx) (norm_nonneg x) (by norm_num)
