name: RandomSetTheory.directionalSupportDeviation_mem_Icc_of_radius
statement:
theorem directionalSupportDeviation_mem_Icc_of_radius
    (S : ι → Ω → Set E) (L : Set E) (u : E) (i : ι) (ω : Ω)
    {RS RL : ℝ}
    (hScompact : IsCompact (S i ω)) (hSne : (S i ω).Nonempty)
    (hLcompact : IsCompact L) (hLne : L.Nonempty)
    (hRS : ∀ x ∈ S i ω, ‖x‖ ≤ RS)
    (hRL : ∀ x ∈ L, ‖x‖ ≤ RL) (hu : ‖u‖ ≤ 1) :
    directionalSupportDeviation S L u i ω ∈ Icc (-(RS + RL)) (RS + RL)
proof:
:= by
  have hS := abs_supportFunction_le_radius hScompact hSne hRS hu
  have hL := abs_supportFunction_le_radius hLcompact hLne hRL hu
  unfold directionalSupportDeviation
  constructor <;>
    linarith [le_abs_self (supportFunction (S i ω) u),
      neg_le_abs (supportFunction (S i ω) u),
      le_abs_self (supportFunction L u), neg_le_abs (supportFunction L u)]

name: RandomSetTheory.norm_le_radius_of_mem_nonempty_minkowskiAverage
statement:
theorem norm_le_radius_of_mem_nonempty_minkowskiAverage
    (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty) (K : ι → Set E) {R : ℝ}
    (hR : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ x ∈ K i, ‖x‖ ≤ R)
    {x : E} (hx : x ∈ minkowskiAverage s K) :
    ‖x‖ ≤ R
proof:
:= by
  have h := norm_le_average_radius_of_mem_minkowskiAverage
    s K (fun _ => R) hR hx
  calc
    ‖x‖ ≤ (s.card : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ _i ∈ s, R := h
    _ = R := by
      simp only [sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
      field_simp [Finset.card_ne_zero.mpr hs]

name: RandomSetTheory.supportFunction_minkowskiAverage_sub_eq_average_deviation
statement:
theorem supportFunction_minkowskiAverage_sub_eq_average_deviation
    (S : ι → Ω → Set E) (L : Set E) (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (hScompact : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ ω, IsCompact (S i ω))
    (hSne : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    (ω : Ω) (u : E) :
    supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) u -
        supportFunction L u =
      (∑ i ∈ s, directionalSupportDeviation S L u i ω) / (s.card : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [supportFunction_minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)
    (fun i hi => hScompact i hi ω) (fun i hi => hSne i hi ω)]
  simp only [directionalSupportDeviation, sum_sub_distrib, sum_const,
    nsmul_eq_mul, div_eq_inv_mul]
  field_simp [Finset.card_ne_zero.mpr hs]

name: RandomSetTheory.minkowskiAverage_support_hoeffding
statement:
theorem minkowskiAverage_support_hoeffding
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (S : ι → Ω → Set E) (L : Set E) (u : E)
    (a b : ι → ℝ)
    (h_indep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun
      (directionalSupportDeviation S L u) μ)
    (h_meas : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (directionalSupportDeviation S L u i) μ)
    (h_bounds : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ,
      directionalSupportDeviation S L u i ω ∈ Icc (a i) (b i))
    (h_centered : ∀ i, μ[directionalSupportDeviation S L u i] = 0)
    (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (hScompact : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ ω, IsCompact (S i ω))
    (hSne : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ |supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) u -
        supportFunction L u|} ≤
      2 * exp (-((s.card : ℝ) * t) ^ 2 / (2 * (↑(∑ i ∈ s,
        (((‖b i - a i‖₊ / (2 : NNReal)) ^ (2 : ℕ)) : NNReal) : NNReal) : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  have htail := ProbabilityTheory.hoeffding_finset_average_abs_real
    (directionalSupportDeviation S L u) a b h_indep h_meas h_bounds
    h_centered s hs ht
  have hset :
      {ω | t ≤ |supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) u -
        supportFunction L u|} =
      {ω | t ≤ |(∑ i ∈ s, directionalSupportDeviation S L u i ω) /
        (s.card : ℝ)|} := by
    ext ω
    simp only [mem_setOf_eq]
    rw [supportFunction_minkowskiAverage_sub_eq_average_deviation
      S L s hs hScompact hSne]
  rw [hset]
  exact htail

name: RandomSetTheory.symmetricSupportHoeffdingTail_eq
statement:
theorem symmetricSupportHoeffdingTail_eq
    {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (t : ℝ) {B : ℝ} (hB : 0 < B) :
    symmetricSupportHoeffdingTail m t B =
      2 * exp (-(m : ℝ) * t ^ 2 / (2 * B ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  unfold symmetricSupportHoeffdingTail
  congr 2
  field_simp [Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hm.ne', hB.ne']

name: RandomSetTheory.minkowskiAverage_support_hoeffding_of_radius
statement:
theorem minkowskiAverage_support_hoeffding_of_radius
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (S : ι → Ω → Set E) (L : Set E) (u : E)
    {RS RL : ℝ}
    (hScompact : ∀ i ω, IsCompact (S i ω))
    (hSne : ∀ i ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    (hLcompact : IsCompact L) (hLne : L.Nonempty)
    (hRS : ∀ i ω, ∀ x ∈ S i ω, ‖x‖ ≤ RS)
    (hRL : ∀ x ∈ L, ‖x‖ ≤ RL)
    (hu : ‖u‖ ≤ 1)
    (h_indep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun
      (directionalSupportDeviation S L u) μ)
    (h_meas : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (directionalSupportDeviation S L u i) μ)
    (h_centered : ∀ i, μ[directionalSupportDeviation S L u i] = 0)
    (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ |supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) u -
        supportFunction L u|} ≤
      symmetricSupportHoeffdingTail s.card t (RS + RL)
proof:
:= by
  have htail := minkowskiAverage_support_hoeffding S L u
    (fun _ => -(RS + RL)) (fun _ => RS + RL)
    h_indep h_meas
    (fun i => ae_of_all μ fun ω =>
      directionalSupportDeviation_mem_Icc_of_radius S L u i ω
        (hScompact i ω) (hSne i ω) hLcompact hLne
        (hRS i ω) hRL hu)
    h_centered s hs
    (fun i _hi ω => hScompact i ω)
    (fun i _hi ω => hSne i ω) ht
  have hsum :
      (↑(∑ i ∈ s,
        (((‖(RS + RL) - (-(RS + RL))‖₊ / (2 : NNReal)) ^ (2 : ℕ)) :
          NNReal) : NNReal) : ℝ) =
        (s.card : ℝ) * (RS + RL) ^ 2 := by
    push_cast
    rw [sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
    congr 1
    simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sub_neg_eq_add]
    rw [← two_mul, abs_mul]
    norm_num
  simpa only [symmetricSupportHoeffdingTail, hsum] using htail

name: RandomSetTheory.measureReal_hausdorffDist_gt_le_finset_support
statement:
theorem measureReal_hausdorffDist_gt_le_finset_support
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (K L : Ω → Set E)
    (hKcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (K ω))
    (hLcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (L ω))
    (hKne : ∀ ω, (K ω).Nonempty) (hLne : ∀ ω, (L ω).Nonempty)
    (hKconv : ∀ ω, Convex ℝ (K ω)) (hLconv : ∀ ω, Convex ℝ (L ω))
    {RK RL eps t q : ℝ}
    (hRK : ∀ ω, ∀ x ∈ K ω, ‖x‖ ≤ RK)
    (hRL : ∀ ω, ∀ x ∈ L ω, ‖x‖ ≤ RL)
    (heps : 0 ≤ eps) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hq : 0 ≤ q)
    (N : Finset E)
    (hnet : ∀ u : E, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 → ∃ v ∈ N, dist u v ≤ eps)
    (htail : ∀ v ∈ N, μ.real {ω |
      t < |supportFunction (K ω) v - supportFunction (L ω) v|} ≤ q) :
    μ.real {ω | t + (RK + RL) * eps < hausdorffDist (K ω) (L ω)} ≤
      N.card * q
proof:
:= by
  have htailENN : ∀ v ∈ N, μ {ω |
      t < |supportFunction (K ω) v - supportFunction (L ω) v|} ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal q := by
    intro v hv
    rw [← MeasureTheory.ofReal_measureReal]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (htail v hv)
  have hbound := measure_hausdorffDist_gt_le_finset_support
    hKcompact hLcompact hKne hLne hKconv hLconv hRK hRL
    heps ht N hnet htailENN
  have hleft : μ {ω |
      t + (RK + RL) * eps < hausdorffDist (K ω) (L ω)} ≠ ∞ := by
    finiteness
  have hright : (∑ _v ∈ N, ENNReal.ofReal q) ≠ ∞ := by
    rw [sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
    exact ENNReal.mul_ne_top (by simp) (by simp)
  have hreal := (ENNReal.toReal_le_toReal hleft hright).2 hbound
  simpa [Measure.real, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hq] using hreal

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_risk_bound_of_hoeffding
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_risk_bound_of_hoeffding
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (S : ι → Ω → Set E) (L : Set E)
    (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty) {RS RL eps t : ℝ}
    (hScompact : ∀ i ω, IsCompact (S i ω))
    (hSne : ∀ i ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    (hSconv : ∀ i ω, Convex ℝ (S i ω))
    (hLcompact : IsCompact L) (hLne : L.Nonempty) (hLconv : Convex ℝ L)
    (hRS : ∀ i ω, ∀ x ∈ S i ω, ‖x‖ ≤ RS)
    (hRL : ∀ x ∈ L, ‖x‖ ≤ RL)
    (heps : 0 ≤ eps) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (N : Finset E) (hN : ∀ v ∈ N, ‖v‖ ≤ 1)
    (hnet : ∀ u : E, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 → ∃ v ∈ N, dist u v ≤ eps)
    (h_indep : ∀ v ∈ N, ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun
      (directionalSupportDeviation S L v) μ)
    (h_meas : ∀ v ∈ N, ∀ i,
      AEMeasurable (directionalSupportDeviation S L v i) μ)
    (h_centered : ∀ v ∈ N, ∀ i,
      μ[directionalSupportDeviation S L v i] = 0) :
    μ.real {ω | t + (RS + RL) * eps <
        hausdorffDist (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) L} ≤
      N.card * symmetricSupportHoeffdingTail s.card t (RS + RL)
proof:
:= by
  apply measureReal_hausdorffDist_gt_le_finset_support
    (μ := μ) (fun ω => minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) (fun _ => L)
    (fun ω => isCompact_minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)
      (fun i hi => hScompact i ω))
    (fun _ => hLcompact)
    (fun ω => nonempty_minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)
      (fun i hi => hSne i ω))
    (fun _ => hLne)
    (fun ω => convex_minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)
      (fun i hi => hSconv i ω))
    (fun _ => hLconv)
    (fun ω x hx => norm_le_radius_of_mem_nonempty_minkowskiAverage s hs
      (fun i => S i ω) (fun i hi => hRS i ω) hx)
    (fun _ => hRL) heps ht
    (by unfold symmetricSupportHoeffdingTail; positivity)
    N hnet
  intro v hv
  calc
    μ.real {ω | t < |supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) v -
        supportFunction L v|} ≤
        μ.real {ω | t ≤ |supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) v -
          supportFunction L v|} := by
      apply measureReal_mono
      · intro ω hω
        change t < |supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) v -
          supportFunction L v| at hω
        change t ≤ |supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) v -
          supportFunction L v|
        exact hω.le
      · finiteness
    _ ≤ symmetricSupportHoeffdingTail s.card t (RS + RL) :=
      minkowskiAverage_support_hoeffding_of_radius
        S L v hScompact hSne hLcompact hLne hRS hRL (hN v hv)
        (h_indep v hv) (h_meas v hv) (h_centered v hv) s hs ht

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_risk_bound_standard
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_risk_bound_standard
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (S : ι → Ω → Set E) (L : Set E)
    (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty) {RS RL eps t : ℝ}
    (hScompact : ∀ i ω, IsCompact (S i ω))
    (hSne : ∀ i ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    (hSconv : ∀ i ω, Convex ℝ (S i ω))
    (hLcompact : IsCompact L) (hLne : L.Nonempty) (hLconv : Convex ℝ L)
    (hRS : ∀ i ω, ∀ x ∈ S i ω, ‖x‖ ≤ RS)
    (hRL : ∀ x ∈ L, ‖x‖ ≤ RL)
    (hB : 0 < RS + RL)
    (heps : 0 ≤ eps) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (N : Finset E) (hN : ∀ v ∈ N, ‖v‖ ≤ 1)
    (hnet : ∀ u : E, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 → ∃ v ∈ N, dist u v ≤ eps)
    (h_indep : ∀ v ∈ N, ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun
      (directionalSupportDeviation S L v) μ)
    (h_meas : ∀ v ∈ N, ∀ i,
      AEMeasurable (directionalSupportDeviation S L v i) μ)
    (h_centered : ∀ v ∈ N, ∀ i,
      μ[directionalSupportDeviation S L v i] = 0) :
    μ.real {ω | t + (RS + RL) * eps <
        hausdorffDist (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) L} ≤
      N.card * (2 * exp (-(s.card : ℝ) * t ^ 2 /
        (2 * (RS + RL) ^ 2)))
proof:
:= by
  have hbound := hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_risk_bound_of_hoeffding
    (μ := μ) S L s hs hScompact hSne hSconv hLcompact hLne hLconv
    hRS hRL heps ht N hN hnet h_indep h_meas h_centered
  rw [symmetricSupportHoeffdingTail_eq (Finset.card_pos.mpr hs) t hB] at hbound
  exact hbound

name: ProbabilityTheory.rioConfidenceScale_pos
statement:
theorem rioConfidenceScale_pos
    {q : Nat} {Q alpha : Real}
    (hQ : 0 < Q) (halpha : 0 < alpha) :
    0 < rioConfidenceScale q Q alpha
proof:
:= by
  unfold rioConfidenceScale
  exact mul_pos (strongMomentQScale_pos hQ)
    (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (one_div_pos.mpr halpha) _)

name: ProbabilityTheory.rioConfidenceScale_pow
statement:
theorem rioConfidenceScale_pow
    {q : Nat} (hq : 1 <= q) {Q alpha : Real}
    (hQ : 0 < Q) (halpha : 0 < alpha) :
    rioConfidenceScale q Q alpha ^ q = Q * alpha⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hroot : ((1 / alpha) ^ (1 / (q : Real))) ^ q = 1 / alpha := by
    simpa only [one_div] using
      (Real.rpow_inv_natCast_pow (le_of_lt (one_div_pos.mpr halpha))
        (by omega : q ≠ 0))
  unfold rioConfidenceScale
  rw [mul_pow, strongMomentQScale_pow hq hQ, hroot]
  simp only [one_div]

name: ProbabilityTheory.rio_scale_condition
statement:
theorem rio_scale_condition
    {q : Nat} (hq : 1 <= q) {Q alpha : Real}
    (hQ : 0 < Q) (halpha : 0 < alpha) :
    Q * Real.exp (-Real.log alpha) <=
      rioConfidenceScale q Q alpha ^ q
proof:
:= by
  rw [rioConfidenceScale_pow hq hQ halpha, Real.exp_neg,
    Real.exp_log halpha]

name: ProbabilityTheory.rio_explicit_bound_le_confidenceRadius
statement:
theorem rio_explicit_bound_le_confidenceRadius
    {q : Nat} (hq : 3 <= q) {V Q alpha : Real}
    (hQ : 0 < Q) (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) :
    Real.sqrt (2 * V * (-Real.log alpha)) +
          (1 + 1 / (q : Real)) * rioConfidenceScale q Q alpha +
          Real.exp 1 * strongMomentQScale q Q * (-Real.log alpha) / 3 +
          alpha⁻¹ *
            (Q / ((q : Real) * rioConfidenceScale q Q alpha ^ (q - 1))) <=
      rioStrongMomentConfidenceRadius q V Q alpha
proof:
:= by
  have hy : 0 < rioConfidenceScale q Q alpha :=
    rioConfidenceScale_pos hQ halpha0
  have hresidual :
      alpha⁻¹ *
          (Q / ((q : Real) * rioConfidenceScale q Q alpha ^ (q - 1))) <=
        rioConfidenceScale q Q alpha / (q : Real) :=
    inv_mul_strongMomentResidual_le_div q (by omega) hy halpha0
      (rio_scale_condition (by omega) hQ halpha0)
  calc
    Real.sqrt (2 * V * (-Real.log alpha)) +
          (1 + 1 / (q : Real)) * rioConfidenceScale q Q alpha +
          Real.exp 1 * strongMomentQScale q Q * (-Real.log alpha) / 3 +
          alpha⁻¹ *
            (Q / ((q : Real) * rioConfidenceScale q Q alpha ^ (q - 1))) <=
        Real.sqrt (2 * V * (-Real.log alpha)) +
          (1 + 1 / (q : Real)) * rioConfidenceScale q Q alpha +
          Real.exp 1 * strongMomentQScale q Q * (-Real.log alpha) / 3 +
          rioConfidenceScale q Q alpha / (q : Real) :=
      add_le_add_right hresidual _
    _ = rioStrongMomentConfidenceRadius q V Q alpha := by
      unfold rioStrongMomentConfidenceRadius
      ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.conditionalValueAtRisk_le_rioStrongMomentConfidenceRadius
statement:
theorem conditionalValueAtRisk_le_rioStrongMomentConfidenceRadius
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega] {mu : Measure Omega}
    {X : Omega -> Real} {q : Nat} (hq : 3 <= q) {V Q alpha : Real}
    (hQ : 0 < Q) (halpha0 : 0 < alpha)
    (hRio :
      conditionalValueAtRisk alpha X mu <=
        Real.sqrt (2 * V * (-Real.log alpha)) +
          (1 + 1 / (q : Real)) * rioConfidenceScale q Q alpha +
          Real.exp 1 * strongMomentQScale q Q * (-Real.log alpha) / 3 +
          alpha⁻¹ *
            (Q / ((q : Real) * rioConfidenceScale q Q alpha ^ (q - 1)))) :
    conditionalValueAtRisk alpha X mu <=
      rioStrongMomentConfidenceRadius q V Q alpha
proof:
:=
  hRio.trans (rio_explicit_bound_le_confidenceRadius hq hQ halpha0)

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_rioStrongMomentConfidenceRadius_lt_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_rioStrongMomentConfidenceRadius_lt_le
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega] {mu : Measure Omega}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu : RandomSetTheory.IsAtomlessMeasure mu)
    {X : Omega -> Real} (hXmeas : Measurable X) (hX : Integrable X mu)
    {q : Nat} (hq : 3 <= q) {V Q alpha : Real}
    (hQ : 0 < Q) (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha <= 1)
    (hRio :
      conditionalValueAtRisk alpha X mu <=
        Real.sqrt (2 * V * (-Real.log alpha)) +
          (1 + 1 / (q : Real)) * rioConfidenceScale q Q alpha +
          Real.exp 1 * strongMomentQScale q Q * (-Real.log alpha) / 3 +
          alpha⁻¹ *
            (Q / ((q : Real) * rioConfidenceScale q Q alpha ^ (q - 1)))) :
    mu.real {omega |
      rioStrongMomentConfidenceRadius q V Q alpha < X omega} <= alpha
proof:
:= by
  apply measureReal_lt_le_of_conditionalValueAtRisk_le_of_atomless
    hmu hXmeas hX halpha0 halpha1
  exact conditionalValueAtRisk_le_rioStrongMomentConfidenceRadius
    hq hQ halpha0 hRio

name: ProbabilityTheory.measurable_lipschitzIncrement
statement:
theorem measurable_lipschitzIncrement
    (H : Z → T → ℝ) (X : iota → Omega → Z)
    (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hH : ∀ t, Measurable (fun z ↦ H z t))
    (i : iota) (s t : T) :
    Measurable (lipschitzIncrement H X i s t)
proof:
:= by
  exact ((hH s).comp (hX i)).sub ((hH t).comp (hX i))

name: ProbabilityTheory.integrable_lipschitzIncrement
statement:
theorem integrable_lipschitzIncrement
    (H : Z → T → ℝ) (R : Z → ℝ)
    (X : iota → Omega → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hH : ∀ t, Measurable (fun z ↦ H z t))
    (hLip : ∀ z s t, |H z s - H z t| ≤ R z * dist s t)
    (i : iota) (hRint : Integrable (fun omega ↦ R (X i omega)) mu)
    (s t : T) :
    Integrable (lipschitzIncrement H X i s t) mu
proof:
:= by
  apply Integrable.mono'
    (hRint.const_mul (dist s t))
    (measurable_lipschitzIncrement H X hX hH i s t).aestronglyMeasurable
  filter_upwards with omega
  simpa only [lipschitzIncrement, Real.norm_eq_abs, norm_mul,
    Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg dist_nonneg, mul_comm] using
      hLip (X i omega) s t

name: ProbabilityTheory.lipschitzWith_integral_lipschitzIncrement
statement:
theorem lipschitzWith_integral_lipschitzIncrement
    (H : Z → T → ℝ) (R : Z → ℝ)
    (X : iota → Omega → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hH : ∀ t, Measurable (fun z ↦ H z t))
    (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (hLip : ∀ z s t, |H z s - H z t| ≤ R z * dist s t)
    (i : iota) (hRint : Integrable (fun omega ↦ R (X i omega)) mu)
    (o : T) :
    LipschitzWith
      (nnrealOfNonneg (∫ omega, R (X i omega) ∂mu)
        (integral_nonneg fun omega ↦ hR (X i omega)))
      (fun t ↦ ∫ xi, lipschitzIncrement H X i t o xi ∂mu)
proof:
:= by
  apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro s t
  have hs := integrable_lipschitzIncrement
    H R X hX hH hLip i hRint s o
  have ht := integrable_lipschitzIncrement
    H R X hX hH hLip i hRint t o
  rw [Real.dist_eq, ← integral_sub hs ht]
  have hbound : ∀ᵐ xi ∂mu,
      ‖lipschitzIncrement H X i s o xi -
          lipschitzIncrement H X i t o xi‖ ≤
        dist s t * R (X i xi) := by
    filter_upwards with xi
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    calc
      |lipschitzIncrement H X i s o xi -
          lipschitzIncrement H X i t o xi| =
          |H (X i xi) s - H (X i xi) t| := by
            congr 1
            unfold lipschitzIncrement
            ring
      _ ≤ R (X i xi) * dist s t := hLip (X i xi) s t
      _ = dist s t * R (X i xi) := mul_comm _ _
  have hint := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le
    (hRint.const_mul (dist s t)) hbound
  rw [integral_const_mul] at hint
  simpa only [coe_nnrealOfNonneg, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_comm] using hint

name: ProbabilityTheory.continuous_centeredAnchoredEmpiricalProcess
statement:
theorem continuous_centeredAnchoredEmpiricalProcess
    (H : Z → T → ℝ) (R : Z → ℝ) (c : ℝ)
    (X : iota → Omega → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hHmeas : ∀ t, Measurable (fun z ↦ H z t))
    (hHcont : ∀ z, Continuous (H z))
    (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (hLip : ∀ z s t, |H z s - H z t| ≤ R z * dist s t)
    (hRint : ∀ i, Integrable (fun omega ↦ R (X i omega)) mu)
    (I : Finset iota) (o : T) (omega : Omega) :
    Continuous
      (centeredAnchoredEmpiricalProcess
        (mu := mu) H c X I o omega)
proof:
:= by
  unfold centeredAnchoredEmpiricalProcess
  apply continuous_const.mul
  apply continuous_finsetSum I
  intro i hi
  apply Continuous.sub
  · exact (hHcont (X i omega)).sub continuous_const
  · exact (lipschitzWith_integral_lipschitzIncrement
      H R X hX hHmeas hR hLip i (hRint i) o).continuous

name: ProbabilityTheory.centeredAnchoredEmpiricalProcess_anchor
statement:
@[simp]
theorem centeredAnchoredEmpiricalProcess_anchor
    (H : Z → T → ℝ) (c : ℝ)
    (X : iota → Omega → Z) (I : Finset iota) (o : T) (omega : Omega) :
    centeredAnchoredEmpiricalProcess
      (mu := mu) H c X I o omega o = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [centeredAnchoredEmpiricalProcess, lipschitzIncrement]

name: ProbabilityTheory.abs_lipschitzObservation_sub_truncated_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_lipschitzObservation_sub_truncated_sub_le
    (H : Z → T → ℝ) (R : Z → ℝ) (M : ℝ)
    (hLip : ∀ z s t, |H z s - H z t| ≤ R z * dist s t)
    (z : Z) (s t : T) :
    |(H z s - H z t) -
        (truncatedLipschitzObservation H R M z s -
          truncatedLipschitzObservation H R M z t)| ≤
      truncationTailEnvelope R M z * dist s t
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hz : R z ≤ M
  · have hz' : ¬ M < R z := not_lt_of_ge hz
    simp only [truncatedLipschitzObservation, if_pos hz,
      truncationTailEnvelope, hz', if_false, zero_mul, sub_self, abs_zero,
      le_refl]
  · have hz' : M < R z := lt_of_not_ge hz
    simp only [truncatedLipschitzObservation, if_neg hz,
      truncationTailEnvelope, hz', if_true, sub_zero]
    exact hLip z s t

name: ProbabilityTheory.measurable_truncationResidualIncrement
statement:
theorem measurable_truncationResidualIncrement
    (H : Z → T → ℝ) (R : Z → ℝ) (M : ℝ)
    (X : iota → Omega → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hH : ∀ t, Measurable (fun z ↦ H z t)) (hRmeas : Measurable R)
    (i : iota) (s t : T) :
    Measurable (truncationResidualIncrement H R M X i s t)
proof:
:= by
  exact (measurable_lipschitzIncrement H X hX hH i s t).sub
    (measurable_truncatedLipschitzIncrement
      H R M X hX hH hRmeas i s t)

name: ProbabilityTheory.abs_truncationResidualIncrement_le
statement:
theorem abs_truncationResidualIncrement_le
    (H : Z → T → ℝ) (R : Z → ℝ) (M : ℝ)
    (hLip : ∀ z s t, |H z s - H z t| ≤ R z * dist s t)
    (X : iota → Omega → Z) (i : iota) (s t : T) (omega : Omega) :
    |truncationResidualIncrement H R M X i s t omega| ≤
      truncationTailEnvelope R M (X i omega) * dist s t
proof:
:= by
  exact abs_lipschitzObservation_sub_truncated_sub_le
    H R M hLip (X i omega) s t

name: ProbabilityTheory.measurable_truncationTailEnvelope
statement:
theorem measurable_truncationTailEnvelope
    (R : Z → ℝ) (M : ℝ) (hRmeas : Measurable R) :
    Measurable (truncationTailEnvelope R M)
proof:
:= by
  unfold truncationTailEnvelope
  exact Measurable.ite (measurableSet_lt measurable_const hRmeas)
    hRmeas measurable_const

name: ProbabilityTheory.truncationTailEnvelope_nonneg
statement:
theorem truncationTailEnvelope_nonneg
    (R : Z → ℝ) (M : ℝ) (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z) (z : Z) :
    0 ≤ truncationTailEnvelope R M z
proof:
:= by
  unfold truncationTailEnvelope
  split_ifs
  · exact hR z
  · exact le_rfl

name: ProbabilityTheory.truncationTailEnvelope_le
statement:
theorem truncationTailEnvelope_le
    (R : Z → ℝ) (M : ℝ) (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z) (z : Z) :
    truncationTailEnvelope R M z ≤ R z
proof:
:= by
  unfold truncationTailEnvelope
  split_ifs
  · exact le_rfl
  · exact hR z

name: ProbabilityTheory.integrable_truncationTailEnvelope_comp
statement:
theorem integrable_truncationTailEnvelope_comp
    (R : Z → ℝ) (M : ℝ) (hRmeas : Measurable R)
    (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z) (X : Omega → Z)
    (hX : Measurable X) (hRint : Integrable (fun omega ↦ R (X omega)) mu) :
    Integrable (fun omega ↦ truncationTailEnvelope R M (X omega)) mu
proof:
:= by
  apply Integrable.mono' hRint
    ((measurable_truncationTailEnvelope R M hRmeas).comp hX).aestronglyMeasurable
  filter_upwards with omega
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg (truncationTailEnvelope_nonneg R M hR (X omega))]
  exact truncationTailEnvelope_le R M hR (X omega)

name: ProbabilityTheory.integrable_truncationResidualIncrement
statement:
theorem integrable_truncationResidualIncrement
    [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    (H : Z → T → ℝ) (R : Z → ℝ) {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (X : iota → Omega → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hH : ∀ t, Measurable (fun z ↦ H z t)) (hRmeas : Measurable R)
    (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (hLip : ∀ z s t, |H z s - H z t| ≤ R z * dist s t)
    (i : iota) (hRint : Integrable (fun omega ↦ R (X i omega)) mu)
    (s t : T) :
    Integrable (truncationResidualIncrement H R M X i s t) mu
proof:
:= by
  exact (integrable_lipschitzIncrement H R X hX hH hLip i hRint s t).sub
    (integrable_truncatedLipschitzIncrement
      H R hM X hX hH hRmeas hR hLip i s t)

name: ProbabilityTheory.centeredAnchoredEmpiricalProcess_sub_truncated
statement:
theorem centeredAnchoredEmpiricalProcess_sub_truncated
    [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    (H : Z → T → ℝ) (R : Z → ℝ) {M c : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (X : iota → Omega → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hH : ∀ t, Measurable (fun z ↦ H z t)) (hRmeas : Measurable R)
    (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (hLip : ∀ z s t, |H z s - H z t| ≤ R z * dist s t)
    (hRint : ∀ i, Integrable (fun omega ↦ R (X i omega)) mu)
    (I : Finset iota) (o : T) (omega : Omega) (t : T) :
    centeredAnchoredEmpiricalProcess (mu := mu) H c X I o omega t -
        centeredAnchoredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess
          (mu := mu) H R M c X I o omega t =
      centeredAnchoredTruncationResidualProcess
        (mu := mu) H R M c X I o omega t
proof:
:= by
  unfold centeredAnchoredEmpiricalProcess
    centeredAnchoredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess
    centeredAnchoredTruncationResidualProcess
  rw [← mul_sub, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  have hraw := integrable_lipschitzIncrement
    H R X hX hH hLip i (hRint i) t o
  have htr := integrable_truncatedLipschitzIncrement (μ := mu)
    H R hM X hX hH hRmeas hR hLip i t o
  have hint :
      ∫ xi, truncationResidualIncrement H R M X i t o xi ∂mu =
        (∫ xi, lipschitzIncrement H X i t o xi ∂mu) -
          ∫ xi, truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X i t o xi ∂mu := by
    unfold truncationResidualIncrement
    exact integral_sub hraw htr
  rw [hint]
  unfold truncationResidualIncrement
  ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.centeredAnchoredTruncationResidualProcess_sub
statement:
theorem centeredAnchoredTruncationResidualProcess_sub
    [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    (H : Z → T → ℝ) (R : Z → ℝ) {M c : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (X : iota → Omega → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hH : ∀ t, Measurable (fun z ↦ H z t)) (hRmeas : Measurable R)
    (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (hLip : ∀ z s t, |H z s - H z t| ≤ R z * dist s t)
    (hRint : ∀ i, Integrable (fun omega ↦ R (X i omega)) mu)
    (I : Finset iota) (o : T) (omega : Omega) (s t : T) :
    centeredAnchoredTruncationResidualProcess
          (mu := mu) H R M c X I o omega s -
        centeredAnchoredTruncationResidualProcess
          (mu := mu) H R M c X I o omega t =
      c * ∑ i ∈ I,
        (truncationResidualIncrement H R M X i s t omega -
          ∫ xi, truncationResidualIncrement H R M X i s t xi ∂mu)
proof:
:= by
  unfold centeredAnchoredTruncationResidualProcess
  rw [← mul_sub, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  have hs := integrable_truncationResidualIncrement
    H R hM X hX hH hRmeas hR hLip i (hRint i) s o
  have ht := integrable_truncationResidualIncrement
    H R hM X hX hH hRmeas hR hLip i (hRint i) t o
  have hpoint :
      truncationResidualIncrement H R M X i s o omega -
          truncationResidualIncrement H R M X i t o omega =
        truncationResidualIncrement H R M X i s t omega := by
    unfold truncationResidualIncrement lipschitzIncrement
      truncatedLipschitzIncrement
    ring
  have hint :
      (∫ xi, truncationResidualIncrement H R M X i s o xi ∂mu) -
          ∫ xi, truncationResidualIncrement H R M X i t o xi ∂mu =
        ∫ xi, truncationResidualIncrement H R M X i s t xi ∂mu := by
    rw [← integral_sub hs ht]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards with xi
    unfold truncationResidualIncrement lipschitzIncrement
      truncatedLipschitzIncrement
    ring
  calc
    _ = (truncationResidualIncrement H R M X i s o omega -
          truncationResidualIncrement H R M X i t o omega) -
        ((∫ xi, truncationResidualIncrement H R M X i s o xi ∂mu) -
          ∫ xi, truncationResidualIncrement H R M X i t o xi ∂mu) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hpoint, hint]

name: ProbabilityTheory.abs_centeredAnchoredTruncationResidualProcess_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_centeredAnchoredTruncationResidualProcess_sub_le
    [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    (H : Z → T → ℝ) (R : Z → ℝ) {M c : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (X : iota → Omega → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hH : ∀ t, Measurable (fun z ↦ H z t)) (hRmeas : Measurable R)
    (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (hLip : ∀ z s t, |H z s - H z t| ≤ R z * dist s t)
    (hRint : ∀ i, Integrable (fun omega ↦ R (X i omega)) mu)
    (I : Finset iota) (o : T) (omega : Omega) (s t : T) :
    |centeredAnchoredTruncationResidualProcess
          (mu := mu) H R M c X I o omega s -
        centeredAnchoredTruncationResidualProcess
          (mu := mu) H R M c X I o omega t| ≤
      centeredTruncationResidualCoefficient
        (mu := mu) R M c X I omega * dist s t
proof:
:= by
  rw [centeredAnchoredTruncationResidualProcess_sub
    H R hM X hX hH hRmeas hR hLip hRint I o omega s t, abs_mul]
  rw [centeredTruncationResidualCoefficient, mul_assoc]
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (abs_nonneg c)
  have hsum := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs (s := I)
    (f := fun i ↦
      truncationResidualIncrement H R M X i s t omega -
        ∫ xi, truncationResidualIncrement H R M X i s t xi ∂mu)
  calc
    |∑ i ∈ I,
        (truncationResidualIncrement H R M X i s t omega -
          ∫ xi, truncationResidualIncrement H R M X i s t xi ∂mu)| ≤
        ∑ i ∈ I,
          |truncationResidualIncrement H R M X i s t omega -
            ∫ xi, truncationResidualIncrement H R M X i s t xi ∂mu| := hsum
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ I,
        (truncationTailEnvelope R M (X i omega) +
          ∫ xi, truncationTailEnvelope R M (X i xi) ∂mu) * dist s t := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i hi
      have htailInt := integrable_truncationTailEnvelope_comp
        R M hRmeas hR (X i) (hX i) (hRint i)
      have hintBound :
          |∫ xi, truncationResidualIncrement H R M X i s t xi ∂mu| ≤
            dist s t *
              ∫ xi, truncationTailEnvelope R M (X i xi) ∂mu := by
        have hnorm := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le
          (htailInt.const_mul (dist s t))
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun xi ↦ by
            rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
            calc
              |truncationResidualIncrement H R M X i s t xi| ≤
                  truncationTailEnvelope R M (X i xi) * dist s t :=
                abs_truncationResidualIncrement_le H R M hLip X i s t xi
              _ = dist s t * truncationTailEnvelope R M (X i xi) :=
                mul_comm _ _)
        rw [integral_const_mul] at hnorm
        simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hnorm
      calc
        |truncationResidualIncrement H R M X i s t omega -
            ∫ xi, truncationResidualIncrement H R M X i s t xi ∂mu| ≤
            |truncationResidualIncrement H R M X i s t omega| +
              |∫ xi, truncationResidualIncrement H R M X i s t xi ∂mu| :=
          abs_sub _ _
        _ ≤ truncationTailEnvelope R M (X i omega) * dist s t +
            dist s t *
              ∫ xi, truncationTailEnvelope R M (X i xi) ∂mu :=
          add_le_add
            (abs_truncationResidualIncrement_le H R M hLip X i s t omega)
            hintBound
        _ = (truncationTailEnvelope R M (X i omega) +
              ∫ xi, truncationTailEnvelope R M (X i xi) ∂mu) *
            dist s t := by ring
    _ = (∑ i ∈ I,
        (truncationTailEnvelope R M (X i omega) +
          ∫ xi, truncationTailEnvelope R M (X i xi) ∂mu)) * dist s t := by
      rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    _ = _ := by ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.truncationTailEnvelope_le_inv_mul_sq
statement:
theorem truncationTailEnvelope_le_inv_mul_sq
    (R : Z → ℝ) {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 < M) (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z) (z : Z) :
    truncationTailEnvelope R M z ≤ M⁻¹ * R z ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold truncationTailEnvelope
  split_ifs with hz
  · rw [le_inv_mul_iff₀ hM]
    calc
      M * R z ≤ R z * R z :=
        mul_le_mul (le_of_lt hz) le_rfl (hR z) (hR z)
      _ = R z ^ 2 := by ring
  · exact mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hM.le) (sq_nonneg _)

name: ProbabilityTheory.integral_truncationTailEnvelope_le_inv_mul_integral_sq
statement:
theorem integral_truncationTailEnvelope_le_inv_mul_integral_sq
    [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    (R : Z → ℝ) {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 < M)
    (hRmeas : Measurable R) (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (X : Omega → Z) (hX : Measurable X)
    (hRL2 : MemLp (fun omega ↦ R (X omega)) 2 mu) :
    ∫ omega, truncationTailEnvelope R M (X omega) ∂mu ≤
      M⁻¹ * ∫ omega, R (X omega) ^ 2 ∂mu
proof:
:= by
  have hRint : Integrable (fun omega ↦ R (X omega)) mu :=
    hRL2.integrable (by norm_num)
  have htailInt := integrable_truncationTailEnvelope_comp
    R M hRmeas hR X hX hRint
  have hsq : Integrable (fun omega ↦ R (X omega) ^ 2) mu :=
    (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq hRL2.aestronglyMeasurable).1 hRL2
  have hright : Integrable (fun omega ↦ M⁻¹ * R (X omega) ^ 2) mu :=
    hsq.const_mul M⁻¹
  calc
    ∫ omega, truncationTailEnvelope R M (X omega) ∂mu ≤
        ∫ omega, M⁻¹ * R (X omega) ^ 2 ∂mu := by
      apply integral_mono htailInt hright
      intro omega
      exact truncationTailEnvelope_le_inv_mul_sq R hM hR (X omega)
    _ = M⁻¹ * ∫ omega, R (X omega) ^ 2 ∂mu := by
      rw [integral_const_mul]

name: ProbabilityTheory.measurable_empiricalEnvelopeSquareAverage
statement:
theorem measurable_empiricalEnvelopeSquareAverage
    (R : Z → ℝ) (hRmeas : Measurable R)
    (X : ℕ → Omega → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i)) (n : ℕ) :
    Measurable (empiricalEnvelopeSquareAverage R X n)
proof:
:= by
  unfold empiricalEnvelopeSquareAverage
  apply measurable_const.mul
  exact Finset.measurable_fun_sum (Finset.range (n + 1)) fun i _hi ↦
    ((hRmeas.comp (hX i)).pow_const 2)

name: ProbabilityTheory.empiricalEnvelopeSquareAverage_nonneg
statement:
theorem empiricalEnvelopeSquareAverage_nonneg
    (R : Z → ℝ) (X : ℕ → Omega → Z) (n : ℕ) (omega : Omega) :
    0 ≤ empiricalEnvelopeSquareAverage R X n omega
proof:
:= by
  unfold empiricalEnvelopeSquareAverage
  positivity

name: ProbabilityTheory.integrable_empiricalEnvelopeSquareAverage
statement:
theorem integrable_empiricalEnvelopeSquareAverage
    (R : Z → ℝ) (X : ℕ → Omega → Z)
    (hRL2 : ∀ i, MemLp (fun omega ↦ R (X i omega)) 2 mu) (n : ℕ) :
    Integrable (empiricalEnvelopeSquareAverage R X n) mu
proof:
:= by
  unfold empiricalEnvelopeSquareAverage
  apply Integrable.const_mul
  exact integrable_finsetSum (Finset.range (n + 1)) fun i _hi ↦
    (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq (hRL2 i).aestronglyMeasurable).1 (hRL2 i)

name: ProbabilityTheory.integral_empiricalEnvelopeSquareAverage_le
statement:
theorem integral_empiricalEnvelopeSquareAverage_le
    (R : Z → ℝ) (X : ℕ → Omega → Z) {K : ℝ}
    (hRL2 : ∀ i, MemLp (fun omega ↦ R (X i omega)) 2 mu)
    (hRsecond : ∀ i, ∫ omega, R (X i omega) ^ 2 ∂mu ≤ K ^ 2)
    (n : ℕ) :
    ∫ omega, empiricalEnvelopeSquareAverage R X n omega ∂mu ≤ K ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hn : 0 < (n + 1 : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hsq : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
      Integrable (fun omega ↦ R (X i omega) ^ 2) mu := fun i _hi ↦
    (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq (hRL2 i).aestronglyMeasurable).1 (hRL2 i)
  unfold empiricalEnvelopeSquareAverage
  rw [integral_const_mul, MeasureTheory.integral_finsetSum _ hsq]
  calc
    (n + 1 : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          ∫ omega, R (X i omega) ^ 2 ∂mu ≤
        (n + 1 : ℝ)⁻¹ *
          ∑ _i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), K ^ 2 := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      · exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _hi ↦ hRsecond i
      · positivity
    _ = K ^ 2 := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
      push_cast
      field_simp

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_empiricalEnvelopeSquareAverage_gt_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_empiricalEnvelopeSquareAverage_gt_le
    [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    (R : Z → ℝ) (X : ℕ → Omega → Z) {K C : ℝ} (hC : 0 < C)
    (hRL2 : ∀ i, MemLp (fun omega ↦ R (X i omega)) 2 mu)
    (hRsecond : ∀ i, ∫ omega, R (X i omega) ^ 2 ∂mu ≤ K ^ 2)
    (n : ℕ) :
    mu.real {omega | C < empiricalEnvelopeSquareAverage R X n omega} ≤
      K ^ 2 / C
proof:
:= by
  let Q : Omega → ℝ := empiricalEnvelopeSquareAverage R X n
  have hQint : Integrable Q mu :=
    integrable_empiricalEnvelopeSquareAverage R X hRL2 n
  have hQnonneg : ∀ omega, 0 ≤ Q omega :=
    empiricalEnvelopeSquareAverage_nonneg R X n
  have hmarkov := mul_meas_ge_le_integral_of_nonneg
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hQnonneg) hQint C
  have hmono :
      mu.real {omega | C < Q omega} ≤ mu.real {omega | C ≤ Q omega} :=
    measureReal_mono (fun _omega homega ↦ by
      simpa only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] using homega.le)
  rw [le_div_iff₀ hC]
  calc
    mu.real {omega | C < Q omega} * C =
        C * mu.real {omega | C < Q omega} := by ring
    _ ≤ C * mu.real {omega | C ≤ Q omega} :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmono hC.le
    _ ≤ ∫ omega, Q omega ∂mu := hmarkov
    _ ≤ K ^ 2 := integral_empiricalEnvelopeSquareAverage_le
      R X hRL2 hRsecond n

name: ProbabilityTheory.centeredTruncationResidualCoefficient_sqrt_le
statement:
theorem centeredTruncationResidualCoefficient_sqrt_le
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (R : Z → ℝ) (hRmeas : Measurable R) (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (X : ℕ → Omega → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i)) {K : ℝ}
    (hRL2 : ∀ i, MemLp (fun omega ↦ R (X i omega)) 2 mu)
    (hRsecond : ∀ i, ∫ omega, R (X i omega) ^ 2 ∂mu ≤ K ^ 2)
    (n : ℕ) (omega : Omega) :
    centeredTruncationResidualCoefficient (mu := mu) R
        (Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ)) (Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ X
        (Finset.range (n + 1)) omega ≤
      empiricalEnvelopeSquareAverage R X n omega + K ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let q : ℝ := Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ)
  have hn : 0 < (n + 1 : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hq : 0 < q := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hn
  have hqSq : q ^ 2 = (n + 1 : ℝ) := Real.sq_sqrt hn.le
  have hqInv : 0 ≤ q⁻¹ := (inv_pos.mpr hq).le
  have hqInvSq : q⁻¹ * q⁻¹ = (n + 1 : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
    calc
      q⁻¹ * q⁻¹ = (q * q)⁻¹ := (mul_inv q q).symm
      _ = (q ^ 2)⁻¹ := by rw [pow_two]
      _ = (n + 1 : ℝ)⁻¹ := by rw [hqSq]
  have hterm : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
      truncationTailEnvelope R q (X i omega) +
          ∫ xi, truncationTailEnvelope R q (X i xi) ∂mu ≤
        q⁻¹ * R (X i omega) ^ 2 +
          q⁻¹ * ∫ xi, R (X i xi) ^ 2 ∂mu := by
    intro i hi
    exact add_le_add
      (truncationTailEnvelope_le_inv_mul_sq R hq hR (X i omega))
      (integral_truncationTailEnvelope_le_inv_mul_integral_sq
        R hq hRmeas hR (X i) (hX i) (hRL2 i))
  change centeredTruncationResidualCoefficient (mu := mu) R q q⁻¹ X
      (Finset.range (n + 1)) omega ≤ _
  rw [centeredTruncationResidualCoefficient, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hq)]
  calc
    q⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        (truncationTailEnvelope R q (X i omega) +
          ∫ xi, truncationTailEnvelope R q (X i xi) ∂mu) ≤
        q⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          (q⁻¹ * R (X i omega) ^ 2 +
            q⁻¹ * ∫ xi, R (X i xi) ^ 2 ∂mu) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Finset.sum_le_sum hterm) hqInv
    _ = empiricalEnvelopeSquareAverage R X n omega +
        (n + 1 : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          ∫ xi, R (X i xi) ^ 2 ∂mu := by
      unfold empiricalEnvelopeSquareAverage
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      simp_rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
      calc
        q⁻¹ *
            (q⁻¹ * ∑ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), R (X x omega) ^ 2 +
              q⁻¹ * ∑ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
                ∫ xi, R (X x xi) ^ 2 ∂mu) =
            (q⁻¹ * q⁻¹) *
                ∑ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), R (X x omega) ^ 2 +
              (q⁻¹ * q⁻¹) * ∑ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
                ∫ xi, R (X x xi) ^ 2 ∂mu := by ring
        _ = _ := by rw [hqInvSq]
    _ ≤ empiricalEnvelopeSquareAverage R X n omega +
        (n + 1 : ℝ)⁻¹ *
          ∑ _i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), K ^ 2 := by
      gcongr with i hi
      exact hRsecond i
    _ = empiricalEnvelopeSquareAverage R X n omega + K ^ 2 := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
      push_cast
      field_simp

name: ProbabilityTheory.centeredAnchoredTruncationResidualProcess_anchor
statement:
@[simp]
theorem centeredAnchoredTruncationResidualProcess_anchor
    (H : Z → T → ℝ) (R : Z → ℝ) (M c : ℝ)
    (X : iota → Omega → Z) (I : Finset iota) (o : T) (omega : Omega) :
    centeredAnchoredTruncationResidualProcess
      (mu := mu) H R M c X I o omega o = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [centeredAnchoredTruncationResidualProcess,
    truncationResidualIncrement, lipschitzIncrement,
    truncatedLipschitzIncrement]

name: ProbabilityTheory.centeredAnchoredEmpiricalContinuousMap_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem centeredAnchoredEmpiricalContinuousMap_apply
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (H : Z → E → ℝ) (R : Z → ℝ)
    (X : ℕ → Omega → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hHmeas : ∀ t, Measurable (fun z ↦ H z t))
    (hHcont : ∀ z, Continuous (H z))
    (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (hLip : ∀ z s t, |H z s - H z t| ≤ R z * dist s t)
    (hRL2 : ∀ i, MemLp (fun omega ↦ R (X i omega)) 2 mu)
    (n : ℕ) (omega : Omega) (t : EuclideanUnitBall E) :
    centeredAnchoredEmpiricalContinuousMap (mu := mu)
        H R X hX hHmeas hHcont hR hLip hRL2 n omega t =
      centeredAnchoredEmpiricalProcess (mu := mu) H
        (Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ X (Finset.range (n + 1)) 0 omega (t : E)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: ProbabilityTheory.centeredTruncationResidualContinuousMap_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem centeredTruncationResidualContinuousMap_apply
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (H : Z → E → ℝ) (R : Z → ℝ)
    (X : ℕ → Omega → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hHmeas : ∀ t, Measurable (fun z ↦ H z t))
    (hHcont : ∀ z, Continuous (H z)) (hRmeas : Measurable R)
    (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (hLip : ∀ z s t, |H z s - H z t| ≤ R z * dist s t)
    (hRL2 : ∀ i, MemLp (fun omega ↦ R (X i omega)) 2 mu)
    (n : ℕ) (omega : Omega) (t : EuclideanUnitBall E) :
    centeredTruncationResidualContinuousMap (mu := mu)
        H R X hX hHmeas hHcont hRmeas hR hLip hRL2 n omega t =
      centeredAnchoredTruncationResidualProcess (mu := mu) H R
        (Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ)) (Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ X
        (Finset.range (n + 1)) 0 omega (t : E)
proof:
:= by
  change centeredAnchoredEmpiricalProcess (mu := mu) H
        (Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ X (Finset.range (n + 1)) 0 omega (t : E) -
      centeredAnchoredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess (mu := mu) H R
        (1 * Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ)) (Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ X
        (Finset.range (n + 1)) 0 omega (t : E) = _
  simpa only [one_mul] using centeredAnchoredEmpiricalProcess_sub_truncated
    (mu := mu) H R (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) X hX hHmeas hRmeas hR hLip
      (fun i ↦ (hRL2 i).integrable (by norm_num))
      (Finset.range (n + 1)) 0 omega (t : E)

name: ProbabilityTheory.centeredTruncated_add_residual_eq_centeredAnchored
statement:
theorem centeredTruncated_add_residual_eq_centeredAnchored
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (H : Z → E → ℝ) (R : Z → ℝ)
    (X : ℕ → Omega → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hHmeas : ∀ t, Measurable (fun z ↦ H z t))
    (hHcont : ∀ z, Continuous (H z)) (hRmeas : Measurable R)
    (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (hLip : ∀ z s t, |H z s - H z t| ≤ R z * dist s t)
    (hRL2 : ∀ i, MemLp (fun omega ↦ R (X i omega)) 2 mu)
    (n : ℕ) (omega : Omega) :
    centeredTruncatedEmpiricalContinuousMap (mu := mu)
          H R (a := 1) (by norm_num) X hX hHmeas hHcont hRmeas hR hLip n omega +
        centeredTruncationResidualContinuousMap (mu := mu)
          H R X hX hHmeas hHcont hRmeas hR hLip hRL2 n omega =
      centeredAnchoredEmpiricalContinuousMap (mu := mu)
        H R X hX hHmeas hHcont hR hLip hRL2 n omega
proof:
:= by
  unfold centeredTruncationResidualContinuousMap
  abel

name: ProbabilityTheory.dist_centeredTruncationResidualContinuousMap_le
statement:
theorem dist_centeredTruncationResidualContinuousMap_le
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (H : Z → E → ℝ) (R : Z → ℝ)
    (X : ℕ → Omega → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hHmeas : ∀ t, Measurable (fun z ↦ H z t))
    (hHcont : ∀ z, Continuous (H z)) (hRmeas : Measurable R)
    (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (hLip : ∀ z s t, |H z s - H z t| ≤ R z * dist s t)
    (hRL2 : ∀ i, MemLp (fun omega ↦ R (X i omega)) 2 mu)
    {K : ℝ}
    (hRsecond : ∀ i, ∫ omega, R (X i omega) ^ 2 ∂mu ≤ K ^ 2)
    (n : ℕ) (omega : Omega) (s t : EuclideanUnitBall E) :
    dist
        (centeredTruncationResidualContinuousMap (mu := mu)
          H R X hX hHmeas hHcont hRmeas hR hLip hRL2 n omega s)
        (centeredTruncationResidualContinuousMap (mu := mu)
          H R X hX hHmeas hHcont hRmeas hR hLip hRL2 n omega t) ≤
      (empiricalEnvelopeSquareAverage R X n omega + K ^ 2) * dist s t
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.dist_eq]
  simp only [centeredTruncationResidualContinuousMap_apply]
  calc
    |centeredAnchoredTruncationResidualProcess (mu := mu) H R
          (Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ)) (Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ X
          (Finset.range (n + 1)) 0 omega (s : E) -
        centeredAnchoredTruncationResidualProcess (mu := mu) H R
          (Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ)) (Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ X
          (Finset.range (n + 1)) 0 omega (t : E)| ≤
        centeredTruncationResidualCoefficient (mu := mu) R
            (Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ)) (Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ X
            (Finset.range (n + 1)) omega * dist (s : E) (t : E) :=
      abs_centeredAnchoredTruncationResidualProcess_sub_le
        H R (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) X hX hHmeas hRmeas hR hLip
          (fun i ↦ (hRL2 i).integrable (by norm_num))
          (Finset.range (n + 1)) 0 omega (s : E) (t : E)
    _ ≤ (empiricalEnvelopeSquareAverage R X n omega + K ^ 2) *
        dist (s : E) (t : E) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (centeredTruncationResidualCoefficient_sqrt_le
          R hRmeas hR X hX hRL2 hRsecond n omega) dist_nonneg
    _ = _ := by rw [Subtype.dist_eq]

name: ProbabilityTheory.norm_centeredTruncationResidualContinuousMap_le
statement:
theorem norm_centeredTruncationResidualContinuousMap_le
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    [CompactSpace (EuclideanUnitBall E)]
    (H : Z → E → ℝ) (R : Z → ℝ)
    (X : ℕ → Omega → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hHmeas : ∀ t, Measurable (fun z ↦ H z t))
    (hHcont : ∀ z, Continuous (H z)) (hRmeas : Measurable R)
    (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (hLip : ∀ z s t, |H z s - H z t| ≤ R z * dist s t)
    (hRL2 : ∀ i, MemLp (fun omega ↦ R (X i omega)) 2 mu)
    {K : ℝ}
    (hRsecond : ∀ i, ∫ omega, R (X i omega) ^ 2 ∂mu ≤ K ^ 2)
    (n : ℕ) (omega : Omega) :
    ‖centeredTruncationResidualContinuousMap (mu := mu)
        H R X hX hHmeas hHcont hRmeas hR hLip hRL2 n omega‖ ≤
      empiricalEnvelopeSquareAverage R X n omega + K ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let D := empiricalEnvelopeSquareAverage R X n omega + K ^ 2
  have hD : 0 ≤ D := add_nonneg
    (empiricalEnvelopeSquareAverage_nonneg R X n omega) (sq_nonneg K)
  let z0 : EuclideanUnitBall E := ⟨0, by simp⟩
  have hz0 : centeredTruncationResidualContinuousMap (mu := mu)
      H R X hX hHmeas hHcont hRmeas hR hLip hRL2 n omega z0 = 0 := by
    simp only [centeredTruncationResidualContinuousMap_apply]
    exact centeredAnchoredTruncationResidualProcess_anchor
      H R _ _ X (Finset.range (n + 1)) 0 omega
  rw [ContinuousMap.norm_le _ hD]
  intro t
  have hlip := dist_centeredTruncationResidualContinuousMap_le
    H R X hX hHmeas hHcont hRmeas hR hLip hRL2 hRsecond n omega t z0
  have htz : dist t z0 ≤ 1 := by
    simpa only [z0, Subtype.dist_eq, dist_zero_right] using t.property
  calc
    ‖centeredTruncationResidualContinuousMap (mu := mu)
        H R X hX hHmeas hHcont hRmeas hR hLip hRL2 n omega t‖ =
        dist
          (centeredTruncationResidualContinuousMap (mu := mu)
            H R X hX hHmeas hHcont hRmeas hR hLip hRL2 n omega t)
          (centeredTruncationResidualContinuousMap (mu := mu)
            H R X hX hHmeas hHcont hRmeas hR hLip hRL2 n omega z0) := by
      rw [hz0, dist_zero_right]
    _ ≤ D * dist t z0 := hlip
    _ ≤ D * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htz hD
    _ = D := mul_one D

name: ProbabilityTheory.isTightMeasureSet_range_centeredTruncationResidualContinuousMap
statement:
theorem isTightMeasureSet_range_centeredTruncationResidualContinuousMap
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    [MeasurableSpace C(EuclideanUnitBall E, ℝ)]
    [BorelSpace C(EuclideanUnitBall E, ℝ)]
    (H : Z → E → ℝ) (R : Z → ℝ) {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K)
    (X : ℕ → Omega → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hHmeas : ∀ t, Measurable (fun z ↦ H z t))
    (hHcont : ∀ z, Continuous (H z)) (hRmeas : Measurable R)
    (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (hLip : ∀ z s t, |H z s - H z t| ≤ R z * dist s t)
    (hRL2 : ∀ i, MemLp (fun omega ↦ R (X i omega)) 2 mu)
    (hRsecond : ∀ i, ∫ omega, R (X i omega) ^ 2 ∂mu ≤ K ^ 2)
    (hpathMeas : ∀ n, AEMeasurable
      (centeredTruncationResidualContinuousMap (mu := mu)
        H R X hX hHmeas hHcont hRmeas hR hLip hRL2 n) mu) :
    IsTightMeasureSet (Set.range fun n ↦ mu.map
      (centeredTruncationResidualContinuousMap (mu := mu)
        H R X hX hHmeas hHcont hRmeas hR hLip hRL2 n))
proof:
:= by
  letI : CompactSpace (EuclideanUnitBall E) :=
    isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp (by
      apply Metric.isCompact_of_isClosed_isBounded
      · exact isClosed_le continuous_norm continuous_const
      · exact (isBounded_iff_forall_norm_le.mpr
          ⟨1, fun _v hv ↦ hv⟩))
  let Y : ℕ → Omega → C(EuclideanUnitBall E, ℝ) := fun n ↦
    centeredTruncationResidualContinuousMap (mu := mu)
      H R X hX hHmeas hHcont hRmeas hR hLip hRL2 n
  let delta : ℕ → ℝ := RandomSetTheory.dyadicResolution
  apply isTightMeasureSet_range_map_of_real_compactContainment
    mu Y hpathMeas delta RandomSetTheory.dyadicResolution_pos
  intro epsilon hepsilon
  let C : ℝ := K ^ 2 / epsilon
  have hKsq : 0 < K ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hK
  have hC : 0 < C := div_pos hKsq hepsilon
  let D : ℝ := C + K ^ 2
  have hD : 0 ≤ D := add_nonneg hC.le (sq_nonneg K)
  let eta : ℕ → ℝ := fun k ↦ D * delta k
  have hdeltaSummable : Summable delta := by
    change Summable (fun k : ℕ ↦ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k)
    exact summable_geometric_of_norm_lt_one (by norm_num [Real.norm_eq_abs])
  have heta : Tendsto eta atTop (nhds 0) := by
    exact (hdeltaSummable.mul_left D).tendsto_atTop_zero
  refine ⟨D, hD, eta, heta, ?_⟩
  intro n
  have hsubset :
      {omega | D < ‖Y n omega‖ ∨
        ∃ k s t, dist s t < delta k ∧
          eta k < dist (Y n omega s) (Y n omega t)} ⊆
        {omega | C < empiricalEnvelopeSquareAverage R X n omega} := by
    intro omega hbad
    by_contra hnot
    have hQle : empiricalEnvelopeSquareAverage R X n omega ≤ C :=
      le_of_not_gt hnot
    have hnorm : ‖Y n omega‖ ≤ D := by
      calc
        ‖Y n omega‖ ≤ empiricalEnvelopeSquareAverage R X n omega + K ^ 2 :=
          norm_centeredTruncationResidualContinuousMap_le
            H R X hX hHmeas hHcont hRmeas hR hLip hRL2
              hRsecond n omega
        _ ≤ D := by
          simpa only [D, add_comm] using add_le_add_right hQle (K ^ 2)
    rcases hbad with hnormBad | ⟨k, s, t, hst, hmodBad⟩
    · exact (not_lt_of_ge hnorm) hnormBad
    · have hlip := dist_centeredTruncationResidualContinuousMap_le
        H R X hX hHmeas hHcont hRmeas hR hLip hRL2
          hRsecond n omega s t
      have hcoeff :
          empiricalEnvelopeSquareAverage R X n omega + K ^ 2 ≤ D :=
        by simpa only [D, add_comm] using add_le_add_right hQle (K ^ 2)
      have hdist : dist (Y n omega s) (Y n omega t) ≤ eta k := by
        calc
          dist (Y n omega s) (Y n omega t) ≤
              (empiricalEnvelopeSquareAverage R X n omega + K ^ 2) *
                dist s t := hlip
          _ ≤ D * dist s t :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcoeff dist_nonneg
          _ ≤ D * delta k := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hst.le hD
          _ = eta k := rfl
      exact (not_lt_of_ge hdist) hmodBad
  have hmarkov := measureReal_empiricalEnvelopeSquareAverage_gt_le
    R X hC hRL2 hRsecond n
  calc
    mu.real {omega | D < ‖Y n omega‖ ∨
        ∃ k s t, dist s t < delta k ∧
          eta k < dist (Y n omega s) (Y n omega t)} ≤
        mu.real {omega | C < empiricalEnvelopeSquareAverage R X n omega} :=
      measureReal_mono hsubset
    _ ≤ K ^ 2 / C := hmarkov
    _ = epsilon := by
      dsimp only [C]
      field_simp

name: ProbabilityTheory.isTightMeasureSet_range_centeredAnchoredEmpiricalContinuousMap
statement:
theorem isTightMeasureSet_range_centeredAnchoredEmpiricalContinuousMap
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    [MeasurableSpace C(EuclideanUnitBall E, ℝ)]
    [BorelSpace C(EuclideanUnitBall E, ℝ)]
    (H : Z → E → ℝ) (R : Z → ℝ) {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K)
    (X : ℕ → Omega → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X mu)
    (hHmeas : ∀ t, Measurable (fun z ↦ H z t))
    (hHcont : ∀ z, Continuous (H z)) (hRmeas : Measurable R)
    (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (hLip : ∀ z s t, |H z s - H z t| ≤ R z * dist s t)
    (hRL2 : ∀ i, MemLp (fun omega ↦ R (X i omega)) 2 mu)
    (hRsecond : ∀ i, ∫ omega, R (X i omega) ^ 2 ∂mu ≤ K ^ 2)
    (hRawPathMeas : ∀ n, AEMeasurable
      (centeredAnchoredEmpiricalContinuousMap (mu := mu)
        H R X hX hHmeas hHcont hR hLip hRL2 n) mu)
    (hTruncatedPathMeas : ∀ n, AEMeasurable
      (centeredTruncatedEmpiricalContinuousMap (mu := mu)
        H R (a := 1) (by norm_num) X hX hHmeas hHcont hRmeas hR hLip n) mu) :
    IsTightMeasureSet (Set.range fun n ↦ mu.map
      (centeredAnchoredEmpiricalContinuousMap (mu := mu)
        H R X hX hHmeas hHcont hR hLip hRL2 n))
proof:
:= by
  letI : CompactSpace (EuclideanUnitBall E) :=
    isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp (by
      apply Metric.isCompact_of_isClosed_isBounded
      · exact isClosed_le continuous_norm continuous_const
      · exact (isBounded_iff_forall_norm_le.mpr
          ⟨1, fun _v hv ↦ hv⟩))
  let Path := C(EuclideanUnitBall E, ℝ)
  let Yraw : ℕ → Omega → Path := fun n ↦
    centeredAnchoredEmpiricalContinuousMap (mu := mu)
      H R X hX hHmeas hHcont hR hLip hRL2 n
  let Ytr : ℕ → Omega → Path := fun n ↦
    centeredTruncatedEmpiricalContinuousMap (mu := mu)
      H R (a := 1) (by norm_num) X hX hHmeas hHcont hRmeas hR hLip n
  let Yres : ℕ → Omega → Path := fun n ↦
    centeredTruncationResidualContinuousMap (mu := mu)
      H R X hX hHmeas hHcont hRmeas hR hLip hRL2 n
  have hresPathMeas : ∀ n, AEMeasurable (Yres n) mu := by
    intro n
    change AEMeasurable (fun omega ↦ Yraw n omega - Ytr n omega) mu
    exact (continuous_sub.measurable.comp_aemeasurable
      ((hRawPathMeas n).prodMk (hTruncatedPathMeas n)))
  have htightTr : IsTightMeasureSet
      (Set.range fun n ↦ mu.map (Ytr n)) := by
    simpa only [Ytr] using
      isTightMeasureSet_range_centeredTruncatedEmpiricalContinuousMap
        H R (a := 1) (K := K) (by norm_num) hK X hX hIndep
          hHmeas hHcont hRmeas hR hLip hRL2 hRsecond hTruncatedPathMeas
  have htightRes : IsTightMeasureSet
      (Set.range fun n ↦ mu.map (Yres n)) := by
    simpa only [Yres] using
      isTightMeasureSet_range_centeredTruncationResidualContinuousMap
        H R hK X hX hHmeas hHcont hRmeas hR hLip hRL2 hRsecond
          hresPathMeas
  let jointLaws : Set (Measure (Path × Path)) :=
    Set.range fun n ↦ mu.map (fun omega ↦ (Ytr n omega, Yres n omega))
  have htightFst : IsTightMeasureSet (Measure.fst '' jointLaws) := by
    apply htightTr.subset
    rintro m ⟨rho, ⟨n, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    rw [Measure.fst_map_prodMk₀ (hresPathMeas n)]
    exact Set.mem_range_self n
  have htightSnd : IsTightMeasureSet (Measure.snd '' jointLaws) := by
    apply htightRes.subset
    rintro m ⟨rho, ⟨n, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    rw [Measure.snd_map_prodMk₀ (hTruncatedPathMeas n)]
    exact Set.mem_range_self n
  have htightJoint : IsTightMeasureSet jointLaws :=
    htightFst.prodMk htightSnd
  let addPaths : Path × Path → Path := fun p ↦ p.1 + p.2
  have haddContinuous : Continuous addPaths := continuous_add
  have htightAdd : IsTightMeasureSet (Measure.map addPaths '' jointLaws) :=
    htightJoint.map haddContinuous
  apply htightAdd.subset
  rintro m ⟨n, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨mu.map (fun omega ↦ (Ytr n omega, Yres n omega)),
    Set.mem_range_self n, ?_⟩
  rw [AEMeasurable.map_map_of_aemeasurable
    haddContinuous.measurable.aemeasurable
    ((hTruncatedPathMeas n).prodMk (hresPathMeas n))]
  congr 1
  funext omega
  change Ytr n omega + Yres n omega = Yraw n omega
  exact centeredTruncated_add_residual_eq_centeredAnchored
    H R X hX hHmeas hHcont hRmeas hR hLip hRL2 n omega

name: ProbabilityTheory.exp_le_oneSidedExpSeriesTaylorBound
statement:
theorem exp_le_oneSidedExpSeriesTaylorBound
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) (x : ℝ) :
    Real.exp x ≤ oneSidedExpSeriesTaylorBound q x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : 0 ≤ x
  · have hexact := exp_eq_sum_range_add_expSeriesTail x q
    let f : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => x ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)
    have hsplit := sum_range_add_sum_Ico f hq
    have hthree : (∑ k ∈ range 3, f k) = 1 + x + x ^ 2 / 2 := by
      simp only [f, sum_range_succ, range_one, sum_singleton, pow_zero,
        Nat.factorial, Nat.cast_one, div_one, pow_one]
      ring
    have hsum : (∑ k ∈ range q, f k) =
        1 + x + x ^ 2 / 2 + ∑ k ∈ Ico 3 q, f k := by
      rw [← hsplit, hthree]
    unfold oneSidedExpSeriesTaylorBound
    rw [max_eq_left hx]
    rw [hexact, hsum]
  · have hxnonpos : x ≤ 0 := le_of_not_ge hx
    have hbase := exp_le_one_add_add_half_sq_of_nonpos hxnonpos
    have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := by omega
    have hsumzero :
        (∑ k ∈ Ico 3 q, (0 : ℝ) ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) = 0 := by
      apply sum_eq_zero
      intro k hk
      have hk0 : k ≠ 0 := by
        have hk3 := (mem_Ico.mp hk).1
        omega
      simp [hk0]
    unfold oneSidedExpSeriesTaylorBound
    rw [max_eq_right hxnonpos, hsumzero, expSeriesTail_zero hq0]
    simp only [add_zero]
    exact hbase

name: ProbabilityTheory.exp_mul_le_exactStrongMomentMajorant
statement:
theorem exp_mul_le_exactStrongMomentMajorant
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) {t x y : ℝ}
    (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hy : 0 < y) (hxy : x ≤ y) :
    Real.exp (t * x) ≤
      1 + t * x + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (t * x) ^ 2 +
        (∑ k ∈ Ico 3 q,
          (t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) * (max x 0) ^ k) +
        (expSeriesTail q (t * y) / y ^ q) * (max x 0) ^ q
proof:
:= by
  have hTaylor := exp_le_oneSidedExpSeriesTaylorBound q hq (t * x)
  have hmax : max (t * x) 0 = t * max x 0 :=
    max_mul_eq_mul_max t x ht
  have ha : 0 ≤ max x 0 := le_max_right _ _
  have hay : max x 0 ≤ y := max_le hxy hy.le
  have htail := expSeriesTail_mul_le_ratio_pow_mul q ht ha hay hy
  have hsumEq :
      (∑ k ∈ Ico 3 q,
        (t * max x 0) ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) =
      ∑ k ∈ Ico 3 q,
        (t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) * (max x 0) ^ k := by
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro k _hk
    rw [mul_pow]
    ring
  have hratio :
      (max x 0 / y) ^ q * expSeriesTail q (t * y) =
        (expSeriesTail q (t * y) / y ^ q) * (max x 0) ^ q := by
    rw [div_pow]
    ring
  unfold oneSidedExpSeriesTaylorBound at hTaylor
  rw [hmax, hsumEq] at hTaylor
  have hprefix :
      1 + t * x + (t * x) ^ 2 / 2 +
          (∑ k ∈ Ico 3 q,
            (t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) * (max x 0) ^ k) =
        1 + t * x + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (t * x) ^ 2 +
          (∑ k ∈ Ico 3 q,
            (t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) * (max x 0) ^ k) := by
    ring
  calc
    Real.exp (t * x) ≤
        1 + t * x + (t * x) ^ 2 / 2 +
          (∑ k ∈ Ico 3 q,
            (t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) * (max x 0) ^ k) +
          expSeriesTail q (t * max x 0) := hTaylor
    _ ≤ 1 + t * x + (t * x) ^ 2 / 2 +
          (∑ k ∈ Ico 3 q,
            (t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) * (max x 0) ^ k) +
          (max x 0 / y) ^ q * expSeriesTail q (t * y) :=
      add_le_add le_rfl htail
    _ = 1 + t * x + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (t * x) ^ 2 +
          (∑ k ∈ Ico 3 q,
            (t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) * (max x 0) ^ k) +
          (expSeriesTail q (t * y) / y ^ q) * (max x 0) ^ q := by
      rw [hratio, hprefix]

name: ProbabilityTheory.sum_strongMomentSeriesExponent
statement:
theorem sum_strongMomentSeriesExponent
    {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (q : ℕ) (t y : ℝ)
    (second : ι → ℝ) (moment : ι → ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, strongMomentSeriesExponent q t y (second i) (moment i)) =
      strongMomentSeriesExponent q t y
        (∑ i ∈ s, second i) (fun k => ∑ i ∈ s, moment i k)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfirst :
      (∑ i ∈ s, (1 / 2 : ℝ) * t ^ 2 * second i) =
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * t ^ 2 * ∑ i ∈ s, second i := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  have hmiddle :
      (∑ i ∈ s, ∑ k ∈ Ico 3 q,
        t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ) * moment i k) =
        ∑ k ∈ Ico 3 q,
          t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ) * ∑ i ∈ s, moment i k := by
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro k _hk
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  have htail :
      (∑ i ∈ s,
        expSeriesTail q (t * y) / y ^ q * moment i q) =
        expSeriesTail q (t * y) / y ^ q * ∑ i ∈ s, moment i q := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  unfold strongMomentSeriesExponent
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rw [hfirst, hmiddle, htail]

name: ProbabilityTheory.integral_exp_mul_le_exp_strongMomentSeriesExponent
statement:
theorem integral_exp_mul_le_exp_strongMomentSeriesExponent
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : Omega → ℝ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    {t y : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hy : 0 < y)
    (hX : Integrable X mu)
    (hXsq : Integrable (fun omega => X omega ^ 2) mu)
    (hpow : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      Integrable (fun omega => (max (X omega) 0) ^ k) mu)
    (hupper : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, X omega ≤ y)
    (hcenter : (∫ omega, X omega ∂mu) ≤ 0) :
    (∫ omega, Real.exp (t * X omega) ∂mu) ≤
      Real.exp (strongMomentSeriesExponent q t y
        (∫ omega, X omega ^ 2 ∂mu)
        (fun k => ∫ omega, (max (X omega) 0) ^ k ∂mu))
proof:
:= by
  let M : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => ∫ omega, (max (X omega) 0) ^ k ∂mu
  let V : ℝ := ∫ omega, X omega ^ 2 ∂mu
  let C : ℝ := expSeriesTail q (t * y) / y ^ q
  let E : ℝ := strongMomentSeriesExponent q t y V M
  have hExp : Integrable (fun omega => Real.exp (t * X omega)) mu := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound
      ((hX.aemeasurable.const_mul t).exp.aestronglyMeasurable)
      (Real.exp (t * y))
    filter_upwards [hupper] with omega homega
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
    exact Real.exp_monotone (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left homega ht)
  have hMomentNonneg : ∀ k, 0 ≤ M k := by
    intro k
    exact integral_nonneg fun omega => pow_nonneg (le_max_right _ _) k
  have hVNonneg : 0 ≤ V := integral_nonneg fun omega => sq_nonneg _
  have hTailNonneg : 0 ≤ expSeriesTail q (t * y) :=
    expSeriesTail_nonneg (mul_nonneg ht hy.le) q
  have hCNonneg : 0 ≤ C := by
    unfold C
    exact div_nonneg hTailNonneg (pow_nonneg hy.le q)
  have hENonneg : 0 ≤ E := by
    unfold E strongMomentSeriesExponent
    have hsum : 0 ≤ ∑ k ∈ Ico 3 q,
        t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ) * M k := by
      positivity
    have htail : 0 ≤
        expSeriesTail q (t * y) / y ^ q * M q := by
      change 0 ≤ C * M q
      positivity
    positivity
  have hfiniteInt : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Ico 3 q,
      Integrable (fun omega =>
        (t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) * (max (X omega) 0) ^ k) mu := by
    intro k hk
    exact (hpow k (Finset.mem_Icc.mpr
      ⟨(Finset.mem_Ico.mp hk).1.trans' (by norm_num),
        (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hk).2.le⟩)).const_mul _
  have htailInt : Integrable (fun omega =>
      C * (max (X omega) 0) ^ q) mu :=
    (hpow q (Finset.mem_Icc.mpr
      ⟨hq.trans' (by norm_num), le_rfl⟩)).const_mul _
  have hmajorantInt : Integrable (fun omega =>
      1 + t * X omega + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (t * X omega) ^ 2 +
        (∑ k ∈ Ico 3 q,
          (t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) * (max (X omega) 0) ^ k) +
        C * (max (X omega) 0) ^ q) mu := by
    have hlin : Integrable (fun omega => t * X omega) mu := hX.const_mul t
    have hquad : Integrable
        (fun omega => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (t * X omega) ^ 2) mu := by
      have hs : Integrable (fun omega => (t * X omega) ^ 2) mu := by
        convert hXsq.const_mul (t ^ 2) using 1
        ext omega
        ring
      exact hs.const_mul _
    have hsumInt : Integrable (fun omega =>
        ∑ k ∈ Ico 3 q,
          (t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) * (max (X omega) 0) ^ k) mu :=
      integrable_finsetSum _ hfiniteInt
    have hshape :
        (fun omega =>
          1 + t * X omega + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (t * X omega) ^ 2 +
            (∑ k ∈ Ico 3 q,
              (t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) * (max (X omega) 0) ^ k) +
            C * (max (X omega) 0) ^ q) =
          ((((fun _ : Omega => (1 : ℝ)) + (fun omega => t * X omega)) +
              (fun omega => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (t * X omega) ^ 2)) +
            (fun omega => ∑ k ∈ Ico 3 q,
              (t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) * (max (X omega) 0) ^ k)) +
            (fun omega => C * (max (X omega) 0) ^ q) := by
      funext omega
      simp only [Pi.add_apply]
    rw [hshape]
    exact (((((integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).add hlin).add hquad).add
      hsumInt).add htailInt)
  have hpoint : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      Real.exp (t * X omega) ≤
        1 + t * X omega + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (t * X omega) ^ 2 +
          (∑ k ∈ Ico 3 q,
            (t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) * (max (X omega) 0) ^ k) +
          C * (max (X omega) 0) ^ q := by
    filter_upwards [hupper] with omega homega
    simpa only [C] using
      (exp_mul_le_exactStrongMomentMajorant q hq ht hy homega)
  have hint := integral_mono_ae hExp hmajorantInt hpoint
  have hlin : Integrable (fun omega => t * X omega) mu := hX.const_mul t
  have hquad : Integrable
      (fun omega => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (t * X omega) ^ 2) mu := by
    have hs : Integrable (fun omega => (t * X omega) ^ 2) mu := by
      convert hXsq.const_mul (t ^ 2) using 1
      ext omega
      ring
    exact hs.const_mul _
  have hsumInt : Integrable (fun omega =>
      ∑ k ∈ Ico 3 q,
        (t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) * (max (X omega) 0) ^ k) mu :=
    integrable_finsetSum _ hfiniteInt
  have hlinIntegral :
      (∫ omega, t * X omega ∂mu) = t * ∫ omega, X omega ∂mu := by
    rw [integral_const_mul]
  have hquadIntegral :
      (∫ omega, (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (t * X omega) ^ 2 ∂mu) =
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * t ^ 2 * V := by
    rw [integral_const_mul]
    have hscaled :
        (∫ omega, (t * X omega) ^ 2 ∂mu) = t ^ 2 * V := by
      change (∫ omega, (t * X omega) ^ 2 ∂mu) =
        t ^ 2 * ∫ omega, X omega ^ 2 ∂mu
      have hfun : (fun omega => (t * X omega) ^ 2) =
          fun omega => t ^ 2 * X omega ^ 2 := by
        funext omega
        ring
      rw [hfun, integral_const_mul]
    rw [hscaled]
    ring
  have hsumIntegral :
      (∫ omega, (∑ k ∈ Ico 3 q,
        (t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) * (max (X omega) 0) ^ k) ∂mu) =
      ∑ k ∈ Ico 3 q,
        t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ) * M k := by
    calc
      (∫ omega, (∑ k ∈ Ico 3 q,
          (t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) * (max (X omega) 0) ^ k) ∂mu) =
          ∑ k ∈ Ico 3 q,
            ∫ omega, (t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) *
              (max (X omega) 0) ^ k ∂mu :=
        integral_finsetSum (Ico 3 q) hfiniteInt
      _ = ∑ k ∈ Ico 3 q,
          t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ) * M k := by
        apply sum_congr rfl
        intro k _hk
        rw [integral_const_mul]
  have htailIntegral :
      (∫ omega, C * (max (X omega) 0) ^ q ∂mu) = C * M q := by
    rw [integral_const_mul]
  have hmajorantIntegral :
      (∫ omega,
        1 + t * X omega + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (t * X omega) ^ 2 +
          (∑ k ∈ Ico 3 q,
            (t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) * (max (X omega) 0) ^ k) +
          C * (max (X omega) 0) ^ q ∂mu) =
        1 + t * (∫ omega, X omega ∂mu) + E := by
    have hconst : Integrable (fun _ : Omega => (1 : ℝ)) mu := integrable_const _
    have hconstLin := hconst.add hlin
    have hconstLinQuad := hconstLin.add hquad
    have hprefix := hconstLinQuad.add hsumInt
    have hshape :
        (fun omega =>
          1 + t * X omega + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (t * X omega) ^ 2 +
            (∑ k ∈ Ico 3 q,
              (t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) * (max (X omega) 0) ^ k) +
            C * (max (X omega) 0) ^ q) =
          ((((fun _ : Omega => (1 : ℝ)) + (fun omega => t * X omega)) +
              (fun omega => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (t * X omega) ^ 2)) +
            (fun omega => ∑ k ∈ Ico 3 q,
              (t ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) * (max (X omega) 0) ^ k)) +
            (fun omega => C * (max (X omega) 0) ^ q) := by
      funext omega
      simp only [Pi.add_apply]
    rw [hshape]
    rw [integral_add' hprefix htailInt,
      integral_add' hconstLinQuad hsumInt,
      integral_add' hconstLin hquad,
      integral_add' hconst hlin,
      integral_const, hlinIntegral, hquadIntegral,
      hsumIntegral, htailIntegral]
    simp only [probReal_univ, one_smul]
    unfold E strongMomentSeriesExponent C
    ring
  rw [hmajorantIntegral] at hint
  calc
    (∫ omega, Real.exp (t * X omega) ∂mu) ≤
        1 + t * (∫ omega, X omega ∂mu) + E := hint
    _ ≤ 1 + E := by
      have htcenter : t * (∫ omega, X omega ∂mu) ≤ 0 :=
        mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos ht hcenter
      linarith
    _ ≤ Real.exp E := by
      simpa [add_comm] using Real.add_one_le_exp E

name: RandomSetTheory.supportArgmax_nonempty
statement:
theorem supportArgmax_nonempty
    {Ω H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
    {S : Ω → Set H} (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty) (u : H) (ω : Ω) :
    (supportArgmax S u ω).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxmax⟩ := supportFunction_attains (hcompact ω) (hne ω) u
  exact ⟨x, hx, hxmax.symm⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.supportArgmax_isCompact
statement:
theorem supportArgmax_isCompact
    {Ω H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]

proof:
:= by
  exact (hcompact ω).inter_right
    (isClosed_eq (by fun_prop : Continuous fun x : H => ⟪u, x⟫_ℝ) continuous_const)

name: RandomSetTheory.supportArgmax_subset
statement:
theorem supportArgmax_subset
    {Ω H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
