name: RandomSetTheory.exists_denseSeq_ball_closedBall_subset
statement:
theorem exists_denseSeq_ball_closedBall_subset
    {H : Type*} [MetricSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H] [Nonempty H]
    {U : Set H} (hU : IsOpen U) {x : H} (hx : x ∈ U) :
    ∃ n m : ℕ,
      x ∈ Metric.ball (denseSeq H n) (1 / (m + 1 : ℝ)) ∧
        Metric.closedBall (denseSeq H n) (1 / (m + 1 : ℝ)) ⊆ U
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδU⟩ := (Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU) x hx
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_nat_one_div_lt (half_pos hδ)
  let r : ℝ := 1 / (m + 1 : ℝ)
  have hr : 0 < r := by positivity
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (denseRange_denseSeq H).exists_dist_lt x hr
  refine ⟨n, m, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [r, Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm] using hn
  · apply (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball' (x := denseSeq H n) (y := x) ?_).trans hδU
    calc
      r + dist (denseSeq H n) x < r + r := by
        rw [dist_comm]
        linarith
      _ < δ := by
        dsimp [r]
        linarith

name: RandomSetTheory.measurableSet_supportArgmaxBasisEvent
statement:
theorem measurableSet_supportArgmaxBasisEvent
    {Ω H : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
    [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H] [Nonempty H]
    {S : Ω → Set H} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω)) (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    (u : H) (U : Set H) (n m : ℕ) :
    MeasurableSet {ω | SupportArgmaxBasisEvent S u U n m ω}
proof:
:= by
  let q : H := denseSeq H n
  let r : ℝ := 1 / (m + 1 : ℝ)
  have hhit : MeasurableSet {ω | (S ω ∩ Metric.ball q r).Nonempty} :=
    hS (Metric.ball q r) Metric.isOpen_ball
  have hlocal : Measurable
      (fun ω => supportFunction (castaingLocalization S q r ω) u) :=
    measurable_supportFunction (effros_castaingLocalization hS q r)
      (castaingLocalization_isCompact hcompact q r)
      (castaingLocalization_nonempty hne q r) u
  have hglobal : Measurable (fun ω => supportFunction (S ω) u) :=
    measurable_supportFunction hS hcompact hne u
  by_cases hb : Metric.closedBall q r ⊆ U
  · have hEq : {ω | SupportArgmaxBasisEvent S u U n m ω} =
        {ω | (S ω ∩ Metric.ball q r).Nonempty} ∩
          {ω | supportFunction (castaingLocalization S q r ω) u =
            supportFunction (S ω) u} := by
      ext ω
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨_, hhitω, heqω⟩
        exact ⟨hhitω, heqω⟩
      · rintro ⟨hhitω, heqω⟩
        exact ⟨by simpa [q, r] using hb, hhitω, by simpa [q, r] using heqω⟩
    rw [hEq]
    exact hhit.inter (measurableSet_eq_fun hlocal hglobal)
  · have hempty : {ω | SupportArgmaxBasisEvent S u U n m ω} = (∅ : Set Ω) := by
      ext ω
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_empty_iff_false]
      constructor
      · intro hω
        exact (hb (by simpa [q, r] using hω.1)).elim
      · exact False.elim
    rw [hempty]
    exact MeasurableSet.empty

name: RandomSetTheory.effrosMeasurable_supportArgmax
statement:
theorem effrosMeasurable_supportArgmax
    {Ω H : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
    [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H] [Nonempty H]
    {S : Ω → Set H} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω)) (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    (u : H) : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable (supportArgmax S u)
proof:
:= by
  intro U hU
  have hEq : {ω | (supportArgmax S u ω ∩ U).Nonempty} =
      ⋃ n : ℕ, ⋃ m : ℕ, {ω | SupportArgmaxBasisEvent S u U n m ω} := by
    ext ω
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_iUnion]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, hxmax, hxU⟩
      obtain ⟨n, m, hxball, hclosedBall⟩ :=
        exists_denseSeq_ball_closedBall_subset hU hxU
      let q : H := denseSeq H n
      let r : ℝ := 1 / (m + 1 : ℝ)
      have hhit : (S ω ∩ Metric.ball q r).Nonempty :=
        ⟨x, hxmax.1, by simpa [q, r] using hxball⟩
      have hxlocal : x ∈ castaingLocalization S q r ω := by
        rw [castaingLocalization, if_pos hhit]
        exact subset_closure ⟨hxmax.1, by simpa [q, r] using hxball⟩
      have hlocalCompact := castaingLocalization_isCompact hcompact q r ω
      have hlocalNe := castaingLocalization_nonempty hne q r ω
      have hlocalSub := castaingLocalization_subset
        (fun ω => (hcompact ω).isClosed) q r ω
      refine ⟨n, m, ?_⟩
      refine ⟨by simpa [q, r] using hclosedBall, hhit, ?_⟩
      apply le_antisymm
      · exact supportFunction_mono hlocalCompact (hcompact ω) hlocalNe hlocalSub u
      · calc
          supportFunction (S ω) u = ⟪u, x⟫_ℝ := hxmax.2.symm
          _ ≤ supportFunction (castaingLocalization S q r ω) u :=
            inner_le_supportFunction hlocalCompact hxlocal u
    · rintro ⟨n, m, hbasis, hhit, heq⟩
      let q : H := denseSeq H n
      let r : ℝ := 1 / (m + 1 : ℝ)
      have hhit' : (S ω ∩ Metric.ball q r).Nonempty := by
        simpa [q, r] using hhit
      have hlocalCompact := castaingLocalization_isCompact hcompact q r ω
      have hlocalNe := castaingLocalization_nonempty hne q r ω
      obtain ⟨y, hy, hymax⟩ := supportFunction_attains hlocalCompact hlocalNe u
      have hyS : y ∈ S ω :=
        castaingLocalization_subset (fun ω => (hcompact ω).isClosed) q r ω hy
      have hyclosure : y ∈ closure (S ω ∩ Metric.ball q r) := by
        simpa [castaingLocalization, hhit'] using hy
      have hyball : y ∈ Metric.closedBall q r :=
        closure_minimal (inter_subset_right.trans Metric.ball_subset_closedBall)
          Metric.isClosed_closedBall hyclosure
      refine ⟨y, ⟨hyS, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · calc
          ⟪u, y⟫_ℝ = supportFunction (castaingLocalization S q r ω) u := hymax.symm
          _ = supportFunction (S ω) u := by simpa [q, r] using heq
      · have hbasis' : Metric.closedBall q r ⊆ U := by
          simpa [q, r] using hbasis
        exact hbasis' hyball
  rw [hEq]
  exact MeasurableSet.iUnion fun n => MeasurableSet.iUnion fun m =>
    measurableSet_supportArgmaxBasisEvent hS hcompact hne u U n m

name: RandomSetTheory.measurable_supportMaximizingSelection
statement:
theorem measurable_supportMaximizingSelection
    {Ω H : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H] [Nonempty H]
    {S : Ω → Set H} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω)) (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    (u : H) : Measurable (supportMaximizingSelection hS hcompact hne u)
proof:
:=
  (kuratowski_ryll_nardzewski
    (effrosMeasurable_supportArgmax hS hcompact hne u)
    (fun ω => (supportArgmax_isCompact hcompact u ω).isClosed)
    (supportArgmax_nonempty hcompact hne u)).1

name: RandomSetTheory.supportMaximizingSelection_mem_and_inner_eq
statement:
theorem supportMaximizingSelection_mem_and_inner_eq
    {Ω H : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H] [Nonempty H]
    {S : Ω → Set H} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω)) (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    (u : H) (ω : Ω) :
    supportMaximizingSelection hS hcompact hne u ω ∈ S ω ∧
      ⟪u, supportMaximizingSelection hS hcompact hne u ω⟫_ℝ =
        supportFunction (S ω) u
proof:
:=
  (kuratowski_ryll_nardzewski
    (effrosMeasurable_supportArgmax hS hcompact hne u)
    (fun ω => (supportArgmax_isCompact hcompact u ω).isClosed)
    (supportArgmax_nonempty hcompact hne u)).2 ω

name: RandomSetTheory.hasIntegrableSupportSelection_of_effros_of_envelope
statement:
theorem hasIntegrableSupportSelection_of_effros_of_envelope
    {Ω H : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H] [Nonempty H]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S : Ω → Set H} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω)) (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    {g : Ω → ℝ} (hg : Integrable g μ)
    (hdom : ∀ ω, ∀ x ∈ S ω, ‖x‖ ≤ g ω) (u : H) :
    HasIntegrableSupportSelection μ S u
proof:
:= by
  let f := supportMaximizingSelection hS hcompact hne u
  have hfmeas : Measurable f :=
    measurable_supportMaximizingSelection hS hcompact hne u
  have hfprop : ∀ ω, f ω ∈ S ω ∧ ⟪u, f ω⟫_ℝ = supportFunction (S ω) u :=
    supportMaximizingSelection_mem_and_inner_eq hS hcompact hne u
  have hfint : Integrable f μ := by
    apply hg.mono' hfmeas.aestronglyMeasurable
    filter_upwards [] with ω
    exact hdom ω (f ω) (hfprop ω).1
  exact ⟨f, ⟨hfint, Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => (hfprop ω).1⟩,
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => (hfprop ω).2⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.supportFunction_aumannExpectation_of_effros_of_envelope
statement:
theorem supportFunction_aumannExpectation_of_effros_of_envelope
    {Ω H : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H] [Nonempty H]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S : Ω → Set H} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω)) (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    {g : Ω → ℝ} (hg : Integrable g μ)
    (hdom : ∀ ω, ∀ x ∈ S ω, ‖x‖ ≤ g ω)
    (hAcompact : IsCompact (aumannExpectation μ S)) (u : H) :
    supportFunction (aumannExpectation μ S) u =
      ∫ ω, supportFunction (S ω) u ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rcases hasIntegrableSupportSelection_of_effros_of_envelope
      hS hcompact hne hg hdom u with ⟨f, hf, hmax⟩
  exact supportFunction_aumannExpectation
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hcompact) hAcompact
    (aumannExpectation_nonempty_of_selection hf) u
    (integrable_supportFunction_of_envelope hS hcompact hne hg hdom u)
    ⟨f, hf, hmax⟩

name: ProbabilityTheory.bernsteinMixedThreshold_zero_confidence
statement:
@[simp] theorem bernsteinMixedThreshold_zero_confidence (v b : ℝ) :
    bernsteinMixedThreshold v b 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [bernsteinMixedThreshold]

name: ProbabilityTheory.bernsteinMixedThreshold_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  unfold bernsteinMixedThreshold
  positivity

name: ProbabilityTheory.bernsteinMixedThreshold_mono
statement:
theorem bernsteinMixedThreshold_mono {v v' b b' x : ℝ}
    (hv : v ≤ v') (hb : b ≤ b') (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    bernsteinMixedThreshold v b x ≤
      bernsteinMixedThreshold v' b' x
proof:
:= by
  unfold bernsteinMixedThreshold
  have hvar : 2 * v * x ≤ 2 * v' * x := by
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hv (by norm_num)) hx
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (2 * v * x) ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * v' * x) :=
    Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hvar
  have hscale : 2 * b * x ≤ 2 * b' * x := by
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb (by norm_num)) hx
  exact add_le_add hsqrt hscale

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasBernsteinMGF.measureReal_abs_gt_mixedThreshold_le
statement:
theorem HasBernsteinMGF.measureReal_abs_gt_mixedThreshold_le
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {X : Omega → ℝ} {v b : ℝ≥0}
    (hX : HasBernsteinMGF X v b mu)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hv : 0 < (v : ℝ)) :
    mu.real {omega |
        bernsteinMixedThreshold (v : ℝ) (b : ℝ) x < |X omega|} ≤
      2 * exp (-x)
proof:
:= by
  refine (measureReal_mono ?_).trans
    (hX.measure_abs_ge_sqrt_add_le hx hv)
  intro omega homega
  change bernsteinMixedThreshold (v : ℝ) (b : ℝ) x < |X omega| at homega
  change Real.sqrt (2 * (v : ℝ) * x) + 2 * (b : ℝ) * x ≤ |X omega|
  exact homega.le

name: ProbabilityTheory.pair_mem_finiteChainingParentEdges
statement:
theorem pair_mem_finiteChainingParentEdges
    (N : ℕ → Finset T) (parent : ℕ → T → T)
    {k : ℕ} {u : T} (hu : u ∈ N (k + 1)) :
    (u, parent k u) ∈ finiteChainingParentEdges N parent k

name: ProbabilityTheory.card_finiteChainingParentEdges_le
statement:

    (N : ℕ → Finset T) (parent : ℕ → T → T) (k : ℕ) :

name: ProbabilityTheory.finiteChainingParentEdges_contains_projection
statement:
theorem finiteChainingParentEdges_contains_projection
    (N : ℕ → Finset T) (parent proj : ℕ → T → T) (m : ℕ)
    (hfine : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ t, proj (k + 1) t ∈ N (k + 1))
    (hcoherent : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ t,
      parent k (proj (k + 1) t) = proj k t) :
    ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ t,
      (proj (k + 1) t, proj k t) ∈
        finiteChainingParentEdges N parent k
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk t
  rw [← hcoherent k hk t]
  exact pair_mem_finiteChainingParentEdges N parent (hfine k hk t)

name: ProbabilityTheory.finiteChaining_largeDeviation_subset_edges
statement:
theorem finiteChaining_largeDeviation_subset_edges
    (Z : Omega → T → ℝ) (N0 : Finset T)
    (edges : ℕ → Finset (T × T)) (proj : ℕ → T → T)
    (threshold : ℕ → ℝ) (baseThreshold remainder : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (hbase : ∀ t, proj 0 t ∈ N0)
    (hedge : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ t,
      (proj (k + 1) t, proj k t) ∈ edges k)
    (hrem : ∀ omega t,
      |Z omega t - Z omega (proj m t)| ≤ remainder) :
    {omega | ∃ t,
        baseThreshold + (∑ k ∈ Finset.range m, threshold k) + remainder <
          |Z omega t|} ⊆
      finiteChainingBaseEvent Z N0 baseThreshold ∪
        finiteChainingEdgeEvent Z edges threshold m
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro omega homega
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := homega
  by_cases hbaseBad : omega ∈ finiteChainingBaseEvent Z N0 baseThreshold
  · exact Or.inl hbaseBad
  right
  by_contra hedgeBad
  have hbase_le : |Z omega (proj 0 t)| ≤ baseThreshold := by
    by_contra hbad
    apply hbaseBad
    refine Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨proj 0 t, Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨hbase t, ?_⟩⟩
    exact lt_of_not_ge hbad
  have hedge_le : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m,
      |Z omega (proj (k + 1) t) - Z omega (proj k t)| ≤ threshold k := by
    intro k hk
    by_contra hbad
    apply hedgeBad
    refine Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨k, Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨hk,
      Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨(proj (k + 1) t, proj k t),
        Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨hedge k hk t, ?_⟩⟩⟩⟩
    exact lt_of_not_ge hbad
  have hchain := abs_process_le_finiteChainingSum Z proj m omega t
  have hsum :
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.range m,
        |Z omega (proj (k + 1) t) - Z omega (proj k t)|) ≤
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range m, threshold k :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum hedge_le
  have htotal : |Z omega t| ≤
      baseThreshold + (∑ k ∈ Finset.range m, threshold k) + remainder :=
    hchain.trans (add_le_add (add_le_add hbase_le hsum) (hrem omega t))
  exact (not_lt_of_ge htotal) ht

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_finiteChaining_edges_largeDeviation_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_finiteChaining_edges_largeDeviation_le
    [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    (Z : Omega → T → ℝ) (N0 : Finset T)
    (edges : ℕ → Finset (T × T)) (proj : ℕ → T → T)
    (threshold delta : ℕ → ℝ)
    (baseThreshold remainder delta0 : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (hbase : ∀ t, proj 0 t ∈ N0)
    (hedge : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ t,
      (proj (k + 1) t, proj k t) ∈ edges k)
    (hrem : ∀ omega t,
      |Z omega t - Z omega (proj m t)| ≤ remainder)
    (hbaseTail : ∀ u ∈ N0,
      mu.real {omega | baseThreshold < |Z omega u|} ≤ delta0)
    (hedgeTail : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ e ∈ edges k,
      mu.real {omega | threshold k < |Z omega e.1 - Z omega e.2|} ≤
        delta k) :
    mu.real {omega | ∃ t,
        baseThreshold + (∑ k ∈ Finset.range m, threshold k) + remainder <
          |Z omega t|} ≤
      N0.card * delta0 +
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range m, (edges k).card * delta k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Base : Set Omega := finiteChainingBaseEvent Z N0 baseThreshold
  let Incr : Set Omega := finiteChainingEdgeEvent Z edges threshold m
  have hsubset :
      {omega | ∃ t,
          baseThreshold + (∑ k ∈ Finset.range m, threshold k) + remainder <
            |Z omega t|} ⊆ Base ∪ Incr := by
    simpa only [Base, Incr] using
      finiteChaining_largeDeviation_subset_edges Z N0 edges proj threshold
        baseThreshold remainder m hbase hedge hrem
  have hBase : mu.real Base ≤ N0.card * delta0 := by
    calc
      mu.real Base ≤
          ∑ u ∈ N0, mu.real {omega | baseThreshold < |Z omega u|} := by
        simpa only [Base, finiteChainingBaseEvent] using
          (measureReal_biUnion_finset_le (μ := mu) N0
            (fun u ↦ {omega | baseThreshold < |Z omega u|}))
      _ ≤ ∑ _u ∈ N0, delta0 := Finset.sum_le_sum hbaseTail
      _ = N0.card * delta0 := by
        simp only [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
  have hLevel : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m,
      mu.real (⋃ e ∈ edges k,
          {omega | threshold k < |Z omega e.1 - Z omega e.2|}) ≤
        (edges k).card * delta k := by
    intro k hk
    calc
      mu.real (⋃ e ∈ edges k,
          {omega | threshold k < |Z omega e.1 - Z omega e.2|}) ≤
          ∑ e ∈ edges k,
            mu.real {omega | threshold k < |Z omega e.1 - Z omega e.2|} :=
        measureReal_biUnion_finset_le (edges k) _
      _ ≤ ∑ _e ∈ edges k, delta k :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun e he ↦ hedgeTail k hk e he
      _ = (edges k).card * delta k := by
        simp only [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
  have hIncr : mu.real Incr ≤
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range m, (edges k).card * delta k := by
    calc
      mu.real Incr ≤
          ∑ k ∈ Finset.range m,
            mu.real (⋃ e ∈ edges k,
              {omega | threshold k < |Z omega e.1 - Z omega e.2|}) := by
        simpa only [Incr, finiteChainingEdgeEvent] using
          (measureReal_biUnion_finset_le (μ := mu) (Finset.range m)
            (fun k ↦ ⋃ e ∈ edges k,
              {omega | threshold k < |Z omega e.1 - Z omega e.2|}))
      _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range m, (edges k).card * delta k :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum hLevel
  calc
    mu.real {omega | ∃ t,
        baseThreshold + (∑ k ∈ Finset.range m, threshold k) + remainder <
          |Z omega t|} ≤ mu.real (Base ∪ Incr) := measureReal_mono hsubset
    _ ≤ mu.real Base + mu.real Incr := measureReal_union_le Base Incr
    _ ≤ N0.card * delta0 +
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range m, (edges k).card * delta k :=
      add_le_add hBase hIncr

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_finiteChaining_largeDeviation_le_of_bernstein_pairwise
statement:
theorem measureReal_finiteChaining_largeDeviation_le_of_bernstein_pairwise
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (Z : Omega → T → ℝ) (N : ℕ → Finset T)
    (proj : ℕ → T → T) (edgeThreshold : ℕ → ℝ)
    (baseVariance baseScale : T → ℝ≥0)
    (edgeVariance edgeScale : ℕ → T → T → ℝ≥0)
    (x : ℕ → ℝ) (baseThreshold remainder x0 : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (hproj : ∀ k, k ≤ m → ∀ t, proj k t ∈ N k)
    (hrem : ∀ omega t,
      |Z omega t - Z omega (proj m t)| ≤ remainder)
    (hx0 : 0 ≤ x0) (hx : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, 0 ≤ x k)
    (hbaseVariance : ∀ u ∈ N 0, 0 < (baseVariance u : ℝ))
    (hedgeVariance : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ u ∈ N (k + 1),
      ∀ v ∈ N k, 0 < (edgeVariance k u v : ℝ))
    (hbaseThreshold : ∀ u ∈ N 0,
      bernsteinMixedThreshold (baseVariance u : ℝ)
          (baseScale u : ℝ) x0 ≤ baseThreshold)
    (hedgeThreshold : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ u ∈ N (k + 1),
      ∀ v ∈ N k,
        bernsteinMixedThreshold (edgeVariance k u v : ℝ)
            (edgeScale k u v : ℝ) (x k) ≤ edgeThreshold k)
    (hbaseBernstein : ∀ u ∈ N 0,
      HasBernsteinMGF (fun omega ↦ Z omega u)
        (baseVariance u) (baseScale u) mu)
    (hedgeBernstein : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ u ∈ N (k + 1),
      ∀ v ∈ N k,
        HasBernsteinMGF (fun omega ↦ Z omega u - Z omega v)
          (edgeVariance k u v) (edgeScale k u v) mu) :
    mu.real {omega | ∃ t,
        baseThreshold +
            (∑ k ∈ Finset.range m, edgeThreshold k) + remainder <
          |Z omega t|} ≤
      (N 0).card * (2 * exp (-x0)) +
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range m,
          ((N (k + 1)).card * (N k).card : ℕ) *
            (2 * exp (-x k))
proof:
:= by
  apply measureReal_finiteChaining_largeDeviation_le
    Z N proj edgeThreshold (fun k ↦ 2 * exp (-x k))
      baseThreshold remainder (2 * exp (-x0)) m hproj hrem
  · intro u hu
    have htail := (hbaseBernstein u hu).measureReal_abs_gt_mixedThreshold_le
      hx0 (hbaseVariance u hu)
    exact (measureReal_mono (by
      intro omega homega
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (hbaseThreshold u hu) homega)).trans htail
  · intro k hk u hu v hv
    have htail :=
      (hedgeBernstein k hk u hu v hv).measureReal_abs_gt_mixedThreshold_le
        (hx k hk) (hedgeVariance k hk u hu v hv)
    exact (measureReal_mono (by
      intro omega homega
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (hedgeThreshold k hk u hu v hv) homega)).trans htail

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_finiteChaining_largeDeviation_le_of_bernstein
statement:
theorem measureReal_finiteChaining_largeDeviation_le_of_bernstein
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (Z : Omega → T → ℝ) (N : ℕ → Finset T)
    (proj : ℕ → T → T)
    (baseVariance baseScale : T → ℝ≥0)
    (edgeVariance edgeScale : ℕ → T → T → ℝ≥0)
    (V B : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (V0 B0 : ℝ≥0)
    (x : ℕ → ℝ) (x0 remainder : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (hproj : ∀ k, k ≤ m → ∀ t, proj k t ∈ N k)
    (hrem : ∀ omega t,
      |Z omega t - Z omega (proj m t)| ≤ remainder)
    (hx0 : 0 ≤ x0) (hx : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, 0 ≤ x k)
    (hbaseVariance : ∀ u ∈ N 0, 0 < (baseVariance u : ℝ))
    (hedgeVariance : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ u ∈ N (k + 1),
      ∀ v ∈ N k, 0 < (edgeVariance k u v : ℝ))
    (hbaseVariance_le : ∀ u ∈ N 0, baseVariance u ≤ V0)
    (hbaseScale_le : ∀ u ∈ N 0, baseScale u ≤ B0)
    (hedgeVariance_le : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ u ∈ N (k + 1),
      ∀ v ∈ N k, edgeVariance k u v ≤ V k)
    (hedgeScale_le : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ u ∈ N (k + 1),
      ∀ v ∈ N k, edgeScale k u v ≤ B k)
    (hbaseBernstein : ∀ u ∈ N 0,
      HasBernsteinMGF (fun omega ↦ Z omega u)
        (baseVariance u) (baseScale u) mu)
    (hedgeBernstein : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ u ∈ N (k + 1),
      ∀ v ∈ N k,
        HasBernsteinMGF (fun omega ↦ Z omega u - Z omega v)
          (edgeVariance k u v) (edgeScale k u v) mu) :
    mu.real {omega | ∃ t,
        bernsteinMixedThreshold (V0 : ℝ) (B0 : ℝ) x0 +
            (∑ k ∈ Finset.range m,
              bernsteinMixedThreshold (V k : ℝ) (B k : ℝ) (x k)) +
            remainder < |Z omega t|} ≤
      (N 0).card * (2 * exp (-x0)) +
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range m,
          ((N (k + 1)).card * (N k).card : ℕ) *
            (2 * exp (-x k))
proof:
:= by
  apply measureReal_finiteChaining_largeDeviation_le_of_bernstein_pairwise
    Z N proj
      (fun k ↦ bernsteinMixedThreshold (V k : ℝ) (B k : ℝ) (x k))
      baseVariance baseScale edgeVariance edgeScale x
      (bernsteinMixedThreshold (V0 : ℝ) (B0 : ℝ) x0)
      remainder x0 m hproj hrem hx0 hx hbaseVariance hedgeVariance
  · intro u hu
    apply bernsteinMixedThreshold_mono
    · exact_mod_cast hbaseVariance_le u hu
    · exact_mod_cast hbaseScale_le u hu
    · exact hx0
  · intro k hk u hu v hv
    apply bernsteinMixedThreshold_mono
    · exact_mod_cast hedgeVariance_le k hk u hu v hv
    · exact_mod_cast hedgeScale_le k hk u hu v hv
    · exact hx k hk
  · exact hbaseBernstein
  · exact hedgeBernstein

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_finiteChaining_edges_largeDeviation_le_of_bernstein
statement:
theorem measureReal_finiteChaining_edges_largeDeviation_le_of_bernstein
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (Z : Omega → T → ℝ) (N0 : Finset T)
    (edges : ℕ → Finset (T × T)) (proj : ℕ → T → T)
    (baseVariance baseScale : T → ℝ≥0)
    (edgeVariance edgeScale : ℕ → T → T → ℝ≥0)
    (V B : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (V0 B0 : ℝ≥0)
    (x : ℕ → ℝ) (x0 remainder : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (hbase : ∀ t, proj 0 t ∈ N0)
    (hedge : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ t,
      (proj (k + 1) t, proj k t) ∈ edges k)
    (hrem : ∀ omega t,
      |Z omega t - Z omega (proj m t)| ≤ remainder)
    (hx0 : 0 ≤ x0) (hx : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, 0 ≤ x k)
    (hbaseVariance : ∀ u ∈ N0, 0 < (baseVariance u : ℝ))
    (hedgeVariance : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ e ∈ edges k,
      0 < (edgeVariance k e.1 e.2 : ℝ))
    (hbaseVariance_le : ∀ u ∈ N0, baseVariance u ≤ V0)
    (hbaseScale_le : ∀ u ∈ N0, baseScale u ≤ B0)
    (hedgeVariance_le : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ e ∈ edges k,
      edgeVariance k e.1 e.2 ≤ V k)
    (hedgeScale_le : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ e ∈ edges k,
      edgeScale k e.1 e.2 ≤ B k)
    (hbaseBernstein : ∀ u ∈ N0,
      HasBernsteinMGF (fun omega ↦ Z omega u)
        (baseVariance u) (baseScale u) mu)
    (hedgeBernstein : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ e ∈ edges k,
      HasBernsteinMGF (fun omega ↦ Z omega e.1 - Z omega e.2)
        (edgeVariance k e.1 e.2) (edgeScale k e.1 e.2) mu) :
    mu.real {omega | ∃ t,
        bernsteinMixedThreshold (V0 : ℝ) (B0 : ℝ) x0 +
            (∑ k ∈ Finset.range m,
              bernsteinMixedThreshold (V k : ℝ) (B k : ℝ) (x k)) +
            remainder < |Z omega t|} ≤
      N0.card * (2 * exp (-x0)) +
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range m, (edges k).card * (2 * exp (-x k))
proof:
:= by
  apply measureReal_finiteChaining_edges_largeDeviation_le
    Z N0 edges proj
      (fun k ↦ bernsteinMixedThreshold (V k : ℝ) (B k : ℝ) (x k))
      (fun k ↦ 2 * exp (-x k))
      (bernsteinMixedThreshold (V0 : ℝ) (B0 : ℝ) x0)
      remainder (2 * exp (-x0)) m hbase hedge hrem
  · intro u hu
    have hthreshold :
        bernsteinMixedThreshold (baseVariance u : ℝ)
            (baseScale u : ℝ) x0 ≤
          bernsteinMixedThreshold (V0 : ℝ) (B0 : ℝ) x0 := by
      exact bernsteinMixedThreshold_mono
        (by exact_mod_cast hbaseVariance_le u hu)
        (by exact_mod_cast hbaseScale_le u hu) hx0
    have htail :=
      (hbaseBernstein u hu).measureReal_abs_gt_mixedThreshold_le
        hx0 (hbaseVariance u hu)
    exact (measureReal_mono (by
      intro omega homega
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt hthreshold homega)).trans htail
  · intro k hk e he
    have hthreshold :
        bernsteinMixedThreshold (edgeVariance k e.1 e.2 : ℝ)
            (edgeScale k e.1 e.2 : ℝ) (x k) ≤
          bernsteinMixedThreshold (V k : ℝ) (B k : ℝ) (x k) := by
      exact bernsteinMixedThreshold_mono
        (by exact_mod_cast hedgeVariance_le k hk e he)
        (by exact_mod_cast hedgeScale_le k hk e he) (hx k hk)
    have htail :=
      (hedgeBernstein k hk e he).measureReal_abs_gt_mixedThreshold_le
        (hx k hk) (hedgeVariance k hk e he)
    exact (measureReal_mono (by
      intro omega homega
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt hthreshold homega)).trans htail

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_finiteChaining_lipschitz_le_of_bernstein_twoMetrics
statement:
theorem measureReal_finiteChaining_lipschitz_le_of_bernstein_twoMetrics
    [PseudoMetricSpace T] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (Z : Omega → T → ℝ) (N : ℕ → Finset T)
    (proj : ℕ → T → T) (d2 d1 : T → T → ℝ≥0)
    (rho2 rho1 : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (x : ℕ → ℝ)
    (L eps : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (hproj : ∀ k, k ≤ m → ∀ t, proj k t ∈ N k)
    (hnear : ∀ t, dist t (proj m t) ≤ eps)
    (hlip : ∀ omega s t, |Z omega s - Z omega t| ≤ L * dist s t)
    (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hbaseZero : ∀ omega, ∀ u ∈ N 0, Z omega u = 0)
    (hx : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, 0 ≤ x k)
    (hd2pos : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ u ∈ N (k + 1),
      ∀ v ∈ N k, 0 < (d2 u v : ℝ))
    (hd2 : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ u ∈ N (k + 1),
      ∀ v ∈ N k, d2 u v ≤ rho2 k)
    (hd1 : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ u ∈ N (k + 1),
      ∀ v ∈ N k, d1 u v ≤ rho1 k)
    (hedgeBernstein : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ u ∈ N (k + 1),
      ∀ v ∈ N k,
        HasBernsteinMGF (fun omega ↦ Z omega u - Z omega v)
          ((d2 u v) ^ (2 : ℕ)) (d1 u v) mu) :
    mu.real {omega | ∃ t,
        (∑ k ∈ Finset.range m,
          bernsteinMixedThreshold ((rho2 k : ℝ) ^ 2)
            (rho1 k : ℝ) (x k)) + L * eps < |Z omega t|} ≤
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range m,
        ((N (k + 1)).card * (N k).card : ℕ) *
          (2 * exp (-x k))
proof:
:= by
  have hrem : ∀ omega t,
      |Z omega t - Z omega (proj m t)| ≤ L * eps := by
    intro omega t
    exact (hlip omega t (proj m t)).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hnear t) hL)
  have hbaseTail : ∀ u ∈ N 0,
      mu.real {omega | (0 : ℝ) < |Z omega u|} ≤ 0 := by
    intro u hu
    simp only [hbaseZero _ u hu, abs_zero, lt_self_iff_false,
      Set.setOf_false, measureReal_empty, le_refl]
  have hedgeTail : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ u ∈ N (k + 1),
      ∀ v ∈ N k,
        mu.real {omega |
          bernsteinMixedThreshold ((rho2 k : ℝ) ^ 2)
              (rho1 k : ℝ) (x k) < |Z omega u - Z omega v|} ≤
            2 * exp (-x k) := by
    intro k hk u hu v hv
    have hthreshold :
        bernsteinMixedThreshold (((d2 u v) ^ (2 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)
            (d1 u v : ℝ) (x k) ≤
          bernsteinMixedThreshold ((rho2 k : ℝ) ^ 2)
            (rho1 k : ℝ) (x k) := by
      apply bernsteinMixedThreshold_mono
      · norm_cast
        exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) (hd2 k hk u hu v hv) 2
      · exact_mod_cast hd1 k hk u hu v hv
      · exact hx k hk
    have htail :=
      (hedgeBernstein k hk u hu v hv).measureReal_abs_gt_mixedThreshold_le
        (hx k hk) (by
          exact_mod_cast sq_pos_of_pos (hd2pos k hk u hu v hv))
    exact (measureReal_mono (by
      intro omega homega
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt hthreshold homega)).trans htail
  have hbound := measureReal_finiteChaining_largeDeviation_le
    Z N proj
      (fun k ↦ bernsteinMixedThreshold ((rho2 k : ℝ) ^ 2)
        (rho1 k : ℝ) (x k))
      (fun k ↦ 2 * exp (-x k)) 0 (L * eps) 0 m hproj hrem
      hbaseTail hedgeTail
  simpa only [zero_add, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, mul_zero] using hbound

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_finiteChaining_edges_lipschitz_le_of_bernstein_twoMetrics
statement:
theorem measureReal_finiteChaining_edges_lipschitz_le_of_bernstein_twoMetrics
    [PseudoMetricSpace T] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (Z : Omega → T → ℝ) (N0 : Finset T)
    (edges : ℕ → Finset (T × T)) (proj : ℕ → T → T)
    (d2 d1 : T → T → ℝ≥0) (rho2 rho1 : ℕ → ℝ≥0)
    (x : ℕ → ℝ) (L eps : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (hbase : ∀ t, proj 0 t ∈ N0)
    (hedge : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ t,
      (proj (k + 1) t, proj k t) ∈ edges k)
    (hnear : ∀ t, dist t (proj m t) ≤ eps)
    (hlip : ∀ omega s t, |Z omega s - Z omega t| ≤ L * dist s t)
    (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hbaseZero : ∀ omega, ∀ u ∈ N0, Z omega u = 0)
    (hx : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, 0 ≤ x k)
    (hd2pos : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ e ∈ edges k,
      0 < (d2 e.1 e.2 : ℝ))
    (hd2 : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ e ∈ edges k,
      d2 e.1 e.2 ≤ rho2 k)
    (hd1 : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ e ∈ edges k,
      d1 e.1 e.2 ≤ rho1 k)
    (hedgeBernstein : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ e ∈ edges k,
      HasBernsteinMGF (fun omega ↦ Z omega e.1 - Z omega e.2)
        ((d2 e.1 e.2) ^ (2 : ℕ)) (d1 e.1 e.2) mu) :
    mu.real {omega | ∃ t,
        (∑ k ∈ Finset.range m,
          bernsteinMixedThreshold ((rho2 k : ℝ) ^ 2)
            (rho1 k : ℝ) (x k)) + L * eps < |Z omega t|} ≤
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range m, (edges k).card * (2 * exp (-x k))
proof:
:= by
  have hrem : ∀ omega t,
      |Z omega t - Z omega (proj m t)| ≤ L * eps := by
    intro omega t
    exact (hlip omega t (proj m t)).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hnear t) hL)
  have hbaseTail : ∀ u ∈ N0,
      mu.real {omega | (0 : ℝ) < |Z omega u|} ≤ 0 := by
    intro u hu
    simp only [hbaseZero _ u hu, abs_zero, lt_self_iff_false,
      Set.setOf_false, measureReal_empty, le_refl]
  have hedgeTail : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ e ∈ edges k,
      mu.real {omega |
        bernsteinMixedThreshold ((rho2 k : ℝ) ^ 2)
            (rho1 k : ℝ) (x k) < |Z omega e.1 - Z omega e.2|} ≤
          2 * exp (-x k) := by
    intro k hk e he
    have hthreshold :
        bernsteinMixedThreshold
            ((((d2 e.1 e.2) ^ (2 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0) : ℝ))
            (d1 e.1 e.2 : ℝ) (x k) ≤
          bernsteinMixedThreshold ((rho2 k : ℝ) ^ 2)
            (rho1 k : ℝ) (x k) := by
      apply bernsteinMixedThreshold_mono
      · norm_cast
        exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) (hd2 k hk e he) 2
      · exact_mod_cast hd1 k hk e he
      · exact hx k hk
    have htail :=
      (hedgeBernstein k hk e he).measureReal_abs_gt_mixedThreshold_le
        (hx k hk) (by
          exact_mod_cast sq_pos_of_pos (hd2pos k hk e he))
    exact (measureReal_mono (by
      intro omega homega
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt hthreshold homega)).trans htail
  have hbound := measureReal_finiteChaining_edges_largeDeviation_le
    Z N0 edges proj
      (fun k ↦ bernsteinMixedThreshold ((rho2 k : ℝ) ^ 2)
        (rho1 k : ℝ) (x k))
      (fun k ↦ 2 * exp (-x k)) 0 (L * eps) 0 m hbase hedge hrem
      hbaseTail hedgeTail
  simpa only [zero_add, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, mul_zero] using hbound

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_finiteChaining_parent_lipschitz_le_of_bernstein_twoMetrics
statement:
theorem measureReal_finiteChaining_parent_lipschitz_le_of_bernstein_twoMetrics
    [PseudoMetricSpace T] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (Z : Omega → T → ℝ) (N : ℕ → Finset T)
    (parent proj : ℕ → T → T)
    (d2 d1 : T → T → ℝ≥0) (rho2 rho1 : ℕ → ℝ≥0)
    (x : ℕ → ℝ) (L eps : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (hbase : ∀ t, proj 0 t ∈ N 0)
    (hfine : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ t,
      proj (k + 1) t ∈ N (k + 1))
    (hcoherent : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ t,
      parent k (proj (k + 1) t) = proj k t)
    (hnear : ∀ t, dist t (proj m t) ≤ eps)
    (hlip : ∀ omega s t, |Z omega s - Z omega t| ≤ L * dist s t)
    (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hbaseZero : ∀ omega, ∀ u ∈ N 0, Z omega u = 0)
    (hx : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, 0 ≤ x k)
    (hd2pos : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ u ∈ N (k + 1),
      0 < (d2 u (parent k u) : ℝ))
    (hd2 : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ u ∈ N (k + 1),
      d2 u (parent k u) ≤ rho2 k)
    (hd1 : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ u ∈ N (k + 1),
      d1 u (parent k u) ≤ rho1 k)
    (hedgeBernstein : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ u ∈ N (k + 1),
      HasBernsteinMGF
        (fun omega ↦ Z omega u - Z omega (parent k u))
        ((d2 u (parent k u)) ^ (2 : ℕ)) (d1 u (parent k u)) mu) :
    mu.real {omega | ∃ t,
        (∑ k ∈ Finset.range m,
          bernsteinMixedThreshold ((rho2 k : ℝ) ^ 2)
            (rho1 k : ℝ) (x k)) + L * eps < |Z omega t|} ≤
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range m, (N (k + 1)).card * (2 * exp (-x k))
proof:
:= by
  let edges : ℕ → Finset (T × T) := finiteChainingParentEdges N parent
  have hedge : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ t,
      (proj (k + 1) t, proj k t) ∈ edges k := by
    exact finiteChainingParentEdges_contains_projection
      N parent proj m hfine hcoherent
  have hd2pos_edges : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ e ∈ edges k,
      0 < (d2 e.1 e.2 : ℝ) := by
    intro k hk e he
    change e ∈ finiteChainingParentEdges N parent k at he
    classical
    obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 he
    exact hd2pos k hk u hu
  have hd2_edges : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ e ∈ edges k,
      d2 e.1 e.2 ≤ rho2 k := by
    intro k hk e he
    change e ∈ finiteChainingParentEdges N parent k at he
    classical
    obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 he
    exact hd2 k hk u hu
  have hd1_edges : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ e ∈ edges k,
      d1 e.1 e.2 ≤ rho1 k := by
    intro k hk e he
    change e ∈ finiteChainingParentEdges N parent k at he
    classical
    obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 he
    exact hd1 k hk u hu
  have hBernstein_edges : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∀ e ∈ edges k,
      HasBernsteinMGF (fun omega ↦ Z omega e.1 - Z omega e.2)
        ((d2 e.1 e.2) ^ (2 : ℕ)) (d1 e.1 e.2) mu := by
    intro k hk e he
    change e ∈ finiteChainingParentEdges N parent k at he
    classical
    obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 he
    exact hedgeBernstein k hk u hu
  have hbound :=
    measureReal_finiteChaining_edges_lipschitz_le_of_bernstein_twoMetrics
      Z (N 0) edges proj d2 d1 rho2 rho1 x L eps m hbase hedge
      hnear hlip hL hbaseZero hx hd2pos_edges hd2_edges hd1_edges
      hBernstein_edges
  refine hbound.trans ?_
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun k hk ↦
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (by
        exact_mod_cast card_finiteChainingParentEdges_le N parent k)
      (by positivity)

name: ProbabilityTheory.measurable_centeredAnchoredEmpiricalProcess
statement:
theorem measurable_centeredAnchoredEmpiricalProcess
    (H : Z → T → ℝ) (c : ℝ)
    (X : iota → Omega → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hH : ∀ t, Measurable (fun z ↦ H z t))
    (I : Finset iota) (o t : T) :
    Measurable
      (fun omega ↦ centeredAnchoredEmpiricalProcess
        (mu := mu) H c X I o omega t)
proof:
:= by
  unfold centeredAnchoredEmpiricalProcess
  apply measurable_const.mul
  exact Finset.measurable_fun_sum I fun i _hi ↦
    (measurable_lipschitzIncrement H X hX hH i t o).sub measurable_const

name: ProbabilityTheory.measurable_centeredAnchoredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess
statement:
theorem measurable_centeredAnchoredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess
    (H : Z → T → ℝ) (R : Z → ℝ) (M c : ℝ)
    (X : iota → Omega → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hH : ∀ t, Measurable (fun z ↦ H z t)) (hR : Measurable R)
    (I : Finset iota) (o t : T) :
    Measurable
      (fun omega ↦ centeredAnchoredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess
        (mu := mu) H R M c X I o omega t)
proof:
:= by
  unfold centeredAnchoredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess
  apply measurable_const.mul
  exact Finset.measurable_fun_sum I fun i _hi ↦
    (measurable_truncatedLipschitzIncrement
      H R M X hX hH hR i t o).sub measurable_const

name: ProbabilityTheory.measurable_centeredAnchoredEmpiricalContinuousMap
statement:
theorem measurable_centeredAnchoredEmpiricalContinuousMap
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    [MeasurableSpace C(EuclideanUnitBall E, ℝ)]
    [BorelSpace C(EuclideanUnitBall E, ℝ)]
    (H : Z → E → ℝ) (R : Z → ℝ)
    (X : ℕ → Omega → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hHmeas : ∀ t, Measurable (fun z ↦ H z t))
    (hHcont : ∀ z, Continuous (H z))
    (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (hLip : ∀ z s t, |H z s - H z t| ≤ R z * dist s t)
    (hRL2 : ∀ i, MemLp (fun omega ↦ R (X i omega)) 2 mu)
    (n : ℕ) :
    Measurable
      (centeredAnchoredEmpiricalContinuousMap (mu := mu)
        H R X hX hHmeas hHcont hR hLip hRL2 n)
proof:
:= by
  letI : CompactSpace (EuclideanUnitBall E) :=
    isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp (by
      apply Metric.isCompact_of_isClosed_isBounded
      · exact isClosed_le continuous_norm continuous_const
      · exact (isBounded_iff_forall_norm_le.mpr
          ⟨1, fun _v hv ↦ hv⟩))
  apply measurable_continuousMap_of_apply
  intro t
  simpa only [centeredAnchoredEmpiricalContinuousMap_apply] using
    (measurable_centeredAnchoredEmpiricalProcess
      (mu := mu) H (Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ X hX hHmeas
        (Finset.range (n + 1)) 0 (t : E))

name: ProbabilityTheory.measurable_centeredTruncatedEmpiricalContinuousMap
statement:
theorem measurable_centeredTruncatedEmpiricalContinuousMap
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    [MeasurableSpace C(EuclideanUnitBall E, ℝ)]
    [BorelSpace C(EuclideanUnitBall E, ℝ)]
    (H : Z → E → ℝ) (R : Z → ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (X : ℕ → Omega → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hHmeas : ∀ t, Measurable (fun z ↦ H z t))
    (hHcont : ∀ z, Continuous (H z)) (hRmeas : Measurable R)
    (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (hLip : ∀ z s t, |H z s - H z t| ≤ R z * dist s t)
    (n : ℕ) :
    Measurable
      (centeredTruncatedEmpiricalContinuousMap (mu := mu)
        H R ha X hX hHmeas hHcont hRmeas hR hLip n)
proof:
:= by
  letI : CompactSpace (EuclideanUnitBall E) :=
    isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp (by
      apply Metric.isCompact_of_isClosed_isBounded
      · exact isClosed_le continuous_norm continuous_const
      · exact (isBounded_iff_forall_norm_le.mpr
          ⟨1, fun _v hv ↦ hv⟩))
  apply measurable_continuousMap_of_apply
  intro t
  simpa only [centeredTruncatedEmpiricalContinuousMap_apply] using
    (measurable_centeredAnchoredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess
      (mu := mu) H R (a * Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ))
        (Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ X hX hHmeas hRmeas
        (Finset.range (n + 1)) 0 (t : E))

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasBernsteinMGF.of_hasSubgaussianMGF
statement:
theorem of_hasSubgaussianMGF [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {X : Ω → ℝ} {v : ℝ≥0}
    (hX : HasSubgaussianMGF X v μ) :
    HasBernsteinMGF X v 0 μ where
  aemeasurable
proof:
:= hX.aemeasurable
  integrable_exp_mul t _ := hX.integrable_exp_mul t
  mgf_le t _ := by
    simpa using hX.mgf_le t

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasBernsteinMGF.zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem zero [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (b : ℝ≥0) :
    HasBernsteinMGF (fun _ : Ω => 0) 0 b μ where
  aemeasurable
proof:
:= aemeasurable_const
  integrable_exp_mul t _ := by simp
  mgf_le t _ := by simp

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasBernsteinMGF.neg
statement:
theorem neg {X : Ω → ℝ} {v b : ℝ≥0}
    (hX : HasBernsteinMGF X v b μ) :
    HasBernsteinMGF (fun ω => -X ω) v b μ where
  aemeasurable
proof:
:= hX.aemeasurable.neg
  integrable_exp_mul t ht := by
    have ht' : (b : ℝ) * |-t| < 1 := by simpa using ht
    simpa [mul_neg] using hX.integrable_exp_mul (-t) ht'
  mgf_le t ht := by
    have ht' : (b : ℝ) * |-t| < 1 := by simpa using ht
    rw [show (fun ω => -X ω) = -X from rfl, mgf_neg]
    simpa using hX.mgf_le (-t) ht'

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasBernsteinMGF.congr
statement:
theorem congr {X Y : Ω → ℝ} {v b : ℝ≥0}
    (hX : HasBernsteinMGF X v b μ) (hXY : X =ᵐ[μ] Y) :
    HasBernsteinMGF Y v b μ where
  aemeasurable
proof:
:= hX.aemeasurable.congr hXY
  integrable_exp_mul t ht :=
    (hX.integrable_exp_mul t ht).congr
      (hXY.fun_comp fun x => exp (t * x))
  mgf_le t ht := by
    rw [← mgf_congr hXY]
    exact hX.mgf_le t ht

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasBernsteinMGF.congr'
proof: := hX.congr hXY

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasBernsteinMGF.congr_identDistrib
statement:
theorem congr_identDistrib
    {Ω' : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω'] {μ' : Measure Ω'}
    {X : Ω → ℝ} {Y : Ω' → ℝ} {v b : ℝ≥0}
    (hX : HasBernsteinMGF X v b μ)
    (hXY : IdentDistrib X Y μ μ') :
    HasBernsteinMGF Y v b μ' where
  aemeasurable
proof:
:= hXY.aemeasurable_snd
  integrable_exp_mul t ht := by
    have hident : IdentDistrib
        (fun ω => exp (t * X ω)) (fun ω => exp (t * Y ω)) μ μ' :=
      hXY.comp (measurable_const_mul t).exp
    exact hident.integrable_iff.mp (hX.integrable_exp_mul t ht)
  mgf_le t ht := by
    rw [← mgf_congr_of_identDistrib X Y hXY t]
    exact hX.mgf_le t ht

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasBernsteinMGF.add_of_indepFun
statement:
theorem add_of_indepFun {X Y : Ω → ℝ} {vX vY b : ℝ≥0}
    (hX : HasBernsteinMGF X vX b μ)
    (hY : HasBernsteinMGF Y vY b μ)
    (hindep : IndepFun X Y μ) :
    HasBernsteinMGF (fun ω => X ω + Y ω) (vX + vY) b μ where
  aemeasurable
proof:
:= hX.aemeasurable.add hY.aemeasurable
  integrable_exp_mul t ht :=
    hindep.integrable_exp_mul_add
      (hX.integrable_exp_mul t ht) (hY.integrable_exp_mul t ht)
  mgf_le t ht := by
    have hXi := hX.integrable_exp_mul t ht
    have hYi := hY.integrable_exp_mul t ht
    calc
      mgf (fun ω => X ω + Y ω) μ t = mgf X μ t * mgf Y μ t :=
        hindep.mgf_add hXi.1 hYi.1
      _ ≤ exp ((vX : ℝ) * t ^ 2 / (2 * (1 - (b : ℝ) * |t|))) *
          exp ((vY : ℝ) * t ^ 2 / (2 * (1 - (b : ℝ) * |t|))) := by
        gcongr
        · exact mgf_nonneg
        · exact hX.mgf_le t ht
        · exact hY.mgf_le t ht
      _ = exp (((vX + vY : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) * t ^ 2 /
          (2 * (1 - (b : ℝ) * |t|))) := by
        rw [← exp_add]
        congr 1
        push_cast
        ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasBernsteinMGF.sum_of_iIndepFun_of_forall_aemeasurable
statement:
private theorem sum_of_iIndepFun_of_forall_aemeasurable
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {X : ι → Ω → ℝ} (h_indep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (h_meas : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) μ)
    {v : ι → ℝ≥0} (b : ℝ≥0) {s : Finset ι}
    (hB : ∀ i ∈ s, HasBernsteinMGF (X i) (v i) b μ) :
    HasBernsteinMGF (fun ω => ∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) (∑ i ∈ s, v i) b μ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert i s his ih =>
      have hindep' :=
        (h_indep.indepFun_finsetSum_of_notMem₀ h_meas his).symm
      have hi := hB i (Finset.mem_insert_self i s)
      have hs : ∀ j ∈ s, HasBernsteinMGF (X j) (v j) b μ :=
        fun j hj => hB j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj)
      have hsum := ih hs
      have hindep'' : IndepFun (X i) (fun ω => ∑ j ∈ s, X j ω) μ := by
        convert! hindep'
        rw [Finset.sum_apply]
      simpa [Finset.sum_insert his] using hi.add_of_indepFun hsum hindep''

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasBernsteinMGF.sum_of_iIndepFun
statement:
theorem sum_of_iIndepFun [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {X : ι → Ω → ℝ} (h_indep : iIndepFun X μ)
    {v : ι → ℝ≥0} (b : ℝ≥0) {s : Finset ι}
    (hB : ∀ i ∈ s, HasBernsteinMGF (X i) (v i) b μ) :
    HasBernsteinMGF (fun ω => ∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) (∑ i ∈ s, v i) b μ
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : HasBernsteinMGF
      (fun ω => ∑ i : s, X i ω) (∑ i : s, v i) b μ := by
    apply sum_of_iIndepFun_of_forall_aemeasurable
    · exact h_indep.precomp Subtype.val_injective
    · exact fun i => (hB i i.2).aemeasurable
    · exact fun i _ => hB i i.2
  rw [Finset.sum_coe_sort] at hsub
  exact hsub.congr' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω =>
    Finset.sum_attach s (fun i => X i ω))

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasBernsteinMGF.measure_ge_le
statement:
theorem measure_ge_le [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {X : Ω → ℝ} {v b : ℝ≥0}
    (hX : HasBernsteinMGF X v b μ)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hv : 0 < (v : ℝ)) :
    μ.real {ω | ε ≤ X ω} ≤
      exp (-ε ^ 2 / (2 * ((v : ℝ) + (b : ℝ) * ε)))
proof:
:= by
  let D : ℝ := (v : ℝ) + (b : ℝ) * ε
  let t : ℝ := ε / D
  have hD : 0 < D := by
    dsimp [D]
    positivity
  have ht : 0 ≤ t := div_nonneg hε hD.le
  have hbdomain : (b : ℝ) * |t| < 1 := by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg ht]
    dsimp [t]
    rw [← mul_div_assoc]
    exact (div_lt_one hD).2 (by
      dsimp [D]
      linarith [mul_nonneg (NNReal.coe_nonneg b) hε])
  have hremain : 1 - (b : ℝ) * |t| = (v : ℝ) / D := by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg ht]
    dsimp [t, D]
    field_simp [hD.ne']
    ring
  have hexponent :
      -t * ε + (v : ℝ) * t ^ 2 /
          (2 * (1 - (b : ℝ) * |t|)) =
        -ε ^ 2 / (2 * D) := by
    rw [hremain]
    dsimp [t]
    field_simp [hD.ne', hv.ne']
    ring
  calc
    μ.real {ω | ε ≤ X ω} ≤ exp (-t * ε) * mgf X μ t :=
      measure_ge_le_exp_mul_mgf ε ht (hX.integrable_exp_mul t hbdomain)
    _ ≤ exp (-t * ε) *
        exp ((v : ℝ) * t ^ 2 / (2 * (1 - (b : ℝ) * |t|))) := by
      gcongr
      exact hX.mgf_le t hbdomain
    _ = exp (-ε ^ 2 / (2 * D)) := by
      rw [← exp_add, hexponent]
    _ = exp (-ε ^ 2 / (2 * ((v : ℝ) + (b : ℝ) * ε))) := rfl

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasBernsteinMGF.measure_abs_ge_le
statement:
theorem measure_abs_ge_le [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {X : Ω → ℝ} {v b : ℝ≥0}
    (hX : HasBernsteinMGF X v b μ)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hv : 0 < (v : ℝ)) :
    μ.real {ω | ε ≤ |X ω|} ≤
      2 * exp (-ε ^ 2 / (2 * ((v : ℝ) + (b : ℝ) * ε)))
proof:
:= by
  let Xneg : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => -X ω
  have hpos := hX.measure_ge_le hε hv
  have hneg := hX.neg.measure_ge_le hε hv
  have hset : {ω | ε ≤ |X ω|} =
      {ω | ε ≤ X ω} ∪ {ω | ε ≤ Xneg ω} := by
    ext ω
    simp only [mem_setOf_eq, mem_union, Xneg]
    rw [le_abs]
  rw [hset]
  calc
    _ ≤ μ.real {ω | ε ≤ X ω} + μ.real {ω | ε ≤ Xneg ω} :=
      measureReal_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ exp (-ε ^ 2 / (2 * ((v : ℝ) + (b : ℝ) * ε))) +
        exp (-ε ^ 2 / (2 * ((v : ℝ) + (b : ℝ) * ε))) :=
      add_le_add hpos hneg
    _ = 2 * exp (-ε ^ 2 / (2 * ((v : ℝ) + (b : ℝ) * ε))) := by ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasBernsteinMGF.measure_abs_ge_sqrt_add_le
statement:
theorem measure_abs_ge_sqrt_add_le [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {X : Ω → ℝ} {v b : ℝ≥0}
    (hX : HasBernsteinMGF X v b μ)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hv : 0 < (v : ℝ)) :
    μ.real {ω |
        Real.sqrt (2 * (v : ℝ) * x) + 2 * (b : ℝ) * x ≤ |X ω|} ≤
      2 * exp (-x)
proof:
:= by
  let ε : ℝ := Real.sqrt (2 * (v : ℝ) * x) + 2 * (b : ℝ) * x
  have hε : 0 ≤ ε := by
    dsimp [ε]
    positivity
  have hsqrt_sq : (Real.sqrt (2 * (v : ℝ) * x)) ^ 2 =
      2 * (v : ℝ) * x := by
    rw [sq_sqrt]
    positivity
  have hquad :
      2 * x * ((v : ℝ) + (b : ℝ) * ε) ≤ ε ^ 2 := by
    apply sub_nonneg.mp
    have heq :
        ε ^ 2 - 2 * x * ((v : ℝ) + (b : ℝ) * ε) =
          2 * (b : ℝ) * x * Real.sqrt (2 * (v : ℝ) * x) := by
      calc
        ε ^ 2 - 2 * x * ((v : ℝ) + (b : ℝ) * ε) =
            Real.sqrt (2 * (v : ℝ) * x) ^ 2 - 2 * (v : ℝ) * x +
              2 * (b : ℝ) * x * Real.sqrt (2 * (v : ℝ) * x) := by
                dsimp [ε]
                ring
        _ = 2 * (b : ℝ) * x * Real.sqrt (2 * (v : ℝ) * x) := by
          rw [hsqrt_sq]
          ring
    rw [heq]
    positivity
  have hden : 0 < 2 * ((v : ℝ) + (b : ℝ) * ε) := by
    positivity
  have hratio :
      x ≤ ε ^ 2 / (2 * ((v : ℝ) + (b : ℝ) * ε)) := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hden]
    simpa [mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using hquad
  have htail := hX.measure_abs_ge_le hε hv
  change μ.real {ω | ε ≤ |X ω|} ≤ 2 * exp (-x)
  exact htail.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by simpa [neg_div] using neg_le_neg hratio))
    (by positivity))

name: ProbabilityTheory.bernstein_finset_sum_abs_real
statement:
theorem bernstein_finset_sum_abs_real [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (v : ι → ℝ≥0) (b : ℝ≥0)
    (h_indep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (s : Finset ι)
    (hB : ∀ i ∈ s, HasBernsteinMGF (X i) (v i) b μ)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hV : 0 < ((∑ i ∈ s, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) :
    μ.real {ω | ε ≤ |∑ i ∈ s, X i ω|} ≤
      2 * exp (-ε ^ 2 /
        (2 * (((∑ i ∈ s, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) + (b : ℝ) * ε)))
proof:
:= by
  exact (HasBernsteinMGF.sum_of_iIndepFun h_indep b hB).measure_abs_ge_le hε hV

name: ProbabilityTheory.bernstein_finset_average_abs_real
statement:
theorem bernstein_finset_average_abs_real [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (v : ι → ℝ≥0) (b : ℝ≥0)
    (h_indep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (hB : ∀ i ∈ s, HasBernsteinMGF (X i) (v i) b μ)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (hV : 0 < ((∑ i ∈ s, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ |(∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) / (s.card : ℝ)|} ≤
      2 * exp (-((s.card : ℝ) * t) ^ 2 /
        (2 * (((∑ i ∈ s, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) +
          (b : ℝ) * ((s.card : ℝ) * t))))
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : 0 < (s.card : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (Finset.card_pos.mpr hs)
  have htail := bernstein_finset_sum_abs_real X v b h_indep s hB
    (mul_nonneg hcard.le ht) hV
  have hset : {ω | t ≤ |(∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) / (s.card : ℝ)|} =
      {ω | (s.card : ℝ) * t ≤ |∑ i ∈ s, X i ω|} := by
    ext ω
    simp only [mem_setOf_eq, abs_div, abs_of_pos hcard]
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hcard]
    ring_nf
  rw [hset]
  exact htail

name: ProbabilityTheory.bernstein_finset_average_abs_sqrt_add_real
statement:
theorem bernstein_finset_average_abs_sqrt_add_real [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (v : ι → ℝ≥0) (b : ℝ≥0)
    (h_indep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (hB : ∀ i ∈ s, HasBernsteinMGF (X i) (v i) b μ)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x)
    (hV : 0 < ((∑ i ∈ s, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) :
    μ.real {ω |
        (Real.sqrt (2 * ((∑ i ∈ s, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) * x) +
            2 * (b : ℝ) * x) / (s.card : ℝ) ≤
          |(∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) / (s.card : ℝ)|} ≤
      2 * exp (-x)
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : 0 < (s.card : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (Finset.card_pos.mpr hs)
  have hsum : HasBernsteinMGF
      (fun ω => ∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) (∑ i ∈ s, v i) b μ :=
    HasBernsteinMGF.sum_of_iIndepFun h_indep b hB
  have htail := hsum.measure_abs_ge_sqrt_add_le hx hV
  have hset :
      {ω |
        (Real.sqrt (2 * ((∑ i ∈ s, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) * x) +
            2 * (b : ℝ) * x) / (s.card : ℝ) ≤
          |(∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) / (s.card : ℝ)|} =
      {ω | Real.sqrt (2 * ((∑ i ∈ s, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) * x) +
          2 * (b : ℝ) * x ≤ |∑ i ∈ s, X i ω|} := by
    ext ω
    simp only [mem_setOf_eq, abs_div, abs_of_pos hcard]
    exact div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hcard
  rw [hset]
  exact htail

name: RandomSetTheory.minkowskiAverage_support_bernstein
statement:
theorem minkowskiAverage_support_bernstein
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (S : ι → Ω → Set E) (L : Set E) (u : E)
    (v : ι → ℝ≥0) (b : ℝ≥0)
    (h_indep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun
      (directionalSupportDeviation S L u) μ)
    (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (hB : ∀ i ∈ s, ProbabilityTheory.HasBernsteinMGF
      (directionalSupportDeviation S L u i) (v i) b μ)
    (hV : 0 < ((∑ i ∈ s, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ))
    (hScompact : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ ω, IsCompact (S i ω))
    (hSne : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ |supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) u -
        supportFunction L u|} ≤
      2 * exp (-((s.card : ℝ) * t) ^ 2 /
        (2 * (((∑ i ∈ s, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) +
          (b : ℝ) * ((s.card : ℝ) * t))))
proof:
:= by
  have htail := ProbabilityTheory.bernstein_finset_average_abs_real
    (directionalSupportDeviation S L u) v b h_indep s hs hB ht hV
  have hset :
      {ω | t ≤ |supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) u -
        supportFunction L u|} =
      {ω | t ≤ |(∑ i ∈ s, directionalSupportDeviation S L u i ω) /
        (s.card : ℝ)|} := by
    ext ω
    simp only [mem_setOf_eq]
    rw [supportFunction_minkowskiAverage_sub_eq_average_deviation
      S L s hs hScompact hSne]
  rw [hset]
  exact htail

name: RandomSetTheory.minkowskiAverage_support_bernstein_sqrt_add
statement:
theorem minkowskiAverage_support_bernstein_sqrt_add
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (S : ι → Ω → Set E) (L : Set E) (u : E)
    (v : ι → ℝ≥0) (b : ℝ≥0)
    (h_indep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun
      (directionalSupportDeviation S L u) μ)
    (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (hB : ∀ i ∈ s, ProbabilityTheory.HasBernsteinMGF
      (directionalSupportDeviation S L u i) (v i) b μ)
    (hV : 0 < ((∑ i ∈ s, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ))
    (hScompact : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ ω, IsCompact (S i ω))
    (hSne : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    μ.real {ω |
        (Real.sqrt (2 * ((∑ i ∈ s, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) * x) +
            2 * (b : ℝ) * x) / (s.card : ℝ) ≤
          |supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) u -
            supportFunction L u|} ≤
      2 * exp (-x)
proof:
:= by
  have htail := ProbabilityTheory.bernstein_finset_average_abs_sqrt_add_real
    (directionalSupportDeviation S L u) v b h_indep s hs hB hx hV
  have hset :
      {ω |
        (Real.sqrt (2 * ((∑ i ∈ s, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) * x) +
            2 * (b : ℝ) * x) / (s.card : ℝ) ≤
          |supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) u -
            supportFunction L u|} =
      {ω |
        (Real.sqrt (2 * ((∑ i ∈ s, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) * x) +
            2 * (b : ℝ) * x) / (s.card : ℝ) ≤
          |(∑ i ∈ s, directionalSupportDeviation S L u i ω) /
            (s.card : ℝ)|} := by
    ext ω

      S L s hs hScompact hSne]

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_risk_bound_of_bernstein
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_risk_bound_of_bernstein
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (S : ι → Ω → Set E) (L : Set E)
    (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (v : ι → ℝ≥0) (b : ℝ≥0)
    {RS RL eps t : ℝ}
    (hScompact : ∀ i ω, IsCompact (S i ω))
    (hSne : ∀ i ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    (hSconv : ∀ i ω, Convex ℝ (S i ω))
    (hLcompact : IsCompact L) (hLne : L.Nonempty) (hLconv : Convex ℝ L)
    (hRS : ∀ i ω, ∀ x ∈ S i ω, ‖x‖ ≤ RS)
    (hRL : ∀ x ∈ L, ‖x‖ ≤ RL)
    (heps : 0 ≤ eps) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (N : Finset E)
    (hnet : ∀ u : E, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 → ∃ w ∈ N, dist u w ≤ eps)
    (h_indep : ∀ w ∈ N, ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun
      (directionalSupportDeviation S L w) μ)
    (hB : ∀ w ∈ N, ∀ i ∈ s, ProbabilityTheory.HasBernsteinMGF
      (directionalSupportDeviation S L w i) (v i) b μ)
    (hV : 0 < ((∑ i ∈ s, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) :
    μ.real {ω | t + (RS + RL) * eps <
        hausdorffDist (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) L} ≤
      N.card * (2 * exp (-((s.card : ℝ) * t) ^ 2 /
        (2 * (((∑ i ∈ s, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) +
          (b : ℝ) * ((s.card : ℝ) * t)))))
proof:
:= by
  apply measureReal_hausdorffDist_gt_le_finset_support
    (μ := μ) (fun ω => minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) (fun _ => L)
    (fun ω => isCompact_minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)
      (fun i hi => hScompact i ω))
    (fun _ => hLcompact)
    (fun ω => nonempty_minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)
      (fun i hi => hSne i ω))
    (fun _ => hLne)
    (fun ω => convex_minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)
      (fun i hi => hSconv i ω))
    (fun _ => hLconv)
    (fun ω x hx => norm_le_radius_of_mem_nonempty_minkowskiAverage s hs
      (fun i => S i ω) (fun i hi => hRS i ω) hx)
    (fun _ => hRL) heps ht
    (by positivity)
    N hnet
  intro w hw
  calc
    μ.real {ω | t < |supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) w -
        supportFunction L w|} ≤
        μ.real {ω | t ≤ |supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) w -
          supportFunction L w|} := by
      apply measureReal_mono
      · intro ω hω
        change t < |supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) w -
          supportFunction L w| at hω
        change t ≤ |supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) w -
          supportFunction L w|
        exact hω.le
      · finiteness
    _ ≤ 2 * exp (-((s.card : ℝ) * t) ^ 2 /
        (2 * (((∑ i ∈ s, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) +
          (b : ℝ) * ((s.card : ℝ) * t)))) :=
      minkowskiAverage_support_bernstein S L w v b
        (h_indep w hw) s hs (hB w hw) hV
        (fun i _hi ω => hScompact i ω)
        (fun i _hi ω => hSne i ω) ht

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_risk_bound_bernstein_sqrt_add
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_risk_bound_bernstein_sqrt_add
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (S : ι → Ω → Set E) (L : Set E)
    (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (v : ι → ℝ≥0) (b : ℝ≥0)
    {RS RL eps x : ℝ}
    (hScompact : ∀ i ω, IsCompact (S i ω))
    (hSne : ∀ i ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    (hSconv : ∀ i ω, Convex ℝ (S i ω))
    (hLcompact : IsCompact L) (hLne : L.Nonempty) (hLconv : Convex ℝ L)
    (hRS : ∀ i ω, ∀ y ∈ S i ω, ‖y‖ ≤ RS)
    (hRL : ∀ y ∈ L, ‖y‖ ≤ RL)
    (heps : 0 ≤ eps) (hx : 0 ≤ x)
    (N : Finset E)
    (hnet : ∀ u : E, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 → ∃ w ∈ N, dist u w ≤ eps)
    (h_indep : ∀ w ∈ N, ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun
      (directionalSupportDeviation S L w) μ)
    (hB : ∀ w ∈ N, ∀ i ∈ s, ProbabilityTheory.HasBernsteinMGF
      (directionalSupportDeviation S L w i) (v i) b μ)
    (hV : 0 < ((∑ i ∈ s, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) :
    μ.real {ω |
        (Real.sqrt (2 * ((∑ i ∈ s, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) * x) +
            2 * (b : ℝ) * x) / (s.card : ℝ) + (RS + RL) * eps <
          hausdorffDist (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) L} ≤
      N.card * (2 * exp (-x))
proof:
:= by
  let t : ℝ :=
    (Real.sqrt (2 * ((∑ i ∈ s, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) * x) +
      2 * (b : ℝ) * x) / (s.card : ℝ)
  have hcard : 0 < (s.card : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (Finset.card_pos.mpr hs)
  have ht : 0 ≤ t := by
    dsimp [t]
    positivity
  apply measureReal_hausdorffDist_gt_le_finset_support
    (μ := μ) (fun ω => minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) (fun _ => L)
    (fun ω => isCompact_minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)
      (fun i hi => hScompact i ω))
    (fun _ => hLcompact)
    (fun ω => nonempty_minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)
      (fun i hi => hSne i ω))
    (fun _ => hLne)
    (fun ω => convex_minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)
      (fun i hi => hSconv i ω))
    (fun _ => hLconv)
    (fun ω y hy => norm_le_radius_of_mem_nonempty_minkowskiAverage s hs
      (fun i => S i ω) (fun i hi => hRS i ω) hy)
    (fun _ => hRL) heps ht
    (by positivity)
    N hnet
  intro w hw
  calc
    μ.real {ω | t < |supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) w -
        supportFunction L w|} ≤
        μ.real {ω | t ≤ |supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) w -
          supportFunction L w|} := by
      apply measureReal_mono
      · intro ω hω
        change t < |supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) w -
          supportFunction L w| at hω
        change t ≤ |supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) w -
          supportFunction L w|
        exact hω.le
      · finiteness
    _ ≤ 2 * exp (-x) := by
      dsimp [t]
      exact minkowskiAverage_support_bernstein_sqrt_add
        S L w v b (h_indep w hw) s hs (hB w hw) hV
        (fun i _hi ω => hScompact i ω)
        (fun i _hi ω => hSne i ω) hx

name: RandomSetTheory.mem_bergeArgmax
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_bergeArgmax
    {Ω X : Type*} {S : Ω → Set X} {f : Ω × X → ℝ} {ω : Ω} {x : X} :
    x ∈ bergeArgmax S f ω ↔
      x ∈ S ω ∧ f (ω, x) = bergeMaxValue S f ω

    {Ω X : Type*} (S : Ω → Set X) (f : Ω × X → ℝ) (ω : Ω) :

  inter_subset_left

name: RandomSetTheory.bergeArgmax_nonempty
statement:
theorem bergeArgmax_nonempty
    {Ω X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
    {S : Ω → Set X} (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty) {f : Ω × X → ℝ}
    (hfcont : ∀ ω, Continuous fun x => f (ω, x)) (ω : Ω) :
    (bergeArgmax S f ω).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hxS, hmax, _⟩ :=
    (hcompact ω).exists_sSup_image_eq_and_ge (hne ω)
      (hfcont ω).continuousOn
  exact ⟨x, hxS, hmax.symm⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.bergeArgmax_isCompact
statement:
theorem bergeArgmax_isCompact
    {Ω X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
    {S : Ω → Set X} (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    {f : Ω × X → ℝ} (hfcont : ∀ ω, Continuous fun x => f (ω, x))
    (ω : Ω) : IsCompact (bergeArgmax S f ω)
proof:
:= by
  exact (hcompact ω).inter_right

    Measurable (bergeMaxValue S f)

:= by
  let T : Ω → Set ℝ := fun ω => (fun x => f (ω, x)) '' S ω
  have hT : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable T :=
    effrosMeasurable_caratheodoryImage hS
      (fun ω => (hcompact ω).isClosed) hne hfmeas hfcont
  have hTcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (T ω) :=
    fun ω => (hcompact ω).image (hfcont ω)
  have hTne : ∀ ω, (T ω).Nonempty :=

  have hsupport : Measurable (fun ω => supportFunction (T ω) (1 : ℝ)) :=

  have heq : bergeMaxValue S f =
      fun ω => supportFunction (T ω) (1 : ℝ) := by
