name: RandomSetTheory.jointLawAttainableMoments_eq_kernelAttainableMoments
statement:
theorem jointLawAttainableMoments_eq_kernelAttainableMoments
    [StandardBorelSpace X] [Nonempty X]
    {mu : Measure O} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {S : O → Set X}
    (hgraph : MeasurableSet {p : O × X | p.2 ∈ S p.1})
    (hSmeas : ∀ o, MeasurableSet (S o))
    {phi : O × X → E} :
    jointLawAttainableMoments mu S phi =
      kernelAttainableMoments mu S phi
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · rintro y ⟨rho, hrho, hfst, hrhoSupp, hphiInt, rfl⟩
    letI : IsProbabilityMeasure rho := hrho
    let kappa : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel O X := rho.condKernel
    letI : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel kappa := by
      dsimp only [kappa]
      infer_instance
    have hkappaSuppFst : KernelSupportedOn rho.fst S kappa :=
      condKernel_supportedOn_of_jointLaw hgraph hSmeas hrhoSupp
    have hkappaSupp : KernelSupportedOn mu S kappa := by
      simpa only [hfst] using hkappaSuppFst
    have hdis : (rho.fst ⊗ₘ kappa) = rho :=
      Measure.disintegrate rho kappa
    have hprod : (mu ⊗ₘ kappa) = rho := by
      rw [← hfst]
      exact hdis
    refine ⟨kappa, inferInstance, hkappaSupp, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rwa [hprod]
    · rw [hprod]
  · rintro y ⟨kappa, hkappa, hkappaSupp, hphiInt, rfl⟩
    letI : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel kappa := hkappa
    let rho : Measure (O × X) := mu ⊗ₘ kappa
    letI : IsProbabilityMeasure rho := by
      dsimp only [rho]
      infer_instance
    have hfst : rho.fst = mu := by
      dsimp only [rho]
      exact Measure.fst_compProd mu kappa
    have hfiber : ∀ᵐ o ∂mu, ∀ᵐ x ∂(kappa o), x ∈ S o := by
      filter_upwards [hkappaSupp] with o ho
      exact (mem_ae_iff_prob_eq_one (hSmeas o)).2 ho
    have hjoint : ∀ᵐ p ∂rho, p.2 ∈ S p.1 := by
      dsimp only [rho]
      exact Measure.ae_compProd_of_ae_ae hgraph hfiber
    have hrhoSupp : rho {p | p.2 ∈ S p.1} = 1 :=
      (mem_ae_iff_prob_eq_one hgraph).1 hjoint
    refine ⟨rho, inferInstance, hfst, hrhoSupp, ?_, rfl⟩
    simpa only [rho] using hphiInt

name: RandomSetTheory.jointLawAttainableMoments_eq_aumannExpectation_of_atomless
statement:
theorem jointLawAttainableMoments_eq_aumannExpectation_of_atomless
    {H : Type*}
    [MetricSpace X] [CompleteSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    [SecondCountableTopology X] [Nonempty X]
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ H]
    {mu : Measure O} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu : IsAtomlessMeasure mu)
    {S : O → Set X} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hgraph : MeasurableSet {p : O × X | p.2 ∈ S p.1})
    (hSmeas : ∀ o, MeasurableSet (S o))
    (hcompact : ∀ o, IsCompact (S o)) (hne : ∀ o, (S o).Nonempty)
    {phi : O × X → H} (hphiMeas : Measurable phi)
    (hphiCont : ∀ o, Continuous fun x => phi (o, x))
    {g : O → ℝ} (hg : Integrable g mu)
    (hdom : ∀ o, ∀ x ∈ S o, ‖phi (o, x)‖ ≤ g o) :
    jointLawAttainableMoments mu S phi =
      aumannExpectation mu (fun o => (fun x => phi (o, x)) '' S o)
proof:
:= by
  rw [jointLawAttainableMoments_eq_kernelAttainableMoments hgraph hSmeas]
  exact kernelAttainableMoments_eq_aumannExpectation_of_atomless
    hmu hS hSmeas hcompact hne hphiMeas hphiCont hg hdom

name: ProbabilityTheory.exponential_markov_real
statement:
lemma exponential_markov_real [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (q t : ℝ) (hq : 0 ≤ q)
    (h_exp : Integrable (fun ω => exp (q * X ω)) μ) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ X ω} ≤ (∫ ω, exp (q * X ω) ∂μ) / exp (q * t)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ X ω} ≤ exp (-q * t) * mgf X μ q :=
      measure_ge_le_exp_mul_mgf t hq h_exp
    _ = (∫ ω, exp (q * X ω) ∂μ) / exp (q * t) := by
      rw [mgf, div_eq_mul_inv, ← exp_neg]
      ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.hoeffding_sum_real
statement:
lemma hoeffding_sum_real [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {ι : Type*} (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (a b : ι → ℝ)
    (h_indep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (h_meas : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) μ)
    (h_bounds : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, X i ω ∈ Icc (a i) (b i))
    (h_centered : ∀ i, μ[X i] = 0)
    (s : Finset ι) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε) :
    μ.real {ω | ε ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, X i ω} ≤
      exp (-ε ^ 2 / (2 * (↑(∑ i ∈ s,
        (((‖b i - a i‖₊ / (2 : NNReal)) ^ (2 : ℕ)) : NNReal) : NNReal) : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  apply HasSubgaussianMGF.measure_sum_ge_le_of_iIndepFun
    (c := fun i => (‖b i - a i‖₊ / 2) ^ 2) h_indep _ hε
  intro i _hi
  exact hasSubgaussianMGF_of_mem_Icc_of_integral_eq_zero
    (h_meas i) (h_bounds i) (h_centered i)

name: ProbabilityTheory.hoeffding_average_real
statement:
lemma hoeffding_average_real [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (a b : ℕ → ℝ)
    (h_indep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (h_meas : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) μ)
    (h_bounds : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, X i ω ∈ Icc (a i) (b i))
    (h_centered : ∀ i, μ[X i] = 0)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ (∑ i ∈ range n, X i ω) / (n : ℝ)} ≤
      exp (-((n : ℝ) * t) ^ 2 / (2 * (↑(∑ i ∈ range n,
        (((‖b i - a i‖₊ / (2 : NNReal)) ^ (2 : ℕ)) : NNReal) : NNReal) : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  have h := hoeffding_sum_real X a b h_indep h_meas h_bounds h_centered
    (range n) (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n) ht)
  have hset : {ω | t ≤ (∑ i ∈ range n, X i ω) / (n : ℝ)} =
      {ω | (n : ℝ) * t ≤ ∑ i ∈ range n, X i ω} := by
    ext ω
    simp only [mem_setOf_eq]
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hn)]
    ring
  rw [hset]
  exact h

name: ProbabilityTheory.hoeffding_average_abs_real
statement:
lemma hoeffding_average_abs_real [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (a b : ℕ → ℝ)
    (h_indep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (h_meas : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) μ)
    (h_bounds : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, X i ω ∈ Icc (a i) (b i))
    (h_centered : ∀ i, μ[X i] = 0)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ |(∑ i ∈ range n, X i ω) / (n : ℝ)|} ≤
      2 * exp (-((n : ℝ) * t) ^ 2 / (2 * (↑(∑ i ∈ range n,
        (((‖b i - a i‖₊ / (2 : NNReal)) ^ (2 : ℕ)) : NNReal) : NNReal) : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  let Xneg : ℕ → Ω → ℝ := fun i ω => -X i ω
  have h_indep_neg : iIndepFun Xneg μ := by
    exact (h_indep.comp (fun _i => fun x : ℝ => -x) (fun _i => measurable_neg)).congr
      (fun _i => ae_of_all μ fun _ω => rfl)
  have h_meas_neg : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (Xneg i) μ := fun i => (h_meas i).neg
  have h_bounds_neg : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Xneg i ω ∈ Icc (-b i) (-a i) := by
    intro i
    filter_upwards [h_bounds i] with ω hω
    exact ⟨neg_le_neg hω.2, neg_le_neg hω.1⟩
  have h_centered_neg : ∀ i, μ[Xneg i] = 0 := by
    intro i
    simp only [Xneg]
    rw [integral_neg, h_centered i, neg_zero]
  have hpos := hoeffding_average_real X a b h_indep h_meas h_bounds h_centered hn ht
  have hneg := hoeffding_average_real Xneg (-b) (-a) h_indep_neg h_meas_neg
    h_bounds_neg h_centered_neg hn ht
  have hset : {ω | t ≤ |(∑ i ∈ range n, X i ω) / (n : ℝ)|} =
      {ω | t ≤ (∑ i ∈ range n, X i ω) / (n : ℝ)} ∪
      {ω | t ≤ (∑ i ∈ range n, Xneg i ω) / (n : ℝ)} := by
    ext ω
    simp only [mem_setOf_eq, mem_union, Xneg]
    rw [show (∑ i ∈ range n, -X i ω) = -(∑ i ∈ range n, X i ω) by simp]
    rw [neg_div, le_abs]
  rw [hset]
  calc
    _ ≤ μ.real {ω | t ≤ (∑ i ∈ range n, X i ω) / (n : ℝ)} +
        μ.real {ω | t ≤ (∑ i ∈ range n, Xneg i ω) / (n : ℝ)} :=
      measureReal_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ exp (-((n : ℝ) * t) ^ 2 / (2 * (↑(∑ i ∈ range n,
          (((‖b i - a i‖₊ / (2 : NNReal)) ^ (2 : ℕ)) : NNReal) : NNReal) : ℝ))) +
        exp (-((n : ℝ) * t) ^ 2 / (2 * (↑(∑ i ∈ range n,
          (((‖b i - a i‖₊ / (2 : NNReal)) ^ (2 : ℕ)) : NNReal) : NNReal) : ℝ))) := by
      apply add_le_add hpos
      simpa [Xneg, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using hneg
    _ = 2 * exp (-((n : ℝ) * t) ^ 2 / (2 * (↑(∑ i ∈ range n,
          (((‖b i - a i‖₊ / (2 : NNReal)) ^ (2 : ℕ)) : NNReal) : NNReal) : ℝ))) := by
      ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_biUnion_finset_le_card_mul
statement:
lemma measureReal_biUnion_finset_le_card_mul {ι : Type*} [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (s : Finset ι) (A : ι → Set Ω) {q : ℝ}
    (hA : ∀ i ∈ s, μ.real (A i) ≤ q) :
    μ.real (⋃ i ∈ s, A i) ≤ s.card * q
proof:
:= by
  calc
    μ.real (⋃ i ∈ s, A i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, μ.real (A i) :=
      measureReal_biUnion_finset_le s A
    _ ≤ ∑ _i ∈ s, q := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => hA i hi
    _ = s.card * q := by simp

name: ProbabilityTheory.finite_family_deviation_bound
statement:
lemma finite_family_deviation_bound {ι : Type*} [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (s : Finset ι) (Z : ι → Ω → ℝ) {t q : ℝ}
    (htail : ∀ i ∈ s, μ.real {ω | t ≤ |Z i ω|} ≤ q) :
    μ.real {ω | ∃ i ∈ s, t ≤ |Z i ω|} ≤ s.card * q
proof:
:= by
  have hset : {ω | ∃ i ∈ s, t ≤ |Z i ω|} =
      ⋃ i ∈ s, {ω | t ≤ |Z i ω|} := by
    ext ω
    simp
  rw [hset]
  exact measureReal_biUnion_finset_le_card_mul s _ htail

name: ProbabilityTheory.finite_family_hoeffding_average_abs
statement:
lemma finite_family_hoeffding_average_abs {ι : Type*} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (s : Finset ι) (X : ι → ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (a b : ℕ → ℝ)
    (h_indep : ∀ u ∈ s, iIndepFun (X u) μ)
    (h_meas : ∀ u ∈ s, ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X u i) μ)
    (h_bounds : ∀ u ∈ s, ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, X u i ω ∈ Icc (a i) (b i))
    (h_centered : ∀ u ∈ s, ∀ i, μ[X u i] = 0)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    μ.real {ω | ∃ u ∈ s, t ≤ |(∑ i ∈ range n, X u i ω) / (n : ℝ)|} ≤
      s.card * (2 * exp (-((n : ℝ) * t) ^ 2 / (2 * (↑(∑ i ∈ range n,
        (((‖b i - a i‖₊ / (2 : NNReal)) ^ (2 : ℕ)) : NNReal) : NNReal) : ℝ))))
proof:
:= by
  apply finite_family_deviation_bound s
    (fun u ω => (∑ i ∈ range n, X u i ω) / (n : ℝ))
  intro u hu
  exact hoeffding_average_abs_real (X u) a b (h_indep u hu) (h_meas u hu)
    (h_bounds u hu) (h_centered u hu) hn ht

name: ProbabilityTheory.finiteNet_deviation_subset
statement:
lemma finiteNet_deviation_subset {E : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace E]
    (D : Set E) (N : Finset E) {ε L s : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hnet : ∀ u ∈ D, ∃ v ∈ N, dist u v ≤ ε)
    (Z : Ω → E → ℝ)
    (hLip : ∀ ω u, u ∈ D → ∀ v, v ∈ N →
      |Z ω u - Z ω v| ≤ L * dist u v) :
    {ω | ∃ u ∈ D, s + L * ε < |Z ω u|} ⊆
      {ω | ∃ v ∈ N, s < |Z ω v|}
proof:
:= by
  rintro ω ⟨u, hu, hlarge⟩
  obtain ⟨v, hv, huv⟩ := hnet u hu
  refine ⟨v, hv, ?_⟩
  by_contra hsmall
  have hvle : |Z ω v| ≤ s := le_of_not_gt hsmall
  have htri : |Z ω u| ≤ |Z ω v| + |Z ω u - Z ω v| := by
    calc
      |Z ω u| = |(Z ω u - Z ω v) + Z ω v| := by ring_nf
      _ ≤ |Z ω u - Z ω v| + |Z ω v| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ = |Z ω v| + |Z ω u - Z ω v| := add_comm _ _
  have hlip := hLip ω u hu v hv
  have hmul : L * dist u v ≤ L * ε := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left huv hL
  linarith

name: ProbabilityTheory.finiteNet_uniform_deviation_bound
statement:
lemma finiteNet_uniform_deviation_bound {E : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace E]
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (D : Set E) (N : Finset E) {ε L s q : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hnet : ∀ u ∈ D, ∃ v ∈ N, dist u v ≤ ε)
    (Z : Ω → E → ℝ)
    (hLip : ∀ ω u, u ∈ D → ∀ v, v ∈ N →
      |Z ω u - Z ω v| ≤ L * dist u v)
    (htail : ∀ v ∈ N, μ.real {ω | s ≤ |Z ω v|} ≤ q) :
    μ.real {ω | ∃ u ∈ D, s + L * ε < |Z ω u|} ≤ N.card * q
proof:
:= by
  calc
    μ.real {ω | ∃ u ∈ D, s + L * ε < |Z ω u|} ≤
        μ.real {ω | ∃ v ∈ N, s ≤ |Z ω v|} := by
      apply measureReal_mono _ (by finiteness)
      exact (finiteNet_deviation_subset D N hL hnet Z hLip).trans
        (by rintro ω ⟨v, hv, hstrict⟩; exact ⟨v, hv, hstrict.le⟩)
    _ ≤ N.card * q :=
      finite_family_deviation_bound (μ := μ) N (fun v ω => Z ω v)
        (t := s) (q := q) htail

name: ProbabilityTheory.compact_exists_finset_net
statement:
lemma compact_exists_finset_net {E : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace E]
    (D : Set E) (hD : IsCompact D) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ N : Finset E,
      (∀ v ∈ N, v ∈ D) ∧
      (∀ u ∈ D, ∃ v ∈ N, dist u v ≤ ε)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T, hTD, hTfinite, hcover⟩ := finite_cover_balls_of_compact hD hε
  classical
  refine ⟨hTfinite.toFinset, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro v hv
    exact hTD (by simpa using hv)
  · intro u hu
    have hucover := hcover hu
    simp only [mem_iUnion, Metric.mem_ball] at hucover
    obtain ⟨v, hvT, huv⟩ := hucover
    exact ⟨v, by simpa using hvT, huv.le⟩

name: ProbabilityTheory.finset_card_mul_ballVolume_le
statement:
theorem finset_card_mul_ballVolume_le
    (s : Finset E) {R eps : ℝ} (heps : 0 < eps)
    (hs : ∀ c ∈ s, ‖c‖ ≤ R)
    (hsep : ∀ c ∈ s, ∀ d ∈ s, c ≠ d → eps ≤ ‖c - d‖) :
    (s.card : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal ((eps / 2) ^ finrank ℝ E) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal ((R + eps / 2) ^ finrank ℝ E)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hs0 : s = ∅
  · subst s
    simp
  borelize E
  let μ : Measure E := Measure.addHaar
  let δ : ℝ := eps / 2
  let ρ : ℝ := R + eps / 2
  have hδ : 0 < δ := by dsimp [δ]; positivity
  have hR : 0 ≤ R := by
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hs0
    exact (norm_nonneg c).trans (hs c hc)
  have hρ : 0 < ρ := by dsimp [ρ]; positivity
  set A := ⋃ c ∈ s, ball (c : E) δ with hA
  have hdisj : Set.Pairwise (s : Set E) (Disjoint on fun c => ball (c : E) δ) := by
    rintro c hc d hd hcd
    apply ball_disjoint_ball
    rw [dist_eq_norm]
    have hcd' := hsep c hc d hd hcd
    dsimp [δ]
    linarith
  have hsubset : A ⊆ ball (0 : E) ρ := by
    refine iUnion₂_subset fun x hx => ?_
    apply ball_subset_ball'
    calc
      δ + dist x 0 ≤ δ + R := by
        simpa only [dist_zero_right, add_le_add_iff_left] using hs x hx
      _ = ρ := by simp [δ, ρ, add_comm]
  have hmeasure :
      (s.card : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal (δ ^ finrank ℝ E) * μ (ball 0 1) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ finrank ℝ E) * μ (ball 0 1) := by
    calc
      (s.card : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal (δ ^ finrank ℝ E) * μ (ball 0 1) = μ A := by
        rw [hA, measure_biUnion_finset hdisj fun c _ => measurableSet_ball]
        simp only [μ.addHaar_ball_of_pos _ hδ]
        simp only [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_assoc]
      _ ≤ μ (ball (0 : E) ρ) := measure_mono hsubset
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ finrank ℝ E) * μ (ball 0 1) := by
        simp only [μ.addHaar_ball_of_pos _ hρ]
  have hcancel :
      (s.card : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal (δ ^ finrank ℝ E) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ finrank ℝ E) :=
    (ENNReal.mul_le_mul_iff_left (measure_ball_pos _ _ zero_lt_one).ne'
      measure_ball_lt_top.ne).1 hmeasure
  simpa [δ, ρ] using hcancel

name: ProbabilityTheory.finset_card_le_volume_ratio
statement:
theorem finset_card_le_volume_ratio
    (s : Finset E) {R eps : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (heps : 0 < eps)
    (hs : ∀ c ∈ s, ‖c‖ ≤ R)
    (hsep : ∀ c ∈ s, ∀ d ∈ s, c ≠ d → eps ≤ ‖c - d‖) :
    (s.card : ℝ) ≤
      (R + eps / 2) ^ finrank ℝ E / (eps / 2) ^ finrank ℝ E
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hs0 : s = ∅
  · subst s
    simp only [Finset.card_empty, Nat.cast_zero]
    positivity
  have hδpow : 0 < (eps / 2) ^ finrank ℝ E := by positivity
  have hρpow : 0 ≤ (R + eps / 2) ^ finrank ℝ E := by positivity
  have h := (ENNReal.toReal_le_toReal (by finiteness) (by finiteness)).2
    (finset_card_mul_ballVolume_le s heps hs hsep)
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_mul] at h
  simp only [ENNReal.toReal_natCast, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hδpow.le,
    ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hρpow] at h
  exact (le_div_iff₀ hδpow).2 h

name: ProbabilityTheory.finset_card_le_one_add_two_div_pow
statement:
theorem finset_card_le_one_add_two_div_pow
    (s : Finset E) {eps : ℝ} (heps : 0 < eps)
    (hs : ∀ c ∈ s, ‖c‖ ≤ 1)
    (hsep : ∀ c ∈ s, ∀ d ∈ s, c ≠ d → eps ≤ ‖c - d‖) :
    (s.card : ℝ) ≤ (1 + 2 / eps) ^ finrank ℝ E
proof:
:= by
  have h := finset_card_le_volume_ratio s (by norm_num) heps hs hsep
  calc
    (s.card : ℝ) ≤
        (1 + eps / 2) ^ finrank ℝ E / (eps / 2) ^ finrank ℝ E := h
    _ = ((1 + eps / 2) / (eps / 2)) ^ finrank ℝ E :=
      (div_pow (1 + eps / 2) (eps / 2) (finrank ℝ E)).symm
    _ = (1 + 2 / eps) ^ finrank ℝ E := by
      congr 1
      field_simp
      ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.packingNumber_ne_top_of_isCompact
statement:
theorem packingNumber_ne_top_of_isCompact {E : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace E]
    (D : Set E) (hD : IsCompact D) {eps : ℝ≥0} (heps : 0 < eps) :
    Metric.packingNumber eps D ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, _hND, hnet⟩ := compact_exists_finset_net D hD
    (show 0 < (eps : ℝ) / 2 by positivity)
  have hcover : Metric.IsCover (eps / 2) D (N : Set E) := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := hnet x hx
    refine ⟨y, by simpa using hy, ?_⟩
    change edist x y ≤ (eps / 2 : ℝ≥0)
    rw [edist_dist, ← ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal]
    apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
    simpa using hxy
  have hext : Metric.externalCoveringNumber (eps / 2) D ≤ (N : Set E).encard :=
    hcover.externalCoveringNumber_le_encard
  have hpack : Metric.packingNumber eps D ≤ (N : Set E).encard := by
    have h := (Metric.packingNumber_two_mul_le_externalCoveringNumber (eps / 2) D).trans hext
    have heq : 2 * (eps / 2) = eps := by field_simp
    rwa [heq] at h
  exact ne_top_of_le_ne_top (by simp) hpack

name: ProbabilityTheory.exists_unitBall_finset_net_card_le
statement:
theorem exists_unitBall_finset_net_card_le
    {eps : ℝ} (heps : 0 < eps) :
    ∃ N : Finset E,
      (∀ v ∈ N, ‖v‖ ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ u : E, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 → ∃ v ∈ N, dist u v ≤ eps) ∧
      (N.card : ℝ) ≤ (1 + 2 / eps) ^ finrank ℝ E
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let epsNN : ℝ≥0 := ⟨eps, heps.le⟩
  let D : Set E := closedBall (0 : E) 1
  have hD : IsCompact D := isCompact_closedBall (0 : E) 1
  have htop : Metric.packingNumber epsNN D ≠ ⊤ :=
    packingNumber_ne_top_of_isCompact D hD (by exact_mod_cast heps)
  let C : Set E := Metric.maximalSeparatedSet epsNN D
  have hCfinite : C.Finite := by
    rw [← Set.encard_ne_top_iff]
    simpa only [C, Metric.encard_maximalSeparatedSet htop] using htop
  let N : Finset E := hCfinite.toFinset
  have hNC : (N : Set E) = C := by simp [N]
  have hNmem : ∀ v ∈ N, ‖v‖ ≤ 1 := by
    intro v hv
    have hvN : v ∈ (N : Set E) := by simpa using hv
    have hvC : v ∈ C := hNC ▸ hvN
    have hvD : v ∈ D := Metric.maximalSeparatedSet_subset hvC
    simpa [D, mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hvD
  have hNsep : ∀ c ∈ N, ∀ d ∈ N, c ≠ d → eps ≤ ‖c - d‖ := by
    intro c hc d hd hcd
    have hcN : c ∈ (N : Set E) := by simpa using hc
    have hdN : d ∈ (N : Set E) := by simpa using hd
    have hcC : c ∈ C := hNC ▸ hcN
    have hdC : d ∈ C := hNC ▸ hdN
    have h := Metric.isSeparated_maximalSeparatedSet hcC hdC hcd
    have hreal : eps < dist c d := by
      change (epsNN : ℝ≥0∞) < edist c d at h
      rw [edist_dist, ENNReal.coe_lt_ofReal] at h
      exact h
    rw [dist_eq_norm] at hreal
    exact hreal.le
  have hNcover : ∀ u : E, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 → ∃ v ∈ N, dist u v ≤ eps := by
    intro u hu
    have huD : u ∈ D := by simpa [D, mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hu
    obtain ⟨v, hvC, huv⟩ := Metric.isCover_maximalSeparatedSet htop huD
    have hvN : v ∈ (N : Set E) := hNC.symm ▸ hvC
    refine ⟨v, by simpa using hvN, ?_⟩
    change edist u v ≤ (epsNN : ℝ≥0∞) at huv
    rw [edist_dist, ← ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal] at huv
    change ENNReal.ofReal (dist u v) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal eps at huv
    exact (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff heps.le).mp huv
  refine ⟨N, hNmem, hNcover, ?_⟩
  exact finset_card_le_one_add_two_div_pow N heps hNmem hNsep

name: ProbabilityTheory.exists_unitBall_finset_net_card_le_three_div
statement:
theorem exists_unitBall_finset_net_card_le_three_div
    {eps : ℝ} (heps : 0 < eps) (heps_one : eps ≤ 1) :
    ∃ N : Finset E,
      (∀ v ∈ N, ‖v‖ ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ u : E, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 → ∃ v ∈ N, dist u v ≤ eps) ∧
      (N.card : ℝ) ≤ (3 / eps) ^ finrank ℝ E
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hNmem, hNcover, hcard⟩ :=
    exists_unitBall_finset_net_card_le (E := E) heps
  refine ⟨N, hNmem, hNcover, hcard.trans ?_⟩
  apply pow_le_pow_left₀
  · positivity
  · apply (le_div_iff₀ heps).2
    calc
      (1 + 2 / eps) * eps = eps + 2 := by field_simp
      _ ≤ 3 := by linarith

name: ProbabilityTheory.compact_uniform_deviation_bound
statement:
lemma compact_uniform_deviation_bound {E : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace E]
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (D : Set E) (hD : IsCompact D)
    {ε L s q : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (Z : Ω → E → ℝ)
    (hLip : ∀ ω u, u ∈ D → ∀ v, v ∈ D →
      |Z ω u - Z ω v| ≤ L * dist u v)
    (htail : ∀ v ∈ D, μ.real {ω | s ≤ |Z ω v|} ≤ q) :
    ∃ N : Finset E,
      (∀ v ∈ N, v ∈ D) ∧
      μ.real {ω | ∃ u ∈ D, s + L * ε < |Z ω u|} ≤ N.card * q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hND, hnet⟩ := compact_exists_finset_net D hD hε
  refine ⟨N, hND, finiteNet_uniform_deviation_bound D N hL hnet Z ?_ ?_⟩
  · intro ω u hu v hv
    exact hLip ω u hu v (hND v hv)
  · intro v hv
    exact htail v (hND v hv)

name: ProbabilityTheory.strong_law_ae_of_iIndepFun
statement:
lemma strong_law_ae_of_iIndepFun
    (X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (hint : Integrable (X 0) μ)
    (h_indep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (h_ident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) μ μ) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ,
      Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (∑ i ∈ range n, X i ω) / n) atTop (𝓝 μ[X 0])
proof:
:= by
  apply strong_law_ae_real X hint
  · exact fun _i _j hij => h_indep.indepFun hij
  · exact h_ident

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasSubgammaMGF.sum_of_iIndepFun
statement:
lemma HasSubgammaMGF.sum_of_iIndepFun [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {ι : Type*} {X : ι → Ω → ℝ} {v : ι → ℝ} {c : ℝ}
    (h_indep : iIndepFun X μ) (h_meas : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hc : 0 ≤ c) (s : Finset ι) (h : ∀ i ∈ s, HasSubgammaMGF (X i) (v i) c μ) :
    HasSubgammaMGF (fun ω => ∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) (∑ i ∈ s, v i) c μ where
  v_nonneg
proof:
:= Finset.sum_nonneg fun i hi => (h i hi).v_nonneg
  c_nonneg := hc
  integrable_exp_mul q hq hcq := by
    simpa only [Finset.sum_apply] using
      h_indep.integrable_exp_mul_sum h_meas
        (fun i hi => (h i hi).integrable_exp_mul q hq hcq)
  mgf_le q hq hcq := by
    rw [show (fun ω => ∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) = ∑ i ∈ s, X i by ext; simp,
      h_indep.mgf_sum h_meas s]
    calc
      ∏ i ∈ s, mgf (X i) μ q ≤
          ∏ i ∈ s, exp (v i * q ^ 2 / (2 * (1 - c * q))) := by
        exact Finset.prod_le_prod (fun _i _hi => mgf_nonneg)
          (fun i hi => (h i hi).mgf_le q hq hcq)
      _ = exp ((∑ i ∈ s, v i) * q ^ 2 / (2 * (1 - c * q))) := by
        rw [← exp_sum]
        congr 1
        rw [← Finset.sum_div, ← Finset.sum_mul]

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasSubgammaMGF.measure_ge_le
statement:
lemma HasSubgammaMGF.measure_ge_le [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {X : Ω → ℝ} {v c : ℝ} (h : HasSubgammaMGF X v c μ)
    (hv : 0 < v) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε) :
    μ.real {ω | ε ≤ X ω} ≤ exp (-ε ^ 2 / (2 * (v + c * ε)))
proof:
:= by
  let q := ε / (v + c * ε)
  have hden : 0 < v + c * ε := by
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg h.c_nonneg hε]
  have hq : 0 ≤ q := div_nonneg hε hden.le
  have hcq : c * q < 1 := by
    dsimp [q]
    calc
      c * (ε / (v + c * ε)) = (c * ε) / (v + c * ε) := by ring
      _ < 1 := (div_lt_one hden).2 (by linarith)
  have hone_eq : 1 - c * q = v / (v + c * ε) := by
    dsimp [q]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hden]
    ring
  calc
    μ.real {ω | ε ≤ X ω} ≤ exp (-q * ε) * mgf X μ q :=
      measure_ge_le_exp_mul_mgf ε hq (h.integrable_exp_mul q hq hcq)
    _ ≤ exp (-q * ε) * exp (v * q ^ 2 / (2 * (1 - c * q))) := by
      gcongr
      exact h.mgf_le q hq hcq
    _ = exp (-ε ^ 2 / (2 * (v + c * ε))) := by
      rw [← exp_add]
      congr 1
      rw [hone_eq]
      dsimp [q]
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hv, ne_of_gt hden]
      ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasTwoSidedSubgammaMGF.sum_of_iIndepFun
statement:
lemma HasTwoSidedSubgammaMGF.sum_of_iIndepFun [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {ι : Type*} {X : ι → Ω → ℝ} {v : ι → ℝ} {c : ℝ}
    (h_indep : iIndepFun X μ) (h_meas : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hc : 0 ≤ c) (s : Finset ι) (h : ∀ i ∈ s, HasTwoSidedSubgammaMGF (X i) (v i) c μ) :
    HasTwoSidedSubgammaMGF (fun ω => ∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) (∑ i ∈ s, v i) c μ where
  pos
proof:
:= HasSubgammaMGF.sum_of_iIndepFun h_indep h_meas hc s fun i hi => (h i hi).pos
  neg := by
    have h_indep_neg : iIndepFun (fun i => -X i) μ := by
      exact (h_indep.comp (fun _i => fun x : ℝ => -x) (fun _i => measurable_neg)).congr
        (fun _i => ae_of_all μ fun _ω => rfl)
    have h_neg := HasSubgammaMGF.sum_of_iIndepFun h_indep_neg
      (fun i => (h_meas i).neg) hc s (fun i hi => (h i hi).neg)
    change HasSubgammaMGF (fun ω => -(∑ i ∈ s, X i ω)) (∑ i ∈ s, v i) c μ
    simpa only [Pi.neg_apply, Finset.sum_neg_distrib] using h_neg

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasTwoSidedSubgammaMGF.measure_abs_ge_le
statement:
lemma HasTwoSidedSubgammaMGF.measure_abs_ge_le [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {X : Ω → ℝ} {v c : ℝ} (h : HasTwoSidedSubgammaMGF X v c μ)
    (hv : 0 < v) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε) :
    μ.real {ω | ε ≤ |X ω|} ≤ 2 * exp (-ε ^ 2 / (2 * (v + c * ε)))
proof:
:= by
  have hset : {ω | ε ≤ |X ω|} = {ω | ε ≤ X ω} ∪ {ω | ε ≤ (-X) ω} := by
    ext ω
    simp only [mem_setOf_eq, mem_union, Pi.neg_apply, le_abs]
  rw [hset]
  calc
    μ.real ({ω | ε ≤ X ω} ∪ {ω | ε ≤ (-X) ω}) ≤
        μ.real {ω | ε ≤ X ω} + μ.real {ω | ε ≤ (-X) ω} :=
      measureReal_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ exp (-ε ^ 2 / (2 * (v + c * ε))) +
        exp (-ε ^ 2 / (2 * (v + c * ε))) :=
      add_le_add (h.pos.measure_ge_le hv hε) (h.neg.measure_ge_le hv hε)
    _ = 2 * exp (-ε ^ 2 / (2 * (v + c * ε))) := by ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.conditionalValueAtRisk_congr_ae
statement:
theorem conditionalValueAtRisk_congr_ae
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {X Y : Omega → ℝ} (hX : Integrable X mu) (hY : Integrable Y mu)
    {alpha : ℝ} (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha ≤ 1)
    (hXY : X =ᵐ[mu] Y) :
    conditionalValueAtRisk alpha X mu =
      conditionalValueAtRisk alpha Y mu
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact conditionalValueAtRisk_mono_ae
      hX hY halpha0 halpha1 hXY.le
  · exact conditionalValueAtRisk_mono_ae
      hY hX halpha0 halpha1 hXY.symm.le

name: ProbabilityTheory.conditionalValueAtRisk_finiteProcessSupremum_sub_integral_le_strongMomentSeries
statement:
theorem conditionalValueAtRisk_finiteProcessSupremum_sub_integral_le_strongMomentSeries
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    [SigmaFiniteFiltration mu filtration]
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty) (X : T → Omega → ℝ)
    (A : Omega → ℝ) (hA : Integrable A mu)
    (hX : ∀ u ∈ s, Measurable (X u))
    (hdom : ∀ omega u, u ∈ s → |X u omega| ≤ |A omega|)
    (second : ℕ → ℝ) (moment : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (n q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    (hterminal : mu[finiteProcessSupremum s hs X | filtration n]
      =ᵐ[mu] finiteProcessSupremum s hs X)
    (hDsq : ∀ i < n + 1, Integrable (fun omega ↦
      doobCenteredDifference filtration mu
        (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X) i omega ^ 2) mu)
    (hpow : ∀ i < n + 1, ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      Integrable (fun omega ↦
        (max (doobCenteredDifference filtration mu
          (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X) i omega) 0) ^ k) mu)
    (hsecond0 : (∫ omega,
      doobCenteredDifference filtration mu
        (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X) 0 omega ^ 2 ∂mu) ≤ second 0)
    (hsecondSucc : ∀ i < n,
      mu[fun omega ↦ doobCenteredDifference filtration mu
          (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X) (i + 1) omega ^ 2 |
        filtration i] ≤ᵐ[mu] fun _ ↦ second (i + 1))
    (hmoment0 : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      (∫ omega, (max (doobCenteredDifference filtration mu
        (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X) 0 omega) 0) ^ k ∂mu) ≤
        moment 0 k)
    (hmomentSucc : ∀ i < n, ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      mu[fun omega ↦ (max (doobCenteredDifference filtration mu
          (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X) (i + 1) omega) 0) ^ k |
        filtration i] ≤ᵐ[mu] fun _ ↦ moment (i + 1) k)
    {y alpha t : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y)
    (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha ≤ 1) (ht : 0 < t) :
    conditionalValueAtRisk alpha
        (fun omega ↦ finiteProcessSupremum s hs X omega -
          ∫ z, finiteProcessSupremum s hs X z ∂mu) mu ≤
      (strongMomentSeriesExponent q t y
          (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), second i)
          (fun k ↦ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), moment i k) -
        Real.log alpha) / t +
      alpha⁻¹ *
        ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), moment i q) /
          ((q : ℝ) * y ^ (q - 1)))
proof:
:= by
  let F : Omega → ℝ := finiteProcessSupremum s hs X
  let D : ℕ → Omega → ℝ :=
    doobCenteredDifference filtration mu F
  have hFint : Integrable F mu :=
    integrable_finiteProcessSupremum s hs X A hA hX hdom
  have hDint : ∀ i < n + 1, Integrable (D i) mu := by
    intro i _hi
    cases i with
    | zero =>
        change Integrable
          (fun omega ↦ mu[F | filtration 0] omega - ∫ z, F z ∂mu) mu
        exact integrable_condExp.sub (integrable_const _)
    | succ i =>
        change Integrable
          (fun omega ↦ mu[F | filtration (i + 1)] omega -
            mu[F | filtration i] omega) mu
        exact integrable_condExp.sub integrable_condExp
  have hDAdapted : StronglyAdapted filtration D :=
    stronglyAdapted_doobCenteredDifference filtration mu F
  have hDsq' : ∀ i < n + 1,
      Integrable (fun omega ↦ D i omega ^ 2) mu := by
    intro i hi
    simpa only [D, F] using hDsq i hi
  have hpow' : ∀ i < n + 1, ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      Integrable (fun omega ↦ (max (D i omega) 0) ^ k) mu := by
    intro i hi k hk
    simpa only [D, F] using hpow i hi k hk
  have hcenter0 : ∫ omega, D 0 omega ∂mu = 0 :=
    integral_doobCenteredDifference_zero filtration F
  have hcenterSucc : ∀ i < n + 1 - 1,
      mu[D (i + 1) | filtration i] =ᵐ[mu] 0 := by
    intro i _hi
    exact condExp_doobCenteredDifference_succ_ae_eq_zero filtration F i
  have hsecond0' : (∫ omega, D 0 omega ^ 2 ∂mu) ≤ second 0 := by
    simpa only [D, F] using hsecond0
  have hsecondSucc' : ∀ i < n + 1 - 1,
      mu[fun omega ↦ D (i + 1) omega ^ 2 | filtration i] ≤ᵐ[mu]
        fun _ ↦ second (i + 1) := by
    intro i hi
    simpa only [D, F] using hsecondSucc i (by omega)
  have hmoment0' : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      (∫ omega, (max (D 0 omega) 0) ^ k ∂mu) ≤ moment 0 k := by
    intro k hk
    simpa only [D, F] using hmoment0 k hk
  have hmomentSucc' : ∀ i < n + 1 - 1, ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      mu[fun omega ↦ (max (D (i + 1) omega) 0) ^ k |
        filtration i] ≤ᵐ[mu] fun _ ↦ moment (i + 1) k := by
    intro i hi k hk
    simpa only [D, F] using hmomentSucc i (by omega) k hk
  have hsum :=
    conditionalValueAtRisk_sum_le_strongMomentSeriesExponent_add_residual
      filtration D hDAdapted second moment (n + 1) q (by omega) hq hy
        hDint hDsq' hpow' hcenter0 hcenterSucc hsecond0'
        hsecondSucc' hmoment0' hmomentSucc' halpha0 halpha1 ht
  have hsumEq : (fun omega ↦ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), D i omega)
      =ᵐ[mu] fun omega ↦ F omega - ∫ z, F z ∂mu := by
    filter_upwards [hterminal] with omega hterminalOmega
    rw [sum_doobCenteredDifference filtration mu F n omega]
    exact sub_left_inj.mpr hterminalOmega
  have hcenteredInt : Integrable
      (fun omega ↦ F omega - ∫ z, F z ∂mu) mu :=
    hFint.sub (integrable_const _)
  have hsumInt : Integrable
      (fun omega ↦ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), D i omega) mu :=
    hcenteredInt.congr hsumEq.symm
  have hcvarEq := conditionalValueAtRisk_congr_ae
    hsumInt hcenteredInt halpha0 halpha1 hsumEq
  rw [← hcvarEq]
  simpa only [F] using hsum

name: RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable.finset_sum
statement:
theorem IsEffrosMeasurable.finset_sum
    {Ω E ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] [Nonempty E]
    (s : Finset ι) (S : ι → Ω → Set E)
    (hS : ∀ i ∈ s, IsEffrosMeasurable (S i))
    (hcompact : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ ω, IsCompact (S i ω))
    (hne : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ ω, (S i ω).Nonempty) :
    IsEffrosMeasurable (fun ω => ∑ i ∈ s, S i ω)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
      simpa using
        (isEffrosMeasurable_const (Ω := Ω) (0 : Set E))
  | @insert a s ha ih =>
      simp_rw [Finset.sum_insert ha]
      apply (hS a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)).add
        (ih
          (fun i hi => hS i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))
          (fun i hi ω => hcompact i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi) ω)
          (fun i hi ω => hne i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi) ω))
      · exact fun ω => (hcompact a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s) ω).isClosed
      · intro ω
        exact (isCompact_finset_sum s (fun i => S i ω)
          (fun i hi => hcompact i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi) ω)).isClosed
      · exact fun ω => hne a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s) ω
      · intro ω
        exact nonempty_finset_sum s (fun i => S i ω)
          (fun i hi => hne i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi) ω)

name: RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable.minkowskiAverage
statement:
theorem IsEffrosMeasurable.minkowskiAverage
    {Ω E ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] [Nonempty E]
    (s : Finset ι) (S : ι → Ω → Set E)
    (hS : ∀ i ∈ s, IsEffrosMeasurable (S i))

      (fun ω => minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω))
proof:

  have hsum := IsEffrosMeasurable.finset_sum s S hS hcompact hne
  simpa only [RandomSetTheory.minkowskiAverage] using
    hsum.const_smul (s.card : ℝ)⁻¹

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasCondBernsteinMGF.ae_condExp_le
statement:
theorem ae_condExp_le
    (hX : HasCondBernsteinMGF m hm X v b mu) (t : ℝ)
    (ht : (b : ℝ) * |t| < 1) :
    ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      mu[fun z ↦ exp (t * X z) | m] omega ≤
        exp ((v : ℝ) * t ^ 2 /
          (2 * (1 - (b : ℝ) * |t|)))
proof:
:=
  hX.cond_mgf_le t ht

name: ProbabilityTheory.hasCondBernsteinMGF_of_memLp_two_of_ae_abs_le_of_condExp_ae_eq_zero
statement:
theorem hasCondBernsteinMGF_of_memLp_two_of_ae_abs_le_of_condExp_ae_eq_zero
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hm : m ≤ mOmega) (X : Omega → ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 2 mu)
    {v b : ℝ} (hv : 0 ≤ v) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hbound : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, |X omega| ≤ b)
    (hcenter : mu[X | m] =ᵐ[mu] 0)
    (hsecond : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      mu[fun z ↦ X z ^ 2 | m] omega ≤ v) :
    HasCondBernsteinMGF m hm X
      ⟨2 * v, mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hv⟩ ⟨b, hb⟩ mu
proof:
:= by
  have hXint : Integrable X mu := hX.integrable (by norm_num)
  have hXsq : Integrable (fun omega ↦ X omega ^ 2) mu :=
    (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq hX.aestronglyMeasurable).1 hX
  refine
    { aemeasurable := hX.aemeasurable
      integrable_exp_mul := ?_
      cond_mgf_le := ?_ }
  · intro t ht
    apply Integrable.of_bound
      ((hX.aemeasurable.const_mul t).exp.aestronglyMeasurable)
      (exp (|t| * b))
    filter_upwards [hbound] with omega homega
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (exp_pos _)]
    apply exp_le_exp.mpr
    calc
      t * X omega ≤ |t * X omega| := le_abs_self _
      _ = |t| * |X omega| := abs_mul _ _
      _ ≤ |t| * b := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left homega (abs_nonneg _)
  · intro t ht
    have hExpInt : Integrable (fun omega ↦ exp (t * X omega)) mu := by
      apply Integrable.of_bound
        ((hX.aemeasurable.const_mul t).exp.aestronglyMeasurable)
        (exp (|t| * b))
      filter_upwards [hbound] with omega homega
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (exp_pos _)]
      apply exp_le_exp.mpr
      calc
        t * X omega ≤ |t * X omega| := le_abs_self _
        _ = |t| * |X omega| := abs_mul _ _
        _ ≤ |t| * b := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left homega (abs_nonneg _)
    let Xmk : Omega → ℝ := hX.aestronglyMeasurable.mk X
    have hXeq : X =ᵐ[mu] Xmk := hX.aestronglyMeasurable.ae_eq_mk
    have hXeqKernel : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu.trim hm,
        X =ᵐ[condExpKernel mu m omega] Xmk := by
      apply Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_comp
      rw [condExpKernel_comp_trim hm]
      exact hXeq
    have hXsqKernel : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu.trim hm,
        Integrable (fun z ↦ X z ^ 2) (condExpKernel mu m omega) := by
      apply Measure.ae_integrable_of_integrable_comp
      rw [condExpKernel_comp_trim hm]
      exact hXsq
    have hboundKernel : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu.trim hm,
        ∀ᵐ z ∂condExpKernel mu m omega, |X z| ≤ b := by
      apply Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_comp
      rw [condExpKernel_comp_trim hm]
      exact hbound
    have hmeanKernel : mu[X | m] =ᵐ[mu.trim hm]
        fun omega ↦ ∫ z, X z ∂condExpKernel mu m omega :=
      condExp_ae_eq_trim_integral_condExpKernel hm hXint
    have hsecondKernel : mu[fun z ↦ X z ^ 2 | m] =ᵐ[mu.trim hm]
        fun omega ↦ ∫ z, X z ^ 2 ∂condExpKernel mu m omega :=
      condExp_ae_eq_trim_integral_condExpKernel hm hXsq
    have hcenterTrim : mu[X | m] =ᵐ[mu.trim hm] 0 :=
      stronglyMeasurable_condExp.ae_eq_trim_of_stronglyMeasurable
        hm stronglyMeasurable_zero hcenter
    have hsecondTrim :
        mu[fun z ↦ X z ^ 2 | m] ≤ᵐ[mu.trim hm] fun _ ↦ v :=
      StronglyMeasurable.ae_le_trim_of_stronglyMeasurable hm
        stronglyMeasurable_condExp stronglyMeasurable_const hsecond
    have hExpKernel : mu[fun z ↦ exp (t * X z) | m] =ᵐ[mu.trim hm]
        fun omega ↦ ∫ z, exp (t * X z) ∂condExpKernel mu m omega :=
      condExp_ae_eq_trim_integral_condExpKernel hm hExpInt
    apply ae_of_ae_trim hm
    filter_upwards [hXeqKernel, hXsqKernel, hboundKernel,
        hmeanKernel, hsecondKernel, hcenterTrim, hsecondTrim, hExpKernel]
      with omega hXeqOmega hXsqOmega hboundOmega hmeanOmega
        hsecondOmega hcenterOmega hsecondBoundOmega hExpOmega
    have hXmeasOmega : AEStronglyMeasurable X
        (condExpKernel mu m omega) :=
      hX.aestronglyMeasurable.stronglyMeasurable_mk.aestronglyMeasurable.congr
        hXeqOmega.symm
    have hXlpOmega : MemLp X 2 (condExpKernel mu m omega) :=
      (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq hXmeasOmega).2 hXsqOmega
    have hmeanZero : ∫ z, X z ∂condExpKernel mu m omega = 0 := by
      rw [← hmeanOmega, hcenterOmega]
      rfl
    have hsecondLe : ∫ z, X z ^ 2 ∂condExpKernel mu m omega ≤ v := by
      rw [← hsecondOmega]
      exact hsecondBoundOmega
    rw [hExpOmega]
    exact (hasBernsteinMGF_of_memLp_two_of_ae_abs_le_of_integral_eq_zero
      X hXlpOmega hv hb hboundOmega hmeanZero hsecondLe).mgf_le t ht

name: ProbabilityTheory.integrable_exp_mul_add_of_ae_abs_le
statement:
theorem integrable_exp_mul_add_of_ae_abs_le
    [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    {X Y : Omega → ℝ} (hX : AEMeasurable X mu) (hY : AEMeasurable Y mu)
    {BX BY : ℝ} (hBX : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, |X omega| ≤ BX)
    (hBY : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, |Y omega| ≤ BY) (t : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun omega ↦ exp (t * (X omega + Y omega))) mu
proof:
:= by
  apply Integrable.of_bound
    (((hX.add hY).const_mul t).exp.aestronglyMeasurable)
    (exp (|t| * (BX + BY)))
  filter_upwards [hBX, hBY] with omega hXomega hYomega
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (exp_pos _)]
  apply exp_le_exp.mpr
  calc
    t * (X omega + Y omega) ≤ |t * (X omega + Y omega)| := le_abs_self _
    _ = |t| * |X omega + Y omega| := abs_mul _ _
    _ ≤ |t| * (|X omega| + |Y omega|) := by
      gcongr
      exact abs_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ |t| * (BX + BY) := by gcongr

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasBernsteinMGF.add_of_hasCondBernsteinMGF
statement:
theorem HasBernsteinMGF.add_of_hasCondBernsteinMGF
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {X Y : Omega → ℝ} {vX vY b : ℝ≥0}
    (hm : m ≤ mOmega) (hX : HasBernsteinMGF X vX b mu)
    (hXm : StronglyMeasurable[m] X)
    (hY : HasCondBernsteinMGF m hm Y vY b mu)
    {BX BY : ℝ} (hBX : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, |X omega| ≤ BX)
    (hBY : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, |Y omega| ≤ BY) :
    HasBernsteinMGF (fun omega ↦ X omega + Y omega) (vX + vY) b mu
proof:
:= by
  refine
    { aemeasurable := hX.aemeasurable.add hY.aemeasurable
      integrable_exp_mul := ?_
      mgf_le := ?_ }
  · intro t _ht
    exact integrable_exp_mul_add_of_ae_abs_le
      hX.aemeasurable hY.aemeasurable hBX hBY t
  · intro t ht
    let C : ℝ := exp ((vY : ℝ) * t ^ 2 /
      (2 * (1 - (b : ℝ) * |t|)))
    let f : Omega → ℝ := fun omega ↦ exp (t * X omega)
    let g : Omega → ℝ := fun omega ↦ exp (t * Y omega)
    have hfMeas : StronglyMeasurable[m] f := by
      simpa only [f, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using
        continuous_exp.comp_stronglyMeasurable (hXm.const_smul t)
    have hgInt : Integrable g mu := hY.integrable_exp_mul t ht
    have hfgInt : Integrable (f * g) mu := by
      have hsum := integrable_exp_mul_add_of_ae_abs_le
        hX.aemeasurable hY.aemeasurable hBX hBY t
      convert hsum using 1
      ext omega
      simp only [f, g, Pi.mul_apply, mul_add, exp_add]
    have hpull : mu[f * g | m] =ᵐ[mu] f * mu[g | m] :=
      condExp_mul_of_stronglyMeasurable_left hfMeas hfgInt hgInt
    have hrightInt : Integrable (f * mu[g | m]) mu :=
      integrable_condExp.congr hpull
    have hCInt : Integrable (fun omega ↦ f omega * C) mu :=
      (hX.integrable_exp_mul t ht).mul_const C
    have hcond := hY.cond_mgf_le t ht
    have hmono : f * mu[g | m] ≤ᵐ[mu] fun omega ↦ f omega * C := by
      filter_upwards [hcond] with omega homega
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left homega (exp_nonneg _)
    calc
      mgf (fun omega ↦ X omega + Y omega) mu t =
          ∫ omega, (f * g) omega ∂mu := by
        simp only [mgf, f, g, mul_add, exp_add, Pi.mul_apply]
      _ = ∫ omega, mu[f * g | m] omega ∂mu := by
        rw [integral_condExp hm]
      _ = ∫ omega, f omega * mu[g | m] omega ∂mu :=
        integral_congr_ae hpull
      _ ≤ ∫ omega, f omega * C ∂mu :=
        integral_mono_ae hrightInt hCInt hmono
      _ = mgf X mu t * C := by
        rw [integral_mul_const]
        rfl
      _ ≤ exp ((vX : ℝ) * t ^ 2 /
            (2 * (1 - (b : ℝ) * |t|))) * C := by
        gcongr
        exact hX.mgf_le t ht
      _ = exp (((vX + vY : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) * t ^ 2 /
            (2 * (1 - (b : ℝ) * |t|))) := by
        rw [show C = exp ((vY : ℝ) * t ^ 2 /
          (2 * (1 - (b : ℝ) * |t|))) by rfl, ← exp_add]
        congr 1
        push_cast
        ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.ae_abs_sum_range_le_nat_mul
statement:
theorem ae_abs_sum_range_le_nat_mul
    {Y : ℕ → Omega → ℝ} {b : ℝ} {n : ℕ}
    (hbound : ∀ i < n, ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, |Y i omega| ≤ b) :
    ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      |∑ i ∈ range n, Y i omega| ≤ (n : ℝ) * b
proof:
:= by
  have hall : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, ∀ i ∈ range n, |Y i omega| ≤ b := by
    rw [(range n).eventually_all]
    intro i hi
    exact hbound i (mem_range.mp hi)
  filter_upwards [hall] with omega homega
  calc
    |∑ i ∈ range n, Y i omega| ≤ ∑ i ∈ range n, |Y i omega| :=
      Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ (range n)
    _ ≤ ∑ _i ∈ range n, b := by
      gcongr with i hi
      exact homega i hi
    _ = (n : ℝ) * b := by simp

name: ProbabilityTheory.HasBernsteinMGF.sum_of_hasCondBernsteinMGF
statement:
theorem HasBernsteinMGF.sum_of_hasCondBernsteinMGF
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {Y : ℕ → Omega → ℝ} {v : ℕ → ℝ≥0} {b : ℝ≥0}
    (hAdapted : StronglyAdapted filtration Y)
    (hzero : HasBernsteinMGF (Y 0) (v 0) b mu)
    (n : ℕ)
    (hbound : ∀ i < n, ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, |Y i omega| ≤ (b : ℝ))
    (hcond : ∀ i < n - 1,
      HasCondBernsteinMGF (filtration i) (filtration.le i)
        (Y (i + 1)) (v (i + 1)) b mu) :
    HasBernsteinMGF (fun omega ↦ ∑ i ∈ range n, Y i omega)
      (∑ i ∈ range n, v i) b mu
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
      cases n with
      | zero => simpa using hzero
      | succ n =>
          have ih' := ih
            (fun i hi ↦ hbound i (by omega))
            (fun i hi ↦ hcond i (by omega))
          have hSmeas : StronglyMeasurable[filtration n]
              (fun omega ↦ ∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), Y i omega) := by
            apply Finset.stronglyMeasurable_fun_sum
            intro i hi
            exact (hAdapted i).mono (filtration.mono (by
              have hi' := mem_range.mp hi
              omega))
          have hSbound : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
              |∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), Y i omega| ≤
                ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (b : ℝ) :=
            ae_abs_sum_range_le_nat_mul
              (fun i hi ↦ hbound i (by omega))
          have hnextBound : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
              |Y (n + 1) omega| ≤ (b : ℝ) :=
            hbound (n + 1) (by omega)
          have hnext : HasCondBernsteinMGF (filtration n)
              (filtration.le n) (Y (n + 1)) (v (n + 1)) b mu :=
            hcond n (by omega)
          simp_rw [sum_range_succ _ (n + 1)]
          exact ih'.add_of_hasCondBernsteinMGF
            (filtration.le n) hSmeas hnext hSbound hnextBound

name: ProbabilityTheory.hasBernsteinMGF_sum_martingaleDiff_of_condSecondMoment_le
statement:
theorem hasBernsteinMGF_sum_martingaleDiff_of_condSecondMoment_le
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (Y : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hAdapted : StronglyAdapted filtration Y)
    (v : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (b : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ)
    (hLp : ∀ i < n, MemLp (Y i) 2 mu)
    (hbound : ∀ i < n, ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, |Y i omega| ≤ (b : ℝ))
    (hcenter0 : ∫ omega, Y 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hcenterSucc : ∀ i < n - 1,
      mu[Y (i + 1) | filtration i] =ᵐ[mu] 0)
    (hsecond0 : ∫ omega, Y 0 omega ^ 2 ∂mu ≤ (v 0 : ℝ))
    (hsecondSucc : ∀ i < n - 1, ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      mu[fun z ↦ Y (i + 1) z ^ 2 | filtration i] omega ≤
        (v (i + 1) : ℝ)) :
    HasBernsteinMGF (fun omega ↦ ∑ i ∈ range n, Y i omega)
      (2 * ∑ i ∈ range n, v i) b mu
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n =>
      let vB : ℕ → ℝ≥0 := fun i ↦ 2 * v i
      have hzero : HasBernsteinMGF (Y 0) (vB 0) b mu := by
        have hraw :=
          hasBernsteinMGF_of_memLp_two_of_ae_abs_le_of_integral_eq_zero
            (Y 0) (hLp 0 (by omega)) (v 0).coe_nonneg b.coe_nonneg
              (hbound 0 (by omega)) hcenter0 hsecond0
        convert hraw using 1
        · apply NNReal.eq
          rfl
        · apply NNReal.eq
          rfl
      have hcond : ∀ i < (n + 1) - 1,
          HasCondBernsteinMGF (filtration i) (filtration.le i)
            (Y (i + 1)) (vB (i + 1)) b mu := by
        intro i hi
        have hraw :=
          hasCondBernsteinMGF_of_memLp_two_of_ae_abs_le_of_condExp_ae_eq_zero
            (filtration.le i) (Y (i + 1)) (hLp (i + 1) (by omega))
              (v (i + 1)).coe_nonneg b.coe_nonneg
              (hbound (i + 1) (by omega)) (hcenterSucc i (by omega))
              (hsecondSucc i (by omega))
        convert hraw using 1
        · apply NNReal.eq
          rfl
        · apply NNReal.eq
          rfl
      have hsum := HasBernsteinMGF.sum_of_hasCondBernsteinMGF
        filtration hAdapted hzero (n + 1) hbound hcond
      convert hsum using 1
      simp only [vB, ← Finset.mul_sum]

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_sum_martingaleDiff_ge_le_of_condSecondMoment_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_sum_martingaleDiff_ge_le_of_condSecondMoment_le
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (Y : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hAdapted : StronglyAdapted filtration Y)
    (v : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (b : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ)
    (hLp : ∀ i < n, MemLp (Y i) 2 mu)
    (hbound : ∀ i < n, ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, |Y i omega| ≤ (b : ℝ))
    (hcenter0 : ∫ omega, Y 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hcenterSucc : ∀ i < n - 1,
      mu[Y (i + 1) | filtration i] =ᵐ[mu] 0)
    (hsecond0 : ∫ omega, Y 0 omega ^ 2 ∂mu ≤ (v 0 : ℝ))
    (hsecondSucc : ∀ i < n - 1, ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      mu[fun z ↦ Y (i + 1) z ^ 2 | filtration i] omega ≤
        (v (i + 1) : ℝ))
    {epsilon : ℝ} (hepsilon : 0 ≤ epsilon)
    (hV : 0 < ((∑ i ∈ range n, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) :
    mu.real {omega | epsilon ≤ ∑ i ∈ range n, Y i omega} ≤
      exp (-epsilon ^ 2 /
        (2 * (2 * ((∑ i ∈ range n, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) +
          (b : ℝ) * epsilon)))
proof:
:= by
  have hmgf := hasBernsteinMGF_sum_martingaleDiff_of_condSecondMoment_le
    filtration Y hAdapted v b n hLp hbound hcenter0 hcenterSucc
      hsecond0 hsecondSucc
  have hproxy : 0 < ((2 * ∑ i ∈ range n, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) := by
    simpa only [NNReal.coe_mul, NNReal.coe_ofNat, NNReal.coe_sum] using
      mul_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) hV
  simpa only [NNReal.coe_mul, NNReal.coe_ofNat] using
    hmgf.measure_ge_le hepsilon hproxy

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_abs_sum_martingaleDiff_ge_le_of_condSecondMoment_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_abs_sum_martingaleDiff_ge_le_of_condSecondMoment_le
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (Y : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hAdapted : StronglyAdapted filtration Y)

name: ProbabilityTheory.memLp_finiteProcessSupremum
statement:
theorem memLp_finiteProcessSupremum
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty) (X : T → Omega → ℝ)
    (A : Omega → ℝ) {p : ℝ≥0∞} (hA : MemLp A p mu)
    (hX : ∀ t ∈ s, Measurable (X t))
    (hdom : ∀ omega t, t ∈ s → |X t omega| ≤ |A omega|) :
    MemLp (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X) p mu
proof:
:= by
  apply hA.norm.mono'
    (measurable_finiteProcessSupremum s hs X hX).aestronglyMeasurable
  filter_upwards [] with omega
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_abs] using
    abs_finiteProcessSupremum_le s hs X A hdom omega

name: ProbabilityTheory.memLp_doobCenteredDifference
statement:
theorem memLp_doobCenteredDifference
    [IsFiniteMeasure mu] {p : ℝ≥0∞} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    {F : Omega → ℝ} (hF : MemLp F p mu) (k : ℕ) :
    MemLp (doobCenteredDifference filtration mu F k) p mu
proof:
:= by
  cases k with
  | zero =>
      change MemLp
        (mu[F | filtration 0] - fun _ ↦ ∫ z, F z ∂mu) p mu
      exact (hF.condExp hp).sub (memLp_const _)
  | succ k =>
      change MemLp
        (mu[F | filtration (k + 1)] - mu[F | filtration k]) p mu
      exact (hF.condExp hp).sub (hF.condExp hp)

name: ProbabilityTheory.condExp_sq_doobCenteredDifference_succ_le_of_finiteReplaceOne
statement:
theorem condExp_sq_doobCenteredDifference_succ_le_of_finiteReplaceOne
    {Z Beta : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] [MeasurableSpace Beta]
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [StandardBorelSpace Z] [Nonempty Z]
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (F : Omega → ℝ) (hF2 : MemLp F 2 mu) (k : ℕ)
    (P : Omega → Beta) (Y : Omega → Z)
    (hPY : IndepFun P Y mu) (hP : Measurable P) (hY : Measurable Y)
    (hfiltration : filtration k = MeasurableSpace.comap P inferInstance)
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (r : Beta → T → ℝ) (X : Z → T → ℝ) (A : Z → ℝ)
    (hr : ∀ t, t ∈ s → Measurable (fun b ↦ r b t))
    (hX : ∀ t, t ∈ s → Measurable (fun z ↦ X z t))
    (hA : ∀ z, 0 ≤ A z)
    (hdom : ∀ z t, t ∈ s → |X z t| ≤ A z)
    (hA2 : MemLp A 2 (mu.map Y))
    (hrepresentation :
      doobCenteredDifference filtration mu F (k + 1) =ᵐ[mu]
        fun omega ↦
          finiteReplaceOneCenteredSupremum (mu.map Y) s hs r X
            (P omega, Y omega)) :
    ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      mu[fun z ↦
        doobCenteredDifference filtration mu F (k + 1) z ^ 2 |
          filtration k] omega ≤
        2 * ∫ z, A z ^ 2 ∂(mu.map Y)
proof:
:= by
  let R : Omega → ℝ := fun omega ↦
    finiteReplaceOneCenteredSupremum (mu.map Y) s hs r X
      (P omega, Y omega)
  have hDoob2 : MemLp
      (doobCenteredDifference filtration mu F (k + 1)) 2 mu :=
    memLp_doobCenteredDifference filtration (by norm_num) hF2 (k + 1)
  have hR2 : MemLp R 2 mu :=
    (memLp_congr_ae hrepresentation).1 hDoob2
  have hghost := condExp_sq_finiteReplaceOneCenteredSupremum_le
    P Y hPY hP hY s hs r X A hr hX hA hdom hA2 hR2
  have hsquare :
      (fun z ↦ doobCenteredDifference filtration mu F (k + 1) z ^ 2)
        =ᵐ[mu] fun z ↦ R z ^ 2 := by
    filter_upwards [hrepresentation] with omega homega
    rw [homega]
  have hcondCongr := condExp_congr_ae (m := filtration k) hsquare
  rw [hfiltration] at hcondCongr ⊢
  filter_upwards [hcondCongr, hghost] with omega hcongrOmega hghostOmega
  exact hcongrOmega.trans_le hghostOmega

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_finiteProcessSupremum_sub_integral_large_le_fukNagaev
statement:
theorem measureReal_finiteProcessSupremum_sub_integral_large_le_fukNagaev
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    [SigmaFiniteFiltration mu filtration]
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty) (X : T → Omega → ℝ)
    (A : Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ t ∈ s, Measurable (X t))
    (hdom : ∀ omega t, t ∈ s → |X t omega| ≤ |A omega|)
    (v : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (n q r : ℕ) (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hAq : MemLp A q mu) (hA2 : MemLp A 2 mu)
    (hterminal : mu[finiteProcessSupremum s hs X | filtration n]
      =ᵐ[mu] finiteProcessSupremum s hs X)
    (hsecond0 : ∫ omega,
      doobCenteredDifference filtration mu (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X)
        0 omega ^ 2 ∂mu ≤ (v 0 : ℝ))
    (hsecondSucc : ∀ k < n,
      ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
        mu[fun z ↦
          doobCenteredDifference filtration mu
            (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X) (k + 1) z ^ 2 |
              filtration k] omega ≤ (v (k + 1) : ℝ))
    (K : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hmoment0 : absoluteMoment
      (doobCenteredDifference filtration mu
        (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X) 0) q mu ≤ K 0)
    (hcondMoment : ∀ k < n,
      ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
        mu[fun z ↦
          |doobCenteredDifference filtration mu
            (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X) (k + 1) z| ^ q |
              filtration k] omega ≤ K (k + 1))
    {y t : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) (ht : 0 < t)
    (hV : 0 < (((∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ))) :
    mu.real {omega |
        t + (∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), K k) / y ^ (q - 1) ≤
          finiteProcessSupremum s hs X omega -
            ∫ z, finiteProcessSupremum s hs X z ∂mu} ≤
      (∑ k ∈ range (n + 1),
          absoluteMoment
            (doobCenteredDifference filtration mu
              (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X) k) q mu) / y ^ q +
        (exp (-t ^ 2 /
          (8 * (((∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)))) +
          (r.factorial : ℝ) * (8 * y / t) ^ r)
proof:
:= by
  let F : Omega → ℝ := finiteProcessSupremum s hs X
  let D : ℕ → Omega → ℝ := doobCenteredDifference filtration mu F
  have hFq : MemLp F q mu :=
    memLp_finiteProcessSupremum s hs X A hAq hX hdom
  have hF2 : MemLp F 2 mu :=
    memLp_finiteProcessSupremum s hs X A hA2 hX hdom
  have hDAdapted : StronglyAdapted filtration D :=
    stronglyAdapted_doobCenteredDifference filtration mu F
  have hDqLp : ∀ k < n + 1, MemLp (D k) q mu := by
    intro k _hk
    exact memLp_doobCenteredDifference filtration (by exact_mod_cast hq) hFq k
  have hDq : ∀ k < n + 1,
      Integrable (fun omega ↦ |D k omega| ^ q) mu := by
    intro k hk
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      (hDqLp k hk).integrable_norm_pow (by omega : q ≠ 0)
  have hD2 : ∀ k < n + 1, MemLp (D k) 2 mu := by
    intro k _hk
    exact memLp_doobCenteredDifference filtration (by norm_num) hF2 k
  have hcenter0 : ∫ omega, D 0 omega ∂mu = 0 :=
    integral_doobCenteredDifference_zero filtration F
  have hcenterSucc : ∀ k < n + 1 - 1,
      mu[D (k + 1) | filtration k] =ᵐ[mu] 0 := by
    intro k _hk
    exact condExp_doobCenteredDifference_succ_ae_eq_zero filtration F k
  have hsecond0' : ∫ omega, D 0 omega ^ 2 ∂mu ≤ (v 0 : ℝ) := by
    simpa only [D, F] using hsecond0
  have hsecondSucc' : ∀ k < n + 1 - 1, ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      mu[fun z ↦ D (k + 1) z ^ 2 | filtration k] omega ≤
        (v (k + 1) : ℝ) := by
    intro k hk
    simpa only [D, F] using hsecondSucc k (by omega)
  have hmoment0' : absoluteMoment (D 0) q mu ≤ K 0 := by
    simpa only [D, F] using hmoment0
  have hcondMoment' : ∀ k < n + 1 - 1, ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      mu[fun z ↦ |D (k + 1) z| ^ q | filtration k] omega ≤
        K (k + 1) := by
    intro k hk
    simpa only [D, F] using hcondMoment k (by omega)
  have hbase :=
    measureReal_martingale_sum_large_le_condMoment_bias_add_gaussian_add_polynomial
      filtration D hDAdapted v (n + 1) q r hq hDq hD2
        hcenter0 hcenterSucc hsecond0' hsecondSucc' K hmoment0'
          hcondMoment' hy ht hV
  have hsumEq :
      (fun omega ↦ ∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), D k omega) =ᵐ[mu]
        fun omega ↦ F omega - ∫ z, F z ∂mu := by
    filter_upwards [hterminal] with omega hterminalOmega
    rw [sum_doobCenteredDifference filtration mu F n omega]
    exact sub_left_inj.mpr hterminalOmega
  have hset :
      {omega |
        t + (∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), K k) / y ^ (q - 1) ≤
          F omega - ∫ z, F z ∂mu} =ᵐ[mu]
      {omega |
        t + (∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), K k) / y ^ (q - 1) ≤
          ∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), D k omega} := by
    filter_upwards [hsumEq] with omega hsumOmega
    apply propext
    change
      (t + (∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), K k) / y ^ (q - 1) ≤
        F omega - ∫ z, F z ∂mu) ↔
      (t + (∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), K k) / y ^ (q - 1) ≤
        ∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), D k omega)
    rw [hsumOmega]
  rw [measureReal_congr hset]
  simpa only [D, F] using hbase

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_add_lt_le_of_mean_le_of_centered_cvar
statement:
theorem measureReal_add_lt_le_of_mean_le_of_centered_cvar
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega] {mu : Measure Omega}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu : RandomSetTheory.IsAtomlessMeasure mu)
    (S : Omega -> Real) (hSmeas : Measurable S) (hS : Integrable S mu)
    {E C alpha : Real}
    (hmean : (∫ omega, S omega ∂mu) <= E)
    (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha <= 1)
    (hcvar : conditionalValueAtRisk alpha
      (fun omega => S omega - ∫ z, S z ∂mu) mu <= C) :
    mu.real {omega | E + C < S omega} <= alpha
proof:
:= by
  have hcenteredMeas : Measurable
      (fun omega => S omega - ∫ z, S z ∂mu) :=
    hSmeas.sub measurable_const
  have hcenteredInt : Integrable
      (fun omega => S omega - ∫ z, S z ∂mu) mu :=
    hS.sub (integrable_const _)
  have htail := measureReal_lt_le_of_conditionalValueAtRisk_le_of_atomless
    hmu hcenteredMeas hcenteredInt halpha0 halpha1 hcvar
  apply (measureReal_mono ?_).trans htail
  intro omega homega
  change E + C < S omega at homega
  change C < S omega - ∫ z, S z ∂mu
  linarith

name: ProbabilityTheory.coe_nnrealOfNonneg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_nnrealOfNonneg (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
