name: ProbabilityTheory.measurable_truncatedLipschitzObservation
statement:
theorem measurable_truncatedLipschitzObservation
    (H : Z → T → ℝ) (R : Z → ℝ) (M : ℝ)
    (hH : ∀ t, Measurable (fun z ↦ H z t)) (hR : Measurable R)
    (t : T) :
    Measurable (fun z ↦ truncatedLipschitzObservation H R M z t)
proof:
:= by
  unfold truncatedLipschitzObservation
  exact Measurable.ite (measurableSet_le hR measurable_const) (hH t) measurable_const

name: ProbabilityTheory.measurable_truncatedLipschitzIncrement
statement:
theorem measurable_truncatedLipschitzIncrement
    (H : Z → T → ℝ) (R : Z → ℝ) (M : ℝ)
    (X : ι → Ω → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hH : ∀ t, Measurable (fun z ↦ H z t)) (hR : Measurable R)
    (i : ι) (s t : T) :
    Measurable (truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X i s t)
proof:
:= by
  exact
    ((measurable_truncatedLipschitzObservation H R M hH hR s).comp (hX i)).sub
      ((measurable_truncatedLipschitzObservation H R M hH hR t).comp (hX i))

name: ProbabilityTheory.abs_truncatedLipschitzObservation_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_truncatedLipschitzObservation_sub_le
    (H : Z → T → ℝ) (R : Z → ℝ) {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (hLip : ∀ z s t, |H z s - H z t| ≤ R z * dist s t)
    (z : Z) (s t : T) :
    |truncatedLipschitzObservation H R M z s -
        truncatedLipschitzObservation H R M z t| ≤ M * dist s t
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hz : R z ≤ M
  · simp only [truncatedLipschitzObservation, if_pos hz]
    exact (hLip z s t).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hz dist_nonneg)
  · simp only [truncatedLipschitzObservation, if_neg hz, sub_zero, abs_zero]
    exact mul_nonneg hM dist_nonneg

name: ProbabilityTheory.abs_truncatedLipschitzObservation_sub_le_envelope
statement:
theorem abs_truncatedLipschitzObservation_sub_le_envelope
    (H : Z → T → ℝ) (R : Z → ℝ) (M : ℝ)
    (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (hLip : ∀ z s t, |H z s - H z t| ≤ R z * dist s t)
    (z : Z) (s t : T) :
    |truncatedLipschitzObservation H R M z s -
        truncatedLipschitzObservation H R M z t| ≤ R z * dist s t
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hz : R z ≤ M
  · simpa only [truncatedLipschitzObservation, if_pos hz] using hLip z s t
  · simp only [truncatedLipschitzObservation, if_neg hz, sub_zero, abs_zero]
    exact mul_nonneg (hR z) dist_nonneg

name: ProbabilityTheory.integrable_truncatedLipschitzIncrement
statement:
theorem integrable_truncatedLipschitzIncrement
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (H : Z → T → ℝ) (R : Z → ℝ) {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (X : ι → Ω → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hH : ∀ t, Measurable (fun z ↦ H z t)) (hRmeas : Measurable R)
    (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (hLip : ∀ z s t, |H z s - H z t| ≤ R z * dist s t)
    (i : ι) (s t : T) :
    Integrable (truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X i s t) μ
proof:
:= by
  apply Integrable.of_bound
    (measurable_truncatedLipschitzIncrement
      H R M X hX hH hRmeas i s t).aestronglyMeasurable
    (M * dist s t)
  filter_upwards with ω
  simpa only [truncatedLipschitzIncrement, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
    abs_truncatedLipschitzObservation_sub_le
      H R hM hR hLip (X i ω) s t

name: ProbabilityTheory.centeredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess_sub
statement:
theorem centeredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess_sub
    (H : Z → T → ℝ) (R : Z → ℝ) (M c : ℝ)
    (X : ι → Ω → Z) (I : Finset ι) (ω : Ω) (s t : T) :
    (∀ i ∈ I, ∀ u : T,
      Integrable (fun ξ ↦ truncatedLipschitzObservation H R M (X i ξ) u) μ) →
    centeredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess (μ := μ) H R M c X I ω s -
        centeredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess (μ := μ) H R M c X I ω t =
      c * ∑ i ∈ I,
        (truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X i s t ω -
          ∫ ξ, truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X i s t ξ ∂μ)
proof:
:= by
  intro hint
  unfold centeredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess truncatedLipschitzIncrement
  rw [← mul_sub, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  rw [integral_sub]
  · ring
  · exact hint i hi s
  · exact hint i hi t

name: ProbabilityTheory.hasBernsteinMGF_centered_truncatedLipschitzIncrement
statement:
theorem hasBernsteinMGF_centered_truncatedLipschitzIncrement
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (H : Z → T → ℝ) (R : Z → ℝ) {M K : ℝ}
    (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (X : ι → Ω → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hH : ∀ t, Measurable (fun z ↦ H z t)) (hRmeas : Measurable R)
    (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (hLip : ∀ z s t, |H z s - H z t| ≤ R z * dist s t)
    (i : ι) (hRL2 : MemLp (fun ω ↦ R (X i ω)) 2 μ)
    (hRsecond : ∫ ω, R (X i ω) ^ 2 ∂μ ≤ K ^ 2)
    (s t : T) :
    HasBernsteinMGF
      (fun ω ↦ truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X i s t ω -
        ∫ ξ, truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X i s t ξ ∂μ)
      ⟨2 * (K * dist s t) ^ 2, by positivity⟩
      ⟨2 * (M * dist s t), by positivity⟩ μ
proof:
:= by
  let W : Ω → ℝ := truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X i s t
  have hWmeas : Measurable W :=
    measurable_truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X hX hH hRmeas i s t
  have hWbound : ∀ ω, |W ω| ≤ M * dist s t := by
    intro ω
    exact abs_truncatedLipschitzObservation_sub_le H R hM hR hLip (X i ω) s t
  have hWL2 : MemLp W 2 μ :=
    MemLp.of_bound hWmeas.aestronglyMeasurable (M * dist s t)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω ↦ by
        simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hWbound ω)
  have hRsq : Integrable (fun ω ↦ R (X i ω) ^ 2) μ :=
    (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq hRL2.aestronglyMeasurable).1 hRL2
  have hright : Integrable (fun ω ↦ (R (X i ω) * dist s t) ^ 2) μ := by
    convert hRsq.const_mul (dist s t ^ 2) using 1
    ext ω
    ring
  have hWsq : Integrable (fun ω ↦ W ω ^ 2) μ :=
    (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq hWL2.aestronglyMeasurable).1 hWL2
  have hWsecond : ∫ ω, W ω ^ 2 ∂μ ≤ (K * dist s t) ^ 2 := by
    calc
      ∫ ω, W ω ^ 2 ∂μ ≤
          ∫ ω, (R (X i ω) * dist s t) ^ 2 ∂μ := by
        apply integral_mono_ae hWsq hright
        filter_upwards with ω
        have henv :=
          abs_truncatedLipschitzObservation_sub_le_envelope
            H R M hR hLip (X i ω) s t
        exact sq_le_sq' (neg_le_of_abs_le henv) (le_of_abs_le henv)
      _ = dist s t ^ 2 * ∫ ω, R (X i ω) ^ 2 ∂μ := by
        rw [← integral_const_mul]
        congr 1
        funext ω
        ring
      _ ≤ dist s t ^ 2 * K ^ 2 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hRsecond (sq_nonneg _)
      _ = (K * dist s t) ^ 2 := by ring
  exact hasBernsteinMGF_centered_of_memLp_two_of_ae_abs_le
    W hWL2 (sq_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hM dist_nonneg)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hWbound) hWsecond

name: ProbabilityTheory.hasBernsteinMGF_centeredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess_increment
statement:
theorem hasBernsteinMGF_centeredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess_increment
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (H : Z → T → ℝ) (R : Z → ℝ) {M K : ℝ} (c : ℝ≥0)
    (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (X : ι → Ω → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hH : ∀ t, Measurable (fun z ↦ H z t)) (hRmeas : Measurable R)
    (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (hLip : ∀ z s t, |H z s - H z t| ≤ R z * dist s t)
    (I : Finset ι)
    (hRL2 : ∀ i ∈ I, MemLp (fun ω ↦ R (X i ω)) 2 μ)
    (hRsecond : ∀ i ∈ I, ∫ ω, R (X i ω) ^ 2 ∂μ ≤ K ^ 2)
    (s t : T) :
    HasBernsteinMGF
      (fun ω ↦ (c : ℝ) * ∑ i ∈ I,
        (truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X i s t ω -
          ∫ ξ, truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X i s t ξ ∂μ))
      (c ^ 2 *
        ∑ _i ∈ I, nnrealOfNonneg (2 * (K * dist s t) ^ 2) (by positivity))
      (c *
        nnrealOfNonneg (2 * (M * dist s t)) (by positivity)) μ
proof:
:= by
  let W : ι → Ω → ℝ := fun i ↦
    truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X i s t
  let m : ι → ℝ := fun i ↦ ∫ ξ, W i ξ ∂μ
  have hcenteredIndep : iIndepFun (fun i ω ↦ W i ω - m i) μ := by
    have hcomp := hIndep.comp
      (fun i z ↦
        (truncatedLipschitzObservation H R M z s -
          truncatedLipschitzObservation H R M z t) - m i)
      (fun i ↦
        ((measurable_truncatedLipschitzObservation H R M hH hRmeas s).sub
          (measurable_truncatedLipschitzObservation H R M hH hRmeas t)).sub
            measurable_const)
    convert hcomp using 1
    funext i ω
    rfl
  have hB : ∀ i ∈ I,
      HasBernsteinMGF (fun ω ↦ W i ω - m i)
        ⟨2 * (K * dist s t) ^ 2, by positivity⟩
        ⟨2 * (M * dist s t), by positivity⟩ μ := by
    intro i hi
    simpa only [W, m] using
      hasBernsteinMGF_centered_truncatedLipschitzIncrement
        H R hM hK X hX hH hRmeas hR hLip i (hRL2 i hi)
          (hRsecond i hi) s t
  have hsum := HasBernsteinMGF.sum_of_iIndepFun hcenteredIndep
    (nnrealOfNonneg (2 * (M * dist s t)) (by positivity))
    (v := fun _ ↦ nnrealOfNonneg (2 * (K * dist s t) ^ 2) (by positivity))
    (s := I) hB
  exact hsum.nnreal_mul c

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_centeredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess_increment_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_centeredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess_increment_le
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (H : Z → T → ℝ) (R : Z → ℝ) {M K : ℝ} (c : ℝ≥0)
    (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hK : 0 < K) (hc : 0 < c)
    (X : ι → Ω → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hH : ∀ t, Measurable (fun z ↦ H z t)) (hRmeas : Measurable R)
    (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (hLip : ∀ z s t, |H z s - H z t| ≤ R z * dist s t)
    (I : Finset ι) (hI : I.Nonempty)
    (hRL2 : ∀ i ∈ I, MemLp (fun ω ↦ R (X i ω)) 2 μ)
    (hRsecond : ∀ i ∈ I, ∫ ω, R (X i ω) ^ 2 ∂μ ≤ K ^ 2)
    (s t : T) (hdist : 0 < dist s t) {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    let v : ℝ≥0 := c ^ 2 *
      ∑ _i ∈ I, nnrealOfNonneg (2 * (K * dist s t) ^ 2) (by positivity)
    let b : ℝ≥0 := c *
      nnrealOfNonneg (2 * (M * dist s t)) (by positivity)
    μ.real { ω |
      Real.sqrt (2 * (v : ℝ) * y) + 2 * (b : ℝ) * y ≤
        |(c : ℝ) * ∑ i ∈ I,
          (truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X i s t ω -
            ∫ ξ, truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X i s t ξ ∂μ)| } ≤
      2 * Real.exp (-y)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  have hmgf := hasBernsteinMGF_centeredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess_increment
    H R c hM hK.le X hX hIndep hH hRmeas hR hLip I hRL2 hRsecond s t
  apply hmgf.measure_abs_ge_sqrt_add_le hy
  push_cast
  simp only [coe_nnrealOfNonneg, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
  have hcard : 0 < (I.card : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (Finset.card_pos.mpr hI)
  positivity

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_range_succ_centeredTruncated_increment_mixedTail
statement:
theorem measureReal_range_succ_centeredTruncated_increment_mixedTail
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (H : Z → T → ℝ) (R : Z → ℝ) {a K : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hK : 0 < K)
    (X : ℕ → Ω → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hH : ∀ t, Measurable (fun z ↦ H z t)) (hRmeas : Measurable R)
    (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (hLip : ∀ z s t, |H z s - H z t| ≤ R z * dist s t)
    (hRL2 : ∀ i, MemLp (fun ω ↦ R (X i ω)) 2 μ)
    (hRsecond : ∀ i, ∫ ω, R (X i ω) ^ 2 ∂μ ≤ K ^ 2)
    (n : ℕ) (s t : T) (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    μ.real { ω |
      (2 * K) * dist s t * Real.sqrt (2 * y) +
          2 * (2 * a) * dist s t * y <
        |(Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          (truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R
              (a * Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ)) X i s t ω -
            ∫ ξ, truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R
              (a * Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ)) X i s t ξ ∂μ)| } ≤
      2 * Real.exp (-y)
proof:
:= by
  let q : ℝ := Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ)
  let M : ℝ := a * q
  let c : ℝ≥0 := Real.toNNReal q⁻¹
  have hn : 0 < (n : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
  have hq : 0 < q := by
    dsimp only [q]
    exact Real.sqrt_pos.2 hn
  have hM : 0 ≤ M := mul_nonneg ha hq.le
  have hc : 0 < c := by
    dsimp only [c]
    exact Real.toNNReal_pos.mpr (inv_pos.mpr hq)
  have hccoe : (c : ℝ) = q⁻¹ := by
    dsimp only [c]
    exact Real.coe_toNNReal _ (inv_nonneg.mpr hq.le)
  by_cases hdistzero : dist s t = 0
  · have hinczero : ∀ i ω,
        truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X i s t ω = 0 := by
      intro i ω
      have hb := abs_truncatedLipschitzObservation_sub_le
        H R hM hR hLip (X i ω) s t
      rw [hdistzero, mul_zero] at hb
      exact abs_eq_zero.mp (le_antisymm hb (abs_nonneg _))
    have hprocesszero : ∀ ω,
        q⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          (truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X i s t ω -
            ∫ ξ, truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X i s t ξ ∂μ) = 0 := by
      intro ω
      apply mul_eq_zero_of_right
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro i hi
      rw [hinczero i ω]
      have hint : ∫ ξ, truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X i s t ξ ∂μ = 0 := by
        simp_rw [hinczero i]
        simp
      rw [hint, sub_zero]
    have hset : { ω |
        (2 * K) * dist s t * Real.sqrt (2 * y) +
            2 * (2 * a) * dist s t * y <
          |q⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
            (truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X i s t ω -
              ∫ ξ, truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X i s t ξ ∂μ)| } =
        ∅ := by
      ext ω
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false,
        hprocesszero, abs_zero, hdistzero, mul_zero, zero_mul, add_zero,
        lt_self_iff_false]
    change μ.real { ω |
        (2 * K) * dist s t * Real.sqrt (2 * y) +
            2 * (2 * a) * dist s t * y <
          |q⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
            (truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X i s t ω -
              ∫ ξ, truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X i s t ξ ∂μ)| } ≤ _
    rw [hset]
    simp only [measureReal_empty]
    exact mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (Real.exp_pos _).le
  · have hdist : 0 < dist s t := lt_of_le_of_ne dist_nonneg
        (Ne.symm hdistzero)
    have htail := measureReal_centeredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess_increment_le
      H R c hM hK hc X hX hIndep hH hRmeas hR hLip
        (Finset.range (n + 1)) (by simp) (fun i _ ↦ hRL2 i)
        (fun i _ ↦ hRsecond i) s t hdist hy
    dsimp only at htail
    have hv :
        (((c ^ 2 * ∑ _i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          nnrealOfNonneg (2 * (K * dist s t) ^ 2) (by positivity)) : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) =
          2 * (K * dist s t) ^ 2 := by
      push_cast
      rw [hccoe]
      simp only [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, Finset.card_range,
        coe_nnrealOfNonneg]
      push_cast
      dsimp only [q] at hq ⊢
      rw [inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hn.le]
      field_simp
    have hb :
        (((c * nnrealOfNonneg (2 * (M * dist s t)) (by positivity)) : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) =
          2 * a * dist s t := by
      push_cast
      rw [hccoe]
      simp only [coe_nnrealOfNonneg, M]
      field_simp
    rw [hv, hb, hccoe] at htail
    have hsqrt :
        Real.sqrt (2 * (2 * (K * dist s t) ^ 2) * y) ≤
          (2 * K) * dist s t * Real.sqrt (2 * y) := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_le_iff]
      constructor
      · positivity
      · have h2y : 0 ≤ 2 * y := by positivity
        nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt h2y, sq_nonneg (K * dist s t)]
    apply (measureReal_mono ?_).trans htail
    intro ω hω
    change (2 * K) * dist s t * Real.sqrt (2 * y) +
        2 * (2 * a) * dist s t * y <
      |q⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        (truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X i s t ω -
          ∫ ξ, truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X i s t ξ ∂μ)| at hω
    have hlinear : 2 * (2 * a * dist s t) * y =
        2 * (2 * a) * dist s t * y := by ring
    exact (add_le_add hsqrt hlinear.le).trans hω.le

name: RandomSetTheory.inclusionInDoubleDualWeak_surjective_real_hilbert
statement:
theorem inclusionInDoubleDualWeak_surjective_real_hilbert
    {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
    [CompleteSpace H] :
    Function.Surjective (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDualWeak ℝ H)
proof:
:= by
  intro Phi
  let Phi' : StrongDual ℝ (StrongDual ℝ H) :=
    WeakDual.toStrongDual Phi
  let psi : StrongDual ℝ H :=
    Phi'.comp (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ H).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap
  let x : H := (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ H).symm psi
  refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
  apply DFunLike.ext _ _
  intro ell
  change ell x = Phi ell
  let y : H := (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ H).symm (WeakDual.toStrongDual ell)
  have hell : WeakDual.toStrongDual ell = InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ H y := by
    simp [y]
  have hpsi : psi y = Phi ell := by
    change Phi' (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ H y) = Phi ell
    rw [← hell]
    rfl
  have hxpsi : InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ H x = psi := by simp [x]
  have hx : ⟪x, y⟫_ℝ = Phi ell := by
    rw [← InnerProductSpace.toDual_apply_apply, hxpsi, hpsi]
  have hellx : ell x = ⟪y, x⟫_ℝ := by
    change (WeakDual.toStrongDual ell) x = _
    rw [hell]
    rfl
  rw [hellx, real_inner_comm, hx]

name: RandomSetTheory.isCompact_toWeakSpace_image_of_isClosed_convex_isBounded
statement:
theorem isCompact_toWeakSpace_image_of_isClosed_convex_isBounded
    {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
    [CompleteSpace H] {C : Set H}
    (hCclosed : IsClosed C) (hCconv : Convex ℝ C)
    (hCbounded : Bornology.IsBounded C) :
    IsCompact ((toWeakSpace ℝ H) '' C)
proof:
:= by
  let S : Set (WeakSpace ℝ H) := (toWeakSpace ℝ H) '' C
  have hpre : (toWeakSpace ℝ H) ⁻¹' S = C := by
    ext x
    simp [S]
  have hSclosure : closure S = S := by
    have h := hCconv.toWeakSpace_closure ℝ
    rw [hCclosed.closure_eq] at h
    simpa [S] using h.symm
  change IsCompact S
  rw [← hSclosure]
  apply NormedSpace.isCompact_closure_of_isBounded ℝ H S
  · rwa [hpre]
  · intro z hz
    exact inclusionInDoubleDualWeak_surjective_real_hilbert z

name: RandomSetTheory.isCompact_image_clm_of_isClosed_convex_isBounded_hilbert
statement:
theorem isCompact_image_clm_of_isClosed_convex_isBounded_hilbert
    {H E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
    [CompleteSpace H] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {C : Set H} (hCclosed : IsClosed C) (hCconv : Convex ℝ C)
    (hCbounded : Bornology.IsBounded C) (L : H →L[ℝ] E) :
    IsCompact (L '' C)
proof:
:= by
  let S : Set (WeakSpace ℝ H) := (toWeakSpace ℝ H) '' C
  have hScompact : IsCompact S := by
    exact isCompact_toWeakSpace_image_of_isClosed_convex_isBounded
      hCclosed hCconv hCbounded
  let T : Set (WeakSpace ℝ E) := WeakSpace.map L '' S
  have hTcompact : IsCompact T :=
    hScompact.image (WeakSpace.map L).continuous
  have hTclosed : IsClosed T := hTcompact.isClosed
  have himage : L '' C = (toWeakSpace ℝ E) ⁻¹' T := by
    ext y
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨toWeakSpace ℝ H x, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨w, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, hw⟩
      have hw' : L x = y := by
        exact (toWeakSpace ℝ E).injective hw
      exact ⟨x, hx, hw'⟩
  apply Metric.isCompact_iff_isClosed_bounded.2
  constructor
  · rw [himage]
    exact hTclosed.preimage (toWeakSpaceCLM ℝ E).continuous
  · exact hCbounded.image L

name: RandomSetTheory.l2SelectionSet_convex
statement:
theorem l2SelectionSet_convex
    {Omega E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (mu : Measure Omega) {S : Omega → Set E}
    (hSconv : ∀ omega, Convex ℝ (S omega)) :
    Convex ℝ (l2SelectionSet mu S)
proof:
:= by
  intro F hF G hG a b ha hb hab
  filter_upwards [hF, hG, Lp.coeFn_add (a • F) (b • G),
    Lp.coeFn_smul a F, Lp.coeFn_smul b G] with omega hFomega hGomega hadd haF hbG
  rw [hadd]
  change (a • F) omega + (b • G) omega ∈ S omega
  rw [haF, hbG]
  change a • F omega + b • G omega ∈ S omega
  exact hSconv omega hFomega hGomega ha hb hab

name: RandomSetTheory.l2SelectionSet_isClosed
statement:
theorem l2SelectionSet_isClosed
    {Omega E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [CompleteSpace E]
    (mu : Measure Omega) {S : Omega → Set E}
    (hSclosed : ∀ omega, IsClosed (S omega)) :
    IsClosed (l2SelectionSet mu S)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsSeqClosed.isClosed
  intro F z hF hFz
  have hmeasure : TendstoInMeasure mu (fun n => (F n : Omega → E)) atTop z :=
    tendstoInMeasure_of_tendsto_Lp hFz
  obtain ⟨phi, _hphi, hphiAE⟩ := hmeasure.exists_seq_tendsto_ae
  have hmemAE : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, ∀ n, F n omega ∈ S omega :=
    ae_all_iff.2 hF
  filter_upwards [hphiAE, hmemAE] with omega hconv hmem
  exact (hSclosed omega).mem_of_tendsto hconv
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n => hmem (phi n))

name: RandomSetTheory.l2SelectionSet_isBounded_of_memLp_envelope
statement:
theorem l2SelectionSet_isBounded_of_memLp_envelope
    {Omega E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (mu : Measure Omega) {S : Omega → Set E} {g : Omega → ℝ}
    (hg : MemLp g 2 mu)
    (hdom : ∀ omega, ∀ x ∈ S omega, ‖x‖ ≤ g omega) :
    Bornology.IsBounded (l2SelectionSet mu S)
proof:
:= by
  let G : Omega →₂[mu] ℝ := hg.toLp g
  rw [Metric.isBounded_iff_subset_closedBall 0]
  refine ⟨‖G‖, ?_⟩
  intro F hF
  rw [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
  have hnormAE : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, ‖F omega‖ ≤ ‖G omega‖ := by
    filter_upwards [hF, hg.coeFn_toLp] with omega hFomega hGomega
    rw [hGomega]
    have hg0 : 0 ≤ g omega := (norm_nonneg _).trans (hdom omega _ hFomega)
    simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hg0] using hdom omega _ hFomega
  have hLp : eLpNorm F 2 mu ≤ eLpNorm G 2 mu :=
    eLpNorm_mono_ae hnormAE
  rw [Lp.norm_def, Lp.norm_def]
  exact ENNReal.toReal_mono (Lp.eLpNorm_ne_top G) hLp

name: RandomSetTheory.integralL2CLM_apply
statement:
theorem integralL2CLM_apply
    {Omega E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    (mu : Measure Omega) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (F : Omega →₂[mu] E) :
    integralL2CLM mu F = ∫ omega, F omega ∂mu
proof:
:= by
  have hFint : Integrable (fun omega => F omega) mu :=
    memLp_one_iff_integrable.mp ((Lp.memLp F).mono_exponent (by norm_num))
  rw [MeasureTheory.integral_eq _ hFint]
  change L1.integralCLM (l2ToL1CLM mu F) = L1.integral (hFint.toL1 F)
  rw [← L1.integral_eq]
  congr 1
  apply Lp.ext
  exact hFint.coeFn_toL1.symm

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_eq_integralL2CLM_image
statement:
theorem aumannExpectation_eq_integralL2CLM_image
    {Omega E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    (mu : Measure Omega) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (S : Omega → Set E) {g : Omega → ℝ} (hg : MemLp g 2 mu)
    (hdom : ∀ omega, ∀ x ∈ S omega, ‖x‖ ≤ g omega) :
    aumannExpectation mu S =
      integralL2CLM mu '' l2SelectionSet mu S
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · rintro z ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
    have hf2 : MemLp f 2 mu := by
      apply hg.mono' hf.1.aestronglyMeasurable
      filter_upwards [hf.2] with omega hfomega
      exact hdom omega _ hfomega
    let F : Omega →₂[mu] E := hf2.toLp f
    have hFmem : F ∈ l2SelectionSet mu S := by
      filter_upwards [hf.2, hf2.coeFn_toLp] with omega hfomega hFomega
      rwa [hFomega]
    refine ⟨F, hFmem, ?_⟩
    rw [integralL2CLM_apply]
    exact integral_congr_ae hf2.coeFn_toLp
  · rintro z ⟨F, hFmem, rfl⟩
    have hFint : Integrable (fun omega => F omega) mu :=
      memLp_one_iff_integrable.mp ((Lp.memLp F).mono_exponent (by norm_num))
    refine ⟨fun omega => F omega, ⟨hFint, hFmem⟩, ?_⟩
    exact (integralL2CLM_apply mu F).symm

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_isCompact_of_memLp_two_envelope
statement:
theorem aumannExpectation_isCompact_of_memLp_two_envelope
    {Omega E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (mu : Measure Omega) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {S : Omega → Set E} (hclosed : ∀ omega, IsClosed (S omega))
    (hconv : ∀ omega, Convex ℝ (S omega))
    {g : Omega → ℝ} (hg : MemLp g 2 mu)
    (hdom : ∀ omega, ∀ x ∈ S omega, ‖x‖ ≤ g omega) :
    IsCompact (aumannExpectation mu S)
proof:
:= by
  rw [aumannExpectation_eq_integralL2CLM_image mu S hg hdom]
  exact isCompact_image_clm_of_isClosed_convex_isBounded_hilbert
    (l2SelectionSet_isClosed mu hclosed)
    (l2SelectionSet_convex mu hconv)
    (l2SelectionSet_isBounded_of_memLp_envelope mu hg hdom)
    (integralL2CLM mu)

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_inverseDensityCorrespondence
statement:
theorem aumannExpectation_inverseDensityCorrespondence
    {Omega E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    (mu : Measure Omega) (r : Omega → NNReal) (hr : Measurable r)
    (hrpos : ∀ omega, 0 < r omega) (S : Omega → Set E) :
    aumannExpectation (mu.withDensity fun omega => (r omega : ENNReal))
        (inverseDensityCorrespondence r S) =
      aumannExpectation mu S
proof:
:= by
  let nu : Measure Omega := mu.withDensity fun omega => (r omega : ENNReal)
  have hrE : Measurable fun omega => (r omega : ENNReal) := hr.coe_nnreal_ennreal
  have hrnz : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, (r omega : ENNReal) ≠ 0 := by
    filter_upwards [] with omega
    exact_mod_cast (hrpos omega).ne'
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · rintro z ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
    let f : Omega → E := fun omega => (r omega : ℝ) • t omega
    have hfint : Integrable f mu := by
      exact (integrable_withDensity_iff_integrable_smul hr).mp ht.1
    have hfmem : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, f omega ∈ S omega := by
      have htmem : ∀ᵐ omega ∂nu,
          t omega ∈ inverseDensityCorrespondence r S omega := ht.2
      have htmem' : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
          t omega ∈ inverseDensityCorrespondence r S omega :=
        (withDensity_absolutelyContinuous' hrE.aemeasurable hrnz).ae_le htmem
      filter_upwards [htmem'] with omega htomega
      rcases htomega with ⟨x, hx, htx⟩
      change (r omega : ℝ) • t omega ∈ S omega
      rw [← htx]
      have hrne : (r omega : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
        exact_mod_cast (hrpos omega).ne'
      simpa [smul_smul, hrne] using hx
    refine ⟨f, ⟨hfint, hfmem⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [integral_withDensity_eq_integral_smul hr]
    rfl
  · rintro z ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
    let t : Omega → E := fun omega => ((r omega : ℝ)⁻¹) • f omega
    have htint : Integrable t nu := by
      rw [integrable_withDensity_iff_integrable_smul hr]
      simp_rw [NNReal.smul_def]
      have hfun : (fun omega => (r omega : ℝ) • t omega) = f := by
        funext omega
        have hrne : (r omega : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
          exact_mod_cast (hrpos omega).ne'
        simp [t, smul_smul, hrne]
      rw [hfun]
      exact hf.1
    have htmemMu : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
        t omega ∈ inverseDensityCorrespondence r S omega := by
      filter_upwards [hf.2] with omega hfomega
      exact ⟨f omega, hfomega, rfl⟩
    have htmemNu : ∀ᵐ omega ∂nu,
        t omega ∈ inverseDensityCorrespondence r S omega :=
      (withDensity_absolutelyContinuous mu
        (fun omega => (r omega : ENNReal))).ae_le htmemMu
    refine ⟨t, ⟨htint, htmemNu⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [integral_withDensity_eq_integral_smul hr]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [] with omega
    have hrne : (r omega : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
      exact_mod_cast (hrpos omega).ne'
    simp [NNReal.smul_def, t, smul_smul, hrne]

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_isCompact_of_integrable_envelope
statement:
theorem aumannExpectation_isCompact_of_integrable_envelope
    {Omega E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (mu : Measure Omega) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {S : Omega → Set E} (hclosed : ∀ omega, IsClosed (S omega))
    (hconv : ∀ omega, Convex ℝ (S omega))
    {g : Omega → ℝ} (hgmeas : Measurable g) (hgint : Integrable g mu)
    (hg0 : ∀ omega, 0 ≤ g omega)
    (hdom : ∀ omega, ∀ x ∈ S omega, ‖x‖ ≤ g omega) :
    IsCompact (aumannExpectation mu S)
proof:
:= by
  let h : Omega → ℝ := fun omega => 1 + g omega
  let c : ℝ := ∫ omega, h omega ∂mu
  have hhint : Integrable h mu := (integrable_const 1).add hgint
  have hhmeas : Measurable h := measurable_const.add hgmeas
  have hhpos : ∀ omega, 0 < h omega := fun omega => by
    dsimp [h]
    linarith [hg0 omega]
  have hcEq : c = 1 + ∫ omega, g omega ∂mu := by
    rw [show c = ∫ omega, (1 : ℝ) + g omega ∂mu by rfl]
    rw [integral_add (integrable_const 1) hgint, integral_const]
    simp
  have hgInt0 : 0 ≤ ∫ omega, g omega ∂mu :=
    integral_nonneg hg0
  have hcpos : 0 < c := by rw [hcEq]; linarith
  let r : Omega → NNReal := fun omega => Real.toNNReal (h omega / c)
  have hrmeas : Measurable r :=
    (hhmeas.div_const c).real_toNNReal
  have hratio0 : ∀ omega, 0 ≤ h omega / c := fun omega =>
    div_nonneg (hhpos omega).le hcpos.le
  have hrreal : ∀ omega, (r omega : ℝ) = h omega / c := fun omega => by
    exact Real.coe_toNNReal _ (hratio0 omega)
  have hrpos : ∀ omega, 0 < r omega := fun omega => by
    rw [← NNReal.coe_pos, hrreal]
    exact div_pos (hhpos omega) hcpos
  let nu : Measure Omega :=
    mu.withDensity fun omega => (r omega : ENNReal)
  have hnu : nu Set.univ = 1 := by
    change (mu.withDensity fun omega => (r omega : ENNReal)) Set.univ = 1
    rw [withDensity_apply _ MeasurableSet.univ]
    simp only [Measure.restrict_univ]
    have hratioInt : Integrable (fun omega => h omega / c) mu :=
      hhint.div_const c
    calc
      (∫⁻ omega, (r omega : ENNReal) ∂mu) =
          ∫⁻ omega, ENNReal.ofReal (h omega / c) ∂mu := by
            apply lintegral_congr
            intro omega
            calc
              (r omega : ENNReal) = ENNReal.ofReal (r omega : ℝ) := by simp
              _ = ENNReal.ofReal (h omega / c) := by rw [hrreal]
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (∫ omega, h omega / c ∂mu) :=
        (ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hratioInt
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hratio0)).symm
      _ = 1 := by
        rw [integral_div]
        simp [c, hcpos.ne']
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure nu := ⟨hnu⟩
  let T : Omega → Set E := inverseDensityCorrespondence r S
  have hTclosed : ∀ omega, IsClosed (T omega) := by
    intro omega
    have hrne : (r omega : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
      exact_mod_cast (hrpos omega).ne'
    have ha : ((r omega : ℝ)⁻¹) ≠ 0 := inv_ne_zero hrne
    simpa only [T, inverseDensityCorrespondence, Set.image_smul] using
      (hclosed omega).smul_of_ne_zero ha
  have hTconv : ∀ omega, Convex ℝ (T omega) := by
    intro omega
    simpa only [T, inverseDensityCorrespondence, Set.image_smul] using
      (hconv omega).smul ((r omega : ℝ)⁻¹)
  have hTdom : ∀ omega, ∀ x ∈ T omega, ‖x‖ ≤ c := by
    intro omega x hx
    rcases hx with ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (show 0 ≤ (r omega : ℝ) from (hrpos omega).le))]
    calc
      (r omega : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖y‖ ≤ (r omega : ℝ)⁻¹ * g omega :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hdom omega y hy) (inv_nonneg.mpr (hrpos omega).le)
      _ ≤ c := by
        rw [hrreal]
        rw [inv_div, div_mul_eq_mul_div]
        apply (div_le_iff₀ (hhpos omega)).2
        dsimp [h]
        nlinarith [hcpos, hg0 omega]
  have hcMemLp : MemLp (fun _omega : Omega => c) 2 nu :=
    memLp_const c
  have hcompactT : IsCompact (aumannExpectation nu T) :=
    aumannExpectation_isCompact_of_memLp_two_envelope
      nu hTclosed hTconv hcMemLp hTdom
  rw [← aumannExpectation_inverseDensityCorrespondence mu r hrmeas hrpos S]
  exact hcompactT

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_isCompact_of_integrable_envelope_ae
statement:
theorem aumannExpectation_isCompact_of_integrable_envelope_ae
    {Omega E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (mu : Measure Omega) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {S : Omega → Set E} (hclosed : ∀ omega, IsClosed (S omega))
    (hconv : ∀ omega, Convex ℝ (S omega))
    {g : Omega → ℝ} (hgint : Integrable g mu)
    (hg0 : ∀ omega, 0 ≤ g omega)
    (hdom : ∀ omega, ∀ x ∈ S omega, ‖x‖ ≤ g omega) :
    IsCompact (aumannExpectation mu S)
proof:
:= by
  let gm : Omega → ℝ := hgint.aestronglyMeasurable.mk g
  have hgEq : g =ᵐ[mu] gm := hgint.aestronglyMeasurable.ae_eq_mk
  have hbadNull : mu {omega | gm omega ≠ g omega} = 0 := by
    rw [← ae_iff]
    exact hgEq.symm
  obtain ⟨N, hbadN, hNmeas, hNnull⟩ :=
    exists_measurable_superset_of_null hbadNull
  let A : Set Omega := Nᶜ
  have hAmeas : MeasurableSet A := hNmeas.compl
  have hA : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, omega ∈ A := by
    rw [ae_iff]
    simpa [A] using hNnull
  have hAgood : ∀ omega ∈ A, gm omega = g omega := by
    intro omega homega
    by_contra hne
    exact homega (hbadN hne)
  let G : Omega → ℝ := fun omega => max (gm omega) 0
  have hGmeas : Measurable G :=
    hgint.aestronglyMeasurable.measurable_mk.max measurable_const
  have hgmint : Integrable gm mu := hgint.congr hgEq
  have hGint : Integrable G mu := by
    apply hgmint.norm.mono' hGmeas.aestronglyMeasurable
    filter_upwards [] with omega
    dsimp [G]
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (le_max_right (gm omega) 0)]
    exact max_le (le_abs_self _) (abs_nonneg _)
  have hG0 : ∀ omega, 0 ≤ G omega := fun omega => le_max_right _ _
  let T : Omega → Set E := correspondenceOn A S ({0} : Set E)
  have hTclosed : ∀ omega, IsClosed (T omega) :=
    correspondenceOn_isClosed (fun omega _ => hclosed omega) isClosed_singleton
  have hTconv : ∀ omega, Convex ℝ (T omega) :=
    correspondenceOn_convex (fun omega _ => hconv omega)
      (convex_singleton (0 : E))
  have hTdom : ∀ omega, ∀ x ∈ T omega, ‖x‖ ≤ G omega := by
    intro omega x hx
    by_cases homega : omega ∈ A
    · change x ∈ correspondenceOn A S ({0} : Set E) omega at hx
      rw [correspondenceOn_of_mem homega] at hx
      exact (hdom omega x hx).trans <| by
        rw [← hAgood omega homega]
        exact le_max_left _ _
    · change x ∈ correspondenceOn A S ({0} : Set E) omega at hx
      rw [correspondenceOn_of_not_mem homega] at hx
      simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
      subst x
      simpa using hG0 omega
  have hcompactT : IsCompact (aumannExpectation mu T) :=
    aumannExpectation_isCompact_of_integrable_envelope
      mu hTclosed hTconv hGmeas hGint hG0 hTdom
  rw [← aumannExpectation_correspondenceOn (S := S) (K := ({0} : Set E)) hA]
  exact hcompactT

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_isCompact_of_integrable_envelope_nonempty
statement:
theorem aumannExpectation_isCompact_of_integrable_envelope_nonempty
    {Omega E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (mu : Measure Omega) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {S : Omega → Set E} (hclosed : ∀ omega, IsClosed (S omega))
    (hconv : ∀ omega, Convex ℝ (S omega))
    (hne : ∀ omega, (S omega).Nonempty)
    {g : Omega → ℝ} (hgint : Integrable g mu)
    (hdom : ∀ omega, ∀ x ∈ S omega, ‖x‖ ≤ g omega) :
    IsCompact (aumannExpectation mu S)
proof:
:= by
  have hg0 : ∀ omega, 0 ≤ g omega := by
    intro omega
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hne omega
    exact (norm_nonneg x).trans (hdom omega x hx)
  exact aumannExpectation_isCompact_of_integrable_envelope_ae
    mu hclosed hconv hgint hg0 hdom

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_isCompact_of_atomless
statement:
theorem aumannExpectation_isCompact_of_atomless
    {Omega E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (mu : Measure Omega) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu : IsAtomlessMeasure mu)
    {S : Omega → Set E} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ omega, IsCompact (S omega))
    (hne : ∀ omega, (S omega).Nonempty)
    {g : Omega → ℝ} (hgint : Integrable g mu)
    (hdom : ∀ omega, ∀ x ∈ S omega, ‖x‖ ≤ g omega) :
    IsCompact (aumannExpectation mu S)
proof:
:= by
  let C : Omega → Set E := fun omega => closedConvexHull ℝ (S omega)
  have hCcompact : ∀ omega, IsCompact (C omega) := fun omega =>
    closedConvexHull_compact (hcompact omega)
  have hCclosed : ∀ omega, IsClosed (C omega) := fun omega =>
    (hCcompact omega).isClosed
  have hCconv : ∀ omega, Convex ℝ (C omega) := fun _ =>
    convex_closedConvexHull
  have hCne : ∀ omega, (C omega).Nonempty := fun omega =>
    (hne omega).mono subset_closedConvexHull
  have hCdom : ∀ omega, ∀ x ∈ C omega, ‖x‖ ≤ g omega := fun omega =>
    norm_le_on_closedConvexHull_of_norm_le (hdom omega)
  have hCcompactA : IsCompact (aumannExpectation mu C) :=
    aumannExpectation_isCompact_of_integrable_envelope_nonempty
      mu hCclosed hCconv hCne hgint hCdom
  have hpur : aumannExpectation mu C = aumannExpectation mu S :=
    aumannExpectation_closedConvexHull_eq_of_atomless
      mu hmu hS hcompact hne hgint hdom
  rwa [hpur] at hCcompactA

statement:
theorem aumannExpectation_isClosed_of_atomless
    {Omega E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]

statement:
theorem closure_aumannExpectation_eq_of_atomless
    {Omega E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
