name: RandomSetTheory.measurable_infDist_correspondence_joint
statement:
theorem measurable_infDist_correspondence_joint
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [MetricSpace E] [CompleteSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] [Nonempty E]
    {S : Ω → Set E} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hclosed : ∀ ω, IsClosed (S ω)) (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty) :
    Measurable (fun p : Ω × E => infDist p.2 (S p.1))
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℕ → Ω → E := castaingRepresentation hS hclosed hne
  have hf : ∀ n, Measurable (f n) :=
    castaingRepresentation_measurable hS hclosed hne
  have hclosure : ∀ ω, closure (Set.range fun n => f n ω) = S ω :=
    closure_range_castaingRepresentation hS hclosed hne
  have hEq : (fun p : Ω × E => infDist p.2 (S p.1)) =
      fun p => ⨅ n : ℕ, dist p.2 (f n p.1) := by
    funext p
    rw [← hclosure p.1, Metric.infDist_closure]
    rw [Metric.infDist_eq_iInf, iInf, iInf]
    apply congrArg sInf
    ext z
    simp only [Set.mem_range]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := y.property
      exact ⟨n, congrArg (dist p.2) hn⟩
    · rintro ⟨n, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨⟨f n p.1, ⟨n, rfl⟩⟩, rfl⟩
  rw [hEq]
  exact Measurable.iInf fun n =>
    measurable_snd.dist ((hf n).comp measurable_fst)

name: RandomSetTheory.measurableSet_correspondenceGraph
statement:
theorem measurableSet_correspondenceGraph
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [MetricSpace E] [CompleteSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] [Nonempty E]
    {S : Ω → Set E} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hclosed : ∀ ω, IsClosed (S ω)) (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty) :
    MeasurableSet (correspondenceGraph S)
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℕ → Ω → E := castaingRepresentation hS hclosed hne
  have hf : ∀ n, Measurable (f n) :=
    castaingRepresentation_measurable hS hclosed hne
  have hclosure : ∀ ω, closure (Set.range fun n => f n ω) = S ω :=
    closure_range_castaingRepresentation hS hclosed hne
  have hEq : correspondenceGraph S =
      ⋂ m : ℕ, ⋃ n : ℕ,
        {p : Ω × E | dist p.2 (f n p.1) < 1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1)} := by
    ext p
    simp only [correspondenceGraph, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_iInter,
      Set.mem_iUnion]
    rw [← hclosure p.1, Metric.mem_closure_range_iff_nat]
  rw [hEq]
  apply MeasurableSet.iInter
  intro m
  apply MeasurableSet.iUnion
  intro n
  exact (measurable_snd.dist ((hf n).comp measurable_fst)) measurableSet_Iio

name: ProbabilityTheory.conditionalValueAtRisk_finiteCoordinateSumAbsSupremum_le_rio
statement:
theorem conditionalValueAtRisk_finiteCoordinateSumAbsSupremum_le_rio
    {mu : Measure Omega} {nu : Measure Z}
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    [StandardBorelSpace Z] [Nonempty Z] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (z0 : Z) (Y : Nat → Omega → Z)
    (hY : ∀ i, Measurable (Y i)) (hIndep : iIndepFun Y mu)
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (n q : Nat) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    (W : Fin n → Z → T → ℝ) (A : Fin n → Z → ℝ)
    (hYlaw : ∀ i, i < n → mu.map (Y i) = nu)
    (hW : ∀ j t, t ∈ s → Measurable (fun z ↦ W j z t))
    (hAq : ∀ j, MemLp (A j) q nu)
    (hA : ∀ j z, 0 ≤ A j z)
    (hdom : ∀ j z t, t ∈ s → |W j z t| ≤ A j z)
    {V Q y alpha : ℝ} (hV : 0 < V) (hQ : 0 < Q) (hy : 0 < y)
    (hsecond :
      (∑ i : Fin n, replaceOneCenteredMoment nu (A i) 2) ≤ V)
    (hmomentQ :
      (∑ i : Fin n, replaceOneCenteredMoment nu (A i) q) ≤ Q)
    (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha < 1)
    (hscale : Q * Real.exp (-Real.log alpha) ≤ y ^ q) :
    conditionalValueAtRisk alpha
        (fun omega ↦
          finiteCoordinateSumAbsSupremum s hs W
              (fun j ↦ Y j omega) -
            ∫ z, finiteCoordinateSumAbsSupremum s hs W
              (fun j ↦ Y j z) ∂mu) mu ≤
      Real.sqrt (2 * V * (-Real.log alpha)) +
        (1 + 1 / (q : ℝ)) * y +
          Real.exp 1 * strongMomentQScale q Q * (-Real.log alpha) / 3 +
        alpha⁻¹ * (Q / ((q : ℝ) * y ^ (q - 1)))
proof:
:= by
  let ss : Finset (T ⊕ T) := signedFinset s
  have hss : ss.Nonempty := signedFinset_nonempty hs
  let Ws : Fin n → Z → T ⊕ T → ℝ := signedCoordinateKernel W
  have hWs : ∀ j u, u ∈ ss → Measurable (fun z ↦ Ws j z u) := by
    intro j u hu
    cases u with
    | inl t =>
        apply hW j t
        simpa only [ss, signedFinset, Finset.inl_mem_disjSum] using hu
    | inr t =>
        change Measurable (fun z ↦ -W j z t)
        apply (hW j t ?_).neg
        simpa only [ss, signedFinset, Finset.inr_mem_disjSum] using hu
  have hdomSigned : ∀ j z u, u ∈ ss → |Ws j z u| ≤ A j z := by
    intro j z u hu
    cases u with
    | inl t =>
        apply hdom j z t
        simpa only [ss, signedFinset, Finset.inl_mem_disjSum] using hu
    | inr t =>
        change |-W j z t| ≤ A j z
        rw [abs_neg]
        apply hdom j z t
        simpa only [ss, signedFinset, Finset.inr_mem_disjSum] using hu
  have hbase := conditionalValueAtRisk_finiteCoordinateSumSupremum_le_rio
    (mu := mu) (nu := nu) z0 Y hY hIndep ss hss n q hq Ws A
      hYlaw hWs hAq hA hdomSigned hV hQ hy hsecond hmomentQ
      halpha0 halpha1 hscale
  have hsup : ∀ x : Fin n → Z,
      finiteCoordinateSumSupremum ss hss Ws x =
        finiteCoordinateSumAbsSupremum s hs W x := by
    intro x
    change finiteCoordinateSumSupremum (signedFinset s) hss
        (signedCoordinateKernel W) x =
      finiteCoordinateSumAbsSupremum s hs W x
    exact finiteCoordinateSumSupremum_signedCoordinateKernel s hs W x
  simpa only [hsup] using hbase

name: RandomSetTheory.castaingLocalization_isClosed
statement:
theorem castaingLocalization_isClosed
    {Ω E : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace E]
    {S : Ω → Set E} (hclosed : ∀ ω, IsClosed (S ω))
    (q : E) (r : ℝ) (ω : Ω) :
    IsClosed (castaingLocalization S q r ω)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hhit : (S ω ∩ Metric.ball q r).Nonempty
  · rw [castaingLocalization, if_pos hhit]
    exact isClosed_closure
  · simpa [castaingLocalization, hhit] using hclosed ω

name: RandomSetTheory.castaingLocalization_nonempty
statement:
theorem castaingLocalization_nonempty
    {Ω E : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace E]
    {S : Ω → Set E} (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    (q : E) (r : ℝ) (ω : Ω) :
    (castaingLocalization S q r ω).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hhit : (S ω ∩ Metric.ball q r).Nonempty
  · rw [castaingLocalization, if_pos hhit]
    exact hhit.closure
  · simpa [castaingLocalization, hhit] using hne ω

name: RandomSetTheory.castaingLocalization_isCompact
statement:
theorem castaingLocalization_isCompact
    {Ω E : Type*} [MetricSpace E]
    {S : Ω → Set E} (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (q : E) (r : ℝ) (ω : Ω) :
    IsCompact (castaingLocalization S q r ω)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hhit : (S ω ∩ Metric.ball q r).Nonempty
  · rw [castaingLocalization, if_pos hhit]
    exact IsCompact.of_isClosed_subset (hcompact ω) isClosed_closure
      (closure_minimal inter_subset_left (hcompact ω).isClosed)
  · simpa [castaingLocalization, hhit] using hcompact ω

name: RandomSetTheory.castaingLocalization_subset
statement:
theorem castaingLocalization_subset
    {Ω E : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace E]
    {S : Ω → Set E} (hclosed : ∀ ω, IsClosed (S ω))
    (q : E) (r : ℝ) (ω : Ω) :
    castaingLocalization S q r ω ⊆ S ω
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hhit : (S ω ∩ Metric.ball q r).Nonempty
  · rw [castaingLocalization, if_pos hhit]
    exact closure_minimal inter_subset_left (hclosed ω)
  · simp [castaingLocalization, hhit]

name: RandomSetTheory.effros_castaingLocalization
statement:
theorem effros_castaingLocalization
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [MetricSpace E]
    {S : Ω → Set E} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (q : E) (r : ℝ) :
    RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable (castaingLocalization S q r)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro U hU
  let A : Set Ω := {ω | (S ω ∩ Metric.ball q r).Nonempty}
  have hA : MeasurableSet A := hS (Metric.ball q r) Metric.isOpen_ball
  have hEq :
      {ω | (castaingLocalization S q r ω ∩ U).Nonempty} =
        (A ∩ {ω | (S ω ∩ (Metric.ball q r ∩ U)).Nonempty}) ∪
          (Aᶜ ∩ {ω | (S ω ∩ U).Nonempty}) := by
    ext ω
    by_cases hhit : (S ω ∩ Metric.ball q r).Nonempty
    · simp [A, castaingLocalization, hhit,
        closure_inter_open_nonempty_iff hU, inter_assoc]
    · simp [A, castaingLocalization, hhit]
  rw [hEq]
  exact (hA.inter
      (hS (Metric.ball q r ∩ U) (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter hU))).union
    (hA.compl.inter (hS U hU))

name: RandomSetTheory.castaingRepresentation_measurable
statement:
theorem castaingRepresentation_measurable
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [MetricSpace E] [CompleteSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] [Nonempty E]
    {S : Ω → Set E} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hclosed : ∀ ω, IsClosed (S ω)) (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    (n : ℕ) : Measurable (castaingRepresentation hS hclosed hne n)
proof:
:= by
  let p := Nat.unpair n
  exact (kuratowski_ryll_nardzewski
    (effros_castaingLocalization hS (denseSeq E p.1) (1 / (p.2 + 1 : ℝ)))
    (castaingLocalization_isClosed hclosed
      (denseSeq E p.1) (1 / (p.2 + 1 : ℝ)))
    (castaingLocalization_nonempty hne
      (denseSeq E p.1) (1 / (p.2 + 1 : ℝ)))).1

name: RandomSetTheory.castaingRepresentation_mem
statement:
theorem castaingRepresentation_mem
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [MetricSpace E] [CompleteSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] [Nonempty E]
    {S : Ω → Set E} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hclosed : ∀ ω, IsClosed (S ω)) (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) : castaingRepresentation hS hclosed hne n ω ∈ S ω
proof:
:= by
  let p := Nat.unpair n
  have hloc := (kuratowski_ryll_nardzewski
    (effros_castaingLocalization hS (denseSeq E p.1) (1 / (p.2 + 1 : ℝ)))
    (castaingLocalization_isClosed hclosed
      (denseSeq E p.1) (1 / (p.2 + 1 : ℝ)))
    (castaingLocalization_nonempty hne
      (denseSeq E p.1) (1 / (p.2 + 1 : ℝ)))).2 ω
  exact castaingLocalization_subset hclosed
    (denseSeq E p.1) (1 / (p.2 + 1 : ℝ)) ω hloc

name: RandomSetTheory.closure_range_castaingRepresentation
statement:
theorem closure_range_castaingRepresentation
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [MetricSpace E] [CompleteSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] [Nonempty E]
    {S : Ω → Set E} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hclosed : ∀ ω, IsClosed (S ω)) (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    (ω : Ω) :
    closure (Set.range fun n => castaingRepresentation hS hclosed hne n ω) = S ω
proof:
:= by
  apply Subset.antisymm
  · apply closure_minimal _ (hclosed ω)
    rintro _ ⟨n, rfl⟩
    exact castaingRepresentation_mem hS hclosed hne n ω
  · intro x hx
    rw [Metric.mem_closure_range_iff]
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_nat_one_div_lt (half_pos hε)
    let r : ℝ := 1 / (m + 1 : ℝ)
    have hr : 0 < r := by positivity
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (denseRange_denseSeq E).exists_dist_lt x hr
    let n := Nat.pair k m
    refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
    have hhit : (S ω ∩ Metric.ball (denseSeq E k) r).Nonempty := by
      refine ⟨x, hx, ?_⟩
      simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm] using hk
    have hzloc := (kuratowski_ryll_nardzewski
      (effros_castaingLocalization hS (denseSeq E k) r)
      (castaingLocalization_isClosed hclosed (denseSeq E k) r)
      (castaingLocalization_nonempty hne (denseSeq E k) r)).2 ω
    have hzloc' :
        krnSelection
            (effros_castaingLocalization hS (denseSeq E k) r)
            (castaingLocalization_nonempty hne (denseSeq E k) r) ω ∈
          closure (S ω ∩ Metric.ball (denseSeq E k) r) := by
      rw [castaingLocalization, if_pos hhit] at hzloc
      exact hzloc
    have hzclosure :
        castaingLocalSelection hS hclosed hne k m ω ∈
          closure (S ω ∩ Metric.ball (denseSeq E k) r) := by
      simpa [castaingLocalSelection, r] using hzloc'
    have hzball :
        castaingLocalSelection hS hclosed hne k m ω ∈
          Metric.closedBall (denseSeq E k) r :=
      closure_minimal
        (inter_subset_right.trans Metric.ball_subset_closedBall)
        Metric.isClosed_closedBall hzclosure
    have hrepr :
        castaingRepresentation hS hclosed hne n ω =
          castaingLocalSelection hS hclosed hne k m ω := by
      simp [n, castaingRepresentation]
    rw [hrepr]
    calc
      dist x (castaingLocalSelection hS hclosed hne k m ω) ≤
          dist x (denseSeq E k) +
            dist (denseSeq E k) (castaingLocalSelection hS hclosed hne k m ω) :=
        dist_triangle _ _ _
      _ < r + r := add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le hk
        (by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_comm] using hzball)
      _ < ε := by
        dsimp [r] at hm ⊢
        linarith

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_castaingRepresentation
statement:
theorem exists_castaingRepresentation
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [MetricSpace E] [CompleteSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] [Nonempty E]
    {S : Ω → Set E} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hclosed : ∀ ω, IsClosed (S ω)) (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty) :
    ∃ f : ℕ → Ω → E,
      (∀ n, Measurable (f n)) ∧
        (∀ n ω, f n ω ∈ S ω) ∧
          ∀ ω, closure (Set.range fun n => f n ω) = S ω
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨castaingRepresentation hS hclosed hne,
    castaingRepresentation_measurable hS hclosed hne,
    castaingRepresentation_mem hS hclosed hne,
    closure_range_castaingRepresentation hS hclosed hne⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.effrosMeasurable_of_closure_range
statement:
theorem effrosMeasurable_of_closure_range
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [TopologicalSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {S : Ω → Set E} {f : ℕ → Ω → E}
    (hf : ∀ n, Measurable (f n))
    (hclosure : ∀ ω, closure (Set.range fun n => f n ω) = S ω) :
    RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S
proof:
:= by
  intro U hU
  have hEq : {ω | (S ω ∩ U).Nonempty} = ⋃ n : ℕ, f n ⁻¹' U := by
    ext ω
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_preimage]
    rw [← hclosure ω, closure_inter_open_nonempty_iff hU]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, ⟨n, rfl⟩, hUmem⟩
      exact ⟨n, hUmem⟩
    · rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
      exact ⟨f n ω, ⟨n, rfl⟩, hn⟩
  rw [hEq]
  exact MeasurableSet.iUnion fun n => hf n hU.measurableSet

name: RandomSetTheory.effrosMeasurable_iff_exists_castaing
statement:
theorem effrosMeasurable_iff_exists_castaing
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [MetricSpace E] [CompleteSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] [Nonempty E]
    {S : Ω → Set E} (hclosed : ∀ ω, IsClosed (S ω))
    (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty) :
    RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S ↔
      ∃ f : ℕ → Ω → E,
        (∀ n, Measurable (f n)) ∧
          (∀ n ω, f n ω ∈ S ω) ∧
            ∀ ω, closure (Set.range fun n => f n ω) = S ω
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hS
    exact exists_castaingRepresentation hS hclosed hne
  · rintro ⟨f, hf, -, hclosure⟩
    exact effrosMeasurable_of_closure_range hf hclosure

name: ProbabilityTheory.strictPrefixFiltration_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem strictPrefixFiltration_zero
    (Y : Nat -> Omega -> Z) (hY : forall i, Measurable (Y i)) :
    strictPrefixFiltration Y hY 0 = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  simp [strictPrefixFiltration]

name: ProbabilityTheory.strictPrefixFiltration_eq_comap
statement:
theorem strictPrefixFiltration_eq_comap
    (Y : Nat -> Omega -> Z) (hY : forall i, Measurable (Y i)) (i : Nat) :
    strictPrefixFiltration Y hY i =
      MeasurableSpace.comap (fun omega (j : Fin i) => Y j omega)
        inferInstance
proof:
:= by
  rw [strictPrefixFiltration, MeasurableSpace.comap_process_pi]

name: ProbabilityTheory.measurable_strictPrefix
statement:
theorem measurable_strictPrefix
    (Y : Nat -> Omega -> Z) (hY : forall i, Measurable (Y i)) (i : Nat) :
    Measurable (fun omega (j : Fin i) => Y j omega)
proof:
:= by
  exact measurable_pi_lambda _ fun j => hY j

name: ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun.indepFun_strictPrefix
statement:
theorem iIndepFun.indepFun_strictPrefix
    {mu : Measure Omega} (Y : Nat -> Omega -> Z)
    (hIndep : iIndepFun Y mu) (hY : forall i, Measurable (Y i)) (i : Nat) :
    IndepFun (fun omega (j : Fin i) => Y j omega) (Y i) mu
proof:
:= by
  let S : Finset Nat := Finset.range i
  let T : Finset Nat := {i}
  have hdisjoint : Disjoint S T := by
    simp [S, T]
  have hfinite := hIndep.indepFun_finset S T hdisjoint hY
  let leftMap : (S -> Z) -> (Fin i -> Z) := fun values j =>
    values ⟨j, Finset.mem_range.mpr j.isLt⟩
  let rightMap : (T -> Z) -> Z := fun values =>
    values ⟨i, Finset.mem_singleton_self i⟩
  have hleft : Measurable leftMap := by fun_prop
  have hright : Measurable rightMap := by fun_prop
  have hcomp := hfinite.comp hleft hright
  convert hcomp using 1
  · funext omega j
    rfl
  · funext omega
    rfl

name: ProbabilityTheory.measurable_paddedStrictPrefix
statement:
theorem measurable_paddedStrictPrefix
    (z0 : Z) (Y : Nat -> Omega -> Z)
    (hY : forall i, Measurable (Y i)) (i : Nat) :
    Measurable (paddedStrictPrefix z0 Y i)
proof:
:= by
  apply measurable_pi_lambda
  intro j
  by_cases hj : j < i
  · simpa [paddedStrictPrefix, hj] using hY j
  · simp [paddedStrictPrefix, hj]

name: ProbabilityTheory.strictPrefixFiltration_eq_comap_paddedStrictPrefix
statement:
theorem strictPrefixFiltration_eq_comap_paddedStrictPrefix
    (z0 : Z) (Y : Nat -> Omega -> Z)
    (hY : forall i, Measurable (Y i)) (i : Nat) :
    strictPrefixFiltration Y hY i =
      MeasurableSpace.comap (paddedStrictPrefix z0 Y i) inferInstance
proof:
:= by
  change (⨆ j : Fin i, MeasurableSpace.comap (Y j) inferInstance) = _
  rw [MeasurableSpace.comap_process_pi]
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply iSup_le
    intro j
    apply le_iSup_of_le (j : Nat)
    simp [paddedStrictPrefix, j.isLt]
  · apply iSup_le
    intro j
    by_cases hj : j < i
    · simp only [paddedStrictPrefix, dif_pos hj]
      exact le_iSup
        (fun r : Fin i ↦ MeasurableSpace.comap (Y r) inferInstance)
        (⟨j, hj⟩ : Fin i)
    · simp [paddedStrictPrefix, hj]

name: ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun.indepFun_paddedStrictPrefix
statement:
theorem iIndepFun.indepFun_paddedStrictPrefix
    {mu : Measure Omega} (z0 : Z) (Y : Nat -> Omega -> Z)
    (hIndep : iIndepFun Y mu) (hY : forall i, Measurable (Y i)) (i : Nat) :
    IndepFun (paddedStrictPrefix z0 Y i) (Y i) mu
proof:
:= by
  have hprefix := hIndep.indepFun_strictPrefix Y hY i
  let extendPrefix : (Fin i -> Z) -> (Nat -> Z) := fun values j =>
    if h : j < i then values ⟨j, h⟩ else z0
  have hextend : Measurable extendPrefix := by
    apply measurable_pi_lambda
    intro j
    by_cases hj : j < i
    · simpa [extendPrefix, hj] using
        (measurable_pi_apply (⟨j, hj⟩ : Fin i))
    · simp [extendPrefix, hj]
  have hcomp := hprefix.comp hextend measurable_id
  convert hcomp using 1
  · funext omega j
    by_cases hj : j < i <;> simp [extendPrefix, paddedStrictPrefix, hj]
  · rfl

name: ProbabilityTheory.measurable_insertCurrentIntoPaddedPrefix
statement:
theorem measurable_insertCurrentIntoPaddedPrefix (z0 : Z) (i : Nat) :
    Measurable (insertCurrentIntoPaddedPrefix z0 i)
proof:
:= by
  apply measurable_pi_lambda
  intro j
  by_cases hlt : j < i
  · simp only [insertCurrentIntoPaddedPrefix, dif_pos hlt]
    exact (measurable_pi_apply j).comp measurable_fst
  · by_cases heq : j = i
    · simp only [insertCurrentIntoPaddedPrefix, dif_neg hlt, if_pos heq]
      exact measurable_snd
    · simp only [insertCurrentIntoPaddedPrefix, dif_neg hlt, if_neg heq]
      exact measurable_const

name: ProbabilityTheory.insertCurrentIntoPaddedPrefix_comp
statement:
theorem insertCurrentIntoPaddedPrefix_comp
    (z0 : Z) (Y : Nat -> Omega -> Z) (i : Nat) (omega : Omega) :
    insertCurrentIntoPaddedPrefix z0 i
        (paddedStrictPrefix z0 Y i omega, Y i omega) =
      paddedStrictPrefix z0 Y (i + 1) omega
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  by_cases hlt : j < i
  · simp [insertCurrentIntoPaddedPrefix, paddedStrictPrefix, hlt,
      hlt.trans (Nat.lt_succ_self i)]
  · by_cases heq : j = i
    · subst j
      simp [insertCurrentIntoPaddedPrefix, paddedStrictPrefix]
    · have hgt : i < j := by omega
      have hnlt : ¬j < i + 1 := by omega
      simp [insertCurrentIntoPaddedPrefix, paddedStrictPrefix, hlt, heq, hnlt]

name: ProbabilityTheory.exists_stronglyMeasurable_nextPrefixValueFiber
statement:
theorem exists_stronglyMeasurable_nextPrefixValueFiber
    {mu : Measure Omega} (z0 : Z) (Y : Nat -> Omega -> Z)
    (hY : ∀ i, Measurable (Y i)) (F : Omega -> Real) (i : Nat) :
    ∃ G : (Nat -> Z) -> Z -> Real,
      StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry G) ∧
      mu[F | strictPrefixFiltration Y hY (i + 1)] =ᵐ[mu]
        fun omega => G (paddedStrictPrefix z0 Y i omega) (Y i omega)
proof:
:= by
  let Pnext : Omega -> (Nat -> Z) := paddedStrictPrefix z0 Y (i + 1)
  have hcond : StronglyMeasurable[MeasurableSpace.comap Pnext inferInstance]
      mu[F | strictPrefixFiltration Y hY (i + 1)] := by
    rw [← strictPrefixFiltration_eq_comap_paddedStrictPrefix
      z0 Y hY (i + 1)]
    exact stronglyMeasurable_condExp
  obtain ⟨H, hH, hfactor⟩ := hcond.exists_eq_measurable_comp
  let G : (Nat -> Z) -> Z -> Real := fun past current =>
    H (insertCurrentIntoPaddedPrefix z0 i (past, current))
  refine ⟨G, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact hH.comp_measurable (measurable_insertCurrentIntoPaddedPrefix z0 i)
  · rw [hfactor]
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun omega => by
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, G, Pnext]
      rw [insertCurrentIntoPaddedPrefix_comp]

name: RandomSetTheory.measurable_supportFunction_joint
statement:
theorem measurable_supportFunction_joint
    {Ω H : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H] [Nonempty H]
    {S : Ω → Set H} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω)) (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty) :
    Measurable (fun p : Ω × H => supportFunction (S p.1) p.2)
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℕ → Ω → H :=
    castaingRepresentation hS (fun ω => (hcompact ω).isClosed) hne
  have hf : ∀ n, Measurable (f n) :=
    castaingRepresentation_measurable hS (fun ω => (hcompact ω).isClosed) hne
  have hfmem : ∀ n ω, f n ω ∈ S ω :=
    castaingRepresentation_mem hS (fun ω => (hcompact ω).isClosed) hne
  have hclosure : ∀ ω, closure (Set.range fun n => f n ω) = S ω :=
    closure_range_castaingRepresentation hS (fun ω => (hcompact ω).isClosed) hne
  have hEq : (fun p : Ω × H => supportFunction (S p.1) p.2) =
      fun p => ⨆ n : ℕ, ⟪p.2, f n p.1⟫_ℝ := by
    funext p
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxmax⟩ :=
      supportFunction_attains (hcompact p.1) (hne p.1) p.2
    have hupper : ∀ n, ⟪p.2, f n p.1⟫_ℝ ≤ supportFunction (S p.1) p.2 :=
      fun n => inner_le_supportFunction (hcompact p.1) (hfmem n p.1) p.2
    have hbdd : BddAbove (Set.range fun n => ⟪p.2, f n p.1⟫_ℝ) :=
      ⟨supportFunction (S p.1) p.2, Set.forall_mem_range.mpr hupper⟩
    rw [hxmax]
    apply le_antisymm
    · have hxclosure : x ∈ closure (Set.range fun n => f n p.1) := by
        rw [hclosure p.1]
        exact hx
      exact closure_minimal
        (by
          rintro _ ⟨n, rfl⟩
          exact le_ciSup hbdd n)
        (isClosed_le (by fun_prop : Continuous fun y : H => ⟪p.2, y⟫_ℝ)
          continuous_const) hxclosure
    · exact ciSup_le fun n => by simpa [hxmax] using hupper n
  rw [hEq]
  exact Measurable.iSup fun n =>
    measurable_snd.inner ((hf n).comp measurable_fst)

name: ProbabilityTheory.centeredProcessEnvelope_nonneg
statement:
theorem centeredProcessEnvelope_nonneg
    (A : Omega → ℝ) (mu : Measure Omega) (omega : Omega) :
    0 ≤ centeredProcessEnvelope A mu omega
proof:
:= by
  unfold centeredProcessEnvelope
  exact add_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (integral_nonneg fun _ ↦ abs_nonneg _)

name: ProbabilityTheory.abs_centeredProcess_le_centeredProcessEnvelope
statement:
theorem abs_centeredProcess_le_centeredProcessEnvelope
    (X : Omega → T → ℝ) (A : Omega → ℝ)
    (hA : Integrable A mu)
    (hX : ∀ t, AEMeasurable (fun omega ↦ X omega t) mu)
    (hdom : ∀ omega t, |X omega t| ≤ |A omega|)
    (omega : Omega) (t : T) :
    |centeredProcess X mu omega t| ≤ centeredProcessEnvelope A mu omega
proof:
:= by
  have hXt : Integrable (fun z ↦ X z t) mu := by
    apply hA.norm.mono' (hX t).aestronglyMeasurable
    filter_upwards with z
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hdom z t
  have hmean : |∫ z, X z t ∂mu| ≤ ∫ z, |A z| ∂mu := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      (norm_integral_le_of_norm_le (f := fun z ↦ X z t) hA.norm
        (ae_of_all mu fun z ↦ by
          simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hdom z t))
  calc
    |centeredProcess X mu omega t| =
        |X omega t - ∫ z, X z t ∂mu| := rfl
    _ ≤ |X omega t| + |∫ z, X z t ∂mu| := abs_sub _ _
    _ ≤ |A omega| + ∫ z, |A z| ∂mu := add_le_add (hdom omega t) hmean
    _ = centeredProcessEnvelope A mu omega := rfl

name: ProbabilityTheory.lpNorm_one_le_lpNorm_nat
statement:
theorem lpNorm_one_le_lpNorm_nat
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (A : Omega → ℝ) {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hAq : MemLp A q mu) :
    lpNorm A 1 mu ≤ lpNorm A q mu
proof:
:= by
  have hpq : (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ (q : ℝ≥0∞) := by
    exact_mod_cast hq
  have hle : eLpNorm A 1 mu ≤ eLpNorm A q mu :=
    eLpNorm_le_eLpNorm_of_exponent_le hpq hAq.aestronglyMeasurable
  have hreal := ENNReal.toReal_mono hAq.eLpNorm_ne_top hle
  simpa only [toReal_eLpNorm hAq.aestronglyMeasurable] using hreal

name: ProbabilityTheory.integral_abs_le_lpNorm_nat
statement:
theorem integral_abs_le_lpNorm_nat
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (A : Omega → ℝ) {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hAq : MemLp A q mu) :
    ∫ omega, |A omega| ∂mu ≤ lpNorm A q mu
proof:
:= by
  have hqone : (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ (q : ℝ≥0∞) := by
    exact_mod_cast hq
  have hAone : MemLp A 1 mu := hAq.mono_exponent hqone
  calc
    ∫ omega, |A omega| ∂mu = lpNorm A 1 mu := by
      rw [lpNorm_one_eq_integral_norm hAone.aestronglyMeasurable]
      simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    _ ≤ lpNorm A q mu := lpNorm_one_le_lpNorm_nat A hq hAq

name: ProbabilityTheory.lpNorm_centeredProcessEnvelope_le_two_mul
statement:
theorem lpNorm_centeredProcessEnvelope_le_two_mul
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (A : Omega → ℝ) {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hAq : MemLp A q mu) :
    lpNorm (centeredProcessEnvelope A mu) q mu ≤
      2 * lpNorm A q mu
proof:
:= by
  let m : ℝ := ∫ z, |A z| ∂mu
  have hq0 : (q : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_zero_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one hq))
  have hsum : MemLp
      (fun omega ↦ |A omega| + m) q mu :=
    hAq.norm.add (memLp_const m)
  have htri :
      lpNorm (fun omega ↦ |A omega| + m) q mu ≤
        lpNorm (fun omega ↦ |A omega|) q mu +
          lpNorm (fun _ : Omega ↦ m) q mu :=
    lpNorm_add_le hAq.norm (by exact_mod_cast hq)
  have hm : m ≤ lpNorm A q mu := by
    exact integral_abs_le_lpNorm_nat A hq hAq
  have hconst : lpNorm (fun _ : Omega ↦ m) q mu = |m| := by
    rw [lpNorm_const hq0 (IsProbabilityMeasure.ne_zero mu) m]
    simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, probReal_univ, one_rpow, mul_one]
  have hmnonneg : 0 ≤ m := integral_nonneg fun _ ↦ abs_nonneg _
  change lpNorm (fun omega ↦ |A omega| + m) q mu ≤
    2 * lpNorm A q mu
  calc
    lpNorm (fun omega ↦ |A omega| + m) q mu ≤
        lpNorm (fun omega ↦ |A omega|) q mu +
          lpNorm (fun _ : Omega ↦ m) q mu := htri
    _ = lpNorm A q mu + m := by
      rw [lpNorm_fun_abs hAq.aestronglyMeasurable, hconst,
        abs_of_nonneg hmnonneg]
    _ ≤ lpNorm A q mu + lpNorm A q mu := add_le_add le_rfl hm
    _ = 2 * lpNorm A q mu := by ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.memLp_centeredProcessEnvelope
statement:
theorem memLp_centeredProcessEnvelope
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (A : Omega → ℝ) {q : ℕ} (hAq : MemLp A q mu) :
    MemLp (centeredProcessEnvelope A mu) q mu
proof:
:= by
  unfold centeredProcessEnvelope
  exact hAq.norm.add (memLp_const (∫ z, |A z| ∂mu))

name: ProbabilityTheory.absoluteMoment_eq_lpNorm_pow
statement:
theorem absoluteMoment_eq_lpNorm_pow
    (A : Omega → ℝ) {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hAq : MemLp A q mu) :
    absoluteMoment A q mu = lpNorm A q mu ^ q
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 : (q : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hq.ne'
  have hqtop : (q : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ∞ := by simp
  have hmoment : 0 ≤ absoluteMoment A q mu := absoluteMoment_nonneg A q mu
  have hlp : lpNorm A q mu = (absoluteMoment A q mu) ^ ((q : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
    rw [lpNorm_eq_integral_norm_rpow_toReal hq0 hqtop hAq.aestronglyMeasurable]
    simp only [ENNReal.toReal_natCast, Real.rpow_natCast, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      absoluteMoment]
  rw [hlp]
  exact (Real.rpow_inv_natCast_pow hmoment hq.ne').symm

name: ProbabilityTheory.absoluteMoment_centeredProcessEnvelope_le
statement:
theorem absoluteMoment_centeredProcessEnvelope_le
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (A : Omega → ℝ) {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hAq : MemLp A q mu) {K : ℝ} (_hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hAnorm : lpNorm A q mu ≤ K) :
    absoluteMoment (centeredProcessEnvelope A mu) q mu ≤ (2 * K) ^ q
proof:
:= by
  have hqpos : 0 < q := lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one hq
  have hcenterMem := memLp_centeredProcessEnvelope A hAq
  rw [absoluteMoment_eq_lpNorm_pow _ hqpos hcenterMem]
  exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (lpNorm_nonneg)
    ((lpNorm_centeredProcessEnvelope_le_two_mul A hq hAq).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hAnorm (by norm_num))) q

name: ProbabilityTheory.absoluteMoment_centeredProcess_two_le
statement:
theorem absoluteMoment_centeredProcess_two_le
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : Omega → T → ℝ) (A : Omega → ℝ)
    (hA2 : MemLp A 2 mu)
    (hX : ∀ t, AEMeasurable (fun omega ↦ X omega t) mu)
    (hdom : ∀ omega t, |X omega t| ≤ |A omega|)
    {K2 : ℝ} (hK2 : 0 ≤ K2) (hAnorm : lpNorm A 2 mu ≤ K2)
    (t : T) :
    absoluteMoment (centeredProcess X mu · t) 2 mu ≤ (2 * K2) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have _K2_nonneg : 0 ≤ K2 := hK2
  have hAint : Integrable A mu := hA2.integrable (by norm_num)
  have hcenterMem := memLp_centeredProcessEnvelope A hA2
  have hcoordMeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (centeredProcess X mu · t) mu := by
    exact (hX t).aestronglyMeasurable.sub aestronglyMeasurable_const
  have hcoordMem : MemLp (centeredProcess X mu · t) 2 mu :=
    hcenterMem.mono' hcoordMeas (ae_of_all mu fun omega ↦ by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_nonneg (centeredProcessEnvelope_nonneg A mu omega)] using
        abs_centeredProcess_le_centeredProcessEnvelope X A hAint hX hdom omega t)
  rw [absoluteMoment_eq_lpNorm_pow _ (by norm_num) hcoordMem]
  have hlp : lpNorm (centeredProcess X mu · t) 2 mu ≤
      lpNorm (centeredProcessEnvelope A mu) 2 mu := by
    apply lpNorm_mono_real hcenterMem
    intro omega
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (centeredProcessEnvelope_nonneg A mu omega)] using
      abs_centeredProcess_le_centeredProcessEnvelope X A hAint hX hdom omega t
  exact pow_le_pow_left₀ lpNorm_nonneg
    (hlp.trans ((lpNorm_centeredProcessEnvelope_le_two_mul A (by norm_num) hA2).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hAnorm (by norm_num)))) 2

name: ProbabilityTheory.absoluteMoment_auxiliary_le_sixteen_mul_sq
statement:
theorem absoluteMoment_auxiliary_le_sixteen_mul_sq
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (A zeta : Omega → ℝ)
    (hA2 : MemLp A 2 mu) (hzeta : AEMeasurable zeta mu)
    (hdom : ∀ omega, |zeta omega| ≤
      2 * centeredProcessEnvelope A mu omega)
    {K2 : ℝ} (_hK2 : 0 ≤ K2) (hAnorm : lpNorm A 2 mu ≤ K2) :
    absoluteMoment zeta 2 mu ≤ 16 * K2 ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let B : Omega → ℝ := centeredProcessEnvelope A mu
  have hBMem : MemLp B 2 mu := memLp_centeredProcessEnvelope A hA2
  have htwoBMem : MemLp (fun omega ↦ 2 * B omega) 2 mu :=
    hBMem.const_mul 2
  have hzetaMem : MemLp zeta 2 mu := by
    apply htwoBMem.mono' hzeta.aestronglyMeasurable
    filter_upwards with omega
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact hdom omega
  have hlp : lpNorm zeta 2 mu ≤
      lpNorm (fun omega ↦ 2 * B omega) 2 mu := by
    apply lpNorm_mono_real htwoBMem
    intro omega
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact hdom omega
  have hscaled : lpNorm (fun omega ↦ 2 * B omega) 2 mu =
      2 * lpNorm B 2 mu := by
    change lpNorm (2 * B) 2 mu = 2 * lpNorm B 2 mu
    exact lpNorm_natCast_mul 2 B 2 mu
  have hfour : lpNorm zeta 2 mu ≤ 4 * K2 := by
    calc
      lpNorm zeta 2 mu ≤ lpNorm (fun omega ↦ 2 * B omega) 2 mu := hlp
      _ = 2 * lpNorm B 2 mu := hscaled
      _ ≤ 2 * (2 * lpNorm A 2 mu) := by
        gcongr
        exact lpNorm_centeredProcessEnvelope_le_two_mul A (by norm_num) hA2
      _ ≤ 2 * (2 * K2) := by gcongr
      _ = 4 * K2 := by ring
  rw [absoluteMoment_eq_lpNorm_pow zeta (by norm_num) hzetaMem]
  calc
    lpNorm zeta 2 mu ^ 2 ≤ (4 * K2) ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ lpNorm_nonneg hfour 2
    _ = 16 * K2 ^ 2 := by ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.averageAbsoluteSecondMoment_le_sixteen_mul_sq
statement:
theorem averageAbsoluteSecondMoment_le_sixteen_mul_sq
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (zeta : Fin n → Omega → ℝ)
    {K2 : ℝ}
    (hzeta : ∀ i, absoluteMoment (zeta i) 2 mu ≤ 16 * K2 ^ 2) :
    averageAbsoluteSecondMoment zeta mu ≤ 16 * K2 ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hnreal : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  unfold averageAbsoluteSecondMoment
  rw [div_le_iff₀ hnreal]
  calc
    ∑ i : Fin n, absoluteMoment (zeta i) 2 mu ≤
        ∑ _i : Fin n, 16 * K2 ^ 2 := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ ↦ hzeta i
    _ = (n : ℝ) * (16 * K2 ^ 2) := by simp [mul_comm]
    _ = (16 * K2 ^ 2) * (n : ℝ) := by ring

name: RandomSetTheory.IsIntegrableSelection.exists_lift_continuousLinearMap
statement:
theorem IsIntegrableSelection.exists_lift_continuousLinearMap
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S : Ω → Set E} {v : Ω → F}
    (L : E →L[ℝ] F)
    (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    {g : Ω → ℝ} (hg : Integrable g μ)
    (hdom : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∀ x ∈ S ω, ‖x‖ ≤ g ω)
    (hv : IsIntegrableSelection μ (fun ω => L '' S ω) v) :
    ∃ f : Ω → E, IsIntegrableSelection μ S f ∧
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, L (f ω) = v ω
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, _, hLf⟩ :=
    hv.exists_lift_caratheodory_image
      hS hcompact hne
      (L.measurable.comp measurable_snd) (fun _ => L.continuous)
      hg hdom
  exact ⟨f, hf, hLf⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_image_continuousLinearMap
statement:
theorem aumannExpectation_image_continuousLinearMap
    [CompleteSpace F]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S : Ω → Set E}
    (L : E →L[ℝ] F)
    (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    {g : Ω → ℝ} (hg : Integrable g μ)
    (hdom : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∀ x ∈ S ω, ‖x‖ ≤ g ω) :
    aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => L '' S ω) =
      L '' aumannExpectation μ S
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · rintro y ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hLf⟩ :=
      hv.exists_lift_continuousLinearMap L hS hcompact hne hg hdom
    refine ⟨∫ ω, f ω ∂μ, ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    calc
      L (∫ ω, f ω ∂μ) = ∫ ω, L (f ω) ∂μ :=
        (L.integral_comp_comm hf.1).symm
      _ = ∫ ω, v ω ∂μ := integral_congr_ae hLf
  · exact image_aumannExpectation_subset_aumannExpectation_image L

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_affine_image_continuousLinearMap
statement:
theorem aumannExpectation_affine_image_continuousLinearMap
    [CompleteSpace F]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S : Ω → Set E} {b : Ω → F}
    (L : E →L[ℝ] F)
    (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    {g : Ω → ℝ} (hg : Integrable g μ)
    (hdom : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∀ x ∈ S ω, ‖x‖ ≤ g ω)
    (hb : Integrable b μ) :
    aumannExpectation μ
        (fun ω => (fun x => L x + b ω) '' S ω) =
      (fun x => L x + ∫ ω, b ω ∂μ) '' aumannExpectation μ S
proof:
:= by
  have himage :
      (fun ω => (fun x => L x + b ω) '' S ω) =
        (fun ω => L '' S ω + ({b ω} : Set F)) := by
    funext ω
    ext y
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨L x, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, b ω, Set.mem_singleton _, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨z, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, t, ht, hzt⟩
      simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at ht
      subst t
      exact ⟨x, hx, hzt⟩
  rw [himage, aumannExpectation_add_singleton hb,
    aumannExpectation_image_continuousLinearMap L hS hcompact hne hg hdom]
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, t, ht, hzt⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at ht
    subst t
    exact ⟨x, hx, hzt⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨L x, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, ∫ ω, b ω ∂μ,
      Set.mem_singleton _, rfl⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.closure_image_closure_aumannExpectation_continuousLinearMap
statement:
theorem closure_image_closure_aumannExpectation_continuousLinearMap
    [CompleteSpace F]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S : Ω → Set E}
    (L : E →L[ℝ] F)
    (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    {g : Ω → ℝ} (hg : Integrable g μ)
    (hdom : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∀ x ∈ S ω, ‖x‖ ≤ g ω) :
    closure (L '' closure (aumannExpectation μ S)) =
      closure (aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => L '' S ω))
proof:
:= by
  rw [aumannExpectation_image_continuousLinearMap L hS hcompact hne hg hdom]
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · apply closure_minimal
    · exact image_closure_subset_closure_image L.continuous
    · exact isClosed_closure
  · exact closure_mono (Set.image_mono subset_closure)

name: RandomSetTheory.closedConvexHull_image_closedConvexHull_aumannExpectation_continuousLinearMap
statement:
theorem closedConvexHull_image_closedConvexHull_aumannExpectation_continuousLinearMap
    [CompleteSpace F]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S : Ω → Set E}
    (L : E →L[ℝ] F)
    (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    {g : Ω → ℝ} (hg : Integrable g μ)
    (hdom : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∀ x ∈ S ω, ‖x‖ ≤ g ω) :
    closedConvexHull ℝ
        (L '' closedConvexHull ℝ (aumannExpectation μ S)) =
      closedConvexHull ℝ
        (aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => L '' S ω))
proof:
:= by
  have hEq :=
    aumannExpectation_image_continuousLinearMap L hS hcompact hne hg hdom
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · apply closedConvexHull_min
    · exact image_closedConvexHull_aumannExpectation_subset L
    · exact convex_closedConvexHull
    · exact isClosed_closedConvexHull
  · rw [hEq]
    apply closedConvexHull_min
    · rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      apply subset_closedConvexHull (𝕜 := ℝ)
      exact ⟨x, subset_closedConvexHull (𝕜 := ℝ) hx, rfl⟩
    · exact convex_closedConvexHull
    · exact isClosed_closedConvexHull

name: ProbabilityTheory.integral_le_add_of_shifted_exponential_tail
statement:
theorem integral_le_add_of_shifted_exponential_tail
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (S : Omega → ℝ) (hS : Integrable S mu)
    {A b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (htail : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x →
      mu.real {omega | A + b * x < S omega} ≤ Real.exp (-x)) :
    (∫ omega, S omega ∂mu) ≤ A + b
proof:
:= by
  let R : Omega → ℝ := fun omega ↦ max (S omega - A) 0
  have hR : Integrable R mu := by
    exact (hS.sub (integrable_const A)).sup (integrable_const 0)
  have hRnonneg : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, 0 ≤ R omega :=
    ae_of_all mu fun omega ↦ le_max_right _ _
  have hpoint : ∀ omega, S omega ≤ A + R omega := by
    intro omega
    dsimp only [R]
    have hmax := le_max_left (S omega - A) 0
    linarith
  have hSle : (∫ omega, S omega ∂mu) ≤
      ∫ omega, A + R omega ∂mu := by
    exact integral_mono hS ((integrable_const A).add hR) hpoint
  have htailR : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t →
      mu.real {omega | t < R omega} ≤ Real.exp (-b⁻¹ * t) := by
    intro t ht
    have hx : 0 ≤ t / b := (div_pos ht hb).le
    have hbase := htail (t / b) hx
    have hevent : {omega | t < R omega} =
        {omega | A + b * (t / b) < S omega} := by
      ext omega
      simp only [R, lt_max_iff, not_lt_of_ge ht.le, or_false,
        lt_sub_iff_add_lt]
      rw [mul_div_cancel₀ t hb.ne']
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, add_comm]
    rw [hevent]
    calc
      mu.real {omega | A + b * (t / b) < S omega} ≤
          Real.exp (-(t / b)) := hbase
      _ = Real.exp (-b⁻¹ * t) := by
        congr 1
        rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
        ring
  have hExpInt : IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ ↦ Real.exp (-b⁻¹ * t))
      (Set.Ioi 0) := by
    exact exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi 0 (inv_pos.mpr hb)
  have htailIntegral :
      (∫ t in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), mu.real {omega | t < R omega}) ≤ b := by
    have hmono :
        (∫ t in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), mu.real {omega | t < R omega}) ≤
          ∫ t in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), Real.exp (-b⁻¹ * t) := by
      apply integral_mono_of_nonneg
      · exact ae_of_all _ fun _ ↦ measureReal_nonneg
      · exact hExpInt
      · filter_upwards [self_mem_ae_restrict measurableSet_Ioi] with t ht
        exact htailR t ht
    have hExpIntegral :
        (∫ t in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), Real.exp (-b⁻¹ * t)) = b := by
      have hcoef : -b⁻¹ < 0 := neg_lt_zero.mpr (inv_pos.mpr hb)
      rw [integral_exp_mul_Ioi hcoef 0]
      simp only [mul_zero, Real.exp_zero, neg_div, one_div]
      field_simp
    exact hmono.trans_eq hExpIntegral
  have hRIntegral : (∫ omega, R omega ∂mu) ≤ b := by
    rw [hR.integral_eq_integral_meas_lt hRnonneg]
    exact htailIntegral
  calc
    (∫ omega, S omega ∂mu) ≤
        ∫ omega, A + R omega ∂mu := hSle
    _ = A + ∫ omega, R omega ∂mu := by
      rw [integral_add (integrable_const A) hR, integral_const,
        probReal_univ, one_smul]
    _ ≤ A + b := add_le_add le_rfl hRIntegral

name: RandomSetTheory.integral_iSup_abs_unitBall_subgaussianProcess_le
statement:
theorem integral_iSup_abs_unitBall_subgaussianProcess_le
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (Z : Omega → EuclideanUnitBall E → ℝ) (B : Omega → ℝ)
    {sigma : ℝ} (hsigma : 0 < sigma)
    (hcontinuous : ∀ omega, Continuous (Z omega))
    (hmeas : ∀ t, Measurable (fun omega ↦ Z omega t))
    (hB : Integrable B mu)
    (hdom : ∀ omega t, |Z omega t| ≤ |B omega|)
    (hzero : ∀ omega, Z omega ⟨0, by simp⟩ = 0)
    (hsubgaussian : ∀ (s t : EuclideanUnitBall E) (y : ℝ), 0 ≤ y →
      mu.real {omega |
        sigma * dist s t * Real.sqrt (2 * y) <
          |Z omega s - Z omega t|} ≤
        2 * Real.exp (-y)) :
    (∫ omega, (⨆ t : EuclideanUnitBall E, |Z omega t|) ∂mu) ≤
      84 * sigma * Real.sqrt (finrank ℝ E + 1 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let S : Omega → ℝ := fun omega ↦
    ⨆ t : EuclideanUnitBall E, |Z omega t|
  have hSmeas : Measurable S := by
    apply measurable_iSup_continuous_of_measurable_dense
      (fun omega t ↦ |Z omega t|)
    · intro omega
      exact (hcontinuous omega).abs
    · intro k
      exact (hmeas _).abs
  have hSbdd : ∀ omega,
      BddAbove (Set.range fun t : EuclideanUnitBall E ↦ |Z omega t|) := by
    intro omega
    exact ⟨|B omega|, by
      rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩
      exact hdom omega t⟩
  have hSnonneg : ∀ omega, 0 ≤ S omega := by
    intro omega
    let zero : EuclideanUnitBall E := ⟨0, by simp⟩
    exact (abs_nonneg (Z omega zero)).trans (le_ciSup (hSbdd omega) zero)
  have hSdom : ∀ omega, S omega ≤ |B omega| := by
    intro omega
    exact ciSup_le fun t ↦ hdom omega t
  have hSint : Integrable S mu := by
    apply hB.abs.mono' hSmeas.aestronglyMeasurable
    exact ae_of_all mu fun omega ↦ by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hSnonneg omega)]
      exact hSdom omega
  let droot : ℝ := Real.sqrt (finrank ℝ E + 1 : ℝ)
  let A : ℝ := 72 * sigma * droot + 6 * sigma
  let b : ℝ := 6 * sigma
  have hdrootOne : 1 ≤ droot := by
    dsimp only [droot]
    have hdnonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ finrank ℝ E := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    calc
      (1 : ℝ) = Real.sqrt 1 := by norm_num
      _ ≤ Real.sqrt (finrank ℝ E + 1 : ℝ) :=
        Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by linarith)
  have hb : 0 < b := by
    dsimp only [b]
    positivity
  have htail : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x →
      mu.real {omega | A + b * x < S omega} ≤ Real.exp (-x) := by
    intro x hx
    have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (2 * x) ≤ x + 1 := by
      have hsqrtSq : (Real.sqrt (2 * x)) ^ 2 = 2 * x := by
        rw [Real.sq_sqrt]
        positivity
      have hsqrtNonneg := Real.sqrt_nonneg (2 * x)
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg x]
    have hthreshold :
        6 * sigma * Real.sqrt (2 * x) + 72 * sigma * droot ≤
          A + b * x := by
      have hsix : 0 ≤ 6 * sigma := mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hsigma.le
      have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsqrt hsix
      dsimp only [A, b]
      linarith
    have hchain :=
      measureReal_unitBall_subgaussianProcess_largeDeviation_le
        Z hsigma.le hx hcontinuous hzero hsubgaussian
    apply (measureReal_mono ?_).trans hchain
    intro omega homega
    have hlarge :
        6 * sigma * Real.sqrt (2 * x) + 72 * sigma * droot < S omega :=
      hthreshold.trans_lt homega
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := exists_lt_of_lt_ciSup hlarge
    exact ⟨t, by simpa only [droot] using ht⟩
  have hbase := ProbabilityTheory.integral_le_add_of_shifted_exponential_tail
    S hSint hb htail
  change (∫ omega, S omega ∂mu) ≤ _
  calc
    (∫ omega, S omega ∂mu) ≤ A + b := hbase
    _ ≤ 84 * sigma * droot := by
      dsimp only [A, b]
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdrootOne hsigma.le]

name: RandomSetTheory.integral_iSup_abs_unitBall_subgaussianEmpiricalProcess_le
statement:
theorem integral_iSup_abs_unitBall_subgaussianEmpiricalProcess_le
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (Z : Omega → EuclideanUnitBall E → ℝ) (B : Omega → ℝ)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) {K2 : ℝ} (hK2 : 0 < K2)
    (hcontinuous : ∀ omega, Continuous (Z omega))
    (hmeas : ∀ t, Measurable (fun omega ↦ Z omega t))
    (hB : Integrable B mu)
    (hdom : ∀ omega t, |Z omega t| ≤ |B omega|)
    (hzero : ∀ omega, Z omega ⟨0, by simp⟩ = 0)
    (hsubgaussian : ∀ (s t : EuclideanUnitBall E) (y : ℝ), 0 ≤ y →
      mu.real {omega |
        (K2 / Real.sqrt n) * dist s t * Real.sqrt (2 * y) <
          |Z omega s - Z omega t|} ≤
        2 * Real.exp (-y)) :
    (∫ omega, (⨆ t : EuclideanUnitBall E, |Z omega t|) ∂mu) ≤
      84 * (K2 / Real.sqrt n) *
        Real.sqrt (finrank ℝ E + 1 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hnreal : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hsqrt : 0 < Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hnreal
  exact integral_iSup_abs_unitBall_subgaussianProcess_le
    Z B (div_pos hK2 hsqrt) hcontinuous hmeas hB hdom hzero hsubgaussian

name: ProbabilityTheory.measurable_finiteCoordinateBlock
statement:
theorem measurable_finiteCoordinateBlock
    (Y : Nat -> Omega -> Z) (hY : forall j, Measurable (Y j))
    (I : Finset Nat) :
    Measurable (finiteCoordinateBlock Y I)
proof:
:= by
  exact measurable_pi_lambda _ fun j => hY j

name: ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun.indepFun_paddedPrefix_futureBlock
statement:
theorem iIndepFun.indepFun_paddedPrefix_futureBlock
    {mu : Measure Omega} (z0 : Z) (Y : Nat -> Omega -> Z)
    (hIndep : iIndepFun Y mu) (hY : forall j, Measurable (Y j))
    (i n : Nat) :
    IndepFun (paddedStrictPrefix z0 Y (i + 1))
      (finiteFutureBlock Y i n) mu
proof:
:= by
  change IndepFun (paddedStrictPrefix z0 Y (i + 1))
    (fun omega (j : Finset.Ico (i + 1) n) => Y j omega) mu
  let S : Finset Nat := Finset.range (i + 1)
  let U : Finset Nat := Finset.Ico (i + 1) n
  have hdisjoint : Disjoint S U := by
    apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro j hjS hjU
    have hjlt : j < i + 1 := Finset.mem_range.mp hjS
    have hjle : i + 1 <= j := (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hjU).1
    omega
  have hfinite := hIndep.indepFun_finset S U hdisjoint hY
  let extendPrefix : (S -> Z) -> (Nat -> Z) := fun values j =>
    if h : j < i + 1 then values ⟨j, Finset.mem_range.mpr h⟩ else z0
  have hextend : Measurable extendPrefix := by
    apply measurable_pi_lambda
    intro j
    by_cases hj : j < i + 1
    · have hj' : j <= i := by omega
      simpa only [extendPrefix, dif_pos hj, if_pos hj'] using
        (measurable_pi_apply (⟨j, Finset.mem_range.mpr hj⟩ : S))
    · have hj' : ¬j <= i := by omega
      simpa only [extendPrefix, dif_neg hj, if_neg hj'] using
        (measurable_const : Measurable (fun _ : S -> Z => z0))
  have hcomp := hfinite.comp hextend measurable_id
  have hleft :
      extendPrefix ∘ (fun omega (j : S) => Y j omega) =
        paddedStrictPrefix z0 Y (i + 1) := by
    funext omega j
    by_cases hj : j < i + 1
    · simp only [Function.comp_apply, extendPrefix, dif_pos hj,
        paddedStrictPrefix]
    · simp only [Function.comp_apply, extendPrefix, dif_neg hj,
        paddedStrictPrefix]
  rw [← hleft]
  simpa only [U, Function.id_comp] using hcomp

name: ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun.map_finiteFutureBlock_eq_pi
statement:
theorem iIndepFun.map_finiteFutureBlock_eq_pi
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (Y : Nat -> Omega -> Z) (hIndep : iIndepFun Y mu)
    (hY : forall j, Measurable (Y j)) (nu : Measure Z)
    (i n : Nat) (hYlaw : forall j, j < n -> mu.map (Y j) = nu) :
    mu.map (finiteFutureBlock Y i n) =
      Measure.pi (fun _ : Finset.Ico (i + 1) n => nu)
proof:
:= by
  let U : Finset Nat := Finset.Ico (i + 1) n
  have hrestricted : iIndepFun (fun j : U => Y j) mu :=
    hIndep.restrict U
  have hproduct := iIndepFun.map_fun_eq_pi_map
    (f := fun j : U => Y j) (μ := mu)
    (fun j => (hY j).aemeasurable) hrestricted
  change mu.map (fun omega (j : U) => Y j omega) = _ at hproduct
  change mu.map (fun omega (j : U) => Y j omega) = _
  rw [hproduct]
  congr 1
  funext j
  exact hYlaw j (Finset.mem_Ico.mp j.property).2

name: ProbabilityTheory.measurable_mergePrefixFuture
statement:
theorem measurable_mergePrefixFuture (i n : Nat) :
    Measurable (mergePrefixFuture (Z := Z) i n)
proof:
:= by
  apply measurable_pi_lambda
  intro j
  by_cases hj : (j : Nat) < i + 1
  · simp only [mergePrefixFuture, dif_pos hj]
    exact (measurable_pi_apply (j : Nat)).comp measurable_fst
  · simp only [mergePrefixFuture, dif_neg hj]
    exact (measurable_pi_apply
      (⟨j, Finset.mem_Ico.mpr ⟨Nat.le_of_not_gt hj, j.isLt⟩⟩ :
        Finset.Ico (i + 1) n)).comp measurable_snd

name: ProbabilityTheory.mergePrefixFuture_comp
statement:
theorem mergePrefixFuture_comp
    (z0 : Z) (Y : Nat -> Omega -> Z) (i n : Nat) (omega : Omega) :
    mergePrefixFuture i n
        (paddedStrictPrefix z0 Y (i + 1) omega,
          finiteFutureBlock Y i n omega) =
      fun j : Fin n => Y j omega
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  by_cases hj : (j : Nat) < i + 1
  · simp [mergePrefixFuture, paddedStrictPrefix, hj]
  · simp [mergePrefixFuture, finiteFutureBlock,
      finiteCoordinateBlock, hj]

name: ProbabilityTheory.stronglyMeasurable_nextPrefixFutureValue
statement:
theorem stronglyMeasurable_nextPrefixFutureValue
    {mu : Measure Omega} [SFinite mu]
    (Y : Nat -> Omega -> Z) (i n : Nat)
    (Phi : (Fin n -> Z) -> Real) (hPhi : StronglyMeasurable Phi) :
    StronglyMeasurable (nextPrefixFutureValue mu Y i n Phi)
proof:
:= by
  have hjoint : StronglyMeasurable
      (fun pf : (Nat -> Z) × (Finset.Ico (i + 1) n -> Z) =>
        Phi (mergePrefixFuture i n pf)) :=
    hPhi.comp_measurable (measurable_mergePrefixFuture i n)
  change StronglyMeasurable (fun pastCurrent : Nat -> Z =>
    ∫ future, Phi (mergePrefixFuture i n (pastCurrent, future))
      ∂(mu.map (finiteFutureBlock Y i n)))
  exact hjoint.integral_prod_right'

name: ProbabilityTheory.stronglyMeasurable_uncurry_finiteFutureValue
statement:
theorem stronglyMeasurable_uncurry_finiteFutureValue
    {mu : Measure Omega} [SFinite mu]
    (z0 : Z) (Y : Nat -> Omega -> Z)
    (i n : Nat) (Phi : (Fin n -> Z) -> Real)
    (hPhi : StronglyMeasurable Phi) :
    StronglyMeasurable
      (Function.uncurry (finiteFutureValue mu z0 Y i n Phi))
proof:
:= by
  have hnext := stronglyMeasurable_nextPrefixFutureValue
    (mu := mu) Y i n Phi hPhi
  exact hnext.comp_measurable (measurable_insertCurrentIntoPaddedPrefix z0 i)

name: ProbabilityTheory.integrable_terminal_futureSlice_of_sum_envelope
statement:
theorem integrable_terminal_futureSlice_of_sum_envelope
    {mu : Measure Omega} {nu : Measure Z}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (z0 : Z) (Y : Nat -> Omega -> Z)
    (hY : forall j, Measurable (Y j)) (hIndep : iIndepFun Y mu)
    (i n : Nat) (hYlaw : forall j, j < n -> mu.map (Y j) = nu)
    (Phi : (Fin n -> Z) -> Real)
    (hPhi : StronglyMeasurable Phi) (A : Fin n -> Z -> Real)
    (hAint : forall j, Integrable (A j) nu)
    (hA : forall j z, 0 <= A j z)
    (hdom : forall x, abs (Phi x) <= ∑ j : Fin n, A j (x j))
    (past : Nat -> Z) (current : Z) :
    Integrable (fun future => Phi (mergePrefixFuture i n
      (insertCurrentIntoPaddedPrefix z0 i (past, current), future)))
      (mu.map (finiteFutureBlock Y i n))
proof:
:= by
  rw [hIndep.map_finiteFutureBlock_eq_pi Y hY nu i n hYlaw]
  let I := Finset.Ico (i + 1) n
  let kappa : Measure (I -> Z) := Measure.pi (fun _ : I => nu)
  let fixed : Nat -> Z :=
    insertCurrentIntoPaddedPrefix z0 i (past, current)
  have hcomponent : forall j : Fin n,
      Integrable (fun future : I -> Z =>
        A j (mergePrefixFuture i n (fixed, future) j)) kappa := by
    intro j
    by_cases hj : (j : Nat) < i + 1
    · simpa only [mergePrefixFuture, dif_pos hj] using
        (integrable_const (μ := kappa) (A j (fixed j)))
    · let k : I :=
        ⟨j, Finset.mem_Ico.mpr ⟨Nat.le_of_not_gt hj, j.isLt⟩⟩
      have hmap : MeasurePreserving (Function.eval k) kappa nu := by
        exact measurePreserving_eval (fun _ : I => nu) k
      have hcomp := hmap.integrable_comp_of_integrable (hAint j)
      change Integrable (fun future : I -> Z => A j (future k)) kappa at hcomp
      simpa only [kappa, Function.comp_apply, mergePrefixFuture,
        dif_neg hj, k] using hcomp
  have henvelope : Integrable (fun future : I -> Z =>
      ∑ j : Fin n, A j (mergePrefixFuture i n (fixed, future) j)) kappa :=
    integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ fun j _ => hcomponent j
  have hterminalStrong : StronglyMeasurable (fun future : I -> Z =>
      Phi (mergePrefixFuture i n (fixed, future))) := by
    exact hPhi.comp_measurable ((measurable_mergePrefixFuture i n).comp
      (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id))
  apply henvelope.mono' hterminalStrong.aestronglyMeasurable
  filter_upwards [] with future
  have hsumNonneg : 0 <=
      ∑ j : Fin n, A j (mergePrefixFuture i n (fixed, future) j) :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => hA j _
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hsumNonneg] using
    hdom (mergePrefixFuture i n (fixed, future))

name: ProbabilityTheory.condExp_terminal_ae_eq_finiteFutureValue
statement:
theorem condExp_terminal_ae_eq_finiteFutureValue
    [StandardBorelSpace Z] [Nonempty Z]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (z0 : Z) (Y : Nat -> Omega -> Z)
    (hY : forall j, Measurable (Y j)) (hIndep : iIndepFun Y mu)
    (i n : Nat) (Phi : (Fin n -> Z) -> Real)
    (hPhi : StronglyMeasurable Phi)
    (hterminalInt : Integrable
      (fun omega => Phi (fun j : Fin n => Y j omega)) mu) :
    mu[(fun omega => Phi (fun j : Fin n => Y j omega)) |
        strictPrefixFiltration Y hY (i + 1)] =ᵐ[mu]
      fun omega => finiteFutureValue mu z0 Y i n Phi
        (paddedStrictPrefix z0 Y i omega) (Y i omega)
proof:
:= by
  let P : Omega -> (Nat -> Z) := paddedStrictPrefix z0 Y (i + 1)
  let U : Omega -> (Finset.Ico (i + 1) n -> Z) :=
    finiteFutureBlock Y i n
  let H : (Nat -> Z) × (Finset.Ico (i + 1) n -> Z) -> Real :=
    fun pu => Phi (mergePrefixFuture i n pu)
  have hP : Measurable P := measurable_paddedStrictPrefix z0 Y hY (i + 1)
  have hU : Measurable U :=
    measurable_finiteCoordinateBlock Y hY (Finset.Ico (i + 1) n)
  have hPU : IndepFun P U mu := by
    exact hIndep.indepFun_paddedPrefix_futureBlock z0 Y hY i n
  have hH : StronglyMeasurable H :=
    hPhi.comp_measurable (measurable_mergePrefixFuture i n)
  have hterminalEq :
      (fun omega => H (P omega, U omega)) =
        fun omega => Phi (fun j : Fin n => Y j omega) := by
    funext omega
    exact congrArg Phi (mergePrefixFuture_comp z0 Y i n omega)
  have hreconstructedInt : Integrable
      (fun omega => H (P omega, U omega)) mu := by
    rw [hterminalEq]
    exact hterminalInt
  have hbase := hPU.condExp_prod_ae_eq_integral_map hP hU H hH
    hreconstructedInt
  rw [hterminalEq] at hbase
  rw [strictPrefixFiltration_eq_comap_paddedStrictPrefix
    z0 Y hY (i + 1)]
  filter_upwards [hbase] with omega homega
  rw [homega]
  change (∫ future, Phi (mergePrefixFuture i n
      (paddedStrictPrefix z0 Y (i + 1) omega, future))
        ∂(mu.map (finiteFutureBlock Y i n))) = _
  unfold finiteFutureValue nextPrefixFutureValue
  rw [insertCurrentIntoPaddedPrefix_comp]

name: ProbabilityTheory.mergePrefixFuture_insertCurrent_apply_current
statement:
theorem mergePrefixFuture_insertCurrent_apply_current
    (z0 : Z) (i n : Nat) (hi : i < n)
    (past : Nat -> Z) (current : Z)
    (future : Finset.Ico (i + 1) n -> Z) :
    mergePrefixFuture i n
        (insertCurrentIntoPaddedPrefix z0 i (past, current), future)
        (⟨i, hi⟩ : Fin n) = current
proof:
:= by
  simp [mergePrefixFuture, insertCurrentIntoPaddedPrefix]

name: ProbabilityTheory.mergePrefixFuture_insertCurrent_eq_of_ne
statement:
theorem mergePrefixFuture_insertCurrent_eq_of_ne
    (z0 : Z) (i n : Nat) (hi : i < n)
    (past : Nat -> Z) (current current' : Z)
    (future : Finset.Ico (i + 1) n -> Z) (j : Fin n)
    (hj : j ≠ (⟨i, hi⟩ : Fin n)) :
    mergePrefixFuture i n
        (insertCurrentIntoPaddedPrefix z0 i (past, current), future) j =
      mergePrefixFuture i n
        (insertCurrentIntoPaddedPrefix z0 i (past, current'), future) j
proof:
:= by
  unfold mergePrefixFuture
  by_cases hjprefix : (j : Nat) < i + 1
  · simp only [dif_pos hjprefix]
    unfold insertCurrentIntoPaddedPrefix
    by_cases hjpast : (j : Nat) < i
    · simp [hjpast]
    · have hjeq : (j : Nat) = i := by omega
      have : j = (⟨i, hi⟩ : Fin n) := Fin.ext hjeq
      exact (hj this).elim
  · simp only [dif_neg hjprefix]

name: ProbabilityTheory.abs_finiteFutureValue_sub_le_of_terminal_replaceOne
statement:
theorem abs_finiteFutureValue_sub_le_of_terminal_replaceOne
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (z0 : Z) (Y : Nat -> Omega -> Z)
    (hY : forall j, Measurable (Y j))
    (i n : Nat) (hi : i < n)
    (Phi : (Fin n -> Z) -> Real) (A : Z -> Real)
    (hFiberInt : forall past current,
      Integrable (fun future => Phi (mergePrefixFuture i n
        (insertCurrentIntoPaddedPrefix z0 i (past, current), future)))
        (mu.map (finiteFutureBlock Y i n)))
    (hreplace : forall x x' : Fin n -> Z,
      (forall j, j ≠ (⟨i, hi⟩ : Fin n) -> x j = x' j) ->
      abs (Phi x - Phi x') <=
        A (x ⟨i, hi⟩) + A (x' ⟨i, hi⟩))
    (past : Nat -> Z) (current current' : Z) :
    abs (finiteFutureValue mu z0 Y i n Phi past current -
        finiteFutureValue mu z0 Y i n Phi past current') <=
      A current + A current'
proof:
:= by
  let U : Omega -> (Finset.Ico (i + 1) n -> Z) :=
    finiteFutureBlock Y i n
  have hU : Measurable U :=
    measurable_finiteCoordinateBlock Y hY (Finset.Ico (i + 1) n)
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (mu.map U) :=
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hU.aemeasurable
  unfold finiteFutureValue nextPrefixFutureValue
  apply abs_integral_sub_integral_le_add_envelopes
      (kappa := mu.map U)
      (fun past current future => Phi (mergePrefixFuture i n
        (insertCurrentIntoPaddedPrefix z0 i (past, current), future))) A
  · intro b z
    simpa only [U] using hFiberInt b z
  · intro b z z' future
    let x : Fin n -> Z := mergePrefixFuture i n
      (insertCurrentIntoPaddedPrefix z0 i (b, z), future)
    let x' : Fin n -> Z := mergePrefixFuture i n
      (insertCurrentIntoPaddedPrefix z0 i (b, z'), future)
    have hterminal := hreplace x x' (fun j hj =>
      mergePrefixFuture_insertCurrent_eq_of_ne
        z0 i n hi b z z' future j hj)
    have hxi : x ⟨i, hi⟩ = z :=
      mergePrefixFuture_insertCurrent_apply_current
        z0 i n hi b z future
    have hxi' : x' ⟨i, hi⟩ = z' :=
      mergePrefixFuture_insertCurrent_apply_current
        z0 i n hi b z' future
    simpa only [x, x', hxi, hxi'] using hterminal

name: ProbabilityTheory.doobCenteredDifference_terminal_succ_ae_eq_finiteFutureValue
statement:
theorem doobCenteredDifference_terminal_succ_ae_eq_finiteFutureValue
    {mu : Measure Omega}
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    [StandardBorelSpace Z] [Nonempty Z]
    (z0 : Z) (Y : Nat -> Omega -> Z)
    (hY : forall j, Measurable (Y j)) (hIndep : iIndepFun Y mu)
    (i n : Nat) (Phi : (Fin n -> Z) -> Real)
    (hPhi : StronglyMeasurable Phi)
    (hterminalInt : Integrable
      (fun omega => Phi (fun j : Fin n => Y j omega)) mu) :
    doobCenteredDifference (strictPrefixFiltration Y hY) mu
        (fun omega => Phi (fun j : Fin n => Y j omega)) (i + 1) =ᵐ[mu]
      fun omega =>
        finiteFutureValue mu z0 Y i n Phi
            (paddedStrictPrefix z0 Y i omega) (Y i omega) -
          ∫ z, finiteFutureValue mu z0 Y i n Phi
            (paddedStrictPrefix z0 Y i omega) z ∂(mu.map (Y i))
proof:
:= by
  apply doobCenteredDifference_succ_ae_eq_centeredGhostFiber_of_condExp_next
    (strictPrefixFiltration Y hY)
    (fun omega => Phi (fun j : Fin n => Y j omega)) i
    (paddedStrictPrefix z0 Y i) (Y i)
  · exact hIndep.indepFun_paddedStrictPrefix z0 Y hY i
  · exact measurable_paddedStrictPrefix z0 Y hY i
  · exact hY i
  · exact strictPrefixFiltration_eq_comap_paddedStrictPrefix z0 Y hY i
  · exact stronglyMeasurable_uncurry_finiteFutureValue
      (mu := mu) z0 Y i n Phi hPhi
  · exact condExp_terminal_ae_eq_finiteFutureValue
      z0 Y hY hIndep i n Phi hPhi hterminalInt

statement:
@[simp]
theorem finiteSuccessorEnvelope_zero (A : Fin n -> Z -> Real) :

proof: := rfl

statement:
@[simp]
theorem finiteSuccessorEnvelope_succ (A : Fin n -> Z -> Real)

name: ProbabilityTheory.measurable_finiteCoordinateSumSupremum
statement:
theorem measurable_finiteCoordinateSumSupremum {T : Type*}
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (W : Fin n -> Z -> T -> Real)
    (hW : forall j t, t ∈ s -> Measurable (fun z => W j z t)) :
    Measurable (finiteCoordinateSumSupremum s hs W)
proof:
:= by
  apply measurable_finiteProcessSupremum s hs
  intro t ht
  exact Finset.measurable_sum Finset.univ fun j _ =>
    (hW j t ht).comp (measurable_pi_apply j)

name: ProbabilityTheory.abs_finiteCoordinateSumSupremum_replace_le_add_envelopes
statement:
theorem abs_finiteCoordinateSumSupremum_replace_le_add_envelopes
    {T : Type*} (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (W : Fin n -> Z -> T -> Real) (A : Fin n -> Z -> Real)
    (hdom : forall j z t, t ∈ s -> abs (W j z t) <= A j z)
    (i : Nat) (hi : i < n) (x x' : Fin n -> Z)
    (hxeq : forall j, j ≠ (⟨i, hi⟩ : Fin n) -> x j = x' j) :
    abs (finiteCoordinateSumSupremum s hs W x -
        finiteCoordinateSumSupremum s hs W x') <=
      A ⟨i, hi⟩ (x ⟨i, hi⟩) + A ⟨i, hi⟩ (x' ⟨i, hi⟩)
proof:
:= by
  let idx : Fin n := ⟨i, hi⟩
  let r : T -> Real := fun t =>
    ∑ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase idx), W j (x j) t
  have hsumX : forall t,
      (∑ j : Fin n, W j (x j) t) = r t + W idx (x idx) t := by
    intro t
    symm
    exact Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (Finset.mem_univ idx)
  have hsumX' : forall t,
      (∑ j : Fin n, W j (x' j) t) = r t + W idx (x' idx) t := by
    intro t
    rw [show (∑ j : Fin n, W j (x' j) t) =
        (∑ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase idx), W j (x' j) t) +
          W idx (x' idx) t by
      symm
      exact Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (Finset.mem_univ idx)]
    congr 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    apply congrArg (fun z => W j z t)
    exact (hxeq j (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1).symm
  unfold finiteCoordinateSumSupremum
  simp_rw [hsumX, hsumX']
  exact abs_finset_sup'_sum_replace_one_le_add_envelopes
    s hs r (fun t => W idx (x idx) t) (fun t => W idx (x' idx) t)
      (hdom idx (x idx)) (hdom idx (x' idx))

name: ProbabilityTheory.abs_finiteCoordinateSumSupremum_le_sum_envelopes
statement:
theorem abs_finiteCoordinateSumSupremum_le_sum_envelopes
    {T : Type*} (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (W : Fin n -> Z -> T -> Real) (A : Fin n -> Z -> Real)
    (hA : forall j z, 0 <= A j z)
    (hdom : forall j z t, t ∈ s -> abs (W j z t) <= A j z)
    (x : Fin n -> Z) :
    abs (finiteCoordinateSumSupremum s hs W x) <=
      ∑ j : Fin n, A j (x j)
proof:
:= by
  have hsumNonneg : 0 <= ∑ j : Fin n, A j (x j) :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => hA j _
  have hcoordinate : forall t, t ∈ s ->
      abs (∑ j : Fin n, W j (x j) t) <=
        ∑ j : Fin n, A j (x j) := by
    intro t ht
    calc
      abs (∑ j : Fin n, W j (x j) t) <=
          ∑ j : Fin n, abs (W j (x j) t) :=
        Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ <= ∑ j : Fin n, A j (x j) := by
        exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => hdom j (x j) t ht
  have hbound := abs_finiteProcessSupremum_le s hs
    (fun t (_ : Unit) => ∑ j : Fin n, W j (x j) t)
    (fun _ : Unit => ∑ j : Fin n, A j (x j))
    (fun _ t ht => by
      simpa only [abs_of_nonneg hsumNonneg] using hcoordinate t ht) ()
  simpa only [finiteCoordinateSumSupremum, finiteProcessSupremum,
    abs_of_nonneg hsumNonneg] using hbound

name: ProbabilityTheory.integrable_finiteCoordinateSumSupremum_futureSlice
statement:
theorem integrable_finiteCoordinateSumSupremum_futureSlice
    {T : Type*} {mu : Measure Omega} {nu : Measure Z}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (z0 : Z) (Y : Nat -> Omega -> Z)
    (hY : forall j, Measurable (Y j)) (hIndep : iIndepFun Y mu)
    (i n : Nat) (hYlaw : forall j, j < n -> mu.map (Y j) = nu)
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (W : Fin n -> Z -> T -> Real) (A : Fin n -> Z -> Real)
    (hW : forall j t, t ∈ s -> Measurable (fun z => W j z t))
    (hAint : forall j, Integrable (A j) nu)
    (hA : forall j z, 0 <= A j z)
    (hdom : forall j z t, t ∈ s -> abs (W j z t) <= A j z)
    (past : Nat -> Z) (current : Z) :
    Integrable (fun future => finiteCoordinateSumSupremum s hs W
      (mergePrefixFuture i n
        (insertCurrentIntoPaddedPrefix z0 i (past, current), future)))
      (mu.map (finiteFutureBlock Y i n))
proof:
:= by
  apply integrable_terminal_futureSlice_of_sum_envelope
    z0 Y hY hIndep i n hYlaw
    (finiteCoordinateSumSupremum s hs W)
    (measurable_finiteCoordinateSumSupremum s hs W hW).stronglyMeasurable
    A hAint hA
  exact abs_finiteCoordinateSumSupremum_le_sum_envelopes
    s hs W A hA hdom

name: ProbabilityTheory.abs_finiteFutureValue_coordinateSumSupremum_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_finiteFutureValue_coordinateSumSupremum_sub_le
    {T : Type*} {mu : Measure Omega} {nu : Measure Z}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (z0 : Z) (Y : Nat -> Omega -> Z)
    (hY : forall j, Measurable (Y j)) (hIndep : iIndepFun Y mu)
    (i n : Nat) (hi : i < n)
    (hYlaw : forall j, j < n -> mu.map (Y j) = nu)
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (W : Fin n -> Z -> T -> Real) (A : Fin n -> Z -> Real)
    (hW : forall j t, t ∈ s -> Measurable (fun z => W j z t))
    (hAint : forall j, Integrable (A j) nu)
    (hA : forall j z, 0 <= A j z)
    (hdom : forall j z t, t ∈ s -> abs (W j z t) <= A j z)
    (past : Nat -> Z) (current current' : Z) :
    abs (finiteFutureValue mu z0 Y i n
          (finiteCoordinateSumSupremum s hs W) past current -
        finiteFutureValue mu z0 Y i n
          (finiteCoordinateSumSupremum s hs W) past current') <=
      A ⟨i, hi⟩ current + A ⟨i, hi⟩ current'
proof:
:= by
  apply abs_finiteFutureValue_sub_le_of_terminal_replaceOne
    z0 Y hY i n hi (finiteCoordinateSumSupremum s hs W)
      (A ⟨i, hi⟩)
  · exact integrable_finiteCoordinateSumSupremum_futureSlice
      z0 Y hY hIndep i n hYlaw s hs W A hW hAint hA hdom
  · intro x x' hxeq
    exact abs_finiteCoordinateSumSupremum_replace_le_add_envelopes
      s hs W A hdom i hi x x' hxeq

name: RandomSetTheory.isClosed_structuredSupportProcessSet
statement:
theorem isClosed_structuredSupportProcessSet :
    IsClosed (structuredSupportProcessSet (E := E))
proof:
:= by
  change IsClosed
    ({f : C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ) |
        f (closedUnitBallZero (E := E)) = 0} ∩
      {f : C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ) |
        PositivelyHomogeneousOnClosedUnitBall f})
  apply IsClosed.inter
  · exact isClosed_eq
      (continuous_eval_const (closedUnitBallZero (E := E))) continuous_const
  · simp only [PositivelyHomogeneousOnClosedUnitBall, Set.setOf_forall]
    refine isClosed_iInter fun x ↦ isClosed_iInter fun y ↦
      isClosed_iInter fun r ↦ isClosed_iInter fun _hr ↦
        isClosed_iInter fun _hxy ↦ ?_
    exact isClosed_eq (continuous_eval_const y)
      ((continuous_const : Continuous
        (fun _ : C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ) ↦ r)).mul
          (continuous_eval_const x))

name: RandomSetTheory.scaledSupportDifferenceContinuousMap_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem scaledSupportDifferenceContinuousMap_zero
    (c : ℝ) (K L : Set E) (hK : IsCompact K) (hL : IsCompact L)

    scaledSupportDifferenceContinuousMap c K L hK hL hKne hLne
        (closedUnitBallZero (E := E)) = 0
proof:

name: RandomSetTheory.scaledSupportDifferenceContinuousMap_positivelyHomogeneous
statement:
theorem scaledSupportDifferenceContinuousMap_positivelyHomogeneous
    (c : ℝ) (K L : Set E) (hK : IsCompact K) (hL : IsCompact L)
    (hKne : K.Nonempty) (hLne : L.Nonempty) :
    PositivelyHomogeneousOnClosedUnitBall
      (scaledSupportDifferenceContinuousMap c K L hK hL hKne hLne)
proof:
:= by

name: RandomSetTheory.scaledSupportDifferenceContinuousMap_mem_structured
statement:
theorem scaledSupportDifferenceContinuousMap_mem_structured
    (c : ℝ) (K L : Set E) (hK : IsCompact K) (hL : IsCompact L)
