name: RandomSetTheory.TendstoInDistribution.ae_mem_closed_of_forall_mem
statement:
theorem TendstoInDistribution.ae_mem_closed_of_forall_mem
    {I Ω' F : Type*} {Omega : I → Type*}
    {mOmega : ∀ i, MeasurableSpace (Omega i)}
    {mu : ∀ i, Measure (Omega i)} [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (mu i)]
    {mOmega' : MeasurableSpace Ω'} {mu' : Measure Ω'}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu']
    [TopologicalSpace F] [MeasurableSpace F] [BorelSpace F]
    [HasOuterApproxClosed F]
    {X : (i : I) → Omega i → F} {Z : Ω' → F} {l : Filter I}
    [l.NeBot]
    (h : TendstoInDistribution X l Z mu mu')
    {S : Set F} (hS : IsClosed S)
    (hmem : ∀ i ω, X i ω ∈ S) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂mu', Z ω ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  have hport :=
    ProbabilityMeasure.limsup_measure_closed_le_of_tendsto h.tendsto hS
  have hmass : ∀ i,
      ((⟨(mu i).map (X i),
          Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (h.forall_aemeasurable i)⟩ :
        ProbabilityMeasure F) : Measure F) S = 1 := by
    intro i
    rw [Measure.map_apply_of_aemeasurable
      (h.forall_aemeasurable i) hS.measurableSet]
    have hpre : X i ⁻¹' S = Set.univ := by
      exact Set.eq_univ_of_forall fun ω ↦ hmem i ω
    rw [hpre, measure_univ]
  have hport' :
      l.limsup (fun _ : I ↦ (1 : ENNReal)) ≤ (mu'.map Z) S := by
    have hfun :
        (fun i ↦
          ((⟨(mu i).map (X i),
              Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (h.forall_aemeasurable i)⟩ :
            ProbabilityMeasure F) : Measure F) S) =
          (fun _ : I ↦ (1 : ENNReal)) := by
      funext i
      exact hmass i
    calc
      l.limsup (fun _ : I ↦ (1 : ENNReal)) =
          l.limsup (fun i ↦
            ((⟨(mu i).map (X i),
                Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (h.forall_aemeasurable i)⟩ :
              ProbabilityMeasure F) : Measure F) S) :=
        congrArg (fun f : I → ENNReal ↦ l.limsup f) hfun.symm
      _ ≤ (mu'.map Z) S := by
        simpa only [ProbabilityMeasure.coe_mk] using hport
  have hone : (mu'.map Z) S = 1 := by
    apply le_antisymm prob_le_one
    simpa only [Filter.limsup_const] using hport'
  rw [Measure.map_apply_of_aemeasurable h.aemeasurable_limit
    hS.measurableSet] at hone
  have hpre : NullMeasurableSet (Z ⁻¹' S) mu' :=
    h.aemeasurable_limit.nullMeasurableSet_preimage hS.measurableSet
  have hae : ∀ᵐ ω ∂mu', ω ∈ Z ⁻¹' S :=
    (ae_mem_iff_measure_eq hpre).2
      (by simpa only [measure_univ] using hone)
  simpa only [Set.mem_preimage] using hae

name: RandomSetTheory.TendstoInDistribution.ae_structuredSupportProcess_of_supportDifferences
statement:
theorem TendstoInDistribution.ae_structuredSupportProcess_of_supportDifferences
    {I Ω' : Type*} {Omega : I → Type*}
    {mOmega : ∀ i, MeasurableSpace (Omega i)}
    {mu : ∀ i, Measure (Omega i)} [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (mu i)]
    {mOmega' : MeasurableSpace Ω'} {mu' : Measure Ω'}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu']
    [MeasurableSpace C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ)]
    [BorelSpace C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ)]
    (c : I → ℝ) (K : (i : I) → Omega i → Set E) (L : Set E)
    (Z : Ω' → C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ))
    (hKcompact : ∀ i ω, IsCompact (K i ω))
    (hKne : ∀ i ω, (K i ω).Nonempty)
    (hLcompact : IsCompact L) (hLne : L.Nonempty)
    {l : Filter I} [l.NeBot]
    (hprocess : TendstoInDistribution
      (fun i ω ↦ scaledSupportDifferenceContinuousMap
        (c i) (K i ω) L (hKcompact i ω) hLcompact
          (hKne i ω) hLne)
      l Z mu mu') :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂mu',
      Z ω (closedUnitBallZero (E := E)) = 0 ∧
        PositivelyHomogeneousOnClosedUnitBall (Z ω)
proof:
:= by
  exact RandomSetTheory.TendstoInDistribution.ae_mem_closed_of_forall_mem
    hprocess
    isClosed_structuredSupportProcessSet
    (fun i ω ↦ scaledSupportDifferenceContinuousMap_mem_structured
      (c i) (K i ω) L (hKcompact i ω) hLcompact
        (hKne i ω) hLne)

name: RandomSetTheory.pointwiseRandomSetCLT_of_supportProcess_unitSphere_of_weakLimit
statement:
theorem pointwiseRandomSetCLT_of_supportProcess_unitSphere_of_weakLimit
    [Nontrivial E]
    {I Ω' : Type*} {Omega : I → Type*}
    {mOmega : ∀ i, MeasurableSpace (Omega i)}
    {mu : ∀ i, Measure (Omega i)} [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (mu i)]
    {mOmega' : MeasurableSpace Ω'} {mu' : Measure Ω'}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu']
    [MeasurableSpace C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ)]
    [BorelSpace C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ)]
    (c : I → ℝ) (K : (i : I) → Omega i → Set E) (L : Set E)
    (Z : Ω' → C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ))
    (hc : ∀ i, 0 ≤ c i)
    (hKcompact : ∀ i ω, IsCompact (K i ω))
    (hKne : ∀ i ω, (K i ω).Nonempty)
    (hKconv : ∀ i ω, Convex ℝ (K i ω))
    (hLcompact : IsCompact L) (hLne : L.Nonempty)
    (hLconv : Convex ℝ L)
    {l : Filter I} [l.NeBot]
    (hprocess : TendstoInDistribution
      (fun i ω ↦ scaledSupportDifferenceContinuousMap
        (c i) (K i ω) L (hKcompact i ω) hLcompact
          (hKne i ω) hLne)
      l Z mu mu') :
    TendstoInDistribution
        (fun i ω ↦ |c i| * hausdorffDist (K i ω) L)
        l (fun ω ↦ unitSphereSupAbs (Z ω)) mu mu' ∧
      TendstoInDistribution
        (fun i ω ↦ c i * directedHausdorffDist (K i ω) L)
        l (fun ω ↦ unitSphereSupPositivePart (Z ω)) mu mu' ∧
      TendstoInDistribution
        (fun i ω ↦ c i * directedHausdorffDist L (K i ω))
        l (fun ω ↦ unitSphereSupNegativePart (Z ω)) mu mu'
proof:
:= by
  have hstructure : ∀ᵐ ω ∂mu',
      Z ω (closedUnitBallZero (E := E)) = 0 ∧
        PositivelyHomogeneousOnClosedUnitBall (Z ω) :=
    RandomSetTheory.TendstoInDistribution.ae_structuredSupportProcess_of_supportDifferences
      c K L Z hKcompact hKne hLcompact hLne hprocess
  obtain ⟨hsymmetric, hforward, hreverse⟩ :=
    pointwiseRandomSetCLT_of_supportProcess
      c K L Z hc hKcompact hKne hKconv hLcompact hLne hLconv hprocess
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply hsymmetric.congr
    · exact fun _ ↦ Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ ↦ rfl
    · filter_upwards [hstructure] with ω hω
      exact norm_eq_unitSphereSupAbs (Z ω) hω.1 hω.2
  · apply hforward.congr
    · exact fun _ ↦ Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ ↦ rfl
    · filter_upwards [hstructure] with ω hω
      exact continuousSup_eq_unitSphereSupPositivePart (Z ω) hω.1 hω.2
  · apply hreverse.congr
    · exact fun _ ↦ Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ ↦ rfl
    · filter_upwards [hstructure] with ω hω
      exact continuousSup_neg_eq_unitSphereSupNegativePart (Z ω) hω.1 hω.2

name: ProbabilityTheory.replaceOneCenteredEnvelope_nonneg
statement:
theorem replaceOneCenteredEnvelope_nonneg
    (A : Z → ℝ) (hA : ∀ z, 0 ≤ A z) (z : Z) :
    0 ≤ replaceOneCenteredEnvelope nu A z
proof:
:= by
  unfold replaceOneCenteredEnvelope
  exact add_nonneg (hA z) (integral_nonneg hA)

name: ProbabilityTheory.memLp_fiber_of_abs_sub_le_add_envelopes
statement:
theorem memLp_fiber_of_abs_sub_le_add_envelopes
    [IsProbabilityMeasure nu] [Nonempty Z]
    (F A : Z → ℝ) (q : ℕ)
    (hF : StronglyMeasurable F) (hAq : MemLp A q nu)
    (hA : ∀ z, 0 ≤ A z)
    (hreplace : ∀ z z', |F z - F z'| ≤ A z + A z') :
    MemLp F q nu
proof:
:= by
  let z₀ : Z := Classical.choice inferInstance
  let C : ℝ := |F z₀| + A z₀
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := add_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (hA z₀)
  have hmajorant : MemLp (fun z ↦ C + A z) q nu :=
    (memLp_const C).add hAq
  apply hmajorant.mono' hF.aestronglyMeasurable
  filter_upwards [] with z
  have hbound : |F z| ≤ C + A z := by
    calc
      |F z| = |(F z - F z₀) + F z₀| := by rw [sub_add_cancel]
      _ ≤ |F z - F z₀| + |F z₀| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ A z + A z₀ + |F z₀| :=
        by simpa only [add_comm] using
          add_le_add_right (hreplace z z₀) |F z₀|
      _ = C + A z := by ring
  exact hbound

name: ProbabilityTheory.max_sub_integral_le_replaceOneCenteredEnvelope
statement:
theorem max_sub_integral_le_replaceOneCenteredEnvelope
    [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (F A : Z → ℝ) (hFint : Integrable F nu) (hAint : Integrable A nu)
    (hreplace : ∀ z z', |F z - F z'| ≤ A z + A z')
    (z : Z) :
    max (F z - ∫ z', F z' ∂nu) 0 ≤ replaceOneCenteredEnvelope nu A z
proof:
:= by
  have hdiffInt : Integrable (fun z' ↦ F z - F z') nu :=
    (integrable_const _).sub hFint
  have henvInt : Integrable (fun z' ↦ A z + A z') nu :=
    (integrable_const _).add hAint
  have heq : F z - ∫ z', F z' ∂nu =
      ∫ z', (F z - F z') ∂nu := by
    rw [integral_sub (integrable_const _) hFint, integral_const,
      probReal_univ, one_smul]
  have habs : |∫ z', (F z - F z') ∂nu| ≤
      ∫ z', (A z + A z') ∂nu := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      norm_integral_le_of_norm_le (f := fun z' ↦ F z - F z') henvInt
        (ae_of_all nu fun z' ↦ by
          simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hreplace z z')
  have hright : ∫ z', (A z + A z') ∂nu =
      replaceOneCenteredEnvelope nu A z := by
    rw [integral_add (integrable_const _) hAint, integral_const,
      probReal_univ, one_smul]
    rfl
  rw [heq]
  calc
    max (∫ z', (F z - F z') ∂nu) 0 ≤
        |∫ z', (F z - F z') ∂nu| :=
      max_le (le_abs_self _) (abs_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ ∫ z', (A z + A z') ∂nu := habs
    _ = replaceOneCenteredEnvelope nu A z := hright

name: ProbabilityTheory.integrable_pow_replaceOneCenteredEnvelope
statement:
theorem integrable_pow_replaceOneCenteredEnvelope
    [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (A : Z → ℝ) (q k : ℕ) (hkq : k ≤ q)
    (hAq : MemLp A q nu) (hA : ∀ z, 0 ≤ A z) :
    Integrable (fun z ↦ replaceOneCenteredEnvelope nu A z ^ k) nu
proof:
:= by
  have hkq' : (k : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ (q : ℝ≥0∞) := by exact_mod_cast hkq
  have hAk : MemLp A k nu := hAq.mono_exponent hkq'
  have hB : MemLp (replaceOneCenteredEnvelope nu A) k nu := by
    unfold replaceOneCenteredEnvelope
    exact hAk.add (memLp_const (∫ z, A z ∂nu))
  have hnorm := hB.integrable_norm_pow'
  convert hnorm using 1
  funext z
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg (replaceOneCenteredEnvelope_nonneg A hA z)]

name: ProbabilityTheory.integral_pow_max_centeredFiber_le_replaceOneCenteredMoment
statement:
theorem integral_pow_max_centeredFiber_le_replaceOneCenteredMoment
    [IsProbabilityMeasure nu] [Nonempty Z]
    (F A : Z → ℝ) (q k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hkq : k ≤ q)
    (hF : StronglyMeasurable F) (hAq : MemLp A q nu)
    (hA : ∀ z, 0 ≤ A z)
    (hreplace : ∀ z z', |F z - F z'| ≤ A z + A z') :
    (∫ z, max (F z - ∫ z', F z' ∂nu) 0 ^ k ∂nu) ≤
      replaceOneCenteredMoment nu A k
proof:
:= by
  have hqone : (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ (q : ℝ≥0∞) := by
    exact_mod_cast (le_trans (by omega : 1 ≤ k) hkq)
  have hFq : MemLp F q nu :=
    memLp_fiber_of_abs_sub_le_add_envelopes F A q hF hAq hA hreplace
  have hFint : Integrable F nu :=
    (hFq.mono_exponent hqone).integrable (by norm_num)
  have hAint : Integrable A nu :=
    (hAq.mono_exponent hqone).integrable (by norm_num)
  have hright := integrable_pow_replaceOneCenteredEnvelope A q k hkq hAq hA
  have hleftStrong : AEStronglyMeasurable
      (fun z ↦ max (F z - ∫ z', F z' ∂nu) 0 ^ k) nu :=
    (((hF.measurable.sub measurable_const).max measurable_const).pow_const k).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hleft : Integrable
      (fun z ↦ max (F z - ∫ z', F z' ∂nu) 0 ^ k) nu := by
    apply hright.mono' hleftStrong
    filter_upwards [] with z
    have hpow := pow_le_pow_left₀ (le_max_right
        (F z - ∫ z', F z' ∂nu) 0)
      (max_sub_integral_le_replaceOneCenteredEnvelope
        F A hFint hAint hreplace z) k
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (pow_nonneg (le_max_right
        (F z - ∫ z', F z' ∂nu) 0) k)] using hpow
  unfold replaceOneCenteredMoment
  apply integral_mono hleft hright
  intro z
  exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (le_max_right _ _)
    (max_sub_integral_le_replaceOneCenteredEnvelope
      F A hFint hAint hreplace z) k

name: ProbabilityTheory.sum_replaceOneCenteredMoment_le_interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient
statement:
theorem sum_replaceOneCenteredMoment_le_interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient
    {I : Type*} [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (s : Finset I) (A : I → Z → ℝ)
    (q k : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hkq : k ≤ q)
    (hAq : ∀ i ∈ s, MemLp (A i) q nu)
    (hA : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ z, 0 ≤ A i z)
    {V Q : ℝ} (hV : 0 ≤ V) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q)
    (hSecond :
      (∑ i ∈ s, replaceOneCenteredMoment nu (A i) 2) ≤ V)
    (hQMoment :
      (∑ i ∈ s, replaceOneCenteredMoment nu (A i) q) ≤ Q) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, replaceOneCenteredMoment nu (A i) k) ≤
      interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient q V Q k
proof:
:= by
  unfold interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient
  apply sum_integral_pow_le_strongMomentInterpolation_of_le
    nu s (fun i ↦ replaceOneCenteredEnvelope nu (A i))
      hq hk hkq
  · intro i hi
    unfold replaceOneCenteredEnvelope
    exact (hAq i hi).aestronglyMeasurable.aemeasurable.add aemeasurable_const
  · intro i hi
    exact ae_of_all nu fun z ↦
      replaceOneCenteredEnvelope_nonneg (A i) (hA i hi) z
  · intro i hi
    exact integrable_pow_replaceOneCenteredEnvelope
      (A i) q 2 (by omega) (hAq i hi) (hA i hi)
  · intro i hi
    exact integrable_pow_replaceOneCenteredEnvelope
      (A i) q k hkq (hAq i hi) (hA i hi)
  · intro i hi
    exact integrable_pow_replaceOneCenteredEnvelope
      (A i) q q le_rfl (hAq i hi) (hA i hi)
  · exact hV
  · exact hQ
  · simpa only [replaceOneCenteredMoment] using hSecond
  · simpa only [replaceOneCenteredMoment] using hQMoment

name: ProbabilityTheory.condExp_pow_max_centeredGhostFiber_le
statement:
theorem condExp_pow_max_centeredGhostFiber_le
    {Omega Beta : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace Omega] [MeasurableSpace Beta]
    [StandardBorelSpace Z] [Nonempty Z]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (P : Omega → Beta) (Y : Omega → Z)
    (hPY : IndepFun P Y mu) (hP : Measurable P) (hY : Measurable Y)
    (G : Beta → Z → ℝ) (A : Z → ℝ) (q k : ℕ)
    (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hkq : k ≤ q)
    (hG : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry G))
    (hAq : MemLp A q (mu.map Y)) (hA : ∀ z, 0 ≤ A z)
    (hreplace : ∀ b z z', |G b z - G b z'| ≤ A z + A z') :
    ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      mu[fun omega' ↦
          max (G (P omega') (Y omega') -
            ∫ z, G (P omega') z ∂(mu.map Y)) 0 ^ k |
          MeasurableSpace.comap P inferInstance] omega ≤
        replaceOneCenteredMoment (mu.map Y) A k
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (mu.map Y) :=
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hY.aemeasurable
  have hmean : StronglyMeasurable
      (fun b ↦ ∫ z, G b z ∂(mu.map Y)) :=
    hG.integral_prod_right
  have hcentered : StronglyMeasurable (fun bz : Beta × Z ↦
      G bz.1 bz.2 - ∫ z, G bz.1 z ∂(mu.map Y)) :=
    hG.sub (hmean.comp_measurable measurable_fst)
  have hmomentStrong : StronglyMeasurable (fun bz : Beta × Z ↦
      max (G bz.1 bz.2 - ∫ z, G bz.1 z ∂(mu.map Y)) 0 ^ k) :=
    (((hcentered.measurable.max measurable_const).pow_const k).stronglyMeasurable)
  have hqone : (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ (q : ℝ≥0∞) := by
    exact_mod_cast (le_trans (by omega : 1 ≤ k) hkq)
  have hAint : Integrable A (mu.map Y) :=
    (hAq.mono_exponent hqone).integrable (by norm_num)
  have hright := integrable_pow_replaceOneCenteredEnvelope
    (nu := mu.map Y) A q k hkq hAq hA
  have hrightComp : Integrable
      (fun omega ↦ replaceOneCenteredEnvelope (mu.map Y) A (Y omega) ^ k) mu :=
    hright.comp_measurable hY
  have hcomposed : Integrable (fun omega ↦
      max (G (P omega) (Y omega) -
        ∫ z, G (P omega) z ∂(mu.map Y)) 0 ^ k) mu := by
    apply hrightComp.mono'
      (hmomentStrong.comp_measurable (hP.prodMk hY)).aestronglyMeasurable
    filter_upwards [] with omega
    have hGb : StronglyMeasurable (G (P omega)) :=
      hG.comp_measurable (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id)
    have hGq : MemLp (G (P omega)) q (mu.map Y) :=
      memLp_fiber_of_abs_sub_le_add_envelopes
        (G (P omega)) A q hGb hAq hA (hreplace (P omega))
    have hGint : Integrable (G (P omega)) (mu.map Y) :=
      (hGq.mono_exponent hqone).integrable (by norm_num)
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    have hpow := pow_le_pow_left₀ (le_max_right
        (G (P omega) (Y omega) -
          ∫ z, G (P omega) z ∂(mu.map Y)) 0)
      (max_sub_integral_le_replaceOneCenteredEnvelope
        (G (P omega)) A hGint hAint (hreplace (P omega)) (Y omega)) k
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (pow_nonneg (le_max_right
        (G (P omega) (Y omega) -
          ∫ z, G (P omega) z ∂(mu.map Y)) 0) k)] using hpow
  have hbase := hPY.condExp_prod_ae_eq_integral_map hP hY
    (fun bz : Beta × Z ↦
      max (G bz.1 bz.2 - ∫ z, G bz.1 z ∂(mu.map Y)) 0 ^ k)
    hmomentStrong hcomposed
  filter_upwards [hbase] with omega hbaseOmega
  rw [hbaseOmega]
  exact integral_pow_max_centeredFiber_le_replaceOneCenteredMoment
      (nu := mu.map Y) (G (P omega)) A q k hk hkq
      (hG.comp_measurable (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id))
      hAq hA (hreplace (P omega))

name: ProbabilityTheory.condExp_pow_max_doobCenteredDifference_succ_le_of_centeredGhostFiber
statement:
theorem condExp_pow_max_doobCenteredDifference_succ_le_of_centeredGhostFiber
    {Omega Beta : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace Omega] [MeasurableSpace Beta]
    [StandardBorelSpace Z] [Nonempty Z]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (filtration : Filtration ℕ inferInstance)
    (F : Omega → ℝ) (i : ℕ)
    (P : Omega → Beta) (Y : Omega → Z)
    (hPY : IndepFun P Y mu) (hP : Measurable P) (hY : Measurable Y)
    (hfiltration : filtration i = MeasurableSpace.comap P inferInstance)
    (G : Beta → Z → ℝ) (A : Z → ℝ) (q k : ℕ)
    (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hkq : k ≤ q)
    (hG : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry G))
    (hAq : MemLp A q (mu.map Y)) (hA : ∀ z, 0 ≤ A z)
    (hreplace : ∀ b z z', |G b z - G b z'| ≤ A z + A z')
    (hrepresentation :
      doobCenteredDifference filtration mu F (i + 1) =ᵐ[mu]
        fun omega ↦ G (P omega) (Y omega) -
          ∫ z, G (P omega) z ∂(mu.map Y)) :
    ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      mu[fun omega' ↦
          max (doobCenteredDifference filtration mu F (i + 1) omega') 0 ^ k |
        filtration i] omega ≤
          replaceOneCenteredMoment (mu.map Y) A k
proof:
:= by
  let R : Omega → ℝ := fun omega ↦
    G (P omega) (Y omega) - ∫ z, G (P omega) z ∂(mu.map Y)
  have hpower :
      (fun omega ↦
        max (doobCenteredDifference filtration mu F (i + 1) omega) 0 ^ k)
        =ᵐ[mu] fun omega ↦ max (R omega) 0 ^ k := by
    filter_upwards [hrepresentation] with omega homega
    rw [homega]
  have hcondCongr := condExp_congr_ae (m := filtration i) hpower
  have hghost := condExp_pow_max_centeredGhostFiber_le
    P Y hPY hP hY G A q k hk hkq hG hAq hA hreplace
  rw [hfiltration] at hcondCongr ⊢
  filter_upwards [hcondCongr, hghost] with omega hcongrOmega hghostOmega
  exact hcongrOmega.trans_le hghostOmega

name: ProbabilityTheory.fukNagaevTruncationLevel_pos
statement:
theorem fukNagaevTruncationLevel_pos (q : ℕ)
    {A u : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A) (hu : 0 < u) :
    0 < fukNagaevTruncationLevel q A u
proof:
:= by
  unfold fukNagaevTruncationLevel
  positivity

name: ProbabilityTheory.fukNagaevTruncationLevel_pow
statement:
theorem fukNagaevTruncationLevel_pow {q : ℕ} (hq : q ≠ 0)
    {A u : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hu : 0 < u) :
    fukNagaevTruncationLevel q A u ^ q = 3 * A / u
proof:
:= by
  unfold fukNagaevTruncationLevel
  exact Real.rpow_inv_natCast_pow (by positivity) hq

name: ProbabilityTheory.fukNagaevTruncationLevel_uniformMoment_eq
statement:
theorem fukNagaevTruncationLevel_uniformMoment_eq
    {q n : ℕ} (hq : q ≠ 0) {K u : ℝ}
    (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hu : 0 < u) :
    fukNagaevTruncationLevel q ((n : ℝ) * K ^ q) u =
      3 ^ ((q : ℝ)⁻¹) * (n : ℝ) ^ ((q : ℝ)⁻¹) * K *
        u ^ (-((q : ℝ)⁻¹))
proof:
:= by
  unfold fukNagaevTruncationLevel
  rw [Real.div_rpow (by positivity) hu.le]
  rw [Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3)
    (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n) (pow_nonneg hK q))]
  rw [Real.mul_rpow (Nat.cast_nonneg n) (pow_nonneg hK q)]
  rw [Real.pow_rpow_inv_natCast hK hq]
  rw [Real.rpow_neg hu.le]
  ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.momentBias_at_fukNagaevTruncationLevel_eq
statement:
theorem momentBias_at_fukNagaevTruncationLevel_eq
    {q : ℕ} (hq : q ≠ 0) {A u : ℝ}
    (hA : 0 < A) (hu : 0 < u) :
    A / fukNagaevTruncationLevel q A u ^ (q - 1) =
      (u / 3) * fukNagaevTruncationLevel q A u
proof:
:= by
  let y := fukNagaevTruncationLevel q A u
  have hy : 0 < y := fukNagaevTruncationLevel_pos q hA hu
  have hyPow : y ^ q = 3 * A / u :=
    fukNagaevTruncationLevel_pow hq hA.le hu
  have hqOne : 1 ≤ q := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hq
  have hpow : y ^ q = y ^ (q - 1) * y := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel hqOne]
    rw [pow_succ]
  change A / y ^ (q - 1) = (u / 3) * y
  calc
    A / y ^ (q - 1) = (A * y) / y ^ q := by
      rw [hpow]
      field_simp
    _ = (u / 3) * y := by
      rw [hyPow]
      field_simp

name: ProbabilityTheory.fukNagaevPolynomialDeviation_pos
statement:
theorem fukNagaevPolynomialDeviation_pos (r : ℕ)
    {y u : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) (hu : 0 < u) :
    0 < fukNagaevPolynomialDeviation r y u
proof:
:= by
  unfold fukNagaevPolynomialDeviation
  positivity

name: ProbabilityTheory.fukNagaevPolynomialRoot_pow
statement:
theorem fukNagaevPolynomialRoot_pow {r : ℕ} (hr : r ≠ 0)
    {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 < u) :
    ((3 * (r.factorial : ℝ) / u) ^ ((r : ℝ)⁻¹) : ℝ) ^ r =
      3 * (r.factorial : ℝ) / u
proof:
:= by
  exact Real.rpow_inv_natCast_pow (by positivity) hr

name: ProbabilityTheory.fukNagaev_three_term_le
statement:
theorem fukNagaev_three_term_le
    {A V y t u : ℝ} {q r : ℕ}
    (hy : 0 < y) (ht : 0 < t) (hV : 0 < V) (hu : 0 < u)
    (hraw : 3 * A ≤ u * y ^ q)
    (hgaussian : 8 * V * log (3 / u) ≤ t ^ 2)
    (hpolynomial :
      3 * (r.factorial : ℝ) * (8 * y) ^ r ≤ u * t ^ r) :
    A / y ^ q +
        (exp (-t ^ 2 / (8 * V)) +
          (r.factorial : ℝ) * (8 * y / t) ^ r) ≤ u
proof:
:= by
  have hyq : 0 < y ^ q := pow_pos hy q
  have htq : 0 < t ^ r := pow_pos ht r
  have hrawThird : A / y ^ q ≤ u / 3 := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hyq]
    nlinarith
  have hlogRatio : log (3 / u) ≤ t ^ 2 / (8 * V) := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 8 * V)]
    nlinarith
  have hthreeDiv : 0 < 3 / u := div_pos (by norm_num) hu
  have hgaussianThird : exp (-t ^ 2 / (8 * V)) ≤ u / 3 := by
    calc
      exp (-t ^ 2 / (8 * V)) ≤ exp (-log (3 / u)) := by
        apply exp_le_exp.mpr
        simpa only [neg_div] using neg_le_neg hlogRatio
      _ = u / 3 := by
        rw [Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log hthreeDiv]
        field_simp
  have hpolyThird :
      (r.factorial : ℝ) * (8 * y / t) ^ r ≤ u / 3 := by
    have hdiv :
        ((r.factorial : ℝ) * (8 * y) ^ r) / t ^ r ≤ u / 3 := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ htq]
      nlinarith
    convert hdiv using 1
    rw [div_pow]
    ring
  nlinarith

name: ProbabilityTheory.fukNagaevGaussianDeviation_nonneg
statement:
theorem fukNagaevGaussianDeviation_nonneg (V u : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ fukNagaevGaussianDeviation V u
proof:
:=
  sqrt_nonneg _

name: ProbabilityTheory.fukNagaevGaussianDeviation_sq
statement:
theorem fukNagaevGaussianDeviation_sq
    {V u : ℝ} (hV : 0 ≤ V) (hu : 0 < u) (hu1 : u < 1) :
    fukNagaevGaussianDeviation V u ^ 2 =
      8 * V * log (3 / u)
proof:
:= by
  unfold fukNagaevGaussianDeviation
  rw [sq_sqrt]
  have hratio : 1 < 3 / u := by
    rw [lt_div_iff₀ hu]
    linarith
  exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hV) (Real.log_pos hratio).le

name: ProbabilityTheory.fukNagaev_explicit_allocation
statement:
theorem fukNagaev_explicit_allocation
    {A V u : ℝ} {q r : ℕ} (hq : q ≠ 0) (hr : r ≠ 0)
    (hA : 0 < A) (hV : 0 < V) (hu : 0 < u) (hu1 : u < 1) :
    let y := fukNagaevTruncationLevel q A u
    let t := fukNagaevDeviation r V y u
    A / y ^ q +
        (exp (-t ^ 2 / (8 * V)) +
          (r.factorial : ℝ) * (8 * y / t) ^ r) ≤ u
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let y := fukNagaevTruncationLevel q A u
  let g := fukNagaevGaussianDeviation V u
  let p := fukNagaevPolynomialDeviation r y u
  have hy : 0 < y := fukNagaevTruncationLevel_pos q hA hu
  have hg : 0 ≤ g := fukNagaevGaussianDeviation_nonneg V u
  have hp : 0 < p := fukNagaevPolynomialDeviation_pos r hy hu
  have ht : 0 < g + p := add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos hg hp
  apply fukNagaev_three_term_le hy ht hV hu
  · rw [fukNagaevTruncationLevel_pow hq hA.le hu]
    field_simp
    norm_num
  · have hgSq := fukNagaevGaussianDeviation_sq hV.le hu hu1
    change 8 * V * log (3 / u) ≤ (g + p) ^ 2
    rw [← hgSq]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg p]
  · have hroot := fukNagaevPolynomialRoot_pow hr hu
    have hpPow : p ^ r =
        (8 * y) ^ r * (3 * (r.factorial : ℝ) / u) := by
      change (8 * y *
        (3 * (r.factorial : ℝ) / u) ^ ((r : ℝ)⁻¹)) ^ r = _
      rw [mul_pow, hroot]
    have hple : p ^ r ≤ (g + p) ^ r := by
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ hp.le (le_add_of_nonneg_left hg) r
    rw [← show fukNagaevDeviation r V y u = g + p by rfl]
    change 3 * (r.factorial : ℝ) * (8 * y) ^ r ≤
      u * (g + p) ^ r
    calc
      3 * (r.factorial : ℝ) * (8 * y) ^ r = u * p ^ r := by
        rw [hpPow]
        field_simp
      _ ≤ u * (g + p) ^ r := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hple hu.le

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_martingale_sum_large_le_u_explicit
statement:
theorem measureReal_martingale_sum_large_le_u_explicit
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (D : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hD : StronglyAdapted filtration D)
    (v : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (n q r : ℕ) (hq : q ≠ 0) (hr : r ≠ 0)
    (hDq : ∀ k < n, Integrable (fun omega ↦ |D k omega| ^ q) mu)
    (hLp : ∀ i < n, MemLp (D i) 2 mu)
    (hsecond0 : ∫ omega, D 0 omega ^ 2 ∂mu ≤ (v 0 : ℝ))
    (hsecondSucc : ∀ i < n - 1, ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      mu[fun z ↦ D (i + 1) z ^ 2 | filtration i] omega ≤
        (v (i + 1) : ℝ))
    {A u : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A)
    (hmomentSum :
      ∑ k ∈ range n, absoluteMoment (D k) q mu ≤ A)
    (hu : 0 < u) (hu1 : u < 1)
    (hV : 0 < (((∑ i ∈ range n, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ))) :
    mu.real {omega |
        fukNagaevDeviation r
            (((∑ i ∈ range n, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ))
            (fukNagaevTruncationLevel q A u) u +
          |∑ k ∈ range n,
            martingaleTruncationCenter filtration mu D
              (fukNagaevTruncationLevel q A u) k omega| ≤
        ∑ k ∈ range n, D k omega} ≤ u
proof:
:= by
  let V : ℝ := (((∑ i ∈ range n, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ))
  let y : ℝ := fukNagaevTruncationLevel q A u
  let t : ℝ := fukNagaevDeviation r V y u
  have hy : 0 < y := fukNagaevTruncationLevel_pos q hA hu
  have hg : 0 ≤ fukNagaevGaussianDeviation V u :=
    fukNagaevGaussianDeviation_nonneg V u
  have hp : 0 < fukNagaevPolynomialDeviation r y u :=
    fukNagaevPolynomialDeviation_pos r hy hu
  have ht : 0 < t := add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos hg hp
  have hbase :=
    measureReal_martingale_sum_large_le_moment_add_gaussian_add_polynomial
      (mu := mu) filtration D hD v n q r hDq hLp hsecond0
        hsecondSucc hy ht hV
  have hdet := fukNagaev_explicit_allocation hq hr hA hV hu hu1
  have hmomentDiv :
      (∑ k ∈ range n, absoluteMoment (D k) q mu) / y ^ q ≤
        A / y ^ q :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hmomentSum (pow_nonneg hy.le q)
  have hdet' :
      A / y ^ q +
          (exp (-t ^ 2 / (8 * V)) +
            (r.factorial : ℝ) * (8 * y / t) ^ r) ≤ u := by
    simpa only [V, y, t] using hdet
  have hreplace :
      (∑ k ∈ range n, absoluteMoment (D k) q mu) / y ^ q +
          (exp (-t ^ 2 / (8 * V)) +
            (r.factorial : ℝ) * (8 * y / t) ^ r) ≤
        A / y ^ q +
          (exp (-t ^ 2 / (8 * V)) +
            (r.factorial : ℝ) * (8 * y / t) ^ r) :=
    add_le_add hmomentDiv le_rfl
  change mu.real {omega | t +
      |∑ k ∈ range n,
        martingaleTruncationCenter filtration mu D y k omega| ≤
      ∑ k ∈ range n, D k omega} ≤ u
  exact hbase.trans (hreplace.trans hdet')

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_martingale_sum_large_le_u_uniformMoment
statement:
theorem measureReal_martingale_sum_large_le_u_uniformMoment
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (D : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hD : StronglyAdapted filtration D)
    (v : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (n q r : ℕ) (hq : q ≠ 0) (hr : r ≠ 0)
    (hDq : ∀ k < n, Integrable (fun omega ↦ |D k omega| ^ q) mu)
    (hLp : ∀ i < n, MemLp (D i) 2 mu)
    (hcenter0 : ∫ omega, D 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hcenterSucc : ∀ k < n - 1,
      mu[D (k + 1) | filtration k] =ᵐ[mu] 0)
    (hsecond0 : ∫ omega, D 0 omega ^ 2 ∂mu ≤ (v 0 : ℝ))
    (hsecondSucc : ∀ i < n - 1, ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      mu[fun z ↦ D (i + 1) z ^ 2 | filtration i] omega ≤
        (v (i + 1) : ℝ))
    {K u : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K)
    (hmoment : ∀ k < n, absoluteMoment (D k) q mu ≤ K ^ q)
    (hcondMoment : ∀ k < n - 1, ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      mu[fun z ↦ |D (k + 1) z| ^ q | filtration k] omega ≤ K ^ q)
    (hu : 0 < u) (hu1 : u < 1)
    (hV : 0 < (((∑ i ∈ range n, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ))) :
    mu.real {omega |
        fukNagaevDeviation r
            (((∑ i ∈ range n, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ))
            (fukNagaevTruncationLevel q ((n : ℝ) * K ^ q) u) u +
          (u / 3) *
            fukNagaevTruncationLevel q ((n : ℝ) * K ^ q) u ≤
        ∑ k ∈ range n, D k omega} ≤ u
proof:
:= by
  let V : ℝ := (((∑ i ∈ range n, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ))
  let A : ℝ := (n : ℝ) * K ^ q
  let y : ℝ := fukNagaevTruncationLevel q A u
  let t : ℝ := fukNagaevDeviation r V y u
  let Kseq : ℕ → ℝ := fun _ ↦ K ^ q
  have hn : 0 < n := by
    cases n with
    | zero => simp at hV
    | succ n => omega
  have hA : 0 < A := mul_pos (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hn) (pow_pos hK q)
  have hy : 0 < y := fukNagaevTruncationLevel_pos q hA hu
  have hg : 0 ≤ fukNagaevGaussianDeviation V u :=
    fukNagaevGaussianDeviation_nonneg V u
  have hp : 0 < fukNagaevPolynomialDeviation r y u :=
    fukNagaevPolynomialDeviation_pos r hy hu
  have ht : 0 < t := add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos hg hp
  have hqOne : 1 ≤ q := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hq
  have hmoment0 : absoluteMoment (D 0) q mu ≤ Kseq 0 := by
    exact hmoment 0 hn
  have hcondMoment' : ∀ k < n - 1, ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      mu[fun z ↦ |D (k + 1) z| ^ q | filtration k] omega ≤
        Kseq (k + 1) := by
    intro k hk
    exact hcondMoment k hk
  have hbase :=
    measureReal_martingale_sum_large_le_condMoment_bias_add_gaussian_add_polynomial
      (mu := mu) filtration D hD v n q r hqOne hDq hLp hcenter0
        hcenterSucc hsecond0 hsecondSucc Kseq hmoment0 hcondMoment'
        hy ht hV
  have hKsum : ∑ k ∈ range n, Kseq k = A := by
    simp only [Kseq, sum_const, card_range, nsmul_eq_mul, A]
  rw [hKsum] at hbase
  have hbias : A / y ^ (q - 1) = (u / 3) * y := by
    exact momentBias_at_fukNagaevTruncationLevel_eq hq hA hu
  rw [hbias] at hbase
  have hmomentSum :
      ∑ k ∈ range n, absoluteMoment (D k) q mu ≤ A := by
    calc
      ∑ k ∈ range n, absoluteMoment (D k) q mu ≤
          ∑ _k ∈ range n, K ^ q := by
        gcongr with k hk
        exact hmoment k (mem_range.mp hk)
      _ = A := by
        simp only [sum_const, card_range, nsmul_eq_mul, A]
  have hmomentDiv :
      (∑ k ∈ range n, absoluteMoment (D k) q mu) / y ^ q ≤
        A / y ^ q :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hmomentSum (pow_nonneg hy.le q)
  have hdet := fukNagaev_explicit_allocation hq hr hA hV hu hu1
  have hdet' :
      A / y ^ q +
          (exp (-t ^ 2 / (8 * V)) +
            (r.factorial : ℝ) * (8 * y / t) ^ r) ≤ u := by
    simpa only [V, A, y, t] using hdet
  have hreplace :
      (∑ k ∈ range n, absoluteMoment (D k) q mu) / y ^ q +
          (exp (-t ^ 2 / (8 * V)) +
            (r.factorial : ℝ) * (8 * y / t) ^ r) ≤
        A / y ^ q +
          (exp (-t ^ 2 / (8 * V)) +
            (r.factorial : ℝ) * (8 * y / t) ^ r) :=
    add_le_add hmomentDiv le_rfl
  change mu.real {omega | t + (u / 3) * y ≤
      ∑ k ∈ range n, D k omega} ≤ u
  exact hbase.trans (hreplace.trans hdet')

name: ProbabilityTheory.polynomial_remainder_control_forces_power_deviation
statement:
theorem polynomial_remainder_control_forces_power_deviation
    {r : ℕ} {y t u : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t)
    (hcontrol :
      (r.factorial : ℝ) * (8 * y / t) ^ r ≤ u / 3) :
    3 * (r.factorial : ℝ) * (8 * y) ^ r ≤ u * t ^ r
proof:
:= by
  have htPow : 0 < t ^ r := pow_pos ht r
  rw [div_pow] at hcontrol
  have hcontrol' :
      ((r.factorial : ℝ) * (8 * y) ^ r) / t ^ r ≤ u / 3 := by
    convert hcontrol using 1
    ring
  rw [div_le_iff₀ htPow] at hcontrol'
  nlinarith

name: ProbabilityTheory.polynomial_remainder_control_forces_deviation
statement:
theorem polynomial_remainder_control_forces_deviation
    {r : ℕ} (hr : r ≠ 0) {y t u : ℝ}
    (ht : 0 < t) (hu : 0 < u)
    (hcontrol :
      (r.factorial : ℝ) * (8 * y / t) ^ r ≤ u / 3) :
    8 * y * (3 * (r.factorial : ℝ) / u) ^ ((r : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤ t
proof:
:= by
  have hpower := polynomial_remainder_control_forces_power_deviation
    ht hcontrol
  let c : ℝ := (3 * (r.factorial : ℝ) / u) ^ ((r : ℝ)⁻¹)
  have hcPow : c ^ r = 3 * (r.factorial : ℝ) / u := by
    exact fukNagaevPolynomialRoot_pow hr hu
  apply le_of_pow_le_pow_left₀ hr ht.le
  rw [mul_pow, hcPow]
  have huPower :
      (3 * (r.factorial : ℝ) / u) * (8 * y) ^ r ≤ t ^ r := by
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_iff₀ hu]
    nlinarith
  nlinarith

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_supportDenseCandidate
statement:
theorem exists_supportDenseCandidate
    {Ω H : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
    {S : Ω → Set H} (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    {f : ℕ → Ω → H}
    (hclosure : ∀ ω, closure (Set.range fun n => f n ω) = S ω)
    (u : H) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (ω : Ω) :
    ∃ n, SupportDenseCandidate S f u ε n ω
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxmax⟩ := supportFunction_attains (hcompact ω) (hne ω) u
  let U : Set H := {y | supportFunction (S ω) u - ε < ⟪u, y⟫_ℝ}
  have hUopen : IsOpen U := isOpen_lt continuous_const (by fun_prop)
  have hxU : x ∈ U := by
    dsimp [U]
    rw [hxmax]
    linarith
  have hxclosure : x ∈ closure (Set.range fun n => f n ω) := by
    rw [hclosure ω]
    exact hx
  obtain ⟨y, hyU, hyRange⟩ :=
    (_root_.mem_closure_iff.mp hxclosure) U hUopen hxU
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := hyRange
  exact ⟨n, hyU⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.measurable_supportApproximateSelection
statement:
theorem measurable_supportApproximateSelection
    {Ω H : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H] [Nonempty H]
    {S : Ω → Set H} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω)) (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    (u : H) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    Measurable (supportApproximateSelection hS hcompact hne u ε hε)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f : ℕ → Ω → H := castaingRepresentation hS (fun ω => (hcompact ω).isClosed) hne
  have hf : ∀ n, Measurable (f n) :=
    castaingRepresentation_measurable hS (fun ω => (hcompact ω).isClosed) hne
  have hsupport : Measurable (fun ω => supportFunction (S ω) u) :=
    measurable_supportFunction hS hcompact hne u
  have hp : ∀ n, MeasurableSet {ω | SupportDenseCandidate S f u ε n ω} := by
    intro n
    exact measurableSet_lt (hsupport.sub measurable_const) ((hf n).const_inner)
  have hexists : ∀ ω, ∃ n, SupportDenseCandidate S f u ε n ω :=
    exists_supportDenseCandidate hcompact hne
      (closure_range_castaingRepresentation hS (fun ω => (hcompact ω).isClosed) hne)
      u hε
  exact Measurable.find hf hp hexists

name: RandomSetTheory.supportApproximateSelection_mem
statement:
theorem supportApproximateSelection_mem
    {Ω H : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H] [Nonempty H]
    {S : Ω → Set H} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω)) (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    (u : H) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (ω : Ω) :
    supportApproximateSelection hS hcompact hne u ε hε ω ∈ S ω
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact castaingRepresentation_mem hS (fun ω => (hcompact ω).isClosed) hne _ ω

name: RandomSetTheory.supportFunction_sub_lt_inner_supportApproximateSelection
statement:
theorem supportFunction_sub_lt_inner_supportApproximateSelection
    {Ω H : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H] [Nonempty H]
    {S : Ω → Set H} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω)) (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    (u : H) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (ω : Ω) :
    supportFunction (S ω) u - ε <
      ⟪u, supportApproximateSelection hS hcompact hne u ε hε ω⟫_ℝ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact Nat.find_spec (exists_supportDenseCandidate hcompact hne
    (closure_range_castaingRepresentation hS (fun ω => (hcompact ω).isClosed) hne)
    u hε ω)

name: RandomSetTheory.integrableSelection_supportApproximateSelection_of_envelope
statement:
theorem integrableSelection_supportApproximateSelection_of_envelope
    {Ω H : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H] [Nonempty H]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S : Ω → Set H} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω)) (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    {g : Ω → ℝ} (hg : Integrable g μ)
    (hdom : ∀ ω, ∀ x ∈ S ω, ‖x‖ ≤ g ω)
    (u : H) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    IsIntegrableSelection μ S
      (supportApproximateSelection hS hcompact hne u ε hε)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · apply hg.mono'
      (measurable_supportApproximateSelection hS hcompact hne u hε).aestronglyMeasurable
    filter_upwards [] with ω
    exact hdom ω _ (supportApproximateSelection_mem hS hcompact hne u hε ω)
  · filter_upwards [] with ω
    exact supportApproximateSelection_mem hS hcompact hne u hε ω

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_integrable_supportApproximation
statement:
theorem exists_integrable_supportApproximation
    {Ω H : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H] [Nonempty H]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S : Ω → Set H} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω)) (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    {g : Ω → ℝ} (hg : Integrable g μ)
    (hdom : ∀ ω, ∀ x ∈ S ω, ‖x‖ ≤ g ω)
    (u : H) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ f : Ω → H, IsIntegrableSelection μ S f ∧
      ∀ ω, supportFunction (S ω) u - ε < ⟪u, f ω⟫_ℝ
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨supportApproximateSelection hS hcompact hne u ε hε,
    integrableSelection_supportApproximateSelection_of_envelope
      hS hcompact hne hg hdom u hε,
    supportFunction_sub_lt_inner_supportApproximateSelection
      hS hcompact hne u hε⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.inner_integral_supportApproximateSelection_lower_bound
statement:
theorem inner_integral_supportApproximateSelection_lower_bound
    {Ω H : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H] [Nonempty H]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {S : Ω → Set H} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω)) (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    {g : Ω → ℝ} (hg : Integrable g μ)
    (hdom : ∀ ω, ∀ x ∈ S ω, ‖x‖ ≤ g ω)
    (u : H) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    (∫ ω, supportFunction (S ω) u ∂μ) - μ.real Set.univ * ε ≤
      ⟪u, ∫ ω, supportApproximateSelection hS hcompact hne u ε hε ω ∂μ⟫_ℝ
proof:
:= by
  let f := supportApproximateSelection hS hcompact hne u ε hε
  have hf : IsIntegrableSelection μ S f :=
    integrableSelection_supportApproximateSelection_of_envelope
      hS hcompact hne hg hdom u hε
  have hsupport : Integrable (fun ω => supportFunction (S ω) u) μ :=
    integrable_supportFunction_of_envelope hS hcompact hne hg hdom u
  rw [← integral_inner hf.1 u]
  calc
    (∫ ω, supportFunction (S ω) u ∂μ) - μ.real Set.univ * ε =
        ∫ ω, supportFunction (S ω) u - ε ∂μ := by
      rw [integral_sub hsupport (integrable_const ε), integral_const]
      simp [smul_eq_mul]
    _ ≤ ∫ ω, ⟪u, f ω⟫_ℝ ∂μ := by
      apply integral_mono_ae (hsupport.sub (integrable_const ε)) (hf.1.const_inner u)
      filter_upwards [] with ω
      exact (supportFunction_sub_lt_inner_supportApproximateSelection
        hS hcompact hne u hε ω).le

name: RandomSetTheory.supportFunction_closure_aumannExpectation_of_envelope
statement:
theorem supportFunction_closure_aumannExpectation_of_envelope
    {Ω H : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H] [Nonempty H]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {S : Ω → Set H} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω)) (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    {g : Ω → ℝ} (hg : Integrable g μ)
    (hdom : ∀ ω, ∀ x ∈ S ω, ‖x‖ ≤ g ω)
    (hAcompact : IsCompact (closure (aumannExpectation μ S))) (u : H) :
    supportFunction (closure (aumannExpectation μ S)) u =
      ∫ ω, supportFunction (S ω) u ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have hsupport : Integrable (fun ω => supportFunction (S ω) u) μ :=
    integrable_supportFunction_of_envelope hS hcompact hne hg hdom u
  have hfOne : IsIntegrableSelection μ S
      (supportApproximateSelection hS hcompact hne u 1 (by norm_num)) :=
    integrableSelection_supportApproximateSelection_of_envelope
      hS hcompact hne hg hdom u (by norm_num)
  have hAne : (closure (aumannExpectation μ S)).Nonempty :=
    (aumannExpectation_nonempty_of_selection hfOne).closure
  apply le_antisymm
  · obtain ⟨x, hx, hxEq⟩ := supportFunction_attains hAcompact hAne u
    rw [hxEq]
    apply closure_minimal _
        (isClosed_le (by fun_prop : Continuous fun x : H => ⟪u, x⟫_ℝ)
          continuous_const) hx
    intro y hy
    exact inner_le_integral_supportFunction_of_mem_aumannExpectation
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hcompact) u hsupport hy
  · apply le_of_forall_pos_le_add
    intro δ hδ
    let m : ℝ := μ.real Set.univ
    let ε : ℝ := δ / (m + 1)
    have hm : 0 ≤ m := measureReal_nonneg
    have hm1 : 0 < m + 1 := by linarith
    have hε : 0 < ε := div_pos hδ hm1
    have hmε : m * ε < δ := by
      calc
        m * ε < (m + 1) * ε := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (by linarith) hε
        _ = δ := by
          dsimp [ε]
          exact mul_div_cancel₀ δ (ne_of_gt hm1)
    have hlower := inner_integral_supportApproximateSelection_lower_bound
      hS hcompact hne hg hdom u hε
    have hmem :
        (∫ ω, supportApproximateSelection hS hcompact hne u ε hε ω ∂μ) ∈
          closure (aumannExpectation μ S) := by
      apply subset_closure
      exact ⟨supportApproximateSelection hS hcompact hne u ε hε,
        integrableSelection_supportApproximateSelection_of_envelope
          hS hcompact hne hg hdom u hε, rfl⟩
    have hinner := inner_le_supportFunction hAcompact hmem u
    dsimp [m] at hmε hlower
    linarith

name: RandomSetTheory.supportFunction_aumannExpectation_of_envelope
statement:
theorem supportFunction_aumannExpectation_of_envelope
    {Ω H : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H] [Nonempty H]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ H]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {S : Ω → Set H} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω)) (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    {g : Ω → ℝ} (hg : Integrable g μ)
    (hdom : ∀ ω, ∀ x ∈ S ω, ‖x‖ ≤ g ω) (u : H) :
    supportFunction (aumannExpectation μ S) u =
      ∫ ω, supportFunction (S ω) u ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have hAcompact : IsCompact (closure (aumannExpectation μ S)) :=
    closure_aumannExpectation_compact_of_integrable_envelope hg
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hdom)
  have hf : IsIntegrableSelection μ S
      (supportApproximateSelection hS hcompact hne u 1 (by norm_num)) :=
    integrableSelection_supportApproximateSelection_of_envelope
      hS hcompact hne hg hdom u (by norm_num)
  have hAne : (aumannExpectation μ S).Nonempty :=
    aumannExpectation_nonempty_of_selection hf
  rw [← supportFunction_closure_eq hAcompact hAne u]
  exact supportFunction_closure_aumannExpectation_of_envelope
    hS hcompact hne hg hdom hAcompact u

name: RandomSetTheory.abs_supportFunction_sub_le_radiusEnvelope
statement:
theorem abs_supportFunction_sub_le_radiusEnvelope
    (F : Z → Set E) (hFcompact : ∀ z, IsCompact (F z))
    (hFne : ∀ z, (F z).Nonempty) (R : Z → ℝ)
    (hRbound : ∀ z x, x ∈ F z → ‖x‖ ≤ R z) :
    ∀ z s t,
      |supportFunction (F z) s - supportFunction (F z) t| ≤
        R z * dist s t
proof:
:= by
  intro z s t
  simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using
    abs_supportFunction_sub_le
      (hFcompact z) (hFne z) (hRbound z) s t

    (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (hRbound : ∀ z x, x ∈ F z → ‖x‖ ≤ R z) :
    ∀ z, Continuous (supportFunction (F z))
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  apply (LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul (K := ⟨R z, hR z⟩) ?_).continuous
  intro s t
  exact abs_supportFunction_sub_le_radiusEnvelope
    F hFcompact hFne R hRbound z s t

name: RandomSetTheory.measurable_centeredSupportEmpiricalContinuousMap
statement:
theorem measurable_centeredSupportEmpiricalContinuousMap
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    [MeasurableSpace C(EuclideanUnitBall E, ℝ)]
    [BorelSpace C(EuclideanUnitBall E, ℝ)]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (F : Z → Set E) (hF : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable F)
    (hFcompact : ∀ z, IsCompact (F z))
    (hFne : ∀ z, (F z).Nonempty)
    (R : Z → ℝ) (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (hRbound : ∀ z x, x ∈ F z → ‖x‖ ≤ R z)
    (hRL2 : ∀ i, MemLp (fun omega ↦ R (X i omega)) 2 mu)
    (n : ℕ) :
    Measurable (centeredSupportEmpiricalContinuousMap (mu := mu)
      X hX F hF hFcompact hFne R hR hRbound hRL2 n)
proof:
:= by
  exact ProbabilityTheory.measurable_centeredAnchoredEmpiricalContinuousMap
    (fun z u ↦ supportFunction (F z) u) R X hX
      (fun u ↦ measurable_supportFunction hF hFcompact hFne u)
      (continuous_supportFunction_of_radiusEnvelope
        F hFcompact hFne R hR hRbound)
      hR (abs_supportFunction_sub_le_radiusEnvelope
        F hFcompact hFne R hRbound) hRL2 n

name: RandomSetTheory.measurable_centeredTruncatedSupportEmpiricalContinuousMap
statement:
theorem measurable_centeredTruncatedSupportEmpiricalContinuousMap
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    [MeasurableSpace C(EuclideanUnitBall E, ℝ)]
    [BorelSpace C(EuclideanUnitBall E, ℝ)]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (F : Z → Set E) (hF : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable F)
    (hFcompact : ∀ z, IsCompact (F z))
    (hFne : ∀ z, (F z).Nonempty)
    (R : Z → ℝ) (hRmeas : Measurable R)
    (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (hRbound : ∀ z x, x ∈ F z → ‖x‖ ≤ R z)
    (n : ℕ) :
    Measurable (centeredTruncatedSupportEmpiricalContinuousMap (mu := mu)
      X hX F hF hFcompact hFne R hRmeas hR hRbound n)
proof:
:= by
  exact ProbabilityTheory.measurable_centeredTruncatedEmpiricalContinuousMap
    (fun z u ↦ supportFunction (F z) u) R (a := 1) (by norm_num) X hX
      (fun u ↦ measurable_supportFunction hF hFcompact hFne u)
      (continuous_supportFunction_of_radiusEnvelope
        F hFcompact hFne R hR hRbound)
      hRmeas hR (abs_supportFunction_sub_le_radiusEnvelope
        F hFcompact hFne R hRbound) n

name: RandomSetTheory.memLp_finiteDirectionalSupportDeviation_of_radiusEnvelope
statement:
theorem memLp_finiteDirectionalSupportDeviation_of_radiusEnvelope
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → Z)
    (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (F : Z → Set E) (hF : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable F)
    (hFcompact : ∀ z, IsCompact (F z))
    (hFne : ∀ z, (F z).Nonempty)
    (L : Set E) (R : Z → ℝ)
    (hRbound : ∀ z x, x ∈ F z → ‖x‖ ≤ R z)
    (hRL2 : MemLp (fun omega ↦ R (X 0 omega)) 2 mu)
    {k : ℕ} (t : Fin k → EuclideanUnitBall E) :
    MemLp
      (finiteDirectionalSupportDeviation
        (fun i omega ↦ F (X i omega)) L (fun j ↦ (t j : E)) 0)
      2 mu
proof:
:= by
  apply MemLp.of_eval_piLp
  intro j
  have hsuppMeas : Measurable
    (fun omega ↦ supportFunction (F (X 0 omega)) (t j : E)) :=
    (measurable_supportFunction hF hFcompact hFne (t j : E)).comp
      (hX 0)
  have hsuppL2 : MemLp
      (fun omega ↦ supportFunction (F (X 0 omega)) (t j : E)) 2 mu := by
    apply hRL2.mono' hsuppMeas.aestronglyMeasurable
    filter_upwards [] with omega
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      abs_supportFunction_le_radius
        (hFcompact (X 0 omega)) (hFne (X 0 omega))
        (hRbound (X 0 omega)) (t j).property
  exact hsuppL2.sub (memLp_const (supportFunction L (t j : E)))

name: RandomSetTheory.centeredAnchoredEmpiricalContinuousMap_supportFunction_apply
statement:
theorem centeredAnchoredEmpiricalContinuousMap_supportFunction_apply
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (F : Z → Set E)
    (hFcompact : ∀ z, IsCompact (F z))
    (hFne : ∀ z, (F z).Nonempty)
    (L : Set E) (R : Z → ℝ)
    (hHmeas : ∀ t, Measurable (fun z ↦ supportFunction (F z) t))
    (hHcont : ∀ z, Continuous (supportFunction (F z)))
    (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (hLip : ∀ z s t,
      |supportFunction (F z) s - supportFunction (F z) t| ≤
        R z * dist s t)
    (hRL2 : ∀ i, MemLp (fun omega ↦ R (X i omega)) 2 mu)
    (hLsupport : ∀ u,
      supportFunction L u =
        ∫ omega, supportFunction (F (X 0 omega)) u ∂mu)
    (n : ℕ) (omega : Omega) (t : EuclideanUnitBall E) :
    ProbabilityTheory.centeredAnchoredEmpiricalContinuousMap (mu := mu)
        (fun z u ↦ supportFunction (F z) u) R X hX hHmeas hHcont
        hR hLip hRL2 n omega t =
      √((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        (supportFunction
            (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range (n + 1))
              (fun i ↦ F (X i omega))) (t : E) -
          supportFunction L (t : E))
proof:
:= by
  rw [ProbabilityTheory.centeredAnchoredEmpiricalContinuousMap_apply]
  unfold ProbabilityTheory.centeredAnchoredEmpiricalProcess
  simp only [ProbabilityTheory.lipschitzIncrement,
    supportFunction_zero (hFcompact _) (hFne _), sub_zero]
  have hint : ∀ i,
      ∫ xi, supportFunction (F (X i xi)) (t : E) ∂mu =
        ∫ xi, supportFunction (F (X 0 xi)) (t : E) ∂mu := by
    intro i
    exact ((hident i).comp (hHmeas (t : E))).integral_eq
  simp_rw [hint]
  rw [← hLsupport (t : E)]
  rw [supportFunction_minkowskiAverage
    (Finset.range (n + 1)) (fun i ↦ F (X i omega))
    (fun i _ ↦ hFcompact (X i omega))
    (fun i _ ↦ hFne (X i omega))]
  simp only [Finset.card_range, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
  have hn : (0 : ℝ) < (n + 1 : ℕ) := by positivity
  have hsqrt : √((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≠ 0 :=
    ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hn)
  norm_num [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] at hn hsqrt ⊢
  field_simp
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt hn.le]

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_gaussianProcess_tendsto_centeredSupport_of_l2
statement:
theorem exists_gaussianProcess_tendsto_centeredSupport_of_l2
    [MeasurableSpace C(EuclideanUnitBall E, ℝ)]
    [BorelSpace C(EuclideanUnitBall E, ℝ)]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hindep : iIndepFun X mu)
    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (F : Z → Set E) (hF : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable F)
    (hFcompact : ∀ z, IsCompact (F z))
    (hFne : ∀ z, (F z).Nonempty)
    (L : Set E) (R : Z → ℝ) (hRmeas : Measurable R)
    (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (hRbound : ∀ z x, x ∈ F z → ‖x‖ ≤ R z)
    {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K)
    (hRL2 : ∀ i, MemLp (fun omega ↦ R (X i omega)) 2 mu)
    (hRsecond : ∀ i,
      ∫ omega, R (X i omega) ^ 2 ∂mu ≤ K ^ 2)
    (hLsupport : ∀ u,
      supportFunction L u =
        ∫ omega, supportFunction (F (X 0 omega)) u ∂mu) :
    ∃ mu0 : ProbabilityMeasure C(EuclideanUnitBall E, ℝ),
      TendstoInDistribution
          (fun n ↦ centeredSupportEmpiricalContinuousMap (mu := mu)
            X hX F hF hFcompact hFne R hR hRbound hRL2 n)
          atTop id (fun _ ↦ mu) (mu0 : Measure C(EuclideanUnitBall E, ℝ)) ∧
        (∀ (k : ℕ) (t : Fin k → EuclideanUnitBall E),
          ProbabilityMeasure.map mu0
              (finiteEvaluationVectorCLM (EuclideanUnitBall E) t).measurable.aemeasurable =
            ⟨multivariateGaussian 0
                (finiteDirectionalSupportCovariance
                  (fun i omega ↦ F (X i omega)) L
                  (fun j ↦ (t j : E)) mu), inferInstance⟩) ∧
        IsGaussianProcess
          (fun q (f : C(EuclideanUnitBall E, ℝ)) ↦ f q)
          (mu0 : Measure C(EuclideanUnitBall E, ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let H : Z → E → ℝ := fun z u ↦ supportFunction (F z) u
  let Y : ℕ → Omega → C(EuclideanUnitBall E, ℝ) := fun n ↦
    centeredSupportEmpiricalContinuousMap (mu := mu)
      X hX F hF hFcompact hFne R hR hRbound hRL2 n
  let Ytr : ℕ → Omega → C(EuclideanUnitBall E, ℝ) := fun n ↦
    centeredTruncatedSupportEmpiricalContinuousMap (mu := mu)
      X hX F hF hFcompact hFne R hRmeas hR hRbound n
  have hRawPathMeas : ∀ n, AEMeasurable (Y n) mu := fun n ↦
    (measurable_centeredSupportEmpiricalContinuousMap
      X hX F hF hFcompact hFne R hR hRbound hRL2 n).aemeasurable
  have hTruncatedPathMeas : ∀ n, AEMeasurable (Ytr n) mu := fun n ↦
    (measurable_centeredTruncatedSupportEmpiricalContinuousMap
      X hX F hF hFcompact hFne R hRmeas hR hRbound n).aemeasurable
  let laws : ℕ → ProbabilityMeasure C(EuclideanUnitBall E, ℝ) :=
    fun n ↦ ⟨mu.map (Y n),
      Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (hRawPathMeas n)⟩
  let rho : ∀ k : ℕ, (Fin k → EuclideanUnitBall E) →
      ProbabilityMeasure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) := fun k t ↦
    ⟨multivariateGaussian 0
      (finiteDirectionalSupportCovariance
        (fun i omega ↦ F (X i omega)) L (fun j ↦ (t j : E)) mu),
      inferInstance⟩
  have hHmeas : ∀ u, Measurable (fun z ↦ H z u) := fun u ↦
    measurable_supportFunction hF hFcompact hFne u
  have hHcont : ∀ z, Continuous (H z) :=
    continuous_supportFunction_of_radiusEnvelope
      F hFcompact hFne R hR hRbound
  have hLip : ∀ z s t, |H z s - H z t| ≤ R z * dist s t :=
    abs_supportFunction_sub_le_radiusEnvelope
      F hFcompact hFne R hRbound
  have htight : IsTightMeasureSet
      {((laws n : ProbabilityMeasure C(EuclideanUnitBall E, ℝ)) :
        Measure C(EuclideanUnitBall E, ℝ)) | n} := by
    have ht :=
      ProbabilityTheory.isTightMeasureSet_range_centeredAnchoredEmpiricalContinuousMap
        (fun z u ↦ supportFunction (F z) u) R hK X hX hindep
          (fun u ↦ measurable_supportFunction hF hFcompact hFne u)
          (continuous_supportFunction_of_radiusEnvelope
            F hFcompact hFne R hR hRbound)
          hRmeas hR
          (abs_supportFunction_sub_le_radiusEnvelope
            F hFcompact hFne R hRbound) hRL2
          hRsecond
          hRawPathMeas hTruncatedPathMeas
    change IsTightMeasureSet (Set.range fun n ↦ mu.map (Y n))
    have hYdef : Y = fun n ↦
        ProbabilityTheory.centeredAnchoredEmpiricalContinuousMap (mu := mu)
          (fun z u ↦ supportFunction (F z) u) R X hX
          (fun u ↦ measurable_supportFunction hF hFcompact hFne u)
          (continuous_supportFunction_of_radiusEnvelope
            F hFcompact hFne R hR hRbound)
          hR (abs_supportFunction_sub_le_radiusEnvelope
            F hFcompact hFne R hRbound) hRL2 n := rfl
    rw [hYdef]
    exact ht
  have hvec : ∀ (k : ℕ) (t : Fin k → EuclideanUnitBall E),
      Tendsto
        (fun n ↦ ProbabilityMeasure.map (laws n)
          (finiteEvaluationVectorCLM (EuclideanUnitBall E) t).measurable.aemeasurable)
        atTop (nhds (rho k t)) := by
    intro k t
    let V : ℕ → Omega → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) := fun n omega ↦
      toLp 2 (fun j ↦
        √((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          (supportFunction
              (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range (n + 1))
                (fun i ↦ F (X i omega))) (t j : E) -
            supportFunction L (t j : E)))
    have hfiniteL2 : MemLp
        (finiteDirectionalSupportDeviation
          (fun i omega ↦ F (X i omega)) L (fun j ↦ (t j : E)) 0)
        2 mu :=
      memLp_finiteDirectionalSupportDeviation_of_radiusEnvelope
        X hX F hF hFcompact hFne L R hRbound (hRL2 0) t
    have hYlaw : HasLaw
        (id : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k))
        (rho k t : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)))
        (rho k t : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k))) := HasLaw.id
    have hclt : TendstoInDistribution V atTop id (fun _ ↦ mu)
        (rho k t : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k))) := by
      simpa only [V, rho] using
        tendstoInDistribution_iid_finiteDirectionalSupport_minkowskiAverage
          X hindep hident F hF hFcompact hFne L
            (fun j ↦ (t j : E)) id hYlaw hfiniteL2
            (fun j ↦ hLsupport (t j : E))
    have heval : TendstoInDistribution
        (fun n omega ↦
          finiteEvaluationVectorCLM (EuclideanUnitBall E) t (Y n omega))
        atTop id (fun _ ↦ mu)
        (rho k t : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k))) := by
      apply hclt.congr
      · intro n
        filter_upwards [] with omega
        ext j
        exact (centeredAnchoredEmpiricalContinuousMap_supportFunction_apply
          X hX hident F hFcompact hFne L R hHmeas hHcont hR hLip hRL2
            hLsupport n omega (t j)).symm
      · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ ↦ rfl
    let evalLaws : ℕ → ProbabilityMeasure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) :=
      fun n ↦ ⟨mu.map (fun omega ↦
        finiteEvaluationVectorCLM (EuclideanUnitBall E) t (Y n omega)),
        Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (heval.forall_aemeasurable n)⟩
    let limitLaw : ProbabilityMeasure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) :=
      ⟨(rho k t : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k))).map id,
        Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map heval.aemeasurable_limit⟩
    have hevalTendsto : Tendsto evalLaws atTop (nhds limitLaw) := by
      exact heval.tendsto
    have hsource :
        (fun n ↦ ProbabilityMeasure.map (laws n)
          (finiteEvaluationVectorCLM
            (EuclideanUnitBall E) t).measurable.aemeasurable) = evalLaws := by
      funext n
      apply Subtype.ext
      change (mu.map (Y n)).map
          (finiteEvaluationVectorCLM (EuclideanUnitBall E) t) =
        mu.map (fun omega ↦
          finiteEvaluationVectorCLM (EuclideanUnitBall E) t (Y n omega))
      rw [AEMeasurable.map_map_of_aemeasurable
        (finiteEvaluationVectorCLM
          (EuclideanUnitBall E) t).measurable.aemeasurable
        (hRawPathMeas n)]
      rfl
    have hlimit : limitLaw = rho k t := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact Measure.map_id
    rw [hsource, ← hlimit]
    exact hevalTendsto
  obtain ⟨mu0, hmu0, _hunique⟩ :=
    ProbabilityMeasure.existsUnique_tendsto_of_tight_of_finiteEvaluationVectorLimits
      (EuclideanUnitBall E) laws rho htight hvec
  have hprocess : TendstoInDistribution Y atTop id (fun _ ↦ mu)
      (mu0 : Measure C(EuclideanUnitBall E, ℝ)) :=
    { forall_aemeasurable := hRawPathMeas
      aemeasurable_limit := measurable_id.aemeasurable
      tendsto := by
        let targetLaw : ProbabilityMeasure C(EuclideanUnitBall E, ℝ) :=
          ⟨(mu0 : Measure C(EuclideanUnitBall E, ℝ)).map id,
            Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map measurable_id.aemeasurable⟩
        have htarget : targetLaw = mu0 := by
          apply Subtype.ext
          exact Measure.map_id
        change Tendsto laws atTop (nhds targetLaw)
        rw [htarget]
        exact hmu0.1 }
  have hgaussian : IsGaussianProcess
      (fun q (f : C(EuclideanUnitBall E, ℝ)) ↦ f q)
      (mu0 : Measure C(EuclideanUnitBall E, ℝ)) :=
    isGaussianProcess_canonical_of_finiteEvaluationVector_isGaussian
      (EuclideanUnitBall E) mu0 rho hmu0.2 (fun _k _t ↦ by
        change IsGaussian (multivariateGaussian 0
          (finiteDirectionalSupportCovariance
            (fun i omega ↦ F (X i omega)) L
            (fun j ↦ (_t j : E)) mu))
        infer_instance)
  refine ⟨mu0, ?_, ?_, hgaussian⟩
  · simpa only [Y] using hprocess
  · intro k t
    simpa only [rho] using hmu0.2 k t

name: RandomSetTheory.pointwiseRandomSetL2CLT_of_iid
statement:
theorem pointwiseRandomSetL2CLT_of_iid
    [Nontrivial E]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hindep : iIndepFun X mu)
    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (F : Z → Set E) (hF : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable F)
    (hFcompact : ∀ z, IsCompact (F z))
    (hFne : ∀ z, (F z).Nonempty)
    (hFconv : ∀ z, Convex ℝ (F z))
    (L : Set E) (hLcompact : IsCompact L) (hLne : L.Nonempty)
    (hLconv : Convex ℝ L)
    (R : Z → ℝ) (hRmeas : Measurable R)
    (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (hRbound : ∀ z x, x ∈ F z → ‖x‖ ≤ R z)
    {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K)
    (hRL2 : ∀ i, MemLp (fun omega ↦ R (X i omega)) 2 mu)
    (hRsecond : ∀ i,
      ∫ omega, R (X i omega) ^ 2 ∂mu ≤ K ^ 2)
    (hLsupport : ∀ u,
      supportFunction L u =
        ∫ omega, supportFunction (F (X 0 omega)) u ∂mu) :
    ∃ mu0 : ProbabilityMeasure C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ),
      TendstoInDistribution
          (fun n omega ↦ scaledSupportDifferenceContinuousMap
            √((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
            (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range (n + 1))
              (fun i ↦ F (X i omega))) L
            (isCompact_minkowskiAverage _ _
              (fun i _ ↦ hFcompact (X i omega))) hLcompact
            (nonempty_minkowskiAverage _ _
              (fun i _ ↦ hFne (X i omega))) hLne)
          atTop id (fun _ ↦ mu)
            (mu0 : Measure C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ)) ∧
        (∀ (k : ℕ) (t : Fin k → Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1),
          ProbabilityMeasure.map mu0
              (finiteEvaluationVectorCLM
                (Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1) t).measurable.aemeasurable =
            ⟨multivariateGaussian 0
                (finiteDirectionalSupportCovariance
                  (fun i omega ↦ F (X i omega)) L
                  (fun j ↦ (t j : E)) mu), inferInstance⟩) ∧
        IsGaussianProcess
          (fun q (f : C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ)) ↦ f q)
          (mu0 : Measure C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ)) ∧
        (TendstoInDistribution
            (fun n omega ↦ √((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
              hausdorffDist
                (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range (n + 1))
                  (fun i ↦ F (X i omega))) L)
            atTop (fun f ↦ unitSphereSupAbs f) (fun _ ↦ mu)
              (mu0 : Measure C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ)) ∧
          TendstoInDistribution
            (fun n omega ↦ √((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
              directedHausdorffDist
                (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range (n + 1))
                  (fun i ↦ F (X i omega))) L)
            atTop (fun f ↦ unitSphereSupPositivePart f) (fun _ ↦ mu)
              (mu0 : Measure C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ)) ∧
          TendstoInDistribution
            (fun n omega ↦ √((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
              directedHausdorffDist L
                (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range (n + 1))
                  (fun i ↦ F (X i omega))))
            atTop (fun f ↦ unitSphereSupNegativePart f) (fun _ ↦ mu)
              (mu0 : Measure C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨muU, hraw, hmarginalsU, _hgaussianU⟩ :=
    exists_gaussianProcess_tendsto_centeredSupport_of_l2
      X hX hindep hident F hF hFcompact hFne L R hRmeas hR hRbound
        hK hRL2 hRsecond hLsupport
  let Savg : ℕ → Omega → Set E := fun n omega ↦
    minkowskiAverage (Finset.range (n + 1)) (fun i ↦ F (X i omega))
  have hScompact : ∀ n omega, IsCompact (Savg n omega) := fun n omega ↦
    isCompact_minkowskiAverage _ _ (fun i _ ↦ hFcompact (X i omega))
  have hSne : ∀ n omega, (Savg n omega).Nonempty := fun n omega ↦
    nonempty_minkowskiAverage _ _ (fun i _ ↦ hFne (X i omega))
  have hSconv : ∀ n omega, Convex ℝ (Savg n omega) := fun n omega ↦
    convex_minkowskiAverage _ _ (fun i _ ↦ hFconv (X i omega))
  let pathMap : C(EuclideanUnitBall E, ℝ) →
      C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ) :=
    unitBallPathToClosedBall (E := E)
  have hpathMap : Continuous pathMap :=
    continuous_unitBallPathToClosedBall (E := E)
  let mu0 : ProbabilityMeasure C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ) :=
    ProbabilityMeasure.map muU hpathMap.measurable.aemeasurable
  have hmappedRaw := hraw.continuous_comp hpathMap
  have hsetProcessU : TendstoInDistribution
      (fun n omega ↦ scaledSupportDifferenceContinuousMap
        √((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) (Savg n omega) L
          (hScompact n omega) hLcompact (hSne n omega) hLne)
      atTop pathMap (fun _ ↦ mu)
        (muU : Measure C(EuclideanUnitBall E, ℝ)) := by
    apply hmappedRaw.congr
    · intro n
      filter_upwards [] with omega
      ext u
      change unitBallPathToClosedBall
          (centeredSupportEmpiricalContinuousMap (mu := mu)
            X hX F hF hFcompact hFne R hR hRbound hRL2 n omega) u = _
      rw [unitBallPathToClosedBall_apply,
        scaledSupportDifferenceContinuousMap_apply]
      exact centeredAnchoredEmpiricalContinuousMap_supportFunction_apply
        X hX hident F hFcompact hFne L R
          (fun u ↦ measurable_supportFunction hF hFcompact hFne u)
          (continuous_supportFunction_of_radiusEnvelope
            F hFcompact hFne R hR hRbound)
          hR (abs_supportFunction_sub_le_radiusEnvelope
            F hFcompact hFne R hRbound) hRL2 hLsupport n omega
              (euclideanUnitBallHomeomorphClosedBall (E := E).symm u)
    · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ ↦ rfl
  have hsetProcess : TendstoInDistribution
      (fun n omega ↦ scaledSupportDifferenceContinuousMap
        √((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) (Savg n omega) L
          (hScompact n omega) hLcompact (hSne n omega) hLne)
      atTop id (fun _ ↦ mu)
        (mu0 : Measure C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ)) :=
    { forall_aemeasurable := hsetProcessU.forall_aemeasurable
      aemeasurable_limit := measurable_id.aemeasurable
      tendsto := by
        let targetId :
            ProbabilityMeasure C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ) :=
          ⟨(mu0 : Measure C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ)).map id,
            Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map measurable_id.aemeasurable⟩
        have htarget : targetId = mu0 := by
          apply Subtype.ext
          exact Measure.map_id
        change Tendsto _ atTop (nhds targetId)
        rw [htarget]
        simpa only [mu0, pathMap, ProbabilityMeasure.map,
          ProbabilityMeasure.coe_mk, Function.comp_id] using
            hsetProcessU.tendsto }
  have hmarginals : ∀ (k : ℕ)
      (t : Fin k → Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1),
      ProbabilityMeasure.map mu0
          (finiteEvaluationVectorCLM
            (Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1) t).measurable.aemeasurable =
        ⟨multivariateGaussian 0
            (finiteDirectionalSupportCovariance
              (fun i omega ↦ F (X i omega)) L
              (fun j ↦ (t j : E)) mu), inferInstance⟩ := by
    intro k t
    let tU : Fin k → EuclideanUnitBall E := fun j ↦
      euclideanUnitBallHomeomorphClosedBall (E := E).symm (t j)
    have hmap : ProbabilityMeasure.map mu0
          (finiteEvaluationVectorCLM
            (Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1) t).measurable.aemeasurable =
        ProbabilityMeasure.map muU
          (finiteEvaluationVectorCLM
            (EuclideanUnitBall E) tU).measurable.aemeasurable := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      change ((muU : Measure C(EuclideanUnitBall E, ℝ)).map pathMap).map
          (finiteEvaluationVectorCLM
            (Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1) t) =
        (muU : Measure C(EuclideanUnitBall E, ℝ)).map
          (finiteEvaluationVectorCLM (EuclideanUnitBall E) tU)
      rw [AEMeasurable.map_map_of_aemeasurable
        (finiteEvaluationVectorCLM
          (Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1) t).measurable.aemeasurable
        hpathMap.measurable.aemeasurable]
      apply Measure.map_congr
      filter_upwards [] with f
      ext j
      rfl
    rw [hmap]
    simpa only [tU,
      euclideanUnitBallHomeomorphClosedBall_symm_coe] using
        hmarginalsU k tU
  let rho : ∀ k : ℕ, (Fin k → Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1) →
      ProbabilityMeasure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) := fun k t ↦
    ⟨multivariateGaussian 0
      (finiteDirectionalSupportCovariance
        (fun i omega ↦ F (X i omega)) L (fun j ↦ (t j : E)) mu),
      inferInstance⟩
  have hgaussian : IsGaussianProcess
      (fun q (f : C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ)) ↦ f q)
      (mu0 : Measure C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ)) :=
    isGaussianProcess_canonical_of_finiteEvaluationVector_isGaussian
      (Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1) mu0 rho
      (by intro k t; simpa only [rho] using hmarginals k t)
      (fun k t ↦ by
        change IsGaussian (multivariateGaussian 0
          (finiteDirectionalSupportCovariance
            (fun i omega ↦ F (X i omega)) L
            (fun j ↦ (t j : E)) mu))
        infer_instance)
  have hthree :=
    pointwiseRandomSetCLT_of_supportProcess_unitSphere_of_weakLimit
      (fun n ↦ √((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) Savg L id
      (fun n ↦ Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
      hScompact hSne hSconv hLcompact hLne hLconv hsetProcess
  refine ⟨mu0, ?_, hmarginals, hgaussian, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [Savg] using hsetProcess
  · simpa only [Savg, abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _), id_eq] using hthree

name: RandomSetTheory.pointwiseRandomSetL2CLT_of_iid_setNormEnvelope
statement:
theorem pointwiseRandomSetL2CLT_of_iid_setNormEnvelope
    [Nontrivial E]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]

    (hindep : iIndepFun X mu)
    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (F : Z → Set E) (hF : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable F)
    (hFcompact : ∀ z, IsCompact (F z))
    (hFne : ∀ z, (F z).Nonempty)
    (hFconv : ∀ z, Convex ℝ (F z))
    (L : Set E) (hLcompact : IsCompact L) (hLne : L.Nonempty)
    (hLconv : Convex ℝ L)
    (henvelope : MemLp
      (fun omega ↦ setNormEnvelope (F (X 0 omega))) 2 mu)
    (hLsupport : ∀ u,
      supportFunction L u =
        ∫ omega, supportFunction (F (X 0 omega)) u ∂mu) :
    ∃ mu0 : ProbabilityMeasure C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ),
      TendstoInDistribution
          (fun n omega ↦ scaledSupportDifferenceContinuousMap
            √((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
