            (isCompact_minkowskiAverage _ _
              (fun i _ ↦ hFcompact (X i omega))) hLcompact
            (nonempty_minkowskiAverage _ _
              (fun i _ ↦ hFne (X i omega))) hLne)
          atTop id (fun _ ↦ mu)
            (mu0 : Measure C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ)) ∧
        (∀ (k : ℕ) (t : Fin k → Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1),
          ProbabilityMeasure.map mu0
              (finiteEvaluationVectorCLM
                (Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1) t).measurable.aemeasurable =
            ⟨multivariateGaussian 0
                (finiteDirectionalSupportCovariance
                  (fun i omega ↦ F (X i omega)) L
                  (fun j ↦ (t j : E)) mu), inferInstance⟩) ∧
        IsGaussianProcess
          (fun q (f : C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ)) ↦ f q)
          (mu0 : Measure C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ)) ∧
        (TendstoInDistribution
            (fun n omega ↦ √((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
              hausdorffDist
                (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range (n + 1))
                  (fun i ↦ F (X i omega))) L)
            atTop (fun f ↦ unitSphereSupAbs f) (fun _ ↦ mu)
              (mu0 : Measure C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ)) ∧
          TendstoInDistribution
            (fun n omega ↦ √((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
              directedHausdorffDist
                (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range (n + 1))
                  (fun i ↦ F (X i omega))) L)
            atTop (fun f ↦ unitSphereSupPositivePart f) (fun _ ↦ mu)
              (mu0 : Measure C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ)) ∧
          TendstoInDistribution
            (fun n omega ↦ √((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
              directedHausdorffDist L
                (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range (n + 1))
                  (fun i ↦ F (X i omega))))
            atTop (fun f ↦ unitSphereSupNegativePart f) (fun _ ↦ mu)
              (mu0 : Measure C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  letI : MeasurableSpace E := borel E
  letI : BorelSpace E := ⟨rfl⟩
  let R : Z → ℝ := fun z ↦ setNormEnvelope (F z)
  have hRmeas : Measurable R := by
    exact measurable_setNormEnvelope hF hFcompact hFne
  have hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z := by
    intro z
    exact setRadiusAt_nonneg (hFcompact z) (hFne z)
  have hRbound : ∀ z x, x ∈ F z → ‖x‖ ≤ R z := by
    intro z x hx
    exact norm_le_setNormEnvelope (hFcompact z) hx
  have hRL2 : ∀ i, MemLp (fun omega ↦ R (X i omega)) 2 mu := by
    intro i
    exact (((hident i).comp hRmeas).memLp_iff).2 henvelope
  let m : ℝ := ∫ omega, R (X 0 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu
  have hm : 0 ≤ m := integral_nonneg fun _ ↦ sq_nonneg _
  let K : ℝ := Real.sqrt m + 1
  have hK : 0 < K := by
    dsimp only [K]
    positivity
  have hRsecond : ∀ i, ∫ omega, R (X i omega) ^ 2 ∂mu ≤ K ^ 2 := by
    intro i
    have hi : ∫ omega, R (X i omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = m := by
      dsimp only [m]
      exact ((hident i).comp (hRmeas.pow_const 2)).integral_eq
    rw [hi]
    dsimp only [K]
    nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt hm, Real.sqrt_nonneg m]
  exact pointwiseRandomSetL2CLT_of_iid
    X hX hindep hident F hF hFcompact hFne hFconv
      L hLcompact hLne hLconv R hRmeas hR hRbound hK
      hRL2 hRsecond hLsupport

name: RandomSetTheory.rootN_uniformError_isBoundedInProbability_of_processCLT
statement:
theorem rootN_uniformError_isBoundedInProbability_of_processCLT
    {Ω Ω' F : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Ω']
    [MeasurableSpace F] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [BorelSpace F]
    (mu : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (mu' : Measure Ω') [IsProbabilityMeasure mu']
    (X : ℕ → Ω → F) (Z : Ω' → F) (Δ : ℕ → Ω → ℝ)
    (hΔ : ∀ n ω, 0 ≤ Δ n ω)
    (hprocess : TendstoInDistribution X atTop Z (fun _ ↦ mu) mu')
    (hlink : ∀ (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω),
      Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) * Δ n ω ≤ ‖X n ω‖) :
    IsBoundedInProbability mu atTop
      (fun (n : ℕ) ω ↦ Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) * Δ n ω)
proof:
:= by
  have hnorm : TendstoInDistribution
      (fun n ↦ (fun f : F ↦ ‖f‖) ∘ X n) atTop
      ((fun f : F ↦ ‖f‖) ∘ Z) (fun _ ↦ mu) mu' :=
    hprocess.continuous_comp continuous_norm
  apply hnorm.isBoundedInProbability.mono_norm (c := 1) zero_le_one
  filter_upwards [] with n
  intro ω
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, one_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg (n : ℝ)) (hΔ n ω)),
    abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg (X n ω))]
  exact hlink n ω

name: RandomSetTheory.rootN_enlargedZeroSet_of_processCLT
statement:
theorem rootN_enlargedZeroSet_of_processCLT
    {Ω Ω' Θ E F : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Ω']
    [PseudoMetricSpace Θ] [SeminormedAddCommGroup E]
    [MeasurableSpace F] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [BorelSpace F]
    (mu : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (mu' : Measure Ω') [IsProbabilityMeasure mu']
    (X : ℕ → Ω → F) (Z : Ω' → F)
    (Ghat : ℕ → Ω → Θ → Set E) (G : Θ → Set E)
    (Δ : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) {κ : ℝ}
    (hΔ : ∀ n ω, 0 ≤ Δ n ω)
    (hprocess : TendstoInDistribution X atTop Z (fun _ ↦ mu) mu')
    (hlink : ∀ (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω),
      Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) * Δ n ω ≤ ‖X n ω‖)
    (hκ : 0 < κ)
    (hfin : ∀ n ω θ, hausdorffEDist (Ghat n ω θ) (G θ) ≠ ⊤)
    (hhaus : ∀ n ω θ,
      hausdorffDist (Ghat n ω θ) (G θ) ≤ Δ n ω)
    (herror : ∀ θ,
      κ * infDist θ (setValuedZeroSet G) ≤ infDist 0 (G θ)) :
    IsBoundedInProbability mu atTop (fun (n : ℕ) ω ↦
      Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) * hausdorffDist
        (enlargedSetValuedZeroSet (Ghat n ω) (Δ n ω))
        (setValuedZeroSet G))
proof:
:= by
  apply rootN_enlargedZeroSet_of_rootN_uniformHausdorff
    mu Ghat G Δ hΔ hκ hfin hhaus herror
  exact rootN_uniformError_isBoundedInProbability_of_processCLT
    mu mu' X Z Δ hΔ hprocess hlink

name: ProbabilityTheory.tendsto_measure_failure_strictDomination_of_uniformApproximation
statement:
theorem tendsto_measure_failure_strictDomination_of_uniformApproximation
    {oracleCurvature oracleSignal actualCurvature actualSignal :
      Nat → Omega → Real}
    {curvatureError signalError : Nat → Real}
    {curvatureLimit signalLimit : Real}
    (hgap : curvatureLimit < signalLimit)
    (horacleCurvature : TendstoInMeasure probabilityMeasure oracleCurvature
      atTop (fun _ ↦ curvatureLimit))
    (horacleSignal : TendstoInMeasure probabilityMeasure oracleSignal
      atTop (fun _ ↦ signalLimit))
    (hcurvatureError : Tendsto curvatureError atTop (nhds 0))
    (hsignalError : Tendsto signalError atTop (nhds 0))
    (hactualCurvature : ∀ n omega,
      actualCurvature n omega ≤ oracleCurvature n omega + curvatureError n)
    (hactualSignal : ∀ n omega,
      oracleSignal n omega ≤ actualSignal n omega + signalError n) :
    Tendsto (fun n ↦ probabilityMeasure {omega |
      actualSignal n omega ≤ actualCurvature n omega})
      atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  let delta : Real := (signalLimit - curvatureLimit) / 5
  have hdelta : 0 < delta := by
    dsimp [delta]
    linarith
  have hcurvatureBad : Tendsto (fun n ↦ probabilityMeasure {omega |
      delta ≤ dist (oracleCurvature n omega) curvatureLimit})
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa using
      (tendstoInMeasure_iff_dist.mp horacleCurvature delta hdelta)
  have hsignalBad : Tendsto (fun n ↦ probabilityMeasure {omega |
      delta ≤ dist (oracleSignal n omega) signalLimit})
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa using (tendstoInMeasure_iff_dist.mp horacleSignal delta hdelta)
  have hbad : Tendsto (fun n ↦
      probabilityMeasure {omega |
        delta ≤ dist (oracleCurvature n omega) curvatureLimit} +
      probabilityMeasure {omega |
        delta ≤ dist (oracleSignal n omega) signalLimit})
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [add_zero] using hcurvatureBad.add hsignalBad
  have herrors : ∀ᶠ n in atTop,
      curvatureError n < delta ∧ signalError n < delta := by
    filter_upwards [
      (tendsto_order.mp hcurvatureError).2 delta hdelta,
      (tendsto_order.mp hsignalError).2 delta hdelta] with n hnC hnS
    exact ⟨hnC, hnS⟩
  have hupper : ∀ᶠ n in atTop,
      probabilityMeasure {omega |
          actualSignal n omega ≤ actualCurvature n omega} ≤
        probabilityMeasure {omega |
          delta ≤ dist (oracleCurvature n omega) curvatureLimit} +
        probabilityMeasure {omega |
          delta ≤ dist (oracleSignal n omega) signalLimit} := by
    filter_upwards [herrors] with n hn
    rcases hn with ⟨hnC, hnS⟩
    have hsubset :
        {omega | actualSignal n omega ≤ actualCurvature n omega} ⊆
          {omega | delta ≤ dist (oracleCurvature n omega) curvatureLimit} ∪
          {omega | delta ≤ dist (oracleSignal n omega) signalLimit} := by
      intro omega hfailure
      change actualSignal n omega ≤ actualCurvature n omega at hfailure
      by_contra hnot
      simp only [mem_union, mem_setOf_eq, not_or, not_le] at hnot
      simp only [Real.dist_eq] at hnot
      obtain ⟨hcurvatureLower, hcurvatureUpper⟩ := abs_lt.mp hnot.1
      obtain ⟨hsignalLower, hsignalUpper⟩ := abs_lt.mp hnot.2
      have hactualCurvature' := hactualCurvature n omega
      have hactualSignal' := hactualSignal n omega
      dsimp [delta] at hcurvatureLower hcurvatureUpper hsignalLower hsignalUpper hnC hnS
      linarith
    exact (measure_mono hsubset).trans (measure_union_le _ _)
  rw [tendsto_order]
  constructor
  · intro lower hlower
    exact False.elim (not_lt_of_ge (bot_le : (0 : ENNReal) ≤ lower) hlower)
  · intro upper hupperPos
    have hbadUpper := (tendsto_order.mp hbad).2 upper hupperPos
    filter_upwards [hupper, hbadUpper] with n hn hnBad
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt hn hnBad

name: RandomSetTheory.norm_le_on_closedConvexHull_of_norm_le
statement:
theorem norm_le_on_closedConvexHull_of_norm_le
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {K : Set E} {R : ℝ} (hR : ∀ x ∈ K, ‖x‖ ≤ R) :
    ∀ x ∈ closedConvexHull ℝ K, ‖x‖ ≤ R
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hsub : K ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) R := by
    intro y hy
    simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hR y hy
  have hxball : x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) R :=
    closedConvexHull_min hsub (convex_closedBall (0 : E) R)
      Metric.isClosed_closedBall hx
  simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hxball

name: RandomSetTheory.closedConvexHull_closure_aumannExpectation_eq
statement:
theorem closedConvexHull_closure_aumannExpectation_eq
    {Ω H : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ H] [Nonempty H]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {S : Ω → Set H}
    (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hHull : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable
      (fun ω => closedConvexHull ℝ (S ω)))
    (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    {g : Ω → ℝ} (hg : Integrable g μ)
    (hdom : ∀ ω, ∀ x ∈ S ω, ‖x‖ ≤ g ω) :
    closedConvexHull ℝ (closure (aumannExpectation μ S)) =
      closure (aumannExpectation μ
        (fun ω => closedConvexHull ℝ (S ω)))
proof:
:= by
  let C : Ω → Set H := fun ω => closedConvexHull ℝ (S ω)
  have hCcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (C ω) := fun ω =>
    closedConvexHull_compact (hcompact ω)
  have hCne : ∀ ω, (C ω).Nonempty := fun ω =>
    (hne ω).mono subset_closedConvexHull
  have hCdom : ∀ ω, ∀ x ∈ C ω, ‖x‖ ≤ g ω := fun ω =>
    norm_le_on_closedConvexHull_of_norm_le (hdom ω)
  have hAcompact : IsCompact (closure (aumannExpectation μ S)) :=
    closure_aumannExpectation_compact_of_integrable_envelope hg
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hdom)
  have hCcompactA : IsCompact (closure (aumannExpectation μ C)) :=
    closure_aumannExpectation_compact_of_integrable_envelope hg
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hCdom)
  have hfS : IsIntegrableSelection μ S
      (supportApproximateSelection hS hcompact hne 0 1 (by norm_num)) :=
    integrableSelection_supportApproximateSelection_of_envelope
      hS hcompact hne hg hdom 0 (by norm_num)
  have hfC : IsIntegrableSelection μ C
      (supportApproximateSelection hHull hCcompact hCne 0 1 (by norm_num)) :=
    integrableSelection_supportApproximateSelection_of_envelope
      hHull hCcompact hCne hg hCdom 0 (by norm_num)
  have hAne : (closure (aumannExpectation μ S)).Nonempty :=
    (aumannExpectation_nonempty_of_selection hfS).closure
  have hCAne : (closure (aumannExpectation μ C)).Nonempty :=
    (aumannExpectation_nonempty_of_selection hfC).closure
  have hCAconv : Convex ℝ (closure (aumannExpectation μ C)) :=
    (aumannExpectation_convex
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => convex_closedConvexHull)).closure
  apply eq_of_supportFunction_eq
    (closedConvexHull_compact hAcompact) hCcompactA
    (hAne.mono subset_closedConvexHull) hCAne
    convex_closedConvexHull hCAconv
  intro u
  rw [supportFunction_closedConvexHull hAcompact hAne u]
  rw [supportFunction_closure_aumannExpectation_of_envelope
    hS hcompact hne hg hdom hAcompact u]
  rw [supportFunction_closure_aumannExpectation_of_envelope
    hHull hCcompact hCne hg hCdom hCcompactA u]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [] with ω
  exact (supportFunction_closedConvexHull (hcompact ω) (hne ω) u).symm

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_closedConvexHull_eq_of_lyapunov
statement:
theorem aumannExpectation_closedConvexHull_eq_of_lyapunov
    {Ω H : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ H] [Nonempty H]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {S : Ω → Set H}
    (hμ : HasLyapunovConvexity μ H)
    (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hHull : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable
      (fun ω => closedConvexHull ℝ (S ω)))
    (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    {g : Ω → ℝ} (hg : Integrable g μ)
    (hdom : ∀ ω, ∀ x ∈ S ω, ‖x‖ ≤ g ω)
    (hASclosed : IsClosed (aumannExpectation μ S))
    (hACclosed : IsClosed (aumannExpectation μ
      (fun ω => closedConvexHull ℝ (S ω)))) :
    aumannExpectation μ S =
      aumannExpectation μ
        (fun ω => closedConvexHull ℝ (S ω))
proof:
:= by
  have hEq := closedConvexHull_closure_aumannExpectation_eq
    hS hHull hcompact hne hg hdom
  rw [hASclosed.closure_eq, hACclosed.closure_eq] at hEq
  have hconv : Convex ℝ (aumannExpectation μ S) :=
    aumannExpectation_convex_of_lyapunov hμ S
  have hhull : closedConvexHull ℝ (aumannExpectation μ S) =
      aumannExpectation μ S := by
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · exact closedConvexHull_min Subset.rfl hconv hASclosed
    · exact subset_closedConvexHull
  rwa [hhull] at hEq
