name: ProbabilityTheory.boundedEuclideanThreshold_nonneg
statement:
theorem boundedEuclideanThreshold_nonneg {sigma : ℝ} (hsigma : 0 ≤ sigma)
    (d : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (k : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ boundedEuclideanThreshold sigma d x k
proof:
:= by
  unfold boundedEuclideanThreshold
  positivity

name: ProbabilityTheory.sqrt_boundedEuclideanConfidence_le
statement:
theorem sqrt_boundedEuclideanConfidence_le (d : ℕ) {x : ℝ}
    (hx : 0 ≤ x) (k : ℕ) :
    Real.sqrt (2 * boundedEuclideanConfidence d x k) ≤
      Real.sqrt (2 * x) +
        4 * Real.sqrt (d + 1 : ℝ) * (k + 2 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hd0 : 0 ≤ (d : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg d
  have hD : 0 ≤ (d + 1 : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hk : 0 ≤ (k + 2 : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hkone : 1 ≤ (k + 2 : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ k + 2 by omega)
  have hx2 : 0 ≤ 2 * x := by positivity
  have hsqx := Real.sq_sqrt hx2
  have hsqD := Real.sq_sqrt hD
  have hdim :
      (8 * (d : ℝ) + 4) * (k + 2 : ℝ) ≤
        16 * (d + 1 : ℝ) * (k + 2 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    have hcoef : 8 * (d : ℝ) + 4 ≤
        16 * (d + 1 : ℝ) * (k + 2 : ℝ) := by nlinarith
    simpa only [pow_two, mul_assoc] using
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcoef hk)
  have hcross :
      0 ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * x) *
        (4 * Real.sqrt (d + 1 : ℝ) * (k + 2 : ℝ)) := by
    positivity
  rw [Real.sqrt_le_iff]
  constructor
  · positivity
  · unfold boundedEuclideanConfidence
    nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (2 * x), Real.sqrt_nonneg (d + 1 : ℝ)]

name: ProbabilityTheory.summable_boundedEuclideanThreshold
statement:
theorem summable_boundedEuclideanThreshold {sigma : ℝ} (hsigma : 0 ≤ sigma)
    (d : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    Summable (boundedEuclideanThreshold sigma d x)
proof:
:= by
  let q : ℝ := 1 / 2
  have hq : ‖q‖ < 1 := by norm_num [q, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have hgeom : Summable (fun k : ℕ ↦ q ^ k) :=
    summable_geometric_of_norm_lt_one hq
  have hnat : Summable (fun k : ℕ ↦ (k : ℝ) * q ^ k) :=
    by simpa using summable_pow_mul_geometric_of_norm_lt_one 1 hq
  have hlinear : Summable (fun k : ℕ ↦ (k + 2 : ℝ) * q ^ k) := by
    have htwo := hgeom.mul_left (2 : ℝ)
    convert hnat.add htwo using 1
    ext k
    push_cast
    ring
  have hmajor : Summable (fun k : ℕ ↦
      3 * sigma * (q ^ k) *
        (Real.sqrt (2 * x) +
          4 * Real.sqrt (d + 1 : ℝ) * (k + 2 : ℝ))) := by
    have hfirst := hgeom.mul_left (3 * sigma * Real.sqrt (2 * x))
    have hsecond := hlinear.mul_left
      (12 * sigma * Real.sqrt (d + 1 : ℝ))
    exact (hfirst.add hsecond).congr (fun k ↦ by
      push_cast
      ring)
  apply Summable.of_nonneg_of_le
    (fun k ↦ boundedEuclideanThreshold_nonneg hsigma d hx k)
    (fun k ↦ ?_) hmajor
  unfold boundedEuclideanThreshold
  change 3 * sigma * q ^ k *
      Real.sqrt (2 * boundedEuclideanConfidence d x k) ≤ _
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (sqrt_boundedEuclideanConfidence_le d hx k) (by positivity)

name: ProbabilityTheory.tsum_boundedEuclideanThreshold_le
statement:
theorem tsum_boundedEuclideanThreshold_le {sigma : ℝ} (hsigma : 0 ≤ sigma)
    (d : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    ∑' k, boundedEuclideanThreshold sigma d x k ≤
      6 * sigma * Real.sqrt (2 * x) +
        72 * sigma * Real.sqrt (d + 1 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let q : ℝ := 1 / 2
  have hq : ‖q‖ < 1 := by norm_num [q, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have hgeom : HasSum (fun k : ℕ ↦ q ^ k) 2 := by
    have h := hasSum_geometric_of_norm_lt_one hq
    norm_num [q] at h
    exact h
  have hnat : HasSum (fun k : ℕ ↦ (k : ℝ) * q ^ k) 2 := by
    have h := hasSum_coe_mul_geometric_of_norm_lt_one hq
    norm_num [q] at h
    exact h
  have hlinear : HasSum (fun k : ℕ ↦ (k + 2 : ℝ) * q ^ k) 6 := by
    convert hnat.add (hgeom.mul_left (2 : ℝ)) using 1
    · ext k
      push_cast
      ring
    · ring
  have hmajor : HasSum (fun k : ℕ ↦
      3 * sigma * (q ^ k) *
        (Real.sqrt (2 * x) +
          4 * Real.sqrt (d + 1 : ℝ) * (k + 2 : ℝ)))
      (6 * sigma * Real.sqrt (2 * x) +
        72 * sigma * Real.sqrt (d + 1 : ℝ)) := by
    have hfirst := hgeom.mul_left (3 * sigma * Real.sqrt (2 * x))
    have hsecond := hlinear.mul_left
      (12 * sigma * Real.sqrt (d + 1 : ℝ))
    have hsum : HasSum (fun k : ℕ ↦
        3 * sigma * (q ^ k) *
          (Real.sqrt (2 * x) +
            4 * Real.sqrt (d + 1 : ℝ) * (k + 2 : ℝ)))
        (3 * sigma * Real.sqrt (2 * x) * 2 +
          12 * sigma * Real.sqrt (d + 1 : ℝ) * 6) :=
      (hfirst.add hsecond).congr (fun k ↦ by
        push_cast
        ring)
    convert hsum using 1
    ring
  have hthreshold := summable_boundedEuclideanThreshold hsigma d hx
  calc
    ∑' k, boundedEuclideanThreshold sigma d x k ≤
        ∑' k : ℕ, 3 * sigma * (q ^ k) *
          (Real.sqrt (2 * x) +
            4 * Real.sqrt (d + 1 : ℝ) * (k + 2 : ℝ)) := by
      apply hthreshold.tsum_le_tsum
      · intro k
        unfold boundedEuclideanThreshold
        change 3 * sigma * q ^ k *
            Real.sqrt (2 * boundedEuclideanConfidence d x k) ≤ _
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (sqrt_boundedEuclideanConfidence_le d hx k) (by positivity)
      · exact hmajor.summable
    _ = 6 * sigma * Real.sqrt (2 * x) +
        72 * sigma * Real.sqrt (d + 1 : ℝ) := hmajor.tsum_eq

name: ProbabilityTheory.boundedEuclideanEntropyCost_eq
statement:
theorem boundedEuclideanEntropyCost_eq (d : ℕ) (x : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    boundedEuclideanEntropyCost d x k =
      2 * Real.exp (-x) * (Real.exp (-2)) ^ 2 *
        (Real.exp (-2)) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  unfold boundedEuclideanEntropyCost boundedEuclideanConfidence
  have hexponent :
      4 * (d : ℝ) * (k + 2 : ℝ) +
          -(x + (4 * (d : ℝ) + 2) * (k + 2 : ℝ)) =
        -x + ((k + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (-2) := by
    push_cast
    ring
  calc
    Real.exp (4 * (d : ℝ) * (k + 2 : ℝ)) *
        (2 * Real.exp (-(x + (4 * (d : ℝ) + 2) * (k + 2 : ℝ)))) =
      2 * Real.exp (4 * (d : ℝ) * (k + 2 : ℝ) +
        -(x + (4 * (d : ℝ) + 2) * (k + 2 : ℝ))) := by
          rw [Real.exp_add]
          ring
    _ = 2 * Real.exp (-x + ((k + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (-2)) := by
      rw [hexponent]
    _ = 2 * Real.exp (-x) * (Real.exp (-2)) ^ (k + 2) := by
      rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_nat_mul]
      ring
    _ = 2 * Real.exp (-x) * (Real.exp (-2)) ^ 2 *
        (Real.exp (-2)) ^ k := by rw [pow_add]; ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.summable_boundedEuclideanEntropyCost
statement:
theorem summable_boundedEuclideanEntropyCost (d : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    Summable (boundedEuclideanEntropyCost d x)
proof:
:= by
  let q : ℝ := Real.exp (-2)
  have hq : ‖q‖ < 1 := by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _), Real.exp_lt_one_iff]
    norm_num [q]
  have hgeom : Summable (fun k : ℕ ↦ q ^ k) :=
    summable_geometric_of_norm_lt_one hq
  have hscaled := hgeom.mul_left
    (2 * Real.exp (-x) * q ^ 2)
  exact hscaled.congr (fun k ↦ by
    symm
    simpa only [q] using boundedEuclideanEntropyCost_eq d x k)

name: ProbabilityTheory.tsum_boundedEuclideanEntropyCost_le
statement:
theorem tsum_boundedEuclideanEntropyCost_le (d : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    ∑' k, boundedEuclideanEntropyCost d x k ≤ Real.exp (-x)
proof:
:= by
  let q : ℝ := Real.exp (-2)
  have hqpos : 0 < q := Real.exp_pos _
  have hq : ‖q‖ < 1 := by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hqpos, Real.exp_lt_one_iff]
    norm_num [q]
  have hqquarter : q ≤ 1 / 4 := by
    have he : Real.exp (-1) < 0.3678794412 := Real.exp_neg_one_lt_d9
    have hqeq : q = Real.exp (-1) ^ 2 := by
      dsimp only [q]
      calc
        Real.exp (-2) = Real.exp ((-1) + (-1)) := by norm_num
        _ = Real.exp (-1) * Real.exp (-1) := Real.exp_add _ _
        _ = Real.exp (-1) ^ 2 := by ring
    rw [hqeq]
    nlinarith [Real.exp_pos (-1)]
  have hsum :
      ∑' k, boundedEuclideanEntropyCost d x k =
        2 * Real.exp (-x) * q ^ 2 * (1 - q)⁻¹ := by
    rw [show (∑' k, boundedEuclideanEntropyCost d x k) =
        ∑' k, (2 * Real.exp (-x) * q ^ 2) * q ^ k by
      apply tsum_congr
      intro k
      simpa only [q] using boundedEuclideanEntropyCost_eq d x k]
    rw [tsum_mul_left, tsum_geometric_of_norm_lt_one hq]
  rw [hsum]
  have hden : 0 < 1 - q := by nlinarith
  have hfactor : 2 * q ^ 2 * (1 - q)⁻¹ ≤ 1 := by
    rw [inv_eq_one_div]
    rw [show 2 * q ^ 2 * (1 / (1 - q)) =
      (2 * q ^ 2) / (1 - q) by ring]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hden).2
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg q]
  calc
    2 * Real.exp (-x) * q ^ 2 * (1 - q)⁻¹ =
        Real.exp (-x) * (2 * q ^ 2 * (1 - q)⁻¹) := by ring
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-x) * 1 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfactor (Real.exp_pos _).le
    _ = Real.exp (-x) := mul_one _

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_boundedEuclideanProcess_largeDeviation_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_boundedEuclideanProcess_largeDeviation_le
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (Z : Omega → T → ℝ) (N0 : Finset T)
    (edges : ℕ → Finset (T × T)) (proj : ℕ → T → T)
    (d : ℕ) {sigma x : ℝ} (hsigma : 0 ≤ sigma) (hx : 0 ≤ x)
    (hbase : ∀ t, proj 0 t ∈ N0)
    (hedge : ∀ k t, (proj (k + 1) t, proj k t) ∈ edges k)
    (hremainder : ∀ omega t, Tendsto
      (fun m ↦ |Z omega t - Z omega (proj m t)|) atTop (nhds 0))
    (hbaseZero : ∀ omega, ∀ u ∈ N0, Z omega u = 0)
    (hedgeDist : ∀ k, ∀ e ∈ edges k,
      dist e.1 e.2 ≤ 3 * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k))
    (hedgeCard : ∀ k,
      ((edges k).card : ℝ) ≤
        Real.exp (4 * (d : ℝ) * (k + 2 : ℝ)))
    (hsubgaussian : ∀ k, ∀ e ∈ edges k,
      mu.real {omega |
        sigma * dist e.1 e.2 *
            Real.sqrt (2 * boundedEuclideanConfidence d x k) <
          |Z omega e.1 - Z omega e.2|} ≤
        2 * Real.exp (-boundedEuclideanConfidence d x k)) :
    mu.real {omega | ∃ t,
        6 * sigma * Real.sqrt (2 * x) +
            72 * sigma * Real.sqrt (d + 1 : ℝ) <
          |Z omega t|} ≤
      Real.exp (-x)
proof:
:= by
  let threshold : ℕ → ℝ := boundedEuclideanThreshold sigma d x
  let delta : ℕ → ℝ := fun k ↦
    2 * Real.exp (-boundedEuclideanConfidence d x k)
  have hthresholdSummable : Summable threshold :=
    summable_boundedEuclideanThreshold hsigma d hx
  have hbaseTail : ∀ u ∈ N0,
      mu.real {omega | (0 : ℝ) < |Z omega u|} ≤ 0 := by
    intro u hu
    simp only [hbaseZero _ u hu, abs_zero, lt_self_iff_false,
      Set.setOf_false, measureReal_empty, le_refl]
  have hedgeTail : ∀ k, ∀ e ∈ edges k,
      mu.real {omega | threshold k < |Z omega e.1 - Z omega e.2|} ≤
        delta k := by
    intro k e he
    have hlocal :
        sigma * dist e.1 e.2 *
            Real.sqrt (2 * boundedEuclideanConfidence d x k) ≤
          threshold k := by
      dsimp only [threshold]
      unfold boundedEuclideanThreshold
      have hsqrt :
          0 ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * boundedEuclideanConfidence d x k) :=
        Real.sqrt_nonneg _
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (by
          calc
            sigma * dist e.1 e.2 ≤ sigma * (3 * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k)) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hedgeDist k e he) hsigma
            _ = 3 * sigma * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k) := by ring)
        hsqrt
    exact (measureReal_mono (by
      intro omega homega
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt hlocal homega)).trans (by
        exact hsubgaussian k e he)
  have hcostPointwise : ∀ k,
      (edges k).card * delta k ≤ boundedEuclideanEntropyCost d x k := by
    intro k
    unfold boundedEuclideanEntropyCost
    dsimp only [delta]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hedgeCard k) (by positivity)
  have hcostSummable : Summable fun k ↦ (edges k).card * delta k :=
    Summable.of_nonneg_of_le
      (fun k ↦ mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (by positivity))
      hcostPointwise (summable_boundedEuclideanEntropyCost d x)
  have hchain := measureReal_countableChaining_edges_largeDeviation_le
    Z N0 edges proj threshold delta 0 0 hbase hedge hthresholdSummable
      hremainder hcostSummable hbaseTail hedgeTail
  have hchain' :
      mu.real {omega | ∃ t, (∑' k, threshold k) < |Z omega t|} ≤
        ∑' k, (edges k).card * delta k := by
    simpa only [zero_add, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, mul_zero, add_zero] using hchain
  calc
    mu.real {omega | ∃ t,
        6 * sigma * Real.sqrt (2 * x) +
            72 * sigma * Real.sqrt (d + 1 : ℝ) < |Z omega t|} ≤
        mu.real {omega | ∃ t, (∑' k, threshold k) < |Z omega t|} := by
      apply measureReal_mono
      rintro omega ⟨t, ht⟩
      refine ⟨t, lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ ht⟩
      exact tsum_boundedEuclideanThreshold_le hsigma d hx
      finiteness
    _ ≤ ∑' k, (edges k).card * delta k := hchain'
    _ ≤ ∑' k, boundedEuclideanEntropyCost d x k :=
      hcostSummable.tsum_le_tsum hcostPointwise
        (summable_boundedEuclideanEntropyCost d x)
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-x) := tsum_boundedEuclideanEntropyCost_le d x

name: RandomSetTheory.dyadicResolution_pos
statement: theorem dyadicResolution_pos (k : ℕ) : 0 < dyadicResolution k
proof:
:= by
  unfold dyadicResolution
  positivity

name: RandomSetTheory.dyadicResolution_le_one
statement: theorem dyadicResolution_le_one (k : ℕ) : dyadicResolution k ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold dyadicResolution
  exact pow_le_one₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num)

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_unitBall_dyadic_finset_nets
statement:
theorem exists_unitBall_dyadic_finset_nets
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] :
    ∃ N : ℕ → Finset E,
      N 0 = {0} ∧
      (∀ k, ∀ v ∈ N k, ‖v‖ ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ k, ∀ u : E, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 →
        ∃ v ∈ N k, dist u v ≤ dyadicResolution k) ∧
      ∀ k, ((N k).card : ℝ) ≤
        (3 / dyadicResolution k) ^ finrank ℝ E
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hexists : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ M : Finset E,
      (∀ v ∈ M, ‖v‖ ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ u : E, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 →
        ∃ v ∈ M, dist u v ≤ dyadicResolution k) ∧
      (M.card : ℝ) ≤
        (3 / dyadicResolution k) ^ finrank ℝ E := by
    intro k
    exact exists_unitBall_finset_net_card_le_three_div
      (dyadicResolution_pos k) (dyadicResolution_le_one k)
  let M : ℕ → Finset E := fun k ↦ Classical.choose (hexists k)
  let N : ℕ → Finset E := fun k ↦ if k = 0 then {0} else M k
  refine ⟨N, by simp [N], ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro k v hv
    by_cases hk : k = 0
    · subst k
      simp only [N, if_pos, Finset.mem_singleton] at hv
      subst v
      simp
    · have hvM : v ∈ M k := by simpa [N, hk] using hv
      exact (Classical.choose_spec (hexists k)).1 v hvM
  · intro k u hu
    by_cases hk : k = 0
    · subst k
      refine ⟨0, by simp [N], ?_⟩
      simpa [dyadicResolution, dist_zero_right] using hu
    · obtain ⟨v, hv, huv⟩ :=
        (Classical.choose_spec (hexists k)).2.1 u hu
      exact ⟨v, by simpa [N, hk] using hv, huv⟩
  · intro k
    by_cases hk : k = 0
    · subst k
      simp only [N, if_pos, Finset.card_singleton, Nat.cast_one,
        dyadicResolution, pow_zero, div_one]
      exact one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
    · simpa only [N, if_neg hk] using
        (Classical.choose_spec (hexists k)).2.2

name: RandomSetTheory.mem_unitBallLocalDyadicEdges_iff
statement:
theorem mem_unitBallLocalDyadicEdges_iff
    {E : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace E] (N : ℕ → Finset E)
    (k : ℕ) (e : E × E) :
    e ∈ unitBallLocalDyadicEdges N k ↔
      e.1 ∈ N (k + 1) ∧ e.2 ∈ N k ∧
        dist e.1 e.2 ≤
          dyadicResolution (k + 1) + dyadicResolution k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [unitBallLocalDyadicEdges, and_assoc]

name: RandomSetTheory.card_unitBallLocalDyadicEdges_le
statement:
theorem card_unitBallLocalDyadicEdges_le
    {E : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace E] (N : ℕ → Finset E) (k : ℕ) :
    (unitBallLocalDyadicEdges N k).card ≤
      (N (k + 1)).card * (N k).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact (Finset.card_filter_le _ _).trans_eq (Finset.card_product _ _)

name: RandomSetTheory.dist_le_three_mul_dyadicResolution_of_mem_localEdges
statement:
theorem dist_le_three_mul_dyadicResolution_of_mem_localEdges
    {E : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace E] (N : ℕ → Finset E)
    {k : ℕ} {e : E × E} (he : e ∈ unitBallLocalDyadicEdges N k) :
    dist e.1 e.2 ≤ 3 * dyadicResolution k
proof:
:= by
  have hdist := (mem_unitBallLocalDyadicEdges_iff N k e).1 he |>.2.2
  have hhalf : dyadicResolution (k + 1) =
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * dyadicResolution k := by
    simp [dyadicResolution, pow_succ, mul_comm]
  rw [hhalf] at hdist
  have hr := (dyadicResolution_pos k).le
  nlinarith

name: RandomSetTheory.three_div_dyadicResolution_le_exp
statement:
theorem three_div_dyadicResolution_le_exp (k : ℕ) :
    3 / dyadicResolution k ≤
      Real.exp (2 * (k + 1 : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have he : (3 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 2 := by
    have he1 : 2.7182818283 < Real.exp 1 := Real.exp_one_gt_d9
    have he2 : Real.exp 2 = Real.exp 1 * Real.exp 1 := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]
      norm_num
    rw [he2]
    nlinarith
  have hpow : (2 : ℝ) ^ k ≤ (Real.exp 2) ^ k :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) (by linarith : (2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 2) k
  calc
    3 / dyadicResolution k = 3 * (2 : ℝ) ^ k := by
      simp [dyadicResolution, div_eq_mul_inv, inv_pow]
    _ ≤ Real.exp 2 * (Real.exp 2) ^ k :=
      mul_le_mul he hpow (by positivity) (by positivity)
    _ = (Real.exp 2) ^ (k + 1) := by rw [pow_succ']
    _ = Real.exp (2 * (k + 1 : ℝ)) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]
      congr 1
      push_cast
      ring

name: RandomSetTheory.card_unitBallLocalDyadicEdges_real_le_exp
statement:
theorem card_unitBallLocalDyadicEdges_real_le_exp
    {E : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace E]
    (N : ℕ → Finset E) (d : ℕ)
    (hcard : ∀ j, ((N j).card : ℝ) ≤
      (3 / dyadicResolution j) ^ d) (k : ℕ) :
    ((unitBallLocalDyadicEdges N k).card : ℝ) ≤
      Real.exp (4 * (d : ℝ) * (k + 2 : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hA : (3 / dyadicResolution (k + 1)) ^ d ≤
      (Real.exp (2 * (k + 2 : ℝ))) ^ d :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀
      (div_nonneg (by norm_num) (dyadicResolution_pos (k + 1)).le)
      (by
        simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, add_assoc, one_add_one_eq_two]
          using three_div_dyadicResolution_le_exp (k + 1)) d
  have hB : (3 / dyadicResolution k) ^ d ≤
      (Real.exp (2 * (k + 1 : ℝ))) ^ d :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀
      (div_nonneg (by norm_num) (dyadicResolution_pos k).le)
      (three_div_dyadicResolution_le_exp k) d
  calc
    ((unitBallLocalDyadicEdges N k).card : ℝ) ≤
        (((N (k + 1)).card * (N k).card : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast card_unitBallLocalDyadicEdges_le N k
    _ = ((N (k + 1)).card : ℝ) * ((N k).card : ℝ) := by push_cast; rfl
    _ ≤ (3 / dyadicResolution (k + 1)) ^ d *
          (3 / dyadicResolution k) ^ d :=
      mul_le_mul (hcard (k + 1)) (hcard k) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
        (pow_nonneg (div_nonneg (by norm_num)
          (dyadicResolution_pos (k + 1)).le) _)
    _ ≤ (Real.exp (2 * (k + 2 : ℝ))) ^ d *
          (Real.exp (2 * (k + 1 : ℝ))) ^ d :=
      mul_le_mul hA hB
        (pow_nonneg (div_nonneg (by norm_num)
          (dyadicResolution_pos k).le) _)
        (pow_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le _)
    _ = Real.exp ((d : ℝ) * (2 * (k + 2 : ℝ)) +
          (d : ℝ) * (2 * (k + 1 : ℝ))) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul, ← Real.exp_nat_mul, ← Real.exp_add]
    _ ≤ Real.exp (4 * (d : ℝ) * (k + 2 : ℝ)) := by
      rw [Real.exp_le_exp]
      calc
        (d : ℝ) * (2 * (k + 2 : ℝ)) +
            (d : ℝ) * (2 * (k + 1 : ℝ)) =
          4 * (d : ℝ) * (k + 2 : ℝ) - 2 * (d : ℝ) := by ring
        _ ≤ 4 * (d : ℝ) * (k + 2 : ℝ) :=
          sub_le_self _ (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (Nat.cast_nonneg d))

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_unitBall_dyadic_chainingData
statement:
theorem exists_unitBall_dyadic_chainingData
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] :
    ∃ (N : ℕ → Finset (EuclideanUnitBall E))
      (proj : ℕ → EuclideanUnitBall E → EuclideanUnitBall E),
      (∀ u ∈ N 0, (u : E) = 0) ∧
      (∀ k, ((N k).card : ℝ) ≤
        (3 / dyadicResolution k) ^ finrank ℝ E) ∧
      (∀ k t, proj k t ∈ N k) ∧
      (∀ k t, dist t (proj k t) ≤ dyadicResolution k) ∧
      (∀ k t, (proj (k + 1) t, proj k t) ∈
        unitBallLocalDyadicEdges N k) ∧
      ∀ t, Tendsto (fun k ↦ dist t (proj k t)) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨M, hM0, hMmem, hMcover, hMcard⟩ :=
    exists_unitBall_dyadic_finset_nets (E := E)
  let emb : ∀ k, {v : E // v ∈ M k} ↪ EuclideanUnitBall E := fun k ↦
    ⟨fun v ↦ ⟨v.1, hMmem k v.1 v.2⟩, by
      intro a b hab
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact congrArg (fun z : EuclideanUnitBall E ↦ (z : E)) hab⟩
  let N : ℕ → Finset (EuclideanUnitBall E) := fun k ↦
    (M k).attach.map (emb k)
  have hNzero : ∀ u ∈ N 0, (u : E) = 0 := by
    intro u hu
    obtain ⟨v, _hv, hvu⟩ := Finset.mem_map.1 hu
    have hv0 : (v : E) = 0 := by
      have hvM : (v : E) ∈ M 0 := v.property
      simpa [hM0] using hvM
    rw [← hvu]
    exact hv0
  have hNcard : ∀ k, ((N k).card : ℝ) ≤
      (3 / dyadicResolution k) ^ finrank ℝ E := by
    intro k
    simpa only [N, Finset.card_map, Finset.card_attach] using hMcard k
  have hNcover : ∀ k (t : EuclideanUnitBall E),
      ∃ u ∈ N k, dist t u ≤ dyadicResolution k := by
    intro k t
    obtain ⟨v, hvM, htv⟩ := hMcover k (t : E) t.property
    let vM : {w : E // w ∈ M k} := ⟨v, hvM⟩
    refine ⟨emb k vM, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact Finset.mem_map.2 ⟨vM, Finset.mem_attach _ _, rfl⟩
    · change dist (t : E) v ≤ dyadicResolution k
      exact htv
  let zeroUnit : EuclideanUnitBall E := ⟨0, by simp⟩
  letI : Nonempty (EuclideanUnitBall E) := ⟨zeroUnit⟩
  obtain ⟨proj, hprojMem, hprojNear⟩ :=
    ProbabilityTheory.exists_countableNetProjections N dyadicResolution hNcover
  have hedge : ∀ k t, (proj (k + 1) t, proj k t) ∈
      unitBallLocalDyadicEdges N k := by
    intro k t
    rw [mem_unitBallLocalDyadicEdges_iff]
    refine ⟨hprojMem (k + 1) t, hprojMem k t, ?_⟩
    calc
      dist (proj (k + 1) t) (proj k t) ≤
          dist (proj (k + 1) t) t + dist t (proj k t) := dist_triangle _ _ _
      _ ≤ dyadicResolution (k + 1) + dyadicResolution k :=
        add_le_add (by simpa only [dist_comm] using hprojNear (k + 1) t)
          (hprojNear k t)
  have heps : Tendsto dyadicResolution atTop (nhds 0) := by
    change Tendsto (fun k : ℕ ↦ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k) atTop (nhds 0)
    exact tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_abs_lt_one
      (show |(1 / 2 : ℝ)| < 1 by norm_num)
  have hprojTendsto : ∀ t, Tendsto (fun k ↦ dist t (proj k t))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    intro t
    exact squeeze_zero (fun k ↦ dist_nonneg) (fun k ↦ hprojNear k t) heps
  exact ⟨N, proj, hNzero, hNcard, hprojMem, hprojNear, hedge, hprojTendsto⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.measureReal_unitBall_subgaussianProcess_largeDeviation_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_unitBall_subgaussianProcess_largeDeviation_le
    {Omega E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (Z : Omega → EuclideanUnitBall E → ℝ)
    {sigma x : ℝ} (hsigma : 0 ≤ sigma) (hx : 0 ≤ x)
    (hcontinuous : ∀ omega, Continuous (Z omega))
    (hzero : ∀ omega, Z omega ⟨0, by simp⟩ = 0)
    (hsubgaussian : ∀ (s t : EuclideanUnitBall E) (y : ℝ), 0 ≤ y →
      mu.real {omega |
        sigma * dist s t * Real.sqrt (2 * y) <
          |Z omega s - Z omega t|} ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-y)) :
    mu.real {omega | ∃ t : EuclideanUnitBall E,
        6 * sigma * Real.sqrt (2 * x) +
            72 * sigma * Real.sqrt (finrank ℝ E + 1 : ℝ) <
          |Z omega t|} ≤
      Real.exp (-x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, proj, hNzero, hNcard, hprojMem, _hprojNear, hedge,
      hprojDist⟩ := exists_unitBall_dyadic_chainingData (E := E)
  let edges : ℕ → Finset (EuclideanUnitBall E × EuclideanUnitBall E) :=
    unitBallLocalDyadicEdges N
  have hbase : ∀ t, proj 0 t ∈ N 0 := hprojMem 0
  have hbaseZero : ∀ omega, ∀ u ∈ N 0, Z omega u = 0 := by
    intro omega u hu
    have huval : (u : E) = 0 := hNzero u hu
    have hu : u = (⟨0, by simp⟩ : EuclideanUnitBall E) := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact huval
    rw [hu]
    exact hzero omega
  have hedgeDist : ∀ k, ∀ e ∈ edges k,
      dist e.1 e.2 ≤ 3 * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k) := by
    intro k e he
    simpa only [edges, dyadicResolution] using
      dist_le_three_mul_dyadicResolution_of_mem_localEdges N he
  have hedgeCard : ∀ k, ((edges k).card : ℝ) ≤
      Real.exp (4 * (finrank ℝ E : ℝ) * (k + 2 : ℝ)) := by
    intro k
    exact card_unitBallLocalDyadicEdges_real_le_exp N (finrank ℝ E)
      hNcard k
  have hremainder : ∀ omega t, Tendsto
      (fun m ↦ |Z omega t - Z omega (proj m t)|) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    intro omega t
    have hproj : Tendsto (fun m ↦ proj m t) atTop (nhds t) := by
      rw [tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero]
      simpa only [dist_comm] using hprojDist t
    have hZproj : Tendsto (fun m ↦ Z omega (proj m t)) atTop
        (nhds (Z omega t)) := (hcontinuous omega).tendsto t |>.comp hproj
    have hsub : Tendsto (fun m ↦ Z omega t - Z omega (proj m t)) atTop
        (nhds 0) := by
      have hc : Tendsto (fun _m : ℕ ↦ Z omega t) atTop
          (nhds (Z omega t)) := tendsto_const_nhds
      simpa only [sub_self] using hc.sub hZproj
    simpa only [abs_zero] using hsub.abs
  apply ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_boundedEuclideanProcess_largeDeviation_le
    Z (N 0) edges proj (finrank ℝ E) hsigma hx hbase
      (by simpa only [edges] using hedge) hremainder hbaseZero hedgeDist
      hedgeCard
  intro k e he
  exact hsubgaussian e.1 e.2
    (ProbabilityTheory.boundedEuclideanConfidence (finrank ℝ E) x k)
    (ProbabilityTheory.boundedEuclideanConfidence_nonneg (finrank ℝ E) hx k)

name: RandomSetTheory.mem_piCorrespondence
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_piCorrespondence {E : ι → Type*}
    {S : ∀ i, Ω → Set (E i)} {ω : Ω} {x : ∀ i, E i} :
    x ∈ piCorrespondence S ω ↔ ∀ i, x i ∈ S i ω
proof:
:= by
  simp [piCorrespondence]

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_piCorrespondence
statement:
theorem aumannExpectation_piCorrespondence
    [Fintype ι]
    {E : ι → Type*}
    [∀ i, NormedAddCommGroup (E i)]
    [∀ i, NormedSpace ℝ (E i)]
    [∀ i, CompleteSpace (E i)]
    {μ : Measure Ω} (S : ∀ i, Ω → Set (E i)) :
    aumannExpectation μ (piCorrespondence S) =
      Set.pi Set.univ fun i => aumannExpectation μ (S i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, hf, hfx⟩
    rw [Set.mem_pi]
    intro i _
    refine ⟨fun ω => f ω i, ⟨hf.1.eval i, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · filter_upwards [hf.2] with ω hω
      exact (mem_piCorrespondence.mp hω) i
    · calc
        (∫ ω, f ω i ∂μ) = (∫ ω, f ω ∂μ) i :=
          (eval_integral (fun j => hf.1.eval j) i).symm
        _ = x i := congrFun hfx i
  · intro hx
    rw [Set.mem_pi] at hx
    have hcoord : ∀ i, ∃ f : Ω → E i,
        IsIntegrableSelection μ (S i) f ∧ ∫ ω, f ω ∂μ = x i := by
      intro i
      exact hx i (Set.mem_univ i)
    choose f hf hInt using hcoord
    let F : Ω → ∀ i, E i := fun ω i => f i ω
    have hFint : Integrable F μ := by
      apply Integrable.of_eval
      intro i
      exact (hf i).1
    have hFmem : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, F ω ∈ piCorrespondence S ω := by
      filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_all.2 fun i => (hf i).2] with ω hω
      rw [mem_piCorrespondence]
      exact hω
    refine ⟨F, ⟨hFint, hFmem⟩, ?_⟩
    funext i
    calc
      (∫ ω, F ω ∂μ) i = ∫ ω, F ω i ∂μ :=
        eval_integral (fun j => hFint.eval j) i
      _ = ∫ ω, f i ω ∂μ := rfl
      _ = x i := hInt i

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_isCompact_pi_real
statement:
theorem aumannExpectation_isCompact_pi_real
    [Fintype ι]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S : ι → Ω → Set ℝ}
    (hS : ∀ i, RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable (S i))
    (hcompact : ∀ i ω, IsCompact (S i ω))
    (hne : ∀ i ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    (hconv : ∀ i ω, Convex ℝ (S i ω))
    {g : ι → Ω → ℝ} (hg : ∀ i, Integrable (g i) μ)
    (hdom : ∀ i ω, ∀ x ∈ S i ω, ‖x‖ ≤ g i ω) :
    IsCompact (aumannExpectation μ (piCorrespondence S))
proof:
:= by
  rw [aumannExpectation_piCorrespondence]
  exact isCompact_univ_pi fun i =>
    aumannExpectation_isCompact_real (hS i) (hcompact i) (hne i)
      (hconv i) (hg i) (hdom i)

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_isClosed_pi_real
statement:
theorem aumannExpectation_isClosed_pi_real
    [Fintype ι]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S : ι → Ω → Set ℝ}
    (hS : ∀ i, RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable (S i))
    (hcompact : ∀ i ω, IsCompact (S i ω))
    (hne : ∀ i ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    (hconv : ∀ i ω, Convex ℝ (S i ω))
    {g : ι → Ω → ℝ} (hg : ∀ i, Integrable (g i) μ)
    (hdom : ∀ i ω, ∀ x ∈ S i ω, ‖x‖ ≤ g i ω) :
    IsClosed (aumannExpectation μ (piCorrespondence S))
proof:
:=
  (aumannExpectation_isCompact_pi_real hS hcompact hne hconv hg hdom).isClosed

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_Icc_eq_aumannExpectation_pi_real
statement:
theorem exists_Icc_eq_aumannExpectation_pi_real
    [Fintype ι]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S : ι → Ω → Set ℝ}
    (hS : ∀ i, RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable (S i))
    (hcompact : ∀ i ω, IsCompact (S i ω))
    (hne : ∀ i ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    (hconv : ∀ i ω, Convex ℝ (S i ω))
    {g : ι → Ω → ℝ} (hg : ∀ i, Integrable (g i) μ)
    (hdom : ∀ i ω, ∀ x ∈ S i ω, ‖x‖ ≤ g i ω) :
    ∃ a b : ι → ℝ, a ≤ b ∧
      aumannExpectation μ (piCorrespondence S) = Icc a b
proof:
:= by
  have hi : ∀ i, ∃ a b : ℝ, a ≤ b ∧
      aumannExpectation μ (S i) = Icc a b := by
    intro i
    exact exists_Icc_eq_aumannExpectation_real
      (hS i) (hcompact i) (hne i) (hconv i) (hg i) (hdom i)
  choose a b hab hEq using hi
  refine ⟨a, b, hab, ?_⟩
  rw [aumannExpectation_piCorrespondence]
  simp_rw [hEq]
  exact Set.pi_univ_Icc (x := a) (y := b)

name: RandomSetTheory.closure_aumannExpectation_eq_pi_real
statement:
theorem closure_aumannExpectation_eq_pi_real
    [Fintype ι]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S : ι → Ω → Set ℝ}
    (hS : ∀ i, RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable (S i))
    (hcompact : ∀ i ω, IsCompact (S i ω))
    (hne : ∀ i ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    (hconv : ∀ i ω, Convex ℝ (S i ω))
    {g : ι → Ω → ℝ} (hg : ∀ i, Integrable (g i) μ)
    (hdom : ∀ i ω, ∀ x ∈ S i ω, ‖x‖ ≤ g i ω) :
    closure (aumannExpectation μ (piCorrespondence S)) =
      aumannExpectation μ (piCorrespondence S)
proof:
:=
  (aumannExpectation_isClosed_pi_real hS hcompact hne hconv hg hdom).closure_eq

name: ProbabilityTheory.ae_tendsto_scalarEmpiricalAverage_iid
statement:
theorem ae_tendsto_scalarEmpiricalAverage_iid
    (observation : Nat → Omega → Sample) (f : Sample → Real)
    (hf : Measurable f)
    (hintegrable : Integrable (f ∘ observation 0) probabilityMeasure)
    (hindep : Pairwise ((· ⟂ᵢ[probabilityMeasure] ·) on observation))
    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (observation i) (observation 0)
      probabilityMeasure probabilityMeasure) :
    ∀ᵐ omega ∂probabilityMeasure,
      Tendsto
        (fun n : Nat ↦
          scalarEmpiricalAverage (fun i ↦ f ∘ observation i) n omega)
        atTop
        (nhds (∫ omega, f (observation 0 omega) ∂probabilityMeasure))
proof:
:= by
  let X : Nat → Omega → Real := fun i ↦ f ∘ observation i
  have hXident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0)
      probabilityMeasure probabilityMeasure := fun i ↦ (hident i).comp hf
  simpa only [scalarEmpiricalAverage, X, Function.comp_apply] using
    (strong_law_ae_real X hintegrable
      (fun i j hij ↦ (hindep hij).comp hf hf) hXident)

name: ProbabilityTheory.tendstoInMeasure_scalarEmpiricalAverage_iid
statement:
theorem tendstoInMeasure_scalarEmpiricalAverage_iid
    [IsFiniteMeasure probabilityMeasure]
    (observation : Nat → Omega → Sample) (f : Sample → Real)
    (hf : Measurable f)
    (hintegrable : Integrable (f ∘ observation 0) probabilityMeasure)
    (hindep : Pairwise ((· ⟂ᵢ[probabilityMeasure] ·) on observation))
    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (observation i) (observation 0)
      probabilityMeasure probabilityMeasure) :
    TendstoInMeasure probabilityMeasure
      (fun n ↦ scalarEmpiricalAverage (fun i ↦ f ∘ observation i) n)
      atTop (fun _ ↦ ∫ omega, f (observation 0 omega) ∂probabilityMeasure)
proof:
:= by
  let X : Nat → Omega → Real := fun i ↦ f ∘ observation i
  have hXident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0)
      probabilityMeasure probabilityMeasure := fun i ↦ (hident i).comp hf
  have hXintegrable : ∀ i, Integrable (X i) probabilityMeasure :=
    fun i ↦ (hXident i).integrable_iff.mpr hintegrable
  apply tendstoInMeasure_of_tendsto_ae
  · intro n
    exact ((integrable_finsetSum (Finset.range n)
      (fun i _hi ↦ hXintegrable i)).div_const (n : Real)).aestronglyMeasurable
  · simpa only [X] using
      (ae_tendsto_scalarEmpiricalAverage_iid observation f hf hintegrable
        hindep hident)

name: RandomSetTheory.IsAtomlessMeasure.exists_subset_measureReal_pos_le
statement:
theorem IsAtomlessMeasure.exists_subset_measureReal_pos_le
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hμ : IsAtomlessMeasure μ)
    {s : Set Ω} (hs : MeasurableSet s) (hspos : 0 < μ s)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ t : Set Ω, t ⊆ s ∧ MeasurableSet t ∧
      0 < μ.real t ∧ μ.real t ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  let P : Set ℝ :=
    {x | ∃ t : Set Ω, t ⊆ s ∧ MeasurableSet t ∧
      0 < μ.real t ∧ μ.real t = x}
  have hsreal : 0 < μ.real s :=
    ENNReal.toReal_pos hspos.ne' (measure_ne_top μ s)
  have hPne : P.Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨μ.real s, s, Subset.rfl, hs, hsreal, rfl⟩
  have hPbelow : BddBelow P := by
    refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    rintro x ⟨t, -, -, htpos, rfl⟩
    exact htpos.le
  have hInf : sInf P = 0 := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · by_contra hnot
      have hInfPos : 0 < sInf P := lt_of_not_ge hnot
      have hInfTwo : sInf P < 2 * sInf P := by linarith
      obtain ⟨x, hxP, hxTwo⟩ :=
        exists_lt_of_csInf_lt hPne hInfTwo
      rcases hxP with ⟨t, hts, ht, htposReal, htx⟩
      have htpos : 0 < μ t :=
        (ENNReal.toReal_pos_iff.mp htposReal).1
      obtain ⟨u, hut, hu, hupos, hvpos⟩ :=
        hμ.exists_measurable_split ht htpos
      let v : Set Ω := t \ u
      have hv : MeasurableSet v := ht.diff hu
      have hus : u ⊆ s := hut.trans hts
      have hvs : v ⊆ s := Set.sdiff_subset.trans hts
      have huposReal : 0 < μ.real u :=
        ENNReal.toReal_pos hupos.ne' (measure_ne_top μ u)
      have hvposReal : 0 < μ.real v :=
        ENNReal.toReal_pos hvpos.ne' (measure_ne_top μ v)
      have hvMeasure : μ.real v = μ.real t - μ.real u := by
        exact measureReal_sdiff hut hu
      have hxMeasure : μ.real t = x := htx
      by_cases huHalf : μ.real u ≤ x / 2
      · have huP : μ.real u ∈ P :=
          ⟨u, hus, hu, huposReal, rfl⟩
        have hInfLe : sInf P ≤ μ.real u := csInf_le hPbelow huP
        have hxHalfLt : x / 2 < sInf P := by linarith [hxTwo]
        linarith
      · have hvHalf : μ.real v ≤ x / 2 := by
          rw [hvMeasure, hxMeasure]
          linarith
        have hvP : μ.real v ∈ P :=
          ⟨v, hvs, hv, hvposReal, rfl⟩
        have hInfLe : sInf P ≤ μ.real v := csInf_le hPbelow hvP
        have hxHalfLt : x / 2 < sInf P := by linarith [hxTwo]
        linarith
    · exact le_csInf hPne fun x hx ↦ by
        rcases hx with ⟨t, -, -, htpos, rfl⟩
        exact htpos.le
  have hInfLt : sInf P < ε := by simpa [hInf] using hε
  obtain ⟨x, hxP, hxε⟩ := exists_lt_of_csInf_lt hPne hInfLt
  rcases hxP with ⟨t, hts, ht, htpos, htx⟩
  refine ⟨t, hts, ht, htpos, ?_⟩
  rw [htx]
  exact hxε.le

name: RandomSetTheory.IsAtomlessMeasure.exists_subset_measureReal_quasiMax
statement:
theorem IsAtomlessMeasure.exists_subset_measureReal_quasiMax
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hμ : IsAtomlessMeasure μ)
    {s : Set Ω} (hs : MeasurableSet s) (hspos : 0 < μ s)
    {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    ∃ t : Set Ω, t ⊆ s ∧ MeasurableSet t ∧
      0 < μ.real t ∧ μ.real t ≤ b ∧
      ∀ u : Set Ω, u ⊆ s → MeasurableSet u →
        0 < μ.real u → μ.real u ≤ b →
        μ.real u ≤ 2 * μ.real t
proof:
:= by
  let P : Set ℝ :=
    {x | ∃ t : Set Ω, t ⊆ s ∧ MeasurableSet t ∧
      0 < μ.real t ∧ μ.real t ≤ b ∧ μ.real t = x}
  obtain ⟨t₀, ht₀s, ht₀, ht₀pos, ht₀b⟩ :=
    hμ.exists_subset_measureReal_pos_le hs hspos hb
  have hPne : P.Nonempty := by
    exact ⟨μ.real t₀, t₀, ht₀s, ht₀, ht₀pos, ht₀b, rfl⟩
  have hPabove : BddAbove P := by
    refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
    rintro x ⟨t, -, -, -, htb, rfl⟩
    exact htb
  have hSupPos : 0 < sSup P :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le ht₀pos
      (le_csSup hPabove
        ⟨t₀, ht₀s, ht₀, ht₀pos, ht₀b, rfl⟩)
  have hHalf : sSup P / 2 < sSup P := by linarith
  obtain ⟨x, hxP, hxHalf⟩ := exists_lt_of_lt_csSup hPne hHalf
  rcases hxP with ⟨t, hts, ht, htpos, htb, htx⟩
  refine ⟨t, hts, ht, htpos, htb, ?_⟩
  intro u hus hu hupos hub
  have huP : μ.real u ∈ P :=
    ⟨u, hus, hu, hupos, hub, rfl⟩
  have huSup : μ.real u ≤ sSup P := le_csSup hPabove huP
  linarith [htx]

name: RandomSetTheory.IsAtomlessMeasure.exists_subset_measureReal_eq
statement:
theorem IsAtomlessMeasure.exists_subset_measureReal_eq
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hμ : IsAtomlessMeasure μ)
    {s : Set Ω} (hs : MeasurableSet s)
    {b : ℝ} (hb0 : 0 ≤ b) (hbs : b ≤ μ.real s) :
    ∃ t : Set Ω, t ⊆ s ∧ MeasurableSet t ∧ μ.real t = b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hbzero : b = 0
  · exact ⟨∅, empty_subset s, MeasurableSet.empty, by simp [hbzero]⟩
  have hbpos : 0 < b := lt_of_le_of_ne hb0 (Ne.symm hbzero)
  let Good : Set Ω → Set Ω → Prop := fun A t ↦
    t ⊆ s \ A ∧ MeasurableSet t ∧
      0 < μ.real t ∧ μ.real t ≤ b - μ.real A ∧
      ∀ u : Set Ω, u ⊆ s \ A → MeasurableSet u →
        0 < μ.real u → μ.real u ≤ b - μ.real A →
        μ.real u ≤ 2 * μ.real t
  have exists_good (A : Set Ω) (hA : MeasurableSet A)
      (hAs : A ⊆ s) (hAb : μ.real A < b) :
      ∃ t : Set Ω, Good A t := by
    have hremReal : μ.real (s \ A) = μ.real s - μ.real A :=
      measureReal_sdiff hAs hA
    have hremRealPos : 0 < μ.real (s \ A) := by
      rw [hremReal]
      linarith
    have hremPos : 0 < μ (s \ A) :=
      (ENNReal.toReal_pos_iff.mp hremRealPos).1
    have hgap : 0 < b - μ.real A := sub_pos.mpr hAb
    obtain ⟨t, htr, ht, htpos, htle, htdom⟩ :=
      hμ.exists_subset_measureReal_quasiMax (hs.diff hA) hremPos hgap
    exact ⟨t, htr, ht, htpos, htle, htdom⟩
  let Admissible : Set Ω → Prop := fun A ↦
    MeasurableSet A ∧ A ⊆ s ∧ μ.real A < b
  let piece : Set Ω → Set Ω := fun A ↦
    if h : Admissible A then
      Classical.choose (exists_good A h.1 h.2.1 h.2.2)
    else ∅
  have piece_spec (A : Set Ω) (hA : Admissible A) :
      Good A (piece A) := by
    rw [show piece A = Classical.choose
      (exists_good A hA.1 hA.2.1 hA.2.2) by simp [piece, hA]]
    exact Classical.choose_spec (exists_good A hA.1 hA.2.1 hA.2.2)
  have piece_eq_empty (A : Set Ω) (hA : ¬ Admissible A) :
      piece A = ∅ := by simp [piece, hA]
  let A : ℕ → Set Ω := fun n ↦
    Nat.rec ∅ (fun _ C ↦ C ∪ piece C) n
  have A_zero : A 0 = ∅ := rfl
  have A_succ (n : ℕ) : A (n + 1) = A n ∪ piece (A n) := rfl
  have A_invariant (n : ℕ) :
      MeasurableSet (A n) ∧ A n ⊆ s ∧ μ.real (A n) ≤ b := by
    induction n with
    | zero => simp [A, hb0]
    | succ n ih =>
        rw [show A (n + 1) = A n ∪ piece (A n) from A_succ n]
        by_cases hlt : μ.real (A n) < b
        · have hAdm : Admissible (A n) := ⟨ih.1, ih.2.1, hlt⟩
          have hp := piece_spec (A n) hAdm
          have hpSub : piece (A n) ⊆ s \ A n := hp.1
          have hpMeas : MeasurableSet (piece (A n)) := hp.2.1
          have hpLe : μ.real (piece (A n)) ≤ b - μ.real (A n) :=
            hp.2.2.2.1
          have hdisj : Disjoint (A n) (piece (A n)) := by
            rw [Set.disjoint_left]
            intro x hxA hxp
            exact (hpSub hxp).2 hxA
          refine ⟨ih.1.union hpMeas,
            union_subset ih.2.1 (hpSub.trans Set.sdiff_subset), ?_⟩
          rw [measureReal_union hdisj hpMeas]
          linarith
        · have hNotAdm : ¬ Admissible (A n) := by
            intro hAdm
            exact hlt hAdm.2.2
          rw [piece_eq_empty (A n) hNotAdm, union_empty]
          exact ih
  have A_step (n : ℕ) : A n ⊆ A (n + 1) := by
    rw [A_succ]
    exact subset_union_left
  have A_mono : Monotone A := monotone_nat_of_le_succ A_step
  let U : Set Ω := ⋃ n, A n
  have hUmeas : MeasurableSet U :=
    MeasurableSet.iUnion fun n ↦ (A_invariant n).1
  have hUs : U ⊆ s :=
    iUnion_subset fun n ↦ (A_invariant n).2.1
  have hlimReal :
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n ↦ μ.real (A n)) Filter.atTop
        (nhds (μ.real U)) := by
    have hlim := tendsto_measure_iUnion_atTop (μ := μ) A_mono
    have htoReal := ENNReal.tendsto_toReal (measure_ne_top μ U)
    convert htoReal.comp hlim using 1 <;>
      simp [Measure.real, Function.comp_def, U]
  have hUb : μ.real U ≤ b :=
    le_of_tendsto hlimReal
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n ↦ (A_invariant n).2.2)
  refine ⟨U, hUs, hUmeas, ?_⟩
  apply le_antisymm hUb
  by_contra hnot
  have hUlt : μ.real U < b := lt_of_not_ge hnot
  have hremReal : μ.real (s \ U) = μ.real s - μ.real U :=
    measureReal_sdiff hUs hUmeas
  have hremRealPos : 0 < μ.real (s \ U) := by
    rw [hremReal]
    linarith
  have hremPos : 0 < μ (s \ U) :=
    (ENNReal.toReal_pos_iff.mp hremRealPos).1
  have hgapPos : 0 < b - μ.real U := sub_pos.mpr hUlt
  obtain ⟨t, htRem, htMeas, htPos, htGap⟩ :=
    hμ.exists_subset_measureReal_pos_le (hs.diff hUmeas) hremPos hgapPos
  have A_subset_U (n : ℕ) : A n ⊆ U := by
    exact subset_iUnion A n
  have A_real_le_U (n : ℕ) : μ.real (A n) ≤ μ.real U :=
    measureReal_mono (A_subset_U n)
  have A_admissible (n : ℕ) : Admissible (A n) := by
    refine ⟨(A_invariant n).1, (A_invariant n).2.1, ?_⟩
    exact (A_real_le_U n).trans_lt hUlt
  have piece_good (n : ℕ) : Good (A n) (piece (A n)) :=
    piece_spec (A n) (A_admissible n)
  have t_subset_remainder (n : ℕ) : t ⊆ s \ A n := by
    intro x hxt
    refine ⟨(htRem hxt).1, ?_⟩
    intro hxA
    exact (htRem hxt).2 (A_subset_U n hxA)
  have htGap_n (n : ℕ) : μ.real t ≤ b - μ.real (A n) := by
    calc
      μ.real t ≤ b - μ.real U := htGap
      _ ≤ b - μ.real (A n) := sub_le_sub_left (A_real_le_U n) b
  have piece_lower (n : ℕ) : μ.real t / 2 ≤ μ.real (piece (A n)) := by
    have hdom := (piece_good n).2.2.2.2
      t (t_subset_remainder n) htMeas htPos (htGap_n n)
    linarith
  have A_measure_succ (n : ℕ) :
      μ.real (A (n + 1)) =
        μ.real (A n) + μ.real (piece (A n)) := by
    rw [A_succ]
    have hpSub : piece (A n) ⊆ s \ A n := (piece_good n).1
    have hpMeas : MeasurableSet (piece (A n)) := (piece_good n).2.1
    have hdisj : Disjoint (A n) (piece (A n)) := by
      rw [Set.disjoint_left]
      intro x hxA hxp
      exact (hpSub hxp).2 hxA
    exact measureReal_union hdisj hpMeas
  let δ : ℝ := μ.real t / 2
  have hδpos : 0 < δ := by simp only [δ]; linarith
  have A_growth (n : ℕ) : (n : ℝ) * δ ≤ μ.real (A n) := by
    induction n with
    | zero => simp [A_zero]
    | succ n ih =>
        rw [show μ.real (A (n + 1)) =
          μ.real (A n) + μ.real (piece (A n)) from A_measure_succ n]
        have hp := piece_lower n
        simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
        simp only [δ] at ih ⊢
        nlinarith
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Archimedean.arch (b + 1) hδpos
  have hn' : b + 1 ≤ (n : ℝ) * δ := by
    simpa [nsmul_eq_mul] using hn
  have hnb := (A_invariant n).2.2
  have hng := A_growth n
  linarith

name: RandomSetTheory.IsAtomlessMeasure.exists_subset_measure_eq
statement:
theorem IsAtomlessMeasure.exists_subset_measure_eq
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hμ : IsAtomlessMeasure μ)
    {s : Set Ω} (hs : MeasurableSet s)
    {c : ℝ≥0∞} (hcs : c ≤ μ s) :
    ∃ t : Set Ω, t ⊆ s ∧ MeasurableSet t ∧ μ t = c
proof:
:= by
  have hcTop : c ≠ ∞ := ne_top_of_le_ne_top (measure_ne_top μ s) hcs
  have hcRealLe : c.toReal ≤ μ.real s := by
    exact (ENNReal.toReal_le_toReal hcTop (measure_ne_top μ s)).mpr hcs
  obtain ⟨t, hts, ht, htMeasure⟩ :=
    hμ.exists_subset_measureReal_eq hs ENNReal.toReal_nonneg hcRealLe
  refine ⟨t, hts, ht, ?_⟩
  apply (ENNReal.toReal_eq_toReal_iff'
    (measure_ne_top μ t) hcTop).mp
  simpa [Measure.real] using htMeasure

name: RandomSetTheory.hasExactDivisibility_of_atomless
statement:
theorem hasExactDivisibility_of_atomless
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (hμ : IsAtomlessMeasure μ) :
    HasExactDivisibility μ
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs a ha0 ha1
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ μ.real s := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
  have hab0 : 0 ≤ a * μ.real s := mul_nonneg ha0 hs0
  have habs : a * μ.real s ≤ μ.real s := by
    nlinarith
  obtain ⟨A, hAs, hA, hmeasure⟩ :=
    hμ.exists_subset_measureReal_eq hs hab0 habs
  exact ⟨A, hAs, hA, hmeasure⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.hasExactDivisibility_iff_isAtomlessMeasure
statement:
theorem hasExactDivisibility_iff_isAtomlessMeasure
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] :
    HasExactDivisibility μ ↔ IsAtomlessMeasure μ
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨HasExactDivisibility.isAtomlessMeasure,
    hasExactDivisibility_of_atomless⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.IsAtomlessMeasure.exists_isMeasurableFinpartition_measureReal_eq
statement:
theorem IsAtomlessMeasure.exists_isMeasurableFinpartition_measureReal_eq
    {ι : Type*} {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (hμ : IsAtomlessMeasure μ)
    (s : Finset ι) (B : Set Ω) (hB : MeasurableSet B)
    (w : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i)
    (hsum : ∑ i ∈ s, w i = 1) :
    ∃ A : ι → Set Ω, IsMeasurableFinpartition s B A ∧
      ∀ i ∈ s, μ.real (A i) = w i * μ.real B
proof:
:= by
  exact (hasExactDivisibility_of_atomless hμ)
    |>.exists_isMeasurableFinpartition_measureReal_eq
      s B hB w hw hsum

name: RandomSetTheory.tendsto_supportHausdorffGap_iff_hausdorffDist
statement:
theorem tendsto_supportHausdorffGap_iff_hausdorffDist
    {ι E : Type*} {l : Filter ι}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    {K : ι → Set E} {L : Set E}
    (hKcompact : ∀ i, IsCompact (K i)) (hLcompact : IsCompact L)
    (hKne : ∀ i, (K i).Nonempty) (hLne : L.Nonempty)
    (hKconv : ∀ i, Convex ℝ (K i)) (hLconv : Convex ℝ L) :
    Tendsto (fun i => supportHausdorffGap (K i) L) l (𝓝 0) ↔
      Tendsto (fun i => hausdorffDist (K i) L) l (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hEq : ∀ i, supportHausdorffGap (K i) L = hausdorffDist (K i) L :=
    fun i => supportHausdorffGap_eq_hausdorffDist
      (hKcompact i) hLcompact (hKne i) hLne (hKconv i) hLconv
  simp_rw [hEq]

name: RandomSetTheory.ae_tendsto_hausdorffDist_of_supportHausdorffGap
statement:
theorem ae_tendsto_hausdorffDist_of_supportHausdorffGap
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {K : ℕ → Ω → Set E} {L : Ω → Set E}
    (hKcompact : ∀ n ω, IsCompact (K n ω))
    (hLcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (L ω))
    (hKne : ∀ n ω, (K n ω).Nonempty) (hLne : ∀ ω, (L ω).Nonempty)
    (hKconv : ∀ n ω, Convex ℝ (K n ω))
    (hLconv : ∀ ω, Convex ℝ (L ω))
    (h : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ,
      Tendsto (fun n => supportHausdorffGap (K n ω) (L ω)) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ,
      Tendsto (fun n => hausdorffDist (K n ω) (L ω)) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [h] with ω hω
  exact (tendsto_supportHausdorffGap_iff_hausdorffDist
    (fun n => hKcompact n ω) (hLcompact ω)
    (fun n => hKne n ω) (hLne ω)
    (fun n => hKconv n ω) (hLconv ω)).mp hω

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_ge_event_eq_supportHausdorffGap_ge_event
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_ge_event_eq_supportHausdorffGap_ge_event
    {Ω E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    {K L : Ω → Set E}
    (hKcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (K ω))
    (hLcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (L ω))
    (hKne : ∀ ω, (K ω).Nonempty) (hLne : ∀ ω, (L ω).Nonempty)
    (hKconv : ∀ ω, Convex ℝ (K ω))
    (hLconv : ∀ ω, Convex ℝ (L ω)) (r : ℝ) :
    {ω | r ≤ hausdorffDist (K ω) (L ω)} =
      {ω | r ≤ supportHausdorffGap (K ω) (L ω)}
proof:
:= by
  ext ω
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  rw [supportHausdorffGap_eq_hausdorffDist
    (hKcompact ω) (hLcompact ω) (hKne ω) (hLne ω)
    (hKconv ω) (hLconv ω)]

name: RandomSetTheory.measure_hausdorffDist_ge_le_of_supportHausdorffGap_ge_le
statement:
theorem measure_hausdorffDist_ge_le_of_supportHausdorffGap_ge_le
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {K L : Ω → Set E}
    (hKcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (K ω))
    (hLcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (L ω))
    (hKne : ∀ ω, (K ω).Nonempty) (hLne : ∀ ω, (L ω).Nonempty)
    (hKconv : ∀ ω, Convex ℝ (K ω))
    (hLconv : ∀ ω, Convex ℝ (L ω))
    {r : ℝ} {δ : ℝ≥0∞}
    (hbound : μ {ω | r ≤ supportHausdorffGap (K ω) (L ω)} ≤ δ) :
    μ {ω | r ≤ hausdorffDist (K ω) (L ω)} ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  rw [hausdorffDist_ge_event_eq_supportHausdorffGap_ge_event
    hKcompact hLcompact hKne hLne hKconv hLconv]
  exact hbound

name: RandomSetTheory.measure_hausdorffDist_gt_le_finset_support
statement:
theorem measure_hausdorffDist_gt_le_finset_support
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {K L : Ω → Set E}
    (hKcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (K ω))
    (hLcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (L ω))
    (hKne : ∀ ω, (K ω).Nonempty) (hLne : ∀ ω, (L ω).Nonempty)
    (hKconv : ∀ ω, Convex ℝ (K ω))
    (hLconv : ∀ ω, Convex ℝ (L ω))
    {RK RL eps s : ℝ}
    (hRK : ∀ ω, ∀ x ∈ K ω, ‖x‖ ≤ RK)
    (hRL : ∀ ω, ∀ x ∈ L ω, ‖x‖ ≤ RL)
    (heps : 0 ≤ eps) (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (N : Finset E)
    (hnet : ∀ u : E, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 → ∃ v ∈ N, dist u v ≤ eps)
    {δ : ℝ≥0∞}
    (htail : ∀ v ∈ N,
      μ {ω | s < |supportFunction (K ω) v - supportFunction (L ω) v|} ≤ δ) :
    μ {ω | s + (RK + RL) * eps < hausdorffDist (K ω) (L ω)} ≤
      ∑ _v ∈ N, δ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let A : E → Set Ω := fun v =>
    {ω | s < |supportFunction (K ω) v - supportFunction (L ω) v|}
  have hsub :
      {ω | s + (RK + RL) * eps < hausdorffDist (K ω) (L ω)} ⊆
        ⋃ v ∈ N, A v := by
    intro ω hω
    by_contra hnone
    have hN : ∀ v ∈ N,
        |supportFunction (K ω) v - supportFunction (L ω) v| ≤ s := by
      intro v hv
      by_contra hvbad
      apply hnone
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨v, Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨hv, lt_of_not_ge hvbad⟩⟩
    have hhd := hausdorffDist_le_of_finset_net_supportFunction
      (hKcompact ω) (hLcompact ω) (hKne ω) (hLne ω)
      (hKconv ω) (hLconv ω) (hRK ω) (hRL ω)
      heps hs N hnet hN
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hhd) hω
  calc
    μ {ω | s + (RK + RL) * eps < hausdorffDist (K ω) (L ω)} ≤
        μ (⋃ v ∈ N, A v) := measure_mono hsub
    _ ≤ ∑ v ∈ N, μ (A v) := measure_biUnion_finset_le N A
    _ ≤ ∑ _v ∈ N, δ := by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun v hv => htail v hv

name: ProbabilityTheory.integral_sq_centeredTruncation_le_integral_sq
statement:
theorem integral_sq_centeredTruncation_le_integral_sq
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] {X : Omega → ℝ} (hX : MemLp X 2 mu)
    (y : ℝ) :
    ∫ omega, centeredTruncation X y mu omega ^ 2 ∂mu ≤
      ∫ omega, X omega ^ 2 ∂mu
proof:
:= by
  let W : Omega → ℝ := truncation X y
  have hW : MemLp W 2 mu :=
    hX.aestronglyMeasurable.memLp_truncation
  have hcentered :
      ∫ omega, centeredTruncation X y mu omega ^ 2 ∂mu =
        Var[W; mu] := by
    simpa only [centeredTruncation, W] using
      (variance_eq_integral hW.aemeasurable).symm
  have htruncSq : ∀ omega, W omega ^ 2 ≤ X omega ^ 2 := by
    intro omega
    rw [sq_le_sq]
    exact abs_truncation_le_abs_self X y omega
  calc
    ∫ omega, centeredTruncation X y mu omega ^ 2 ∂mu =
        Var[W; mu] := hcentered
    _ = (∫ omega, W omega ^ 2 ∂mu) -
        (∫ omega, W omega ∂mu) ^ 2 := variance_eq_sub hW
    _ ≤ ∫ omega, W omega ^ 2 ∂mu := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (∫ omega, W omega ∂mu)]
    _ ≤ ∫ omega, X omega ^ 2 ∂mu :=
      integral_mono hW.integrable_sq hX.integrable_sq htruncSq

name: ProbabilityTheory.condExp_sq_conditionallyCenteredTruncation_le_condExp_sq
statement:
theorem condExp_sq_conditionallyCenteredTruncation_le_condExp_sq
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] (hm : m ≤ mOmega)
    {X : Omega → ℝ} (hX : MemLp X 2 mu) (y : ℝ) :
    mu[fun omega ↦
        conditionallyCenteredTruncation mu m X y omega ^ 2 | m]
      ≤ᵐ[mu] mu[fun omega ↦ X omega ^ 2 | m]
proof:
:= by
  let W : Omega → ℝ := truncation X y
  have hW : MemLp W 2 mu :=
    hX.aestronglyMeasurable.memLp_truncation
  have hvariance :
      mu[fun omega ↦
          conditionallyCenteredTruncation mu m X y omega ^ 2 | m]
        ≤ᵐ[mu] mu[fun omega ↦ W omega ^ 2 | m] := by
    change mu[(W - mu[W | m]) ^ 2 | m] ≤ᵐ[mu] mu[W ^ 2 | m]
    exact condVar_ae_le_condExp_sq (X := W) hm hW
  have htruncSq : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, W omega ^ 2 ≤ X omega ^ 2 := by
    filter_upwards [] with omega
    rw [sq_le_sq]
    exact abs_truncation_le_abs_self X y omega
  exact hvariance.trans
    (condExp_mono (m := m) hW.integrable_sq hX.integrable_sq htruncSq)

name: ProbabilityTheory.exp_neg_le_factorial_div_pow
statement:
theorem exp_neg_le_factorial_div_pow (r : ℕ) {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 < z) :
    exp (-z) ≤ (r.factorial : ℝ) / z ^ r
proof:
:= by
  have hseries : z ^ r / (r.factorial : ℝ) ≤ exp z :=
    Real.pow_div_factorial_le_exp z hz.le r
  have hden : 0 < z ^ r / (r.factorial : ℝ) := by positivity
  calc
    exp (-z) = 1 / exp z := by rw [Real.exp_neg]; simp only [one_div]
    _ ≤ 1 / (z ^ r / (r.factorial : ℝ)) :=
      one_div_le_one_div_of_le hden hseries
    _ = (r.factorial : ℝ) / z ^ r := by
      field_simp

name: ProbabilityTheory.exp_neg_sq_div_bernstein_le_gaussian_add_polynomial
statement:
theorem exp_neg_sq_div_bernstein_le_gaussian_add_polynomial
    (r : ℕ) {x V b : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hV : 0 < V) (hb : 0 < b) :
    exp (-x ^ 2 / (2 * (2 * V + b * x))) ≤
      exp (-x ^ 2 / (8 * V)) +
        (r.factorial : ℝ) * (4 * b / x) ^ r
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hsmall : b * x ≤ 2 * V
  · have hden : 0 < 2 * (2 * V + b * x) := by positivity
    have hdenLe : 2 * (2 * V + b * x) ≤ 8 * V := by nlinarith
    have hfrac : x ^ 2 / (8 * V) ≤
        x ^ 2 / (2 * (2 * V + b * x)) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (sq_nonneg x) hden hdenLe
    have hexp : exp (-x ^ 2 / (2 * (2 * V + b * x))) ≤
        exp (-x ^ 2 / (8 * V)) := by
      apply exp_le_exp.mpr
      simpa only [neg_div] using neg_le_neg hfrac
    exact hexp.trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right (by positivity))
  · have hlarge : 2 * V < b * x := lt_of_not_ge hsmall
    have hden : 0 < 2 * (2 * V + b * x) := by positivity
    have hfour : 0 < 4 * b * x := by positivity
    have hdenLt : 2 * (2 * V + b * x) < 4 * b * x := by nlinarith
    have hfrac : x / (4 * b) ≤
        x ^ 2 / (2 * (2 * V + b * x)) := by
      have hraw : x ^ 2 / (4 * b * x) ≤
          x ^ 2 / (2 * (2 * V + b * x)) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (sq_nonneg x) hden hdenLt.le
      convert hraw using 1
      field_simp
    have hexp : exp (-x ^ 2 / (2 * (2 * V + b * x))) ≤
        exp (-(x / (4 * b))) := by
      apply exp_le_exp.mpr
      simpa only [neg_div] using neg_le_neg hfrac
    have hpower := exp_neg_le_factorial_div_pow r
      (div_pos hx (by positivity : 0 < 4 * b))
    have hrewrite :
        (r.factorial : ℝ) / (x / (4 * b)) ^ r =
          (r.factorial : ℝ) * (4 * b / x) ^ r := by
      rw [div_eq_mul_inv, ← inv_pow]
      congr 2
      field_simp
    calc
      exp (-x ^ 2 / (2 * (2 * V + b * x))) ≤
          exp (-(x / (4 * b))) := hexp
      _ ≤ (r.factorial : ℝ) / (x / (4 * b)) ^ r := hpower
      _ = (r.factorial : ℝ) * (4 * b / x) ^ r := hrewrite
      _ ≤ exp (-x ^ 2 / (8 * V)) +
          (r.factorial : ℝ) * (4 * b / x) ^ r :=
        le_add_of_nonneg_left (exp_pos _).le

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_sum_martingaleCenteredTruncation_ge_le_gaussian_add_polynomial
statement:
theorem measureReal_sum_martingaleCenteredTruncation_ge_le_gaussian_add_polynomial
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (D : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hD : StronglyAdapted filtration D)
    (v : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (n r : ℕ)
    (hLp : ∀ i < n, MemLp (D i) 2 mu)
    (hsecond0 : ∫ omega, D 0 omega ^ 2 ∂mu ≤ (v 0 : ℝ))
    (hsecondSucc : ∀ i < n - 1, ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      mu[fun z ↦ D (i + 1) z ^ 2 | filtration i] omega ≤
        (v (i + 1) : ℝ))
    {y t : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) (ht : 0 < t)
    (hV : 0 < (((∑ i ∈ range n, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ))) :
    mu.real {omega | t ≤
        ∑ i ∈ range n,
          martingaleCenteredTruncation filtration mu D y i omega} ≤
      exp (-t ^ 2 /
        (8 * (((∑ i ∈ range n, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)))) +
        (r.factorial : ℝ) * (8 * y / t) ^ r
proof:
:= by
  let Y : ℕ → Omega → ℝ :=
    martingaleCenteredTruncation filtration mu D y
  let b : ℝ≥0 := ⟨2 * |y|, mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (abs_nonneg y)⟩
  have hn : 0 < n := by
    cases n with
    | zero => simp at hV
    | succ n => omega
  have hYAdapted : StronglyAdapted filtration Y :=
    stronglyAdapted_martingaleCenteredTruncation filtration D y hD
  have hYLp : ∀ i < n, MemLp (Y i) 2 mu := by
    intro i hi
    have hDi := hLp i hi
    have hWi : MemLp (truncation (D i) y) 2 mu :=
      hDi.aestronglyMeasurable.memLp_truncation
    cases i with
    | zero =>
        change MemLp
          (truncation (D 0) y -
            fun _ ↦ ∫ z, truncation (D 0) y z ∂mu) 2 mu
        exact hWi.sub (memLp_const _)
    | succ i =>
        change MemLp
          (truncation (D (i + 1)) y -
            mu[truncation (D (i + 1)) y | filtration i]) 2 mu
        exact hWi.sub (hWi.condExp one_le_two)
  have hYBound : ∀ i < n, ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      |Y i omega| ≤ (b : ℝ) := by
    intro i _hi
    cases i with
    | zero =>
        exact ae_of_all mu fun omega ↦ by
          change |centeredTruncation (D 0) y mu omega| ≤ 2 * |y|
          rcases centeredTruncation_mem_Icc (mu := mu) (D 0) y omega with
            ⟨hl, hu⟩
          exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, hu⟩
    | succ i =>
        filter_upwards [conditionallyCenteredTruncation_mem_Icc
            (mu := mu) (m := filtration i) (D (i + 1)) y]
          with omega homega
        change |conditionallyCenteredTruncation mu (filtration i)
          (D (i + 1)) y omega| ≤ 2 * |y|
        rcases homega with ⟨hl, hu⟩
        exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, hu⟩
  have hYCenter0 : ∫ omega, Y 0 omega ∂mu = 0 := by
    exact integral_centeredTruncation
      (hLp 0 hn).aemeasurable y
  have hYCenterSucc : ∀ i < n - 1,
      mu[Y (i + 1) | filtration i] =ᵐ[mu] 0 := by
    intro i hi
    exact condExp_conditionallyCenteredTruncation_ae_eq_zero
      (filtration.le i) (hLp (i + 1) (by omega)).aemeasurable y
  have hYSecond0 : ∫ omega, Y 0 omega ^ 2 ∂mu ≤ (v 0 : ℝ) := by
    exact (integral_sq_centeredTruncation_le_integral_sq
      (hLp 0 hn) y).trans hsecond0
  have hYSecondSucc : ∀ i < n - 1, ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      mu[fun z ↦ Y (i + 1) z ^ 2 | filtration i] omega ≤
        (v (i + 1) : ℝ) := by
    intro i hi
    exact (condExp_sq_conditionallyCenteredTruncation_le_condExp_sq
      (filtration.le i) (hLp (i + 1) (by omega)) y).trans
        (hsecondSucc i hi)
  have hBernstein :=
    measureReal_sum_martingaleDiff_ge_le_of_condSecondMoment_le
      filtration Y hYAdapted v b n hYLp hYBound hYCenter0
        hYCenterSucc hYSecond0 hYSecondSucc ht.le hV
  have hbcoe : (b : ℝ) = 2 * |y| := rfl
  rw [hbcoe, abs_of_pos hy] at hBernstein
  have hsplit :=
    exp_neg_sq_div_bernstein_le_gaussian_add_polynomial r
      (x := t)
      (V := (((∑ i ∈ range n, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)))
      (b := 2 * y) ht hV (by positivity)
  calc
    mu.real {omega | t ≤
        ∑ i ∈ range n,
          martingaleCenteredTruncation filtration mu D y i omega} ≤
      exp (-t ^ 2 /
        (2 * (2 * (((∑ i ∈ range n, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) +
          (2 * y) * t))) := by
        simpa only [Y] using hBernstein
    _ ≤ exp (-t ^ 2 /
        (8 * (((∑ i ∈ range n, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)))) +
        (r.factorial : ℝ) * (8 * y / t) ^ r := by
      have hbase : 4 * (2 * y) / t = 8 * y / t := by ring
      simpa only [hbase] using hsplit

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_martingale_sum_large_le_moment_add_gaussian_add_polynomial
statement:
theorem measureReal_martingale_sum_large_le_moment_add_gaussian_add_polynomial
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (D : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hD : StronglyAdapted filtration D)
    (v : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (n q r : ℕ)
    (hDq : ∀ k < n, Integrable (fun omega ↦ |D k omega| ^ q) mu)
    (hLp : ∀ i < n, MemLp (D i) 2 mu)
    (hsecond0 : ∫ omega, D 0 omega ^ 2 ∂mu ≤ (v 0 : ℝ))
    (hsecondSucc : ∀ i < n - 1, ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      mu[fun z ↦ D (i + 1) z ^ 2 | filtration i] omega ≤
        (v (i + 1) : ℝ))
    {y t : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) (ht : 0 < t)
    (hV : 0 < (((∑ i ∈ range n, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ))) :
    mu.real {omega | t +
        |∑ k ∈ range n,
          martingaleTruncationCenter filtration mu D y k omega| ≤
        ∑ k ∈ range n, D k omega} ≤
      (∑ k ∈ range n, absoluteMoment (D k) q mu) / y ^ q +
        (exp (-t ^ 2 /
          (8 * (((∑ i ∈ range n, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)))) +
          (r.factorial : ℝ) * (8 * y / t) ^ r)
proof:
:= by
  have hdecomp :=
    measureReal_martingale_sum_large_le_sum_large_add_truncation
      (mu := mu) filtration D y t n
  have htrunc :=
    measureReal_sum_martingaleCenteredTruncation_ge_le_gaussian_add_polynomial
      (mu := mu) filtration D hD v n r hLp hsecond0 hsecondSucc
        hy ht hV
  calc
    mu.real {omega | t +
        |∑ k ∈ range n,
          martingaleTruncationCenter filtration mu D y k omega| ≤
        ∑ k ∈ range n, D k omega} ≤
      (∑ k ∈ range n, mu.real {omega | y ≤ |D k omega|}) +
        mu.real {omega | t ≤
          ∑ k ∈ range n,
            martingaleCenteredTruncation filtration mu D y k omega} :=
      hdecomp
    _ ≤ (∑ k ∈ range n,
          absoluteMoment (D k) q mu / y ^ q) +
        (exp (-t ^ 2 /
          (8 * (((∑ i ∈ range n, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)))) +
          (r.factorial : ℝ) * (8 * y / t) ^ r) := by
      apply add_le_add
      · gcongr with k hk
        exact measureReal_abs_ge_le_absoluteMoment_div
          (D k) q (hDq k (mem_range.mp hk)) hy
      · exact htrunc
    _ = (∑ k ∈ range n, absoluteMoment (D k) q mu) / y ^ q +
        (exp (-t ^ 2 /
          (8 * (((∑ i ∈ range n, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)))) +
          (r.factorial : ℝ) * (8 * y / t) ^ r) := by
      rw [sum_div]

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_martingale_sum_large_le_condMoment_bias_add_gaussian_add_polynomial
statement:
theorem measureReal_martingale_sum_large_le_condMoment_bias_add_gaussian_add_polynomial
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (D : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hD : StronglyAdapted filtration D)
    (v : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (n q r : ℕ) (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hDq : ∀ k < n, Integrable (fun omega ↦ |D k omega| ^ q) mu)
    (hLp : ∀ i < n, MemLp (D i) 2 mu)
    (hcenter0 : ∫ omega, D 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hcenterSucc : ∀ k < n - 1,
      mu[D (k + 1) | filtration k] =ᵐ[mu] 0)
    (hsecond0 : ∫ omega, D 0 omega ^ 2 ∂mu ≤ (v 0 : ℝ))
    (hsecondSucc : ∀ i < n - 1, ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      mu[fun z ↦ D (i + 1) z ^ 2 | filtration i] omega ≤
        (v (i + 1) : ℝ))
    (K : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hmoment0 : absoluteMoment (D 0) q mu ≤ K 0)
    (hcondMoment : ∀ k < n - 1, ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      mu[fun z ↦ |D (k + 1) z| ^ q | filtration k] omega ≤
        K (k + 1))
    {y t : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) (ht : 0 < t)
    (hV : 0 < (((∑ i ∈ range n, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ))) :
    mu.real {omega |
        t + (∑ k ∈ range n, K k) / y ^ (q - 1) ≤
          ∑ k ∈ range n, D k omega} ≤
      (∑ k ∈ range n, absoluteMoment (D k) q mu) / y ^ q +
        (exp (-t ^ 2 /
          (8 * (((∑ i ∈ range n, v i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)))) +
          (r.factorial : ℝ) * (8 * y / t) ^ r)
proof:
:= by
  let B : ℝ := (∑ k ∈ range n, K k) / y ^ (q - 1)
  let C : Omega → ℝ := fun omega ↦
    ∑ k ∈ range n,
      martingaleTruncationCenter filtration mu D y k omega
  have hcenterBound : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, |C omega| ≤ B := by
    simpa only [B, C] using
      abs_sum_martingaleTruncationCenter_le_moment_div
        filtration D hD hq hDq hcenter0 hcenterSucc K hmoment0
          hcondMoment hy
  have hmono :
      mu.real {omega | t + B ≤ ∑ k ∈ range n, D k omega} ≤
        mu.real {omega | t + |C omega| ≤
          ∑ k ∈ range n, D k omega} := by
    rw [measureReal_def, measureReal_def]
    apply ENNReal.toReal_mono (measure_ne_top _ _)
    apply measure_mono_ae
    filter_upwards [hcenterBound] with omega hcenter
    intro homega
    change t + B ≤ ∑ k ∈ range n, D k omega at homega
    change t + |C omega| ≤ ∑ k ∈ range n, D k omega
    linarith
  have hbase :=
    measureReal_martingale_sum_large_le_moment_add_gaussian_add_polynomial
      (mu := mu) filtration D hD v n q r hDq hLp hsecond0
        hsecondSucc hy ht hV
  change mu.real {omega | t + B ≤
    ∑ k ∈ range n, D k omega} ≤ _
  exact hmono.trans (by simpa only [C] using hbase)

name: ProbabilityTheory.hoeffding_fin_average_real
statement:
lemma hoeffding_fin_average_real [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {n : ℕ} (X : Fin n → Ω → ℝ) (a b : Fin n → ℝ)
    (h_indep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (h_meas : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) μ)
    (h_bounds : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, X i ω ∈ Icc (a i) (b i))
    (h_centered : ∀ i, μ[X i] = 0)
    (hn : 0 < n) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ (∑ i, X i ω) / (n : ℝ)} ≤
      exp (-((n : ℝ) * t) ^ 2 / (2 * (↑(∑ i,
        (((‖b i - a i‖₊ / (2 : NNReal)) ^ (2 : ℕ)) : NNReal) : NNReal) : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  have h := hoeffding_sum_real X a b h_indep h_meas h_bounds h_centered
    Finset.univ (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n) ht)
  have hset : {ω | t ≤ (∑ i, X i ω) / (n : ℝ)} =
      {ω | (n : ℝ) * t ≤ ∑ i, X i ω} := by
    ext ω
    simp only [mem_setOf_eq]
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hn)]
    ring
  rw [hset]
  exact h

name: ProbabilityTheory.hoeffding_fin_average_abs_real
statement:
lemma hoeffding_fin_average_abs_real [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {n : ℕ} (X : Fin n → Ω → ℝ) (a b : Fin n → ℝ)
    (h_indep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (h_meas : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) μ)
    (h_bounds : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, X i ω ∈ Icc (a i) (b i))
    (h_centered : ∀ i, μ[X i] = 0)
    (hn : 0 < n) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ |(∑ i, X i ω) / (n : ℝ)|} ≤
      2 * exp (-((n : ℝ) * t) ^ 2 / (2 * (↑(∑ i,
        (((‖b i - a i‖₊ / (2 : NNReal)) ^ (2 : ℕ)) : NNReal) : NNReal) : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  let Xneg : Fin n → Ω → ℝ := fun i ω => -X i ω
  have h_indep_neg : iIndepFun Xneg μ := by
    exact (h_indep.comp (fun _i => fun x : ℝ => -x) (fun _i => measurable_neg)).congr
      (fun _i => ae_of_all μ fun _ω => rfl)
  have h_meas_neg : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (Xneg i) μ := fun i => (h_meas i).neg
  have h_bounds_neg : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Xneg i ω ∈ Icc (-b i) (-a i) := by
    intro i
    filter_upwards [h_bounds i] with ω hω
    exact ⟨neg_le_neg hω.2, neg_le_neg hω.1⟩
  have h_centered_neg : ∀ i, μ[Xneg i] = 0 := by
    intro i
    simp only [Xneg]
    rw [integral_neg, h_centered i, neg_zero]
  have hpos := hoeffding_fin_average_real X a b h_indep h_meas h_bounds
    h_centered hn ht
  have hneg := hoeffding_fin_average_real Xneg (-b) (-a) h_indep_neg h_meas_neg
    h_bounds_neg h_centered_neg hn ht
  have hset : {ω | t ≤ |(∑ i, X i ω) / (n : ℝ)|} =
      {ω | t ≤ (∑ i, X i ω) / (n : ℝ)} ∪
      {ω | t ≤ (∑ i, Xneg i ω) / (n : ℝ)} := by
    ext ω
    simp only [mem_setOf_eq, mem_union, Xneg]
    rw [show (∑ i, -X i ω) = -(∑ i, X i ω) by simp]
    rw [neg_div, le_abs]
  rw [hset]
  calc
    _ ≤ μ.real {ω | t ≤ (∑ i, X i ω) / (n : ℝ)} +
        μ.real {ω | t ≤ (∑ i, Xneg i ω) / (n : ℝ)} :=
      measureReal_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ exp (-((n : ℝ) * t) ^ 2 / (2 * (↑(∑ i,
          (((‖b i - a i‖₊ / (2 : NNReal)) ^ (2 : ℕ)) : NNReal) : NNReal) : ℝ))) +
        exp (-((n : ℝ) * t) ^ 2 / (2 * (↑(∑ i,
          (((‖b i - a i‖₊ / (2 : NNReal)) ^ (2 : ℕ)) : NNReal) : NNReal) : ℝ))) := by
      apply add_le_add hpos
      simpa [Xneg, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using hneg
    _ = 2 * exp (-((n : ℝ) * t) ^ 2 / (2 * (↑(∑ i,
          (((‖b i - a i‖₊ / (2 : NNReal)) ^ (2 : ℕ)) : NNReal) : NNReal) : ℝ))) := by
      ring

name: RandomSetTheory.Empirical.empiricalMinkowskiAverage_compact
statement:
theorem empiricalMinkowskiAverage_compact
    (S : ℕ → Ω → Set E) (n : ℕ)
    (hS : ∀ i < n, ∀ ω, IsCompact (S i ω)) (ω : Ω) :
    IsCompact (empiricalMinkowskiAverage S n ω)
proof:
:= by
  unfold empiricalMinkowskiAverage
  apply (isCompact_finset_sum (range n) (fun i => S i ω) ?_).smul
  intro i hi
  exact hS i (mem_range.mp hi) ω

name: RandomSetTheory.Empirical.empiricalMinkowskiAverage_nonempty
statement:
theorem empiricalMinkowskiAverage_nonempty
    (S : ℕ → Ω → Set E) (n : ℕ)
    (hS : ∀ i < n, ∀ ω, (S i ω).Nonempty) (ω : Ω) :
    (empiricalMinkowskiAverage S n ω).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  unfold empiricalMinkowskiAverage
  exact (nonempty_finset_sum (range n) (fun i => S i ω)
    (fun i hi => hS i (mem_range.mp hi) ω)).smul_set

name: RandomSetTheory.Empirical.empiricalMinkowskiAverage_convex
statement:
theorem empiricalMinkowskiAverage_convex
    (S : ℕ → Ω → Set E) (n : ℕ)
    (hS : ∀ i < n, ∀ ω, Convex ℝ (S i ω)) (ω : Ω) :
    Convex ℝ (empiricalMinkowskiAverage S n ω)
proof:
:= by
  unfold empiricalMinkowskiAverage
  apply Convex.smul
  exact convex_sum (fun i => S i ω)
    (fun i hi => hS i (mem_range.mp hi) ω)

name: RandomSetTheory.Empirical.empiricalMinkowskiAverage_radius
statement:
theorem empiricalMinkowskiAverage_radius
    (S : ℕ → Ω → Set E) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {R : ℝ}
    (hS : ∀ i < n, ∀ ω, ∀ x ∈ S i ω, ‖x‖ ≤ R) (ω : Ω) :
    ∀ x ∈ empiricalMinkowskiAverage S n ω, ‖x‖ ≤ R
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  unfold empiricalMinkowskiAverage at hx
  obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hx
  rw [Set.mem_finsetSum] at hy
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hsum⟩ := hy
  rw [← hsum, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg n))]
  calc
    (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖∑ i ∈ range n, g i‖ ≤
        (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ range n, ‖g i‖ := by
      gcongr
      exact norm_sum_le _ _
    _ ≤ (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ _i ∈ range n, R := by
      gcongr with i hi
      exact hS i (mem_range.mp hi) ω (g i) (hg hi)
    _ = R := by
      simp only [sum_const, card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
      field_simp [Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hn.ne']

name: RandomSetTheory.Empirical.supportFunction_smul_set
proof:
:= by
  have hCK : IsCompact (c • K) := hK.smul c
  have hCKne : (c • K).Nonempty := hKne.smul_set
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hymax⟩ := supportFunction_attains hCK hCKne u
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxmax⟩ := supportFunction_attains hK hKne u
  apply le_antisymm
  · obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [hymax, real_inner_smul_right]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (inner_le_supportFunction hK hz u) hc
  · rw [hxmax, ← real_inner_smul_right]
    exact inner_le_supportFunction hCK (smul_mem_smul_set hx) u

name: RandomSetTheory.Empirical.supportFunction_empiricalMinkowskiAverage
statement:
theorem supportFunction_empiricalMinkowskiAverage
    (S : ℕ → Ω → Set E) {n : ℕ}
    (hScompact : ∀ i < n, ∀ ω, IsCompact (S i ω))
    (hSne : ∀ i < n, ∀ ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    (ω : Ω) (u : E) :
    supportFunction (empiricalMinkowskiAverage S n ω) u =
      (∑ i ∈ range n, supportFunction (S i ω) u) / (n : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold empiricalMinkowskiAverage
  rw [supportFunction_smul_set
      (isCompact_finset_sum (range n) (fun i => S i ω)
        (fun i hi => hScompact i (mem_range.mp hi) ω))
      (nonempty_finset_sum (range n) (fun i => S i ω)
        (fun i hi => hSne i (mem_range.mp hi) ω))]
  · rw [supportFunction_finset_sum]
    · rw [div_eq_inv_mul]
    · intro i hi
      exact hScompact i (mem_range.mp hi) ω
    · intro i hi
      exact hSne i (mem_range.mp hi) ω
  · exact inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg n)

name: RandomSetTheory.Empirical.abs_supportFunction_le_radius
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hmax⟩ := supportFunction_attains hK hKne u
  rw [hmax]
  calc
    |⟪u, x⟫_ℝ| ≤ ‖u‖ * ‖x‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
    _ ≤ 1 * R := by
      exact mul_le_mul hu (hR x hx) (norm_nonneg x) (by norm_num)
    _ = R := one_mul R

name: RandomSetTheory.Empirical.directionalSupportDeviation_mem_Icc_of_radius
statement:
theorem directionalSupportDeviation_mem_Icc_of_radius
    (S : ℕ → Ω → Set E) (L : Set E) (u : E) (i : ℕ) (ω : Ω)
    {RS RL : ℝ}
    (hScompact : IsCompact (S i ω)) (hSne : (S i ω).Nonempty)
    (hLcompact : IsCompact L) (hLne : L.Nonempty)
    (hRS : ∀ x ∈ S i ω, ‖x‖ ≤ RS)
    (hRL : ∀ x ∈ L, ‖x‖ ≤ RL) (hu : ‖u‖ ≤ 1) :
    directionalSupportDeviation S L u i ω ∈ Icc (-(RS + RL)) (RS + RL)
proof:
:= by
  have hS := abs_supportFunction_le_radius hScompact hSne hRS hu
  have hL := abs_supportFunction_le_radius hLcompact hLne hRL hu
  unfold directionalSupportDeviation
  constructor <;>
    linarith [le_abs_self (supportFunction (S i ω) u),
      neg_le_abs (supportFunction (S i ω) u),
      le_abs_self (supportFunction L u), neg_le_abs (supportFunction L u)]

name: RandomSetTheory.Empirical.supportFunction_empirical_sub_eq_average_deviation
statement:
theorem supportFunction_empirical_sub_eq_average_deviation
    (S : ℕ → Ω → Set E) (L : Set E) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (hScompact : ∀ i < n, ∀ ω, IsCompact (S i ω))
    (hSne : ∀ i < n, ∀ ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    (ω : Ω) (u : E) :
    supportFunction (empiricalMinkowskiAverage S n ω) u - supportFunction L u =
      (∑ i ∈ range n, directionalSupportDeviation S L u i ω) / (n : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [supportFunction_empiricalMinkowskiAverage S hScompact hSne]
  simp only [directionalSupportDeviation, sum_sub_distrib, sum_const, card_range,
    nsmul_eq_mul]
  field_simp [Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hn.ne']

name: RandomSetTheory.Empirical.empiricalMinkowskiAverage_support_hoeffding
statement:
theorem empiricalMinkowskiAverage_support_hoeffding
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (S : ℕ → Ω → Set E) (L : Set E) (u : E)
    (a b : ℕ → ℝ)
    (h_indep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun
      (directionalSupportDeviation S L u) μ)
    (h_meas : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (directionalSupportDeviation S L u i) μ)
    (h_bounds : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ,
      directionalSupportDeviation S L u i ω ∈ Icc (a i) (b i))
    (h_centered : ∀ i, μ[directionalSupportDeviation S L u i] = 0)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (hScompact : ∀ i < n, ∀ ω, IsCompact (S i ω))
    (hSne : ∀ i < n, ∀ ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ |supportFunction (empiricalMinkowskiAverage S n ω) u -
        supportFunction L u|} ≤
      2 * exp (-((n : ℝ) * t) ^ 2 / (2 * (↑(∑ i ∈ range n,
        (((‖b i - a i‖₊ / (2 : NNReal)) ^ (2 : ℕ)) : NNReal) : NNReal) : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  have htail := ProbabilityTheory.hoeffding_average_abs_real
    (directionalSupportDeviation S L u) a b h_indep h_meas h_bounds
    h_centered hn ht
  have hset : {ω | t ≤ |supportFunction (empiricalMinkowskiAverage S n ω) u -
        supportFunction L u|} =
      {ω | t ≤ |(∑ i ∈ range n, directionalSupportDeviation S L u i ω) /
        (n : ℝ)|} := by
    ext ω
    simp only [mem_setOf_eq]
    rw [supportFunction_empirical_sub_eq_average_deviation
      S L hn hScompact hSne]
  rw [hset]
  exact htail

name: RandomSetTheory.Empirical.symmetricSupportHoeffdingTail_eq_standard
statement:
theorem symmetricSupportHoeffdingTail_eq_standard
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (t : ℝ) {B : ℝ} (hB : 0 < B) :
    symmetricSupportHoeffdingTail n t B =
      2 * exp (-(n : ℝ) * t ^ 2 / (2 * B ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hwidth : ‖B - (-B)‖₊ / (2 : NNReal) = ⟨B, hB.le⟩ := by
    apply NNReal.eq
    simp only [NNReal.coe_div, NNReal.coe_ofNat, coe_nnnorm, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      sub_neg_eq_add]
    rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith : 0 < B + B)]
    norm_num
    rfl
  have hsum :
      (↑(∑ _i ∈ range n,
        (((‖B - (-B)‖₊ / (2 : NNReal)) ^ (2 : ℕ)) : NNReal) : NNReal) : ℝ) =
        (n : ℝ) * B ^ 2 := by
    rw [hwidth]
    push_cast
    rw [sum_const, card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
    change (n : ℝ) * B ^ 2 = (n : ℝ) * B ^ 2
    rfl
  unfold symmetricSupportHoeffdingTail
  rw [hsum]
  congr 2
  field_simp [Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hn.ne', hB.ne']

name: RandomSetTheory.Empirical.empiricalMinkowskiAverage_support_hoeffding_of_radius
statement:
theorem empiricalMinkowskiAverage_support_hoeffding_of_radius
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (S : ℕ → Ω → Set E) (L : Set E) (u : E)
    {RS RL : ℝ}
    (hScompact : ∀ i ω, IsCompact (S i ω))
    (hSne : ∀ i ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    (hLcompact : IsCompact L) (hLne : L.Nonempty)
    (hRS : ∀ i ω, ∀ x ∈ S i ω, ‖x‖ ≤ RS)
    (hRL : ∀ x ∈ L, ‖x‖ ≤ RL)
    (hu : ‖u‖ ≤ 1)
    (h_indep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun
      (directionalSupportDeviation S L u) μ)
    (h_meas : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (directionalSupportDeviation S L u i) μ)
    (h_centered : ∀ i, μ[directionalSupportDeviation S L u i] = 0)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ |supportFunction (empiricalMinkowskiAverage S n ω) u -
        supportFunction L u|} ≤
      symmetricSupportHoeffdingTail n t (RS + RL)
proof:
:= by
  unfold symmetricSupportHoeffdingTail
  apply empiricalMinkowskiAverage_support_hoeffding S L u
    (fun _ => -(RS + RL)) (fun _ => RS + RL)
    h_indep h_meas
  · intro i
    exact ae_of_all μ fun ω =>
      directionalSupportDeviation_mem_Icc_of_radius S L u i ω
        (hScompact i ω) (hSne i ω) hLcompact hLne

name: RandomSetTheory.Empirical.finEmpiricalMinkowskiAverage_radius
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  unfold finEmpiricalMinkowskiAverage at hx
  obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hx
  rw [Set.mem_finsetSum] at hy
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hsum⟩ := hy
  rw [← hsum, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg n))]
  calc
    (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖∑ i, g i‖ ≤ (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, ‖g i‖ := by
      gcongr
      exact norm_sum_le _ _
    _ ≤ (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ _i : Fin n, R := by
      gcongr with i hi
      exact hS i ω (g i) (hg hi)
    _ = R := by
      simp only [sum_const, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
      field_simp [Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hn.ne']

proof:
:= by
  unfold finEmpiricalMinkowskiAverage

      (isCompact_finset_sum Finset.univ (fun i => S i ω)

  · exact inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg n)

name: RandomSetTheory.Empirical.finDirectionalSupportDeviation_mem_Icc_of_radius
statement:
theorem finDirectionalSupportDeviation_mem_Icc_of_radius {n : ℕ}

proof:

  have hL := abs_supportFunction_le_radius hLcompact hLne hRL hu
  unfold finDirectionalSupportDeviation
  constructor <;>
    linarith [le_abs_self (supportFunction (S i ω) u),
      neg_le_abs (supportFunction (S i ω) u),
      le_abs_self (supportFunction L u), neg_le_abs (supportFunction L u)]

name: RandomSetTheory.Empirical.finEmpiricalMinkowskiAverage_support_hoeffding
statement:
theorem finEmpiricalMinkowskiAverage_support_hoeffding
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {n : ℕ}
    (S : Fin n → Ω → Set E) (L : Set E) (u : E)
    (a b : Fin n → ℝ)
    (h_indep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun
      (finDirectionalSupportDeviation S L u) μ)
    (h_meas : ∀ i, AEMeasurable
      (finDirectionalSupportDeviation S L u i) μ)

      finDirectionalSupportDeviation S L u i ω ∈ Icc (a i) (b i))

    (hn : 0 < n)
    (hScompact : ∀ i ω, IsCompact (S i ω))

    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ |supportFunction (finEmpiricalMinkowskiAverage S ω) u -
        supportFunction L u|} ≤
      2 * exp (-((n : ℝ) * t) ^ 2 / (2 * (↑(∑ i,
        (((‖b i - a i‖₊ / (2 : NNReal)) ^ (2 : ℕ)) : NNReal) : NNReal) : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  have htail := ProbabilityTheory.hoeffding_fin_average_abs_real
    (finDirectionalSupportDeviation S L u) a b h_indep h_meas h_bounds
    h_centered hn ht
  have hset :
      {ω | t ≤ |supportFunction (finEmpiricalMinkowskiAverage S ω) u -
        supportFunction L u|} =
      {ω | t ≤ |(∑ i, finDirectionalSupportDeviation S L u i ω) /
        (n : ℝ)|} := by
    ext ω
    simp only [mem_setOf_eq]
    rw [supportFunction_finEmpirical_sub_eq_average_deviation
      S L hn hScompact hSne]
  rw [hset]
  exact htail
