theorem abs_scaledCenteredSupportProcess_sub_le
    {I : Type*} (c : ℝ) (s : Finset I) (K : I → Set E) (L : Set E)
    (R : I → ℝ) (RL : ℝ)
    (hKcompact : ∀ i ∈ s, IsCompact (K i))
    (hKne : ∀ i ∈ s, (K i).Nonempty)
    (hLcompact : IsCompact L) (hLne : L.Nonempty)
    (hR : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ x ∈ K i, ‖x‖ ≤ R i)
    (hRL : ∀ x ∈ L, ‖x‖ ≤ RL) (u v : E) :
    |scaledCenteredSupportProcess c s K L u -
        scaledCenteredSupportProcess c s K L v| ≤
      supportProcessDirectionConstant c s R RL * ‖u - v‖
proof:
:= by
  let Rbar : ℝ := (s.card : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ s, R i
  have hAvgCompact : IsCompact (minkowskiAverage s K) :=
    isCompact_minkowskiAverage s K hKcompact
  have hAvgNe : (minkowskiAverage s K).Nonempty :=
    nonempty_minkowskiAverage s K hKne
  have hAvgRadius : ∀ x ∈ minkowskiAverage s K, ‖x‖ ≤ Rbar := by
    intro x hx
    exact norm_le_average_radius_of_mem_minkowskiAverage s K R hR hx
  have hbase := abs_supportFunctionDifference_sub_le
    hAvgCompact hLcompact hAvgNe hLne hAvgRadius hRL u v
  have hrad : Rbar + RL ≤ |Rbar| + |RL| :=
    add_le_add (le_abs_self Rbar) (le_abs_self RL)
  calc
    |scaledCenteredSupportProcess c s K L u -
        scaledCenteredSupportProcess c s K L v| =
        |c| * |(supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s K) u -
          supportFunction L u) -
          (supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s K) v -
            supportFunction L v)| := by
      rw [scaledCenteredSupportProcess, scaledCenteredSupportProcess]
      rw [← mul_sub, abs_mul]
    _ ≤ |c| * ((Rbar + RL) * ‖u - v‖) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbase (abs_nonneg c)
    _ ≤ |c| * ((|Rbar| + |RL|) * ‖u - v‖) := by
      gcongr
    _ = supportProcessDirectionConstant c s R RL * ‖u - v‖ := by
      simp only [supportProcessDirectionConstant, Rbar]
      ring

name: RandomSetTheory.lipschitzWith_scaledCenteredSupportProcess
statement:
theorem lipschitzWith_scaledCenteredSupportProcess
    {I : Type*} (c : ℝ) (s : Finset I) (K : I → Set E) (L : Set E)
    (R : I → ℝ) (RL : ℝ)
    (hKcompact : ∀ i ∈ s, IsCompact (K i))
    (hKne : ∀ i ∈ s, (K i).Nonempty)
    (hLcompact : IsCompact L) (hLne : L.Nonempty)
    (hR : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ x ∈ K i, ‖x‖ ≤ R i)
    (hRL : ∀ x ∈ L, ‖x‖ ≤ RL) :
    LipschitzWith
      ⟨supportProcessDirectionConstant c s R RL,
        supportProcessDirectionConstant_nonneg c s R RL⟩
      (scaledCenteredSupportProcess c s K L)
proof:
:= by
  apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro u v
  change dist (scaledCenteredSupportProcess c s K L u)
      (scaledCenteredSupportProcess c s K L v) ≤
    supportProcessDirectionConstant c s R RL * dist u v
  simpa only [Real.dist_eq, dist_eq_norm, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
    abs_scaledCenteredSupportProcess_sub_le
      c s K L R RL hKcompact hKne hLcompact hLne hR hRL u v

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_unitSphere_isMax_abs_scaledCenteredSupportProcess
statement:
theorem exists_unitSphere_isMax_abs_scaledCenteredSupportProcess
    {I : Type*} [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [Nontrivial E]
    (c : ℝ) (s : Finset I) (K : I → Set E) (L : Set E)
    (R : I → ℝ) (RL : ℝ)
    (hKcompact : ∀ i ∈ s, IsCompact (K i))
    (hKne : ∀ i ∈ s, (K i).Nonempty)
    (hLcompact : IsCompact L) (hLne : L.Nonempty)
    (hR : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ x ∈ K i, ‖x‖ ≤ R i)
    (hRL : ∀ x ∈ L, ‖x‖ ≤ RL) :
    ∃ u ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : E) 1,
      ∀ v ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : E) 1,
        |scaledCenteredSupportProcess c s K L v| ≤
          |scaledCenteredSupportProcess c s K L u|
proof:
:= by
  have hcont : Continuous
      (fun u : E ↦ |scaledCenteredSupportProcess c s K L u|) :=
    (lipschitzWith_scaledCenteredSupportProcess
      c s K L R RL hKcompact hKne hLcompact hLne hR hRL).continuous.abs
  obtain ⟨u, hu, humax⟩ :=
    (isCompact_sphere (0 : E) 1).exists_isMaxOn
      (NormedSpace.sphere_nonempty.mpr zero_le_one) hcont.continuousOn
  exact ⟨u, hu, fun v hv ↦ humax hv⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.abs_scaledCenteredSupportProcess_change_sets_le
statement:
theorem abs_scaledCenteredSupportProcess_change_sets_le
    {I : Type*} (c : ℝ) (s : Finset I)
    (K K' : I → Set E) (L L' : Set E) (u : E) {a b : ℝ}
    (hK : |supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s K) u -
      supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s K') u| ≤ a)
    (hL : |supportFunction L u - supportFunction L' u| ≤ b) :
    |scaledCenteredSupportProcess c s K L u -
        scaledCenteredSupportProcess c s K' L' u| ≤
      |c| * (a + b)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    |scaledCenteredSupportProcess c s K L u -
        scaledCenteredSupportProcess c s K' L' u| =
        |c| * |(supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s K) u -
          supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s K') u) -
          (supportFunction L u - supportFunction L' u)| := by
      rw [scaledCenteredSupportProcess, scaledCenteredSupportProcess]
      rw [← mul_sub, abs_mul]
      congr 2
      ring
    _ ≤ |c| *
        (|supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s K) u -
            supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s K') u| +
          |supportFunction L u - supportFunction L' u|) := by
      gcongr
      exact abs_sub _ _
    _ ≤ |c| * (a + b) := by
      gcongr

name: RandomSetTheory.abs_scaledCenteredSupportProcess_change_sets_le_hausdorffDist
statement:
theorem abs_scaledCenteredSupportProcess_change_sets_le_hausdorffDist
    {I : Type*} (c : ℝ) (s : Finset I)
    (K K' : I → Set E) (L L' : Set E)
    (hKcompact : ∀ i ∈ s, IsCompact (K i))
    (hKne : ∀ i ∈ s, (K i).Nonempty)
    (hK'compact : ∀ i ∈ s, IsCompact (K' i))
    (hK'ne : ∀ i ∈ s, (K' i).Nonempty)
    (hLcompact : IsCompact L) (hLne : L.Nonempty)
    (hL'compact : IsCompact L') (hL'ne : L'.Nonempty) (u : E) :
    |scaledCenteredSupportProcess c s K L u -
        scaledCenteredSupportProcess c s K' L' u| ≤
      |c| * ‖u‖ *
        (hausdorffDist (minkowskiAverage s K) (minkowskiAverage s K') +
          hausdorffDist L L')
proof:
:= by
  have hAvgCompact : IsCompact (minkowskiAverage s K) :=
    isCompact_minkowskiAverage s K hKcompact
  have hAvgNe : (minkowskiAverage s K).Nonempty :=
    nonempty_minkowskiAverage s K hKne
  have hAvg'Compact : IsCompact (minkowskiAverage s K') :=
    isCompact_minkowskiAverage s K' hK'compact
  have hAvg'Ne : (minkowskiAverage s K').Nonempty :=
    nonempty_minkowskiAverage s K' hK'ne
  have h := abs_scaledCenteredSupportProcess_change_sets_le
    c s K K' L L' u
    (abs_supportFunction_sub_le_hausdorffDist
      hAvgCompact hAvg'Compact hAvgNe hAvg'Ne u)
    (abs_supportFunction_sub_le_hausdorffDist
      hLcompact hL'compact hLne hL'ne u)
  calc
    |scaledCenteredSupportProcess c s K L u -
        scaledCenteredSupportProcess c s K' L' u| ≤
        |c| * (‖u‖ *
          hausdorffDist (minkowskiAverage s K) (minkowskiAverage s K') +
          ‖u‖ * hausdorffDist L L') := h
    _ = |c| * ‖u‖ *
        (hausdorffDist (minkowskiAverage s K) (minkowskiAverage s K') +
          hausdorffDist L L') := by ring

name: RandomSetTheory.abs_scaledCenteredSupportProcess_le_of_finset_net
statement:
theorem abs_scaledCenteredSupportProcess_le_of_finset_net
    {I : Type*} (c : ℝ) (s : Finset I) (K : I → Set E) (L : Set E)
    (R : I → ℝ) (RL eps t : ℝ) (N : Finset E)
    (hKcompact : ∀ i ∈ s, IsCompact (K i))
    (hKne : ∀ i ∈ s, (K i).Nonempty)
    (hLcompact : IsCompact L) (hLne : L.Nonempty)
    (hR : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ x ∈ K i, ‖x‖ ≤ R i)
    (hRL : ∀ x ∈ L, ‖x‖ ≤ RL)
    (hnet : ∀ u : E, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 → ∃ v ∈ N, dist u v ≤ eps)
    (hN : ∀ v ∈ N, |scaledCenteredSupportProcess c s K L v| ≤ t) :
    ∀ u : E, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 →
      |scaledCenteredSupportProcess c s K L u| ≤
        t + supportProcessDirectionConstant c s R RL * eps
proof:
:= by
  intro u hu
  obtain ⟨v, hvN, huv⟩ := hnet u hu
  have hmod := abs_scaledCenteredSupportProcess_sub_le
    c s K L R RL hKcompact hKne hLcompact hLne hR hRL u v
  have hdist : ‖u - v‖ ≤ eps := by
    simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using huv
  have hmod' :
      |scaledCenteredSupportProcess c s K L u -
        scaledCenteredSupportProcess c s K L v| ≤
        supportProcessDirectionConstant c s R RL * eps :=
    hmod.trans <| mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdist
      (supportProcessDirectionConstant_nonneg c s R RL)
  calc
    |scaledCenteredSupportProcess c s K L u| =
        |scaledCenteredSupportProcess c s K L v +
          (scaledCenteredSupportProcess c s K L u -
            scaledCenteredSupportProcess c s K L v)| := by
      congr 1
      ring
    _ ≤ |scaledCenteredSupportProcess c s K L v| +
        |scaledCenteredSupportProcess c s K L u -
          scaledCenteredSupportProcess c s K L v| := abs_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ t + supportProcessDirectionConstant c s R RL * eps :=
      add_le_add (hN v hvN) hmod'

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_finset_gt_of_exists_unitBall_gt_scaledCenteredSupportProcess
statement:
theorem exists_finset_gt_of_exists_unitBall_gt_scaledCenteredSupportProcess
    {I : Type*} (c : ℝ) (s : Finset I) (K : I → Set E) (L : Set E)
    (R : I → ℝ) (RL eps t : ℝ) (N : Finset E)
    (hKcompact : ∀ i ∈ s, IsCompact (K i))
    (hKne : ∀ i ∈ s, (K i).Nonempty)
    (hLcompact : IsCompact L) (hLne : L.Nonempty)
    (hR : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ x ∈ K i, ‖x‖ ≤ R i)
    (hRL : ∀ x ∈ L, ‖x‖ ≤ RL)
    (hnet : ∀ u : E, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 → ∃ v ∈ N, dist u v ≤ eps)
    (hlarge : ∃ u : E, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 ∧
      t + supportProcessDirectionConstant c s R RL * eps <
        |scaledCenteredSupportProcess c s K L u|) :
    ∃ v ∈ N, t < |scaledCenteredSupportProcess c s K L v|
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hsmall
  have hN : ∀ v ∈ N,
      |scaledCenteredSupportProcess c s K L v| ≤ t := by
    intro v hv
    exact le_of_not_gt fun hvt ↦ hsmall ⟨v, hv, hvt⟩
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hult⟩ := hlarge
  have hule := abs_scaledCenteredSupportProcess_le_of_finset_net
    c s K L R RL eps t N hKcompact hKne hLcompact hLne hR hRL hnet hN u hu
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hule) hult

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_convexified_iid_risk_bound_dimensional_bernstein
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_convexified_iid_risk_bound_dimensional_bernstein
    {Ω Z E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Z]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [Nonempty E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : ℕ → Ω → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hindep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X μ)
    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) μ μ)
    (F : Z → Set E) (hF : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable F)
    (hFcompact : ∀ z, IsCompact (F z)) (hFne : ∀ z, (F z).Nonempty)
    {R : ℝ} (hFbound : ∀ z, ∀ y ∈ F z, ‖y‖ ≤ R)
    (v b : ℝ≥0) (hv : 0 < (v : ℝ))
    (hB₀ : ∀ w : E, ‖w‖ ≤ 1 →
      ProbabilityTheory.HasBernsteinMGF
        (directionalSupportDeviation
          (fun i ω => closedConvexHull ℝ (F (X i ω)))
          (iidAumannTarget μ (X 0) F) w 0) v b μ)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {eps x : ℝ}
    (heps : 0 < eps) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    μ.real {ω |
        (Real.sqrt (2 *
              (((∑ _i ∈ Finset.range n, v : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) * x) +
            2 * (b : ℝ) * x) / (n : ℝ) + (R + R) * eps <
          hausdorffDist
            (closedConvexHull ℝ
              (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n) (fun i => F (X i ω))))
            (iidAumannTarget μ (X 0) F)} ≤
      (1 + 2 / eps) ^ finrank ℝ E * (2 * exp (-x))
proof:
:= by
  let S₀ : Ω → Set E := fun ω => F (X 0 ω)
  let A : Set E := closure (aumannExpectation μ S₀)
  let L : Set E := closedConvexHull ℝ A
  have hS₀Effros : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S₀ :=
    hF.comp_measurable (hX 0)
  have hS₀compact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S₀ ω) := fun ω =>
    hFcompact (X 0 ω)
  have hS₀ne : ∀ ω, (S₀ ω).Nonempty := fun ω =>
    hFne (X 0 ω)
  have hg : Integrable (fun _ : Ω => R) μ := integrable_const R
  have hS₀dom : ∀ ω, ∀ y ∈ S₀ ω, ‖y‖ ≤ R := fun ω =>
    hFbound (X 0 ω)
  have hAcompact : IsCompact A :=
    closure_aumannExpectation_compact_of_integrable_envelope hg
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hS₀dom)
  have hfOne : IsIntegrableSelection μ S₀
      (supportApproximateSelection
        hS₀Effros hS₀compact hS₀ne 0 1 (by norm_num)) :=
    integrableSelection_supportApproximateSelection_of_envelope
      hS₀Effros hS₀compact hS₀ne hg hS₀dom 0 (by norm_num)
  have hAne : A.Nonempty :=
    (aumannExpectation_nonempty_of_selection hfOne).closure
  have hLcompact : IsCompact L := closedConvexHull_compact hAcompact
  have hLne : L.Nonempty := hAne.mono subset_closedConvexHull
  have hLconv : Convex ℝ L := convex_closedConvexHull
  have hLbound : ∀ y ∈ L, ‖y‖ ≤ R := by
    have hAsub : A ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) R := by
      intro y hy
      have hyR := norm_le_integral_envelope_of_mem_closure_aumannExpectation
        hg (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hS₀dom) hy
      have hyR' : ‖y‖ ≤ R := by simpa using hyR
      simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hyR'
    have hLsub : L ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) R :=
      closedConvexHull_min hAsub (convex_closedBall (0 : E) R)
        Metric.isClosed_closedBall
    intro y hy
    simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hLsub hy
  have hHullCompact : ∀ i ω,
      IsCompact (closedConvexHull ℝ (F (X i ω))) := fun i ω =>
    closedConvexHull_compact (hFcompact (X i ω))
  have hHullNe : ∀ i ω,
      (closedConvexHull ℝ (F (X i ω))).Nonempty := fun i ω =>
    (hFne (X i ω)).mono subset_closedConvexHull
  have hHullBound : ∀ i ω, ∀ y ∈ closedConvexHull ℝ (F (X i ω)),
      ‖y‖ ≤ R := by
    intro i ω
    have hsub : closedConvexHull ℝ (F (X i ω)) ⊆
        Metric.closedBall (0 : E) R := by
      apply closedConvexHull_min
      · intro y hy
        simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using
          hFbound (X i ω) y hy
      · exact convex_closedBall (0 : E) R
      · exact Metric.isClosed_closedBall
    intro y hy
    simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hsub hy
  have hdevIndep : ∀ w : E, ‖w‖ ≤ 1 →
      ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun
        (directionalSupportDeviation
          (fun i ω => closedConvexHull ℝ (F (X i ω))) L w) μ :=
    fun w _ => iIndepFun_convexifiedDirectionalSupportDeviation
      X hindep F hF hFcompact hFne L w
  have hdevBernstein : ∀ w : E, ‖w‖ ≤ 1 → ∀ i ∈ Finset.range n,
      ProbabilityTheory.HasBernsteinMGF
        (directionalSupportDeviation
          (fun j ω => closedConvexHull ℝ (F (X j ω))) L w i) v b μ := by
    intro w hw i _hi
    have hmap : Measurable (fun z =>
        supportFunction (closedConvexHull ℝ (F z)) w - supportFunction L w) :=
      (measurable_supportFunction_closedConvexHull_of_effros
        hF hFcompact hFne w).sub_const (supportFunction L w)
    have hid : IdentDistrib
        (directionalSupportDeviation
          (fun j ω => closedConvexHull ℝ (F (X j ω))) L w 0)
        (directionalSupportDeviation
          (fun j ω => closedConvexHull ℝ (F (X j ω))) L w i) μ μ := by
      change IdentDistrib
        (fun ω => supportFunction (closedConvexHull ℝ (F (X 0 ω))) w -
          supportFunction L w)
        (fun ω => supportFunction (closedConvexHull ℝ (F (X i ω))) w -
          supportFunction L w) μ μ
      exact (hident i).symm.comp hmap
    have hbase : ProbabilityTheory.HasBernsteinMGF
        (directionalSupportDeviation
          (fun j ω => closedConvexHull ℝ (F (X j ω))) L w 0) v b μ := by
      simpa [L, iidAumannTarget, A, S₀] using hB₀ w hw
    exact hbase.congr_identDistrib hid
  have hV : 0 <
      ((∑ _i ∈ Finset.range n, v : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) := by
    have hnR : 0 < (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
    simpa [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul] using mul_pos hnR hv
  have hbound :=
    hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_risk_bound_dimensional_bernstein_sqrt_add
      (μ := μ)
      (fun i ω => closedConvexHull ℝ (F (X i ω))) L
      (Finset.range n) (Finset.nonempty_range_iff.mpr hn.ne')
      (fun _ => v) b hHullCompact hHullNe
      (fun _ _ => convex_closedConvexHull)
      hLcompact hLne hLconv hHullBound hLbound heps hx
      hdevIndep hdevBernstein hV
  have hEvent :
      {ω |
        (Real.sqrt (2 *
              (((∑ _i ∈ Finset.range n, v : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) * x) +
            2 * (b : ℝ) * x) / (n : ℝ) + (R + R) * eps <
          hausdorffDist
            (closedConvexHull ℝ
              (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n) (fun i => F (X i ω)))) L} =
      {ω |
        (Real.sqrt (2 *
              (((∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (fun _ => v) i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) * x) +
            2 * (b : ℝ) * x) / ((Finset.range n).card : ℝ) +
              (R + R) * eps <
          hausdorffDist
            (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n)
              (fun i => closedConvexHull ℝ (F (X i ω)))) L} := by
    ext ω
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Finset.card_range]
    rw [closedConvexHull_minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n)
      (fun i => F (X i ω))
      (fun i _ => hFcompact (X i ω))
      (fun i _ => hFne (X i ω))]
  change μ.real {ω |
      (Real.sqrt (2 *
            (((∑ _i ∈ Finset.range n, v : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) * x) +
          2 * (b : ℝ) * x) / (n : ℝ) + (R + R) * eps <
        hausdorffDist
          (closedConvexHull ℝ
            (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n) (fun i => F (X i ω)))) L} ≤ _
  rw [hEvent]
  simpa only using hbound

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_convexified_iid_risk_bound_bernstein_confidence
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_convexified_iid_risk_bound_bernstein_confidence
    {Ω Z E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Z]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [Nonempty E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : ℕ → Ω → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hindep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X μ)
    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) μ μ)
    (F : Z → Set E) (hF : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable F)
    (hFcompact : ∀ z, IsCompact (F z)) (hFne : ∀ z, (F z).Nonempty)
    {R : ℝ} (hFbound : ∀ z, ∀ y ∈ F z, ‖y‖ ≤ R)
    (v b : ℝ≥0) (hv : 0 < (v : ℝ))
    (hB₀ : ∀ w : E, ‖w‖ ≤ 1 →
      ProbabilityTheory.HasBernsteinMGF
        (directionalSupportDeviation
          (fun i ω => closedConvexHull ℝ (F (X i ω)))
          (iidAumannTarget μ (X 0) F) w 0) v b μ)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {eps δ : ℝ}
    (heps : 0 < eps) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδone : δ ≤ 1) :
    μ.real {ω |
        (Real.sqrt (2 *
              (((∑ _i ∈ Finset.range n, v : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) *
                Real.log
                  (2 * (1 + 2 / eps) ^ finrank ℝ E / δ)) +
            2 * (b : ℝ) *
              Real.log
                (2 * (1 + 2 / eps) ^ finrank ℝ E / δ)) /
            (n : ℝ) + (R + R) * eps <
          hausdorffDist
            (closedConvexHull ℝ
              (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n) (fun i => F (X i ω))))
            (iidAumannTarget μ (X 0) F)} ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  let C : ℝ := (1 + 2 / eps) ^ finrank ℝ E
  let x : ℝ := Real.log (2 * C / δ)
  have hbase : 1 ≤ 1 + 2 / eps := by
    have : 0 ≤ 2 / eps := by positivity
    linarith
  have hC : 1 ≤ C := by
    dsimp [C]
    exact one_le_pow₀ hbase
  have hCpos : 0 < C := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hC
  have harg : 1 ≤ 2 * C / δ := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hδ]
    nlinarith
  have hargpos : 0 < 2 * C / δ := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one harg
  have hx : 0 ≤ x := by
    dsimp [x]
    exact Real.log_nonneg harg
  have hprob :=
    hausdorffDist_convexified_iid_risk_bound_dimensional_bernstein
      X hX hindep hident F hF hFcompact hFne hFbound v b hv hB₀
      hn heps hx
  change μ.real {ω |
      (Real.sqrt (2 *
            (((∑ _i ∈ Finset.range n, v : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) * x) +
          2 * (b : ℝ) * x) / (n : ℝ) + (R + R) * eps <
        hausdorffDist
          (closedConvexHull ℝ
            (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n) (fun i => F (X i ω))))
          (iidAumannTarget μ (X 0) F)} ≤ δ
  refine hprob.trans ?_
  change C * (2 * exp (-x)) ≤ δ
  have heq : C * (2 * exp (-x)) = δ := by
    rw [Real.exp_neg]
    have hexp : Real.exp x = 2 * C / δ := by
      dsimp [x]
      exact Real.exp_log hargpos
    rw [hexp]
    field_simp [hδ.ne', hCpos.ne']
  exact heq.le

name: ProbabilityTheory.strongMomentSeriesExponent_mono
statement:
theorem strongMomentSeriesExponent_mono
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) {t y second second' : ℝ}
    (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hy : 0 < y) (hsecond : second ≤ second')
    {moment moment' : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hmoment : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q, moment k ≤ moment' k) :
    strongMomentSeriesExponent q t y second moment ≤
      strongMomentSeriesExponent q t y second' moment'
proof:
:= by
  unfold strongMomentSeriesExponent
  apply add_le_add
  · apply add_le_add
    · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsecond (by positivity)
    · apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro k hk
      have hkBounds := Finset.mem_Ico.mp hk
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (hmoment k (Finset.mem_Icc.mpr
          ⟨(by omega : 2 ≤ k), hkBounds.2.le⟩))
      positivity
  · apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (hmoment q (Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨by omega, le_rfl⟩))
    exact div_nonneg
      (expSeriesTail_nonneg (mul_nonneg ht hy.le) q)
      (pow_nonneg hy.le q)

name: ProbabilityTheory.condExp_exp_mul_le_exp_strongMomentSeriesExponent
statement:
theorem condExp_exp_mul_le_exp_strongMomentSeriesExponent
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hm : m ≤ mOmega) (X : Omega → ℝ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    {t y second : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hy : 0 < y)
    (hX : Integrable X mu)
    (hXsq : Integrable (fun omega => X omega ^ 2) mu)
    (hpow : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      Integrable (fun omega => (max (X omega) 0) ^ k) mu)
    (hupper : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, X omega ≤ y)
    (hcenter : mu[X | m] ≤ᵐ[mu] 0)
    (hsecond : mu[fun omega => X omega ^ 2 | m] ≤ᵐ[mu]
      fun _ => second)
    (moment : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hmoment : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      mu[fun omega => (max (X omega) 0) ^ k | m] ≤ᵐ[mu]
        fun _ => moment k) :
    ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      mu[fun z => Real.exp (t * X z) | m] omega ≤
        Real.exp (strongMomentSeriesExponent q t y second moment)
proof:
:= by
  have hExp : Integrable (fun omega => Real.exp (t * X omega)) mu := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound
      ((hX.aemeasurable.const_mul t).exp.aestronglyMeasurable)
      (Real.exp (t * y))
    filter_upwards [hupper] with omega homega
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
    exact Real.exp_monotone (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left homega ht)
  have hXKernel : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu.trim hm,
      Integrable X (condExpKernel mu m omega) := by
    apply Measure.ae_integrable_of_integrable_comp
    rw [condExpKernel_comp_trim hm]
    exact hX
  have hXsqKernel : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu.trim hm,
      Integrable (fun z => X z ^ 2) (condExpKernel mu m omega) := by
    apply Measure.ae_integrable_of_integrable_comp
    rw [condExpKernel_comp_trim hm]
    exact hXsq
  have hpowKernel : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu.trim hm,
      ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
        Integrable (fun z => (max (X z) 0) ^ k)
          (condExpKernel mu m omega) := by
    rw [(Finset.Icc 2 q).eventually_all]
    intro k hk
    apply Measure.ae_integrable_of_integrable_comp
    rw [condExpKernel_comp_trim hm]
    exact hpow k hk
  have hupperKernel : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu.trim hm,
      ∀ᵐ z ∂condExpKernel mu m omega, X z ≤ y := by
    apply Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_comp
    rw [condExpKernel_comp_trim hm]
    exact hupper
  have hmeanKernel : mu[X | m] =ᵐ[mu.trim hm]
      fun omega => ∫ z, X z ∂condExpKernel mu m omega :=
    condExp_ae_eq_trim_integral_condExpKernel hm hX
  have hsecondKernel : mu[fun z => X z ^ 2 | m] =ᵐ[mu.trim hm]
      fun omega => ∫ z, X z ^ 2 ∂condExpKernel mu m omega :=
    condExp_ae_eq_trim_integral_condExpKernel hm hXsq
  have hmomentKernel : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu.trim hm,
      ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
        mu[fun z => (max (X z) 0) ^ k | m] omega =
          ∫ z, (max (X z) 0) ^ k ∂condExpKernel mu m omega := by
    rw [(Finset.Icc 2 q).eventually_all]
    intro k hk
    exact condExp_ae_eq_trim_integral_condExpKernel hm (hpow k hk)
  have hcenterTrim : mu[X | m] ≤ᵐ[mu.trim hm] 0 :=
    StronglyMeasurable.ae_le_trim_of_stronglyMeasurable
      hm stronglyMeasurable_condExp stronglyMeasurable_zero hcenter
  have hsecondTrim :
      mu[fun z => X z ^ 2 | m] ≤ᵐ[mu.trim hm] fun _ => second :=
    StronglyMeasurable.ae_le_trim_of_stronglyMeasurable
      hm stronglyMeasurable_condExp stronglyMeasurable_const hsecond
  have hmomentTrim : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu.trim hm,
      ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
        mu[fun z => (max (X z) 0) ^ k | m] omega ≤ moment k := by
    rw [(Finset.Icc 2 q).eventually_all]
    intro k hk
    exact StronglyMeasurable.ae_le_trim_of_stronglyMeasurable
      hm stronglyMeasurable_condExp stronglyMeasurable_const (hmoment k hk)
  have hExpKernel : mu[fun z => Real.exp (t * X z) | m] =ᵐ[mu.trim hm]
      fun omega => ∫ z, Real.exp (t * X z) ∂condExpKernel mu m omega :=
    condExp_ae_eq_trim_integral_condExpKernel hm hExp
  apply ae_of_ae_trim hm
  filter_upwards [hXKernel, hXsqKernel, hpowKernel,
      hupperKernel, hmeanKernel, hsecondKernel, hmomentKernel,
      hcenterTrim, hsecondTrim, hmomentTrim, hExpKernel]
    with omega hXOmega hXsqOmega hpowOmega hupperOmega
      hmeanOmega hsecondOmega hmomentOmega hcenterOmega
      hsecondBoundOmega hmomentBoundOmega hExpOmega
  have hcenterFiber : (∫ z, X z ∂condExpKernel mu m omega) ≤ 0 := by
    rw [← hmeanOmega]
    exact hcenterOmega
  have hsecondFiber : (∫ z, X z ^ 2 ∂condExpKernel mu m omega) ≤
      second := by
    rw [← hsecondOmega]
    exact hsecondBoundOmega
  let fiberMoment : ℕ → ℝ := fun k =>
    ∫ z, (max (X z) 0) ^ k ∂condExpKernel mu m omega
  have hmomentFiber : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      fiberMoment k ≤ moment k := by
    intro k hk
    unfold fiberMoment
    rw [← hmomentOmega k hk]
    exact hmomentBoundOmega k hk
  have hbase := integral_exp_mul_le_exp_strongMomentSeriesExponent
    (mu := condExpKernel mu m omega) X q hq ht hy hXOmega hXsqOmega
      hpowOmega hupperOmega hcenterFiber
  have hexponent :
      strongMomentSeriesExponent q t y
          (∫ z, X z ^ 2 ∂condExpKernel mu m omega) fiberMoment ≤
        strongMomentSeriesExponent q t y second moment :=
    strongMomentSeriesExponent_mono q hq ht hy
      hsecondFiber hmomentFiber
  rw [hExpOmega]
  exact hbase.trans (Real.exp_monotone hexponent)

name: ProbabilityTheory.integral_exp_mul_upperTruncation_le_exp_strongMomentSeriesExponent
statement:
theorem integral_exp_mul_upperTruncation_le_exp_strongMomentSeriesExponent
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (D : Omega → ℝ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    {t y second : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hy : 0 < y)
    (hD : Integrable D mu)
    (hDsq : Integrable (fun omega => D omega ^ 2) mu)
    (hpow : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      Integrable (fun omega => (max (D omega) 0) ^ k) mu)
    (hcenter : ∫ omega, D omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hsecond : (∫ omega, D omega ^ 2 ∂mu) ≤ second)
    (moment : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hmoment : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      (∫ omega, (max (D omega) 0) ^ k ∂mu) ≤ moment k) :
    (∫ omega, Real.exp (t * upperTruncation D y omega) ∂mu) ≤
      Real.exp (strongMomentSeriesExponent q t y second moment)
proof:
:= by
  let U : Omega → ℝ := upperTruncation D y
  have hU : Integrable U mu := integrable_upperTruncation hD y
  have hUsq : Integrable (fun omega => U omega ^ 2) mu :=
    integrable_sq_upperTruncation hD.aemeasurable hDsq hy.le
  have hUpow : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      Integrable (fun omega => (max (U omega) 0) ^ k) mu := by
    intro k hk
    exact integrable_pow_max_upperTruncation_zero
      hD.aemeasurable y k (hpow k hk)
  have hmeanU : (∫ omega, U omega ∂mu) ≤ 0 := by
    calc
      (∫ omega, U omega ∂mu) ≤ ∫ omega, D omega ∂mu :=
        integral_mono hU hD
          (fun omega => upperTruncation_le_self D y omega)
      _ = 0 := hcenter
  have hsecondU : (∫ omega, U omega ^ 2 ∂mu) ≤ second := by
    calc
      (∫ omega, U omega ^ 2 ∂mu) ≤
          ∫ omega, D omega ^ 2 ∂mu :=
        integral_mono hUsq hDsq
          (fun omega => sq_upperTruncation_le_sq_self D hy.le omega)
      _ ≤ second := hsecond
  let UMoment : ℕ → ℝ := fun k =>
    ∫ omega, (max (U omega) 0) ^ k ∂mu
  have hmomentU : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q, UMoment k ≤ moment k := by
    intro k hk
    unfold UMoment
    calc
      (∫ omega, (max (U omega) 0) ^ k ∂mu) ≤
          ∫ omega, (max (D omega) 0) ^ k ∂mu :=
        integral_mono (hUpow k hk) (hpow k hk)
          (fun omega =>
            pow_max_upperTruncation_zero_le_pow_max_self D y k omega)
      _ ≤ moment k := hmoment k hk
  have hbase := integral_exp_mul_le_exp_strongMomentSeriesExponent
    U q hq ht hy hU hUsq hUpow
      (ae_of_all mu fun omega => upperTruncation_le D y omega) hmeanU
  exact hbase.trans (Real.exp_monotone
    (strongMomentSeriesExponent_mono q hq ht hy hsecondU hmomentU))

name: ProbabilityTheory.condExp_exp_mul_upperTruncation_le_exp_strongMomentSeriesExponent
statement:
theorem condExp_exp_mul_upperTruncation_le_exp_strongMomentSeriesExponent
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hm : m ≤ mOmega) (D : Omega → ℝ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    {t y second : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hy : 0 < y)
    (hD : Integrable D mu)
    (hDsq : Integrable (fun omega => D omega ^ 2) mu)
    (hpow : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      Integrable (fun omega => (max (D omega) 0) ^ k) mu)
    (hcenter : mu[D | m] =ᵐ[mu] 0)
    (hsecond : mu[fun omega => D omega ^ 2 | m] ≤ᵐ[mu]
      fun _ => second)
    (moment : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hmoment : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      mu[fun omega => (max (D omega) 0) ^ k | m] ≤ᵐ[mu]
        fun _ => moment k) :
    ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      mu[fun z => Real.exp (t * upperTruncation D y z) | m] omega ≤
        Real.exp (strongMomentSeriesExponent q t y second moment)
proof:
:= by
  let U : Omega → ℝ := upperTruncation D y
  have hU : Integrable U mu := integrable_upperTruncation hD y
  have hUsq : Integrable (fun omega => U omega ^ 2) mu :=
    integrable_sq_upperTruncation hD.aemeasurable hDsq hy.le
  have hUpow : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      Integrable (fun omega => (max (U omega) 0) ^ k) mu := by
    intro k hk
    exact integrable_pow_max_upperTruncation_zero
      hD.aemeasurable y k (hpow k hk)
  have hcenterU : mu[U | m] ≤ᵐ[mu] 0 := by
    have hmono := condExp_mono (m := m) hU hD
      (ae_of_all mu fun omega => upperTruncation_le_self D y omega)
    filter_upwards [hmono, hcenter] with omega hle heq
    simpa only [heq] using hle
  have hsecondU : mu[fun omega => U omega ^ 2 | m] ≤ᵐ[mu]
      fun _ => second := by
    have hmono := condExp_mono (m := m) hUsq hDsq
      (ae_of_all mu fun omega =>
        sq_upperTruncation_le_sq_self D hy.le omega)
    exact hmono.trans hsecond
  have hmomentU : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      mu[fun omega => (max (U omega) 0) ^ k | m] ≤ᵐ[mu]
        fun _ => moment k := by
    intro k hk
    have hmono := condExp_mono (m := m) (hUpow k hk) (hpow k hk)
      (ae_of_all mu fun omega =>
        pow_max_upperTruncation_zero_le_pow_max_self D y k omega)
    exact hmono.trans (hmoment k hk)
  exact condExp_exp_mul_le_exp_strongMomentSeriesExponent
    hm U q hq ht hy hU hUsq hUpow
      (ae_of_all mu fun omega => upperTruncation_le D y omega)
      hcenterU hsecondU moment hmomentU

name: ProbabilityTheory.hasOneSidedMGF_upperTruncation_of_strongMomentSeries
statement:
theorem hasOneSidedMGF_upperTruncation_of_strongMomentSeries
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (D : Omega → ℝ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    {y second : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y)
    (hD : Integrable D mu)
    (hDsq : Integrable (fun omega => D omega ^ 2) mu)
    (hpow : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      Integrable (fun omega => (max (D omega) 0) ^ k) mu)
    (hcenter : ∫ omega, D omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hsecond : (∫ omega, D omega ^ 2 ∂mu) ≤ second)
    (moment : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hmoment : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      (∫ omega, (max (D omega) 0) ^ k ∂mu) ≤ moment k) :
    HasOneSidedMGF (upperTruncation D y)
      (fun t => strongMomentSeriesExponent q t y second moment) mu
proof:
:= by
  have hU : Integrable (upperTruncation D y) mu :=
    integrable_upperTruncation hD y
  refine
    { aemeasurable := hU.aemeasurable
      integrable_exp_mul := ?_
      mgf_le := ?_ }
  · intro t ht
    apply Integrable.of_bound
      ((hU.aemeasurable.const_mul t).exp.aestronglyMeasurable)
      (Real.exp (t * y))
    filter_upwards [] with omega
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
    exact Real.exp_monotone
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (upperTruncation_le D y omega) ht)
  · intro t ht
    exact
      integral_exp_mul_upperTruncation_le_exp_strongMomentSeriesExponent
        D q hq ht hy hD hDsq hpow hcenter hsecond moment hmoment

statement:
theorem hasCondOneSidedMGF_upperTruncation_of_strongMomentSeries
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hm : m ≤ mOmega) (D : Omega → ℝ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    {y second : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y)
    (hD : Integrable D mu)
    (hDsq : Integrable (fun omega => D omega ^ 2) mu)
    (hpow : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      Integrable (fun omega => (max (D omega) 0) ^ k) mu)
    (hcenter : mu[D | m] =ᵐ[mu] 0)
    (hsecond : mu[fun omega => D omega ^ 2 | m] ≤ᵐ[mu]
      fun _ => second)
    (moment : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hmoment : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      mu[fun omega => (max (D omega) 0) ^ k | m] ≤ᵐ[mu]
        fun _ => moment k) :
    HasCondOneSidedMGF m hm (upperTruncation D y)
      (fun t => strongMomentSeriesExponent q t y second moment) mu
proof:
:= by
  have hU : Integrable (upperTruncation D y) mu :=
    integrable_upperTruncation hD y
  refine
    { aemeasurable := hU.aemeasurable
      integrable_exp_mul := ?_
      cond_mgf_le := ?_ }
  · intro t ht
    apply Integrable.of_bound
      ((hU.aemeasurable.const_mul t).exp.aestronglyMeasurable)
      (Real.exp (t * y))
    filter_upwards [] with omega
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
    exact Real.exp_monotone
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (upperTruncation_le D y omega) ht)
  · intro t ht
    exact
      condExp_exp_mul_upperTruncation_le_exp_strongMomentSeriesExponent
