name: ProbabilityTheory.hasOneSidedMGF_sum_upperTruncation_of_strongMomentSeries
statement:
theorem hasOneSidedMGF_sum_upperTruncation_of_strongMomentSeries
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (D : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hAdapted : StronglyAdapted filtration D)
    (second : ℕ → ℝ) (moment : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (n q : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y)
    (hD : ∀ i < n, Integrable (D i) mu)
    (hDsq : ∀ i < n, Integrable (fun omega => D i omega ^ 2) mu)
    (hpow : ∀ i < n, ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      Integrable (fun omega => (max (D i omega) 0) ^ k) mu)
    (hcenter0 : ∫ omega, D 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hcenterSucc : ∀ i < n - 1,
      mu[D (i + 1) | filtration i] =ᵐ[mu] 0)
    (hsecond0 : (∫ omega, D 0 omega ^ 2 ∂mu) ≤ second 0)
    (hsecondSucc : ∀ i < n - 1,
      mu[fun omega => D (i + 1) omega ^ 2 | filtration i] ≤ᵐ[mu]
        fun _ => second (i + 1))
    (hmoment0 : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      (∫ omega, (max (D 0 omega) 0) ^ k ∂mu) ≤ moment 0 k)
    (hmomentSucc : ∀ i < n - 1, ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      mu[fun omega => (max (D (i + 1) omega) 0) ^ k | filtration i]
        ≤ᵐ[mu] fun _ => moment (i + 1) k) :
    HasOneSidedMGF
      (fun omega => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, upperTruncation (D i) y omega)
      (fun t => strongMomentSeriesExponent q t y
        (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, second i)
        (fun k => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, moment i k)) mu
proof:
:= by
  let U : ℕ → Omega → ℝ := fun i => upperTruncation (D i) y
  let psi : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun i t =>
    strongMomentSeriesExponent q t y (second i) (moment i)
  let B : ℕ → ℝ := fun _ => y
  have hUAdapted : StronglyAdapted filtration U := by
    intro i
    change StronglyMeasurable[filtration i]
      (fun omega => min (D i omega) y)
    exact ((hAdapted i).measurable.min measurable_const).stronglyMeasurable
  have hzero : HasOneSidedMGF (U 0) (psi 0) mu := by
    dsimp only [U, psi]
    exact hasOneSidedMGF_upperTruncation_of_strongMomentSeries
      (D 0) q hq hy (hD 0 hn) (hDsq 0 hn) (hpow 0 hn)
        hcenter0 hsecond0 (moment 0) hmoment0
  have hcond : ∀ i < n - 1,
      HasCondOneSidedMGF (filtration i) (filtration.le i)
        (U (i + 1)) (psi (i + 1)) mu := by
    intro i hi
    dsimp only [U, psi]
    exact hasCondOneSidedMGF_upperTruncation_of_strongMomentSeries
      (filtration.le i) (D (i + 1)) q hq hy
        (hD (i + 1) (by omega)) (hDsq (i + 1) (by omega))
        (hpow (i + 1) (by omega)) (hcenterSucc i hi)
        (hsecondSucc i hi) (moment (i + 1)) (hmomentSucc i hi)
  have hbound : ∀ i < n, ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, U i omega ≤ B i := by
    intro i hi
    exact ae_of_all mu fun omega => upperTruncation_le (D i) y omega
  have hsum := HasOneSidedMGF.sum_of_hasCondOneSidedMGF
    filtration hUAdapted hzero n hbound hcond
  convert hsum using 1
  funext t
  dsimp only [psi]
  exact (sum_strongMomentSeriesExponent
    (Finset.range n) q t y second moment).symm

name: ProbabilityTheory.conditionalValueAtRisk_sum_le_strongMomentSeriesExponent_add_residual
statement:
theorem conditionalValueAtRisk_sum_le_strongMomentSeriesExponent_add_residual
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (D : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hAdapted : StronglyAdapted filtration D)
    (second : ℕ → ℝ) (moment : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (n q : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    {y alpha t : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y)
    (hD : ∀ i < n, Integrable (D i) mu)
    (hDsq : ∀ i < n, Integrable (fun omega => D i omega ^ 2) mu)
    (hpow : ∀ i < n, ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      Integrable (fun omega => (max (D i omega) 0) ^ k) mu)
    (hcenter0 : ∫ omega, D 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hcenterSucc : ∀ i < n - 1,
      mu[D (i + 1) | filtration i] =ᵐ[mu] 0)
    (hsecond0 : (∫ omega, D 0 omega ^ 2 ∂mu) ≤ second 0)
    (hsecondSucc : ∀ i < n - 1,
      mu[fun omega => D (i + 1) omega ^ 2 | filtration i] ≤ᵐ[mu]
        fun _ => second (i + 1))
    (hmoment0 : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      (∫ omega, (max (D 0 omega) 0) ^ k ∂mu) ≤ moment 0 k)
    (hmomentSucc : ∀ i < n - 1, ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      mu[fun omega => (max (D (i + 1) omega) 0) ^ k | filtration i]
        ≤ᵐ[mu] fun _ => moment (i + 1) k)
    (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha ≤ 1) (ht : 0 < t) :
    conditionalValueAtRisk alpha
        (fun omega => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, D i omega) mu ≤
      (strongMomentSeriesExponent q t y
          (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, second i)
          (fun k => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, moment i k) -
        Real.log alpha) / t +
      alpha⁻¹ *
        ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, moment i q) /
          ((q : ℝ) * y ^ (q - 1)))
proof:
:= by
  have hqOne : 1 ≤ q := by omega
  have hqIcc : q ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q :=
    Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨by omega, le_rfl⟩
  have hpowq : ∀ i < n,
      Integrable (fun omega => (max (D i omega) 0) ^ q) mu := by
    intro i hi
    exact hpow i hi q hqIcc
  have hmgf :=
    hasOneSidedMGF_sum_upperTruncation_of_strongMomentSeries
      filtration D hAdapted second moment n q hn hq hy hD hDsq hpow
        hcenter0 hcenterSucc hsecond0 hsecondSucc hmoment0 hmomentSucc
  have hraw := conditionalValueAtRisk_sum_le_of_upperTruncation_mgf
      D n q hqOne hD hpowq
        (fun t => strongMomentSeriesExponent q t y
          (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, second i)
          (fun k => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, moment i k))
        hy halpha0 halpha1 ht hmgf
  have hmomentQ : ∀ i < n,
      (∫ omega, (max (D i omega) 0) ^ q ∂mu) ≤ moment i q := by
    intro i hi
    cases i with
    | zero => exact hmoment0 q hqIcc
    | succ i =>
        have hiPred : i < n - 1 := by omega
        have hcond := hmomentSucc i hiPred q hqIcc
        have hint :
            (∫ omega,
                mu[fun z => (max (D (i + 1) z) 0) ^ q |
                  filtration i] omega ∂mu) ≤
              ∫ _ : Omega, moment (i + 1) q ∂mu :=
          integral_mono_ae integrable_condExp (integrable_const _) hcond
        rw [integral_condExp (filtration.le i), integral_const] at hint
        simpa only [probReal_univ, smul_eq_mul, one_mul] using hint
  have hsumMoment :
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
        ∫ omega, (max (D i omega) 0) ^ q ∂mu) ≤
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, moment i q := by
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi =>
      hmomentQ i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
  have hden : 0 < (q : ℝ) * y ^ (q - 1) := by positivity
  have hresidual :
      alpha⁻¹ *
          ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
            ∫ omega, (max (D i omega) 0) ^ q ∂mu) /
              ((q : ℝ) * y ^ (q - 1))) ≤
        alpha⁻¹ *
          ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, moment i q) /
            ((q : ℝ) * y ^ (q - 1))) := by
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hsumMoment hden.le)
      (inv_nonneg.mpr halpha0.le)
  exact hraw.trans (add_le_add le_rfl hresidual)

name: ProbabilityTheory.uniformEquicontinuous_continuousProcessModulusFamily
statement:
theorem uniformEquicontinuous_continuousProcessModulusFamily
    {delta eta : ℕ → ℝ} {B : ℝ}
    (hdelta : ∀ k, 0 < delta k)
    (heta : Tendsto eta atTop (nhds 0)) :
    UniformEquicontinuous
      (fun f : continuousProcessModulusFamily delta eta B ↦
        (f.1 : T → ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Metric.uniformEquicontinuous_iff]
  intro epsilon hepsilon
  have hevent : ∀ᶠ k in atTop, eta k < epsilon :=
    heta (Iio_mem_nhds hepsilon)
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (eventually_atTop.1 hevent)
  refine ⟨delta k, hdelta k, fun s t hst f ↦ ?_⟩
  exact (f.property.2 k s t hst).trans_lt (hk k le_rfl)

name: ProbabilityTheory.isCompact_closure_continuousProcessModulusFamily
statement:
theorem isCompact_closure_continuousProcessModulusFamily
    {delta eta : ℕ → ℝ} {B : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hdelta : ∀ k, 0 < delta k)
    (heta : Tendsto eta atTop (nhds 0)) :
    IsCompact (closure
      (continuousProcessModulusFamily (T := T) delta eta B))
proof:
:= by
  let S : Set C(T, ℝ) :=
    continuousProcessModulusFamily (T := T) delta eta B
  let F : C(T, ℝ) → T → ℝ := fun f ↦ f
  let compactSets : Set (Set T) := {Set.univ}
  have hcompactSets : ∀ K ∈ compactSets, IsCompact K := by
    intro K hK
    simpa only [compactSets, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using
      (hK ▸ (isCompact_univ : IsCompact (Set.univ : Set T)))
  have hclosedEmbedding : IsClosedEmbedding
      (UniformOnFun.ofFun compactSets ∘ F) := by
    let e := UniformOnFun.uniformEquivUniformFun ℝ compactSets
      (show Set.univ ∈ compactSets by simp only [compactSets, Set.mem_singleton_iff])
    have he : IsClosedEmbedding e.symm :=
      e.symm.toHomeomorph.isClosedEmbedding
    have hfun : IsClosedEmbedding
        (fun f : C(T, ℝ) ↦ UniformFun.ofFun (f : T → ℝ)) :=
      ContinuousMap.isUniformEmbedding_uniformFunOfFun.isClosedEmbedding
    have hcomp := he.comp hfun
    convert hcomp using 1
    funext f
    rfl
  have heq : ∀ K ∈ compactSets,
      EquicontinuousOn (F ∘ ((↑) : S → C(T, ℝ))) K := by
    intro K hK
    exact (uniformEquicontinuous_continuousProcessModulusFamily
      hdelta heta).equicontinuous.equicontinuousOn K
  have hpoint : ∀ K ∈ compactSets, ∀ x ∈ K,
      ∃ Q : Set ℝ, IsCompact Q ∧ ∀ f ∈ S, F f x ∈ Q := by
    intro K hK x hx
    refine ⟨Set.Icc (-B) B, isCompact_Icc, ?_⟩
    intro f hf
    have hfx : |f x| ≤ B := by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
        (f.norm_coe_le_norm x).trans hf.1
    exact (abs_le.mp hfx)
  simpa only [S] using
    ArzelaAscoli.isCompact_closure_of_isClosedEmbedding
      hcompactSets hclosedEmbedding heq hpoint

name: ProbabilityTheory.isTightMeasureSet_range_of_norm_and_modulus
statement:
theorem isTightMeasureSet_range_of_norm_and_modulus
    {I : Type*} [MeasurableSpace C(T, ℝ)]
    (nu : I → Measure C(T, ℝ))
    (delta : ℕ → ℝ) (hdelta : ∀ k, 0 < delta k)
    (hcontrol : ∀ epsilon : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < epsilon →
      ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧
        ∃ eta : ℕ → ℝ, Tendsto eta atTop (nhds 0) ∧
          ∃ p : ℕ → ℝ≥0∞,
            (∑' k, p k) ≤ epsilon / 2 ∧
            (∀ i, nu i {f | B < ‖f‖} ≤ epsilon / 2) ∧
            ∀ i k, nu i {f | ∃ s t, dist s t < delta k ∧
              eta k < dist (f s) (f t)} ≤ p k) :
    IsTightMeasureSet (Set.range nu)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isTightMeasureSet_iff_exists_isCompact_measure_compl_le]
  intro epsilon hepsilon
  obtain ⟨B, hB, eta, heta, p, hp, hnorm, hmodulus⟩ :=
    hcontrol epsilon hepsilon
  let S : Set C(T, ℝ) :=
    continuousProcessModulusFamily (T := T) delta eta B
  let K : Set C(T, ℝ) := closure S
  refine ⟨K, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact isCompact_closure_continuousProcessModulusFamily
      hB hdelta heta
  · intro m hm
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hm
    let normBad : Set C(T, ℝ) := {f | B < ‖f‖}
    let modulusBad : ℕ → Set C(T, ℝ) := fun k ↦
      {f | ∃ s t, dist s t < delta k ∧ eta k < dist (f s) (f t)}
    have hScompl : Sᶜ ⊆ normBad ∪ ⋃ k, modulusBad k := by
      intro f hf
      by_cases hfnorm : ‖f‖ ≤ B
      · have hnotmodulus : ¬ ∀ k s t,
            dist s t < delta k → dist (f s) (f t) ≤ eta k := by
          intro h
          exact hf ⟨hfnorm, h⟩
        push_neg at hnotmodulus
        obtain ⟨k, s, t, hst, hbad⟩ := hnotmodulus
        exact Set.mem_union_right normBad
          (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨k, s, t, hst, hbad⟩)
      · exact Set.mem_union_left _ (lt_of_not_ge hfnorm)
    calc
      nu i Kᶜ ≤ nu i Sᶜ := measure_mono (compl_subset_compl.mpr subset_closure)
      _ ≤ nu i (normBad ∪ ⋃ k, modulusBad k) := measure_mono hScompl
      _ ≤ nu i normBad + nu i (⋃ k, modulusBad k) := measure_union_le _ _
      _ ≤ epsilon / 2 + ∑' k, nu i (modulusBad k) :=
        add_le_add (hnorm i) (measure_iUnion_le _)
      _ ≤ epsilon / 2 + ∑' k, p k :=
        add_le_add_right (ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum (hmodulus i)) _
      _ ≤ epsilon / 2 + epsilon / 2 := add_le_add_right hp _
      _ = epsilon := ENNReal.add_halves epsilon

name: ProbabilityTheory.isOpen_continuousProcessModulusBad
proof:
:= by
  rw [isOpen_iff_forall_mem_open]
  intro f hf
  obtain ⟨s, t, hst, hft⟩ := hf
  let U : Set C(T, ℝ) := {g | eta < dist (g s) (g t)}
  refine ⟨U, ?_, ?_, hft⟩
  · intro g hg
    exact ⟨s, t, hst, hg⟩
  · exact isOpen_lt continuous_const
      ((continuous_eval_const s).dist (continuous_eval_const t))

name: ProbabilityTheory.isTightMeasureSet_range_map_of_real_norm_and_modulus
statement:
theorem isTightMeasureSet_range_map_of_real_norm_and_modulus
    {I Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    [MeasurableSpace C(T, ℝ)] [BorelSpace C(T, ℝ)]
    (mu : Measure Omega) [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    (Y : I → Omega → C(T, ℝ))
    (hY : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (Y i) mu)
    (delta : ℕ → ℝ) (hdelta : ∀ k, 0 < delta k)
    (hcontrol : ∀ epsilon : ℝ, 0 < epsilon →
      ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧
        ∃ eta : ℕ → ℝ, Tendsto eta atTop (nhds 0) ∧
          ∃ p : ℕ → ℝ,
            (∀ k, 0 ≤ p k) ∧ Summable p ∧
            (∑' k, p k) ≤ epsilon / 2 ∧
            (∀ i, mu.real {omega | B < ‖Y i omega‖} ≤ epsilon / 2) ∧
            ∀ i k, mu.real {omega | ∃ s t, dist s t < delta k ∧
              eta k < dist (Y i omega s) (Y i omega t)} ≤ p k) :
    IsTightMeasureSet (Set.range fun i ↦ mu.map (Y i))
proof:
:= by
  apply isTightMeasureSet_range_of_norm_and_modulus
    (fun i ↦ mu.map (Y i)) delta hdelta
  intro epsilon hepsilon
  by_cases hepsilonTop : epsilon = ∞
  · have hhalf : epsilon / 2 = ∞ := by
      rw [hepsilonTop, ENNReal.top_div_of_ne_top]
      norm_num
    refine ⟨0, by norm_num, fun _ ↦ 0, tendsto_const_nhds, fun _ ↦ ∞,
        ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hhalf]
      exact le_top
    · intro i
      rw [hhalf]
      exact le_top
    · intro i k
      exact le_top
  · let epsilonReal := epsilon.toReal
    have hepsilonReal : 0 < epsilonReal :=
      ENNReal.toReal_pos hepsilon.ne' hepsilonTop
    obtain ⟨B, hB, eta, heta, p, hpnonneg, hpsum, hp,
      hnorm, hmodulus⟩ := hcontrol epsilonReal hepsilonReal
    let pENN : ℕ → ℝ≥0∞ := fun k ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (p k)
    refine ⟨B, hB, eta, heta, pENN, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_tsum_of_nonneg hpnonneg hpsum]
      have hepsilonEq : ENNReal.ofReal epsilonReal = epsilon := by
        exact ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hepsilonTop
      calc
        ENNReal.ofReal (∑' k, p k) ≤
            ENNReal.ofReal (epsilonReal / 2) :=
          ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hp
        _ = ENNReal.ofReal epsilonReal / ENNReal.ofReal 2 :=
          ENNReal.ofReal_div_of_pos (by norm_num)
        _ = epsilon / 2 := by rw [hepsilonEq]; norm_num
    · intro i
      let normBad : Set C(T, ℝ) := {f | B < ‖f‖}
      have hnormBad : MeasurableSet normBad :=
        (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm).measurableSet
      rw [Measure.map_apply_of_aemeasurable (hY i) hnormBad]
      apply (ENNReal.toReal_le_toReal (measure_ne_top mu _)
        (ENNReal.div_ne_top hepsilonTop (by norm_num))).1
      change mu.real {omega | B < ‖Y i omega‖} ≤ (epsilon / 2).toReal
      rw [ENNReal.toReal_div]
      norm_num
      exact hnorm i
    · intro i k
      let modulusBad : Set C(T, ℝ) :=
        {f | ∃ s t, dist s t < delta k ∧
          eta k < dist (f s) (f t)}
      have hmodulusBad : MeasurableSet modulusBad :=
        (isOpen_continuousProcessModulusBad (T := T)
          (delta k) (eta k)).measurableSet
      rw [Measure.map_apply_of_aemeasurable (hY i) hmodulusBad]
      apply (ENNReal.toReal_le_toReal (measure_ne_top mu _)
        (ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top)).1
      change mu.real {omega | ∃ s t, dist s t < delta k ∧
        eta k < dist (Y i omega s) (Y i omega t)} ≤
          (ENNReal.ofReal (p k)).toReal
      rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (hpnonneg k)]
      exact hmodulus i k

name: ProbabilityTheory.isTightMeasureSet_range_map_of_real_compactContainment
statement:
theorem isTightMeasureSet_range_map_of_real_compactContainment
    {I Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    [MeasurableSpace C(T, ℝ)] [BorelSpace C(T, ℝ)]
    (mu : Measure Omega) [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    (Y : I → Omega → C(T, ℝ))
    (hY : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (Y i) mu)
    (delta : ℕ → ℝ) (hdelta : ∀ k, 0 < delta k)
    (hcontrol : ∀ epsilon : ℝ, 0 < epsilon →
      ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧
        ∃ eta : ℕ → ℝ, Tendsto eta atTop (nhds 0) ∧
          ∀ i, mu.real {omega |
            B < ‖Y i omega‖ ∨
              ∃ k s t, dist s t < delta k ∧
                eta k < dist (Y i omega s) (Y i omega t)} ≤ epsilon) :
    IsTightMeasureSet (Set.range fun i ↦ mu.map (Y i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [isTightMeasureSet_iff_exists_isCompact_measure_compl_le]
  intro epsilon hepsilon
  by_cases hepsilonTop : epsilon = ∞
  · refine ⟨∅, isCompact_empty, ?_⟩
    intro m hm
    rw [hepsilonTop]
    exact le_top
  · let epsilonReal := epsilon.toReal
    have hepsilonReal : 0 < epsilonReal :=
      ENNReal.toReal_pos hepsilon.ne' hepsilonTop
    obtain ⟨B, hB, eta, heta, hbad⟩ :=
      hcontrol epsilonReal hepsilonReal
    let S : Set C(T, ℝ) :=
      continuousProcessModulusFamily (T := T) delta eta B
    let K : Set C(T, ℝ) := closure S
    refine ⟨K, isCompact_closure_continuousProcessModulusFamily
      hB hdelta heta, ?_⟩
    intro m hm
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hm
    let bad : Set C(T, ℝ) := {f |
      B < ‖f‖ ∨ ∃ k s t, dist s t < delta k ∧
        eta k < dist (f s) (f t)}
    have hbadOpen : IsOpen bad := by
      rw [show bad = ({f : C(T, ℝ) | B < ‖f‖} ∪
          ⋃ k, {f : C(T, ℝ) | ∃ s t, dist s t < delta k ∧
            eta k < dist (f s) (f t)}) by
        ext f
        simp only [bad, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_iUnion]]
      apply IsOpen.union (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm)
      exact isOpen_iUnion fun k ↦
        isOpen_continuousProcessModulusBad (T := T) (delta k) (eta k)
    have hKcompl : Kᶜ ⊆ bad := by
      intro f hf
      have hfS : f ∉ S := fun hfmem ↦ hf (subset_closure hfmem)
      by_cases hfnorm : ‖f‖ ≤ B
      · right
        have hnotmodulus : ¬ ∀ k s t,
            dist s t < delta k → dist (f s) (f t) ≤ eta k := by
          intro h
          exact hfS ⟨hfnorm, h⟩
        push Not at hnotmodulus
        exact hnotmodulus
      · exact Or.inl (lt_of_not_ge hfnorm)
    calc
      (mu.map (Y i)) Kᶜ ≤ (mu.map (Y i)) bad := measure_mono hKcompl
      _ = mu (Y i ⁻¹' bad) :=
        Measure.map_apply_of_aemeasurable (hY i) hbadOpen.measurableSet
      _ ≤ epsilon := by
        apply (ENNReal.toReal_le_toReal (measure_ne_top mu _) hepsilonTop).1
        change mu.real {omega |
          B < ‖Y i omega‖ ∨ ∃ k s t, dist s t < delta k ∧
            eta k < dist (Y i omega s) (Y i omega t)} ≤ epsilon.toReal
        exact hbad i

name: ProbabilityTheory.abs_le_finiteSubgaussianSupAbs
statement:
theorem abs_le_finiteSubgaussianSupAbs
    (X : Omega → T → ℝ) (N : Finset T) (hN : N.Nonempty)
    {t : T} (ht : t ∈ N) (omega : Omega) :
    |X omega t| ≤ finiteSubgaussianSupAbs X N hN omega
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.le_sup' (fun u => |X omega u|) ht

name: ProbabilityTheory.finiteSubgaussianSupAbs_nonneg
statement:
theorem finiteSubgaussianSupAbs_nonneg
    (X : Omega → T → ℝ) (N : Finset T) (hN : N.Nonempty)
    (omega : Omega) :
    0 ≤ finiteSubgaussianSupAbs X N hN omega
proof:
:= by
  exact (abs_nonneg (X omega hN.choose)).trans
    (abs_le_finiteSubgaussianSupAbs X N hN hN.choose_spec omega)

name: ProbabilityTheory.integrable_finiteSubgaussianSupAbs
statement:
theorem integrable_finiteSubgaussianSupAbs
    (X : Omega → T → ℝ) (N : Finset T) (hN : N.Nonempty) (v : ℝ≥0)
    (hX : ∀ t ∈ N, HasSubgaussianMGF (fun omega => X omega t) v mu) :
    Integrable (finiteSubgaussianSupAbs X N hN) mu
proof:
:= by
  have hfold : Integrable
      (N.sup' hN (fun t => fun omega => |X omega t|)) mu :=
    Finset.sup'_induction
      (p := fun f : Omega → ℝ => Integrable f mu) hN _
      (fun _ hf _ hg => Integrable.sup hf hg)
      (fun t ht => (hX t ht).integrable.abs)
  have heq : finiteSubgaussianSupAbs X N hN =
      N.sup' hN (fun t => fun omega => |X omega t|) := by
    funext omega
    exact (Finset.sup'_apply hN (fun t => fun omega => |X omega t|) omega).symm
  rw [heq]
  exact hfold

name: ProbabilityTheory.exp_mul_finiteSubgaussianSupAbs_le_sum
statement:
theorem exp_mul_finiteSubgaussianSupAbs_le_sum
    (X : Omega → T → ℝ) (N : Finset T) (hN : N.Nonempty)
    (lambda : ℝ) (omega : Omega) :
    exp (lambda * finiteSubgaussianSupAbs X N hN omega) ≤
      ∑ t ∈ N, (exp (lambda * X omega t) + exp (-lambda * X omega t))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hmax⟩ :=
    Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup' hN (fun u => |X omega u|)
  have hterm :
      exp (lambda * finiteSubgaussianSupAbs X N hN omega) ≤
        exp (lambda * X omega t) + exp (-lambda * X omega t) := by
    rw [finiteSubgaussianSupAbs, hmax]
    by_cases hx : 0 ≤ X omega t
    · rw [abs_of_nonneg hx]
      exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (exp_pos _).le
    · rw [abs_of_nonpos (le_of_not_ge hx)]
      have hmul : lambda * -X omega t = -lambda * X omega t := by ring
      rw [hmul]
      exact le_add_of_nonneg_left (exp_pos _).le
  have hsingle :
      exp (lambda * X omega t) + exp (-lambda * X omega t) ≤
        ∑ u ∈ N, (exp (lambda * X omega u) + exp (-lambda * X omega u)) := by
    exact Finset.single_le_sum
      (s := N)
      (f := fun u => exp (lambda * X omega u) + exp (-lambda * X omega u))
      (fun u _ => add_nonneg (exp_pos _).le (exp_pos _).le) ht
  exact hterm.trans hsingle

name: ProbabilityTheory.integrable_exp_mul_finiteSubgaussianSupAbs
statement:
theorem integrable_exp_mul_finiteSubgaussianSupAbs
    (X : Omega → T → ℝ) (N : Finset T) (hN : N.Nonempty) (v : ℝ≥0)
    (hX : ∀ t ∈ N, HasSubgaussianMGF (fun omega => X omega t) v mu)
    (lambda : ℝ) :
    Integrable
      (fun omega => exp (lambda * finiteSubgaussianSupAbs X N hN omega)) mu
proof:
:= by
  have hsumInt : Integrable
      (fun omega =>
        ∑ t ∈ N, (exp (lambda * X omega t) + exp (-lambda * X omega t))) mu := by
    apply integrable_finsetSum N
    intro t ht
    have hpos := (hX t ht).integrable_exp_mul lambda
    have hneg := (hX t ht).integrable_exp_mul (-lambda)
    have hneg' : Integrable (fun omega => exp (-lambda * X omega t)) mu := by
      convert hneg using 1
    exact hpos.add hneg'
  apply hsumInt.mono'
  · exact (((integrable_finiteSubgaussianSupAbs X N hN v hX).aemeasurable
      |>.const_mul lambda).exp.aestronglyMeasurable)
  · exact ae_of_all mu fun omega => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (exp_pos _)]
      exact exp_mul_finiteSubgaussianSupAbs_le_sum X N hN lambda omega

name: ProbabilityTheory.integral_exp_mul_finiteSubgaussianSupAbs_le
statement:
theorem integral_exp_mul_finiteSubgaussianSupAbs_le
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : Omega → T → ℝ) (N : Finset T) (hN : N.Nonempty) (v : ℝ≥0)
    (hX : ∀ t ∈ N, HasSubgaussianMGF (fun omega => X omega t) v mu)
    (lambda : ℝ) :
    (∫ omega, exp (lambda * finiteSubgaussianSupAbs X N hN omega) ∂mu) ≤
      2 * (N.card : ℝ) * exp ((v : ℝ) * lambda ^ 2 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hExp := integrable_exp_mul_finiteSubgaussianSupAbs
    X N hN v hX lambda
  have hsumInt : Integrable
      (fun omega =>
        ∑ t ∈ N, (exp (lambda * X omega t) + exp (-lambda * X omega t))) mu := by
    apply integrable_finsetSum N
    intro t ht
    have hpos := (hX t ht).integrable_exp_mul lambda
    have hneg := (hX t ht).integrable_exp_mul (-lambda)
    have hneg' : Integrable (fun omega => exp (-lambda * X omega t)) mu := by
      convert hneg using 1
    exact hpos.add hneg'
  calc
    (∫ omega, exp (lambda * finiteSubgaussianSupAbs X N hN omega) ∂mu) ≤
        ∫ omega,
          ∑ t ∈ N, (exp (lambda * X omega t) + exp (-lambda * X omega t)) ∂mu := by
      exact integral_mono_ae hExp hsumInt
        (ae_of_all mu fun omega =>
          exp_mul_finiteSubgaussianSupAbs_le_sum X N hN lambda omega)
    _ = ∑ t ∈ N,
          ∫ omega, (exp (lambda * X omega t) + exp (-lambda * X omega t)) ∂mu := by
      exact integral_finsetSum N fun t ht => by
        have hpos := (hX t ht).integrable_exp_mul lambda
        have hneg := (hX t ht).integrable_exp_mul (-lambda)
        have hneg' : Integrable (fun omega => exp (-lambda * X omega t)) mu := by
          convert hneg using 1
        exact hpos.add hneg'
    _ ≤ ∑ _t ∈ N, 2 * exp ((v : ℝ) * lambda ^ 2 / 2) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro t ht
      have hpos :
          (∫ omega, exp (lambda * X omega t) ∂mu) ≤
            exp ((v : ℝ) * lambda ^ 2 / 2) := by
        simpa only [mgf] using (hX t ht).mgf_le lambda
      have hneg :
          (∫ omega, exp (-lambda * X omega t) ∂mu) ≤
            exp ((v : ℝ) * lambda ^ 2 / 2) := by
        simpa only [mgf, neg_sq] using (hX t ht).mgf_le (-lambda)
      rw [integral_add
        ((hX t ht).integrable_exp_mul lambda)
        (by
          have h := (hX t ht).integrable_exp_mul (-lambda)
          convert h using 1)]
      linarith
    _ = 2 * (N.card : ℝ) * exp ((v : ℝ) * lambda ^ 2 / 2) := by
      simp
      ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.integral_finiteSubgaussianSupAbs_le
statement:
theorem integral_finiteSubgaussianSupAbs_le
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : Omega → T → ℝ) (N : Finset T) (hN : N.Nonempty) (v : ℝ≥0)
    (hX : ∀ t ∈ N, HasSubgaussianMGF (fun omega => X omega t) v mu)
    {lambda : ℝ} (hlambda : 0 < lambda) :
    (∫ omega, finiteSubgaussianSupAbs X N hN omega ∂mu) ≤
      log (2 * (N.card : ℝ)) / lambda + (v : ℝ) * lambda / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hM := integrable_finiteSubgaussianSupAbs X N hN v hX
  have hExp := integrable_exp_mul_finiteSubgaussianSupAbs
    X N hN v hX lambda
  have hjensen :
      exp (∫ omega, lambda * finiteSubgaussianSupAbs X N hN omega ∂mu) ≤
        ∫ omega, exp (lambda * finiteSubgaussianSupAbs X N hN omega) ∂mu := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply] using
      ((convexOn_exp).map_integral_le
        Real.continuous_exp.continuousOn isClosed_univ
        (ae_of_all mu fun _ => Set.mem_univ _)
        (hM.const_mul lambda) hExp)
  rw [integral_const_mul] at hjensen
  have hmgf := integral_exp_mul_finiteSubgaussianSupAbs_le
    X N hN v hX lambda
  have hcardPos : 0 < 2 * (N.card : ℝ) := by
    positivity
  have hexpForm :
      2 * (N.card : ℝ) * exp ((v : ℝ) * lambda ^ 2 / 2) =
        exp (log (2 * (N.card : ℝ)) + (v : ℝ) * lambda ^ 2 / 2) := by
    rw [exp_add, exp_log hcardPos]
  have hlinear :
      lambda * (∫ omega, finiteSubgaussianSupAbs X N hN omega ∂mu) ≤
        log (2 * (N.card : ℝ)) + (v : ℝ) * lambda ^ 2 / 2 := by
    apply exp_le_exp.mp
    exact hjensen.trans (hmgf.trans_eq hexpForm)
  calc
    (∫ omega, finiteSubgaussianSupAbs X N hN omega ∂mu) ≤
        (log (2 * (N.card : ℝ)) + (v : ℝ) * lambda ^ 2 / 2) / lambda := by
      apply (le_div_iff₀ hlambda).2
      simpa [mul_comm] using hlinear
    _ = log (2 * (N.card : ℝ)) / lambda + (v : ℝ) * lambda / 2 := by
      field_simp [hlambda.ne']

name: ProbabilityTheory.integral_finiteSubgaussianSupAbs_le_sqrt
statement:
theorem integral_finiteSubgaussianSupAbs_le_sqrt
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : Omega → T → ℝ) (N : Finset T) (hN : N.Nonempty) (v : ℝ≥0)
    (hX : ∀ t ∈ N, HasSubgaussianMGF (fun omega => X omega t) v mu)
    (hv : 0 < (v : ℝ)) :
    (∫ omega, finiteSubgaussianSupAbs X N hN omega ∂mu) ≤
      sqrt (2 * (v : ℝ) * log (2 * (N.card : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  have hcardOne : 1 ≤ (N.card : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (Finset.card_pos.mpr hN)
  have hcardArg : 1 < 2 * (N.card : ℝ) := by
    nlinarith
  have hlog : 0 < log (2 * (N.card : ℝ)) := log_pos hcardArg
  let L : ℝ := log (2 * (N.card : ℝ))
  let V : ℝ := (v : ℝ)
  let lambda : ℝ := sqrt (2 * L / V)
  have hL : 0 < L := by simpa [L] using hlog
  have hV : 0 < V := by simpa [V] using hv
  have hlambda : 0 < lambda := by
    dsimp only [lambda]
    exact sqrt_pos.2 (div_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num) hL) hV)
  have hbase := integral_finiteSubgaussianSupAbs_le
    X N hN v hX hlambda
  have hlambdaSq : lambda ^ 2 = 2 * L / V := by
    dsimp only [lambda]
    rw [sq_sqrt]
    exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hL.le) hV.le
  have hlambdaSqMul : lambda ^ 2 * V = 2 * L := by
    exact (eq_div_iff hV.ne').mp hlambdaSq
  let R : ℝ := sqrt (2 * V * L)
  have hRnonneg : 0 ≤ R := sqrt_nonneg _
  have hRsq : R ^ 2 = 2 * V * L := by
    dsimp only [R]
    rw [sq_sqrt]
    positivity
  have hVlambdaNonneg : 0 ≤ V * lambda :=
    mul_nonneg hV.le hlambda.le
  have hVlambdaSq : (V * lambda) ^ 2 = 2 * V * L := by
    calc
      (V * lambda) ^ 2 = V * (lambda ^ 2 * V) := by ring
      _ = 2 * V * L := by rw [hlambdaSqMul]; ring
  have hVlambda : V * lambda = R := by
    nlinarith
  have hhalf : L / lambda = V * lambda / 2 := by
    apply (div_eq_iff hlambda.ne').2
    nlinarith [hlambdaSqMul]
  have hopt : L / lambda + V * lambda / 2 = R := by
    rw [hhalf]
    nlinarith
  change (∫ omega, finiteSubgaussianSupAbs X N hN omega ∂mu) ≤
    L / lambda + V * lambda / 2 at hbase
  change (∫ omega, finiteSubgaussianSupAbs X N hN omega ∂mu) ≤ R
  exact hbase.trans_eq hopt

name: RandomSetTheory.forall_supportHausdorffGap_le_iff_forall_hausdorffDist_le
statement:
theorem forall_supportHausdorffGap_le_iff_forall_hausdorffDist_le
    {Theta E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    {K L : Theta → Set E}
    (hKcompact : ∀ theta, IsCompact (K theta))
    (hLcompact : ∀ theta, IsCompact (L theta))
    (hKne : ∀ theta, (K theta).Nonempty)
    (hLne : ∀ theta, (L theta).Nonempty)
    (hKconv : ∀ theta, Convex ℝ (K theta))
    (hLconv : ∀ theta, Convex ℝ (L theta))
    (r : ℝ) :
    (∀ theta, supportHausdorffGap (K theta) (L theta) ≤ r) ↔
      ∀ theta, hausdorffDist (K theta) (L theta) ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [supportHausdorffGap_eq_hausdorffDist
    (hKcompact _) (hLcompact _) (hKne _) (hLne _)
    (hKconv _) (hLconv _)]

name: RandomSetTheory.forall_hausdorffDist_le_iff_forall_unitBall_supportFunction_sub_le
statement:
theorem forall_hausdorffDist_le_iff_forall_unitBall_supportFunction_sub_le
    {Theta E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    {K L : Theta → Set E}
    (hKcompact : ∀ theta, IsCompact (K theta))
    (hLcompact : ∀ theta, IsCompact (L theta))
    (hKne : ∀ theta, (K theta).Nonempty)
    (hLne : ∀ theta, (L theta).Nonempty)
    (hKconv : ∀ theta, Convex ℝ (K theta))
    (hLconv : ∀ theta, Convex ℝ (L theta))
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    (∀ theta, hausdorffDist (K theta) (L theta) ≤ r) ↔
      ∀ theta (u : E), ‖u‖ ≤ 1 →
        |supportFunction (K theta) u - supportFunction (L theta) u| ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h theta u hu
    calc
      |supportFunction (K theta) u - supportFunction (L theta) u| ≤
          ‖u‖ * hausdorffDist (K theta) (L theta) :=
        abs_supportFunction_sub_le_hausdorffDist
          (hKcompact theta) (hLcompact theta) (hKne theta) (hLne theta) u
      _ ≤ 1 * r := mul_le_mul hu (h theta) hausdorffDist_nonneg (by norm_num)
      _ = r := one_mul r
  · intro h theta
    exact hausdorffDist_le_of_unitBall_supportFunction_sub_le
      (hKcompact theta) (hLcompact theta) (hKne theta) (hLne theta)
      (hKconv theta) (hLconv theta) hr (h theta)

name: RandomSetTheory.uniform_hausdorffDist_le_of_unitBall_supportFunction_le
statement:
theorem uniform_hausdorffDist_le_of_unitBall_supportFunction_le
    {I Theta E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    {K L : I → Theta → Set E} {r : I → ℝ}
    (hKcompact : ∀ i theta, IsCompact (K i theta))
    (hLcompact : ∀ i theta, IsCompact (L i theta))
    (hKne : ∀ i theta, (K i theta).Nonempty)
    (hLne : ∀ i theta, (L i theta).Nonempty)
    (hKconv : ∀ i theta, Convex ℝ (K i theta))
    (hLconv : ∀ i theta, Convex ℝ (L i theta))
    (hr : ∀ i, 0 ≤ r i)
    (hsupport : ∀ i theta (u : E), ‖u‖ ≤ 1 →
      |supportFunction (K i theta) u - supportFunction (L i theta) u| ≤ r i) :
    ∀ i theta, hausdorffDist (K i theta) (L i theta) ≤ r i
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  exact (forall_hausdorffDist_le_iff_forall_unitBall_supportFunction_sub_le
    (hKcompact i) (hLcompact i) (hKne i) (hLne i)
    (hKconv i) (hLconv i) (hr i)).mpr (hsupport i)

name: RandomSetTheory.tendstoUniformly_hausdorffDist_zero_iff_supportFunction_sub_zero
statement:
theorem tendstoUniformly_hausdorffDist_zero_iff_supportFunction_sub_zero
    {I Theta E : Type*} {l : Filter I}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    {K L : I → Theta → Set E}
    (hKcompact : ∀ i theta, IsCompact (K i theta))
    (hLcompact : ∀ i theta, IsCompact (L i theta))
    (hKne : ∀ i theta, (K i theta).Nonempty)
    (hLne : ∀ i theta, (L i theta).Nonempty)
    (hKconv : ∀ i theta, Convex ℝ (K i theta))
    (hLconv : ∀ i theta, Convex ℝ (L i theta)) :
    TendstoUniformly
        (fun i theta ↦ hausdorffDist (K i theta) (L i theta))
        (fun _ ↦ (0 : ℝ)) l ↔
      TendstoUniformly
        (fun i (p : Theta × Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1) ↦
          supportFunction (K i p.1) p.2 - supportFunction (L i p.1) p.2)
        (fun _ ↦ (0 : ℝ)) l
proof:
:= by
  rw [tendstoUniformly_iff, tendstoUniformly_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h eps heps
    filter_upwards [h eps heps] with i hi
    rintro ⟨theta, u⟩
    have hu : ‖(u : E)‖ ≤ 1 := by
      simpa only [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using u.property
    have hs := abs_supportFunction_sub_le_hausdorffDist
      (hKcompact i theta) (hLcompact i theta)
      (hKne i theta) (hLne i theta) (u : E)
    have hhd : hausdorffDist (K i theta) (L i theta) < eps := by
      simpa [Real.dist_eq, abs_of_nonneg hausdorffDist_nonneg] using hi theta
    have hmul : ‖(u : E)‖ * hausdorffDist (K i theta) (L i theta) < eps := by
      calc
        ‖(u : E)‖ * hausdorffDist (K i theta) (L i theta) ≤
            1 * hausdorffDist (K i theta) (L i theta) := by
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hu hausdorffDist_nonneg
        _ < eps := by simpa using hhd
    simpa [Real.dist_eq, abs_sub_comm] using hs.trans_lt hmul
  · intro h eps heps
    have heps2 : 0 < eps / 2 := half_pos heps
    filter_upwards [h (eps / 2) heps2] with i hi
    intro theta
    have hs : ∀ u : E, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 →
        |supportFunction (K i theta) u - supportFunction (L i theta) u| ≤
          eps / 2 := by
      intro u hu
      let v : Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1 :=
        ⟨u, by simpa only [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hu⟩
      have hv := hi (theta, v)
      simpa [v, Real.dist_eq, abs_sub_comm] using le_of_lt hv
    have hhd := hausdorffDist_le_of_unitBall_supportFunction_sub_le
      (hKcompact i theta) (hLcompact i theta)
      (hKne i theta) (hLne i theta)
      (hKconv i theta) (hLconv i theta) heps2.le hs
    have hlt : hausdorffDist (K i theta) (L i theta) < eps :=
      hhd.trans_lt (half_lt_self heps)
    simpa [Real.dist_eq, abs_of_nonneg hausdorffDist_nonneg] using hlt

name: RandomSetTheory.tendstoUniformly_hausdorffDist_zero_of_supportFunction_rate
statement:
theorem tendstoUniformly_hausdorffDist_zero_of_supportFunction_rate
    {I Theta E : Type*} {l : Filter I}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    {K L : I → Theta → Set E} {r : I → ℝ}
    (hKcompact : ∀ i theta, IsCompact (K i theta))
    (hLcompact : ∀ i theta, IsCompact (L i theta))
    (hKne : ∀ i theta, (K i theta).Nonempty)
    (hLne : ∀ i theta, (L i theta).Nonempty)
    (hKconv : ∀ i theta, Convex ℝ (K i theta))
    (hLconv : ∀ i theta, Convex ℝ (L i theta))
    (hr_nonneg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ r i)
    (hr : Tendsto r l (nhds 0))
    (hsupport : ∀ i theta (u : E), ‖u‖ ≤ 1 →
      |supportFunction (K i theta) u - supportFunction (L i theta) u| ≤ r i) :
    TendstoUniformly
      (fun i theta ↦ hausdorffDist (K i theta) (L i theta))
      (fun _ ↦ (0 : ℝ)) l
proof:
:= by
  rw [tendstoUniformly_iff]
  intro eps heps
  have hev : ∀ᶠ i in l, r i < eps := hr.eventually (Iio_mem_nhds heps)
  filter_upwards [hev] with i hi
  intro theta
  have hhd : hausdorffDist (K i theta) (L i theta) ≤ r i :=
    uniform_hausdorffDist_le_of_unitBall_supportFunction_le
      hKcompact hLcompact hKne hLne hKconv hLconv hr_nonneg hsupport i theta
  have hlt := hhd.trans_lt hi
  simpa [Real.dist_eq, abs_of_nonneg hausdorffDist_nonneg] using hlt

name: RandomSetTheory.measure_exists_mem_hausdorffDist_gt_le_finset_supportHausdorffGap
statement:
theorem measure_exists_mem_hausdorffDist_gt_le_finset_supportHausdorffGap
    {Omega Theta E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    {mu : Measure Omega} {K L : Omega → Theta → Set E}
    (hKcompact : ∀ omega theta, IsCompact (K omega theta))
    (hLcompact : ∀ omega theta, IsCompact (L omega theta))
    (hKne : ∀ omega theta, (K omega theta).Nonempty)
    (hLne : ∀ omega theta, (L omega theta).Nonempty)
    (hKconv : ∀ omega theta, Convex ℝ (K omega theta))
    (hLconv : ∀ omega theta, Convex ℝ (L omega theta))
    (s : Finset Theta) (r : ℝ) (delta : Theta → ℝ≥0∞)
    (htail : ∀ theta ∈ s,
      mu {omega | r < supportHausdorffGap (K omega theta) (L omega theta)} ≤
        delta theta) :
    mu {omega | ∃ theta ∈ s,
      r < hausdorffDist (K omega theta) (L omega theta)} ≤
      ∑ theta ∈ s, delta theta
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let A : Theta → Set Omega := fun theta ↦
    {omega | r < supportHausdorffGap (K omega theta) (L omega theta)}
  have hsub :
      {omega | ∃ theta ∈ s,
        r < hausdorffDist (K omega theta) (L omega theta)} ⊆
        ⋃ theta ∈ s, A theta := by
    rintro omega ⟨theta, htheta, hdev⟩
    refine Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨theta, Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨htheta, ?_⟩⟩
    change r < supportHausdorffGap (K omega theta) (L omega theta)
    rwa [supportHausdorffGap_eq_hausdorffDist
      (hKcompact omega theta) (hLcompact omega theta)
      (hKne omega theta) (hLne omega theta)
      (hKconv omega theta) (hLconv omega theta)]
  calc
    mu {omega | ∃ theta ∈ s,
        r < hausdorffDist (K omega theta) (L omega theta)} ≤
        mu (⋃ theta ∈ s, A theta) := measure_mono hsub
    _ ≤ ∑ theta ∈ s, mu (A theta) := measure_biUnion_finset_le s A
    _ ≤ ∑ theta ∈ s, delta theta := by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun theta htheta ↦ htail theta htheta

name: RandomSetTheory.measure_exists_hausdorffDist_gt_le_tsum_supportHausdorffGap
statement:
theorem measure_exists_hausdorffDist_gt_le_tsum_supportHausdorffGap
    {Omega Theta E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega] [Countable Theta]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    {mu : Measure Omega} {K L : Omega → Theta → Set E}
    (hKcompact : ∀ omega theta, IsCompact (K omega theta))
    (hLcompact : ∀ omega theta, IsCompact (L omega theta))
    (hKne : ∀ omega theta, (K omega theta).Nonempty)
    (hLne : ∀ omega theta, (L omega theta).Nonempty)
    (hKconv : ∀ omega theta, Convex ℝ (K omega theta))
    (hLconv : ∀ omega theta, Convex ℝ (L omega theta))
    (r : ℝ) (delta : Theta → ℝ≥0∞)
    (htail : ∀ theta,
      mu {omega | r < supportHausdorffGap (K omega theta) (L omega theta)} ≤
        delta theta) :
    mu {omega | ∃ theta,
      r < hausdorffDist (K omega theta) (L omega theta)} ≤
      ∑' theta, delta theta
proof:
:= by
  let A : Theta → Set Omega := fun theta ↦
    {omega | r < supportHausdorffGap (K omega theta) (L omega theta)}
  have hsub :
      {omega | ∃ theta,
        r < hausdorffDist (K omega theta) (L omega theta)} ⊆
        ⋃ theta, A theta := by
    rintro omega ⟨theta, hdev⟩
    refine Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨theta, ?_⟩
    change r < supportHausdorffGap (K omega theta) (L omega theta)
    rwa [supportHausdorffGap_eq_hausdorffDist
      (hKcompact omega theta) (hLcompact omega theta)
      (hKne omega theta) (hLne omega theta)
      (hKconv omega theta) (hLconv omega theta)]
  calc
    mu {omega | ∃ theta,
        r < hausdorffDist (K omega theta) (L omega theta)} ≤
        mu (⋃ theta, A theta) := measure_mono hsub
    _ ≤ ∑' theta, mu (A theta) := measure_iUnion_le A
    _ ≤ ∑' theta, delta theta := ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum htail

name: RandomSetTheory.minkowskiDecompositionArgmin_subset
statement:
theorem minkowskiDecompositionArgmin_subset
    {Ω E : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace E] [Add E]
    (S T : Ω → Set E) (h : Ω → E) (ω : Ω) :
    minkowskiDecompositionArgmin S T h ω ⊆ S ω ×ˢ T ω
proof:
:=
  inter_subset_left

name: RandomSetTheory.minkowskiDecompositionArgmin_isCompact
statement:
theorem minkowskiDecompositionArgmin_isCompact
    {Ω E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    {S T : Ω → Set E} (hScompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hTcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (T ω)) (h : Ω → E) (ω : Ω) :
    IsCompact (minkowskiDecompositionArgmin S T h ω)
proof:
:= by
  apply (hScompact ω).prod (hTcompact ω) |>.inter_right
  exact isClosed_eq
    ((continuous_fst.add continuous_snd).dist continuous_const)
    continuous_const

name: RandomSetTheory.minkowskiDecompositionArgmin_nonempty
statement:
theorem minkowskiDecompositionArgmin_nonempty
    {Ω E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    {S T : Ω → Set E} (hScompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hTcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (T ω))
    (hSne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty) (hTne : ∀ ω, (T ω).Nonempty)
    (h : Ω → E) (ω : Ω) :
    (minkowskiDecompositionArgmin S T h ω).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  have hsumCompact : IsCompact (S ω + T ω) :=
    (hScompact ω).add (hTcompact ω)
  have hsumNe : (S ω + T ω).Nonempty := (hSne ω).add (hTne ω)
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzmin⟩ := hsumCompact.exists_infDist_eq_dist hsumNe (h ω)
  rcases hz with ⟨x, hx, y, hy, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨(x, y), ⟨hx, hy⟩, ?_⟩
  simpa [dist_comm] using hzmin.symm

name: RandomSetTheory.measurable_infDist_correspondence_comp
statement:
theorem measurable_infDist_correspondence_comp
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [MetricSpace E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] [Nonempty E]
    {Q : Ω → Set E} (hQ : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable Q)
    (hQclosed : ∀ ω, IsClosed (Q ω)) (hQne : ∀ ω, (Q ω).Nonempty)
    {h : Ω → E} (hh : Measurable h) :
    Measurable (fun ω => infDist (h ω) (Q ω))
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℕ → Ω → E := castaingRepresentation hQ hQclosed hQne
  have hf : ∀ n, Measurable (f n) :=
    castaingRepresentation_measurable hQ hQclosed hQne
  have hclosure : ∀ ω, closure (Set.range fun n => f n ω) = Q ω :=
    closure_range_castaingRepresentation hQ hQclosed hQne
  have hEq : (fun ω => infDist (h ω) (Q ω)) =
      fun ω => ⨅ n : ℕ, dist (h ω) (f n ω) := by
    funext ω
    rw [← hclosure ω, Metric.infDist_closure]
    rw [Metric.infDist_eq_iInf, iInf, iInf]
    apply congrArg sInf
    ext z
    simp only [Set.mem_range]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := y.property
      exact ⟨n, congrArg (dist (h ω)) hn⟩
    · rintro ⟨n, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨⟨f n ω, ⟨n, rfl⟩⟩, rfl⟩
  rw [hEq]
  exact Measurable.iInf fun n => hh.dist (hf n)

name: RandomSetTheory.measurableSet_minkowskiArgminBasisEvent
statement:
theorem measurableSet_minkowskiArgminBasisEvent
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] [Nonempty E]
    {S T : Ω → Set E} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hT : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable T)
    (hScompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hTcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (T ω))
    (hSne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty) (hTne : ∀ ω, (T ω).Nonempty)
    {h : Ω → E} (hh : Measurable h)
    (U : Set (E × E)) (n m : ℕ) :
    MeasurableSet {ω | MinkowskiArgminBasisEvent S T h U n m ω}
proof:
:= by
  let P : Ω → Set (E × E) := fun ω => S ω ×ˢ T ω
  let addMap : E × E → E := fun p => p.1 + p.2
  let q : E × E := denseSeq (E × E) n
  let r : ℝ := 1 / (m + 1 : ℝ)
  have hPcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (P ω) := fun ω =>
    (hScompact ω).prod (hTcompact ω)
  have hPne : ∀ ω, (P ω).Nonempty := fun ω => (hSne ω).prod (hTne ω)
  have hPEffros : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable P :=
    hS.prod hT (fun ω => (hScompact ω).isClosed)
      (fun ω => (hTcompact ω).isClosed) hSne hTne
  have haddContinuous : Continuous addMap := continuous_fst.add continuous_snd
  have hlocalEffros : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable
      (fun ω => addMap '' castaingLocalization P q r ω) :=
    (effros_castaingLocalization hPEffros q r).image haddContinuous
  have hlocalCompact : ∀ ω,
      IsCompact (addMap '' castaingLocalization P q r ω) := fun ω =>
    (castaingLocalization_isCompact hPcompact q r ω).image haddContinuous
  have hlocalNe : ∀ ω,
      (addMap '' castaingLocalization P q r ω).Nonempty := fun ω =>
    (castaingLocalization_nonempty hPne q r ω).image addMap
  have hlocalDist : Measurable (fun ω =>
      infDist (h ω) (addMap '' castaingLocalization P q r ω)) := by
    exact measurable_infDist_correspondence_comp hlocalEffros
      (fun ω => (hlocalCompact ω).isClosed) hlocalNe hh
  have hsumEffros : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable (fun ω => S ω + T ω) :=
    hS.add hT (fun ω => (hScompact ω).isClosed)
      (fun ω => (hTcompact ω).isClosed) hSne hTne
  have hsumCompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω + T ω) := fun ω =>
    (hScompact ω).add (hTcompact ω)
  have hsumNe : ∀ ω, (S ω + T ω).Nonempty := fun ω =>
    (hSne ω).add (hTne ω)
  have hglobalDist : Measurable (fun ω => infDist (h ω) (S ω + T ω)) := by
    exact measurable_infDist_correspondence_comp hsumEffros
      (fun ω => (hsumCompact ω).isClosed) hsumNe hh
  have hhit : MeasurableSet {ω | (P ω ∩ Metric.ball q r).Nonempty} :=
    hPEffros (Metric.ball q r) Metric.isOpen_ball
  by_cases hb : Metric.closedBall q r ⊆ U
  · have hEq : {ω | MinkowskiArgminBasisEvent S T h U n m ω} =
        {ω | (P ω ∩ Metric.ball q r).Nonempty} ∩
          {ω | infDist (h ω)
              (addMap '' castaingLocalization P q r ω) =
            infDist (h ω) (S ω + T ω)} := by
      ext ω
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨_, hhitω, heqω⟩
        exact ⟨hhitω, by simpa [P, addMap, q, r] using heqω⟩
      · rintro ⟨hhitω, heqω⟩
        exact ⟨by simpa [q, r] using hb, by simpa [P, q, r] using hhitω,
          by simpa [P, addMap, q, r] using heqω⟩
    rw [hEq]
    exact hhit.inter (measurableSet_eq_fun hlocalDist hglobalDist)
  · have hempty : {ω | MinkowskiArgminBasisEvent S T h U n m ω} =
        (∅ : Set Ω) := by
      ext ω
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_empty_iff_false]
      constructor
      · intro hω
        exact (hb (by simpa [q, r] using hω.1)).elim
      · exact False.elim
    rw [hempty]
    exact MeasurableSet.empty

name: RandomSetTheory.effrosMeasurable_minkowskiDecompositionArgmin
statement:
theorem effrosMeasurable_minkowskiDecompositionArgmin
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] [Nonempty E]
    {S T : Ω → Set E} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hT : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable T)
    (hScompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hTcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (T ω))
    (hSne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty) (hTne : ∀ ω, (T ω).Nonempty)
    {h : Ω → E} (hh : Measurable h) :
    RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable (minkowskiDecompositionArgmin S T h)
proof:
:= by
  intro U hU
  have hEq : {ω | (minkowskiDecompositionArgmin S T h ω ∩ U).Nonempty} =
      ⋃ n : ℕ, ⋃ m : ℕ, {ω | MinkowskiArgminBasisEvent S T h U n m ω} := by
    ext ω
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_iUnion]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨p, hpmin, hpU⟩
      obtain ⟨n, m, hpball, hclosedBall⟩ :=
        exists_denseSeq_ball_closedBall_subset hU hpU
      let P : Ω → Set (E × E) := fun ω => S ω ×ˢ T ω
      let addMap : E × E → E := fun p => p.1 + p.2
      let q : E × E := denseSeq (E × E) n
      let r : ℝ := 1 / (m + 1 : ℝ)
      have hPcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (P ω) := fun ω =>
        (hScompact ω).prod (hTcompact ω)
      have hPne : ∀ ω, (P ω).Nonempty := fun ω =>
        (hSne ω).prod (hTne ω)
      have hhit : (P ω ∩ Metric.ball q r).Nonempty :=
        ⟨p, hpmin.1, by simpa [q, r] using hpball⟩
      have hplocal : p ∈ castaingLocalization P q r ω := by
        rw [castaingLocalization, if_pos hhit]
        exact subset_closure ⟨hpmin.1, by simpa [q, r] using hpball⟩
      have hlocalCompact := castaingLocalization_isCompact hPcompact q r ω
      have hlocalNe := castaingLocalization_nonempty hPne q r ω
      have hlocalSub := castaingLocalization_subset
        (fun ω => (hPcompact ω).isClosed) q r ω
      have hlocalImageNe : (addMap '' castaingLocalization P q r ω).Nonempty :=
        hlocalNe.image addMap
      have hlocalImageSub : addMap '' castaingLocalization P q r ω ⊆
          S ω + T ω := by
        rintro _ ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
        have haP : a ∈ P ω := hlocalSub ha
        exact Set.add_mem_add haP.1 haP.2
      refine ⟨n, m, ?_⟩
      refine ⟨by simpa [q, r] using hclosedBall, hhit, ?_⟩
      apply le_antisymm
      · calc
          infDist (h ω) (addMap '' castaingLocalization P q r ω) ≤
              dist (h ω) (addMap p) :=
            infDist_le_dist_of_mem ⟨p, hplocal, rfl⟩
          _ = dist (p.1 + p.2) (h ω) := by simp [addMap, dist_comm]
          _ = infDist (h ω) (S ω + T ω) := hpmin.2
      · exact infDist_le_infDist_of_subset hlocalImageSub hlocalImageNe
    · rintro ⟨n, m, hbasis, hhit, heq⟩
      let P : Ω → Set (E × E) := fun ω => S ω ×ˢ T ω
      let addMap : E × E → E := fun p => p.1 + p.2
      let q : E × E := denseSeq (E × E) n
      let r : ℝ := 1 / (m + 1 : ℝ)
      have hPcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (P ω) := fun ω =>
        (hScompact ω).prod (hTcompact ω)
      have hPne : ∀ ω, (P ω).Nonempty := fun ω =>
        (hSne ω).prod (hTne ω)
      have hhit' : (P ω ∩ Metric.ball q r).Nonempty := by
        simpa [P, q, r] using hhit
      have hlocalCompact := castaingLocalization_isCompact hPcompact q r ω
      have hlocalNe := castaingLocalization_nonempty hPne q r ω
      have haddContinuous : Continuous addMap := continuous_fst.add continuous_snd
      have hlocalImageCompact :
          IsCompact (addMap '' castaingLocalization P q r ω) :=
        hlocalCompact.image haddContinuous
      have hlocalImageNe : (addMap '' castaingLocalization P q r ω).Nonempty :=
        hlocalNe.image addMap
      obtain ⟨z, hz, hzmin⟩ :=
        hlocalImageCompact.exists_infDist_eq_dist hlocalImageNe (h ω)
      rcases hz with ⟨p, hplocal, rfl⟩
      have hpP : p ∈ P ω :=
        castaingLocalization_subset
          (fun ω => (hPcompact ω).isClosed) q r ω hplocal
      have hpclosure : p ∈ closure (P ω ∩ Metric.ball q r) := by
        simpa [castaingLocalization, hhit'] using hplocal
      have hpclosedBall : p ∈ Metric.closedBall q r :=
        closure_minimal
          (inter_subset_right.trans Metric.ball_subset_closedBall)
          Metric.isClosed_closedBall hpclosure
      refine ⟨p, ⟨hpP, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · calc
          dist (p.1 + p.2) (h ω) = dist (h ω) (addMap p) := by
            simp [addMap, dist_comm]
          _ = infDist (h ω) (addMap '' castaingLocalization P q r ω) :=
            hzmin.symm
          _ = infDist (h ω) (S ω + T ω) := by
            simpa [P, addMap, q, r] using heq
      · have hbasis' : Metric.closedBall q r ⊆ U := by
          simpa [q, r] using hbasis
        exact hbasis' hpclosedBall
  rw [hEq]
  exact MeasurableSet.iUnion fun n => MeasurableSet.iUnion fun m =>
    measurableSet_minkowskiArgminBasisEvent
      hS hT hScompact hTcompact hSne hTne hh U n m

name: RandomSetTheory.measurable_minkowskiDecompositionSelection
statement:
theorem measurable_minkowskiDecompositionSelection
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] [Nonempty E]
    {S T : Ω → Set E} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hT : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable T)
    (hScompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hTcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (T ω))
    (hSne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty) (hTne : ∀ ω, (T ω).Nonempty)
    {h : Ω → E} (hh : Measurable h) :
    Measurable
      (minkowskiDecompositionSelection
        hS hT hScompact hTcompact hSne hTne hh)
proof:
:=
  (kuratowski_ryll_nardzewski
    (effrosMeasurable_minkowskiDecompositionArgmin
      hS hT hScompact hTcompact hSne hTne hh)
    (fun ω =>
      (minkowskiDecompositionArgmin_isCompact hScompact hTcompact h ω).isClosed)
    (minkowskiDecompositionArgmin_nonempty
      hScompact hTcompact hSne hTne h)).1

name: RandomSetTheory.minkowskiDecompositionSelection_mem_and_residual_eq
statement:
theorem minkowskiDecompositionSelection_mem_and_residual_eq
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] [Nonempty E]
    {S T : Ω → Set E} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hT : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable T)
    (hScompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hTcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (T ω))
    (hSne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty) (hTne : ∀ ω, (T ω).Nonempty)
    {h : Ω → E} (hh : Measurable h) (ω : Ω) :
    let p := minkowskiDecompositionSelection
      hS hT hScompact hTcompact hSne hTne hh ω
    p.1 ∈ S ω ∧ p.2 ∈ T ω ∧
      dist (p.1 + p.2) (h ω) = infDist (h ω) (S ω + T ω)
proof:
:= by
  have hp := (kuratowski_ryll_nardzewski
    (effrosMeasurable_minkowskiDecompositionArgmin
      hS hT hScompact hTcompact hSne hTne hh)
    (fun ω =>
      (minkowskiDecompositionArgmin_isCompact hScompact hTcompact h ω).isClosed)
    (minkowskiDecompositionArgmin_nonempty
      hScompact hTcompact hSne hTne h)).2 ω
  exact ⟨hp.1.1, hp.1.2, hp.2⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_measurable_minkowski_decomposition
statement:
theorem exists_measurable_minkowski_decomposition
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] [Nonempty E]
    {S T : Ω → Set E} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hT : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable T)
    (hScompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hTcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (T ω))
    (hSne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty) (hTne : ∀ ω, (T ω).Nonempty)
    {h : Ω → E} (hh : Measurable h)
    (hhmem : ∀ ω, h ω ∈ S ω + T ω) :
    ∃ f g : Ω → E,
      Measurable f ∧ Measurable g ∧
        (∀ ω, f ω ∈ S ω) ∧ (∀ ω, g ω ∈ T ω) ∧
          ∀ ω, h ω = f ω + g ω
proof:
:= by
  let p := minkowskiDecompositionSelection
    hS hT hScompact hTcompact hSne hTne hh
  have hpmeas : Measurable p :=
    measurable_minkowskiDecompositionSelection
      hS hT hScompact hTcompact hSne hTne hh
  have hpprop := minkowskiDecompositionSelection_mem_and_residual_eq
    hS hT hScompact hTcompact hSne hTne hh
  refine ⟨fun ω => (p ω).1, fun ω => (p ω).2,
    hpmeas.fst, hpmeas.snd, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact fun ω => (hpprop ω).1
  · exact fun ω => (hpprop ω).2.1
  · intro ω
    have hdist : dist ((p ω).1 + (p ω).2) (h ω) = 0 :=
      (hpprop ω).2.2.trans (infDist_zero_of_mem (hhmem ω))
    exact (dist_eq_zero.mp hdist).symm

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_measurable_minkowski_decomposition_ae
statement:
theorem exists_measurable_minkowski_decomposition_ae
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] [Nonempty E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S T : Ω → Set E}
    (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hT : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable T)
    (hScompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hTcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (T ω))
    (hSne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty) (hTne : ∀ ω, (T ω).Nonempty)
    {h : Ω → E} (hh : Measurable h)
    (hhmem : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, h ω ∈ S ω + T ω) :
    ∃ f g : Ω → E,
      Measurable f ∧ Measurable g ∧
        (∀ ω, f ω ∈ S ω) ∧ (∀ ω, g ω ∈ T ω) ∧
          h =ᵐ[μ] fun ω => f ω + g ω
proof:
:= by
  let p := minkowskiDecompositionSelection
    hS hT hScompact hTcompact hSne hTne hh
  have hpmeas : Measurable p :=
    measurable_minkowskiDecompositionSelection
      hS hT hScompact hTcompact hSne hTne hh
  have hpprop := minkowskiDecompositionSelection_mem_and_residual_eq
    hS hT hScompact hTcompact hSne hTne hh
  refine ⟨fun ω => (p ω).1, fun ω => (p ω).2,
    hpmeas.fst, hpmeas.snd, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact fun ω => (hpprop ω).1
  · exact fun ω => (hpprop ω).2.1
  · filter_upwards [hhmem] with ω hω
    have hdist : dist ((p ω).1 + (p ω).2) (h ω) = 0 :=
      (hpprop ω).2.2.trans (infDist_zero_of_mem hω)
    exact (dist_eq_zero.mp hdist).symm

name: RandomSetTheory.hasIntegrableMinkowskiDecomposition_of_effros_of_envelopes
statement:
theorem hasIntegrableMinkowskiDecomposition_of_effros_of_envelopes
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] [Nonempty E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S T : Ω → Set E}
    (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hT : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable T)
    (hScompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hTcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (T ω))
    (hSne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty) (hTne : ∀ ω, (T ω).Nonempty)
    {gS gT : Ω → ℝ} (hgS : Integrable gS μ) (hgT : Integrable gT μ)
    (hdomS : ∀ ω, ∀ x ∈ S ω, ‖x‖ ≤ gS ω)
    (hdomT : ∀ ω, ∀ x ∈ T ω, ‖x‖ ≤ gT ω) :
    HasIntegrableMinkowskiDecomposition μ S T
proof:
:= by
  intro h hh
  let h' : Ω → E := hh.1.aestronglyMeasurable.mk h
  have hh'meas : Measurable h' :=
    hh.1.aestronglyMeasurable.measurable_mk
  have hheq : h =ᵐ[μ] h' :=
    hh.1.aestronglyMeasurable.ae_eq_mk
  have hh'mem : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, h' ω ∈ S ω + T ω := by
    filter_upwards [hh.2, hheq] with ω hmem heq
    rw [← heq]
    exact hmem
  obtain ⟨f, g, hfmeas, hgmeas, hfmem, hgmem, hsum⟩ :=
    exists_measurable_minkowski_decomposition_ae
      hS hT hScompact hTcompact hSne hTne hh'meas hh'mem
  have hfint : Integrable f μ := by
    apply hgS.mono' hfmeas.aestronglyMeasurable
    filter_upwards [] with ω
    exact hdomS ω (f ω) (hfmem ω)
  have hgint : Integrable g μ := by
    apply hgT.mono' hgmeas.aestronglyMeasurable
    filter_upwards [] with ω
    exact hdomT ω (g ω) (hgmem ω)
  exact ⟨f, g,
    ⟨hfint, Filter.Eventually.of_forall hfmem⟩,
    ⟨hgint, Filter.Eventually.of_forall hgmem⟩,
    hheq.trans hsum⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_add_of_effros_of_envelopes
statement:
theorem aumannExpectation_add_of_effros_of_envelopes
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] [Nonempty E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S T : Ω → Set E}
    (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hT : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable T)
    (hScompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hTcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (T ω))
    (hSne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty) (hTne : ∀ ω, (T ω).Nonempty)
    {gS gT : Ω → ℝ} (hgS : Integrable gS μ) (hgT : Integrable gT μ)
    (hdomS : ∀ ω, ∀ x ∈ S ω, ‖x‖ ≤ gS ω)
    (hdomT : ∀ ω, ∀ x ∈ T ω, ‖x‖ ≤ gT ω) :
    aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => S ω + T ω) =
      aumannExpectation μ S + aumannExpectation μ T
proof:
:=
  aumannExpectation_add
    (hasIntegrableMinkowskiDecomposition_of_effros_of_envelopes
      hS hT hScompact hTcompact hSne hTne hgS hgT hdomS hdomT)

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_image_le_of_lipschitzOnWith
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_image_le_of_lipschitzOnWith
    {X Y : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace X] [PseudoMetricSpace Y]
    {f : X → Y} {K L : Set X} {c : NNReal}
    (hf : LipschitzOnWith c f (K ∪ L))
    (hK : IsCompact K) (hL : IsCompact L)
    (hKne : K.Nonempty) (hLne : L.Nonempty) :
    hausdorffDist (f '' K) (f '' L) ≤
      (c : ℝ) * hausdorffDist K L
proof:
:= by
  have hfin : hausdorffEDist K L ≠ ⊤ :=
    hausdorffEDist_ne_top_of_nonempty_of_bounded
      hKne hLne hK.isBounded hL.isBounded
  apply hausdorffDist_le_of_mem_dist
    (mul_nonneg c.coe_nonneg hausdorffDist_nonneg)
  · rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := hL.exists_infDist_eq_dist hLne x
    refine ⟨f y, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    calc
      dist (f x) (f y) ≤ (c : ℝ) * dist x y :=
        hf.dist_le_mul x (subset_union_left hx) y (subset_union_right hy)
      _ = (c : ℝ) * infDist x L := by rw [hxy]
      _ ≤ (c : ℝ) * hausdorffDist K L := by
        gcongr
        exact infDist_le_hausdorffDist_of_mem hx hfin
  · rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hyx⟩ := hK.exists_infDist_eq_dist hKne y
    refine ⟨f x, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    calc
      dist (f y) (f x) ≤ (c : ℝ) * dist y x :=
        hf.dist_le_mul y (subset_union_right hy) x (subset_union_left hx)
      _ = (c : ℝ) * infDist y K := by rw [hyx]
      _ ≤ (c : ℝ) * hausdorffDist K L := by
        gcongr
        rw [hausdorffDist_comm]
        apply infDist_le_hausdorffDist_of_mem hy
        simpa [hausdorffEDist_comm] using hfin

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_image_le_of_lipschitzOnWith_of_subset
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_image_le_of_lipschitzOnWith_of_subset
    {X Y : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace X] [PseudoMetricSpace Y]
    {f : X → Y} {D K L : Set X} {c : NNReal}
    (hf : LipschitzOnWith c f D)
    (hK : IsCompact K) (hL : IsCompact L)
    (hKne : K.Nonempty) (hLne : L.Nonempty)
    (hKD : K ⊆ D) (hLD : L ⊆ D) :
    hausdorffDist (f '' K) (f '' L) ≤
      (c : ℝ) * hausdorffDist K L
proof:
:=
  hausdorffDist_image_le_of_lipschitzOnWith
    (hf.mono (union_subset hKD hLD)) hK hL hKne hLne

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_closedConvexHull_image_le_of_lipschitzOnWith
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_closedConvexHull_image_le_of_lipschitzOnWith
    {X Y : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace X]
    [NormedAddCommGroup Y] [NormedSpace ℝ Y]
    {f : X → Y} {K L : Set X} {c : NNReal}
    (hf : LipschitzOnWith c f (K ∪ L))
    (hK : IsCompact K) (hL : IsCompact L)
    (hKne : K.Nonempty) (hLne : L.Nonempty) :
    hausdorffDist (closedConvexHull ℝ (f '' K))
        (closedConvexHull ℝ (f '' L)) ≤
      (c : ℝ) * hausdorffDist K L
proof:
:= by
  have hKimage : IsCompact (f '' K) :=
    hK.image_of_continuousOn
      (hf.continuousOn.mono subset_union_left)
  have hLimage : IsCompact (f '' L) :=
    hL.image_of_continuousOn
      (hf.continuousOn.mono subset_union_right)
  calc
    hausdorffDist (closedConvexHull ℝ (f '' K))
        (closedConvexHull ℝ (f '' L)) ≤
        hausdorffDist (f '' K) (f '' L) :=
      hausdorffDist_closedConvexHull_le hKimage hLimage
        (hKne.image f) (hLne.image f)
    _ ≤ (c : ℝ) * hausdorffDist K L :=
      hausdorffDist_image_le_of_lipschitzOnWith hf hK hL hKne hLne

name: RandomSetTheory.tendsto_hausdorffDist_image_of_lipschitzOnWith
statement:
theorem tendsto_hausdorffDist_image_of_lipschitzOnWith
    {X Y ι : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace X] [PseudoMetricSpace Y]
    {l : Filter ι} {f : X → Y} {K : ι → Set X} {L : Set X} {c : NNReal}
    (hf : ∀ i, LipschitzOnWith c f (K i ∪ L))
    (hK : ∀ i, IsCompact (K i)) (hL : IsCompact L)
    (hKne : ∀ i, (K i).Nonempty) (hLne : L.Nonempty)
    (hKL : Tendsto (fun i => hausdorffDist (K i) L) l (nhds 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun i => hausdorffDist (f '' K i) (f '' L)) l (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply squeeze_zero
    (fun _ => hausdorffDist_nonneg)
    (fun i => hausdorffDist_image_le_of_lipschitzOnWith
      (hf i) (hK i) hL (hKne i) hLne)
  simpa using hKL.const_mul (c : ℝ)

name: RandomSetTheory.tendsto_hausdorffDist_closedConvexHull_image_of_lipschitzOnWith

theorem tendsto_hausdorffDist_closedConvexHull_image_of_lipschitzOnWith

    (hKne : ∀ i, (K i).Nonempty) (hLne : L.Nonempty)
    (hKL : Tendsto (fun i => hausdorffDist (K i) L) l (nhds 0)) :
    Tendsto
      (fun i => hausdorffDist (closedConvexHull ℝ (f '' K i))
        (closedConvexHull ℝ (f '' L))) l (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
