    (fun _ => hausdorffDist_nonneg)
    (fun i => hausdorffDist_closedConvexHull_image_le_of_lipschitzOnWith
      (hf i) (hK i) hL (hKne i) hLne)
  simpa using hKL.const_mul (c : ℝ)

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_finset_sum_of_effros_of_envelopes
statement:
theorem aumannExpectation_finset_sum_of_effros_of_envelopes
    {Ω E ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] [Nonempty E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} (s : Finset ι) (S : ι → Ω → Set E)
    (hS : ∀ i ∈ s, RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable (S i))
    (hcompact : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ ω, IsCompact (S i ω))
    (hne : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    (g : ι → Ω → ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ i ∈ s, Integrable (g i) μ)
    (hdom : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ ω, ∀ x ∈ S i ω, ‖x‖ ≤ g i ω) :
    aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => ∑ i ∈ s, S i ω) =
      ∑ i ∈ s, aumannExpectation μ (S i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
      have hzero : Integrable (fun _ : Ω => (0 : E)) μ :=
        integrable_zero Ω E μ
      simpa only [Finset.sum_empty, ← Set.singleton_zero, integral_zero] using
        (aumannExpectation_singleton hzero)
  | @insert a s ha ih =>
      have hSa : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable (S a) :=
        hS a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)
      have hSrest : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable
          (fun ω => ∑ i ∈ s, S i ω) :=
        RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable.finset_sum s S
          (fun i hi => hS i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))
          (fun i hi ω => hcompact i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi) ω)
          (fun i hi ω => hne i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi) ω)
      have hcompactRest : ∀ ω, IsCompact (∑ i ∈ s, S i ω) :=
        fun ω => isCompact_finset_sum s (fun i => S i ω)
          (fun i hi => hcompact i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi) ω)
      have hneRest : ∀ ω, (∑ i ∈ s, S i ω).Nonempty :=
        fun ω => nonempty_finset_sum s (fun i => S i ω)
          (fun i hi => hne i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi) ω)
      have hgRest : Integrable (fun ω => ∑ i ∈ s, g i ω) μ :=
        integrable_finsetSum s
          (fun i hi => hg i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))
      have hdomRest : ∀ ω, ∀ x ∈ ∑ i ∈ s, S i ω,
          ‖x‖ ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, g i ω := by
        intro ω x hx
        exact norm_le_sum_radius_of_mem_finset_sum s
          (fun i => S i ω) (fun i => g i ω)
          (fun i hi y hy =>
            hdom i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi) ω y hy) hx
      have hadd := aumannExpectation_add_of_effros_of_envelopes
        (μ := μ) (S := S a) (T := fun ω => ∑ i ∈ s, S i ω)
        hSa hSrest
        (fun ω => hcompact a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s) ω)
        hcompactRest
        (fun ω => hne a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s) ω)
        hneRest
        (hg a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)) hgRest
        (fun ω x hx =>
          hdom a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s) ω x hx)
        hdomRest
      have hih := ih
        (fun i hi => hS i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))
        (fun i hi ω => hcompact i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi) ω)
        (fun i hi ω => hne i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi) ω)
        (fun i hi => hg i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))
        (fun i hi ω x hx =>
          hdom i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi) ω x hx)
      calc
        aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => ∑ i ∈ insert a s, S i ω) =
            aumannExpectation μ
              (fun ω => S a ω + ∑ i ∈ s, S i ω) := by
                congr 1
                funext ω
                rw [Finset.sum_insert ha]
        _ = aumannExpectation μ (S a) +
              aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => ∑ i ∈ s, S i ω) := hadd
        _ = aumannExpectation μ (S a) +
              ∑ i ∈ s, aumannExpectation μ (S i) := by rw [hih]
        _ = ∑ i ∈ insert a s, aumannExpectation μ (S i) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_insert ha]

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_minkowskiAverage_of_effros_of_envelopes
statement:
theorem aumannExpectation_minkowskiAverage_of_effros_of_envelopes
    {Ω E ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] [Nonempty E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (S : ι → Ω → Set E)
    (hS : ∀ i ∈ s, RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable (S i))
    (hcompact : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ ω, IsCompact (S i ω))
    (hne : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    (g : ι → Ω → ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ i ∈ s, Integrable (g i) μ)
    (hdom : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ ω, ∀ x ∈ S i ω, ‖x‖ ≤ g i ω) :
    aumannExpectation μ
        (fun ω => minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) =
      minkowskiAverage s (fun i => aumannExpectation μ (S i))
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : ((s.card : ℝ)⁻¹) ≠ 0 := by
    exact inv_ne_zero (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hs.card_ne_zero)
  unfold minkowskiAverage
  rw [aumannExpectation_smul_of_ne (s.card : ℝ)⁻¹ hcard]
  rw [aumannExpectation_finset_sum_of_effros_of_envelopes
    s S hS hcompact hne g hg hdom]

name: RandomSetTheory.FiniteEvaluationDual.exists_fin_sum_evalCLM
statement:
theorem FiniteEvaluationDual.exists_fin_sum_evalCLM
    (w : FiniteEvaluationDual T) :
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (a : Fin k → ℝ) (t : Fin k → T),
      ∑ j, a j • ContinuousMap.evalCLM ℝ (t j) = w.1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, a, g, hg⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_set'.1 w.2
  let t : Fin k → T := fun j ↦ (g j).2.choose
  have ht (j : Fin k) : ContinuousMap.evalCLM ℝ (t j) = (g j).1 :=
    (g j).2.choose_spec
  refine ⟨k, a, t, ?_⟩
  calc
    ∑ j, a j • ContinuousMap.evalCLM ℝ (t j) =
        ∑ j, a j • ((g j).1 : StrongDual ℝ C(T, ℝ)) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro j _
          rw [ht j]
    _ = w.1 := hg

name: RandomSetTheory.FiniteEvaluationDual.exists_apply_eq_fin_sum
statement:
theorem FiniteEvaluationDual.exists_apply_eq_fin_sum
    (w : FiniteEvaluationDual T) :
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (a : Fin k → ℝ) (t : Fin k → T),
      ∀ f : C(T, ℝ),
        (w.1 : StrongDual ℝ C(T, ℝ)) f = ∑ j, a j * f (t j)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, a, t, hw⟩ :=
    FiniteEvaluationDual.exists_fin_sum_evalCLM T w
  refine ⟨k, a, t, fun f ↦ ?_⟩
  have happly := congrArg
    (fun L : StrongDual ℝ C(T, ℝ) ↦ L f) hw
  simpa only [sum_apply, smul_apply,
    ContinuousMap.evalCLM_apply, smul_eq_mul] using happly.symm

name: RandomSetTheory.finiteEvaluationVectorCLM_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finiteEvaluationVectorCLM_apply {k : ℕ} (t : Fin k → T)
    (f : C(T, ℝ)) (j : Fin k) :
    finiteEvaluationVectorCLM T t f j = f (t j)
proof: := rfl

name: RandomSetTheory.finiteLinearCombinationCLM_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finiteLinearCombinationCLM_apply {k : ℕ} (a : Fin k → ℝ)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) :
    finiteLinearCombinationCLM a x = ∑ j, a j * x j
proof:
:= by
  simp [finiteLinearCombinationCLM, PiLp.inner_apply, mul_comm]

name: RandomSetTheory.finiteLinearCombinationCLM_comp_finiteEvaluationVectorCLM
statement:
theorem finiteLinearCombinationCLM_comp_finiteEvaluationVectorCLM
    {k : ℕ} (a : Fin k → ℝ) (t : Fin k → T)
    (w : FiniteEvaluationDual T)
    (hw : ∑ j, a j • ContinuousMap.evalCLM ℝ (t j) = w.1) :
    (finiteLinearCombinationCLM a).comp (finiteEvaluationVectorCLM T t) = w.1
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  have happly := congrArg
    (fun L : StrongDual ℝ C(T, ℝ) ↦ L f) hw
  simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
    finiteLinearCombinationCLM_apply, finiteEvaluationVectorCLM_apply,
    sum_apply, smul_apply,
    ContinuousMap.evalCLM_apply, smul_eq_mul] using happly

name: RandomSetTheory.ProbabilityMeasure.tendsto_map_finiteEvaluationDual_of_vector
statement:
theorem ProbabilityMeasure.tendsto_map_finiteEvaluationDual_of_vector
    {k : ℕ} (a : Fin k → ℝ) (t : Fin k → T)
    (w : FiniteEvaluationDual T)
    (hw : ∑ j, a j • ContinuousMap.evalCLM ℝ (t j) = w.1)
    (mu : iota → ProbabilityMeasure C(T, ℝ))
    (rho : ProbabilityMeasure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)))
    (hvec : Tendsto
      (fun i ↦ ProbabilityMeasure.map (mu i)
        (finiteEvaluationVectorCLM T t).measurable.aemeasurable)
      l
      (nhds rho)) :
    Tendsto
      (fun i ↦ ProbabilityMeasure.map (mu i)
        w.1.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable)
      l
      (nhds (ProbabilityMeasure.map rho
        (finiteLinearCombinationCLM a).measurable.aemeasurable))
proof:
:= by
  let evalMap := finiteEvaluationVectorCLM T t
  let linearMap := finiteLinearCombinationCLM a
  have hfactor : linearMap.comp evalMap = w.1 := by
    exact finiteLinearCombinationCLM_comp_finiteEvaluationVectorCLM T a t w hw
  have hmapped := ProbabilityMeasure.tendsto_map_of_tendsto_of_continuous
    (fun i ↦ ProbabilityMeasure.map (mu i) evalMap.measurable.aemeasurable)
    rho hvec linearMap.continuous
  have hmap_map (i : iota) :
      ProbabilityMeasure.map
          (ProbabilityMeasure.map (mu i) evalMap.measurable.aemeasurable)
          linearMap.measurable.aemeasurable =
        ProbabilityMeasure.map (mu i)
          w.1.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable := by
    apply ProbabilityMeasure.toMeasure_injective
    simp only [ProbabilityMeasure.toMeasure_map]
    rw [Measure.map_map linearMap.measurable evalMap.measurable]
    rw [show linearMap ∘ evalMap = w.1 from by
      funext f
      exact DFunLike.congr_fun hfactor f]
  simpa only [evalMap, linearMap, hmap_map] using hmapped

name: RandomSetTheory.ProbabilityMeasure.exists_fin_tendsto_map_finiteEvaluationDual_bridge
statement:
theorem ProbabilityMeasure.exists_fin_tendsto_map_finiteEvaluationDual_bridge
    (w : FiniteEvaluationDual T)
    (mu : iota → ProbabilityMeasure C(T, ℝ)) :
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (a : Fin k → ℝ) (t : Fin k → T),
      (∑ j, a j • ContinuousMap.evalCLM ℝ (t j) = w.1) ∧
      ∀ (rho : ProbabilityMeasure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k))),
        Tendsto
          (fun i ↦ ProbabilityMeasure.map (mu i)
            (finiteEvaluationVectorCLM T t).measurable.aemeasurable)
          l
          (nhds rho) →
        Tendsto
          (fun i ↦ ProbabilityMeasure.map (mu i)
            w.1.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable)
          l
          (nhds (ProbabilityMeasure.map rho
            (finiteLinearCombinationCLM a).measurable.aemeasurable))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, a, t, hw⟩ :=
    FiniteEvaluationDual.exists_fin_sum_evalCLM T w
  refine ⟨k, a, t, hw, ?_⟩
  intro rho hvec
  exact ProbabilityMeasure.tendsto_map_finiteEvaluationDual_of_vector
    T a t w hw mu rho hvec

name: ProbabilityTheory.strongMomentSecondWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem strongMomentSecondWeight_nonneg {q k : ℕ} (hkq : k ≤ q)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) :
    0 ≤ strongMomentSecondWeight q k
proof:
:= by
  unfold strongMomentSecondWeight
  exact div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (mod_cast hkq))
    (sub_nonneg.mpr (by norm_num; omega))

name: ProbabilityTheory.strongMomentQWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem strongMomentQWeight_nonneg {q k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) :
    0 ≤ strongMomentQWeight q k
proof:
:= by
  unfold strongMomentQWeight
  exact div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (by norm_num; omega))
    (sub_nonneg.mpr (by norm_num; omega))

name: ProbabilityTheory.strongMomentSecondWeight_add_QWeight
statement:
theorem strongMomentSecondWeight_add_QWeight {q k : ℕ} (hq : 3 ≤ q) :
    strongMomentSecondWeight q k + strongMomentQWeight q k = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold strongMomentSecondWeight strongMomentQWeight
  have hqReal : (3 : ℝ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hden : (q : ℝ) - 2 ≠ 0 := by linarith
  field_simp
  ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.two_mul_strongMomentSecondWeight_add_q_mul_strongMomentQWeight
statement:
theorem two_mul_strongMomentSecondWeight_add_q_mul_strongMomentQWeight
    {q k : ℕ} (hq : 3 ≤ q) :
    2 * strongMomentSecondWeight q k +
        (q : ℝ) * strongMomentQWeight q k = k
proof:
:= by
  unfold strongMomentSecondWeight strongMomentQWeight
  have hqReal : (3 : ℝ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hden : (q : ℝ) - 2 ≠ 0 := by linarith
  field_simp
  ring

name: ProbabilityTheory.sum_rpow_mul_rpow_le_sum_rpow_mul_sum_rpow
statement:
theorem sum_rpow_mul_rpow_le_sum_rpow_mul_sum_rpow
    {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (A B : ι → ℝ≥0∞)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hab : a + b = 1) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, A i ^ a * B i ^ b ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, A i) ^ a * (∑ i ∈ s, B i) ^ b
proof:
:= by
  rcases ha.eq_or_lt with rfl | ha
  · simp only [zero_add] at hab
    simp [hab]
  rcases hb.eq_or_lt with rfl | hb
  · simp only [add_zero] at hab
    simp [hab]
  have hholder : (1 / a).HolderConjugate (1 / b) :=
    Real.holderConjugate_one_div ha hb hab
  have h := ENNReal.inner_le_Lp_mul_Lq s
    (fun i => A i ^ a) (fun i => B i ^ b) hholder
  simpa only [← ENNReal.rpow_mul, one_div, inv_inv, mul_inv_cancel₀ ha.ne',
    mul_inv_cancel₀ hb.ne', ENNReal.rpow_one] using h

name: ProbabilityTheory.lintegral_rpow_nat_le_strongMomentInterpolation
statement:
theorem lintegral_rpow_nat_le_strongMomentInterpolation
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega] (mu : Measure Omega)
    (X : Omega → ℝ≥0∞) {q k : ℕ} (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hkq : k ≤ q) (hX : AEMeasurable X mu) :
    ∫⁻ omega, X omega ^ (k : ℝ) ∂mu ≤
      (∫⁻ omega, X omega ^ (2 : ℝ) ∂mu) ^
          strongMomentSecondWeight q k *
        (∫⁻ omega, X omega ^ (q : ℝ) ∂mu) ^
          strongMomentQWeight q k
proof:
:= by
  let a := strongMomentSecondWeight q k
  let b := strongMomentQWeight q k
  have ha : 0 ≤ a := strongMomentSecondWeight_nonneg hkq hq
  have hb : 0 ≤ b := strongMomentQWeight_nonneg hk hq
  have hab : a + b = 1 := strongMomentSecondWeight_add_QWeight hq
  have hexp : 2 * a + (q : ℝ) * b = k :=
    two_mul_strongMomentSecondWeight_add_q_mul_strongMomentQWeight hq
  have hXtwo : AEMeasurable (fun omega => X omega ^ (2 : ℝ)) mu :=
    ENNReal.continuous_rpow_const.measurable.comp_aemeasurable hX
  have hXq : AEMeasurable (fun omega => X omega ^ (q : ℝ)) mu :=
    ENNReal.continuous_rpow_const.measurable.comp_aemeasurable hX
  have hholder := ENNReal.lintegral_mul_norm_pow_le
    (μ := mu) (f := fun omega => X omega ^ (2 : ℝ))
    (g := fun omega => X omega ^ (q : ℝ))
    hXtwo hXq ha hb hab
  calc
    ∫⁻ omega, X omega ^ (k : ℝ) ∂mu =
        ∫⁻ omega,
          (X omega ^ (2 : ℝ)) ^ a *
            (X omega ^ (q : ℝ)) ^ b ∂mu := by
      apply lintegral_congr
      intro omega
      rw [← ENNReal.rpow_mul, ← ENNReal.rpow_mul,
        ← ENNReal.rpow_add_of_nonneg _ _ (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) ha)
          (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg q) hb)]
      exact congrArg (X omega ^ ·) hexp.symm
    _ ≤ _ := by simpa [a, b] using hholder

name: ProbabilityTheory.sum_lintegral_rpow_nat_le_strongMomentInterpolation
statement:
theorem sum_lintegral_rpow_nat_le_strongMomentInterpolation
    {ι Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega] (mu : Measure Omega)
    (s : Finset ι) (X : ι → Omega → ℝ≥0∞)
    {q k : ℕ} (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hkq : k ≤ q)
    (hX : ∀ i ∈ s, AEMeasurable (X i) mu) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, ∫⁻ omega, X i omega ^ (k : ℝ) ∂mu ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, ∫⁻ omega, X i omega ^ (2 : ℝ) ∂mu) ^
          strongMomentSecondWeight q k *
        (∑ i ∈ s, ∫⁻ omega, X i omega ^ (q : ℝ) ∂mu) ^
          strongMomentQWeight q k
proof:
:= by
  let a := strongMomentSecondWeight q k
  let b := strongMomentQWeight q k
  calc
    ∑ i ∈ s, ∫⁻ omega, X i omega ^ (k : ℝ) ∂mu ≤
        ∑ i ∈ s,
          (∫⁻ omega, X i omega ^ (2 : ℝ) ∂mu) ^ a *
            (∫⁻ omega, X i omega ^ (q : ℝ) ∂mu) ^ b := by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi =>
        lintegral_rpow_nat_le_strongMomentInterpolation
          mu (X i) hq hk hkq (hX i hi)
    _ ≤ _ := sum_rpow_mul_rpow_le_sum_rpow_mul_sum_rpow
      s
      (fun i => ∫⁻ omega, X i omega ^ (2 : ℝ) ∂mu)
      (fun i => ∫⁻ omega, X i omega ^ (q : ℝ) ∂mu)
      (strongMomentSecondWeight_nonneg hkq hq)
      (strongMomentQWeight_nonneg hk hq)
      (strongMomentSecondWeight_add_QWeight hq)

name: ProbabilityTheory.ofReal_integral_pow_eq_lintegral_rpow_of_ae_nonneg
statement:
theorem ofReal_integral_pow_eq_lintegral_rpow_of_ae_nonneg
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega] {mu : Measure Omega}
    {X : Omega → ℝ} (r : ℕ) (hX : 0 ≤ᵐ[mu] X)
    (hInt : Integrable (fun omega => X omega ^ r) mu) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (∫ omega, X omega ^ r ∂mu) =
      ∫⁻ omega, ENNReal.ofReal (X omega) ^ (r : ℝ) ∂mu
proof:
:= by
  have hpow : 0 ≤ᵐ[mu] fun omega => X omega ^ r :=
    hX.mono fun omega homega => pow_nonneg homega r
  calc
    ENNReal.ofReal (∫ omega, X omega ^ r ∂mu) =
        ∫⁻ omega, ENNReal.ofReal (X omega ^ r) ∂mu :=
      ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hInt hpow
    _ = ∫⁻ omega, ENNReal.ofReal (X omega) ^ (r : ℝ) ∂mu := by
      apply lintegral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [hX] with omega homega
      rw [ENNReal.rpow_natCast, ← ENNReal.ofReal_pow homega]

name: ProbabilityTheory.sum_integral_pow_le_strongMomentInterpolation
statement:
theorem sum_integral_pow_le_strongMomentInterpolation
    {ι Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega] (mu : Measure Omega)
    (s : Finset ι) (X : ι → Omega → ℝ)
    {q k : ℕ} (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hkq : k ≤ q)
    (hX : ∀ i ∈ s, AEMeasurable (X i) mu)
    (hXnonneg : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ᵐ[mu] X i)
    (hIntTwo : ∀ i ∈ s, Integrable (fun omega => X i omega ^ 2) mu)
    (hIntK : ∀ i ∈ s, Integrable (fun omega => X i omega ^ k) mu)
    (hIntQ : ∀ i ∈ s, Integrable (fun omega => X i omega ^ q) mu) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, ∫ omega, X i omega ^ k ∂mu ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, ∫ omega, X i omega ^ 2 ∂mu) ^
          strongMomentSecondWeight q k *
        (∑ i ∈ s, ∫ omega, X i omega ^ q ∂mu) ^
          strongMomentQWeight q k
proof:
:= by
  let a := strongMomentSecondWeight q k
  let b := strongMomentQWeight q k
  have ha : 0 ≤ a := strongMomentSecondWeight_nonneg hkq hq
  have hb : 0 ≤ b := strongMomentQWeight_nonneg hk hq
  have hmomentNonneg : ∀ (r : ℕ), ∀ i ∈ s,
      0 ≤ ∫ omega, X i omega ^ r ∂mu := by
    intro r i hi
    exact integral_nonneg_of_ae (hXnonneg i hi |>.mono fun omega homega =>
      pow_nonneg homega r)
  have hsumNonneg : ∀ (r : ℕ),
      0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, ∫ omega, X i omega ^ r ∂mu := by
    intro r
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i hi => hmomentNonneg r i hi
  have hcore := sum_lintegral_rpow_nat_le_strongMomentInterpolation
    mu s (fun i omega => ENNReal.ofReal (X i omega)) hq hk hkq
    (fun i hi => ENNReal.measurable_ofReal.comp_aemeasurable (hX i hi))
  have htwo : ∀ i ∈ s,
      ENNReal.ofReal (∫ omega, X i omega ^ 2 ∂mu) =
        ∫⁻ omega, ENNReal.ofReal (X i omega) ^ (2 : ℝ) ∂mu := by
    intro i hi
    exact ofReal_integral_pow_eq_lintegral_rpow_of_ae_nonneg
      2 (hXnonneg i hi) (hIntTwo i hi)
  have hkMoment : ∀ i ∈ s,
      ENNReal.ofReal (∫ omega, X i omega ^ k ∂mu) =
        ∫⁻ omega, ENNReal.ofReal (X i omega) ^ (k : ℝ) ∂mu := by
    intro i hi
    exact ofReal_integral_pow_eq_lintegral_rpow_of_ae_nonneg
      k (hXnonneg i hi) (hIntK i hi)
  have hqMoment : ∀ i ∈ s,
      ENNReal.ofReal (∫ omega, X i omega ^ q ∂mu) =
        ∫⁻ omega, ENNReal.ofReal (X i omega) ^ (q : ℝ) ∂mu := by
    intro i hi
    exact ofReal_integral_pow_eq_lintegral_rpow_of_ae_nonneg
      q (hXnonneg i hi) (hIntQ i hi)
  have hsumTwo :
      ENNReal.ofReal (∑ i ∈ s, ∫ omega, X i omega ^ 2 ∂mu) =
        ∑ i ∈ s,
          ∫⁻ omega, ENNReal.ofReal (X i omega) ^ (2 : ℝ) ∂mu := by
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (fun i hi => hmomentNonneg 2 i hi)]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl htwo
  have hsumK :
      ENNReal.ofReal (∑ i ∈ s, ∫ omega, X i omega ^ k ∂mu) =
        ∑ i ∈ s,
          ∫⁻ omega, ENNReal.ofReal (X i omega) ^ (k : ℝ) ∂mu := by
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (fun i hi => hmomentNonneg k i hi)]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl hkMoment
  have hsumQ :
      ENNReal.ofReal (∑ i ∈ s, ∫ omega, X i omega ^ q ∂mu) =
        ∑ i ∈ s,
          ∫⁻ omega, ENNReal.ofReal (X i omega) ^ (q : ℝ) ∂mu := by
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (fun i hi => hmomentNonneg q i hi)]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl hqMoment
  have hrhs :
      ENNReal.ofReal
          ((∑ i ∈ s, ∫ omega, X i omega ^ 2 ∂mu) ^ a *
            (∑ i ∈ s, ∫ omega, X i omega ^ q ∂mu) ^ b) =
        (∑ i ∈ s,
          ∫⁻ omega, ENNReal.ofReal (X i omega) ^ (2 : ℝ) ∂mu) ^ a *
          (∑ i ∈ s,
            ∫⁻ omega, ENNReal.ofReal (X i omega) ^ (q : ℝ) ∂mu) ^ b := by
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Real.rpow_nonneg (hsumNonneg 2) a),
      ← ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg (hsumNonneg 2) ha,
      ← ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg (hsumNonneg q) hb,
      hsumTwo, hsumQ]
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff (mul_nonneg
    (Real.rpow_nonneg (hsumNonneg 2) a)
    (Real.rpow_nonneg (hsumNonneg q) b))]
  rw [hsumK, hrhs]
  simpa [a, b] using hcore

name: ProbabilityTheory.sum_integral_pow_le_strongMomentInterpolation_of_le
statement:
theorem sum_integral_pow_le_strongMomentInterpolation_of_le
    {ι Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega] (mu : Measure Omega)
    (s : Finset ι) (X : ι → Omega → ℝ)
    {q k : ℕ} (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hkq : k ≤ q)
    (hX : ∀ i ∈ s, AEMeasurable (X i) mu)
    (hXnonneg : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ᵐ[mu] X i)
    (hIntTwo : ∀ i ∈ s, Integrable (fun omega => X i omega ^ 2) mu)
    (hIntK : ∀ i ∈ s, Integrable (fun omega => X i omega ^ k) mu)
    (hIntQ : ∀ i ∈ s, Integrable (fun omega => X i omega ^ q) mu)
    {V Q : ℝ} (hV : 0 ≤ V) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q)
    (hSecond : (∑ i ∈ s, ∫ omega, X i omega ^ 2 ∂mu) ≤ V)
    (hQMoment : (∑ i ∈ s, ∫ omega, X i omega ^ q ∂mu) ≤ Q) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, ∫ omega, X i omega ^ k ∂mu ≤
      V ^ strongMomentSecondWeight q k *
        Q ^ strongMomentQWeight q k
proof:
:= by
  have ha : 0 ≤ strongMomentSecondWeight q k :=
    strongMomentSecondWeight_nonneg hkq hq
  have hb : 0 ≤ strongMomentQWeight q k :=
    strongMomentQWeight_nonneg hk hq
  have hbase := sum_integral_pow_le_strongMomentInterpolation
    mu s X hq hk hkq hX hXnonneg hIntTwo hIntK hIntQ
  refine hbase.trans ?_
  have _hVPowerNonneg :
      0 ≤ V ^ strongMomentSecondWeight q k :=
    Real.rpow_nonneg hV _
  have hmul := mul_le_mul
    (Real.rpow_le_rpow
      (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i hi => integral_nonneg_of_ae
        ((hXnonneg i hi).mono fun omega homega => pow_nonneg homega q))
      hQMoment hb)
    (Real.rpow_le_rpow
      (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i hi => integral_nonneg_of_ae
        ((hXnonneg i hi).mono fun omega homega => pow_nonneg homega 2))
      hSecond ha)
    (Real.rpow_nonneg
      (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i hi => integral_nonneg_of_ae
        ((hXnonneg i hi).mono fun omega homega => pow_nonneg homega 2))
      (strongMomentSecondWeight q k))
    (Real.rpow_nonneg hQ (strongMomentQWeight q k))
  simpa only [mul_comm] using hmul

name: ProbabilityTheory.sum_integral_pow_max_zero_le_strongMomentInterpolation_of_le
statement:
theorem sum_integral_pow_max_zero_le_strongMomentInterpolation_of_le
    {ι Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega] (mu : Measure Omega)
    (s : Finset ι) (D : ι → Omega → ℝ)
    {q k : ℕ} (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hkq : k ≤ q)
    (hD : ∀ i ∈ s, AEMeasurable (D i) mu)
    (hIntTwo : ∀ i ∈ s,
      Integrable (fun omega => (max (D i omega) 0) ^ 2) mu)
    (hIntK : ∀ i ∈ s,
      Integrable (fun omega => (max (D i omega) 0) ^ k) mu)
    (hIntQ : ∀ i ∈ s,
      Integrable (fun omega => (max (D i omega) 0) ^ q) mu)
    {V Q : ℝ} (hV : 0 ≤ V) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q)
    (hSecond :
      (∑ i ∈ s, ∫ omega, (max (D i omega) 0) ^ 2 ∂mu) ≤ V)
    (hQMoment :
      (∑ i ∈ s, ∫ omega, (max (D i omega) 0) ^ q ∂mu) ≤ Q) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, ∫ omega, (max (D i omega) 0) ^ k ∂mu ≤
      V ^ strongMomentSecondWeight q k *
        Q ^ strongMomentQWeight q k
proof:
:= by
  apply sum_integral_pow_le_strongMomentInterpolation_of_le
    mu s (fun i omega => max (D i omega) 0)
      hq hk hkq
  · intro i hi
    exact (hD i hi).max aemeasurable_const
  · intro i hi
    exact ae_of_all mu fun omega => le_max_right (D i omega) 0
  · exact hIntTwo
  · exact hIntK
  · exact hIntQ
  · exact hV
  · exact hQ
  · exact hSecond
  · exact hQMoment

name: RandomSetTheory.finiteEvaluationPairing_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finiteEvaluationPairing_apply
    (f : C(T, ℝ)) (w : FiniteEvaluationDual T) :
    finiteEvaluationPairing T f w = (w.1 : StrongDual ℝ C(T, ℝ)) f
proof: := rfl

name: RandomSetTheory.continuous_finiteEvaluationPairing
statement:
theorem continuous_finiteEvaluationPairing :
    Continuous fun p : C(T, ℝ) × FiniteEvaluationDual T ↦
      finiteEvaluationPairing T p.1 p.2
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : Continuous fun p : C(T, ℝ) × FiniteEvaluationDual T ↦
      (p.2.1 : StrongDual ℝ C(T, ℝ)) :=
    continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd
  have hp : Continuous fun p : C(T, ℝ) × FiniteEvaluationDual T ↦
      (p.1, (p.2.1 : StrongDual ℝ C(T, ℝ))) :=
    continuous_fst.prodMk hsub
  exact (isBoundedBilinearMap_apply (E := C(T, ℝ)) (F := ℝ)).symm.continuous.comp hp

name: RandomSetTheory.finiteEvaluationPairing_ne_zero
statement:
theorem finiteEvaluationPairing_ne_zero
    {f : C(T, ℝ)} (hf : f ≠ 0) : finiteEvaluationPairing T f ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : (f : T → ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hf
    ext t
    simpa using congrFun h t
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hfun
  apply DFunLike.ne_iff.mpr
  let w : FiniteEvaluationDual T :=
    ⟨ContinuousMap.evalCLM ℝ t,
      Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self t)⟩
  exact ⟨w, by simpa [w] using ht⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.ProbabilityMeasure.tendsto_of_tight_of_finiteEvaluationChar
statement:
theorem ProbabilityMeasure.tendsto_of_tight_of_finiteEvaluationChar
    {μ : ι → ProbabilityMeasure C(T, ℝ)}
    {μ₀ : ProbabilityMeasure C(T, ℝ)}
    (htight : IsTightMeasureSet {(μ i : Measure C(T, ℝ)) | i})
    (hchar : ∀ w : FiniteEvaluationDual T,
      Tendsto
        (fun i ↦ charFunDual (μ i : Measure C(T, ℝ)) w.1)
        l
        (nhds (charFunDual (μ₀ : Measure C(T, ℝ)) w.1))) :
    Tendsto μ l (nhds μ₀)
proof:
:= by
  let A : StarSubalgebra ℂ (BoundedContinuousFunction C(T, ℝ) ℂ) :=
    BoundedContinuousFunction.charPoly continuous_probChar
      (V := C(T, ℝ)) (W := FiniteEvaluationDual T)
      (L := finiteEvaluationPairing T) (continuous_finiteEvaluationPairing T)
  apply ProbabilityMeasure.tendsto_of_tight_of_separatesPoints ℂ htight
      (A := A)
  · exact BoundedContinuousFunction.separatesPoints_charPoly
      (V := C(T, ℝ)) (W := FiniteEvaluationDual T)
      (L := finiteEvaluationPairing T)
      continuous_probChar probChar_ne_one
      (continuous_finiteEvaluationPairing T)
      (fun _ hf ↦ finiteEvaluationPairing_ne_zero T hf)
  · intro g hg
    change g ∈ BoundedContinuousFunction.charPoly continuous_probChar
      (V := C(T, ℝ)) (W := FiniteEvaluationDual T)
      (L := finiteEvaluationPairing T) (continuous_finiteEvaluationPairing T) at hg
    rw [BoundedContinuousFunction.mem_charPoly] at hg
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hg
    have hint (P : Measure C(T, ℝ)) [IsFiniteMeasure P] :
        ∫ f, g f ∂P =
          w.coeff.sum (fun a z ↦
            z * ∫ f, (probChar (finiteEvaluationPairing T f a) : ℂ) ∂P) := by
      simp_rw [hw, Finsupp.sum]
      rw [integral_finsetSum]
      · congr with a
        rw [integral_const_mul]
      · intro a ha
        refine Integrable.const_mul ?_ _
        change Integrable (BoundedContinuousFunction.char continuous_probChar
          (continuous_finiteEvaluationPairing T) a) P
        exact BoundedContinuousFunction.integrable P _
    simp_rw [hint (μ _), hint μ₀]
    refine tendsto_finsetSum _ fun a ha ↦ Tendsto.const_mul _ ?_
    simpa only [charFunDual_apply, finiteEvaluationPairing_apply,
      probChar_apply] using hchar a

name: RandomSetTheory.ProbabilityMeasure.tendsto_of_tight_of_finiteEvaluationProjections
statement:
theorem ProbabilityMeasure.tendsto_of_tight_of_finiteEvaluationProjections
    {μ : ι → ProbabilityMeasure C(T, ℝ)}
    {μ₀ : ProbabilityMeasure C(T, ℝ)}
    (htight : IsTightMeasureSet {(μ i : Measure C(T, ℝ)) | i})
    (hproj : ∀ w : FiniteEvaluationDual T,
      Tendsto
        (fun i ↦ ProbabilityMeasure.map (μ i)
          w.1.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable)
        l
        (nhds (ProbabilityMeasure.map μ₀
          w.1.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable))) :
    Tendsto μ l (nhds μ₀)
proof:
:= by
  apply ProbabilityMeasure.tendsto_of_tight_of_finiteEvaluationChar T htight
  intro w
  have h :=
    (ProbabilityMeasure.tendsto_iff_forall_integral_rclike_tendsto ℂ).1
      (hproj w) (BoundedContinuousFunction.innerProbChar (1 : ℝ))
  have hchar : Tendsto
      (fun i ↦ charFun
        (ProbabilityMeasure.map (μ i)
          w.1.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) 1)
      l
      (nhds (charFun
        (ProbabilityMeasure.map μ₀
          w.1.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) 1)) := by
    simpa only [charFun_eq_integral_innerProbChar] using h
  simpa only [ProbabilityMeasure.toMeasure_map,
    charFunDual_eq_charFun_map_one] using hchar

name: RandomSetTheory.tendstoInDistribution_of_tight_of_finiteEvaluationProjections
statement:
theorem tendstoInDistribution_of_tight_of_finiteEvaluationProjections
    (X : ι → Ω → C(T, ℝ)) (Z : Ω' → C(T, ℝ))
    (hX : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) μ)
    (hZ : AEMeasurable Z μ')
    (htight : IsTightMeasureSet {(μ.map (X i)) | i})
    (hproj : ∀ w : FiniteEvaluationDual T,
      Tendsto
        (fun i ↦ ProbabilityMeasure.map
          ⟨μ.map (X i), Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (hX i)⟩
          w.1.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable)
        l
        (nhds (ProbabilityMeasure.map
          ⟨μ'.map Z, Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hZ⟩
          w.1.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable))) :
    TendstoInDistribution X l Z (fun _ ↦ μ) μ'
proof:
:= by
  refine
    { forall_aemeasurable := hX
      aemeasurable_limit := hZ
      tendsto :=
        ProbabilityMeasure.tendsto_of_tight_of_finiteEvaluationProjections
          T htight hproj }

name: RandomSetTheory.measurable_supportFunction
statement:
theorem measurable_supportFunction
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    {S : Ω → Set E} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω)) (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    (u : E) :
    Measurable (fun ω => supportFunction (S ω) u)
proof:
:= by
  apply measurable_of_Ioi
  intro a
  have hEq : (fun ω => supportFunction (S ω) u) ⁻¹' Ioi a =
      {ω | (S ω ∩ {x : E | a < ⟪u, x⟫_ℝ}).Nonempty} := by
    ext ω
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_Ioi, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    constructor
    · intro hsup
      obtain ⟨x, hx, hxEq⟩ := supportFunction_attains (hcompact ω) (hne ω) u
      exact ⟨x, hx, by simpa [← hxEq] using hsup⟩
    · rintro ⟨x, hx, hax⟩
      exact hax.trans_le (inner_le_supportFunction (hcompact ω) hx u)
  rw [hEq]
  apply hS
  exact isOpen_lt continuous_const (by fun_prop)

name: RandomSetTheory.integrable_supportFunction_of_envelope
statement:
theorem integrable_supportFunction_of_envelope
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S : Ω → Set E} {g : Ω → ℝ}
    (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω)) (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    (hg : Integrable g μ) (hdom : ∀ ω, ∀ x ∈ S ω, ‖x‖ ≤ g ω)
    (u : E) :
    Integrable (fun ω => supportFunction (S ω) u) μ
proof:
:= by
  apply (hg.const_mul ‖u‖).mono'
    (measurable_supportFunction hS hcompact hne u).aestronglyMeasurable
  filter_upwards [] with ω
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxEq⟩ := supportFunction_attains (hcompact ω) (hne ω) u
  rw [hxEq, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  calc
    |⟪u, x⟫_ℝ| ≤ ‖u‖ * ‖x‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
    _ ≤ ‖u‖ * g ω :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hdom ω x hx) (norm_nonneg u)

name: RandomSetTheory.RandomSet.EffrosRandomClosedSet.measurable_supportFunction
statement:
theorem RandomSet.EffrosRandomClosedSet.measurable_supportFunction
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (S : RandomSet.EffrosRandomClosedSet Ω E)
    (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω)) (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    (u : E) :
    Measurable (fun ω => supportFunction (S ω) u)
proof:
:=
  RandomSetTheory.measurable_supportFunction S.measurable' hcompact hne u

name: RandomSetTheory.RandomSet.EffrosRandomClosedSet.integrable_supportFunction_of_envelope
statement:
theorem RandomSet.EffrosRandomClosedSet.integrable_supportFunction_of_envelope
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} (S : RandomSet.EffrosRandomClosedSet Ω E)
    (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω)) (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    {g : Ω → ℝ} (hg : Integrable g μ)
    (hdom : ∀ ω, ∀ x ∈ S ω, ‖x‖ ≤ g ω) (u : E) :
    Integrable (fun ω => supportFunction (S ω) u) μ
proof:

  RandomSetTheory.integrable_supportFunction_of_envelope
    S.measurable' hcompact hne hg hdom u

theorem mem_kernelAttainableZeroSet_iff

    theta ∈ kernelAttainableZeroSet mu S phi ↔

theorem mem_jointLawAttainableZeroSet_iff

name: RandomSetTheory.jointLawAttainableZeroSet_eq_kernelAttainableZeroSet
statement:
theorem jointLawAttainableZeroSet_eq_kernelAttainableZeroSet
    [StandardBorelSpace X] [Nonempty X]
    {mu : Measure O} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {S : O → Set X}
    (hgraph : MeasurableSet {p : O × X | p.2 ∈ S p.1})
    (hSmeas : ∀ o, MeasurableSet (S o))
    (phi : Theta → O × X → H) :
    jointLawAttainableZeroSet mu S phi =
      kernelAttainableZeroSet mu S phi
proof:
:= by
  ext theta
  change 0 ∈ jointLawAttainableMoments mu S (phi theta) ↔
    0 ∈ kernelAttainableMoments mu S (phi theta)
  rw [jointLawAttainableMoments_eq_kernelAttainableMoments hgraph hSmeas]

name: RandomSetTheory.kernelAttainableZeroSet_eq_setValuedZeroSet_aumann_of_atomless
statement:
theorem kernelAttainableZeroSet_eq_setValuedZeroSet_aumann_of_atomless
    [MetricSpace X] [CompleteSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    [SecondCountableTopology X] [Nonempty X]
    [CompleteSpace H] [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H]
    [SecondCountableTopology H] [FiniteDimensional ℝ H]
    {mu : Measure O} [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    (hmu : IsAtomlessMeasure mu)
    {S : O → Set X} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hSmeas : ∀ o, MeasurableSet (S o))
    (hcompact : ∀ o, IsCompact (S o)) (hne : ∀ o, (S o).Nonempty)
    (phi : Theta → O × X → H)
    (hphiMeas : ∀ theta, Measurable (phi theta))
    (hphiCont : ∀ theta o, Continuous fun x ↦ phi theta (o, x))
    (g : Theta → O → ℝ) (hg : ∀ theta, Integrable (g theta) mu)
    (hdom : ∀ theta o, ∀ x ∈ S o, ‖phi theta (o, x)‖ ≤ g theta o) :
    kernelAttainableZeroSet mu S phi =
      setValuedZeroSet (aumannMomentMap mu S phi)
proof:
:= by
  ext theta
  change 0 ∈ kernelAttainableMoments mu S (phi theta) ↔
    0 ∈ aumannExpectation mu
      (fun o ↦ (fun x ↦ phi theta (o, x)) '' S o)
  rw [kernelAttainableMoments_eq_aumannExpectation_of_atomless
    hmu hS hSmeas hcompact hne (hphiMeas theta)
      (hphiCont theta) (hg theta) (hdom theta)]

name: RandomSetTheory.jointLawAttainableZeroSet_eq_setValuedZeroSet_aumann_of_atomless
statement:
theorem jointLawAttainableZeroSet_eq_setValuedZeroSet_aumann_of_atomless
    [MetricSpace X] [CompleteSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    [SecondCountableTopology X] [Nonempty X]
    [CompleteSpace H] [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H]
    [SecondCountableTopology H] [FiniteDimensional ℝ H]
    {mu : Measure O} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu : IsAtomlessMeasure mu)
    {S : O → Set X} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hgraph : MeasurableSet {p : O × X | p.2 ∈ S p.1})
    (hSmeas : ∀ o, MeasurableSet (S o))
    (hcompact : ∀ o, IsCompact (S o)) (hne : ∀ o, (S o).Nonempty)
    (phi : Theta → O × X → H)
    (hphiMeas : ∀ theta, Measurable (phi theta))
    (hphiCont : ∀ theta o, Continuous fun x ↦ phi theta (o, x))
    (g : Theta → O → ℝ) (hg : ∀ theta, Integrable (g theta) mu)
    (hdom : ∀ theta o, ∀ x ∈ S o, ‖phi theta (o, x)‖ ≤ g theta o) :
    jointLawAttainableZeroSet mu S phi =
      setValuedZeroSet (aumannMomentMap mu S phi)
proof:
:= by
  rw [jointLawAttainableZeroSet_eq_kernelAttainableZeroSet
    hgraph hSmeas phi]
  exact kernelAttainableZeroSet_eq_setValuedZeroSet_aumann_of_atomless
    hmu hS hSmeas hcompact hne phi hphiMeas hphiCont g hg hdom

name: RandomSetTheory.continuousSupportProcess_separable
statement:
theorem continuousSupportProcess_separable
    (Θ E : Type*) [MetricSpace Θ] [CompactSpace Θ]
    [SecondCountableTopology Θ]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] :

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_le_norm_continuousSupportProcess
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_le_norm_continuousSupportProcess
    {Θ E : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Θ] [CompactSpace Θ]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {K L : Θ → Set E}
    (hKcompact : ∀ θ, IsCompact (K θ))
    (hLcompact : ∀ θ, IsCompact (L θ))
    (hKne : ∀ θ, (K θ).Nonempty)
    (hLne : ∀ θ, (L θ).Nonempty)
    (hKconv : ∀ θ, Convex ℝ (K θ))
    (hLconv : ∀ θ, Convex ℝ (L θ))
    (U : ContinuousSupportProcess Θ E)
    (hU : ∀ q : SupportProcessIndex Θ E,
      U q = supportFunction (K q.1) q.2 - supportFunction (L q.1) q.2)
    (θ : Θ) :
    hausdorffDist (K θ) (L θ) ≤ ‖U‖
proof:
:= by
  apply hausdorffDist_le_of_unitBall_supportFunction_sub_le
    (hKcompact θ) (hLcompact θ) (hKne θ) (hLne θ)
    (hKconv θ) (hLconv θ) (norm_nonneg U)
  intro u hu
  let us : Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1 :=
    ⟨u, by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hu⟩
  have hnorm := ContinuousMap.norm_coe_le_norm U (θ, us)
  rw [hU (θ, us)] at hnorm
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hnorm

name: RandomSetTheory.norm_continuousSupportProcess_eq_parameterUniformHausdorffDist
statement:
theorem norm_continuousSupportProcess_eq_parameterUniformHausdorffDist
    {Θ E : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Θ] [CompactSpace Θ] [Nonempty Θ]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {K L : Θ → Set E}
    (hKcompact : ∀ θ, IsCompact (K θ))
    (hLcompact : ∀ θ, IsCompact (L θ))
    (hKne : ∀ θ, (K θ).Nonempty)
    (hLne : ∀ θ, (L θ).Nonempty)
    (hKconv : ∀ θ, Convex ℝ (K θ))
    (hLconv : ∀ θ, Convex ℝ (L θ))
    (U : ContinuousSupportProcess Θ E)
    (hU : ∀ q : SupportProcessIndex Θ E,
      U q = supportFunction (K q.1) q.2 - supportFunction (L q.1) q.2) :
    ‖U‖ = parameterUniformHausdorffDist K L
proof:
:= by
  have hupper : ∀ θ, hausdorffDist (K θ) (L θ) ≤ ‖U‖ :=
    hausdorffDist_le_norm_continuousSupportProcess
      hKcompact hLcompact hKne hLne hKconv hLconv U hU
  have hlub : IsLUB
      (Set.range fun θ => hausdorffDist (K θ) (L θ)) ‖U‖ := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rintro _ ⟨θ, rfl⟩
      exact hupper θ
    · intro b hb
      let θ₀ : Θ := Classical.choice inferInstance
      have hb0 : 0 ≤ b :=
        hausdorffDist_nonneg.trans (hb (Set.mem_range_self θ₀))
      rw [ContinuousMap.norm_le U hb0]
      rintro ⟨θ, u⟩
      have hu : ‖(u : E)‖ ≤ 1 := by
        simpa only [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using u.property
      have hs := abs_supportFunction_sub_le_hausdorffDist
        (hKcompact θ) (hLcompact θ) (hKne θ) (hLne θ) (u : E)
      rw [hU (θ, u), Real.norm_eq_abs]
      calc
        |supportFunction (K θ) u - supportFunction (L θ) u| ≤
            ‖(u : E)‖ * hausdorffDist (K θ) (L θ) := hs
        _ ≤ 1 * hausdorffDist (K θ) (L θ) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hu hausdorffDist_nonneg
        _ ≤ b := by simpa using hb (Set.mem_range_self θ)
  exact (hlub.csSup_eq (Set.range_nonempty _)).symm

name: RandomSetTheory.IsPDonskerSupportClass.norm_eq_parameterUniformHausdorffDist
statement:
theorem norm_eq_parameterUniformHausdorffDist
    (h : IsPDonskerSupportClass μ μ' Ghat G U Z)
    (hGhatcompact : ∀ n ω θ, IsCompact (Ghat n ω θ))
    (hGcompact : ∀ θ, IsCompact (G θ))
    (hGhatne : ∀ n ω θ, (Ghat n ω θ).Nonempty)
    (hGne : ∀ θ, (G θ).Nonempty)
    (hGhatconv : ∀ n ω θ, Convex ℝ (Ghat n ω θ))
    (hGconv : ∀ θ, Convex ℝ (G θ))
    (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :
    ‖U n ω‖ = parameterUniformHausdorffDist (Ghat n ω) G
proof:
:=
  norm_continuousSupportProcess_eq_parameterUniformHausdorffDist
    (hGhatcompact n ω) hGcompact (hGhatne n ω) hGne
    (hGhatconv n ω) hGconv (U n ω) (h.supportDifference n ω)

name: RandomSetTheory.IsPDonskerSupportClass.norm_rootNScaledSupportProcess_eq
statement:
theorem norm_rootNScaledSupportProcess_eq
    (h : IsPDonskerSupportClass μ μ' Ghat G U Z)
    (hGhatcompact : ∀ n ω θ, IsCompact (Ghat n ω θ))
    (hGcompact : ∀ θ, IsCompact (G θ))
    (hGhatne : ∀ n ω θ, (Ghat n ω θ).Nonempty)
    (hGne : ∀ θ, (G θ).Nonempty)
    (hGhatconv : ∀ n ω θ, Convex ℝ (Ghat n ω θ))
    (hGconv : ∀ θ, Convex ℝ (G θ))
    (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :
    ‖rootNScaledSupportProcess U n ω‖ =
      Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) *
        parameterUniformHausdorffDist (Ghat n ω) G
proof:
:= by
  rw [rootNScaledSupportProcess, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg (n : ℝ)),
    h.norm_eq_parameterUniformHausdorffDist hGhatcompact hGcompact
      hGhatne hGne hGhatconv hGconv n ω]

name: RandomSetTheory.IsPDonskerSupportClass.rootN_parameterUniformHausdorffDist_tendstoInDistribution
statement:
theorem rootN_parameterUniformHausdorffDist_tendstoInDistribution
    (h : IsPDonskerSupportClass μ μ' Ghat G U Z)
    (hGhatcompact : ∀ n ω θ, IsCompact (Ghat n ω θ))
    (hGcompact : ∀ θ, IsCompact (G θ))
    (hGhatne : ∀ n ω θ, (Ghat n ω θ).Nonempty)
    (hGne : ∀ θ, (G θ).Nonempty)
    (hGhatconv : ∀ n ω θ, Convex ℝ (Ghat n ω θ))
    (hGconv : ∀ θ, Convex ℝ (G θ)) :
    TendstoInDistribution (fun (n : ℕ) ω =>
      Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) *
        parameterUniformHausdorffDist (Ghat n ω) G)
      atTop (fun ω => ‖Z ω‖) (fun _ => μ) μ'
proof:
:= by
  have hnorm := h.weakConvergence.continuousMap_supNorm
  apply hnorm.congr
  · intro n
    filter_upwards [] with ω
    exact h.norm_rootNScaledSupportProcess_eq
      hGhatcompact hGcompact hGhatne hGne hGhatconv hGconv n ω
  · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => rfl)

name: RandomSetTheory.IsPDonskerSupportClass.rootN_parameterUniformHausdorffDist_isBoundedInProbability
statement:
theorem rootN_parameterUniformHausdorffDist_isBoundedInProbability
    (h : IsPDonskerSupportClass μ μ' Ghat G U Z)
    (hGhatcompact : ∀ n ω θ, IsCompact (Ghat n ω θ))
    (hGcompact : ∀ θ, IsCompact (G θ))
    (hGhatne : ∀ n ω θ, (Ghat n ω θ).Nonempty)
    (hGne : ∀ θ, (G θ).Nonempty)
    (hGhatconv : ∀ n ω θ, Convex ℝ (Ghat n ω θ))
    (hGconv : ∀ θ, Convex ℝ (G θ)) :
    IsBoundedInProbability μ atTop (fun (n : ℕ) ω =>
      Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) *
        parameterUniformHausdorffDist (Ghat n ω) G)
proof:
:= by
  let Δ : ℕ → Ω → ℝ := fun n ω =>
    parameterUniformHausdorffDist (Ghat n ω) G
  apply rootN_uniformError_isBoundedInProbability_of_processCLT
    μ μ' (rootNScaledSupportProcess U) Z Δ
  · intro n ω
    change 0 ≤ parameterUniformHausdorffDist (Ghat n ω) G
    rw [← h.norm_eq_parameterUniformHausdorffDist hGhatcompact hGcompact
      hGhatne hGne hGhatconv hGconv n ω]
    exact norm_nonneg _
  · exact h.weakConvergence
  · intro n ω
    exact le_of_eq (h.norm_rootNScaledSupportProcess_eq
      hGhatcompact hGcompact hGhatne hGne hGhatconv hGconv n ω).symm

name: RandomSetTheory.IsPDonskerSupportClass.rootN_oracleEnlargedZeroSet_isBoundedInProbability
statement:
theorem rootN_oracleEnlargedZeroSet_isBoundedInProbability
    (h : IsPDonskerSupportClass μ μ' Ghat G U Z)
    (hGhatcompact : ∀ n ω θ, IsCompact (Ghat n ω θ))
    (hGcompact : ∀ θ, IsCompact (G θ))
    (hGhatne : ∀ n ω θ, (Ghat n ω θ).Nonempty)
    (hGne : ∀ θ, (G θ).Nonempty)
    (hGhatconv : ∀ n ω θ, Convex ℝ (Ghat n ω θ))
    (hGconv : ∀ θ, Convex ℝ (G θ))
    {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 < κ)
    (herror : ∀ θ,
      κ * infDist θ (setValuedZeroSet G) ≤ infDist 0 (G θ)) :
    IsBoundedInProbability μ atTop (fun (n : ℕ) ω =>
      Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) * hausdorffDist
        (enlargedSetValuedZeroSet (Ghat n ω)
          (parameterUniformHausdorffDist (Ghat n ω) G))
        (setValuedZeroSet G))
proof:
:= by
  let Δ : ℕ → Ω → ℝ := fun n ω =>
    parameterUniformHausdorffDist (Ghat n ω) G
  have hΔ : ∀ n ω, 0 ≤ Δ n ω := by
    intro n ω
    change 0 ≤ parameterUniformHausdorffDist (Ghat n ω) G
    rw [← h.norm_eq_parameterUniformHausdorffDist hGhatcompact hGcompact
      hGhatne hGne hGhatconv hGconv n ω]
    exact norm_nonneg _
  have hhaus : ∀ n ω θ,
      hausdorffDist (Ghat n ω θ) (G θ) ≤ Δ n ω := by
    intro n ω θ
    calc
      hausdorffDist (Ghat n ω θ) (G θ) ≤ ‖U n ω‖ :=
        hausdorffDist_le_norm_continuousSupportProcess
          (hGhatcompact n ω) hGcompact (hGhatne n ω) hGne
          (hGhatconv n ω) hGconv (U n ω) (h.supportDifference n ω) θ
      _ = Δ n ω :=
        h.norm_eq_parameterUniformHausdorffDist hGhatcompact hGcompact
          hGhatne hGne hGhatconv hGconv n ω
  have hfin : ∀ n ω θ,
      hausdorffEDist (Ghat n ω θ) (G θ) ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro n ω θ
    exact hausdorffEDist_ne_top_of_nonempty_of_bounded
      (hGhatne n ω θ) (hGne θ)
      (hGhatcompact n ω θ).isBounded (hGcompact θ).isBounded
  apply rootN_enlargedZeroSet_of_processCLT
    μ μ' (rootNScaledSupportProcess U) Z Ghat G Δ
    hΔ h.weakConvergence
  · intro n ω
    exact le_of_eq (h.norm_rootNScaledSupportProcess_eq
      hGhatcompact hGcompact hGhatne hGne hGhatconv hGconv n ω).symm
  · exact hκ
  · exact hfin
  · exact hhaus
  · exact herror

name: ProbabilityTheory.conditionalValueAtRisk_iSup_finiteCoordinateSumProcess_le_rioConfidence
statement:
theorem conditionalValueAtRisk_iSup_finiteCoordinateSumProcess_le_rioConfidence
    {mu : Measure Omega} {nu : Measure Z}
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    [StandardBorelSpace Z] [Nonempty Z] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (z0 : Z) (Y : Nat -> Omega -> Z)
    (hY : forall i, Measurable (Y i)) (hIndep : iIndepFun Y mu)
    (n q : Nat) (hq : 3 <= q)
    (W : Fin n -> Z -> T -> Real) (A : Fin n -> Z -> Real)
    (hYlaw : forall i, i < n -> mu.map (Y i) = nu)
    (hWmeas : forall j t, Measurable (fun z => W j z t))
    (hWcontinuous : forall j z, Continuous (W j z))
    (hAq : forall j, MemLp (A j) q nu)
    (hA : forall j z, 0 <= A j z)
    (hdom : forall j z t, abs (W j z t) <= A j z)
    {V Q alpha : Real} (hV : 0 < V) (hQ : 0 < Q)
    (hsecond :
      (∑ i : Fin n, replaceOneCenteredMoment nu (A i) 2) <= V)
    (hmomentQ :
      (∑ i : Fin n, replaceOneCenteredMoment nu (A i) q) <= Q)
    (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha < 1) :
    conditionalValueAtRisk alpha
        (fun omega =>
          (⨆ t, finiteCoordinateSumProcess Y W t omega) -
            ∫ z, (⨆ t, finiteCoordinateSumProcess Y W t z) ∂mu) mu <=
      rioStrongMomentConfidenceRadius q V Q alpha
proof:
:= by
  let F : Omega -> T -> Real := fun omega t =>
    finiteCoordinateSumProcess Y W t omega
  let B : Omega -> Real := fun omega => ∑ j : Fin n, A j (Y j omega)
  have hqone : (1 : ENNReal) <= (q : ENNReal) := by
    exact_mod_cast (show 1 <= q by omega)
  have hAint : forall j, Integrable (A j) nu := by
    intro j
    exact ((hAq j).mono_exponent hqone).integrable (by norm_num)
  have hBint : Integrable B mu := by
    apply integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ
    intro j _hj
    have hjmap : Integrable (A j) (mu.map (Y j)) := by
      rw [hYlaw j j.isLt]
      exact hAint j
    simpa only [B, Function.comp_def] using
      hjmap.comp_measurable (hY j)
  have hFcontinuous : forall omega, Continuous (F omega) := by
    intro omega
    exact continuous_finsetSum Finset.univ fun j _ =>
      hWcontinuous j (Y j omega)
  have hFmeas : forall k,
      Measurable (fun omega => F omega (denseSeq T k)) := by
    intro k
    exact measurable_finiteCoordinateSumProcess Y hY W (denseSeq T k)
      (fun j => hWmeas j (denseSeq T k))
  have hFdom : forall omega t, abs (F omega t) <= abs (B omega) := by
    intro omega t
    have hsum : abs (∑ j : Fin n, W j (Y j omega) t) <=
        ∑ j : Fin n, A j (Y j omega) := by
      calc
        abs (∑ j : Fin n, W j (Y j omega) t) <=
            ∑ j : Fin n, abs (W j (Y j omega) t) :=
          Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
        _ <= ∑ j : Fin n, A j (Y j omega) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => hdom j (Y j omega) t
    have hBnonneg : 0 <= B omega :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => hA j (Y j omega)
    simpa only [F, finiteCoordinateSumProcess, B, abs_of_nonneg hBnonneg]
      using hsum
  apply RandomSetTheory.conditionalValueAtRisk_centered_iSup_le_of_densePrefixes
    F B hFcontinuous hFmeas hBint hFdom halpha0 halpha1.le
  intro m
  let Wdense : Fin n -> Z -> Nat -> Real :=
    fun j z k => W j z (denseSeq T k)
  have hfinite :=
    conditionalValueAtRisk_finiteCoordinateSumSupremum_le_rioConfidence
      z0 Y hY hIndep (Finset.range (m + 1))
      Finset.nonempty_range_add_one n q hq Wdense A hYlaw
      (fun j k _hk => hWmeas j (denseSeq T k)) hAq hA
      (fun j z k _hk => hdom j z (denseSeq T k))
      hV hQ hsecond hmomentQ halpha0 halpha1
  simpa only [F, Wdense, finiteCoordinateSumProcess,
    RandomSetTheory.densePrefixSupremum_eq_sup'_range,
    finiteCoordinateSumSupremum] using hfinite

name: ProbabilityTheory.finiteSupAbsEvent_prod_finiteUniformAbsLeEvent_subset
statement:
theorem finiteSupAbsEvent_prod_finiteUniformAbsLeEvent_subset
    (X : Omega → T → ℝ) (Y : Omega' → T → ℝ)
    (N : Finset T) {r : ℝ} :
    finiteSupAbsEvent X N (2 * r) ×ˢ finiteUniformAbsLeEvent Y N r ⊆
      finitePairedDifferenceEvent X Y N r
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨hx, hy⟩ := hz
  obtain ⟨t, htN, ht⟩ := mem_finiteSupAbsEvent.1 hx
  have hy_t : |Y z.2 t| ≤ r :=
    (mem_finiteUniformAbsLeEvent.1 hy) t htN
  apply mem_finitePairedDifferenceEvent.2
  refine ⟨t, htN, ?_⟩
  have hreverse : |X z.1 t| - |Y z.2 t| ≤ |X z.1 t - Y z.2 t| :=
    abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub _ _
  linarith

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_mul_finiteUniformAbsLeEvent_le_pairedDifference
statement:
theorem measureReal_mul_finiteUniformAbsLeEvent_le_pairedDifference
    [IsFiniteMeasure mu] [IsFiniteMeasure nu]
    (X : Omega → T → ℝ) (Y : Omega' → T → ℝ)
    (N : Finset T) {r : ℝ} :
    mu.real (finiteSupAbsEvent X N (2 * r)) *
        nu.real (finiteUniformAbsLeEvent Y N r) ≤
      (mu.prod nu).real (finitePairedDifferenceEvent X Y N r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← measureReal_prod_prod]
  exact measureReal_mono
    (finiteSupAbsEvent_prod_finiteUniformAbsLeEvent_subset X Y N)

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_finiteSupAbsEvent_le_of_ghost
statement:
theorem measureReal_finiteSupAbsEvent_le_of_ghost
    [IsFiniteMeasure mu] [IsFiniteMeasure nu]
    (X : Omega → T → ℝ) (Y : Omega' → T → ℝ)
    (N : Finset T) {r p delta : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p)
    (hgood : p ≤ nu.real (finiteUniformAbsLeEvent Y N r))
    (hpair : (mu.prod nu).real (finitePairedDifferenceEvent X Y N r) ≤ delta) :
    mu.real (finiteSupAbsEvent X N (2 * r)) ≤ delta / p
proof:
:= by
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hp).2
  calc
    mu.real (finiteSupAbsEvent X N (2 * r)) * p ≤
        mu.real (finiteSupAbsEvent X N (2 * r)) *
          nu.real (finiteUniformAbsLeEvent Y N r) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hgood measureReal_nonneg
    _ ≤ (mu.prod nu).real (finitePairedDifferenceEvent X Y N r) :=
      measureReal_mul_finiteUniformAbsLeEvent_le_pairedDifference X Y N
    _ ≤ delta := hpair

name: ProbabilityTheory.finiteEmpiricalSum_sub_finiteEmpiricalSum
statement:
theorem finiteEmpiricalSum_sub_finiteEmpiricalSum
    (X : ι → Omega → T → ℝ) (Y : ι → Omega' → T → ℝ)
    (s : Finset ι) (omega : Omega) (omega' : Omega') (t : T) :
    finiteEmpiricalSum X s omega t - finiteEmpiricalSum Y s omega' t =
      ∑ i ∈ s, (X i omega t - Y i omega' t)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [finiteEmpiricalSum, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]

name: ProbabilityTheory.hasSymmetricLaw_ghostDifference
statement:
theorem hasSymmetricLaw_ghostDifference [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {X : Omega → ℝ} (hX : Measurable X) :
    HasSymmetricLaw (fun z : Omega × Omega ↦ X z.1 - X z.2) (mu.prod mu)
proof:
:= by
  let D : Omega × Omega → ℝ := fun z ↦ X z.1 - X z.2
  have hD : Measurable D :=
    (hX.comp measurable_fst).sub (hX.comp measurable_snd)
  refine {
    aemeasurable_fst := hD.aemeasurable
    aemeasurable_snd := hD.neg.aemeasurable
    map_eq := ?_ }
  calc
    Measure.map D (mu.prod mu) =
        Measure.map D (Measure.map Prod.swap (mu.prod mu)) := by
      rw [Measure.prod_swap]
    _ = Measure.map (D ∘ Prod.swap) (mu.prod mu) := by
      rw [Measure.map_map hD measurable_swap]
    _ = Measure.map (-D) (mu.prod mu) := by
      apply Measure.map_congr
      filter_upwards [] with z
      simp [D]

name: ProbabilityTheory.identDistrib_finset_sum_of_independent_coordinates
statement:
theorem identDistrib_finset_sum_of_independent_coordinates
    [Countable ι]
    (X : ι → Omega → ℝ) (Y : ι → Omega' → ℝ)
    (hXY : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (Y i) mu nu)
    (hX_indep : iIndepFun X mu) (hY_indep : iIndepFun Y nu)
    (s : Finset ι) :
    IdentDistrib (fun omega ↦ ∑ i ∈ s, X i omega)
      (fun omega ↦ ∑ i ∈ s, Y i omega) mu nu
proof:
:= by
  have hpi := IdentDistrib.pi hXY hX_indep hY_indep
  have hsum : Measurable (fun x : ι → ℝ ↦ ∑ i ∈ s, x i) := by
    fun_prop
  simpa [Function.comp_def] using hpi.comp hsum

name: ProbabilityTheory.identDistrib_finset_sum_sign_mul_of_independent_symmetric
statement:
theorem identDistrib_finset_sum_sign_mul_of_independent_symmetric
    [Countable ι]
    (X : ι → Omega → ℝ) (hX_indep : iIndepFun X mu)
    (hX_symm : ∀ i, HasSymmetricLaw (X i) mu)
    (sign : ι → ℝ) (hsign : ∀ i, sign i = 1 ∨ sign i = -1)
    (s : Finset ι) :
    IdentDistrib (fun omega ↦ ∑ i ∈ s, X i omega)
      (fun omega ↦ ∑ i ∈ s, sign i * X i omega) mu mu
proof:
:= by
  have hcoord : ∀ i,
      IdentDistrib (X i) (fun omega ↦ sign i * X i omega) mu mu := by
    intro i
    rcases hsign i with hi | hi
    · rw [hi]
      simpa using IdentDistrib.refl (hX_symm i).aemeasurable_fst
    · rw [hi]
      simp only [neg_one_mul]
      change IdentDistrib (X i) (-X i) mu mu
      exact hX_symm i
  have hsigned_indep :
      iIndepFun (fun i omega ↦ sign i * X i omega) mu := by
    have hcomp := hX_indep.comp
      (fun i (x : ℝ) ↦ sign i * x)
      (fun _ ↦ measurable_const.mul measurable_id)
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using hcomp
  exact identDistrib_finset_sum_of_independent_coordinates
    X (fun i omega ↦ sign i * X i omega)
      hcoord hX_indep hsigned_indep s

name: ProbabilityTheory.hasSymmetricFiniteLaw_ghostDifference
statement:
theorem hasSymmetricFiniteLaw_ghostDifference [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : Omega → T → ℝ) (N : Finset T)
    (hX : ∀ t ∈ N, Measurable (fun omega ↦ X omega t)) :
    HasSymmetricFiniteLaw
      (fun z : Omega × Omega ↦ fun t ↦ X z.1 t - X z.2 t)
      N (mu.prod mu)
proof:
:= by
  let D : Omega × Omega → (N → ℝ) :=
    fun z t ↦ X z.1 t - X z.2 t
  have hD : Measurable D := by
    apply measurable_pi_lambda
    intro t
    exact ((hX t t.property).comp measurable_fst).sub
      ((hX t t.property).comp measurable_snd)
  change IdentDistrib D (-D) (mu.prod mu) (mu.prod mu)
  refine {
    aemeasurable_fst := hD.aemeasurable
    aemeasurable_snd := hD.neg.aemeasurable
    map_eq := ?_ }
  calc
    Measure.map D (mu.prod mu) =
        Measure.map D (Measure.map Prod.swap (mu.prod mu)) := by
      rw [Measure.prod_swap]
    _ = Measure.map (D ∘ Prod.swap) (mu.prod mu) := by
      rw [Measure.map_map hD measurable_swap]
    _ = Measure.map (-D) (mu.prod mu) := by
      apply Measure.map_congr
      filter_upwards [] with z
      funext t
      simp [D]

name: ProbabilityTheory.identDistrib_finiteProcessSum_sign_mul_of_independent_symmetric
statement:
theorem identDistrib_finiteProcessSum_sign_mul_of_independent_symmetric
    [Countable ι]
    (X : ι → Omega → T → ℝ) (N : Finset T)
    (hX_indep : iIndepFun
      (fun i omega (t : N) ↦ X i omega t) mu)
    (hX_symm : ∀ i, HasSymmetricFiniteLaw (X i) N mu)
    (sign : ι → ℝ) (hsign : ∀ i, sign i = 1 ∨ sign i = -1)
    (s : Finset ι) :
    IdentDistrib
      (fun omega (t : N) ↦ ∑ i ∈ s, X i omega t)
      (fun omega (t : N) ↦ ∑ i ∈ s, sign i * X i omega t)
      mu mu
proof:
:= by
  let V : ι → Omega → (N → ℝ) :=
    fun i omega t ↦ X i omega t
  let W : ι → Omega → (N → ℝ) :=
    fun i omega t ↦ sign i * X i omega t
  have hcoord : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (V i) (W i) mu mu := by
    intro i
    rcases hsign i with hi | hi
    · have hrefl := IdentDistrib.refl (hX_symm i).aemeasurable_fst
      simpa [V, W, hi] using hrefl
    · have hsymm := hX_symm i
      simpa [HasSymmetricFiniteLaw, V, W, hi] using hsymm
  have hW_indep : iIndepFun W mu := by
    have hcomp := hX_indep.comp
      (fun i (x : N → ℝ) t ↦ sign i * x t)
      (fun _ ↦ by fun_prop)
    simpa [V, W, Function.comp_def] using hcomp
  have hpi := IdentDistrib.pi hcoord (by simpa [V] using hX_indep) hW_indep
  have hsum : Measurable
      (fun x : ι → (N → ℝ) ↦ fun t ↦ ∑ i ∈ s, x i t) := by
    fun_prop
  simpa [V, W, Function.comp_def] using hpi.comp hsum

name: ProbabilityTheory.identDistrib_finiteProcessSum_randomSigns_conditionally
statement:
theorem identDistrib_finiteProcessSum_randomSigns_conditionally
    [Countable ι]
    (X : ι → Omega → T → ℝ) (N : Finset T)
    (hX_indep : iIndepFun
      (fun i omega (t : N) ↦ X i omega t) mu)
    (hX_symm : ∀ i, HasSymmetricFiniteLaw (X i) N mu)
    (epsilon : Omega' → ι → ℝ)
    (hepsilon : ∀ eta i, epsilon eta i = 1 ∨ epsilon eta i = -1)
    (s : Finset ι) (eta : Omega') :
    IdentDistrib
      (fun omega (t : N) ↦ ∑ i ∈ s, X i omega t)
      (fun omega (t : N) ↦ ∑ i ∈ s, epsilon eta i * X i omega t)
      mu mu
proof:
:=
  identDistrib_finiteProcessSum_sign_mul_of_independent_symmetric
    X N hX_indep hX_symm (epsilon eta) (hepsilon eta) s

statement:
theorem measureReal_rademacher_finset_sum_abs_gt_le

      2 * exp (-r ^ 2 /
        (2 * (↑(∑ i ∈ s, rademacherSqProxy (a i)) : ℝ)))

    epsilon a h_indep s hR).measureReal_abs_gt_le hr

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_finiteSupAbsEvent_le_of_subgaussian
statement:
theorem measureReal_finiteSupAbsEvent_le_of_subgaussian
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : Omega → T → ℝ) (N : Finset T) (c : T → ℝ≥0)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hX : ∀ t ∈ N, HasSubgaussianMGF (fun omega ↦ X omega t) (c t) mu) :
    mu.real (finiteSupAbsEvent X N r) ≤
      ∑ t ∈ N, 2 * exp (-r ^ 2 / (2 * (c t : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    mu.real (finiteSupAbsEvent X N r) ≤
        ∑ t ∈ N, mu.real {omega | r < |X omega t|} := by
      simpa only [finiteSupAbsEvent] using
        (measureReal_biUnion_finset_le (μ := mu) N
          (fun t ↦ {omega | r < |X omega t|}))
    _ ≤ ∑ t ∈ N, 2 * exp (-r ^ 2 / (2 * (c t : ℝ))) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun t ht ↦ (hX t ht).measureReal_abs_gt_le hr

theorem measureReal_finiteRademacherClass_le

    (h_indep : iIndepFun epsilon mu)
    (s : Finset ι) (hR : ∀ i ∈ s, IsRademacher (epsilon i) mu)

    mu.real (finiteSupAbsEvent
        (fun omega t ↦ ∑ i ∈ s, a t i * epsilon i omega) N r) ≤
      ∑ t ∈ N, 2 * exp (-r ^ 2 /
        (2 * (↑(∑ i ∈ s, rademacherSqProxy (a t i)) : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  refine measureReal_finiteSupAbsEvent_le_of_subgaussian
    (fun omega t ↦ ∑ i ∈ s, a t i * epsilon i omega) N
    (fun t ↦ ∑ i ∈ s, rademacherSqProxy (a t i)) hr ?_
  intro t _ht
  exact hasSubgaussianMGF_rademacher_finset_sum
    epsilon (a t) h_indep s hR
