name: ProbabilityTheory.absoluteMoment_nonneg
statement:
theorem absoluteMoment_nonneg (X : Ω → ℝ) (q : ℕ) (μ : Measure Ω) :
    0 ≤ absoluteMoment X q μ
proof:
:=
  integral_nonneg fun _ => pow_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) _

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_abs_ge_le_absoluteMoment_div
statement:
theorem measureReal_abs_ge_le_absoluteMoment_div
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (X : Ω → ℝ) (q : ℕ)
    (hX : Integrable (fun ω => |X ω| ^ q) μ)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ |X ω|} ≤ absoluteMoment X q μ / t ^ q
proof:
:= by
  let f : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => |X ω| ^ q / t ^ q
  have htq : 0 < t ^ q := pow_pos ht q
  have hfint : Integrable f μ := hX.div_const _
  have hfnn : 0 ≤ᵐ[μ] f := ae_of_all μ fun ω =>
    div_nonneg (pow_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) _) htq.le
  have hs : ∀ ω ∈ {ω | t ≤ |X ω|}, 1 ≤ f ω := by
    intro ω hω
    change 1 ≤ |X ω| ^ q / t ^ q
    rw [le_div_iff₀ htq]
    simpa using pow_le_pow_left₀ ht.le hω q
  have hmarkov : μ {ω | t ≤ |X ω|} ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (∫ ω, f ω ∂μ) :=
    hfint.measure_le_integral hfnn hs
  have htop : μ {ω | t ≤ |X ω|} ≠ ∞ := measure_ne_top μ _
  have hreal := ENNReal.toReal_le_toReal htop (by finiteness) |>.2 hmarkov
  have hmomentnn : 0 ≤ absoluteMoment X q μ := absoluteMoment_nonneg X q μ
  have hrhs : 0 ≤ absoluteMoment X q μ / t ^ q :=
    div_nonneg hmomentnn htq.le
  have hintf : (∫ ω, f ω ∂μ) = absoluteMoment X q μ / t ^ q := by
    simp only [f, absoluteMoment, integral_div]
  rw [hintf, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hrhs] at hreal
  exact hreal

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_abs_ge_le_of_absoluteMoment_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_abs_ge_le_of_absoluteMoment_le
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (X : Ω → ℝ) {q : ℕ}
    (hX : Integrable (fun ω => |X ω| ^ q) μ)
    {M t : ℝ} (hM : absoluteMoment X q μ ≤ M) (ht : 0 < t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ |X ω|} ≤ M / t ^ q
proof:
:= by
  exact (measureReal_abs_ge_le_absoluteMoment_div X q hX ht).trans
    (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hM (pow_nonneg ht.le q))

name: ProbabilityTheory.abs_finset_sum_pow_le
statement:
theorem abs_finset_sum_pow_le
    (x : ι → ℝ) (s : Finset ι) {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) :
    |∑ i ∈ s, x i| ^ q ≤
      (s.card : ℝ) ^ (q - 1) * ∑ i ∈ s, |x i| ^ q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hq.ne'
  calc
    |∑ i ∈ s, x i| ^ (n + 1) ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, |x i|) ^ (n + 1) := by
      gcongr
      exact abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ ≤ (s.card : ℝ) ^ n * ∑ i ∈ s, |x i| ^ (n + 1) := by
      exact pow_sum_le_card_mul_sum_pow (s := s) (f := fun i => |x i|)
        (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _) n
    _ = (s.card : ℝ) ^ ((n + 1) - 1) *
        ∑ i ∈ s, |x i| ^ (n + 1) := by simp

name: ProbabilityTheory.integrable_abs_finset_sum_pow
statement:
theorem integrable_abs_finset_sum_pow
    (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (s : Finset ι) {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hX : ∀ i ∈ s, AEMeasurable (X i) μ)
    (hXq : ∀ i ∈ s, Integrable (fun ω => |X i ω| ^ q) μ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => |∑ i ∈ s, X i ω| ^ q) μ
proof:
:= by
  let g : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => ∑ i ∈ s, |X i ω| ^ q
  have hgint : Integrable g μ := by
    exact integrable_finsetSum s fun i hi => hXq i hi
  have hmajorant : Integrable (fun ω => (s.card : ℝ) ^ (q - 1) * g ω) μ :=
    hgint.const_mul _
  have hsumMeas : AEMeasurable (fun ω => ∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) μ :=
    Finset.aemeasurable_fun_sum s hX
  apply Integrable.mono' hmajorant (hsumMeas.abs.pow_const q).aestronglyMeasurable
  filter_upwards with ω
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (pow_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) _)]
  exact abs_finset_sum_pow_le (fun i => X i ω) s hq

name: ProbabilityTheory.absoluteMoment_finset_sum_le
statement:
theorem absoluteMoment_finset_sum_le
    (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (s : Finset ι) {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hX : ∀ i ∈ s, AEMeasurable (X i) μ)
    (hXq : ∀ i ∈ s, Integrable (fun ω => |X i ω| ^ q) μ) :
    absoluteMoment (fun ω => ∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) q μ ≤
      (s.card : ℝ) ^ (q - 1) * ∑ i ∈ s, absoluteMoment (X i) q μ
proof:
:= by
  let g : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => ∑ i ∈ s, |X i ω| ^ q
  have hgint : Integrable g μ := by
    exact integrable_finsetSum s fun i hi => hXq i hi
  have hmajorant : Integrable (fun ω => (s.card : ℝ) ^ (q - 1) * g ω) μ :=
    hgint.const_mul _
  have htarget : Integrable (fun ω => |∑ i ∈ s, X i ω| ^ q) μ :=
    integrable_abs_finset_sum_pow X s hq hX hXq
  unfold absoluteMoment
  calc
    (∫ ω, |∑ i ∈ s, X i ω| ^ q ∂μ) ≤
        ∫ ω, (s.card : ℝ) ^ (q - 1) * g ω ∂μ := by
      apply integral_mono htarget hmajorant
      intro ω
      exact abs_finset_sum_pow_le (fun i => X i ω) s hq
    _ = (s.card : ℝ) ^ (q - 1) *
        ∑ i ∈ s, ∫ ω, |X i ω| ^ q ∂μ := by
      rw [integral_const_mul]
      congr 1
      exact integral_finsetSum s hXq

name: ProbabilityTheory.absoluteMoment_finset_average_le
statement:
theorem absoluteMoment_finset_average_le
    (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hX : ∀ i ∈ s, AEMeasurable (X i) μ)
    (hXq : ∀ i ∈ s, Integrable (fun ω => |X i ω| ^ q) μ) :
    absoluteMoment (fun ω => (∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) / (s.card : ℝ)) q μ ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, absoluteMoment (X i) q μ) / (s.card : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : 0 < (s.card : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Finset.card_pos.mpr hs
  have hsum := absoluteMoment_finset_sum_le X s hq hX hXq
  have havg :
      absoluteMoment (fun ω => (∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) / (s.card : ℝ)) q μ =
        absoluteMoment (fun ω => ∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) q μ / (s.card : ℝ) ^ q := by
    unfold absoluteMoment
    simp only [abs_div, abs_of_pos hcard, div_pow, integral_div]
  rw [havg]
  calc
    absoluteMoment (fun ω => ∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) q μ / (s.card : ℝ) ^ q ≤
        ((s.card : ℝ) ^ (q - 1) *
          ∑ i ∈ s, absoluteMoment (X i) q μ) / (s.card : ℝ) ^ q :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hsum (pow_nonneg hcard.le q)
    _ = (∑ i ∈ s, absoluteMoment (X i) q μ) / (s.card : ℝ) := by
      obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hq.ne'
      simp only [Nat.succ_sub_one, pow_succ]
      field_simp

name: ProbabilityTheory.markov_finset_average_abs_real
statement:
theorem markov_finset_average_abs_real
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hX : ∀ i ∈ s, AEMeasurable (X i) μ)
    (hXq : ∀ i ∈ s, Integrable (fun ω => |X i ω| ^ q) μ)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ |(∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) / (s.card : ℝ)|} ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, absoluteMoment (X i) q μ) /
        ((s.card : ℝ) * t ^ q)
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : 0 < (s.card : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Finset.card_pos.mpr hs
  have hsumInt := integrable_abs_finset_sum_pow X s hq hX hXq
  have hsumMoment := absoluteMoment_finset_sum_le X s hq hX hXq
  have htail := measureReal_abs_ge_le_absoluteMoment_div
    (μ := μ) (fun ω => ∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) q hsumInt (mul_pos hcard ht)
  have hset :
      {ω | t ≤ |(∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) / (s.card : ℝ)|} =
        {ω | (s.card : ℝ) * t ≤ |∑ i ∈ s, X i ω|} := by
    ext ω
    simp only [mem_setOf_eq, abs_div, abs_of_pos hcard]
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hcard]
    simp only [mul_comm]
  rw [hset]
  calc
    μ.real {ω | (s.card : ℝ) * t ≤ |∑ i ∈ s, X i ω|} ≤
        absoluteMoment (fun ω => ∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) q μ /
          ((s.card : ℝ) * t) ^ q := htail
    _ ≤ ((s.card : ℝ) ^ (q - 1) *
          ∑ i ∈ s, absoluteMoment (X i) q μ) /
          ((s.card : ℝ) * t) ^ q :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hsumMoment
        (pow_nonneg (mul_nonneg hcard.le ht.le) q)
    _ = (∑ i ∈ s, absoluteMoment (X i) q μ) /
          ((s.card : ℝ) * t ^ q) := by
      obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hq.ne'
      simp only [Nat.succ_sub_one, mul_pow, pow_succ]
      field_simp

name: ProbabilityTheory.markov_finset_average_abs_real_of_common_bound
statement:
theorem markov_finset_average_abs_real_of_common_bound
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hX : ∀ i ∈ s, AEMeasurable (X i) μ)
    (hXq : ∀ i ∈ s, Integrable (fun ω => |X i ω| ^ q) μ)
    {M t : ℝ}
    (hM : ∀ i ∈ s, absoluteMoment (X i) q μ ≤ M)
    (ht : 0 < t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ |(∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) / (s.card : ℝ)|} ≤ M / t ^ q
proof:
:= by
  have h := markov_finset_average_abs_real X s hs hq hX hXq ht
  calc
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ |(∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) / (s.card : ℝ)|} ≤
        (∑ i ∈ s, absoluteMoment (X i) q μ) /
          ((s.card : ℝ) * t ^ q) := h
    _ ≤ ((s.card : ℝ) * M) / ((s.card : ℝ) * t ^ q) := by
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
      · simpa only [← nsmul_eq_mul, ← Finset.sum_const] using
          (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => hM i hi)
      · positivity
    _ = M / t ^ q := by
      have hcard : (s.card : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
        exact_mod_cast (Finset.card_ne_zero.mpr hs)
      field_simp

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_exists_gt_le_card_mul_pow_div
statement:
theorem measureReal_exists_gt_le_card_mul_pow_div
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (s : Finset ι) {q : ℕ}
    (hXq : ∀ i ∈ s, Integrable (fun ω ↦ |X i ω| ^ q) μ)
    {K t : ℝ} (hK : ∀ i ∈ s, absoluteMoment (X i) q μ ≤ K ^ q)
    (ht : 0 < t) :
    μ.real {ω | ∃ i ∈ s, t < X i ω} ≤
      s.card * (K ^ q / t ^ q)
proof:
:= by
  have hset : {ω | ∃ i ∈ s, t < X i ω} =
      ⋃ i ∈ s, {ω | t < X i ω} := by
    ext ω
    simp
  rw [hset]
  calc
    μ.real (⋃ i ∈ s, {ω | t < X i ω}) ≤
        ∑ i ∈ s, μ.real {ω | t < X i ω} :=
      measureReal_biUnion_finset_le s _
    _ ≤ ∑ _i ∈ s, K ^ q / t ^ q := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i hi
      have hsubset : {ω | t < X i ω} ⊆ {ω | t ≤ |X i ω|} := by
        intro ω hω
        exact hω.le.trans (le_abs_self (X i ω))
      exact (measureReal_mono hsubset (by finiteness)).trans
        (measureReal_abs_ge_le_of_absoluteMoment_le
          (X i) (hXq i hi) (hK i hi) ht)
    _ = s.card * (K ^ q / t ^ q) := by simp

name: ProbabilityTheory.one_sub_le_measureReal_forall_le_mul_card_div_rpow
statement:
theorem one_sub_le_measureReal_forall_le_mul_card_div_rpow
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hX : ∀ i ∈ s, AEMeasurable (X i) μ)
    (hXq : ∀ i ∈ s, Integrable (fun ω ↦ |X i ω| ^ q) μ)
    {K δ : ℝ} (hKpos : 0 < K)
    (hK : ∀ i ∈ s, absoluteMoment (X i) q μ ≤ K ^ q)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    1 - δ ≤ μ.real {ω | ∀ i ∈ s,
      X i ω ≤ K * ((s.card : ℝ) / δ) ^ (1 / (q : ℝ))}
proof:
:= by
  let r : ℝ := (s.card : ℝ) / δ
  let t : ℝ := K * r ^ (1 / (q : ℝ))
  let B : Set Ω := {ω | ∃ i ∈ s, t < X i ω}
  have hcard : 0 < (s.card : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast s.card_pos.mpr hs
  have hqreal : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hr : 0 < r := div_pos hcard hδ
  have ht : 0 < t := mul_pos hKpos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hr _)
  have hroot_pow : (r ^ (1 / (q : ℝ))) ^ q = r := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hr.le]
    rw [one_div, inv_mul_cancel₀ hqreal.ne', Real.rpow_one]
  have ht_pow : t ^ q = K ^ q * r := by
    simp only [t, mul_pow, hroot_pow]
  have hbad : μ.real B ≤ δ := by
    have htail := measureReal_exists_gt_le_card_mul_pow_div
      X s hXq hK ht
    calc
      μ.real B ≤ s.card * (K ^ q / t ^ q) := by
        simpa only [B] using htail
      _ = δ := by
        rw [ht_pow]
        have hKpow : K ^ q ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero q hKpos.ne'
        dsimp only [r]
        field_simp
  have hBnull : NullMeasurableSet B μ := by
    have hunion : B = ⋃ i ∈ s, {ω | t < X i ω} := by
      ext ω
      simp [B]
    rw [hunion]
    apply s.nullMeasurableSet_biUnion
    intro i hi
    exact (hX i hi).nullMeasurableSet_preimage measurableSet_Ioi
  have hsum := measureReal_add_measureReal_compl₀ hBnull
  have hcompl : Bᶜ = {ω | ∀ i ∈ s, X i ω ≤ t} := by
    ext ω
    simp [B, not_lt]
  rw [probReal_univ, hcompl] at hsum
  dsimp only [t, r] at hsum ⊢
  linarith

name: ProbabilityTheory.chebyshev_finset_average_abs_real
statement:
theorem chebyshev_finset_average_abs_real
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (h_indep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (hX : ∀ i ∈ s, MemLp (X i) 2 μ)
    (hcentered : ∀ i ∈ s, μ[X i] = 0)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ |(∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) / (s.card : ℝ)|} ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, variance (X i) μ) / (((s.card : ℝ) * t) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : 0 < (s.card : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Finset.card_pos.mpr hs
  have hsumLp : MemLp (fun ω => ∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) 2 μ :=
    memLp_finsetSum s hX
  have hsumCentered : μ[fun ω => ∑ i ∈ s, X i ω] = 0 := by
    rw [integral_finsetSum s fun i hi => (hX i hi).integrable one_le_two]
    exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i hi => hcentered i hi
  have hpairwise : Set.Pairwise (s : Set ι) fun i j => X i ⟂ᵢ[μ] X j := by
    intro i hi j hj hij
    exact h_indep.indepFun hij
  have hvariance :
      variance (fun ω => ∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) μ =
        ∑ i ∈ s, variance (X i) μ :=
    by
      have hfun : (fun ω => ∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) = ∑ i ∈ s, X i := by
        funext ω
        simp
      rw [hfun]
      exact IndepFun.variance_sum hX hpairwise
  have hENN := meas_ge_le_variance_div_sq hsumLp (mul_pos hcard ht)
  have hENN' :
      μ {ω | (s.card : ℝ) * t ≤ |∑ i ∈ s, X i ω|} ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal
          ((∑ i ∈ s, variance (X i) μ) / (((s.card : ℝ) * t) ^ 2)) := by
    simpa only [hsumCentered, sub_zero, hvariance] using hENN
  have hreal := (ENNReal.toReal_le_toReal (measure_ne_top μ _) (by finiteness)).2 hENN'
  have hrhs : 0 ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, variance (X i) μ) / (((s.card : ℝ) * t) ^ 2) :=
    div_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => variance_nonneg (X i) μ) (sq_nonneg _)
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hrhs] at hreal
  have hset :
      {ω | t ≤ |(∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) / (s.card : ℝ)|} =
        {ω | (s.card : ℝ) * t ≤ |∑ i ∈ s, X i ω|} := by
    ext ω
    simp only [mem_setOf_eq, abs_div, abs_of_pos hcard]
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hcard]
    simp only [mul_comm]
  rw [hset]
  exact hreal

name: ProbabilityTheory.chebyshev_finset_average_abs_real_of_variance_le
statement:
theorem chebyshev_finset_average_abs_real_of_variance_le
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (h_indep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (hX : ∀ i ∈ s, MemLp (X i) 2 μ)
    (hcentered : ∀ i ∈ s, μ[X i] = 0)
    {V t : ℝ} (hvariance : ∀ i ∈ s, variance (X i) μ ≤ V)
    (ht : 0 < t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ |(∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) / (s.card : ℝ)|} ≤
      V / ((s.card : ℝ) * t ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h := chebyshev_finset_average_abs_real X h_indep s hs hX hcentered ht
  calc
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ |(∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) / (s.card : ℝ)|} ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, variance (X i) μ) / (((s.card : ℝ) * t) ^ 2) := h
    _ ≤ ((s.card : ℝ) * V) / (((s.card : ℝ) * t) ^ 2) := by
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
      · simpa only [← nsmul_eq_mul, ← Finset.sum_const] using
          (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => hvariance i hi)
      · positivity
    _ = V / ((s.card : ℝ) * t ^ 2) := by
      have hcard : (s.card : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
        exact_mod_cast (Finset.card_ne_zero.mpr hs)
      field_simp

name: ProbabilityTheory.chebyshev_finset_average_gt_two_mul_le
statement:
theorem chebyshev_finset_average_gt_two_mul_le
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (h_indep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    {K2 Kq δ : ℝ} (hK2 : 0 ≤ K2) (hKq : 0 < Kq)
    (hK2q : K2 ≤ Kq)
    (hX : ∀ i ∈ s, MemLp (X i) 2 μ)
    (hmean : ∀ i ∈ s, μ[X i] ≤ Kq)
    (hvariance : ∀ i ∈ s, variance (X i) μ ≤ K2 ^ 2)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hsize : 1 / δ ≤ (s.card : ℝ)) :
    μ.real {ω | 2 * Kq < (∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) / (s.card : ℝ)} ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  let Xc : ι → Ω → ℝ := fun i ω => X i ω - μ[X i]
  let N : ℝ := s.card
  have hN : 0 < N := by
    dsimp only [N]
    exact_mod_cast s.card_pos.mpr hs
  have hcenter : ∀ i ∈ s, μ[Xc i] = 0 := by
    intro i hi
    dsimp only [Xc]
    rw [integral_sub ((hX i hi).integrable one_le_two) (integrable_const _),
      integral_const]
    simp
  have hXc : ∀ i ∈ s, MemLp (Xc i) 2 μ := by
    intro i hi
    exact (hX i hi).sub (memLp_const _)
  have hindepCenter : iIndepFun Xc μ := by
    have hcomp := h_indep.comp
      (fun i (x : ℝ) => x - μ[X i])
      (fun _i => measurable_id.sub measurable_const)
    simpa only [Xc, Function.comp_def] using hcomp
  have hvarCenter : ∀ i ∈ s, variance (Xc i) μ ≤ K2 ^ 2 := by
    intro i hi
    rw [show variance (Xc i) μ = variance (X i) μ by
      exact variance_sub_const (hX i hi).aestronglyMeasurable μ[X i]]
    exact hvariance i hi
  have htail := chebyshev_finset_average_abs_real_of_variance_le
    Xc hindepCenter s hs hXc hcenter hvarCenter hKq
  have hmeanAvg : (∑ i ∈ s, μ[X i]) / N ≤ Kq := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hN]
    calc
      (∑ i ∈ s, μ[X i]) ≤ ∑ _i ∈ s, Kq :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => hmean i hi
      _ = Kq * N := by
        simp [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, N, mul_comm]
  have hsubset :
      {ω | 2 * Kq < (∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) / (s.card : ℝ)} ⊆
      {ω | Kq ≤ |(∑ i ∈ s, Xc i ω) / (s.card : ℝ)|} := by
    intro ω hω
    change 2 * Kq < (∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) / (s.card : ℝ) at hω
    have hcenterAvg :
        (∑ i ∈ s, Xc i ω) / (s.card : ℝ) =
          (∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) / (s.card : ℝ) -
            (∑ i ∈ s, μ[X i]) / (s.card : ℝ) := by
      dsimp only [Xc]
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      ring
    have hdev : Kq <
        (∑ i ∈ s, Xc i ω) / (s.card : ℝ) := by
      rw [hcenterAvg]
      dsimp only [N] at hmeanAvg
      linarith
    exact hdev.le.trans (le_abs_self _)
  have hbad :
      μ.real {ω | 2 * Kq <
        (∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) / (s.card : ℝ)} ≤
          K2 ^ 2 / ((s.card : ℝ) * Kq ^ 2) :=
    (measureReal_mono hsubset (by finiteness)).trans htail
  have hsq : K2 ^ 2 ≤ Kq ^ 2 :=
    (sq_le_sq₀ hK2 hKq.le).2 hK2q
  have hone_div : 1 / N ≤ δ := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hN]
    have hone : 1 ≤ δ * N := by
      have := (div_le_iff₀ hδ).1 hsize
      dsimp only [N]
      nlinarith
    linarith
  calc
    μ.real {ω | 2 * Kq <
        (∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) / (s.card : ℝ)} ≤
        K2 ^ 2 / ((s.card : ℝ) * Kq ^ 2) := hbad
    _ ≤ Kq ^ 2 / (N * Kq ^ 2) := by
      dsimp only [N]
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hsq (by positivity)
    _ = 1 / N := by field_simp [hKq.ne']
    _ ≤ δ := hone_div

name: RandomSetTheory.minkowskiAverage_support_markov
statement:
theorem minkowskiAverage_support_markov
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (S : ι → Ω → Set E) (L : Set E) (u : E)
    (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (h_meas : ∀ i ∈ s,
      AEMeasurable (directionalSupportDeviation S L u i) μ)
    (h_moment : ∀ i ∈ s, Integrable
      (fun ω => |directionalSupportDeviation S L u i ω| ^ q) μ)
    (hScompact : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ ω, IsCompact (S i ω))
    (hSne : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ |supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) u -
        supportFunction L u|} ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, ProbabilityTheory.absoluteMoment
        (directionalSupportDeviation S L u i) q μ) /
          ((s.card : ℝ) * t ^ q)
proof:
:= by
  have htail := ProbabilityTheory.markov_finset_average_abs_real
    (directionalSupportDeviation S L u) s hs hq h_meas h_moment ht
  have hset :
      {ω | t ≤ |supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) u -
        supportFunction L u|} =
      {ω | t ≤ |(∑ i ∈ s, directionalSupportDeviation S L u i ω) /
        (s.card : ℝ)|} := by
    ext ω
    simp only [mem_setOf_eq]
    rw [supportFunction_minkowskiAverage_sub_eq_average_deviation
      S L s hs hScompact hSne]
  rw [hset]
  exact htail

name: RandomSetTheory.minkowskiAverage_support_markov_of_moment_le
statement:
theorem minkowskiAverage_support_markov_of_moment_le
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (S : ι → Ω → Set E) (L : Set E) (u : E)
    (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty) (m : ι → ℝ)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (h_meas : ∀ i ∈ s,
      AEMeasurable (directionalSupportDeviation S L u i) μ)
    (h_moment : ∀ i ∈ s, Integrable
      (fun ω => |directionalSupportDeviation S L u i ω| ^ q) μ)
    (h_moment_le : ∀ i ∈ s, ProbabilityTheory.absoluteMoment
      (directionalSupportDeviation S L u i) q μ ≤ m i)
    (hScompact : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ ω, IsCompact (S i ω))
    (hSne : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ |supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) u -
        supportFunction L u|} ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, m i) / ((s.card : ℝ) * t ^ q)
proof:
:= by
  have h := minkowskiAverage_support_markov S L u s hs hq h_meas h_moment
    hScompact hSne ht
  refine h.trans ?_
  apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
  · exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => h_moment_le i hi
  · positivity

name: RandomSetTheory.minkowskiAverage_support_markov_of_common_moment_le
statement:
theorem minkowskiAverage_support_markov_of_common_moment_le
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (S : ι → Ω → Set E) (L : Set E) (u : E)
    (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (h_meas : ∀ i ∈ s,
      AEMeasurable (directionalSupportDeviation S L u i) μ)
    (h_moment : ∀ i ∈ s, Integrable
      (fun ω => |directionalSupportDeviation S L u i ω| ^ q) μ)
    {M : ℝ}
    (h_moment_le : ∀ i ∈ s, ProbabilityTheory.absoluteMoment
      (directionalSupportDeviation S L u i) q μ ≤ M)
    (hScompact : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ ω, IsCompact (S i ω))
    (hSne : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ |supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) u -
        supportFunction L u|} ≤ M / t ^ q
proof:
:= by
  have h := minkowskiAverage_support_markov_of_moment_le
    S L u s hs (fun _ => M) hq h_meas h_moment h_moment_le
      hScompact hSne ht
  calc
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ |supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) u -
        supportFunction L u|} ≤
      (∑ _i ∈ s, M) / ((s.card : ℝ) * t ^ q) := h
    _ = M / t ^ q := by
      have hcard : (s.card : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
        exact_mod_cast (Finset.card_ne_zero.mpr hs)
      rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
      field_simp

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_risk_bound_of_moment
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_risk_bound_of_moment
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (S : ι → Ω → Set E) (L : Set E)
    (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty) (m : ι → ℝ)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    {RS RL eps t : ℝ}
    (hScompact : ∀ i ω, IsCompact (S i ω))
    (hSne : ∀ i ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    (hSconv : ∀ i ω, Convex ℝ (S i ω))
    (hLcompact : IsCompact L) (hLne : L.Nonempty) (hLconv : Convex ℝ L)
    (hRS : ∀ i ω, ∀ x ∈ S i ω, ‖x‖ ≤ RS)
    (hRL : ∀ x ∈ L, ‖x‖ ≤ RL)
    (heps : 0 ≤ eps) (ht : 0 < t)
    (N : Finset E)
    (hnet : ∀ u : E, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 → ∃ v ∈ N, dist u v ≤ eps)
    (h_meas : ∀ v ∈ N, ∀ i ∈ s,
      AEMeasurable (directionalSupportDeviation S L v i) μ)
    (h_moment : ∀ v ∈ N, ∀ i ∈ s, Integrable
      (fun ω => |directionalSupportDeviation S L v i ω| ^ q) μ)
    (h_moment_le : ∀ v ∈ N, ∀ i ∈ s,
      ProbabilityTheory.absoluteMoment
        (directionalSupportDeviation S L v i) q μ ≤ m i) :
    μ.real {ω | t + (RS + RL) * eps <
        hausdorffDist (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) L} ≤
      N.card * ((∑ i ∈ s, m i) / ((s.card : ℝ) * t ^ q))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v₀, hv₀, _hv₀dist⟩ := hnet (0 : E) (by simp)
  have hm_nonneg : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ m i := by
    intro i hi
    exact (ProbabilityTheory.absoluteMoment_nonneg
      (directionalSupportDeviation S L v₀ i) q μ).trans
        (h_moment_le v₀ hv₀ i hi)
  have hrisk : 0 ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, m i) / ((s.card : ℝ) * t ^ q) :=
    div_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg hm_nonneg) (by positivity)
  apply measureReal_hausdorffDist_gt_le_finset_support
    (μ := μ) (fun ω => minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) (fun _ => L)
    (fun ω => isCompact_minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)
      (fun i hi => hScompact i ω))
    (fun _ => hLcompact)
    (fun ω => nonempty_minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)
      (fun i hi => hSne i ω))
    (fun _ => hLne)
    (fun ω => convex_minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)
      (fun i hi => hSconv i ω))
    (fun _ => hLconv)
    (fun ω x hx => norm_le_radius_of_mem_nonempty_minkowskiAverage s hs
      (fun i => S i ω) (fun i hi => hRS i ω) hx)
    (fun _ => hRL) heps ht.le hrisk N hnet
  intro v hv
  calc
    μ.real {ω | t < |supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) v -
        supportFunction L v|} ≤
        μ.real {ω | t ≤ |supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) v -
          supportFunction L v|} := by
      apply measureReal_mono
      · intro ω hω
        change t < |supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) v -
          supportFunction L v| at hω
        change t ≤ |supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) v -
          supportFunction L v|
        exact hω.le
      · finiteness
    _ ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, m i) / ((s.card : ℝ) * t ^ q) :=
      minkowskiAverage_support_markov_of_moment_le S L v s hs m hq
        (h_meas v hv) (h_moment v hv) (h_moment_le v hv)
        (fun i _hi ω => hScompact i ω)
        (fun i _hi ω => hSne i ω) ht

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_risk_bound_of_common_moment
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_risk_bound_of_common_moment
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (S : ι → Ω → Set E) (L : Set E)
    (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    {RS RL eps t M : ℝ}
    (hScompact : ∀ i ω, IsCompact (S i ω))
    (hSne : ∀ i ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    (hSconv : ∀ i ω, Convex ℝ (S i ω))
    (hLcompact : IsCompact L) (hLne : L.Nonempty) (hLconv : Convex ℝ L)
    (hRS : ∀ i ω, ∀ x ∈ S i ω, ‖x‖ ≤ RS)
    (hRL : ∀ x ∈ L, ‖x‖ ≤ RL)
    (heps : 0 ≤ eps) (ht : 0 < t)
    (N : Finset E)
    (hnet : ∀ u : E, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 → ∃ v ∈ N, dist u v ≤ eps)
    (h_meas : ∀ v ∈ N, ∀ i ∈ s,
      AEMeasurable (directionalSupportDeviation S L v i) μ)
    (h_moment : ∀ v ∈ N, ∀ i ∈ s, Integrable
      (fun ω => |directionalSupportDeviation S L v i ω| ^ q) μ)
    (h_moment_le : ∀ v ∈ N, ∀ i ∈ s,
      ProbabilityTheory.absoluteMoment
        (directionalSupportDeviation S L v i) q μ ≤ M) :
    μ.real {ω | t + (RS + RL) * eps <
        hausdorffDist (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) L} ≤
      N.card * (M / t ^ q)
proof:
:= by
  have h := hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_risk_bound_of_moment
    S L s hs (fun _ => M) hq hScompact hSne hSconv hLcompact hLne hLconv
      hRS hRL heps ht N hnet h_meas h_moment h_moment_le
  calc
    μ.real {ω | t + (RS + RL) * eps <
        hausdorffDist (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) L} ≤
      N.card * ((∑ _i ∈ s, M) / ((s.card : ℝ) * t ^ q)) := h
    _ = N.card * (M / t ^ q) := by
      congr 1
      have hcard : (s.card : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
        exact_mod_cast (Finset.card_ne_zero.mpr hs)
      rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
      field_simp

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_risk_bound_dimensional_of_moment
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_risk_bound_dimensional_of_moment
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (S : ι → Ω → Set E) (L : Set E)
    (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty) (m : ι → ℝ)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    {RS RL eps t : ℝ}
    (hScompact : ∀ i ω, IsCompact (S i ω))
    (hSne : ∀ i ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    (hSconv : ∀ i ω, Convex ℝ (S i ω))
    (hLcompact : IsCompact L) (hLne : L.Nonempty) (hLconv : Convex ℝ L)
    (hRS : ∀ i ω, ∀ x ∈ S i ω, ‖x‖ ≤ RS)
    (hRL : ∀ x ∈ L, ‖x‖ ≤ RL)
    (heps : 0 < eps) (ht : 0 < t)
    (h_meas : ∀ v : E, ‖v‖ ≤ 1 → ∀ i ∈ s,
      AEMeasurable (directionalSupportDeviation S L v i) μ)
    (h_moment : ∀ v : E, ‖v‖ ≤ 1 → ∀ i ∈ s, Integrable
      (fun ω => |directionalSupportDeviation S L v i ω| ^ q) μ)
    (h_moment_le : ∀ v : E, ‖v‖ ≤ 1 → ∀ i ∈ s,
      ProbabilityTheory.absoluteMoment
        (directionalSupportDeviation S L v i) q μ ≤ m i) :
    μ.real {ω | t + (RS + RL) * eps <
        hausdorffDist (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) L} ≤
      (1 + 2 / eps) ^ Module.finrank ℝ E *
        ((∑ i ∈ s, m i) / ((s.card : ℝ) * t ^ q))
proof:
:= by
  have hm_nonneg : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ m i := by
    intro i hi
    exact (ProbabilityTheory.absoluteMoment_nonneg
      (directionalSupportDeviation S L (0 : E) i) q μ).trans
        (h_moment_le (0 : E) (by simp) i hi)
  have hrisk : 0 ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, m i) / ((s.card : ℝ) * t ^ q) :=
    div_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg hm_nonneg) (by positivity)
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hnet, hcard⟩ :=
    exists_unitBall_finset_net_card_le (E := E) heps
  have hprob := hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_risk_bound_of_moment
    S L s hs m hq hScompact hSne hSconv hLcompact hLne hLconv
    hRS hRL heps.le ht N hnet
    (fun v hv => h_meas v (hN v hv))
    (fun v hv => h_moment v (hN v hv))
    (fun v hv => h_moment_le v (hN v hv))
  exact hprob.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcard hrisk)

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_risk_bound_dimensional_of_common_moment
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_risk_bound_dimensional_of_common_moment
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (S : ι → Ω → Set E) (L : Set E)
    (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    {RS RL eps t M : ℝ}
    (hScompact : ∀ i ω, IsCompact (S i ω))
    (hSne : ∀ i ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    (hSconv : ∀ i ω, Convex ℝ (S i ω))
    (hLcompact : IsCompact L) (hLne : L.Nonempty) (hLconv : Convex ℝ L)
    (hRS : ∀ i ω, ∀ x ∈ S i ω, ‖x‖ ≤ RS)
    (hRL : ∀ x ∈ L, ‖x‖ ≤ RL)
    (heps : 0 < eps) (ht : 0 < t)
    (h_meas : ∀ v : E, ‖v‖ ≤ 1 → ∀ i ∈ s,
      AEMeasurable (directionalSupportDeviation S L v i) μ)
    (h_moment : ∀ v : E, ‖v‖ ≤ 1 → ∀ i ∈ s, Integrable
      (fun ω => |directionalSupportDeviation S L v i ω| ^ q) μ)
    (h_moment_le : ∀ v : E, ‖v‖ ≤ 1 → ∀ i ∈ s,
      ProbabilityTheory.absoluteMoment
        (directionalSupportDeviation S L v i) q μ ≤ M) :
    μ.real {ω | t + (RS + RL) * eps <
        hausdorffDist (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) L} ≤
      (1 + 2 / eps) ^ Module.finrank ℝ E * (M / t ^ q)
proof:
:= by
  have h := hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_risk_bound_dimensional_of_moment
    S L s hs (fun _ => M) hq hScompact hSne hSconv hLcompact hLne hLconv
      hRS hRL heps ht h_meas h_moment h_moment_le
  calc
    μ.real {ω | t + (RS + RL) * eps <
        hausdorffDist (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) L} ≤
      (1 + 2 / eps) ^ Module.finrank ℝ E *
        ((∑ _i ∈ s, M) / ((s.card : ℝ) * t ^ q)) := h
    _ = (1 + 2 / eps) ^ Module.finrank ℝ E * (M / t ^ q) := by
      congr 1
      have hcard : (s.card : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
        exact_mod_cast (Finset.card_ne_zero.mpr hs)
      rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
      field_simp

name: RandomSetTheory.minkowskiAverage_support_chebyshev
statement:
theorem minkowskiAverage_support_chebyshev
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (S : ι → Ω → Set E) (L : Set E) (u : E)
    (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (h_indep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun
      (directionalSupportDeviation S L u) μ)
    (hL2 : ∀ i ∈ s, MemLp (directionalSupportDeviation S L u i) 2 μ)
    (h_centered : ∀ i ∈ s,
      μ[directionalSupportDeviation S L u i] = 0)
    (hScompact : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ ω, IsCompact (S i ω))
    (hSne : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ |supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) u -
        supportFunction L u|} ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, ProbabilityTheory.variance
        (directionalSupportDeviation S L u i) μ) /
          (((s.card : ℝ) * t) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have htail := ProbabilityTheory.chebyshev_finset_average_abs_real
    (directionalSupportDeviation S L u) h_indep s hs hL2 h_centered ht
  have hset :
      {ω | t ≤ |supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) u -
        supportFunction L u|} =
      {ω | t ≤ |(∑ i ∈ s, directionalSupportDeviation S L u i ω) /
        (s.card : ℝ)|} := by
    ext ω
    simp only [mem_setOf_eq]
    rw [supportFunction_minkowskiAverage_sub_eq_average_deviation
      S L s hs hScompact hSne]
  rw [hset]
  exact htail

name: RandomSetTheory.minkowskiAverage_support_chebyshev_of_variance_le
statement:
theorem minkowskiAverage_support_chebyshev_of_variance_le
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (S : ι → Ω → Set E) (L : Set E) (u : E)
    (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty) (v : ι → ℝ)
    (h_indep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun
      (directionalSupportDeviation S L u) μ)
    (hL2 : ∀ i ∈ s, MemLp (directionalSupportDeviation S L u i) 2 μ)
    (h_centered : ∀ i ∈ s,
      μ[directionalSupportDeviation S L u i] = 0)
    (h_variance_le : ∀ i ∈ s, ProbabilityTheory.variance
      (directionalSupportDeviation S L u i) μ ≤ v i)
    (hScompact : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ ω, IsCompact (S i ω))
    (hSne : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ |supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) u -
        supportFunction L u|} ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, v i) / (((s.card : ℝ) * t) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h := minkowskiAverage_support_chebyshev S L u s hs h_indep hL2
    h_centered hScompact hSne ht
  refine h.trans ?_
  apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
  · exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => h_variance_le i hi
  · positivity

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_risk_bound_of_variance
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_risk_bound_of_variance
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (S : ι → Ω → Set E) (L : Set E)
    (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty) (v : ι → ℝ)
    {RS RL eps t : ℝ}
    (hScompact : ∀ i ω, IsCompact (S i ω))
    (hSne : ∀ i ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    (hSconv : ∀ i ω, Convex ℝ (S i ω))
    (hLcompact : IsCompact L) (hLne : L.Nonempty) (hLconv : Convex ℝ L)
    (hRS : ∀ i ω, ∀ x ∈ S i ω, ‖x‖ ≤ RS)
    (hRL : ∀ x ∈ L, ‖x‖ ≤ RL)
    (heps : 0 ≤ eps) (ht : 0 < t)
    (N : Finset E)
    (hnet : ∀ u : E, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 → ∃ w ∈ N, dist u w ≤ eps)
    (h_indep : ∀ w ∈ N, ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun
      (directionalSupportDeviation S L w) μ)
    (hL2 : ∀ w ∈ N, ∀ i ∈ s,
      MemLp (directionalSupportDeviation S L w i) 2 μ)
    (h_centered : ∀ w ∈ N, ∀ i ∈ s,
      μ[directionalSupportDeviation S L w i] = 0)
    (h_variance_le : ∀ w ∈ N, ∀ i ∈ s,
      ProbabilityTheory.variance
        (directionalSupportDeviation S L w i) μ ≤ v i) :
    μ.real {ω | t + (RS + RL) * eps <
        hausdorffDist (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) L} ≤
      N.card * ((∑ i ∈ s, v i) / (((s.card : ℝ) * t) ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w₀, hw₀, _hw₀dist⟩ := hnet (0 : E) (by simp)
  have hv_nonneg : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ v i := by
    intro i hi
    exact (ProbabilityTheory.variance_nonneg
      (directionalSupportDeviation S L w₀ i) μ).trans
        (h_variance_le w₀ hw₀ i hi)
  have hrisk : 0 ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, v i) / (((s.card : ℝ) * t) ^ 2) :=
    div_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg hv_nonneg) (sq_nonneg _)
  apply measureReal_hausdorffDist_gt_le_finset_support
    (μ := μ) (fun ω => minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) (fun _ => L)
    (fun ω => isCompact_minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)
      (fun i hi => hScompact i ω))
    (fun _ => hLcompact)
    (fun ω => nonempty_minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)
      (fun i hi => hSne i ω))
    (fun _ => hLne)
    (fun ω => convex_minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)
      (fun i hi => hSconv i ω))
    (fun _ => hLconv)
    (fun ω x hx => norm_le_radius_of_mem_nonempty_minkowskiAverage s hs
      (fun i => S i ω) (fun i hi => hRS i ω) hx)
    (fun _ => hRL) heps ht.le hrisk N hnet
  intro w hw
  calc
    μ.real {ω | t < |supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) w -
        supportFunction L w|} ≤
        μ.real {ω | t ≤ |supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) w -
          supportFunction L w|} := by
      apply measureReal_mono
      · intro ω hω
        change t < |supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) w -
          supportFunction L w| at hω
        change t ≤ |supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) w -
          supportFunction L w|
        exact hω.le
      · finiteness
    _ ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, v i) / (((s.card : ℝ) * t) ^ 2) :=
      minkowskiAverage_support_chebyshev_of_variance_le S L w s hs v
        (h_indep w hw) (hL2 w hw) (h_centered w hw) (h_variance_le w hw)
        (fun i _hi ω => hScompact i ω)
        (fun i _hi ω => hSne i ω) ht

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_risk_bound_dimensional_of_variance
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_risk_bound_dimensional_of_variance
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (S : ι → Ω → Set E) (L : Set E)
    (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty) (v : ι → ℝ)
    {RS RL eps t : ℝ}
    (hScompact : ∀ i ω, IsCompact (S i ω))
    (hSne : ∀ i ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    (hSconv : ∀ i ω, Convex ℝ (S i ω))
    (hLcompact : IsCompact L) (hLne : L.Nonempty) (hLconv : Convex ℝ L)
    (hRS : ∀ i ω, ∀ x ∈ S i ω, ‖x‖ ≤ RS)
    (hRL : ∀ x ∈ L, ‖x‖ ≤ RL)
    (heps : 0 < eps) (ht : 0 < t)
    (h_indep : ∀ w : E, ‖w‖ ≤ 1 → ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun
      (directionalSupportDeviation S L w) μ)
    (hL2 : ∀ w : E, ‖w‖ ≤ 1 → ∀ i ∈ s,
      MemLp (directionalSupportDeviation S L w i) 2 μ)
    (h_centered : ∀ w : E, ‖w‖ ≤ 1 → ∀ i ∈ s,
      μ[directionalSupportDeviation S L w i] = 0)
    (h_variance_le : ∀ w : E, ‖w‖ ≤ 1 → ∀ i ∈ s,
      ProbabilityTheory.variance
        (directionalSupportDeviation S L w i) μ ≤ v i) :
    μ.real {ω | t + (RS + RL) * eps <
        hausdorffDist (minkowskiAverage s (fun i => S i ω)) L} ≤
      (1 + 2 / eps) ^ Module.finrank ℝ E *
        ((∑ i ∈ s, v i) / (((s.card : ℝ) * t) ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hv_nonneg : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ v i := by
    intro i hi
    exact (ProbabilityTheory.variance_nonneg
      (directionalSupportDeviation S L (0 : E) i) μ).trans
        (h_variance_le (0 : E) (by simp) i hi)
  have hrisk : 0 ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, v i) / (((s.card : ℝ) * t) ^ 2) :=
    div_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg hv_nonneg) (sq_nonneg _)
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hnet, hcard⟩ :=
    exists_unitBall_finset_net_card_le (E := E) heps
  have hprob := hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_risk_bound_of_variance
    S L s hs v hScompact hSne hSconv hLcompact hLne hLconv
    hRS hRL heps.le ht N hnet
    (fun w hw => h_indep w (hN w hw))
    (fun w hw => hL2 w (hN w hw))
    (fun w hw => h_centered w (hN w hw))
    (fun w hw => h_variance_le w (hN w hw))

name: ProbabilityTheory.finiteProcessSupremum_finiteCoordinateSumProcess
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finiteProcessSupremum_finiteCoordinateSumProcess
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty) (Y : Nat -> Omega -> Z)
    (W : Fin n -> Z -> T -> Real) (omega : Omega) :
    finiteProcessSupremum s hs (finiteCoordinateSumProcess Y W) omega =
      finiteCoordinateSumSupremum s hs W (fun j => Y j omega)
proof: := rfl

name: ProbabilityTheory.measurable_finiteCoordinateSumProcess
statement:
theorem measurable_finiteCoordinateSumProcess
    (Y : Nat -> Omega -> Z) (hY : forall j, Measurable (Y j))
    (W : Fin n -> Z -> T -> Real)
    (t : T) (hWt : forall j, Measurable (fun z => W j z t)) :
    Measurable (finiteCoordinateSumProcess Y W t)
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.measurable_sum Finset.univ fun j _ =>
    (hWt j).comp (hY j)

name: ProbabilityTheory.measurable_finiteCoordinateSumProcess_prefix
statement:
theorem measurable_finiteCoordinateSumProcess_prefix
    (Y : Nat -> Omega -> Z) (hY : forall j, Measurable (Y j))
    (W : Fin n -> Z -> T -> Real)
    (t : T) (hWt : forall j, Measurable (fun z => W j z t)) :
    Measurable[strictPrefixFiltration Y hY n]
      (finiteCoordinateSumProcess Y W t)
proof:
:= by
  have hvector : Measurable[strictPrefixFiltration Y hY n]
      (fun omega (j : Fin n) => Y j omega) := by
    rw [strictPrefixFiltration_eq_comap Y hY n]
    exact comap_measurable _
  have hsum : Measurable (fun x : Fin n -> Z =>
      ∑ j : Fin n, W j (x j) t) :=
    Finset.measurable_sum Finset.univ fun j _ =>
      (hWt j).comp (measurable_pi_apply j)
  exact hsum.comp hvector

name: ProbabilityTheory.sum_range_replaceOneCenteredMoment_finiteSuccessorEnvelope
statement:
theorem sum_range_replaceOneCenteredMoment_finiteSuccessorEnvelope
    (nu : Measure Z) (A : Fin n -> Z -> Real) (k : Nat) (hk : 0 < k) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
      replaceOneCenteredMoment nu (finiteSuccessorEnvelope A j) k) =
      ∑ i : Fin n, replaceOneCenteredMoment nu (A i) k
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  simp [finiteSuccessorEnvelope, replaceOneCenteredMoment,
    replaceOneCenteredEnvelope, Nat.ne_of_gt hk]

name: ProbabilityTheory.conditionalValueAtRisk_finiteCoordinateSumSupremum_le_rio
statement:
theorem conditionalValueAtRisk_finiteCoordinateSumSupremum_le_rio
    {mu : Measure Omega} {nu : Measure Z}
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    [StandardBorelSpace Z] [Nonempty Z] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (z0 : Z) (Y : Nat -> Omega -> Z)
    (hY : forall i, Measurable (Y i)) (hIndep : iIndepFun Y mu)
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (n q : Nat) (hq : 3 <= q)
    (W : Fin n -> Z -> T -> Real) (A : Fin n -> Z -> Real)
    (hYlaw : forall i, i < n -> mu.map (Y i) = nu)
    (hW : forall j t, t ∈ s -> Measurable (fun z => W j z t))
    (hAq : forall j, MemLp (A j) q nu)
    (hA : forall j z, 0 <= A j z)
    (hdom : forall j z t, t ∈ s -> abs (W j z t) <= A j z)
    {V Q y alpha : Real} (hV : 0 < V) (hQ : 0 < Q) (hy : 0 < y)
    (hsecond :
      (∑ i : Fin n, replaceOneCenteredMoment nu (A i) 2) <= V)
    (hmomentQ :
      (∑ i : Fin n, replaceOneCenteredMoment nu (A i) q) <= Q)
    (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha < 1)
    (hscale : Q * Real.exp (-Real.log alpha) <= y ^ q) :
    conditionalValueAtRisk alpha
        (fun omega =>
          finiteCoordinateSumSupremum s hs W (fun j => Y j omega) -
            ∫ z, finiteCoordinateSumSupremum s hs W
              (fun j => Y j z) ∂mu) mu <=
      Real.sqrt (2 * V * (-Real.log alpha)) +
        (1 + 1 / (q : Real)) * y +
          Real.exp 1 * strongMomentQScale q Q * (-Real.log alpha) / 3 +
        alpha⁻¹ * (Q / ((q : Real) * y ^ (q - 1)))
proof:
:= by
  let X : T -> Omega -> Real := finiteCoordinateSumProcess Y W
  let B : Omega -> Real := finiteCoordinateSumEnvelope Y A
  let Phi : (Fin n -> Z) -> Real := finiteCoordinateSumSupremum s hs W
  let G : Nat -> (Nat -> Z) -> Z -> Real := fun i =>
    finiteFutureValue mu z0 Y i n Phi
  let Acoord : Nat -> Z -> Real := finiteSuccessorEnvelope A
  have hPhiMeas : Measurable Phi := by
    exact measurable_finiteCoordinateSumSupremum s hs W
      (fun j t ht => hW j t ht)
  have hqone : (1 : ENNReal) <= (q : ENNReal) := by
    exact_mod_cast (show 1 <= q by omega)
  have hAintNu : forall j, Integrable (A j) nu := by
    intro j
    exact ((hAq j).mono_exponent hqone).integrable (by norm_num)
  have hXmeas : forall t, t ∈ s -> Measurable (X t) := by
    intro t ht
    exact measurable_finiteCoordinateSumProcess Y hY W t
      (fun j => hW j t ht)
  have hXprefix : forall t, t ∈ s ->
      Measurable[strictPrefixFiltration Y hY n] (X t) := by
    intro t ht
    exact measurable_finiteCoordinateSumProcess_prefix Y hY W t
      (fun j => hW j t ht)
  have hBint : Integrable B mu := by
    apply integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ
    intro j _
    have hjmap : Integrable (A j) (mu.map (Y j)) := by
      rw [hYlaw j j.isLt]
      exact hAintNu j
    simpa only [B, finiteCoordinateSumEnvelope, Function.comp_def] using
      hjmap.comp_measurable (hY j)
  have hBnonneg : forall omega, 0 <= B omega := by
    intro omega
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => hA j _
  have hdomX : forall omega t, t ∈ s ->
      abs (X t omega) <= abs (B omega) := by
    intro omega t ht
    have hsum : abs (∑ j : Fin n, W j (Y j omega) t) <=
        ∑ j : Fin n, A j (Y j omega) := by
      calc
        abs (∑ j : Fin n, W j (Y j omega) t) <=
            ∑ j : Fin n, abs (W j (Y j omega) t) :=
          Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
        _ <= ∑ j : Fin n, A j (Y j omega) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => hdom j (Y j omega) t ht
    change abs (∑ j : Fin n, W j (Y j omega) t) <=
      abs (∑ j : Fin n, A j (Y j omega))
    calc
      abs (∑ j : Fin n, W j (Y j omega) t) <=
          ∑ j : Fin n, A j (Y j omega) := hsum
      _ = abs (∑ j : Fin n, A j (Y j omega)) :=
        (abs_of_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => hA j _)).symm
  have hterminalEq : finiteProcessSupremum s hs X =
      fun omega => Phi (fun j : Fin n => Y j omega) := by
    funext omega
    rfl
  have hFint : Integrable
      (fun omega => Phi (fun j : Fin n => Y j omega)) mu := by
    have hsup := integrable_finiteProcessSupremum
      s hs X B hBint hXmeas hdomX
    rw [← hterminalEq]
    exact hsup
  have hG : forall i, i < n ->
      StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (G i)) := by
    intro i _hi
    exact stronglyMeasurable_uncurry_finiteFutureValue
      (mu := mu) z0 Y i n Phi hPhiMeas.stronglyMeasurable
  have hnext : forall i, i < n ->
      mu[finiteProcessSupremum s hs X |
          strictPrefixFiltration Y hY (i + 1)] =ᵐ[mu]
        fun omega => G i (paddedStrictPrefix z0 Y i omega) (Y i omega) := by
    intro i _hi
    have hbase := condExp_terminal_ae_eq_finiteFutureValue
      z0 Y hY hIndep i n Phi hPhiMeas.stronglyMeasurable hFint
    rw [hterminalEq]
    exact hbase
  have hreplace : forall i, i < n -> forall b z z',
      abs (G i b z - G i b z') <=
        Acoord (i + 1) z + Acoord (i + 1) z' := by
    intro i hi b z z'
    have hbase := abs_finiteFutureValue_coordinateSumSupremum_sub_le
      (mu := mu) (nu := nu) z0 Y hY hIndep i n hi hYlaw
      s hs W A hW hAintNu hA hdom b z z'
    simpa only [G, Acoord, finiteSuccessorEnvelope_succ A i hi] using hbase
  have hAcoordQ : forall j, j < n + 1 -> MemLp (Acoord j) q nu := by
    intro j hj
    cases j with
    | zero => simp [Acoord]
    | succ i =>
        have hi : i < n := by omega
        simpa only [Acoord, finiteSuccessorEnvelope_succ A i hi] using
          hAq (⟨i, hi⟩ : Fin n)
  have hAcoordNonneg : forall j, j < n + 1 -> forall z,
      0 <= Acoord j z := by
    intro j hj z
    cases j with
    | zero => simp [Acoord]
    | succ i =>
        have hi : i < n := by omega
        simpa only [Acoord, finiteSuccessorEnvelope_succ A i hi] using
          hA (⟨i, hi⟩ : Fin n) z
  have hsecondCoord :
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        replaceOneCenteredMoment nu (Acoord j) 2) <= V := by
    rw [show Acoord = finiteSuccessorEnvelope A by rfl,
      sum_range_replaceOneCenteredMoment_finiteSuccessorEnvelope
        nu A 2 (by norm_num)]
    exact hsecond
  have hmomentQCoord :
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        replaceOneCenteredMoment nu (Acoord j) q) <= Q := by
    rw [show Acoord = finiteSuccessorEnvelope A by rfl,
      sum_range_replaceOneCenteredMoment_finiteSuccessorEnvelope
        nu A q (by omega)]
    exact hmomentQ
  have hRio := conditionalValueAtRisk_finiteSupremum_le_rio_of_iidGhostFibers
    (mu := mu) (nu := nu) z0 Y hY hIndep s hs X B hBint hdomX
      G Acoord n q hq hV hQ hy hYlaw hXprefix hG hAcoordQ
      hAcoordNonneg hreplace hnext hsecondCoord hmomentQCoord
      halpha0 halpha1 hscale
  rw [← hterminalEq]
  exact hRio

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_convexJoin_self_eq_of_atomless
statement:
theorem aumannExpectation_convexJoin_self_eq_of_atomless
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (hμ : IsAtomlessMeasure μ) [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {S : Ω → Set E} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    {g : Ω → ℝ} (hg : Integrable g μ)
    (hdom : ∀ ω, ∀ x ∈ S ω, ‖x‖ ≤ g ω) :
    aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => convexJoin ℝ (S ω) (S ω)) =
      aumannExpectation μ S
proof:
:= by
  let P : Ω → Set ((E × E) × ℝ) := fun ω =>
    ((S ω ×ˢ S ω) ×ˢ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
  let φ : Ω × ((E × E) × ℝ) → E := fun q => convexJoinMap q.2
  have hSS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable (fun ω => S ω ×ˢ S ω) :=
    hS.prod hS (fun ω => (hcompact ω).isClosed)
      (fun ω => (hcompact ω).isClosed) hne hne
  have hP : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable P := by
    exact hSS.prod
      (RandomSet.isEffrosMeasurable_const (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1))
      (fun ω => (hcompact ω).isClosed.prod (hcompact ω).isClosed)
      (fun _ => isClosed_Icc)
      (fun ω => (hne ω).prod (hne ω))
      (fun _ => nonempty_Icc.2 zero_le_one)
  have hPcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (P ω) := fun ω =>
    ((hcompact ω).prod (hcompact ω)).prod isCompact_Icc
  have hPne : ∀ ω, (P ω).Nonempty := fun ω =>
    ((hne ω).prod (hne ω)).prod (nonempty_Icc.2 zero_le_one)
  have hφmeas : Measurable φ := by
    exact continuous_convexJoinMap.measurable.comp measurable_snd
  have hφcont : ∀ ω, Continuous fun q => φ (ω, q) := fun _ =>
    continuous_convexJoinMap
  have hImage (ω : Ω) :
      (fun q => φ (ω, q)) '' P ω = convexJoin ℝ (S ω) (S ω) := by
    exact (convexJoin_eq_image (S ω) (S ω)).symm
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · rintro z ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    let v' : Ω → E := hv.1.aestronglyMeasurable.mk v
    have hv'meas : Measurable v' :=
      hv.1.aestronglyMeasurable.measurable_mk
    have hvv' : v =ᵐ[μ] v' :=
      hv.1.aestronglyMeasurable.ae_eq_mk
    have hv'mem : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, v' ω ∈ (fun q => φ (ω, q)) '' P ω := by
      filter_upwards [hv.2, hvv'] with ω hvω heq
      rw [hImage]
      rwa [← heq]
    obtain ⟨T, hTmeas, hTmem, hφT⟩ :=
      exists_measurable_lifting_of_ae_mem_image
        hP hPcompact hPne hφmeas hφcont hv'meas hv'mem
    let x : Ω → E := fun ω => (T ω).1.1
    let y : Ω → E := fun ω => (T ω).1.2
    let a : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => (T ω).2
    have hxmeas : Measurable x := hTmeas.fst.fst
    have hymeas : Measurable y := hTmeas.fst.snd
    have hameas : Measurable a := hTmeas.snd
    have hxmem : ∀ ω, x ω ∈ S ω := fun ω => (hTmem ω).1.1
    have hymem : ∀ ω, y ω ∈ S ω := fun ω => (hTmem ω).1.2
    have ha0 : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ a ω := fun ω => (hTmem ω).2.1
    have ha1 : ∀ ω, a ω ≤ 1 := fun ω => (hTmem ω).2.2
    have hxint : Integrable x μ := by
      apply hg.mono' hxmeas.aestronglyMeasurable
      filter_upwards [] with ω
      exact hdom ω (x ω) (hxmem ω)
    have hyint : Integrable y μ := by
      apply hg.mono' hymeas.aestronglyMeasurable
      filter_upwards [] with ω
      exact hdom ω (y ω) (hymem ω)
    obtain ⟨q, hq, _hchoice, hqIntegral⟩ :=
      exists_binary_purification_of_integrableSelections_of_atomless
        μ hμ
        (S := S)
        (f := y) (g := x)
        ⟨hyint, Filter.Eventually.of_forall hymem⟩
        ⟨hxint, Filter.Eventually.of_forall hxmem⟩
        hameas (Filter.Eventually.of_forall ha0)
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall ha1)
    refine ⟨q, hq, ?_⟩
    calc
      (∫ ω, q ω ∂μ) =
          ∫ ω, a ω • y ω + (1 - a ω) • x ω ∂μ := hqIntegral
      _ = ∫ ω, v ω ∂μ := by
        apply integral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards [hφT, hvv'] with ω hφTω hvv'ω
        calc
          a ω • y ω + (1 - a ω) • x ω = φ (ω, T ω) := by
            simp only [φ, convexJoinMap, AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module]
            abel
          _ = v' ω := hφTω
          _ = v ω := hvv'ω.symm
  · exact aumannExpectation_mono fun ω =>
      subset_convexJoin_left (hne ω)

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_convexJoinIterate_eq_of_atomless
statement:
theorem aumannExpectation_convexJoinIterate_eq_of_atomless
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (hμ : IsAtomlessMeasure μ) [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {S : Ω → Set E} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    {g : Ω → ℝ} (hg : Integrable g μ)
    (hdom : ∀ ω, ∀ x ∈ S ω, ‖x‖ ≤ g ω) :
    ∀ n, aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => convexJoinIterate (S ω) n) =
      aumannExpectation μ S
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      let T : Ω → Set E := fun ω => convexJoinIterate (S ω) n
      have hT : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable T :=
        effrosMeasurable_convexJoinIterate hS hcompact hne n
      have hTcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (T ω) := fun ω =>
        convexJoinIterate_compact (hcompact ω) n
      have hTne : ∀ ω, (T ω).Nonempty := fun ω =>
        convexJoinIterate_nonempty (hne ω) n
      have hTdom : ∀ ω, ∀ x ∈ T ω, ‖x‖ ≤ g ω := by
        intro ω x hx
        have hxball : x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) (g ω) :=
          convexJoinIterate_subset_convex
            (fun y hy => by
              simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using
                hdom ω y hy)
            (convex_closedBall (0 : E) (g ω)) n hx
        simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hxball
      calc
        aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => convexJoinIterate (S ω) (n + 1)) =
            aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => convexJoin ℝ (T ω) (T ω)) := rfl
        _ = aumannExpectation μ T :=
          aumannExpectation_convexJoin_self_eq_of_atomless
            μ hμ hT hTcompact hTne hg hTdom
        _ = aumannExpectation μ S := ih

name: RandomSetTheory.aumannExpectation_closedConvexHull_eq_of_atomless
statement:
theorem aumannExpectation_closedConvexHull_eq_of_atomless
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (hμ : IsAtomlessMeasure μ) [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {S : Ω → Set E} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω))
    (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    {g : Ω → ℝ} (hg : Integrable g μ)
    (hdom : ∀ ω, ∀ x ∈ S ω, ‖x‖ ≤ g ω) :
    aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => closedConvexHull ℝ (S ω)) =
      aumannExpectation μ S
proof:
:= by
  have hfibers :
      (fun ω => closedConvexHull ℝ (S ω)) =
        fun ω => convexJoinIterate (S ω) (Module.finrank ℝ E + 1) := by
    funext ω
    exact
      (convexJoinIterate_finrank_add_one_eq_closedConvexHull
        (hcompact ω) (hne ω)).symm
  rw [hfibers]
  exact aumannExpectation_convexJoinIterate_eq_of_atomless
    μ hμ hS hcompact hne hg hdom (Module.finrank ℝ E + 1)

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_denseHit

theorem exists_denseHit
    {Ω E : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace E] [SeparableSpace E] [Nonempty E]

proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hne ω
  obtain ⟨n, hxn⟩ := (denseRange_denseSeq E).exists_dist_lt x hε

name: RandomSetTheory.isDenseSeqValued_effrosApproximateSelection
statement:
theorem isDenseSeqValued_effrosApproximateSelection
    {Ω E : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace E] [SeparableSpace E] [Nonempty E]

name: RandomSetTheory.measurable_effrosApproximateSelection
statement:
theorem measurable_effrosApproximateSelection
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [MetricSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] [Nonempty E]
    {S : Ω → Set E} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    Measurable (effrosApproximateSelection S hne ε hε)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact Measurable.find
    (p := fun n ω => DenseHit S ε n ω)
    (f := fun n _ => denseSeq E n)
    (fun _ => measurable_const)
    (fun n => by
      simpa [DenseHit] using
        hS (Metric.ball (denseSeq E n) ε) Metric.isOpen_ball)
    (exists_denseHit S hne hε)

name: RandomSetTheory.infDist_effrosApproximateSelection_lt
statement:
theorem infDist_effrosApproximateSelection_lt
    {Ω E : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace E] [SeparableSpace E] [Nonempty E]
    (S : Ω → Set E) (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (ω : Ω) :
    infDist (effrosApproximateSelection S hne ε hε ω) (S ω) < ε
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hhit := Nat.find_spec (exists_denseHit S hne hε ω)
  rcases hhit with ⟨x, hx, hxball⟩
  apply (infDist_le_dist_of_mem hx).trans_lt
  simpa [effrosApproximateSelection, DenseHit, Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm] using hxball

name: RandomSetTheory.RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable.inter_ball_of_isDenseSeqValued
statement:
theorem RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable.inter_ball_of_isDenseSeqValued
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [MetricSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] [Nonempty E]
    {S : Ω → Set E} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    {f : Ω → E} (hf : Measurable f) (hfdense : IsDenseSeqValued f)
    (r : ℝ) :
    RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable (fun ω => S ω ∩ Metric.ball (f ω) r)
proof:
:= by
  intro U hU
  have hEq : {ω | ((S ω ∩ Metric.ball (f ω) r) ∩ U).Nonempty} =
      ⋃ n : ℕ, (f ⁻¹' ({denseSeq E n} : Set E)) ∩
        {ω | (S ω ∩ (Metric.ball (denseSeq E n) r ∩ U)).Nonempty} := by
    ext ω
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_inter_iff,
      Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, ⟨hxS, hxball⟩, hxU⟩
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hfdense ω
      refine ⟨n, hn, x, hxS, ?_, hxU⟩
      simpa [hn] using hxball
    · rintro ⟨n, hfn, x, hxS, hxball, hxU⟩
      refine ⟨x, ⟨hxS, ?_⟩, hxU⟩
      simpa [hfn] using hxball
  rw [hEq]
  apply MeasurableSet.iUnion
  intro n
  exact (hf (measurableSet_singleton (denseSeq E n))).inter
    (hS (Metric.ball (denseSeq E n) r ∩ U) (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter hU))

name: RandomSetTheory.nonempty_inter_ball_of_infDist_lt

:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hdist⟩ := (infDist_lt_iff (hne ω)).mp (hclose ω)

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_measurable_infDist_lt
statement:
theorem exists_measurable_infDist_lt
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [MetricSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] [Nonempty E]
    {S : Ω → Set E} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)

proof:

name: RandomSetTheory.isMeasurableSelection_of_tendsto_infDist_zero
statement:
theorem isMeasurableSelection_of_tendsto_infDist_zero
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [PseudoMetricSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {S : Ω → Set E} (hclosed : ∀ ω, IsClosed (S ω))
    (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    {f : ℕ → Ω → E} {g : Ω → E}
    (hf : ∀ n, Measurable (f n))
    (hfg : ∀ ω, Tendsto (fun n => f n ω) atTop (𝓝 (g ω)))
    (hdist : ∀ ω,
      Tendsto (fun n => infDist (f n ω) (S ω)) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    IsMeasurableSelection S g
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · apply measurable_of_tendsto_metrizable hf
    rw [tendsto_pi_nhds]
    exact hfg
  · intro ω
    apply ((hclosed ω).mem_iff_infDist_zero (hne ω)).mpr
    have hcont : Tendsto (fun n => infDist (f n ω) (S ω)) atTop
        (𝓝 (infDist (g ω) (S ω))) :=
      (continuous_infDist_pt (S ω)).tendsto (g ω) |>.comp (hfg ω)
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique hcont (hdist ω)

name: RandomSetTheory.measurableSet_measurableLiftingBasisEvent
statement:
theorem measurableSet_measurableLiftingBasisEvent
    {Ω X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [MetricSpace X] [CompleteSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    [SecondCountableTopology X] [Nonempty X]
    [MetricSpace Y] [MeasurableSpace Y] [BorelSpace Y]
    [SecondCountableTopology Y]
    {S : Ω → Set X} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω)) (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    {φ : Ω × X → Y} (hφmeas : Measurable φ)
    (hφcont : ∀ ω, Continuous fun x => φ (ω, x))
    {v : Ω → Y} (hv : Measurable v)
    (U : Set X) (n m : ℕ) :
    MeasurableSet
      {ω | MeasurableLiftingBasisEvent S φ v U n m ω}
proof:
:= by
  let q : X := denseSeq X n
  let r : ℝ := 1 / (m + 1 : ℝ)
  let L : Ω → Set X := castaingLocalization S q r
  let ρ : Ω × X → ℝ := fun p => dist (φ p) (v p.1)
  have hLcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (L ω) :=
    castaingLocalization_isCompact hcompact q r
  have hLne : ∀ ω, (L ω).Nonempty :=
    castaingLocalization_nonempty hne q r
  have hLEffros : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable L :=
    effros_castaingLocalization hS q r
  have hρmeas : Measurable ρ := by
    exact hφmeas.dist (hv.comp measurable_fst)
  have hρcont : ∀ ω, Continuous fun x => ρ (ω, x) := by
    intro ω
    simpa [ρ] using
      (hφcont ω).dist (continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : X => v ω)
  have himageEffros : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable
      (fun ω => (fun x => ρ (ω, x)) '' L ω) :=
    effrosMeasurable_caratheodoryImage hLEffros
      (fun ω => (hLcompact ω).isClosed) hLne hρmeas hρcont
  have himageNe : ∀ ω, ((fun x => ρ (ω, x)) '' L ω).Nonempty :=
    fun ω => (hLne ω).image fun x => ρ (ω, x)
  have hlocalDist : Measurable
      (fun ω => infDist 0 ((fun x => ρ (ω, x)) '' L ω)) :=
    measurable_infDist_correspondence himageEffros himageNe 0
  have hhit : MeasurableSet {ω | (S ω ∩ Metric.ball q r).Nonempty} :=
    hS (Metric.ball q r) Metric.isOpen_ball
  by_cases hb : Metric.closedBall q r ⊆ U
  · have hEq :
        {ω | MeasurableLiftingBasisEvent S φ v U n m ω} =
          {ω | (S ω ∩ Metric.ball q r).Nonempty} ∩
            {ω | infDist 0 ((fun x => ρ (ω, x)) '' L ω) = 0} := by
      ext ω
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨_, hhitω, hzero⟩
        exact ⟨by simpa [q, r] using hhitω,
          by simpa [L, ρ, q, r] using hzero⟩
      · rintro ⟨hhitω, hzero⟩
        exact ⟨by simpa [q, r] using hb,
          by simpa [q, r] using hhitω,
          by simpa [L, ρ, q, r] using hzero⟩
    rw [hEq]
    exact hhit.inter (measurableSet_eq_fun hlocalDist measurable_const)
  · have hempty :
        {ω | MeasurableLiftingBasisEvent S φ v U n m ω} =
          (∅ : Set Ω) := by
      ext ω
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_empty_iff_false]
      constructor
      · intro hω
        exact (hb (by simpa [q, r] using hω.1)).elim
      · exact False.elim
    rw [hempty]
    exact MeasurableSet.empty

name: RandomSetTheory.effrosMeasurable_measurableLiftingFiber
statement:
theorem effrosMeasurable_measurableLiftingFiber
    {Ω X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [MetricSpace X] [CompleteSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    [SecondCountableTopology X] [Nonempty X]
    [MetricSpace Y] [MeasurableSpace Y] [BorelSpace Y]
    [SecondCountableTopology Y]
    {S : Ω → Set X} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω)) (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    {φ : Ω × X → Y} (hφmeas : Measurable φ)
    (hφcont : ∀ ω, Continuous fun x => φ (ω, x))
    {v : Ω → Y} (hv : Measurable v) :
    RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable (measurableLiftingFiber S φ v)
proof:
:= by
  intro U hU
  have hEq :
      {ω | (measurableLiftingFiber S φ v ω ∩ U).Nonempty} =
        ⋃ n : ℕ, ⋃ m : ℕ,
          {ω | MeasurableLiftingBasisEvent S φ v U n m ω} := by
    ext ω
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_iUnion]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, hxFiber, hxU⟩
      obtain ⟨n, m, hxball, hclosedBall⟩ :=
        exists_denseSeq_ball_closedBall_subset hU hxU
      let q : X := denseSeq X n
      let r : ℝ := 1 / (m + 1 : ℝ)
      have hhit : (S ω ∩ Metric.ball q r).Nonempty :=
        ⟨x, hxFiber.1, by simpa [q, r] using hxball⟩
      have hxlocal : x ∈ castaingLocalization S q r ω := by
        rw [castaingLocalization, if_pos hhit]
        exact subset_closure ⟨hxFiber.1, by simpa [q, r] using hxball⟩
      have hzeroMem : (0 : ℝ) ∈
          (fun z => dist (φ (ω, z)) (v ω)) ''
            castaingLocalization S q r ω := by
        refine ⟨x, hxlocal, ?_⟩
        change dist (φ (ω, x)) (v ω) = 0
        rw [hxFiber.2]
        exact dist_self _
      refine ⟨n, m, ?_⟩
      exact ⟨by simpa [q, r] using hclosedBall,
        by simpa [q, r] using hhit,
        by simpa [q, r] using Metric.infDist_zero_of_mem hzeroMem⟩
    · rintro ⟨n, m, hbasis, hhit, hzero⟩
      let q : X := denseSeq X n
      let r : ℝ := 1 / (m + 1 : ℝ)
      let L : Set X := castaingLocalization S q r ω
      let ρ : X → ℝ := fun x => dist (φ (ω, x)) (v ω)
      have hhit' : (S ω ∩ Metric.ball q r).Nonempty := by
        simpa [q, r] using hhit
      have hLcompact : IsCompact L := by
        simpa [L] using castaingLocalization_isCompact hcompact q r ω
      have hLne : L.Nonempty := by
        simpa [L] using castaingLocalization_nonempty hne q r ω
      have hρcont : Continuous ρ := by
        simpa [ρ] using
          (hφcont ω).dist (continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : X => v ω)
      have himageCompact : IsCompact (ρ '' L) := hLcompact.image hρcont
      have himageNe : (ρ '' L).Nonempty := hLne.image ρ
      have hzero' : infDist 0 (ρ '' L) = 0 := by
        simpa [L, ρ, q, r] using hzero
      have hzeroMem : (0 : ℝ) ∈ ρ '' L :=
        (himageCompact.isClosed.mem_iff_infDist_zero himageNe).2 hzero'
      rcases hzeroMem with ⟨x, hxL, hρx⟩
      have hxS : x ∈ S ω :=
        castaingLocalization_subset
          (fun ω => (hcompact ω).isClosed) q r ω (by simpa [L] using hxL)
      have hxclosure : x ∈ closure (S ω ∩ Metric.ball q r) := by
        have : x ∈ castaingLocalization S q r ω := by simpa [L] using hxL
        simpa [castaingLocalization, hhit'] using this
      have hxclosedBall : x ∈ Metric.closedBall q r :=
        closure_minimal
          (inter_subset_right.trans Metric.ball_subset_closedBall)
          Metric.isClosed_closedBall hxclosure
      have hφx : φ (ω, x) = v ω := by
        apply dist_eq_zero.mp
        simpa [ρ] using hρx
      refine ⟨x, ⟨hxS, hφx⟩, ?_⟩
      have hbasis' : Metric.closedBall q r ⊆ U := by
        simpa [q, r] using hbasis
      exact hbasis' hxclosedBall
  rw [hEq]
  exact MeasurableSet.iUnion fun n => MeasurableSet.iUnion fun m =>
    measurableSet_measurableLiftingBasisEvent
      hS hcompact hne hφmeas hφcont hv U n m

name: RandomSetTheory.measurable_measurableLiftingSelection
statement:
theorem measurable_measurableLiftingSelection
    {Ω X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [MetricSpace X] [CompleteSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    [SecondCountableTopology X] [Nonempty X]
    [MetricSpace Y] [MeasurableSpace Y] [BorelSpace Y]
    [SecondCountableTopology Y]
    {S : Ω → Set X} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω)) (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    {φ : Ω × X → Y} (hφmeas : Measurable φ)
    (hφcont : ∀ ω, Continuous fun x => φ (ω, x))
    {v : Ω → Y} (hv : Measurable v)
    (hfiberNe : ∀ ω, (measurableLiftingFiber S φ v ω).Nonempty) :
    Measurable
      (measurableLiftingSelection hS hcompact hne hφmeas hφcont hv hfiberNe)
proof:
:=
  (kuratowski_ryll_nardzewski
    (effrosMeasurable_measurableLiftingFiber hS hcompact hne
      hφmeas hφcont hv)
    (fun ω => (measurableLiftingFiber_isCompact hcompact hφcont v ω).isClosed)
    hfiberNe).1

statement:

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_measurable_lifting
statement:
theorem exists_measurable_lifting
    {Ω X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [MetricSpace X] [CompleteSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    [SecondCountableTopology X] [Nonempty X]
    [MetricSpace Y] [MeasurableSpace Y] [BorelSpace Y]
    [SecondCountableTopology Y]
    {S : Ω → Set X} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω)) (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)

    (hφcont : ∀ ω, Continuous fun x => φ (ω, x))
    {v : Ω → Y} (hv : Measurable v)
    (hfiberNe : ∀ ω, (measurableLiftingFiber S φ v ω).Nonempty) :
    ∃ T : Ω → X, Measurable T ∧
      ∀ ω, T ω ∈ S ω ∧ φ (ω, T ω) = v ω
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨measurableLiftingSelection hS hcompact hne
      hφmeas hφcont hv hfiberNe,
    measurable_measurableLiftingSelection hS hcompact hne
      hφmeas hφcont hv hfiberNe, ?_⟩
  exact measurableLiftingSelection_mem_and_map_eq hS hcompact hne
    hφmeas hφcont hv hfiberNe

statement:

proof:

name: RandomSetTheory.measurableSet_measurableLiftingFiber_nonempty
statement:
theorem measurableSet_measurableLiftingFiber_nonempty

    (hφcont : ∀ ω, Continuous fun x => φ (ω, x))
    {v : Ω → Y} (hv : Measurable v) :

      {ω | (measurableLiftingFiber S φ v ω).Nonempty}
proof:
:= by
  have hFiber := effrosMeasurable_measurableLiftingFiber

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_measurable_lifting_of_ae_mem_image
statement:
theorem exists_measurable_lifting_of_ae_mem_image
    {Ω X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [MetricSpace X] [CompleteSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    [SecondCountableTopology X] [Nonempty X]
    [MetricSpace Y] [MeasurableSpace Y] [BorelSpace Y]
    [SecondCountableTopology Y]
    {μ : Measure Ω}
    {S : Ω → Set X} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω)) (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    {φ : Ω × X → Y} (hφmeas : Measurable φ)
    (hφcont : ∀ ω, Continuous fun x => φ (ω, x))
    {v : Ω → Y} (hv : Measurable v)
    (hvmem : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, v ω ∈ (fun x => φ (ω, x)) '' S ω) :
    ∃ T : Ω → X, Measurable T ∧
      (∀ ω, T ω ∈ S ω) ∧
        ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, φ (ω, T ω) = v ω
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let A : Set Ω :=
    {ω | (measurableLiftingFiber S φ v ω).Nonempty}
  have hAmeas : MeasurableSet A := by
    simpa only [A] using
      measurableSet_measurableLiftingFiber_nonempty
        hS hcompact hne hφmeas hφcont hv
  let f₀ : Ω → X := krnSelection hS hne
  have hf₀sel : IsMeasurableSelection S f₀ := by
    simpa only [f₀] using
      kuratowski_ryll_nardzewski hS
        (fun ω => (hcompact ω).isClosed) hne
  have hφf₀ : Measurable (fun ω => φ (ω, f₀ ω)) :=
    hφmeas.comp (measurable_id.prodMk hf₀sel.1)
  let v' : Ω → Y := A.piecewise v (fun ω => φ (ω, f₀ ω))
  have hv' : Measurable v' := by
    simpa only [v'] using
      Measurable.piecewise hAmeas hv hφf₀
  have hv'fiberNe : ∀ ω,
      (measurableLiftingFiber S φ v' ω).Nonempty := by
    intro ω
    by_cases hω : ω ∈ A
    · have hneω : (measurableLiftingFiber S φ v ω).Nonempty := by
        simpa only [A, Set.mem_setOf_eq] using hω
      rcases hneω with ⟨x, hxS, hxφ⟩
      refine ⟨x, hxS, ?_⟩
      simpa [v', Set.piecewise, hω] using hxφ
    · refine ⟨f₀ ω, hf₀sel.2 ω, ?_⟩
      simp [v', hω]
  obtain ⟨T, hTmeas, hTprop⟩ :=
    exists_measurable_lifting hS hcompact hne
      hφmeas hφcont hv' hv'fiberNe
  have hAae : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ω ∈ A := by
    filter_upwards [hvmem] with ω hω
    rcases hω with ⟨x, hxS, hxφ⟩
    change (measurableLiftingFiber S φ v ω).Nonempty
    exact ⟨x, hxS, hxφ⟩
  refine ⟨T, hTmeas, fun ω => (hTprop ω).1, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hAae] with ω hω
  calc
    φ (ω, T ω) = v' ω := (hTprop ω).2
    _ = v ω := by simp [v', hω]

name: RandomSetTheory.effrosMeasurable_measurableLiftingFiber_param
statement:
theorem effrosMeasurable_measurableLiftingFiber_param
    {Ω Θ X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Θ]
    [MetricSpace X] [CompleteSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    [SecondCountableTopology X] [Nonempty X]
    [MetricSpace Y] [MeasurableSpace Y] [BorelSpace Y]
    [SecondCountableTopology Y]
    {S : Ω → Set X} (hS : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    (hcompact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S ω)) (hne : ∀ ω, (S ω).Nonempty)
    {φ : (Ω × Θ) × X → Y} (hφmeas : Measurable φ)
    (hφcont : ∀ p : Ω × Θ, Continuous fun x => φ (p, x))
    {v : Ω × Θ → Y} (hv : Measurable v) :
    RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable
      (measurableLiftingFiber (fun p : Ω × Θ => S p.1) φ v)
proof:
:= by
  have hSlift : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable
      (fun p : Ω × Θ => S p.1) := by
    intro U hU
    have hEq :
        {p : Ω × Θ | (S p.1 ∩ U).Nonempty} =
          Prod.fst ⁻¹' {ω | (S ω ∩ U).Nonempty} := by
      ext p
      rfl
    rw [hEq]
    exact measurable_fst (hS U hU)
  exact effrosMeasurable_measurableLiftingFiber hSlift
    (fun p => hcompact p.1) (fun p => hne p.1) hφmeas hφcont hv
