name: ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun_finiteProcess_ghostDifference
statement:
theorem iIndepFun_finiteProcess_ghostDifference
    [Fintype ι] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ι → Omega → T → ℝ) (N : Finset T)
    (hXmeas : ∀ i, Measurable (fun omega (t : N) ↦ X i omega t))
    (hXindep : iIndepFun
      (fun i omega (t : N) ↦ X i omega t) mu) :
    iIndepFun
      (fun i (z : Omega × Omega) (t : N) ↦
        X i z.1 t - X i z.2 t) (mu.prod mu)
proof:
:= by
  let V : ι → Omega → (N → ℝ) :=
    fun i omega t ↦ X i omega t
  let nu : ι → Measure (N → ℝ) := fun i ↦ mu.map (V i)
  have hVmeas : ∀ i, Measurable (V i) := by
    intro i
    exact hXmeas i
  have hVlaw : ∀ i, HasLaw (V i) (nu i) mu := by
    intro i
    exact
      { aemeasurable := (hVmeas i).aemeasurable
        map_eq := rfl }
  have hVindep : iIndepFun V mu := by
    simpa only [V] using hXindep
  have hJointLaw :
      HasLaw (fun omega i ↦ V i omega) (Measure.pi nu) mu :=
    hVindep.hasLaw_pi hVlaw
  let J : Omega → (ι → (N → ℝ)) := fun omega i ↦ V i omega
  have hJmeas : Measurable J := by
    exact measurable_pi_lambda _ hVmeas
  have hJlaw : HasLaw J (Measure.pi nu) mu := by
    simpa only [J] using hJointLaw
  have hcopiesIndep :
      IndepFun (fun z : Omega × Omega ↦ J z.1)
        (fun z : Omega × Omega ↦ J z.2) (mu.prod mu) :=
    indepFun_prod hJmeas hJmeas
  have hfstLaw : HasLaw (fun z : Omega × Omega ↦ J z.1)
      (Measure.pi nu) (mu.prod mu) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def] using
      hJlaw.comp (measurePreserving_fst.hasLaw :
        HasLaw Prod.fst mu (mu.prod mu))
  have hsndLaw : HasLaw (fun z : Omega × Omega ↦ J z.2)
      (Measure.pi nu) (mu.prod mu) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def] using
      hJlaw.comp (measurePreserving_snd.hasLaw :
        HasLaw Prod.snd mu (mu.prod mu))
  have hpairArrays : HasLaw
      (fun z : Omega × Omega ↦ (J z.1, J z.2))
      ((Measure.pi nu).prod (Measure.pi nu)) (mu.prod mu) :=
    hcopiesIndep.hasLaw_prod hfstLaw hsndLaw
  let pairByCoordinate :
      ((ι → (N → ℝ)) × (ι → (N → ℝ))) → (ι → ((N → ℝ) × (N → ℝ))) :=
    (MeasurableEquiv.arrowProdEquivProdArrow (N → ℝ) (N → ℝ) ι).symm
  have hpairByCoordinatePreserving : MeasurePreserving pairByCoordinate
      ((Measure.pi nu).prod (Measure.pi nu))
      (Measure.pi fun i ↦ (nu i).prod (nu i)) := by
    simpa only [pairByCoordinate] using
      (measurePreserving_arrowProdEquivProdArrow
        (N → ℝ) (N → ℝ) ι nu nu).symm
  have hallPairLaw : HasLaw
      (fun z : Omega × Omega ↦ pairByCoordinate (J z.1, J z.2))
      (Measure.pi fun i ↦ (nu i).prod (nu i)) (mu.prod mu) := by
    exact hpairByCoordinatePreserving.fun_comp_hasLaw hpairArrays
  let P : ι → (Omega × Omega) → ((N → ℝ) × (N → ℝ)) :=
    fun i z ↦ (V i z.1, V i z.2)
  have hPmeas : ∀ i, Measurable (P i) := by
    intro i
    exact ((hVmeas i).comp measurable_fst).prodMk
      ((hVmeas i).comp measurable_snd)
  have hPcoordLaw : ∀ i, HasLaw (P i) ((nu i).prod (nu i)) (mu.prod mu) := by
    intro i
    have hiIndep : IndepFun (fun z : Omega × Omega ↦ V i z.1)
        (fun z : Omega × Omega ↦ V i z.2) (mu.prod mu) :=
      indepFun_prod (hVmeas i) (hVmeas i)
    have hiFst : HasLaw (fun z : Omega × Omega ↦ V i z.1)
        (nu i) (mu.prod mu) := by
      simpa only [Function.comp_def] using
        (hVlaw i).comp (measurePreserving_fst.hasLaw :
          HasLaw Prod.fst mu (mu.prod mu))
    have hiSnd : HasLaw (fun z : Omega × Omega ↦ V i z.2)
        (nu i) (mu.prod mu) := by
      simpa only [Function.comp_def] using
        (hVlaw i).comp (measurePreserving_snd.hasLaw :
          HasLaw Prod.snd mu (mu.prod mu))
    simpa only [P] using hiIndep.hasLaw_prod hiFst hiSnd
  have hPairsIndep : iIndepFun P (mu.prod mu) := by
    apply (iIndepFun_iff_hasLaw_pi_pi hPcoordLaw).2
    have hcoordinateIdentity :
        (fun z : Omega × Omega ↦ pairByCoordinate (J z.1, J z.2)) =
          (fun z i ↦ (V i z.1, V i z.2)) := by
      funext z i
      rfl
    rw [hcoordinateIdentity] at hallPairLaw
    simpa only [P] using hallPairLaw
  have hDiff := hPairsIndep.comp
      (fun _ (v : (N → ℝ) × (N → ℝ)) t ↦ v.1 t - v.2 t)
      (fun _ ↦ by fun_prop)
  simpa only [P, V, Function.comp_def] using hDiff

name: ProbabilityTheory.integrable_finsetSupAbs_of_le
statement:
theorem integrable_finsetSupAbs_of_le
    {Omega T : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega}
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (F : Omega → T → ℝ) (B : Omega → ℝ)
    (hFmeas : ∀ t ∈ s, Measurable (fun omega ↦ F omega t))
    (hBint : Integrable B mu)
    (hdom : ∀ omega t, t ∈ s → |F omega t| ≤ |B omega|) :
    Integrable
      (fun omega ↦ s.sup' hs (fun t ↦ |F omega t|)) mu
proof:
:= by
  let S : Omega → ℝ := fun omega ↦ s.sup' hs (fun t ↦ |F omega t|)
  have hSmeas : Measurable S := by
    have h : Measurable
        (s.sup' hs (fun t ↦ fun omega : Omega ↦ |F omega t|)) := by
      apply Finset.measurable_sup' hs
      intro t ht
      exact (hFmeas t ht).abs
    convert h using 1
    funext omega
    exact (Finset.sup'_apply hs
      (fun t ↦ fun z ↦ |F z t|) omega).symm
  apply hBint.abs.mono' hSmeas.aestronglyMeasurable
  exact ae_of_all mu fun omega ↦ by
    have hSnonneg : 0 ≤ S omega := by
      obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hs
      exact (abs_nonneg (F omega t)).trans
        (Finset.le_sup' (fun u ↦ |F omega u|) ht)
    have hSupper : S omega ≤ |B omega| := by
      apply Finset.sup'_le hs
      intro t ht
      exact hdom omega t ht
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hSnonneg] using hSupper

name: ProbabilityTheory.inv_mul_strongMomentResidual_le_div
statement:
theorem inv_mul_strongMomentResidual_le_div
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 1 ≤ q) {Q y alpha : ℝ}
    (hy : 0 < y) (halpha0 : 0 < alpha)
    (hscale : Q * Real.exp (-Real.log alpha) ≤ y ^ q) :
    alpha⁻¹ * (Q / ((q : ℝ) * y ^ (q - 1))) ≤ y / (q : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hscale' : Q * alpha⁻¹ ≤ y ^ q := by
    rw [Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log halpha0] at hscale
    exact hscale
  have hden : 0 < (q : ℝ) * y ^ (q - 1) := by positivity
  have hquotient :
      (Q * alpha⁻¹) / ((q : ℝ) * y ^ (q - 1)) ≤
        y ^ q / ((q : ℝ) * y ^ (q - 1)) :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hscale' hden.le
  calc
    alpha⁻¹ * (Q / ((q : ℝ) * y ^ (q - 1))) =
        (Q * alpha⁻¹) / ((q : ℝ) * y ^ (q - 1)) := by ring
    _ ≤ y ^ q / ((q : ℝ) * y ^ (q - 1)) := hquotient
    _ = y / (q : ℝ) := by
      have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := by omega
      rw [← pow_sub_one_mul hq0 y]
      field_simp [hy.ne']

name: ProbabilityTheory.conditionalValueAtRisk_sum_le_rioStrongMoment_explicit
statement:
theorem conditionalValueAtRisk_sum_le_rioStrongMoment_explicit
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (D : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hAdapted : StronglyAdapted filtration D)
    (second : ℕ → ℝ) (moment : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (n q : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    {V Q y alpha : ℝ} (hV : 0 < V) (hQ : 0 < Q) (hy : 0 < y)
    (hD : ∀ i < n, Integrable (D i) mu)
    (hDsq : ∀ i < n, Integrable (fun omega ↦ D i omega ^ 2) mu)
    (hpow : ∀ i < n, ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      Integrable (fun omega ↦ (max (D i omega) 0) ^ k) mu)
    (hcenter0 : ∫ omega, D 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hcenterSucc : ∀ i < n - 1,
      mu[D (i + 1) | filtration i] =ᵐ[mu] 0)
    (hsecond0 : (∫ omega, D 0 omega ^ 2 ∂mu) ≤ second 0)
    (hsecondSucc : ∀ i < n - 1,
      mu[fun omega ↦ D (i + 1) omega ^ 2 | filtration i] ≤ᵐ[mu]
        fun _ ↦ second (i + 1))
    (hmoment0 : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      (∫ omega, (max (D 0 omega) 0) ^ k ∂mu) ≤ moment 0 k)
    (hmomentSucc : ∀ i < n - 1, ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      mu[fun omega ↦ (max (D (i + 1) omega) 0) ^ k | filtration i]
        ≤ᵐ[mu] fun _ ↦ moment (i + 1) k)
    (hsecond : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, second i) ≤ V)
    (hmiddle : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Ico 3 q,
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, moment i k) ≤
        interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient q V Q k)
    (hmomentQ : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, moment i q) ≤ Q)
    (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha < 1)
    (hscale : Q * Real.exp (-Real.log alpha) ≤ y ^ q) :
    conditionalValueAtRisk alpha
        (fun omega ↦ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, D i omega) mu ≤
      Real.sqrt (2 * V * (-Real.log alpha)) +
        (1 + 1 / (q : ℝ)) * y +
          Real.exp 1 * strongMomentQScale q Q * (-Real.log alpha) / 3 +
        alpha⁻¹ * (Q / ((q : ℝ) * y ^ (q - 1)))
proof:
:= by
  let U : Omega → ℝ := fun omega ↦
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, upperTruncation (D i) y omega
  let R : Omega → ℝ := fun omega ↦
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, upperTruncationResidual (D i) y omega
  let seriesExponent : ℝ → ℝ := fun t ↦
    strongMomentSeriesExponent q t y
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, second i)
      (fun k ↦ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, moment i k)
  have hUInt : Integrable U mu := by
    dsimp only [U]
    apply integrable_finsetSum
    intro i hi
    exact integrable_upperTruncation (hD i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)) y
  have hRInt : Integrable R mu := by
    dsimp only [R]
    apply integrable_finsetSum
    intro i hi
    exact integrable_upperTruncationResidual
      (hD i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)) y
  have hmgfSeries : HasOneSidedMGF U seriesExponent mu := by
    simpa only [U, seriesExponent] using
      hasOneSidedMGF_sum_upperTruncation_of_strongMomentSeries
        filtration D hAdapted second moment n q hn hq hy hD hDsq hpow
          hcenter0 hcenterSucc hsecond0 hsecondSucc hmoment0 hmomentSucc
  have hseriesLe : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t →
      seriesExponent t ≤ rioStrongMomentExponent q V Q y t := by
    intro t ht
    exact strongMomentSeriesExponent_le_rioStrongMomentExponent
      q ht hy hsecond hmiddle hmomentQ
  have hmgfRio : HasOneSidedMGF U (rioStrongMomentExponent q V Q y) mu :=
    hmgfSeries.mono_exponent hseriesLe
  have hx : 0 < -Real.log alpha :=
    neg_pos.mpr (Real.log_neg halpha0 halpha1)
  have hcvarU : conditionalValueAtRisk alpha U mu ≤
      Real.sqrt (2 * V * (-Real.log alpha)) +
        (1 + 1 / (q : ℝ)) * y +
          Real.exp 1 * strongMomentQScale q Q * (-Real.log alpha) / 3 := by
    have hchernoff := hmgfRio.conditionalValueAtRisk_le_chernoffTransform
      hUInt halpha0 halpha1.le
    exact hchernoff.trans
      (chernoffTransform_rioStrongMomentExponent_le_explicit
        q hq hV hQ hy hx hscale)
  have hqIcc : q ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q :=
    Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨by omega, le_rfl⟩
  have hpowq : ∀ i < n,
      Integrable (fun omega ↦ (max (D i omega) 0) ^ q) mu := by
    intro i hi
    exact hpow i hi q hqIcc
  have hmomentQEach : ∀ i < n,
      (∫ omega, (max (D i omega) 0) ^ q ∂mu) ≤ moment i q := by
    intro i hi
    cases i with
    | zero => exact hmoment0 q hqIcc
    | succ i =>
        have hiPred : i < n - 1 := by omega
        have hcond := hmomentSucc i hiPred q hqIcc
        have hint :
            (∫ omega,
                mu[fun z ↦ (max (D (i + 1) z) 0) ^ q |
                  filtration i] omega ∂mu) ≤
              ∫ _ : Omega, moment (i + 1) q ∂mu :=
          integral_mono_ae integrable_condExp (integrable_const _) hcond
        rw [integral_condExp (filtration.le i), integral_const] at hint
        simpa only [probReal_univ, smul_eq_mul, one_mul] using hint
  have hrawMoment :
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
        ∫ omega, (max (D i omega) 0) ^ q ∂mu) ≤ Q := by
    exact (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi ↦
      hmomentQEach i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)).trans hmomentQ
  have hresidualBase :=
    conditionalValueAtRisk_sum_upperTruncationResidual_le
      D n q (by omega) hD hpowq hy halpha0 halpha1.le
  have hden : 0 < (q : ℝ) * y ^ (q - 1) := by positivity
  have hresidual : conditionalValueAtRisk alpha R mu ≤
      alpha⁻¹ * (Q / ((q : ℝ) * y ^ (q - 1))) := by
    have hresidualBase' : conditionalValueAtRisk alpha R mu ≤
        alpha⁻¹ *
          ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
            ∫ omega, (max (D i omega) 0) ^ q ∂mu) /
              ((q : ℝ) * y ^ (q - 1))) := by
      simpa only [R] using hresidualBase
    have hproxy :
        alpha⁻¹ *
            ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
              ∫ omega, (max (D i omega) 0) ^ q ∂mu) /
                ((q : ℝ) * y ^ (q - 1))) ≤
          alpha⁻¹ * (Q / ((q : ℝ) * y ^ (q - 1))) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hrawMoment hden.le)
        (inv_nonneg.mpr halpha0.le)
    exact hresidualBase'.trans hproxy
  have hdecomp :
      (fun omega ↦ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, D i omega) =
        fun omega ↦ U omega + R omega := by
    funext omega
    dsimp only [U, R]
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _hi
    exact (upperTruncation_add_residual (D i) y omega).symm
  rw [hdecomp]
  exact (conditionalValueAtRisk_add_le hUInt hRInt
    halpha0 halpha1.le).trans (add_le_add hcvarU hresidual)

name: ProbabilityTheory.lipschitzWith_integral_truncatedLipschitzIncrement
statement:
theorem lipschitzWith_integral_truncatedLipschitzIncrement
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (H : Z → T → ℝ) (R : Z → ℝ) {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (X : iota → Omega → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hH : ∀ t, Measurable (fun z ↦ H z t)) (hRmeas : Measurable R)
    (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (hLip : ∀ z s t, |H z s - H z t| ≤ R z * dist s t)
    (i : iota) (o : T) :
    LipschitzWith (Real.toNNReal M)
      (fun t ↦ ∫ xi, truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X i t o xi ∂mu)
proof:
:= by
  apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro s t
  have hs := integrable_truncatedLipschitzIncrement
    (μ := mu) H R hM X hX hH hRmeas hR hLip i s o
  have ht := integrable_truncatedLipschitzIncrement
    (μ := mu) H R hM X hX hH hRmeas hR hLip i t o
  rw [Real.dist_eq, ← integral_sub hs ht]
  have hbound : ∀ᵐ xi ∂mu,
      ‖truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X i s o xi -
          truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X i t o xi‖ ≤
        M * dist s t := by
    filter_upwards with xi
    have hst := abs_truncatedLipschitzObservation_sub_le
      H R hM hR hLip (X i xi) s t
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    convert hst using 1
    unfold truncatedLipschitzIncrement
    ring
  have hint := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const hbound
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, probReal_univ, mul_one,
    Real.coe_toNNReal _ hM] using hint

name: ProbabilityTheory.continuous_centeredAnchoredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess
statement:
theorem continuous_centeredAnchoredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (H : Z → T → ℝ) (R : Z → ℝ) {M c : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (X : iota → Omega → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hHmeas : ∀ t, Measurable (fun z ↦ H z t))
    (hHcont : ∀ z, Continuous (H z)) (hRmeas : Measurable R)
    (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (hLip : ∀ z s t, |H z s - H z t| ≤ R z * dist s t)
    (I : Finset iota) (o : T) (omega : Omega) :
    Continuous
      (centeredAnchoredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess
        (mu := mu) H R M c X I o omega)
proof:
:= by
  unfold centeredAnchoredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess
  apply continuous_const.mul
  apply continuous_finsetSum I
  intro i hi
  apply Continuous.sub
  · unfold truncatedLipschitzIncrement truncatedLipschitzObservation
    by_cases hz : R (X i omega) ≤ M
    · simp only [if_pos hz]
      exact (hHcont (X i omega)).sub continuous_const
    · simp only [if_neg hz]
      fun_prop
  · exact (lipschitzWith_integral_truncatedLipschitzIncrement
      (mu := mu) H R hM X hX hHmeas hRmeas hR hLip i o).continuous

name: ProbabilityTheory.centeredAnchoredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess_sub
statement:
theorem centeredAnchoredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess_sub
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (H : Z → T → ℝ) (R : Z → ℝ) {M c : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (X : iota → Omega → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hHmeas : ∀ t, Measurable (fun z ↦ H z t))
    (hRmeas : Measurable R) (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (hLip : ∀ z s t, |H z s - H z t| ≤ R z * dist s t)
    (I : Finset iota) (o : T) (omega : Omega) (s t : T) :
    centeredAnchoredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess
          (mu := mu) H R M c X I o omega s -
        centeredAnchoredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess
          (mu := mu) H R M c X I o omega t =
      c * ∑ i ∈ I,
        (truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X i s t omega -
          ∫ xi, truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X i s t xi ∂mu)
proof:
:= by
  unfold centeredAnchoredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess
  rw [← mul_sub, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  have hs := integrable_truncatedLipschitzIncrement
    (μ := mu) H R hM X hX hHmeas hRmeas hR hLip i s o
  have ht := integrable_truncatedLipschitzIncrement
    (μ := mu) H R hM X hX hHmeas hRmeas hR hLip i t o
  have hpoint :
      truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X i s o omega -
          truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X i t o omega =
        truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X i s t omega := by
    unfold truncatedLipschitzIncrement
    ring
  have hint :
      (∫ xi, truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X i s o xi ∂mu) -
          ∫ xi, truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X i t o xi ∂mu =
        ∫ xi, truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X i s t xi ∂mu := by
    rw [← integral_sub hs ht]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards with xi
    unfold truncatedLipschitzIncrement
    ring
  calc
    _ = (truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X i s o omega -
          truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X i t o omega) -
        ((∫ xi, truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X i s o xi ∂mu) -
          ∫ xi, truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R M X i t o xi ∂mu) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hpoint, hint]

name: ProbabilityTheory.centeredAnchoredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess_anchor
statement:
@[simp]
theorem centeredAnchoredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess_anchor
    (H : Z → T → ℝ) (R : Z → ℝ) (M c : ℝ)
    (X : iota → Omega → Z) (I : Finset iota) (o : T) (omega : Omega) :
    centeredAnchoredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess
      (mu := mu) H R M c X I o omega o = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [centeredAnchoredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess,
    truncatedLipschitzIncrement]

name: ProbabilityTheory.summable_dyadic_mixedEuclideanProcessBound
statement:
theorem summable_dyadic_mixedEuclideanProcessBound
    (sigma2 sigma1 : ℝ) (d : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    Summable (fun k ↦ mixedEuclideanProcessBound
      (((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k) * sigma2)
      (((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k) * sigma1) d
      (mixedEuclideanConfidence d x k))
proof:
:= by
  let q : ℝ := 1 / 2
  have hq : ‖q‖ < 1 := by norm_num [q, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have hgeom : Summable (fun k : ℕ ↦ q ^ k) :=
    summable_geometric_of_norm_lt_one hq
  have hthresholdSqrt :=
    summable_mixedEuclideanThreshold
      (σ₂ := (1 : ℝ)) (σ₁ := (0 : ℝ))
      (by norm_num) (by norm_num) d hx
  have hsqrt : Summable (fun k : ℕ ↦
      q ^ k * Real.sqrt (2 * mixedEuclideanConfidence d x k)) := by
    have h := hthresholdSqrt.mul_left (1 / 3 : ℝ)
    simpa [mixedEuclideanThreshold, q, mul_comm, mul_left_comm,
      mul_assoc] using h
  have hthresholdLinear :=
    summable_mixedEuclideanThreshold
      (σ₂ := (0 : ℝ)) (σ₁ := (1 : ℝ))
      (by norm_num) (by norm_num) d hx
  have hlinear : Summable (fun k : ℕ ↦
      q ^ k * mixedEuclideanConfidence d x k) := by
    have h := hthresholdLinear.mul_left (1 / 6 : ℝ)
    simpa [mixedEuclideanThreshold, q, mul_comm, mul_left_comm,
      mul_assoc] using h
  have hsum :=
    (((hsqrt.mul_left (6 * sigma2)).add
      (hgeom.mul_left (72 * sigma2 * Real.sqrt (d + 1 : ℝ)))).add
      (hlinear.mul_left (12 * sigma1))).add
      (hgeom.mul_left (144 * sigma1 * (d + 1 : ℝ)))
  simpa [mixedEuclideanProcessBound, q, add_comm, add_left_comm,
    add_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hsum

name: ProbabilityTheory.one_add_two_div_dyadicResolution_pow_le_exp
statement:
theorem one_add_two_div_dyadicResolution_pow_le_exp
    (d k : ℕ) :
    (1 + 2 / RandomSetTheory.dyadicResolution k) ^ d ≤
      Real.exp (4 * (d : ℝ) * (k + 2 : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hdelta := RandomSetTheory.dyadicResolution_pos k
  have hdeltaOne := RandomSetTheory.dyadicResolution_le_one k
  have hbase :
      1 + 2 / RandomSetTheory.dyadicResolution k ≤
        3 / RandomSetTheory.dyadicResolution k := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hdelta).2
    calc
      (1 + 2 / RandomSetTheory.dyadicResolution k) *
          RandomSetTheory.dyadicResolution k =
        RandomSetTheory.dyadicResolution k + 2 := by field_simp
      _ ≤ 3 := by linarith
  have hpow :
      (1 + 2 / RandomSetTheory.dyadicResolution k) ^ d ≤
        (3 / RandomSetTheory.dyadicResolution k) ^ d :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hbase d
  have hexpBase := RandomSetTheory.three_div_dyadicResolution_le_exp k
  calc
    (1 + 2 / RandomSetTheory.dyadicResolution k) ^ d ≤
        (3 / RandomSetTheory.dyadicResolution k) ^ d := hpow
    _ ≤ (Real.exp (2 * (k + 1 : ℝ))) ^ d :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hexpBase d
    _ = Real.exp ((d : ℝ) * (2 * (k + 1 : ℝ))) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]
    _ ≤ Real.exp (4 * (d : ℝ) * (k + 2 : ℝ)) := by
      rw [Real.exp_le_exp]
      nlinarith [show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (d : ℝ) from Nat.cast_nonneg d,
        show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) from Nat.cast_nonneg k]

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_unitBall_range_succ_centeredTruncated_largeDeviation_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_unitBall_range_succ_centeredTruncated_largeDeviation_le
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (H : Z → E → ℝ) (R : Z → ℝ) {a K x : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hK : 0 < K) (hx : 0 ≤ x)
    (X : ℕ → Omega → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X mu)
    (hHmeas : ∀ t, Measurable (fun z ↦ H z t))
    (hHcont : ∀ z, Continuous (H z)) (hRmeas : Measurable R)
    (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (hLip : ∀ z s t, |H z s - H z t| ≤ R z * dist s t)
    (hRL2 : ∀ i, MemLp (fun omega ↦ R (X i omega)) 2 mu)
    (hRsecond : ∀ i, ∫ omega, R (X i omega) ^ 2 ∂mu ≤ K ^ 2)
    (n : ℕ) :
    let G : Omega → EuclideanUnitBall E → ℝ := fun omega t ↦
      centeredAnchoredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess (mu := mu) H R
        (a * Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ)) (Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ X
        (Finset.range (n + 1)) 0 omega (t : E)
    mu.real {omega | ∃ t : EuclideanUnitBall E,
      mixedEuclideanProcessBound (2 * K) (2 * a) (finrank ℝ E) x <
        |G omega t|} ≤ Real.exp (-x)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let G : Omega → EuclideanUnitBall E → ℝ := fun omega t ↦
    centeredAnchoredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess (mu := mu) H R
      (a * Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ)) (Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ X
      (Finset.range (n + 1)) 0 omega (t : E)
  apply measureReal_unitBall_mixedProcess_largeDeviation_le
    G (by positivity) (by positivity) hx
  · intro omega
    exact (continuous_centeredAnchoredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess
      H R (mul_nonneg ha (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)) X hX hHmeas hHcont
        hRmeas hR hLip (Finset.range (n + 1)) 0 omega).comp
          continuous_subtype_val
  · intro omega
    exact centeredAnchoredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess_anchor
      H R _ _ X (Finset.range (n + 1)) 0 omega
  · intro s t y hy
    have htail :=
      measureReal_range_succ_centeredTruncated_increment_mixedTail
        H R ha hK X hX hIndep hHmeas hRmeas hR hLip hRL2 hRsecond
          n (s : E) (t : E) y hy
    have hsub : ∀ omega, G omega s - G omega t =
        (Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          (truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R
              (a * Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ)) X i (s : E) (t : E) omega -
            ∫ xi, truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R
              (a * Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ)) X i (s : E) (t : E) xi ∂mu) := by
      intro omega
      exact centeredAnchoredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess_sub
        H R (mul_nonneg ha (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)) X hX hHmeas hRmeas
          hR hLip (Finset.range (n + 1)) 0 omega (s : E) (t : E)
    simpa only [G, hsub, Subtype.dist_eq] using htail

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_unitBall_local_range_succ_centeredTruncated_largeDeviation_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_unitBall_local_range_succ_centeredTruncated_largeDeviation_le
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (H : Z → E → ℝ) (R : Z → ℝ) {a K r x : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hK : 0 < K) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hx : 0 ≤ x)
    (X : ℕ → Omega → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X mu)
    (hHmeas : ∀ t, Measurable (fun z ↦ H z t))
    (hHcont : ∀ z, Continuous (H z)) (hRmeas : Measurable R)
    (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (hLip : ∀ z s t, |H z s - H z t| ≤ R z * dist s t)
    (hRL2 : ∀ i, MemLp (fun omega ↦ R (X i omega)) 2 mu)
    (hRsecond : ∀ i, ∫ omega, R (X i omega) ^ 2 ∂mu ≤ K ^ 2)
    (n : ℕ) (u : E) :
    let G : Omega → E → ℝ := fun omega t ↦
      centeredAnchoredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess (mu := mu) H R
        (a * Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ)) (Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ X
        (Finset.range (n + 1)) 0 omega t
    mu.real {omega | ∃ t : EuclideanUnitBall E,
      mixedEuclideanProcessBound (2 * (r * K)) (2 * (r * a))
          (finrank ℝ E) x <
        |G omega (u + r • (t : E)) - G omega u|} ≤ Real.exp (-x)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let G : Omega → E → ℝ := fun omega t ↦
    centeredAnchoredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess (mu := mu) H R
      (a * Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ)) (Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ X
      (Finset.range (n + 1)) 0 omega t
  let GLocal : Omega → EuclideanUnitBall E → ℝ := fun omega t ↦
    G omega (u + r • (t : E)) - G omega u
  apply measureReal_unitBall_mixedProcess_largeDeviation_le
    GLocal (by positivity) (by positivity) hx
  · intro omega
    have hG : Continuous (G omega) :=
      continuous_centeredAnchoredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess
        H R (mul_nonneg ha (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)) X hX hHmeas hHcont
          hRmeas hR hLip (Finset.range (n + 1)) 0 omega
    exact (hG.comp
      (continuous_const.add (continuous_const.smul continuous_subtype_val))).sub
        continuous_const
  · intro omega
    simp only [GLocal, G, smul_zero, add_zero, sub_self]
  · intro s t y hy
    have htail :=
      measureReal_range_succ_centeredTruncated_increment_mixedTail
        H R ha hK X hX hIndep hHmeas hRmeas hR hLip hRL2 hRsecond
          n (u + r • (s : E)) (u + r • (t : E)) y hy
    have hdist :
        dist (u + r • (s : E)) (u + r • (t : E)) =
          r * dist s t := by
      rw [dist_add_left, dist_smul₀, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hr,
        Subtype.dist_eq]
    have hthreshold :
        2 * K * dist (u + r • (s : E)) (u + r • (t : E)) *
              Real.sqrt (2 * y) +
            2 * (2 * a) *
              dist (u + r • (s : E)) (u + r • (t : E)) * y =
          2 * (r * K) * dist s t * Real.sqrt (2 * y) +
            2 * (2 * (r * a)) * dist s t * y := by
      rw [hdist]
      ring
    have hsub : ∀ omega,
        GLocal omega s - GLocal omega t =
          (Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ *
            ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
              (truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R
                  (a * Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ)) X i
                    (u + r • (s : E)) (u + r • (t : E)) omega -
                ∫ xi, truncatedLipschitzIncrement H R
                  (a * Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ)) X i
                    (u + r • (s : E)) (u + r • (t : E)) xi ∂mu) := by
      intro omega
      calc
        GLocal omega s - GLocal omega t =
            G omega (u + r • (s : E)) - G omega (u + r • (t : E)) := by
              dsimp only [GLocal]
              ring
        _ = _ := centeredAnchoredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess_sub
          H R (mul_nonneg ha (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)) X hX hHmeas hRmeas
            hR hLip (Finset.range (n + 1)) 0 omega
              (u + r • (s : E)) (u + r • (t : E))
    simpa only [hthreshold, hsub] using htail

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_closedBall_local_range_succ_centeredTruncated_largeDeviation_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_closedBall_local_range_succ_centeredTruncated_largeDeviation_le
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (H : Z → E → ℝ) (R : Z → ℝ) {a K r x : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hK : 0 < K) (hr : 0 < r) (hx : 0 ≤ x)
    (X : ℕ → Omega → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X mu)
    (hHmeas : ∀ t, Measurable (fun z ↦ H z t))
    (hHcont : ∀ z, Continuous (H z)) (hRmeas : Measurable R)
    (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (hLip : ∀ z s t, |H z s - H z t| ≤ R z * dist s t)
    (hRL2 : ∀ i, MemLp (fun omega ↦ R (X i omega)) 2 mu)
    (hRsecond : ∀ i, ∫ omega, R (X i omega) ^ 2 ∂mu ≤ K ^ 2)
    (n : ℕ) (u : E) :
    let G : Omega → E → ℝ := fun omega t ↦
      centeredAnchoredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess (mu := mu) H R
        (a * Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ)) (Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ X
        (Finset.range (n + 1)) 0 omega t
    mu.real {omega | ∃ v : E, dist v u ≤ r ∧
      mixedEuclideanProcessBound (2 * (r * K)) (2 * (r * a))
          (finrank ℝ E) x < |G omega v - G omega u|} ≤
      Real.exp (-x)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let G : Omega → E → ℝ := fun omega t ↦
    centeredAnchoredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess (mu := mu) H R
      (a * Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ)) (Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ X
      (Finset.range (n + 1)) 0 omega t
  have hunit :=
    measureReal_unitBall_local_range_succ_centeredTruncated_largeDeviation_le
      H R ha hK hr.le hx X hX hIndep hHmeas hHcont hRmeas hR hLip
        hRL2 hRsecond n u
  apply (measureReal_mono ?_).trans hunit
  intro omega homega
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hbad⟩ := homega
  have hvnorm : ‖v - u‖ ≤ r := by
    simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using hv
  have hinv : 0 ≤ r⁻¹ := (inv_pos.mpr hr).le
  have hqnorm : ‖r⁻¹ • (v - u)‖ ≤ 1 := by
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hr)]
    calc
      r⁻¹ * ‖v - u‖ ≤ r⁻¹ * r :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hvnorm hinv
      _ = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hr.ne'
  let q : EuclideanUnitBall E := ⟨r⁻¹ • (v - u), hqnorm⟩
  refine ⟨q, ?_⟩
  have hqpoint : u + r • (q : E) = v := by
    dsimp only [q]
    rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hr.ne', one_smul]
    abel
  simpa only [hqpoint] using hbad

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_unitBall_oscillation_range_succ_centeredTruncated_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_unitBall_oscillation_range_succ_centeredTruncated_le
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (H : Z → E → ℝ) (R : Z → ℝ) {a K delta x : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hK : 0 < K) (hdelta : 0 < delta) (hx : 0 ≤ x)
    (X : ℕ → Omega → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X mu)
    (hHmeas : ∀ t, Measurable (fun z ↦ H z t))
    (hHcont : ∀ z, Continuous (H z)) (hRmeas : Measurable R)
    (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (hLip : ∀ z s t, |H z s - H z t| ≤ R z * dist s t)
    (hRL2 : ∀ i, MemLp (fun omega ↦ R (X i omega)) 2 mu)
    (hRsecond : ∀ i, ∫ omega, R (X i omega) ^ 2 ∂mu ≤ K ^ 2)
    (n : ℕ) :
    let G : Omega → E → ℝ := fun omega t ↦
      centeredAnchoredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess (mu := mu) H R
        (a * Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ)) (Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ X
        (Finset.range (n + 1)) 0 omega t
    let L : ℝ := mixedEuclideanProcessBound
      (2 * ((2 * delta) * K)) (2 * ((2 * delta) * a))
        (finrank ℝ E) x
    mu.real {omega | ∃ s t : EuclideanUnitBall E,
      dist s t < delta ∧ 2 * L < |G omega (s : E) - G omega (t : E)|} ≤
        (1 + 2 / delta) ^ finrank ℝ E * Real.exp (-x)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  classical
  let G : Omega → E → ℝ := fun omega t ↦
    centeredAnchoredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess (mu := mu) H R
      (a * Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ)) (Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ X
      (Finset.range (n + 1)) 0 omega t
  let L : ℝ := mixedEuclideanProcessBound
    (2 * ((2 * delta) * K)) (2 * ((2 * delta) * a))
      (finrank ℝ E) x
  obtain ⟨N, hnet, hcard⟩ :=
    RandomSetTheory.exists_euclideanUnitBall_finset_net_card_le
      (E := E) hdelta
  let A : EuclideanUnitBall E → Set Omega := fun v ↦
    {omega | ∃ w : E, dist w (v : E) ≤ 2 * delta ∧
      L < |G omega w - G omega (v : E)|}
  have hlocal : ∀ v ∈ N, mu.real (A v) ≤ Real.exp (-x) := by
    intro v hv
    simpa only [A, G, L] using
      (measureReal_closedBall_local_range_succ_centeredTruncated_largeDeviation_le
        H R ha hK (mul_pos (by norm_num) hdelta) hx X hX hIndep
          hHmeas hHcont hRmeas hR hLip hRL2 hRsecond n (v : E))
  have hsubset :
      {omega | ∃ s t : EuclideanUnitBall E,
        dist s t < delta ∧
          2 * L < |G omega (s : E) - G omega (t : E)|} ⊆
        ⋃ v ∈ N, A v := by
    intro omega homega
    obtain ⟨s, t, hst, hbad⟩ := homega
    obtain ⟨v, hvN, hsv⟩ := hnet s
    have hsvE : dist (s : E) (v : E) ≤ delta := by
      simpa only [Subtype.dist_eq] using hsv
    have htvE : dist (t : E) (v : E) ≤ 2 * delta := by
      have htsE : dist (t : E) (s : E) < delta := by
        simpa only [Subtype.dist_eq, dist_comm] using hst
      exact (calc
          dist (t : E) (v : E) ≤
              dist (t : E) (s : E) + dist (s : E) (v : E) :=
            dist_triangle _ _ _
          _ < delta + delta := add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le htsE hsvE
          _ = 2 * delta := by ring).le
    have hsvLocal : dist (s : E) (v : E) ≤ 2 * delta :=
      hsvE.trans (by linarith [hdelta])
    have htriangle :
        |G omega (s : E) - G omega (t : E)| ≤
          |G omega (s : E) - G omega (v : E)| +
            |G omega (t : E) - G omega (v : E)| := by
      calc
        |G omega (s : E) - G omega (t : E)| =
            |(G omega (s : E) - G omega (v : E)) -
              (G omega (t : E) - G omega (v : E))| := by
                congr 1
                ring
        _ ≤ _ := abs_sub _ _
    have hside :
        L < |G omega (s : E) - G omega (v : E)| ∨
          L < |G omega (t : E) - G omega (v : E)| := by
      by_contra h
      push Not at h
      linarith
    apply Set.mem_iUnion.2
    refine ⟨v, Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨hvN, ?_⟩⟩
    rcases hside with hs | ht
    · exact ⟨s, hsvLocal, hs⟩
    · exact ⟨t, htvE, ht⟩
  calc
    mu.real {omega | ∃ s t : EuclideanUnitBall E,
        dist s t < delta ∧
          2 * L < |G omega (s : E) - G omega (t : E)|} ≤
        mu.real (⋃ v ∈ N, A v) :=
      measureReal_mono hsubset (measure_ne_top mu _)
    _ ≤ ∑ v ∈ N, mu.real (A v) :=
      measureReal_biUnion_finset_le N A
    _ ≤ ∑ _v ∈ N, Real.exp (-x) := Finset.sum_le_sum hlocal
    _ = N.card * Real.exp (-x) := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
    _ ≤ (1 + 2 / delta) ^ finrank ℝ E * Real.exp (-x) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcard (Real.exp_pos _).le

name: ProbabilityTheory.measureReal_unitBall_dyadicOscillation_range_succ_centeredTruncated_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_unitBall_dyadicOscillation_range_succ_centeredTruncated_le
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (H : Z → E → ℝ) (R : Z → ℝ) {a K x : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hK : 0 < K) (hx : 0 ≤ x)
    (X : ℕ → Omega → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X mu)
    (hHmeas : ∀ t, Measurable (fun z ↦ H z t))
    (hHcont : ∀ z, Continuous (H z)) (hRmeas : Measurable R)
    (hR : ∀ z, 0 ≤ R z)
    (hLip : ∀ z s t, |H z s - H z t| ≤ R z * dist s t)
    (hRL2 : ∀ i, MemLp (fun omega ↦ R (X i omega)) 2 mu)
    (hRsecond : ∀ i, ∫ omega, R (X i omega) ^ 2 ∂mu ≤ K ^ 2)
    (n k : ℕ) :
    let d := finrank ℝ E
    let delta := RandomSetTheory.dyadicResolution k
    let confidence := mixedEuclideanConfidence d x k
    let G : Omega → E → ℝ := fun omega t ↦
      centeredAnchoredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess (mu := mu) H R
        (a * Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ)) (Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ X
        (Finset.range (n + 1)) 0 omega t
    let eta := 2 * mixedEuclideanProcessBound
      (2 * ((2 * delta) * K)) (2 * ((2 * delta) * a)) d confidence
    mu.real {omega | ∃ s t : EuclideanUnitBall E,
      dist s t < delta ∧
        eta < |G omega (s : E) - G omega (t : E)|} ≤
      mixedEuclideanEntropyCost d x k
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let d := finrank ℝ E
  let delta := RandomSetTheory.dyadicResolution k
  let confidence := mixedEuclideanConfidence d x k
  have hosc :=
    measureReal_unitBall_oscillation_range_succ_centeredTruncated_le
      H R ha hK (RandomSetTheory.dyadicResolution_pos k)
        (mixedEuclideanConfidence_nonneg d hx k) X hX hIndep
          hHmeas hHcont hRmeas hR hLip hRL2 hRsecond n
  have hentropy :
      (1 + 2 / delta) ^ d ≤
        Real.exp (4 * (d : ℝ) * (k + 2 : ℝ)) := by
    simpa only [d, delta] using
      one_add_two_div_dyadicResolution_pow_le_exp d k
  calc
    mu.real {omega | ∃ s t : EuclideanUnitBall E,
        dist s t < delta ∧
          2 * mixedEuclideanProcessBound
              (2 * ((2 * delta) * K)) (2 * ((2 * delta) * a)) d confidence <
            |centeredAnchoredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess (mu := mu) H R
                (a * Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ))
                (Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ X
                (Finset.range (n + 1)) 0 omega (s : E) -
              centeredAnchoredTruncatedEmpiricalProcess (mu := mu) H R
                (a * Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ))
                (Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ X
                (Finset.range (n + 1)) 0 omega (t : E)|} ≤
        (1 + 2 / delta) ^ d * Real.exp (-confidence) := by
      simpa only [d, delta, confidence] using hosc
    _ ≤ Real.exp (4 * (d : ℝ) * (k + 2 : ℝ)) *
        Real.exp (-confidence) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hentropy (Real.exp_pos _).le
    _ ≤ Real.exp (4 * (d : ℝ) * (k + 2 : ℝ)) *
        (2 * Real.exp (-confidence)) := by
      gcongr
      linarith [Real.exp_pos (-confidence)]
    _ = mixedEuclideanEntropyCost d x k := by
      rfl

proof:

  · intro h

  exact hfix

@[simp]

name: RandomSetTheory.norm_radstromEmbedding_sub_eq_hausdorffDist
statement:
theorem norm_radstromEmbedding_sub_eq_hausdorffDist
    (K L : CompactConvexSet E) :
    ‖radstromEmbedding K - radstromEmbedding L‖ =
      hausdorffDist (K : Set E) (L : Set E)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [ContinuousMap.norm_le _ hausdorffDist_nonneg]
    intro u
    simp only [ContinuousMap.sub_apply, radstromEmbedding_apply,
      Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have hu : ‖(u : E)‖ ≤ 1 := by
      have hu' := u.property
      change dist (u : E) 0 ≤ 1 at hu'
      simpa only [dist_zero_right] using hu'
    calc
      |supportFunction (K : Set E) u - supportFunction (L : Set E) u| ≤
          ‖(u : E)‖ * hausdorffDist (K : Set E) (L : Set E) :=
        abs_supportFunction_sub_le_hausdorffDist
          K.isCompact L.isCompact K.nonempty L.nonempty u
      _ ≤ 1 * hausdorffDist (K : Set E) (L : Set E) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hu hausdorffDist_nonneg
      _ = hausdorffDist (K : Set E) (L : Set E) := one_mul _
  · apply hausdorffDist_le_of_unitBall_supportFunction_sub_le
      K.isCompact L.isCompact K.nonempty L.nonempty K.convex L.convex
      (norm_nonneg _)
    intro u hu
    let us : Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1 :=
      ⟨u, by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hu⟩
    have hnorm := ContinuousMap.norm_coe_le_norm
      (radstromEmbedding K - radstromEmbedding L) us
    simpa only [ContinuousMap.sub_apply, radstromEmbedding_apply,
      Real.norm_eq_abs] using hnorm

name: RandomSetTheory.isometry_radstromEmbedding
statement:
theorem isometry_radstromEmbedding :
    Isometry (radstromEmbedding : CompactConvexSet E →
      C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  apply Isometry.of_dist_eq
  intro K L
  rw [dist_eq_norm]
  change ‖radstromEmbedding K - radstromEmbedding L‖ =
    hausdorffDist (K : Set E) (L : Set E)
  exact norm_radstromEmbedding_sub_eq_hausdorffDist K L

name: RandomSetTheory.radstromEmbedding_injective
statement:
theorem radstromEmbedding_injective :
    Function.Injective (radstromEmbedding : CompactConvexSet E →
      C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ))
proof:
:=
  (isometry_radstromEmbedding (E := E)).injective

name: RandomSetTheory.isClosed_range_radstromEmbedding
statement:
theorem isClosed_range_radstromEmbedding :
    IsClosed (Set.range (radstromEmbedding : CompactConvexSet E →
      C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ)))
proof:
:=
  (isometry_radstromEmbedding (E := E)).isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range

name: RandomSetTheory.dist_radstromEmbedding_eq_hausdorffDist
statement:
theorem dist_radstromEmbedding_eq_hausdorffDist
    (K L : CompactConvexSet E) :
    dist (radstromEmbedding K) (radstromEmbedding L) =
      hausdorffDist (K : Set E) (L : Set E)
proof:
:= by
  rw [(isometry_radstromEmbedding (E := E)).dist_eq]
  rfl

name: RandomSetTheory.tendsto_radstromEmbedding_iff
statement:
theorem tendsto_radstromEmbedding_iff
    {I : Type*} {l : Filter I} {K : I → CompactConvexSet E}
    {L : CompactConvexSet E} :
    Filter.Tendsto K l (nhds L) ↔
      Filter.Tendsto (fun i ↦ radstromEmbedding (K i)) l
        (nhds (radstromEmbedding L))
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Function.comp_def] using
    (isometry_radstromEmbedding (E := E)).tendsto_nhds_iff

name: RandomSetTheory.radstromEmbedding_minkowskiAdd
statement:
theorem radstromEmbedding_minkowskiAdd (K L : CompactConvexSet E) :
    radstromEmbedding (CompactConvexSet.minkowskiAdd K L) =
      radstromEmbedding K + radstromEmbedding L
proof:
:= by
  ext u
  simp only [radstromEmbedding_apply, CompactConvexSet.coe_minkowskiAdd,
    ContinuousMap.add_apply]
  exact supportFunction_add K.isCompact L.isCompact K.nonempty L.nonempty u

name: RandomSetTheory.radstromEmbedding_nnsmul
statement:
theorem radstromEmbedding_nnsmul (c : ℝ≥0) (K : CompactConvexSet E) :
    radstromEmbedding (CompactConvexSet.nnsmul c K) =
      (c : ℝ) • radstromEmbedding K
proof:
:= by
  ext u
  simp only [radstromEmbedding_apply, CompactConvexSet.coe_nnsmul,
    ContinuousMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  exact supportFunction_smul_set K.isCompact K.nonempty c.coe_nonneg u

name: RandomSetTheory.radstromEmbedding_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem radstromEmbedding_singleton (x : E)
    (u : Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1) :
    radstromEmbedding (CompactConvexSet.singleton x) u = inner ℝ (u : E) x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [radstromEmbedding_apply, CompactConvexSet.coe_singleton,
    supportFunction_singleton]

name: RandomSetTheory.radstromEmbedding_singleton_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem radstromEmbedding_singleton_zero :
    radstromEmbedding (CompactConvexSet.singleton (0 : E)) = 0
proof:
