  simp

name: RandomSetTheory.zero_mem_range_radstromEmbedding
statement:
theorem zero_mem_range_radstromEmbedding :
    (0 : C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ)) ∈
      Set.range (radstromEmbedding : CompactConvexSet E →
        C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨CompactConvexSet.singleton 0, radstromEmbedding_singleton_zero⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.add_mem_range_radstromEmbedding
statement:
theorem add_mem_range_radstromEmbedding
    {f g : C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ)}
    (hf : f ∈ Set.range (radstromEmbedding : CompactConvexSet E →
      C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ)))
    (hg : g ∈ Set.range (radstromEmbedding : CompactConvexSet E →
      C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ))) :
    f + g ∈ Set.range (radstromEmbedding : CompactConvexSet E →
      C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K, rfl⟩ := hf
  obtain ⟨L, rfl⟩ := hg
  exact ⟨CompactConvexSet.minkowskiAdd K L,
    radstromEmbedding_minkowskiAdd K L⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.nnreal_smul_mem_range_radstromEmbedding
statement:
theorem nnreal_smul_mem_range_radstromEmbedding
    (c : ℝ≥0) {f : C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ)}
    (hf : f ∈ Set.range (radstromEmbedding : CompactConvexSet E →
      C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ))) :
    (c : ℝ) • f ∈ Set.range (radstromEmbedding : CompactConvexSet E →
      C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K, rfl⟩ := hf
  exact ⟨CompactConvexSet.nnsmul c K, radstromEmbedding_nnsmul c K⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.convex_range_radstromEmbedding
statement:
theorem convex_range_radstromEmbedding :
    Convex ℝ (Set.range (radstromEmbedding : CompactConvexSet E →
      C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨K, rfl⟩ _ ⟨L, rfl⟩ a b ha hb _hab
  let ca : ℝ≥0 := ⟨a, ha⟩
  let cb : ℝ≥0 := ⟨b, hb⟩
  refine ⟨CompactConvexSet.minkowskiAdd
      (CompactConvexSet.nnsmul ca K) (CompactConvexSet.nnsmul cb L), ?_⟩
  rw [radstromEmbedding_minkowskiAdd, radstromEmbedding_nnsmul,
    radstromEmbedding_nnsmul]
  rfl

name: RandomSetTheory.isClosed_convex_range_radstromEmbedding
statement:
theorem isClosed_convex_range_radstromEmbedding [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] :
    IsClosed (Set.range (radstromEmbedding : CompactConvexSet E →
      C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ))) ∧
    Convex ℝ (Set.range (radstromEmbedding : CompactConvexSet E →
      C(Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ℝ)))
proof:
:=
  ⟨isClosed_range_radstromEmbedding, convex_range_radstromEmbedding⟩

name: RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable.comp_measurable
statement:
theorem IsEffrosMeasurable.comp_measurable
    {Ω Ω' E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Ω']
    [TopologicalSpace E] {S : Ω → Set E} (hS : IsEffrosMeasurable S)
    {f : Ω' → Ω} (hf : Measurable f) :
    IsEffrosMeasurable (fun ω => S (f ω))
proof:
:= by
  intro U hU
  change MeasurableSet (f ⁻¹' {ω | (S ω ∩ U).Nonempty})
  exact (hS U hU).preimage hf

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_finset_unitBall_net
statement:
theorem exists_finset_unitBall_net
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ N : Finset E, ∀ u : E, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 →
      ∃ v ∈ N, dist u v < ε
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨t, htunit, htfinite, hcover⟩ :=
    finite_cover_balls_of_compact
      (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E) 1) hε
  refine ⟨htfinite.toFinset, ?_⟩
  intro u hu
  have hu' : u ∈ closedBall (0 : E) 1 := by
    simpa [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hu
  obtain ⟨v, hvt, huv⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (hcover hu')
  exact ⟨v, by simpa using hvt, by simpa [mem_ball] using huv⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_finset_denseSeq_unitBall_net
statement:
theorem exists_finset_denseSeq_unitBall_net
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ I : Finset ℕ, ∀ u : E, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 →
      ∃ k ∈ I, dist u (denseSeq E k) < ε
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hhalf : 0 < ε / 2 := half_pos hε
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_finset_unitBall_net (E := E) hhalf
  let index : E → ℕ := fun v =>
    Nat.find ((denseRange_denseSeq E).exists_dist_lt v hhalf)
  have hindex : ∀ v : E, dist (denseSeq E (index v)) v < ε / 2 := by
    intro v
    simpa [dist_comm] using
      Nat.find_spec ((denseRange_denseSeq E).exists_dist_lt v hhalf)
  refine ⟨N.image index, ?_⟩
  intro u hu
  obtain ⟨v, hvN, huv⟩ := hN u hu
  refine ⟨index v, Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨v, hvN, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  calc
    dist u (denseSeq E (index v)) ≤
        dist u v + dist v (denseSeq E (index v)) := dist_triangle _ _ _
    _ < ε / 2 + ε / 2 :=
      add_lt_add huv (by simpa [dist_comm] using hindex v)
    _ = ε := by ring

name: RandomSetTheory.norm_le_radius_of_mem_minkowskiAverage
statement:
theorem norm_le_radius_of_mem_minkowskiAverage
    {E ι : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (s : Finset ι) (K : ι → Set E) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hbound : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ x ∈ K i, ‖x‖ ≤ R)
    {x : E} (hx : x ∈ minkowskiAverage s K) :
    ‖x‖ ≤ R
proof:
:= by
  have hx' := norm_le_average_radius_of_mem_minkowskiAverage
    s K (fun _ => R) hbound hx
  by_cases hs : s.card = 0
  · have hx0 : ‖x‖ ≤ 0 := by simpa [hs] using hx'
    exact hx0.trans hR
  · have hs' : (s.card : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hs
    simpa [hs'] using hx'

name: RandomSetTheory.tendsto_hausdorffDist_of_tendsto_supportFunction_denseSeq
statement:
theorem tendsto_hausdorffDist_of_tendsto_supportFunction_denseSeq
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {K : ℕ → Set E} {L : Set E} {R : ℝ}
    (hKcompact : ∀ n, IsCompact (K n)) (hLcompact : IsCompact L)
    (hKne : ∀ n, (K n).Nonempty) (hLne : L.Nonempty)
    (hKconv : ∀ n, Convex ℝ (K n)) (hLconv : Convex ℝ L)
    (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hKbound : ∀ n, ∀ x ∈ K n, ‖x‖ ≤ R)
    (hLbound : ∀ x ∈ L, ‖x‖ ≤ R)
    (hsupport : ∀ k : ℕ,
      Tendsto (fun n => supportFunction (K n) (denseSeq E k)) atTop
        (𝓝 (supportFunction L (denseSeq E k)))) :
    Tendsto (fun n => hausdorffDist (K n) L) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine Metric.tendsto_atTop.mpr ?_
  intro ε hε
  let δ : ℝ := ε / (8 * (R + 1))
  have hRone : 0 < R + 1 := by linarith
  have hden : 0 < 8 * (R + 1) := mul_pos (by norm_num) hRone
  have hδ : 0 < δ := div_pos hε hden
  have hprod : (R + R) * δ ≤ ε / 4 := by
    dsimp [δ]
    rw [← mul_div_assoc]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hden).2
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hR hε.le]
  obtain ⟨I, hInet⟩ :=
    exists_finset_denseSeq_unitBall_net (E := E) hδ
  let N : Finset E := I.image (denseSeq E)
  have hnet : ∀ u : E, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 → ∃ v ∈ N, dist u v ≤ δ := by
    intro u hu
    obtain ⟨k, hkI, huk⟩ := hInet u hu
    refine ⟨denseSeq E k, ?_, huk.le⟩
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨k, hkI, rfl⟩
  have heach : ∀ k ∈ I, ∀ᶠ n in atTop,
      |supportFunction (K n) (denseSeq E k) -
        supportFunction L (denseSeq E k)| ≤ ε / 2 := by
    intro k _
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ :=
      Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp (hsupport k) (ε / 2) (half_pos hε)
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop m] with n hn
    have hmn := (hm n hn).le
    simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hmn
  have hall : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ k ∈ I,
      |supportFunction (K n) (denseSeq E k) -
        supportFunction L (denseSeq E k)| ≤ ε / 2 :=
    I.eventually_all.mpr heach
  apply eventually_atTop.mp
  filter_upwards [hall] with n hn
  have hNsupport : ∀ v ∈ N,
      |supportFunction (K n) v - supportFunction L v| ≤ ε / 2 := by
    intro v hv
    obtain ⟨k, hkI, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hv
    exact hn k hkI
  have hhd : hausdorffDist (K n) L ≤
      ε / 2 + (R + R) * δ :=
    hausdorffDist_le_of_finset_net_supportFunction
      (hKcompact n) hLcompact (hKne n) hLne
      (hKconv n) hLconv (hKbound n) hLbound
      hδ.le (half_pos hε).le N hnet hNsupport
  have hlt : hausdorffDist (K n) L < ε :=
    hhd.trans_lt <| calc
      ε / 2 + (R + R) * δ ≤ ε / 2 + ε / 4 :=
        add_le_add (le_refl _) hprod
      _ < ε := by linarith
  simpa [Real.dist_eq, abs_of_nonneg hausdorffDist_nonneg] using hlt

name: RandomSetTheory.tendsto_hausdorffDist_of_tendsto_supportFunction_denseSeq_eventually
statement:
theorem tendsto_hausdorffDist_of_tendsto_supportFunction_denseSeq_eventually
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {K : ℕ → Set E} {L : Set E} {R : ℝ}
    (hKcompact : ∀ n, IsCompact (K n)) (hLcompact : IsCompact L)
    (hKne : ∀ n, (K n).Nonempty) (hLne : L.Nonempty)
    (hKconv : ∀ n, Convex ℝ (K n)) (hLconv : Convex ℝ L)
    (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hKbound : Filter.Eventually (fun n => ∀ x ∈ K n, ‖x‖ ≤ R) atTop)
    (hLbound : ∀ x ∈ L, ‖x‖ ≤ R)
    (hsupport : ∀ k : ℕ,
      Tendsto (fun n => supportFunction (K n) (denseSeq E k)) atTop
        (nhds (supportFunction L (denseSeq E k)))) :
    Tendsto (fun n => hausdorffDist (K n) L) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := (eventually_atTop.1 hKbound)
  let K' : ℕ → Set E := fun n => if N ≤ n then K n else L
  have hK'compact : ∀ n, IsCompact (K' n) := by
    intro n
    by_cases hn : N ≤ n
    · simpa [K', hn] using hKcompact n
    · simpa [K', hn] using hLcompact
  have hK'ne : ∀ n, (K' n).Nonempty := by
    intro n
    by_cases hn : N ≤ n
    · simpa [K', hn] using hKne n
    · simpa [K', hn] using hLne
  have hK'conv : ∀ n, Convex ℝ (K' n) := by
    intro n
    by_cases hn : N ≤ n
    · simpa [K', hn] using hKconv n
    · simpa [K', hn] using hLconv
  have hK'bound : ∀ n, ∀ x ∈ K' n, ‖x‖ ≤ R := by
    intro n
    by_cases hn : N ≤ n
    · simpa [K', hn] using hN n hn
    · simpa [K', hn] using hLbound
  have hsupport' : ∀ k : ℕ,
      Tendsto (fun n => supportFunction (K' n) (denseSeq E k)) atTop
        (nhds (supportFunction L (denseSeq E k))) := by
    intro k
    apply Tendsto.congr' _ (hsupport k)
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop N] with n hn
    simp [K', hn]
  have hconv := tendsto_hausdorffDist_of_tendsto_supportFunction_denseSeq
    hK'compact hLcompact hK'ne hLne hK'conv hLconv hR
    hK'bound hLbound hsupport'
  apply Tendsto.congr' _ hconv
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop N] with n hn
  simp [K', hn]

name: RandomSetTheory.ae_tendsto_hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_of_scalar_slln
statement:
theorem ae_tendsto_hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_of_scalar_slln
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S : ℕ → Ω → Set E} {L : Set E} {R : ℝ}
    (hScompact : ∀ i ω, IsCompact (S i ω))
    (hSne : ∀ i ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    (hSconv : ∀ i ω, Convex ℝ (S i ω))
    (hLcompact : IsCompact L) (hLne : L.Nonempty)
    (hLconv : Convex ℝ L) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hSbound : ∀ i ω, ∀ x ∈ S i ω, ‖x‖ ≤ R)
    (hLbound : ∀ x ∈ L, ‖x‖ ≤ R)
    (hint : ∀ k : ℕ,
      Integrable (fun ω => supportFunction (S 0 ω) (denseSeq E k)) μ)
    (hindep : ∀ k : ℕ, Pairwise (fun i j =>
      IndepFun
        (fun ω => supportFunction (S i ω) (denseSeq E k))
        (fun ω => supportFunction (S j ω) (denseSeq E k)) μ))
    (hident : ∀ k i : ℕ,
      IdentDistrib
        (fun ω => supportFunction (S i ω) (denseSeq E k))
        (fun ω => supportFunction (S 0 ω) (denseSeq E k)) μ μ)
    (hLsupport : ∀ k : ℕ,
      supportFunction L (denseSeq E k) =
        ∫ ω, supportFunction (S 0 ω) (denseSeq E k) ∂μ) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Tendsto
      (fun n => hausdorffDist
        (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n) (fun i => S i ω)) L)
      atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hscalar : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ,
      Tendsto
        (fun n : ℕ =>
          (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
            supportFunction (S i ω) (denseSeq E k)) / n)
        atTop
        (𝓝 (∫ ω, supportFunction (S 0 ω) (denseSeq E k) ∂μ)) := by
    intro k
    exact ProbabilityTheory.strong_law_ae_real
      (fun i ω => supportFunction (S i ω) (denseSeq E k))
      (hint k) (hindep k) (hident k)
  filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr hscalar] with ω hω
  apply tendsto_hausdorffDist_of_tendsto_supportFunction_denseSeq
    (K := fun n => minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n) (fun i => S i ω))
    (L := L) (R := R)
  · intro n
    exact isCompact_minkowskiAverage _ _
      (fun i _ => hScompact i ω)
  · exact hLcompact
  · intro n
    exact nonempty_minkowskiAverage _ _ (fun i _ => hSne i ω)
  · exact hLne
  · intro n
    exact convex_minkowskiAverage _ _ (fun i _ => hSconv i ω)
  · exact hLconv
  · exact hR
  · intro n x hx
    exact norm_le_radius_of_mem_minkowskiAverage
      (Finset.range n) (fun i => S i ω) hR
      (fun i _ => hSbound i ω) hx
  · exact hLbound
  · intro k
    rw [hLsupport k]
    apply Tendsto.congr'
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n => ?_) (hω k)
    rw [supportFunction_minkowskiAverage]
    · simp only [Finset.card_range, div_eq_inv_mul]
    · exact fun i _ => hScompact i ω
    · exact fun i _ => hSne i ω

name: RandomSetTheory.ae_tendsto_hausdorffDist_convexifiedAverage_of_scalar_slln
statement:
theorem ae_tendsto_hausdorffDist_convexifiedAverage_of_scalar_slln
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {S : ℕ → Ω → Set E} {L : Set E} {R : ℝ}
    (hScompact : ∀ i ω, IsCompact (S i ω))
    (hSne : ∀ i ω, (S i ω).Nonempty)
    (hLcompact : IsCompact L) (hLne : L.Nonempty)
    (hLconv : Convex ℝ L) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hSbound : ∀ i ω, ∀ x ∈ S i ω, ‖x‖ ≤ R)
    (hLbound : ∀ x ∈ L, ‖x‖ ≤ R)
    (hint : ∀ k : ℕ,
      Integrable (fun ω => supportFunction (S 0 ω) (denseSeq E k)) μ)
    (hindep : ∀ k : ℕ, Pairwise (fun i j =>
      IndepFun
        (fun ω => supportFunction (S i ω) (denseSeq E k))
        (fun ω => supportFunction (S j ω) (denseSeq E k)) μ))
    (hident : ∀ k i : ℕ,
      IdentDistrib
        (fun ω => supportFunction (S i ω) (denseSeq E k))
        (fun ω => supportFunction (S 0 ω) (denseSeq E k)) μ μ)
    (hLsupport : ∀ k : ℕ,
      supportFunction L (denseSeq E k) =
        ∫ ω, supportFunction (S 0 ω) (denseSeq E k) ∂μ) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Tendsto
      (fun n => hausdorffDist
        (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n)
          (fun i => closedConvexHull ℝ (S i ω))) L)
      atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hsuppHull : ∀ i ω u,
      supportFunction (closedConvexHull ℝ (S i ω)) u =
        supportFunction (S i ω) u := by
    intro i ω u
    exact supportFunction_closedConvexHull
      (hScompact i ω) (hSne i ω) u
  apply ae_tendsto_hausdorffDist_minkowskiAverage_of_scalar_slln
    (S := fun i ω => closedConvexHull ℝ (S i ω))
    (L := L) (R := R)
  · exact fun i ω => closedConvexHull_compact (hScompact i ω)
  · exact fun i ω => (hSne i ω).mono subset_closedConvexHull
  · exact fun _ _ => convex_closedConvexHull
  · exact hLcompact
  · exact hLne
  · exact hLconv
  · exact hR
  · intro i ω
    have hsub : closedConvexHull ℝ (S i ω) ⊆ closedBall (0 : E) R := by
      apply closedConvexHull_min
      · intro x hx
        simpa [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hSbound i ω x hx
      · exact convex_closedBall (0 : E) R
      · exact isClosed_closedBall
    intro x hx
    simpa [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hsub hx
  · exact hLbound
  · intro k
    simpa only [hsuppHull] using hint k
  · intro k
    simpa only [hsuppHull] using hindep k
  · intro k i
    simpa only [hsuppHull] using hident k i
  · intro k
    simpa only [hsuppHull] using hLsupport k

name: RandomSetTheory.ae_tendsto_hausdorffDist_convexified_iid
statement:
theorem ae_tendsto_hausdorffDist_convexified_iid
    {Ω Z E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Z]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [Nonempty E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : ℕ → Ω → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hindep : Pairwise (fun i j => IndepFun (X i) (X j) μ))
    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) μ μ)
    (F : Z → Set E) (hF : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable F)
    (hFcompact : ∀ z, IsCompact (F z)) (hFne : ∀ z, (F z).Nonempty)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hFbound : ∀ z, ∀ x ∈ F z, ‖x‖ ≤ R) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Tendsto
      (fun n => hausdorffDist
        (closedConvexHull ℝ
          (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n) (fun i => F (X i ω))))
        (closedConvexHull ℝ
          (closure (aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => F (X 0 ω))))))
      atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  let S₀ : Ω → Set E := fun ω => F (X 0 ω)
  let A : Set E := closure (aumannExpectation μ S₀)
  let L : Set E := closedConvexHull ℝ A
  have hS₀Effros : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S₀ :=
    hF.comp_measurable (hX 0)
  have hS₀compact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S₀ ω) := fun ω =>
    hFcompact (X 0 ω)
  have hS₀ne : ∀ ω, (S₀ ω).Nonempty := fun ω =>
    hFne (X 0 ω)
  have hg : Integrable (fun _ : Ω => R) μ := integrable_const R
  have hS₀dom : ∀ ω, ∀ x ∈ S₀ ω, ‖x‖ ≤ R := fun ω =>
    hFbound (X 0 ω)
  have hAcompact : IsCompact A :=
    closure_aumannExpectation_compact_of_integrable_envelope hg
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hS₀dom)
  have hfOne : IsIntegrableSelection μ S₀
      (supportApproximateSelection
        hS₀Effros hS₀compact hS₀ne 0 1 (by norm_num)) :=
    integrableSelection_supportApproximateSelection_of_envelope
      hS₀Effros hS₀compact hS₀ne hg hS₀dom 0 (by norm_num)
  have hAne : A.Nonempty :=
    (aumannExpectation_nonempty_of_selection hfOne).closure
  have hLcompact : IsCompact L := closedConvexHull_compact hAcompact
  have hLne : L.Nonempty := hAne.mono subset_closedConvexHull
  have hLbound : ∀ x ∈ L, ‖x‖ ≤ R := by
    have hAsub : A ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) R := by
      intro x hx
      have hxR := norm_le_integral_envelope_of_mem_closure_aumannExpectation
        hg (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hS₀dom) hx
      have hxR' : ‖x‖ ≤ R := by simpa using hxR
      simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hxR'
    have hLsub : L ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) R :=
      closedConvexHull_min hAsub (convex_closedBall (0 : E) R)
        Metric.isClosed_closedBall
    intro x hx
    simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hLsub hx
  have hsuppMeas : ∀ k : ℕ,
      Measurable (fun z => supportFunction (F z) (denseSeq E k)) := fun k =>
    measurable_supportFunction hF hFcompact hFne (denseSeq E k)
  have hint : ∀ k : ℕ,
      Integrable (fun ω => supportFunction (F (X 0 ω)) (denseSeq E k)) μ :=
    fun k => integrable_supportFunction_of_envelope
      hS₀Effros hS₀compact hS₀ne hg hS₀dom (denseSeq E k)
  have hindepSupport : ∀ k : ℕ, Pairwise (fun i j =>
      IndepFun
        (fun ω => supportFunction (F (X i ω)) (denseSeq E k))
        (fun ω => supportFunction (F (X j ω)) (denseSeq E k)) μ) := by
    intro k i j hij
    exact (hindep hij).comp (hsuppMeas k) (hsuppMeas k)
  have hidentSupport : ∀ k i : ℕ,
      IdentDistrib
        (fun ω => supportFunction (F (X i ω)) (denseSeq E k))
        (fun ω => supportFunction (F (X 0 ω)) (denseSeq E k)) μ μ := by
    intro k i
    exact (hident i).comp (hsuppMeas k)
  have hLsupport : ∀ k : ℕ,
      supportFunction L (denseSeq E k) =
        ∫ ω, supportFunction (F (X 0 ω)) (denseSeq E k) ∂μ := by
    intro k
    rw [supportFunction_closedConvexHull hAcompact hAne]
    exact supportFunction_closure_aumannExpectation_of_envelope
      hS₀Effros hS₀compact hS₀ne hg hS₀dom hAcompact (denseSeq E k)
  have hcore := ae_tendsto_hausdorffDist_convexifiedAverage_of_scalar_slln
    (S := fun i ω => F (X i ω)) (L := L) (R := R)
    (fun i ω => hFcompact (X i ω))
    (fun i ω => hFne (X i ω))
    hLcompact hLne convex_closedConvexHull hR
    (fun i ω => hFbound (X i ω)) hLbound
    hint hindepSupport hidentSupport hLsupport
  filter_upwards [hcore] with ω hω
  apply Tendsto.congr' _ hω
  filter_upwards [] with n
  rw [closedConvexHull_minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n)
    (fun i => F (X i ω))
    (fun i _ => hFcompact (X i ω))
    (fun i _ => hFne (X i ω))]

name: RandomSetTheory.ae_tendsto_hausdorffDist_convexified_iid_of_integrable_envelope
statement:
theorem ae_tendsto_hausdorffDist_convexified_iid_of_integrable_envelope
    {Ω Z E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Z]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [Nonempty E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : ℕ → Ω → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hindep : Pairwise (fun i j => IndepFun (X i) (X j) μ))
    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) μ μ)
    (F : Z → Set E) (hF : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable F)
    (hFcompact : ∀ z, IsCompact (F z)) (hFne : ∀ z, (F z).Nonempty)
    (g : Z → ℝ) (hg : Measurable g)
    (hgint : Integrable (fun ω => g (X 0 ω)) μ)
    (hFbound : ∀ z, ∀ x ∈ F z, ‖x‖ ≤ g z) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Tendsto
      (fun n => hausdorffDist
        (closedConvexHull ℝ
          (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n) (fun i => F (X i ω))))
        (closedConvexHull ℝ
          (closure (aumannExpectation μ (fun ω => F (X 0 ω))))))
      atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S₀ : Ω → Set E := fun ω => F (X 0 ω)
  let A : Set E := closure (aumannExpectation μ S₀)
  let L : Set E := closedConvexHull ℝ A
  let m : ℝ := ∫ ω, g (X 0 ω) ∂μ
  let R : ℝ := m + 1
  have hgnonneg : ∀ z, 0 ≤ g z := by
    intro z
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hFne z
    exact (norm_nonneg x).trans (hFbound z x hx)
  have hm : 0 ≤ m := by
    dsimp [m]
    exact integral_nonneg (fun ω => hgnonneg (X 0 ω))
  have hR : 0 ≤ R := by
    dsimp [R]
    linarith
  have hS₀Effros : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable S₀ :=
    hF.comp_measurable (hX 0)
  have hS₀compact : ∀ ω, IsCompact (S₀ ω) := fun ω =>
    hFcompact (X 0 ω)
  have hS₀ne : ∀ ω, (S₀ ω).Nonempty := fun ω =>
    hFne (X 0 ω)
  have hS₀dom : ∀ ω, ∀ x ∈ S₀ ω, ‖x‖ ≤ g (X 0 ω) := fun ω =>
    hFbound (X 0 ω)
  have hAcompact : IsCompact A :=
    closure_aumannExpectation_compact_of_integrable_envelope hgint
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hS₀dom)
  have hfOne : IsIntegrableSelection μ S₀
      (supportApproximateSelection
        hS₀Effros hS₀compact hS₀ne 0 1 (by norm_num)) :=
    integrableSelection_supportApproximateSelection_of_envelope
      hS₀Effros hS₀compact hS₀ne hgint hS₀dom 0 (by norm_num)
  have hAne : A.Nonempty :=
    (aumannExpectation_nonempty_of_selection hfOne).closure
  have hLcompact : IsCompact L := closedConvexHull_compact hAcompact
  have hLne : L.Nonempty := hAne.mono subset_closedConvexHull
  have hLbound : ∀ x ∈ L, ‖x‖ ≤ R := by
    have hAsub : A ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) R := by
      intro x hx
      have hxm := norm_le_integral_envelope_of_mem_closure_aumannExpectation
        hgint (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hS₀dom) hx
      have hxR : ‖x‖ ≤ R := hxm.trans <| by
        dsimp [m, R]
        linarith
      simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hxR
    have hLsub : L ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) R :=
      closedConvexHull_min hAsub (convex_closedBall (0 : E) R)
        Metric.isClosed_closedBall
    intro x hx
    simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hLsub hx
  have hsuppMeas : ∀ k : ℕ,
      Measurable (fun z => supportFunction (F z) (denseSeq E k)) := fun k =>
    measurable_supportFunction hF hFcompact hFne (denseSeq E k)
  have hint : ∀ k : ℕ,
      Integrable (fun ω => supportFunction (F (X 0 ω)) (denseSeq E k)) μ :=
    fun k => integrable_supportFunction_of_envelope
      hS₀Effros hS₀compact hS₀ne hgint hS₀dom (denseSeq E k)
  have hindepSupport : ∀ k : ℕ, Pairwise (fun i j =>
      IndepFun
        (fun ω => supportFunction (F (X i ω)) (denseSeq E k))
        (fun ω => supportFunction (F (X j ω)) (denseSeq E k)) μ) := by
    intro k i j hij
    exact (hindep hij).comp (hsuppMeas k) (hsuppMeas k)
  have hidentSupport : ∀ k i : ℕ,
      IdentDistrib
        (fun ω => supportFunction (F (X i ω)) (denseSeq E k))
        (fun ω => supportFunction (F (X 0 ω)) (denseSeq E k)) μ μ := by
    intro k i
    exact (hident i).comp (hsuppMeas k)
  have hLsupport : ∀ k : ℕ,
      supportFunction L (denseSeq E k) =
        ∫ ω, supportFunction (F (X 0 ω)) (denseSeq E k) ∂μ := by
    intro k
    rw [supportFunction_closedConvexHull hAcompact hAne]
    exact supportFunction_closure_aumannExpectation_of_envelope
      hS₀Effros hS₀compact hS₀ne hgint hS₀dom hAcompact (denseSeq E k)
  have hscalar : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ,
      Tendsto
        (fun n : ℕ =>
          (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
            supportFunction (F (X i ω)) (denseSeq E k)) / n)
        atTop
        (nhds (∫ ω, supportFunction (F (X 0 ω)) (denseSeq E k) ∂μ)) := by
    intro k
    exact ProbabilityTheory.strong_law_ae_real
      (fun i ω => supportFunction (F (X i ω)) (denseSeq E k))
      (hint k) (hindepSupport k) (hidentSupport k)
  have hindepEnvelope : Pairwise (fun i j =>
      IndepFun (fun ω => g (X i ω)) (fun ω => g (X j ω)) μ) := by
    intro i j hij
    exact (hindep hij).comp hg hg
  have hidentEnvelope : ∀ i,
      IdentDistrib (fun ω => g (X i ω)) (fun ω => g (X 0 ω)) μ μ := by
    intro i
    exact (hident i).comp hg
  have henvelope : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ,
      Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, g (X i ω)) / n)
        atTop (nhds m) := by
    simpa [m] using ProbabilityTheory.strong_law_ae_real
      (fun i ω => g (X i ω)) hgint hindepEnvelope hidentEnvelope
  have hsuppHull : ∀ i ω u,
      supportFunction (closedConvexHull ℝ (F (X i ω))) u =
        supportFunction (F (X i ω)) u := by
    intro i ω u
    exact supportFunction_closedConvexHull
      (hFcompact (X i ω)) (hFne (X i ω)) u
  filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr hscalar, henvelope] with ω hω henvω
  have henvBound : ∀ᶠ n in atTop,
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, g (X i ω)) / n ≤ R := by
    exact (henvω.eventually_lt_const (by
      dsimp [R]
      linarith)).mono (fun _ hn => hn.le)
  have hKbound : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ x ∈
      minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n)
        (fun i => closedConvexHull ℝ (F (X i ω))), ‖x‖ ≤ R := by
    filter_upwards [henvBound] with n hn
    intro x hx
    have hHullBound : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range n,
        ∀ y ∈ closedConvexHull ℝ (F (X i ω)), ‖y‖ ≤ g (X i ω) := by
      intro i _ y hy
      have hsub : closedConvexHull ℝ (F (X i ω)) ⊆
          Metric.closedBall (0 : E) (g (X i ω)) := by
        apply closedConvexHull_min
        · intro z hz
          simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using
            hFbound (X i ω) z hz
        · exact convex_closedBall (0 : E) (g (X i ω))
        · exact Metric.isClosed_closedBall
      simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hsub hy
    have hxavg := norm_le_average_radius_of_mem_minkowskiAverage
      (Finset.range n) (fun i => closedConvexHull ℝ (F (X i ω)))
      (fun i => g (X i ω)) hHullBound hx
    have hxavg' : ‖x‖ ≤ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, g (X i ω)) / n := by
      simpa only [Finset.card_range, div_eq_inv_mul] using hxavg
    exact hxavg'.trans hn
  have hcore : Tendsto
      (fun n => hausdorffDist
        (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n)
          (fun i => closedConvexHull ℝ (F (X i ω)))) L)
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    apply tendsto_hausdorffDist_of_tendsto_supportFunction_denseSeq_eventually
      (R := R)
    · intro n
      exact isCompact_minkowskiAverage _ _ (fun i _ =>
        closedConvexHull_compact (hFcompact (X i ω)))
    · exact hLcompact
    · intro n
      exact nonempty_minkowskiAverage _ _ (fun i _ =>
        (hFne (X i ω)).mono subset_closedConvexHull)
    · exact hLne
    · intro n
      exact convex_minkowskiAverage _ _ (fun _ _ => convex_closedConvexHull)
    · exact convex_closedConvexHull
    · exact hR
    · exact hKbound
    · exact hLbound
    · intro k
      rw [hLsupport k]
      apply Tendsto.congr' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n => ?_) (hω k)
      rw [supportFunction_minkowskiAverage]
      · simp only [hsuppHull, Finset.card_range, div_eq_inv_mul]
      · exact fun i _ => closedConvexHull_compact (hFcompact (X i ω))
      · exact fun i _ => (hFne (X i ω)).mono subset_closedConvexHull
  apply Tendsto.congr' _ hcore
  filter_upwards [] with n
  rw [closedConvexHull_minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n)
    (fun i => F (X i ω))
    (fun i _ => hFcompact (X i ω))
    (fun i _ => hFne (X i ω))]

name: ProbabilityTheory.positiveTailPow_mul_measureReal_le_absoluteMoment
statement:
theorem positiveTailPow_mul_measureReal_le_absoluteMoment
    [IsFiniteMeasure mu] (X : Omega → ℝ) {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hXq : Integrable (fun omega ↦ |X omega| ^ q) mu)
    (t : ℝ≥0) :
    (t : ℝ) ^ q * mu.real {omega | (t : ℝ) < X omega} ≤
      absoluteMoment X q mu
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ht : (t : ℝ) = 0
  · simp [ht, hq.ne', absoluteMoment_nonneg X q mu]
  have htpos : 0 < (t : ℝ) := lt_of_le_of_ne t.property (Ne.symm ht)
  have hsubset : {omega | (t : ℝ) < X omega} ⊆
      {omega | (t : ℝ) ≤ |X omega|} := by
    intro omega homega
    exact homega.le.trans (le_abs_self (X omega))
  have htail : mu.real {omega | (t : ℝ) < X omega} ≤
      absoluteMoment X q mu / (t : ℝ) ^ q := by
    exact (measureReal_mono hsubset (by finiteness)).trans
      (measureReal_abs_ge_le_absoluteMoment_div X q hXq htpos)
  calc
    (t : ℝ) ^ q * mu.real {omega | (t : ℝ) < X omega} ≤
        (t : ℝ) ^ q *
          (absoluteMoment X q mu / (t : ℝ) ^ q) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htail (pow_nonneg t.property q)
    _ = absoluteMoment X q mu := by
      field_simp [pow_ne_zero q ht]

name: ProbabilityTheory.positiveWeakMomentPower_le_absoluteMoment
statement:
theorem positiveWeakMomentPower_le_absoluteMoment
    [IsFiniteMeasure mu] (X : Omega → ℝ) {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hXq : Integrable (fun omega ↦ |X omega| ^ q) mu) :
    positiveWeakMomentPower X q mu ≤ absoluteMoment X q mu
proof:
:= by
  unfold positiveWeakMomentPower
  apply csSup_le
  · exact Set.range_nonempty _
  · rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩
    exact positiveTailPow_mul_measureReal_le_absoluteMoment X hq hXq t

name: ProbabilityTheory.positiveWeakMomentPower_nonneg
statement:
theorem positiveWeakMomentPower_nonneg
    [IsFiniteMeasure mu] (X : Omega → ℝ) {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hXq : Integrable (fun omega ↦ |X omega| ^ q) mu) :
    0 ≤ positiveWeakMomentPower X q mu
proof:
:= by
  unfold positiveWeakMomentPower
  have hbdd : BddAbove (Set.range (fun t : ℝ≥0 ↦
      (t : ℝ) ^ q * mu.real {omega | (t : ℝ) < X omega})) := by
    refine ⟨absoluteMoment X q mu, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩
    exact positiveTailPow_mul_measureReal_le_absoluteMoment X hq hXq t
  have hzero : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.range (fun t : ℝ≥0 ↦
      (t : ℝ) ^ q * mu.real {omega | (t : ℝ) < X omega}) := by
    refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    simp [hq.ne']
  exact le_csSup hbdd hzero

name: ProbabilityTheory.positiveWeakMoment_le_lpNorm
statement:
theorem positiveWeakMoment_le_lpNorm
    [IsFiniteMeasure mu] (X : Omega → ℝ) {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hXq : MemLp X q mu) :
    positiveWeakMoment X q mu ≤ lpNorm X q mu
proof:
:= by
  have hInt : Integrable (fun omega ↦ |X omega| ^ q) mu := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hXq.integrable_norm_pow hq.ne'
  have hpowNonneg := positiveWeakMomentPower_nonneg X hq hInt
  have hpowLe := positiveWeakMomentPower_le_absoluteMoment
    X hq hInt
  have hexponent : 0 ≤ ((q : ℝ)⁻¹) := inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg q)
  unfold positiveWeakMoment
  calc
    positiveWeakMomentPower X q mu ^ ((q : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
        absoluteMoment X q mu ^ ((q : ℝ)⁻¹) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow hpowNonneg hpowLe hexponent
    _ = lpNorm X q mu := by
      rw [absoluteMoment_eq_lpNorm_pow X hq hXq]
      exact Real.pow_rpow_inv_natCast lpNorm_nonneg hq.ne'

name: ProbabilityTheory.positiveWeakMoment_centeredProcessEnvelope_le_two_mul
statement:
theorem positiveWeakMoment_centeredProcessEnvelope_le_two_mul
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] (A : Omega → ℝ) {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hAq : MemLp A q mu) :
    positiveWeakMoment (centeredProcessEnvelope A mu) q mu ≤
      2 * lpNorm A q mu
proof:
:= by
  have hqpos : 0 < q := lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one hq
  exact (positiveWeakMoment_le_lpNorm
    (centeredProcessEnvelope A mu) hqpos
      (memLp_centeredProcessEnvelope A hAq)).trans
    (lpNorm_centeredProcessEnvelope_le_two_mul A hq hAq)

name: ProbabilityTheory.positiveWeakMoment_centeredProcessEnvelope_le
statement:
theorem positiveWeakMoment_centeredProcessEnvelope_le
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] (A : Omega → ℝ) {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hAq : MemLp A q mu) {K : ℝ}
    (hAnorm : lpNorm A q mu ≤ K) :
    positiveWeakMoment (centeredProcessEnvelope A mu) q mu ≤ 2 * K
proof:
:= by
  exact (positiveWeakMoment_centeredProcessEnvelope_le_two_mul A hq hAq).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hAnorm (by norm_num))

name: RandomSetTheory.finset_card_mul_ballVolume_le
statement:
theorem finset_card_mul_ballVolume_le
    (s : Finset E) {R eps : ℝ} (heps : 0 < eps)
    (hs : ∀ c ∈ s, ‖c‖ ≤ R)
    (hsep : ∀ c ∈ s, ∀ d ∈ s, c ≠ d → eps ≤ ‖c - d‖) :
    (s.card : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal ((eps / 2) ^ finrank ℝ E) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal ((R + eps / 2) ^ finrank ℝ E)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hs0 : s = ∅
  · subst s
    simp
  borelize E
  let μ : Measure E := Measure.addHaar
  let δ : ℝ := eps / 2
  let ρ : ℝ := R + eps / 2
  have hδ : 0 < δ := by dsimp [δ]; positivity
  have hR : 0 ≤ R := by
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hs0
    exact (norm_nonneg c).trans (hs c hc)
  have hρ : 0 < ρ := by dsimp [ρ]; positivity
  set A := ⋃ c ∈ s, ball (c : E) δ with hA
  have hdisj : Set.Pairwise (s : Set E)
      (fun c d => Disjoint (ball (c : E) δ) (ball (d : E) δ)) := by
    rintro c hc d hd hcd
    apply ball_disjoint_ball
    rw [dist_eq_norm]
    have hcd' := hsep c hc d hd hcd
    dsimp [δ]
    linarith
  have hsubset : A ⊆ ball (0 : E) ρ := by
    refine iUnion₂_subset fun x hx => ?_
    apply ball_subset_ball'
    calc
      δ + dist x 0 ≤ δ + R := by
        simpa only [dist_zero_right, add_le_add_iff_left] using hs x hx
      _ = ρ := by simp [δ, ρ, add_comm]
  have hmeasure :
      (s.card : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal (δ ^ finrank ℝ E) * μ (ball 0 1) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ finrank ℝ E) * μ (ball 0 1) := by
    calc
      (s.card : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal (δ ^ finrank ℝ E) * μ (ball 0 1) =
          μ A := by
        rw [hA, measure_biUnion_finset hdisj fun c _ => measurableSet_ball]
        simp only [μ.addHaar_ball_of_pos _ hδ]
        simp only [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_assoc]
      _ ≤ μ (ball (0 : E) ρ) := measure_mono hsubset
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ finrank ℝ E) * μ (ball 0 1) := by
        simp only [μ.addHaar_ball_of_pos _ hρ]
  have hcancel :
      (s.card : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal (δ ^ finrank ℝ E) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ finrank ℝ E) :=
    (ENNReal.mul_le_mul_iff_left (measure_ball_pos _ _ zero_lt_one).ne'
      measure_ball_lt_top.ne).1 hmeasure
  simpa [δ, ρ] using hcancel

name: RandomSetTheory.finset_card_le_volume_ratio
statement:
theorem finset_card_le_volume_ratio
    (s : Finset E) {R eps : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (heps : 0 < eps)
    (hs : ∀ c ∈ s, ‖c‖ ≤ R)
    (hsep : ∀ c ∈ s, ∀ d ∈ s, c ≠ d → eps ≤ ‖c - d‖) :
    (s.card : ℝ) ≤
      (R + eps / 2) ^ finrank ℝ E / (eps / 2) ^ finrank ℝ E
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hs0 : s = ∅
  · subst s
    simp only [Finset.card_empty, Nat.cast_zero]
    positivity
  have hδpow : 0 < (eps / 2) ^ finrank ℝ E := by positivity
  have hρpow : 0 ≤ (R + eps / 2) ^ finrank ℝ E := by positivity
  have h := (ENNReal.toReal_le_toReal (by finiteness) (by finiteness)).2
    (finset_card_mul_ballVolume_le s heps hs hsep)
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_mul] at h
  simp only [ENNReal.toReal_natCast, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hδpow.le,
    ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hρpow] at h
  exact (le_div_iff₀ hδpow).2 h

name: RandomSetTheory.finset_card_le_one_add_two_div_pow
statement:
theorem finset_card_le_one_add_two_div_pow
    (s : Finset E) {eps : ℝ} (heps : 0 < eps)
    (hs : ∀ c ∈ s, ‖c‖ ≤ 1)
    (hsep : ∀ c ∈ s, ∀ d ∈ s, c ≠ d → eps ≤ ‖c - d‖) :
    (s.card : ℝ) ≤ (1 + 2 / eps) ^ finrank ℝ E
proof:
:= by
  have h := finset_card_le_volume_ratio s (by norm_num) heps hs hsep
  calc
    (s.card : ℝ) ≤
        (1 + eps / 2) ^ finrank ℝ E / (eps / 2) ^ finrank ℝ E := h
    _ = ((1 + eps / 2) / (eps / 2)) ^ finrank ℝ E :=
      (div_pow (1 + eps / 2) (eps / 2) (finrank ℝ E)).symm
    _ = (1 + 2 / eps) ^ finrank ℝ E := by
      congr 1
      field_simp
      ring

name: RandomSetTheory.packingNumber_ne_top_of_isCompact
statement:
theorem packingNumber_ne_top_of_isCompact
    {X : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace X]
    (D : Set X) (hD : IsCompact D) {eps : ℝ≥0} (heps : 0 < eps) :
    Metric.packingNumber eps D ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T, hTD, hTfinite, hcoverOpen⟩ :=
    finite_cover_balls_of_compact hD
      (show 0 < (eps : ℝ) / 2 by positivity)
  classical
  let N : Finset X := hTfinite.toFinset
  have hcover : Metric.IsCover (eps / 2) D (N : Set X) := by
    intro x hx
    have hxcover := hcoverOpen hx
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Metric.mem_ball] at hxcover
    obtain ⟨y, hyT, hxy⟩ := hxcover
    refine ⟨y, by simpa [N] using hyT, ?_⟩
    change edist x y ≤ (eps / 2 : ℝ≥0)
    rw [edist_dist, ← ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal]
    apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
    simpa using hxy.le
  have hext : Metric.externalCoveringNumber (eps / 2) D ≤ (N : Set X).encard :=
    hcover.externalCoveringNumber_le_encard
  have hpack : Metric.packingNumber eps D ≤ (N : Set X).encard := by
    have h :=
      (Metric.packingNumber_two_mul_le_externalCoveringNumber (eps / 2) D).trans hext
    have heq : 2 * (eps / 2) = eps := by field_simp
    rwa [heq] at h
  exact ne_top_of_le_ne_top (by simp) hpack

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_unitBall_finset_net_card_le
statement:
theorem exists_unitBall_finset_net_card_le
    {eps : ℝ} (heps : 0 < eps) :
    ∃ N : Finset E,
      (∀ v ∈ N, ‖v‖ ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ u : E, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 → ∃ v ∈ N, dist u v ≤ eps) ∧
      (N.card : ℝ) ≤ (1 + 2 / eps) ^ finrank ℝ E
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let epsNN : ℝ≥0 := ⟨eps, heps.le⟩
  let D : Set E := closedBall (0 : E) 1
  have hD : IsCompact D := isCompact_closedBall (0 : E) 1
  have htop : Metric.packingNumber epsNN D ≠ ⊤ :=
    packingNumber_ne_top_of_isCompact D hD (by exact_mod_cast heps)
  let C : Set E := Metric.maximalSeparatedSet epsNN D
  have hCfinite : C.Finite := by
    rw [← Set.encard_ne_top_iff]
    simpa only [C, Metric.encard_maximalSeparatedSet htop] using htop
  let N : Finset E := hCfinite.toFinset
  have hNC : (N : Set E) = C := by simp [N]
  have hNmem : ∀ v ∈ N, ‖v‖ ≤ 1 := by
    intro v hv
    have hvN : v ∈ (N : Set E) := by simpa using hv
    have hvC : v ∈ C := hNC ▸ hvN
    have hvD : v ∈ D := Metric.maximalSeparatedSet_subset hvC
    simpa [D, mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hvD
  have hNsep : ∀ c ∈ N, ∀ d ∈ N, c ≠ d → eps ≤ ‖c - d‖ := by
    intro c hc d hd hcd
    have hcN : c ∈ (N : Set E) := by simpa using hc
    have hdN : d ∈ (N : Set E) := by simpa using hd
    have hcC : c ∈ C := hNC ▸ hcN
    have hdC : d ∈ C := hNC ▸ hdN
    have h := Metric.isSeparated_maximalSeparatedSet hcC hdC hcd
    have hreal : eps < dist c d := by
      change (epsNN : ℝ≥0∞) < edist c d at h
      rw [edist_dist, ENNReal.coe_lt_ofReal] at h
      exact h
    rw [dist_eq_norm] at hreal
    exact hreal.le
  have hNcover : ∀ u : E, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 → ∃ v ∈ N, dist u v ≤ eps := by
    intro u hu
    have huD : u ∈ D := by
      simpa [D, mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hu
    obtain ⟨v, hvC, huv⟩ := Metric.isCover_maximalSeparatedSet htop huD
    have hvN : v ∈ (N : Set E) := hNC.symm ▸ hvC
    refine ⟨v, by simpa using hvN, ?_⟩
    change edist u v ≤ (epsNN : ℝ≥0∞) at huv
    rw [edist_dist, ← ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal] at huv
    change ENNReal.ofReal (dist u v) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal eps at huv
    exact (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff heps.le).mp huv
  refine ⟨N, hNmem, hNcover, ?_⟩
  exact finset_card_le_one_add_two_div_pow N heps hNmem hNsep

name: RandomSetTheory.exists_unitBall_finset_net_card_le_three_div
statement:
theorem exists_unitBall_finset_net_card_le_three_div
    {eps : ℝ} (heps : 0 < eps) (heps_one : eps ≤ 1) :
    ∃ N : Finset E,
      (∀ v ∈ N, ‖v‖ ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ u : E, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 → ∃ v ∈ N, dist u v ≤ eps) ∧
      (N.card : ℝ) ≤ (3 / eps) ^ finrank ℝ E
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hNmem, hNcover, hcard⟩ :=
    exists_unitBall_finset_net_card_le (E := E) heps
  refine ⟨N, hNmem, hNcover, hcard.trans ?_⟩
  apply pow_le_pow_left₀
  · positivity
  · apply (le_div_iff₀ heps).2
    calc
      (1 + 2 / eps) * eps = eps + 2 := by field_simp
      _ ≤ 3 := by linarith

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_convexified_iid_risk_bound_dimensional
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_convexified_iid_risk_bound_dimensional
    {Ω Z E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Z]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [Nonempty E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : ℕ → Ω → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hindep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X μ)
    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) μ μ)
    (F : Z → Set E) (hF : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable F)
    (hFcompact : ∀ z, IsCompact (F z)) (hFne : ∀ z, (F z).Nonempty)
    {R : ℝ} (hFbound : ∀ z, ∀ x ∈ F z, ‖x‖ ≤ R)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {eps t : ℝ}
    (heps : 0 < eps) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    μ.real {ω | t + (R + R) * eps <
        hausdorffDist
          (closedConvexHull ℝ
            (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n) (fun i => F (X i ω))))
          (iidAumannTarget μ (X 0) F)} ≤
      (1 + 2 / eps) ^ finrank ℝ E *
        symmetricSupportHoeffdingTail n t (R + R)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hnet, hcard⟩ :=
    exists_unitBall_finset_net_card_le (E := E) heps
  have hprob := hausdorffDist_convexified_iid_risk_bound_of_hoeffding
    (μ := μ) X hX hindep hident F hF hFcompact hFne hFbound
    hn heps.le ht N hN hnet
  exact hprob.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcard (by
    unfold symmetricSupportHoeffdingTail
    positivity))

name: RandomSetTheory.hausdorffDist_convexified_iid_risk_bound_dimensional_standard
statement:
theorem hausdorffDist_convexified_iid_risk_bound_dimensional_standard
    {Ω Z E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Z]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [Nonempty E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : ℕ → Ω → Z) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hindep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X μ)
    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) μ μ)
    (F : Z → Set E) (hF : RandomSet.IsEffrosMeasurable F)
    (hFcompact : ∀ z, IsCompact (F z)) (hFne : ∀ z, (F z).Nonempty)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R)
    (hFbound : ∀ z, ∀ x ∈ F z, ‖x‖ ≤ R)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {eps t : ℝ}
    (heps : 0 < eps) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    μ.real {ω | t + (R + R) * eps <
        hausdorffDist
          (closedConvexHull ℝ
            (minkowskiAverage (Finset.range n) (fun i => F (X i ω))))
          (iidAumannTarget μ (X 0) F)} ≤
      (1 + 2 / eps) ^ finrank ℝ E *
        (2 * exp (-(n : ℝ) * t ^ 2 / (2 * (R + R) ^ 2)))
proof:
:= by
  have hbound := hausdorffDist_convexified_iid_risk_bound_dimensional
    (μ := μ) X hX hindep hident F hF hFcompact hFne hFbound
    hn heps ht
  rw [symmetricSupportHoeffdingTail_eq hn t (by linarith : 0 < R + R)] at hbound
  exact hbound

name: RandomSetTheory.inner_le_supportFunction
statement:
theorem inner_le_supportFunction {K : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K)
    {x : E} (hx : x ∈ K) (u : E) :
    ⟪u, x⟫_ℝ ≤ supportFunction K u
proof:
:= by
  apply le_csSup
  · exact (hK.image (by fun_prop)).bddAbove
  · exact ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.supportFunction_attains
statement:
theorem supportFunction_attains {K : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hKne : K.Nonempty) (u : E) :
    ∃ x ∈ K, supportFunction K u = ⟪u, x⟫_ℝ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxmax⟩ :=
    hK.exists_isMaxOn hKne
      (by fun_prop : ContinuousOn (fun x : E => ⟪u, x⟫_ℝ) K)
  refine ⟨x, hx, le_antisymm ?_ ?_⟩
  · apply csSup_le
    · exact ⟨⟪u, x⟫_ℝ, x, hx, rfl⟩
    · rintro y ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
      exact hxmax hz
  · exact inner_le_supportFunction hK hx u

name: RandomSetTheory.supportFunction_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem supportFunction_singleton (x u : E) :
    supportFunction ({x} : Set E) u = ⟪u, x⟫_ℝ
proof:
:= by
  simp [supportFunction]

name: RandomSetTheory.supportFunction_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem supportFunction_zero {K : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hKne : K.Nonempty) : supportFunction K 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, _hx, hmax⟩ := supportFunction_attains hK hKne 0
  simpa using hmax

name: RandomSetTheory.supportFunction_smul_direction
statement:
theorem supportFunction_smul_direction {K : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hKne : K.Nonempty) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (u : E) :
    supportFunction K (c • u) = c * supportFunction K u
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxmax⟩ := supportFunction_attains hK hKne (c • u)
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hymax⟩ := supportFunction_attains hK hKne u
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [hxmax, real_inner_smul_left]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (inner_le_supportFunction hK hx u) hc
  · rw [hymax, ← real_inner_smul_left]
    exact inner_le_supportFunction hK hy (c • u)

name: RandomSetTheory.supportFunction_add_direction_le
statement:
theorem supportFunction_add_direction_le {K : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hKne : K.Nonempty) (u v : E) :
    supportFunction K (u + v) ≤ supportFunction K u + supportFunction K v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hmax⟩ := supportFunction_attains hK hKne (u + v)
  rw [hmax, inner_add_left]
  exact add_le_add (inner_le_supportFunction hK hx u)
    (inner_le_supportFunction hK hx v)

name: RandomSetTheory.supportFunction_convexOn
statement:
theorem supportFunction_convexOn {K : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hKne : K.Nonempty) :
    ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (supportFunction K)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨convex_univ, ?_⟩
  intro u _hu v _hv a b ha hb hab
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hmax⟩ :=
    supportFunction_attains hK hKne (a • u + b • v)
  rw [hmax, inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_left]
  calc
    a * ⟪u, x⟫_ℝ + b * ⟪v, x⟫_ℝ ≤
        a * supportFunction K u + b * supportFunction K v :=
      add_le_add
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (inner_le_supportFunction hK hx u) ha)
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (inner_le_supportFunction hK hx v) hb)
    _ = a • supportFunction K u + b • supportFunction K v := by
      simp [smul_eq_mul]

name: RandomSetTheory.supportFunction_mono
statement:
theorem supportFunction_mono {K L : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hL : IsCompact L) (hKne : K.Nonempty) (hKL : K ⊆ L) (u : E) :
    supportFunction K u ≤ supportFunction L u
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hmax⟩ := supportFunction_attains hK hKne u
  rw [hmax]
  exact inner_le_supportFunction hL (hKL hx) u

name: RandomSetTheory.supportFunction_closure_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hclosureNe : (closure K).Nonempty := hKne.closure
  have hbounded : BddAbove ((fun x : E ↦ ⟪u, x⟫_ℝ) '' K) := by
    refine ⟨supportFunction (closure K) u, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact inner_le_supportFunction hKcompact (subset_closure hx) u
  apply le_antisymm
  · obtain ⟨x, hx, hmax⟩ :=
      supportFunction_attains hKcompact hclosureNe u
    rw [hmax]
    apply closure_minimal (s := K)
        (t := {y : E | ⟪u, y⟫_ℝ ≤ supportFunction K u}) ?_ ?_ hx
    · intro y hy
      exact le_csSup hbounded ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    · exact isClosed_le (by fun_prop : Continuous fun y : E ↦ ⟪u, y⟫_ℝ)
        continuous_const
  · apply csSup_le
    · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hKne
      exact ⟨⟪u, x⟫_ℝ, x, hx, rfl⟩
    · rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      exact inner_le_supportFunction hKcompact (subset_closure hx) u

name: RandomSetTheory.supportFunction_convexHull
statement:
theorem supportFunction_convexHull {K : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hKne : K.Nonempty) (u : E) :
    supportFunction (convexHull ℝ K) u = supportFunction K u
proof:
:= by
  have hKle : K ⊆ {x : E | ⟪u, x⟫_ℝ ≤ supportFunction K u} :=
    fun _ hx => inner_le_supportFunction hK hx u
  have hhalf : Convex ℝ {x : E | ⟪u, x⟫_ℝ ≤ supportFunction K u} :=
    convex_halfSpace_le (innerSL ℝ u).toLinearMap.isLinear _
  have hhull : convexHull ℝ K ⊆
      {x : E | ⟪u, x⟫_ℝ ≤ supportFunction K u} :=
    convexHull_min hKle hhalf
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply csSup_le
    · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hKne
      exact ⟨⟪u, x⟫_ℝ, x, subset_convexHull ℝ K hx, rfl⟩
    · rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      exact hhull hx
  · obtain ⟨x, hx, hmax⟩ := supportFunction_attains hK hKne u
    rw [hmax]
    apply le_csSup
    · exact ⟨supportFunction K u, by
        rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
        exact hhull hy⟩
    · exact ⟨x, subset_convexHull ℝ K hx, rfl⟩

name: RandomSetTheory.supportFunction_add
statement:
theorem supportFunction_add {K L : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hL : IsCompact L) (hKne : K.Nonempty) (hLne : L.Nonempty) (u : E) :
    supportFunction (K + L) u = supportFunction K u + supportFunction L u
proof:
:= by
  have hKL : IsCompact (K + L) := hK.add hL
  have hKLne : (K + L).Nonempty := hKne.add hLne
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzmax⟩ := supportFunction_attains hKL hKLne u
  obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_add.mp hz
  rw [hzmax, inner_add_right]
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact add_le_add (inner_le_supportFunction hK hx u)
      (inner_le_supportFunction hL hy u)
  · obtain ⟨x', hx', hx'max⟩ := supportFunction_attains hK hKne u
    obtain ⟨y', hy', hy'max⟩ := supportFunction_attains hL hLne u
    calc
      supportFunction K u + supportFunction L u =
          ⟪u, x'⟫_ℝ + ⟪u, y'⟫_ℝ := by rw [hx'max, hy'max]
      _ = ⟪u, x' + y'⟫_ℝ := (inner_add_right u x' y').symm
      _ ≤ supportFunction (K + L) u :=
        inner_le_supportFunction hKL (Set.add_mem_add hx' hy') u
      _ = ⟪u, x⟫_ℝ + ⟪u, y⟫_ℝ := by rw [hzmax, inner_add_right]

name: RandomSetTheory.supportFunction_smul_set
statement:
theorem supportFunction_smul_set {K : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hKne : K.Nonempty) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (u : E) :
    supportFunction (c • K) u = c * supportFunction K u
proof:
:= by
  have hcK : IsCompact (c • K) := hK.smul c
  have hcKne : (c • K).Nonempty := hKne.smul_set
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzmax⟩ := supportFunction_attains hcK hcKne u
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hcx⟩ := Set.mem_smul_set.mp hz
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hymax⟩ := supportFunction_attains hK hKne u
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [hzmax, ← hcx, real_inner_smul_right]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (inner_le_supportFunction hK hx u) hc
  · rw [hymax, ← real_inner_smul_right]
    exact inner_le_supportFunction hcK (Set.smul_mem_smul_set hy) u

name: RandomSetTheory.abs_supportFunction_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_supportFunction_sub_le {K : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hKne : K.Nonempty) {R : ℝ} (hR : ∀ x ∈ K, ‖x‖ ≤ R) (u v : E) :
    |supportFunction K u - supportFunction K v| ≤ R * ‖u - v‖
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxmax⟩ := supportFunction_attains hK hKne u
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hymax⟩ := supportFunction_attains hK hKne v
  rw [abs_sub_le_iff]
  constructor
  · calc
      supportFunction K u - supportFunction K v =
          ⟪u, x⟫_ℝ - supportFunction K v := by rw [hxmax]
      _ ≤ ⟪u, x⟫_ℝ - ⟪v, x⟫_ℝ := by
        gcongr
        exact inner_le_supportFunction hK hx v
      _ = ⟪u - v, x⟫_ℝ := (inner_sub_left _ _ _).symm
      _ ≤ |⟪u - v, x⟫_ℝ| := le_abs_self _
      _ ≤ ‖u - v‖ * ‖x‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
      _ ≤ ‖u - v‖ * R :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hR x hx) (norm_nonneg _)
      _ = R * ‖u - v‖ := mul_comm _ _
  · calc
      supportFunction K v - supportFunction K u =
          ⟪v, y⟫_ℝ - supportFunction K u := by rw [hymax]
      _ ≤ ⟪v, y⟫_ℝ - ⟪u, y⟫_ℝ := by
        gcongr
        exact inner_le_supportFunction hK hy u
      _ = ⟪v - u, y⟫_ℝ := (inner_sub_left _ _ _).symm
      _ ≤ |⟪v - u, y⟫_ℝ| := le_abs_self _
      _ ≤ ‖v - u‖ * ‖y‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
      _ ≤ ‖v - u‖ * R :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hR y hy) (norm_nonneg _)
      _ = R * ‖u - v‖ := by rw [norm_sub_rev, mul_comm]

name: RandomSetTheory.abs_supportFunctionDifference_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_supportFunctionDifference_sub_le {K L : Set E}
    (hK : IsCompact K) (hL : IsCompact L)
    (hKne : K.Nonempty) (hLne : L.Nonempty) {RK RL : ℝ}
    (hRK : ∀ x ∈ K, ‖x‖ ≤ RK) (hRL : ∀ x ∈ L, ‖x‖ ≤ RL)
    (u v : E) :
    |(supportFunction K u - supportFunction L u) -
        (supportFunction K v - supportFunction L v)| ≤
      (RK + RL) * ‖u - v‖
proof:
:= by
  have hKu := abs_supportFunction_sub_le hK hKne hRK u v
  have hLu := abs_supportFunction_sub_le hL hLne hRL u v
  calc
    |(supportFunction K u - supportFunction L u) -
        (supportFunction K v - supportFunction L v)| =
        |(supportFunction K u - supportFunction K v) +
          -(supportFunction L u - supportFunction L v)| := by
            congr 1
            ring
    _ ≤ |supportFunction K u - supportFunction K v| +
        |-(supportFunction L u - supportFunction L v)| := abs_add_le _ _
    _ = |supportFunction K u - supportFunction K v| +
        |supportFunction L u - supportFunction L v| := by rw [abs_neg]
    _ ≤ RK * ‖u - v‖ + RL * ‖u - v‖ := add_le_add hKu hLu
    _ = (RK + RL) * ‖u - v‖ := by ring

name: RandomSetTheory.isCompact_finset_sum
statement:
theorem isCompact_finset_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (K : ι → Set E)
    (hK : ∀ i ∈ s, IsCompact (K i)) : IsCompact (∑ i ∈ s, K i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert a s ha ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_insert ha]
      exact (hK a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)).add <|
        ih fun i hi => hK i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)

name: RandomSetTheory.nonempty_finset_sum
statement:
theorem nonempty_finset_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (K : ι → Set E)
    (hKne : ∀ i ∈ s, (K i).Nonempty) : (∑ i ∈ s, K i).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert a s ha ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_insert ha]
      exact (hKne a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)).add <|
        ih fun i hi => hKne i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)

name: RandomSetTheory.norm_le_sum_radius_of_mem_finset_sum
statement:
theorem norm_le_sum_radius_of_mem_finset_sum
    {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (K : ι → Set E) (R : ι → ℝ)
    (hR : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ x ∈ K i, ‖x‖ ≤ R i)
    {x : E} (hx : x ∈ ∑ i ∈ s, K i) :
    ‖x‖ ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, R i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on generalizing x with
  | empty =>
      simp only [Finset.sum_empty] at hx ⊢
      subst x
      exact norm_zero.le
  | @insert a s ha ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_insert ha] at hx ⊢
      obtain ⟨y, hy, z, hz, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_add.mp hx
      calc
        ‖y + z‖ ≤ ‖y‖ + ‖z‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ R a + ∑ i ∈ s, R i := add_le_add
          (hR a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s) y hy)
          (ih (fun i hi => hR i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)) hz)

name: RandomSetTheory.supportFunction_finset_sum
statement:
theorem supportFunction_finset_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (K : ι → Set E) (hK : ∀ i ∈ s, IsCompact (K i))
    (hKne : ∀ i ∈ s, (K i).Nonempty) (u : E) :
    supportFunction (∑ i ∈ s, K i) u =
      ∑ i ∈ s, supportFunction (K i) u
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
      change supportFunction ({0} : Set E) u = 0
      simp
  | @insert a s ha ih =>
      have hKa : IsCompact (K a) := hK a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)
      have hKane : (K a).Nonempty := hKne a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)
      have hKs : ∀ i ∈ s, IsCompact (K i) :=
        fun i hi => hK i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)
      have hKsne : ∀ i ∈ s, (K i).Nonempty :=
        fun i hi => hKne i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)
      rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, Finset.sum_insert ha]
      rw [supportFunction_add hKa (isCompact_finset_sum s K hKs)
        hKane (nonempty_finset_sum s K hKsne) u]
      rw [ih hKs hKsne]

name: RandomSetTheory.supportFunction_univ_sum
statement:
theorem supportFunction_univ_sum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (K : ι → Set E)
    (hK : ∀ i, IsCompact (K i)) (hKne : ∀ i, (K i).Nonempty) (u : E) :
    supportFunction (∑ i, K i) u = ∑ i, supportFunction (K i) u
proof:
:=
  supportFunction_finset_sum Finset.univ K
    (fun i _ => hK i) (fun i _ => hKne i) u

name: RandomSetTheory.norm_le_average_radius_of_mem_minkowskiAverage
statement:
theorem norm_le_average_radius_of_mem_minkowskiAverage
    {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (K : ι → Set E) (R : ι → ℝ)
    (hR : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ x ∈ K i, ‖x‖ ≤ R i)
    {x : E} (hx : x ∈ minkowskiAverage s K) :
    ‖x‖ ≤ (s.card : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ s, R i
proof:
:= by
  rcases Set.mem_smul_set.mp hx with ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg s.card))]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (norm_le_sum_radius_of_mem_finset_sum s K R hR hy)
    (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg s.card))

name: RandomSetTheory.convexHull_finset_sum
statement:
theorem convexHull_finset_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (K : ι → Set E) :
    convexHull ℝ (∑ i ∈ s, K i) = ∑ i ∈ s, convexHull ℝ (K i)
proof:
:= by
  exact convexHull_sum s K

name: RandomSetTheory.convexHull_minkowskiAverage
statement:
theorem convexHull_minkowskiAverage {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (K : ι → Set E) :
    convexHull ℝ (minkowskiAverage s K) =
      minkowskiAverage s (fun i => convexHull ℝ (K i))
proof:
:= by
  unfold minkowskiAverage
  rw [convexHull_smul, convexHull_sum]

name: RandomSetTheory.isCompact_minkowskiAverage
statement:
theorem isCompact_minkowskiAverage {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (K : ι → Set E) (hK : ∀ i ∈ s, IsCompact (K i)) :
    IsCompact (minkowskiAverage s K)
proof:
:=
  (isCompact_finset_sum s K hK).smul (s.card : ℝ)⁻¹

name: RandomSetTheory.nonempty_minkowskiAverage
statement:
theorem nonempty_minkowskiAverage {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (K : ι → Set E) (hKne : ∀ i ∈ s, (K i).Nonempty) :
    (minkowskiAverage s K).Nonempty
proof:
:=
  (nonempty_finset_sum s K hKne).smul_set

name: RandomSetTheory.convex_minkowskiAverage
statement:
theorem convex_minkowskiAverage {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (K : ι → Set E) (hKconv : ∀ i ∈ s, Convex ℝ (K i)) :
    Convex ℝ (minkowskiAverage s K)
proof:
:=
  (convex_sum K hKconv).smul (s.card : ℝ)⁻¹

name: RandomSetTheory.supportFunction_minkowskiAverage
statement:
theorem supportFunction_minkowskiAverage {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (K : ι → Set E) (hK : ∀ i ∈ s, IsCompact (K i))
    (hKne : ∀ i ∈ s, (K i).Nonempty) (u : E) :
    supportFunction (minkowskiAverage s K) u =
      (s.card : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ s, supportFunction (K i) u
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold minkowskiAverage
  rw [supportFunction_smul_set (isCompact_finset_sum s K hK)
    (nonempty_finset_sum s K hKne) (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg s.card))]
  rw [supportFunction_finset_sum s K hK hKne]

name: ProbabilityTheory.abs_integral_sub_integral_le_add_envelopes
statement:
theorem abs_integral_sub_integral_le_add_envelopes
    {Beta W : Type*} [MeasurableSpace W]
    {kappa : Measure W} [IsProbabilityMeasure kappa]
    (H : Beta → Z → W → ℝ) (A : Z → ℝ)
    (hH : ∀ b z, Integrable (H b z) kappa)
    (hreplace : ∀ b z z' w,
      |H b z w - H b z' w| ≤ A z + A z')
    (b : Beta) (z z' : Z) :
    |∫ w, H b z w ∂kappa - ∫ w, H b z' w ∂kappa| ≤
      A z + A z'
proof:
:= by
  rw [← integral_sub (hH b z) (hH b z')]
  have hbound := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le
    (f := fun w ↦ H b z w - H b z' w)
    (integrable_const (A z + A z'))
    (ae_of_all kappa fun w ↦ by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hreplace b z z' w)
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul]
    using hbound

name: ProbabilityTheory.abs_sub_integral_le_replaceOneCenteredEnvelope
statement:
theorem abs_sub_integral_le_replaceOneCenteredEnvelope
    [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (F A : Z → ℝ) (hFint : Integrable F nu) (hAint : Integrable A nu)
    (hreplace : ∀ z z', |F z - F z'| ≤ A z + A z') (z : Z) :
    |F z - ∫ z', F z' ∂nu| ≤ replaceOneCenteredEnvelope nu A z
proof:
:= by
  have henvInt : Integrable (fun z' ↦ A z + A z') nu :=
    (integrable_const _).add hAint
  have heq : F z - ∫ z', F z' ∂nu =
      ∫ z', (F z - F z') ∂nu := by
    rw [integral_sub (integrable_const _) hFint, integral_const,
      probReal_univ, one_smul]
  have habs : |∫ z', (F z - F z') ∂nu| ≤
      ∫ z', (A z + A z') ∂nu := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      norm_integral_le_of_norm_le (f := fun z' ↦ F z - F z') henvInt
        (ae_of_all nu fun z' ↦ by
          simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hreplace z z')
  have hright : ∫ z', (A z + A z') ∂nu =
      replaceOneCenteredEnvelope nu A z := by
    rw [integral_add (integrable_const _) hAint, integral_const,
      probReal_univ, one_smul]
    rfl
  rw [heq, ← hright]
  exact habs

name: ProbabilityTheory.memLp_centeredGhostFiber_comp
statement:
theorem memLp_centeredGhostFiber_comp
    {Omega Beta : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace Omega] [MeasurableSpace Beta]
    [StandardBorelSpace Z] [Nonempty Z]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (P : Omega → Beta) (Y : Omega → Z)
    (hP : Measurable P) (hY : Measurable Y)
    (G : Beta → Z → ℝ) (A : Z → ℝ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hG : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry G))
    (hAq : MemLp A q (mu.map Y)) (hA : ∀ z, 0 ≤ A z)
    (hreplace : ∀ b z z', |G b z - G b z'| ≤ A z + A z') :
    MemLp (fun omega ↦
      G (P omega) (Y omega) - ∫ z, G (P omega) z ∂(mu.map Y)) q mu
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (mu.map Y) :=
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hY.aemeasurable
  have hqone : (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ (q : ℝ≥0∞) := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hAint : Integrable A (mu.map Y) :=
    (hAq.mono_exponent hqone).integrable (by norm_num)
  have hmean : StronglyMeasurable
      (fun b ↦ ∫ z, G b z ∂(mu.map Y)) :=
    hG.integral_prod_right
  have hcentered : StronglyMeasurable (fun bz : Beta × Z ↦
      G bz.1 bz.2 - ∫ z, G bz.1 z ∂(mu.map Y)) :=
    hG.sub (hmean.comp_measurable measurable_fst)
  have henv : MemLp (replaceOneCenteredEnvelope (mu.map Y) A) q
      (mu.map Y) := by
    unfold replaceOneCenteredEnvelope
    exact hAq.add (memLp_const (∫ z, A z ∂(mu.map Y)))
  have henvComp : MemLp
      (replaceOneCenteredEnvelope (mu.map Y) A ∘ Y) q mu :=
    henv.comp_of_map hY.aemeasurable
  apply henvComp.mono'
    (hcentered.comp_measurable (hP.prodMk hY)).aestronglyMeasurable
  filter_upwards [] with omega
  have hGb : StronglyMeasurable (G (P omega)) :=
    hG.comp_measurable (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id)
  have hGq : MemLp (G (P omega)) q (mu.map Y) :=
    memLp_fiber_of_abs_sub_le_add_envelopes
      (G (P omega)) A q hGb hAq hA (hreplace (P omega))
  have hGint : Integrable (G (P omega)) (mu.map Y) :=
    (hGq.mono_exponent hqone).integrable (by norm_num)
  simpa only [Function.comp_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
    abs_sub_integral_le_replaceOneCenteredEnvelope
      (G (P omega)) A hGint hAint (hreplace (P omega)) (Y omega)

name: ProbabilityTheory.condExp_sq_centeredGhostFiber_le_replaceOneCenteredMoment
statement:
theorem condExp_sq_centeredGhostFiber_le_replaceOneCenteredMoment
    {Omega Beta : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace Omega] [MeasurableSpace Beta]
    [StandardBorelSpace Z] [Nonempty Z]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (P : Omega → Beta) (Y : Omega → Z)
    (hPY : IndepFun P Y mu) (hP : Measurable P) (hY : Measurable Y)
    (G : Beta → Z → ℝ) (A : Z → ℝ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 2 ≤ q)
    (hG : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry G))
    (hAq : MemLp A q (mu.map Y)) (hA : ∀ z, 0 ≤ A z)
    (hreplace : ∀ b z z', |G b z - G b z'| ≤ A z + A z') :
    ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      mu[fun omega' ↦
          (G (P omega') (Y omega') -
            ∫ z, G (P omega') z ∂(mu.map Y)) ^ 2 |
          MeasurableSpace.comap P inferInstance] omega ≤
        replaceOneCenteredMoment (mu.map Y) A 2
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (mu.map Y) :=
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hY.aemeasurable
  have hqone : (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ (q : ℝ≥0∞) := by
    exact_mod_cast (le_trans (by omega : 1 ≤ 2) hq)
  have hqtwo : (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ (q : ℝ≥0∞) := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hAint : Integrable A (mu.map Y) :=
    (hAq.mono_exponent hqone).integrable (by norm_num)
  have hmean : StronglyMeasurable
      (fun b ↦ ∫ z, G b z ∂(mu.map Y)) :=
    hG.integral_prod_right
  have hcentered : StronglyMeasurable (fun bz : Beta × Z ↦
      G bz.1 bz.2 - ∫ z, G bz.1 z ∂(mu.map Y)) :=
    hG.sub (hmean.comp_measurable measurable_fst)
  have hR2 := (memLp_centeredGhostFiber_comp
    P Y hP hY G A q (by omega) hG hAq hA hreplace).mono_exponent hqtwo
  have hbase := hPY.condExp_prod_ae_eq_integral_map hP hY
    (fun bz : Beta × Z ↦
      (G bz.1 bz.2 - ∫ z, G bz.1 z ∂(mu.map Y)) ^ 2)
    (hcentered.pow 2) hR2.integrable_sq
  filter_upwards [hbase] with omega hbaseOmega
  rw [hbaseOmega]
  have hGb : StronglyMeasurable (G (P omega)) :=
    hG.comp_measurable (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id)
  have hGq : MemLp (G (P omega)) q (mu.map Y) :=
    memLp_fiber_of_abs_sub_le_add_envelopes
      (G (P omega)) A q hGb hAq hA (hreplace (P omega))
  have hG2 : MemLp (G (P omega)) 2 (mu.map Y) :=
    hGq.mono_exponent hqtwo
  have hGint : Integrable (G (P omega)) (mu.map Y) :=
    (hGq.mono_exponent hqone).integrable (by norm_num)
  have hleft : Integrable (fun z ↦
      (G (P omega) z - ∫ z', G (P omega) z' ∂(mu.map Y)) ^ 2)
      (mu.map Y) :=
    (hG2.sub (memLp_const _)).integrable_sq
  have hright := integrable_pow_replaceOneCenteredEnvelope
    (nu := mu.map Y) A q 2 hq hAq hA
  unfold replaceOneCenteredMoment
  apply integral_mono hleft hright
  intro z
  have habs := abs_sub_integral_le_replaceOneCenteredEnvelope
    (G (P omega)) A hGint hAint (hreplace (P omega)) z
  have hpow := pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) habs 2
  simpa only [sq_abs] using hpow

name: ProbabilityTheory.condExp_sq_doobCenteredDifference_succ_le_of_centeredGhostFiber
statement:
theorem condExp_sq_doobCenteredDifference_succ_le_of_centeredGhostFiber
    {Omega Beta : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace Omega] [MeasurableSpace Beta]
    [StandardBorelSpace Z] [Nonempty Z]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (filtration : Filtration ℕ inferInstance)
    (F : Omega → ℝ) (i : ℕ)
    (P : Omega → Beta) (Y : Omega → Z)
    (hPY : IndepFun P Y mu) (hP : Measurable P) (hY : Measurable Y)
    (hfiltration : filtration i = MeasurableSpace.comap P inferInstance)
    (G : Beta → Z → ℝ) (A : Z → ℝ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 2 ≤ q)
    (hG : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry G))
    (hAq : MemLp A q (mu.map Y)) (hA : ∀ z, 0 ≤ A z)
    (hreplace : ∀ b z z', |G b z - G b z'| ≤ A z + A z')
    (hrepresentation :
      doobCenteredDifference filtration mu F (i + 1) =ᵐ[mu]
        fun omega ↦ G (P omega) (Y omega) -
          ∫ z, G (P omega) z ∂(mu.map Y)) :
    ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      mu[fun omega' ↦
          doobCenteredDifference filtration mu F (i + 1) omega' ^ 2 |
        filtration i] omega ≤
          replaceOneCenteredMoment (mu.map Y) A 2
proof:
:= by
  let R : Omega → ℝ := fun omega ↦
    G (P omega) (Y omega) - ∫ z, G (P omega) z ∂(mu.map Y)
  have hsquare :
      (fun omega ↦
        doobCenteredDifference filtration mu F (i + 1) omega ^ 2)
        =ᵐ[mu] fun omega ↦ R omega ^ 2 := by
    filter_upwards [hrepresentation] with omega homega
    rw [homega]
  have hcondCongr := condExp_congr_ae (m := filtration i) hsquare
  have hghost := condExp_sq_centeredGhostFiber_le_replaceOneCenteredMoment
    P Y hPY hP hY G A q hq hG hAq hA hreplace
  rw [hfiltration] at hcondCongr ⊢
  filter_upwards [hcondCongr, hghost] with omega hcongrOmega hghostOmega
  exact hcongrOmega.trans_le hghostOmega

name: ProbabilityTheory.doobCenteredDifference_succ_ae_eq_centeredGhostFiber_of_condExp_next
statement:
theorem doobCenteredDifference_succ_ae_eq_centeredGhostFiber_of_condExp_next
    {Omega Beta : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace Omega] [MeasurableSpace Beta]
    [StandardBorelSpace Z] [Nonempty Z]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (filtration : Filtration ℕ inferInstance)
    (F : Omega → ℝ) (i : ℕ)
    (P : Omega → Beta) (Y : Omega → Z)
    (hPY : IndepFun P Y mu) (hP : Measurable P) (hY : Measurable Y)
    (hfiltration : filtration i = MeasurableSpace.comap P inferInstance)
    (G : Beta → Z → ℝ)
    (hG : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry G))
    (hnext : mu[F | filtration (i + 1)] =ᵐ[mu]
      fun omega ↦ G (P omega) (Y omega)) :
    doobCenteredDifference filtration mu F (i + 1) =ᵐ[mu]
      fun omega ↦ G (P omega) (Y omega) -
        ∫ z, G (P omega) z ∂(mu.map Y)
proof:
:= by
  let H : Omega → ℝ := fun omega ↦ G (P omega) (Y omega)
  have hHint : Integrable H mu := by
    exact integrable_condExp.congr hnext
  have hcondCongr :
      mu[mu[F | filtration (i + 1)] | filtration i] =ᵐ[mu]
        mu[H | filtration i] :=
    condExp_congr_ae (m := filtration i) hnext
  have htower :
      mu[mu[F | filtration (i + 1)] | filtration i] =ᵐ[mu]
        mu[F | filtration i] :=
    condExp_condExp_of_le (filtration.mono (Nat.le_succ i))
      (filtration.le (i + 1))
  have hghostRaw := hPY.condExp_prod_ae_eq_integral_map hP hY
    (Function.uncurry G) hG
      (by simpa only [Function.uncurry_apply_pair, H] using hHint)
  have hghost : mu[H | MeasurableSpace.comap P inferInstance] =ᵐ[mu]
      fun omega ↦ ∫ z, G (P omega) z ∂(mu.map Y) := by
    simpa only [H, Function.uncurry_apply_pair] using hghostRaw
  rw [← hfiltration] at hghost
  have hpast : mu[F | filtration i] =ᵐ[mu]
      fun omega ↦ ∫ z, G (P omega) z ∂(mu.map Y) :=
    htower.symm.trans (hcondCongr.trans hghost)
  filter_upwards [hnext, hpast] with omega hnextOmega hpastOmega
  change mu[F | filtration (i + 1)] omega -
      mu[F | filtration i] omega = _
  rw [hnextOmega, hpastOmega]

name: ProbabilityTheory.doobCenteredDifference_zero_ae_eq_zero_of_filtration_zero_eq_bot
statement:
theorem doobCenteredDifference_zero_ae_eq_zero_of_filtration_zero_eq_bot
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (filtration : Filtration ℕ mOmega) (F : Omega → ℝ)
    (hzero : filtration 0 = ⊥) :
    doobCenteredDifference filtration mu F 0 =ᵐ[mu] 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [show doobCenteredDifference filtration mu F 0 =
      fun omega ↦ mu[F | filtration 0] omega - ∫ z, F z ∂mu by
        rfl, hzero, condExp_bot]
  exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun omega ↦ by simp

name: ProbabilityTheory.conditionalValueAtRisk_finiteSupremum_le_rio_of_centeredGhostFibers
statement:
theorem conditionalValueAtRisk_finiteSupremum_le_rio_of_centeredGhostFibers
    (filtration : Filtration ℕ mOmega)
    [StandardBorelSpace Omega] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    [SigmaFiniteFiltration mu filtration]
    [StandardBorelSpace Z] [Nonempty Z] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (s : Finset T) (hs : s.Nonempty) (X : T → Omega → ℝ)
    (B : Omega → ℝ) (hB : Integrable B mu)
    (hX : ∀ u ∈ s, Measurable (X u))
    (hdom : ∀ omega u, u ∈ s → |X u omega| ≤ |B omega|)
    (P : ℕ → Omega → Beta) (Y : ℕ → Omega → Z)
    (G : ℕ → Beta → Z → ℝ) (Acoord : ℕ → Z → ℝ)
    (n q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    {V Q y alpha : ℝ} (hV : 0 < V) (hQ : 0 < Q) (hy : 0 < y)
    (hterminal : mu[finiteProcessSupremum s hs X | filtration n]
      =ᵐ[mu] finiteProcessSupremum s hs X)
    (hzero : doobCenteredDifference filtration mu
      (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X) 0 =ᵐ[mu] 0)
    (hPY : ∀ i < n, IndepFun (P i) (Y i) mu)
    (hP : ∀ i < n, Measurable (P i))
    (hY : ∀ i < n, Measurable (Y i))
    (hYlaw : ∀ i < n, mu.map (Y i) = nu)
    (hfiltration : ∀ i < n,
      filtration i = MeasurableSpace.comap (P i) inferInstance)
    (hG : ∀ i < n, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (G i)))
    (hAq : ∀ j < n + 1, MemLp (Acoord j) q nu)
    (hA : ∀ j < n + 1, ∀ z, 0 ≤ Acoord j z)
    (hreplace : ∀ i < n, ∀ b z z',
      |G i b z - G i b z'| ≤ Acoord (i + 1) z + Acoord (i + 1) z')
    (hrepresentation : ∀ i < n,
      doobCenteredDifference filtration mu
          (finiteProcessSupremum s hs X) (i + 1) =ᵐ[mu]
        fun omega ↦ G i (P i omega) (Y i omega) -
          ∫ z, G i (P i omega) z ∂(mu.map (Y i)))
    (hsecond :
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        replaceOneCenteredMoment nu (Acoord j) 2) ≤ V)
    (hmomentQ :
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        replaceOneCenteredMoment nu (Acoord j) q) ≤ Q)
    (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha < 1)
    (hscale : Q * Real.exp (-Real.log alpha) ≤ y ^ q) :
    conditionalValueAtRisk alpha
        (fun omega ↦ finiteProcessSupremum s hs X omega -
          ∫ z, finiteProcessSupremum s hs X z ∂mu) mu ≤
      Real.sqrt (2 * V * (-Real.log alpha)) +
        (1 + 1 / (q : ℝ)) * y +
          Real.exp 1 * strongMomentQScale q Q * (-Real.log alpha) / 3 +
        alpha⁻¹ * (Q / ((q : ℝ) * y ^ (q - 1)))
proof:
:= by
  let F : Omega → ℝ := finiteProcessSupremum s hs X
  let D : ℕ → Omega → ℝ :=
    doobCenteredDifference filtration mu F
  let R : ℕ → Omega → ℝ := fun i omega ↦
    G i (P i omega) (Y i omega) -
      ∫ z, G i (P i omega) z ∂(mu.map (Y i))
  have hzero' : D 0 =ᵐ[mu] 0 := by
    simpa only [D, F] using hzero
  have hrepresentation' : ∀ i < n, D (i + 1) =ᵐ[mu] R i := by
    intro i hi
    simpa only [D, F, R] using hrepresentation i hi
  have hRmem : ∀ i < n, MemLp (R i) q mu := by
    intro i hi
    have hAqMap : MemLp (Acoord (i + 1)) q (mu.map (Y i)) := by
      rw [hYlaw i hi]
      exact hAq (i + 1) (by omega)
    simpa only [R] using memLp_centeredGhostFiber_comp
      (P i) (Y i) (hP i hi) (hY i hi) (G i) (Acoord (i + 1))
        q (by omega) (hG i hi) hAqMap (hA (i + 1) (by omega))
        (hreplace i hi)
  have hDsq : ∀ j < n + 1,
      Integrable (fun omega ↦ D j omega ^ 2) mu := by
    intro j hj
    cases j with
    | zero =>
        have heq : (fun omega ↦ D 0 omega ^ 2) =ᵐ[mu]
            (fun _ ↦ (0 : ℝ)) := by
          filter_upwards [hzero'] with omega homega
          rw [homega]
          norm_num
        exact (integrable_zero Omega ℝ mu).congr heq.symm
    | succ i =>
        have hi : i < n := by omega
        have hqtwo : (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ (q : ℝ≥0∞) := by
          exact_mod_cast (by omega : 2 ≤ q)
        have hR2 : MemLp (R i) 2 mu :=
          (hRmem i hi).mono_exponent hqtwo
        have hRint : Integrable (fun omega ↦ R i omega ^ 2) mu := by
          simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] using
            hR2.integrable_norm_pow (by norm_num : 2 ≠ 0)
        have heq : (fun omega ↦ D (i + 1) omega ^ 2) =ᵐ[mu]
            fun omega ↦ R i omega ^ 2 := by
          filter_upwards [hrepresentation' i hi] with omega homega
          rw [homega]
        exact hRint.congr heq.symm
  have hpow : ∀ j < n + 1, ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      Integrable (fun omega ↦ (max (D j omega) 0) ^ k) mu := by
    intro j hj k hk
    have hkIcc := Finset.mem_Icc.mp hk
    have hkpos : k ≠ 0 := by omega
    cases j with
    | zero =>
        have heq : (fun omega ↦ (max (D 0 omega) 0) ^ k) =ᵐ[mu]
            (fun _ ↦ (0 : ℝ)) := by
          filter_upwards [hzero'] with omega homega
          simp [homega, hkpos]
        exact (integrable_zero Omega ℝ mu).congr heq.symm
    | succ i =>
        have hi : i < n := by omega
        have hkq : (k : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ (q : ℝ≥0∞) := by
          exact_mod_cast (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hk).2
        have hRk : MemLp (R i) k mu :=
          (hRmem i hi).mono_exponent hkq
        have hRint : Integrable (fun omega ↦ (max (R i omega) 0) ^ k) mu := by
          simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs,
            abs_of_nonneg (le_max_right (R i _) 0)] using
              hRk.pos_part.integrable_norm_pow hkpos
        have heq : (fun omega ↦ (max (D (i + 1) omega) 0) ^ k)
            =ᵐ[mu] fun omega ↦ (max (R i omega) 0) ^ k := by
          filter_upwards [hrepresentation' i hi] with omega homega
          rw [homega]
        exact hRint.congr heq.symm
  have hsecond0 : (∫ omega, D 0 omega ^ 2 ∂mu) ≤
      replaceOneCenteredMoment nu (Acoord 0) 2 := by
    have heq : (fun omega ↦ D 0 omega ^ 2) =ᵐ[mu]
        (fun _ ↦ (0 : ℝ)) := by
      filter_upwards [hzero'] with omega homega
      rw [homega]
      norm_num
    rw [integral_congr_ae heq, integral_zero]
    unfold replaceOneCenteredMoment
    exact integral_nonneg fun z ↦ pow_nonneg
      (replaceOneCenteredEnvelope_nonneg
        (Acoord 0) (hA 0 (by omega)) z) 2
  have hsecondSucc : ∀ i < n,
      mu[fun omega ↦ D (i + 1) omega ^ 2 | filtration i] ≤ᵐ[mu]
        fun _ ↦ replaceOneCenteredMoment nu (Acoord (i + 1)) 2 := by
    intro i hi
    have hAqMap : MemLp (Acoord (i + 1)) q (mu.map (Y i)) := by
      rw [hYlaw i hi]
      exact hAq (i + 1) (by omega)
    have hghost :=
      condExp_sq_doobCenteredDifference_succ_le_of_centeredGhostFiber
        filtration F i (P i) (Y i) (hPY i hi) (hP i hi) (hY i hi)
          (hfiltration i hi) (G i) (Acoord (i + 1)) q (by omega)
          (hG i hi) hAqMap (hA (i + 1) (by omega))
          (hreplace i hi) (hrepresentation' i hi)
    rw [hYlaw i hi] at hghost
    exact hghost
  have hmoment0 : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      (∫ omega, (max (D 0 omega) 0) ^ k ∂mu) ≤
        replaceOneCenteredMoment nu (Acoord 0) k := by
    intro k hk
    have hkIcc := Finset.mem_Icc.mp hk
    have hkpos : k ≠ 0 := by omega
    have heq : (fun omega ↦ (max (D 0 omega) 0) ^ k) =ᵐ[mu]
        (fun _ ↦ (0 : ℝ)) := by
      filter_upwards [hzero'] with omega homega
      simp [homega, hkpos]
    rw [integral_congr_ae heq, integral_zero]
    unfold replaceOneCenteredMoment
    exact integral_nonneg fun z ↦ pow_nonneg
      (replaceOneCenteredEnvelope_nonneg
        (Acoord 0) (hA 0 (by omega)) z) k
  have hmomentSucc : ∀ i < n, ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 q,
      mu[fun omega ↦ (max (D (i + 1) omega) 0) ^ k | filtration i]
        ≤ᵐ[mu] fun _ ↦
          replaceOneCenteredMoment nu (Acoord (i + 1)) k := by
    intro i hi k hk
    have hAqMap : MemLp (Acoord (i + 1)) q (mu.map (Y i)) := by
      rw [hYlaw i hi]
      exact hAq (i + 1) (by omega)
    have hghost :=
      condExp_pow_max_doobCenteredDifference_succ_le_of_centeredGhostFiber
        filtration F i (P i) (Y i) (hPY i hi) (hP i hi) (hY i hi)
          (hfiltration i hi) (G i) (Acoord (i + 1)) q k
          (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hk).1 (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hk).2
          (hG i hi) hAqMap (hA (i + 1) (by omega))
          (hreplace i hi) (hrepresentation' i hi)
    rw [hYlaw i hi] at hghost
    exact hghost
  have hmiddle : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Ico 3 q,
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        replaceOneCenteredMoment nu (Acoord j) k) ≤
          interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient q V Q k := by
    intro k hk
    have hkIco := Finset.mem_Ico.mp hk
    exact sum_replaceOneCenteredMoment_le_interpolatedStrongMomentCoefficient
      (nu := nu) (Finset.range (n + 1)) Acoord q k hq (by omega)
        (by omega) (fun j hj ↦ hAq j (Finset.mem_range.mp hj))
        (fun j hj ↦ hA j (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)) hV.le hQ.le
        hsecond hmomentQ
  apply conditionalValueAtRisk_finiteProcessSupremum_sub_integral_le_rioStrongMoment
    filtration s hs X B hB hX hdom
      (fun j ↦ replaceOneCenteredMoment nu (Acoord j) 2)
      (fun j k ↦ replaceOneCenteredMoment nu (Acoord j) k)
      n q hq hV hQ hy hterminal
  · simpa only [D, F] using hDsq
  · simpa only [D, F] using hpow
  · simpa only [D, F] using hsecond0
  · simpa only [D, F] using hsecondSucc
  · simpa only [D, F] using hmoment0
  · simpa only [D, F] using hmomentSucc
  · exact hsecond
  · exact hmiddle
  · exact hmomentQ
  · exact halpha0
  · exact halpha1
  · exact hscale
